28Yisaka bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 29Yisaka abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburannu ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nna.
30Sebulɔn bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 31Sebulɔn abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburannu ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nna.
32Yosef bosofoɛ ne, Efraim sasofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 33Efraim abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburanna ne ɛyaa nnu. 34Manase sasofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 35Manase abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburasa ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nyɔ.
36Benyamin bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 37Benyamin abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburasa ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nna.
38Dan bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 39Dan abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburasia ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nzoo.
40Asɛ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 41Asɛ abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburanna ne ko ɔne ɛyaa nnu.
42Nafetali bosofoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ngoko ngoko, kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, ɔne mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 43Nafetali abusua kure nu ama bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee aburannu ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nna.
44Sɔ mmenia ne yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn, bɛmane Yisrael mbanyi buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɔ ebiala gyi ye abusua kure gya nu ne, bɛbokale bɛ maa bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa ɔ. 45Yiti Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ebiala bɔ ɔkora kɔ koɛ ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 46bɛ mu bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nzia ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nnu ne aburannu. 47 Bɛhale mmusua kure ngaa nemɔ, nakoso Lewifoɛ mɔ de, banga bɛ.
48Né AWURADE aha ahyire Mose kyɛ, 49“Lewi abusua kure ne angome yeɛ nnɛka bɛ ɔ; nnɛka bɛ fra Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne aso. 50 Na mmom, adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne, nu nningyein amukoraa, ɔne ye nwo nikyee biala, odi kyɛ ɛye Lewifoɛ maa bɛnea so. Odi kyɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua ne, ɔne nu nningyein amukoraa, ná bɛ́nea so, ná bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ bɛ́pɛ ye nwo bɛbra beyia. 51Sɛ mmerɛ dwu kyɛ ɛmɔtutu nyianu sua ne bɛkɔ a, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ yeɛ betutu ɔ. Na odwu ye silɛ so a, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ besa bɛnea bɛhyehyɛ. Na sɛ ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ opingye ɛtena sua ne a, odi kyɛ beku ye. 52Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ de, odi kyɛ ebiala si ye asikyeleɛ wɔ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure nemɔ anu; 53nakoso Lewifoɛ mɔ de, odi kyɛ besi b’asikyeleɛ maa ɔbra adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne anwo yia, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE yaafɛlɛ piri ne wamma Yisraelfoɛ so. Odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne anwo waen.” 54Yisraelfoɛ yɔle sɔ ala; bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

Title: NUMERI 2
Content:
Mmusua kure nemɔ atenaleɛ
1AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 2“Odi kyɛ Yisraelniɛ biala ɔkyekye ye asikyeleɛ wɔ ye koɛhonɛfoɛ kure nu. Ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛboa bɛ noa wɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ frangaa nwo; odi kyɛ bɛma b’asikyeleɛ nemɔ pɛ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anwo bra yia, ná ebiala ma ye deɛ nye kyire ɛtena sua ne. 3Yuda bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure ne yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ kure kure wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɔ. Aminadabo awa Nason yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Yuda boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ. 4Na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasoo ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nzia. 5Yisaka abusua kure ne yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ deɛ bɛtoa Yuda so ɔ. Suare awa Netanɛl yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Yisaka boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 6na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nna. 7Afei Sebulɔn abusua kure ne yeɛ bɛtoa so ɔ: Helon awa Eliabo yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Sebulɔn boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 8na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nna. 9Yuda asikyeleɛ nu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ kure kure ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa ko aburawɔtwɛ ne nzia ɔne ɛyaa nna. Bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bedi moa betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu ɔ.
10“Ruben yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔkyekye ye asikyeleɛ deɛ kure kure wɔ ngwaen dɔ ɔ. Sedɛre awa Elisure yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Ruben boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 11na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nzia ɔne ɛyaa nnu. 12Na Simeon abusua kure ne yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ deɛ bɛtoa Ruben so ɔ. Surisadai awa Selumiɛl yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Simeon boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 13na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne ngona ɔne ɛyaa nza. 14Na afei Gade abusua kure ne yeɛ ɔtoa so ɔ. Rewel awa Eliasafe yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Gade boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 15na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nzia ne aburannu. 16Ruben asikyeleɛ nu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ kure kure ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa ko aburannu ne ko ɔne ɛyaa nna ne aburannu. Sɛ betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛtɔ so nyɔ ɔ.
17“Odi kyɛ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne, ɔne Lewifoɛ asikyeleɛ nemɔ, bɛba asikyeleɛ ngaa nemɔ afia. Kyɛbɔ besi bɛhyehyɛle asikyeleɛ nemɔ ne, odi kyɛ abusua kure biala di ye nekaa.
18“Efraim yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔkyekye ye asikyeleɛ deɛ kure kure wɔ eyia atɔleɛ ɔ. Amihude awa Elisama yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Efraim boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 19na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ɔne ɛyaa nnu. 20Manase abusua kure ne yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔtoa Efraim so ɔ. Pedasure awa Gamaliɛl yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Manase boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 21na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nyɔ. 22Afei Benyamin abusua kure ne yeɛ ɔtoa so ɔ. Gideoni awa Abidan yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Benyamin boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 23na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nna. 24Efraim asikyeleɛ nu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ kure kure ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa ko ne mmɔtwɛ ɔne ɛyaa ko. Sɛ betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛtɔ so nza ɔ.
25“Dan yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔkyekye ye asikyeleɛ deɛ kure kure wɔ sorɔ dɔ ɔ. Amisadae awa Ahiesa yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Dan boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 26na ye lɔen bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasia ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nzoo. 27Asɛ abusua kure ne yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ deɛ bɛtoa Dan so ɔ; Okran awa Pagyiɛl yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Asɛ boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 28na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne ko ɔne ɛyaa nnu. 29Afei Nafetali abusua kure ne yeɛ ɔtoa so ɔ; Enan awa Ahira yeɛ odi kyɛ otua Nafetali boso ama nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ, 30na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nna. 31Dan asikyeleɛ nu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa ko aburannu ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nzia. Sɛ betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, bɛ yeɛ bekotu bɛ bo kure kure bekoli nziɛ ɔ.”
32Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ bɛ sasofoɛ te ɔ. Asikyeleɛ ahoroɔ nemɔ anu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ kure kure ne amukoraa, bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nzia ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nnu ne aburannu. 33Nakoso kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen, Lewifoɛ mɔ de, banga bɛ bammoka Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ aso.
34Na Yisraelfoɛ yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala. Bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ kure kure; na sɔ ala koso yeɛ besili nu ɔ. Ebiala li ye abusua nu, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.

Title: NUMERI 3
Content:
Aarɔn mma mmienzua mɔ
1Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE ne Mose dwudwole wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso ne, né Aarɔn ne Mose bɛ sasofoɛ mɔ ɛhe: 2 Aarɔn mma mmienzua bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Nadabo bɔ ɔte bamuɛbaa, Abihu, Eleasa ɔne Yitama. 3Aarɔn mma mmienzua mɔ bɔ bapopa bɛ ngoo bɔ Aarɔn hyɛle bɛ sɔfo ne, bɛ dumaa ɛne. 4Nakoso Nadabo ne Abihu de, bewuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso, ofikyɛ né bɛmvata kyɛ bɛfa see bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, nakoso bɛyɔle sɔ. Né belle ba. Na Eleasa ne Yitama yeɛ belili sɔfo mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ baba Aarɔn te ase ɔ.
Lewifoɛ adwuma
5 Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 6“Ma Lewi abusua kure ne bɛbra, ná maa bɛɛyɛ Aarɔn somvoɛ bɛboka ye wɔ ɔsɔfo adwumayɔlɛ ne anu. 7Odi kyɛ bɛso wɔ nyianu sua ne anu, ná bɛyɔ adwuma bɛma Aarɔn ne maen ne amukoraa wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu berɛ. 8Odi kyɛ bɛnea ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu nningyein amukoraa so, ná begyina Yisraelfoɛ gya nu bɛyɔ nyianu sua ne anu adwuma bɛma bɛ. 9Ma Lewifoɛ mɔ bewura Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bo; maye bɛ mafi Yisraelfoɛ nu bɔkɔɔ mafa bɛ mama Aarɔn. 10Tu Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ sie berɛ, na bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔfo adwuma ne ɔ. Sɛ ebie mbaen kɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma ne anwo a, odi kyɛ beku ye.”
11 Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 12“Nea, maye Lewifoɛ ne mafi Yisraelfoɛ nu, na mafa bɛ masi Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ amukoraa bɛ gya nu. Lewifoɛ mɔ kɔyɛ me deɛ, 13ofikyɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraa te me deɛ. Mmerɛ bɔ ngukuni Misraim aseɛ so bamuɛbaa amukoraa ne, nduli Yisrael bamuɛbaa amukoraa nziele berɛ mane me nwo, kyɛ mmenia deɛ oo, kyɛ ngaka deɛ oo; bɛte me deɛ. Me ole AWURADE.”
14Na AWURADE sele Mose wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ, 15 “Ka Lewifoɛ mɔ. Nea bɛ nana mɔ saso ɔne mmusua mmusua ná fa ka bɛ. Bienzua biala bɔ wali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, ka ye bie.” 16Yiti Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so hale bɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne. 17 Lewi mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Gɛsɔn, Kohate ne Merari. 18Gɛsɔn mma mmienzua mɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ mmusua mmusua a, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Libini ne Simei. 19Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ mmusua mmusua a, bɛ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl. 20Merari mma mmienzua mɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ mmusua mmusua a, bɛ ole Maheli ne Musi. Lewifoɛ mmusua nemɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ nana mɔ saso a, bɛ ɛne.
21Gɛsɔn boso ama deɛ ole Libini abusua ne Simei abusua; Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua nemɔ ɛne. 22Bɛ nu mmienzua amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee nzoo ɛyaa nnu. 23Odi kyɛ Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua nemɔ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne asi wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, 24na Layel awa bienzua Eliasafe yeɛ né ɔla Gɛsɔnfoɛ b’abusua ne noa ɔ. 25Gɛsɔn boso ama nemɔ, b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ole kyɛ, bɛ́nea ɛhemɔ amukoraa so: nyianu sua ne, pumbu ne ɔne ye ngatasoɛ, ɛtena bɔ onwi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne, 26aluo berɛ mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ; aluo berɛ bɔ wapɛ nyianu sua ne ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wayia ne, ye nyunu berɛ ɛtena bɔ onwi berɛ ne, ɔne ye nyamaa nemɔ, ɔne bɛ nwo adwuma amukoraa.
27Kohate boso ama deɛ ole Amramfoɛ abusua, Yisarefoɛ abusua, Hebronfoɛ abusua ɔne Yusiɛlfoɛ abusua; Kohatefoɛ mmusua nemɔ ɛne. 28Bɛ nu mmienzua amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee mmɔtwɛ ɛyaa nzia. Kohatefoɛ yeɛ né bɛyɔ nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ɔ. 29Odi kyɛ Kohatefoɛ mmusua nemɔ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne ngwaen, 30na Yusiɛl awa bienzua Elisafan yeɛ né ɔla Kohatefoɛ b’abusua ne noa ɔ. 31B’adwuma ole kyɛ bɛkɔnea ɛhemɔ aso: apam alaka ne, ɛpoen ne, kanea bakaa ne, afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ, nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein bɔ asɔfo nemɔ fa yɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, ɔne mbɛmuɛ ɛtena ne, ɔne sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo adwuma amukoraa. 32Né ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa yeɛ ɔla Lewifoɛ mbanyi nemɔ noa, na ye yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ne aso ɔ.
33Merari boso ama deɛ ole Mahelifoɛ abusua ɔne Musifoɛ abusua; bɛ yeɛ bɛte Merarifoɛ mmusua ɔ. 34Bɛ nu mmienzua amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee nzia ɛyaa nyɔ. 35Na Abihail awa bienzua Suriɛl yeɛ né ɔla Merari mmusua nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne sorɔ. 36Adwuma bɔ bɛfa bewurale Merari boso ama nemɔ sa ole kyɛ, bɛnea ɛhemɔ aso: nyianu sua ndaboa nemɔ, ye kwatena nemɔ, ye bonima nemɔ, ye nyinasoɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo nningyein amukoraati, ɔne adwuma biala bɔ ɔfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ anwo ɔ; 37yeɛ bonima mɔ bɔ bapɛ aluo berɛ nwo babra bayia amukoraa, bɛ nyinasoɛ, bɛ pɛmbɛen mɔ, ɔne bɛ nyamaa mɔ.
38Na bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne nyunu, wɔ ye eyia afiteleɛ so yeɛ ole Mose ne Aarɔn ne Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ. Nekaa krongron berɛ sɔnenɛ adwuma biala bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ owura bɛ sa ɔ. Sɛ ebie mbaen pingye nekaa krongron ne a, odi kyɛ beku ye. 39Lewifoɛ mmienzua amukoraa bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn gyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ so hale bɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ.
Pɔ wɔ bamuɛbaa mɔ fi AWURADE berɛ
40Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ka Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ná kyerɛ bɛ dumaa. 41Nakoso Lewifoɛ de, ye bɛ sie berɛ ma me; Me ole AWURADE, ná fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraati bɛ gya nu. Lewifoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa koso, fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ mɔ nyɛmmoa bamuɛbaa amukoraa bɛ gya nu.” 42Yiti Mose hale Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ amu, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne. 43Na bamuɛbaa mmienzua bɔ bɛhale bɛ ná bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa ne amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ɛyaa nyɔ aburasoo ne nza.
44Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 45 “Fa Lewifoɛ mɔ si Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraati bɛ gya nu, ná Lewifoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ koso, fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ gya nu, na Lewifoɛ mɔ kɔyɛ me deɛ: Me ole AWURADE. 46Na kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpɔ Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburasoo ne nza, bɔ bɛbo Lewifoɛ ne somaa so nen, 47de bɛ nu biala ye ti nyɔboɛ sekel nnu, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te nen; sekel bɔ nu nonɛ te gyera aburanyɔ ɔ. 48Na sikaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpɔ bɛ bɔ bɛbo so nen, odi kyɛ ɛfa ma Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ.” 49Mmenia bɔ bɛbole bɛ bɔ Lewifoɛ pɔle bɛ ne aso ne, bɛ ti nyɔboɛ ne, Mose le fili bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ berɛ. 50Olele sikaa ne fili Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ berɛ; né ɔte sekel apee ko ɛyaa nza aburasia ne nnu, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te ɔ. 51Na Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale bɛ ti nyɔboɛ sikaa ne mane Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

Title: NUMERI 4
Content:
Kohatefoɛ b’adwuma
1 Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 2“Ɛ́mɔye Kohatefoɛ befi Lewifoɛ ngaa nemɔ anu ná ɛ́mɔha bɛ ngome. Bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ saso yeɛ ɛ́mɔgyina so bɛha bɛ ɔ. 3Ɛ́mɔha ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu aburannu, bɔ waso kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma ɔ. 4Kohatefoɛ mɔ, b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ole kyɛ bɛkɔnea nningyein krongron paa nemɔ aso.
5Sɛ mmerɛ dwu kyɛ ɛmɔtutu asikyeleɛ ne bɛkɔ a, odi kyɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma bɛkɔ ɛtena sua ne anu bɛkɔye mbɛmuɛ tena ne bɛfa bɛkyekye Adanzeɛ alaka ne anwo. 6Odi kyɛ bɛfa abɔngye nwomaa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so; bɛ́fa ɛtena bibire bɛ́sɛ so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ bewurawura nu. 7Na paanoo krongron poen ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛsɛ so, ná bɛ́fa ɛhemɔ bégua so: ndalie ne ɛyɛɛ kulie nemɔ, turonzemaa ne bua mɔ bɔ bɛkɔfa bekohwie afɔleɛ nzaa ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛfa daa biala paanoo ne koso bɛto so. 8Afei odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena kɔkorɛ bɛsɛ so, ná bɛ́fa abɔngye nwomaa ngatasoɛ bɛ́kata so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ bewurawura nu. 9Odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛkata ɛhemɔ anwo: kanea bakaa ne ɔne ye nganea nemɔ, akapɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ kanea nyamaa ne noa ne, kanea nyamaa nzoen ndalie nemɔ, yeɛ ngoo ndowaa amukoraa bɔ behwie nu ngoo begua kanea ne anu ne. 10Odi kyɛ bɛfa abɔngye nwomaa bɛkyekye kanea bakaa ne ɔne ye nwo nningyein amukoraati nwo, ná bɛ́fa bésie ndaboa bɔ bɛfa bɛsoa ɛtena sua ne aso. 11Odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛsɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ne aso, ná bɛ́fa abɔngye nwomaa ngatasoɛ bɛ́kata so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ bewurawura nu. 12Odi kyɛ bɛsesa nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne amukoraa, ná bɛ́fa bégua ɛtena bibire nu. Bɛ́fa nwomaa paa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so, ná bɛ́fa bésie ye mbuna ne aso. 13Odi kyɛ betu nzoen ne befi afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu, ná bɛ́fa koogyan bɛ́sɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; 14ná bɛ́fa nningyein hemɔ amukoraati bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ne begua so: ngukue bɔ bɛfa see begua nu ɔ, ateɛ anoa tworɔntworɔn nemɔ, sofi nemɔ, ayaa nemɔ, afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso nningyein amukoraati; bɛ́fa nwomaa paa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ béwurawura nu. 15Sɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mɔ bɛkata nekaa krongron ne ɔne nekaa krongron ne anu nningyein anwo beyie, ná sɛ mmenia ne betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ berɛ a, odi kyɛ Kohatefoɛ basoa sɔ nningyein nemɔ. Nakoso onni kyɛ bɛ nwo ka nningyein krongron ne, ná banwu. Ɛhemɔ ole ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu nningyein mɔ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ Kohatefoɛ mɔ bɛsoa ɔ.
16“Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa yeɛ ɔnea ɛhemɔ aso ɔ: ngoo bɔ bɛfa begua kanea ne anu ne, ɛyɛɛ fona ne, daa biala aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, nyianu sua ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraa so nealɛ, nekaa krongron ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati.”
17Yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 18“Kohatefoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, ɛ́mɔnea yé kyɛ bɛ boso ngonua wɔ Lewifoɛ nu ɔ. 19Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma bɛ ɔ, amaa sɛ bɛba nningyein krongron paa nemɔ anwo a, banya ngoa ná banwuwu: Aarɔn ne ye mma yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛkɔ nekaa krongron ne anu ná bekokyire Kohatefoɛ bɛ nu biala ye adwuma bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɔ, ɔne nningyein bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsoa ɔ. 20Nakoso nnɛma Kohatefoɛ mɔ bɛkɔ nekaa krongron ne anu bɛkɔnea nningyein krongron nemɔ le, amaa banwuwu.”
Gɛsɔnfoɛ ne Merarifoɛ b’adwuma
21Afei AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 22“Ka Gɛsɔnfoɛ mɔ koso: Bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ saso yeɛ gyina so ka bɛ ɔ. 23Ka ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu, bɔ waso kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma ɔ. 24Ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ɔne nningyein soalɛ ne, Gɛsɔnfoɛ bɛ deɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛhe: 25odi kyɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ, ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne ɔne ye ngatasoɛ, abɔngye nwomaa bɔ ɔsɛ so ne, ngatasoɛ bɔ ɔsɛ so ne, ɔne ɛtena bɔ onwi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne, 26aluo berɛ mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ, aluo berɛ bɔ wapɛ nyianu sua ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wayia ne, ye ɛtena bɔ onwi ye anoa nu berɛ ne ɔne ye nyamaa nemɔ, yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ohia kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma ɔ. Na odi kyɛ bɛyɔ adwuma biala bɔ ɔfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ anwo ɔ. 27Odi kyɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ bekyire Gɛsɔnfoɛ adwuma amukoraa bɔ bɛ́yɔ ɔ: nningyein amukoraa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛsoa ɔne adwuma amukoraa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa nningyein bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛsoa amukoraa nwo adwuma béwura bɛ sa. 28Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, b’adwuma bɔ ɔfa ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nwo ɛne; na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ ɔnea bɛ so maa bɛyɔ b’adwuma ɔ.
29Merarifoɛ de, gyina bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so yeɛ ka bɛ ɔ. 30Ka ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu ɔ, bɔ waso kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma ɔ. 31Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte b’asɛdeɛ kyɛ bɛsoa ɔ. Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu nningyein amukoraa, bɔ odi kyɛ bɛsoa hɔ ɛhe: nyianu sua ndaboa nemɔ, ye kwatena nemɔ, ye bonima nemɔ, ye nyinasoɛ nemɔ, 32bonima mɔ bɔ bapɛ aluo berɛ amukoraa nwo bayia ne, bɛ nyinasoɛ, pɛmbɛen nemɔ, nyamaa nemɔ, ɔne bɛ nwo nningyein amukoraati, ɔne adwuma bɔ ɔboka so amukoraati. Na ɛ́mɔhyire ebiala nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ ɔsoa ɔ. 33Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nwo adwuma ne, Merarifoɛ mmusua mmusua ne b’adwuma amukoraa ɛne, na ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔnea bɛ so ɔ.
Bɛhale Lewifoɛ
34 Yiti Mose ne Aarɔn ne maen mbanyi ne hale Kohatefoɛ nemɔ. Begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so yeɛ bɛhale bɛ ɔ. 35Bɛhale ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu, bɔ waso kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu adwuma ɔ. 36Na mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ mmusua mmusua ne anu ne, bɛ somaa te apee nyɔ ɛyaa nzoo ne aburannu. 37Kohatefoɛ mmusua mmusua ne anu mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛso wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu, bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn hale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛne. Begyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so hyɛle ne aso yeɛ bɛhale bɛ ɔ.
38Gɛsɔnfoɛ bɔ begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so bɛhale bɛ ne, 39bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu bɔ baso kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu adwuma nen, 40bɛ somaa, kyɛbɔ begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so bɛhale bɛ ne, ɔte apee nyɔ ɛyaa nzia ne aburasa. 41Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua mmusua nu mmenia bɔ bɛso wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ amukoraa, bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn gyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ so hale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛne.
42Merarifoɛ bɔ begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so bɛhale bɛ ne, 43bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu, bɔ baso kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu adwuma nen, 44kyɛbɔ begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua so bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee nza ɛyaa nyɔ. 45Merari mmusua mmusua ne anu mmenia bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn hale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛne. Begyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so hyɛle ne aso yeɛ bɛhale bɛ ɔ.
46Lewifoɛ amukoraa bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn ne Yisrael mbanyi begyinane bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ so bɛhale bɛ ne, 47bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburannu, bɔ baso kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu adwuma, ɔne kyɛ bɛsoa ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nwo nningyein nen, 48bɛ somaa te apee mmɔtwɛ ɛyaa nnu ne aburawɔtwɛ. 49Bɛfale ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ahoroɔ ɔne nningyein soalɛ adwuma ahoroɔ bewurale bɛ sa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle bɛ ne. Yiti Mose hale bɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne.

Title: NUMERI 5
Content:
Mmenia bɔ bɛ nwo nde ɔ
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2 “Hyɛ Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ ye, anaakyɛ ye nwo nzue se, anaakyɛ ye nwo kɔha fuin ma ye nwo kogua fiɛ ne, odi kyɛ betu ye befi asikyeleɛ ne anu. 3Kyɛ bienzua ahɔ oo, anaa brasua ahɔ oo, ɛ́mɔtu ye maa ɔhɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. Onni kyɛ b’asikyeleɛ bɔ me ne bɛ yɛte nu ne, bɛfa efiɛ bɛka ye.” 4Yisraelfoɛ yɔle sɔ. Betuli bɛ maa bɛhɔle asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE ha hyirele Mose ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ yɔle ɔ.
Bɔnehanɛ ne mbatatualɛ
5 AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 6“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua bie anaa brasua bie yɔ obiɛngo tɛɛ, maa ɔnate so ti ɔyɔ bɔne tia AWURADE a, sɔ sona ne di fɔ, 7na odi kyɛ sɔ sona ne ka bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne. Odi kyɛ ɔfa nikyee si ye gya nu otua kerɛ; ósa fa nnu nu ngyɛmuɛ ko boka so ná ɔfa ma sona bɔ wayɔ ye tɛɛ ne. 8Sona bɔ bayɔ ye tɛɛ ne, sɛ wawu ná olle abusuaniɛ kaenn biala bɔ bɛkɔfa nikyee bɔ bɛfa besi ye gya nu ne bɛkɔma ye a, ye de sɔ nikyee ne te AWURADE deɛ, na odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma ɔsɔfo ne. Mbata boaen nyii bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpata bɛkɔma sona bɔ wayɔ tɛɛ ne, bɛ́fa bɛ́boka so. 9Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron ne amukoraa, nu biala bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ ɔsɔfo ne, ɔkɔyɛ ye deɛ. 10Ebiala ye akyɛdeɛ krongron te ɔsɔfo nemɔ deɛ. Nikyee biala bɔ ebiala kɔfa kɔbrɛ ɔsɔfo biala ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɔ ɔsɔfo ne deɛ.”
Braa bɔ wabɔ ature ɔ
11AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 12“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua bie aye fa ye si, ná wanni nahorɛ wamma ye, 13bɔ bienzua foforɛ bie ne sɔ braa ne bala, nakoso ohu ande ye nwo hwee, bɔ ohu ne annwu ye, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ braa ne nwo agua fiɛ, ná ye sɔ ti ohu ne olle edwirɛ ne nwo adanzeniɛ biala, ɔnate kyɛ bangɔ amvite ye so ne ati; 14sɛ nungunɛ wura biaa ne anu maa ɔtwe ɔye bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ne anwo nungunɛ, anaakyɛ nungunɛ wura biaa ne anu maa ɔtwe ɔye ne anwo nungunɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔye ne nwo ogguale fiɛ a, 15ye de odi kyɛ biaa ne fa ɔye ne ba ɔsɔfo ne nyunu. Odi kyɛ ɔfa braa ne ti afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte ayuo esam olonka ko ne ɔba. Nnɛmaa ɔfa ngoo gua so, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa ɛyɛɛ ogua so, ofikyɛ ɔte nungunɛhwenɛ aburoo afɔleɛ. Ɔte ngayeɛ aburoo afɔleɛ, bɔ bɛfa bɛkaye amumuyɛɛ ɔ.
16Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa braa ne bagyina AWURADE nyunu; 17odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa nzue krongron bɔ ɔwɔ bua nu, ná ɔsa nyianu sua nu aseɛnwo mvuture ne bie gua nzue ne anu. 18Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa braa ne bagyina AWURADE nyunu, ɔsangye braa ne ti nwiaa, ná ngayeɛ aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte nungunɛhwenɛ aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔ́fa wura braa ne sa nu. Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne bɔbɔ otira nzue weewee bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ne. 19Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma braa ne ta ndaen ná ɔsɔfo ne ka kyɛ, “Sɛ bienzua biala ɔne wɔ bɛllale, sɛ ɛffili ehu asi eegguale wɔ nwo fiɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ etegya ye a, ye de nnɛma nzue weewee bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ye ɔyɔ wɔ hwee. 20Nakoso sɛ afi ehu asi wɔ aberɛ bɔ etegya ye, sɛ agua wɔ nwo fiɛ bɔ bienzua foforɛ bɔ nna ehu ahɔ ɔ ɔne wɔ bala a,” 21ye de ɔsɔfo ne, ɔ́ma braa ne ta ɛnomalɛ ndaen ne ná ɔha hyire braa ne kyɛ, ‘AWURADE ma ɛpɔ baa ná mogya tu wɔ maa ɔnate so wɔ mmenia mɔ benwu wɔ kyɛ AWURADE anoma wɔ, na ɛte akyiwadeɛ wɔ bɛ nu. 22Afei nzue he bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ye oogua wɔ kunu ma mogya tu wɔ ná ɛpɔ baa!’ Na odi kyɛ braa ne ka kyɛ, Amen, Amen.’
23Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne kyerɛ sɔ ɛnomalɛ dwirɛ ne gua nwomaa so, ná onwunzi gua nzue weewee ne anu. 24Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma braa ne no nzue weewee bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ne, na ɛnomalɛ nzue ne koogua ye kunu kɔmaa ɔkɔte yealɛ serɛserɛ paa. 25Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne de nungunɛhwenɛ aburoo afɔleɛ ne fi braa ne sa nu, ná ɔnwaha ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná ɔfa ba afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. 26Aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne sa ye sa bum ko fa yɛ ngayeɛ nikye ná ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Afei odi kyɛ ɔma braa ne no nzue ne. 27Sɛ ɔma braa ne no nzue ne yie, ná sɛ braa ne wafi ohu asi waagua ye nwo fiɛ a, ye de nzue bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ne kowurawura ye nu kɔma ye nwo kotutu ye paa. Mogya kotu ye, ɔkɔpɔ baa, na ye mmenia mɔ konwu kyɛ ɔte sona bɔ AWURADE anoma ye ɔ. 28Nakoso sɛ braa ne ogguale ye nwo fiɛ, ná mmom ye nwo te a, ye de hwee ngɔyɔ ye, na ɔkɔhora kɔwo baa.
29Ɛhe ole nungunɛhwenɛ nwo mmeraa, na ɔfa brasua bɔ ɔtɛ gya ohu, ná koso okofi ohu asi kogua ye nwo fiɛ nwo. 30Anaa sɛ nungunɛhwenɛ wura bienzua nu maa ɔtwe ɔye anwo nungunɛ a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔfa brasua ne bagyina AWURADE nyunu ma ɔsɔfo ne fa braa ne fa nhyehyɛleɛ he amukoraati nu. 31Bienzua ne ngoli amumuyɛɛ biala nwo fɔ, nakoso brasua ne de, ye amumuyɛɛ kɔbɔ ye ti so.

Title: NUMERI 6
Content:
Nasiritefoɛ
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua anaa brasua bie bɔ anohoba sonongo, bɔ ɔte nasiritefoɛ anohoba, kyɛ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE a, 3 odi kyɛ otua ye nwo bobe nzaa ne nzaa serɛ. Onni kyɛ ɔno bobe nzaa kekarekekare anaa nzaa kekarekekare biala. Onni kyɛ ɔno bobe nzue anaa odi ye aleɛ, kyɛ ye monɛ oo, anaa ye worowaa oo. 4Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔtɛ te nasiriteniɛ ne, onni kyɛ odi nikyee biala bɔ bafa bobe bayɔ ɔ, kyɛ bafa ye mma anaakyɛ ye boen po yeɛ bayɔ hɔ oo.
5Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wayɛ nasiriteniɛ ne, onni kyɛ ɔtete ye ti. Kɔpem kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE kɔpɛ nu ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ krongron; ɔ́ma ye ti nwiaa mbɛsɛmbɛsɛ ne ofu gua ye ti anwo.
6Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne, onni kyɛ ɔkɔ fuin nwo. 7Sɛ ɔse anaa oni anaa oliɛma bienzua anaa oliɛma brasua po wu a, nnɛmaa ɔkɔ ye fuin nwo ma ye nwo gua fiɛ, ofikyɛ ye nwo bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne, ye ti so yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ. 8Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔtɛ te Nasiriteniɛ ne, ɔte krongron ma AWURADE.
9Sɛ mvum nu ebie wu wɔ ye nyunu maa ɔnate so efiɛ ka ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne a, ye de kyẽa bɔ ɔpete ye nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye ti. Ɛlɛsoo ne aso yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye ti ɔ. 10Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa mmubure nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ brɛ ɔsɔfo ne wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. 11Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɔfa ko koso bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ná ɔpata ma ye, ofikyɛ ɔnate efuin ne ati wali fɔ. Odi kyɛ osa te ye ti ne anwo maa ɔyɛ krongron sɔ kyẽa ne ala, 12ná otu ye nwo sie berɛ ma AWURADE mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔtɛ te nasiriteniɛ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɔfa boaen nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko ɔbabɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ. Mmerɛ daa bɔ olili moa tuli ye nwo siele berɛ mane AWURADE ne de, wayera wagua, ofikyɛ efiɛ hane ye ti bɔ ɔyɛle ye krongron ne.
13 Sɛ mmerɛ bɔ nasiriteniɛ ne wafa watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne ɔba ayieleɛ a, ye nwo mmeraa ɛhe: odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛbagyina ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. 14Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye akyɛdeɛ hemɔ ɔbrɛ AWURADE: boaen nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko, bɔ ollili nnɛen biala, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔ; boaen beleɛ akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko, bɔ ollili nnɛen biala, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ; boaen nyii ko bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ɔ, 15paanoo kabrɛdi kɛndɛen ko, taterɛ bɔ bafa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye bayɔ ɔ; apiti kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafa ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ. 16Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa nningyein hemɔ ba AWURADE nyunu ná ɔbɔ nasiriteniɛ ne ye bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne. 17Odi kyɛ ɔfa boaen nyii ne ɔne paanoo kabrɛdi kɛndɛen ko ne bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Afei ɔsɔfo ne ɔ́bɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛboka so ne. 18Nasiriteniɛ ne, ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, na tire bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne aso nwiaa ne, ɔ́fa ógua asomdwee afɔleɛ ne abo see ne anu. 19Sɛ nasiriteniɛ ne, ɔpoa ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne oyie a, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ɛhemɔ gua nasiriteniɛ ne ye sa munyɔ nu: sɔ boaen nyii ne ye waen bɔ bato ɔ, taterɛ kabrɛdi ko bɔ baye bafi kɛndɛen ne anu ɔ, ɔne apiti kabrɛdi ko. 20Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne pagya nningyein nemɔ aso bɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu; bɛ ne ye sa bɔ bɛnwaha ne, ɔne ye gya bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, bɛte krongron, ná ɔsɔfo bue deɛ ɛne. Ye si ye, nasiriteniɛ ne le ye nwo ate kyɛ ɔno nzaa ɔ.
21Mmeraa he la berɛ ma nasiriteniɛ bɔ ɔkɔbɔ anohoba ɔ: ye afɔleɛ bɔ ɔfa ma AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye kyɛbɔ nasiritefoɛ anohobabɔlɛ te ɔ, na odi kyɛ ɔfa nikyee bɔ ye nwo kɔsõ so ɔ ɔboka so. Anohoba biala bɔ ɔkɔbɔ ne, odi kyɛ ogyina nasiriteniɛyɛlɛ mmeraa so odi so.”
Ɔsɔfo saleɛ mbaeɛ
22Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 23“Kã kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ: Edwirɛ he yeɛ ɛmɔhã bɛfa beyira Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. Ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ,
24‘AWURADE yira wɔ, ná ɔnea wɔ so;
25AWURADE ɔ́ma ye nyunu ɔta hyireinn ɔma wɔ, ná ɔlo wɔ;

Title: NUMERI 7
Content:

1Kyẽa bɔ Mose sili nyianu sua ne yiele ne, ɔfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo popale ye, na ɔtele ye ne nu nningyein amukoraati nwo. Ɔfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo popale afɔleɛ bokyea ne, na ɔtele ye ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraati nwo. 2Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisrael mbanyi, yeɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa, yeɛ mmusua kure nu mbanyi bɔ bɛlela mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ nemɔ noa ne, bɛbɔle afɔleɛ. 3Bɛfale b’afɔleɛ hemɔ bɛwale AWURADE nyunu: teaseɛnam nzia bɔ bakata so ɔ, ɔne nandwie buru ne nyɔ; mbanyi nyɔ biala bɛ teaseɛnam ko, yeɛ panyi biala ye nandwie ko. Bɛfale bɛ bɛbrɛle AWURADE wɔ nyianu sua ne anyunu. 4Yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 5“Dé sɔ nningyein nemɔ fi bɛ berɛ, maa bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ɛsolɛ adwuma, ná fa ma Lewifoɛ mɔ biala kyɛbɔ adwuma bɔ owura ye sa te ɔ.” 6Yiti Mose lele teaseɛnam nemɔ ne nandwie nyii nemɔ, na ɔfa mane Lewifoɛ mɔ. 7Ɔneane Gɛsɔnfoɛ b’adwuma nwo mane bɛ teaseɛnam nyɔ ne nandwie nyii nna, 8yeɛ ɔneane Merarifoɛ b’adwuma nwo mane bɛ teaseɛnam nna ne nandwie nyii mmɔtwɛ, na ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ né ɔnea Merarifoɛ nemɔ aso maa bɛyɔ b’adwuma ɔ. 9Nakoso Kohatefoɛ de, wamma bɛ bie, ofikyɛ bɛ de, nningyein krongron bɔ owura bɛ sa ne, bɛsoa ye wɔ bɛ bati.
10Kyẽa bɔ bɛpopale afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngoo ne, mbanyi nemɔ sá fale afɔleɛ bɛwale maa bɛfa betuli afɔleɛ bokyea ne bewurale AWURADE sa; mbanyi nemɔ fale b’afɔleɛ ne bɛwale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anyunu. 11Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ ɛlɛho biala mbanyi ne anu ko fa ye afɔleɛ ba, maa bɛfa betu afɔleɛ bokyea ne bewura me sa.”
12Aminadabo awa bienzua Nason bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne yeɛ ɔfale ye afɔleɛ deɛ wale kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne ɔ. 13Ye afɔleɛ ne ɛhe: talie bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ ko, bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo ko ne bue, ayaa ko bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ, bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo ko, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ kilo nonɛ te ɔ. Né esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ, bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ɔ wayi bɛ munyɔ tɛkyɛ; 14ayaa ko bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ɔ, bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo ko nu ngyɛmuɛ buru, bɔ ɛyɛɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛ ɔ; 15nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, boaen nyii ko, yeɛ boaen nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔ; 16abɔngye nyii ko bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ; 17ɔne asomdwee afɔleɛ nwo nningyein hemɔ: nandwie nyɔ, mmoaen nyii nnu, mbɔngye nyii nnu, ɔne mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nnu bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ. Aminadabo awa Nason ye afɔleɛ deɛ ɛne.

Enan awa Ahira ye afɔleɛ deɛ ɛne.
84Mmerɛ bɔ bɛfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo bɛpopale afɔleɛ bokyea nen, nningyein hemɔ yeɛ Yisrael mbanyi fa wale maa bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ betuli afɔleɛ bokyea ne bewurale Nyameɛ sa ɔ: talie bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ buru ne nyɔ, ayaa bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ buru ne nyɔ, kulie bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ɔ buru ne nyɔ. 85Talie bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ne, ko biala nu nonɛ te kilo ko ne bue, yeɛ ayaa bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ne, ko biala nu nonɛ te kilo ko. Nningyein bɔ bɛfale ɛdwetɛ bɛyɔle ne amukoraa, nu nonɛ te kilo aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ kilo nonɛ te ɔ. 86Ayaa buru ne nyɔ bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ, bɔ ɛyɛɛ ayi bɛ tɛkyɛɛ ne, bɛ nu biala nu nonɛ, ɛkyɛ kilo ko nu ɛyaa a, ɔte nu ngyɛmuɛ nza, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ kilo nonɛ te ɔ. Na sikaa kɔkorɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔle ayaa nemɔ ne, nu nonɛ te kilo ko ne bue. 87Ngaka amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, bɛte nandwie nyii buru ne nyɔ, mmoaen nyii buru ne nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nyɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ boka so ɔ; yeɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mbɔngye nyii buru ne nyɔ. 88Asomdwee afɔleɛ ngaka ne amukoraa bɛte nandwie nyii aburanyɔ ne nna, mmoaen nyii aburasia, mbɔngye nyii aburasia, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma aburasia bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ. Bɛfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo bɛpopale afɔleɛ bokyea ne beyiele ne, sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ betuli afɔleɛ bokyea ne bewurale AWURADE sa ɔ.
89Sɛ né Mose kɔ ɛtena sua ne anu kyɛ ɔne AWURADE bɛkwaadwudwo a, né ɔte komviɛ ne kyɛ odwudwo kyire ye fi Adanzeɛ alaka ne aso mbata bia bɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nyɔ ne b’afia ne, ye anwuro ɔ; né komviɛ ne ɔne Mose bedwudwo.

Title: NUMERI 8
Content:
Kanea nzoo nemɔ
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Ka kyire Aarɔn kyɛ, Sɛ ɛ́fa nganea nemɔ siesie kanea bakaa ne aso a, odi kyɛ ɛfa nganea nzoo nemɔ siesie so maa bɛta kanea bakaa ne nyunu berɛ.” 3Yiti Aarɔn yɔle sɔ. Ɔfale nganea nemɔ siesiele kanea bakaa ne aso maa bɛtale kanea bakaa ne nyunu, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne. 4Sɔa yeɛ bɛyɔle kanea bakaa ne ɔ: bɛborole sikaa kɔkorɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛyɔle ɔ. Ofi ye nyinasoɛ so kodwu ye nyerɛen ne aso ne, ɔte sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ baboro ɔ. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE fa hyirele Mose ne sɛso te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔyɔle kanea bakaa ne ɔ.
Betu Lewifoɛ besie berɛ bɛma AWURADE
5AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 6 “Yeye Lewifoɛ mɔ fi Yisraelfoɛ nu ná te bɛ nwo. 7Ɛhe yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ná ɛfa te bɛ nwo ɔ: Fa nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ne pete bɛ nwo. Maa bɛfa dɛmaa bɛpoa bɛ nwo nwiaa amukoraa ná bɛpo bɛ nwo nningyein, amaa ɔnate so bɛ nwo ate. 8Afei maa bɛfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bafa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ, na odi kyɛ esa fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko babɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. 9Odi kyɛ ɛma Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu, ná ɛma Yisrael maen ne amukoraa babɔ dwaa. 10Sɛ ɛma Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina AWURADE nyunu a, odi kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ fa bɛ sa gua Lewifoɛ mɔ aso. 11Odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina AWURADE nyunu maa bɛyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ofi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so Lewifoɛ bayɔ AWURADE adwuma. 12Ɔsɛ kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛfa bɛ sa begua nandwie nyii nemɔ ti afia; ná Aarɔn ɔ́fa ko ɔ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɔ́fa ko koso ɔ́bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE, ná ɔfa pata ma Lewifoɛ mɔ. 13Afei ma Lewifoɛ mɔ beegyina Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ nyunu, ná fa bɛ yɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE.
14“Fa sɔ atee ye aso ye Lewifoɛ sie ahameɛ fi Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ anu, na Lewifoɛ mɔ kɔɔyɛ me deɛ. 15Sɛ ɛte Lewifoɛ mɔ anwo yie, ná ɛfa bɛ yɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu a, ye si ye, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛkɔhyɛ b’adwuma bo wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu berɛ. 16Ofikyɛ, Yisraelfoɛ nu, bɛ yeɛ batu bɛ basie berɛ bɔkɔɔ bama me ɔ. Matu bɛ masie berɛ mama me nwo, na mafa bɛ masi ebiala bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔwo ye, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte Yisrael bamuɛbaa mmienzua amukoraa bɛ gya nu. 17Ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraa, kyɛ sona oo, kyɛ kaka oo, ɔte me deɛ. Kyẽa bɔ nguni bamuɛbaa amukoraa wɔ Misraim aseɛ so ne yeɛ nduli bɛ nziele berɛ mane me nwo ɔ. 18 Mafa Lewifoɛ mɔ masi Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua amukoraa bɛ gya nu. 19Afei koso, maye Lewifoɛ masie ahameɛ mafi Yisraelfoɛ nu, na mafa bɛ mayɛ akyɛdeɛ mama Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma bɛma Yisraelfoɛ wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu, ná bɛpata bɛma Yisraelfoɛ, amaa sɛ Yisraelfoɛ bepingye nekaa krongron ne a, amaneɛ biala ando bɛ.”
20Yiti Mose ne Aarɔn ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati betuli Lewifoɛ besiele berɛ bɛmane AWURADE. Yisraelfoɛ tuli Lewifoɛ siele berɛ kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose fale bɛ nwo ne ala. 21Lewifoɛ mɔ petene bɛ nwo, na bɛpole bɛ nwo nningyein. Afei Aarɔn fale bɛ yɛle ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na Aarɔn patale mane bɛ fa tele bɛ nwo. 22Ye si ye, Lewifoɛ mɔ hɔle bɛɛyɔle b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu. Né Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ bɛnea bɛ so ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose fale Lewifoɛ mɔ nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ betuli bɛ besiele berɛ bɛmane AWURADE ɔ.
23AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 24“Nhyehyɛleɛ he wɔ berɛ ma Lewifoɛ mɔ: bɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu bɔ ɔkɔ ne, odi kyɛ bɛhyɛ ye bo bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu. 25Na ofi afoɛ aburannu bɔ ɔkɔ ne, odi kyɛ bede bɛ nwome befi ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne anu na onni kyɛ bɛso ko. 26Bɛkɔhora bɛkɔbokaboka b’eliɛma mɔ maa bɛkɔyɔ b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu, nakoso onni kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne bie. Sɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛfa Lewifoɛ nemɔ adwuma wura bɛ sa ɔ.

Title: NUMERI 9
Content:
Bedi Abɔtra aluolue wɔ Sinai
1 Yisraelfoɛ tu fili Misraim aseɛ so ne asi, bosome bɔ oli moa wɔ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, AWURADE sele Mose wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ, 2“Ma Yisraelfoɛ beli Abɔtra aluolue ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ mato berɛ ɔ nu. 3Sɔ bosome he, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, sɛ aleɛ dwo a, ɛ́mɔli ye kyɛbɔ ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ɔ nu.” 4Yiti Mose ha hyirele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ beli Abɔtra aluolue ne. 5Belili Abɔtra aluolue ne wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, wɔ ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne aso. Aleɛ dwole ne, belili ye wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ lili ye ɔ. 6Né mmenia ne biemɔ bɛ nwo aha fuin ama bɛ nwo agua fiɛ, yiti bangora banni Abɔtra aluolue ne bie sɔ kyẽa ne. Bɛwale Mose ne Aarɔn nyunu sɔ kyẽa ne, 7na beebisale Mose kyɛ, “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛ nwo aha fuin ama yɛ nwo agua fiɛ de, nakoso nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ besi yɛ ate maa ye sɔ ti yɛngora yɛmva yɛ afɔleɛ yɛmmrɛ AWURADE wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ɔ nu, kyɛbɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne de bayɔ ne?” 8Mose buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnwondɛ maa ndie mmeraa bɔ AWURADE kɔhyɛ kɔfa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ.”
9Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 10“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Ɛmɔ nu biala anaa ɛmɔ bosoniɛ biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha fuin kɔma ye nwo kogua fiɛ, anaakyɛ ebiala bɔ watu atee ne, ye koso ɔsɛ kyɛ odi AWURADE Abɔtra aluolue ne bie. 11Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu ne, aleɛ dwo a yeɛ odi kyɛ bedi Abɔtra ne ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa paanoo kabrɛdi ne awɔwee nyaa yeɛ bɛboka so bedi ɔ. 12 Nnɛmaa bɛyakyi bie ma aleɛ kye so, yeɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ naen ne bowue nu. Beli ye kyɛbɔ Abɔtra aluolue ne nwo nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa te ɔ. 13Nakoso ebiala bɔ ye nwo te, bɔ ottuli atee, nakoso wanni Abɔtra aluolue ne bie ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi ye mmenia nu, ofikyɛ wamva AWURADE afɔleɛ wammrɛ ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ɔ nu. Sɔ sona ne, ye bɔne kɔbɔ ye ti so. 14Sɛ amanvraniɛ bie bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu kuro kyɛ odi AWURADE Abɔtra aluolue ne bie a, óli ye kyɛbɔ Abɔtra aluolue ne nwo ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. Amanvoraniɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu oo, maen ne anu niɛ oo, ahyɛdeɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma ɛmɔ ɔ.”
Munungum ne see ne
(Ɛksadɔso 40.34-38)
15Kyẽa bɔ besili nyianu sua ne, munungum ne munduni nyianu sua bɔ ɔte adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne aso, fi nɔsoa maa oodwuli ngyerɛmɔ. Né munungum ne sue te kyɛ see, na omunduni nyianu sua ne aso. 16Daa biala sɔ ala yeɛ né ɔte ɔ: sɛ aleɛ kye a, munungum ne mundu so, na aleɛ sa a né wakakyi kyɛ see. 17Mmerɛ biala bɔ munungum ne kɔma ye nwo so kofi ɛtena sua ne aso ne yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ betu bɛ bo ɔ; na nekaa biala bɔ munungum ne kogyina ne, berɛ yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ fa yɛ b’asikyeleɛ ɔ. 18Sɛ AWURADE ka kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ betu bɛ bo a yeɛ betu bɛ bo ɔ; na sɛ AWURADE ka kyɛ begyina a, yeɛ begyina bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ ɔ. Mmerɛ biala, bɔ munungum ne tɛ mundu nyianu sua ne aso ne, Yisraelfoɛ tena asikyeleɛ berɛ. 19Sɛ ɔba ye kyɛ munungum ne mundu nyianu sua ne aso ngyẽa pee po a, Yisraelfoɛ di AWURADE dwirɛ ne aso, na bendu bɛ bo. 20Sɛ né odwu mmerɛ bie a, munungum ne mundu nyianu sua ne aso ngyẽa kãa bie, na kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ bɛ ne, né bɛtena asikyeleɛ berɛ. Ye si ye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ bɛ ne, né besa betu bɛ bo. 21Sɛ né odwu mmerɛ bie a, munungum ne mundu so fi nɔsoa kodwu ngyerɛmɔ; na sɛ munungum ne ma ye nwo so ngyerɛmɔ ne a, né batu bɛ bo. Sɛ munungum ne toa so mundu so eyia ne kɔngɔen a, mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔma ye nwo so ne, né batu bɛ bo. 22Na sɛ munungum ne toa so mundu nyianu sua ne aso elenyɔ, anaa bosome, anaa mmerɛ tendenn biala a, Yisraelfoɛ kɔ so tena asikyeleɛ berɛ bɔ bendu bɛ bo ɔ. Nakoso sɛ munungum ne ma ye nwo so a, né batu bɛ bo. 23Sɛ AWURADE ka kyɛ bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ a yeɛ bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ ɔ, na sɛ AWURADE ka kyɛ betu bɛ bo a yeɛ betu bɛ bo ɔ. Belili AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ so, ahyɛdeɛ bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so fa mane bɛ ne.

Title: NUMERI 10
Content:
Ɛdwetɛ totorobɛndo nemɔ
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Boro ɛdwetɛ fa yɔ totorobɛndo nyɔ bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔfrɛ maen ne maa bɛkɔbɔ dwaa, ná asa ahu amaa batu bɛ bo bafi asikyeleɛ ne anu ɔ. 3Sɛ behu bɛ munyɔ ne a, odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraa babɔ dwaa wɔ wɔ nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. 4Nakoso sɛ behu komapɛ a, mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anoa ne yeɛ beeyia wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ. 5Sɛ ɛmɔhu maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi a, odi kyɛ asikyeleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne betu bɛ bo. 6Na sɛ ɛmɔhu ye bɔ ɔtɔ so pɛen nyɔ maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi a, odi kyɛ asikyeleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ngwaen ne betu bɛ bo. Mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ betu bɛ bo ne, odi kyɛ behu maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi. 7Nakoso sɛ odi kyɛ maen ne amu bɛbɔ dwaa a, ye de ɛ́mɔhu, nakoso nnɛma ɛ́mɔhu maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi. 8Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne yeɛ odi kyɛ behu totorobɛndo ne ɔ. Ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ɔma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu. 9Sɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye bɛko koɛ wɔ ɛmɔ aseɛ ne aso a, ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ maa ohyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ waboka ɛmɔ, ná ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu bafi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu. 10Afei koso, ngyẽa bɔ ɛmɔfa bɛgye bɛ nye, ɔne ɛmɔ aluolue ngyẽa, ɔne kyẽa bɔ bosome kofi ne, ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ɛmɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ɔ. Bɛkɔyɛ ngayeɛ nikyee bɛkɔma ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nyunu: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.
Betu bɛ bo befi Sinai
11Befili Misraim ne, afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne, munungum ne mane ye nwo so fili adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne aso. 12Afei Yisraelfoɛ sili nu kure kure fili Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso, na munungum ne oogyinane Paran ɛserɛ ne aso. 13Betuli bɛ bo bɔ oli moa ne, begyinane AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so hane ne aso yeɛ betuli ɔ. 14Yuda asikyeleɛ ne anu ama yeɛ bɛfale bɛ frangaa belili moa betuli bɛ bo kure kure ɔ. Aminadabo awa Nason yeɛ né otua Yuda ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ. 15Né Suare awa Netanɛl yeɛ otua Yisaka abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ; 16yeɛ né Helon awa Eliabo yeɛ otua Sebulɔn abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.
17Afei betutuli nyianu sua ne, na Gɛsɔnfoɛ ne Merarifoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua ne, betuli bɛ bo. 18Ruben asikyeleɛ ne anu ama bɛfale bɛ frangaa ne betuli bɛ bo kure kure, na Sedɛre awa Elisure yeɛ né otua Ruben ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ. 19Né Surisadai awa Selumiɛl yeɛ otua Simeon abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ; 20yeɛ né Dewel awa Eliasafe yeɛ otua Gade abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.
21Yeɛ Kohatefoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛsoa nningyein krongron ne, betuli bɛ bo, na Gɛsɔnfoɛ ne Merarifoɛ bɛhyehyɛle nyianu sua ne koraka yeɛ Kohatefoɛ bedwu berɛ ɔ. 22Afei, Efraim asikyeleɛ ne anu ama bɛfale bɛ frangaa betuli bɛ bo kure kure, na Amihude awa Elisama yeɛ né otua Efraim ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ. 23Né Pedasure awa Gamaliɛl yeɛ otua Manase abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ; 24yeɛ né Gideoni awa Abidan yeɛ otua Benyamin abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.
25Afei Dan asikyeleɛ ne anu ama, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ beli nziɛ bɛbɔ ɛlɔen ne amukoraati bɛ nwo waen ne, bɛfale bɛ frangaa betuli bɛ bo kure kure. Né Amisadae awa Ahiesa yeɛ otua Dan ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ. 26Né Okran awa Pagyiɛl yeɛ otua Asɛ abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ; 27yeɛ né Enan awa Ahira yeɛ otua Nafetali abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ. 28Mmerɛ biala, sɛ né Yisraelfoɛ betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure nemɔ, sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne yeɛ né begyina so bɛfa bɛkɔ ɔ.
29Mose sele Midianniɛ Rewel bɔ yeɛ ɔte ye sia bienzua ne, ɔwa Hobabo kyɛ, “Yɛtu yɛkɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE aha ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Ngɔfa ngɔma ɛmɔ’ ne. Ɛne yɛ hɔ, na yɛkɔnea wɔ yé; ofikyɛ AWURADE ahyɛ Yisrael bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okoyie ye yé.” 30Nakoso Hobabo buale ye kyɛ, “Mengɔhɔ, na mmom mesa mekɔ me bɔbɔ me maen nu ne m’abusuafoɛ dɔ.” 31Yeɛ Mose sele kyɛ, “Nnɛyakyi yɛ nu, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛse nekaa bɔ odi kyɛ yɛkyekye asikyeleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ɔ, na wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔhora kohyire yɛ atee ɔ. 32Asa koso, sɛ ɛne yɛ kɔ a, nikyee paa biala bɔ AWURADE kɔfa kɔlo yɛ ne, yɛ koso yɛkɔmaa ekonya bie.”
33Yiti besili nu befili AWURADE bokaa ne aso bɛpɛle atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ. Né AWURADE apam alaka ne li bɛ nyunu wɔ sɔ ɛlɛsa ateetulɛ ne anu kyɛ ɔkwaapena nekaa maa bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ. 34Mmerɛ biala sɛ né betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, né AWURADE munungum ne mundu bɛ so eyia.
35 Mmerɛ biala bɔ alaka ne kotu ye bo ne, Mose ka kyɛ,
“O AWURADE dwɔso, ná ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ aya,
ná ma bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ɔ bɛnwati befi wɔ nyunu.”
36Mmerɛ biala bɔ apam alaka ne kogyina neka horɛ ne, Mose ka kyɛ,
“Sá bra, O Yisraelfoɛ apee apee b’AWURADE.”

Title: NUMERI 11
Content:
Bɛpenepene bɛ komvi wɔ ɛserɛ so
1Yisraelfoɛ penepenene bɛ komvi fale amaneɛ bɔ benwu ye ɔ nwo maa odwuli AWURADE nyunu. AWURADE tele, na ɔfɛle yaa paa. Yiti AWURADE see ne tɔle wɔ b’asikyeleɛ ne anu, na ɔyerale asikyeleɛ berɛ bondua ne bie. 2Nakoso mmenia ne sũ frɛle Mose. Mose srɛle AWURADE na see ne nuane. 3Yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Tabera ofikyɛ AWURADE see ne tɔle bɛ berɛ.
4 Mmenia bɔ bɛɛfrafrale Yisraelfoɛ nu ne bɛ komvi wale aleɛ biemɔ aso. Na Yisraelfoɛ sá bɔle awuye kyɛ, “Yɛnyane naen a ahaa yɛkoli! 5Yɛkaye nzue nu naen bɔ né yɛfa ye mbaen wɔ Misraim, ɔne ndropo, ferɛ, ngondomire, gyeene ne galeke bɔ né yɛdi ɔ. 6Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛhɔen yeɛ oku yɛ ɔ, na yɛnnya hwee, sana mana ye angome.”
7Mana te kyɛ mviɛlɛ, na ye nwo sue te kyɛ anengyene. 8Né mmenia kyini bɛkɔsesa. Né beti ye nyɔboɛ so anaa besi ye duwaa nu, ná afei bato ye kukue nu bafa bayɛ taterɛ. Ye fɛɛ te kyɛ taterɛ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye bato ɔ. 9Sɛ odwu kɔngɔen ná sɛ bosue tɔ gua asikyeleɛ ne anu a, mana koso tɔ boka so.
10Mose tele kyɛ mmusua mmusua ne anu mmenia besu, na né sona biala te ye ɛtena sua anoa nu. AWURADE fɛle yaa paa, na edwirɛ ne yɛle Mose ahomete. 11Yiti Mose bisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛne w’akoaa bali ye weewee sɔa ye? Nzu ati yeɛ annwu me anwumvoin bɔ afa mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nwo ngyeleɛ ahye me ye? 12Aso me yeɛ mvale mmenia hemɔ amukoraati mmale wiase ɔ? Me yeɛ nwole bɛ ɔ, bɔ yeɛ ɛkã kyire me kyɛ, ‘Dodo bɛ kyɛbɔ baanealɛniɛ ododo adɔma bɔ otua nyɔfone noa ɔ’, ná mva bɛ ngɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛtale ndaen fa hyɛle bɛ nana mɔ bɔ ne aso ɔ? 13Nisua yeɛ mekwaanya naen mema mmenia hemɔ amukoraa ɔ? Baasu bagua me so kyɛ, ‘Ma yɛ naen maa yɛli!’ 14Me ngome mengɔhora mmenia hemɔ amukoraati so nea, ofikyɛ ɔbo m’anwoserɛ so. 15Sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɛfa di me de a, ye de ku me pɛen ko. Nakoso sɛ anya alo me de a, nnɛma aworabɔlɛ to me.”
Mbanyi aburasoo ne
16Yiti AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Yisrael mbanyi bɔ ɛse kyɛ bɛte mmenia ne aso mbanyi ne atitire ne, boaboa bɛ nu aburasoo noa ma me. Fa bɛ bra ɛtena sua ne anu, ná ɛne bɛ gyina berɛ. 17Ngodwu ngɔwa me ne wɔ yɛkoodwudwo wɔ berɛ, na ngɔfa sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne bie ngowura bɛ nu. Ɛne bɛ ɛmɔkɔfa mmenia ne anwo fɛɛ bɛkɔto ɛmɔ nwo so, amaa wanna wɔ ngome wɔ so. 18Na se mmenia ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo krongron bɛfa bɛnwondɛ ɛhema, na ɛmɔkoli naen; ofikyɛ ɛmɔasu maa AWURADE ate, bɔ ɛmɔnwa: ‘Yɛpena naen yɛdi! Amba yɛwɔ Misraim ne po, né ɔte paa ma yɛ.’ Yiti AWURADE kɔma ɛmɔ naen ma ɛmɔkoli. 19Ɛmɔngoli ye ɛlɛho anaa elenyɔ, anaa elennu anaa eleburu, anaa eleburanyɔ, 20na mmom ɛmɔkoli ye bosome ko mumua, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bonyi anu, ná wabɔ ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔapo AWURADE bɔ ɔne ɛmɔ te ne, na ɛmɔabɔ awuye wɔ ye nyunu kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati po yeɛ yɛtu yɛfili Misraim ye?’ ” 21Na Mose buale kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ ndua bɛ noa ye, bɛ somaa te apee sɔ alaa ɛyaa nzia. Nakoso ɛnwa, ‘Ngɔma bɛ naen maa bekoli ye bosome ko mumua’! 22Aso yɛkonya bɛ noa mmoaen ne nandwie bɔ bekohu bɛ bɛkɔma bɛ ɔ? Aso yɛkonya bɛ noa naen yɛkɔhye bɛ wɔ ɛpo nu?” 23Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “AWURADE tumi ne, aso nikyee bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ɔngora ye yɔ ɔ? Afei ekonwu ye, sɛ me dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu kɔma wɔ anaakyɛ ɔngɔwa nu a.”
24Yiti Mose fitele ɔɔfale AWURADE dwirɛ ne bɔle mmenia ne amaneɛ. Ɔboaboale maen ne anu mbanyi aburasoo noa, na ɔmaa beegyinagyinane ɛtena sua ne anwo bɛbra beyiale. 25Yeɛ AWURADE nate munungum nu dwu wale ase, na ɔne Mose beedwudwole. AWURADE fale sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ Mose nu ne bie wurale mbanyi aburasoo nemɔ anu. Sunzum ne wale bɛ so ne, bɛhyɛle ngɔm. Nakoso ye si ye, banhyɛ ngɔm ko.
26Mmienzua nyɔ hale asikyeleɛ ne anu. Bɛfrɛ ko Eldade, yeɛ bɛfrɛ ko koso Medade. Sunzum ne wale bɛ so. Né bɛboka mbanyi bɔ Mose yele bɛ ne aso de, nakoso bamma ɛtena sua ne anwo dɔ bie, yiti bɛhyɛle ngɔm wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu. 27Aberandeɛ bie le amirika ɔɔbɔle Mose amaneɛ kyɛ, “Eldade ne Medade bɛwɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu dɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm.” 28Yeɛ Nun awa Yosua bɔ ɔte Mose bokafoɛ fite ye mmerandeɛ nu, bɔ ɔboka mmienzua bɔ Mose yele bɛ ne aso ne, ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mene Mose, bera bɛ!” 29Nakoso Mose buale ye kyɛ, “Ɛ́ko me ti ngondii anaa? Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa AWURADE mmenia amukoraati bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ; ahaa AWURADE afa ye sunzum wawura bɛ nu!” 30Na Mose ne Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ besa bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu.
Ayenzii nemɔ
31AWURADE mane mvrama bie tuli, na ɔbɔle ayenzii fili ɛpo so maa beeguale asikyeleɛ ne ngyɛnu. Asikyeleɛ ne bue ko ne, ayenzii ne tete guale toonn kɔyɛ atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛho yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ, yeɛ ye bue ko ne koso, beguale toonn kɔyɛ atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛho yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ, maa bɛpɛle asikyeleɛ ne anwo amu beyiale. Né bataataa so bawa anwuro alaa kɔyɛ agyirɛ nyɔ. 32Yiti maen ne boaboale ayenzii ne noa sɔ kyẽa ne amukoraa eyia ne kɔngɔen, na aleɛ hyene ne koso, besa bɛtoale so kyẽa ne amukoraa. Sona bɔ wanzesa bie koraa ne, nna angora buru ɔ, na bɛworɛle bɛpɛle asikyeleɛ ne anwo beyiale. 33Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ begu so bedi naen ne, bɔ né bennya belli beyyiele ne, AWURADE fɛle mmenia ne aso yaa paa, na AWURADE fale amaneɛ piri paa tole bɛ so. 34 Yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Kibrote Hataawa, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ besiele mmenia bɔ benyane akɔnnɔ tɛɛ ne ɔ. 35Mmenia ne fili Kibrote Hataawa ne, bɛtoale so bɛhɔle Haserote.

Title: NUMERI 12
Content:
Aarɔn ne Miriam dwudwo tia Mose
1Mmerɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Haserote né, Miriam ne Aarɔn dwudwo tiale Mose, ɔnate kyɛ né Mose waagya Kuseniɛ braa bie (né wagya Kuseniɛ braa amba). 2Na besele kyɛ, “Aso Mose ngome yeɛ AWURADE afa ye so wadwudwo anaa? Aso yɛ koso, ɔffale yɛ so oddwudwole anaa?” Na AWURADE tele sɔ dwirɛ ne. 3Né Mose odwo tra sona biala bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ. 4Mvum nu, AWURADE sele Mose, Aarɔn ɔne Miriam kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ amɛsa, ɛmɔbra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu.” Yiti bɛ mmɛsa befite bɛwale. 5AWURADE nate munungum ningɔnn nu dwu wale ase, na oogyinane ɛtena sua ne anoa nu berɛ. Ɔfrɛle Aarɔn ne Miriam, na bɛ munyɔ bɛwale anyunu. 6Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ bɔ meka ye:
Sɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie wɔ ɛmɔ nu a,
me AWURADE yeɛ mefa nyekyire nu meye me nwo ali mekyire ye ɔ;
medwudwo mekyire ye wɔ laleɛ nu.
7 Nakoso Mose deɛ de, ɔtte sɔ;
me maen amukoraati wura ye sa.
8 Ye de megyina ye nyunu me ne ye yɛdwudwo pefee; mendwudwo mengyire ye anyandera nu;
na onwu kyɛbɔ AWURADE ye sue te ɔ.
Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔanzuro kyɛ ɛmɔkodwudwo bekotia me somvoɛ Mose ɔ?” 9AWURADE fɛle bɛ so yaa paa, na ofili bɛ berɛ hɔle.
10Munungum ne fili ɛtena sua ne aso hɔle ne, né kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ Miriam maa ye nwo ayɛ horaenn kyɛ asukɔtwea. Aarɔn pɛnene ye nye neane Miriam, na onwuni kyɛ kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ ye. 11Yeɛ Aarɔn sele Mose kyɛ, “Ao, me mene, nnɛtwe yɛ so wɔ bɔne bɔ yali ngwaseasɛm yayɔ ye anwo. 12Nnɛmaa Miriam yɛ kyɛ baa bɔ bapɔ ye ɔ, bɔ ofi oni kunu wale ne, né ye nwonaen bue asɛkye dada ɔ.” 13Na Mose sũ frɛle AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, sa ye anwonyerɛ.” 14Nakoso AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔse fele nwɔserɛ guale ye nyunu a, aso ahaa ye nyunu ngogua ase ɛlɛsoo? Maa bɛye ye maa ɔɔtena asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo, ná ye si né basa bafa ye bawa asikyeleɛ ne anu.” 15Yiti bɛyele Miriam bɛhɔle asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo; na mmenia ne andoa ateetulɛ ne aso maa odwuli kyɛ besa bɛfale Miriam bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu ɔ. 16Ɛhe asi ye, mmenia ne tuli bɛ bo fili Haserote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Paran ɛserɛ ne aso.

Title: NUMERI 13
Content:
Bɛsoma maentetɛlɛfoɛ
(Deuteronomi 1.19-33)
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Soma mmenia maa bɛɛtetɛ Kanaan aseɛ bɔ méfa méma Yisraelfoɛ ne. Ye sona ko fi b’abusua kure biala anu, bɔ ɔte abusua kure ne anu mbanyi nemɔ ko ɔ.” 3Yiti Mose somane bɛ fili Paran ɛserɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne. Né bɛ nu biala te Yisraelfoɛ nu sona titire. 4Bɛ dumaa mɔ ɛhe: Ruben abusua kure nu deɛ ole Sakure awa Samua; 5Simeon abusua kure nu deɛ ole Hori awa Safate; 6Yuda abusua kure nu deɛ ole Yefune awa Kalebo; 7Yisaka abusua kure nu deɛ ole Yosef awa Yigale; 8Efraim abusua kure nu deɛ ole Nun awa Hosea; 9Benyamin abusua kure nu deɛ ole Rafu awa Palti; 10Sebulɔn abusua kure nu deɛ ole Sodi awa Gadiɛl; 11Yosef abusua kure nu (Manase abusua kure nu) deɛ ole Susi awa Gadi; 12Dan abusua kure nu deɛ ole Gemali awa Amiɛl; 13Asɛ abusua kure nu deɛ ole Mikayɛl awa Seture; 14Nafetali abusua kure nu deɛ ole Wofesi awa Nahebi; 15Gade abusua kure nu deɛ ole Maki awa Gewel. 16Mmienzua bɔ Mose somane bɛ kyɛ bɛɛtetɛ maen ne, bɛ dumaa mɔ ɛne. Na Mose sesane Nun awa Hosea ye dumaa yɛle ye Yosua.
17Mose somane bɛ kyɛ bɛɛtetɛ Kanaan aseɛ ne, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔfa ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛfo bɛhɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, 18ná ɛmɔɔnea kyɛbɔ aseɛ ne osi te ɔ; kyɛ so mmenia ne bɛ nwo yɛ se anaa bɛ nwo nyɛ se; kyɛ banzo anaa bɛsone; 19kyɛ aseɛ bɔ bɛte so ne ɔte paa anaa ɔtte mayee; kyɛ bɛ nguro bɔ bɛtete so ne bɛttole bɛ nwo fasue anaa bato bɛ nwo fasue; 20ɔne kyɛ aseɛ ne ɔkye aleɛ anaa ɔngye aleɛ; kyɛ mmakaa wɔ so anaa mmakaa nne so. Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ hue yɛ se, ná ɛ́mɔfa aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa ne bie bɛ́bra.” Né sɔ mmerɛ ne te mmerɛ bɔ bobe ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔboro ɔ.
21Yiti bɛhɔle bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne fi Sen ɛserɛ ne aso maa oodwuli Rehobo bɔ opingye Lebo Hamate ne. 22Bɛfo bɛɛfale ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso. Beedwuli Hebron, na berɛ yeɛ né Anake bosofoɛ Ahiman, Sesayi ɔne Talmae bɛte ɔ. (Bɛkyekyele Hebron ɔ, afoɛ nzoo koraka yeɛ bɛkyekye Soan bɔ ɔwɔ Misraim ne ɔ.) 23Beedwuli Ɛseko bɔnza ne anu, bɛpɛle bobe mmaen ko bɔ wasu betire biribiraa ko ɔ wɔ berɛ, na bɛ nu nyɔ fa tole mbuna so bɛsoale. Afei koso bɛtetele akengaa ne borɔdoma bɛbokale so bɛwale. 24Bɛfrɛle berɛ Ɛseko bɔnza, ɔnate bobe betire biribiraa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ pɛle ye berɛ ne ati.
Maentetɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɔ b’amaneɛ
25Ye eleburanna ne aso, befili nekaa bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne besa bɛwale. 26Bɛwale Mose ne Aarɔn ɔne Yisrael maen amukoraa berɛ wɔ Kadese bɔ ɔwɔ Paran ɛserɛ ne aso ne. Bɛfale amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle bɛ ne maen ne amukoraa, na bɛfale aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa ne behyirele bɛ. 27Bɛbɔle Mose amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yɛɛdwuli aseɛ bɔ ɛsomane yɛ wɔ so ne aso. Nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, na so mmakaammaa ne bie ɛhe. 28Nakoso mmenia bɔ bɛtete aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛ nwo yɛ se. Bato ɛwaen bafa bɛ nguro nemɔ anwo, na nguro nemɔ te mbiri. Asa koso, yɛnwuni Anake bosofoɛ nemɔ wɔ berɛ. 29Amalɛkefoɛ nemɔ bɛte ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso; Hitifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ, ɔne Amorifoɛ nemɔ bɛte mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, yeɛ Kanaanfoɛ te mboanoa ne asue Yɔɔdan noa.”
30Nakoso Kalebo tuli mmenia ne noa dwirɛ guale wɔ Mose nyunu, na ɔhane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔma yɛhã yɛ nwo yɛhɔ kekesaala ye yɛɛfa aseɛ ne, ofikyɛ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔho yɛkɔfa.” 31Yeɛ mmienzua bɔ bɛ ne ye hɔle ne hane kyɛ, “Yɛngɔhora yɛne mmenia hemɔ ngɔho, ofikyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se tra yɛ.” 32Yiti bɛfale aseɛ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle ne nwo amaneɛ tɛɛ bɛɛbɔle Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Aseɛ bɔ yɛɛtetɛle yɛhyinini so ne, ɔte aseɛ bɔ ɔngye aleɛ mma so ama nnya bie benni ɔ. Na mmenia bɔ yɛnwuni bɛ berɛ ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛte kwabranoa paa. 33 Yɛnwuni Nefilifoɛ wɔ berɛ (Anakefoɛ te Nefilifoɛ mɔ bosofoɛ); na yɛnea yɛ nwo a, né yɛte kyɛ torɔka mɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ koso benwu yɛ ɔ.”

Title: NUMERI 14
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ dwɔso tia AWURADE
1Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛteateane nu serɛserɛ, na besuni sɔ kɔngɔen ne. 2Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose ne Aarɔn so. Maen ne amukoraa sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛwuwuli wɔ Misraim aseɛ so po a, ahaa ɔte paa! Sɛ yɛwuwuli wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso po a, ahaa ɔte paa! 3 Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE ɔfa yɛ ba aseɛ he aso maa yɛbatotɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa ye? Yɛ ye mɔ ne yɛ mma mɔ kɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ. Sɛ yɛsa yɛ si yɛkɔ Misraim a, aso ahaa ɔtte paa mma yɛ?” 4Yiti besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛpena safohene maa oli yɛ nyunu ɔfa yɛ sá hɔ Misraim.”
5Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase wɔ Yisrael maen amukoraa bɔ babɔ dwaa ne nyunu. 6Na Nun awa Yosua ɔne Yefune awa Kalebo, bɔ bɛboka mmenia bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne aso ne, besunzuale bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ndaadeɛ nu, 7na besele Yisrael maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “Aseɛ bɔ yɛɛtetɛle yɛhyinini so ne, ɔte aseɛ paa paa. 8Sɛ AWURADE do yɛ a, aseɛ he bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ye, ɔkɔfa yɛ kɔhɔ so ná wafa wama yɛ. 9Mmom, nnɛma ɛmɔdwɔso betia AWURADE, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsuro aseɛ ne aso ama, ofikyɛ bɛte yɛ sa nu ngwadaa koraa. AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne, waye ye sa wafi bɛ bo, nakoso yɛ de, AWURADE gyi yɛ si; nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ.” 10Nakoso maen ne amu yɛle b’adwene kyɛ bɛkɔboro bɛ nyɔboɛ.
Yeɛ AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu hyirele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa. 11 Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ kobu me animtia maa okoodwu kyinzu? Nzɛngyerɛnneɛ amukoraa bɔ mayɔ mama bɛ ye asi ye, kyinzu yeɛ bekole me bekoli ɔ? 12Ngɔfa ewue anwonyerɛ ngɔto bɛ so ná mapo bɛ, na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ maen bɔ ɔte piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ se tra bɛ ɔ.”
Mose srɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ
13Nakoso Mose sele AWURADE kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, Misraimfoɛ kɔte, ofikyɛ wɔ tumi yeɛ ɛfa yele mmenia hemɔ fili bɛ nu ɔ, 14na bɛkɔhã bekohyire aseɛ ye aso ama. Bate ye kyɛ wɔ AWURADE ɛne mmenia hemɔ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; ofikyɛ wɔ AWURADE, bɛ nye bɔ wɔ nyunu, na wɔ munungum mundu bɛ so. Ɛfa munungum ningɔnn nu edi bɛ nyunu eyia, yeɛ kɔngɔen ɛfa see ningɔnn nu edi bɛ nyunu. 15Na sɛ eku mmenia ye amukoraa kyɛbɔ eku sona horɛ ne a, ye de maen maen bɔ bate wɔ nga ne kɔha kyɛ, 16‘Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ndaen kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma mmenia nemɔ ne, wangora wamva bɛ wangɔandwu so, yiti yeɛ wahũhũ bɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso ye.’ 17Yiti mesrɛ wɔ AWURADE, wɔ tumi piri ne, maa ɔla ali kyɛbɔ ɛhyɛle bɔ ne, bɔ ɛhane kyɛ,
18‘AWURADE ahone nhu ndɛ,
na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi sone;
ɔfa amumuyɛɛ ne mmeraatolɛ kyɛ,
nakoso ɔmma sona bɔ odi fɔ ne, ɔmva ye nwo tɔtorɔtɔɔ;
ɔprapra seɛ mɔ bɔne nwo asohwenɛ
gua bɛ boso ama mɔ so,
maa okodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nza ne nna so.’
19Wɔ ɔdɔ pindinn ne, kyɛbɔ osi te piri ne, fa wɔ nye to ná fa mmenia ye b’amumuyɛɛ kyɛ bɛ, kyɛbɔ afa ahyɛ bɛ fi Misraim maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.”
20Yeɛ AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Mafa mahyɛ bɛ kyɛbɔ asrɛ ne ala. 21Nakoso, kyɛ nde ase ye, ɔne kyɛ AWURADE animnyam koyi aseɛ ye aso amukoraa tɛkyɛɛ ye, 22 mmenia ye mɔ bɔ banwu m’animnyam ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ nyɔle ye wɔ Misraim ɛserɛ ne aso, nakoso baso me banea pɛen buru, ná bandie me dwirɛ ne, 23bɛ nu biala ngonwu aseɛ bɔ ndale ye nwo ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ nana mɔ ne. Bɛ bɔ bebuli me animtia ne, bɛ nu biala ngonwu aseɛ ne. 24Nakoso me somvoɛ Kalebo de, ɔnate kyɛ ye suban deɛ te sonongo ná wali nahorɛ wama me ne ati, ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔhɔle so ne aso, na aseɛ ne kɔyɛ ye boso ama bɛ deɛ. 25Na afei, ɔnate kyɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɛte bɔnza nemɔ anu ne ati, ɛhema ɛ́mɔkakyi bɛ nwo ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nye behyire Ɛpo kɔkorɛ atee ne aso bɛhɔ ɛserɛ ne aso dɔ.”
26Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 27“Mmenia amumuyɛɛfoɛ ye, bɛkɔpenepene bɛ komvi bekogua me so maa okoodwu kyinzu? Mate Yisraelfoɛ bɛ komvi bɔ bɛpenepenene beguale me so ne. 28Se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Kyɛ nde ase ye, edwirɛ mɔ bɔ mate kyɛ ɛmɔaha ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔfa ngoli ɛmɔ ɔ. 29 Ɛserɛ ye aso yeɛ ɛmɔkowu bekogua ɔ, na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛhale ɛmɔ ne, ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ, bɔ wapenepene ye komvi wagua me so ne, 30ɛmɔ nu ko po ngodwu aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔɔtena so ne aso, sana Yefune awa Kalebo ɔne Nun awa Yosua. 31Na ɛmɔ mma mmaa mmaa bɔ ɛmɔnwa bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure ne, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔhɔ aseɛ ne aso maa bekonwu aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔato ye nwo ne. 32Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkowuwu bekogua ɛserɛ ye aso. 33 Na ɛmɔ mma mɔ de, bɛkɔyɛ mmoaenneafoɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna. Na ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔanne me banni ne ati, bekonwu amaneɛ toonn kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔ nu sona bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo kowu kɔla ɛserɛ so ɔ. 34Ngyẽa eleburanna yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ ngyẽa ne somaa te ne, ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ kɔbɔ ɛmɔ ti so afoɛ aburanna, bɔ kyẽa ko biala gyi berɛ ma afoɛ ko ɔ; na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛbɔ me yaafɛlɛ si te ɔ. 35Me, AWURADE, yeɛ mahã ɔ. Amba ngɔyɔ ɛhe ngotia mmenia atianuserɛfoɛ bɔ bɛ mukoraa babɔ porɛ bayɛ lɔen batia me ye. Bɛ mukoraa bɛ boso konua ɛserɛ ye aso, na berɛ yeɛ bekowuwu ɔ.’ ”
36Mmenia bɔ Mose somane bɛ maa bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne, bɔ besa bɛwale bɛɛbɔle aseɛ ne nwo amaneɛ tɛɛ maa yiti maen ne amukoraa bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose so ne, 37mmenia bɔ bɛɛbɔle aseɛ ne anwo amaneɛ tɛɛ ne, ewue te pene bɛ so maa bewuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 38Na mmenia bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ nen, Nun awa Yosua ɔne Yefune awa Kalebo angome yeɛ bɛhale ɔ.
39Mose hane edwirɛ hemɔ hyirele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa ne, besuni hahii. 40Bedwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutututu bɛhɔle mmokaa aseɛ ne ati afia, na besele kyɛ, “Yɛ ɛhe. Yɛkɔhɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE fa hyɛle yɛ bɔ ne, ofikyɛ yayɔ bɔne.” 41Nakoso Mose sele kye, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔtɛbu AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so ye? Sɔ ngɔboka ɛmɔ. 42Nnɛma ɛmɔsi nu bɛkɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE aye ye sa wafi ɛmɔ bo. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo ate ma ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ kuku ɛmɔ. 43Ofikyɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ kɔfa koɛ kɔtoa ɛmɔ wɔ dɔ, na ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa. Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen ne ati, AWURADE ngogyina ɛmɔ si.” 44Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né AWURADE apam alaka ne, ɔne Mose bɛtɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ de, nakoso Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo kyɛ bɛfo bɛkɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ. 45Yeɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne beeyiale bɛ ɔ. Belili Yisraelfoɛ so ngonim, na bɛfoane bɛ toonn beedwuli Hɔma.

Title: NUMERI 15
Content:
Afɔleɛ ahoroɔ nwo mmeraa
1Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔbadwu aseɛ bɔ mefa mema ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔtena so ne aso, 3ná ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bɛma AWURADE a, kyɛ kaka ne ofi nandwie kure nu oo, anaa mmoaen kure nu oo, kyɛ ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ oo anaa afɔleɛ biala oo; sɛ ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa betua aboadeɛ, anaakyɛ ɔte akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ, anaa sɛ ɛmɔdi ɛmɔ aluolue bɔ mahyehyɛ mama ɛmɔ ne a, bɔ ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona a, 4ye de ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ sɔ afɔleɛ ne ma AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ɔbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ koso boka so. Ɔ́fa aburoo esam paa olonka ko bɔ bafa ngoo towaa ko ne bue bafra ye ɔ. 5Afei koso, boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala, fa bobe nzaa towaa ko ne bue yɛ anonneɛ afɔleɛ boka naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ ne aso. 6Boaen nyii de, fa aburoo afɔleɛ esam paa olonka nyɔ bɔ bafa ngoo towaa ko ne bue bafra ye ɔ boka so, 7ná fa bobe nzaa towaa nyɔ bɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ. 8Sɛ ɛfa nandwie nyii bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ biala a, kyɛ ɛfa tua aboadeɛ oo, anaakyɛ ɛfa bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ma AWURADE oo, 9ye de fa ɛhemɔ boka nandwie nyii ne aso: aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte esam paa olonka nza bɔ bafa ngoo towaa nza ne bue bafra ɔ, 10na fa bobe nzaa towaa nza ne bue bɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ wɔ see so, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.
11Nandwie biala, anaa boaen nyii biala, anaa boaen akrɔngrɔma nyii biala anaa abɔngye nyii biala bɔ ɛfa bɔ afɔleɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ ɔ. 12Kyɛbɔ ngaka bɔ ɛfa bɔ afɔleɛ ne bɛ somaa te ne, odi kyɛ ɛfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ boka bɛ nu biala so. 13Yisrael maen baa biala, sɛ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona a, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ye ɔ. 14 Sɛ ɛwɔfoɛ bie waasikye ɛmɔ, anaakyɛ waatena ɛmɔ nu ná okuro kyɛ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona a, odi kyɛ ɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ala. 15Yisraelfoɛ de, ahyɛdeɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma ɛmɔ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ baatena ɛmɔ nu ne ɔ; odi kyɛ ɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nu. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛwɔfoɛ ne bɛyɛ pɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 16Mmeraa komapɛ ne ala ne nhyehyɛleɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu ne odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi so ɔ.”
17 AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 18“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔkodwu aseɛ bɔ mefa ɛmɔ mekɔ so ne aso a, 19mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkoli aseɛ ne aso aleɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfa akyɛdeɛ bɛ́brɛ AWURADE. 20Mɔle bɔ ofi aburoo bɔ ɛmɔkoli moa bekobu nu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bie bɛyɔ taterɛ bɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ AWURADE. Ɛ́mɔfa bɛbrɛ ye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔfa akyɛdeɛ bɔ ofi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo bɛbrɛ ye ne. 21Wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu, aburoo bɔ ɛmɔkoli moa bekobu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bie bɛ́yɔ mɔle bɛ́fa bɛ́yɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛ́brɛ AWURADE.
Bɔne bɔ bɛmmoa pa nwo afɔleɛ
22 Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanhyɛ da, ná sɛ ɛmɔanni mmeraa dwirɛ hemɔ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE aha ahyire Mose ne aso a, 23nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so wahyɛ, ofi kyẽa bɔ AWURADE mane ɛmɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu, 24ná sɛ ɛmɔanhyɛ da yeɛ ɛmɔbuli so bɔ maen ne nze ye nwo hwee a, ye de odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraati bɛfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne, ná bɛ́fa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. 25Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne pata ma Yisrael maen ne amu, na AWURADE kɔfa bɛ bɔne kɔhyɛ bɛ. Banhyɛ da, yeɛ afei babɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bama AWURADE, na babɔ bɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate bɛ mvomsoɛ ti. 26AWURADE kɔfa Yisrael maen ne amukoraati ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena bɛ nu ne, bɛ bɔne kɔhyɛ bɛ, ofikyɛ mmenia ne amu yeɛ bɛyɔle mvomsoɛ ne ɔ.
27 Sona biala bɔ wanhyɛ da ná ɔkɔyɔ bɔne ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye beleɛ bɔ wali afoɛ ko ɔ ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. 28Sɛ ebie anhyɛ da ná ɔyɔ mvomsoɛ a, ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma sɔ sona ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na AWURADE kɔfa ye mvomsoɛ kɔhyɛ ye. 29Ɛ́mɔma mmeraa komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma ebiala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ mvomsoɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɔte Yisrael maen baa oo, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ biala bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu oo. 30Nakoso ebiala bɔ ye nye la ye nwo ná ɔkɔyɔ bɔne ne, kyɛ ɔte maen baa oo, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ oo, wabu AWURADE animtia, na odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi ye mmenia nu. 31Ɔnate kyɛ sɔ sona ne wabu AWURADE noa dwirɛ animtia, ná wabu ye mmeraa dwirɛ so ne ati, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue korakora, na ye musue kɔbɔ ye ti so.”
Afofikyẽa tonɛ nwo asohwenɛ
32Mmerɛ bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ne, afofikyẽa bie, benwuni kyɛ biaa bie obubu eyein ɔ. 33Mmenia bɔ benwuni kyɛ obubu eyein ne fale ye wale Mose, Aarɔn ɔne maen ne amukoraati bɛ nyunu. 34Bɛfale ye bɛtole kuku nu, ofikyɛ né bennya bennwuni bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ye ɔ. 35Yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ beku biaa ne; ma mmenia ne amukoraa bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ.” 36Mmenia ne amukoraa bɛfale ye bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne asi, na bɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala.
Ndaadeɛ noa nwonɛ
37AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 38 “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, wɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu, odi kyɛ bɛnwo nikyee besinzesinze bɛ ndaadeɛ noa, ná bɛ́fa nyamaa bibire bɛ́sosɔ nningyein bɔ bafa basinzesinze ye noa ne anu. 39Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa sɔ nningyein ne besinzesinze ye noa, amaa sɛ ɛmɔnwu ye a, ɛmɔakaye AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa ná ɛmɔali so, ná ɛmɔanni ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ ɔne nningyein bɔ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nyemene si. 40Na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔkɔkaye me mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraati ná ɛmɔali so, amaa ɛmɔayɛ krongron bama ɛmɔ Nyameɛ. 41Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, bɔ me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.”

Title: NUMERI 16
Content:
Kora, Datan ne Abiram yɛ lɔen
1 Kora baba ole Yisare bɔ ye baba ole Kohate bɔ ye koso ye baba ole Lewi ne. Eliabo mma Datan ne Abiram, yeɛ Pelete awa On bɔ bɛte Ruben bosofoɛ ne, Kora ne bɛ bɛfale 2Yisraelfoɛ mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu, bɔ bɛte maen mbanyi, bɔ bapa nu baye bɛ, bɔ bɛte atitirefoɛ ɔ, na bɛhɔle Mose so. 3Bɛyɛle lɔen betiale Mose ne Aarɔn, na besele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔduo boɛ! Maen ne anu mmenia amu te krongron, ebiala te krongron, na AWURADE gyi bɛ si. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafo batena AWURADE mmenia kɔme so ɔ?” 4Mose tele ɛhe ne, ɔfale ye nyunu butuli ase. 5 Na osele Kora ne ye lɔen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛhema ngyerɛmɔ, AWURADE kɔmaa yɛkonwu sona horɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE deɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔkɔpene so maa okopingye ye ɔ. Sona bɔ AWURADE kɔnea nu kɔye ye ne, ɔkɔmaa okopingye ye. 6Wɔ Kora, ɛne wɔ lɔen, bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ hɔ ɛhe: ɛ́mɔfa see kulie mɔ. 7Ɛhema ɛ́mɔfa see begua bɛ nu, na ɛ́mɔfa ɛyɛɛ bégua so wɔ AWURADE nyunu. Na sona bɔ AWURADE kɔnea nu kɔye ye ne, ye yeɛ ɔte krongronniɛ ne ɔ. Ɛmɔ Lewifoɛ, ɛmɔduo boɛ!” 8Yeɛ Mose sele Kora kyɛ, “Afei ɛmɔ Lewifoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie! 9Aso ɔte nikyee ba ma ɛmɔ, kyɛ Yisrael Nyameɛ waneanea Yisraelfoɛ nu waye ɛmɔ, ná wama ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔbra ye nyunu bɛɛyɔ AWURADE nyianu sua ne anu adwuma, ná ɛmɔgyina maen ne anyunu bɛso bɛ ɔ? 10Wama wɔ ne eliɛma mɔ Lewifoɛ amukoraa ate ama ɛmɔawa ye nyunu; nakoso afei de ɛmɔpere asɔfo adwuma ne bɛboka so! 11Yiti ɛne wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛboka wɔ so ne amukoraa, ɛmɔayɔ AWURADE nwo lɔen. Aarɔn ole nwa bɔ ɛmɔpenepene bɛ komvi begua ye so ye?”
12Mose somane maa bɛɛfrɛle Eliabo mma Datan ne Abiram; nakoso besele kyɛ, “Yɛngɔwa! 13Aso ɔte edwirɛ baa kyɛ aaye yɛ afi aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ɔ so, kyɛ ɛbaahu yɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso, bɔ yeɛ esa hyɛ yɛ so ɔ? 14Wala ali pefee kyɛ nna aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ɔ so yeɛ afa yɛ awa ɔ, yeɛ ɛmma yɛnnyane agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔte aseɛ ne bobe boo ɔ. Nna ɛlakalɛ yeɛ ɛlakalaka mmenia ye ɔ? Yɛngɔwa!”
15Mose fɛle yaa paa, na osele AWURADE kyɛ, “Nnɛde b’afɔleɛ ne to nu. Nnnele afunum ko po mmvili bɛ berɛ, yeɛ nnyɔle bɛ nu biala tɛɛ.” 16Afei Mose sele Kora kyɛ, “Ɛne wɔ lɔen ne amukoraa, ɛhema ɛmɔɔgyina AWURADE nyunu, ɛne bɛ ne Aarɔn; 17ná ma ɛmɔ nu biala ɔ́fa ye see kulie ne, ɔ́fa ɛyɛɛ ogua so, ná ɛmɔ nu biala ɔ́fa ye see kulie ne ɔ́bra AWURADE nyunu: see kulie ne amu te ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu. Wɔ koso, ɛne Aarɔn ebiala ɔ́fa ye see kulie deɛ.” 18Yiti ebiala fale ye see kulie, bɛfale see beguale nu, bɛfale ɛyɛɛ beguale so, na bɛ ne Mose ne Aarɔn beegyinane ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.
19Yeɛ Kora boaboale maen ne amukoraa noa maa begyinane Mose ne Aarɔn bɛ ndendeneɛ so wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Na AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali hyirele maen ne amu.
20Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 21“Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔfra sɔ ɛlɔen he anu, na mebaanua bɛ boso kekesaala ye.” 22Na Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase, na besele kyɛ, “O Nyameɛ, anwoɔnaen amukoraa bɛ sunzum Nyameɛ, aso sona ko yɔ bɔne maa ɔnate so ɛfɛ maen ne amukoraa so yaa anaa?”
23Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 24“Ka kyire ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi Kora, Datan ne Abiram b’atenaleɛ nwo.”
25Yiti Mose dwɔsole hɔle Datan ne Abiram berɛ. Na Yisrael mbanyi lili ye si. 26Mose sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi amumuyɛɛfoɛ hemɔ b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anwo. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo ka bɛ nikye fee; anyɔ a, ɔnate bɛ bɔne amukoraa ti AWURADE konua ɛmɔ aboso.” 27Yiti bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili Kora, Datan ne Abiram b’atenaleɛ nemɔ anwo. Na Datan ne Abiram ne bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mma mɔ, ɔne bɛ nnomaa mɔ befitele beegyinane b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anoa nu. 28Yeɛ Mose sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me kyɛ mmanyɔ sɔ nningyein he amu ɔ; na mmom nna me bɔbɔ yeɛ medi me ti piri ɔ. 29Sɛ mmenia hemɔ bewu bɛ bɔbɔ b’ɛdangama wue, anaa sɛ bɔ ɔto kuro sona biala yeɛ ɔto bɛ a, ye de nna AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɔ. 30Nakoso sɛ AWURADE yɔ anwanwadeɛ bie, ná aseɛ bukye ye noa nu meme bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama amukoraa ɔne bɛ nwo nningyein amukoraa, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ nye gua so maa bɛkɔ ɛborɔ a, ye de ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ mmenia hemɔ abu AWURADE animtia.”
31Mose noa pene pɛ, aseɛ bɔ sɔ mmenia nemɔ gyigyi so ne anu dwale. 32Aseɛ bukyele ye noa nu, na ɔmemene bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama: ebiala bɔ né ɔte Kora nwoniɛ, ɔne nikyee biala bɔ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ. 33Yiti bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama amukoraa bɛhɔle ɛborɔ dɔ bɔ né bɛ nye gua so ɔ. Aseɛ ne ha tuale katale bɛ so, na bɛ boso nuane fili maen ne anu. 34Ɔnate kyɛ Kora mɔ né bɛbɔ awuye ne ati, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ né bapɛ bayia berɛ ne, bɛnwatili, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Aseɛ ne kɔme yɛ koso!” 35Na see fili AWURADE berɛ ɔɔyerale mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu bɔ né bɛbɔ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ ne.
36AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 37“Ka kyire ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa kyɛ ɔyeye see kulie nemɔ ofi see bɔ ogye ne anu; ná to see ne pete dededede. 38Amumuyɛɛfoɛ hemɔ bɛ see kulie nemɔ ayɛ krongron, ofikyɛ bafa bɛ ngoa bapɛ so. Yiti maa bɛboro bɛ ma bɛyɛ taataa ná bɛ́fa bɛ́yɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngatasoɛ, ofikyɛ bafa bawa AWURADE nyunu maa bayɛ krongron. Na ngatasoɛ nemɔ kɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ. 39Yiti mmenia bɔ bɛyerale nemɔ bɛ kɔɔbere kulie mɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛwale ne, ɔsɔfo Eleasa fale, na bɛborole bɛ taataa bɛfa bɛyɛle afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngatasoɛ. 40Ɛhe te ngayeɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so ha hyirele Eleasa ne, nnɛma eboosiniɛ biala bɔ nna Aarɔn bosoniɛ ahɔ ɔ, ɔba afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo kyɛ ɔbaayera ɛyɛɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, amaa bɔ ɔtole Kora ne ye lɔen ne bie wando ye.
41Nakoso aleɛ hyene ne, maen ne amukoraati bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose ne Aarɔn so kyɛ, “Ɛmɔahu AWURADE mmenia.” 42Na maen ne yɛle bɛ nwo lɔen beyiele nen, Mose ne Aarɔn kakyili bɛ nye behyirele ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne. Né munungum ne amundu so, na né AWURADE animnyam aye ye nwo ali. 43Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn wale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu, 44na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 45“Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi sɔ lɔen he anwo maa nua bɛ boso kekesaala ye.” Na Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase. 46Yeɛ Mose sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Fa wɔ see kulie ne, fa afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu see ne bie gua nu, fa ɛyɛɛ gua nu, ná fa kɔ maen ne berɛ ndɛndɛ kɔpata ma bɛ. Ofikyɛ AWURADE afɛ ɛyaa hahii; amaneɛ piri ne ahyɛ ye bo.” 47Yiti Aarɔn fale see kulie ne kyɛbɔ Mose hyɛle ye ne, na ole amirika hɔle mmenia ne afia, bɛ nu nekaa bɔ né amaneɛ piri ne ahyɛ ye bo ne. Ɔyerale ɛyɛɛ ne, na ɔpatale mane maen ne. 48Ogyinane mmenia bɔ bawu ne mmenia bɔ bɛte ase nemɔ afia; na amaneɛ piri ne bo pɛle. 49Bɛ bɔ bewuwuli wɔ amaneɛ piri ne anu ne, bɛ somaa te apee buru ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nzoo, asora bɛ bɔ bewuli wɔ Kora ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne anu ne. 50Amaneɛ piri ne bo pɛle ne, Aarɔn sa wale Mose berɛ wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anoa nu berɛ.

Title: NUMERI 17
Content:
Aarɔn pɔmaa ne fefɛ
1Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ maa bɛma wɔ pɔmaa buru ne nyɔ. Dé fi bɛ bɔ betua bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ne amukoraa bɛ dɔ; bɛ bɔ betua bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ne, ebiala ye deɛ ko. Kyerɛ ebiala ye dumaa gua ye pɔmaa nwo, 3na kyerɛ Aarɔn dumaa gua Lewi pɔmaa deɛ anwo. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ otua bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa biala, odi kyɛ onya pɔmaa ko. 4Fa gua ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu wɔ Adanzeɛ ne anyunu, nekaa bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛyia ne. 5Na sona bɔ ngɔneanea nu ngɔye ye ne, ye pɔmaa deɛ kɔfefɛ. Na ɔnate so ngɔma Yisraelfoɛ bɛ komvi bɔ bɛpenepene begua ɛmɔ so daa biala ne, ye bo kɔpɛ.” 6Mose ha hyirele Yisraelfoɛ, na bɛ mbanyi nemɔ amu bɛmane ye pɔmaa: panyi biala deɛ ko, pɔmaa buru ne nyɔ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ, na né Aarɔn pɔmaa deɛ boka bɛ deɛ ne aso. 7Yiti Mose fale pɔmaa nemɔ guale AWURADE nyunu wɔ apam ɛtena sua ne anu.
8Aleɛ hyene ne, mmerɛ bɔ Mose hɔle apam ɛtena sua ne anu ne, né Aarɔn ye pɔmaa bɔ ɔte Lewi sasofoɛ bɛ pɔmaa ne wafefɛ. Né wabɔ nyerɛen, wanya nyaa, na wasu atonwaa bɔ waboro ɔ. 9Yeɛ Mose sesale pɔmaa nemɔ amu fili AWURADE nyunu fitele, na ɔfa brɛle Yisraelfoɛ amu. Bɛneane nu, na ebiala yele ye pɔmaa deɛ. 10Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Sá fa Aarɔn pɔmaa ne baato Adanzeɛ ne nyunu, maa ɔbɔ ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kɔkɔ, bɔ ɔnate so ɛkɔma bɛ komvi bɔ bɛpenepene begua me so ne, ye bo kɔpɛ ɔ, anyɔ sɔ a bekowuwu.” 11Mose yɔle sɔ ala; kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ.
12Yisraelfoɛ sele Mose kyɛ, “Yawu oo, yawu yayie, yɛ mukoraa yawu yayie! 13Ebiala bɔ okopingye AWURADE nyianu sua ne, okowu. Aso odi kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛtotɔ anaa?”

Title: NUMERI 18
Content:
Asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ asɛdeɛ
1AWURADE sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Nekaa krongron ne anu ɛsɔnenɛ ne, bɔne biala ba ye nwo a, ɛne wɔ mma mɔ ne wɔ nana mɔ sasofoɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea bedi ye nwo dwumaa ɔ, yeɛ asɔfo adwuma ne koso, bɔne biala ba ye nwo a, ɛne wɔ mma mɔ ngome yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea bedi ye nwo dwumaa ɔ. 2Yiti fa eliɛma mɔ bɔ bɛte wɔ nana Lewi abusua kure nu ama ne bra maa bɛɛboka wɔ so, ná bɛso wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yeɛ ɛne wɔ mma mɔ ɛmɔwɔ apam ɛtena sua ne anyunu ɔ. 3 Odi kyɛ bɛso wɔ ná bɛyɔ ɛtena sua ne anu adwuma amukoraa. Nakoso onni kyɛ bepingye nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein nemɔ, anaakyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, amaa ɔnate so bɛ ne ɛmɔ, ɛmɔanwuwu. 4Odi kyɛ bɛboka wɔ so bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma, ná bɛ́yɔ adwuma biala bɔ ɔfa ɛtena sua ne anwo ɔ. Nnɛmaa ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ opingye ɛmɔ. 5Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔyɔ nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ne ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo adwuma, amaa ɛyaafɛlɛ piri amma Yisraelfoɛ so ko le. 6Me yeɛ maneanea Yisraelfoɛ nu maye ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ Lewifoɛ ɔ. Bɛte akyɛdeɛ bɛma ɛmɔ, bɔ me AWURADE matu bɛ masie berɛ mama me nwo, kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma ɔ. 7Nakoso ɛne wɔ mma mɔ bɔ bɛboka wɔ so de, ɛ́mɔye ɛmɔ kunu bɛ́yɔ ɛmɔ asɔfo adwuma wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ɔne mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi dɔ nwo ɔ. Mafa asɔfo adwuma ne mahyɛ ɛmɔ. Ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ bɔ ɔkɔwa adwuma ne anwo ne de, odi kyɛ beku ye.”
Asɔfo nemɔ kyɛfa
8AWURADE sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛ me ne, bɔ ɔte Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron amukoraa ne, mafa mawura wɔ sa. Mafa mama wɔ ne wɔ mma kyɛ ɔsɔfo kyɛfa bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ deɛ afebɔɔ ɔ. 9Afɔleɛ krongron paa bɔ banyera bɛ wɔ see nu ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kyɛfa ɔ: b’akyɛdeɛ biala bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ me kyɛ nikyee krongron paa ne, kyɛ ɔte aburoo afɔleɛ oo, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ oo, anaa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ oo, ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ne wɔ mma mɔ deɛ. 10Ɔte nikyee krongron paa, na ɛmɔli. Bienzua biala kora odi bie; ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma ɛmɔ. 11Ɛhe koso te wɔ deɛ: akyɛdeɛ biala bɔ baye bafi Yisraelfoɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ amukoraa nu ɔ. Mafa mama wɔ ne wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua. Ɔte akyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ, ebiala bɔ ye nwo te wɔ w’awuro berɛ ne, ɔkora odi bie. 12Ngoo ne anu paa paa, nzaa ne anu paa paa, ɔne aburoo ne anu paa paa, fieso aleɛ paa paa bɔ bɛfa bɛma AWURADE ne, mafa mama wɔ. 13Fieso aleɛ amukoraa bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔfa wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso, bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛ AWURADE ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ. Ebiala bɔ ye nwo te wɔ w’awuro berɛ ne ɔkora odi bie. 14 Nikyee biala bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE wɔ Yisrael ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ. 15Abɔdeɛ biala, kyɛ sona oo, kyɛ kaka oo, ye bamuɛbaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma AWURADE ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ. Nakoso kuro sona bamuɛbaa mɔ de, odi kyɛ ɛpɔ bɛ, yeɛ ngaka bɔ bɛ nwo nde mɔ bamuɛbaa mɔ koso, odi kyɛ ɛpɔ bɛ. 16Sɛ wali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne a, ye ti nyɔboɛ ne, sese ye ɛdwetɛ sekel nnu kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te ɔ (ɔte gyera aburanyɔ). 17Nakoso nandwie bamuɛbaa, anaa boaen bamuɛbaa, anaa abɔngye bamuɛbaa de, nnɛpɔ bɛ; bɛte krongron. To bɛ mogya ne pete afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, ná yera bɛ loe ne ma ɔyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera ye, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ. 18Nakoso bɛ naen de, ɔte wɔ deɛ, kyɛbɔ ye sa bɔ banwaha ne, ɔne ye sɔ famaa ne te wɔ deɛ ne. 19Afɔleɛ krongron amukoraa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ ma AWURADE ne, mafa mama wɔ ne wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua mɔ. Ɔte ɛmɔ deɛ afebɔɔ. Ɔte ngyee apam afebɔɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ma wɔ ne wɔ bosofoɛ koso.”
20Na AWURADE sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Engonya b’aseɛ ne bie, yeɛ engonya b’agyapadeɛ ne bie. Me yeɛ nde wɔ kyɛfa ne w’agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu ɔ.
21“Nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ Yisrael ne, mafa nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko mama Lewifoɛ.
