Ɛsolɛ bɔ bɛso wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne. 22Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, nnɛma Yisraelfoɛ bepingye ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne, anyɔ a musue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so maa bekowuwu. 23Nakoso odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ adwuma ne ɔ, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mvomsoɛ nwo musue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so. Ɔkɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mukoraati nu. Nakoso bengonya agyapadeɛ biala wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu, 24ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nningyein nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɔ baye basie berɛ bafa babɔ afɔleɛ bama AWURADE ne, mafa mama Lewifoɛ kyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɛne. Yiti mahã mafa bɛ nwo kyɛ bengonya agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu.”
25Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 26“Ka kyire Lewifoɛ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ sa ka buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne befi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, bɔ male mafi bɛ berɛ mama ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ɛne ne a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa nu bie bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE, maa ɔyɛ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne anu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko. 27Odi kyɛ bebu sɔ afɔleɛ ne kyɛ ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ ɛne. Ɔte kyɛ aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ mmenia fa fi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo, ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ofi kumaa bɔ betwi nu nzaa ne ala. 28Yiti buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔde befi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔye bie bésie berɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Nu bie yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbɔ AWURADE afɔleɛ ma ɔsɔfo Aarɔn ye sa ka ye ɔ. 29Akyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔkonya ye ne, nu yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔye AWURADE afɔleɛ amukoraa befi ɔ; na nu bɔ ɔte paa paa ne yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔtu besie berɛ bɛma AWURADE ɔ. 30Sa ka kyire bɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔtu nu bie bɔ ɔte paa paa ne besie berɛ bɛma AWURADE beyie a, ye ngaa ne de ɛ́mɔfa bɛma Lewifoɛ. Ɔte kyɛ aburoo bɔ ofi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo, ɔne nzaa bɔ ofi kumaa bɔ betwi nu nzaa ne ala. 31Ɛmɔkɔhora bekoli ye wɔ nekaa biala, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ awuro ama; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ adwuma bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne. 32Sɛ ɛmɔfa bɔ ɔte paa paa ne bɛma AWURADE a, ye de foɛlilɛ biala ɔnne ɛmɔ so. Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔgua Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron nemɔ anwo fiɛ, ná ɛmɔanwuwu.”

Title: NUMERI 19
Content:
Nandwie mmeleɛ kɔkorɛ nzoen ne
1AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, 2“Mmeraa bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne, ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ ɛhe: Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛ́fa nandwie beleɛ kɔkorɛ bɔ ollili nnɛen, bɔ ngekalewa biala ɔnne ye nwo, bɔ bɛffale kɔnnua biala bɛttole ye kɔme le ɔ bɛ́brɛ wɔ. 3Ɛ́mɔfa nandwie beleɛ ne bɛ́ma ɔsɔfo Eleasa. Odi kyɛ bɛfa nandwie ne bɛkɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi ná beku ye wɔ Eleasa nyunu. 4Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo Eleasa fa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ nandwie mogya ne anu, ná ɔpete ye pɛen nzoo ogua ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu dɔ. 5Odi kyɛ bɛyera nandwie beleɛ ne wɔ Eleasa nyunu berɛ. Bɛ́yera ye nwomaa, ye naen, ye mogya, ɔne ye fure ne. 6Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida, sufiɛ ne adaabene, ná ógyi bɛ gua see bɔ bɛyera nandwie beleɛ ne wɔ nu ne anu. 7Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ, ná ɔfa nzue obia, ná ye si ye wawa asikyeleɛ ne anu; nakoso ɔsɔfo ne nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa. 8Sona bɔ ɔyera nandwie beleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa nzue ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ ná ɔfa nzue obia; ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa. 9Na odi kyɛ sona bie bɔ ye nwo te ɔ sesa nandwie beleɛ nzoen ne, ná ɔ́fa kogua asikyeleɛ ne asi nekaa bɔ berɛ te sannwuu ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa besie bɛma Yisrael maen ne, ná bafa bafra nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ne. Bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo befi bɔne nwo. 10Sona bɔ ɔkɔsesa nandwie beleɛ nzoen ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nningyein, na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa. Ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ kɔla berɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena bɛ nu ɔ.
11Ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sona fuin ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo. 12Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa sɔ nzue ne bie pete ye nwo ma ye nwo te. Nakoso sɛ wambete ye nwo ɛlɛsa ne aso ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso a, ye nwo ngɔte. 13Ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sona fuin, ná wambete ye nwo ne, ɔfa fiɛ ka AWURADE nyianu sua ne. Sɔ sona ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi Yisrael. Ɔnate kyɛ bamva nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛpete bɛ nwo ne bie bambete ye nwo ne ati, ye nwo nde, na ye nwo bɔ wagua fiɛ ne tɛ wɔ berɛ.
14Sɛ sona wu wɔ ɛtena sua nu a, ye wo mmeraa ɛhe: ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ sɔ ɛtena sua ne anu, ɔne ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ sɔ ɛtena sua ne anu ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo. 15Na kukue biala bɔ bamva tire bangata so ne, ye nwo nde. 16Sona biala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ buro ná ye nwo kɔha sona bɔ watɔ ngrandɛ noa, anaa sona bɔ wawu ye ɛdangama wue ye fuin, anaa ye nwo kɔha kuro sona bowue, anaa asieleɛ ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo. 17Na ɔnate kyɛ sɔ sona ne ye nwo agua fiɛ ne ati, odi kyɛ bɛfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɔ bayera ye ne ye nzoen ne bie, ná bɛfa asue nu nzue begua so wɔ kukue nu. 18Odi kyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo te ɔ fa sufiɛ bɔ nzue ne anu, ná ɔ́fa pete ɛtena sua ne anwo, ɔne nu nningyein amukoraa so, ɔne mmenia bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne aso, ɔne ebiala bɔ ye nwo hane bowue ne anaa sona bɔ bahu ye ne, anaa fuin ne, anaa asieleɛ ne. 19Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo te ne fa nzue ne bie pete bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo agua fiɛ nemɔ aso, ná ɔnate so ɔte bɛ nwo ɛlɛsoo ne aso. Afei odi kyɛ bɛpo bɛ ndaadeɛ ná bɛfa nzue bebia, na ye nɔsoa ne bɛ nwo kɔte. 20Sona biala bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ, nakoso bande ye nwo ne, sɔ sona ne odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi mmenia ne anu, ofikyɛ wagua AWURADE nekaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ. Ɔnate kyɛ banhwie nzue krongron ne bangua ye nwo ne ati, ye nwo nde.
21Ɛhe kɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ kɔma bɛ. Sona bɔ ɔpete nzue fa te bɛ nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, na sona biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛpete bɛ nwo ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa. 22Sona bɔ ye nwo nde ne, nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha ye ne, sɔ nikyee ne nwo kogua fiɛ, na ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sɔ nikyee ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.”

Title: NUMERI 20
Content:
Meriba nzue ne
1Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, Yisrael maen ne amukoraa beedwuli Sen ɛserɛ ne aso, na mmenia ne tenane Kadese. Berɛ yeɛ Miriam wuli ɔ, na berɛ yeɛ besiele ye ɔ.
2 Né mmenia ne nnya nzue wɔ berɛ, yiti bɛyɛle Mose ne Aarɔn nwo lɔen. 3Mmenia ne ne Mose nyane edwudwolɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Y’eliɛma nemɔ wuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, yɛ koso yɛwuwuli bie po a ahaa né so apɛ!” 4Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafa AWURADE mmenia bawa ɛserɛ ye aso maa yɛ ne yɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ yɛbaawuwu wɔ wa ye? 5Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafa yɛ bafi Misraim bawa aseɛ tɛɛtɛɛ ye aso ye? Aseɛ ye ngɔhye aburoo anaa borɔdoma anaa bobe anaa akengaa, na nzue bɔ yɛkɔno ɔ po nne wa.” 6Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn fili mmenia ne anu bɛhɔle ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase, na AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali hyirele bɛ. 7AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 8Fa pɔmaa ne, ná ɛne eliɛma Aarɔn bɛboaboa mmenia ne anoa. Bɛ nyunu berɛ ala, ɛ́mɔdwudwo béhyire nyɔbotaen ne maa opu ye nzue bra. Ɛhe kɔmaa ekonya nzue kofi nyɔbotaen ne anu kɔma bɛ; ɔnate so ɛkɔmaa mmenia nemɔ ne bɛ nyɛmmoa konya nzue bɛkɔno.
9Yiti Mose fale pɔmaa ne fili AWURADE nyunu berɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ye ne. 10Mose ne Aarɔn boaboale mmenia ne anoa wɔ nyɔbotaen ne anyunu, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ, ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ! Aso nyɔbotaen he anu yeɛ odi kyɛ yɛnya nzue yɛma ɛmɔ ɔ?” 11Yeɛ Mose pagyale ye sa, na ɔfale ye pɔmaa ne fini nyɔbotaen ne aso pɛen nyɔ. Nzue pu fili nu wale pee, na mmenia nemɔ ne bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ none bie.
12Nakoso AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔanne me banni, ná ɛmɔamma wanna ali wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu kyɛ nde krongron ne ati, ɛmɔngɔfa mmenia hemɔ bengodwu aseɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ ne aso.” 13Ɛhe ole Meriba asue, nekaa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ ne AWURADE nyane dwudwolɛ, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE yele ye krongronyɛlɛ ali ɔ.
Edomfoɛ amma Yisraelfoɛ ate
14Mose tuli ɛbɔfoɛ fili Kadese maa bɛhɔle Edom hene berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Eliɛma Yisrael nwa: Ɛse edwirɛ tɛɛ mɔ bɔ watoto yɛ ne amukoraa. 15Ɛse kyɛbɔ yɛ nana mɔ hɔle Misraim, ɔne kyɛbɔ yɛtenane Misraim yɛhyɛle, ná Misraimfoɛ hyɛle yɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ so ɔ. 16Yɛsu yɛfrɛle AWURADE. Otiele yɛ suɛ, na ɔsomane abɔfo maa ɔɔyele yɛ fili Misraim. Kekesaala ye yɛwɔ Kadese, kuro bɔ ɔwɔ w’aseɛ ne noa ne aso. 17Maa yɛfa w’aseɛ ye aso yɛpɛ nu yɛhɔ. Yɛngɔfa fieso anaa bobe boo nu, yeɛ yɛngɔno abura biala nu nzue. Yɛkɔfa atee bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ɛhene Atimbire ne aso, na yɛngɔmakye yɛngɔhɔ bɛen anaa famaa kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔpɛ nu wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso ɔ.”
18Nakoso Edom buale ye kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa yɛ aseɛ ye aso. Sɛ ɛmɔfa so a, yɛkɔhwe ngrandɛ yɛkɔwa ɛmɔ so.” 19Yisraelfoɛ sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛkɔfa atimbire ne aso ala; na sɛ yɛ ne yɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ, yɛno ɛmɔ nzue po a, ye de yɛkotua ye kerɛ. Ɛhe de ɔnyɛ se; maa yɛbɔ ase yɛpɛ nu yɛhɔ.” 20Nakoso Edom hene sele kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa yɛ aseɛ ye aso.” Yeɛ Edom fale mmenia pee ne ɛlɔen bɔ bɛ nwo ye se wale Yisraelfoɛ so. 21Edom amma Yisrael ate maa wamva ye aseɛ ne aso, yiti Yisrael kakyili ye nwo hɔle.
Aarɔn wue
22Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo befili Kadese, na maen ne amukoraa beedwuli Hore bokaa ne anwo. 23Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn wɔ Hore bokaa ne anwo, bɔ ɔwɔ Edomfoɛ aseɛ ne wɛen so kyɛ, 24“Aarɔn kowu kɔɔtoa ye mbanyi mɔ. Ye gya baa ngotia aseɛ bɔ mafa mama Yisraelfoɛ ne aso, ofikyɛ ɛmɔyɛle m’ahyɛdeɛ nwo asoserɛ wɔ Meriba asue nwo. 25 Fa Aarɔn ne ɔwa Eleasa, ná ɛne bɛ fo bra Hore bokaa ne aso. 26Puro Aarɔn ndaadeɛ ne, ná fa wura ɔwa Eleasa. Nakoso Aarɔn de, okowu kɔɔtoa ye mbanyi mɔ: berɛ yeɛ okowu ɔ.” 27Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala. Bɛfole bɛhɔle Hore bokaa ne aso bɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛ nye tua bɛ ɔ. 28Mose puropurole Aarɔn ndaadeɛ nemɔ, ɔfa wurale ɔwa Eleasa, na Aarɔn wuli wɔ bokaa ne ati afia. Mose ne Eleasa fi bokaa ne aso dwu wale ase. 29Na maen ne amukoraa nwuni kyɛ Aarɔn awu ne, Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa suni ye eleburasa.

Title: NUMERI 21
Content:
Kɔɔbere woo ne
1 Arade hene, bɔ ɔte Kanaanniɛ, bɔ né ɔte ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, ɔtele kyɛ Yisrael nate Atarim atee so ɔba. Ɔne Yisraelfoɛ bɛɛhone, na ɔhyele bɛ nu biemɔ nnure. 2Yeɛ Yisrael hyɛle AWURADE bɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛkɔfa mmenia hemɔ kowura yɛ sa amba a, ye de yɛkɔsɛkye bɛ nguro mɔ bɔkɔɔ.” 3AWURADE tiele Yisrael abisadeɛ ne, na ɔfale Kanaanfoɛ ne wurale bɛ sa. Behuhuni bɛ bɛsɛkyele bɛ nguro nemɔ pasaa; yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Hɔma.
4 Yisraelfoɛ fili Hɔre bokaa ne anwo ne, bɛtoale so bɛfale Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ atee ne aso kyɛ bɛkondo bɛfa Edom aseɛ ne asi; nakoso mmenia ne annya aboterɛ wɔ atunu. 5Yisraelfoɛ dwudwole tiale Nyameɛ ne Mose kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔaye yɛ bafi Misraim aseɛ so kyɛ yɛɛwuwu wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso ye? Ofikyɛ aleɛ ne nzue nne wa, na sɔ aleɛ tɛɛtɛɛ he abɔ yɛ.” 6Yiti AWURADE somane ewoo mɔ bɔ bɛ noa te borɔ maa bɛwale mmenia ne anu, na bɛkekale Yisraelfoɛ maa bɛ nu pee wuwuli. 7Yeɛ mmenia ne wale Mose berɛ beesele kyɛ, “Yayɔ bɔne kyɛ yadwudwo yatia AWURADE, ɔne wɔ ɔ; serɛ AWURADE maa ɔye ewoo nemɔ ofi yɛ wa hɔ.” Yiti Mose pale kyerɛ mane maen ne. 8Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Yɔ ewoo bɔ ye noa te borɔ ɔ ye sɛso, na fa sinze mbuna so. Ebiala bɔ ewoo ne bie aha ye ne, sɛ ɔnea mbuna ne aso ewoo ne a, okonya ngoa.” 9Yiti Mose fale kɔɔbere yɔle ewoo ne. Ɔfa sinzele mbuna so; na sɛ ewoo ka ebie ná sɔ sona ne nea kɔɔbere ewoo ne a, onya ngoa.
Yisraelfoɛ toa so bɛkɔ Moabo
10Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Obote. 11Befili Obote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Yiye Abarim bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo ndendeneɛ so ɛserɛ so ne, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ. 12Befili berɛ ne, besili nu bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Serede bɔnza ne anu. 13Befili berɛ ne, besili nu, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ asue Anɔn ye bue dɔ, wɔ ɛserɛ bɔ ɔtrɛ fi Amorifoɛ ɛwɛen so ne aso; ofikyɛ asue Anɔn yeɛ ɔte Moabo ne Amorifoɛ b’ɛwɛen ɔ. 14Yiti yeɛ baha ye wɔ AWURADE Koɛ Nwo Nwomaa ne anu kyɛ,
“Wahebo bɔ ɔwɔ Sufa ɔne bɔnza nemɔ anu.
Asue Anɔn
15ɔne bɔnza nemɔ ndoroleɛ,
bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ Are aseɛ bɔ mmenia wɔ so,
bɔ ɔla Moabo ɛwɛen so ne.”
16Befili berɛ ne, bɛtoale so bɛhɔle Beɛ, abura bɔ ye nwo berɛ yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Boaboa mmenia ne noa, na ngɔma bɛ nzue” ne. 17Afei Yisrael tole edwein he:
“Abura, pu nzue bra! Ɛ́mɔbɔ bele ye so!
18Abura bɔ mbanyi mɔ tuli ne,
bɔ mmenia nemɔ anu atitire tuli ne,
ɛhɔtɔ ne pɔmaa yeɛ bɛfa betuli ɔ.”
Befili ɛserɛ ne aso bɛhɔle Matana, 19befili Matana bɛhɔle Nahaliɛl, befili Nahaliɛl bɛhɔle Bamote, 20na befili Bamote bɛhɔle bɔnza bɔ ɔla Moabo mbɔtam, bɔ ɔwɔ Pisiga ti afia bɔ ye nye nea ɛserɛ pralaa ne aso ne.
Yisraelfoɛ di Sihon so ngonim
21 Afei Yisrael tuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Amorifoɛ hene Sihon berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, 22“Maa mva w’aseɛ ye aso mbɛ nu ngɔ. Yɛngɔmakye ngɔhɔ fieso anaa bobe boo nu; yɛngɔno abura biala nu nzue. Yɛkɔfa Ɛhene Atimbire ne aso kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔpɛ nu wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso ɔ.” 23Nakoso Sihon amma Yisrael ate maa wamva ye aseɛ ne aso. Sihon boaboale ye mmenia amukoraa noa, na ɔfale koɛ toale Yisrael wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Ɔwale Yahase, na ɔne Yisrael bɛhone. 24Yisrael le ngrandɛ huni ye, na bɛfale ye aseɛ ne fite asue Anɔn kɔpem Yabɔko, toonn kɔpem Amorifoɛ nemɔ dɔ; ofikyɛ né Amorifoɛ nemɔ abɔ b’ɛwɛen ne anwo waen pambee. 25Yisrael fale nguro sɔ ne amukoraati, na Yisraelfoɛ tenatenane Amorifoɛ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so, wɔ Hesebon ne ye nguraa amukoraa nu. 26Ofikyɛ Hesebon te Amorifoɛ hene Sihon ye ahenguro. Né ɔne Moabo hene daa baho maa wale ye aseɛ amukoraa toonn waadwu asue Anɔn. 27Yiti edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ ka kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔbra Hesebon. Maa besa bɛkyekye kuro ne,
maa bɛpagya Sihon kuro ne besie berɛ.
28Ofikyɛ see fili Hesebon wale,
see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi fili Sihon kuro ne anu.
Ɔɔyerale Are bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo,
ɔne asue Anɔn nwo atitirefoɛ.
29Moabo, wɔ yaakɔ!
Mmenia bɔ bɛso bosoen Kemose, ɛmɔ boso anua!
Wama ye mma mmienzua ayɛ akobɔfoɛ,
yeɛ wayakyi ye mma mmrasua mɔ
wama Amori hene Sihon wahye bɛ nnure.
30Yiti bɛ boso anua,
ofi Hesebon bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dibɔn,
na yɛhuhuni bɛ maa oodwuli kyɛ see trɛ hɔle Medeba ɔ.”
31Yiti Yisrael tenane Amorifoɛ aseɛ ne aso. 32Na Mose somane maa bɛɛtetɛle Yasere. Belili Yasere nwo nguraa nemɔ aso ngonim, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛtete aseɛ ne aso ne befili berɛ.
Yisraelfoɛ di Ogo so ngonim
33 Ye si ye, Yisraelfoɛ kakyili bɛ nye bɛfo bɛhɔle Basan atee so. Basan hene Ogo ne ye mmenia amukoraa bɛfale koɛ beeyiale Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Yedrei. 34Nakoso AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro ye, ofikyɛ mafa ye mawura wɔ sa, ɔne ye mmenia amukoraa ne ye aseɛ amukoraa. Na kyɛbɔ ɛyɔle Amori hene Sihon bɔ né odi bia wɔ Hesebon ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔyɔ ye ɔ.” 35Yiti Yisraelfoɛ huni Ogo ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, ɔne ye mmenia ne amukoraa, bɔ yeɛ sona komapɛ po wanga ɔ. Na bɛfale ye aseɛ ne bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ.

Title: NUMERI 22
Content:
Balake fa amoenwaa soma Balaam
1 Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ asue Yɔɔdan si bɔ opingye Yeriko ne aso. 2Né Sipore awa Balake anwu nningyein amukoraa bɔ Yisrael afa ayɔ Amorifoɛ ɔ. 3Moabo surole Yisrael maen ne paa, ofikyɛ né bɛsone pee. Na Yisraelfoɛ nwo suronyi tɔle Moabo so. 4Yeɛ Moabo sele Midian mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛlɔen piri he koli nningyein amukoraa bɔ wapɛ yɛ nwo wayia ɔ, kyɛbɔ nandwie di aseɛ so ndire ɔ.” Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Sipore awa Balake yeɛ ɔte Moabo hene ɔ. 5Otuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Beɔ awa Balaam berɛ wɔ Petore bɔ ɔla asue Yufreti noa, wɔ Amawo aseɛ so ne. Na bɛtole bɛ sa bɛfrɛle ye kyɛ, “Mmenia bie fi Misraim bawa; bayɛ aseɛ so mitimiti, na baatena bapingye me. 6Bra kekesaala ye ná baanoma mmenia ye mɔ ma me, ofikyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se tra me. Ebiaa né mali bɛ so ngonim ná mafoa bɛ mafi aseɛ ye aso. Ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ebiala bɔ ekoyira ye ne, okonya saleɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɛkɔnoma ye ne, musue kɔto ye.”
7Yiti Moabo mbanyi ne Midian mbanyi fale abisa aboadeɛ ne, na besili nu bɛhɔle Balaam berɛ bɛɛfale Balake dwirɛ ne bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ. 8Balaam buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔla wa ma aleɛ hye, na edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔha kohyire me biala ngɔma ɛmɔ so kɔte.” Yiti Moabo mbanyi nemɔ lale Balaam berɛ. 9Nyameɛ wale Balaam berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ yeɛ bɛ ne wɔ wɔ wa ye?” 10Balaam buale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Sipore awa Balake bɔ ɔte Moabo hene ne ɔtole me ngraa kyɛ, 11‘Mmenia biemɔ afi Misraim bawa, na bayɛ aseɛ ye aso mitimiti, yiti bra ná baanoma bɛ ma me; ebiaa ngɔhora me ne bɛ yɛkɔho na mafoa bɛ mafi wa.’ ” 12Na Nyameɛ sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nnɛne bɛ kɔ; nnɛnoma mmenia nemɔ, ofikyɛ mayira bɛ.” 13Yiti Balaam dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ, na osele Balake ye mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa bɛhɔ ɛmɔ kuro, ofikyɛ AWURADE amma me ate kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛhɔ.” 14Yiti Moabo mbanyi nemɔ sili nu bɛhɔle Balake berɛ na bɛɛbɔle amaneɛ kyɛ, “Balaam ambene so kyɛ ɔne yɛ kɔwa ɔ.”
15Balake sá somane mbanyi, bɔ bɛsone na besa bedi mu bɛtra bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛhɔle nemɔ ɔ. 16Bɛhɔle Balaam berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Sipore awa Balake nwa: ‘Nnɛma hwee si wɔ ate wɔ me wa walɛ ne anwo; 17ofikyɛ ngɔma wɔ akatuaa bɔ ɔfata paa ɔ, na bɔ ekose me ne biala ngɔyɔ. Mesrɛ wɔ, bra baanoma mmenia ye ma me.’ ” 18Nakoso Balaam buale Balake ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ Balake fa ye awuro bɔ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛɛ po ma me a, mengɔhora mengohwi mengɔfa AWURADE me Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so mengɔyɔ ye nwo hwee. 19Ɛmɔ koso, ɛ́mɔla wa ɛnɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛbɔfoɛ hene mɔ yɔle ne ala, maa ndie edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔha kohyire me bieku ɔ.” 20Sɔ kɔngɔen ne, Nyameɛ wale Balaam berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ biaa nemɔ bawa baato bɛ sa bafrɛ wɔ a, dwɔso na ɛne bɛ hɔ; na mmom bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ne ala yeɛ yɔ ɔ.” 21Yiti Balaam dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ, osiesiele ye afunum, na ɔne Moabo mbanyi nemɔ besili nu bɛhɔle.
Balaam afunum ne dwudwo
22Nyameɛ fɛle yaa paa, ofikyɛ Balaam sili nu kyɛ ɔkɔ. Na AWURADE abɔfo oogyinane atee ne anu sili ye ate. Né Balaam te ye afunum ne aso, na né ɔne ye ngoaa nyɔ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ. 23Afunum ne nwuni kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne gyi atee ne anu, bɔ yeɛ otira ngrandɛ ɔ. Yiti afunum ne makyele fili atee ne anu, na oowurale eburo. Balaam bɔle afunum ne kyɛ ɔmaa ɔfa ye nye kyire atee nu. 24Né atee kyenɔnn bie la bobe boo nemɔ anu. Ɛwaen wɔ ye bɛen ne famaa. Na AWURADE abɔfo oogyinane atee ne anu. 25Afunum ne nye bɔle AWURADE abɔfo ne aso ne, ɔfale ye nwo hwili ɛwaen ne mane Balaam gya hwili ɛwaen ne. Yiti Balaam bɔle kaka ne bieku. 26Nyameɛ abɔfo ne wale ye nyunu, na oogyinane nekaa kyenɔnn bie, bɔ yeɛ ɛpɛne wɔ nwo kɔ bɛen anaa famaa a ɔnyɛ yee ɔ. 27Afunum ne nwuni Nyameɛ abɔfo ne, obutuli berɛ bɔ né Balaam tɛ te ye so ɔ. Balaam fɛle yaa hahii, na ɔfale ye pɔmaa bɔle afunum ne. 28AWURADE mane afunum ne dwudwole, na obisale Balaam kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ mayɔ wɔ ɔ, bɔ yeɛ yiti abɔ me pɛen nza ye?” 29Balaam buale afunum ne kyɛ, “Ofikyɛ edi me nwo angorɛ! Sɛ ndira ngrandɛ a, ahaa ngohũ wɔ kekesaala ye!” 30Nakoso afunum ne bisale Balaam kyɛ, “Aso nna w’afunum ole me, bɔ yeɛ atena me so alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye? Aso mayɔ wɔ sɔ le?” Na Balaam buale ye kyɛ, “Daabi.”
31Yeɛ AWURADE bukyele Balaam nye, na onwuni kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne gyi atee ne anu, bɔ wahwe ye ngrandɛ ɔ. Balaam bɔle ye nu ase fale ye nyunu butuli ase. 32Yeɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ abɔ wɔ kaka ne pɛen nza ye? Mawa kyɛ mebaasi wɔ ate, ofikyɛ nikyee bɔ ɛyɔ ne, ɔndengyɛ wɔ me nyunu. 33Afunum ne nwuni me, na ɔmakyele fili me nyunu pɛen nza. Sɛ wammakye wamvi me nyunu a, amba, ahaa mahu wɔ dadaada, maa ye de wanya ye ti wadidi nu.” 34Yeɛ Balaam sele AWURADE abɔfo ne kyɛ, “Mayɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ né menze kyɛ agyina atee ne anu kyɛ esi me ate ɔ. Afei, sɛ bɔ meyɔ ne ɔnzɔ wɔ nye a, ye de, mesa mekɔ awuro.” 35Na AWURADE abɔfo ne sele Balaam kyɛ, “Ɛne biaa nemɔ bɛhɔ, nakoso bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ne angome yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.” Yiti Balaam ne Balake mbanyi nemɔ bɛhɔle.
36Balake tele kyɛ Balaam awa ne, ooyiale ye wɔ Moabo kuro Yiri, bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn ɛwɛen so, ɛwɛen ne anoa dɔ paa ne. 37Na Balake bisale Balaam kyɛ, “Manzoma kyɛ bɛɛfrɛ wɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ amma ɔ?” Aso mengɔhora mengɔma wɔ akatuaa bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ?” 38Balaam buale Balake kyɛ, “Kekesaala ye, mawa, nakoso atee nne berɛ kyɛ meka bɔ me bɔbɔ mekuro ɔ. Edwirɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa kotua me noa ne, ye ala yeɛ odi kyɛ meka ɔ.” 39Balaam ne Balake bɛhɔle, na beedwuli Kiriate Husote. 40Balake fale nandwie mɔ ne mmoaen bɔle afɔleɛ, na ɔfale naen ne mane Balaam ne mbanyi bɔ né bɛboka ye so ne.
Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ oli moa
41Aleɛ hyene ne, Balake fale Balaam ɔne ye bɛfo bɛhɔle Bamote Baal. Bɛwɔ berɛ ne, né Balaam nye tua Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ anu bie.

Title: NUMERI 23
Content:
1Yeɛ Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Si afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo wɔ wa ma me, ná ma me nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo.” 2Balake yɔle kyɛbɔ Balaam hane ne ala, na Balake ne Balaam bɛfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so. 3Yeɛ Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Tena wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, na mekɔ ahameɛ kãa. Ebiaa AWURADE ne me kooli ngitahoɛ. Bɔ ɔkɔye kohyire me biala, ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ.” Na Balaam sili nu hɔle bokaa pralaa bie aso.
4Nyameɛ yele ye nwo ali hyirele Balaam, na Balaam sele ye kyɛ, “Masiesie afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo ne, na mafa nandwie nyii ko ɔne boaen nyii ko biala mabɔ afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.” 5Na AWURADE fale edwirɛ tuale Balaam noa kyɛ, “Sa kɔ Balake dɔ, na edwirɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.” 6Yiti Balaam sa wale Balake berɛ. Né Balake gyi ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo berɛ, bɔ Moabo mbanyi nemɔ boka ye so ɔ. 7Yeɛ Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
“Balake waafa me wafi Aram wawa,
Moabo hene waafa me wafi eyia afiteleɛ mmokaa so.
Ɔnwa: ‘Bra ná baanoma Yakob ma me;
Bra baawa Yisrael amoen!’
8Meyɛ sɛɛ né manoma mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ ɔnnomane bɛ ɔ?
Meyɛ sɛɛ né mawa mmenia bɔ AWURADE ɔppole bɛ ɔ amoen?
9Ngyi nyɔbotaen nemɔ ti afia yeɛ menwu bɛ ɔ:
Ngyi mmokaa nemɔ aso yeɛ me nye tua bɛ ɔ.
Ɛhemɔ te mmenia bɔ bɛ ngome bɛte ɔ,
na bɛnga bɛ nwo bɛmvora maen maen ngaa nemɔ!
10Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔha Yakob boso ama bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ mvuture ɔ,
anaakyɛ ɔkɔhora kɔha Yisraelfoɛ nna nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔ?
Ma me wue yɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ bɛ wue,
ná m’ayieleɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ deɛ!”
11Yeɛ Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ afa ali me ye? Mvale wɔ mmale kyɛ baanoma me pɔfoɛ mɔ, nakoso eyiralɛ mmom yeɛ ayira bɛ ɔ.” 12Balaam buale kyɛ, “Aso nna bɔ AWURADE afa atua me noa yeɛ odi kyɛ menea meka ye yé ɔ?”
Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ
13Yiti Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Bra ma me ne wɔ yɛhɔ nekaa foforɛ bɔ egyi berɛ a wɔ nye tua bɛ ɔ; ekonwu bɛ nu bie, engonwu bɛ mukoraati; na afei gyina berɛ na noma bɛ ma me.” 14Balake fale ye hɔle bokaa Pisiga ti afia wɔ Sofim ɛserɛ so. Osili afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo, na ɔfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so. 15Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Gyina wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, na maa ngɔ moa dɔ me ne AWURADE yɛɛli ngitahoɛ.” 16AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Balaam, na ɔfale edwirɛ tuale ye noa kyɛ, “Sá kɔ Balake dɔ, na edwirɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.” 17Osa hɔle Balake dɔ ne, né Balake gyi ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, bɔ Moabo mbanyi nemɔ boka ye so ɔ. Na Balake bisale Balaam kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nzɛ?” 18Yeɛ Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
“Dwɔso, Balake, ná tie;
Sipore awa, tie bɔ meka ye.
19Nyameɛ ɔtte kyɛ kuro sona, ná wapɛ anoanu,
yeɛ ɔtte kyɛ dasaniɛ, ná wasesã ye adwene.
Aso wahyɛ bɔ bɔ ongoli so anaa?
Anaa waha edwirɛ bie bɔ ɔngɔma ɔngɔwa nu ɔ?
20Tie, saleɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ wafa wasoma me ɔ,
wayira bɛ, yiti mengɔhora ye sesã.
21Wannwu amumuyɛɛ biala wɔ Yakob nu;
yeɛ wannwu amaneɛ dwirɛ biala wɔ Yisrael.
AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ gyi bɛ si,
babɔ ye ohomoo wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ b’ɛhene ɛne.
22Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim ne,
ye anwoserɛ te kyɛ torɔen mmɛen ma bɛ.
23Amba, bɛyyele ngonyaa biala bettiale Yakob,
yeɛ bɛwwale Yisrael amoen biala.
Afei bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa Yakob ne Yisrael nwo kyɛ,
‘Nea bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ!’
24Tie, Yisrael te maen bɔ odwɔso kyɛ gyata beleɛ,
na ɔpagya ye nwo kyɛ gyata nyii!
Ommutu berɛ, sana wali naen bɔ wahye ye ɔ,
sana wano kaka bɔ wahũ ye ɔ, ye mogya.”
25Yeɛ Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nzaade a, nnɛnoma bɛ koraa, yeɛ nnɛyira bɛ koraa.” 26Nakoso Balaam buale Balake kyɛ, “Manga mangyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE kɔha biala, yeɛ odi kyɛ meyɔ ɔ’?”
27Yiti Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Bra, maa mva wɔ ngɔ neka foforɛ. Ebiaa, berɛ de, Nyameɛ kɔpene so maa ɛkɔnoma mmenia nemɔ kɔma me.” 28Yiti Balake fale Balaam hɔle bokaa Peɔ so, bɔ egyi berɛ a, wɔ nye tua ɛserɛ pralaa ne. 29Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Si afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo wɔ wa ma me, ná ma me nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo.” 30Yiti Balake yɔle kyɛbɔ Balaam hane ne, ɔfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.

Title: NUMERI 24
Content:
Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza
1Afei Balaam nwuni kyɛ ɔyɛle AWURADE fɛ kyɛ ye Balaam wayira Yisrael ɔ. Yiti wangɔ ammisa so kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye daa ne, na mmom ɔfale ye nye hyirele ɛserɛ ne aso. 2Balaam mane ye ti so, na onwuni kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ baboaboa bɛ noa mmusua kure mmusua kure. Na Nyameɛ Sunzum wale ye so, 3na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
“Beɔ awa Balaam ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ ɛhe,
sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,
4sona bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,
bɔ onwu Ɛdangama ye nyekyire ne,
bɔ ɔkata ye nye po a, ye nye nwu nikyee ne.
5O Yakob, wɔ ɛtena sua mɔ yɛ nyemene,
O Yisrael, w’atenaleɛ mɔ yɛ nyemene!
6Bɛte kyɛ bɔnza bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ dede ɔ,
bɛte kyɛ asue noa turo mɔ,
bɛte kyɛ pɛprɛ mmakaa bɔ AWURADE alua ɔ,
bɛte kyɛ sida mmakaa bɔ begyigyi asue noa ɔ.
7Nzue kofi ye bua nu kɔtengyɛ,
na ye boso ama konya nzue pee,
ye hene kɔyɛ titire kɔtra Agage,
na ye ahennie konya ngɔsoɛ.
8Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele Yisrael fili Misraim ne,
ye anwoserɛ te kyɛ torɔen mmɛen ma ye.
Ɔkɔsɛkye maen maen bɔ bɛte ye pɔfoɛ ɔ,
ná wabubu bɛ mmowue nu.
Ɔkɔto ye agyaen kɔwowɔ bɛ.
9 Okunduni, na obutu berɛ kyɛ gyata,
ɔte kyɛ gyata beleɛ; nwa yeɛ okotingye ye ɔ?
Ebiala bɔ okoyira wɔ ne, Nyameɛ koyira ye,
yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔnoma wɔ ne, Nyameɛ kɔnoma ye.”
10Yeɛ Balake fɛle Balaam so yaa hahii. Ɔfale ye sa fini ye bɔbɔ ye sa nu, na osele Balaam kyɛ, “Ndole me sa mvrɛle wɔ kyɛ baanoma me pɔfoɛ mɔ; nakoso ayira bɛ pɛen nza mmom. 11Fi wa kɔ! Kɔ wɔ kuro! Ngane kyɛ ahaa ngɔma wɔ akatuaa piri paa, nakoso AWURADE abɔ w’akatuaa agua.” 12Yeɛ Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Aso manga mangyire wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ ɛsomane bɛ me berɛ ne kyɛ, 13‘Sɛ Balake fa ye awuro bɔ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛɛ po ma me a, mengɔhora mengoli me ti piri mengobu AWURADE dwirɛ so, ná mengɔyɔ paa anaa tɛɛ biala; na mmom bɔ AWURADE kɔha ne, ye ala yeɛ ngɔhã ɔ’? 14Afei, mesa mekɔ me maen nu. Na maa nga bɔ kyẽa bie maen he kɔfa kɔyɔ wɔ maen ɔ ngyire wɔ.”
Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna
15Afei Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
Beɔ awa Balaam ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,
sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,
16sona bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,
sona bɔ ole Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ,
ná onwu Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ye nyekyire,
sona bɔ ɔkata ye nye po a, ye nye nwu nikyee ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ:
17Bɔ menwu ye mefa ye nwo ne, nna kekesaala ye yeɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ;
bɔ me nye tua fa ye nwo ne, ongosi kekesaala ye.
Nzramaa bie kofi Yakob nu kofite,
na ɛhɔtɔ bie kofi Yisrael nu kodwɔso.
Okoli Moabo mbanyi so ngonim,
ná wabrɛ Sɛti boso ama amukoraa ase.
18Edom kɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ deɛ
na Sɛre koso, ɔkɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ deɛ,
nakoso Yisrael de, ɔkɔhɔ so koli ngonim.
19Sona bie bɔ ofi Yakob abusua nu yeɛ okoli hene ɔ,
na nguro nemɔ aso ama bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, okohũhũ bɛ.”
20Afei Balaam tole ye nye neane Amalɛke, na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
“Amalɛke yeɛ odi mu paa wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ,
nakoso ye ayieleɛ ole kyɛ ɔkɔbɔ koraa.”
21Yeɛ ɔtole ye nye neane Kenifoɛ, na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,
“Wɔ atenaleɛ gyi berɛ pindinn,
na wɔ bue wɔ nyɔbotaen nu;
22nakoso bɛkɔbɔ Kenifoɛ maen ne,
kɔpem kyɛ Asure kɔhye wɔ nnure ɔ?”
23Na osa toale so kyɛ,
“Aworabɔlɛ dwirɛ, sɛ Nyameɛ yɔ ɛhe a, nwa yeɛ okonya ye ti kodidi nu ɔ?
24Nakoso ɛlɛen mɔ kofi Kitim kɔwa,
nu koɛhonɛfoɛ ne koli Asure ne Ebere so ngonim;
na Kitim koso kɔbɔ afebɔɔ.”
25Afei Balaam sili nu sá hɔle ye kuro, na Balake koso sili nu hɔle.

Title: NUMERI 25
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ sɔne Baal Peɔ
1Mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ bɛtenane Sitim ne, Yisraelfoɛ hyɛle ye bo bɛ ne Moabo mmrasua nemɔ bɛlelale. 2Moabo mmrasua nemɔ hwehwene Yisraelfoɛ hɔle Moabo mmosoen sɔnenɛ nu. Yisraelfoɛ lili mmosoen so aleɛ ne bie, na bɛkotole bɛ mmosoen nemɔ. 3Yisrael fale ye nwo wurale bosoen Baal Peɔ bo, yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa. 4Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Yeye bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia ne noa amukoraa, ná fa nyamaa bɔ bɛ kɔme eyia nu wɔ AWURADE nyunu, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE ayakyi ye yaa piri bɔ wafɛ ye Yisrael so ne.” 5Yiti Mose sele Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ anu biala ohuhu ye mmenia bɔ bafa bɛ nwo baawura bosoen Baal Peɔ bo ne.”
6Berɛ ne ala, bɔ begu so besu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne, Yisraelniɛ bienzua bie ɔɔfale Midianniɛ braa bie oowurale ye ɛtena sua nu. Né Mose ne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛ nye tua ye. 7Mmerɛ bɔ Finehase, bɔ ɔse ole ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa nwuni ye ne, odwɔsole hwene ye nwo fili mmenia ne anu. Ɔfale pealɛɛ tirale, 8na ɔpole Yisraelniɛ biaa ne wɔ ɛtena sua nu berɛ. Ɔfale pealɛɛ ne wɔle Yisraelniɛ biaa ne ɔne Midianniɛ braa ne bɛ munyɔ bɛ kunu. Na amaneɛ ne fili Yisraelfoɛ so. 9Nakoso bɛ bɔ bewuli amaneɛ ne anu ne, né bɛte apee aburanyɔ ne nna.
10Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 11“Me yaa bɔ mvɛle ye wɔ Yisraelfoɛ so ne, Finehase bɔ ɔse ole ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa ne, wama m’ahone atɔ nzue nu. Ofikyɛ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wagyina me gya nu wahwe bɛ nwo nungunɛ wama me. Ɔnate ye sɔ ti, mangũkũ Yisraelfoɛ mɔ wɔ me nungunɛhwenɛ nu. 12Yiti ka kyire ye kyɛ, me ne ye yayɛ m’asomdwee apam. 13Na ɛhe kɔyɛ daa sɔfolilɛ nwo apam kɔma ye ne ye boso ama, ofikyɛ wagyina ye gya nu pindinn wama ye Nyameɛ, na wapata wama Yisraelfoɛ.” 14Yisraelniɛ biaa bɔ ohuni ye ne Midianniɛ braa ne, bɛfrɛ ye Simri. Ye baba ole Salu bɔ né ɔla Simeonfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ kure ko anoa ne. 15Midianniɛ braa bɔ ohuni ye ne, bɛfrɛ ye Kosibi. Sure bɔ ɔla Midian abusua ko anoa ne, ɔwa brasua ɛne.
16AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 17“Ɛ́mɔtane Midianfoɛ nye, ná ɛ́mɔhuhu bɛ, 18ofikyɛ bɛnate nnakannaka so baha ɛmɔ. Balakalaka ɛmɔ wɔ edwirɛ hemɔ anwo: Baal Peɔ sɔnenɛ nwo, yeɛ b’eliɛma brasua Kosibi bɔ ɔte Midian panyi bie awa ne anwo. Kyẽa bɔ Peɔ sɔnenɛ hwene amaneɛ wale ne yeɛ behuni Kosibi ɔ.”

Title: NUMERI 26
Content:
Bɛka Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ so
1Amaneɛ ne bo pɛle ne, AWURADE sele Mose ne ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa kyɛ, 2“Ɛ́mɔha Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa: Yisraelniɛ biala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔkora kɔ koɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.” 3Na Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa, bɛ ne mmenia nemɔ bedwudwole, wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne kyɛ, 4“Ɛ́mɔha mmenia ne: ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.”
Yisraelfoɛ bɔ befili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale nemɔ ɛhe: 5 Ruben, bɔ ɔte Yisrael bamuɛbaa ne. Ruben boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Hanokefoɛ bɔ bɛte Hanoke sasofoɛ; Palufoɛ bɔ bɛte Palu sasofoɛ; 6Hesronfoɛ bɔ bɛte Hesron sasofoɛ; yeɛ Karemifoɛ bɔ bɛte Kami sasofoɛ. 7Rubenfoɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nza, ɛyaa nzoo ne aburasa. 8Palu awa ole Eliabo. 9Eliabo mma mɔ ole Nemuel, Datan ne Abiram. Sɔ Datan ne Abiram hemɔ ala yeɛ né bɛte mbanyi wɔ Yisrael, bɔ bɛ ne Kora bedwɔsole betiale Mose ne Aarɔn, ná bɛyɔle AWURADE nwo lɔen ne. 10Aseɛ bukyele ye noa nu, na ɔmemene bɛ ne Kora. Sɔ mmenia ne wuwuli ne, see yerale mmenia ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu, na bɛ nwo dwirɛ yɛle kɔkɔbɔlɛ. 11Nakoso Kora mma mɔ de, banwuwu bie.
12Simeon boso ama, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Nemuelfoɛ bɔ bɛte Nemuel sasofoɛ, Yaminfoɛ bɔ bɛte Yamin sasofoɛ; Yakinfoɛ bɔ bɛte Yakin sasofoɛ; 13Serafoɛ bɔ bɛte Sera sasofoɛ; Sɔɔlofoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɔɔlo sasofoɛ. 14Simeonfoɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ ɛne. Bɛ mukoraa bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ne ɛyaa nyɔ.
15Gade mma mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Sefonfoɛ bɔ bɛte Sefon sasofoɛ; Hagyifoɛ bɔ bɛte Hagyi sasofoɛ; Sunifoɛ bɔ bɛte Suni sasofoɛ; 16Osinifoɛ bɔ bɛte Osini sasofoɛ; Ɛrifoɛ bɔ bɛte Ɛri sasofoɛ; 17Arodefoɛ bɔ bɛte Arode sasofoɛ; Arelifoɛ bɔ bɛte Areli sasofoɛ. 18Gadefoɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne ɛyaa nnu.
19Yuda mma mɔ ole Ɛre ne Onan. Ɛre ne Onan wuli wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so. 20Yuda boso ama bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Hyelafoɛ bɔ bɛte Hyela sasofoɛ; Pɛrɛsefoɛ bɔ bɛte Pɛrɛse sasofoɛ; Serafoɛ bɔ bɛte Sera sasofoɛ. 21Pɛrɛse boso ama mɔ ole Hesronfoɛ bɔ bɛte Hesron sasofoɛ yeɛ Hamulfoɛ bɔ bɛte Hamul sasofoɛ. 22Yuda mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasoo ne nzia ɔne ɛyaa nnu.
23Yisaka boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Tolafoɛ bɔ bɛte Tola sasofoɛ; Punifoɛ bɔ bɛte Puwa sasofoɛ; 24Yasubofoɛ bɔ bɛte Yasubo sasofoɛ; Simronfoɛ bɔ bɛte Simron sasofoɛ. 25Yisaka mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne: bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasia ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nza.
26Sebulɔn boso ama bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Seredefoɛ bɔ bɛte Serede sasofoɛ; Elonfoɛ bɔ bɛte Elon sasofoɛ; Yaleelfoɛ bɔ bɛte Yaleel sasofoɛ. 27Sebulɔn mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasia ne ɛyaa nnu.
28Yosef mma Manase ne Efraim bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: 29Manase boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Makyirifoɛ bɔ bɛte Makyiri sasofoɛ. Makyiri ɔwa ole Gileade, na Gileade sasofoɛ ole Gileadefoɛ. 30Gileade ye boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Yiesafoɛ bɔ bɛte Yiesa sasofoɛ; Helekefoɛ bɔ bɛte Heleke sasofoɛ; 31Aseriɛlfoɛ bɔ bɛte Aseriɛl sasofoɛ; Sɛkemfoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɛkem sasofoɛ; 32Semidafoɛ bɔ bɛte Semida sasofoɛ, yeɛ Hefafoɛ bɔ bɛte Hefa sasofoɛ. 33Né Hefa awa Selofehade olle baa bienzua biala, na mmom ye mma te mmrasua ngome. Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ ole Mahela, Nowa, Hogela, Milka yeɛ Tisa. 34Manase mmusua mmusua nemɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nyɔ ne ɛyaa nzoo.
35Efraim boso ama mɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Sutelafoɛ bɔ bɛte Sutela sasofoɛ; Bekyafoɛ bɔ bɛte Bekya sasofoɛ, yeɛ Tahanfoɛ bɔ bɛte Tahan sasofoɛ. 36Sutela ye boso ama mɔ ole Eranfoɛ bɔ bɛte Eran sasofoɛ. 37Efraimfoɛ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nu. Yosef boso ama mɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne.
38Benyamin boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Belafoɛ bɔ bɛte Bela sasofoɛ; Asebelfoɛ bɔ bɛte Asebel sasofoɛ; Ahiramfoɛ bɔ bɛte Ahiram sasofoɛ; 39Sufamfoɛ bɔ bɛte Sufam sasofoɛ yeɛ Hufamfoɛ bɔ bɛte Hufam sasofoɛ. 40Bela mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ade ne Naaman. Adefoɛ bɔ bɛte Ade sasofoɛ; Naamanfoɛ bɔ bɛte Naaman sasofoɛ. 41Benyamin boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nzia.
42Dan boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Suhamfoɛ bɔ bɛte Suham sasofoɛ. Danfoɛ ne, bɛ mmusua mmusua ɛne. 43Suhamfoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasia ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nna.
44Asɛ boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Yiminafoɛ bɔ bɛte Yimina sasofoɛ; Yisiwifoɛ bɔ bɛte Yisiwi sasofoɛ, yeɛ Beriafoɛ bɔ bɛte Beria sasofoɛ. 45Beria boso ama mɔ ole Heberifoɛ bɔ bɛte Heberi sasofoɛ, yeɛ Malkiɛlfoɛ bɔ bɛte Malkiɛl sasofoɛ. 46Né Asɛ awa brasua li Sera. 47Asɛfoɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nna.
48Nafetali boso ama mɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Yaseelfoɛ bɔ bɛte Yaseel sasofoɛ, Gunifoɛ bɔ bɛte Guni sasofoɛ; 49Yesarefoɛ bɔ bɛte Yesare sasofoɛ; Silemfoɛ bɔ bɛte Silem sasofoɛ. 50Nafetalifoɛ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛne. Bɛhale nu mmenia ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nu ɔne ɛyaa nna.
51Bɛhale Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nzia ne ko, ɛyaa nzoo ɔne aburasa.
52AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 53“Ɛhemɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkyɛ aseɛ ne ma bɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmenia bɔ baha bɛ ne somaa te ɔ, maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ. 54Abusua kure bɔ ɔte piri ne, ma bɛ aseɛ piri; yeɛ abusua kure bɔ ɔte kãa ne koso, ma bɛ aseɛ kaaba. Abusua kure biala aseɛ bɔ okonya ye ne, ye piri gyi nu mmenia bɔ baha bɛ ɔ so. 55Nakoso serewagualɛ so yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛfa kyɛ aseɛ ne ɔ; kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ b’abusua kure ne dumaa te ne, nu yeɛ odi kyɛ benya b’aseɛ ɔ. 56Odi kyɛ egyina serewagualɛ so ɛkyɛ aseɛ ne ma mmusua kure mbiri ne mmaa mmaa nemɔ.”
57 Bɛhale Lewifoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ ɛhe: Gɛsɔnfoɛ bɔ bɛte Gɛsɔn sasofoɛ; Kohatefoɛ bɔ bɛte Kohate sasofoɛ, yeɛ Merarifoɛ bɔ bɛte Merari sasofoɛ. 58Lewi mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Libinifoɛ abusua, Hebronfoɛ abusua, Mahelifoɛ abusua, Musifoɛ abusua, yeɛ Korafoɛ abusua. Kohate awa ole Amram. 59Amram ɔye ole Lewi awa brasua Yokebɛde. Lewi wole Yokebɛde wɔ Misraim, na Yokebɛde ne Amram bɛwole Aarɔn ne Mose yeɛ b’eliɛma brasua Miriam. 60Aarɔn mma ole Nadabo, Abihu, Eleasa ɔne Yitama. 61Nakoso Nadabo ne Abihu de, bewuwuli ofikyɛ né bɛmvata kyɛ bɛfa see bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, nakoso bɛyɔle sɔ. 62Lewifoɛ mmienzua bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nza. Banga bɛ bamvra Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ, ofikyɛ bamma bɛ aseɛ biala wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu.
63Mmenia bɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa bɛhale bɛ nemɔ ɛne. Bɛhale Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne. 64 Yisraelfoɛ bɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Aarɔn bɛhale bɛ wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso ne, bɛ nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ né ɔboka mmenia hemɔ aso ɔ. 65Ofikyɛ né AWURADE aha afa bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Bekowuwu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.” Bɛ nu ko po anga, sana Yefune awa Kalebo ɔne Nun awa Yosua angome.

Title: NUMERI 27
Content:
Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ
1 Selofehade ɔse ole Hefa, bɔ ɔse ole Gileade, bɔ ɔse ole Makyiri, bɔ ɔse ole Manase, bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Yosef ne. Yiti Selofehade te Manase bosoniɛ. Ye mmrasua mɔ ole Mahela, Nowa, Hogela, Milka ɔne Tisa. Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ wale 2Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Yisrael mbanyi ɔne maen ne amukoraati bɛ nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, 3“Yɛ baba wuli wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Bɛ bɔ bɛ ne Kora yɛle AWURADE nwo lɔen ne, né ye de ɔbboka bɛ so. Nakoso ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne ti, owuli bɔ wanwo baa bienzua biala ɔ. 4Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ yɛ baba wanwo baa bienzua ne ati, odi kyɛ bɛma ye dumaa mini wɔ ye abusua nu ɔ? Yɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua nemɔ b’agyapadeɛ deɛ ne, fa nu bie ma yɛ.”
5Mose fale bɛ dwirɛ ne tole AWURADE nyunu. 6Na AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ, 7“Edwirɛ bɔ Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ bɛka ne, ɔte turoloo. Odi kyɛ ɛma bɛ koso benya bɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua nemɔ b’aseɛ deɛ ne bie, amaa ɔnate so bɛ sa aha bɛ baba agyapadeɛ deɛ. 8Afei sá ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua bie wu, ná sɛ olle ba bienzua a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛma ɔwa brasua. 9Sɛ olle baa brasua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛ́ma oliɛma mmienzua mɔ. 10Na sɛ olle aliɛmaa bienzua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛ́ma ye baba aliɛma mmienzua mɔ. 11Na sɛ ye baba olle aliɛmaa bienzua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ ne bɛ́ma ye abusuaniɛ kaenn, maa ɔfa. Ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.”
Yosua si Mose gya nu
12 AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Fo Abarim mmokaa he, ná to wɔ nye nea aseɛ bɔ mafa mama Yisraelfoɛ ne. 13Sɛ ɛnea yie a, ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ kyɛbɔ eliɛma Aarɔn toale bɛ ne. 14Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ maen ne dwɔso tiale me wɔ Sen ɛserɛ ne aso ne, ɛmɔyɛle me mmeraa dwirɛ nwo asoserɛ. Ɛmɔamma wanna ali wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu kyɛ nde krongron, wɔ nekaa bɔ nzue wale ne.” (Ɛhe ole Meribate Kadese asue bɔ ɔwɔ Sen ɛserɛ ne aso ne.) 15Na Mose srɛle AWURADE kyɛ, 16“AWURADE bɔ ɛte anwoɔnaen amukoraati, bɛ sunzum Nyameɛ ne, ye sona maa otua maen ye anoa, 17sona bɔ okoli bɛ nyunu wɔ nikyee biala anu, na afei watua bɛ noa wɔ bɛ koɛhonɛ nu, amaa AWURADE mmenia banyɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ.” 18 Na AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ, “Ye Nun awa Yosua, bɔ sunzum ne akanyane ye ne, ná fa wɔ sa gua ye so. 19Maa oogyina ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu, na fa ye tua maen ne anoa wɔ bɛ nyunu. 20Fa wɔ tumi ne bie wura ye sa, amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bayɛ sotie bama ye. 21Nakoso odi kyɛ ɔba ɔsɔfo Eleasa nyunu maa ɔfa Yurim so obisa AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɔma ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu. AWURADE noa dwirɛ so yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa begyina bɛyɔ nikyee biala ɔ.” 22Yiti Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala. Ɔyele Yosua, na ɔmaa oogyinane ɔsɔfo Eleasa ɔne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu. 23Mose fale ye sa guale Yosua so, na ɔfale ye tuale maen ne anoa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle ne.

Title: NUMERI 28
Content:
Daa biala afɔleɛbɔlɛ
(Ɛksadɔso 29.38-46)
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Fa sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he ma Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, M’afɔleɛ, aleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma me, bɔ ɔbo me fona ne, ɛ́mɔnea yé kyɛ ɛmɔkɔbɔ bɛkɔma me mmerɛ bɔ m’ahyɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛ. 3 Na se bɛ kyɛ, afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛma AWURADE ne ɛhe: daa biala, ɛ́mɔfa mmoaen nyii nyɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, bɛbɔ afɔleɛ. 4Fa boaen nyii ko bɔ afɔleɛ ngyerɛmɔ ná fa ko ne koso bɔ afɔleɛ nɔsoa. 5Odi kyɛ ɛfa esam paa olonka ko, bɔ bafa ngoo bɔ bahwi towaa ko ne bue bafra ɔ, ɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ boka so. 6Ɛhe te daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, bɔ nhyehyɛle ye wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso ɔ. Ɔte afɔleɛ fona bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ. 7Odi kyɛ boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala bɛfa anonneɛ afɔleɛ towaa ko ne bue bɛboka so. Odi kyɛ ehwie nzaa serɛ fa bɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ. 8Boaen ko bɔ waha ne koso, fa bɔ afɔleɛ nɔsoa ne. Odi kyɛ ɛfa aburoo afɔleɛ ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ ɛboka so, kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ deɛ ne ala. Bɔ sɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ne wɔ see so.
Afofikyẽa afɔleɛbɔlɛ
9Sɛ odwu afofikyẽa a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, ɔne esam paa olonka nyɔ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ɔ, ɔne ye anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ. 10Ɛhe te afofikyẽa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ye anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne aso ɔ.
Bosome bosome afɔleɛ
11Sɛ ɛmɔhyɛ bosome biala bo a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ. 12Afei odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa esam paa olonka nza bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka nandwie nyii ko biala so. Asa koso, esam paa olonka nyɔ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka boaen nyii ko ne aso. 13Esam paa olonka ko bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala so. Ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona, bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ. 14B’anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ bɛfa bobe nzaa towaa nza ne bue bɛboka nandwie nyii ko biala so, ná bɛfa bobe nzaa towaa nyɔ bɛboka boaen nyii ko biala so, ná bɛfa bobe nzaa towaa ko ne bue bɛboka boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala so. Ɛhe te bosome bosome naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye afoɛ biala nu ɔ. 15Na odi kyɛ bɛfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Bɛ́fa bɛ́boka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne aso.
Abɔtra aluolue afɔleɛ mɔ
16 Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ Abɔtra afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. 17 Sɔ bosome ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, ɔte aluolue. Odi kyɛ bedi paanoo kabrɛdi ɛlɛsoo. 18Kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. 19Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bɛma AWURADE: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, ɔne mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔ wali nnɛen biala ɔ. 20Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ko biala so. 21Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa olonka ko bɛboka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so. 22Afei koso, ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ mbata ɔma ɛmɔ. 23Ngyerɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aso ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛboka so. 24Sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ ɛlɛsoo ne, daa biala, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ see so aleɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona ɔ bɛma AWURADE ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne aso. 25Na ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.
Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue afɔleɛ
26 Fieso aleɛ bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔfa ne, ye aluolue kyẽa ne, sɛ ɛmɔfa aburoo foforɛ bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE wɔ ɛmɔ Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue ne anu a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. 27Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ. 28Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ko biala so. 29Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa olonka ko bɛboka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so. 30Ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́boka so maa ɔyɛ mbata ma ɛmɔ. 31Sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ ne b’anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye aburoo afɔleɛ ne aso. Onni kyɛ bɛ nu biala nwo nya ngekalewa biala.

Title: NUMERI 29
Content:
Totorobɛndo aluolue afɔleɛ
1 “Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Ɔte kyẽa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ ɔ. 2Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, boaen nyii ko, yeɛ mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ. 3Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ. Bɛ́fa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ne aso, ná bɛ́fa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ne aso, 4ná bɛ́fa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so. 5Afei koso, ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ mbata ma ɛmɔ. 6Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɛsraen fi a bɛbɔ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. Ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE bɔ ɔbo ye fona ɔ.
Mbata kyẽa afɔleɛ
7 “Sɔ bosome nzoo ne ala, ye eleburu ne aso, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron. Ɛ́mɔhye hɔen, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. 8Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, boaen nyii ko, yeɛ mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ. 9Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ne aso, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ne aso, 10ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so. 11Afei koso, bɔne nwo mbata afɔleɛ ne, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛ́boka so.
Asese aluolue afɔleɛ
12 Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron; Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Ɛ́mɔli aluolue ɛlɛsoo bɛma AWURADE. 13Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ wɔ see so bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie akrɔngrɔma buru ne nza, mmoaen nyii nyɔ ɔne mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ. 14Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii buru ne nza ne anu ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka mmoaen nyii nyɔ ne anu ko biala so, 15ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna ne anu ko biala so. 16Afei koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
17“Ye elenyɔ ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛ́bɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nyɔ, mmoaen nyii nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, 18ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 19Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
20Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛ́bɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii buru ne ko, mmoaen nyɔ, ɔne mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, 21ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 22Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
23Ye ɛlɛnna ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii buru, mmoaen nyii nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, 24ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 25Afei koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
26Ye elennu ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii ngona, mmoaen nyii nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, 27ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ.
28Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
29Ye elesia ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii mmɔtwɛ, mmoaen nyii nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, 30ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 31Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
32Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛ́bɔ afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii nzoo, mmoaen nyii nyɔ, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ; 33ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nemɔ, mmoaen nyii nemɔ ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛ́boka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 34Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
35 Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. 36Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ wɔ see so bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii ko, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ; 37ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii ne, boaen nyii ne ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. 38Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.
39Ɛhemɔ ole aluolue bɔ AWURADE ahyehyɛ wato berɛ wama ɛmɔ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔhyɛlɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ ɔne ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne ɛmɔ aburoo afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ɛmɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ nemɔ koso, ɛmɔbɔ.”
40Yiti Mose hane edwirɛ ne amukoraa hyirele Yisraelfoɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala.

Title: NUMERI 30
Content:
Mmrasua anohoba nwo mmeraa
1Na Mose sele mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisraelfoɛ mmusua kure nemɔ noa kyɛ, “Ahyɛdeɛ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ato berɛ hɔ ɛhe: 2 Sɛ bienzua bie hyɛ AWURADE bɔ, anaakyɛ sɛ ɔta ndaen fa foa edwirɛ bie aso a, onni kyɛ obu edwirɛ bɔ waha ne aso. Odi kyɛ ɔyɔ bɔ wato ye noa nu tui waha ne biala.
3Sɛ brasua bie hyɛ AWURADE bɔ, anaakyɛ ɔta ndaen fa foa edwirɛ bie aso a, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔte taluwa bɔ ɔtɛ te ɔse awuro, 4na sɛ ɔse te ye bɔhyɛ ne, anaa ye ndaen bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne, nakoso wanga hwee wangyire taluwa ne a, ye de odi kyɛ taluwa ne di ye bɔhyɛ ne amu so, ɔne ye nwo nikyee bɔ watua ne koso so. 5Nakoso sɛ ye baba te ye dwirɛ ne, ná ɔne ye anyɛ adwene a, ye bɔ bɔ wahyɛ ne, anaa ndaen bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne, nu biala ngɔyɛ adwuma. AWURADE kɔfa kɔhyɛ ye, ofikyɛ ye baba amaa wanwu ye kyɛ ɔne ye nyɛ adwene.
6Mmerɛ bɔ ye anohoba anaa ye bɔhyɛ bɔ wandwene ye nwo yeɛ ɔhyɛle ne tɛ la ye so ne, sɛ okogya biaa, 7ná sɛ ohu te dwirɛ ne, nakoso mmerɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔkɔte ne wanga hwee wangyire ye a, ye de bɔhyɛlɛ ne tɛ la ye so, na ndaen bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne koso tɛ la ye so. 8Nakoso sɛ mmerɛ bɔ ohu kɔte dwirɛ ne, ɔma braa ne nwu kyɛ ɔne ye nyɛ adwene a, ye de né ohu ne wakyikyi bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔla braa ne so ne, anaa ye noa dwirɛ bɔ wandwene ye nwo yeɛ ɔhane bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi so ne; na AWURADE kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye.
9(Nakoso kunaniɛ brasua biala anaa brasua bɔ ɔne ohu bayira biala, anohoba bɔ wabɔ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi so ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔla ye so). 10Na sɛ né ɔtɛwɔ agyaa bo yeɛ ɔbɔle sɔ anohoba ne, anaa ɔtale ndaen fa foale edwirɛ bie aso, 11bɔ ohu tele koso wanga hwee wangyire braa ne, bɔ wamma braa ne wannwu ye kyɛ ɔne ye nyɛ adwene a, ye de odi kyɛ braa ne di ye bɔhyɛ ne amu so, ɔne ndaen biala bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne aso. 12Nakoso sɛ ohu ne te edwirɛ ne, ná sɔ mmerɛ ne ala a, okyikyi bɔhyɛ ne ɔne anohoba ne fi berɛ a, ye de anohoba biala bɔ braa ne wafa ye noa wabɔ, anaa ndaen biala bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ odi so. Ohu ne akyikyi afi berɛ, na AWURADE kɔfa kɔhyɛ braa ne. 13Anohoba biala anaa ndaen biala bɔ braa ne ta fa tua ye nwo nikyee biala de, ohu ne kɔhora kɔmaa ɔkɔyɔ adwuma, anaa ɔkɔhora kokyikyi kofi berɛ. 14Nakoso sɛ ohu ne wanga ye nwo hwee wangyire braa ne, ná ɔma aleɛ kye so a, ye de né wale braa ne bɔhyɛ ne amukoraa, anaa ye anohoba bɔ ɔla ye so ne amukoraa wato nu. Wale wato nu, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔtele dwirɛ ne, wanga ye nwo hwee wangyire braa ne. 15Na sɛ ohu ne te edwirɛ ne, nakoso ɔma aleɛ kye so koraka né wakyikyi wafi berɛ a, ye de ɔkɔsoa braa ne amumuyɛɛ.”
16Ɛhemɔ ole ahyɛdeɛ mɔ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose, bɔ ɔfa biaa ne ɔye nwo, ɔne bɔ ɔfa baba ne ɔwa brasua ababunu bɔ ɔtɛ te ɔse awuro nwo ɔ.

Title: NUMERI 31
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ ne Midianfoɛ ko koɛ
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Tɔ Midianfoɛ so wereɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ; na ɛhe asi ye, ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ.” 3Yiti Mose sele Yisrael maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ mmenia ne bie noa maa bɛhɔ koɛ, ná bɛ ne Midian bɛɛho, ma AWURADE wereɛtɔlɛ ɔ́bra Midian so. 4Ɛmɔye Yisrael abusua kure biala anu mmenia apee ko maa bɛhɔ koɛ ne.” 5Yiti Yisrael mmenia worawora ne, abusua kure biala anu, bɛyele mmenia apee ko; mmenia apee buru ne nyɔ yeɛ bɛboaboale bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛkɔ koɛ ne ɔ. 6Mose somane bɛ maa bɛhɔle koɛ ne; abusua kure biala anu mmenia apee ko. Né ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase boka bɛ so. Né ye yeɛ otira nekaa krongron berɛ ndalie nemɔ ɔne totorobɛndo mɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ ese ne ɔ. 7Bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Midian, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne, na behuni Midian bienzua biala. 8Behuhuni Midian ahemvo hemɔ bɛbokale mmenia bɔ behuhuni bɛ ne aso: Ewi, Rekem, Sure, Hure ne Reba. Besa bɛfale ngrandɛ behuni Beɔ awa Balaam. 9Yisraelfoɛ hyele Midian mmrasua, bɛ ne bɛ mma mmaa mmaa mɔ nnure. Bɛfale bɛ nandwie amukoraa, bɛ mmoaen amukoraa, ɔne bɛ nningyein amukoraa bɛyɛle koɛ nu nzesadeɛ. 10Bɛyerale bɛ nguro bɔ né bɛtete so amukoraati, ɔne b’asikyeleɛ amukoraati. 11Nakoso koɛ nu nningyein amukoraa ɔne koɛ nu nzesadeɛ amukoraa de, kyɛ mmenia oo, kyɛ ngaka oo, bɛfa bɛhɔle. 12Afei mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne, koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne, ɔne koɛ nu nningyein ne, bɛfa bɛbrɛle Mose, ɔne ɔsɔfo Eleasa, ɔne Yisrael maen ne, wɔ asikyeleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ne, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne.
13Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasa ɔne Yisrael mbanyi ne amukoraa beeyiale koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi. 14Safohene mɔ bɔ bɛlela apee apee noa, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛlela ɛyaa ɛyaa noa bɔ befi koɛ noa bɛwale ne, Mose fɛle bɛ so yaa. 15Mose bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔama mmrasua hemɔ amu banya bɛ ti badidi nu? 16 Mmrasua hemɔ yeɛ Balaam tuli bɛ foɛ tɛɛ maa bɛlakalakale Yisraelfoɛ, bɔ ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ hwi fale AWURADE dwirɛ so ná bɛɛsɔnene Peɔ ne. Na ɛhe mane amaneɛ piri tole AWURADE mmenia. 17Yiti kekesaala ye, ɛ́mɔhu ngwadaa ne anu bienzua biala, ná ɛ́mɔhu brasua biala bɔ ɔne bienzua bala le ɔ. 18Nakoso abaayaa biala bɔ ɔne bienzua bɛllale le ne de, ɛ́mɔma onya ye ti odidi nu na ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. 19Ɛ́mɔtena asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo. Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔahu sona anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala bɔ ye nwo aha fuin ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔpete ɛmɔ nwo ɔne mmenia bɔ ɛmɔahye bɛ nnure nemɔ anwo ye ɛlɛsa ne aso ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso. 20Odi kyɛ ɛmɔpete ɛhemɔ anwo: ataadeɛ biala, nikyee biala bɔ bafa nwomaa bapa ɔ, nikyee biala bɔ bafa abɔngye nwiaa banwo ɔ, ɔne nikyee biala bɔ bafa bakaa base ɔ.”
21Ɔsɔfo Eleasa sele koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne kyɛ, “Mmeraa bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ama Mose ne, ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ ɛhe: 22sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere, buralɛ, kyɛnzee, sum, 23yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ bɛfa see bɛka ye a onhuro ne, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́te ye nwo, na ye nwo kofi. Nakoso odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa anwotelɛ nzue koso bɛte ye nwo. Na nikyee biala bɔ bɛfa see bɛka ye a ohuro ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bewura nzue ne anu. 24Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔpo ɛmɔ nwo nningyein, amaa ɛmɔ nwo afi. Ye si ye, ɛmɔkora bɛba asikyeleɛ ne anu.”
Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ hyɛlɛ
25AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 26“Ɛne ɔsɔfo Eleasa ɔne Yisraelfoɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ atitire nemɔ, ɛ́mɔha koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne, kyɛ mmenia ahɔ oo, anaa ngaka ahɔ oo. 27Kyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne anu nyɔ: fa bue ko ma koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne, ná fa bue ko koso ma Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne amukoraa. 28Koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne, bɛ bue deɛ ne, tua so toɔ ma AWURADE. Nningyein ɛyaa nnu biala, ye nu ko: kyɛ mmenia oo, nandwie oo, afunum oo, mmoaen oo, anaa mbɔngye oo. 29Ye fi bɛ bue deɛ ne anu ná fa ma ɔsɔfo Eleasa. Ɔte afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. 30Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ ngaa bɛ bue deɛ ne de, nningyein aburannu biala, kyɛ mmenia oo, nandwie oo, afunum oo, mmoaen oo, mbɔngye oo, anaa kaka biala oo, ye nu ko, ná fa ma Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛso wɔ AWURADE nyianu sua ne anu ne.”
31Na Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala: 32Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ sesale ne, ye ngaa ne somaa te mmoaen apee ɛyaa nzia ne aburasoo ne nnu, 33nandwie apee aburasoo ne nyɔ, 34afunum apee aburasia ne ko, 35ɔne mmenia apee aburasa ne nyɔ, bɔ bɛte mmrasua bɔ bennwuni biaa le ɔ.
36Bɛ bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne, bɛ bue deɛ te mmoaen ne mbɔngye apee ɛyaa nza aburasa ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nnu. 37Mmoaen ne mbɔngye ne, ɛtoɔ bɔ bɛye befili nu bɛmane AWURADE te ɛyaa nzia ne aburasoo ne nnu. 38Né nandwie nemɔ bɛte apee aburasa ne nzia, na ɛtoɔ bɔ bɛye befili nu bɛmane AWURADE te aburasoo ne nyɔ. 39Afunum nemɔ bɛte apee aburasa ɔne ɛyaa nnu, na ɛtoɔ bɔ bɛye befili nu bɛmane AWURADE te aburasia ne ko. 40Mmenia nemɔ bɛte apee buru ne nzia, na ɛtoɔ bɔ bɛye befili nu bɛmane AWURADE te mmenia aburasa ne nyɔ. 41Ɛtoɔ ne, bɔ ɔte afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ne, Mose fa mane ɔsɔfo Eleasa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.
42Mose fale koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bue deɛ mane bɛ ne, osa fale Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛ bue deɛ mane bɛ. 43Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛ bue deɛ bɔ ɔfa mane bɛ ne, ɔte mmoaen ne mbɔngye apee ɛyaa nza aburasa ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nnu, 44nandwie apee aburasa ne nzia, 45afunum apee aburasa ɔne ɛyaa nnu, 46ɔne mmenia apee buru ne nzia. 47Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ bue deɛ ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne, Mose yele mmenia ne ngaka aburannu biala nu ko, na ɔfa mane Lewifoɛ bɔ yeɛ bɛso wɔ AWURADE nyianu sua ne anu ne.
48Na mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛlela koɛhonɛfoɛ apee apee noa ne: safohene mɔ bɔ bɛlela apee apee noa, ɔne safohene mɔ bɔ bɛlela ɛyaa ɛyaa noa ne, bɛwale Mose berɛ, 49na beesele ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa mɔ yaha koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bewura yɛ bo ne, na yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ wafi nu ɔ. 50Na bɔ yɛ nu biala nwuni ye ne: sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ, bɛ bati ngaa ne bɛ sa kɔm ngaa, nzɔanoɛ ngaa, asomade ne akomuade, yafa AWURADE afɔleɛ yabrɛ ye, na yafa yapata yama yɛ kra wɔ AWURADE nyunu.” 51Na sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa ye mukoraa bayɔ mbembenanneɛ ne, Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa le fili bɛ berɛ. 52Na koɛhonɛfoɛ apee apee so safohene nemɔ ne ɛyaa ɛyaa so safohene nemɔ, bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE ne, ɔte kilo ɛyaa ko aburahona. 53(Sɔ nningyein nemɔ, né koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ de bafa bɛ deɛ basie.) 54Yiti Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa lele sikaa kɔkorɛ ne fili koɛhonɛfoɛ apee apee so safohene nemɔ ɔne koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛyaa ɛyaa so safohene nemɔ berɛ. Bɛfa bɛwale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu maa ɔyɛle ngayeɛ nikyee mane Yisraelfoɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

Title: NUMERI 32
Content:
Bɛkyɛ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ aseɛ
(Deuteronomi 3.12-22)
1Né Ruben boso ama mɔ ne Gade boso ama mɔ bele nyɛmmoa pee paa. Mmerɛ bɔ Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ nwuni kyɛ Yasere aseɛ ɔne Gileade aseɛ te paa ma ngaka sielɛ ne, 2bɛhɔle Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Yisrael mbanyi berɛ beesele bɛ kyɛ, 3“Atarote, Dibɔn, Yasere, Nimra, Hesebon, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo ɔne Beon: 4AWURADE lili sɔ aseɛ nemɔ aso ngonim wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu. Ɔte aseɛ paa ma nyɛmmoa, na wɔ ngoaa koso yɛle nyɛmmoa.” 5Bɛtoale so kyɛ, “Sɛ anya alo yɛ de a, ye de maa bɛfa aseɛ ye bɛma wɔ ngoaa ma ɔyɛ yɛ agyapadeɛ. Nnɛmaa yɛpɛ asue Yɔɔdan yɛkɔ ye si.”
6Nakoso Mose bisale Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ kyɛ, “Aso odi kyɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ kɔ koɛ ma ɛmɔ de ɛmɔtena wa? 7Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbu Yisraelfoɛ abasa nu maa ɔnate so bɛngɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE afa ama bɛ ne aso ɔ? 8Nzomane ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Kadese Banea kyɛ bɛɛnea aseɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔle ɔ. 9Beedwuli Ɛseko bɔnza ne anu ná benwuni aseɛ nen, bebuli Yisraelfoɛ abasa nu kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛkɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE afa ama bɛ ne aso. 10AWURADE fɛle yaa paa sɔ kyẽa ne, na ɔtale ndaen kyɛ, 11‘Nahorɛ nu, bɛ bɔ befili Misraim bɛwale ne, bɛ nu biala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ne, ongonwu aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma Abraham, Yisake ɔne Yakob ne, ofikyɛ banni nahorɛ bamma me. 12Sana Kenisiniɛ Yefune ɔwa Kalebo ɔne Nun awa Yosua angome yeɛ bekonwu ye ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bali nahorɛ bamma AWURADE ɔ.’ 13Na AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa, na ɔmaa behyinihyinini ɛserɛ so toonn afoɛ aburanna, kɔpem kyɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ bayɔ bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, bɛ mukoraa bewuwuli ɔ. 14Afei ɛmɔ, bɔnefoɛ boso ama, ɛmɔasi ɛmɔ nana mɔ gya nu, ɛmɔahɔ so bahu AWURADE ahone maa wafɛ Yisrael so yaa piri paa. 15Sɛ ɛmɔyakyi ye si lilɛ a, okosa kɔyakyi mmenia hemɔ bɛ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na ɛmɔkɔmaa mmenia he amukoraa bɛ boso konua.”
16Afei bɛwale Mose berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Yɛkosisi mmoaennduin wɔ wa yɛkɔma yɛ mmoaen mɔ, na yɛkɔkyekye nguro yɛkɔma yɛ mma mɔ. 17Nakoso yɛkɔfa akodeɛ yɛkoli Yisrael ama anyunu yɛkɔɔho, kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔfa bɛ yɛkodwu b’aseɛ so ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔnate porɛ ye anu mmenia ne ati, yɛ ngwadaa mɔ kɔtena nguro bɔ yabɔ bɛ nwo waen nemɔ anu. 18Yɛngosa yɛ si yɛngɔhɔ yɛ awuro kɔpem kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛ sa kɔha b’agyapadeɛ ɔ. 19Yɛ ne bɛ ngɔhyɛ Yɔɔdan si dɔ aseɛ ne, ofikyɛ yɛ sa aha yɛ agyapadeɛ deɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan ye bue faen bɔ ɔkɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne.”
20Yeɛ Mose sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhemɔ a: sɛ ɛmɔfa akodeɛ ná ɛmɔkɔ koɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, 21ná ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔtira akodeɛ ne, sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔfoa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kofi ye nyunu, 22ná AWURADE di aseɛ ne aso ngonim a, ye si ye, ɛmɔkɔhora bekosa bɛ si. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, né ɛmɔnni AWURADE ne Yisrael nyunu fɔ, na aseɛ he kɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ AWURADE nyunu. 23Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanyɔ sɔ a, ye de ɛmɔayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE, na ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔne nwo asohwenɛ kɔwa ɛmɔ so. 24Ɛ́mɔkyekye nguro bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ngwadaa mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsisi tuin bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mmoaen mɔ. Nakoso odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɛmɔahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne.”
25Na Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ ne sele Mose kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa kɔyɔ kyɛbɔ me mene ahyɛ ne. 26Yɛ mma mɔ, yɛ ye mɔ, yɛ mmoaen kure mɔ, ɔne yɛ nyɛmmoa amukoraa kɔhɔ so bɛkɔtena Gileade nguro nemɔ anu. 27Nakoso wɔ ngoaa mɔ, yɛ nu biala aboaboa ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ koɛ kɔma AWURADE, na yɛkɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan ne kyɛbɔ me mene ahyɛ ne ala.”
28Yiti ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfa Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ nwo ne, Mose ha hyirele ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Nun awa Yosua, ɔne Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi nemɔ. 29Na Mose sele bɛ kyɛ, “Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ, bɔ bɛ nu biala waboaboa ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔ koɛ ma AWURADE ne, sɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ pɛ asue Yɔɔdan ná ɛmɔkodi aseɛ ne aso ngonim a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa Gileade aseɛ ne bɛ́ma bɛ ma ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ. 30Nakoso sɛ bamva b’akodeɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ bangɔambɛ asue Yɔɔdan a, ye de odi kyɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ nya agyapadeɛ wɔ neka horɛ wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so.” 31Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ AWURADE aha ahyire wɔ ngoaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛkɔyɔ ɔ. 32Yɛkɔfa yɛ akodeɛ, yɛkɔpɛ asue ne AWURADE nyunu yɛkɔhɔ Kaanan aseɛ so. Nakoso y’aseɛ bɔ yanya ye wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue faen ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔyɛ yɛ deɛ.”
33Amorifoɛ hene Sihon ye ahennie ɔne Basan hene Ogo ye ahennie: b’aseɛ ne bɛ nguro, ɔne nguro bɔ wapɛ bɛ nwo wayia nemɔ aseɛ ne, Mose fa mane Gadefoɛ, Rubenfoɛ ɔne Yosef awa Manase abusua kure ne bue. 34Gadefoɛ kyekyele nguro hemɔ bieku: Dibɔn, Atarote, Aroye, 35Atrote Sofan, Yasere, Yobeha, 36Bete Nimra, ne Bete Haran. Bɛtole nguro nemɔ anwo fasue, yeɛ besisili mmoaen nduin wɔ bɛ nu. 37Rubenfoɛ kyekyele nguro hemɔ bieku: Hesebon, Eleale, Kiriatim, 38Nebo, ɔne Baal Meon (bɛsesane dumaa ne biemɔ), ɔne Sibima. Nguro bɔ besa bɛkyekyele nemɔ, bɛtotole bɛ dumaa foforɛ. 39Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ mɔ, bɛhɔle Gileade beelili so ngonim, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne. 40Yiti Mose fale Gileade mane Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ maa bɛtenane berɛ. 41Manase awa Yari hɔle oolili bɛ nguraa nemɔ aso ngonim, na osa tole bɛ dumaa Hawote Yari. 42Yeɛ Noba hɔle oolili Kenate ne ye nwo nguraa nemɔ so ngonim, na ɔsesane kuro ne dumaa fa tole ye nwo Noba.

Title: NUMERI 33
Content:
Yisrael ateetulɛ fi Misraim kwaadwu Moabo
1Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure fili Misraim aseɛ so, bɔ né Mose ne Aarɔn la bɛ noa ne, nekaa ahoroɔ bɔ bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ mɔ ɛhe. 2Mose hyerɛhyerɛle nekaa ahoroɔ bɔ betuli bɛ bo befili ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɛ ne. Na nekaa ahoroɔ bɔ betuli bɛ bo befili nemɔ ɛhe. 3Bosome bɔ oli moa, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, besili nu befili Ramese. Belili Abɔtra ne, ye alehyeleɛ, Yisraelfoɛ sili bɛ hue betuli bɛ bo, bɔ né Misraimfoɛ nye tua bɛ ɔ. 4Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Misraimfoɛ begu so besie bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE ahũhũ bɛ wafi bɛ nu ne. Misraimfoɛ nyameɛ nemɔ koso, AWURADE amva bɛ nwo angyɛ bɛ.
5Yiti Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo fili Ramese, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sukote. 6Betuli bɛ bo befili Sukote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Etam, bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ ne anoa dɔ ne. 7Betuli bɛ bo befili Etam, na besale bɛ si bɛhɔle Pi Hahirote, bɔ ɔwɔ Baal Sefon ndendeneɛ so ne, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Migidol nyunu. 8Betuli bɛ bo befili Pi Hahirote, bɛpɛle ɛpo ne bɛhɔle ɛserɛ ne aso, bɛpɛle atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ wɔ Etam ɛserɛ ne aso, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Mara. 9Betuli bɛ bo befili Mara, na beedwuli Elim. Né mbombonzue buru ne nyɔ ɔne ayee aburasoo wɔ Elim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ berɛ. 10Betuli bɛ bo befili Elim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anoa. 11Betuli bɛ bo befili Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anoa, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sin ɛserɛ ne aso. 12Betuli bɛ bo befili Sin ɛserɛ ne aso, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Dofeka. 13Betuli bɛ bo befili Dofeka, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Aluse. 14Betuli bɛ bo befili Aluse, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Refidim. Né mmenia ne bennya nzue bɛnno wɔ berɛ. 15Betuli bɛ bo befili Refidim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso. 16Betuli bɛ bo befili Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Kibrote Hataawa. 17Betuli bɛ bo befili Kibrote Hataawa, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Haserote. 18Betuli bɛ bo befili Haserote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Ritema. 19Betuli bɛ bo befili Ritema, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Rimon Pɛrɛse. 20Betuli bɛ bo befili Rimon Pɛrɛse, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Libina. 21Betuli bɛ bo befili Libina, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Risa. 22Betuli bɛ bo befili Risa, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Kehelata. 23Betuli bɛ bo befili Kehelata, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sefere bokaa ne anwo. 24Betuli bɛ bo befili Sefere bokaa ne anwo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Harada. 25Betuli bɛ bo befili Harada, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Makelote. 26Betuli bɛ bo befili Makelote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Tahate. 27Betuli bɛ bo befili Tahate, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Tara. 28Betuli bɛ bo befili Tara, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Miteka. 29Betuli bɛ bo befili Miteka, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Hasemona. 30Betuli bɛ bo befili Hasemona, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Moserote. 31Betuli bɛ bo befili Moserote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Bene Yaakan. 32Betuli bɛ bo befili Bene Yaakan, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Hore Hagidade. 33Betuli bɛ bo befili Hore Hagidade, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Yotebata. 34Betuli bɛ bo befili Yotebata, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Abrona. 35Betuli bɛ bo befili Abrona, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Esion Gebɛre. 36Betuli bɛ bo befili Esion Gebɛre, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sen ɛserɛ so (bɔ ye ole Kadese). 37Betuli bɛ bo befili Kadese, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Hore bokaa ne anwo. Ɔwɔ Edom aseɛ ne wɛen so.
38 Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, ye afoɛ aburanna ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne anu ne, ɔsɔfo Aarɔn fo hɔle Hore bokaa ne aso kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne, na oowuli wɔ berɛ. 39Aarɔn wuli wɔ Hore bokaa ne aso nen, né wali afoɛ ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ ne nza.
40Na Arade hene, bɔ ɔte Kanaanniɛ bɔ né ɔte Kanaan aseɛ ne ye ngwaen dɔ ne, ɔtele Yisraelfoɛ nga kyɛ bɛba.
41Betuli bɛ bo befili Hore bokaa ne anwo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Salmona. 42Betuli bɛ bo befili Salmona, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Punɔn. 43Betuli bɛ bo befili Punɔn, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Obote. 44Betuli bɛ bo befili Obote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Yiye Abarim, bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo aseɛ so ne. 45Betuli bɛ bo befili Yiyim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Dibɔn-Gade. 46Betuli bɛ bo befili Dibɔn Gade na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Almɔn Diblatayim. 47Betuli bɛ bo befili Almɔn Diblatayim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Abarim mmokaa nemɔ anu, wɔ Nebo ndendeneɛ so. 48Betuli bɛ bo befili Abarim mmokaa nemɔ anu, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne. 49Bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan noa, fi Bete Yesimote alaa beedwuli Abel Sitim wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso.
Kanaan aseɛ ne aso ngonimlilɛ
50Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 51“Kã kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔ Kanaan aseɛ ne aso a, 52 ye de ɛ́mɔfoa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa béfi ɛmɔ nyunu. Bɛ mmosoen bɔ bafa nyɔboɛ base ɔne b’amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsɛkye bɛ. Ɛ́mɔbubu b’asɔneyɛɛ amukoraa bégua, 53ná ɛ́mɔfa aseɛ ne bɛtena so, ofikyɛ mafa aseɛ ne mama ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔfa. 54Na ɛ́mɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛ́hyɛ aseɛ ne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ mmusua mmusua nemɔ bɛ mbiri si te ɔ. Abusua bɔ ɔte piri ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma bɛ aseɛ piri, yeɛ bɔ ɔte kãa ne koso ɛ́mɔma bɛ aseɛ ne kaaba. Nekaa bɔ serewagualɛ ne kɔye kɔma ebiala ne, ma berɛ ɔyɛ ye deɛ. Ebiala konya ye agyapadeɛ wɔ ye nana mɔ abusua kure deɛ nu. 55Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔamvoa aseɛ ne aso ama bamvi ɛmɔ nyunu a, ye de bɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔmaa bɛkɔha aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mmakaa bɛkɔwowɔ ɛmɔ nye, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mmowue bɛkɔwowɔ ɛmɔ mvenu, na bɛkɔha ɛmɔ adwene wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaatena so ne aso. 56Na nikyee bɔ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ bɛ ne, ɛmɔ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ ɛmɔ ɔ.”

Title: NUMERI 34
Content:
Kanaan aseɛ ne wɛen
1AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Fa ahyɛdeɛ he ma Yisraelfoɛ ná ka kyire bɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔkodwu Kanaan aseɛ ne aso a (Kanaan aseɛ bɔ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ne, ye wɛen mɔ ɛhe), 3 ɛmɔ aseɛ ne, ye ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne, ɔkɔtrɛ kofi Sen ɛserɛ so ná ɔne Edom babɔ wɛen. Ɛmɔ ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne, ɔkɔtrɛ kofi Ngyee Ɛpo ne anoa wɔ eyia afiteleɛ. 4Ɛmɔ wɛen ne kɔkondo kɔfa Akrabim pambaa ne ngwaen, ná wapɛ nu wahɔ Sen, na ye noa kɔɔpem Kadese Banea ngwaen. Ɔkɔtoa so kɔhɔ Hasa Ada, na wapɛ nu waadwu Asimɔn. 5Ɛwɛen ne kɔtrɛ kofi Asimɔn koodwu Misraim bɔnza ne anu, na ye noa kɔɔpem ɛpo ne.
6“Ɛmɔ eyia atɔleɛ wɛen kɔyɛ Ɛpo Piri ne ye mboanoa; ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ atɔleɛ ɛwɛen ɔ.
7Ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ɔ: ɛ́mɔto wɛen ne béfi Ɛpo Piri ne beedwu Hore bokaa ne. 8Ɛ́mɔto wɛen ne befi Hore bokaa ne maa oodwu Lebo Hamate, ná ye noa ɔɔpem Sedade. 9Afei ɛwɛen ne kɔtrɛ koodwu Sifron, na ye noa kɔɔpem Hasa Enan; berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ɔ.
10Ɛ́mɔto ɛmɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɛwɛen ne befi Hasa Enan beedwu Sefam; 11na ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro kofi Sefam koodwu Ribla bɔ ɔwɔ Ayin eyia afiteleɛ ne. Ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro koodwu Kinerete Ɛpo eyia afiteleɛ ndoroleɛ nu. 12Ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro kɔhɔ Asue Yɔɔdan noa, na ye noa kɔɔpem Ngyee Ɛpo ne. Ɛmɔ aseɛ ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ye noa wɛen mɔ ɔ.”
13 Na Mose fale ahyɛdeɛ he mane Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Aseɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛkyɛ ɔ. AWURADE ahyɛ kyɛ bɛ́fa bɛ́ma mmusua kure ngona ne bue ne. 14Ofikyɛ Rubenfoɛ abusua kure bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ, bɛ ne Gadefoɛ abusua kure bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue de, bale b’aseɛ deɛ. 15Sɔ mmusua kure nyɔ ne bue ne, bale b’aseɛ deɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan bɔ opingye Yeriko ne, ye si dɔ, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ.
Mbanyi bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne ɔ
16AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 17“Mmenia bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne bɛkɔma ɛmɔ maa ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ne, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Nun awa Yosua. 18Odi kyɛ ɛmɔye panyi ko befi abusua kure biala anu maa bɛkyɛ aseɛ ne maa ɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ. 19Mbanyi nemɔ, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Yuda abusua kure deɛ ole Yefune awa Kalebo. 20Simeon abusua kure deɛ ole Amihude awa Semuel. 21Benyamin abusua kure deɛ ole Kisilɔn awa Elidade. 22Dan abusua kure deɛ ole Yogli awa Buki bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 23Yosef boso ama mɔ: Manase abusua kure deɛ ole Efode awa Haniɛl bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 24Efraim abusua kure deɛ ole Sifitan awa Kemuel bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 25Sebulɔn abusua kure deɛ ole Panake awa Elisafan bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 26Yisaka abusua kure deɛ ole Asan awa Paltiɛl bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 27Asɛ abusua kure deɛ ole Selomi awa Ahihude bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 28Nafetali abusua kure deɛ ole Amihude awa Pedahel bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne. 29Mmenia hemɔ yeɛ AWURADE fa wurale bɛ sa kyɛ bɛhyɛ aseɛ ne bɛma Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so ne.”

Title: NUMERI 35
Content:
Lewifoɛ nguro
1 Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 2“Fa ahyɛdeɛ he ma Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, b’agyapadeɛ bɔ bɛ sa aha ye ne, bɛ́neanea nu bɛ́yeye nguro bɛ́ma Lewifoɛ mɔ maa bɛtena so. Afei koso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa Lewifoɛ bɛ nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɛma bɛ ma bɛ nyɛmmoa didi so. 3Nguro nemɔ kɔyɛ b’atenaleɛ, na nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ ne, so yeɛ bɛ nandwie mɔ, bɛ nyɛmmoa ne bɛ ngaka amukoraa bekodidi ɔ. 4Nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa kodidi so, bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔma Lewifoɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔhyɛ ye bo fi kuro berɛ fasue ne, ná ɔtrɛ kɔ agyirɛ apee ko ɔpɛ ye nwo bra yia. 5Kuro ne asi dɔ ne, ɛmɔsusu agyirɛ apee nyɔ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ, apee nyɔ wɔ ngwaen, apee nyɔ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, yeɛ apee nyɔ wɔ sorɔ, maa kuro ne ɔla afia. Sɔ aseɛ ne kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ bɛ nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa kodidi so ɔ.
6 Nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔma Lewifoɛ ne, mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nzia nemɔ, bɔ ɛmɔkɔma sona bɔ wali awue ate maa ɔkɔɔbɔ ye nwo adwaa wɔ nu ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛboka so. Ɛ́mɔfa nguro aburanna ne nyɔ bɛ́boka so bɛma bɛ. 7Nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔma Lewifoɛ ne, ye mukoraa kɔyɛ aburanna ne mmɔtwɛ, bɔ bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa kodidi so ɔ boka so ɔ. 8Yisraelfoɛ agyapadeɛ bɔ banya ye ne, nu nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bekofi nu bɛkɔma Lewifoɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔde nguro pee befi mmusua kure mbiri nemɔ berɛ, ná ɛmɔde nguro kãa bie befi mmusua kure mmaa mmaa nemɔ berɛ. Abusua kure biala, ye aseɛ bɔ wanya ye ne, kyɛbɔ ye piri si te ne, so yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔnea na ɔma Lewifoɛ mɔ nguro ɔ.
Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro
(Deuteronomi 19.1-13; Yosua 20.1-9)
9AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, 10“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔ Kaanan aseɛ ne aso a, 11odi kyɛ ɛmɔye nguro nemɔ bie besie berɛ maa bɛyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro bɛma ɛmɔ, amaa sona biala bɔ ɔmmoapa ná okoli awue ne, wanwati wahɔ berɛ. 12Sɔ nguro nemɔ, ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen bekofi wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne sa nu. Ɛhe kɔmaa bengohu sona bɔ wali awue ne wɔ aberɛ bɔ bennya bellili ye dwirɛ wɔ badwa nu ɔ.
13Nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bekosie berɛ ne, bɛkɔyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nzia kɔma ɛmɔ. 14Odi kyɛ ɛmɔye nguro nza besie berɛ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan asi dɔ, yeɛ nguro nza koso wɔ Kanaan aseɛ ne aso, maa bɛyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro bɛma ɛmɔ. 15Sɔ nguro nzia nemɔ kɔyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro kɔma Yisraelfoɛ, ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ wanya amandena, ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ ɔngɔhyɛ Yisrael maen nu ɔ, amaa sona biala bɔ ɔmmoapa ná okoli awue ne, wanwati wahɔ berɛ.
Awuelilɛ ne ye nwo wereɛtɔlɛ
16Nakoso sɛ ebie fa buralɛ bɔ obiɛngo maa owu a, ɔte kodiawuniɛ, na odi kyɛ beku ye bie. 17Anaakyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa nyɔboɛ kɔbɔ obiɛngo maa okowu ne, ɔte kodiawuniɛ, na odi kyɛ beku ye bie. 18Anaakyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa bakaa bɔ ɔte akodeɛ kɔbɔ obiɛngo maa okowu ne, ɔte kodiawuniɛ, na odi kyɛ beku ye bie. 19Wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne yeɛ odi kyɛ oku kodiawuniɛ ne ɔ. Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu kodiawuniɛ ne a, odi kyɛ oku ye. 20Sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ebie onguro obiɛngo dwirɛ, ná osumu ye to ase, anaa ɔtetɛ ye fa nikyee bɔ ye maa owu a, 21anaa sɛ ebie pɔ obiɛngo, ná ɔtwe ye sa bɔ ye maa owu a, ye de sɔ sona bɔ ɔtole twɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ beku ye; ɔte kodiawuniɛ. Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu kodiawuniɛ ne a, odi kyɛ oku ye.
22Nakoso sɛ mvum nu, ebie sumu obiɛngo bɔ ɔmbɔ ye to ase, anaa ɔto nikyee bɔ ye wɔ aberɛ bɔ wandetɛ ye, 23anaakyɛ otira nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔkora di awue, na ɔyakyi nu to ebie so maa owu wɔ aberɛ bɔ wanhyɛ da a, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛmbɔ bɛ nwo bɔ adwene tɛɛ biala ɔnne ye ti anu a, 24ye de maen ne kogyina nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ aso koli sona bɔ wali awue ne ɔne wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne b’afia dwirɛ. 25Na maen ne kole sona bɔ wali awue ne kofi wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne sa nu. Afei maen ne kɔfa sona bɔ wali awue ne kɔhɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bɔ ɔnwati hɔle nu ne aso. Sona bɔ wali awue ne kɔtena kuro ne aso kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo panyi bɔ bapopa ye ngoo krongron ne okowu ɔ. 26Nakoso sona bɔ wali awue ne, sɛ ofi mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro ne anu fite mmerɛ biala, 27ná sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu ye wɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro ne asi, ná wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ku ye a, ye de onni ye mogya nwo fɔ. 28Ofikyɛ, odi kyɛ sona bɔ wali awue ne, ɔtena mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro ne anu kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo panyi ne kowu ɔ. Nakoso ɔsɔfo panyi ne wue si de, sona bɔ wali awue ne, ɔkɔhora kosa kɔhɔ ye kuro. 29Nekaa bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena biala, sɔ dwirɛ ne kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ kɔma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
30 “Sɛ ebie ku obiɛngo a, odi kyɛ begyina adanzefoɛ noa dwirɛ so beku kodiawuniɛ ne bie; nakoso onni kyɛ begyina adanzeniɛ komapɛ noa dwirɛ so beku ebiala. 31Afei koso, kodiawuniɛ bɔ ɔfata ewue ne, onni kyɛ ɛmɔde mbata bɛfa bɛsesã ye ngoa; odi kyɛ beku kodiawuniɛ. 32Yeɛ sona bɔ wanwati wahɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bie aso ne, onni kyɛ ɛmɔde mbata befi ye berɛ maa onya ate osa batena maen ne anu koraka né ɔsɔfo panyi ne awu. 33Nnɛma ɛmɔfa efiɛ bɛka aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔte so ne, ofikyɛ mogya ma efiɛ ka aseɛ ne. Na mogya bɔ bɛkɔhã bekogua aseɛ ne aso ne, mbata biala ngɔhora ngɔte aseɛ ne anwo, sana sona bɔ waha sɔ mogya wagua ne, ye mogya ala. 34Nnɛfa efiɛ ka aseɛ bɔ ɛte so, bɔ me koso nde so bie ne. Ofikyɛ me AWURADE, nde Yisraelfoɛ nu.”

Title: NUMERI 36
Content:
Mmrasua mɔ agyapadeɛ
1Manase awa Makyiri ɔwa Gileade boso ama mɔ befi Yosef abusua nu. Bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi bɛɛfale bɛ dwirɛ bɛtole Mose ne Yisrael mbanyi, ɔne Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi nyunu. 2 Bɛhane kyɛ, “AWURADE hyɛle me mene kyɛ ɔfa serewagualɛ so ɔhyɛ aseɛ ne ma Yisraelfoɛ; na AWURADE hyɛle me mene kyɛ ɔfa y’eliɛma Selofehade agyapadeɛ ɔma ye mma mmrasua mɔ. 3Nakoso sɛ begya biaa wɔ Yisrael abusua kure foforɛ nu a, ye de bekole b’aseɛ deɛ bekofi yɛ nana mɔ aseɛ deɛ nu, ná bafa baaboka abusua kure bɔ bahɔ nu agyaa ne b’aseɛ deɛ so. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, yɛ aseɛ deɛ ne, so kɔte. 4Na sɛ Yisraelfoɛ Yubilee afoɛ ne so a, ye de odi kyɛ bɛfa b’aseɛ deɛ bɛboka abusua kure bɔ bahɔ nu agyaa ne bɛ deɛ so; na bekole b’aseɛ deɛ bekofi yɛ nana mɔ abusua kure aseɛ deɛ nu.”
5Yeɛ Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he mane Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ Yosef boso ama nemɔ baha ne, ɔte nahorɛ. 6Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ka fa Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ nwo ɛhe: Bɛkɔhora bekogya biaa biala bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bekuro ɔ; na mmom abusua bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ nana mɔ abusua kure ne anu yeɛ odi kyɛ begya nu biaa ɔ; 7amaa ɔnate so bamva Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure biala aseɛ bamma abusua kure foforɛ; ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ abusua kure aseɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛ nu biala maa ɔka abusua kure ne anu. 8Baa brasua biala bɔ ole aseɛ wɔ Yisrael abusua kure biala nu ne, odi kyɛ abusua bɔ ɔwɔ ye baba abusua kure nu yeɛ ogya nu biaa ɔ, amaa Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ abusua kure aseɛ ne wahɔ so waha abusua kure ne anu. 9Onni kyɛ bɛfa abusua kure biala aseɛ bɛma abusua kure foforɛ; ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure biala b’aseɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛmaa ɔka abusua kure ne anu.”
10Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala. 11Mahela, Tisa, Hogela, Milka ɔne Nowa bɔ yeɛ bɛte Selofehade mma mmrasua ne begyigyale bɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua mɔ bɛ mma mmienzua ne bie. 12Yosef awa Manase abusua kure ne, nu mmusua nemɔ anu mmienzua yeɛ begyigyale bɛ ɔ. Na b’aseɛ hale bɛ baba abusua nu wɔ abusua kure ne anu.
13Ɛhemɔ ole mmeraa dwirɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so fa mane Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. Ɔfa mane bɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne.

Title: DEUTERONOMI BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
