15Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, bɛpɛle aleɛ bedwɔsole, na bɛbɔle kuro ne anwo nzra bɛbra beyiale, kyɛbɔ bɛyɔle ye daa ne ala, sɔ alaa pɛen nzoo. Sɔ kyẽa ne angome de, bɛbɔle kuro ne anwo nzra bɛbra beyiale pɛen nzoo. 16Ye pɛen nzoo ne aso, bɔ asɔfo nemɔ huli totorobɛndo nemɔ nen, Yosua sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbɔ ese, ofikyɛ AWURADE afa kuro ne wawura ɛmɔ sa. 17Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɛkye kuro ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati bɔkɔɔ maa ɔyɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Sana gyanderaniɛ Rahabo ngome, ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ ye awuro berɛ amukoraati yeɛ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔfale ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ yɛsomane bɛ ne feale ɔ. 18 Nakoso ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ nningyein bɔ AWURADE atu asie berɛ kyɛ ɛ́mɔsɛkye ye ne anwo, ná wamma ye kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa sɔ nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔsɛkye ye ne bie, bɔ ɔkɔmaa Yisrael asikyeleɛ ne kɔyɛ nikyee bɔ odi kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ɔ, bɔ ɔkɔfa amaneɛ kɔbrɛ ye ɔ. 19Nakoso nikyee biala bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ anaa sikaa kɔkorɛ anaa kɔɔbere anaa buralɛ bayɔ de, ɔte krongron ma AWURADE; odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛkoogua AWURADE nningyein sua ne anu.” 20 Yiti mmenia ne bɔle ese, na asɔfo nemɔ huli totorobɛndo nemɔ. Mmerɛ bɔ mmenia ne tele kyɛ bahu totorobɛndo nemɔ pɛ, bɛbɔle ese serɛserɛ, na fasue ne bu guale gyirigorɔɔ. Na mmenia ne amukoraa hɔle bɛ nyunu tee beewura kuro ne anu, na belili so ngonim. 21Afei bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraa bɔkɔɔ: mmienzua ne mmrasua, ngwadaa ne mbanyi, yeɛ behuhuni nandwie, mmoaen ne afunum amukoraa.
22Na Yosua sele mmienzua nyɔ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne besiele ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ gyanderaniɛ n’awuro berɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa braa ne bɛbra, ɔne ye nwo ama mukoraati, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔtale ndaen behyirele ye ne.” 23Yiti mmerandeɛ maentetɛlɛfoɛ ne hɔle berɛ, na bɛyele Rahabo befitele, ɔne ye baba, ye maame, oliɛma mɔ ne ye nwo ama mukoraati. Bɛyele ye abusuafoɛ mukoraati befitele, na bɛfale bɛ bɛhɔle Yisrael asikyeleɛ ne asi. 24Bɛtole kuro ne anu ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati nu see bɛyerale ye. Nu nikyee biala bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ anaa esikaa kɔkorɛ anaa kɔɔbere anaa buralɛ bayɔ de, bɛsesale beeguale AWURADE awuro nningyein sua ne anu. 25 Nakoso gyanderaniɛ Rahabo ne ye nwo ama mukoraa de, Yosua maa benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu. Na ye abusua ne atena Yisrael maa waadwu ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ofikyɛ ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ Yosua somane bɛ maa bɛɛtetɛle Yeriko nen, ɔfale bɛ feale.
26 Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua payele kyɛ,
“Sona biala bɔ ɔkɔkyekye Yeriko kuro he bieku nen,
AWURADE prápra musue ógua ye so;
sɛ ɔ́to kuro ne fapem a,
ɔkɔfa ye bamuɛbaa yeɛ ɔkɔpɛ so ɔ,
yeɛ sɛ ótuatua ye pambim mɔ a,
ɔkɔfa ye kasiɛ yeɛ ɔkɔpɛ so ɔ!”
27Yiti AWURADE gyinane Yosua si, na bɛtele ye nga wɔ aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala.

Title: YOSUA 7
Content:
Akan bɔne nwo asohwenɛ
1Nakoso AWURADE mmeraa bɔ ɔfa nningyein bɔ watu wasie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne anwo ne, Yisraelfoɛ buli so. Akan bɔ ɔse ole Karemi, bɔ ɔse ole Sabidi, bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Sera bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne, ɔfale nningyein bɔ AWURADE atu asie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie, yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisraelfoɛ so yaa piri paa.
2Yosua somane mmienzua biemɔ maa befili Yeriko bɛhɔle Aye, bɔ opingye Bete Awen, wɔ Betel eyia afiteleɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfo bɛhɔ bɛɛtetɛ aseɛ ne.” Na mmenia ne hɔle bɛɛtetɛle Aye besiele. 3Na besa bɛwale bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ kyɛ, “Onhia kyɛ mmenia ne amukoraati bɛkɔfo bɛkɔhɔ dɔ ɔ. Ma mmienzua kɔyɛ apee nyɔ anaa apee nza beetua Aye beli so ngonim. Berɛ ama bɛnzone, yiti nnɛma mmenia ne amukoraa bɛkɔ dɔ bɛkɔko.” 4Yiti mmenia kɔyɛ apee nza fo hɔle dɔ, na bangora Ayefoɛ nyunu gyina, bɛnwatili. 5Ayefoɛ huhuni bɛ nu mmenia kɔyɛ aburasa ne nzia, bɛfoane bɛ befili kuro berɛ pambim ne asi toonn beedwuli Hyebarim, na behuhuni bɛ wɔ bokaa ne ndoroleɛ nu. Ɛserɛ hane Yisraelfoɛ, na bɛbɔle fuin.
6Ɛhe mane Yosua sunzuale ye ndaadeɛ nu, na ɔfale ye nyunu butuli aseɛnwo wɔ AWURADE alaka ne nyunu toonn maa oodwuli nɔsoa. Ɔne Yisrael mbanyi yeɛ bɛyɔle sɔ ɔ, na betuli mvuture beguale bɛ ti so. 7Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “O, AWURADE Nyameɛ! Nzu ati koraa yeɛ ɛfale maen he pɛle asue Yɔɔdan ɔ, kyɛ ɛbaafa yɛ wura Amorifoɛ sa maa bekuku yɛ ɔ? Sɛ né yɛse po a, ahaa yɛhale Yɔɔdan si dɔ! 8Mesrɛ wɔ ala, AWURADE, afei bɔ Yisrael wanwati wafi ye pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu ye, nzikyɛ dwirɛ koraa yeɛ nga ɔ? 9 Kanaanfoɛ ne aseɛ ye asofoɛ mukoraati bɛkɔte sɔ dwirɛ ye, bɛkɔpɛ yɛ nwo bekoyia, na bɛkɔma yɛ boso konua. Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkɔyɔ kɔfa wɔ dumaa bɔ odi mu ne anwo ɔ?
10Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Dwɔso! Nzu ati yeɛ afa wɔ nyunu abutu ase ye? 11Yisrael ayɔ bɔne. M’apam bɔ nhyɛle bɛ kyɛ beli so ne, babu so. Basesa nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie; bawua, bapɛ ngondombo, na bafa baafea bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nningyein nu. 12Ɔnate sɔ ne ati yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛngora bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu gyina ɔ; bɛnwati befi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ bayɛ mmenia bɔ matu bɛ masie berɛ kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku bɛ ɔ. Mengogyina ɛmɔ si ko, sana nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ behũ bɛ ná bɛsɛkye bɛ ne, ɛ́mɔye befi ɛmɔ nu. 13Dwɔso! Te mmenia nemɔ nwo, ná ka kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nwo bésie bɛ́fa bɛ́nwondɛ ɛhema, ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne nwa: O Yisrael, nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne, ebie wɔ wɔ berɛ. Na ɛngɔhora wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu gyina, sana ɛmɔye nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne befi ɛmɔ nu.’ 14Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ ɛmɔbagyina me nyunu mmusua kure mmusua kure. Na abusua kure bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa mmusua mmusua; yeɛ abusua bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa awuro ama awuro ama; na awuro ama bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa ngoko ngoko. 15Na sona bɔ ngɔye ye kyɛ nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie wɔ ye berɛ nen, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera ye, ɔne ye nwo ama ne ye nikyee biala, ofikyɛ wabu AWURADE apam ne aso, na wabɔ nyanzoen bra wɔ Yisrael.”
16Yiti Yosua dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ wale AWURADE nyunu abusua kure abusua kure, na serewagualɛ ne yele Yuda abusua kure ne. 17Ɔmane Yuda mmusua mmusua nemɔ pingyele berɛ, na serewagualɛ ne yele Serafoɛ abusua. Ɔmane Serafoɛ abusua ne anu ama pingyele berɛ bɛ sasofoɛ bɛ sasofoɛ, na serewagualɛ ne yele Sabidi sasofoɛ. 18Ɔmane Sabidi sasofoɛ wale ngoko ngoko, na serewagualɛ ne yele Akan bɔ ɔse ole Karemi, bɔ ɔse ole Sabodi, bɔ ɔse ole Sera bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne. 19Na Yosua sele Akan kyɛ, “Mma, fa animnyam ma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ná ka nahorɛ wɔ ye nyunu. Nikyee bɔ ayɔ ne, ka kyire me kekesaala ye. Nnɛfa fea me.” 20Na Akan buale Yosua kyɛ, “Ɔte nahorɛ, me yeɛ mayɔ bɔne matia AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ɔ. Bɔ nyɔle ɛhe: 21Nwuni aguasoɛ nyemenenyemene bie bɔ bɛyɔle ye wɔ Sinari, ɛdwetɛ kilo nyɔ, ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo bue wɔ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne anu. Me nye yɛle bɛ nwo koakoa, na nzesale. Mafu mawura ase wɔ me tena sua ne anu, na ɛdwetɛ ne yeɛ ɔwɔ ye bo paa ɔ.”
22Yiti Yosua somane mmenia, betuli amirika bɛhɔle ɛtena sua ne anu, na amba, né wafa wafea ye tena sua ne anu, bɔ ɛdwetɛ ne wura ye bo paa ɔ. 23Bɛsesale nningyein ne befili ɛtena sua ne anu, bɛfa bɛbrɛle Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati, na bɛfa beguale AWURADE nyunu. 24Afei Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛfale Sera awa Akan, ɛdwetɛ ne, aguasoɛ ne, sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, Akan mma mmienzua ne mmrasua, ye nandwie mɔ, ye afunum mɔ, ye mmoaen, ye tena sua ne, ɔne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɛwale Akɔre Bɔnza nu. 25Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ amaneɛ yeɛ aahwe abrɛ yɛ ye? AWURADE kɔma amaneɛ kɔto wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye.” Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye. Bɛfale see bɛyerale bɛ, na bɛsesale nyɔboɛ beguale bɛ so. 26Na bɛboaboale nyɔboɛ kure kandinga beguale ye so, bɔ nyɔboɛ kure ne tɛ wɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ. Na AWURADE mane ye ahone tɔle nzue nu. Yiti bɛfrɛ berɛ Akɔre bɔnza maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

Title: YOSUA 8
Content:
Belili Aye so ngonim
1Afei AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ. Fa koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraati boka wɔ nwo so, na fo kɔ Aye. Tie, mafa Aye hene ne ye mmenia, ye kuro ne, ɔne ye aseɛ mawura wɔ sa. 2Nikyee bɔ ɛfa yɔle Yeriko ne ye hene nen, sɔ ala yeɛ fa yɔ Aye ne ye hene ɔ. Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne nyɛmmoa bɔ bɛwɔ nu ne, bɛ ngome yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɔ. Ma mmenia bɛɛtɛ kuro ne wɔ ye si dɔ.”
3Yiti Yosua ne koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraati betuli bɛ bo kyɛ bɛkwaafo bɛkɔ Aye. Yosua yele koɛhonɛfoɛ apee aburasa, na ɔmaa bɛhɔle kɔngɔen. 4Na ɔhyɛle bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie! Ɛmɔɔtɛ kuro ne wɔ ye si dɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔfi kuro ne anwo bɛkɔ dede biala, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔboa bɛ nwo kyɛ ɛmɔkwaagyina koɛ noa ɔ. 5Na me ne mmenia bɔ bɛboka me so ne yɛkopingye kuro ne. Sɛ befite bɛba yɛ so, kyɛbɔ daa ne bɛyɔle ne a, ye de yɛkɔnwati yɛkofi bɛ nyunu. 6Bɛkɔfoa yɛ alaa kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔmaa bekofi kuro ne anu bekofite ɔ; ofikyɛ bekosusu kyɛ, ‘Bɛ́nwati béfi yɛ nyunu, kyɛbɔ daa ne bɛyɔle ne.’ Yiti yɛkɔnwati yɛkofi bɛ nyunu, 7na ɛmɔ koso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔtetɛ ne befite, ná ɛmɔkɔfa kuro ne; ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ. 8Na sɛ kuro ne badi ɛmɔ sa nu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa see bɛto nu; ɛ́mɔyɔ kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne ala. Ɛ́mɔtie! Bɔ menwa ɛ́mɔyɔ hɔ ɛne.” 9Yiti Yosua guale bɛ ate, na bɛhɔle bɛɛtetɛle. Bɛɛfeale Betel ne Aye b’afia, wɔ Aye eyia atɔleɛ; nakoso Yosua de, ɔne mmenia ne bɛlale asikyeleɛ berɛ kɔngɔen ne.
10Yosua dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu boaboale mmenia ne noa, ɔne Yisrael mbanyi bɛfo belili mmenia ne nyunu, na bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele Aye. 11Koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ né bɛboka ye so ne, bɛ mukoraati bɛfole bokaa ne bɛhɔle, bepingyele kuro berɛ pambim ne, na bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Aye sorɔ dɔ. Né bɔnza la bɛ ne Aye b’afia. 12Yosua fale mmenia kɔyɛ apee nnu, na ɔmaa bɛɛtetɛle Betel ne Aye b’afia, wɔ kuro ne eyia atɔleɛ. 13Yiti bɛmane koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ gyinagyinane: koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbaaho koɛ ne deinn ne, bɛwɔ sorɔ, yeɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ beli nziɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne koso bɛwɔ kuro ne atɔleɛ. Nakoso Yosua de, ɔhɔle bɔnza ne anu dɔ kɔngɔen ne. 14Mmerɛ bɔ Aye hene nwuni edwirɛ bɔ ɔ́kɔ so nen, ɔne ye mmenia mukoraati, kuro berɛ mmienzua ne, bɛyɛle ndɛndɛ ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtetale Yisrael wɔ Araba ndendeneɛ so, nakoso né ɔnze kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ baatetɛ ye wɔ kuro ne asi. 15Yosua ne Yisrael amukoraati bɛboapa bɛyɛle kyɛ kuro berɛ ama ali bɛ so ngonim, na bɛnwatili bɛfale ɛserɛ so dɔ atee ne aso. 16Yiti kuro berɛ ama teateane nu bɛfrɛfrɛle ebiala kyɛ ɔbra ma bɛfoa Yisraelfoɛ. Ayefoɛ foane Yosua, na ɔnate so maa Ayefoɛ fili bɛ kuro berɛ bɛhɔle moa. 17Bienzua ko po wanga Aye anaa Betel bɔ wamvite wangɔamvoa Yisrael bie ɔ. Bɛyakyili kuro berɛ pambim ne bɛtole so bɛɛfoane Yisrael.
18Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn bɔ otira wɔ sa nu ne, tengyɛ ye wɔ Aye so, ofikyɛ ngɔfa kuro ne ngowura wɔ sa.” Yiti Yosua tengyɛle buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn bɔ otira ye sa nu ne wɔ kuro ne aso. 19Ɔtengyɛle ye sa pɛ, yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baatetɛ eburo ne hane bɛ nwo befitele ɔ, na bele amirika bewurale kuro ne anu beelili so ngonim. Na berɛ ne ala, bɛtole kuro ne anu see. 20Na mmerɛ bɔ Aye mmienzua tole bɛ nye bɛneane nziɛ nen, benwuni kyɛ kuro ne anu nwosina ótu kɔ anwuro. Yiti né bennwu nekaa horɛ bɔ bɛnwati bɛhɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛnwatili bɛhɔle ɛserɛ so dɔ ne, bɛkakyili bɛ nwo bɛwale Ayefoɛ so. 21Na Yosua ne Yisrael amukoraati benwuni kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle ne bali kuro ne aso ngonim, ná afei kuro ne anu nwosina koso ótu kɔ anwuro nen, bɛkakyili bɛ nwo beehuhuni Aye mmienzua nemɔ. 22Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ fekue ko ne koso fili kuro ne anu fitele, na bɛwale Ayefoɛ so. Yiti Ayefoɛ hale Yisraelfoɛ afia, bɔ Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bie wɔ bue faen, ná ebiemɔ koso wɔ bue dɔ ɔ. Na Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ, bɔ ko po wanga anaa wannwati ɔ. 23Nakoso Aye hene de, bɛhyele ye anyekaenn so, na bɛfale ye bɛbrɛle Yosua.
24Yisraelfoɛ huhuni Ayefoɛ amukoraati wɔ ɛserɛ pralaa ne aso yiele. Berɛ yeɛ Ayefoɛ foane Yisraelfoɛ hɔle ɔ, na bɛ mukoraa bɛtotɔle ngrandɛ noa maa beyiele bɔkɔɔ nen, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa sa wale Aye, na bɛfale ngrandɛ beehuhuni mmenia bɔ baha berɛ ne. 25Ayefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛtotɔle sɔ kyẽa ne: mmienzua ne mmrasua, bɛte apee buru ne nyɔ. 26Yosua sa bɔ ɔfa tengyɛle buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn wɔ Aye so nen, wandwe wanza kɔpem kyɛ ohuhuni Ayefoɛ amukoraa bɔkɔɔ ɔ. 27Kuro ne anu nyɛmmoa ne koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ngome yeɛ Yisrael fale ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yosua ne ala. 28Yiti Yosua yerale Aye, na ɔkakyili ye kurofoen esire afebɔɔ maa waadwu ɛnɛ. 29Na Aye hene de, osinzele ye bakaa so maa oodwuli nɔsoa. Na eyia tɔle ne, Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ yele ye fuin ne befili bakaa ne aso, befindini ye bɛtole kuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu, na ɔmaa bɛboaboale nyɔboɛ kure kandinga beguale ye so, bɔ ɔtɛwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ɔ.
Yosua kenga mmeraa ne wɔ Ebal bokaa ne aso
30 Afei Yosua sili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Ebal bokaa ne aso mane AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, 31 kyɛbɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyehyɛle mane Yisraelfoɛ ne ala, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose mmeraa nwomaa ne anu kyɛ, “Afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bafa nyɔboɛ mumua mumua basi ɔ, bɔ nna pɛwaa yeɛ bafa base ɔ.” Bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so bɛmane AWURADE, na bɛbɔle asomdwee afɔleɛ koso. 32Na Mose mmeraa bɔ ɔhyerɛle ne, Yosua hyerɛle ɛhene ala bie guale nyɔboɛ ne aso wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu berɛ. 33 Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati, ɛwɔfoɛ ne maen mmaa, bɛ ne Yisrael mbanyi ne safohene mɔ ne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ mɔ, begyinagyinane apam alaka ne bue faen ne ye bue faen, wɔ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo bɔ bɛsõ AWURADE apam alaka ne anyunu. Bɛ bue ko gyinagyinane Gerisim bokaa ndendeneɛ so, yeɛ bɛ bue ko wora gyinagyinane Ebal bokaa ndendeneɛ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose lili moa hyehyɛle ne; kyɛ, odi kyɛ beyira Yisrael. 34Na ɛhe asi ne, Yosua kengale mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ amukoraa: saleɛ ne musue ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye mukoraa wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu ne. 35Edwirɛ bɔ Mose hyɛle ne amukoraa, nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ Yosua wangenga ye wɔ Yisrael badwa ne amukoraa nyunu ɔ, mmrasua ne ngwadaa mɔ nyunu, yeɛ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena Yisraelfoɛ mɔ nu koso bɛ nyunu.

Title: YOSUA 9
Content:
Gibeonfoɛ lakalaka Yosua
1Ahemvo amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ mmokaa aseɛ so, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛwɔ Ɛpo Piri noa, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Lebanon ne, bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne: bɛ ole Hitifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ ahemvo mɔ. 2Beyiale bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bɛ ne Yosua ne Yisrael bɛkwaaho.
3Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Gibeonfoɛ tele nikyee bɔ Yosua afa ayɛ Yeriko ne Aye nen, 4bɛ de bɛfale nnakannaka atee so: bɛfale aleɛ, na bɛfale mmɔtɔ teterewaa, ɔne nzaa ngotoku daa bɔ nu asunzua bɔ bapomba ɔ bɛsoale b’afunum mɔ. 5Bewurale mbaboa daadaa bɔ bapombapomba ɔ, ɔne ndaadeɛ teterewaa. Né b’aleɛ ne amukoraa wayɛ wosee, yeɛ né wasa wali ature. 6Bɛhɔle Yosua berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Gilgal, na besele ye ne Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Yɛfi maen bie anu dedeede yeɛ yawa ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛ́yɛ apam.” 7 Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ buale Hiwifoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ebiaa né ɛmɔte bepingye yɛ; ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yɛ ne ɛmɔ yayɛ apam?” 8Na Gibeonfoɛ buale Yosua kyɛ, “Yɛte wɔ ngoaa.” Na Yosua bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ ole nwa mɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔfi nisua?” 9Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa bɔ watrɛ wahɔ dede ne, ɔnate ye ti yeɛ wɔ ngoaa yafi maen dedeede bie aso yawa ɔ; ofikyɛ yate ye nwo dwirɛ, bɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Misraim amukoraa, 10 ɔne nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa yɔle Amorifoɛ ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ: Sihon ne Hesebon bɔ né bɛwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, ɔne Basan hene Ogo bɔ né ɔte Astarote ne. 11Yiti yɛ mbanyi mɔ ne yɛ maen ne anu ama mukoraa ha hyirele yɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa aleɛ ná ɛ́mɔsi nu beeyia bɛ, ná ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛte ɛmɔ ngoaa, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛ́yɛ apam.” ’ 12Ɛ́mɔnea yɛ paanoo ye. Kyẽa bɔ yɛsili nu kyɛ yɛba ɛmɔ wa nen, yeɛ yɛfa yɛwurale yɛ nningyein nu wɔ awuro, kyɛ yɛbaali ye atunu ɔ, na né ɔyɛ hye. Nakoso afei de, ɛ́mɔnea, wayɛ wosee, na wali ature. 13Sɔ nzaa nwomaa ngotoku hemɔ, yɛfale nzaa yɛguale nu maa beyiyili ne, né bɛte monɛ, nakoso ɛ́mɔnea, basunzuasunzua. Yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ atee ne wale soma ne ati, yɛ ndaadeɛ ne yɛ mbaboa hemɔ atete.” 14Yiti Yisraelfoɛ lili b’aleɛ ne bie, na bammisa AWURADE bandie ye noa dwirɛ. 15Yosua ne bɛ yɛle asomdwee apam, bɔ odi agyinamuɛ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ɔ; na Yisrael ɛlɔen ne anu mbanyi tale ndaen foale so.
16Yisraelfoɛ ne bɛ yɛle apam ne, ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ tele kyɛ bɛte bepingye bɛ ɔ, na befi porɛ ne anu berɛ ala. 17Yiti Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo befili asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ, na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, beedwuli Gibeonfoɛ nguro nemɔ aso. Bɛ nguro nemɔ ole: Gibeon, Kefira, Beerote ne Kiriate Yearim. 18Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ anguku bɛ, ofikyɛ né Yisrael ɛlɔen ne anu mbanyi bali moa bafa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ bata ndaen bahyire bɛ. Afei ɛlɔen ne amukoraa penepenene bɛ komvi beguale mbanyi nemɔ so. 19Nakoso Yisrael mbanyi amukoraa sele ɛlɔen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Yafa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ yata ndaen yahyire bɛ, yiti ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛ sa yɛkã bɛ. 20Bɔ yɛkɔyɛ bɛ hɔ ɛhe: Yɛkɔmaa bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu, amaa ɔnate ndaen bɔ yata yahyire bɛ ne ati Nyameɛ amvɛ yɛ so yaa.” 21Na mbanyi nemɔ sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma bénya bɛ ti bédidi nu, nakoso yɛkɔmaa bɛkɔyɔ eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma bɛkɔma ɛlɔen ne amukoraati.” Yiti ɛlɔen ne tiele bɔ mbanyi nemɔ hane ne.
22Yosua frɛfrɛle Gibeonfoɛ maa bɛwale, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔlakalakale yɛ kyɛ, ‘Nekaa bɔ yɛfi ne, ɔne ɛmɔ wa wale paa,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔte yɛ porɛ ye anu ala ɔ? 23Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, Nyameɛ apaye ɛmɔ: ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kɔyɛ ngoaa daa, na bɛkɔyɛ eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma wɔ me Nyameɛ awuro.” 24Na bebuale Yosua kyɛ, “Ebie ha hyirele wɔ ngoaa mɔ pefee kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle ye somvoɛ Mose kyɛ ɔ́fa aseɛ ne amukoraa ɔ́ma ɛmɔ, ná ohuhu so mmenia amukoraa ofi ɛmɔ nyunu. Na ɔnate ɛmɔ ti, né yɛsuro paa kyɛ yɛ ngoa kofi yɛ sa ɔ; yiti yeɛ ɔmaa yɛyɔle sɔ ne. 25Na afei de, yɛwura wɔ sa. Bɔ ɛnea a ɔte paa ná ɔtengyɛ wɔ wɔ nye so ne, fa yɔ yɛ.” 26Na bɔ Yosua yɔ mane bɛ hɔ ɛhe: ɔbɔle bɛ nwo waen fili Yisraelfoɛ sa nu; yiti bangu bɛ. 27Nakoso ofi sɔ kyẽa ne, Yosua mane Gibeonfoɛ yɔle eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma mane ɛlɔen ne, na bɛyɔle sɔ bɛmane AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne koso, wɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE aye asie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɔne ye ne, toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

Title: YOSUA 10
Content:
Eyia gyinane neka horɛ
1Yerusalem hene Adoni Sɛdɛke tele kyɛ Yosua aho afa Aye, na wasɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ, na nikyee bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko ne ye hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wafa wayɔ Aye ne ye hene ɔ. Osa tele kyɛ Gibeonfoɛ ne Yisrael bayɛ asomdwee apam, na bɛ ne bɛ yeɛ bɛte ɔ. 2Na osurole paa, ofikyɛ Gibeon te kuro piri kyɛ ahenguro nemɔ ko. Ye piri tra Aye, afei koso ye mmienzua mukoraati bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ. 3Yiti Yerusalem hene Adoni Sɛdɛke somane maa beesele Hebron hene Hoham, Yamute hene Piram, Lakise hene Yafia ɔne Eglon hene Dɛbi kyɛ, 4“Ɛmɔbra bɛɛboka me maa yɛɛhuhu Gibeonfoɛ; ofikyɛ bɛ ne Yosua ne Yisrael bayɛ apam.” 5Na Amorifoɛ ahemvo nnu ne: Yerusalem hene, Hebron hene, Yamute hene, Lakise hene ɔne Eglon hene boaboale bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ mukoraati noa, na bɛ ne koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraa beetuale Gibeon kyɛ bɛ ne bɛ kwaaho.
6Yeɛ Gibeonfoɛ somane maa bɛhɔle Gilgal asikyeleɛ ne anu beesele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛyakyi wɔ ngoaa mɔ nu; ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera ná baale yɛ ngoa, baaboka yɛ; ofikyɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ bɛtete mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ ne, bɛ hene mɔ amukoraa bayɛ ko bɛ ne yɛ baaho.” 7Yiti Yosua ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, yeɛ afei koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ amukoraa befili Gilgal bɛfo bɛhɔle. 8Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ mafa bɛ mawura wɔ sa; na bɛ nu ko po ngɔhora ngogyina wɔ nyunu.” 9Yiti Yosua fili Gilgal natele kɔngɔen toonn hɔle Gibeon, na ɔhɔle Amorifoɛ so mvum nu. 10Na AWURADE mane bɛ nye so tanene bɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu. Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ paa wɔ Gibeon, na bɛfoane bɛ maa bɛɛfale Bete Horon pambaa atee ne aso, na behuhuni bɛ alaa beedwuli Aseka ne Makeda. 11 Na mmerɛ bɔ bɛ́nwati béfi Yisraelfoɛ nyunu, ná beedwuli Bete Horon ndoroleɛ nu ne, AWURADE yakyili asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ fili nyameɛso guale bɛ so toonn maa beedwuli Aseka, na bewuwuli. Na mmenia bɔ asukɔtwea ne huni bɛ ne, bɛsone bɛtra mmenia bɔ bɛtotɔle Yisraelfoɛ ngrandɛ noa ɔ.
12Kyẽa bɔ AWURADE mane Yisraelfoɛ lili Amorifoɛ so ngonim ne, Yosua srɛle AWURADE wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu berɛ kyɛ,
“Eyia, gyina neka horɛ wɔ Gibeon!
Ɛsraen, gyina neka horɛ wɔ Ayalɔn bɔnza nu!”
13 Yiti eyia gyinane neka horɛ, na ɛsraen angɔ moa ko,
kɔpem kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ tɔle bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so wereɛ ɔ.
Sɔ dwirɛ he, aso bangyerɛ ye wɔ Yasa nwomaa ne anu? Eyia gyinane afia neka horɛ wɔ ewienu, na kɔyɛ kyẽa ko mumua, wambepere ye nwo kyɛ ɔkwaatɔ ɔ. 14 Ofikyɛ AWURADE ho mane Yisraelfoɛ. Kyẽa bɔ ɔte sɔ de, né ebie ɔwwale le, yeɛ ofi sɔ kyẽa ne koso, sɔ kyẽa ne bie amma le, bɔ yeɛ AWURADE tiele kuro sona sufrɛ sɔa ɔ.
15Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa besa bɛwale Gilgal.
Yosua kye Amorifoɛ ahemvo nnu ne
16Sɔ ahemvo nnu nemɔ nwatili, na bɛɛfeale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu wɔ Makeda. 17Na ebiemɔ bɔle Yosua amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yanwu ahemvo nnu nemɔ kyɛ baafea nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu wɔ Makeda.” 18Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔmunu nyɔbotaen bétua nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, ná ɛ́mɔma mmenia gyinagyina ye nwo bɛ́wɛne. 19Nakoso ɛmɔ ngaa ne de, nnɛma ɛmɔgyina berɛ. Ɛ́mɔfoa ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ nemɔ, ná ɛ́mɔfite bɛ si béhuhu bɛ. Nnɛmɔma bɛnwati bɛkɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ anu, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa bɛ wawura ɛmɔ sa.” 20Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ pasaa yiele nen, bɛ nu kãa bie yeɛ benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu ɔ, na bɛnwatili bɛhɔle nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ anu bɛɛbɔle bɛ nwo adwaa. 21Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ de, bɛ mukoraa besa bɛwale Yosua berɛ asomdwee nu wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Makeda. Na ebiala angora wamva ye dwirɛ wamma Yisraelfoɛ so.
22Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye nyɔbotaen ne béfi nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, ná ɛ́mɔye ahemvo nnu ne béfi nu bɛ́brɛ me.” 23Bɛyɔle sɔ, na bɛyele ahemvo nnu ne befili nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne anu bɛbrɛle ye. Bɛ ole Yerusalem hene, Hebron hene, Yamute hene, Lakise hene ɔne Eglon hene. 24Bɛfale ahemvo nemɔ bɛbrɛle Yosua nen, Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati beyiale, na osele koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ so safohene mɔ bɔ bɛ ne ye hɔle koɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpingye wa ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ gya bétia ahemvo hemɔ kɔme so.” Yiti bepingyele berɛ, na bɛfale bɛ gya betiale bɛ kɔme so. 25Na Yosua sele safohene nemɔ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ; ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn ná ɛmɔma ɛmɔ ahone yɛ se; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraati bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɛ kɔho ne, sɔ yeɛ AWURADE kɔfa kɔyɔ bɛ ɔ.” 26Nziɛ ye, Yosua huhuni ahemvo nemɔ, na ɔfale bɛ sinzele mmakaa nnu so. Na besinzele mmakaa ne aso maa oodwuli nɔsoa. 27 Na eyia kwaatɔ ne, Yosua maa bɛyele bɛ befili mmakaa ne aso bɛwale ase, na beegyili bɛ beguale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua bɔ bɛɛfeale nu ne anu. Bɛfale nyɔbotaen betuale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, na nyɔboɛ ne tɛ wɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
Yosua di Kanaan ngwaen so ngonim
28Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, Yosua ho fale Makeda. Ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama ne berɛ hene; ohuhuni berɛ ama mukoraa bɔkɔɔ. Wanyakyi sona ko po. Na bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle Makeda hene ɔ.
29Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Makeda bɛhɔle Libina, na bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Libinafoɛ. 30Na AWURADE fale Libina koso ne ye hene wurale Yisrael sa. Yisrael fale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati. Wanyakyi sona ko po wɔ nu. Na bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle berɛ hene ne ɔ.
31Ɛhe asi ne, Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Libina bɛhɔle Lakise, betuale kuro ne, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye. 32AWURADE fale Lakise wurale Yisrael sa. Ye elenyɔ ne aso yeɛ Yisrael lili so ngonim ɔ, na ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati, kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Libina kuro mma ne ala.
33Gɛsɛre hene Horam fo wale ɔɔbokale Lakisefoɛ, nakoso Yosua huhuni ye ne ye lɔen ne, na wanyakyi sona ko po.
34Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Lakise bɛhɔle Eglon; betuale kuro ne, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye. 35Belili so ngonim sɔ kyẽa ne, na bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati bɔkɔɔ sɔ kyẽa ne, kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Lakisefoɛ ne ala.
36Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Eglon bɛhɔle Hebron, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye. 37Belili so ngonim. Bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni nu mmenia ne nu hene, mbɔtam berɛ nguro nemɔ nu mmenia, na behuni nu mmenia amukoraa. Wanyakyi sona ko po; na kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Eglon nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛkyele Hebron bɔkɔɔ ɔ, na ohuhuni nu mmenia mukoraati.
38Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa besa bɛwale Dɛbi, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye. 39Olili kuro ne, nu hene, ɔne ye nwo nguro mɔ so ngonim. Bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni bɛ, na behuni kuro ne anu mmenia mukoraa bɔkɔɔ. Wanyakyi sona ko po. Na nikyee bɔ ɔfa yɔle Hebron, yeɛ Libina ne ye hene nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle Dɛbi ne ye hene ɔ.
40Yiti Yosua lili ngonim wɔ aseɛ ne aso amukoraati: mmokaa aseɛ ne ne ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, mmokaa ndoroleɛ ne anu, ɔne b’ahemvo ne amukoraa so ngonim. Wanyakyi sona ko po, na mmom ohuhuni nikyee biala bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ ye nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ hyɛle ne. 41Yosua lili bɛ so ngonim alaa fite Kadese Banea oodwuli Gasa, fite Gosen mbɔtam mukoraati maa oodwuli Gibeon. 42Yosua lili ahemvo hemɔ amukoraa ne b’aseɛ so ngonim wɔ koɛ komapɛ anu, ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔho mane Yisrael ɔ. 43Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa besa bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Gilgal.

Title: YOSUA 11
Content:
Yisrael di Kanaan sorɔ dɔ ahemvo mɔ so ngonim
1Mmerɛ bɔ Hasɔ hene Yabin tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔsomane maa bɛɛbɔle ahemvo hemɔ amaneɛ: Madon hene Yobabo, Simron hene, Akisafe hene, 2ahemvo mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ sorɔ dɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Araba ne anu wɔ Kinerote ngwaen dɔ ne, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Nafɔte Dɔɔ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ ne. 3Bɛɛbɔle ɛhemɔ koso amaneɛ: Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne atɔleɛ, Amorifoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, ɔne Hiwifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne nye abo wɔ Misepa aseɛ so ne. 4Bɛ ne bɛ lɔen ne amukoraati bɛwale, ɛlɔen pembepembe bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ mboanoa anweaa ɔ, bɛ ne mbɔngɔ mɔ ne teaseɛnam pee wale. 5Sɔ ahemvo ne amukoraa boaboale bɛ lɔen noa, na bɛbɔle nu bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Merom nzue nwo kyɛ bɛ ne Yisrael bɛkwaaho.
6Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ ɛhema bekye sɔa ala, ngohũhũ bɛ mukoraati ngɔma Yisrael. Na odi kyɛ ɛpepɛ bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ gya ndii nu, ná ɛfa see yera bɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ.” 7Yiti Yosua ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛhɔle bɛ so mvum nu wɔ Merom nzue nwo, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale bɛ. 8AWURADE fale bɛ wurale Yisrael sa. Behuhuni bɛ, na bɛfoane bɛ toonn beedwuli Sidon Piri ne Misrefote Maim nwo, ɔne Misepe bɔnza nu wɔ eyia afiteleɛ. Behuhuni bɛ toonn bɔ bɛ nu ko po anga ɔ. 9Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yosua kyɛ ɔyɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle bɛ ɔ. Ɔpepɛle bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ gya ndii nu, na ɔfale see yerale bɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ.
10Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua sale ye si, olili Hasɔ so ngonim, na ɔfale ngrandɛ huni berɛ hene ne. Ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ nen, né Hasɔ yeɛ ɔte sɔ ahennie ne amukoraa b’ahenguro ɔ. 11Bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati. Behuhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ; banyakyi nikyee ko po bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ ye nu ɔ, na bɛfale see bɛtole Hasɔ nu. 12Yosua lili sɔ nguro ne amukoraa ne bɛ hene amukoraa so ngonim, na ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni bɛ; ohuhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ kyɛbɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle ne. 13Nakoso nguro mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ pambaa mɔ so ne de, Yisraelfoɛ anyera bɛ nu biala, sana Hasɔ ngome yeɛ Yosua yerale ɔ. 14Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ mukoraa ne nyɛmmoa bɔ bɛwɔ sɔ nguro nemɔ anu ne, Yisraelfoɛ fale. Nakoso bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni nu mmenia mukoraati, kɔpem kyɛ behuhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ ɔ, na banyakyi nikyee ko po bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ ye nu ɔ. 15Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye somvoɛ Mose nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Mose hyɛle Yosua ɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ Yosua koso yɔle ɔ. Nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose kyɛ ɔyɔ nen, nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ Yosua anyɔ ɔ.
Yosua lili aseɛ ne amu so ngonim
16Yiti Yosua ho fale aseɛ hemɔ amukoraati: mmokaa aseɛ ne, ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne amukoraa, Gosen aseɛ ne amukoraa, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, Araba ne, Yisrael mmokaa aseɛ ne ɔne ye aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne; 17fite Halake bokaa, bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ Sɛre, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Baal Gade, wɔ Lebanon bɔnza nu, wɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne nye abo. Yosua hyehyele bɛ hene nemɔ amukoraa, na ohuhuni bɛ. 18Yosua ne sɔ hene nemɔ bɛhone koɛ mmerɛ pee. 19 Kuro biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔne Yisraelfoɛ bɛyɛle asomdwee apam ɔ, sana Hiwifoɛ bɔ bɛte Gibeon ne ngome. Nguro ngaa ne de, Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim wɔ koɛ nu. 20 Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔmaa bɛyɛle asoserɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔho koɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ ahũhũ bɛ bɔkɔɔ bama bɛ boso anua, bɔ bengonwu bɛ anwumvoin ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen.
21Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua hɔle oohuhuni Anakefoɛ. Na ɔmane bɛ boso nuane fili mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, Hebron, Dɛbi, Anabo, Yuda mmokaa aseɛ ne amukoraa so, ɔne Yisrael mmokaa aseɛ ne amukoraa so. Yosua huhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ, na ɔsɛkyele bɛ nguro nemɔ bɔkɔɔ. 22Banyakyi Anakeniɛ ko po wɔ Yisraelfoɛ aseɛ so; sana Gasa ne Gate ne Asedɔde ngome yeɛ ebiemɔ hale ɔ. 23Yiti Yosua ho fale aseɛ ne amukoraa, kyɛbɔ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE ha hyirele Mose te ne. Na Yosua hyehyɛle nu mane Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ, na ɔfale abusua kure biala ye bue deɛ mane ye. Na asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso bɔ koɛ anzi ɔ.

Title: YOSUA 12
Content:
Ahemvo bɔ Mose lili bɛ so ngonim ne
1Aseɛ ne aso ahemvo bɔ Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, bɔ Yisraelfoɛ fale b’aseɛ bɛtenane so wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ, fite Anɔn Bɔnza ne anu bɔ ɔkwaadwu Hɛmɔn bokaa ne anwo, ɔne Araba bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ amukoraati ne, bɛ ɛhe: 2Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ ɔtenane Hesebon, bɔ olili hene fite Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza ne noa, fite bɔnza ne afia ne, bɔ ɔkwaadwu asue Yabɔko, bɔ ɔte Amonfoɛ ɛwɛen ne. Sɔ aseɛ ne amukoraa te Gileade bue; 3ɔne Araba ne bɔ ɔkwaadwu Kinerote ɛpo eyia afiteleɛ, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Araba ɛpo ne, bɔ ɔte Ngyee po ne, wɔ Bete Yesimote atee so dɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ Pisiga bokaa ne aseɛnwo, wɔ ngwaen dɔ ne; 4ɔne Basan hene Ogo, bɔ ɔte Refaimfoɛ bɛ bosofoɛ bɔ baha ne ko. Ɔtenane Astarote ne Yedrei. 5Olili hene wɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne aso bɔ ɔkwaadwu kuro Saleka so, ɔne Basan amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ ɛwɛen so, ɔne Gileade bue bɔ ɔkwaadwu Hesebon hene Sihon ɛwɛen so. 6 AWURADE somvoɛ Mose ne Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, na AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle b’aseɛ ne mane Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue.
Ahemvo bɔ Yosua lili bɛ so ngonim ne
7Ɛhemɔ ole aseɛ ne aso ahemvo bɔ Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan eyia atɔleɛ, fite Baal Gade bɔ ɔwɔ Lebanon bɔnza ne anu bɔ ɔkwaadwu Halake bokaa bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ Sɛre ne. (Yosua hyehyɛle b’aseɛ ne anu mane Yisrael abusua kure nemɔ maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ, na ɔfale abusua kure biala ye bue deɛ mane ye: 8mmokaa aseɛ ne, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, Araba ne, mmokaa nemɔ nye abo, ɛserɛ ne, ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne, yeɛ Hitifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ b’aseɛ ne). 9Ahemvo nemɔ ole: Yeriko hene, Aye bɔ opingye Betel ne hene; 10Yerusalem hene, Hebron hene; 11Yamute hene, Lakise hene; 12Eglon hene, Gɛsɛre hene, 13Dɛbi hene, Gɛdɛ hene; 14Hɔma hene, Arade hene; 15Libina hene, Adulam hene; 16Makeda hene, Betel hene; 17Tapua hene ko, Hefa hene; 18Afeke hene, Lasaron hene; 19Madon hene, Hasɔ hene; 20Simron Meron hene, Akisafe hene; 21Taanake hene, Megido hene; 22Kedese hene, Yokeneam bɔ ɔwɔ Kamɛl hene; 23Dɔɔ hene bɔ ɔwɔ Nafate Dɔɔ, Goyim hene bɔ ɔwɔ Gilgal; 24Tisa hene. Ahemvo ne amukoraati bɛte aburasa ne ko.

Title: YOSUA 13
Content:
Yosua kyɛ Kanaan aseɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ
1Né Yosua ayɛ panyi, yeɛ afei né wayɛ aworowaa; na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Ayɛ panyi, yeɛ afei ayɛ aworowaa, nakoso aseɛ bɔ waha bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɛ bɛ deɛ ne, ɔte dɔnn. 2Aseɛ bɔ waha berɛ ne ɛhe: Filistifoɛ aseɛ ne amukoraati, ɔne Gesurefoɛ deɛ amukoraati, 3fite asue Sihɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Misraim eyia afiteleɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu Ekron ɛwɛen so wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ ne. Ye mukoraa te Kanaan aseɛ. Filistifoɛ ahemvo nnu yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. Bɛwɔ Gasa, Asedɔde, Asekelɔn, Gate ne Ekron, yeɛ Awimfoɛ koso bɔ bɛwɔ ngwaen dɔ ne. 4Kanaanfoɛ aseɛ ne amukoraati, Meara bɔ ɔte Sidonfoɛ aseɛ ne, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Afeke bɔ ɔwɔ Amorifoɛ ɛwɛen so ne; 5Gebalfoɛ aseɛ, Lebanon amukoraa bɔ ɛfa kɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne, fite Baal Gade bɔ ɔwɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne nye abo bɔ ɔkwaadwu Lebo Hamate ne. 6 Na Sidonfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛtete mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, fite Lebanon bɔ ɔkwaadwu Misrefote Maim ne, me bɔbɔ yeɛ ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ɔ. Na wɔ de, kyekyɛ aseɛ ne ma Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ, kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛyɔ ne ala. 7Afei de, kyɛ aseɛ he maa ɔyɛ agyapadeɛ ma abusua kure ngona ne ɔne Manase abusua kure ne bue.”
Yosua kyɛ Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ aseɛ ne
8 Manase abusua kure ne bue ko bɔ waha ne de, né bɛ ne Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ bali moa banya b’aseɛ deɛ dada. Mose yeɛ ɔfa mane bɛ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛ mane bɛ ne: 9Aseɛ ne trɛ fi Aroye bɔ ɔla Anɔn bɔnza ne noa ne, ɔne kuro bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne afia ne, ɔne Medeba bokaa frɛtɛɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dibɔn; 10ɔne Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ olili hene wɔ Hesebon ne, ye nguro amukoraati, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Amonfoɛ ɛwɛen so ne. 11Yeɛ Gileade, Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ aseɛ, Hɛmɔn bokaa ne amukoraa, Basan amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Saleka ne. 12Ogo bɔ olili hene wɔ Astarote ne Yedrei ne, ye maen amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ Basan (Refaim bosofoɛ ne, né waha ye ngome). Né Mose ali moa wali sɔ ahemvo nemɔ so ngonim watu bɛ wafi berɛ. 13Nakoso Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ de, Yisraelfoɛ andu bɛ amvi berɛ, yiti Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ tɛ te Yisraelfoɛ nu maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
14 14 Lewi abusua kure ne angome de, Mose amma bɛ aseɛ ne bie. Afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔha hyirele bɛ ne.
Ruben abusua kure aseɛ
15Mose fale aseɛ ne bie mane Ruben abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ. 16B’aseɛ ne, ye noa hyɛ ye bo fi Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza noa, ɔne kuro bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne afia ne, ɔne bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Medeba; 17Hesebon ne ye nguro amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso ne: Dibɔn, Bamote Baal ne Betebaal Meon; 18Yahasa, Kedemote, Mefaate, 19Kiriatim, Sibima, yeɛ Serete Sahare bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne noa bokaa ne aso ne, 20Bete Peɔ, Pisiga bokaa ne ngyɛnu, ɔne Bete Yesimote: 21mekyire bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso nguro amukoraati, yeɛ afei Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ olili hene Hesebon ne, ye maen amukoraati. Mose lili ye ne Midian mbanyi hemɔ so ngonim: Ewi, Rekem, Sure, Hure ne Reba. Sɔ mmenia hemɔ tenane Sihon gya nu belili hene wɔ aseɛ ne aso. 22 Beɔ awa Balaam bɔ odi ahɔen ne, Yisraelfoɛ fale ngrandɛ huni ye bɛbokale mmenia bɔ behuni bɛ ne aso. 23Asue Yɔɔdan noa yeɛ ɔte Ruben abusua kure ne wɛen ɔ. Ruben abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne. Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne namue nemɔ yeɛ Ruben mmusua mmusua nemɔ nyane ye ɔ.
Gade abusua kure aseɛ
24Mose mane Gade abusua kure ne koso agyapadeɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ. 25B’aseɛ ne noa fa Yasere, Gileade nguro ne amukoraa, ɔne Amonfoɛ aseɛ ne bue, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Raba eyia afiteleɛ ne; 26ofi Hesebon bɔ ɔkwaadwu Ramate Misepe ne Betonim, ofi Mahanaim bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dɛbi ɛwɛen so, 27ɔne bɔnza ne anu nguro hemɔ: Bete Haram, Bete Nimra, Sukote, Safon, yeɛ Hesebon hene Sihon ahennie ngaa ne, Yɔɔdan ɛwɛen so, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Kinerete ɛpo ngwaen dɔ, ɔne Yɔɔdan si eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ. 28Gade abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne. Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne namue nemɔ yeɛ Gade mmusua mmusua nemɔ nyane ye ɔ.
Manase abusua kure ne bue aseɛ
29Mose mane Manase abusua kure ne bue aseɛ; na ɔyɛle Manase abusua kure ne bue agyapadeɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ. 30B’aseɛ ne, ye noa hyɛ ye bo fi Mahanaim, Basan amukoraa, Basan hene Ogo maen amukoraa, ɔne Yari nguro aburasia mukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Basan ne, 31Gileade bue, Astarote ne Yedrei, Ogo ahennie nu nguro bɔ bɛwɔ Basan. Mose fale sɔ aseɛ ne amukoraa mane Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ; kyɛ ɔyɛ Makyirifoɛ bue nu ko deɛ.
32Sɔ aseɛ nemɔ yeɛ Mose hyɛle ye wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ɔ, asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ Yeriko eyia afiteleɛ ɔ. 33 Nakoso Lewi abusua kure ne de, Mose amma bɛ aseɛ biala, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔha hyirele bɛ ne.

Title: YOSUA 14
Content:
Yɔɔdan eyia atɔleɛ aseɛ ne hyɛlɛ
1Agyapadeɛ hemɔ yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ nyane ye wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so ɔ. Ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Nun awa Yosua, yeɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛlela mmusua nemɔ noa wɔ Yisrael abusua kure nemɔ anu yeɛ bɛhyɛle aseɛ ne bɛmane Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. 2 Bɛfale serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛhyɛle b’aseɛ ne ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose fale abusua ngona ne bue ne anwo ne. 3Ofikyɛ abusua nyɔ ne bue bɔ bɛwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, né Mose ali moa wafa b’agyapadeɛ deɛ wama bɛ; nakoso Lewifoɛ de, wamma bɛ agyapadeɛ biala. 4Né Yosef mma nemɔ bɛte abusua kure nyɔ: Manase ne Efraim. Lewifoɛ nemɔ de, bannya aseɛ ne bie, sana nguro mɔ bɔ bɛkɔtena so ɔ, ɔne nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ bɛ mmoaen ne nandwie kodidi so ɔ. 5Kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ yɔle ɔ; bɛhyɛle aseɛ ne.
Bɛfale Hebron bɛmane Kalebo
6 Afei Yudafoɛ wale Yosua berɛ wɔ Gilgal, na Kalebo bɔ ɔse ole Kenisiniɛ Yefune ne, osele Yosua kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔbɔ ala ɛse edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ha fale me ne wɔ nwo hyirele Nyameɛ sona Mose wɔ Kadese Banea ɔ. 7 Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose somane me fili Kadese Banea maa ngɔndetɛle aseɛ ne, né mali afoɛ aburanna; na nza mvale ye nwo amaneɛ turoloo mma mmɔle ye. 8Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛ ne me hɔle ne, bɛmane ahunundetelɛ tɔle yɛ mmenia ne aso, nakoso me de, nnili nahorɛ turoloo mane AWURADE me Nyameɛ. 9 Na Mose tale ndaen sɔ kyẽa ne kyɛ, ‘Nahorɛ nu, aseɛ bɔ wɔ gya atia so ne, ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ne wɔ mma deɛ afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ ali nahorɛ turoloo ama AWURADE me Nyameɛ.’ 10Na wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nye ta, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɔ nen, wamaa matena ngoa nu alaa afoɛ aburanna ne nnu ɛhe, fite mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE hane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele Mose ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né Yisrael nate ɛserɛ ne aso ne. Na kekesaala ye, mali afoɛ aburawɔtwɛ ne nnu. 11Na kyẽa bɔ Mose somane me ne, kyɛbɔ né me nwo si yɛ se ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kekesaala ye me nwo tɛ yɛ se ɔ. M’anwoserɛ tɛ tua me, bɔ ngɔhora ngɔhɔ koɛ, ná mali akɔneaba ɔ. 12Yiti, mmokaa aseɛ he bɔ AWURADE hane ye nwo dwirɛ sɔ kyẽa nen, fa ma me. Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛtele kyɛ né Anakefoɛ ne nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue mɔ wɔ berɛ. Nakoso ebiaa AWURADE kogyina me si maa ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi berɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hane ne.”
13Yeɛ Yosua yirale Yefune awa Kalebo, na ɔfale Hebron mane ye maa ɔyɛle ye agyapadeɛ. 14Yiti Kalebo bɔ ɔse ole Kenisiniɛ Yefune ne, Hebron ayɛ ye agyapadeɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ, ofikyɛ olili nahorɛ turoloo mane AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ. 15Daa ne, né Hebron dumaa ole Kiriate Aba. Aba sɔ ne, né ye yeɛ ɔte branoa paa wɔ Anakefoɛ nu ɔ. Na asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso bɔ koɛ anzi ɔ.

Title: YOSUA 15
Content:
Yuda aseɛ ne wɛen
1 Aseɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Yuda abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne, ɔtrɛ kɔ ngwaen kodwu Edom ɛwɛen so, ɔne Sen ɛserɛ so ngwaen dɔ paa. 2Bɛ ngwaen dɔ ɛwɛen ne, ɔhyɛ ye bo fi Ngyee Po noa dɔ, ɔne mboanoa bɔ ye nye nea ngwaen dɔ ne. 3Ɔkɔ alaa kɔfa Akrabim pambaa ne ngwaen dɔ, toonn kodwu Sen, na ɔkɔfa Kadese Banea ngwaen dɔ. Ɔpɛ nu Hesron, na ɔfo kɔ Ada, na ɔkondo kɔ Kaka. 4Ɔpɛ nu kɔ Asimɔn, na okofite Misraim bɔnza ne anu, na okogua mboanoa. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ ngwaen dɔ wɛen ɔ. 5Ngyee Po ne yeɛ ɔte Yuda eyia afiteleɛ ɛwɛen ɔ, na ɛwɛen ne kɔ alaa kodwu asue Yɔɔdan abɔleɛ. Sorɔ dɔ ɛwɛen ne trɛ fi Ngyee Po ne noa bɔ ɔwɔ asue Yɔɔdan abɔleɛ ne. 6Ɛwɛen ne trɛ kɔ Bete Hogela, na ɔkɔpɛ nu wɔ Bete Araba, na okodwu Ruben awa Bohan nyɔboɛ ne anwo. 7Ɛwɛen ne fi Akɔre bɔnza ne anu fo kɔ Dɛbi, na ɔkondo fa sorɔ dɔ kɔ Gilgal, bɔ ɔwɔ Adumim pambaa ne ndendeneɛ so, bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne ngwaen dɔ ne. Ɛwɛen ne toa so kɔfa Ɛn Semese nzue noa, na ye noa kɔpem Ɛn Rogyel. 8Ɛwɛen ne fo kɔfa Hinom Awa bɔnza ne anu, wɔ Yebusifoɛ bokaa ne ngwaen dɔ (bɔ ye ole Yerusalem). Bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Hinom bɔnza ndendeneɛ so ne, ɛwɛen ne nate ye anwuro dɔ, wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, wɔ Refaim bɔnza ne sorɔ dɔ. 9Ɛwɛen ne fi bokaa ne aso a, ɔkɔfa Nefetoa nzue ne ti, na ofi berɛ a, ɔkɔfa Efron bokaa nguro nemɔ aso. Ɛwɛen ne kondo bafa Baala (bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kiriate Yearim); 10ɛwɛen ne fi Baala a, ɔkondo fa eyia atɔleɛ kɔ Sɛre bokaa ne anwo, ɔpɛ nu kɔ Yearim bokaa ndoroleɛ nu wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ, (bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Kesalon ne), ɔtorotoro kɔ Bete Semese, na ɔpɛ nu kɔ Timina. 11Ɛwɛen ne kɔ Ekron sorɔ dɔ bokaa ne ndoroleɛ nu. Afei ɔkondo kɔ Sikeron, ɔpɛ nu kɔ Baala bokaa ne aso kodwu Yabeneel, na afei ye noa kɔpem ɛpo ne. 12Mediterenia Ɛpo ne yeɛ ɔte eyia atɔleɛ ɛwɛen ɔ. Sɔ wɛen ne yeɛ wapɛ Yudafoɛ nwo wayia ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.
Kalebo di Hebron ne Dɛbi so ngonim
(Maenbulɛfoɛ 1.11-15)
13Kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yosua nen, ɔfale Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne bie mane Yefune awa Kalebo. Aseɛ ne ole Kiriate Aba, bɔ ye ole Hebron ne. (Né Aba te Anake baba). 14Kalebo foane Anake bosofoɛ nza nemɔ fili berɛ. Bɛ ole Sesayi, Ahiman ne Talmae. 15Ofili berɛ ne, ɔɔfale koɛ tetale Dɛbifoɛ. Daa ne, né Dɛbi dumaa ole Kiriate Sefa. 16Na Kalebo sele kyɛ, “Bienzua biala bɔ ɔkɔho koli Kiriate Sefa so ngonim nen, ngɔfa mma brasua Akesa maa okogya.” 17Na Otiniɛl bɔ ɔte Kalebo aliɛma bienzua Kenase awa ne, ɔho lili Kiriate Sefa so ngonim, yiti Kalebo fale ɔwa brasua Akesa maa ogyale ye. 18Na braa ne hɔle agyaa bo wɔ Otiniɛl awuro nen, osele ohu kyɛ ɔ́srɛ aseɛ ófi ye baba Kalebo berɛ. Na braa ne fili ye afunum ne aso dwuli ase nen, Kalebo bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ekuro ɔ?” 19Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Kyɛ me nikye. Ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ afa ama me wɔ ngwaen dɔ ne, ɔte wosee. Yiti ma me mbombonzue koso.” Yiti Kalebo fale sorɔ dɔ mbombonzue ne ngwaen dɔ mbombonzue bokale ye so.
Yuda nguro nemɔ
20Yuda abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne. 21Yuda abusua kure ne anu ama, bɛ nguro mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ngwaen dɔ paa, bɔ ɔkɔ Edom ɛwɛen so ne, bɛ ɛhe: Kabeseel, Edere, Yagure, 22Kina, Dimona, Adada, 23Kedese, Hasɔ, Yitinan, 24Sife, Telem, Bealote, 25Hasɔ Hadata, Keriote Hesron (bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Hasɔ ne), 26Amam, Sema, Molada, 27Hasa Gada, Hesemon, Bete Pelete, 28Hasa Soale, Beɛ Hyeba, Bisiotia, 29Baala, Yim, Esem, 30Ɛltolade, Kyɛsil, Hɔma, 31Siklage, Mademana, Sansana, 32Lebaote, Silihim, Ayin ne Rimon. Nguro ne amukoraa bɛte aburanyɔ ne ngona, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
33Aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso nguro nemɔ ɛhe: Esetao, Sora, Asena, 34Sanoa, Ɛn Ganim, Tapua, Enam, 35Yamute, Adulam, Soko, Aseka, 36Saaraim, Aditim, Gedera, Gederotim. Nguro nemɔ te buru ne nna, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
37Senan, Hadasa, Migidal Gade, 38Dilan, Misepe, Yokete Ɛl, 39Lakise, Bosekate, Eglon, 40Kabon, Lamam, Kitilisi, 41Gederote, Bete Dagɔn, Naama ne Makeda. Nguro nemɔ te buru ne nzia, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
42Libina, Eta, Asan, 43Yipita, Asena, Nesibo, 44Keila, Akisibo ne Maresa. Nguro nemɔ te ngona, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
45Ekron ne ye nwo nguro ne namue mɔ; 46fite Ekron bɔ ɔkwaadwu mboanoa, Asedɔde ne ye mbɔtam amukoraa, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
47Asedɔde ne ye nwo nguro ne ye namue mɔ; Gasa ne ye nwo nguro ne ye namue mɔ; bɔ ɔkwaadwu Misraim bɔnza ne, yeɛ afei Ɛpo Piri ne noa.
48Mmokaa nemɔ aso nguro ɛhe: Samiri, Yatiri, Soko, 49Dana, Kiriate Sana (bɔ ye ole Dɛbi), 50Anabo, Esetemo, Anim, 51Gosen, Holon ne Gilo. Nguro nemɔ te buru ne ko, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
52Arabo, Duma, Esan, 53Yanum, Bete Tapua, Afeka, 54Humita, Kiriate Aba (bɔ ye ole Hebron), ɔne Siɔ. Nguro nemɔ te ngona, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
55Mayɔn, Kamɛl, Sife, Yuta, 56Yesreel, Yokedeam, Sanoa, 57Kain, Gibea ne Timina. Nguro nemɔ te buru, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
58Halehul, Bete Sure, Gedɔ, 59Maarate, Bete Anote ne Ɛltekon. Nguro nemɔ te nzia, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
60Kiriate Baal (bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kiriate Yearim) ne Raba. Nguro nemɔ te nyɔ, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
61Ɛserɛ ne aso nguro nemɔ ɛhe: Bete Araba, Midin, Sekaka, 62Nibesan, Ngyee Kuro, yeɛ Ɛn Gedi. Nguro nemɔ te nzia, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
63 Nakoso Yebusifoɛ bɔ né bɛte Yerusalem ne de, Yudafoɛ angora andu bɛ bamvi berɛ; yiti Yebusifoɛ ne Yudafoɛ batena Yerusalem toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

Title: YOSUA 16
Content:
Efraim ne Manase b’aseɛ
1Aseɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Yosef boso ama ne, ɔhyɛ ye bo fi asue Yɔɔdan noa wɔ Yeriko bue nu dɔ, wɔ Yeriko berɛ nzue ye eyia atɔleɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na ɔfa Yeriko kodwu mmokaa ne aso dɔ ɔkɔ Betel. 2Afei ofi Betel kɔ Luse, na ɔpɛ nu kɔ Atarote bɔ ɔwɔ Akifoɛ aseɛ so. 3Ɔtorotoro kɔ eyia atɔleɛ, ɔkɔ Yafletefoɛ ɛwɛen so, ɔkɔ Bete Horon aseɛnwo dɔ ɛwɛen so, ɔtoa so kɔ Gɛsɛre, na ye noa kodwu mboanoa.
4Yosef boso ama bɔ bɛ ole Manase abusua kure ne Efraim abusua kure ne, bɛ sa hane b’agyapadeɛ.
Efraim aseɛ deɛ
5Efraim abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ ye mmusua mmusua te ne, b’aseɛ ne wɛen ɛhe: b’aseɛ ne, ye wɛen wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ole Atarote Ada bɔ ɔkwaadwu Bete Horon sorɔ dɔ ne. 6Ɛwɛen ne fi berɛ kogua ɛpo nu; Mikimeta wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ. Ɛwɛen ne kondo wɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ kɔ Taanate Silo, na ɔpɛ nu berɛ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɔkɔ Yanoa. 7Afei ɛwɛen ne fi Yanoa torotoro kɔ Atarote ne Naara, odwu Yeriko, na ɔkɔpem Yɔɔdan noa. 8Ɛwɛen ne fi Tapua a, ɔkɔfa eyia atɔleɛ dɔ kɔ Kana bɔnza ne anu, na ye noa kɔpem ɛpo ne. Efraim abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ ye mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne, b’agyapadeɛ ɛne. 9 Afei koso, nguro bɔ bɛye befili Manasefoɛ agyapadeɛ nu bɛmane Efraimfoɛ ne, bɛboka aseɛ ne aso, nguro ne amukoraa ne bɛ namue mɔ. 10 Nakoso Kanaanfoɛ bɔ né bɛte Gɛsɛre ne de, Yisraelfoɛ andu bɛ amvi berɛ; yiti Kanaanfoɛ atena Efraimfoɛ nu toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ, nakoso Efraimfoɛ hyɛ bɛ maa bɛyɔ adwuma.

Title: YOSUA 17
Content:
Manase aseɛ deɛ
1 Bɛmane Manase abusua kure ne aseɛ, ofikyɛ Manase yeɛ ɔte Yosef bamuɛbaa ɔ. Gileade ne Basan aseɛ ne, bɛfa bɛmane Manase bamuɛbaa Makyiri bɔ ɔwa ole Gileade ne, ofikyɛ né Makyiri te koɛhonɛniɛ. 2Bɛfale aseɛ ne bie koso bɛmane Manase abusua kure ne anu mmusua ngaa nemɔ: Abiesa abusua, Heleke abusua, Aseriɛl abusua, Sɛkem abusua, Hefa abusua ne Semida abusua. Sɔ mmienzua nemɔ, bɛte Yosef awa Manase ye bosofoɛ, na bɛ yeɛ bɛlela bɛ mmusua nemɔ noa ɔ.
3 Selofehade de, wannya baa bienzua. Ɔse ole Hefa bɔ ɔse ole Gileade bɔ ɔse ole Makyiri bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Manase ne. Ye mma nemɔ te mmrasua ngome. Bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Mahela, Nowa, Hogela, Milka ne Tisa. 4Na bɛhɔle ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Nun awa Yosua ne mbanyi nemɔ berɛ beesele bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE hyɛle Mose kyɛ, aseɛ bɔ ɔfa ma yɛ abusuafoɛ mmienzua nemɔ nen, yɛ koso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma yɛ bie.” Yiti kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle nen, Yosua mane bɛ aseɛ bɔ ɔfa mane bɛ baba abusuafoɛ mmienzua ne bie. 5Yiti aseɛ ne, Manase bosofoɛ nyane ngyɛmuɛ buru bɛfa bɛbokale Gileade ne Basan bɔ bɛwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne aso. 6Ofikyɛ Manase bosofoɛ mmrasua ne, benyane agyapadeɛ bɔ ye bosofoɛ mmienzua ne nyane ye ne bie. Na Gileade aseɛ ne, Manasefoɛ ngaa ne yeɛ benyane ye ɔ.
7Manase aseɛ ne wɛen fi Asɛ kɔka Mikimeta bɔ ɔwɔ Sɛkem eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne, na ɛwɛen ne fi berɛ kɔ ngwaen dɔ, wɔ Ɛn Tapuafoɛ bue nu dɔ. 8Tapua aseɛ ne yɛle Manase deɛ, nakoso Tapua kuro bɔ ɔwɔ Manase ɛwɛen so ne de, ɔyɛle Efraimfoɛ deɛ. 9 Ɛwɛen ne torotoro kɔ Kana bɔnza ne anu dɔ. Berɛ nguro nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ bɔnza ne ngwaen dɔ ne, bɛte Efraimfoɛ deɛ, nakoso bɛwɔ Manasefoɛ aseɛ so. Afei Manase ɛwɛen ne kɔfa bɔnza ne sorɔ dɔ, na ye noa kɔpem mboanoa. 10Ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne te Efraim deɛ, yeɛ sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne te Manase deɛ, na bɛ wɛen ole ɛpo ne. Manase ne Asɛ bɛbɔ wɛen wɔ sorɔ dɔ, na osa ne Yisaka bɛbɔ wɛen wɔ eyia afiteleɛ. 11 Yisaka ne Asɛ aseɛ ne, nguro hemɔ wɔ so bɔ bɛte Manase deɛ ɔ: Bete Sean ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Yiblim ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Dɔɔ kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Ɛn Dɔɔ kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Taanake kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Megido kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ (yeɛ Nafate nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko). 12 Nakoso Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛtete sɔ nguro nemɔ aso ne, Manasefoɛ bangora bandu bɛ bamvi berɛ, yiti Kanaanfoɛ hɔle so tenane sɔ aseɛ ne aso. 13Na nziɛ ye bɔ Yisraelfoɛ nwo yɛle se ne, bɛhyɛle Kanaanfoɛ nemɔ maa bɛyɔle adwuma bɛmane bɛ, nakoso bandu bɛ bamvi aseɛ ne aso.
Yosef boso ama pena aseɛ bieku
14Yosef abusua kure ne sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ afa agyapadeɛ aseɛ porɛ komapɛ ama me ɔ? Me bosofoɛ sone, ofikyɛ AWURADE ayira me alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ.” 15Na Yosua buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ boso atrɛ a, nzaade kɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu dɔ, wɔ Perisifoɛ ne Refaimfoɛ aseɛ ne aso kɔsoso dɔ fa, ofikyɛ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne te kãa ma wɔ.” 16Na Yosef abusua kure ne buale kyɛ, “Mmokaa aseɛ ne te kãa ma yɛ. Afei koso, Kanaanfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ne, bele buralɛ teaseɛnam mɔ: bɛwɔ Bete Sean ne ye namue mɔ nu, ɔne Yesreel bɔnza ne anu.” 17Na Yosua sele Efraimfoɛ ne Manasefoɛ, bɔ bɛte Yosef boso ama ne kyɛ, “Wɔ boso atrɛ amba, na wɔ nwo yɛ se; yiti nna aseɛ porɛ komapɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ enya ɔ, 18na mmom mmokaa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte ɛhɔayeɛ de, nakoso kɔso fa, na ofi ye ti bɔ ɔkwaaha ye ti ne kɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Kanaanfoɛ ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bele buralɛ teaseɛnam, yeɛ afei bɛ nwo yɛ se de, nakoso ɛkɔhora kɔfoa bɛ kofi berɛ.”

Title: YOSUA 18
Content:
Abusua kure ngaa nemɔ aseɛ
1Yisraelfoɛ lili aseɛ ne aso ngonim yiele nen, bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle dwaa wɔ Silo, na besili ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne wɔ berɛ.
2Né waha Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure nzoo bɔ né bɛ de bennyane agyapadeɛ ne bie ɔ. 3Yiti Yosua sele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama ɛmɔ ne, kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛmɔtwetwe ɛmɔ gya ase maa okoodwu koraka né ɛmɔaafa ɔ? 4Abusua kure biala, ɛ́mɔye nu mmienzua nza. Mésoma bɛ maa bɛkɔfa aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, ná bɛkyerɛ aseɛ ne, ɔne so nningyein nwo dwirɛ. Ɛhe yeɛ yɛkogyina so yɛkɔhyɛ maa ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, ná ye si ye basa bawa me wa. 5Odi kyɛ bɛkyɛ aseɛ ne anu nzoo; ofikyɛ Yuda abusua kure de, wanya ye deɛ wɔ ngwaen dɔ dada, yeɛ Yosef boso ama wora banya bɛ deɛ wɔ sorɔ dɔ dada. 6Odi kyɛ ɛmɔkyɛ aseɛ ne anu nzoo, ná ɛ́mɔfa ye nwo amaneɛ bɛbabɔ me, na ngogua serewa ngɔma ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu wa. 7 Lewifoɛ mɔ de, bengonya aseɛ biala wɔ ɛmɔ nu, ofikyɛ AWURADE sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ. Na Gade abusua kure, Ruben abusua kure, ɔne Manase abusua kure ne bue de, banya b’agyapadeɛ deɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan si eyia afiteleɛ, na sɔ aseɛ ne yeɛ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose fa mane bɛ ne.”
8Mmenia bɔ bɛkwaafa aseɛ ne aso ná bɛkyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ nen, anzana bɛbaasi nu ne, Yosua hyɛle bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛfa aseɛ ne amukoraati so, ɛmɔhyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔsa bɛbra me wa; na ngogua serewa wɔ Silo wa, wɔ AWURADE nyunu ngɔma ɛmɔ.” 9Yiti ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ hɔle bɛɛfale aseɛ ne aso, bɛhyerɛle kyɛbɔ besi bɛhyɛle nu nzoo ne, ɔne nguro somaa bɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nu biala nu beguale nwomaa bie anu, na afei besa bɛwale Yosua berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Silo. 10Yosua guale serewa mane bɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ Silo, na afei Yosua mane Yisrael abusua kure ngaa ne anu biala sa hane ye aseɛ.
Benyamin aseɛ deɛ
11Serewagualɛ ne lili moa yele Benyamin abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne, na aseɛ bɔ Yosua fa mane ye ne ɔla Yuda abusua kure ne Yosef abusua kure bɛ deɛ afia. 12Bɛ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ne ɔhyɛ ye bo fi asue Yɔɔdan noa. Ɛwɛen ne kɔ Yeriko ndoroleɛ nu wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ. Ɔsẽ kɔfa mmokaa aseɛ ne aso kɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ, na ye noa kɔpem Bete Awen ɛserɛ so. 13Ɛwɛen ne fi berɛ a, ɔpɛ nu kɔ Luse ngwaen dɔ, ɔkɔ Luse (bɔ ye ole Betel) ndoroleɛ nu dɔ, na afei ɔtorotoro kɔ Atarote Ada, na ɔkɔ bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Bete Horon aseɛnwo dɔ ne aso. 14Ɛwɛen ne buka fa neka foforɛ, na ɔkondo kɔ eyia atɔleɛ. Ɔfa aseɛnwo dɔ bokaa ne ngwaen wɔ Bete Horon ndendeneɛ so, na ɔkɔpem Kiriate Baal (bɔ ye ole Kiriate Yearim), bɔ ɔte Yuda abusua kure kuro ne. Aseɛ ne, ye eyia atɔleɛ dɔ ɛwɛen ɛne. 15Ye ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne hyɛ ye bo fi Kiriate Yearim tiwaa, ɔtoa so kɔ Efron, na ɔkɔ alaa kodwu Nefetoa nzue ne ti. 16Bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Hinom Awa bɔnza ndendeneɛ so, bɔ ɔwɔ Refaim bɔnza ne sorɔ dɔ ne, ɛwɛen ne torotoro kɔ ye nye abo. Ɔkɔ Hinom bɔnza ne ngwaen dɔ, wɔ Yebusifoɛ ndoroleɛ nu ngwaen dɔ, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Ɛn Rogyel. 17Afei ɛwɛen ne kondo fa sorɔ dɔ kɔ Ɛn Semese, na ɔtoa so kɔ Gelilote bɔ ɔwɔ Adumim pambaa ndendeneɛ so ne, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Ruben awa Bohan Nyɔboɛ ne anwo. 18Ɔpɛ nu kɔ Bete Araba ndoroleɛ nu sorɔ dɔ, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Araba. 19Ɛwɛen ne pɛ nu kɔ Bete Hogela ndoroleɛ nu sorɔ dɔ, na ye noa kɔpem Ngyee Po ne sorɔ, wɔ ye boo ne anu, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan ngwaen dɔ. Aseɛ ne, ye ngwaen dɔ ɛwɛen ɛne. 20Asue Yɔɔdan yeɛ ɔte ye wɛen wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɔ. Benyamin abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne, na ye nwo wɛen amukoraa ɛne.
21Benyamin abusua kure ne, ye mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ nguro nemɔ ɛhe: Yeriko, Bete Hogela, Emeke Kesise, 22Bete Araba, Semaraim, Betel, 23Awim, Para, Ofra, 24Kefare Amoni, Ofini ne Geba: bɛte nguro buru ne nyɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. 25Gibeon, Rama, Beerote, 26Misepe, Kefira, Mosa, 27Rekem, Yirepeel, Tarala, 28Sela, Haelefe, Yebusi (bɔ ye ole Yerusalem), Gibea ne Kiriate Yearim: bɛte nguro buru ne nna ne bɛ namue mɔ. Benyamin abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne.

Title: YOSUA 19
Content:
Simeon aseɛ deɛ
1Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne yele Simeon, Simeon abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne. B’aseɛ ne, Yuda abusua kure aseɛ deɛ ne wapɛ ye nwo wayia. 2 Ye agyapadeɛ bɔ onyane ye ɛhe: Beɛ Hyeba, Hyeba, Molada, 3Hasa Soale, Bala, Esem, 4Ɛltolade, Betul, Hɔma, 5Siklage, Bete Makabote, Hasa Susa, 6Bete Lebaote ne Saruhen: bɛte nguro buru ne nza ne bɛ namue mɔ; 7Ayin, Rimon, Eta, Asan: bɛte nguro nna ne bɛ namue mɔ; 8yeɛ afei namue amukoraa bɔ bapɛ nguro hemɔ nwo bayia, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Baalate Beɛ, ɔne Rama bɔ ɔwɔ ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso ne. Simeon abusua kure ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua nemɔ te ne. 9Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne bie yeɛ bɛpɛ bɛmane Simeon abusua kure ne ɔ, ofikyɛ Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne, né ye piri bo bɛ so. Yiti b’aseɛ ne bie yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Simeon abusua kure ne maa ɔyɛle ye agyapadeɛ ɔ.
Sebulɔn aseɛ deɛ
10Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne yele Sebulɔn abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne. B’aseɛ ne, ye wɛen ne trɛ kodwu Saride. 11Bɛ wɛen ne fo kɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ ɔkɔ Marala, na ɔkɔpem Dabesete. Afei ɔkɔpem bɔnza bɔ ɔwɔ Yokeneam eyia atɔleɛ ne. 12Ofi Saride a, ɔkondo fa eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ kɔ Kiselote Tabɔ ɛwɛen so. Ɔtoa so kɔ Daberate, na ɔfo kɔ Yafia. 13Ofi berɛ a, ɔfa eyia afiteleɛ dɔ kɔ Gate Hefa, ɔkɔ Ete Kasin, na Rimon bue nu dɔ wora ɔkondo kɔ Nea. 14Ye sorɔ dɔ ne, ɛwɛen ne kondo kɔ Hanaton, na ye noa kogua Yifta Ɛl bɔnza ne anu; 15yeɛ Katate, Nahalale, Simron, Yidala ne Betlehem boka so: bɛte nguro buru ne nyɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. 16Sebulɔn abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
Yisaka aseɛ deɛ
17Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne yele Yisaka. Yisaka abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ ye mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne. 18Sɔ nguro hemɔ wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso: Yesreel, Kyesulote, Sunem, 19Hafaraim, Sihon, Anaharate, 20Rabite, Kision, Ebese, 21Remete, Ɛn Ganim, Ɛn Hada ne Bete Pasese. 22Ɛwɛen ne fa Tabɔ bokaa ne, Sahasuma, Bete Semese, na ye noa kɔpem asue Yɔɔdan: bɛte nguro buru ne nzia ne bɛ namue mɔ. 23Yisaka abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
Asɛ aseɛ deɛ
24Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne yele Asɛ abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne. 25Bɛ wɛen ne nate Hɛlkate, Hali, Beten, Akisafe, 26Alamɛlɛke, Amade ne Misal; na ye noa kɔpem Kamɛl ne Sihɔ Libinate wɔ eyia atɔleɛ. 27Afei ɔkondo kɔ eyia afiteleɛ kɔfa Bete Dagɔn, ɔkɔpem Sebulɔn ne Yifta Ɛl bɔnza ne wɔ Bete Emeke ne Neyiɛl sorɔ dɔ, na ɔtoa so fa ye sorɔ dɔ kɔ Kabul, 28Ebron, Rehobo, Hamon ne Kana alaa kodwu Sidon Piri. 29Ɛwɛen ne nate Rama alaa kodwu kuro Tiro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ne. Afei ɔkondo kɔ Hosa, na ye noa kɔpem ɛpo ne. Nguro hemɔ boka so: Mahalabo, Akisibo, 30Yuma, Afeke ne Rehobo: bɛte nguro aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. 31Asɛ abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
Nafetali aseɛ deɛ
32Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne yele Nafetali. Nafetali abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne. 33Bɛ wɛen ne hyɛ ye bo fi Helefe, okodwu Saananim eluii ne, na ɔpɛ nu kɔ Adami Nekebo ne Yabeneel alaa kodwu Lakum, na ye noa kɔpem asue Yɔɔdan. 34Afei ɛwɛen ne kondo kɔfa eyia atɔleɛ ɔkɔ Asenɔte Tabɔ, na ɔtoa so kɔ Hukoke. Ɔkɔpem Sebulɔn wɔ ngwaen dɔ, Asɛ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, yeɛ Yuda wɔ asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ. 35Nguro mɔ bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne ɛhe: Sidim, Sɛre, Hamate, Rakate, Kinerete, 36Adama, Rama, Hasɔ, 37Kedese, Yedrei, Ɛn Hasɔ, 38Yiron, Migidal Ɛl, Horem, Bete Anate ne Bete Semese: bɛte nguro buru ne ngona ne bɛ namue mɔ. 39Nafetali abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
Dan aseɛ deɛ
40Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne yele Dan abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne. 41Sɔ nguro hemɔ wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso: Sora, Esetao, Yiri Semese, 42Saalabin, Ayalɔn, Yitela, 43Elon, Timina, Ekron, 44Ɛlteke, Gibeton, Baalate, 45Yehude, Bene Berake, Gate Rimon, 46Meyakon ne Rakon, yeɛ aseɛ bɔ ɔla Yopa ndendeneɛ so ne. 47 Nziɛ ye, Danfoɛ aseɛ ne fili bɛ sa, yiti bɛfale ngondii bɛɛtetale kuro bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Lesem. Belili so ngonim, na bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni berɛ ama. Bɛfale kuro ne, bɛtenane berɛ, bɛsesane kuro ne dumaa, na bɛfale bɛ nana Dan dumaa bɛtole so. 48Dan abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.
Yisraelfoɛ ma Yosua aseɛ ne bie
49Mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ hyɛle aseɛ ne anu beyiele maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ nen, bɛmane Nun awa Yosua aseɛ ne bie maa ɔyɛle ye deɛ. 50 Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɛ nen, kuro bɔ Yosua hane kyɛ okuro ne ala yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane ye ɔ. Kuro ne ole Timinate Sera bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne; na Yosua sá kyekyele kuro ne tenane nu.
51Sɔ aseɛ nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Nun awa Yosua ɔne mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ noa ne beguale serewa wɔ Silo bɛhyɛle ɔ. Bɛhyɛle ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Yiti bɛhyɛle aseɛ ne anu beyiele.

Title: YOSUA 20
Content:
Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nemɔ
(Numeri 35.9-34)
1 Afei AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, 2“Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro bɔ mvale Mose so ngane ye nwo dwirɛ ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔye bésie berɛ, 3amaa sɛ ebie ɔmmoapa anaa ye sa fõ ná oku sona a, wanwati wahɔ berɛ. Na berɛ kɔyɛ afealeɛ kɔma ɛmɔ kofi wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ye sa nu. 4Na sona bɔ wali awue ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔnwati kɔ sɔ nguro nemɔ ko aso, ná okogyina kuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu, ná okyirekyire ye dwirɛ ne anu kyire kuro berɛ mbanyi mɔ. Na ɛhe asi ye, odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛkɔ kuro ne anu bɛkɔɔma ye nekaa maa ɔne bɛ tena berɛ. 5Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ɔ́po sona bɔ wali awue ne aso a, ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛye bɔ wali awue ne bɛma, ofikyɛ wanhyɛ da yeɛ ohuni obiɛngo ne ɔ. Afei koso, né edwirɛ biala nne b’afia daa. 6Odi kyɛ sona bɔ wali awue ne tena kuro ne anu kɔpem kyɛ bekoli ye dwirɛ badwa nu bekobua ye be ɔ. Bebua ye be a, ɔkɔtena berɛ toonn kɔpem kyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne kowu ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ye, ɔkɔhora kosa kɔhɔ ye awuro, wɔ kuro bɔ ɔnwatili fili so ne aso.’ ”
7Yiti bɛyele nguro hemɔ besiele berɛ: Kedese bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea, bɔ ɔwɔ Nafetali mmokaa aseɛ so, Sɛkem bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so, ɔne Kiriate Aba (bɔ ye ole Hebron) bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda mmokaa aseɛ so ne. 8Na asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ Yeriko eyia afiteleɛ dɔ wora, bɛyele nguro hemɔ besiele berɛ: Besɛre bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔwɔ Ruben abusua kure aseɛ so; Ramote bɔ ɔwɔ Gileade, bɔ ɔwɔ Gade abusua kure aseɛ so; yeɛ Golan bɔ ɔwɔ Basan, bɔ ɔwɔ Manase abusua kure aseɛ so ne. 9Sɔ nguro nemɔ yeɛ betu besiele berɛ bɛmane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena Yisraelfoɛ nu ɔ, amaa sɛ ebie ɔmmoapa ná oku obiɛngo a wanwati wahɔ berɛ. Na kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ bekoli ye dwirɛ badwa nu ne, wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ngonya atee ngohũ ye.

Title: YOSUA 21
Content:
Lewifoɛ nguro nemɔ
1 Afei Lewi abusua ne anu mbanyi mɔ, bɛwale ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Nun awa Yosua ne abusua mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anu berɛ, 2 wɔ Silo bɔ ɔwɔ Kanaan aseɛ so beesele bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE fale Mose so hyɛle kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛma yɛ nguro maa yɛtena so, ɔne nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ yɛ nyɛmmoa kodidi so ɔ.” 3Yiti Yisraelfoɛ gyinane AWURADE noa dwirɛ ne aso, na bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili b’agyapadeɛ nu bɛmane Lewifoɛ mɔ.
4Serewagualɛ ne yele Kohatefoɛ mmusua nemɔ. Yiti Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte ɔsɔfo Aarɔn bosofoɛ ne, serewagualɛ ne maa benyane nguro buru ne nza befili Yuda abusua kure, Simeon abusua kure ne Benyamin abusua kure ne berɛ.
5Serewagualɛ ne mane Kohatefoɛ ngaa ne nyane nguro buru befili mmusua mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ abusua kure hemɔ anu dɔ: Efraim abusua kure, Dan abusua kure, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue.
6Serewagualɛ ne mane Gɛsɔn boso ama nyane nguro buru ne nza befili mmusua bɔ bɛwɔ abusua kure hemɔ anu dɔ: Yisaka abusua kure, Asɛ abusua kure, Nafetali abusua kure, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue bɔ ɔwɔ Basan ne.
7Merari boso ama ne, nu mmusua mmusua ne, bɛyele nguro buru ne nyɔ befili abusua kure hemɔ anu bɛmane bɛ: Ruben abusua kure, Gade abusua kure, yeɛ Sebulɔn abusua kure.
8Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne, Yisraelfoɛ nate serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Lewifoɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle ne.
9Nguro hemɔ bɔ bɛ dumaa lili so ye, yeɛ bɛye befili Yuda abusua kure nu ɔne Simeon abusua kure nu ɔ. 10Bɛfa bɛmane Aarɔn bosofoɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ serewagualɛ ne lili moa yele bɛ ɔ. Befi Kohatefoɛ abusua nu, na sɔ abusua ne koso fi Lewi abusua kure nu. 11 Bɛfale Kiriate Aba (Aba te Anake baba) bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Hebron ne, ɔne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛmane bɛ. Ɔwɔ Yuda mmokaa aseɛ ne aso. 12 Nakoso kuro ne anwo mvofoen ne ye nwo namue mɔ de, né bali moa bafa bama Yefune awa Kalebo maa wayɛ ye agyapadeɛ.
13Ɔsɔfo Aarɔn boso ama ne, bɛfale Hebron bɛmane bɛ. Ɔte mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro, na ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ boka so. Besa bɛfale nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛbokale bɛ so: Libina, 14Yatiri, Ɛsetemoa, 15Holon, Dɛbi, 16Ayin, Yuta, yeɛ Bete Semese. Bɛyele nguro ngona befili sɔ abusua kure nyɔ ne anu. 17Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Benyamin abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Gibeon, Geba, 18Anatote, Almɔn: bɛte nguro nna. 19Aarɔn bosofoɛ ne, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne, né bɛ nguro ne amukoraa te buru ne nza, bɛ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
20Lewi abusua kure ne, nu mmenia bɔ bɛte Kohate boso ama ne, bɛ ngaa ne, bɛmane bɛ Efraim abusua kure nguro nemɔ bie. 21Mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro Sɛkem, bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so ne, ɔne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ɔ. Yeɛ bɛfale nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛbokale bɛ so: Gɛsɛre, 22Kibisaim, yeɛ Bete Horon: bɛte nguro nna. 23Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Dan abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Ɛlteke, Gibeton, 24Ayalɔn ne Gate Rimon: bɛte nguro nna. 25Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Manase abusua kure ne bue nu bɛmane bɛ: Taanake ne Gate Rimon: bɛte nguro nyɔ. 26Kohate mmusua ngaa ne, bɛ nguro ne amukoraa te buru, bɛ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
27Gɛsɔn boso ama ne, bɛte Lewi mmusua mmusua ne anu ko. Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Manase abusua kure ne bue nu bɛmane bɛ: Golan bɔ ɔte mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bɔ ɔwɔ Basan, yeɛ afei Beesetera. Bɛte nguro nyɔ. 28Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Yisaka abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Kision, Daberate, 29Yamute, Ɛn Ganim. Bɛte nguro nna. 30Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Asɛ abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Misal, Abedon, 31Hɛlkate, yeɛ Rehobo. Bɛte nguro nna. 32Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Nafetali abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Kedese bɔ ɔte mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea, Hamote Dɔɔ, yeɛ Katan. Bɛte nguro nza. 33Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ nguro ne amukoraa te buru ne nza, bɛ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
34Lewifoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ ole Merari mmusua mmusua ne. Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Sebulɔn abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Yokeneam, Kata, 35Dimina, yeɛ Nahalale. Bɛte nguro nna. 36Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Ruben abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Besɛre, Yahasa, 37Kedemote, yeɛ Mefaate. Bɛte nguro nna. 38Bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili Gade abusua kure nu bɛmane bɛ: Ramote bɔ ɔte mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bɔ ɔwɔ Gileade, Mahanaim, 39Hesebon, Yasere. Bɛte nguro nna. 40Lewi abusua kure ngaa ne, bɔ bɛte Merari boso ama ahoroɔ nen, bɛ nguro bɔ benyane ye ne amukoraa te buru ne nyɔ.
41Yisraelfoɛ agyapadeɛ ne, nguro amukoraa bɔ bɛye befili nu bɛmane Lewifoɛ te aburanna ne mmɔtwɛ, bɛ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
42Nguro nemɔ anu biala, né aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ apɛ ye nwo ayia. Sɔ ala yeɛ nguro nemɔ amukoraa bɛte ɔ.
43 Yiti aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ye nwo ndaen hyirele Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne, ɔfale ye mukoraa mane bɛ; na bɛfale aseɛ ne bɛtenane so. 44AWURADE bɔle bɛ atenaseɛ asomdwee nu wɔ aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala, kyɛbɔ ɔtale ye nwo ndaen hyirele bɛ nana mɔ ne. Bɛ pɔfoɛ amukoraa nu ko po wangora bɛ nyunu gyina, ofikyɛ AWURADE maa belili bɛ mukoraa so ngonim. 45Edwirɛ fɛɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE fa bɔle Yisrael awuro ama anohoba nen, wanni bɛ ngasi wɔ bɛ nu biala nu, na ye mukoraa wale nu.

Title: YOSUA 22
Content:
Abusua kure ne biemɔ sa kɔ b’aseɛ so
1 Afei Yosua tole ye sa frɛle Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue maa beyiale, 2 na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔli so ne, ɛmɔali ye mukoraa so, yeɛ ɛmɔayɛ sotie bama me wɔ bɔ mahyɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔyɔ ne amukoraa nu. 3Mmerɛ ye amukoraa, toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ɛmɔanyakyi ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ nu, na mmom ɛmɔali AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so nahorɛ nu. 4Afei AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wabɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ atenaseɛ asomdwee nu, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle bɛ bɔ ne. Yiti ɛ́mɔsa ɛmɔ si bɛhɔ ɛmɔ kuro, wɔ aseɛ bɔ waayɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ne aso, aseɛ bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose fa mane ɛmɔ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne. 5Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛ́mɔli mmeraa dwirɛ ne mmeraa bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyehyɛ mane ɛmɔ ne aso: kyɛ ɛmɔhuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔli ye dwirɛ amukoraa so, kyɛ ɛ́mɔli ye mmeraa dwirɛ so, kyɛ ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nwo bɛbɔ ye, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahone mukoraa ne ɛmɔ kra mukoraa bɛso ye.” 6Afei Yosua yirale bɛ, ɔyakyili bɛ ate, na besili nu bɛhɔle b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.
7Manase abusua kure ne bue ko ne, né Mose ali moa wafa b’aseɛ deɛ wama bɛ wɔ Basan. Na sɔ abusua ne bue ko bɔ waha ne wora, Yosua fale aseɛ bɔ ɔwɔ b’eliɛma mɔ Yisraelfoɛ deɛ nu mane bɛ, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan eyia atɔleɛ. Mmerɛ bɔ Yosua baayakyi bɛ ate maa bɛkɔ nen, oyirale bɛ, 8na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Anwonyadeɛ pee, nyɛmmoa pee, ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ, kɔɔbere, mmuralɛ ne ndena pee paa yeɛ ɛmɔsa bɛfa bɛkɔ ɛmɔ tena sua nemɔ anu ɔ; na koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya bafi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɛkyɛ.” 9Yiti Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue yakyili Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne wɔ Silo, bɔ ɔwɔ Kanaan aseɛ so. Na besili nu kyɛ besa bɛkɔ Gileade bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ ne aso; aseɛ bɔ begyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so bɛfale ne.
Besi afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ
10Mmerɛ bɔ Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue beedwuli asue Yɔɔdan porɛ ne anu berɛ wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so nen, besili afɔleɛ bokyea kandinga bie wɔ asue Yɔɔdan noa. 11Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne tele kyɛ Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue basi afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Kanaan aseɛ ɛwɛen so, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan porɛ ne anu berɛ, wɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne b’aseɛ so. 12Na mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, Yisrael maen ye amukoraa boaboale bɛ noa wɔ Silo, kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtoa bɛ.
13Yiti Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne somane ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase maa ɔhɔle Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so. 14Mbanyi atitirefoɛ buru bokale ye so yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ. Yisrael abusua kure biala nu sona ko, na bɛ nu biala la abusua noa wɔ Yisrael mmusua mmusua ne anu. 15Ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ wale Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so, na bɛbɔle b’amaneɛ behyirele bɛ kyɛ, 16 “AWURADE mmenia ne amukoraa nwa nyoo: Ɔwale ye sɛ, bɔ ɛmɔayɔ musue nikyee he batia Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɔ ɛnɛ ye de ɛmɔayakyi AWURADE si lilɛ ɔ; bɔ ɛnɛ ye de ɛmɔasi ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’afɔleɛ bokyea bafa bayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen ɔ? 17 Bɔne bɔ yɛyɔle ye wɔ Peɔ, bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po yɛnnya yɛppetene yɛ nwo yɛffili ye nwo ne, bɔne bɔ ɔfale amaneɛ pirikua tole AWURADE mmenia so ne, aso ɔte bɔne ba? 18Afei de, ɛmɔayakyi AWURADE si lilɛ! Sɛ ɛmɔtwi bɛfa AWURADE dwirɛ so ɛnɛ a, ɛhema ɔkɔfɛ Yisrael mmenia mukoraa so yaa. 19Nakoso, sɛ ɛmɔnea ná efiɛ aha ɛmɔ aseɛ ne a, nzaade ɛ́mɔpɛ asue ne bɛbra AWURADE aseɛ ne aso, nekaa bɔ AWURADE nyianu sua wɔ ne, ná ɛmɔɔfa yɛ aseɛ ne bie. Nnɛma ɛmɔtwi bɛfa AWURADE dwirɛ so, anaa yɛ dwirɛ so, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosi afɔleɛ bokyea bɛboka AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ɔ. 20 Nningyein bɔ AWURADE tu siele berɛ kyɛ yɛsɛkye ye ne, aso Sera awa Akan wando ye nwo mmeraa ne? Aso ɔnate sɔ ati Nyameɛ amvɛ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati so yaa? Ye amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔyɔle ne, ye ngome yeɛ owuli ɔ?”
21Afei Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue buale mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua nemɔ noa kyɛ, 22“AWURADE, ɔte Ɛdangama Nyameɛ! AWURADE, ɔte Ɛdangama Nyameɛ! Ye yeɛ odi yɛ adanzeɛ ɔ, na yɛpena kyɛ Yisrael koso te ye bo. Sɛ yayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen, anaakyɛ yanni nahorɛ yamma ye a, ye de ɛmɔhu yɛ ɛnɛ. 23Sɛ yasi afɔleɛ bokyea kyɛ yɛfa yɛtwe yɛ nwo yɛfi AWURADE nwo, anaa sɛ yɛyɔle sɔ kyɛ yɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so, anaa aburoo afɔleɛ wɔ so, anaa asomdwee afɔleɛ wɔ so a, ye de ma AWURADE bɔbɔ ɔtɔ yɛ so wereɛ. 24Nna sɔ ɔ! Ɛhe ati yeɛ yɛsili ɔ: Né yɛsuro kyɛ kyẽa bie ɛmɔ mma kɔha kohyire yɛ mma kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ ngitahoɛ koraa yeɛ ɔla ɛmɔ ne AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ b’afia ɔ? 25Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ de, AWURADE afa asue Yɔɔdan wato ɛwɛen wɔ yɛ ne ɛmɔ afia; na ɛmɔlle kyɛfa biala wɔ AWURADE nu.’ Na ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔ mma mɔ kɔma yɛ mma kɔyakyi AWURADE sɔnenɛ. 26Ye sɔ ne ati, yeɛ ɔmaa yɛhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛsi afɔleɛ bokyea, bɔ yɛngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ wɔ so ɔ. 27Nakoso ɔkɔyɛ yɛ ne ɛmɔ afia adanzeɛ, ɔne yɛ bosofoɛ bɔ nziɛ ye bɛkɔwa ɔ adanzeɛ, kyɛ yɛfa yɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne y’afɔleɛ ne y’asomdwee afɔleɛ yɛso AWURADE wɔ ye nyunu. Na ɔnate so kyẽa bie ɛmɔ mma mɔ ngɔhã ngohyire yɛ mma mɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔlle kyɛfa biala wɔ AWURADE nu.” ’ 28Na yɛsusuli kyɛ, sɛ kyẽa bie bɛka sɔ dwirɛ ne bekyire yɛ anaa yɛ bosofoɛ a, yɛkɔha kyɛ, ‘AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ɛ́mɔnea ye sɛso bɔ yɛ nana mɔ sili ɔ; bɔ banzi kyɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ wɔ so ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ yɛ ne ɛmɔ afia adanzeɛ ɔ.’ 29Yɛddwenene ye nwo le kyɛ yɛkɔyɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen, anaakyɛ ɛnɛ ye yɛkɔyakyi AWURADE si lilɛ ɔ. Yɛngosi afɔleɛ bokyea ngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, aburoo afɔleɛ, anaa afɔleɛ wɔ so, bɔ ɔngɔma yɛngɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ogyi ye nyianu sua ne nyunu ɔ!”
30Ɔsɔfo Finehase ne Yisrael mbanyi atitire, bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua mɔ noa, bɔ bɛ ne ye hɔle ne, mmerɛ bɔ bɛtele edwirɛ bɔ Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manasefoɛ hane nen, bɛ kunu dwole bɛ fɔnwoo. 31Na ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase sele Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manasefoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ de, yanwu ye kyɛ AWURADE gyi yɛ si, ofikyɛ ɛhe de, nna musue nikye yeɛ ɛmɔayɔ batia AWURADE ɔ; na kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔale Yisraelfoɛ bafi AWURADE tumi asohwenɛ nu.”
32Afei ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase ne mbanyi atitirefoɛ nemɔ fili Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ nwo berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so, na besa bɛhɔle Kanaan aseɛ so bɛɛfale amaneɛ bɛbɔle Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne. 33B’amaneɛ ne yɛle Yisraelfoɛ fɛ. Yisraelfoɛ yele Nyameɛ ayɛ, na banyɛ b’adwene ko kyɛ bɛkɔɔfa koɛ bɛkɔtoa Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ, bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekohũhũ b’aseɛ ne aso ama ná basɛkye so nningyein ɔ. 34Na Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ bɛtole afɔleɛ bokyea ne dumaa kyɛ, Adanzeɛ. Ofikyɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔte yɛ ne b’afia adanzeɛ kyɛ AWURADE ole Nyameɛ.”

Title: YOSUA 23
Content:
Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ di ngraa
1 Afoɛ pee asi ne, mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE mane Yisrael nyane asomdwee fili ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia sa nu nen, mmerɛ bɔ né Yosua anyi wayɛ aworowaa ne, 2Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati, bɛ mbanyi ne bɛ mmusua mbanyi, bɛ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ne b’atitirefoɛ beyiale, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Kekesaala ye de, manyi, yeɛ mayɛ aworowaa. 3Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ nye tua nikyee biala bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa wayɔ sɔ maen hemɔ amukoraa ɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye yeɛ ɔho mane ɛmɔ ɔ. 4Ɛ́mɔtie, maen maen mɔ bɔ baha bɔ yɛnnya yɛllili bɛ so ngonim ne, yeɛ afei maen maen amukoraa bɔ mali bɛ so ngonim ne, b’aseɛ bɔ ofi asue Yɔɔdan noa ɔkwaadwu Ɛpo piri ne wɔ eyia atɔleɛ ne, mahyɛ mama ɛmɔ abusua kure nemɔ maa bafa bayɛ b’agyapadeɛ. 5AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔho bekosa, ɔkɔfoa bɛ kofi ɛmɔ nyunu; b’aseɛ ne kɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne. 6 Yiti ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, ná ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ bahyerɛ ye Mose mmeraa nwomaa ne anu ne, ɛmɔkoli so ná ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔdi ye nwo makyebu bɛkɔ famaa so anaa bɛen so; 7 amaa ɛmɔamva ɛmɔ nwo bammɔ maen maen mɔ bɔ baha wɔ ɛmɔ nwo wa ye, amaa ɛmɔammɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ dumaa, amaa ɛmɔamva bɛ banda ndaen, amaa ɛmɔanzo bɛ, ná ɛmɔangoto bɛ. 8Na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔayɔ alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye. 9 Ofikyɛ AWURADE afoa maen mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ wafi ɛmɔ nyunu. Na ɛmɔ de, toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ wahora wagyina ɛmɔ nyunu ɔ. 10 Ɛmɔ nu sona ko kora foa mmenia apee, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔko ma ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne. 11Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, ná ɛmɔhuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ. 12Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ, ná maen maen hemɔ anu mmenia bɔ baha wɔ ɛmɔ nwo wa ye, ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ afɛ, ná ɛmɔgyigya bɛ nwo, bɔ ɛmɔgya bɛ mmrasua ma bɛ koso begya ɛmɔ deɛ a, 13ye de ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ, AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔngɔfoa maen maen hemɔ ngofi ɛmɔ nyunu ko, na mmom bɛkɔkakyi ɛmɔ so ngaen ne atodum. Bɛkɔkakyi mbire bekofi ɛmɔ, ná bakakyi mmowue bawowɔ ɛmɔ nye, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkowuwu bekofi aseɛ paa he bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama ɛmɔ ne aso ɔ.
14 “Kekesaala ye de, waha kãa né matoa me mbanyi mɔ. Na ɛmɔ ahone nu ne ɛmɔ ti anu de, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛse kyɛ, nningyein paa bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔfa hyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne, nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ wali ɛmɔ ngasi wɔ nu ɔ; ye mukoraa awa nu ama ɛmɔ, ko po anni ngasi. 15Nakoso, nningyein paa bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ fa hyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne, kyɛbɔ ye mukoraa awa nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ (sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ a), AWURADE kɔma edwirɛ tɛɛ amukoraa kɔto ɛmɔ ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ okohũhũ ɛmɔ kofi aseɛ paa he bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama ɛmɔ ne aso ɔ. 16AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ apam bɔ ɔhyehyɛ mane ɛmɔ ne, sɛ ɛmɔbu so, ná ɛmɔkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ, ná ɛmɔkoto bɛ a, ye de AWURADE kɔfɛ ɛmɔ so yaa piri paa, na ɛmɔkowuwu ndɛndɛ bekofi aseɛ paa bɔ wafa wama ɛmɔ ne aso.”

Title: YOSUA 24
Content:
Yosua ne maen ne di ngraa
1Afei Yosua mane Yisrael mmusua kure ne amukoraati yiale wɔ Sɛkem. Ɔfrɛle Yisrael mbanyi, mmusua mbanyi, ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ne atitirefoɛ, na beegyinane Nyameɛ nyunu. 2 Na Yosua sele maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Daa tete ne, ɛmɔ nana mɔ Tera ne ye mma Abraham ne Nahɔ bɛtenane asue Yufreti si, na bɛsole nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ. 3 Yeɛ nyele ɛmɔ nana Abraham mvili asue ne asi dɔ, mvale ye mvale Kanaan aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, na mmane ye bosofoɛ yɛle pee. Mmaa ɔwole Yisake. 4 Na Yisake koso mmaa ɔwole Yakob ne Yisɔ. Mvale Sɛre mmokaa aseɛ mane Yisɔ kyɛ ɔfa tena so, nakoso Yakob ne ye mma mɔ de, bɛhɔle Misraim. 5 Afei nzomane Mose ne Aarɔn, na nikyee bɔ nyɔle ye wɔ Misraim ne, ɔmane ɛhawo pirikua wale berɛ. Na ɛhe asi ne, nyele ɛmɔ mvili berɛ. 6 Na nyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Misraim nen, ɛmɔɔdwuli ɛpo ne noa. Na Misraimfoɛ fale teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɛpole ɛmɔ nana mɔ so toonn beedwuli Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne noa. 7Yisraelfoɛ sũ frɛle AWURADE, na ɔfale awosii kabii tole ɛmɔ ne Misraimfoɛ b’afia. Ɔmane ɛpo oobu fale bɛ so katale bɛ so; na ɛmɔ nye nwuni nikyee bɔ mva nyɔle Misraim ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ne, ɛmɔtenane ɛserɛ so bɛhyɛle. 8 Afei Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛte Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, mvale ɛmɔ male b’aseɛ so. Bɛ ne ɛmɔ hone, na mvale bɛ nwurale ɛmɔ sa. Ɛmɔfale b’aseɛ ne, na ngukuni bɛ mvili ɛmɔ nyunu. 9 Na Moabo hene Balake bɔ ɔse ole Sipore ne, ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtetale Yisrael. Ɔtole ye sa frɛle Beɔ awa Balaam kyɛ ɔɔnoma ɛmɔ, 10nakoso mandie Balaam dwirɛ. Yiti oyirale ɛmɔ; na nnele ɛmɔ mvili ye sa nu. 11 Na ɛmɔpɛle asue Yɔɔdan bɛwale Yeriko nen, Yerikofoɛ ne ɛmɔ hone. Sɔ ala yeɛ Amorifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Gɛgasifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ hone ɔ. Na mvale bɛ nwurale ɛmɔ sa. 12 Nzomane kotokuradu mɔ maa belili ɛmɔ nyunu, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ befili ɛmɔ nyunu. Nna wɔ ngrandɛ anaa w’agyaen yeɛ ɛfa yɔle sɔ ɔ. 13 Aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔamvɛ ye nwo, ɔne nguro bɔ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkyekyele ɔ yeɛ mva mane ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɛmɔtenane so. Bobe boo ne olive boo bɔ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔle ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdi so mmaa ɔ.’
14“Yiti ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE ná ɛ́mɔso ye ferengyemm ne nahorɛ nu. Na mmosoen bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole bɛ wɔ asue Yufreti asi dɔ, ɔne Misraim nen, ɛ́mɔgyi bégua ná ɛ́mɔso AWURADE. 15 Na sɛ ɛmɔ kunu ndwo kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso AWURADE de a, nzaade ɛnɛ kyẽa ye ɛ́mɔhyire bɔ ɛmɔkɔso ye ɔ: sɛ mmosoen bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole bɛ wɔ asue ne asi dɔ ne ahɔ oo, anaakyɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ ɛmɔte b’aseɛ so ye bɛ mmosoen nemɔ ahɔ oo. Nakoso me ne m’awuro ama de, yɛ de yɛkɔso AWURADE.”
16Na Yisraelfoɛ buale kyɛ, “Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ le kyɛ yɛkɔyakyi AWURADE berɛ yɛkɔɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ ɔ. 17Ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyele yɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so ngoaasolɛ nu wale ɔ. Na nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ yɛnwuni ye ne, ye yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ. Atee bɔ yɛfale so ne amukoraa, yeɛ maen maen mukoraa bɔ yɛɛfale so ne, ɔbɔle yɛ nwo waen fili nu. 18Na AWURADE foane maen maen amukoraa, yeɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛte aseɛ ne aso ne fili yɛ nyunu. Yiti yɛ koso yɛkɔso AWURADE, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ.”
19Nakoso Yosua sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔso AWURADE, ofikyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ɔte nungunɛ Nyameɛ; na ɔngɔfa ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ne ɛmɔ bɔne ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ. 20Sɛ ɛmɔyakyi AWURADE si lilɛ bɛkɔɔso Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ a, ye de ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ AWURADE ayɛ ɛmɔ paa ɔ, ɔkɔpɛ ye nwo kɔprapra amaneɛ kogua ɛmɔ so kɔmaa ɛmɔkowuwu.” 21Na maen ne buale Yosua kyɛ, “Daabi! AWURADE yeɛ yɛkɔso ye ɔ.” 22Na afei Yosua sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔte ɛmɔ nwo adanzefoɛ kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɛmɔaneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso ye ɔ.” Na bɛ koso bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛte adanzefoɛ.” 23 Na osele kyɛ, “Nzaade ɛ́mɔgyi Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne begua, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́ma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ.” 24Na maen ne buale Yosua kyɛ, “AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ yɛkɔso ye ɔ, na ye dwirɛ so yeɛ yɛkoli ɔ.” 25Yiti Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ yɛle apam sɔ kyẽa ne, na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ wɔ Sɛkem. 26Yosua hyerɛle sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu. Na ɔfale nyɔboɛ kandinga bie penane eluii bakaa bɔ ogyi AWURADE nekaa krongron berɛ ne abo. 27Na Yosua sele maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, nyɔboɛ he yeɛ ɔte adanzeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ wate AWURADE dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ waha wahyire yɛ ne. Na sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ bamma ɛmɔ Nyameɛ a, nyɔboɛ ne kɔyɛ adanzeɛ kotia ɛmɔ.” 28Na Yosua mane mmenia ne amukoraa betuli apo besa bɛhɔle b’aseɛ nemɔ aso.
Yosua ne Eleasa wue
29Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, Nun awa Yosua bɔ ɔte AWURADE somvoɛ ne, owuli. Olili afoɛ ɛyaa ko ne buru. 30 Besiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so wɔ Timinate Sera, wɔ Efraim mmokaa ne anu dɔ, wɔ Gaase bokaa ne sorɔ dɔ.
31 Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ né Yosua te ase ne, Yisrael sole AWURADE. Na Yosua wue asi ne koso, maen ne anu mbanyi bɔ né bɛtɛ te ase, ná afei benwuni nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ama Yisrael nen, mmerɛ mukoraa bɔ né bɛte ase ne, Yisrael hɔle so sole AWURADE.
32 Yosef mmowue bɔ Yisraelfoɛ sesa fili Misraim wale ne, besiele ye wɔ Sɛkem, wɔ aseɛ bɔ Yakob tɔ fili Sɛkem baba Hamɔ mma nemɔ berɛ ne aso. Ɔtɔle ye sikaa ɛdwetɛ ɛyaa ko. Na aseɛ ne ɔɔyɛle Yosef boso ama agyapadeɛ.
33Aarɔn awa Eleasa wuli, na besiele ye wɔ ɔwa Finehase kuro Gibea, bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Finehase wɔ Efraim mmokaa ne anu dɔ ne aso.

Title: MAENBULƐFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Maenbulɛfoɛ nwomaa ne maa yɛnwu kyɛ, Yosua wue asi ne, Yisraelfoɛ hɔle so behwi bɛfale AWURADE dwirɛ so, na belili mmosoen si. Mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛyɔle sɔ ne, AWURADE hwene bɛ so maa bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ lili bɛ so ngonim. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, né Yisraelfoɛ basa baali AWURADE si, na bɛsrɛ ye kyɛ ɔfa bɛ bɔne ɔhyɛ bɛ. Sɛ bɛsrɛ AWURADE a, ɔma mmienzua ne mmrasua sonongo bie bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Maenbulɛfoɛ bɛbada maen ne noa, na bedi bɛ nyunu maa bedi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim. Na ɛhe ma asomdwee ba maen ne anu. Nakoso ɔngyɛ né basa bapo AWURADE. Na ɔba ye sɔ a, ɔtwe bɛ so bieku. Maenbulɛfoɛ ne, ebiemɔ ole Debora, Gideon yeɛ Yɛfeta. Bɛ nu ko bɔ wale dumaa paa ole Samson bɔ yɛkenga ye nwo dwirɛ wɔ nwomaa ne ye ti 13-16 ne.
Nikyee titire bɔ yɛsua yɛfi nwomaa ne anu ole kyɛ, Yisrael yeeyɛlɛ gyi nahorɛ bɔ okoli kɔma AWURADE ɔ so. Sɛ banni nahorɛ bamma AWURADE a, amaneɛ yeɛ benwu ye ɔ. Nakoso yɛnwu ye kyɛ, mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛkɔyɔ bɔne bekotia AWURADE ne, ɔhale AWURADE ngome a, ahaa né banu bɛ nwo maa wafa wahyɛ bɛ, ná wamaa banya saleɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Yisrael ko fa aseɛ ne ngaa ne 1.1-36
AWURADE ye Maenbulɛfoɛ ma bɛ 2.1—3.6
Otiniɛl, Ehude ne Samega nwo dwirɛ 3.7-31
Debora, Barake ne Yaele nwo dwirɛ 4.1—5.31
Gideon ne Abimɛlɛke nwo dwirɛ 5.31—9.57
Tola, Yari, Yɛfeta, Yibesan, Elon ne Abedon nwo dwirɛ 10.1—12.15
Samson nwo dwirɛ 13.1—16.31
Danfoɛ so mmosoen 17.1—18.31
Koɛ si Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne Benyaminfoɛ afia 19.1—21.25
