Nakoso ye sia bienzua ne sele ye kyɛ, “Didi kãa nya anwoserɛ koraka né ahɔ.” 6Yiti mmienzua nyɔ nemɔ tenane poen nwo bedidili bɛnone, na taluwa ne baba sele Lewiniɛ ne kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛnna wa ɛnɛ ná ɛmma wɔ nye ngye ɔ?” 7Lewiniɛ ne dwɔsole kyɛ ɔkɔ ne, ye sia ne hɔle so gu sele ye kɔpem kyɛ osa lale berɛ sɔ kyẽa ne koso ɔ. 8Ye elennu ne aso, Lewiniɛ ne dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu kyɛ ɔkɔ; na taluwa ne baba sele ye kyɛ, “Didi koraka.” Yiti belele bɛ nwome maa oodwuli kyɛ aleɛ dwole ɔ, na bɛ munyɔ bedidili bɛnone. 9Mmerɛ bɔ Lewiniɛ ne, ye sómaa ne, yeɛ ye somvoɛ ne bedwɔsole kyɛ bɛkɔ ne, taluwa ne baba bɔ ɔte Lewiniɛ ne sia ne, osele Lewiniɛ ne kyɛ, “Nea, mmerɛ ahɔ, aleɛ ayie sa. Ɛ́mɔla wa ɛnɛ, na aleɛ adwo. Ɛ́mɔla wa ɛnɛ, ná ma wɔ nye gye. Ɛhema ɛmɔkɔhora bekodwɔso ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu bekosi nu bɛkɔhɔ ɛmɔ kuro.”
10Nakoso Lewiniɛ ne wambene so kyɛ ɔkɔla berɛ sɔ kyẽa ne. Osili nu, na oodwuli Yebusi (ye ala ole Yerusalem) ndendeneɛ so. Ɔne ye afunum nyɔ bɔ nningyein gua bɛ so, ɔne ye sómaa ne yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ. 11Ɔka kãa maa bedwu Yebusi ne, né aleɛ adwo. Na somvoɛ ne sele ye mene kyɛ, “Maa yɛmakye yɛhɔ Yebusifoɛ kuro ye aso na yɛɛla berɛ ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye.” 12Nakoso ye mene sele ye kyɛ, “Amanvorafoɛ mɔ bɔ nna Yisraelfoɛ ahɔ ɔ ne de, yɛngɔhɔ bɛ kuro so; na mmom yɛkɔtoa so yɛkɔhɔ Gibea.” 13Na osele ye somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Maa yɛmia yɛ nye yɛɛdwu nguro nemɔ ko aso, ná yɛɛla Gibea anaa Rama ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye.” 14Yiti bɛtoale b’ateetulɛ ne aso; na eyia tɔle ne, né bapingye Gibea bɔ ɔte Benyamin kuro ne. 15Bɛmakyele bɛhɔle Gibea kyɛ bɛkwaala berɛ. Lewiniɛ ne hɔle kuro ne anu ɔɔtenane kuro ne dwaaso, nakoso ebiala wamva bɛ wangɔ ye awuro kyɛ beesikye berɛ sɔ kɔngɔen ne.
16Aleɛ dwole ne, benwuni biaa aworowaa bie kyɛ ofi ye fieso ɔba. Biaa ne fi Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, na Gibea yeɛ né ɔte ɔ. (Kuro berɛ ama te Benyaminfoɛ.) 17Biaa aworowaa ne pagyale ye ti so, na onwuni akwanduniɛ ne wɔ kuro ne dwaaso ne, obisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛkɔ ɔ, na efi ni po yeɛ ɛba ye?” 18Lewiniɛ ne buale ye kyɛ, “Yɛfi Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda, na yɛsẽ yɛkɔ namue bie bɔ ɔwɔ dedeede anu wɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso. Berɛ yeɛ mvi ɔ. Ngɔle Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda, na mesa mekɔ AWURADE awuro. Nakoso ebiala ɔmmane me nekaa maa nnzikyele. 19Wɔ ngoaa mɔ, yɛle ɛserɛ ne nzenzaen bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔma yɛ afunum mɔ ɔ, yeɛ me ne braa ye ne aberandeɛ bɔ ɔboka yɛ so ye, yɛle aleɛ ne nzaa. Yɛnhia hwee ko.” 20Biaa aworowaa ne sele kyɛ, “Nyameɛ ɔma wɔ asomdwee. Ngɔma wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ekohia ɔ. Onhia kyɛ ɛkɔla dwaaso wa ɔ.” 21Yiti ɔfale ye hɔle ye awuro, na ɔmane afunum nemɔ aleɛ. Ɛwɔfoɛ nemɔ nwunzini bɛ gya bo, na bedidili bɛnone.
Gibeafoɛ bɔ musue
22 Na begu so bɛgye bɛ nye ne, kuro berɛ mmienzua asanzafoɛ biemɔ bɛɛpɛle awuro ne anwo beyiale, na bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛborole anoa ne anu. Besele biaa aworowaa bɔ yeɛ ɔte awuro ne mene ne kyɛ, “Biaa bɔ wawa w’awuro wa ne, ye ye fite bra maa yɛne ye la.” 23Yeɛ biaa ne bɔ ɔte awuro ne mene ne, ofite ooyiale bɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Daabi, daabi, nniɛma mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ sɔ amumuyɛɛ he. Biaa he te me wɔfoɛ, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ sɔ nyanzoen nikyee he. 24Mma brasua bɔ onwuni biaa le, yeɛ ɛwɔfoɛ ne sómaa ne, bɛwɔ wa. Ɛ́mɔma nye bɛ mvite kekesaala ye. Ɛmɔ ne bɛ la, na bɔ ɛmɔ kuro biala, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɔ bɛ; na mmom biaa he de, nnɛma ɛmɔfa sɔ nyanzoen dwirɛ he bedi ye.” 25Nakoso mmenia nemɔ bandie ye dwirɛ ne. Yiti Lewiniɛ ne sɔle ye sómaa ne anu, na ɔwɔle ye tole aluo dɔ mane bɛ. Bɛtole ye mmɔnaa pasaa, na bɛhyɛle ye bɛ ne ye lale kɔngɔen ne amukoraa mane aleɛ hyene. Na alebahyene ne, bɛyakyili ye kyɛ ɔhɔ. 26Ewienu yɛle kyɛ ɔtete ne, braa ne hɔle ɔɔpɛ fini biaa n’awuro n’anoa nu berɛ, nekaa bɔ né ye somaa ne wɔ ne, na ɔlale berɛ toonn mane aleɛ hyene.
27Aleɛ hyene ne, braa ne somaa ne dwɔsole, na obukyebukyele awuro berɛ anoa nemɔ. Na ofitele kyɛ ɔtoa ye ateetulɛ ne aso ne, onwuni kyɛ ye sómaa ne la awuro n’anoa nu berɛ, bɔ ye sa gua aponnwaa ne aso ɔ. 28Osele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso maa yɛhɔ.” Nakoso braa ne andwudwo. Yeɛ ɔfale braa ne tole afunum ne aso, na osili nu hɔle ye kuro. 29 Odwuli ye awuro ne, ɔfale dadeɛ ba. Ɔsɔle ye sómaa ne fuin ne anu, na ɔpepɛle nu ahuronzi ahuronzi buru ne nyɔ wɔ ye aporɛ aporɛ so, na ɔfa somane maa bɛhɔle Yisrael maen amukoraa nu. 30Na ɔfale ngraa mane ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbisa Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa sɔ dwirɛ he: ‘Ofi mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, aso sɔ dwirɛ he, ebie asi le? Ɛ́mɔdwene ye nwo, ɛmɔhɔ ye nwo agyina, ná ɛ́mɔbua ye nwo bie.’ ”

Title: MAENBULƐFOƐ 20
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne Benyaminfoɛ bɛko
1Afei Yisraelfoɛ ngaa amukoraa, ofi Dan bɔ ɔkwaadwu Beɛ Hyeba, bɔ Gileade mbɔtam boka so ɔ, bɛbɔle nu bɛwale AWURADE nyunu wɔ Misepa. 2Na Yisrael mbanyi amukoraa, mbanyi bɔ bɛlela mmusua kure ne amukoraa noa, beegyinane nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ mmenia babɔ dwaa ne. Koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ betiratira akodeɛ bɔ babɔ dwaa ne, né bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nna. 3(Yeɛ Benyaminfoɛ tele kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bahɔ Misepa.) Na Yisraelfoɛ bisale kyɛ, “Sɔ musue dwirɛ he, ɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ osili ɔ? Ɛ́mɔhã behyire yɛ.” 4Na Lewiniɛ bɔ ɔte braa bɔ behuni ye ne ahu ne, obuale kyɛ, “Mene me sómaa yɛhɔle Benyaminfoɛ kuro Gibea so yɛɛlale berɛ kɔngɔen. 5Gibea mbanyi wale me so, na bɛpɛle awuro ne anwo beyiale kɔngɔen ne. Ahaa bɛpena me beku me, na bɛtole me sómaa ne mmɔnaa toonn maa owuli ɔ. 6Yeɛ mvale me sómaa ne fuin mbepɛle nu ahuronzi ahuronzi maa bɛfa bɛhɔle Yisrael aseɛ so nekaa biala; ofikyɛ Gibeafoɛ babɔ musue ne nyanzoen bra wɔ Yisrael. 7Yiti, ɛmɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔhyire ɛmɔ adwene, ná ɛmɔhã edwirɛ ne anwo bie.”
8Mmenia ne amukoraa bɛbɔle nu bedwɔsole, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛ nu biala ngɔhɔ ye ɛtena sua nu, yeɛ yɛ nu biala ngosa ngɔhɔ ye awuro. 9Na bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔyɔ Gibea kuro ne ɛhe: yɛkɔfa serewagualɛ so yɛkɔye mmenia bɔ bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔɔteta bɛ ɔ. 10Yisrael abusua kure amukoraa, yɛkɔye mmenia ɛyaa ko biala nu buru; mmenia apee ko biala nu ɛyaa ko, yeɛ mmenia apee buru biala nu apee ko. Sɔ mmenia ne yeɛ bɛkɔfa aleɛ bɛkɔbrɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkwaatɔ Benyaminfoɛ kuro Gibea so wereɛ ne ɔ, ɔnate nyanzoen bra amukoraa bɔ Gibeafoɛ babɔ ye wɔ Yisrael ne ati.” 11Yiti Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, bɛbɔle nu kyɛ bɛfa koɛ bɛkɔteta kuro ne.
12Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ somane mmenia maa behyinini Benyamin abusua kure ne anu ama mukoraa so bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nzɛmmɔne yeɛ ɛmɔali ye wɔ wa ye? 13Sɔ busuefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Gibea ye, ɛ́mɔye bɛ bɛma yɛ kekesaala ye maa yɛhu bɛ, ná yɛkyikyi bɔne ne yɛfi Yisrael.” Nakoso Benyaminfoɛ bandɛ b’eliɛma mɔ Yisraelfoɛ so. 14Benyaminfoɛ fili bɛ nguro nemɔ aso bɛɛboale bɛ noa wɔ Gibea kyɛ bɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkwaaho. 15Sɔ kyẽa ne, Benyaminfoɛ boaboale koɛhonɛfoɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nzia bɔ betiratira akodeɛ noa befili bɛ nguro nemɔ aso, asora koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ɛyaa nzoo bɔ befi Gibea ne. 16Né koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ɛyaa nzoo bɔ bɛte bɛen ɔ wɔ sɔ ɛlɔen ne amukoraati nu. Bɛ nu biala nye gyene maa sɛ ɛtengyɛ wɔ sa po a, ɔkɔte bɔ ɔngɔto ngɔfo ɔ. 17Na Yisraelfoɛ, sɛ ɛye Benyaminfoɛ fi nu a, bɛboaboale mmenia apee ɛyaa nna noa, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ɔ.
18Yisraelfoɛ sili nu bɛhɔle Betel beebisale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Yɛ nu abusua kure beni yeɛ oli moa ɔfa koɛ ɔɔteta Benyaminfoɛ ɔ?” Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Yuda abusua kure yeɛ odi kyɛ odi moa ɔkɔ ɔ.”
19Yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ bepingyele Gibea. 20Yisraelfoɛ fale koɛ bɛɛtetale Benyaminfoɛ; bɛ ne Benyaminfoɛ bɛhone wɔ Gibea. 21Benyaminfoɛ fili Gibea befitefitele, na sɔ kyẽa ne, behuhuni Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nu apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ. 22Yisraelfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ sili bɛ hue, na besa beegyinagyinane nekaa bɔ beegyinane kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne. 23Yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ beesuni wɔ AWURADE nyunu maa oodwuli nɔsoa, na bebisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Aso yɛsa yɛɛfa koɛ yɛteta y’eliɛma mɔ Benyaminfoɛ anaa?” Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa koɛ bɛɛteta bɛ.”
24Yiti ye elenyɔ ne aso Yisraelfoɛ bɔ pingyele Benyaminfoɛ. 25Sɔ elenyɔ ne aso, Benyaminfoɛ fili Gibea bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Yisraelfoɛ, na besa behuhuni Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛ mukoraa betiratira akodeɛ ɔ apee buru ne mmɔtwɛ. 26Yeɛ Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraa, besa bɛhɔle Betel bɛɛtenane AWURADE nyunu besuni. Sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛhyele ɛhɔen maa oodwuli nɔsoa. Afei bɛbobɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 27Na Yisraelfoɛ bisale AWURADE dwirɛ (ofikyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Nyameɛ apam alaka ne wɔ berɛ, 28na Finehase bɔ ɔse ole Aarɔn awa Eleasa ne, ye yeɛ né ɔte sɔfo wɔ Nyameɛ alaka ne nyunu ɔ.) Bebisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Yɛfa koɛ yɛɛteta y’eliɛma mɔ Benyaminfoɛ bieku, anaakyɛ yɛyakyi?” Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, Ɛmɔɔho, ofikyɛ ɛhema ngɔfa bɛ ngowura ɛmɔ sa.”
29Yiti Yisrael mane koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛɛfeale bɛpɛle Gibea nwo beyiale. 30Na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, Yisraelfoɛ fale koɛ bɛɛtetale Benyaminfoɛ, na begyinagyinane bɛmane bɛ nye hyirele Gibea kyɛbɔ bɛyɔle ye daa ne ala. 31Benyaminfoɛ fitele kyɛ bɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkwaaho ne, Yisraelfoɛ diediele bɛ hwene bɛ fili kuro ne anu. Kyɛbɔ bɛyɔle ye daa ne, bɛhyɛle ye bo behuhuni Yisraelfoɛ wɔ atimbire nemɔ aso. Atimbire ko kɔ Betel, yeɛ ko koso kɔ Gibea. Behuhuni ebiemɔ koso wɔ buro na behuni Yisraelfoɛ kɔyɛ aburasa. 32Benyaminfoɛ susuli kyɛ, “Bali ngoguo wɔ yɛ nyunu kyɛ daa ne ala.” Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ hane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔma yɛhyɛ da yɛsa yɛ si, na yɛtwetwe bɛ yɛfi kuro ne anu yɛbra atimbire nemɔ aso.” 33Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ kure piri paa ne, befili nekaa bɔ né bɛ wɔ ne bɛhɔle Baal Tamar. Yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bapɛ kuro ne anwo bayia ne, befili b’afealeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Gibea eyia atɔleɛ so ne befitefitele. 34Koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ apee buru bɔ befi Yisrael maen ne anu amukoraa, bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Gibea, na koɛ ne anu yɛle se paa. Nakoso Benyaminfoɛ bannwu ye kyɛ edwirɛ piri yeɛ wato bɛ ɔ.
35Na AWURADE lili Benyamin so ngonim mane Yisrael. Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisraelfoɛ huhuni Benyaminfoɛ bɔ bɛ mukoraa betiratira akodeɛ ɔ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa ko.
36Yiti Benyaminfoɛ nwuni kyɛ bali ngoguo. Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ kure piri ne, bɛboapa bɛnwatili befili Benyaminfoɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ né bɛ nye la bɛ mmango koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ baatetɛ Gibea ne aso. 37Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baatetɛ ne, bɛbɔle twi bɛhɔle Gibea. Na bele ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro berɛ ama amukoraati. 38Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ kure piri ne, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle ne, né bali moa babɔ porɛ kyɛ, sɛ bɛ bɔ baatetɛ ne, bɛma nwosina tu munguu fi kuro ne anu a, 39ye de Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ kure piri ne, odi kyɛ bɛkakyi bɛ nye bɛkɔ Benyaminfoɛ so. Nakoso né Benyaminfoɛ bali moa bahuhu Yisraelfoɛ kɔyɛ aburasa; yiti Benyaminfoɛ nyane adwene kyɛ, “Amba, yali bɛ so ngonim kyɛ daa ne ala.” 40Nakoso nwosina munguu hyɛle ye bo tu fili kuro ne anu ne, Benyaminfoɛ neane bɛ si, na benwuni kyɛ nwosina fi kuro ne anu amukoraa otu kɔ ewienu ɔ! 41Afei Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ kure piri ne kakyili bɛ nye, na Benyaminfoɛ nye so tanene, ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ edwirɛ piri ato bɛ. 42Yiti Benyaminfoɛ kakyili bɛ nwo befili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele ɛserɛ so atee ne aso; nakoso Yisraelfoɛ buale bɛ noa so, na Yisraelfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ kuro ne anu ne, bɛhane Benyaminfoɛ bemiane behuhuni bɛ. 43Yisraelfoɛ pɛle Benyaminfoɛ nwo yiale. Bɛfoane bɛ befili Noha, na behuhuni bɛ alaa beedwuli Gibea eyia afiteleɛ so. 44Benyaminfoɛ apee buru ne mmɔtwɛ totɔle; bɛ mukoraa bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ. 45Bɛkakyili bɛ nwo bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele ɛserɛ so bɛhɔle Rimon nyɔbotaen ne anwo ne, Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ nu apee nnu wɔ atimbire nemɔ aso. Bɛfoane bɛ alaa beedwuli Gidom, na behuhuni bɛ nu apee nyɔ. 46Yiti Benyamin koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa bɔ betiratira akodeɛ, bɔ bɛtotɔle sɔ kyẽa nen, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nnu; bɛ mukoraati bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ. 47Nakoso bɛ nu ɛyaa nzia kakyili bɛ nwo bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele ɛserɛ so bɛhɔle Rimon nyɔbotaen ne anwo, na bɛtenane Rimon nyɔbotaen ne anwo alaa bosome nna. 48Yisraelfoɛ sa kakyili bɛ nye besa bɛwale Benyaminfoɛ so. Bɛbɔle kuro ne, na bele ngrandɛ behuhuni mmenia amukoraa ne ngaka amukoraa. Na nguro bɔ baha nemɔ koso, bɛtole bɛ nu see.

Title: MAENBULƐFOƐ 21
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ ma Benyaminfoɛ mmraa maa begyigya
1Né Yisraelfoɛ ata ndaen wɔ Misepa kyɛ, “Yɛ nu biala ngɔfa ɔwa brasua ngɔma Benyaminniɛ agyaa.” 2Yisraelfoɛ hɔle Betel. Bɛtenane Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ berɛ maa oodwuli nɔsoa, na besuni hahii. 3Bɛhane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛnɛ ye de yɛpena abusua kure ko a, yɛnnwu ye wɔ Yisrael ɔ?” 4Ye alehyeleɛ ne, maen ne dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu. Besili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ berɛ, na bɛbobɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ. 5Yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bisale kyɛ, “Yisrael mmusua kure ne, bɛ nu beni yeɛ dwaa bɔ yɛbɔle wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, wamma ye bo bie ɔ?” Ofikyɛ né bata ndaen bato berɛ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ wamma AWURADE nyunu wɔ Misepa ne, odi kyɛ beku ye. 6Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ nwuni b’eliɛma mɔ Benyaminfoɛ anwumvoin, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Abusua kure ko de, ɛnɛ wabɔ wɔ Yisrael. 7Bɛbɔ baha ye, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yanya mmraa yamaa bagyigya, wɔ aberɛ bɔ yafa AWURADE yata ndaen kyɛ yɛngɔfa yɛ mma mmrasua ngɔma Benyaminfoɛ agyaa ɔ?”
8Na bebisale kyɛ, “Yisrael mmusua kure ne, aso nu bie wamma AWURADE nyunu wɔ Misepa anaa?” Benwuni kyɛ ebiala wamvi Yabese Gileade wamma dwaabɔlɛ ne bie wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu. 9Ofikyɛ bɛhale mmenia bɔ bayia nu berɛ ne, né Yabese Gileadeniɛ biala nne berɛ bie. 10Yiti maen ne somane koɛhonɛfoɛ apee buru ne nyɔ maa bɛhɔle berɛ, na bɛhyɛle bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa ngrandɛ beehuhu Yabese Gileadefoɛ; mmrasua ne ngwandaa koso boka so. 11Ɛhe yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ: bienzua biala, yeɛ brasua biala bɔ wanwu biaa le ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔku ye.” 12Benyane ndaluwa bɔ bennwuni biaa le ɔ ɛyaa nna wɔ Yabese Gileadefoɛ nu, na bɛfale bɛ bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ wɔ Silo, bɔ ɔwɔ Kanaan aseɛ so.
13Afei Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛfale ngraa bɛɛmane Benyaminfoɛ bɔ baatena Rimon nyɔbotaen ne anwo ne kyɛ, afei de bɛ ne bɛ kɔtena asomdwee nu. 14Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Benyaminfoɛ sale bɛ si bɛwale, na Yabese Gileade mmrasua bɔ Yisraelfoɛ yakyili bɛ maa benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu ne, bɛfale bɛ bɛmane Benyaminfoɛ, nakoso banzo Benyaminfoɛ ti.
15Yisraelfoɛ nwuni Benyaminfoɛ anwumvoin, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ama Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anu atete. 16Yiti Yisrael mbanyi bisale kyɛ, “Benyaminfoɛ ngaa bɔ baha ye, yɛkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yanya mmraa maa bagya, ofikyɛ brasua biala wanga wɔ Benyaminfoɛ nu.” 17Na bebuale kyɛ, “Benyaminfoɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, odi kyɛ benya bɛ bosofoɛ, amaa ɔnate so abusua kure ko boso wannua wɔ Yisrael. 18Nakoso yɛngɔhora yɛngɔfa yɛ mma mmrasua yɛngɔma bɛ agyaa.” Ofikyɛ né Yisraelfoɛ bali moa bata ndaen kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔma Benyaminniɛ braa maa okogya ne, musue to ye.” 19Yiti bɛhane kyɛ, “AWURADE afoɛnoa aluolue ne, bekoli ye wɔ Silo bɔ ɔwɔ Betel sorɔ dɔ ne. Atimbire bɔ ofi Betel kɔ Sɛkem ne, Silo wɔ ye eyia afiteleɛ so, na osa wɔ Lebona ngwaen.” 20Yiti bɛha behyirele Benyaminfoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛtetɛ bobe boo nemɔ anu 21ná ɛ́mɔnea. Sɛ Silo ndaluwa nemɔ fite ba kyɛ bɛbaago b’abilie ne a, ɛ́mɔfi bobe boo nemɔ anu befite. Ɛmɔ anu biala ɔɔbɔ Silo brasua ko abum ɔfa ye yɛ ɔye, ná ɛmɔfa bɛ bɛhɔ Benyamin aseɛ so. 22Na sɛ bɛ baba mɔ anaa b’eliɛma mmienzua mɔ fa ye nwo dwirɛ bato yɛ nyunu a, yɛkɔha yɛkohyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nye bɛ́to yɛ, ná ɛmɔlo bɛ; ofikyɛ nna koɛ nu yeɛ yɛhyele braa yɛmane bɛ nu biala ɔ. Yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔnni fɔ kyɛ ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ mma mmrasua bama bɛ agyaa ɔ.’ ” 23Benyaminfoɛ yɔle sɔ ala. Mmrasua bɔ bego abilie bɔ bɛbobɔle bɛ abum ne, ɔnate so mane bɛ nu biala nyane braa ogyale. Besa bɛhɔle b’aseɛ so, na besa bɛkyekyele bɛ nguro mɔ bɛtenane nu. 24Afei Yisraelfoɛ fili berɛ mmusua kure mmusua kure ne mmusua mmusua, na besili nu bɛhɔle bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ mɔ so.
25 Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛhene biala nne Yisrael, yiti né ebiala yɔ bɔ okuro ɔ.

Title: RUTU BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Rutu nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ sili mmerɛ bɔ né maenbulɛfoɛ yeɛ bebu Yisrael maen ne ɔ. Sona titire ko bɔ ye nwo dwirɛ wɔ nwomaa ne anu ole Yisraelniɛ Naomi. Ɛhɔen piri bie wale Yisrael maen nu. Sɔ Naomi ne, ɔne ohu ne ye mma mmienzua nyɔ betu befili Betlehem bɛhɔle Moabofoɛ aseɛ so. Berɛ yeɛ ohu ne ye mma mmienzua nyɔ nemɔ bewuli ɔ. Ye mma nemɔ ko gyale Moaboniɛ Rutu wɔ Moabo aseɛ so. Rutu ohu wuli ne asi ne, ohyirele ɔdɔ sonongo hyirele ye sia Naomi bɔ ɔte Yisraelniɛ ne. Afei koso onyane gyidie paa wɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ nu. Nziɛ ye bɔ Naomi osa ba Yisrael ne, Rutu bokale ye so ɔne ye bɛwale. Rutu gyale biaa foforɛ wɔ Yisrael fili ohu bɔ owuli n’abusua nu. Ɔnate sɔ agyaa he aso, Rutu boso ama nemɔ bie ole Yisrael hene bɔ odi mu paa Dawide.
Afei koso, Rutu nwomaa ne maa yɛnwu saleɛ bɔ ɔwale amanvraniɛ Rutu so, mmerɛ bɔ onyane gyidie wɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ nu ne.
Nu Dwirɛ
Naomi ne Rutu sa ba Betlehem 1.1-22
Rutu nwu Boase 2.1—3.18
Boase gya Rutu 4.1-22

Title: RUTU 1
Content:
Elimɛlɛke tu kɔtena Moabo aseɛ so
1Mmerɛ bɔ né maenbulɛfoɛ yeɛ bɛla Yisraelfoɛ bɛ noa ne, ɛhɔen piri bie wale maen ne anu. Na biaa bie bɔ ofi Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda ɔ otu ɔɔtenane Moabo aseɛ so. Ɔne ɔye ne ye mma mmienzua nyɔ yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ. 2Biaa ne li Elimɛlɛke, yeɛ ɔye ne koso li Naomi. Ye mma mmienzua nemɔ li Malon ne Kilion. Bɛte Efratefoɛ bɔ befi Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda, na betu bɛɛtenane Moabo aseɛ so. 3Nakoso Naomi ohu Elimɛlɛke wuli, maa ɔhale ye ne ye mma mmienzua nyɔ ne. 4Begyigyale Moabo mmrasua; ko li Ɔpa, yeɛ ko koso li Rutu. Ye si ye, bɛtenane berɛ kɔyɛ afoɛ buru ne, 5Malon ne Kilion bɛ munyɔ koso bewuli. Yiti braa ne mma mmienzua nyɔ ne ne ohu befili ye sa.
Naomi ne Rutu sa kɔ Betlehem
6Naomi tele ye wɔ Moabo aseɛ so kyɛ AWURADE alo ye maen maa banya aleɛ. Yiti ɔne ye sia mmrasua nemɔ besili nu kyɛ befi Moabo aseɛ so besa bɛkɔ ye kuro. 7Ɔne ye sia mmrasua nyɔ nemɔ betuli bɛ bo befili kuro bɔ né bɛte so ne aso, kyɛ besa bɛkɔ Yuda aseɛ so. 8Nakoso Naomi sele ye sia mmrasua nyɔ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ebiala osa ɔhɔ ye maame awuro. AWURADE ɔlo ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ ne me, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bawu ne bɛtenane nyemene so ne. 9Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔma ɛmɔ nu biala onya asetena paa wɔ ɛmɔ ahu mɔ awuro.” Afei ɔtɔle bɛ nu, na besuni hahii. 10Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Daabi, yɛne wɔ kosa kɔhɔ w’abusua nu.” 11Nakoso Naomi sele kyɛ, “Me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔsa, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔ ne me bɛkɔ ɔ? Aso ngɔhora ngosa ngɔwo mmaa mmienzua maa bekogya ɛmɔ anaa? 12Me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔsa bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ manyi madwu ye, bienzua biala ngogya me. Na sɛ manya anyelasoɛ po, ná sɛ ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye ala menya biaa megya mewo mmaa mmienzua po a, 13aso ɛmɔkɔnwondɛ toonn maa bekonyi? Aso ɛmɔngogya biaa? Daabi, me mma mɔ, mali yealɛ matra ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ayakyi me nu amaa manwu amaneɛ.” 14Yeɛ besa besuni hahii. Ɔpa tɔle ye sia brasua Naomi nu ɔne ye belili ngraa, nakoso Rutu de, ɔte matane ye.
15Yeɛ Naomi sele kyɛ, “Nea kyɛ ɛhora Ɔpa wasa ye si wahɔ ye abusua ne ye nyameɛ mɔ dɔ ɔ; di ɛhora ne asi.” 16Nakoso Rutu buale kyɛ,
“Nnɛhyɛ me kyɛ nyakyi wɔ nu ngɔ,
anaakyɛ nyakyi wɔ si lilɛ!
Nekaa bɔ ɛkɔhɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ ngɔhɔ ɔ;
yeɛ nekaa bɔ ɛkɔtena ne, berɛ yeɛ ngɔtena ɔ;
wɔ maen kɔyɛ me maen,
yeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ kɔyɛ me Nyameɛ.
17Nekaa bɔ ekowu ne, berɛ yeɛ ngowu ɔ,
na berɛ yeɛ bekosie me ɔ.
AWURADE ɔne me li ye pasaa
maa ɔbo so,
sana ewue yeɛ ɔkɔtete me ne wɔ y’afia ɔ!”
18Naomi nwuni kyɛ Rutu nye aboro kyɛ ɔne ye bɛkɔhɔ ne, wanga hwee wangyire ye ko.
19Yiti bɛ munyɔ besili nu bɛhɔle beedwuli Betlehem. Na beedwuli Betlehem nen, ɔnate bɛ ti, kurotue ne amukoraa bɔle twi, na mmrasua nemɔ bisale kyɛ, “Yiti Naomi ɛhe?” 20Na Naomi sele bɛ kyɛ,
“Nnɛma ɛmɔfrɛ me Naomi ko,
ɛ́mɔfrɛ me Mara,
ofikyɛ Ɛdangama ama me bra ayɛ weewee.
21Me sa bum yeɛ mva ngɔle ɔ,
nakoso AWURADE amaa masa mawa nzanza;
nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfrɛ me Naomi,
wɔ berɛ bɔ AWURADE ne me ali ye anyeborolɛ so,
ná Ɛdangama amaa asane piri ato me ɔ?”
22Yiti Naomi ne ye sia brasua Moaboniɛ Rutu, bɔ ɔne ye befili Moabo aseɛ so besa bɛwale ne, bɛwale Betlehem mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ́hyɛ ye bo bɛte ayuo ɔ.

Title: RUTU 2
Content:
Rutu nwu Boase
1Né biaa sikaniɛ titire bie wɔ berɛ bɔ oli Boase. Ɔte Naomi ahu Elimɛlɛke ye abusuaniɛ. 2 Ɛlɛho bie, Moaboniɛ Rutu sele Naomi kyɛ, “Maa ngɔ ebie bɔ okonwu me anwumvoin ɔ ye fieso, ná nni ye si mbena ayuo bɔ bate basesa maa waha berɛ ne bie.” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Mma, atee la ase.” 3Yiti Rutu sili nu hɔle. Oolili ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ si sesale bɔ waha ye si ne. Na ɔwale kyɛ eboo bɔ oofitele nu ne, né Elimɛlɛke abusuaniɛ Boase deɛ ɔ. 4Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Boase fili Betlehem wale. Ɔha hyirele ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “AWURADE gyina ɛmɔ si oo.” Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “AWURADE yira wɔ oo.” 5Na Boase bisale ye somvoɛ bɔ ɔnea ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ aso ne kyɛ, “Sɔ taluwa he, ofi awuro beni anu?” 6Yeɛ somvoɛ bɔ ɔnea ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ aso ne buale kyɛ, “Moaboniɛ bɔ ɔne Naomi befili Moabo aseɛ so bɛwale ne, ye ɛne. 7Ɔsrɛle me kyɛ, ‘Maa nni ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ si ná nzesa bɔ basesa bahɔ maa waha berɛ ne bie.’ Na ɔwale ye, wagyina ye gya so fi ngyerɛmɔ maa waadwu bekye, bɔ ollele ye nwome koraa ɔ.”
8Yeɛ Boase sele Rutu kyɛ, “Mma, tie, nnɛfi fie he aso, yeɛ nnɛkɔ foforɛ so kɔsesa ayuo si bɔ bate maa waha berɛ ne bie, na mmom fa wɔ nwo bɔ me ndaluwa nemɔ. 9Ma wɔ nye sra nekaa bɔ bɛte ayuo ne, ná di bɛ si. Mahã mahyire mmerandeɛ nemɔ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛha w’adwene. Sɛ nzuhɔen ku wɔ a, kɔ bua nemɔ anwo dɔ kɔno nzue bɔ mmerandeɛ nemɔ basa ne bie.” 10Yeɛ Rutu kotole aseɛnwo berɛ, ɔfale ye nye butuli berɛ, na obisale Boase kyɛ, “Ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ alo me sɔa ye, bɔ ayɛ me paa sɔaa ye, wɔ aberɛ bɔ nde ɛwɔfoɛ ɔ?” 11Nakoso Boase buale ye kyɛ, “Ofi mmerɛ bɔ ehu wuli ɔ, bɔ ayɔ ama wɔ sia brasua ne amukoraa, babɔ me amaneɛ: kyɛbɔ ɛyakyili wɔ baba ne wɔ maame ne wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ maen berɛ, ná ɛɛtoale mmenia bɔ né ɛnze bɛ ɔ ne. 12Bɔ ayɔ ye, mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔma wɔ ye nwo akatuaa. AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɔ aabɔ wɔ nwo adwaa wɔ ye ndaa bo ne, mesrɛ kyɛ ɔma wɔ akatuaa mmorosoɛ.” 13Yeɛ Rutu sele kyɛ, “Me mene, kɔ so do me sɔ ala, ofikyɛ akyekye me wora. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nna w’afaneɛ nemɔ bie ole me, nakoso ɛne w’afaneɛ adwudwo nyemene so.”
14Adidie mmerɛ sone ne, Boase sele ye kyɛ, “Bra baali aleɛ ye bie, ná fa wɔ paanoo ne bɔ nzaa kekarekekare ye anu bie.” Yiti Rutu tenane ayuotelɛfoɛ nemɔ anwo berɛ, na Boase mane ye ayuo bɔ bahye ne bie. Rutu lili mane ye ko yili maa ebie hale. 15Rutu dwɔsole kyɛ ɔkwaasesa ayuo bɔ bate basesa maa waha berɛ ne bie nen, Boase sele ye mmerandeɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ɔsesa bɔ baboaboa ye noa ne bie, na nnɛma ɛmɔsi ye ate. 16Afei koso, ɛ́mɔte bie begua berɛ bɛ́ma ɔsesa, na nnɛma ɛmɔteatea ye.”
17Yiti Rutu boaboale ayuo ne noa wɔ fie ne aso toonn maa aleɛ dwole. Yeɛ ɔborole bɔ waboaboa ye noa ne, na onyane kɔyɛ olonka buru. 18Rutu soa wale kuro, na ye sia ne nwuni ayuo bɔ waasesa wawa ne. Afei aleɛ bɔ Rutu lili mane ye ko yili ne, ɔfale ye ngaa mane ye sia ne. 19Yeɛ ye sia bisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛnɛ ɛɛsesale ayuo ye? Fie beni aso yeɛ ɛhɔle ɔ? Nyameɛ yira sona bɔ wayɛ wɔ paa sɔaa ye.” Yeɛ Rutu hane sona bɔ ɔhɔle ye fieso adwuma ne nwo dwirɛ hyirele ye sia ne kyɛ, “Biaa bɔ ngɔnyɔle adwuma wɔ ye fieso ne, bɛfrɛ ye Boase.” 20Na Naomi sele ye sia ne kyɛ, “AWURADE bɔ daa ɔdo teasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ne, óyira sɔ sona ne!” Naomi sa sele ye kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa ne, ɔte yɛ abusuaniɛ, yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ nwoniɛ kaenn.” 21Yeɛ Moaboniɛ Rutu hane kyɛ, “Ye po ɔha hyirele me kyɛ, Fa wɔ nwo bɔ m’adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ, kɔpem kyɛ bɛkɔte m’ayuo ne amukoraa bekoyie ɔ.” 22Na Naomi sele ye sia Rutu kyɛ, “Mma, ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔbɔ ye ndaluwa nemɔ ɔ; ebie mbaen fieso de, ebiaa né baha w’adwene.” 23Yiti ɔfale ye nwo bɔle Boase ndaluwa nemɔ, na ɔsesale ayuo alaa kɔpem kyɛ ayuo ne atokoɔ telɛ pɛle nu ɔ. Na Rutu hɔle so ne ye sia bɛtenane.

Title: RUTU 3
Content:
Rutu da Boase nwo berɛ
1Ɛlɛho bie, Rutu sia Naomi sele ye kyɛ, “Mma, aso onhia kyɛ memaa egyina wɔ gya so, amaa ɔnate so wayie wɔ yé? 2Yɛ nwoniɛ Boase wɔ berɛ. Ye yeɛ ɛne ye ndaluwa mɔ bɛyɔ adwuma ne. Tie, ɛnɛ kɔngɔen, okohuhu ayuo so wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛboro ayuo ne. 3Yiti bia ná popa. Wura w’ataadeɛ bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene paa ná kɔ nekaa bɔ bɛboro ayuo ne. Nakoso nnɛye wɔ nwo ali kyire biaa ne kɔpem kyɛ okodidi ná ɔkɔno nzaa koyie ɔ. 4Sɛ ɔda a, nea nekaa bɔ ɔkɔla ne yé. Kɔye ɛtena ne fi ye gya bo ná da berɛ; na ɔkɔha nikyee bɔ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ɔ kohyire wɔ.” 5Na Rutu sele Naomi kyɛ, “Bɔ aha biala, ngɔyɔ.”
6Yiti Rutu hɔle nekaa bɔ bɛboro ayuo ne, na ɔɔyɔle kyɛbɔ ye sia hyirele ye ne ala. 7Boase didili ná ɔnone nzaa yiele bɔ ye nye agye ne, ɔɔlale atokoɔ kure ne anwo. Yeɛ Rutu yɛle kudɛɛ ɔɔyele Boase gya nwo tena ne, na ɔlale berɛ. 8Bebuli aleɛ nu ne, biaa ne bɔle pitiri, na ɔpɛnene ye nye ne, mvum nu, onwuni kyɛ brasua bie la ye gya ngwaen berɛ! 9Obisale kyɛ, “Wɔ nwa ɛne?” Yeɛ obuale ye kyɛ, “Me ɔ, w’afaneɛ Rutu; trɛ wɔ tena ne anu fa kata me nwo, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte koliagyaa ɔ.” 10Na Boase sele ye kyɛ, “Mma, AWURADE yira wɔ. Nahorɛ bɔ ali ye kekesaala ye ne, ɔtra nahorɛ bɔ ali moa ali ama wɔ sia ne. Ofikyɛ angɔanni mmerandeɛ mɔ si: kyɛ ehianiɛ oo, kyɛ sikaniɛ oo. 11Afei, mma, nnɛsuro. Nikyee bɔ ekobisa biala, ngɔyɔ ngɔma wɔ, ofikyɛ kuro wa ama mukoraa se ye kyɛ ɛte brasua bɔ wɔ suban te paa ɔ. 12 Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nde abusuaniɛ kaenn de, nakoso abusuaniɛ foforɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ opingye wɔ sia abusua tra me ɔ. 13Da wa ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye, na aleɛ kye ngyerɛmɔ, ná sɛ ode to nu kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ ehu koliagyaa kogya wɔ a, ye de ye paa nu ɔ. Na sɛ ɔngɔyɛ ehu koliagyaa ngogya wɔ de a, ye de, kyɛ AWURADE te ase ye, me yeɛ ngɔyɛ ehu koliagyaa ngogya wɔ ɔ. Da wa ma aleɛ hye.”
14Yiti Rutu lale ye gya ngwaen berɛ maa aleɛ hyene, nakoso odwɔsole mmerɛ bɔ né maen nu onnya ɔttetele ɔ, ofikyɛ Boase nyane adwene kyɛ, “Onni kyɛ ebiala nwu ye kyɛ braa ne wale nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ne.” 15Boase sele ye kyɛ, “W’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ bɔ owura wɔ ne, trɛ nu.” Yiti ɔtrɛle nu, na Boase pɛle ayuo olonka nzia, na ɔfa soale Rutu. Na afei Boase sili nu hɔle kuro ne anu dɔ. 16Rutu wale ye sia berɛ, na ye sia bisale ye kyɛ, “Ɔhɔle sɛɛ, mma?” Na Rutu fale bɔ biaa ne ayɔ ama ye ne amukoraati bɔle ye amaneɛ 17kyɛ, “Ye yeɛ ɔmane me ayuo olonka nzia he ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnwa: ‘Nnɛfa nzanza sa kɔ wɔ sia dɔ.’ ” 18Yeɛ Naomi buale kyɛ, “Mma, nya aboterɛ ná nea bɔ okofi edwirɛ ne anu kɔwa ɔ, ofikyɛ biaa ne ngɔhora tena, sana wabɔ edwirɛ ne porɛ ɛnɛ.”

Title: RUTU 4
Content:
Boase gya Rutu
1Boase hɔle kuro berɛ pambim ne anwo ɔɔtenane ase. Wangyɛ yeɛ busuaniɛ bɔ Boase hane ye dwirɛ ne koso ɔɔpɛle nu berɛ ɔ. Na Boase frɛle ye kyɛ, “Nniɛma, bra wa baatena ase.” Na opingyele ye ɔɔtenane ase. 2Yeɛ Boase frɛle kuro berɛ mbanyi nemɔ anu buru, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtena wa.” Na bɛtenatenane berɛ. 3Afei osele busuaniɛ ne kyɛ, “Naomi bɔ wafi Moabo aseɛ so wawa ne, ɔbaatɔne yɛ abusuaniɛ Elimɛlɛke ye aseɛ. 4Yiti mayɛ kyɛ meye w’asotire kyɛ, pɔ aseɛ ne wɔ mbanyi bɔ bayia wa ye, ɔne me maen mbanyi ye mɔ bɛ nyunu. Sɛ ɛkɔpɔ aseɛ ne a, pɔ ye; nakoso sɛ ɛngɔpɔ ye de a, ka kyire me maa nwu ye, ofikyɛ sona biala nne berɛ bɔ osã wɔ nwo ɔpɔ aseɛ ne a ɔyɛ yé ɔ. Sɛ ambɔ aseɛ ne a, yeɛ mekora mepɔ ye ɔ.” Na obuale kyɛ, “Ngɔpɔ aseɛ ne.” 5Yeɛ Boase toale so hane kyɛ, “Kyẽa bɔ ɛkɔpɔ sɔ aseɛ ne wɔ Naomi sa nu ne, ye de Moaboniɛ Rutu, bɔ ɔte biaa bɔ wawu ne kunaniɛ ne, odi kyɛ egya ye, amaa ɔnate so biaa bɔ wawu ne, ye dumaa ahɔ so wala ye agyapadeɛ so.” 6Yeɛ abusuaniɛ ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔhane kyɛ, “Sɛ mepɔ agyapadeɛ ye mefa a, me mma kɔhwere me bɔbɔ deinn m’agyapadeɛ deɛ. Agyapadeɛ bɔ ahaa me yeɛ odi kyɛ mepɔ ne, kɔpɔ fa, ofikyɛ mengɔhora ngɔpɔ ye.”
7 Daa ne, Yisrael maen nu, agyapadeɛ pɔlɛ ne ye tɔnenɛ nwo amammerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ berɛ hɔ ɛhe: bɔ bɛfa bɛta edwirɛ ne abo ole kyɛ, sona bɔ ɔtɔne ye, ɔne sona bɔ ɔtɔ ne, ebiala ɔye ye mbaboa ko ma obiɛngo. Ɛhe yeɛ né bɛfa bedi edwirɛ nwo adanzeɛ wɔ Yisrael ɔ. 8Yiti mmerɛ bɔ abusuaniɛ ne sele Boase kyɛ, “Pɔ agyapadeɛ ne fa” ne, ɔyele ye mbaboa ko. 9Yeɛ Boase sele mbanyi nemɔ ne mmenia nemɔ amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ ɛmɔdi adanzeɛ, kyɛ Elimɛlɛke, Kilion ne Malon b’agyapadeɛ biala, mapɔ mafi Naomi sa nu. 10 Afei koso, Moaboniɛ Rutu, bɔ né ɔte Malon aye ne, magya ye, amaa ɔnate so sona bɔ wawu ne, ye dumaa ahɔ so wala ye agyapadeɛ so; amaa ɔnate so sona bɔ wawu ne, ye dumaa angyikyi wamvi ye abusua ɔne ye kuro nu. Ɛnɛ, ɛmɔte m’adanzefoɛ.” 11 Yeɛ mmenia bɔ né baayia pambim ne anu berɛ ne amukoraa, bɛ ne mbanyi nemɔ bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛdi adanzeɛ. Braa ye bɔ ɛkwaagya ye ba w’awuro ne, AWURADE ma ɔyɛ kyɛ Rahɛl ne Lea, bɔ bɛ munyɔ yeɛ besuli Yisrael awuro ama nen. AWURADE ma wɔ boso trɛ wɔ Efrata, ná ɛyɛ sona titire wɔ Betlehem. 12 Na ngwadaa bɔ AWURADE kɔfa taluwa he aso ma wɔ sa kɔha bɛ ne, yɛsrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔfa bɛ so ma w’awuro ama bɛyɛ kyɛ Yuda ne Tamar bɛ wa Pɛrɛse ye awuro ama.”
Dawide nana mɔ
13Yiti Boase gyale Rutu maa ɔɔyɛle ɔye, na ɔne ye bɛlale. Na AWURADE mane Rutu nwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa bienzua. 14Yeɛ mmrasua nemɔ sele Naomi kyɛ, “Animnyam hã AWURADE bɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye wamaa anya koliagyaa wɔ w’awuro ɔ. AWURADE ɔma ɔyɛ sona titire wɔ Yisrael! 15Ɔkɔmaa ekonya wɔ boso ama, ná wama wɔ wɔ noa aleɛ wɔ wɔ nworowaa nu. Ofikyɛ wɔ sia bɔ okuro wɔ dwirɛ, bɔ yeɛ ɔtra mmaa mmienzua nzoo ma wɔ ne, ye yeɛ ɔwole ye ɔ.” 16Yeɛ Naomi mane akwadaa ne aso fale ye bɔle ye hue so, na ɔyɛle akwadaa ne neafoɛ. 17Mandamu berɛ mmrasua nemɔ tole akwadaa ne dumaa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Bawo baa bienzua bama Naomi.” Bɛtole ye dumaa Obɛde; na ye yeɛ ɔwole Yese, bɔ yeɛ ɔte Dawide baba ne.
18Pɛrɛse boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Pɛrɛse wole Hesron; 19Hesron wole Ram; Ram wole Aminadabo; 20Aminadabo wole Nason; Nason wole Salmon; 21Salmon wole Boase; Boase wole Obɛde; 22Obɛde wole Yese, yeɛ Yese wole Dawide.

Title: 1 SAMUEL BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Samuel Nwomaa Bɔ Oli Moa ne, ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ Yisraelfoɛ sesane fili maenbulɛfoɛ amamuo nu bɛhɔle ahemvo amamuo nu ɔ. Sɔ nzesãleɛ he, Yisrael mmenia titire nza yeɛ bɛbɔ bɛ dumaa paa wɔ nu ɔ. Bɛ ole Samuel bɔ yeɛ ɔte maenbulɛniɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo, Sɔɔlo bɔ ɔte Yisrael hene bɔ oli moa, yeɛ afei Dawide. Nningyein ahoroɔ bɔ Dawide yɔle koraka yeɛ ɔbaali Yisrael so hene ne, bahyerɛ baboka Samuel ne Sɔɔlo bɛ koso bɛ nningyein bɔ bɛyɔle ne aso, wɔ sɔ nwomaa he anu. Apam daa ne, edwirɛ titire bie wɔ nu bɔ ɔwɔ Samuel Nwomaa bɔ oli moa ne anu ɔ. Ye ole kyɛ, sɛ yɛyɛ sotie yɛma AWURADE dwirɛ nahorɛ nu a, ɔboka yɛ maa yɛdi ngonim. Nakoso sɛ yɛyɛ AWURADE dwirɛ nwo asoserɛ a, musue piri yeɛ ɔto yɛ ɔ. Na ɛhe maa yɛkaye bɔ AWURADE nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Samuel so ha hyirele Nana Sɔɔlo wɔ 1 Samuel 15.22 kyɛ, “Aso AWURADE nye gye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛ mɔ nwo tra kyɛ ekotie AWURADE dwirɛ ɔ? Nahorɛ nu, sotie te paa tra afɔleɛbɔlɛ, yeɛ asoɛ mmerɛlɛyɛlɛ te paa tra boaen nyii loe.”
Samuel Nwomaa Bɔ Oli Moa ne, osa maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ, nna mmenia ne amukoraa yeɛ né bɛpene so kyɛ Yisrael maen ne ɔsesã kɔ ahemvo amamuo nu ɔ. Ahaa né AWURADE bɔbɔ deinn yeɛ ɔte Yisrael hene ɔ. Nakoso bɛhane kyɛ bɛpena ɛhene ne, AWURADE yele ɛhene mane bɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Yisrael maenbulɛniɛ Samuel 1.1—7.17
Bɛyele Sɔɔlo kyɛ oli Yisrael hene 8.1—10.27
Sɔɔlo ahennie afoɛ mɔ bɔ beli moa ɔ 11.1—15.35
Dawide ne Sɔɔlo 16.1—30.31
Sɔɔlo ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ wue 31.1-13

Title: 1 SAMUEL 1
Content:
Hana ne ohu Ɛlkana
1Né biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ɛlkana. Ofi Ramatim Sofim bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso. Ɔse ole Yeroham bɔ ɔse ole Elihu bɔ ɔse ole Tohu bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Efraimniɛ Sufe ne. 2Né ɔye mɔ nyɔ. Ko li Hana, yeɛ ko wora li Penina. Né Penina le mmaa, nakoso Hana de, né olle ba.
3Afoɛ biala, né Ɛlkana fi ye kuro kɔ Silo kɔsɔne Asafo AWURADE ná ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ma ye wɔ berɛ. Hofini ne Finehase bɔ bɛte Eli mma mmienzua nyɔ ne, né bɛte AWURADE asɔfo wɔ Silo. 4Sɔ kyẽa ne dwu ná Ɛlkana bɔ afɔleɛ a, né ɔyɛ a ɔma ɔye Penina ne ye mma mmienzua ne mmrasua ne amukoraa afɔleɛ nningyein ne bie; 5nakoso Hana de, ɔma ye afɔleɛ nningyein ne mmɔhoɛ nyɔ, ofikyɛ né ɔte ye yɛyerɛ braa, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né AWURADE amaa wayɛ mmotaen. 6Né Hana ɔhora taa ka ye anyinga paa ma ye wora bɔ, ofikyɛ né AWURADE amaa wayɛ mmotaen. 7Sɔ dwirɛ ne hɔle so afoɛnoa biala; na mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛkɔhɔ AWURADE awuro ne, ɔyɛ a Penina ka ye anyinga. Yiti ɔyɛ a Hana sũ, na onnidi. 8Na ohu Ɛlkana bisale ye kyɛ, “Hana, na esuɛ ye ɛ? Nzu ati yeɛ engodidi ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ ye? Aso mendra ngwadaa mmienzua buru memma wɔ?”
Nyameɛ tie Hana mbaeɛ
9Bedidili bɛnone beyiele wɔ Silo nen, Hana dwɔsole [ɔɔfale ye mbaeɛ tole AWURADE nyunu]. Né ɔsɔfo Eli te bia so wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nu berɛ. 10Né Hana wora abɔ paa, na ole esuɛ hahii fale ye mbaeɛ tole AWURADE nyunu. 11Na Hana hyɛle bɔ kyɛ, “O Asafo AWURADE, sɛ ahaa ɛkɔpɛ wɔ nye kɔnea w’afaneɛ aworabɔlɛ, ná ɛkɔkaye me, ná amma wɔ wora amvi w’afaneɛ, ná mmom ɛma w’afaneɛ baa bienzua a, ye de ngɔfa ye ngɔma wɔ AWURADE mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔte ase ɔ; na dɛmaa biala ngɔtɔ ye ti so.”
12Na Hana gu so ɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyire AWURADE nen, Eli neane ye noa haa. 13Né Hana bɔ mbaeɛ wɔ ye ti anu. Né ɔbesebese ye noa, nakoso edwirɛ bɔ ɔka de, ebiala ande. Na ɛhe mane Eli susuli kyɛ wano nzaa wabo. 14Yiti Eli sele ye kyɛ, “Kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛkɔno nzaa kɔbo maa okoodwu ɔ? Yakyi wɔ nzaanonɛ ne! 15Nakoso Hana buale kyɛ, “Nna sɔ ɔ, me mene, nde brasua bɔ me wora abɔ paa ɔ. Nnnone bobe nzaa anaa nzaa serɛ biala, na mmom m’aworabɔlɛ dwirɛ yeɛ méfa méto AWURADE nyunu ɔ. 16Nnɛbu w’afaneɛ kyɛ nde brasua sanzaniɛ bie, ofikyɛ edwirɛ yealɛ ne aworabɔlɛ bɔ wato me yeɛ mabɔ ye nwo mbaeɛ maa waadwu bekye ye.” 17Yeɛ Eli sele kyɛ, “Fa asomdwee kɔ, na abisadeɛ bɔ afa ato Yisrael Nyameɛ nyunu ne, mesrɛ kyɛ ɔ́yɔ ma wɔ.” 18Na Hana sele kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, w’adaworoma, do w’afaneɛ sɔ ala.” Afei Hana fili berɛ hɔle, odidili, na aworabɔlɛ andira ye ko.
Samuel aworɛ
19Aleɛ hyene ne, bedwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu bɛsɔnene AWURADE, na afei besa bɛhɔle bɛ kuro Rama. Ɛlkana ne ɔye Hana bɛlale, na AWURADE kayele Hana. 20Hana nwonzɛle, na mmerɛ ne sone ne, ɔwole baa bienzua, na ɔtole ye dumaa Samuel, ofikyɛ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nzrɛle ye mvili AWURADE berɛ.”
21Ɛlkana ne ye awuro ama mukoraati bɛhɔle Silo kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ afoɛnoa afɔleɛ ne ma AWURADE ná otua ye aboadeɛ. 22Nakoso Hana de wangɔ bie, na ɔha hyirele ohu kyɛ, “Sɛ akwadaa ne pɛ nyɔfone a, ngɔfa ye ngɔɔma AWURADE, na ɔkɔtena dɔ mmerɛ biala.” 23Na ohu Ɛlkana buale ye kyɛ, “Bɔ asusu ye nwo ne, yɔ sɔ ala. Nwondɛ maa oodwu mmerɛ bɔ ɛkɔpɛ ye nyɔfone koraka; na mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɔ́bra nu.” Yiti Hana tenane awuro mane ɔwa ne nyɔfone kɔpem kyɛ ɔpɛle ye nyɔfone ɔ. 24Ɔpɛle akwadaa ne nyɔfone nen, ɔne ye bɛhɔle AWURADE awuro wɔ Silo, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né akwadaa ne onnyini. Ɔfale ɛhemɔ koso bokale so: nandwie nyii bɔ wali afoɛ nza ɔ, esam graa ko, yeɛ bobe nzaa kɔndoa ko. 25Afei behuni nandwie nyii ne, na bɛfale akwadaa ne bɛbrɛle Eli. 26Na Hana sele kyɛ, “Me mene, w’adaworoma, me ole braa bɔ ogyinane wɔ nwo wa bɔle mbaeɛ hyirele AWURADE ne. 27Akwadaa he yeɛ mmɔle mbaeɛ nzrɛle ne, na AWURADE ayɔ m’abisadeɛ bɔ mva ndole ye nyunu ne wama me. 28Yiti me koso, mafa ye mahyɛ AWURADE. Na mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔte ase ne, mafa ye mama AWURADE.” Na bɛsɔnene AWURADE wɔ berɛ.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 2
Content:
Hana ye Nyameɛ ayɛ
1 Afei Hana bɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ,
“Me wora akyekye wɔ AWURADE nu;
AWURADE nu yeɛ m’anwoserɛ wɔ ɔ.
Mesere me pɔfoɛ mɔ,
me nye gye, ofikyɛ ali ngonim ama me.
2Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte krongron kyɛ AWURADE ɔ,
amba, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ;
Nyɔbotaen biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ.
3Nnɛma ɛmɔka nduhoɛ dwirɛ mbiri mbiri ko,
nnɛmɔma anwomasoɛ dwirɛ fi ɛmɔ noa nu ba;
ofikyɛ AWURADE te Nyameɛ bɔ onwu nikyee biala ɔ,
na ye yeɛ obua ebiala yɔleɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ.
4Wama anwoserɛfoɛ agyaen mɔ nu abubu,
nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ne de, ɔmaa benya anwoserɛ.
5Bɛ bɔ né bɛ ko ayi ne, afei de bekoli paa koraka né banya aleɛ bali,
nakoso bɛ bɔ né ɛhɔen apɛ bɛ ne, afei de aleɛ abu bɛ so.
Mmotaen braa wawo nzoo,
nakoso braa bɔ ye mma pee ne, afei de waha ye ngome.
6 AWURADE yeɛ oku, ná osa ma ngoa ɔ;
ye yeɛ ɔmaa bɛkɔ ɛborɔ, ná osa maa bedwɔso befi dɔ bɛba ɔ.
7AWURADE yeɛ ɔma ebie di hiaa, ná osa ma ebie nya ye nwo ɔ;
ye yeɛ ɔbrɛ sona ase, ná osa pagya sona ɔ.
8 Ɔma ehianiɛ so fi asefuo nu,
na ɔma sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ so fi fofoɛ so,
maa ɔtena atitirefoɛ nu,
na ɔmaa onya animnyam bia tena so.
Ofikyɛ aseɛ nyinasoɛ nemɔ, AWURADE deɛ ɔ,
na nyinasoɛ nemɔ so yeɛ wafa ewiase wasie ɔ.
9 Ɔbɔ ye anwoteefoɛ nwo waen wɔ atee biala so,
nakoso amumuyɛɛfoɛ de, bewuwu aworabɔlɛ wue;
ofikyɛ nna anwoserɛ yeɛ sona fa di ngonim ɔ.
10Okoyie AWURADE pɔfoɛ mɔ pasapasa,
Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ kɔbɔ nu kurudududu kofi nyameɛso kogua bɛ so,
AWURADE kobua aseɛ so amukoraa ndɛen,
ɔkɔma ye hene ne anwoserɛ,
na ɔkɔma bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne konya tumi.”
11Afei Ɛlkana hɔle ye kuro Rama, nakoso akwadaa ne de, ɔhale ɔsɔfo Eli berɛ yɔle AWURADE adwuma.
Eli mma mmienzua nemɔ
12Eli mma nemɔ, né bɛte busuefoɛ mmenia. Né bɛmva AWURADE bɛnyɛ huu; 13asɔfo asɛdeɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɛma maen ne koso, né bɛtoto ye ase. Sɛ ebie ba bɔ afɔleɛ, ná naen ne gyi see so a, ɔyɛ a somvoɛ bɔ ɔso ɔsɔfo ne, ɔfa ateɛ anoa tworɔntworɔn bie tira ba, 14na ɔfa wura turonzemaa anaa dadesɛn anaa bua anaa kukue ne anu. Na naen biala bɔ ateɛ anoa tworɔntworɔn ne kɔye kɔwa ne, ɔsɔfo ne fa. Sɔ yeɛ né bɛfa bɛyɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛba Silo ɔ. 15Asa koso, anzana bɛkɔyera naen loe nen, ɔyɛ a somvoɛ bɔ ɔso ɔsɔfo ne bakã kyire sona bɔ ɔ́bɔ afɔleɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɔsɔfo ngole wɔ naen bɔ ato ne, naen monɛ yeɛ okole ɔ; yiti ma me naen monɛ ne bie ma ngɔma ye ma ɔtoto.” 16Na sɛ sona ne bua ye kyɛ, “Maa bɛyera ɛloe ne koraka né afa bɔ ekuro ɔ” a, ye koso obua kyɛ, “Daabi, fa ma me kekesaala ye. Anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔfa ye anyeborolɛ so!” 17Yiti mmerandeɛ nemɔ bɔne yɛle piri wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ bamva anidie bamma AWURADE afɔleɛ nemɔ.
Samuel wɔ Silo
18Né Samuel de, ɔte akwadaa bɔ ɔso AWURADE ɔ. Né owura ɔsɔfo somvoɛ ataadeɛ bɔ ɔte nwera ɔ. 19Né ɔyɛ a, ye maame nwo ngwalaa ataadeɛ bie ma ye afoɛ biala. Sɛ ɔne ohu bɛkwaabɔ afoɛnoa afoɛnoa afɔleɛ ne wɔ Silo a, yeɛ né ɔfa kɔma ye ɔ. 20Na ɔyɛ a Eli yira Ɛlkana ne ɔye kyɛ, “Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔfa braa he aso ma enya mmaa bɔ bekosi bɔ wafa wahyɛ AWURADE ne gya nu ɔ.” Na ɛhe asi ne, besa bɛkɔ bɛ kuro. 21AWURADE lole Hana, ɔnwonzɛle, na osa wole mmienzua nza ne mmrasua nyɔ. Na akwadaa Samuel nyini wɔ AWURADE solɛ adwuma ne anu.
Eli bɔ ye mma nemɔ kɔkɔ
22Afei né Eli ayɛ panyi paa. Na ɔtele nikyee biala bɔ ye mma nemɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ Yisrael amukoraa ne. Osa tele kyɛ bɛ ne mmrasua bɔ bɛso wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu anoa nu berɛ ne bɛda. 23Na osele ye mma nemɔ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ sɔ bra ye? Ɛmɔ brabɔne bɔ ɛmɔbɔ ne, mete mefi mmenia ne amukoraa berɛ. 24Daabi, me mma, ɛ́mɔyakyi! Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE mmenia bɛkeka maa mete ne, ɔtte mayee. 25Sɛ ebie yɔ bɔne tia obiɛngo a, ebie kɔpa kyerɛ kɔma ye wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, nakoso sɛ ebie yɔ bɔne tia Nyameɛ a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpa kyerɛ kɔma ye ɔ?” Nakoso bandie bɛ se dwirɛ, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ayɛ kyɛ okohu bɛ. 26 Abɛɛmaa Samuel hɔle so nyini, na ɔsɔle AWURADE ne kuro sona nye.
Eli abusua nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛ
27Nyameɛ sona bie wale Eli berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Mmerɛ bɔ né wɔ nana mɔ bɛte ngoaa bewura Faro bo wɔ Misraim ne, aso manye me nwo ali mangyire wɔ nana mɔ? 28 Nneaneane nu nyele ye mvili Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa nu kyɛ ɔɔyɛ ɔsɔfo ma me, kyɛ ɔhɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea nwo, ɔ́yera ɛyɛɛ, ná ówura ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ógyina me nyunu. Na see so afɔleɛ mukoraa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛbɔ bɛma me ne, mva nwurale wɔ nana abusua ne sa. 29M’afɔleɛ ne m’afɔleɛ nningyein bɔ mahyɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ ye wɔ m’atenaleɛ ne anu ne, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbu ye animtia ɔ. Nzu ati yeɛ ebu wɔ mma mɔ tra me ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔfẽ me maen Yisrael b’afɔleɛ ne anu paa bedi bɛdɔ ɔ?’ 30Yiti AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Nhyɛle bɔ kyɛ w’abusua ne wɔ nana abusua bekoli sɔfo bɛkɔso me daa.’ Nakoso kekesaala ye de, AWURADE nwa: ‘Mengɔma sɔ dwirɛ ne ngɔyɛ adwuma! Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bedi me ni ne, me koso ngoli bɛ ni, yeɛ bɛ bɔ betiatia me nyunu ne, me koso mengɔfa bɛ ngɔyɛ huu. 31Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ ngole wɔ sa nu tumi, ɔne wɔ nana abusua sa nu tumi, na ɔnate so w’awuro ama nu kobu gyeingyein bɔ ebiala ngonyi ngɔyɛ aworowaa ɔ. 32Ekonwu kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ kɔmaa okoyie Yisrael yé ne amukoraa, na ɔkɔyɛ wɔ anyeboro; na w’awuro ama nu kobu gyeingyein bɔ ebiala ngonyi ngɔyɛ aworowaa ɔ. 33Nakoso wɔ bosoniɛ ko nya ye ti didi nu po, na memaa ɔyɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea nwo adwuma po a, okosũ alaa kɔma ye wora kɔbɔ. Na w’awuro ama mukoraa kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa. 34 Na bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ mma nyɔ Hofini ne Finehase ne de, ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma wɔ: bɛ munyɔ bekowu ɛlɛho. 35Me de, ngɔtete ɔsɔfo nahorɛniɛ ko ngɔma me bɔbɔ me nwo, na ye yeɛ okoli m’ahone nu dwirɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ so ɔ. Ngɔma ye bosofoɛ koli sɔfo kɔhyɛ, na okoli sɔfo afebɔɔ kɔso sona bɔ mapopa ye ngoo ne. 36Na wɔ bosoniɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔha ne, ɔkɔhɔ ɔsɔfo ne berɛ kɔɔkoto kɔsrɛ ye sikaa ne aleɛ, na ɔkɔha kyɛ, Mesrɛ wɔ ala, fa ɔsɔfo adwuma ne ko maa nyɔ, ná nya aleɛ kãa nni.’ ”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 3
Content:
AWURADE ye ye nwo ali kyire Samuel
1 Né abɛɛmaa Samuel wura Eli ndeteyɛɛ bo yeɛ ɔso AWURADE ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né AWURADE dwirɛ nwo yɛ nna paa; yeɛ né mmenia koso bɛndaa bennwu nyekyire.
2Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Eli nye ahyɛ ye bo wayɛ wusiwusi bɔ onnwu nikyee yé ɔ, na né ɔla ye sua nu. 3Né Nyameɛ kanea ne onnya nnuane. Né Samuel la AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, wɔ nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ alaka ne gyi ne. 4Na AWURADE frɛle Samuel kyɛ, “Samuel! Samuel!” Na osurole kyɛ, “Me ɛhe.” 5Na ole amirika hɔle Eli berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Ɛfrɛle me, me ɛhe.” Nakoso Eli buale kyɛ, “Mmvrɛle wɔ, sa kɔla.” Yiti osa ɔɔlale. 6Na AWURADE sa frɛle Samuel kyɛ, “Samuel!” Na Samuel dwɔsole hɔle Eli berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Ɛfrɛle me, me ɛhe.” Nakoso Eli buale kyɛ, “Mma, mmvrɛle wɔ, sa kɔla.” 7Né AWURADE onnya ɔyyele ye nwo ali ohhyirele Samuel, yeɛ né onnya ɔttele AWURADE noa dwudwolɛ. 8AWURADE sa frɛle Samuel ye pɛen nza so. Na odwɔsole hɔle Eli berɛ ɔɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛfrɛle me, me ɛhe.” Na Eli nwuni kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔ́frɛ abɛɛmaa ne ɔ. 9Yiti Eli sele Samuel kyɛ, “Kɔ ná kɔla, na sɛ ɔfrɛ wɔ a, ka kyɛ, ‘AWURADE, dwudwo, na wɔ somvoɛ ótie.’ ” Na Samuel hɔle ɔɔlale nekaa bɔ né ɔla ne.
10AWURADE wale oogyinane berɛ. Na kyɛbɔ olili moa yɔle ne ala, ɔfrɛle kyɛ, “Samuel! Samuel!” Yeɛ Samuel surole kyɛ, “Dwudwo, na wɔ somvoɛ ótie.” 11Na AWURADE sele Samuel kyɛ, “Tie, mebaayɔ nikyee bie wɔ Yisrael, na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte sɔ dwirɛ nen, ye kunu kɔte ye. 12Sɔ kyẽa ne, edwirɛ biala bɔ mahã kyɛ ɔkɔto Eli abusua nen, ngɔmaa okosi fite ye bo koodwu ye ayieleɛ. 13 Mahã mahyire ye kyɛ mebaatua ye abusua so kerɛ afebɔɔ, ɔnate amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔse ne ati; ofikyɛ ye mma nemɔ yɔle nningyein bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, wanyɔ bɛ huu. 14Na ɔnate sɔ ati, meta Eli abusua nwo ndaen kyɛ, kaka afɔleɛ anaa aleɛ afɔleɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔhora kɔpata kɔma Eli abusua amumuyɛɛ ɔ le.”
15Samuel lale mane aleɛ hyene ngyerɛmɔ; na afei obukyebukyele AWURADE awuro berɛ anoa nemɔ. Né Samuel suro kyɛ ɔkɔha nyekyire ne kohyire Eli ɔ. 16Nakoso Eli frɛle Samuel kyɛ, “Mma Samuel.” Na osurole kyɛ, “Me ɛhe.” 17Na Eli bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɔha hyirele wɔ ne? Nnɛfa fea me. Edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔha hyirele wɔ ne, sɛ ɛfa nu bie fea me a, Nyameɛ tua wɔ kerɛ maa ɔbo so!” 18Yiti Samuel fale ye mukoraa nwo amaneɛ bɔle Eli, na wamva bie wamvea ye. Na Eli sele kyɛ, “Ye yeɛ ɔte AWURADE ɔ, maa ɔyɔ bɔ okuro ɔ.”
19Na Samuel de onyi ne, AWURADE gyinane ye si, na edwirɛ biala bɔ Samuel hane ne, AWURADE maa ɔwale nu. 20Na Yisrael amukoraati, fite Dan bɔ ɔkwaadwu Beɛ Hyeba, benwuni kyɛ Samuel te AWURADE ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ amba. 21AWURADE hɔle so yele ye nwo ali wɔ Silo, ofikyɛ AWURADE nate ye bɔbɔ ye dwirɛ so yele ye nwo ali hyirele Samuel wɔ Silo.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 4
Content:
Filistifoɛ di Yisrael so ngonim
1Samuel noa dwirɛ dwuli Yisrael amukoraati. Filistifoɛ boaboale bɛ noa kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtoa Yisrael. Na Yisraelfoɛ tuli bi bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛ ne Filistifoɛ bɛkwaaho. Bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Ebenesa, yeɛ Filistifoɛ koso kyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Afeke. 2Filistifoɛ beegyinagyinane koɛ noa, na bɛwale Yisrael so. Koɛ ne anu yɛle se, na Filistifoɛ lili Yisrael so ngonim. Behuhuni Yisraelfoɛ mmienzua kɔyɛ apee nna wɔ koɛ ne anu. 3Na mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ sa wale b’asikyeleɛ ne anu ne, bɛ mbanyi mɔ bisale kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE amaa ɛnɛ yali ngoguo wɔ Filistifoɛ nyunu ye? Ɛ́mɔma yɛɛfa AWURADE apam alaka ne yɛfi Silo yɛbra, ná ɔɔtena yɛ nu ole yɛ fi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu.” 4 Yiti maen ne tuli mmenia maa bɛhɔle Silo, na Asafo AWURADE bɔ ɔte kɛrubim nemɔ b’afia ne, bɛɛfale ye apam alaka ne befili dɔ bɛwale. Hofini ne Finehase bɔ bɛte Eli mma nyɔ ne, né bɛwɔ Nyameɛ apam alaka ne anwo.
5Na mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE apam alaka ne dwuli asikyeleɛ ne anu ne, Yisrael amukoraa bɔle ese mane aseɛ wosole. 6Filistifoɛ tele esebɔlɛ nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Esebɔlɛ bɔ ɔ́kɔ so wɔ Hebrifoɛ asikyeleɛ ye anu ye, ye bo ole sɛɛ?” Na Filistifoɛ tele kyɛ AWURADE alaka ne waadwu asikyeleɛ ne anu ne, 7ɛserɛ hane bɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Nyameɛ bie awa b’asikyeleɛ ne anu.” Na besa bɛbɔle awuye kyɛ, “Yawu oo, yawu oo! Edwirɛ sɔa de, yɛnnwuni bie le. 8“Yawu oo, yawu oo! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole yɛ kofi nyameɛ tumifoɛ hemɔ bɛ sa nu ɔ? Nyameɛ hemɔ yeɛ bɛpraprale amaneɛ ahoroɔ beguale Misraimfoɛ so wɔ ɛserɛ so ne. 9Filistifoɛ, ɛ́mɔma yɛ ahone yɛ se, ná yɛhyire kyɛ yɛte mmienzua, ná yanyɛ Hebrifoɛ nganga, kyɛbɔ bɛte yɛ nganga ye. Ɛ́mɔma yɛhyire kyɛ yɛte mmienzua ná yɛho.”
10Yiti Filistifoɛ hone koɛ ne. Yisrael lili ngoguo, na koɛhonɛniɛ biala nwati hɔle ye tena sua nu. Mmenia pee totɔle, ofikyɛ Yisrael koɛhonɛniɛ apee aburasa bɔ bɛnate ase yeɛ bɛtotɔle ɔ. 11Filistifoɛ lele Yisrael sa nu Nyameɛ alaka ne, na Hofini ne Finehase bɔ bɛte Eli mma nyɔ ne koso bɛtotɔle.
Eli wue
12Benyaminniɛ bie tuli amirika fili koɛ ne noa wale Silo sɔ kyẽa ne ala. Né wasunzua ye ndaadeɛ nu, yeɛ né wafa nnɛterɛ koso wagua ye ti so. 13Mmerɛ bɔ oodwuli ne, né Eli te ye bia nu wɔ atee noa ɔnea ate, ofikyɛ né ye kunu tete ye ma Nyameɛ apam alaka ne. Biaa ne wale kuro ne anu ɔɔbɔle amaneɛ, na kurotue ne amu sɔle awuyebɔlɛ nu. 14Na Eli tele awuyebɔlɛ nen, obisale kyɛ, “Awuyebɔlɛ ye, ye bo ole sɛɛ?” Na biaa ne wale Eli nwo berɛ ndɛndɛ ɔɔbɔle ye amaneɛ. 15 Né Eli ali afoɛ aburahona ne mmɔtwɛ, yeɛ né ye nye so ayɛ ye musinamusina bɔ onnwu nikyee ɔ. 16Biaa ne sele Eli kyɛ, “Me yeɛ mafi koɛ noa mawa ne. Ɛnɛ ala yeɛ nwati mvili koɛ ne anu mmale ɔ.” Na Eli bisale ye kyɛ, “Mma, koɛ ne oosili sɛɛ?” 17Na bɔfoɛ ne buale kyɛ, “Yisrael anwati afi Filistifoɛ nyunu, ɛlɔen ne koso bɛ nu pee atotɔ, Hofini ne Finehase bɔ bɛte wɔ mma nyɔ ne koso bawu, yeɛ Nyameɛ apam alaka ne koso bale bafi Yisrael sa nu bahɔ.” 18Na ɔbɔle Nyameɛ apam alaka ne dumaa pɛ, Eli fili ye bia ne anu muni fale ye si ɔɔtɔle pambim ne anwo, ye kɔme anu buli, na owuli, ofikyɛ né wayɛ aworowaa, yeɛ afei né wayɛ piri paa. Né wabu Yisrael maen ne afoɛ aburanna.
Finehase aye ne wue
19Eli sia, bɔ ɔte Finehase aye ne, né ɔnwonzɛ bɔ waha kãa maa ɔwo ɔ. Mmerɛ bɔ ɔtele kyɛ bale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bahɔ, ɔne kyɛ ye sia ne ohu koso bawu ne, ye ko hale ye mbendene so, na ɔkotole berɛ wole. 20 Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔpena ka nu ne, mmrasua bɔ belele ye aworɛ ne sele ye kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ awo bienzua.” Nakoso wandɛ bɛ so, yeɛ wandie bɛ. 21Ɔtole akwadaa ne dumaa Yikabode, bɔ ye bo kyire: “Animnyam ne atu afi Yisrael.” Ɔnate kyɛ, né bale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bahɔ, yeɛ afei né ye sia ne ohu koso bawu. 22Na osele kyɛ, “Animnyam ne atu afi Yisrael, ofikyɛ bale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bahɔ”.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 5
Content:
Apam alaka ne wɔ Filistifoɛ berɛ
1Mmerɛ bɔ Filistifoɛ lele Nyameɛ apam alaka ne fili Yisrael sa nu nen, bɛfa befili Ebenesa bɛhɔle Asedɔde. 2Afei Filistifoɛ fale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bɛhɔle bosoen Dagɔn sua nu, na bɛfa besiele Dagɔn nwo berɛ. 3Na ye alehyeleɛ nu ngyerɛmɔ tutututu bɔ Asedɔdefoɛ dwɔsole ne, benwuni kyɛ Dagɔn amunu afi, bɔ ye nyunu butu ase wɔ AWURADE alaka ne nyunu ɔ. Yiti bɛmane Dagɔn so besa besiele ye boso. 4Nakoso ye alehyeleɛ nu bieku, ngyerɛmɔ tutututu bɔ bedwɔsole ne, né Dagɔn amunu afi, bɔ ye nyunu butu ase wɔ AWURADE alaka ne nyunu ɔ. Né ebie abu Dagɔn ti ne ye sa nyɔ nemɔ wafi so bɔ bɛlela simbini ne aso ɔ. Né waha ye kundunzii ne angome. 5Na ɔnate sɔ ati, ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye po, Dagɔn ahɔmeɛ ne sona biala bɔ ɔkɔ Dagɔn so ne, bendia Dagɔn simbini bɔ ɔwɔ Asedɔde ne aso.
6AWURADE tumi tuale Asedɔdefoɛ so kerɛ piri paa: ɔfale amaneɛ piri paa tole Asedɔde ne ye mbɔtam so, ɔmane mbɔmbɔ bobɔle bɛ. 7Na Asedɔdefoɛ nwuni kyɛbɔ nningyein si sisi nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛma Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne ɔka yɛ wa, ofikyɛ watua yɛ ne yɛ nyameɛ Dagɔn so kerɛ piri paa.” 8Yiti bɛsomane maa bɛɛfrɛfrɛle Filisti ahemvo amukoraa maa beyiale, na bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne, yɛ́yɛ ye sɛ koraa?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛye Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne yɛfi wa yɛkɔ Gate.” Yiti bɛyele Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne befili berɛ bɛhɔle Gate. 9Nakoso bɛfa bɛhɔle Gate nen, AWURADE tumi tuale kuro ne aso kerɛ piri paa. Ahunundetelɛ piri paa tɔle bɛ so. Ɔmane kuro berɛ mbanyi ne ngwalaa mukoraa nwuni amaneɛ, na mbɔmbɔ bobɔle bɛ. 10Yiti bɛmaa bɛfale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bɛhɔle Ekron. Nakoso bɛfale Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bedwuli Ekron nen, Ekronfoɛ teateane nu kyɛ, “Bafa Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne bawa yɛ wa kyɛ bɛbaafa bekuku yɛ ne yɛ kuro ama.” 11Yeɛ bɛsomane maa bɛɛfrɛfrɛle Filisti ahemvo amukoraa maa beyiale, na besele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne béfi wa besa bɛɛfa besie ye boso, ná wangukũ yɛ ne yɛ kuro ama.” Ofikyɛ né ewue nwo ahunundetelɛ atɔ kuro ne aso amukoraa. Né Nyameɛ ama ɛhawo piri paa awa berɛ. 12Na bɛ bɔ banwu ne, mbɔmbɔ bobɔle bɛ, na kuro berɛ ama hɔle so bɛbɔle awuye piri paa.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 6
Content:
Filistifoɛ fa apam alaka ne sa ba
1AWURADE alaka ne lili bosome nzoo wɔ Filistifoɛ aseɛ so. 2Afei Filistifoɛ tole asaa bɛfrɛfrɛle b’ahɔmeɛ ne bɛ musueyelɛfoɛ, na bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE alaka ne, yɛ́yɛ ye sɛ? Nikye horɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛboka so ná yafa yaasie ye boso ne, ɛmɔhã behyire yɛ.” 3Na bebuale kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔye Yisrael Nyameɛ apam alaka ne befi wa bɛkɔ a, ye de nnɛma ɛmɔfa ye mbaen bɛkɔ, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ bɛboka so bɛkɔma ye. Na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ ne kɔhɔ, na ɛmɔkonwu bɔ yiti yeɛ ɔmma ye amaneɛ piri paa he omvi ɛmɔ so ye.” 4 Na Filistifoɛ bisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛɛma ye ɔ?” Bebuale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ bɛ́yɔ mbɔmbɔ nnu ne mmurokuruwa nnu, kyɛbɔ Filisti ahemvo mɔ somaa te ɔ, ofikyɛ amaneɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ wawa ɛmɔ amukoraa ne ɛmɔ ahemvo mɔ so ɔ. 5Yiti mbɔmbɔ ne mmurokuruwa mɔ bɔ bɛ́sɛkye ɛmɔ maen nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ bɛ sɛso, ná ɛmɔfa animnyam bɛma Yisrael Nyameɛ ne. Ebiaa amaneɛ piri paa bɔ wafa wato ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ nyameɛ mɔ ɔne ɛmɔ aseɛ so ne, ɔkɔyakyi. 6Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ kyɛbɔ Misraimfoɛ ne Faro yɛle asoserɛ ne? Oguale Misraimfoɛ nyunu ase yiele nen, aso bamma Yisraelfoɛ ate ma bangɔ? 7Yiti ɛ́mɔyɔ teaseɛnam monɛ kamee ko, ná ɛmɔfa nandwie mmeleɛ nyɔ bɔ bɛma bɛ mma nyɔfone, bɔ bɛffale kɔnnua bɛttole bɛ kɔme le ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa bakaa bɛ́sosɔ nandwie nemɔ bɛ́bɔ teaseɛnam ne, nakoso bɛ mma nemɔ de, ɛ́mɔte bɛ béfi bɛ ni mɔ anwo bɛɛfa bɛ begua tuin nu. 8Ɛ́mɔfa AWURADE alaka ne bésie teaseɛnam ne aso. Na sikaa kɔkorɛ nningyein bɔ ɛmɔfa bɛyɛ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ bɛma ye ne de, ɛ́mɔfa bégua alaka bie anu bésie apam alaka ne anwo berɛ. Na afei ɛ́mɔyakyi ye ate ma ye bɔbɔ ɔhɔ ye atee. 9Afei ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nye beli ye si. Sɛ ɔfa atee ne aso ɔkɔ Bete Semese ɔkɔ ye bɔbɔ ye maen nu a, ye de AWURADE yeɛ wafa amaneɛ piri he wato yɛ so ɔ. Nakoso sɛ wangɔ dɔ a, ye de yɛkonwu ye kyɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ wafa amaneɛ piri he wato yɛ so ɔ, na mmom asane bie mbaen yeɛ wato yɛ ɔ.”
10Filistifoɛ yɔle sɔ ala: bɛfale nandwie mmeleɛ nyɔ bɔ bɛma bɛ mma nyɔfone ne, bɛfale kɔnnua bɛsosɔle bɛ bɛbɔle teaseɛnam ne, na bɛhane bɛ mma nemɔ beguale tuin nu. 11Bɛfale AWURADE alaka ne besiele teaseɛnam ne aso. Na alaka baa bɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ mmurokuruwa ɔne Filistifoɛ mbɔmbɔ mɔ sɛso wɔ nu ne koso, bɛfa bɛbokale so. 12Nandwie nemɔ hɔle bɛ nyunu tee bɛfale atimbire komapɛ aso bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele Bete Semese. Na nandwie nemɔ bɛkɔ ne, né besu. Bammakye bamva bɛen anaa famaa; na Filisti ahemvo nemɔ lili bɛ si toonn beedwuli Bete Semese ɛwɛen so.
13Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Bete Semesefoɛ bɛ́te b’atokoɔ wɔ bɔnza ne anu. Bɛmane bɛ nye so ná benwuni alaka nen, ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ kyɛ banwu ye ɔ. 14Teaseɛnam ne dwuli Bete Semeseniɛ Yosua ye boo ne anu ne, ogyinane berɛ. Né nyɔbotaen bie timu berɛ, na bebubuli teaseɛnam mmakaa ne anu bɛsɔle see. Bɛfale nandwie nemɔ bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE. 15Na AWURADE alaka ne, yeɛ alaka bie bɔ ogyi ye nwo berɛ bɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ nningyein wɔ nu ne, Lewifoɛ ye siele nyɔbotaen ne aso. Na sɔ kyẽa ne, Bete Semesefoɛ bobɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE. 16Na Filisti ahemvo nnu ne nwuni bɔ wasi nen, besa bɛwale Ekron sɔ kyẽa ne.
17Esikaa kɔkorɛ mbɔmbɔ bɔ Filistifoɛ fa yɛle foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ bɛɛmane AWURADE ne, bɛ ɛhe: Asedɔde deɛ ko, Gasa deɛ ko, Asekelɔn deɛ ko, Gate deɛ ko, yeɛ Ekron deɛ ko. 18Yeɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ mmurokuruwa nemɔ koso, bɛ somaa ne Filisti ahemvo nnu nemɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ somaa pɛ: nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔne namue mɔ bɔ fasue nne bɛ nwo ɔ. Na nyɔbotaen bɔ bɛfale AWURADE alaka ne besiele so, bɔ ɔwɔ Bete Semeseniɛ Yosua boo nu ne, ɔte adanzeɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
Kiriate Yearimfoɛ bɛɛfale apam alaka ne
19 Nyameɛ huni Bete Semesefoɛ nemɔ bie, ofikyɛ bɛneane AWURADE alaka ne anu. Ohuni maen ne anu mmenia aburasoo, na mmenia ne lili aworabɔlɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE huni maen ne anu mmenia pee paa.
20Afei Bete Semesefoɛ hane kyɛ, “AWURADE, Krongronniɛ Nyameɛ he, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye nyunu ɔ? Nwa berɛ koraa yeɛ yɛye AWURADE alaka ne yɛfi yɛ wa yɛkɔ ɔ?” 21Yiti betuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa beesele Kiriate Yearimfoɛ kyɛ, “Filistifoɛ asa afa AWURADE alaka ne bawa. Ɛmɔbra bɛɛfa bɛhɔ ɛmɔ dɔ.”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 7
Content:
1 Yiti Kiriate Yearimfoɛ wale bɛɛfale alaka ne bɛhɔle, na bɛfa bɛhɔle Abinadabo awuro wɔ bokaa ne aso. Na bɛtele ɔwa bienzua Eleasa nwo kyɛ ɔ́nea AWURADE alaka ne aso. 2Ofi kyẽa bɔ bɛfale alaka ne bɛhɔle Kiriate Yearim ne, ɔhyɛle paa wɔ berɛ, kɔyɛ afoɛ aburanyɔ. Na Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa belili aworabɔlɛ bɛpenane AWURADE si atee.
Samuel di Yisrael so panyi
3Afei Samuel sele Yisrael awuro ama amukoraati kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔ ahone nu paa yeɛ ɛmɔsa bɛba AWURADE berɛ a, nzaade ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔye Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ ne mmosoen Astarote befi ɛmɔ nu begyi begua. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtu ɛmɔ nwo besie berɛ bɔkɔɔ bɛma AWURADE, ná ɛmɔso ye ngome, na okole ɛmɔ kofi Filistifoɛ sa nu.” 4Yiti Yisraelfoɛ gyili Baal mɔ ne Astarote mɔ beguale, na bɛsole AWURADE ngome.
5Na Samuel sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa béyia wɔ Misepa, na ngɔfa ɛmɔ mbaeɛ ngɔto AWURADE nyunu ngɔma ɛmɔ.” 6Yiti beeyiale nu wɔ Misepa, na bɛsale nzue behwie beguale ase bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE. Bɛhyele hɔen sɔ kyẽa ne, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yayɔ bɔne yatia AWURADE.” Na Samuel tenane Misepa buli Yisrael maen ne.
7Mmerɛ bɔ Filistifoɛ tele kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ baayia nu wɔ Misepa nen, Filisti ahemvo mɔ hɔle kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtoa Yisrael. Na Yisraelfoɛ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, Filistifoɛ nwo suronyi tɔle bɛ so. 8 Na Yisraelfoɛ sele Samuel kyɛ, “Esuɛ bɔ esu frɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ma yɛ ne, nnɛyakyi; na srɛ kyɛ ole yɛ fi Filistifoɛ sa nu.” 9Yiti Samuel fale boaen ba bɔ otua nyɔfone noa bɔle afɔleɛ mumua yeralɛ mane AWURADE. Afei Samuel sũ frɛle AWURADE mane Yisrael, na AWURADE tiele ye mbaeɛ. 10Na Samuel gu so ɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ nen, Filistifoɛ pingyele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛ ne bɛ baaho. Nakoso AWURADE bɔle nu kurudududu serɛserɛ guale Filistifoɛ so sɔ kyẽa ne mane bɛ nye so tanene, na ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ. 11Yeɛ Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ fili Misepa fitele bɛɛfoane Filistifoɛ, na behuhuni bɛ toonn beedwuli Bete Kare si dɔ.
12Afei Samuel fale nyɔboɛ penane Misepa ne Sɛn b’afia, ɔfrɛle nyɔboɛ ne Ebenesa, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛwa yeɛ AWURADE waboka yɛ waadwu ɔ.” 13Yisrael brɛle Filistifoɛ ase, na Filistifoɛ ambe Yisrael aseɛ so ko. Na AWURADE tumi tuale Filistifoɛ so kerɛ piri paa wɔ mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ né Samuel te ase ɔ. 14Yisrael nguro bɔ Filistifoɛ le fili bɛ sa nu ne, AWURADE lele Yisrael nikyee mane ye, fite Ekron bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gate. Nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ koso, Yisrael le fili Filistifoɛ sa nu. Na asomdwee koso wale Yisrael ne Amorifoɛ b’afia.
15Samuel buli Yisrael maen ne mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔtenane ase ɔ. 16Afoɛ biala, né ɔkɔ aporɔ wɔ Betel, Gilgal ne Misepa; na obuli Yisrael maen ne wɔ sɔ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so. 17Né ɔyɛ a, osa ba Rama, ofikyɛ ye kuro ɛne, na né ɔte berɛ yeɛ obu Yisrael maen ne ɔ. Na osili afɔleɛ bokyea berɛ mane AWURADE.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 8
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ pena ɛhene
1Mmerɛ bɔ Samuel yɛle aworowaa ne, ɔmane ye mma nemɔ yeɛ bɛyɛle maenbulɛfoɛ wɔ Yisrael ɔ. 2 Ye bamuɛbaa bienzua ne li Yowel, yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne li Abiya. Né bɛte maenbulɛfoɛ wɔ Beɛ Hyeba. 3 Nakoso ye mma nemɔ de, bamva ye suban, na mmom bɛmane bɛ nye borole nikye, belele fea-ase-ma, na bebuale ndɛengyea.
4Yiti Yisrael mbanyi mukoraati yiale, na bɛhɔle Samuel berɛ wɔ Rama 5 beesele ye kyɛ, “Ayɛ aworowaa, yeɛ wɔ mma nemɔ koso bamva wɔ suban, yiti ye ɛhene ma yɛ ma oli yɛ so, kyɛbɔ maen ngaa nemɔ bɛyɔ ne ala.” 6Nakoso bɛhane kyɛ, ‘Ma yɛ hene ma ɔla yɛ noa’ ne, wanyɛ Samuel fɛ. Yiti Samuel fa tole AWURADE nyunu, 7na AWURADE buale Samuel kyɛ, “Edwirɛ biala bɔ maen ne fa to wɔ nyunu ne, de to nu, ofikyɛ nna wɔ yeɛ bapo wɔ ɔ, na mmom me yeɛ bapo me kyɛ nnde bɛ so hene ko ɔ. 8Na bɔ bafa bali me amukoraa, fite kyẽa bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim mmale bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ, bɔ bayakyi me si lilɛ baaso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ ɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ́fa bédi wɔ ɔ. 9Wɔ de, de b’edwirɛ ne to nu; nakoso kanzo bɛ kitii, ná maa benwu atee horɛ bɔ ɛhene ne kɔfa so koli bɛ so ɔ.”
10Yiti Samuel hane AWURADE noa dwirɛ ne amukoraa hyirele mmenia bɔ bebisale ɛhene befili ye berɛ ne. 11Na osele kyɛ, “Ɛhene bɔ ɔbaali ɛmɔ so ne, sɔ atee he yeɛ ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ kɔfa so ɔ: ye koɛ teaseɛnam mɔ ne ye mbɔngɔ nemɔ, ɔkɔhyɛ ɛmɔ mma mmienzua maa bɛkɔhã, na ɔkɔmaa bekotu amirika bekoli koɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ nyunu bɛkɔbɔ ye nwo waen. 12Ɛmɔ mma nemɔ, ɔkɔbɔ ebiemɔ safohene maa bɛkɔlela mmenia apee apee noa, ɔne mmenia aburannu aburannu noa. Ɔkɔma ebiemɔ kɔso ye boo, ná wama ebiemɔ abu ye fieso aleɛ. Na ye akodeɛ ne ye teaseɛnam mɔ koso, ɔkɔhyɛ bɛ maa bɛkɔyɔ. 13Ɔkɔhyɛ ɛmɔ mma mmrasua maa bɛkɔyɔ ye sakyeɛfona, bɛkɔto ye aleɛ, ná bato ye paanoo. 14Ɛmɔ boo, bobe boo, ɔne olive boo nemɔ, okole nu aleɛ paa ne kofi ɛmɔ sa nu kɔma ye somvoɛ mɔ. 15Ɛmɔ aburoo ne ɛmɔ bobe mma ne, okole buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko kɔma ye mbanyi ne ye somvoɛ mɔ. 16Ɛmɔ nganga ne ɛmɔ afaneɛ nemɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ nandwie ne ɛmɔ afunum paa nemɔ, ɔkɔhyɛ bɛ maa bɛkɔyɔ ye adwuma. 17Okole ɛmɔ mmoaen buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko, na ɛmɔkɔyɛ ye nganga. 18Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɛmɔkosu, ɔnate ɛmɔ hene bɔ ɛmɔafa ye bali ɛmɔ so ne ati; nakoso AWURADE ngɔtɛ ɛmɔ so sɔ mmerɛ ne.”
19Nakoso maen ne hwi fale Samuel noa dwirɛ so, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Daabi, yɛpena ɛhene bɔ ɔkɔla yɛ noa ɔ; 20amaa ɔnate so yɛ koso yayɛ kyɛ maen ngaa nemɔ. Yɛ hene ne kɔla yɛ noa, na okoli yɛ nyunu maa yɛkɔhɔ yɛ koɛ mɔ.” 21Samuel tiele edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mmenia ne hane ne, na ɔhane ye pɛpɛɛpɛ hyirele AWURADE. 22 Na AWURADE buale Samuel kyɛ, “De b’edwirɛ ne to nu, ná si hene ma bɛ.” Na Samuel sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ebiala osa hɔ ye kuro.”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 9
Content:
Nyameɛ neanea nu ye Sɔɔlo
1Né biaa Benyaminniɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ oli Kise. Ɔse ole Abiɛl, bɔ ɔse ole Sero, bɔ ɔse ole Bekorate, bɔ ɔse ole Afia bɔ ɔte Benyamin bosoniɛ ɔ. Né Kise sa nu le bie. 2Né ole baa bienzua aberandeɛ anwonyemene bie bɔ oli Sɔɔlo. Né sona biala nne Yisrael bɔ ye anwonyemene tra ye ɔ. Maen ne anu, ɔne sona biala gyi berɛ a, ɔwale tra ye.
3Ɛlɛho bie, Sɔɔlo baba Kise afunum mɔ minini. Yiti Kise sele ɔwa Sɔɔlo kyɛ, “Fa somvoɛ nemɔ nu ko boka wɔ nwo so, ná kɔpena afunum nemɔ.” 4Oohyinihyinini Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so ne Salisa aseɛ so, nakoso bannwu bɛ. Behyinihyinini Saalim aseɛ so, nakoso né afunum nemɔ bɛnne berɛ. Afei oohyinihyinini Benyamin aseɛ so, nakoso bannwu bɛ.
5Na beedwuli Sufe aseɛ so ne, Sɔɔlo sele somvoɛ bɔ ɔne ye nate ne kyɛ, “Maa yɛsa yɛhɔ. Anyɔ a, me baba kɔyakyi afunum nemɔ nwo adwenedwene, na ɔkɔma yɛ nwo adwenedwene kɔtɔ ye so.” 6Nakoso somvoɛ ne buale ye kyɛ, “Tie, Nyameɛ sona bie wɔ kuro he aso, na ɔte sona bɔ bebu ye ɔ. Bɔ ɔkɔha biala, ɔba nu. Maa yɛhɔ berɛ, na ebiaa ɔkɔha atee bɔ yawa ye nwo dwirɛ kohyire yɛ.”
7Na Sɔɔlo bisale somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛkɔ berɛ a, nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkwaafa yɛma biaa ne ɔ? Aleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ bɔtɔ nu ne, wayie; na akyɛdeɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ yɛkonya ye yɛkɔma Nyameɛ sona ne ɔ. Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛle ye wɔ berɛ ɔ?”
8Na somvoɛ ne buale Sɔɔlo kyɛ, “Nea, nne ɛdwetɛ sekel ngyɛmuɛ nna nu ko wɔ wa, ngɔfa ngɔma Nyameɛ sona ne, na okohyire yɛ nekaa bɔ odi kyɛ yɛkɔ ɔ.”
9(Daa ne, wɔ Yisrael, né sɛ ebie ɔkwaabisa Nyameɛ berɛ dwirɛ a, ɔka kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra ma yɛhɔ Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔse ase ne berɛ”, ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɛnɛ ye bɛfrɛ ye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne, daa ne de, né bɛfrɛ ye Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔse ase ɔ).
10Na Sɔɔlo sele ye somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Bɔ aha ne ɔte paa, maa yɛhɔ.” Na besili nu bɛhɔle kuro bɔ Nyameɛ sona ne ɔwɔ so ne aso.
11Na bɛ́fo bokaa ne bɛ́kɔ kuro ne aso ne, beyiale mmaayaa biemɔ bɔ befi kuro ne anu befite bɛkɔ asue ɔ. Na bebisale mmaayaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, aso ɔwɔ berɛ?” 12Bebuale kyɛ, “Yoo, ɔwɔ berɛ, oli wɔ nyunu moa. Ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera, na bekye ala yeɛ waadwu kuro wa ɔ, ofikyɛ maen ne baabɔ afɔleɛ ɛnɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ so berɛ. 13Sɛ ɛmɔdwu kuro ne aso ala a, ɛmɔkonwu ye koraka né wafo wahɔ asɔneyɛɛ so berɛ waadidi. Sɛ ɔwwale a, mmenia nnidi, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ odi kyɛ oyira afɔleɛ ne aso koraka ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ne, mmenia bɔ bato bɛ sa bafrɛ bɛ ne, bedidi. Yiti ɛ́mɔfo bɛhɔ, na ɔngɔhyɛ biala ɛmɔkonwu ye.” 14Bɛtoale so kyɛ bɛ́kɔ kuro berɛ. Na bɛyɛle kyɛ béwura kuro berɛ pambim ne anu ne, benwuni kyɛ Samuel fi kuro ne anu ɔ́ba. Né ye nye kyire bɛ dɔ, na né ɔse kɔ asɔneyɛɛ ne aso.
15Ɔhale ɛlɛho ma Sɔɔlo ba ne, né AWURADE ali moa waye wahyire Samuel kyɛ, 16“Ɛhema, bekye sɔa ala, ngɔma biaa bie bɔ ofi Benyamin aseɛ so kɔwa wɔ berɛ, na fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo popa ye ma oli me maen Yisrael so hene. Ɔkɔpepɛ kole me maen kofi Filistifoɛ sa nu, ofikyɛ manwu amaneɛ bɔ me mmenia benwu ye ne, na bɛ suɛ adwu me nyunu.”
17Na Samuel nye bɔle Sɔɔlo so nen, AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Biaa bɔ ngane ye nwo dwirɛ ngyirele wɔ ne, ye ɛne. Ye yeɛ okoli me maen ne nyunu ɔ.” 18Afei Sɔɔlo pingyele Samuel nwo berɛ wɔ pambim ne anu, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ ala, Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ye awuro wɔ nisua?”
19Na Samuel buale Sɔɔlo kyɛ, “Me ole Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔse ase ne. Di me nyunu moa fo kɔ asɔneyɛɛ so dɔ, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ ɛmɔ ne me kodidi. Na edwirɛ bɔ ɔha wɔ ne, ngɔma wɔ ye nwo mmuayɛɛ ɛhema ngyerɛmɔ, ná afei mayakyi wɔ ate maa ahɔ. 20W’afunum mɔ bɔ bamini ɛlɛsa ɛhe ne, nnɛdwene bɛ nwo ko, ofikyɛ banwu bɛ. Na nwa yeɛ Yisrael anwonyadeɛ amukoraa te ye deɛ ɔ? Ɛne wɔ baba abusua nu ama mukoraa, aso nna ɛmɔ deɛ ɔ?” 21 Na Sɔɔlo buale kyɛ, “Nde Benyaminniɛ. Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ, Benyamin yeɛ ɔte kãa paa wɔ nu ɔ. Na Benyamin abusua kure ne, m’abusua yeɛ ɔte awiɛmvoɛ paa wɔ mmusua ne amukoraa nu ɔ. Na nzu ati yeɛ aha sɔ dwirɛ he ahyire me ɔ?”
22Afei Samuel fale Sɔɔlo ne ye somvoɛ ne hɔle poentolɛ bo wɔ asaso. Na bia bɔ odi mu paa ne, ɔmaa bɛtenane so wɔ mmenia kɔyɛ aburasa bɔ bato asaa bafrɛ bɛ nemɔ anu. 23Na Samuel sele sona bɔ ɔto aleɛ ne kyɛ, “Naen bɔ mva mane wɔ kyɛ ɛfa sie ne, fa bra.” 24Na sona bɔ ɔto aleɛ ne pagyale naen ne sɔ ne, ɔne bɔ ɔboka so ne, na ɔfa siele Sɔɔlo nyunu. Na Samuel hane kyɛ, “Nea, naen bɔ yɛfa yɛsiele ne, yeɛ bafa basie wɔ nyunu ne. Di, ofikyɛ mva nziele berɛ mane wɔ, kyɛ odwu sɔ mmerɛ ye a, ɛne mmenia bɔ mato asaa mafrɛ bɛ ne kodidi.” Yiti Sɔɔlo ne Samuel tole asaa didili sɔ kyẽa ne.
25Na befili asɔneyɛɛ so dɔ bedwu bɛwale kuro ne anu ne, bɛtole Sɔɔlo mba wɔ sua ne aso nzamsoɛ ne aso maa ɔlale. 26Alebahyene ne, né Sɔɔlo wɔ nzamsoɛ ne aso. Na Samuel frɛle ye sele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso ma nzoma wɔ ate ma ɛhɔ.” Sɔɔlo dwɔsole, na ɔne Samuel befitele dwaaso dɔ.
27Na bɛ́torotoro bɛ́kɔ kuro ne tiwaa nen, Samuel sele Sɔɔlo kyɛ, “Ka kyire somvoɛ ne ma ɔɔse li yɛ nyunu moa. Na ɔse badi moa a, wɔ de gyina berɛ kãa ma nga Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ngyire wɔ.”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 10
Content:
Samuel popa Sɔɔlo ngoo
1Afei Samuel fale ngoo towaa, otutu guale Sɔɔlo ti so, na ɔtɔle ye nu hane kyɛ, “AWURADE apopa wɔ ngoo wafa wɔ wali ye maen Yisrael so hene. Wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔla AWURADE maen ne noa ɔ, na bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔpepɛ kole bɛ kofi bɛ sa nu ɔ. Na bɔ okohyire kyɛ AWURADE afa wɔ wali ye agyapadeɛ so hene ɛhe: 2Ɛnɛ sɛ efi me nwo wa ná ɛkɔ a, ekoyia mmienzua nyɔ wɔ Rahɛl asieleɛ ne anwo, wɔ Selsa, wɔ Benyamin aseɛ so. Na bekose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Afunum mɔ bɔ ɛhɔle bɛ penalɛ ne, banwu bɛ. Afei de, wɔ baba ndwene afunum nemɔ nwo ko, na mmom ɛmɔ nwo adwenedwene yeɛ watɔ ye so ɔ. Na ɔnwa: Yieee, mma ye, mekwaanwu ye ni?’ 3Efi berɛ toa so kɔ wɔ nyunu, ná ekodwu Tabɔ eluii ne anwo a, ekoyia mmienzua nza wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛkwaasɔne Nyameɛ wɔ Betel ɔ. Ko tira mbɔngye mmaa nza, ko tira paanoo mumua nza, yeɛ ko wora otira bobe nzaa ngomvo ko. 4Bekobisa wɔ ahye, na bɛkɔma wɔ paanoo mumua nyɔ bɔ odi kyɛ ede ɔ. 5Na ɛhe asi ne, ekoodwu Gibeate Elohim, wɔ nekaa bɔ Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ wɔ ne. Na sɛ ɛkwaawura kuro ne anu a, ekoyia ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ kure bɔ befi asɔneyɛɛ so dɔ bɛ́torotoro bɛ́ba, bɔ adengum, akasaa, aweɛn ne sangoo angorɛ li bɛ nyunu ɔ. Na ekonwu kyɛ bɛ́hyɛ ngɔm ɔ. 6 Afei AWURADE Sunzum kɔte kɔpe wɔ so, ɛne bɛ kɔbɔ nu kɔhyɛ ngɔm, na ɔkɔmaa ɛkɔsesã kɔyɛ sona foforɛ. 7Na sɛ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ba nu ma wɔ a, yɔ nikyee biala bɔ ekuro ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ gyi wɔ si. 8 Na ɛhe asi ne, di me nyunu moa kɔ Gilgal, na ngooyia wɔ berɛ ngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ. Tena berɛ nwondɛ ɛlɛsoo, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔɔto wɔ berɛ ná ngohyire wɔ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ɔ.”
Sɔɔlo hyɛ ngɔm
9Sɔɔlo kakyili ye nwo kyɛ ofi Samuel nwo berɛ kɔ ne, Nyameɛ sesane Sɔɔlo maa ɔyɛle sona foforɛ; na sɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne amukoraa wale nu sɔ kyẽa ne ala. 10Na befili berɛ beedwuli Gibea nen, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ kure wale beeyiale ye, na Nyameɛ sunzum wale ye so, na ɔhyɛle ye bo ɔne bɛ bɔle nu hyɛle ngɔm. 11Na mmenia bɔ bɛse ye daa amukoraa nwuni ye kyɛ ɔne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ́hyɛ ngɔm nen, bebisabisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nikye yeɛ wate wape Kise awa ye aso ye? Sɔɔlo koso boka ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ so hɔ ɔ?” 12 Na biaa bie bɔ ofi kuro berɛ ala buale kyɛ, “Na nwa yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ?” Yiti ɔɔyɛle mbanyi mɔ dwirɛ bie bɔ ɔla berɛ kyɛ, “Sɔɔlo koso boka ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ so hɔ ɔ?” 13Na ngɔmhyɛlɛ ne fili ye nye so nen, ɔhɔle asɔneyɛɛ so berɛ.
14Na Sɔɔlo baba aliɛma bienzua bisale ye ne somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛmɔhɔle ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Yɛhɔle afunum nemɔ penalɛ. Na yɛpenane bɛ dee bɔ yannwu bɛ ne, yɛhɔle Samuel berɛ.” 15Yeɛ Sɔɔlo baba aliɛma bienzua ne sele kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ Samuel ha hyirele ɛmɔ ne, ka kyire me.” 16Na Sɔɔlo buale ye baba aliɛma bienzua ne kyɛ, “Osele yɛ pefee kyɛ banwu afunum nemɔ.” Nakoso ahennie ne nwo dwirɛ bɔ Samuel ha hyirele Sɔɔlo ne de, wammɔ so wangyire ye.
Bɛfale Sɔɔlo besili hene
17Samuel tole asaa frɛle Yisrael maen ne maa bɛwale AWURADE nyunu wɔ Misepa, 18na osele bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Me yeɛ nyele Yisrael mvili Misraim ɔ. Mbepɛ nnele ɛmɔ mvili Misraimfoɛ sa nu, ɔne ahennie amukoraa bɔ né bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ so ne sa nu.’ 19 Nakoso ɛnɛ de, ɛmɔapo ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ode ɛmɔ fi ɛmɔ amaneɛ mukoraa ne ɛmɔ anwokyere mukoraa nu ne, na ɛmɔaha bahyire ye kyɛ, ‘Daabi, si hene ma yɛ.’ Ye sɔ ne ati, ɛmɔbra beegyina AWURADE nyunu abusua kure abusua kure ne mmusua mmusua.”
20Afei Samuel mane Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa beegyinane anyunu berɛ, na beguale serewa maa ɔyele Benyamin abusua kure ne. 21Benyamin abusua kure ne, ɔmane nu mmusua mmusua ne beegyinane anyunu berɛ. Na beguale serewa maa ɔyele Matri abusua ne. Ɔmane Matri abusua nu ama beegyinane anyunu berɛ, na serewagualɛ ne yele Kise awa Sɔɔlo. Nakoso bɛpenane Sɔɔlo ne, bannwu ye. 22Yiti besa bebisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Sɔ sona ne, aso wamma wa bie anaa?” Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, waafea nningyein bɔ baboaboa ye noa ne anu.” 23Na bele amirika bɛɛfale ye bɛwale. Oogyinane mmenia ne anu nen, né ɔne sona biala gyi berɛ a, ɔwale tra ye. 24Na Samuel sele mmenia ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE aneanea nu waye ye ɔ. Ebiala nne maen ye anu bɔ ɔte kyɛ ye ɔ.” Na mmenia ne amukoraa bɔ lele so kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo!”
25Samuel hane ahennie ne nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa hyirele maen ne. Ɔhyerɛle ye wɔ nwomaa nu, na ɔfale nwomaa ne tole AWURADE nyunu. Afei Samuel mane mmenia ne amukoraa betuli apo besa bɛhɔle b’awuro. 26Sɔɔlo koso hɔle ye awuro wɔ Gibea, na koɛhonɛfoɛ biemɔ bɔ Nyameɛ kanyane bɛ ɔ yeɛ bɛfale ye bɛhɔle ɔ. 27 Nakoso hohwifoɛ biemɔ sele kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né akoaa he ahora ale yɛ?” Yiti bebuli ye animtia, na bamva akyɛdeɛ biala bammrɛ ye. Nakoso Sɔɔlo andɛ bɛ so.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 11
Content:
Sɔɔlo di Amonfoɛ so ngonim
1Amonniɛ Nahase fo wale ootuale Yabese Gileade. Na Yabese Gileadefoɛ amukoraa sele Nahase kyɛ, “Ɛne yɛ yɛ apam, na yɛkɔso wɔ.” 2Nakoso Amonniɛ Nahase buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ngɔpene so kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ kɔyɛ apam a, sana metu ebiala nye famaa ne, maa ɔyɛ animguaseɛ ka Yisrael amukoraati.” 3Na Yabese mbanyi sele ye kyɛ, “Ma yɛ ɛlɛsoo maa yɛtu ɛbɔfoɛ ma behyini Yisrael amukoraati, na sɛ yannya defoɛ biala a, yɛkɔɔfa yɛ nwo yɛkowura wɔ sa.” 4Ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ dwuli Sɔɔlo kuro Gibea, na bɛfale edwirɛ ne nwo amaneɛ bɛbɔle berɛ ama nen, mmenia ne amukoraa bɛsɔle awuyebɔlɛ nu.
5Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Sɔɔlo ɔ́ka nandwie mɔ ofi eburo ba kuro, na obisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ wato mmenia ye mɔ bɔ besu ye?” Na bɛfale Yabesefoɛ amaneɛ ne bɛbɔle ye. 6Na mmerɛ bɔ Sɔɔlo tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, Nyameɛ sunzum kanyane ye, na ɔfɛle yaa hahii. 7 Ɔhyele nandwie nyii nyɔ bɔ bafa kɔnnua basosɔ bɛ babɔ nu ɔ, ɔpepɛle bɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi, na ɔfa somane ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Yisrael aseɛ so amukoraa beesele kyɛ, “Sona biala bɔ wanni Sɔɔlo ne Samuel si wangɔ koɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔpepɛ ye nandwie mɔ nu ɔ.” Afei AWURADE nwo suronyi tɔle maen ne aso, na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛbɔle nu befite bɛwale. 8Na Sɔɔlo hale bɛ wɔ Beseke nen, né bɛ bɔ befi Yisrael ne bɛte apee ɛyaa nza, yeɛ bɛ bɔ befi Yuda ne koso bɛte apee aburasa. 9Na besele ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwale ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beese Yabese Gileadefoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛhema, kyɛ odwu eyiagyina ne, né ɛmɔanya defoɛ.’ ” Na ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ fale amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle Yabesefoɛ nen, ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ. 10Na Yabesefoɛ sele Amonfoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhema yɛkɔɔfa yɛ nwo yɛkowura ɛmɔ sa, na ɛmɔkɔhora kɔfa bɔ ɛmɔkuro biala bɛkɔyɛ yɛ.” 11Aleɛ hyene ne, Sɔɔlo hyɛle ye lɔen ne anu kure nza. Na alebahyene, bɛhɔle Amonfoɛ asikyeleɛ ne anu, na behuhuni Amonfoɛ toonn maa oodwuli eyia ketee. Bɛ bɔ benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu ne, bɛbɔle aya, bɔ mmenia nyɔ po banga neka horɛ ɔ.
12 Afei Yisraelfoɛ bisale Samuel kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ yeɛ bɛhane kyɛ, ‘Aso Sɔɔlo yeɛ ɔbaali yɛ so hene anaa’ ne? Ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛbra ma yɛhu bɛ!” 13 Nakoso Sɔɔlo buale kyɛ, “Yɛngohu sona biala ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ te kyẽa bɔ AWURADE apepɛ ale Yisrael ɔ.” 14Na Samuel sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra ma yɛhɔ Gilgal yɛɛbɔ ɛhene ne ohomoo bieku wɔ berɛ.” 15Yiti mmenia ne amukoraati hɔle Gilgal, na bɛbɔle Sɔɔlo ohomoo besili ye hene wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ Gilgal. Bɛbɔle asomdwee afɔleɛ berɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na Sɔɔlo ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati nye gyele paa wɔ berɛ.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 12
Content:
Samuel ne maen ne di ngraa
1 Afei Samuel sele Yisrael amukoraa kyɛ, “Matie edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔaha bahyire me ne amukoraa, na masi ɛmɔ hene mama ɛmɔ. 2Ɛ́mɔtie, afei de, ɛhene ne yeɛ ɔla ɛmɔ noa ɔ. Me de, mayɛ aworowaa bɔ mafu gyein ɔ, nakoso me mma mmienzua nemɔ de, bɛboka ɛmɔ so. Mali ɛmɔ nyunu toonn fite me ngwadaa nu maa waadwu ɛnɛ kyẽa ye. 3 Ngyi ɛmɔ nyunu wa. Ɛ́mɔli me nwo adanzeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔne ye sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne nyunu. Nwa nandwie yeɛ male ɔ? Nwa afunum yeɛ male ɔ? Anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ mali ye ndurum ɔ? Nwa yeɛ mahyɛ ye so ɔ? Nwa yeɛ male fea-ase-ma mafi ye berɛ, bɔ ɔnate so mabu me nye magua ndɛen turoloo so ɔ? Ɛ́mɔhã, na ngɔfa bie ngosi ye gya nu ngɔma ɛmɔ.” 4Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ellili yɛ ndurum, ɛhhyɛle yɛ so, yeɛ ellele ebiala nikye fee.” 5Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, AWURADE te ɛmɔ danzeniɛ, yeɛ ye sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne koso ɔte ɛmɔ danzeniɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔ nikye fee oollili me berɛ.” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ɔte danzeniɛ.”
6 Na Samuel sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “AWURADE bɔ ɔneaneane nu yele Mose ne Aarɔn, ná ɔfale ɛmɔ nana mɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, ɔte danzeniɛ. 7Yiti ɛmɔɔgyina wa, maa mmɔ ɛmɔ kwaadu wɔ AWURADE nyunu, wɔ paayɛlɛ mukoraa bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ama ɛmɔ ɔne ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne anwo. 8 Mmerɛ bɔ Yakob hɔle Misraim ne, [Misraimfoɛ hyɛle bɛ so] ɛmɔ nana mɔ sũ frɛle AWURADE, na AWURADE somane Mose ne Aarɔn maa bɛɛyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ befili Misraim, na ɔmaa bɛɛtenane wa. 9 Nakoso bɛmane bɛ wora fili AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ; yiti ɔfale bɛ wurale Hasɔ safohene Sisera sa, Filistifoɛ sa, ɔne Moabo hene sa, na sɔ mmenia nemɔ ne bɛ hone koɛ. 10 Afei besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE kyɛ, “Yayɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ yayakyi AWURADE si lilɛ yaaso Baal mɔ ne Astarote mɔ. Nakoso, de yɛ fi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, na yɛkɔso wɔ.’ 11 Na AWURADE somane Yerubaal, Bedan, Yɛfeta ne Samuel; na ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne, ɔpepɛ lele ɛmɔ fili bɛ sa nu maa ɛmɔtenane asomdwee nu. 12 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ hene ɔ, nakoso mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwuni kyɛ Amonfoɛ hene Nahase ɔbaafa koɛ toa ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔsele me kyɛ, ‘Daabi, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛnya ɛhene maa odi yɛ so.’ 13Afei, ɛ́mɔnea, ɛhene bɔ ɛmɔaneanea nu baye ye, bɔ ɛmɔsrɛle ne, ye ɛhe. Ɛ́mɔtie, AWURADE asi ɛmɔ hene wama ɛmɔ. 14Sɛ ɛmɔkosuro AWURADE, ɛmɔkɔso ye, ɛmɔkotie ye dwirɛ, ná mmom ɛmɔandwi bamva AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so, ná ɛmɔ ne ɛhene bɔ odi ɛmɔ so ne bedi AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ si a, ye de okoyie ɛmɔ yé. 15Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔandie AWURADE dwirɛ, ná sɛ ɛmɔtwi bɛfa AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so de a, ye de AWURADE tumi kotua ɛmɔ so kerɛ, kyɛbɔ otuale ɛmɔ nana mɔ so kerɛ ne. 16Yiti ɛmɔɔgyina wa bɛnea sɔ anwanwadeɛ he bɔ AWURADE baayɔ ma ɛmɔ nye nwu ye ɔ. 17Aso nna atokoɔtelɛ mmerɛ ɛhe? Ngɔsrɛ AWURADE maa ɔkɔma agralaa kɔtete, ná wasa wama esue atɔ. Na ɛmɔkonwu ye, ná ɛmɔale bato nu kyɛ ɛmɔayɔ amumuyɛɛ piri wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kyɛ ɛmɔabisa maa wasi hene wama ɛmɔ ɔ.” 18Yiti Samuel srɛle AWURADE, na AWURADE mane agralaa tetele, yeɛ ɔmane esue koso tɔle sɔ kyẽa ne ala. Na maen ne amukoraati surole AWURADE ne Samuel paa. 19Na maen ne mukoraa sele Samuel kyɛ, “Srɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ma wɔ ngoaa ná yanwuwu, ofikyɛ ɛhene bɔ yabisa yale nwo amumuyɛɛ ne, yafa yafoa yɛ bɔne amukoraa so.” 20Na Samuel sele maen ne kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro. Ɛmɔayɔ amumuyɛɛ he amukoraa de, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi AWURADE si lilɛ, na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa bɛso AWURADE. 21 Yeɛ nningyein mbaen mbaen bɔ mvasoɛ nne so, anaa bɛngora benne ngoa ne, nnɛma ɛmɔdi makyebu bekodi bɛ si, ofikyɛ bɛte mbaen. 22 Na ɔnate AWURADE dumaa piri ne ati, ɔngɔye ye sa ngofi ye mmenia bo, ofikyɛ ɔyɛle AWURADE fɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ kɔyɛ ye mmenia ɔ. 23 Yeɛ me koso, ɔngɔwa ye sɔ le, kyɛ ngɔyakyi ɛmɔ nwo mbaeɛbɔlɛ maa ɔnate so ngɔyɔ bɔne ngotia AWURADE ɔ. Atee bɔ ɔte paa ná ɔtengyɛ ne yeɛ ngohyirehyire ɛmɔ ɔ. 24 Ɛ́mɔnea nningyein mbiri mbiri bɔ wayɔ wama ɛmɔ ɔ. Esurolɛ mmom yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE, ná ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa bɛso ye nahorɛ nu ɔ. 25Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔtoa so bɛyɔ bɔne a, ye de, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ hene ne, ɛmɔ boso konua.”

Title: 1 SAMUEL 13
Content:
Filistifoɛ fa koɛ toa Yisrael bieku
1Sɔɔlo lili hene ne, né wali kɔbo afoɛ [aburasa], na olili Yisrael so hene afoɛ nyɔ. 2Sɔɔlo neaneane Yisrael maen ne anu yele mmienzua apee nza. Bɛ nu apee nyɔ ne Sɔɔlo hɔle Mikimase ne Betel mmokaa aseɛ so, yeɛ apee ko koso ne Yonatan bɛhɔle Gibea bɔ ɔwɔ Benyamin. Na koɛhonɛfoɛ ngaa ne de, ɔmaa besa bɛhɔle b’awuro. 3Filistifoɛ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Geba ne, Yonatan lili so ngonim, na Filistifoɛ tele sɔ dwirɛ ne. Sɔɔlo maa behuli awɛen wɔ aseɛ ne aso amukoraa besele kyɛ, “Hebrifoɛ ee, ɛ́mɔtie oo!” 4Yisrael amukoraa tele kyɛ Sɔɔlo ali Filistifoɛ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ ne aso ngonim. Besa bɛtele kyɛ Filistifoɛ afɛ Yisrael so yaa paa, yiti Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛɛbokale Sɔɔlo so wɔ Gilgal.
5Filistifoɛ boaboale bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtoa Yisrael. Bɛfale teaseɛnam apee aburasa, pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ apee nzia, ɔne koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ mboanoa anweaa ɔ. Bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Mikimase, wɔ Bete Awen eyia afiteleɛ. 6Yisraelfoɛ nwuni kyɛ koɛ ne anu ayɛ se ama bɛ, (ofikyɛ né Filistifoɛ ama koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ ali amia). Na bɛɛfeafeale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu, ngumaa nu, nyɔbotaen nu, asieleɛ ne abura mɔ nu. 7Hebrifoɛ biemɔ pɛle asue Yɔɔdan bɛhɔle Gade ne Gileade aseɛ so. Né Sɔɔlo tɛ wɔ Gilgal, na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛfale ahunundetelɛ belili ye si.
Sɔɔlo di ye ti piri bɔ afɔleɛ
8 Kyɛbɔ Samuel hyɛle Sɔɔlo ne, Sɔɔlo nwondɛle ɛlɛsoo, nakoso Samuel amma Gilgal, na koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ hyɛle ye bo kyɛ bɛyakyi Sɔɔlo nu bɛkɔ. 9Yiti Sɔɔlo sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne asomdwee afɔleɛ ne bɛbrɛ me.” Na ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne. 10Ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne yiele pɛ, berɛ ne ala, Samuel nyunu ɛhe. Na Sɔɔlo hɔle kyɛ ɔkwaayia ye yɛ ye akwaaba. 11Yeɛ Samuel bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nikye yeɛ ayɔ ye?” Na Sɔɔlo buale kyɛ, “Nwuni kyɛ mmenia ne bɛ́yakyi me nu bɛ́kɔ. Wɔ koso mmerɛ bɔ ɛhyɛ tole berɛ ne, amma, yeɛ afei Filistifoɛ koso baboa bɛ noa wɔ Mikimase. 12Yiti nzusuli kyɛ, ‘Afei de, Filistifoɛ kɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa me wɔ Gilgal, yeɛ AWURADE berɛ mmokalɛ koso nnya nnzrɛle.’ Yiti ɔmaa nnili me bɔbɔ me ti piri mmɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne.” 13Na Samuel sele ye kyɛ, “Ali ngwaseasɛm! Anni AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa bɔ ɔhyɛ mane wɔ ne aso. W’ahennie ne, ahaa AWURADE kɔma ye bo kotimu wɔ Yisrael daa, 14 nakoso kekesaala ye de, w’ahennie ne ngogyina. AWURADE apena sona bɔ ɔla ye ahone nwo ɔ, na AWURADE afa ye ali ye maen so hene, ofikyɛ anni edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle wɔ ne aso.” 15Na Samuel fili Gilgal sili nu hɔle. Afei koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ baha berɛ ne, belili Sɔɔlo si bɛɛbokale bɛ mmango nemɔ aso. Na befili Gilgal bɛhɔle Gibea bɔ ɔwɔ Benyamin. Sɔɔlo hale koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ baha ye nwo berɛ ne, na né bɛ somaa te mmienzua kɔyɛ ɛyaa nzia. 16Sɔɔlo ne ɔwa Yonatan ne koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ baha bɛ nwo berɛ ne, bɛtenane Geba bɔ ɔwɔ Benyamin, yeɛ Filistifoɛ koso kyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Mikimase. 17Mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ apaa kure nza fili Filistifoɛ asikyeleɛ ne anu dɔ wale: kure ko fale ye nye hyirele Ofra hɔle Soale aseɛ so; 18kure bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne fale ye nye hyirele Bete Horon, yeɛ kure bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne koso, ɔfale ye nye hyirele ɛwɛen bɔ ɔla Seboyim bɔnza ne anwuro dɔ ne, bɔ opingye ɛserɛ ne.
19Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né buralɛ dwumvoɛ biala nne Yisrael aseɛ so nekaa biala, ofikyɛ Filistifoɛ hane kyɛ, “Yɛmbena kyɛ Hebrifoɛ bɛbɔ ngrandɛ anaa pealɛɛ ɔ.” 20Yiti né ɔyɛ a, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔ Filistifoɛ mɔ dɔ maa besi bɛ kona, esonyi, akumaa ne dadeɛ koateɛ bɛma bɛ. 21Né sɛ besi kona ne esonyi biala a, bede ɛdwetɛ sekel nza nu ngyɛmuɛ nyɔ; yeɛ sɛ besi akumaa ne buralɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛka ngaka koso a, bede ɛdwetɛ sekel nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko. 22Yiti kyẽa bɔ koɛ ne sili ne, ɛlɔen bɔ né bɛwɔ Sɔɔlo ne Yonatan nwo berɛ ne, né bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ole ngrandɛ anaa pealɛɛ ɔ; sana Sɔɔlo ne Yonatan angome yeɛ né bele bie ɔ.
23Na Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure ko fale Mikimase atee ne aso bɛɛtɛle dɔ.

Title: 1 SAMUEL 14
Content:
Yonatan ahoneserɛ
1Ɛlɛho bie, Sɔɔlo awa Yonatan sele ye somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne kyɛ, “Filistifoɛ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne asi dɔ ne, maa yɛhɔ dɔ.” Nakoso Yonatan ammɔ ɔse Sɔɔlo amaneɛ. 2Né Sɔɔlo akyekye asikyeleɛ wɔ Gibea tiwaa, wɔ akengaa bɔ ɔwɔ Migron ne abo. Né koɛhonɛfoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nzia boka ye so. 3Né Ahiya boka bɛ so wɔ berɛ. Ye yeɛ né owura ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne ɔ. Ɔse ole Yikabode aliɛma Ahitubo, bɔ ɔse ole Finehase, bɔ ye koso ɔse ole AWURADE sɔfo Eli bɔ né ɔwɔ Silo ne. Né koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ nze kyɛ Yonatan afi berɛ ahɔ ɔ. 4Atee bɔ Yonatan fale so kyɛ ɔ́kɔ Filistifoɛ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ ne anu dɔ ne, né nyɔbotaen bɔ ye noa te nnaennaen wɔ ye bɛen, yeɛ ko koso wɔ ye famaa. Ko dumaa li Bosese, yeɛ ko wora li Sene. 5Nyɔbotaen ne ko wɔ atee ne sorɔ, wɔ Mikimase ndendeneɛ so, yeɛ ko wora wɔ ye ngwaen, wɔ Geba ndendeneɛ so.
6Na Yonatan sele ye somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne kyɛ, “Sɔ bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ hemɔ, bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ ne, maa yɛpɛ bɔnza ne yɛhɔ dɔ. Ebiaa AWURADE kɔho kɔma yɛ, ofikyɛ nikye fee nzi AWURADE ate kyɛ ɔkɔfa mmenia pee anaa kãa bie so koli ngonim ɔ.” 7Na somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne buale kyɛ, “Bɔ adwene ye nwo biala, yɔ. Bɔ ɛkɔyɔ biala, mefoa so.” 8Yeɛ Yonatan sele kyɛ, “Yɛkɔpɛ nu yɛkɔhɔ sɔ mmenia nemɔ dɔ maa bekonwu yɛ. 9Na sɛ bɛka bekyire yɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔgyina dɔ maa yɛɛto ɛmɔ berɛ’ a, ye de yɛkogyina yɛ boso berɛ, na yɛngɔfo ngɔhɔ bɛ dɔ. 10Nakoso sɛ bɛka kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfo bɛbra yɛ wa’ a, ye de yɛkɔfo kɔhɔ, ofikyɛ okyire kyɛ AWURADE afa bɛ awura yɛ sa. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma yɛ ɔ.” 11Yiti bɛ munyɔ bɛmane Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ nwuni bɛ. Na Filistifoɛ sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, Hebrifoɛ befi ngumaa bɔ baafeafea nu nemɔ anu béfitefite.” 12Na koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu ne, bɛteane nu besele Yonatan ne ye somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ de, ɛ́mɔfo bɛbra wa, na yɛkohyire ɛmɔ nworɛ!” Na Yonatan sele ye somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne kyɛ, “Di me si, ofikyɛ AWURADE afa bɛ awura Yisrael sa.” 13 Afei Yonatan kongone fole bokaa ne, na ye somvoɛ bɔ otira ye akodeɛ ne koso lili ye si.
