Gyata nemɔ kũkũ bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛnze aseɛ ne aso nyameɛ ne, ye mmeraa.” 27Yeɛ Asiria hene hyɛle kyɛ, “Asɔfo nemɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyele bɛ bɛfale bɛ befili Samaria ne, ɛ́mɔma bɛ nu ko ɔhɔ dɔ ɔɔtena dɔ, ná ohyirehyire mmenia nemɔ aseɛ ne aso nyameɛ ne, ye mmeraa.” 28Yiti asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛfale bɛ befili Samaria ne, bɛ nu ko hɔle ɔɔtenane Betel, na ohyirehyirele bɛ kyɛbɔ besi bɛsɔne AWURADE ɔ.
29Nakoso maen maen ahoroɔ bɔ baatena berɛ ne, bɛ nu biala hɔle so bɛyɔle bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ. Begyinagyinane bɛ wɔ mmosoen sua nu wɔ asɔneyɛɛ bɔ Samariafoɛ nemɔ besisili nemɔ aso. Maen biala anu ama yɔle bɛ deɛ wɔ kuro bɔ bɛte so ne aso: 30Babilɔnfoɛ yɔle bɛ nyameɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Sukote Benote; Kutefoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Negal Hamatefoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Asima; 31Awifoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ mɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Nibase ne Tatake. Sefawimfoɛ yerale bɛ mma mɔ wɔ see nu bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Sefawim nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Adramelɛke ne Anamelɛke. 32Besa bɛsɔnene AWURADE, na bɛneaneane bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nu bɛyele mmenia ahoroɔ maa bɛyɛle asɔfo wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso. Sɔ asɔfo nemɔ bobɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane bɛ wɔ bosoen sua nemɔ anu wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso. 33Bɛsɔnene AWURADE de, nakoso bɛsole bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mmosoen mɔ kyɛbɔ maen maen bɔ bɛfale bɛ befili nu bɛwale nemɔ, bɛyɔ ne ala. 34Ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, bɛtɛ yɔ b’amammerɛ daa nemɔ. Benzuro AWURADE. Afei Yakob bɔ AWURADE tole ye dumaa Yisrael ne, AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa mane ye bosofoɛ ne, sɔ maenmaensofoɛ nemɔ benni so. 35Né AWURADE ne Yakob boso ama nemɔ bayɛ apam, na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsɔne nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔkoto bɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔso bɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma bɛ. 36Na mmom ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE, bɔ ole tumi piri ne tumi asaa yele ɛmɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne. Odi kyɛ ye yeɛ ɛmɔkoto ye ná ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma ye ɔ. 37AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔhyerɛ mane ɛmɔ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea bedi so daa. Nnɛma ɛmɔsɔne nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ. 38Nnɛma ɛmɔ wora fi apam bɔ mene ɛmɔ yɛle ne. Nnɛma ɛmɔsɔne nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ; 39na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, na okole ɛmɔ kofi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛ sa nu.” 40Nakoso bandie, na mmom bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye daa ne ala.
41Yiti sɔ maen maen nemɔ sɔnene AWURADE de, nakoso besa bɛsole b’amoen mɔ bɔ base ɔ. Ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, bɛ mma mɔ ne bɛ nnomaa mɔ, bɛtɛ yɔ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ yɔle ne ala.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 18
Content:
Hesekia di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 29.1-2; 31.1)
1Yisrael hene Ela ɔwa Hosea lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nza ne anu, Yuda hene Ahase ɔwa Hesekia lili hene. 2Hesekia lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu, na olili hene afoɛ aburanyɔ ne ngona wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Sakaria awa Abi. 3Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye Nana Dawide yɔle ne ala. 4Otutuli asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ abo, obubuli bonima nemɔ, na ɔpepɛle Asera dosii nemɔ guale. Kɔɔbere ewoo bɔ Mose yɔle ne, obubuli nu. Ofikyɛ ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisraelfoɛ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ kɔɔbere ne aso bɛsɔne ye: né bɛfrɛ ye Nehustan. 5Hesekia fale ye nwo tole AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ so. Ye sɔ ne ati Yuda ahemvo bɔ belili ye nyunu bɛtenane bia so, ɔne bɛ bɔ ye wue asi bɛtenane bia so ne, bɛ nu biala ɔnne berɛ bɔ ɔsole Nyameɛ kyɛ ye ɔ. 6Ofikyɛ olili AWURADE si yé. Wandwe ye nwo wamvi AWURADE nwo, na mmom olili AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa mane Mose ne aso. 7Nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔle ne, oyiele ye yé ofikyɛ AWURADE gyinane ye si. Ɔyɛle Asiria hene nwo lɔen, na wanzo ye. 8Olili Filistifoɛ so ngonim alaa maa oodwuli Gasa ne ye mbɔtam. Olili nguro mmaa mmaa ne nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ so ngonim.
9Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nna ne aso, né Yisrael hene Ela ɔwa Hosea olili Yisrael hene ɔ, ye afoɛ nzoo ɛne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Asiria hene Salmanese fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Samaria. Otuale kuro ne, 10na afoɛ nza sone ne, olili kuro ne aso ngonim. Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nzia ne aso, né Hosea lili Yisrael hene ɔ, afoɛ ngona ɛne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ Salmanese lili Samaria so ngonim ɔ. 11Asiria hene soale Yisraelfoɛ hɔle Asiria, na ɔmaa bɛɛtenane Hala, asue Habo bɔ ɔla Gosan ne anoa, ɔne Medese nguro nemɔ aso. 12Sɔ dwirɛ ne tole Yisraelfoɛ, ofikyɛ bandie AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, na mmom bebuli ye apam so. Bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle ne amukoraa, bandie, na banni so.
Senakeribo fa koɛ kɔtoa Yuda
13Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ buru ne nna ne anu, Asiria hene Senakeribo fale koɛ ɔɔtoale Yuda nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne amukoraa, na olili bɛ so ngonim. 14Yuda hene Hesekia somane maa bɛhɔle Asiria hene berɛ wɔ Lakise beesele ye kyɛ, “Mayɔ bɔne. Yakyi koɛ bɔ afa atoa mene, na ɛtoɔ biala bɔ ɛkɔpɛ kɔma me kyɛ ndua ne, ngotua.” Yiti Asiria hene pɛle ɛdwetɛ kilo apee buru ne esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo apee ko mane Yuda hene Hesekia kyɛ otua. 15Na ɛdwetɛ bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ amukoraa, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ ahemvie berɛ nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne amukoraa, Hesekia sesale ɔɔmane ye. 16Sɔ mmerɛ ne, esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nemɔ anwo ne, ɔne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ Yuda hene Hesekia wafa waboro aponnwaa nemɔ anwo ne, ɔwɔngyewɔngyele ɔfa ɔɔmane Asiria hene. 17Nakoso Asiria hene somane ye mbanyi bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Tatan, Rabosari ne Rabesake maa bɛ ne koɛhonɛfoɛ pee befili Lakise bɛhɔle Nana Hesekia berɛ wɔ Yerusalem. Beedwuli Yerusalem ne, bɛfo beegyinane dodobɛen bɔ nzue tengyɛ fa nu kogua sorɔ dɔ ɛkwaa bɔ ɔwɔ atapoɛ atee so ne anwo. 18Bɛsomane kyɛ bɛfrɛ Nana Hesekia bɛma bɛ nen, Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ɔne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛwale ɔ.
19Yeɛ Rabesake ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire Hesekia kyɛ, Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, obisa wɔ kyɛ, Nzikyɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato so bɔ wamaa asi wɔ hue sɔ ne? 20Ɛnwa nzɛ bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bɛko koɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so bɔ yiti yeɛ ayɛ me nwo lɔen ye? 21Tie, Misraim yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ɔ? Ɔte kyɛ pɔmaa bɔ onzo ɔ, na ebiala bɔ okokisa ye ne, okobu kɔwɔ ye sa nu. Sɔ yeɛ Misraim hene Faro fa di ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto ye so ɔ. 22Nakoso ebiaa ɛmɔkɔhã bekohyire me kyɛ, ‘Yafa yɛ nwo yato AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ so.’ Aso nna ye asɔneyɛɛ mɔ ne afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ yeɛ Hesekia wabubu bɛ ye? Aso Hesekia wanga wangyire Yuda ne Yerusalem kyɛ, Afɔleɛ bokyea he bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, so yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne ɔ’? 23Bra ná ɛne me mene Asiria hene bɛyɛ nhyehyɛleɛ: sɛ ekonya bɛ nwo pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ a, ahaa ngɔma wɔ mbɔngɔ apee nyɔ. 24Me mene safohene mmaa mmaa nemɔ po, ɛyɛ sɛ né ahora agyina bɛ nu ko nyunu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ Misraim teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato bɛ so ɔ? 25Afei koso, aso nna AWURADE yeɛ wagyina me si kyɛ mva koɛ mandoa kuro ye ná nzɛkye ye ɔ? AWURADE sele me kyɛ, fa koɛ kɔteta kuro ne ná sɛkye ye.”
26Yeɛ Hilkia awa Eliakim, Sebena ɔne Yoa besele Rabesake ne kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa, yɛsrɛ wɔ, kã edwirɛ ne kyire yɛ wɔ Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ yɛte Aramaeke. Nnɛdwudwo kyire yɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ fasue ne aso ne, bɛkɔte bɔ ɛkã ne.” 27Nakoso Rabesake ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Aso wɔ ne wɔ mene ne angome ti yeɛ me mene somane me kyɛ mangã edwirɛ he ɔ? Mmenia hemɔ bɔ bɛtete fasue ne aso ne bɛboka so, ofikyɛ bɛ koso edwirɛ kɔto bɛ maa bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ bondua ná bano bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mmien kyɛ ɛmɔ ala.”
28Yeɛ Rabesake ne dwɔsole teane nu serɛserɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, ye noa dwirɛ! 29Nana nwa nyoo: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔngɔhora ɔngɔpepɛ ngole ɛmɔ ngofi me sa nu. 30Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so, ná ɛmɔka kyɛ, AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole yɛ, na ɔngɔfa sɔ kuro ye ngowura Asiria hene sa. 31Nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ Hesekia so, ofikyɛ Asiria hene nwa: Ɛ́mɔfite bɛbra ná ɛmɔɔli ɛmɔ ti dwirɛ wɔ me berɛ, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wanya ye bɔbɔ ye fieso aleɛ wali, na wanya ye bɔbɔ ye abura nu nzue wano, 32kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ngɔɔsesa ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ye ala so ɔ. Aseɛ bɔ nningyein hemɔ wɔ so ɔ: aburoo ne nzaa, aleɛ ne bobe boo mɔ, olive ngoo ne woɛ, amaa ɛmɔanya ngoa ná ɛmɔanwuwu. Sɛ Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ kyɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole ɛmɔ a, nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ ye so. 33Maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, aso bɛ nu biala wahora wale ye aseɛ wafi Asiria hene sa nu le? 34Hamate ne Apade nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Sefawim, Hena ne Yiwa nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Bahora bapepɛ bale Samaria bafi me sa nu anaa? 35Maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ amukoraa, bɛ nu beni yeɛ wahora wapepɛ wale ye maen wafi me sa nu ɔ. Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛdwene kyɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem kofi me sa nu ɔ.”
36Nakoso Yudafoɛ yɛle konn bɔ bammua ye ɔ, ofikyɛ Hesekia bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ nnɛmaa bebua ye nwo bie. 37Yeɛ Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, besunzuale bɛ ndaadeɛ nu, na bɛhɔle Hesekia berɛ bɛɛfale Rabesake ne dwirɛ ne bɛbɔle ye amaneɛ.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 19
Content:
Hesekia susu ye dwirɛ nwo kyire Yesaya
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 32.20-23; Yesaya 37.1-7)
1Nana Hesekia tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, osunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye ndaadeɛ nu, ɔherale ɛsɛen tena, na ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ. 2Ɔsomane Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi mɔ maa bɛhɔle Amoso awa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya berɛ. Bɛherale ɛsɛen tena yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ. 3Besele ye kyɛ, “Hesekia nwa: Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye te aworabɔlɛ, asohwenɛ ne animguaseɛ kyẽa. Mmrasua nemɔ afo aworɛ so, nakoso bennya anwoserɛ bɛmva bɛndwe bɛ nwo. 4Edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ Rabesake ne, ye mene Asiria hene wafa wasoma ye kyɛ ɔfa ɔɔgoro Nyameɛ teasefoɛ nwo ne, ebiaa AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wate. Na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔhwe ye so wɔ edwirɛ bɔ wate ne anwo. Yiti mbaeɛ bɔ ɛbɔ ma yɛ bɔ yaha ne, ma nu ɔ́yɛ se.” 5Hesekia ye mbanyi nemɔ hɔle Yesaya berɛ ne, 6Yesaya sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire ɛmɔ mene kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa: Musue dwirɛ bɔ Asiria hene ye mbanyi baha batia me maa ate ne, nnɛmaa wɔ kunu tete wɔ wɔ ye nwo. 7Me bɔbɔ ngɔfa ahunundetelɛ adwene bie ngowura ye ti anu. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔte ngraa bie bɔ ɔkɔmaa okosa ye si kɔhɔ ye kuro ɔ. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔtɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye maen nu.’ ”
Asiria hene nwunanwuna Yudafoɛ
(Yesaya 37.8-20)
8Afei Rabesake ne tele kyɛ Asiria hene wafi Lakise. Na osale ye si hɔle nen, onwuni kyɛ Asiria hene wafa koɛ waateta Libina. 9Mmerɛ bɔ Asiria hene tele kyɛ Yitiopia hene Tihaka waboaboa ɛlɔen noa ɔbaafa koɛ toa ye ne, otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle Yuda hene Hesekia berɛ. 10Ɔmaa beesele Hesekia kyɛ, Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ne, nnɛmaa ɔlakalaka wɔ, ná ɔhyɛ wɔ bɔ kyɛ ɔngɔfa Yerusalem ngowura Asiria hene sa. 11Tie, nna ate bɔ Asiria hene mɔ bafa bayɔ maen maen amukoraa ɔ? Ate kyɛ bahũhũ bɛ pasaa ne? Aso ebie kɔpepɛ kole wɔ anaa? 12Maen maen mɔ bɔ me nana mɔ bɛbɔle bɛ, bɔ bɛ ole Gosan, Haran ne Resefe ne Edenfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Telasa ne, aso sɔ maen nemɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɛhora bɛpepɛ belele bɛ? 13Hamate hene, Apade hene, kuro Sefawim hene, Hena hene, ɔne Yiwa hene, bɛwɔ nisua?
Hesekia bɔ mbaeɛ
14Hesekia sa hane krataa ne fili ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ berɛ, na ɔkengale. Afei ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ, na ɔtrɛle krataa ne anu wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 15Na Hesekia bɔle mbaeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ bɔ ɛte w’ahennie bia so wɔ kɛrubim mɔ b’afia ɔ, wɔ wiase ahennie amukoraati nu, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ. Wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ɔ. 16Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, tie ná nea. Ao AWURADE, tie edwirɛ bɔ Senakeribo ɔkã ɔ, bɔ wafa wasoma kyɛ bɛfa bɛɛgoro Nyameɛ teasefoɛ nwo ɔ. 17Ao AWURADE, ɔte amba kyɛ Asiria ahemvo mɔ babɔ maen maen mɔ tɔɔ. 18Bagyi maen maen nemɔ bɛ nyameɛ ne bagua see nu, ofikyɛ bɛ de bɛtte nyameɛ biala, na mmom bɛte kuro sona sa noa adwuma bɔ wafa bakaa ne nyɔboɛ wayɔ ɔ. Ye sɔ ne ati basɛkye bɛ. 19Yiti afei, ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de yɛ fi ye sa nu, amaa ɔnate so aseɛ ye aso ahennie amukoraa banwu ye kyɛ AWURADE, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ.”
Yesaya ma Hesekia te ndɛenvɛen
(Yesaya 37.21-38)
20Yeɛ Amoso awa Yesaya somane maa beesele Hesekia kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa, ‘Mate wɔ mbaeɛ bɔ abɔ ahyire me afa Asiria hene Senakeribo nwo ne. 21Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã afa ye nwo ɛhe:
‘Sion awa brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le ne,
obu wɔ animtia, yeɛ ɔgoro wɔ nwo;
Yerusalem awa brasua ne,
ɔsere ɔbɔ wɔ tutue di wɔ si.
22‘Nwa yeɛ agoro ye nwo ná abɔ ye alapaa ne?
Nwa yeɛ adwudwo atia ye,
bɔ ama wɔ nye atra wɔ ndo nwiaa ye?
Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne yeɛ ayɔ ɛhe atia ye ɔ!
23Ɛnate wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ so agoro AWURADE nwo,
na ahã kyɛ, Mafa me teaseɛnam pee nemɔ,
mafo mahɔ mmokaa nemɔ ti afia,
mahɔ Lebanon ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu dɔ paa.
Ye sida ndendenn nemɔ,
ɔne ye ɛframmire nyemenenyemene nemɔ, mabubu bɛ magua.
Mahɔ bokaa ne ti afia dɔ paa,
ɔne so ɛhɔayeɛ too ne anu.
24Matutu abura mɔ,
na mano maen maen mɔ bɛ so nzue,
Misraim asue amukoraa bɔ me gya atia nu ne,
mafa me koɛhonɛfoɛ so mamaa bawewe.
25‘Aso ande,
kyɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne ndwenene ye nwo ahyɛ ɔ?
Fi tete yeɛ nikyee bɔ meyɔ ye kekesaala ye ne,
nhyehyɛ ndole berɛ ɔ,
kyɛ nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ,
odi kyɛ ɛsɛkye bɛ maa bɛkakyi kurofoen ɔ.
26Ɔnate sɔ ati so ama nemɔ b’anwoserɛ te kãa,
besuro na bɛ nyunu agua ase;
bakakyi kyɛ eburo ndire,
bɛyɛ mmerɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ bɔ wafifi foforɛ ɔ,
bayɛ kyɛ ndire bɔ wafifi wɔ sua so anwuro ɔ,
bɔ ɔkese ná onnyi ɔ.
27“ ‘Nakoso mese wɔ nyunu ne wɔ si,
mese wɔ hɔlɛ ne wɔ walɛ,
ɔne wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so ne.
28Ɔnate wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so,
ɔne w’anwomasoɛ bɔ mate ne ati,
ngɔfa me kaa ngosina wɔ bonyi anu,
ná matofi wɔ noa nu mafa me nyamaa mawura nu;
na ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi wɔ nye,
ɛkɔfa atee bɔ ɛnate so wale ne aso ekosa kɔhɔ.
29“ ‘Na Hesekia, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma wɔ ɔ: Afoɛ he, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ wafifi wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ okofifi ye si ne. Na afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne, ɛmɔkolua nningyein, ná ɛmɔafa so aleɛ; ɛmɔkolua bobe, na ɛmɔkoli so mmaa. 30Yuda awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛ bo kosa kotira ndii, ná bata pee. 31Bɛ bɔ baha ne bie bɛ boso kɔtrɛ kofi Yerusalem, na bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛ boso kɔtrɛ kofi Sion bokaa ne aso. Asafo AWURADE ye nungunɛhwenɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɛhe ɔ.
32“ ‘Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã fa Asiria hene nwo ɛhe: Ongowura kuro he anu, ɔngɔto agyaen wɔ nu, ɔngɔfa akokyɛm ngɔwa ye nyunu, yeɛ ongotua kuro ye. 33Atee bɔ ɔnate so wale ne, sɔ atee ne ala yeɛ okosa kɔfa so kɔhɔ ɔ. AWURADE nwa Asiria hene ngowura kuro ne anu. 34Ofikyɛ ngɔbɔ kuro he anwo waen ngɔpepɛ ngole ye, ɔnate me bɔbɔ me ti ɔne me somvoɛ Dawide ti.’ ”
Senakeribo ngoguo ne ye wue
35Sɔ kɔngɔen ne ala, AWURADE abɔfo hɔle Asiria asikyeleɛ ne anu oohuhuni koɛhonɛfoɛ apee ɛyaa ko aburawɔtwɛ ne nnu. Aleɛ hyene ne, né efuin ngome yeɛ begua berɛ ɔ. 36Yeɛ Asiria hene Senakeribo fili berɛ hɔle ye kuro, na ɔɔtenane Ninewe. 37Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɔne wɔ ye nyameɛ Nisroke asɔneyɛɛ so ne, ye mma mmienzua Adramelɛke ne Saresa bɛfale ngrandɛ behuni ye, na bɛnwati bɛhɔle Ararate maen nu. Na ɔwa bienzua Esa Hadon lili ye bia.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 20
Content:
Hesekia bɔ anwonyerɛ na osa te apɔ
(Yesaya 38.1-8, 21-22; 2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 32.24-26)
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne, anwonyerɛ bɔle Hesekia bɔ né ɔla awusu ɔ. Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya bɔ ye baba ole Amoso ne, ɔwale Hesekia berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Toto wɔ si yé, ofikyɛ ɛbaawu, na ɛngɔte apɔ.’ ” 2Yeɛ Hesekia fale ye nye hyirele terɛ bɔle mbaeɛ hyirele AWURADE kyɛ, 3“Ao AWURADE, kyɛbɔ mafa m’ahone amukoraa mali wɔ dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ mayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu ne, mesrɛ wɔ, fa wɔ nye to.” Na Hesekia suni hahii. 4Anzana Yesaya ɔbaafi ahemvie aluo berɛ ofite kɔ ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ye kyɛ, 5“Sa wɔ si kɔhã kyire Hesekia bɔ odi hene wɔ me mmenia so ne kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ nana Dawide ye Nyameɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: Matie wɔ mbaeɛ ne, na manwu ɛmoen bɔ ɛte ne. Nahorɛ nu, ngɔsa wɔ anwonyerɛ na ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɛkɔhɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ. 6Ngɔto wɔ ngoa nu afoɛ buru ne nnu. Ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ ne kuro ye ngofi Asiria hene sa nu. Ɔnate me bɔbɔ me ti, ɔne me somvoɛ Dawide ti, ngɔbɔ kuro ye anwo waen.” 7Yeɛ Yesaya sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbrɛ me borɔdoma bɔ babɔ ye kunguma ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa bɛyɛ mbɔmbɔ ne aso, na ɔkɔte apɔ.”
8Yeɛ Hesekia bisale Yesaya kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ yeɛ okyire kyɛ AWURADE kɔsa me anwonyerɛ, ná afei mahɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ɛlɛsa ne aso ɔ?” 9Na Yesaya buale kyɛ, “Nikyee bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ ye nwo bɔ ne, ye nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɔfa kyire wɔ ɛhe: Ekuro kyɛ wawoɛ ɔkɔ ye nyunu agyirɛ buru, anaakyɛ osa ye si agyirɛ buru?” 10Na Hesekia buale kyɛ, “Kyɛ wawoɛ ɔkɔ ye nyunu agyirɛ buru de, ɔnyɛ se, yiti maa osa ye si agyirɛ buru.” 11Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya sũ frɛle AWURADE, na AWURADE mane wawoɛ ne sale ye si agyirɛ buru, wɔ atweleɛ bɔ Nana Ahase sili ne aso.
Ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ fi Babilɔn ba Hesekia berɛ
(Yesaya 39.1-8)
12Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Babilɔn hene Merodake Baladan bɔ ye baba ole Baladan ne, otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ fale krataa ne akyɛdeɛ maa bɛɛmane Hesekia, ofikyɛ né wate kyɛ anwonyerɛ abɔ Hesekia. 13Hesekia lele bɛ nyemene so, na ye sua bɔ osie nningyein hemɔ amukoraa nu ne, obukye hyirele bɛ: ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ, ayirefona ne ngoo paa. Ye koɛhonɛ nningyein sua, ɔne nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ ye sua mɔ bɔ osie nningyein nu ne koso, obukye hyirele bɛ. Na nikye fee nne Hesekia ahemvie berɛ anaa ye ahennie ne anu amukoraa bɔ wamva wangyire bɛ ɔ. 14Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hɔle Nana Hesekia berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ befi nisua yeɛ bɛwale wɔ berɛ ɔ, na b’amaneɛ? Hesekia buale kyɛ, “Befi maen bie anu dedeede yeɛ bɛwale ɔ. Befi Babilɔn.” 15Yesaya bisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ beenwuni ye wɔ w’awuro wa ɔ?” Na Hesekia buale kyɛ, “Banwu nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ m’awuro wa amukoraa, na me sua mɔ bɔ mesie nningyein nu ne, nu nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ mamva mangyire bɛ ɔ.”
16Yeɛ Yesaya sele Hesekia kyɛ, “Tie, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 17Nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ w’ahemvie wa, ɔne agyapadeɛ bɔ wɔ nana mɔ bapena bagua berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye, tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ bɛkɔsoa ye mukoraa bɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn ɔ. AWURADE nwa nyoo, bɛngɔyakyi nikye fee. 18Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ boso ama nemɔ bie, bɛkɔsesa bɛ bɛkɔhɔ, na bɛkɔyɛ bɛ sayɛɛ wɔ Babilɔn hene ahemvie.” 19Yeɛ Hesekia sele Yesaya kyɛ, “AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ahã ahyire mene, ɔte paa.” Ɔhane sɔ, ofikyɛ onyane adwene kyɛ, “Sɛ me mmerɛ so maen ne konya asomdwee, ná edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngosi de a, ye de edwirɛ ye paa nu ɔ.”
Hesekia wue
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 32.32-33)
20Afei Hesekia nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ye koɛhonɛ nu anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔpɛle ɛkwaa fale dodobɛen tole nu mane nzue fale nu hɔle Yerusalem kuro ne anu ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. 21Hesekia toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Manase lili ye bia.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 21
Content:
Manase di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 33.1-20)
1Manase lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ buru ne nyɔ, na olili hene afoɛ aburannu ne nnu wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Hefesiba. 2Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Maen maen mɔ bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ne, musue nningyein bɔ bɛyɔle ne, ye koso ɔyɔle bie. 3Ofikyɛ bosoen asɔneyɛɛ mɔ bɔ ye baba Hesekia obubuli bɛ ne, Manase sa sili. Osisili Baal afɔleɛ mmokyea, na ogyinane Asera dosii, kyɛbɔ Yisrael hene Ahabo yɔle ne ala. Ɔsɔnene ewienu abɔdeɛ amukoraa ná ɔsole bɛ. 4AWURADE awuro bɔ AWURADE hane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, “Yerusalem yeɛ ngɔmaa bɛkɔsɔne me dumaa” ne, Manase sisili mmosoen afɔleɛ mmokyea wɔ berɛ. 5Aluo nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, osisili afɔleɛ mmokyea mane ewienu abɔdeɛ ahoroɔ amukoraati wɔ berɛ. 6Ɔfale ɔwa bienzua bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ see nu. Ɔhɔle abisa, ɔyele ngonyaa, na ɔfale ye nwo bɔle nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne abayifoɛ. Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne pee wɔ AWURADE nyunu fa huli AWURADE ahone. 7Bosoen Asera amoen bɔ osele ne, ɔfa ɔɔpenane AWURADE awuro berɛ; awuro bɔ AWURADE hane ye nwo dwirɛ hyirele Dawide ne ɔwa Solomon kyɛ, “Sɔ awuro he anu, yeɛ Yerusalem bɔ maneanea Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa nu matu masie berɛ ne, berɛ yeɛ me dumaa kɔtena afebɔɔ ɔ. 8Sɛ Yisraelfoɛ bekoli m’ahyɛdeɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ amukoraa so nahorɛ nu, ná bekoli mmeraa bɔ me somvoɛ Mose fa mane bɛ ne amukoraa so nahorɛ nu a, ye de aseɛ bɔ mva mane bɛ nana mɔ ne, mengɔmaa bɛngɔbɔ aya bengofi so ko.” 9Nakoso bandie ye dwirɛ. Manase lakalakale bɛ maa bɛyɔle bɔne bɛtrale maen maen mɔ bɔ AWURADE huhuni bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu nemɔ.
10AWURADE nate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ aso hane kyɛ, 11“Ɔnate kyɛ Yuda hene Manase wayɔ sɔ akyiwadeɛ nemɔ, ná ye bɔne tra Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Kanaan aseɛ so koraka yeɛ ɔbaatena so ne, bɛ bɔne amukoraa, ná afei ɔnate ye mmosoen nemɔ aso wahwehwe Yuda wahɔ bɔne nu ne ati, 12yiti AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa, “Musue bɔ mebaaprapra megua Yerusalem ne Yuda so ne, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte ne, ye kunu kɔte ye. 13Edwirɛ bɔ mmaa ɔtole Samaria ne, ɔne amaneɛ bɔ mmaa ɔtole Ahabo awuro ama ne, ye ala yeɛ ngɔmaa ɔkɔto Yerusalem ɔ. Ngɔbɔ Yerusalem tɔɔ, na ngɔprapra nu mmenia bo kyɛbɔ sona nwunzi talie ye kunu ne ye si ɔ. 14Na me maen ne, bɛ bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, ngɔpo bɛ, ná mafa bɛ mawura bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa. Bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ kaka bɔ obiɛngo kye ye di ɔ, ɔne koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɛkɔma bɛ pɔfoɛ amukoraa. 15Ofikyɛ ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛ nana mɔ fili Misraim bɛwale bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, bayɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ me nyunu ɔ, na bafa bahu m’ahone.”
16Asa koso, Manase hane mogya bɔ odi be ɔ pee guale, kɔpem kyɛ ɔhane mogya guale Yerusalem nekaa biala ɔ. Asora bɔne bɔ ɔhwehwene Yuda hɔle nu maa ɔnate so bɛyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne.
17Afei Manase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ɔ, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. 18Manase toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Turo bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro berɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yusa turo ne, nu yeɛ besiele ye ɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Amon lili ye bia.
Amon di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 33.21-25)
19Amon lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nyɔ, na olili hene afoɛ nyɔ wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Yotebaniɛ Haruse ɔwa Mesulemete. 20Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔse Manase yɔle ne ala. 21Bɔne bɔ ye baba yɔle ne amukoraa, ye koso ɔyɔle bie. Mmosoen bɔ ye baba sole bɛ ne ye koso ɔsole bɛ, na ɔsɔnene bɛ. 22Ɔpole AWURADE ye nana mɔ bɛ Nyameɛ ne, na wandie AWURADE dwirɛ. 23Nana Amon ye mbanyi mɔ bɔle ye nwo porɛ, na behuni Amon wɔ ye awuro. 24Nakoso maen ne anu ama huhuni bɛ bɔ bɛbɔle Nana Amon nwo porɛ ne amukoraa, na maen ne anu ama fale ɔwa Yosia belili hene besili ye gya nu. 25Afei Amon nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, bɔ ɔyɔle ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. 26Besiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye asieleɛ nu wɔ turo bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yusa ne anu, na ɔwa bienzua Yosia lili ye bia.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 22
Content:
Yosia di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 34.1-2)
1Yosia lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ mmɔtwɛ. Olili hene afoɛ aburasa ne ko wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Bosekateniɛ Adaya ɔwa Yedida. 2Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, na atee bɔ ye Nana Dawide fale so sole Nyameɛ ne, so ala yeɛ ye koso ɔfale ɔ. Wammakye wamva famaa anaa bɛen.
Hilkia nwu mmeraa nwomaa ne
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 34.8-28)
3Nana Yosia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, ɔfale ngraa somane Mesulam awa Asalia ɔwa Safan bɔ ye yeɛ ɔte AWURADE awuro berɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne kyɛ, 4“Kɔ ɔsɔfo panyi Hilkia berɛ. Na esikaa amukoraa bɔ fotoɛ so neafoɛ nemɔ badide bafi mmenia ne berɛ bafa bawa AWURADE awuro ne, maa ɔha. 5Adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛnea AWURADE awuro adwuma ne aso ne, maa ɔfa owura bɛ sa. Sɔ mmenia ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa esikaa ne bie betua adwumayɔlɛfoɛ hemɔ bɔ bɛyɔ AWURADE awuro ne yé ne, bɛ kerɛ: 6bakaa dwumvoɛ nemɔ, suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa nyɔboɛ bɛhyehyɛ sua nemɔ. Mmenia bɔ esikaa ne wura bɛ sa ne, maa bɛfa bie bɛtɔ mmakaa ne nyɔboɛ bɔ badwa ɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ awuro ne yé. 7 Nakoso esikaa bɔ bafa bawura bɛ sa ne, onni kyɛ bɛmaa bebu ye nwo ngondaa, ofikyɛ bedi nahorɛ.”
8Yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi Hilkia sele ahyerɛlɛniɛ Safan kyɛ, “Manwu mmeraa nwomaa ne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.” Hilkia fale nwomaa ne mane Safan ne, Safan kengale. 9Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ Safan hɔle Nana Yosia berɛ ɔɔbɔle ye amaneɛ kyɛ, “Esikaa bɔ banwu ye wɔ awuro berɛ ne, wɔ ngoaa mɔ, yafa ye mukoraati yawura mmenia bɔ bɛnea AWURADE awuro berɛ adwumayɔlɛ ne aso ne, bɛ sa.” 10Ahyerɛlɛniɛ Safan bɔle Nana Yosia amaneɛ kyɛ, “Ɔsɔfo Hilkia wafa nwomaa bie wama me.” Afei Safan kengale nwomaa ne hyirele Nana Yosia.
11Nana Yosia tele mmeraa nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ pɛ, osunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye ndaadeɛ nu. 12Yeɛ Nana Yosia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane ɔsɔfo Hilkia, Safan awa Ahikam, Mikaya awa Akibɔ, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Safan, ɔne Nana Yosia somvoɛ Asaya kyɛ, 13“Nwomaa he bɔ banwu ye ne, nu dwirɛ ne, ɛmɔhɔ AWURADE berɛ beebisa bɛma mene maen ne, ɔne Yuda amukoraa. AWURADE afɛ yɛ so yaa piri paa, ofikyɛ yɛ nana mɔ bandie nwomaa he anu dwirɛ, yeɛ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu kyɛ yɛli so ne, banni so.”
14Yiti ɔsɔfo Hilkia, yeɛ Ahikam, Akibɔ, Safan ne Asaya besili nu bɛhɔle ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ brasua Hulda berɛ. Ohu ole Salum bɔ ye baba ole Tikiwa, bɔ ye baba ole Hahase bɔ ɔnea asɔfo mɔ bɛ ndaadeɛ so ne. Né Hulda te Yerusalem borɔnoɛ foforɛ paa ne aso, na berɛ yeɛ bɛhɔle ye berɛ beebisale Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɔ. 15Hulda fa tole bɛ nyunu kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa: Ɛ́mɔhã behyire biaa bɔ ɔsomane ɛmɔ wɔ me berɛ ne kyɛ, 16AWURADE nwa nyoo: nwomaa bɔ Yuda hene akenga ne, ngogyina nu dwirɛ amukoraa so ngɔfa amaneɛ ngɔto maen he ɔne nu ama so. 17Ofikyɛ bapo me, bayera ɛyɛɛ bama nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ, na ɔnate so bafa bɛ sa noa adwuma amukoraa bahu m’ahone. Yiti mafɛ maen ye aso yaa, bɔ m’ahone ngodwo ɔ. 18Nakoso Yuda hene bɔ ɔsomane ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔbisa AWURADE noa dwirɛ ne de, ɛ́mɔhã behyire ye kyɛ, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa: Ɔfa edwirɛ bɔ ate ne anwo ne, 19mmerɛ bɔ ɛtele edwirɛ bɔ nga mvale maen he ɔne nu ama nwo, kyɛ maen ne kɔbɔ ná musue kɔto bɛ ne, ɔnate kyɛ enuni wɔ nwo ná ɛbrɛle wɔ nwo ase wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná afei esunzuale wɔ ndaadeɛ nu, ná esuni wɔ me nyunu ne ati, me koso mate bɔ aha ne. Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛne. 20Yiti tie, ngɔmaa ɛkɔɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ, na ngɔmaa ekowu asomdwee nu kɔɔla wɔ kumaa nu. Na musue amukoraa bɔ ngɔprapra ngogua maen he aso ne, wɔ de engonwu bie.” Besa bɛfale edwirɛ ne bɛɛbɔle Nana Yosia amaneɛ.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 23
Content:
Yosia ma maen ne sɔne Nyameɛ
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 34.3-7, 29-33)
1Afei Nana Yosia tole ye sa frɛle Yuda mbanyi amukoraa, yeɛ Yerusalem mbanyi amukoraa maa beeyiale nu wɔ ye nyunu. 2Na ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ. Ɔne mmenia hemɔ yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ: Yudafoɛ amukoraa, Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa, asɔfo, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne maen ne amu, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire mɔ. Na apam nwomaa bɔ benwuni ye wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, ɔkengale nu dwirɛ amukoraa maa betiele. 3Nana Yosia gyinane simbini ne aso, na ɔyɛle apam wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kyɛ okoli AWURADE si, kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye ahone amukoraa ne ye kra amukoraa koli AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ, ye dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ so; kyɛ apam he anu dwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nwomaa he anu ne, okoli so. Na maen ne amukoraa belele apam ne bɛtole nu kyɛ bekoli so.
4Nana Yosia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane ɔsɔfo panyi Hilkia, asɔfo bɔ belili so nemɔ, yeɛ afei fotoɛ so neafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ bɛnea AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu bɛyeye nningyein hemɔ befite: ngukue amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne Baal, bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne Asera ɔne bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne ewienu abɔdeɛ pembepembe amukoraa ne. Ɔyerale bɛ wɔ Yerusalem kuro ne asi dɔ wɔ Kidron mvofoen ne anu dɔ, na ɔsesale bɛ nzoen hɔle Betel. 5Ahɔmeɛ mɔ bɔ Yuda ahemvo ahyɛ bɛ sɔfo maa bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso wɔ Yuda nguro ne nguro bɔ bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia nemɔ anu ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ né bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛma Baal, eyia, ɛsraen, nzramaa mɔ ne ewienu abɔdeɛ pembepembe amukoraa ne, ɔyele bɛ ali. 6Yosia tuli Asera amoen bo fili AWURADE awuro berɛ. Ɔfa hɔle Kidron bɔnza ne anu wɔ Yerusalem kuro ne asi dɔ, na ɔyerale ye wɔ Kidron bɔnza ne anu. Otini amoen ne muhumuhu, na ɔto petene maen asieleɛ ne aso. 7Asɔneyɛɛ so gyanderafoɛ mmienzua nemɔ, bɛ sua mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ nekaa bɔ mmrasua nemɔ bɛnwo ndena bɛma bosoen Asera ne, Yosia bubuli bɛ guale. 8Ɔboaboale asɔfo nemɔ amukoraa bɛ noa fili Yuda nguro nemɔ anu, na asɔneyɛɛ mɔ bɔ né asɔfo nemɔ bayera ɛyɛɛ wɔ so ne, ɔfale efiɛ hane bɛ, ofi Geba bɔ ɔkwaadwu Beɛ Hyeba. Asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ kuro berɛ amrado Yosua ye pambim ne anoa nu berɛ, bɔ né bɛwɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne bɛen so ne, obubuli bɛ. 9Asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛsɔnene wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso ne de, bamma bɛ ate maa bammɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso wɔ Yerusalem, nakoso bɛmaa belili paanoo kabrɛdi bɔ né bɛ mmango asɔfo nemɔ bedi ne bie. 10Yosia fale efiɛ hane Tofete bɔ ɔwɔ Ben Hinom bɔnza ne anu ne, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wamva ɔwa bienzua anaa ɔwa brasua wammɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see nu wamma bosoen Moleke ko. 11Mbɔngɔ mɔ bɔ Yuda ahemvo (biemɔ) batu bɛ basie berɛ bɛfa bɛsɔne eyia, wɔ AWURADE awuro ne anoa nu berɛ, wɔ sayɛɛ Natan Mɛlɛke sua ne anwo wɔ aluo berɛ ne, ɔyele bɛ fili berɛ, na ɔfale see yerale teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne eyia ne. 12Na afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Ahase aborɔsaen ne aso, bɔ Yuda ahemvo biemɔ yɔle ne, ɔne asɔneyɛɛ mɔ bɔ Manase sisili wɔ AWURADE awuro aluo nyɔ nemɔ anu ne, obubuli bɛ fili berɛ, na ogyili bɔ wabubu ne guale Kidron bɔnza ne anu. 13Asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem eyia afiteleɛ so, wɔ Ewue Bokaa ne ngwaen, bɔ Yisrael hene Solomon osi mane Sidonfoɛ bosoen Asetate bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ, Moabofoɛ bosoen Kemose bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔne Amonfoɛ bosoen Milkom bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ne, Nana Yosia fale efiɛ hane bɛ. 14Obubuli bonima nemɔ anu, yeɛ ɔpepɛle Asera dosii nemɔ anu, na ɔsesale sona mmowue guale nekaa bɔ né mmosoen nemɔ begyigyi ne.
15Afei koso, asɔneyɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Betel, bɔ Nebate awa Yeroboam sili bɔ ɔnate so ɔfa hwehwene Yisrael hɔle bɔne nu ne, Yosia bubuli sɔ asɔneyɛɛ ne ɔne ye afɔleɛ bokyea ne guale. Ɔyerale asɔneyɛɛ ne, na otini ye muhumuhu. Yeɛ ɔyerale Asera dosii ne koso. 16Afei Yosia pɛnene ye nye, na onwuni asieleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ bokaa ne aso ne. Ɔmaa bɛɛsesale sona mmowue befili asieleɛ nemɔ anu bɛwale. Ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, na ɔnate so ɔfale efiɛ hane afɔleɛ bokyea ne. Ɛhe sili kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ sona ne aso hane [wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Yeroboam oogyinane afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo aluolue kyẽa ne,] ɔte ne ala. [Yosia pɛnene ye nye, na onwuni Nyameɛ sona bɔ ɔhyɛle sɔ ngɔm ne ye asieleɛ ne.] 17Na Yosia bisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ ngayeɛ nyɔboɛ yeɛ menwu ye wɔ dɔ ye?” Na kuro berɛ ama buale ye kyɛ, “Nyameɛ sona bɔ ofi Yuda wale, bɔ ɔhyɛle Betel afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ asɛkye ye ne anwo ngɔm ne, ye asieleɛ ɛne.” 18Na Yosia sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ɔla ye kumaa nu dinn; nnɛma ebiala fa ye sa kã ye mmowue ne.” Yiti ye mmowue, ɔne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ofi Samaria wale ne ye mmowue de, bamva bɛ sa banga bɛ. 19Afei koso, mmosoen sua amukoraa bɔ Yisrael ahemvo basisi wɔ Samaria nguro asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso, bɔ ɔnate so bɛfa bewurale AWURADE apue maa ɔfɛle yaa ne, Yosia sɛkyele bɛ kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Betel ne ala. 20Asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso asɔfo amukoraa bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne, ohuhuni bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ aso, na ɔyerale sona mmowue wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Afei osale ye si hɔle Yerusalem.
Yosia ma besa bedi Abɔtra aluolue
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 35.1-19)
21Nana Yosia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛmɔli Abɔtra aluolue ne bɛma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ kyɛbɔ amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ apam nwomaa he anu ne.” 22Ofi maenbulɛfoɛ bɔ bebuli Yisrael maen ne b’aberɛ so bɔ ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔne Yisrael ne Yuda ahemvo amukoraa b’aberɛ so ne, banni Abɔtra aluolue biala bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛhe ɔ. 23Nakoso Nana Yosia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, belili Abɔtra he bɛmane AWURADE wɔ Yerusalem.
24Afei koso, Yosia huhuni nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ nemɔ, na obubuli abusua amoen ne amoen mɔ ne akyiwadeɛ amukoraa bɔ benwuni bɛ wɔ Yerusalem ne Yuda maen ne anu ɔ. Mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ nwomaa bɔ ɔsɔfo Hilkia nwuni ye wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne anu ne, Yosia yɔle sɔ fa lili nu dwirɛ ne aso. 25Ahemvo bɔ belili bia koraka yeɛ Yosia baatena bia so ne, bɛ nu biala ɔnne berɛ bɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose nwomaa ne anu ne, ɔfale ye ahone amukoraa, ye kra amukoraa, ɔne ye anwoserɛ amukoraa lili so kyɛ Yosia ɔ. Na Yosia wue asi ne, ɛhene biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔsole AWURADE kyɛ ye ɔ.
26Nakoso ɛhe amukoraa si ne, AWURADE yaa piri bɔ né wafɛ ye wɔ Yuda so ne, AWURADE ahone andɔ nzue nu, ɔnate nningyein amukoraa bɔ né Manase wayɔ wafa wahu AWURADE ahone ne ati. 27AWURADE hane kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ mapɛ Yisrael asue mafi me nyunu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔpɛ Yuda koso asue ngofi me nyunu ɔ. Yerusalem kuro ye bɔ maneanea nu maye ye, ɔne awuro bɔ ngane kyɛ me dumaa kɔla so ne, mapo bɛ.”
Yosia tɔ wɔ koɛ noa
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 35.20—36.1)
28Afei Yosia nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. 29Ye aberɛ so, Misraim hene Faro Neko hɔle ɔɔbokale Asiria hene wɔ koɛ nu wɔ asue Yufreti nwo. Nana Yosia fale koɛ ɔɔtoale Faro Neko. Nakoso Faro Neko yiale Yosia wɔ Megido ne, ohuni Yosia. 30Yosia ye somvoɛ mɔ soale ye fuin wɔ teaseɛnam nu befili Megido bɛhɔle Yerusalem, na beesiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye asieleɛ nu. Maen ne anu ama yele Yosia awa bienzua Yehoahase, bɛpopale ye ngoo, na bɛfale ye belili hene besili ye baba gya nu.
Yehoahase di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 36.1-4)
31Yehoahase lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nza, na olili hene bosome nza wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Yeremia bɔ ofi Libina ne, ɔwa Hamutal. 32Yehoahase yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ kyɛbɔ ye nana mɔ yɔle ne ala. 33Faro Neko kyekyele ye tole kuku nu wɔ Ribla wɔ Hamate aseɛ so. Wamma wangɔ so wanni hene wɔ Yerusalem, na Faro Neko pɛle ɛtoɔ ɛdwetɛ talɛnde ɛyaa ko, yeɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ talɛnde ko mane Yuda maen ne. 34Faro Neko fale Nana Yosia awa Eliakim sili ye baba gya nu lili hene, na Faro Neko sesane Eliakim dumaa frɛle ye Yehoakim. Nakoso ɔhyele Yehoahase nnure hɔle Misraim, na owuli wɔ dɔ. 35Yehoakim tuale ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ ne mane Faro, nakoso olele ɛtoɔ fili maen ne anu ama berɛ fa tuale ɛtoɔ bɔ Faro wapɛ wama ye ne. Ɔneane maen ne anu ama ebiala ye anwonya so yeɛ ɔfa didele ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ ne fili bɛ berɛ ɔ, na ɔfa mane Faro Neko.
Yehoakim di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 36.5-8)
36Yehoakim lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu, na olili hene afoɛ buru ne ko wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Pedaya bɔ ofi Ruma ne, ɔwa Sebida. 37Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye nana mɔ yɔle ne ala.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 24
Content:
Pɔfoɛ mɔ di Yuda so ngonim
1Yehoakim aberɛ so, Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Yuda. Yehoakim yɛle akoaa Nebukadenesa sa nu afoɛ nza. Afei Yehoakim yɛle ye nwo lɔen. 2Na AWURADE somane koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛlɔen fili Kaldeafoɛ, Siriafoɛ, Moabofoɛ ne Amonfoɛ nu maa bɛhɔle Yehoakim so. Ɔmaa bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Yuda maen ne kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so hane ne, ɔte ne ala. 3AWURADE yeɛ ɔhyɛle sɔ ɛhawo ne maa ɔwale Yuda so ɔ, kyɛ ɔfa ɔpɛ Yuda asue fi ye nyunu, ɔnate Manase bɔne amukoraa bɔ ɔyɔle ne ati, 4ɔne mogya bɔ odi be bɔ ɔhã guale ne ati. Ofikyɛ ɔhane mogya bɔ odi be ɔ guale wɔ Yerusalem nu amukoraa, na né AWURADE ayɛ ye adwene kyɛ ɔngɔfa sɔ bɔne ne ngɔhyɛ. 5Afei Yehoakim nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. 6Afei Yehoakim toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Yehoakyin lili ye bia. 7Misraim hene wamvi ye maen nu wangɔ koɛ ko, ofikyɛ né Babilɔn hene wali Misraim hene so ngonim wafa ye sa wato ye aseɛ so, fi Misraim bɔnza ne anu kɔka asue Yufreti noa.
Yehoakyin di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 36.9, 10)
8Yehoakyin lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ buru ne mmɔtwɛ, na olili hene bosome nza wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Elnatan bɔ ofi Yerusalem ne ɔwa Nehusta. 9Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye baba yɔle ne ala. 10Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa ye lɔen bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Yerusalem, na betuale kuro ne. 11Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa hɔle Yerusalem wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ye lɔen ne begu so betua kuro ne ɔ. 12Na Yuda hene Yehoakyin bɔbɔ ɔfale ye nwo wurale Babilɔn hene sa ole tole nu kyɛ wali ngoguo ɔne oni, ye somvoɛ mɔ, ye safohene mɔ yeɛ ye ahemvie mbanyi mɔ yeɛ bɛyɔle sɔ ɔ. Babilɔn hene lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so mmɔtwɛ ne anu yeɛ ɔhyele ye nnure ɔ.
Babilɔn hene di Yerusalem so ngonim
13Nebukadenesa sesale AWURADE awuro agudeɛ amukoraa, ɔne ahemvie berɛ agudeɛ ne hɔle. Esikaa kɔkorɛ kulie amukoraa bɔ Yisrael hene Solomon maa bɛyɔle beguale AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, ɔbobɔle bɛ. Ɛhe amukoraa sili kyɛbɔ AWURADE hane ne ala. 14Ɔsesale Yerusalem ama amukoraa hɔle: ahemvie mbanyi amukoraa, koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, mmenia apee buru bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ɔ, adwumvoɛ mɔ ne buralɛ dwumvoɛ amukoraa. Sona ko po wanga aseɛ ne aso, sana bɛ bɔ bɛngɔhora ko bɛngora hute nemɔ ala. 15Ɔfale Yehoakyin hɔle Babilɔn, na ɔhyele Yehoakyin maame, ɔye mɔ, ahemvie mbanyi ɔne maen ne anu atitire nemɔ nnure fili Yerusalem hɔle Babilɔn. 16Anwoserɛfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛ somaa te apee nzoo, bakaa dwumvoɛ ne buralɛ dwumvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛ somaa te apee ko, bɔ sɔ mmenia ne amukoraa bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, Babilɔn hene hyele bɛ nnure fa bɛ hɔle Babilɔn. 17Babilɔn hene fale Yehoakyin baba aliɛma Matania sili ye gya nu maa olili hene. Ɔsesane Matania dumaa frɛle ye Sedekia.
Sedekia di Yuda so hene
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 36.11-16; Yeremia 52.1-3)
18Sedekia lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne ko, na olili hene afoɛ buru ne ko wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Yeremia bɔ ofi Libina ne, ɔwa Hamutal. 19Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ Yehoakim yɔle ne ala. 20 Nahorɛ nu, Yerusalem ne Yuda huli AWURADE ahone maa ɔnate so AWURADE pɛle bɛ asue fili ye nyunu.
Na Sedekia yɛle Babilɔn hene nwo lɔen.

Title: 2 AHEMVO 25
Content:
Babilɔn hene bɔ Yerusalem kuro ne
(2 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 36.13-21; Yeremia 52.3-11)
1Sedekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ ngona ne anu, bosome buru ne anu, ye eleburu ne aso, Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa fale ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa ɔɔfale koɛ tetale Yerusalem, na otuale kuro ne. Bɛkyekyele nyinasoɛ bɔ bɛkɔfo so bɛkɔhɔ kuro ne anu ɔ bɛpɛle kuro berɛ fasue ne anwo beyiale. 2Yiti betuale kuro ne ala maa oodwuli mmerɛ bɔ Sedekia nyane afoɛ buru ne ko wɔ bia ne aso ɔ. 3Bosome nna ne anu, ye ɛlɛhona ne aso, ɛhɔen pohonandafe bie bɔ né wawa kuro ne aso ne, nu yɛle se paa bɔ né aseɛ ne aso ama bennya aleɛ benni ɔ. 4Na Babilɔnfoɛ ɛlɔen ne bɛbɔngyele kuro berɛ fasue ne anu tokuro. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né Babilɔn ɛlɔen ne bapɛ kuro ne anwo bayia de, nakoso kɔngɔen, Nana Sedekia ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛnwati bɛfale pambim bɔ ɔwɔ fasue bɔ ɔbɔ ye nwo nyɔ ne anu bɛhɔle. Pambim ne pingye Nana Sedekia turo ne. Bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele asue Yɔɔdan bɔnza ne anu dɔ. 5Nakoso Babilɔn koɛhonɛfoɛ ne, bɛpole Nana Sedekia so bɛɛtole ye wɔ Yeriko aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, na ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛbɔle aya bɛyakyili ye nu. 6Bɛhyele Nana Sedekia bɛfale ye bɛbrɛle Babilɔn hene wɔ Ribla, na obuale ye foɛ. 7Behuhuni Sedekia mma mmienzua bɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nye tua ɔ, na betutuli Sedekia nye. Beguale ye ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɛfale ye bɛhɔle Babilɔn.
Babilɔn sɛkye Yerusalem ne asɔneyɛɛ sua ne
(Yeremia 52.12-23)
8Nebukadenesa lili Babilɔn hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne ngona ne anu, bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne anu, ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, Nebusaradan bɔ ɔte Babilɔn hene awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene, ná osa te ye mbanyi nemɔ anu ko ne, ɔhɔle Yerusalem. 9Ɔyerale AWURADE awuro ne, ahemvie ne, yeɛ Yerusalem sua amukoraa. Ɔyerale sua biala bɔ odi mu ɔ. 10Babilɔnfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa bɔ né bɛboka awɛmvoɛ nemɔ safohene ne aso ne, bebuli Yerusalem nwo fasue ne beguale. 11Mmenia ngaa bɔ baha kuro ne aso ne, ɔne Yuda koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ né banwati bafa bɛ nwo baabɔ Babilɔn hene ne, yeɛ mmenia ne amukoraa, Nebusaradan bɔ ɔte awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene ne, ɔhyele bɛ nnure fale bɛ hɔle. 12Nakoso awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene ne, ɔyakyili aseɛ ne aso mmenia bɔ bɛngɔhora ko bɛngora hute nemɔ bie berɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ bobe boo ne eboo ngaa nemɔ aso adwuma.
13AWURADE awuro berɛ kɔɔbere bonima nemɔ, yeɛ nyinasoɛ nemɔ ne kɔɔbere nzim bɔ bɛwɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, Babilɔnfoɛ bubuli bɛ, na bɛsesale kɔɔbere ne bɛhɔle Babilɔn. 14Bɛsesale ɛhemɔ koso bɛhɔle: ngukue nemɔ, sofi nemɔ, akapɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ kanea nyamaa noa nemɔ, ɛyɛɛ kulie nemɔ, ɔne kɔɔbere nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma, 15yeɛ ngukue bɔ bɛfa see begua nu ɔ ɔne ayaa nemɔ. Nikyee biala bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ne, yeɛ nikyee biala bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ koso, awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene ne sesale hɔle. 16Na bonima nyɔ nemɔ, nzim ko ne, yeɛ nyinasoɛ bɔ Solomon yɔle siesiele AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, sɔ nningyein nemɔ, kɔɔbere bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔle ne, né bɛkari a, bennwu ye noa. 17Bonima ko biala, fi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ buru ne mmɔtwɛ. Né kɔɔbere abotire wɔ so. Abotire ne ko biala, fi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ nza. Né bafa kɔɔbere bali akengaa adwii ne ɛtɛen adwii bapɛ abotire ne anwo bayia. Bonima bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne koso, sɔ ala yeɛ belili adwii beguale ye nwo ɔ.
(Yeremia 52.24-27)
18Nebusaradan bɔ ɔte awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene ne, ɔhyele ɛhemɔ nnure: ɔsɔfo panyi Seraya, Sefania bɔ ɔsɔfo panyi nne berɛ a, yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, yeɛ mmenia nza bɔ bɛwɛne asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa ne. 19Osa hyele ɛhemɔ koso nnure fili Yerusalem: safohene ko bɔ né ɔnea Yuda koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ aso ne, Nana Sedekia foɛtulɛfoɛ nemɔ anu nnu bɔ onwuni bɛ wɔ kuro berɛ ɔ, safohene bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔboaboa maen ne anu koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anoa, yeɛ maen ne anu mmenia aburasia bɔ onwuni bɛ wɔ kuro berɛ ɔ. 20Nebusaradan bɔ ɔte awɛmvoɛ nemɔ aso safohene ne, ɔhyele bɛ nnure fale bɛ ɔɔmane Babilɔn hene wɔ Ribla. 21Babilɔn hene maa befini bɛ mbire, na ɔmaa behuhuni bɛ wɔ Ribla bɔ ɔwɔ Hamate aseɛ so ne. Yiti bɛhyele Yudafoɛ nnure befili bɛ maen nu bɛhɔle.
Bɛfa Gedalia bedi Yuda so amrado
(Yeremia 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22Mmenia bɔ né baha Yuda aseɛ so, bɔ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa yakyili bɛ maa bɛhale berɛ ne, Nebukadenesa fale Gedalia bɔ ye baba ole Ahikam, bɔ ye baba ole Safan ne, olili bɛ so amrado. 23Na Yuda safohene nemɔ amukoraa bɛ ne bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ tele kyɛ Babilɔn hene abɔ Gedalia amrado ne, bɛ ne bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ hɔle Gedalia berɛ wɔ Misepa. Bɛ ole: Netania awa Yismael, Karea awa Yohanan, Netofaniɛ Tanhumete awa Seraya, yeɛ Yaasania bɔ ɔse te Maakatiniɛ ne. 24Gedalia tale ndaen hyirele bɛ ne bɛ mmenia kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro Babilɔn mbanyi nemɔ. Ɛ́mɔtena maen ye anu ná ɛ́mɔso Babilɔn hene, na okoyie ɛmɔ yé.” 25Nakoso bosome nzoo ne anu, Yismael bɔ ɔte dehyeɛ bɔ ye baba ole Netania bɔ ye baba ole Elisama ne, ɔfale mmienzua buru bokale ye nwo so, na beehuni Gedalia ne Yudafoɛ ne Babilɔnfoɛ bɔ né bɛboka ye so wɔ Misepa ne. 26 Yeɛ mmenia ne amu, atitire ne kwahweabaa mɔ, bɛ ne safohene nemɔ bɛnwati bɛhɔle Misraim, ofikyɛ né besuro kyɛ Babilɔnfoɛ kootua bɛ so kerɛ.
Bɛye Yehoakyin befi kuku nu
(Yeremia 52.31-34)
27Bɛhyele Yuda hene Yehoakyin nnure bɛhɔle ne, ye afoɛ aburasa ne nzoo ne anu, bosome buru ne nyɔ ne anu, kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nzoo ne aso, afoɛ bɔ Babilɔn hene Ewile Merodake lili hene ne ala, ɔyele Yuda hene Yehoakyin fili kuku nu. 28Ɔne Yehoakyin belili ngitahoɛ paa, na ahemvo bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ Babilɔn baboka Yehoakyin so ne, ɔmane ye dibea bɔ ɔtra bɛ mukoraa ɔ. 29Yiti Yehoakyin puropurole ye kuku nu ndaadeɛ ne guale wurale ndaadeɛ paa, na mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ né ɔte ase ne, né ɔne Ewile Merodake yeɛ bɛtena poen nwo bedidi ɔ. 30Na Babilɔn hene mane Yehoakyin nikyee bɔ okohia ɔ daa biala bɔ né Yehoakyin te ase ɔ.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Aberɛso Dwirɛ nwomaa nemɔ anu, besa bɛbobɔ edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Samuel ne Ahemvo nwomaa nemɔ anu ne aso. Nakoso bekyire b’adwene wɔ sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ anwo. Yisrael ahennie nwo dwirɛ bɔ Aberɛso Nwomaa nemɔ kã ne, botaeɛ titire nyɔ yeɛ begyi ɔ: (1) Okyire kyɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né amaneɛ atoto Yisrael ne Yuda ahennie de, nakoso né Nyameɛ odi ye bɔhyɛ bɔ wahyɛ ye wɔ maen ne anwo ne aso. Afei ye nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wama ye maen ne, né ɔnate Yudafoɛ so ɔmaa ɔba nu. Mmɔden bɔ Dawide ne Solomon bɛbɔle, ɔne nzesãleɛ bɔ Yehosafate, Hesekia ne Yosia belili nahorɛ bɛyɛ bɛmane Nyameɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne kã ye nwo dwirɛ. (2) Okyire kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ sɔnenɛ bo tindimuni wɔ Yerusalem, ɔne kyɛbɔ né Lewifoɛ ne asɔfo nemɔ besi bɛyɔ bɛ sɔnenɛ adwuma ne ɔ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Solomon yeɛ osili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɔ, nakoso yɛnwu ye kyɛ Dawide bɔbɔ deinn yeɛ ɔhyɛle asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɛsɔnenɛ ne abo ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mɔ 1.1—9.44
Sɔɔlo wue 10.1-14
Dawide ahennie 11.1—29.30
a. Dawide amaneɛ ne ye mmɔdenbɔlɛ 11.1—22.1
b. Dawide boaboa ye nwo kyɛ okosi asɔneyɛɛ sua 22.2—29.30

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 1
Content:
Ofi Adam bɔ ɔkwaadwu Abraham so
(Gyenesise 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
1Adam wole Sɛte; Sɛte wole Enose; 2Enose wole Kenan, Kenan wole Mahalaleel, Mahalaleel wole Yarede; 3Yarede wole Henɔke; Henɔke wole Metusela; Metusela wole Lamɛke, 4Lamɛke wole Nowa; Nowa wole Sem; Sem wole Ham, yeɛ Ham wole Yafɛte.
5Yafɛte mma mɔ ole Gomɛre, Magɔgo, Madai, Yawan, Tubal, Meseke ne Tirase. 6Gomɛre mma mɔ ole Asekenase, Difate ne Togama. 7Yawan mma mɔ ole Elisiha, Tasise, Kitim ne Rodanim.
8Ham mma mɔ ole Kuse, Misraim, Libia ne Kanaan. 9Kuse mma mɔ ole Seba, Hawila, Sabeta, Raama ne Sabeteka. Raama boso ama mɔ ole Hyeba ne Dedan. 10Kuse wole Nimrode. Na Nimrode yeɛ olili moa yɛle katakyie wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.
11Misraim yeɛ ɔwole Ludim, Anamin, Lehabim, Nafetuhim, 12Patrusim, Kasluhim bɔ yeɛ osuli Filistifoɛ ne, yeɛ afei Kafitorim.
13Kanaan wole ye bamuɛbaa Sidon, yeɛ afei Hɛte, 14na Kanaan boso ama ole Yebusifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, Gɛgasifoɛ, 15Hiwifoɛ, Akifoɛ, Sinifoɛ, 16Awadifoɛ, Semarifoɛ, yeɛ Hamatefoɛ.
17Sem mma mɔ ole Elam, Asure, Afakesade, Lude, Aram, Yuse, Hule, Gɛta, yeɛ Meseke. 18Afakesade wole Hyela, na Hyela wole Ebere. 19Ebere wole mmaa mmienzua nyɔ. Ko dumaa li Pɛlɛge (ofikyɛ ye aberɛ so yeɛ aseɛ nu hyehyɛle ɔ), yeɛ oliɛma ne koso li Yoketan. 20Yoketan wole Almodade, Selefe, Hasamawɛte, Yera, 21Hadoram, Yusal, Dikla, 22Ebal, Abimael, Hyeba, 23Ofire, Hawila ne Yobabo. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ amukoraa bɛte Yoketan boso ama.
24Sem wole Afakesade, Afakesade wole Hyela; 25Hyela wole Ebere; Ebere wole Pɛlɛge, Pɛlɛge wole Reo; 26Reo wole Seruge; Seruge wole Nahɔ; Nahɔ wole Tera; 27Tera wole Abram. Abram ala ole Abraham.
Yismael boso ama
(Gyenesise 25.12-16)
28Abraham mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yisake ne Yismael. 29B’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ɛhe: Yismael ye bamuɛbaa ole Nebayote, yeɛ afei ɔwole Kedare, Adebel, Mibesam, 30Misma, Duma, Masa, Hadade, Tema, 31Yeture, Nafise ne Kedema. Yismael mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne. 32Abraham sómaa Ketura, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Simram, Yokesan, Medan, Midian, Yisbake ne Suwa. Yokesan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hyeba ne Dedan. 33Midian mma mmienzua mɔ ole Efa, Efɛre, Hanoke, Abida ne Eldaa. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Ketura boso ama.
Yisɔ boso ama
(Gyenesise 36.1-19)
34Abraham wole Yisake. Yisake mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yisɔ ne Yisrael. 35Yisɔ mma mmienzua mɔ ole Elifase, Rewel, Yeyuse, Yalam ne Kora. 36Elifase mma mmienzua mɔ ole Teman, Omare, Sefi, Gatam, Kenase, Timina yeɛ Amalɛke. 37Rewel mma mmienzua ole Nahate, Sera, Sama ne Misa.
Edom boso ama
(Gyenesise 36.20-30)
38Sɛre mma mmienzua mɔ ole Lotan, Sobal, Sibeon, Ana, Dison, Esere ne Disan. 39Lotan mma mmienzua ole Hori ne Homam; yeɛ Lotan aliɛma brasua ole Timina. 40Sobal mma mmienzua mɔ ole Alian, Manahate, Ebal, Sefi ne Onam. Sibeon mma mmienzua mɔ ole Aya ne Ana. 41Ana mma mmienzua mɔ, ko ole Dison. Dison mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hamran, Eseban, Yitran ne Kyeran. 42Esere mma mmienzua mɔ ole Bilhan, Saawan ne Yaakan. Disan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yuse ne Aran.
43Anzana Yisraelfoɛ bɛbaanya ɛhene maa odi bɛ so ne, ahemvo hemɔ yeɛ belili bia wɔ Edom aseɛ so ɔ: Beɔ awa Bela bɔ ye kuro ole Dinhaba ne. 44Bela wuli ne, Sera bɔ ofi Bosra ne, ɔwa Yobabo yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. 45Yobabo wuli ne, Husam bɔ ofi Temanfoɛ aseɛ so ne, olili ye bia. 46Husam wuli ne, Bedade awa Hadade, bɔ olili Midian so ngonim wɔ Moabo aseɛ so ne, yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. Né ye kuro ole Awite. 47Hadade wuli ne, Samla bɔ ofi Masereka yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. 48Samla wuli ne, Sɔɔlo bɔ ofi Rehobote bɔ opingye asue Yufreti ne, yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. 49Sɔɔlo wuli ne, Akibɔ awa Baal Hanan lili ye bia. 50Baal Hanan wuli ne, Hadade yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. Ye kuro ole Paye, na ɔye ole Mehetabel bɔ oni ole Matrede bɔ ye koso oni ole Mesahabo ne. 51Na Hadade wuli. Edom mmusua mmusua mbanyi nemɔ ɛhe: Timina, Alia, Yetete, 52Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, 53Kenase, Teman, Mibesa, 54Magediɛl ne Yiram: Edom mmusua mmusua mbanyi nemɔ ɛne.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 2
Content:
Yisrael mma ne Yuda boso ama
(Gyenesise 35.22-26)
1Yisrael mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Ruben, Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Yisaka, Sebulɔn, 2Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Nafetali, Gade ne Asɛ. 3Yuda mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Ɛre, Onan ne Hyela; sɔ mmenia nza nemɔ ɔne Kanaanniɛ braa Bate Sua yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ. Na Yuda bamuɛbaa Ɛre, ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte amumuyɛɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, yiti AWURADE huni ye. 4Yuda sia brasua Tamar koso ɔne Yuda bɛwole Pɛrɛse ne Sera. Yiti Yuda mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛte nnu.
5Pɛrɛse mma mmienzua ole Hesron ne Hamul. 6Sera mma mmienzua ole Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkole ne Dara: bɛ mukoraa bɛte nnu. 7Karemi awa Akare yeɛ ɔhwehwene musue wale Yisrael so ne, ofikyɛ nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne, ɔfale bie. 8Na Etan awa ole Asaria.
Dawide nana mɔ ne ye boso ama
9Hesron mma mmienzua bɔ ɔwole bɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yerameel, Ram ne Kyelubae. 10Ram wole Aminadabo, yeɛ Aminadabo koso wole Nason bɔ ɔɔyɛle sona titire wɔ Yudafoɛ nu ne. 11Nason wole Salma, yeɛ Salma wole Boase. 12Boase wole Obɛde, yeɛ Obɛde wole Yese. 13Yese mma nemɔ, bamuɛbaa ole Eliabo, Abinadabo tɔ so nyɔ, yeɛ Simea tɔ so nza, 14Netanɛl tɔ so nna, Radae tɔ so nnu, 15Osem tɔ so nzia, yeɛ Dawide tɔ so nzoo. 16B’eliɛma mmrasua mɔ ole Seruya ne Abigail. Seruya mma mmienzua mɔ te nza: bɛ ole Abisae, Yoabo ne Asahel. 17Abigail ne Yismaelniɛ Yeta bɛwole Amasa. 18Hesron awa Kalebo ne ɔye Asuba bɛwole mmaa, na ɔne Yeriote koso bɛwole: Ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yesere, Sobabo ne Adɔn. 19Asuba wuli ne, Kalebo gyale Efrate, na ɔne ye bɛwole Hure. 20Hure wole Yuri, na Yuri wole Besalel.
21Ye si ye, Hesron ne Gileade baba Makyiri ɔwa brasua ne bɛlale. Hesron lili afoɛ aburasia yeɛ ogyale ye ɔ, na ɔne ye bɛwole Segubo. 22Segubo wole Yari bɔ oolili nguro aburanyɔ ne nza so wɔ Gileade aseɛ so ne. 23Nakoso Gesure ne Aram belele Hawote Yari, yeɛ Kenate ne ye nwo nguro aburasia nemɔ befili bɛ sa nu. Berɛ mmenia nemɔ amukoraa bɛte Gileade baba Makyiri ye boso ama. 24Hesron wuli wɔ Kalebo Efrata. Na ye si ye, Hesron aye Abiya wole Tekoa baba Asure mane ye.
Yerameel boso ama
25Hesron bamuɛbaa Yerameel, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: ye bamuɛbaa Ram, yeɛ Buna, Oren, Osem ne Ahiya. 26Né Yerameel le braa bieku bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Atara. Onam ye maame ɛne. 27Yerameel bamuɛbaa Ram, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Maase, Yamin ne Ekere. 28Onam mma mmienzua mɔ ole Samae ne Yada. Samae mma mmienzua mɔ ole Nadabo ne Abisure. 29Bɛfrɛ Abisure aye ne Abihail, na ɔne ye bɛwole Aheban ne Molide. 30Nadabo mma mmienzua mɔ ole Selede ne Apayim, na Selede wuli bɔ wanwo ba ɔ. 31Apayim awa bienzua ole Yisi. Yisi awa bienzua ole Sesan. Sesan awa bienzua ole Ahelae. 32Samae aliɛma bienzua Yada, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yeta ne Yonatan; na Yeta wuli bɔ wanwo ba ɔ. 33Yonatan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Pelete ne Sasa. Yerameel boso ama mɔ ɛne.
34Sesan wanwo baa bienzua; ɔwole mmrasua ngome. Nakoso né Sesan le Misraimniɛ kanganiɛ bienzua bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yareha ɔ. 35Yiti Sesan fale ɔwa brasua mane ye kanganiɛ Yareha gyale, na ɔne ye bɛwole Ataye. 36Ataye wole Natan, na Natan wole Sabade. 37Sabade wole Efelale, na Efelale wole Obɛde. 38Obɛde wole Yehu, na Yehu wole Asaria. 39Asaria wole Helese, na Helese wole Eleasa. 40Eleasa wole Sisimae, na Sisimae wole Salum. 41Salum wole Yekamia, na Yekamia wole Elisama.
42Yerameel aliɛma bienzua Kalebo, ye mma mmienzua mɔ, Sife baba Mesa yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ. Hebron baba Maresa, ye mma mmienzua koso bɛte Kalebo boso ama. 43Hebron mma mmienzua mɔ ole Kora, Tapua, Rekem ne Sema. 44Sema wole Yorekeam baba Raham, na Rekem wole Samae. 45Samae wole Mayɔn, yeɛ Mayɔn wole Bete Sure. 46Kalebo sómaa Efa wole Haran, Mosa ne Gasese, na Haran wole Gasese. 47Yahedae mma mmienzua mɔ ole Regyem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelete, Efa ne Saafe. 48Kalebo sómaa Maaka wole Sebere ne Tihana. 49Braa ne sa wole Mademana baba Saafe, yeɛ Makebena ne Gibea bɛ baba Sewa. Kalebo ɔwa brasua ole Akesa. 50Kalebo ye boso ama mɔ ɛne. Efrata ye bamuɛbaa Hure, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Sobal bɔ ɔkyekyele Kiriate Yearim ne, 51Salma bɔ osuli Betlehemfoɛ ne, yeɛ Harefe bɔ ɔkyekyele Bete Gadere ne. 52Sobal bɔ ɔkyekyele Kiriate Yearim ne, né ole mmaa mmienzua foforɛ mɔ. Bɛ ole Haroyefoɛ, bɔ bɛte Manahatefoɛ bɛ bue ne. 53Na mmusua mmusua bɔ bɛwɔ Kiriate Yearim ne, bɛ ɛhe: Yitrifoɛ, Putifoɛ, Sumatifoɛ, yeɛ Misirafoɛ. Bɛ boso ama mɔ ole Soratifoɛ ne Esetaofoɛ. 54Salma boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Betlehemfoɛ, Netofafoɛ, Atrote Bete Yoabo, Manahatefoɛ nemɔ bɛ bue, yeɛ Sorifoɛ. 55Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ mmusua mmusua bɔ bɛte Yabese ne, bɛ mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Tiratifoɛ, Simeatefoɛ, yeɛ Sukatifoɛ. Bɛte Kenifoɛ, na bɛ nana ole Hamate bɔ ye boso ama ole Rekabofoɛ ne.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 3
Content:
Dawide boso ama
1Dawide mma bɔ ɔwole bɛ Hebron ne, bɛ ɛhe: ye bamuɛbaa Amnɔn, ɔne Yesreelniɛ Ahinoam yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ole Daniel, na ɔne Kamɛlniɛ Abigail yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ. 2Bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ole Absalom, na ɔne Gesure hene Talmae ɔwa brasua Maaka yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ole Hagite awa Adoniya. 3Bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ole Sefatia, na ɔne Abital yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ; bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ole Yitream, na ɔne ɔye Egla yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ. 4Hebron berɛ bɔ olili hene afoɛ nzoo ne bosome nzia ne, ɔwole mmaa nzia wɔ berɛ. Na olili hene afoɛ aburasa ne nza wɔ Yerusalem. 5Ɔwole mmaa hemɔ koso wɔ Yerusalem: Simea, Sobabo, Natan, Solomon, yeɛ ngwadaa nna bɔ ɔne Amiɛl awa Bate Sua bɛwole bɛ ne, 6yeɛ afei Yibare, Elisama, Elifɛlɛte, 7Noga, Nefege, Yafia, 8Elisama, Eliada, Elifɛlɛte; bɛ mu bɛte ngona. 9Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Dawide mma mmienzua, asora mmaa bɔ ɔne sómaa mɔ bɛwole bɛ ne. Né Tamar te b’eliɛma brasua.
Solomon boso ama
10Solomon boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Ɔwa bienzua Rehoboam wole Abiya; Abiya wole Asa; Asa wole Yehosafate; 11Yehosafate wole Yoram; Yoram wole Ahasia; Ahasia wole Yoase; 12Yoase wole Amasia; Amasia wole Asaria; Asaria wole Yotam; Yotam wole Ahase; 13Ahase wole Hesekia; Hesekia wole Manase; 14Manase wole Amon; yeɛ Amon wole Yosia. 15Yosia mma mɔ ɛhe: Yohanan yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ, Yehoakim tɔ so nyɔ, Sedekia tɔ so nza, yeɛ Salum tɔ so nna. 16Yehoakim mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Yekonia yeɛ Sedekia. 17Yekonia bɔ bɛhyele ye nnure ne, ye mma mɔ ole ɛhemɔ: Sɛtiɛl, 18Malkiram, Pedaya, Senasa, Yekamia, Hosama ne Nedabia. 19Pedaya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Serubabɛl ne Simei, yeɛ Serubabɛl mma mmienzua mɔ ole Mesulam ne Hanania bɔ b’eliɛma brasua ole Selomite ne. 20Osa wole Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia ne Yusabo Hesede: bɛte nnu. 21Hanania mma mmienzua mɔ ole Pelatia ne Yesaya. Yesaya wole Refaya; Refaya wole Anan; Anan wole Obadia yeɛ Obadia wole Sekania. 22Sekania awa bienzua ole Semaya, yeɛ Semaya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hatuse, Yigal, Baria, Nearia ne Safate; bɛte nzia. 23Nearia mma mmienzua mɔ ole Elionae, Hisikia ne Asrikam; bɛte nza. 24Elionae mma mmienzua ole Hodawia, Eliasibo, Pelaya, Akubo, Yohanan, Delaya ne Anani; bɛte nzoo.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 4
Content:
Yuda boso ama mɔ
1Yuda boso ama mɔ ole Pɛrɛse, Hesron, Karemi, Hure yeɛ Sobal. 2Sobal awa Reaya yeɛ ɔwole Yahate ɔ, na Yahate wole Ahumae ne Lahade. Soratifoɛ mmusua mɔ ɛne. 3Etam boso ama mɔ ole Yesreel, Yisma, Yidebase, na b’eliɛma brasua ole Haseleponi. 4Penuel wole Gedɔ, yeɛ Esere wole Husa. Efrata bamuɛbaa Hure, bɔ yeɛ ɔte Betlehemfoɛ bɛ nana ne, ye boso ama mɔ ɛne. 5Né Tekoa baba Asure ogya mmraa nyɔ: Hela ne Naara. 6Ɔne Naara bɛwole Ahusam, Hefa, Temeni ne Hahasetari. Naara mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne. 7Hela mma mmienzua mɔ ole Serete, Yisare ne Etenan. 8Kose wole Anubo ne Sobeba; na Harum awa Ahahel ye abusuafoɛ bɛte Kose boso ama.
9Né Yabese le animnyam tra oliɛma mɔ amukoraa. Ye maame tole ye dumaa Yabese, ofikyɛ ye maame nwa, “Ye aworɛ nu, nwuni amaneɛ paa.” 10Yabese sũ frɛle Yisrael Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Ao, ahaa né ayira me, ná amaa manya aseɛ piri; ná agyina me si, ná abɔ me nwo waen afi amaneɛ ne asane nu!” Na Nyameɛ yɔle ye abisadeɛ mane ye.
11Suha aliɛma bienzua Kelubo wole Mehiri bɔ ɔwa ole Eseton ne. 12Na Eseton wole Bete Rafa, Pasea ne Tehina bɔ ɔwa ole Yiri Nahase ne. Reka boso ama mɔ ɛne. 13Kenase mma mmienzua mɔ ole Otiniɛl ne Seraya; na Otiniɛl mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hatate ne Meonotae. 14Meonotae wole Ofra, na Seraya wole Yoabo bɔ yeɛ ɔkyekyele Geharasim ne. Bɛfrɛle berɛ sɔ, ofikyɛ né berɛ ama te adwiililɛfoɛ. 15Yefune awa Kalebo ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yiru, Ela ne Naam, na Ela awa bienzua ole Kenase. 16Yehalel mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sife, Sifa, Tiria ne Asarel. 17Ɛsra mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yeta, Merede, Efɛre ne Yalɔn. Merede gyale braa na ɔne ye bɛwole Miriam, Samae ne Yisiba. Yisiba te Ɛsetemoa baba. 18Na Merede aye Yudaniɛ ne, ɔwole Yerede bɔ ɔwa ole Gedɔ ne, Heberi bɔ ɔwa ole Soko ne, yeɛ Yekutiɛl bɔ ɔwa ole Sanoa ne. [Faro awa Bitia bɔ Merede gyale ye ne, ye mma mɔ ɛne]. 19Hodia aye bɔ oliɛma brasua ole Naham ne, ye mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛ boso ama ole Gaminiɛ Keila ne Maakatiniɛ Ɛsetemoa. 20Simɔn mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amnɔn, Rina, Ben Hanan ne Tilɔn. Yisi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sohete ne Ben Sohete. 21Yuda awa bienzua Sela, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ɛre bɔ ɔwa ole Leka ne, ɔne Laada bɔ ɔwa ole Maresa ne, na ye boso ama ole ɛtenanwonɛfoɛ fekue bɔ bɛwɔ Bete Asebea ne; 22yeɛ Yokim, Kosebafoɛ, Yoase ne Sarafo bɔ beegyale mmraa wɔ Moabo besa bɛwale Yasibu Lehem ne (sɔ dwirɛ ne wahyɛ dadaada). 23Bɛ yeɛ bɛnwo ngukue ná bɛte Netaim ne Gedera ne. Né bɛte berɛ bɛyɔ adwuma bɛma (maen ne anu) hene.
Simeon boso ama
24Simeon mma mmienzua mɔ ole Nemuel, Yamin, Yaribo, Sera ne Sɔɔlo. 25Sɔɔlo boso ama mɔ ole Salum, Mibesam yeɛ Misma. 26Misma boso ama mɔ ole Hamuɛl, Sakure yeɛ Simei. 27Simei wole mmaa mmienzua buru ne nzia, yeɛ mmrasua nzia. Nakoso oliɛma mmienzua nemɔ de, né bɛ mma mɔ banzo. Yeɛ b’abusua amukoraati, banda pee kyɛ Yudafoɛ ne. 28Simei abusuafoɛ ne, né bɛtete Beɛ Hyeba, Molada, Hasa Sɔɔlo, 29Bilha, Esem, Tolade, 30Betuel, Hɔma, Siklage, 31Bete Makabote, Hasa Susim, Bete Biri ne Saaraim. Né bɛ nguro mɔ ɛne, kɔpem kyɛ Dawide oolili ɛhene ɔ. 32Na né bɛ nguraa mɔ ole Etam, Ayin, Rimon, Tokyen yeɛ Asan; bɛte nguraa nnu, 33yeɛ afei bɛ nguraa amukoraa bɔ bapɛ nguro nemɔ anwo bayia alaa kɔpem Baal ne. Né bɛ nguro mɔ ɛne, na bahyerɛ bɛ mmusua ne bɛ nguro nemɔ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ngrataa nu.
34Mesobabo, Yamlɛke, Yosa bɔ ye baba ole Amasia ne, 35Yowel, Yehu bɔ ye baba ole Yosibia, bɔ ye baba ole Seraya, bɔ ye baba ole Asiɛl ne, 36Elionae, Yaakoba, Yesohaya, Asaya, Adiɛl, Yesimiɛl, Benaya, 37Sisa bɔ ye baba ole Sifi, bɔ ye baba ole Alon, bɔ ye baba ole Yedaya, bɔ ye baba ole Simri bɔ ye baba ole Semaya ne. 38Sɔ mmenia bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa ne, né bɛte mbanyi wɔ bɛ mmusua mɔ nu, na bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ tale pee. 39Besili nu bɛhɔle beedwuli Gedɔ tiwaa, wɔ bɔnza ne eyia afiteleɛ so, kyɛ bɛkwaapena aleɛ bɛma bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ. 40Benwuni ngaka aleɛ bɔ ɔte monɛ frɔmfrɔm ɔ. Né aseɛ ne te tɛtrɛtɛɛ, yeɛ so te konn bɔ basabasa biala ɔnne so ɔ, ofikyɛ daa ne, né Ham boso ama yeɛ bɛte berɛ ɔ. 41Na Yuda hene Hesekia aberɛ so, bɛ bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa ye, bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Ham boso ama nemɔ ne Meyunimfoɛ bɔ benwuni bɛ wɔ berɛ ne, na bɛsɛkyele b’ɛtena sua mɔ. Benuane bɛ boso maa waadwu ɛnɛ, na bɛfale b’aseɛ ne bɛtenane so, ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ né bekonya aleɛ wɔ berɛ bɛkɔma bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ. 42Na bɛ nu ɛyaa nnu bɔ bɛte Simeonfoɛ, bɔ Yisi mma mmienzua Pelatia, Nearia, Refaya ne Yusiɛl bɛlela bɛ noa ne, bɛhɔle Sɛre bokaa ne aso. 43Beehuhuni Amalɛkefoɛ ngaa bɔ bɛnwatili ne, na batena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 5
Content:
Ruben boso ama
1 Yisrael bamuɛbaa Ruben ye boso ama mɔ. (Ye yeɛ né ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ. Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɔfale efiɛ hane ɔse mba ne ati, ye bamuɛbaa dibea ne, bɛfa bɛmane Yisrael awa Yosef ye mma mmienzua mɔ. Ye sɔ ti, bɛkyerɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne a, bangyerɛ ye dumaa kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ. 2 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ, Yuda ɔɔyɛle titire wɔ oliɛma nemɔ anu, bɔ sona bɔ otua maen ne noa ne, ye nu yeɛ ofi wale ɔ. Nakoso bamuɛbaa dibea ne, ɔɔyɛle Yosef deɛ.) 3Yisrael bamuɛbaa Ruben mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hanoke, Palu, Hesron ne Karemi. 4Yowel boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Semaya, Gɔgo, Simei, 5Mika, Reaya, Baal, 6yeɛ Beera bɔ Asiria hene Tilgate Pilnese hyele ye nnure fale ye hɔle ne. Ne Beera yeɛ otua Rubenfoɛ bɛ noa ɔ. 7Beera boso ama bɛ mmusua mmusua, bɛhale b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so ne, bɛ ɛhe: Yeyiɛl yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, Sakaria, 8yeɛ Bela bɔ ye baba ole Asase, bɔ ye baba ole Sema, bɔ ye baba ole Yowel bɔ né ɔte aseɛ bɔ ofi Aroye ɔkwaadwu Nebo ne Baal Meon ne aso ne. 9Na ɔnate kyɛ né bɛ nyɛmmoa nemɔ bata pee wɔ Gileade aseɛ so ne ati, bɛtenane eyia afiteleɛ so alaa beedwuli ɛserɛ bɔ ɔla asue Yufreti nwo ne, ye noa. 10Na Sɔɔlo aberɛ so, Rubenfoɛ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Hagritefoɛ. Rubenfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, na bɛɛtenane Hagritefoɛ ɛtena sua mɔ anu wɔ Gileade eyia afiteleɛ amukoraa.
Gade boso ama
11Gade boso ama ne, né bɛ ne Rubenfoɛ bɛbɔ wɛen wɔ Basan aseɛ so alaa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Saleka ɔ. 12Né Yowel yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, na sɛ ɔnne berɛ a, Safam yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, yeɛ afei Yanae ne Safate. Né bɛwɔ Basan. 13Na b’abusuafoɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ te ɛhe: Mikayɛl, Mesulam, Hyeba, Yorai, Yakan, Siya ne Heberi; bɛte nzoo. 14Abihail bɔ ye baba ole Huri, bɔ ye baba ole Yaroa, bɔ ye baba ole Gileade, bɔ ye baba ole Mikayɛl, bɔ ye baba ole Yesisae, bɔ ye baba ole Yahedo, bɔ ye baba ole Buse ne, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne. 15Ahi bɔ ye baba ole Abidiɛl, bɔ ye baba ole Guni ne, ye yeɛ né ɔla bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ no ɔ. 16Né bɛtete Gileade, Basan ne ye nwo nguro mɔ so, yeɛ afei Saron aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne aso kɔpem ye noa. 17Sɔ mmenia nemɔ amukoraa, Yuda hene Yotam aberɛ so, ɔne Yisrael hene Yeroboam aberɛ so, begyinane b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so bɛhale bɛ.
Mmusua kure nyɔ ne bue nemɔ
18Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue, né bele koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ apee aburanna ne nna, ɛyaa nzoo ne aburasia bɔ bele buralɛ ataadeɛ ne ngrandɛ, betira agyaen, bɛse ko, bɔ basiesie bɛ nwo kyɛ koɛ ba a, bɛkɔhɔ ɔ. 19Bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Hagritefoɛ, Yeture, Nafise ne Nodabo. 20Nyameɛ bokale Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue maa belili Hagritefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛboka bɛ so ne amukoraa so ngonim, ofikyɛ besu bɛfrɛle Nyameɛ wɔ koɛ ne anu. Nyameɛ tiele bɛ mbaeɛ, ofikyɛ bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole ye so. 21Bɛhyehyele bɛ nyɛmmoa hemɔ bɛfa bɛyɛle koɛ nu nzesadeɛ: afupɔngɔ apee aburannu, mmoaen apee ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu, yeɛ afunum apee nyɔ. Besa bɛhyele mmenia apee ɛyaa ko nnure. 22Pɔfoɛ nemɔ pee totɔle, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ho tiale bɛ, na Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue bɛtenane pɔfoɛ nemɔ aseɛ ne aso alaa kɔpem kyɛ ebiemɔ bɛɛhyele bɛ koso nnure bɛhɔle ɔ.
Manase abusua kure ne bue
23Manase abusua kure ne bue ne, né bɛsone pee, na bɛtenane bɛpetene aseɛ ne aso fite Basan kodwu Baal Hɛmɔn, Seniri ne Hɛmɔn bokaa ne. 24Ɛhemɔ yeɛ né bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa ɔ: Efɛre, Yisi, Eliɛl, Asriɛl, Yeremia, Hodawia ne Yahediɛl. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ bɔ bale dumaa ɔ, na né bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa. 25Nakoso bɛyɔle bɔne betiale bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne. Aseɛ ne aso mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ huhuni bɛ fili bɛ nyunu ne, bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, Manasefoɛ nemɔ sɔnene bɛ. 26Yiti Yisrael Nyameɛ kanyane Asiria hene Pulu bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Tilgate Pilnese ne, na Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue ne, ɔhyele bɛ nnure fale bɛ ooguale Hala, Habo, Hara ne Gosan asue ne anoa, na batena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 6
Content:
Lewi boso ama
1Lewi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Gɛsɔm, Kohate ne Merari. 2Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl. 3Amram mma ole Aarɔn, Mose ne Miriam. Aarɔn mma mmienzua ole Nadabo, Abihu, Eleasa ne Yitama. 4Eleasa wole Finehase, yeɛ Finehase wole Abisua. 5Abisua wole Buki; Buki wole Yusi; 6Yusi wole Serahia; Serahia wole Merayote; 7Merayote wole Amaria; Amaria wole Ahitubo; 8Ahitubo wole Sadoke; Sadoke wole Ahimaase; 9Ahimaase wole Asaria; Asaria wole Yohanan; 10Yohanan wole Asaria (ye yeɛ ɔyɔle sɔfo adwuma wɔ awuro bɔ Solomon sili ye wɔ Yerusalem ne anu ne). 11Asaria wole Amaria; Amaria wole Ahitubo. 12Ahitubo wole Sadoke; Sadoke wole Salum; 13Salum wole Hilkia; Hilkia wole Asaria; 14Asaria wole Seraya yeɛ Seraya wole Yehosadake. 15Na mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE mane Nebukadenesa hyele Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ nnure ne, ɔhyele Yehosadake koso nnure bie. 16Lewi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Gɛsɔm, Kohate ne Merari. 17Gɛsɔm mma mmienzua mɔ ole Libini ne Simei. 18Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl. 19Merari mma mmienzua mɔ ole Maheli ne Musi. Lewifoɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ. 20Gɛsɔm boso ama ɛhe: Libini, Yahate, Sima, 21Yoa, Yido, Sera, Yeaterae. 22Kohate boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Aminadabo, Kora, Asire, 23Ɛlkana, Ebiasafe, Asire, 24Tahate, Yuriɛl, Yusia ne Sɔɔlo. 25Ɛlkana mma mmienzua ole Amasae ne Ahimote. 26Ahimote boso ama ole Ɛlkana, Sofaye, Nahate, 27Eliabo, Yeroham, yeɛ Ɛlkana. 28Samuel mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Yowel te bamuɛbaa, yeɛ Abiya tɔ so nyɔ. 29Merari boso ama mɔ ole Maheli, Libini, Simei, Yusa, 30Simea, Hagiya yeɛ Asaya.
Dawide neanea nu ye edweintolɛfoɛ
31Bɛɛfale Apam alaka ne bɛwale AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, Dawide fale AWURADE awuro berɛ edweintolɛ adwuma ne wurale mmenia biemɔ sa. 32Bɛ yeɛ né bɛto dwein bɛfa bɛsɔne Nyameɛ wɔ nyianu ɛtena sua ne nyunu ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ Solomon sili AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne wɔ Yerusalem yiele ɔ. Na begyinane nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ bafa bama bɛ ne aso bɛyɔle b’adwuma. 33Mmenia bɔ bɛyɔle sɔ adwuma ne, bɛ ne bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Kohatefoɛ bɛ deɛ ole edweintolɛniɛ Heman bɔ ye baba ole Yowel, bɔ ye baba ole Samuel, 34bɔ ye baba ole Ɛlkana, bɔ ye baba ole Yeroham, bɔ ye baba ole Eliɛl bɔ ye baba ole Toya, 35bɔ ye baba ole Sufe, bɔ ye baba ole Ɛlkana, bɔ ye baba ole Mahate, bɔ ye baba ole Amasae, 36bɔ ye baba ole Ɛlkana, bɔ ye baba ole Yowel, bɔ ye baba ole Asaria, bɔ ye baba ole Sefania, 37bɔ ye baba ole Tahate, bɔ ye baba ole Asire, bɔ ye baba ole Ebiasafe, bɔ ye baba ole Kora, 38bɔ ye baba ole Yisare, bɔ ye baba ole Kohate, bɔ ye baba ole Lewi, bɔ ye baba ole Yisrael ne; 39yeɛ Heman aliɛma bienzua Asafe bɔ ɔla edweintolɛfoɛ kure bɔ bɛwɔ ye sa famaa ne, bɛ noa ne. Asafe baba ole Berekia, bɔ ye baba ole Simea, 40bɔ ye baba ole Mikayɛl, bɔ ye baba ole Baaseya, bɔ ye baba ole Malkiya, 41bɔ ye baba ole Eteni, bɔ ye baba ole Sera, bɔ ye baba ole Adaya, 42bɔ ye baba ole Etan, bɔ ye baba ole Sima, bɔ ye baba ole Simei, 43bɔ ye baba ole Yahate, bɔ ye baba ole Gɛsɔm, bɔ ye baba ole Lewi ne. 44Edweintolɛfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Heman sa bɛen so ne, bɛte Merari boso ama, na Etan yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ. Etan ye baba ole Kisi, bɔ ye baba ole Abidi, bɔ ye baba ole Maluke, 45bɔ ye baba ole Hasabia, bɔ ye baba ole Amasia, bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia, 46bɔ ye baba ole Amisi, bɔ ye baba ole Bani, bɔ ye baba ole Semere, 47bɔ ye baba ole Maheli, bɔ ye baba ole Musi, bɔ ye baba ole Merari, bɔ ye baba ole Lewi ne. 48B’eliɛma Lewifoɛ ngaa nemɔ de, bɛfale nyianu sua bɔ ɔte AWURADE awuro ne, nu adwuma ngaa amukoraa bewurale bɛ sa.
49Na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea, ɔne ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ aso. Na bɛyɔle krongron nu krongron berɛ adwuma ne amu bɛfa bɛpatale bɛmane Yisrael, kyɛbɔ ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛ mane bɛ ne, ɔte ne ala. 50Aarɔn boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Ɔwa Eleasa wole Finehase; Finehase wole Abisua; Abisua wole Buki, 51Buki wole Yusi; Yusi wole Serahia; Serahia wole 52Merayote; Merayote wole Amaria; Amaria wole Ahitubo; 53Ahitubo wole Sadoke; yeɛ Sadoke wole Ahimaase.
Lewifoɛ bɛ nguro
54Aarɔn boso ama bɔ befi Kohate mmusua mmusua nemɔ anu ne, bɛ nguro ne b’aseɛ bɔ bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛfa bɛmane bɛ nemɔ ɛhe; ofikyɛ b’aseɛ deɛ yeɛ serewagualɛ ne li moa yele ɔ: 55Hebron bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda aseɛ so ne, ɔne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne, yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ɔ. 56Nakoso kuro ne anwo mvofoen ne ye nwo namue nemɔ de, bɛfa bɛmane Yefune awa Kalebo. 57Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nemɔ, bɛfa bɛmane Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ. Nguro nemɔ ole Hebron ne Libina, ɔne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Yatiri ne Ɛsetemoa ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ; 58Hilen ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Debiri ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 59Asan ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Bete Semese ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 60Bɛyele nguro hemɔ koso befili Benyamin abusua kure b’aseɛ so bɛmane bɛ: Geba ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Alemete ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Anatote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. Bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ anu, bɛ nguro ne amukoraa te buru ne nza.
61Bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛyele nguro buru befili Manase abusua kure ne bue b’aseɛ so bɛmane Kohate boso ama ngaa nemɔ. 62Bɛyele nguro buru ne nza befili Yisaka, Asɛ, Nafetali mmusua kure aseɛ so, yeɛ Basan mbɔtam wɔ Manase aseɛ so bɛfa bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ. 63Bɛyele nguro buru ne nyɔ befili Ruben abusua kure, Gade abusua kure ne Sebulɔn abusua kure aseɛ so bɛmane Merari boso ama nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua nemɔ te ɔ. 64Yiti Yisraelfoɛ fale sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛmane Lewifoɛ nemɔ. 65Bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛyeyele sɔ nguro bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa nemɔ befili Yuda abusua kure, Simeon abusua kure yeɛ Benyamin abusua kure b’aseɛ so bɛfa bɛmane bɛ.
66Bɛyele nguro ne bie befili Efraim abusua kure b’aseɛ so yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Kohate boso ama nemɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ bie ɔ. 67Bɛfale mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro hemɔ bɛmane bɛ: Sɛkem ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ wɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, Gɛsɛre ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 68Yokemeam ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Bete Horon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 69Ayalɔn ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Gate Rimon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 70Na Manase abusua kure ne bue ne anu, bɛyele aseɛ hemɔ befili nu bɛmane Kohate mmusua ngaa nemɔ: Anere ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Bileam ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
71Bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili Manase abusua kure ne bue b’aseɛ nu bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ: Golan bɔ ɔwɔ Basan ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Astarote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 72Na Yisaka abusua kure ne anu koso, bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili nu bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ: Kedese ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Daberate ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 73Ramote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Anem ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 74Asɛ abusua kure ne anu, bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili nu bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ: Masal ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Abedon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 75Hukoke ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Rehobo ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 76Nafetali abusua kure ne anu, bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili nu bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ: Kedese bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Hamon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Kiriatim ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.
77Bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili Sebulɔn abusua kure b’aseɛ nu bɛmane Merari boso ama ngaa nemɔ: Rimono ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Tabɔ ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 78Asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ so, wɔ Yeriko ndendeneɛ so ne, bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili Ruben abusua kure ne b’aseɛ so bɛmane Merari boso ama nemɔ: Besɛre bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ne, ɔne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Yasa ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 79Kedemote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Mefaate ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ. 80Na Gade abusua kure ne aseɛ koso, bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili nu bɛmane Merari boso ama nemɔ: Ramote bɔ ɔwɔ Gileade ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, Mahanaim ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, 81Hesebon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Yasere ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 7
Content:
Yisaka boso ama
1Yisaka mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛte nna. Bɛ ole Tola, Pua, Yasubo, yeɛ Simron. 2Tola mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yusi, Refaya, Yeriɛl, Yamae, Yibesam, yeɛ Semuel. Bɛ mu bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa. Na Dawide aberɛ so, né Tola boso ama bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ, bɛte apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ne ɛyaa nzia. 3Yusi ɔwa bienzua ole Yisrahia, na Yisrahia mma mmienzua mɔ ole Mikayɛl, Obadia, Yowel ne Yisia. Bɛte nnu, na bɛ mukoraa bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ noa. 4Ɔnate kyɛ begyigyale mmraa pee ná bɛwole mmaa mmienzua pee ne ati, bɛ boso ama bɔ né bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ, b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ, bɛte apee aburasa ne nzia. 5Yisaka abusua kure ne, bɛ mmusua mmusua ne anu ama amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ, bɛhale bɛ kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛte apee aburawɔtwɛ ne nzoo.
Benyamin boso ama
6Benyamin mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛte nza. Bɛ ole Bela, Bekya yeɛ Yediayɛl. 7Bela mma mmienzua mɔ te nnu. Bɛ ole Esebon, Yusi, Yusiɛl, Yerimote yeɛ Yiri. Né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ nemɔ noa. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ, na bɛhale bɛ boso ama kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛte apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ɔne aburasa ne nna. 8Bekya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Semira, Yoase, Eliesa, Elionae, Omri, Yeremote, Abiya, Anatote yeɛ Alemete. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Bekya mma mmienzua, 9na né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ nemɔ noa. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ, na bɛhale bɛ boso ama kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛte apee aburanyɔ ɛyaa nyɔ. 10Yediayɛl awa bienzua ole Bilhan, na Bilhan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yeyuse, Benyamin, Ehude, Kenaana, Setan, Tasise yeɛ Ahisahare. 11Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Yediayɛl mma mmienzua. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ bɔ bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ nemɔ noa ɔ. Bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛte apee buru ne nzoo ɛyaa nyɔ bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ. 12Yiri mma mmienzua mɔ ole Supim ne Hupim, yeɛ Ahere awa bienzua ole Husim.
Nafetali boso ama
13Nafetali boso ama mɔ ole Yahesiɛl, Guni, Yesare yeɛ Salum. Bɛte Bilha ye boso ama.
Manase boso ama
14Manase mma mmienzua bɔ ɔne ye sómaa Sirianiɛ braa bie bɛwole bɛ nemɔ, bɛ ole Aseriɛl ne Makyiri bɔ ɔwa ole Gileade ne. 15Na Makyiri gyale bra mane Hupim ne Supim. Makyiri aliɛma brasua ole Maaka. Makyiri bosoniɛ ne bie ole Selofehade, na Selofehade wole mmrasua ngome. 16Makyiri aye Maaka wole baa bienzua, na ɔtole ye dumaa Perese. Perese aliɛma bienzua li Sɛrese, na ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yulam ne Rekem. 17Yulam awa bienzua ole Bedan. Gileade bɔ ye baba ole Makyiri, bɔ ye baba ole Manase ne, ye boso ama mɔ ɛne. 18Gileade aliɛma brasua Hamolekete wole Yisdode, Abiesa yeɛ Mahela. 19Semida mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ahian, Sɛkem, Liki yeɛ Aniam.
Efraim boso ama
20Efraim awa bienzua ole Sutela, bɔ ɔwole Berede, bɔ ɔwole Tahate, bɔ ɔwole Eleada, bɔ ɔwole Tahate, bɔ ɔwole 21Sabade, bɔ ɔwole Sutela ne. Efraim mma mmienzua bieku mɔ ole Esere ne Eleade. Na Gatefoɛ bɔ bɛwole bɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, behuni bɛ munyɔ, ofikyɛ bɛhɔle Gatefoɛ nemɔ dɔ bɛɛbɔle bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ so apaa. 22Yiti bɛ baba Efraim suni bɛ ngyẽa pee, na oliɛma mmienzua mɔ wale bɛɛkyekyele ye wora. 23Na Efraim ne ɔye bɛlale. Braa ne nwonzɛle wole baa bienzua, na Efraim tole ye dumaa Beria, ofikyɛ edwirɛ piri yeɛ né wato ye awuro ama ɔ. 24Efraim awa brasua ole Seera bɔ ɔkyekyele Bete Horon ngwaen ne sorɔ, yeɛ Yusen Seera ne. 25Efraim awa ole Refa, bɔ ɔwole Resefe, bɔ ɔwole Tela, bɔ ɔwole Tahan, bɔ ɔwole 26Ladan, bɔ ɔwole Amihude bɔ ɔwole Elisama, bɔ ɔwole 27Nun, bɔ ɔwole Yosua ne. 28B’agyapadeɛ ne b’atenaleɛ mɔ ole Betel ne ye nwo nguro mɔ, yeɛ Naaran bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ so, Gɛsɛre bɔ ɔwɔ eyia atɔleɛ so ne ye nwo nguro, Sɛkem ne ye nwo nguro, toonn kodwu Aya ne ye nwo nguro, 29kɔfa Manasefoɛ wɛen so, Bete Sean ne ye nwo nguro, Taanake ne ye nwo nguro, Megido ne ye nwo nguro, yeɛ Dɔɔ ne ye nwo nguro. Sɔ nguro nemɔ aso yeɛ né Yisrael awa Yosef ye boso ama bɛtete ɔ.
Asɛ boso ama
30Asɛ mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yimina, Yisiwa, Yisiwi yeɛ Beria, na b’eliɛma brasua ole Sera. 31Beria mma mmienzua mɔ ole Heberi ne Malkiɛl bɔ ɔwa ole Birisate ne. 32Heberi wole Yaflete, Somere, Hotam ne b’eliɛma brasua Sua. 33Yaflete mma mmienzua mɔ ole Pasake, Bimihale yeɛ Asiwate. Yaflete mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne. 34Semere mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ahi, Rohega, Yehuba ne Aram. 35Semere aliɛma Helem, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sofa, Yimina, Selese ne Amale. 36Sofa mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sua, Hanefere, Soale, Beri, Yimira, 37Besɛre, Hode, Sama, Silisa, Yitrane yeɛ Beera. 38Yeta mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yefune, Pisipa yeɛ Ara. 39Yula mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ara, Haniɛl yeɛ Risia. 40Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Asɛ boso ama, bɔ né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ɔ. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ɔ, mbanyi nemɔ anu atitire. Bɛ bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ne, bɛhale bɛ kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nzia.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 8
Content:
Benyamin boso ama
1Benyamin mma mmienzua nemɔ, Bela yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ. Asebel tɔ so nyɔ, Ahara tɔ so nza, 2Noha tɔ so nna, yeɛ Rafa tɔ so nnu. 3Bela mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ada, Gera, Abihude, 4Abisua, Naaman, Ahoa, 5Gera, Sefufan yeɛ Huram. 6Ehude wole mma mmienzua (né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Geba ne bɛ noa, na ebiemɔ hyele Ehude mma nemɔ nnure bɛhɔle Manahate). 7Ye mma mmienzua nemɔ ole Naaman, Ahiya yeɛ Gera. Bɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure ne, Gera yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, na ɔwole Yusa ne Ahihude. 8Na Saharaim yirale ɔye mɔ Husim ne Baara ne, ɔɔwole mmaa wɔ Moabo aseɛ so. 9Ɔne ɔye Hodese bɛwole mmaa mmienzua hemɔ: Yobabo, Sibia, Mesa, Malkam, 10Yeyuso, Sakia ne Mima. Ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne, na né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mɔ noa. 11Ɔne Husim koso bɛwole mmaa mmienzua. Bɛ ole Abitubo ne Elepal. 12Elepal mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ebere, Misam ne Semede bɔ ɔkyekyele Ono ne Lode ne bɛ nwo nguraa mɔ ne. 13Osa wole Beria ne Sema (né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Ayalɔn ne bɛ noa, na bɛ yeɛ bɛfoane Gatefoɛ maa bɛnwatili ɔ). 14Ye boso ama mɔ ole Ahio, Sasake ne Yeremote, 15Sebadia, Arade, Edere, 16Mikayɛl, Yisipa ne Yoha bɔ bɛte Beria mma mmienzua ne; 17Sebadia, Mesulam, Hisiki, Heberi, 18Yismerae, Yisilia, Yobabo bɔ bɛte Elepal mma mmienzua ne, 19yeɛ Yakim, Sikri, Sabidi, 20Elienae, Siletae, Eliɛl, 21Adaya, Beraya ne Simirate bɔ bɛte Simei mma mmienzua ne, 22Yisipan, Ebere, Eliɛl, 23Abedon, Sikri, Hanan, 24Hanania, Elam, Antotiya, 25Yifedeya ne Penuel bɔ bɛte Sasake mma mmienzua ne. 26Samserae, Seharia, Atalia, 27Yaaresia, Elia yeɛ Sikri bɔ bɛte Yeroham mma mmienzua ne. 28Sɔ mmenia nemɔ yeɛ né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ɔ, na né bɛte atitire wɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nu. Né bɛte Yerusalem.
Benyaminfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Gibeon ne Yerusalem ɔ
29Yeyil bɔ ɔwa ole Gibeon ne, né ɔte Gibeon, na ɔye dumaa li Maaka. 30Yeyil mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Abedon te bamuɛbaa, yeɛ afei Sure, Kise, Baal, Nadabo, 31Gedɔ, Ahio, Sekere, 32yeɛ Miklote bɔ ɔwa ole Simea ne. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama bɛtenane bepingyele bɛ mmusuafoɛ ngaa nemɔ wɔ Yerusalem.
Nana Sɔɔlo abusua
33Nɛɛ wole Kise; Kise wole Sɔɔlo; Sɔɔlo wole Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadabo yeɛ Esibaal. 34Yonatan awa bienzua ole Meribaal, yeɛ Meribaal wole Mika. 35Mika mma mmienzua mɔ ole Piton, Mɛlɛke, Tarea ne Ahase. 36Ahase wole Yehoada; Yehoada wole Alemete, Asimawete ne Simri; Simri wole Mosa. 37Mosa wole Binea; Binea wole Rafa; Rafa wole Eleasa yeɛ Eleasa wole Asel. 38Asel wole mmaa mmienzua nzia, na bɛ dumaa mɔ ɛhe: Asrikam, Bokeru, Yismael, Searia, Obadia yeɛ Hanan. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Asel mma mmienzua. 39Asel aliɛma Eseke, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Yulam te bamuɛbaa, Yeyuse tɔ so nyɔ, yeɛ Elifɛlɛte tɔ so nza. 40Yulam mma mmienzua nemɔ, né bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ne agyaentolɛfoɛ. Bele mmaa ne nnomaa pee bɔ bɛ somaa te ɛyaa ko aburannu ɔ. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Benyaminfoɛ.

Title: 1 ABERƐSO DWIRƐ 9
Content:
Mmenia bɔ befi Babilɔn besa bɛwale ɔ
1Bɛhale Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa mmusua mmusua, na bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwomaa ne anu. Ɔnate Yudafoɛ b’asoserɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle Babilɔn ɔ. 2Bɛ bɔ belili moa besa bɛwale bɛ kuro bɛɛtenane b’aseɛ so ne, bɛte Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ bie, yeɛ afei asɔfo, Lewifoɛ yeɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ.
3Na Yuda boso ama nemɔ, Benyamin boso ama nemɔ, Efraim boso ama nemɔ, yeɛ Manase boso ama nemɔ, bɛ nu biemɔ bɛɛtenane Yerusalem. Bɛ ole: 4Yutae bɔ ye baba ole Amihude, bɔ ye baba ole Omri, bɔ ye baba ole Yimri, bɔ ye baba ole Bani, bɔ ɔte Pɛrɛse bɔ ye baba ole Yuda, ye bosoniɛ ne. 5Na Silonfoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Asaya bɔ ɔte bamuɛbaa ne ɔne ye mma mmienzua mɔ. 6Sera boso ama mɔ: Yewel ne ye nwo ama; bɛte ɛyaa nzia ne aburahona.
7Benyamin boso ama: Salu bɔ ye baba ole Mesulam, bɔ ye baba ole Hodawia, bɔ ye baba ole Hasenua ne, 8yeɛ Yibinea bɔ ye baba ole Yeroham, Ela bɔ ye baba ole Yusi, bɔ ye baba ole Mikri, yeɛ Mesulam bɔ ye baba ole Sefatia, bɔ ye baba ole Rewel, bɔ ye baba ole Yibinea ne. 9Na bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛte ɛyaa ngona aburannu ne nzia. Bɛ mukoraa bɛlela bɛ mmusua noa, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.
Asɔfo bɔ besa bɛɛtenane Yerusalem ɔ
