Bɛhyerɛle krataa ne Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu, na bɛtele ye noa wɔ ye dwudwolɛ nu behyirele ye. 8Amrado Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae bɛhyerɛle Yerusalem nwo krataa tɛɛ bɛɛmane Nana Atasɛsɛse. 9(Bɛhyerɛle ye kyɛ, Krataa ne fi ɛhemɔ berɛ: Amrado Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae, yeɛ bɛ mmango ngaa nemɔ, ndɛenbualɛfoɛ, amrado mɔ, mbanyi mɔ, Pɛsiafoɛ; bɛ bɔ befi Ɛreke, Babilɔn, Susa bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Elamfoɛ ne, 10maen maen ngaa bɔ katakyie Asabanipal bɔ wale dumaa ne ɔhyele bɛ nnure ɔɔsoale bɛ guale Samaria nguro nemɔ aso, ɔne asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ngaa nemɔ. 11Krataa bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛɛmane Nana Atasɛsɛse ne, nu dwirɛ ɛhe): “Yɛfa krataa he yɛbrɛ Nana Atasɛsɛse. Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ yɛwɔ asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso ne, yɛbisa wɔ bisabisa. 12Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, Yudafoɛ bɔ befili wɔ dɔ bɛwale yɛ wa ne, baadwu Yerusalem, na besa bɛkyekye ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ ne amumuyɛɛfoɛ kuro ne bieku. Fasue ne, basa bagua ye fapem ne maa wanya anwoserɛ, na waha kãa né bayie ye to. 13Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, sɛ besa bɛkyekye sɔ kuro ne, ná bɛto ye nwo fasue beyie a, ye de bengotua ɛtoɔ, anaa ndɔ, anaa aseɛ nwo toɔ ne. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, sikaa bɔ ɔba ahemvie dɔ ne, so kɔte. 14Nana, w’adaworoma, wɔ yeɛ yɛ ko wura wɔ sa nu ɔ, yiti ɔtte mayee kyɛ yɛkɔnea kɔmaa bekogua wɔ nyunu aseɛ ɔ. Ye sɔ ati yeɛ yahyerɛ krataa yɛbaafa yɛtia wɔ gya so ye, 15amaa ɔnate so aneanea wɔ nana mɔ dwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu. Na ekonwu ye wɔ edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu kyɛ, sɔ kuro ne ɔte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ kuro bɔ ɔmma ahemvo mɔ ne mbɔtam mɔ bɛ nwo ndɔ bɛ ɔ. Ofi tetetete yeɛ kuro berɛ ama bahɔ so bayɔ maen mbanyi nwo lɔen ɔ, na ɔnate sɔ ati yeɛ wɔ mbanyi mɔ bɛbɔle sɔ kuro ne ɔ. 16Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, sɛ besa bɛkyekye sɔ kuro ne, ná bɛto ye nwo fasue beyie a, ye de asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne okofi wɔ sa.”
17Na Nana Atasɛsɛse maa bɛfale mmuayɛɛ he bɛɛmane bɛ, “Mefa mebrɛ Amrado Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae ne bɛ mmango mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Samaria ne asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso ne. Mebisa ɛmɔ oo. 18Krataa bɔ ɛmɔhyerɛ bɛbrɛle yɛ ne, bate ye noa wɔ me dwudwolɛ nu bahyire me. 19Yiti mahyɛ mmeraa maa baneanea edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu, na wala ali pefee kyɛ, ofi tetetete yeɛ sɔ kuro ne wahɔ so wayɛ lɔen watia ahemvo mɔ ɔ, na ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ ɔmba kuro ne aso. 20Ahemvo atitire lili Yerusalem so, bɔ b’ahennie ne ɔtrɛ hɔle asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso amukoraa ɔ. Na mmenia tuale ɛtoɔ, ndɔ, ɔne aseɛ nwo toɔ bɛmane ahemvo nemɔ. 21Yiti ɛ́mɔhyɛ mmeraa ma mmenia nemɔ bɛyakyi, bɔ nnɛmaa bɛkyekye kuro ne ko ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔma bɛ ate ɔ. 22Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔngobu ɛmɔ nye bengogua edwirɛ he aso ɔ. Anyɔ a, edwirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee kɔto m’ahennie ye.”
23Na bɛkengale Nana Atasɛsɛse krataa ne behyirele Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae ne bɛ mmango nemɔ nen, berɛ ne ala, bɛhɔle Yerusalem ndɛndɛ so, na bɛhyɛle Yudafoɛ nemɔ mbendene so maa bɛyakyili adwuma ne yɔlɛ. 24 Yiti Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, bɛyakyili ye nwo adwuma ne bɛtole berɛ, na ɔhale berɛ toonn maa oodwuli Pɛsia hene Dario ye bia lilɛ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne.

Title: ƐSRA 5
Content:
Bɛtoa so besi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne
1 Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne, bɛhane Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ behyirele Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem. Begyinane Yisrael Nyameɛ dumaa bɔ ɔla bɛ so ne aso yeɛ bɛhane edwirɛ ne ɔ. 2 Na ɛhe mane Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne Yosadake awa Yesua bɛhyɛle ye bo kyɛ besa besi Nyameɛ awuro ne wɔ Yerusalem. Na Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ gyinane bɛ si bɛbokale bɛ.
3Sɔ mmerɛ ne ala, asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado Tatenae, ɔne Seta Bosenae ne bɛ mmango mɔ bɛwale Yudafoɛ berɛ beebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔmane ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔsa besi sua ye, ná ɛmɔto ye nwo fasue ɔ?” 4Besa bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ yeɛ besi sua ye?” 5Nakoso Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, né ye nye wɔ Yuda mbanyi nemɔ aso. Yiti Pɛsiafoɛ nemɔ anzi bɛ ate, kɔpem kyɛ bɛfale ye nwo amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle Dario maa ye koso ɔhyerɛle krataa wale ɔ.
6Asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado Tatenae ne Seta Bosenae ne ye mmango maen mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si dɔ ne, krataa bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛɛmane Nana Dario ne, ye ɛhe: 7Krataa bɔ bɛfa bɛɛmane ye ne, nu dwirɛ ɛhe, “Nana Dario, wɔ ngoa so oo. 8Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, yɛhɔle Yuda mbɔtam dɔ, nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ piri ne, ye awuro ne ɔwɔ ne. Nyɔboɛ mbiri mbiri yeɛ bɛ́fa bési ɔ, na basa bafa mbuna bagyinagyina ye fasue ne anu. Bayere bɛ nwo paa yeɛ bɛ́yɔ adwuma ne ɔ, na ɔkɔ so paa. 9Yɛbisale bɛ mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔmane ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔsa besi sua ye ná ɛmɔto ye nwo fasue ɔ?’ 10Asa koso, yɛbisale bɛ dumaa, amaa ɔnate so yahora yahyerɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛla bɛ noa nemɔ dumaa yabrɛ wɔ maa anwu ye. 11Na mmuayɛɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane yɛ ɛhe, ‘Anwuro ne aseɛ Nyameɛ ne, yɛte ye ngoaa. Yɛsa yɛsi awuro bɔ daa tetetete besili, bɔ ɔte awuro bɔ Yisrael hene piri bie osi yiele korakora ɔ. 12 Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ yɛ nana mɔ bɛmane nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne ɔfɛle bɛ so yaa ne ati, ɔfale bɛ wurale Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa bɔ ɔte Kaldeaniɛ ne ye sa. Obubuli sua he guale, na ɔhyele maen ne anu ama nnure hɔle Babilɔn. 13 Na Babilɔn hene Karose lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu, ɔhyɛle mmeraa kyɛ yɛsa yɛsi Nyameɛ awuro he. 14Asa koso, Nyameɛ awuro sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nningyein bɔ Nebukadenesa sesa fili Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ooguale Babilɔn asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ne, Nana Karose sesa fili Babilɔn asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu. Na biaa bie bɔ oli Sesebasa bɔ Nana Karose wabɔ ye amrado ne, ɔfa wurale ye sa. 15Osele ye kyɛ, ‘De sɔ nningyein hemɔ. Fa kogua asɔneyɛɛ sua bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ awuro ne anu, ná maa besa besi besie ye boso.’ 16Na ɛhe mane sɔ Sesebasa ne tole Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne fapem, na sua ne nwo adwuma ahɔ so alaa fi sɔ mmerɛ ne maa waadwu ɛnɛ, bɔ yɛnnya yɛyyiele ye si ɔ.’ 17Nana Dario, sɛ ɔngɔha wɔ a, maa bɛneanea ahemvie ngrataa bɔ bafa basie Babilɔn ne anu bɛnea, kyɛ, aso Nana Karose hyɛle mmeraa kyɛ besi Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne bieku anaa. Nana, bɔ w’adwene kyire wɔ wɔ edwirɛ he anwo ne, soma maa bɛɛhã behyire yɛ.”

Title: ƐSRA 6
Content:
Dario nwu Karose ngrataa ne
1Afei Nana Dario hyɛle mmeraa maa bɛɛpenane sɔ ngrataa ne wɔ nekaa bɔ besie ngrataa wɔ Babilɔn ne. 2Nakoso Ekobatana bɔ ɔte Media mbɔtam ahenguro ne, berɛ yeɛ beenwuni nwomaa bie bɔ bahyerɛ edwirɛ bie bagua so kyɛ, “Ngayeɛ dwirɛ. 3 Nana Karose afoɛ bɔ oli moa wɔ ye ahennie ne anu ne, ɔhyɛle mmeraa tole berɛ kyɛ, Mmeraa he fa Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne anwo. Mama ate kyɛ besa besi sua ne bɛfa bɛyɛ nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔkɔyɛ agyirɛ aburasia, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu koso kɔyɛ agyirɛ aburasia. 4Ye fapem ne, nyɔboɛ mbiri nza biala bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔtaataa so ne, bɛkɔfa bakaa ko bɛkɔto so. Na ye nwo kerɛ ne, yɛkotua yɛkofi ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu. 5Asa koso, Nyameɛ awuro sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nningyein bɔ Nebukadenesa sesa fili Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu wale Babilɔn ne, mahyɛ kyɛ besa bɛɛfa ebiala begua ye boso wɔ Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu. Odi kyɛ bɛfa bekogua Nyameɛ awuro berɛ.”
6“Yiti wɔ Tatenae bɔ ɛte asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado ne, ɛne Seta Bosenae ne ɛmɔ mmango maen mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam dɔ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne silɛ nwo ate. 7Nyameɛ awuro ne nwo adwuma ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsi ye nwo ate; na mmom ɛmɔhwe bɛ nwo ma Yudafoɛ amrado ne, ɔne Yudafoɛ mbanyi besa besi Nyameɛ awuro he besie ye boso. 8Afei, bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛboka sɔ Yudafoɛ mbanyi nemɔ maa besa besi Nyameɛ awuro he ne, mahyɛ ye nwo mmeraa kyɛ, ahemvie fotoɛ, bɔ ɔte ɛtoɔ bɔ yɛde yɛfi asue Yufreti si mbɔtam ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa betua awuro ne anwo kerɛ amukoraa bɛma bɛ ndɛndɛ. 9Asɔfo bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne, nikyee biala bɔ bɛkɔhã kyɛ behia ne, kyɛ nandwie akrɔngrɔma oo, mmoaen nyii oo, mmoaen bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔma nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne oo, atokoɔ oo, ngyee oo, nzaa oo, anaa ngoo oo, kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ biala, ɛ́mɔma bɛ sa hã ye alehyeleɛ biala; 10amaa ɔnate so babɔ afɔleɛ fonafona bama nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne, ná babɔ mbaeɛ bama me, ɛhene ne me mma. 11Masa mahyɛ mmeraa koso kyɛ, ebiala bɔ okotu sɔ mmeraa ne kogua ne, bɛkɔye ye awuro nu mbuna ko, bekosinzi ye noa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpena berɛ, ná bafa ye basina so, na bɛkɔfa ye awuro ne bɛkɔkakyi fofoɛ. 12Na sɛ ɛhene bie anaa maen bie otu sɔ mmeraa ne gua, anaakyɛ ɔsɛkye Nyameɛ awuro he bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne a, Nyameɛ bɔ wama ye dumaa ala Yerusalem so ne, ótu sɔ hene ne anaa ɔ́bɔ sɔ maen ne. Me, Dario yeɛ mahyɛ sɔ mmeraa ye ɔ, na odi kyɛ bedi so pɛpɛɛpɛ!”
Besi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne beyie
13Afei mmuayɛɛ bɔ Nana Dario maa bɛɛfa bɛmane asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado Tatenae, ɔne Seta Bosenae ne bɛ mmango mɔ ne, belili sɔ mmeraa ne aso pɛpɛɛpɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ne ala. 14 Yiti Yuda mbanyi nemɔ hɔle so benyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ sua ne silɛ nu, ɔnate Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne, bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne aso. Na kyɛbɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ɔte ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ Pɛsia ahemvo Karose ne Dario ne Atasɛsɛse mmeraa bɔ bɛhyɛle ne ɔte ne, Yudafoɛ sili sua ne beyiele. 15Beyiele awuro ne si wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nza wɔ bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ada ne anu, wɔ Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne anu.
16Afei Yisraelfoɛ, asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ ne mmenia ngaa bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, belili ahurusi betuli Nyameɛ awuro he bewurale Nyameɛ sa. 17Mmerɛ bɔ bétu Nyameɛ awuro ne bewura Nyameɛ sa ne, bɛfale ɛhemɔ bɛbɔle afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii ɛyaa ko, mmoaen nyii ɛyaa nyɔ, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma ɛyaa nna; yeɛ bɛfale mbɔngye nyii buru ne nyɔ bɛbɔle Yisrael bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, kyɛbɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ somaa te ɔ. 18Afei bɛmane asɔfo nemɔ hɔle bɛ kure kure nu, yeɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ koso bɛ fekue fekue nu. Na bɛfale Nyameɛ sɔnenɛ nwo adwuma wɔ Yerusalem bewurale bɛ sa, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye Mose nwomaa ne anu ne.
Bedi Abɔtra aluolue ne
19 Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, mmenia bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, belili Abɔtra aluolue ne. 20Ofikyɛ né asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bapete bɛ nwo bama bɛ mukoraa bɛ nwo ate. Yiti Lewifoɛ nemɔ huhuni Abɔtra boaen ne bɛmane bɛ bɔ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne amukoraa, bɛ mmango asɔfo nemɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo. 21Yisraelfoɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, bɛ ne ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ maen ne anu, bɔ waaboka Yisraelfoɛ so ɔne bɛ bate bɛ nwo bafi Amaenmaensofoɛ yɔleɛ fiɛ nwo, kyɛ bɛkɔso AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ belili Abɔtra boaen ne ɔ. 22Bele anigye belili Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo. Bɛ nye gyele, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ama Asiria hene anwu bɛ anwumvoin, bɔ ɔnate so ɔbokale bɛ wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, ye awuro ne silɛ nu ɔ.

Title: ƐSRA 7
Content:
Ɛsra sa ba Yerusalem
1Ɛhemɔ asi ne, Pɛsia hene Atasɛsɛse aberɛ so, Ɛsra bɔ ye baba ole Seraya, bɔ ye baba ole Asaria, bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia, 2bɔ ye baba ole Salum, bɔ ye baba ole Sadoke, bɔ ye baba ole Ahitubo, 3bɔ ye baba ole Amaria, bɔ ye baba ole Asaria, bɔ ye baba ole Merayote, 4bɔ ye baba ole Serahia, bɔ ye baba ole Yusi, bɔ ye baba ole Buki, 5bɔ ye baba ole Abisua, bɔ ye baba ole Finehase, bɔ ye baba ole Eleasa, bɔ ye baba ole ɔsɔfo panyi Aarɔn ne, 6sɔ Ɛsra ne fili Babilɔn wale. Né ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ wabe paa wɔ Mose mmeraa bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ fa mane Yisraelfoɛ ne anu. Ye dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa tole Nana Atasɛsɛse nyunu biala, ɔyɔ mane ye, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ye Nyameɛ gyi ye si.
7Nana Atasɛsɛse lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu, Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ bie, bɛ ne asɔfo, Lewifoɛ, edweintolɛfoɛ, anoa awɛmvoɛ ne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ bɛ koso besa bɛwale Yerusalem. 8Nana Atasɛsɛse afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, ye bosome nnu ne anu yeɛ Ɛsra wale Yerusalem ɔ. 9Kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu yeɛ otuli ye bo fili Babilɔn ɔ, na kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome nnu ne anu yeɛ oodwuli Yerusalem ɔ, ofikyɛ ye Nyameɛ nwuni ye anwumvoin gyinane ye si. 10Ofikyɛ né Ɛsra watu ye nwo wasie berɛ kyɛ okosua AWURADE mmeraa ne, kyɛ okoli so, ɔne kyɛ okohyirehyire sɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne ɔne nhyehyɛleɛ ne wɔ Yisrael.
Atasɛsɛse ma Ɛsra krataa
11Ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ wabe paa wɔ AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfa mane Yisrael ne anu ne, krataa bɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse fa mane ye ɛhe: 12“Me Atasɛsɛse, ahemvo mɔ nu hene, mefa krataa ye mema ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Nyameɛ ye mmeraa ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne. Mebisa wɔ oo. M’ahyɛdeɛ ne ɛhe: 13Mahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ, Yisraelniɛ biala bɔ ɔwɔ m’ahennie ye anu, yeɛ b’asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ, ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ Yerusalem ne, ɔkɔhora ne wɔ bɛkɔhɔ. 14Ofikyɛ me Atasɛsɛse, me ne me foɛtulɛfoɛ nzoo nemɔ yeɛ yasoma wɔ ɔ, kyɛ kɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem kɔtoto nningyein yé, kyɛbɔ wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa bɔ otira wɔ sa nu ne okyire ne. 15Asa koso, ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ me Atasɛsɛse, me ne me foɛtulɛfoɛ mɔ yaye yɛ kunu yafa yabɔ afɔleɛ yama Yisrael Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte Yerusalem ne, fa boka so kɔ. 16Yeɛ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ biala bɔ ekonya ye wɔ Babilɔn aseɛ so amukoraa ne, ɔne maen ne asɔfo akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛye bɛ kunu bɛbɔ bɛma bɛ Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, fa boka so kɔ. 17Wɔ sa kã sɔ sikaa ne a, nea kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔtɔ nandwie nyii mɔ, mmoaen nyii, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma, yeɛ b’aburoo afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ. Na sɔ nningyein ne, fa bɔ afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro wɔ Yerusalem ne aso. 18Afei, ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔkɔha ne, nikyee biala bɔ ɛne eliɛma nemɔ bekuro kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɔ ye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ te ɔ. 19Kulie mɔ bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa kyɛ ɛɛfa yɔ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, fa kogua Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne nyunu. 20Wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne, nikyee biala bɔ waha bɔ ekohia kɔfa kɔyɔ ye nwo adwuma ne, de fi ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu.
21“Me Nana Atasɛsɛse, mahyɛ mmeraa he mama fotoɛsoneafoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Nyameɛ ye mmeraa ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne okobisa kofi ɛmɔ berɛ ne, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔkɔma ye sa kɔhã ye ndɛndɛ ɔ; 22sɛ ye somaa te ɛdwetɛ kilo apee nza ɛyaa nna, atokoɔ olonka apee ko, nzaa galɔn ɛyaa nnu ne aburannu, ngoo galɔn ɛyaa nnu ne aburannu, yeɛ ngyee buburugyaa po a. 23Nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne, ahyɛdeɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔhyɛ kɔfa ye awuro ne anwo ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ye pɛpɛɛpɛ bɛma nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne. Anyɔ a, ɔkɔfɛ me Nana Atasɛsɛse, me ne me mma y’ahennie so yaa. 24Yɛ́ma ɛmɔte kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔde asɔfo nemɔ, anaa Lewifoɛ, anaa edweintolɛfoɛ, anaa anoa wɛmvoɛ, anaa asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo awɛmvoɛ, anaa Nyameɛ awuro he anwo somvoɛ biala toɔ, anaa ndɔ, anaa aseɛ nwo toɔ a, otia mmeraa.
25“Na wɔ, Ɛsra, wɔ Nyameɛ nworɛ bɔ wafa wama wɔ ne, gyina so yeye edwirɛlilɛfoɛ ne maenbulɛfoɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne, bɔ bɛkɔla mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam noa bɛkɔtoto nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ. Bɛ bɔ bɛnze mmeraa ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkyirekyire bɛ. 26Na sona biala bɔ wanni wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso, ɔne me, Nana Atasɛsɛse me mmeraa so ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bebua ye fɔ bɛtwe ye so ndɛndɛ: kyɛ bekobua ye ewue foɛ oo, anaa bɛkɔpɛ ye asue oo, anaa bekole ye nwo nningyein oo, anaa bɛkɔto ye kuku nu oo.”
27(Yeɛ Ɛsra sele kyɛ,) “AWURADE, yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wafa sɔ adwene paa he wawura Nana Atasɛsɛse ti anu, kyɛ ɔfa siesie AWURADE awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem maa ɔyɛ nyemene ne, animnyam hã ye, 28ofikyɛ walo me wamaa manya animnyam wɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse ne ye foɛtulɛfoɛ ne ye mbanyi amukoraa bɛ nyunu. AWURADE me Nyameɛ lole me gyinane me si, na ɛhe hyɛle me nguraen. Na mmoaboale mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael noa maa yɛsa yɛwale.”

Title: ƐSRA 8
Content:
Mmusua mbanyi bɔ bɛ ne Ɛsra sa wale ɔ
1Mbanyi bɔ bɛlela bɛ mmusua nemɔ noa, bɔ bɛ ne me fili Babilɔn wale wɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse aberɛ so ne, b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ɛhe: 2Gɛsɔn bɔ ofi Finehase bosofoɛ nu, Daniel bɔ ofi Yitama bosofoɛ nu, Hatuse bɔ ofi Dawide bosofoɛ nu, 3Sekania bosofoɛ: Sakaria bɔ ofi Parose bosofoɛ nu, bɔ bɛhale mmienzua ɛyaa ko aburannu bɛbokale ye so ne. 4Pahate Moabo bosofoɛ nu: Serahia awa Eliehonae, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ boka ye so ɔ. 5Satu bosofoɛ nu: Yahasiɛl awa Sekania, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa nza boka ye so ɔ. 6Adin bosofoɛ nu: Yonatan awa Ebede, bɔ mmienzua aburannu boka ye so ɔ. 7Elam bosofoɛ nu: Atalia awa Yehyaya, bɔ mmienzua aburasoo boka ye so ɔ. 8Sefatia bosofoɛ nu: Mikayɛl awa Sebadia, bɔ mmienzua aburawɔtwɛ boka ye so ɔ. 9Yoabo bosofoɛ nu: Yehiel awa Obadia, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ ne buru ne mmɔtwɛ boka ye so ɔ. 10Bani bosofoɛ nu: Yosifia awa Selomite, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa ko aburasia boka ye so ɔ. 11Bebae bosofoɛ nu: Bebae awa Sakaria, bɔ mmienzua aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ boka ye so ɔ. 12Asegade bosofoɛ nu: Hakatan awa Yohanan, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa ko ne buru boka ye so ɔ. 13Adonikam bosofoɛ nu, bɛ bɔ bɛwale nziɛ ye ne, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Elifɛlɛte, Yeyiɛl ne Semaya, bɔ mmienzua aburasia boka bɛ so ɔ. 14Bigiwae bosofoɛ nu: Yutae ne Sakure, bɔ mmienzua aburasoo boka bɛ so ɔ.
Ɛsra to ye sa frɛ Lewifoɛ
15Mmoaboale bɛ noa wɔ asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ kɔ Ahawa ne anoa, na yɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ yɛlili berɛ ɛlɛsa. Nneaneane mmenia nemɔ ne asɔfo nemɔ nu, nakoso mannwu Lewi bosoniɛ biala berɛ. 16Yiti nzomane maa bɛɛfrɛle mbanyi Eliesa, Ariɛl, Semaya, Elnatan, Yaribo, Elnatan, Natan, Sakaria ne Mesulam, yeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ Yoaribo ne Elnatan. 17Na Yido bɔ ɔte panyi wɔ Kasifia ne, nzomane bɛ maa bɛhɔle ye berɛ. Mvale ngraa mane bɛ kyɛ beese Yido ne oliɛma mɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Kasifia ne kyɛ, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛkɔyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne, bɛma bɛbra yɛ wa. 18Na ɔnate kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ lole yɛ ne ati, bɛmane biaa bie bɔ oli Serebia wale. Ɔte Yisrael awa Lewi ɔwa Maheli ye bosoniɛ. Ɔne ye mma mɔ ne ye mmango Lewifoɛ, bɛte buru ne mmɔtwɛ. 19Besa bɛmane Hasabia ne Yehyaya bɔ bɛte Merari bosofoɛ ne bɛwale. Bɛ ne bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ, bɛte aburanyɔ. 20Asa koso, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburanyɔ bɔ Dawide ne ye mbanyi betuli bɛ besiele berɛ kyɛ bɛbokaboka Lewifoɛ mɔ ne, bɛ koso bɛmaa bɛwale. Bɛ mukoraa bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa.
Ɛsra ne maen ne bɛyɛ akɔngyere bɛbɔ mbaeɛ
21Yeɛ mva ndole dwaa wɔ asue Ahawa noa berɛ, kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala yɛ akɔngyere ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ná yɛsrɛ ye maa ɔbɔ yɛ ne yɛ mma mɔ ne yɛ nningyein mukoraa nwo waen wɔ y’ateetulɛ ne anu. 22Na ɔyɛle me nya kyɛ ngɔsrɛ Nana Atasɛsɛse kyɛ ɔma yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkɔbɔ yɛ nwo waen bekofi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu wɔ atunu ɔ, ofikyɛ né yali moa yahã yahyire ye kyɛ, “Sona biala bɔ ɔpena yɛ Nyameɛ si atee ne, Nyameɛ do ye ɔbɔ ye nwo waen. Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔpo Nyameɛ nen, Nyameɛ tumi ne ye yaafɛlɛ ko tia ye.” 23Yiti yɛyɛle akɔngyere yɛfale sɔ dwirɛ ne yɛtole yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu, na otiele yɛ mbaeɛ ne.
24Afei, asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ, nneaneane nu nyele bɛ nu buru ne nyɔ. Bɛ ole: Serebia, Hasabia, yeɛ bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ buru bɔ bɛboka bɛ so ɔ. 25Na Nana Atasɛsɛse ne ye foɛtulɛfoɛ ne ye mbanyi ne Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ amukoraa ne, ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo adwuma ne, ngarili mva nwurale asɔfo nemɔ sa. 26Bɔ ngarili mva nwurale bɛ sa ɛhe: ɛdwetɛ kilo apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ, ɛdwetɛ nningyein kilo apee nza ɛyaa nna, sikaa kɔkorɛ kilo apee nza ɛyaa nna, 27sikaa kɔkorɛ kulie mɔ bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo mmɔtwɛ ne bue, yeɛ kɔɔbere nningyein hyɛmhyɛm nyɔ bɔ bedi mu te kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ ɔ.
28Na nga ngyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔte krongron ma AWURADE, nningyein nemɔ te nningyein krongron, yeɛ ɛdwetɛ ne ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, bɛte akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne. 29Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa besie yé kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkɔkari bɛ wɔ asɔfo mbanyi ne Lewifoɛ ne Yisrael mmusua mbanyi nyunu, wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ pumbu ne anu wɔ Yerusalem ɔ.” 30Na asɔfo nemɔ bɛ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ belele ɛdwetɛ, sikaa kɔkorɛ ɔne nningyein bɔ ngarili mane bɛ ne, kyɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔwa yɛ Nyameɛ awuro wɔ Yerusalem.
Besa bɛba Yerusalem
31Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nyɔ ne, yeɛ yɛtuli yɛ bo yɛfili asue Ahawa noa kyɛ yɛkɔ Yerusalem ɔ. Yɛ Nyameɛ gyinane yɛ si, na ɔpepɛ lele yɛ fili pɔfoɛ mɔ ne mmenia bɔ bɛɛtetɛle yɛ atunu nemɔ sa nu. 32Yɛɛdwuli Yerusalem, na yɛlili berɛ ɛlɛsa. 33Ye ɛlɛnna ne aso, yɛkarili ɛdwetɛ ne, sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, ɔne nningyein ne wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ, na yɛfa yɛwurale Yuria awa ɔsɔfo Meremote sa. Né Finehase awa Eleasa boka ye so wɔ berɛ. Né Yesua awa Yosabade ne Binuyi awa Noadia bɔ bɛte Lewifoɛ ne koso bɛboka bɛ so wɔ berɛ. 34Ye mukoraa, ye somaa ne nu nonɛ ne, bɛhyerɛle ye sɔ mmerɛ ne ala.
35Sɔ mmerɛ ne, bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu besa bɛwale ne, bɛbobɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane Yisrael Nyameɛ. Begyinane Yisrael amukoraa gya nu bɛfale ɛhemɔ bɛbɔle afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii buru ne nyɔ, mmoaen nyii aburahona ne nzia, yeɛ mmoaen mmaa aburasoo ne nzoo. Besa bɛfale mbɔngye buru ne nyɔ bɛbɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. Bɛfale ye mukoraa bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE. 36Asa koso, Nana Atasɛsɛse mmeraa bɔ ɔhyerɛle ye krataa nu ne, bɛye bɛmane ye mbɔtam mbanyi mɔ ne amrado mɔ bɔ begyi ye gya nu wɔ asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne. Na bɛ koso bɛfale bɛ mmokalɛ bɛtale maen ne ne Nyameɛ awuro ne si.

Title: ƐSRA 9
Content:
Ɛsra bɔ agyaa mvrafra nwo mbaeɛ
1Yɛyɔle ɛhemɔ amukoraa yɛyiele nen, Yisrael mbanyi wale me berɛ beesele kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ, bɔ asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ mɔ boka so ɔ, bande bɛ nwo bamvi mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ nemɔ aso bɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te akyiwadeɛ ne anwo. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ ole: Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ, Amonfoɛ, Moabofoɛ, Misraimfoɛ ne Amorifoɛ. 2Ofikyɛ bagyigya bɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ bie, yeɛ bagyigya bie koso bama bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ. Ɔnate sɔ ati, mmenia krongron mɔ ne aseɛ nemɔ so ama bali afra. Na mbɔtam mbanyi ne mbanyi bɔ bɛla yɛ noa nemɔ po yeɛ bapɛ sɔ esaa tɛɛ ne bato berɛ ɔ.” 3Ndele sɔ dwirɛ nen, nzunzuale m’ataadeɛ ne m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ nu, ndutuli me ti nwiaa ne me kanza nwiaa, na mvale aworabɔlɛ mbofole aseɛnwo berɛ. 4Bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, ɔnate bɛ mvomsoɛ ne ati, mmenia mukoraa bɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne mane bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ ne, bɛɛtenatenane me nwo berɛ, na mvale aworabɔlɛ mbofole berɛ toonn maa oodwuli mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ nɔsoa afɔleɛ ne ɔ.
5Odwuli mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ nɔsoa afɔleɛ nen, mvili nekaa bɔ né maatena medi aworabɔlɛ ne ndwɔsole, bɔ né masunzua m’ataadeɛ ne m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ nu ɔ. Mmuli ndwerɛ, ndrɛle me sa nu mɔle mbaeɛ ngyirele AWURADE me Nyameɛ, 6na nzele kyɛ, “O me Nyameɛ, ɔyɛ me nya paa, na mafɛre kyɛ ngɔpagya me nye ngɔnea wɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ me Nyameɛ, y’amumuyɛɛ wasone pee, na yɛ mvomsoɛ wadwu nyameɛso. 7Fite yɛ nana mɔ aberɛ so toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, mvomsoɛ ali yɛ ti. Na ɔnate yɛ ne y’ahemvo mɔ ne y’asɔfo mɔ amumuyɛɛ ti, yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ ahemvo mɔ bɛ sa ahã yɛ bɔ beku yɛ, bɛkye yɛ nnure, bɛfẽ yɛ nningyein bɛfa, ná begua yɛ nyunu ase, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye. 8Nakoso mmerɛ kãa ye anu de, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ walo yɛ. Wama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu, na wabɔ yɛ atenaseɛ wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ, kyɛ ɔfa kyekye yɛ wora ná ɔma yɛ nwo tɔ yɛ kãa fi nganga tebea bɔ yahɔ nu ne anu. 9Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yayɛ nganga de, nakoso yɛ Nyameɛ anye ye sa wamvi yɛ bo wɔ yɛ ngangayɛlɛ ne anu. Mmom, wama Pɛsia ahemvo banwu yɛ anwumvoin. Na ɔnate so bama yɛ ate kyɛ yɛsa yɛsi yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne, kyɛ yɛhyehyɛ ye nekaa bɔ wabubu ne, na wabɔ yɛ nwo waen wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.
10“O afei yɛ Nyameɛ, ɛhemɔ asi ye, nzikyɛ dwirɛ bieku koraa yeɛ yɛhã ɔ? Yapo wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ 11bɔ ɛnate wɔ somvoɛ mɔ so ɛhyɛle kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaafa bɛtena so ne, ɔte aseɛ bɔ so ama nemɔ bafa bɛ bra fiɛ ne b’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ bahã ye ɔ. Bafa bɛ yɔleɛ fiɛ bayi ye tɛkyɛ fi ye ti kɔka ye ti. 12 Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ mma mmrasua bɛma bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ begya, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔgyigya bɛ mma mmrasua bɛma ɛmɔ mma mmienzua. Nnɛma ɛmɔpena bɛ ne asomdwee anaa paa, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ nwo ayɛ se, ná ɛmɔali aseɛ ne aso nningyein paa, ná ɛmɔafa bayakyi ɛmɔ mma mɔ maa wayɛ agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ.’ 13Yɛ bɔne ne y’amumuyɛɛ kandinga ne ati yeɛ ɛhemɔ atoto yɛ ɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ye po, wɔ, yɛ Nyameɛ, y’amumuyɛɛ nwo asohwenɛ bɔ afa ama yɛ ne ɔte kãa, na ama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu. 14Aso odi kyɛ yɛbu wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso bieku, bɔ yɛne mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ sɔ akyiwadeɛ bra ne yagyigya yɛ nwo ɔ? Aso ɛngɔfɛ yɛ so yaa toonn kɔpem kyɛ ekohũhũ yɛ bɔ yɛ nu biala ngɔha anaa ongonya ye ti ngodidi nu ɔ? 15O AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ɛtengyɛ, ofikyɛ ama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye. Yɛ amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ yɛwɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebiala ngɔhora ngɔfa sɔ amumuyɛɛ ne ngogyina wɔ nyunu.”

Title: ƐSRA 10
Content:
Agyaa mvrafra bralɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ
1Mmerɛ bɔ Ɛsra gu so ɔbɔ mbaeɛ, bɔ ole esuɛ ode bɛ bɔne to nu, bɔ né wafa ye nyunu wabutu berɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ ne, Yisraelfoɛ pembepembe, mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa bɛɛpɛle ye nwo beyiale, na bɛ koso besuni hahii. 2Na Elam bosoniɛ Yehiel ɔwa Sekania sele Ɛsra kyɛ, “Yanni nahorɛ yamma yɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛ yagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ye po, anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma Yisrael. 3Yiti kekesaala ye, odi kyɛ yɛne yɛ Nyameɛ yɛyɛ apam, kyɛ yɛ ye nemɔ, bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ, yɛkɔfoa bɛ maa bekofi yɛ nu bɛkɔhɔ. Me mene, ɛne mmenia bɔ bedi Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso ne, odi kyɛ yɛyɔ ye sɔ kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kyire ɔ. 4Dwɔso, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ asodie ne ɔla wɔ so ɔ. Yɛgyi wɔ si, yiti si wɔ hue ná yɔ ye sɔ.” 5Yeɛ Ɛsra dwɔsole, na ɔmane asɔfo mbanyi ne Lewifoɛ ne Yisrael amukoraa bɛtale ndaen kyɛ bekoli sɔ dwirɛ ne aso. Na bɛtale ndaen ne.
6Afei Ɛsra fili Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ, na ɔhɔle Eliasibo awa Yehohanan sua nu. Ɔhɔle berɛ ne, wannidi, yeɛ wanno nzue, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, né odi b’amumuyɛɛ nwo aworabɔlɛ. 7Na behyinini Yuda ne Yerusalem amukoraa bɛbɔle dawure behyirele bɛ bɔ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne amukoraa, kyɛ beeyia nu wɔ Yerusalem, 8kyɛ bama bɛ ɛlɛsa, na ebiala bɔ wamma ne, mbɔtam mbanyi ne mbanyi nemɔ bahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ bele ye nwo nningyein amu, ná bɛpɛ ye asue befi mmenia bɔ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne anu.
9Na ɛlɛsa ne sone ne, né bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne Benyamin amukoraa baaboa bɛ noa wɔ Yerusalem. Né ɔte kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so ngona ne anu. Mmenia ne amukoraa bɛtenatenane dwaa ne aso wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ. Na ɔnate sɔ dwirɛ ne ɔne esue piri bɔ né ɔtɔ ne ati, bɛ nwo wosowosole bɛ. 10Afei ɔsɔfo Ɛsra dwɔso gyinane sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔabu mmeraa ne aso, kyɛ ɛmɔagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua ɔ, na ɛmɔnate ɛhe aso bama Yisrael foɛlilɛ ne wayɛ piri paa. 11Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔde ɛmɔ bɔne bɛto nu bekyire AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ná ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi aseɛ ne aso mmenia nwo, ɔne Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua nwo.”
12Yeɛ mmenia bɔ bayia berɛ ne amukoraa bɛteane nu bebuale kyɛ, “Ye ala ɛne. Bɔ ahã ne ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ɔ. 13Nakoso mmenia ne sone, asuso koso atikye bɔ yɛngɔhora dwaaso gyina ɔ. Yeɛ nna nikyee bɔ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔfa ɛlɛho anaa elenyɔ yɛkɔyɔ hɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ bɔ yato mmeraa wɔ ɛhe anwo ne, yɛsone paa. 14Yiti ma yɛ mbanyi mɔ begyina mmenia ne amukoraa yɛ gya nu, ná ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ nguro nemɔ aso bɔ wagya Amaenmaensoniɛ braa ne, maa ɔbra bɛ nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ bɛkɔma ye ɔ nu. Sɛ bɛ́ba a, odi kyɛ bɛ kuro mbanyi ne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bɛboka bɛ so bɛ ne bɛ bɛba. Na yɛkɔyɔ ye sɔ toonn kɔpem kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ɛyaa piri bɔ wafɛ ye yɛ so wɔ edwirɛ he anwo ne, ye ahone kɔtɔ nzue nu ɔ.” 15Asahel awa Yonatan ne Tikiwa awa Yahasia bɛ ngome yeɛ betiale sɔ nzusuleɛ ne anu ɔ, na Mesulam ne Lewiniɛ Sabetae bɛfoale bɛ so.
16Na bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne de, belele nzusuleɛ ne bɛtole nu. Na ɔsɔfo Ɛsra yeyele mmusua mbanyi nemɔ, abusua biala nu sona ko, na bɛbobɔle bɛ dumaa. Na kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne anu ne, bɛtenane ase kyɛ bɛneanea edwirɛ ne anu. 17Na oodwuli kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu ne, né baneanea mmienzua bɔ bagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua nemɔ bɛ dwirɛ ne anu bayie.
18Benwuni kyɛ asɔfo abusua ne, bɛ bɔ bagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua mɔ ɛhe: Yosadake awa Yesua ye bosofoɛ ne oliɛma mɔ: Maaseya, Eliesa, Yaribo ne Gedalia. 19Bɛhyɛle ɛbɔ kyɛ bɛkɔfoa bɛ ye nemɔ maa bekofi bɛ nu bɛkɔhɔ. Belele bɛ mvomsoɛ bɛtole nu, na bɛfale boaen nyii ko bɛbɔle mvomsoɛ afɔleɛ. 20Yimere bosofoɛ nemɔ: Hanani ne Sebadia. 21Harim bosofoɛ nemɔ: Maaseya, Elia, Semaya, Yehiel ne Yusia. 22Pasure bosofoɛ nemɔ: Elionae, Maaseya, Yismael, Netanɛl, Yosabade ne Elasa.
23Lewifoɛ nemɔ: Yosabade, Simei, Kelaya (ye ala ole Kelita), Petahia, Yuda ne Eliesa. 24Edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ: Eliasibo. Anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ: Salum, Telem ne Yuri.
25Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne koso, Parose bosofoɛ: Ramia, Yisia, Malkiya, Miyamin, Eleasa, Malkiya ne Benaya. 26Elam bosofoɛ nemɔ: Matania, Sakaria, Yehiel, Abidi, Yeremote ne Elia. 27Satu bosofoɛ nemɔ: Elionae, Eliasibo, Matania, Yeremote, Sabade ne Asisa. 28Bebae bosofoɛ nemɔ: Yehohanan, Hanania, Sabae ne Atelae. 29Bani bosofoɛ nemɔ: Mesulam, Maluke, Adaya, Yasubo, Seale ne Yeremote. 30Pahate Moabo bosofoɛ nemɔ: Adena, Kelale, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Basalel, Binuyi ne Manase. 31Harim bosofoɛ nemɔ: Eliesa, Yisiya, Malkiya, Semaya, Simeon, 32Benyamin, Maluke ne Semaria. 33Hasum bosofoɛ nemɔ: Matenae, Matata, Sabade, Elifɛlɛte, Yeremae, Manase ne Simei. 34Bani bosofoɛ nemɔ: Maadae, Amram, Yuel, 35Benaya, Bedeya, Keluhi, 36Wania, Meremote, Eliasibo, 37Matania, Matenae ne Yaasu. 38Bani, Binuyi, Simei, 39Selemia, Natan, Adaya, 40Makenadebae, Sasae, Sarae, 41Asarel, Selemia, Semaria, 42Salum, Amaria ne Yosef. 43Nebo bosofoɛ nemɔ: Yeyiɛl, Matitia, Sabade, Sebina, Yadae, Yowel ne Benaya.
44Né sɔ mmenia ne amukoraa bagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua, na né bɛ nu biemɔ bɛ ne bɛ bawowo.

Title: NEHEMIA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ahemvo nwomaa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ n’ayieleɛ ne, yɛnwuni kyɛ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa hyele Yudafoɛ nnure fale bɛ hɔle Babilɔn. Ye si ye, Pɛsiafoɛ belili Babilɔnfoɛ so ngonim. Nziɛ ye, Yudaniɛ Nehemia ɔɔyɛle Pɛsia hene ye nzaasulɛniɛ wɔ ye ahemvie berɛ. Nehemia srɛle Pɛsia hene Atasɛsɛse ate kyɛ ɔpena ɔkɔ ye kuro Yerusalem, na osa kɔkyekye kuro ne. Nana Atasɛsɛse mane ye ate. Nwomaa ne anu, yɛnwu kyɛbɔ Nehemia osi boaboale Yudafoɛ noa maa besa besili Yerusalem fasue ne ne ye pambim nemɔ ɔ. Yɛnwu nikyee titire paa ko wɔ nwomaa ne anu: Nehemia te sona bɔ ɔfale ye nwo tole Nyameɛ so, bɔ né ɔtaa bɔ mbaeɛ ɔ. Yɛkɔhora yɛkɔhyɛ Nehemia nwomaa ne anu nna. Bɔ oli moa ɔ, Pɛsia hene mane Nehemia ate kyɛ osa hɔ Yerusalem ɔɔkyekye kuro ne. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, yɛnwu kyɛ besa besili Yerusalem fasue ne; bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ɔ, ɔsɔfo Ɛsra kengale Nyameɛ mmeraa ne, na Yudafoɛ bɛhane bɛ bɔne behyirele Nyameɛ. Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, Nehemia lili Yuda so amrado, na ɔyɛle ndotoleɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa maen ne anu ama nwo bɛ kɔtɔ bɛ, ná afei basɔne bɛ Nyameɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Nehemia sa ba Yerusalem 1.1—2.20
Besa besi Yerusalem fasue ne 3.1—7.73
Bɛkenga Mmeraa ne, na besa bɛ ne Nyameɛ yɛ Apam 8.1—10.39
Nehemia yɛ Yuda so amrado 11.1—13.31

Title: NEHEMIA 1
Content:
Nehemia bɔ mbaeɛ ma Yerusalem
1Hakalia awa Nehemia, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe. Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne, bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kislewi ne anu, ɛlɛho bie, né nwɔ Susa ahemvie. 2Na nniɛma nemɔ anu ko bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Hanani, ɔne mmenia biemɔ befili Yuda bɛwale. Mmisale bɛ Yudafoɛ bɔ baha dɔ bɔ bɛ de bangye bɛ nnure bangɔ bie ne, ɔne Yerusalem kuro ne, bɛ nwo dwirɛ. 3Na bɛbɔle me amaneɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ bangye bɛ nnure bangɔ bie, ná bɛwɔ maen ne anu ne, amaneɛ ne animguaseɛ kandinga paa ato bɛ. Pɔfoɛ nemɔ babubu Yerusalem fasue ne bagua, yeɛ ye pambim nemɔ koso bato nu see bayera bɛ.”
4Na ndele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, ndenane ase nzuni, nnili aworabɔlɛ ngyẽa pee, na nyɛle akɔngyere mmɔle mbaeɛ wɔ nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne nyunu. 5Na ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ, Nyameɛ piri bɔ wɔ nwo yɛ suro bɔ edi apam so ná ɛye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ali kyire bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dwirɛ ná bedi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso ne, 6mesrɛ wɔ, yɛ asoɛ tie, ná fa wɔ nye nea, amaa ate w’akoaa me mbaeɛ bɔ mebɔ wɔ wɔ nyunu kekesaala ye mema wɔ ngoaa Yisraelfoɛ eyia ne kɔngɔen ne. Afei, Yisraelfoɛ, yɛ bɔne bɔ yayɔ yatia wɔ ne, mekã mekyire wɔ. Me ne me baba awuro ama amukoraa, nahorɛ nu, yayɔ bɔne. 7Yayɔ bɔne kandinga paa yatia wɔ, na mmeraa dwirɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɛhyehyɛle mane wɔ somvoɛ Mose ne, yanni so. 8Kaye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛfa mane wɔ somvoɛ Mose kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ bamma me a, ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngɔsande ngɔhɔ maen maen nemɔ aso, 9 nakoso sɛ ɛmɔsa bɛba me berɛ, ná ɛmɔdi me mmeraa dwirɛ so a, ye de aseɛ ye aso nekaa biala bɔ mama ɛmɔ babɔ aya baagua ne, ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ngofi dɔ; ná mafa ɛmɔ mawa nekaa bɔ maye masie berɛ mafa me dumaa mato so ne.’ 10Bɛte wɔ somvoɛ mɔ ne wɔ maen bɔ afa wɔ tumi piri ne w’anwoserɛ kandinga ne apepɛ ale bɛ ɔ. 11Ao AWURADE, wɔ somvoɛ ne wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛ nye gye kyɛ bɛkɔfa anidie bɛkɔma wɔ dumaa ne, mesrɛ wɔ tie yɛ mbaeɛ. Ma nningyein ɔhɔ so yé ɔma wɔ somvoɛ, ná ma biaa ye onwu me anwumvoin.”
Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né nde Ɛhene ne, ye nzaasulɛniɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 2
Content:
Nehemia kɔ Yerusalem
1Nana Atasɛsɛse lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne anu, bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nisan ne anu, ɛlɛho bie, né nzaa gyi Nana nyunu, na nzuli ye. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Nana Atasɛsɛse onnwuni kyɛ me wora abɔ wɔ ye nyunu le. 2Yiti Nana bisale me kyɛ, “Ɛte apɔ, nakoso nzu ati yeɛ wɔ nyunu ayɛ bosaa ye? Ɛhe de nna hwee ɔ, wɔ wora mmom yeɛ wabɔ ɔ.” Na ɛhe mane ɛserɛ hane me paa. 3 Na nzele Nana kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ me wora ngɔbɔ ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ kuro bɔ me nana mɔ asieleɛ wɔ so ne, wabɔ bɔ bafa see bayera ye pambim mɔ ɔ?” 4Yeɛ Nana bisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ meyɔ mema wɔ ɔ?” Yiti mmɔle mbaeɛ ngyirele nyameɛso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne. 5Yeɛ mmuale Nana kyɛ, “Nana, sɛ ɛpene so, ná anya alo wɔ somvoɛ de a, ye de mesrɛ kyɛ ma me ate maa ngɔ Yuda, kuro bɔ me nana mɔ b’asieleɛ wɔ so ne aso, ná nza ngɔngyekye kuro ne.” 6Na Nana Atasɛsɛse bisale me kyɛ (sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛhemmaa ne ɔte ye nwo berɛ), “Ekoli ɛlɛnyɛɛ, ná kyinzu yeɛ ekosa kɔwa ɔ?” Yiti Nana Atasɛsɛse mane me ate, na nhyɛle kyẽa bɔ ngosa ngɔwa ɔ. 7Yeɛ nzele Nana Atasɛsɛse kyɛ, “Nana, sɛ ɛpene so a, maa bɛhyerɛ ngrataa maa ngɔmva mma Asue si dɔ mbɔtam amrado nemɔ, maa bɛma me ate maa mbɛ nu ngɔ kɔpem kyɛ ngodwu Yuda ɔ. 8Afei, Nana, kyerɛ krataa maa ngɔma Asafe bɔ ɔnea wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ ne aso ne, kyɛ ɔma me mmakaa maa mva nyɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua abandenden pambim mbuna nemɔ, kuro berɛ fasue pambim nemɔ ɔne awuro bɔ mekwaatena nu ne anoa nemɔ.” Na nningyein bɔ nzrɛle ne, Nana Atasɛsɛse fa mane me, ofikyɛ né me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔdo sona ne, né ogyi me si.
9Yeɛ amrado mɔ bɔ bɛnea asue ne asi dɔ mbɔtam nemɔ aso ne, ngondwuli bɛ berɛ, na mvale Nana ngrataa nemɔ mmane bɛ. Né Nana Atasɛsɛse watu koɛhonɛfoɛ mbanyi ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ kyɛ bɛboka me so bɛ ne me bra. 10Nakoso Horonniɛ Sanbalate ne Amonniɛ Tobia bɔ ɔte somvoɛ ne, bɛtele bɔ ɔkɔ so ne, ɔyɛle bɛ yea paa kyɛ ebie awa bɔ ɔbaapena Yisraelfoɛ bɛ yeeyɛlɛ ɔ.
Nehemia kɔneanea Yerusalem fasue nemɔ
11Yiti mmandwuli Yerusalem, na nnili berɛ ɛlɛsa. 12Ɛhe asi ye, ndwɔsole kɔngɔen. Né mmenia kãa bie yeɛ bɛboka me so ɔ. Na nikyee bɔ Nyameɛ akanyane me kyɛ nyɔ ma Yerusalem ne, mangã mangyire ebiala. Né kaka biala ɔbboka me so, sana kaka bɔ nde ye so ne ala. 13Nzili nu kɔngɔen mvale Bɔnza Pambim ne anu ndrale Sasrabɔnzam mbombonzue ne anwo ngɔle Fofoɛ Pambim ne anwo, na ngɔneane Yerusalem fasue mɔ bɔ badwiri bɛ bagua ase, ɔne ye pambim mɔ bɔ bafa see bayerayera bɛ nemɔ. 14Yeɛ ndoale so ngɔle Abura Pambim ne anwo ne Ɛhene Ɛkwaa ne anwo, na kaka bɔ nde so ne wanya nekaa fee wamva. 15Yiti mvo mvale bɔnza ne anwo kɔngɔen ngɔneaneane fasue ne. Afei ngakyili me nwo mmamvale Bɔnza Pambim ne anu, na nzale me si. 16Né mbanyi nemɔ, bɛnze nekaa bɔ ngɔle ɔ, yeɛ bɛnze nikyee bɔ ngɔnyɔle ɔ. Yudafoɛ, asɔfo nemɔ, atitirefoɛ nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ, bɛ ne mmenia ngaa nemɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ adwuma ne, né nya mmɔle bɛ amaneɛ.
17Yeɛ nga ngyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔanwu edwirɛ bɔ wato yɛ ye: kyɛbɔ Yerusalem wakakyi kurofoen, bɔ ye pambim nemɔ koso bato nu see ɔ. Ɛ́mɔdwɔso maa yɛsa yɛkyekye Yerusalem fasue ne, amaa yɛ nyunu wangɔ so wangua ase.” 18Ngane kyɛbɔ me Nyameɛ walo me wagyina me si, ɔne edwirɛ bɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse wahã wahyire mene ngyirele bɛ. Na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛdwɔso yɛsi!” Yiti bɛfale bɛ nwo belele sɔ adwuma paa ne anu. 19Nakoso Horonniɛ Sanbalate, Amonniɛ Tobia bɔ ɔte somvoɛ ne, yeɛ Araboniɛ Gesem bɛtele bɔ ɔkɔ so nen, bɛserele yɛ bɛgorole yɛ nwo kyɛ, “Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkyire ye? Ɛmɔyɛ Nana nwo lɔen anaa?” 20Yeɛ mmuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛso Nyameɛ, ye yeɛ ɔkɔmaa yɛkoli ngonim ɔ. Yɛte ye ngoaa mɔ, na yɛkodwɔso yɛkosi. Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔlle kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ anaa ngayeɛ biala wɔ Yerusalem nu.”

Title: NEHEMIA 3
Content:
Bɛhyɛ fasue ne silɛ bo
1Ɔsɔfo panyi paa Eliasibo ɔne ye mmango asɔfo nemɔ, bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛyɔle adwuma, na besili Mmoaen Pambim ne. Bɛtele Mmoaen Pambim ne anwo bɛyɛle ye krongron, na betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ. Bɛtele ye nwo alaa beedwuli Mmenia Ɛyaa Abandenden ne anwo ɔne Hananel abandenden ne anwo. 2Na Yerikofoɛ nemɔ besi bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso. Yeɛ Yimri awa Sakure sili fasue ne toale bɛ deɛ ne aso.
3Hasenaa mma mmienzua nemɔ, besili Tire Pambim ne. Begyinagyinane ye mbuna nemɔ, betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. 4Hakose awa Yuriya ɔwa Meremote toale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé. Mesesabɛl ɔwa Berekia awa Mesulam koso toale so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé. Baana awa Sadoke toale so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé. 5Tekoafoɛ nemɔ, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé, nakoso bɛ mmenia titire nemɔ de, adwuma bɔ bɛ mene nemɔ hyirele bɛ ne, bamva bɛ sa banzɔ nu bie.
6Pasea awa Yowada ne Besodeya awa Mesulam bɛyɔle Pambim Daa ne yé. Begyinagyinane ye mbuna nemɔ, betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. 7Gibeonniɛ Melatia ne Merononiɛ Yadon, yeɛ Gibeonfoɛ ne Misepafoɛ bɔ bɛte mmenia bɔ bewura asue ne asi dɔ amrado ne abo ne, bɛtoale bɛ so bɛyɔle nekaa biemɔ bɔ né basɛkye ɔ yé. 8Hahayia awa Yusiɛl bɔ ɔte esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ nemɔ ko ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé. Hanania bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔ bɛfrafra sakyeɛfona nemɔ bɛ nu ko ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé, na besa bɛkyekyele Yerusalem beedwuli Fasue Tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne. 9Hure awa Refaya bɔ ɔte Yerusalem manzini ne bue so amrado ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé. 10Harumafo awa Yedaya, nekaa bɔ wasɛkye bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé, na Hasabeneya awa Hatuse toale ye so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé. 11Harim awa Malkiya ne Pahate Moabo awa Hasubo yɔle fasue ne nekaa foforɛ bɔ wasɛkye ɔ, ɔne Foonoo Abandenden ne yé. 12Halohese bɔ ɔte Yerusalem manzini ne bue so amrado ne, ɔwa Salum ne Salum mma mmrasua mɔ, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé.
13Hanun ne Sanoafoɛ bɛyɔle Bɔnza Pambim ne yé. Besa besili na betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. Fasue ne, nekaa bɔ bɛyɔle ye yé maa oodwuli Fofoɛ Pambim ne, ye tendenn te agyirɛ apee ko.
14Na Malkiya bɔ ye baba ole Bete Hakerem manzini Rekabo amrado ne, ɔyɔle Fofoɛ Pambim ne yé. Osa sili na otuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na ɔfale mberɛgoo omiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu.
15Na Salum bɔ ye baba ole Misepa manzini amrado Kolhose ne, ɔyɔle Mbombonzue Pambim ne, osa sili, ɔkatale so, na otuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. Na Sela Ɛkwaa fasue bɔ ɔwɔ Nana ye turo ne anu ne, osili alaa oodwuli atweleɛ bɔ ɔtoro kɔ Dawide kuro ne anu nwo. 16Nehemia bɔ ye baba ole Bete Sure manzini ne bue so amrado Azebuke ne, ɔtoale Salum deɛ ne aso. Nekaa bie bɔ ɔwɔ Dawide ɛbaa nu berɛ ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé, maa oodwuli ɛkwaa bɔ bahyɛ da bapɛ ne, ɔne koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ b’awuro ne ndendeneɛ so. 17Lewifoɛ nemɔ toale ye so bɛyoyɔle nekaa biemɔ yé: Bani awa Rehum koso toale Hasabia bɔ ɔte Keila manzini ne bue so safohene ne aso. Ɔtoale so yɔle nekaa biemɔ bɔ basɛkye wɔ ye manzini ne anu ne yé. 18Ye abusuafoɛ mɔ toale ye deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye biemɔ yé. Na Henadade bɔ ɔte manzini ne bue so amrado ne, ɔwa Bawayi koso toale so. 19Yesua bɔ ɔnea Misepa kuro ne aso ne, ɔwa Esere ɔtoale Bawayi deɛ ne aso. Nekaa foforɛ bie bɔ ɔwɔ pambaa bɔ besie akodeɛ wɔ so ne ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé. 20Sabae awa Baruku yɔle fasue ne nekaa bie bɔ ofi Ndweasoɛ ne aso bɔ ɔkwaadwu ɔsɔfo panyi Eliasibo awuro ne anoa ne yé. 21Hakose awa Yuriya ɔwa Meremote, ɔyɔle fasue ne nekaa bie fite Eliasibo awuro ne anoa maa oodwuli Eliasibo awuro ne ye ti dɔ paa. 22Asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ mbɔtam berɛ ne, bɛtoale Hakose deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé. 23Benyamin ne Hasubo bɛtoale bɛ deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ b’awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ne yé. Na Anania awa Maaseya ɔwa Asaria toale bɛ deɛ ne aso ɔyɔle nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ne anwo ne yé. 24Henadade awa Binuyi toale ye deɛ ne aso yɔle fasue ne yé, fi Asaria awuro berɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ndweasoɛ ne ɔne ahameɛ dɔ ne. 25Ndweasoɛ ne abandenden bɔ ogyi ahemvie aborɔsaen so bɔ opingye kuku nu aluo berɛ ne, ye ndendeneɛ so, Yusae awa Palal yɔle berɛ fasue ne yé. Parose awa Pedaya toale ye deɛ ne aso; 26ɔne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛte Ofel, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle fasue ne yé beedwuli Nzue Pambim bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ so ne ɔne abandenden bɔ ogyi sua ne aso ne, bɛ ndendeneɛ so. 27Tekoafoɛ mɔ bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé wɔ abandenden piri ne ndendeneɛ so maa oodwuli Ofel fasue ne.
28Pɔngɔ Pambim ne anwuro dɔ, asɔfo nemɔ yɔle fasue ne yé, na ebiala yɔle nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ndendeneɛ so ɔ. 29Yimere awa Sadoke yɔle fasue ne yé wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ɔ. Sekania awa Semaya bɔ ɔnea Eyia Afiteleɛ Pambim ne aso ne, ɔyɔle fasue ne yé toale Sadoke deɛ ne aso. 30Selemia awa Hanania ne Hanun bɔ ɔte Salafe awa bienzua bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne, bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé. Berekia awa Mesulam ɔyɔle fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye pumbu ndendeneɛ so ne yé. 31Malkiya bɔ ɔte esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ nemɔ anu ko ne, ɔtoale Mesulam deɛ ne aso. Ɔyɔle pambim ne yé alaa odwuli asɔneyɛɛ sua somvoɛ ne dwadifoɛ mɔ awuro wɔ Dwaabɔlɛ Pambim ne ndendeneɛ so, kɔpem ndweasoɛ so aborɔsaen pumbu ne. 32Ndweasoɛ so aborɔsaen so pumbu bɔ ɔkwaadwu Mmoaen Pambim ne, esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ ne dwadifoɛ yeɛ bɛyɔle berɛ fasue ne yé ɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 4
Content:
Pɔfoɛ mɔ mbene fasuesilɛ ne aso
1Mmerɛ bɔ Sanbalate tele kyɛ yɛsi fasue ne, ye ahone huli, na ɔfɛle yaa paa. Ɔhane Yudafoɛ nemɔ anyinga, 2na ɔhane wɔ ye mmango nemɔ ɔne Samaria koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anyunu kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛ nwo anwumvoin hemɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ye? Aso bekosa bɛkɔtoto nningyein ye anaa? Aso bɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ anaa? Aso bekoyie adwuma ye ɛlɛho? Nyɔboɛ bɔ wadwiri wagua wahonhɔn wahɔ anwuro bɔ see ayera ye ye, aso bekonya nyɔboɛ bekofi nu?” 3Né Amonniɛ Tobia gyi Sanbalate nwo berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Nyɔboɛ fasue bɔ besi ye, sɛ safuboa po fo so a, okodwiri kogua ase!” 4(Na mmɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ), “Yɛ Nyameɛ, tie, ofikyɛ bemmu yɛ kyɛ yɛte mmenia po. B’anyinga bɔ bɛkã yɛ ne, maa ɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so, na maa ebiemɔ bɛfa bɛ kyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɛhye bɛ nnure bɛhɔ maen foforɛ aso. 5Nnebu wɔ nye gua b’amumuyɛɛ so. Nnɛma bɛ bɔne kyikyi fi wɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ bagyina suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ nyunu bawura wɔ apue maa afɛ yaa.”
6Yiti yɛsili fasue ne, na yɛtoatoale ye mukoraa so maa ɔhã sili, na kyɛbɔ odi kyɛ ɔkɔ anwuro ne, yɛsili maa odwuli ye afia, ofikyɛ mmenia ne yele bɛ kunu bɛyɔle adwuma ne.
7Nakoso Sanbalate ne Tobia yeɛ Arabofoɛ, Amonfoɛ ne Asedɔdefoɛ bɛtele kyɛ Yerusalem fasue ne silɛ ɔkɔ so, ná yahyɛ ye bo yɛtuatua nu ndokuro nen, bɛfɛle yaa paa, 8na bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛteta Yerusalem ná bɛyɛ basabasa wɔ kuro ne anu. 9Yiti yɛbɔle mbaeɛ yɛhyirele yɛ Nyameɛ, na yɛyele awɛmvoɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ yɛ nwo waen befi bɛ sa nu eyia ne kɔngɔen.
10Nakoso Yudafoɛ sele kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛsesa kungumaboɔ ne befi berɛ ne, b’anwoserɛ so ate, na kungumaboɔ ne somaa ti, yɛngora yɛnyɔ fasue ne nwo adwuma.” 11Na yɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ hane kyɛ, “Bɛ nye kɔwa bɛ nwo so ne, né yahɔ bɛ so yahũhũ bɛ maa adwuma ne bo apɛ.” 12Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛte bepingye pɔfoɛ nemɔ ne, bɛwale bɛɛbɔle yɛ amaneɛ pɛen buru kyɛ, “Bekofi nekaa bɔ bɛtete ne amukoraa bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔɔtoa yɛ.” 13Yiti fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ase ne, ye si dɔ, nekaa bɔ ndokuro lela nu ne, mmane mmenia beegyinane dɔ mmusua mmusua bɔ né betiratira bɛ ngrandɛ, bɛ pealɛɛ ne b’agyaen ɔ. 14Na nneane bɔ ɔkɔ so ne, ndwɔsole nga ngyirele atitire nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne ngaa ne kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ. Ɛ́mɔkaye AWURADE bɔ ɔte piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ne, ná ɛ́mɔho bɛpepɛ bele ɛmɔ abusuafoɛ, ɛmɔ mma mmienzua, ɛmɔ mma mmrasua, ɛmɔ aye mɔ ɔne ɛmɔ awuro ama.”
15Na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ tele kyɛ yate bɛ porɛ bɔ babɔ ne, na afei Nyameɛ ama bɛ nzusuleɛ ayɛ mbaen ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛsa yɛhɔle fasue ne anwo, na ebiala ɔɔtoale ye adwuma so. 16Ofi sɔ kyẽa ne, me somvoɛ nemɔ, bɛ bue bɛyɔle fasuesilɛ adwuma ne, yeɛ bɛ bue koso betiratirale pealɛɛ, akokyɛm, agyaen ne akodeɛ mɔ, na mbanyi nemɔ beegyinagyinane Yuda awuro ama amukoraa bɛ si. 17Sɔ Yudafoɛ nemɔ yeɛ né besi fasue ne ɔ. Bɛ bɔ né bɛsoasoa ne, sɔa yeɛ bɛyɔle adwuma ne ɔ: bɛ nu biala fale ye sa ko yɔle adwuma, yeɛ ɔfale ko koso tirale akodeɛ nu. 18Adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne, begu so besi sua nen, né ebiala wafa ye ngrandɛ wasi. Biaa bɔ ohu totorobɛndo ne, né ogyi me nwo berɛ. 19Na nga ngyirele atitire nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne ngaa ne kyɛ, “Adwuma ne te piri, na ɔtrɛ paa, na yɛ koso yɛmbingyembingye yɛ nwo wɔ fasue ne anwo; yɛ nu atete. 20Yiti nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔte totorobɛndo nga ne, ɛmɔhã bɛ nwo bɛbra yɛ nwo berɛ. Yɛ Nyameɛ kɔho kɔma yɛ.”
21Yiti yɛyerele yɛ nwo yɛyɔle adwuma ne, na yɛ nu bue betiratirale pealɛɛ fi alebahyene maa oodwuli mmerɛ bɔ nzramaa fite ɔ. 22Afei koso sɔ mmerɛ ne, nga ngyirele maen ne kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ bienzua biala ne ye somvoɛ bɛda Yerusalem kɔngɔen biala, amaa bawɛne yɛ kɔngɔen, ná bayɔ adwuma eyia.” 23Yiti me oo, nniɛma nemɔ oo, me somvoɛ nemɔ oo, awɛmvoɛ bɔ beli me si nemɔ oo, yɛ nu biala wanye ye ndaadeɛ wangua berɛ le. Na ebiala fale ye akodeɛ tirale.

Title: NEHEMIA 5
Content:
Nehemia pepɛ de ehiafoɛ
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, mmenia ne pee ne bɛ ye mɔ, bɛfɛle yaa bɛhane kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ b’eliɛma mɔ Yudafoɛ bɛfa bedi bɛ ne, ɔnyɛ bɛ fɛ. 2Ofikyɛ bɛ nu biemɔ hane kyɛ, “Yɛ ne yɛ mma mmienzua ne yɛ mma mmrasua, yɛsone. Odi kyɛ yɛnya aleɛ yɛdi ná yanya ngoa.” 3Yeɛ bɛ nu biemɔ koso hane kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛhɔen kandinga ne ati, yafa yɛ boo mɔ, yɛ bobe boo mɔ, yeɛ y’awuro mɔ yasi awowaa yapena yɛ noa aleɛ.” 4Na né ebiemɔ koso bɛkekã kyɛ, “Ɛtoɔ bɔ odi kyɛ yɛtua yɛma Nana wɔ y’aseɛ ne yɛ bobe boo nwo ne, ɔyɛ a yɛbɔ bosea koraka né yatua. 5Yɛne y’eliɛma Yudafoɛ ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛte sona ko. Yɛ mma te kyɛ bɛ mma deɛ mɔ ala. Nakoso yɛhyɛ yɛ mma mmienzua ne yɛ mma mmrasua mɔ maa bɛyɛ nganga, na yɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ bie de yali moa yatɔne bɛ. Yɛyɔ ye nwo hwee a ɔnyɛ ye, yeɛ y’aseɛ ne yɛ bobe boo mɔ ayɛ ebiemɔ deɛ.”
6Ndele bɛ kwaadu ne sɔ dwirɛ bɔ ɔha bɛ ne, mvɛle yaa paa. 7 Na ndwene ye nwo alaa nen, mmɔle atitire ne mbanyi nemɔ kwaadu nzele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔde nzihoɛ befi ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ berɛ!” Na mmɔle dwaa kandinga kyɛ mene bɛ koli, 8na nzele bɛ kyɛ, “Y’eliɛma Yudafoɛ bɔ batɔne bɛ bama Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ ne, yabɔ mmɔden bɔ yɛkɔhora biala yapɔ bɛ. Nakoso afei de ɛmɔtɔne ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma Yudafoɛ bɛma Yudafoɛ maa yɛsa yɛkɔpɔ bɛ!” Bɛyɛle konn, na né bennwu dwirɛ bɔ bɛhã ɔ. 9Yiti ngane kyɛ, “Nikyee bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne, ɔtte mayee. Aso onni kyɛ ɛmɔsuro yɛ Nyameɛ, amaa ɔnate so maen maen mɔ bɔ bɛte yɛ pɔfoɛ ne, bangoro yɛ nwo ɔ? 10Afei koso, mene nniɛma mɔ ne me somvoɛ mɔ yɛma bɛ esikaa ne aleɛ. Ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi nzihoɛlelɛ ne. 11B’aseɛ mɔ, bɛ bobe boo mɔ, bɛ olive boo mɔ, b’awuro mɔ, bosea nwo nzihoɛ, aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo bɔ ɛmɔale bafi bɛ berɛ ne, ɛnɛ deinn ɛ́mɔsa bɛfa bɛma bɛ.” 12Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛkosa yɛkɔfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ yɛkɔma bɛ. Yɛngole nzihoɛ ko, yeɛ yɛngɔma bɛngɔfa hwee bengosi awowaa ko. Yɛkɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ahã ne ala.” Yeɛ mvrɛle asɔfo nemɔ maa bɛtale ndaen bɛfoale bɔ bahyɛ bɔ kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ ne aso. 13Asa koso, esikaa abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔbɔ m’ataadeɛ ne anu ne, nye mboroporole nu. Na ngane kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ wanni bɔhyɛ he aso ne, Nyameɛ ole ye sua ne ye agyapadeɛ ofi ye sa nu. Sɔaa yeɛ okole b’agyapadeɛ kofi bɛ sa nu maa bɛkɔbɔ hwea ɔ.” Yeɛ maen ne amukoraa sele kyɛ, “Yɛde yɛto nu”, na bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ. Na maen ne yɛle nikyee biala kyɛbɔ bahyɛ bɔ ne ala.
Nehemia maen ne
14Afei koso, ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛfale me bɛyɛle Yuda aseɛ so amrado nen, ofi Nana Atasɛsɛse ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye afoɛ aburasa ne nyɔ ne aso ne, sɔ afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne, me oo, nniɛma nemɔ oo, yɛ nu biala wanne aleɛ ndɔ bɔ odi kyɛ mmenia bɛfa bɛma amrado ne. 15Amrado mɔ bɔ belili me nyunu moa ne de, bɛfale anwokyere kandinga paa yeɛ bɛtole maen ne aso ɔ. Bedidele aleɛ ne nzaa befili mmenia ne berɛ, asora ɛdwetɛ sekel aburanna ne koso. Bɛ somvoɛ nemɔ po, bɛyɛle maen ne aso abakomasɛm. Nakoso me de, manyɔ sɔ, ofikyɛ mesuro Nyameɛ. 16Susu amba, nduli me nwo nziele berɛ mane fasue tolɛ adwuma ne, na mambena me ti anwo aseɛ biala. Me somvoɛ nemɔ amukoraa, mmaa bɛɛsɔle adwuma ne anu bie. 17Afei koso, Yudafoɛ mbanyi bɔ me yeɛ né mema bɛ bɛ noa aleɛ ne, bɛte ɛyaa ko aburannu, asora bɛ bɔ befili maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne aso ne. 18Nandwie nyii ko ne mmoaen bɔ balɔ ɔ nzia yeɛ né mefa meyɛ aleɛ daa biala ɔ. Né beku ngokɔ bɛboka so, na eleburu biala, nzaa ahoroɔ ngomvo pee boka so. Nakoso manne amrado aleɛ ndɔ ne, ofikyɛ adesoa bɔ ɔla maen ne aso ne, né ɔte piri. 19Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye paa amukoraa bɔ mayɔ mama maen he ɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 6
Content:
Pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔso bɛtaataa Yudafoɛ
1Na Sanbalate, Tobia, Araboniɛ Gesem ne pɔfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛtele kyɛ masi fasue ne mayie bɔ tokuro biala ɔnne ye neka fee ɔ (ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔbaadwu sɔ kyẽa nen, né nnya nduatuale pambim anoa nemɔ). 2Yeɛ Sanbalate ne Gesem bɛsomane maa beesele me kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛyia wɔ Ono aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so nguraa nemɔ ko anu.” Nakoso né babɔ me nwo porɛ tɛɛ. 3Yiti nduli ɛbɔfoɛ maa beesele bɛ kyɛ, “Meyɔ adwuma bɔ ohia paa ɔ, yiti mengɔhora ba. Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ meyakyi adwuma ne megua berɛ na mene ɛmɔ bayia ɔ?” 4Betuli mmenia maa bɛwale me berɛ pɛen nna bɛfale sɔ ngraa ne ala bɛbrɛle me, na me koso mvale sɔ mmuayɛɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ mmane bɛ ɔ. 5Sanbalate sa somane ye somvoɛ wɔ me berɛ ye pɛen nnu so maa ɔfale krataa bɔ banda ye noa ɔ ɔbrɛle me. 6Krataa ne anu dwirɛ ole kyɛ, “Bɛkekã ye wɔ maen maen so, na Gesem koso wafa wato so, kyɛ ɛne Yudafoɛ ɛmɔbɔ porɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ lɔen. Ye sɔ ti yeɛ esi fasue nen. Amaneɛ bɔ baabɔ yɛ ne kyire kyɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛyɛ bɛ so hene. 7Afei koso, aye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ kyɛ bɛhyɛ wɔ nwo ngɔm wɔ Yerusalem kyɛ, ‘Yuda anya ɛhene oo!’ Kaye kyɛ bɛkɔfa sɔ dwirɛ he bɛkɔɔbɔ Nana amaneɛ. Yiti bra ma yɛdwene ye nwo.” 8Na mvale mmuayɛɛ ngɔmane ye kyɛ, “Sɔ edwirɛ bɔ ɛkekã ye, nu biala ɔtte nahorɛ, ɛbɔ wɔ sɔ nu yeɛ ɛkã ɔ!” 9Ofikyɛ né bɛ mukoraa bɛpena kyɛ benwunanwuna yɛ. Bɛdwene kyɛ, “Bɛkɔpa aba wɔ adwuma ne anwo, na bɛkɔyakyi ye yɔlɛ.” (Na mmɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ,) “Ao Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, ma me hue yɛ se.”
10Ɛlɛho bie, Semaya bɔ ye baba ole Delaya bɔ ye baba ole Mehetabel bɔ né ɔngora omvi ye awuro mvite ne, ngɔle ye awuro. Semaya hane kyɛ, “Maa yɛyia wɔ Nyameɛ awuro asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ná yɛtoto asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nemɔ anu, ofikyɛ bɛbaahu wɔ. Ɛnɛ kɔngɔen bɛbaahu wɔ.” 11Nakoso mmuale kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ bɛnwati bɛkɔfea ne, ebie ole me? Sona bɔ ɔte kyɛ me, aso odi kyɛ ɔnwati ɔkɔfea asɔneyɛɛ sua nu amaa onya ye ti odidi nu? Mengɔhɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu!” 12Na nwuni kyɛ nna Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔsomane ye ɔ, na mmom ɔhyɛle sɔ ngɔm ne fale me nwo, ofikyɛ Tobia ne Sanbalate yeɛ bɛbɔle ye paa ɔ. 13Ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛbɔle ye paa ɔ: kyɛ ɔma ɛserɛ hã me, na nyɔ sɔ bɔne ne, amaa ɔnate so male dumaa tɛɛ, ná banya me basere me. 14 Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye Tobia ne Sanbalate kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ si te ɔ. Afei koso, kaye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ brasua Noadia ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ ɛserɛ kã mene.
Bɛto fasue ne beyie
15Yiti yɛyiele fasue ne tolɛ bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Elul ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nnu ne aso. Yɛfale ngyẽa aburannu ne nyɔ yeɛ yɛtole ɔ. 16Na yɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛtele nen, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne, esuronyi tɔle bɛ so, na bɛ nyunu guale ase paa. Ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ waboka maa yayɔ sɔ adwuma he ɔ. 17Afei koso, sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yuda atitire nemɔ fale ngrataa pee bɛɛmane Tobia, na Tobia koso hyerɛle bɛ ngrataa. 18Né Yudafoɛ pee bata ndaen kyɛ bɛ ne Tobia kɔyɛ ko, ofikyɛ né Tobia ɔye ye baba ole Ara awa Sekania. Yeɛ né Tobia awa bienzua Yehohanan koso wagya Berekia awa Mesulam ɔwa brasua. 19Na belili Tobia nwo adanzeɛ paa behyirele me, yeɛ bɛɛhane edwirɛ bɔ ngane nemɔ behyirele ye. Na Tobia hyerɛle ngrataa oonwunanwunane me.

Title: NEHEMIA 7
Content:
1Mmerɛ bɔ besili fasue ne beyiele, ná nduatuale anoa nemɔ, ná nneaneane nu nyeyele pambim awɛmvoɛ, edweintolɛfoɛ ne Lewifoɛ nyiele ne, 2mvale Yerusalem nwurale nniɛma Hanani ɔne Hanania bɔ ɔnea abandenden ne aso ne, bɛ sa. Ofikyɛ né ɔte nahorɛniɛ bɔ osuro Nyameɛ tra kyɛbɔ mmenia pee besuro Nyameɛ ɔ. 3Na nga ngyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Yerusalem pambim nemɔ, onni kyɛ bebukye, sana eyia abɔ katekate koraka. Mmerɛ bɔ awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛwɛne ne, odi kyɛ bɛto pambim nemɔ anu bɛbrambram bɛ si. Ɛ́mɔnea Yerusalemfoɛ nemɔ anu bɛ́ye awɛmvoɛ bɔ bɛ nu bie kɔwɛne nekaa bɔ bafa bawura ye sa, ná bɛ nu bie koso bawɛne b’awuro ndendeneɛ so ɔ.”
4Né kuro ne ɔtrɛ, yeɛ ɔte piri, nakoso nu mmenia ne banzo, yeɛ afei né bennya bessisili sua mɔ wɔ nu.
Yudafoɛ bɔ befili Babilɔn bɛwale ɔ
(Ɛsra 2.1-70)
5Yeɛ Nyameɛ maa nyane adwene kyɛ atitire nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne, mma bɛbɔ dwaa maa bɛhyerɛ bɛ dumaa kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua te ɔ. Na nwuni mmusua mmusua nwomaa bɔ bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛwale ne, bɛ dumaa wɔ nu ɔ. Na nwuni kyɛ bahyerɛ ɛhe wɔ nu: 6 Mmenia bɔ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa hyele bɛ nnure hɔle Babilɔn nen, bɛ bɔ befili mbɔtam mbɔtam nemɔ anu besa bɛwale Yerusalem ne Yuda, bɔ ebiala sa hɔle ye kuro nen, bɛ ɛhe. 7Mmenia hemɔ yeɛ belili bɛ nyunu bɛ ne bɛ wale ɔ: Serubabɛl, Yesua, Nehemia, Asaria, Raamia, Nahamani, Modekae, Bilsan, Mispere, Bigiwae, Nehum, yeɛ Baana.
Yisrael mmienzua bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: 8Parose boso ama te apee nyɔ ɛyaa ko ne aburasoo ne nyɔ. 9Sefatia boso ama te ɛyaa nza ne aburasoo ne nyɔ. 10Ara boso ama te ɛyaa nzia aburannu ne nyɔ. 11Pahate Moabo boso ama, bɔ bɛte Yesua ne Yoabo abusua ne, bɛte apee nyɔ ɛyaa mmɔtwɛ ne buru ne mmɔtwɛ. 12Elam boso ama te apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu ne nna. 13Satu boso ama te ɛyaa mmɔtwɛ aburanna ne nnu. 14Sakae boso ama te ɛyaa nzoo ne aburasia. 15Binuyi boso ama te ɛyaa nzia ne aburanna ne mmɔtwɛ. 16Bebae boso ama te ɛyaa nzia ne aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ. 17Asegade boso ama te apee nyɔ ɛyaa nza ne aburanyɔ ne nyɔ. 18Adonikam boso ama te ɛyaa nzia aburasia ne nzoo. 19Bigiwae boso ama te apee nyɔ aburasia ne nzoo. 20Adin boso ama te ɛyaa nzia aburannu ne nnu. 21Atɛ boso ama, bɔ bɛte Hesekia abusua ne, bɛte aburahona ne mmɔtwɛ. 22Hasum boso ama te ɛyaa nza aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ. 23Besae boso ama te ɛyaa nza aburanyɔ ne nna. 24Harife boso ama te ɛyaa ko buru ne nyɔ. 25Gibeon boso ama te aburahona ne nnu.
26Afei koso, bɛ bɔ bɛ si fi nguro hemɔ aso ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: Betlehem ne Netofa: ɛyaa ko aburawɔtwɛ ne mmɔtwɛ. 27Anatote: ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ. 28Bete Asimawete: aburanna ne nyɔ. 29Kiriate Yearim, Kefira ne Beerote: ɛyaa nzoo aburanna ne nza. 30Rama ne Geba: ɛyaa nzia aburanyɔ ne ko. 31Mikimase: ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ ne nyɔ. 32Betel ne Aye: ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ ne nza. 33Nebo ko ne: aburannu ne nyɔ. 34Elam ko ne: apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ aburannu ne nna. 35Harim: ɛyaa nza aburanyɔ. 36Yeriko: ɛyaa nza aburanna ne nnu. 37Lode, Hadidi ne Ono: ɛyaa nzoo aburanyɔ ne ko. 38Senaa: apee nza ɛyaa ngona ne aburasa.
39Asɔfo bɔ besa bɛwale ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: Yedaya boso ama bɔ bɛte Yesua awuro ama ne: ɛyaa ngona aburasoo ne nza. 40Yimere boso ama te apee ko aburannu ne nyɔ. 41Pasure boso ama te apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ aburanna ne nzoo. 42Harim boso ama te apee ko buru ne nzoo.
43Lewifoɛ bɔ besa bɛwale ne, bɛ somaa ɛhe: Hodewa boso ama Yesua ne Kadimiɛl b’awuro ama: aburasoo ne nna.
44Edweintolɛfoɛ mɔ: Asafe boso ama te ɛyaa ko aburanna ne mmɔtwɛ. 45Asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛte mmenia hemɔ boso ama: Salum, Atɛ, Talmon, Akubo, Hatita, yeɛ Sobae. Bɛte ɛyaa ko aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ.
46Asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ bɛte mmenia hemɔ bɛ boso ama: Siha, Hasufa, Tabayote, 47Kerose, Sia, Padon, 48Lebana, Hagaba, Salmae, 49Hanan, Gidel, Gahare, 50Reaya, Resin, Nekoda, 51Gasam, Yusa, Pasea, 52Besae, Meyunim, Nefusesim, 53Bakebuke, Hakufa, Hahure, 54Baslite, Mehida, Hasa, 55Bakose, Sisera, Tema, 56Nesia ne Hatifa.
57Solomon somvoɛ hemɔ, bɛ koso bɛ boso ama besa bɛwale: Sotae, Soferete, Perida, 58Yaala, Dakon, Gidel, 59Sefatia, Hatile, Pokerete Hasebaim, yeɛ Amon.
60Asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ amukoraa, bɛ ne Solomon somvoɛ mɔ bɛ boso ama nemɔ, bɛte ɛyaa nza aburahona ne nyɔ.
61Mmeni kure hemɔ fili Tel Mela, Tel Hasa, Kɛrubo, Adon ne Yimere bɛwale, nakoso bangora bangyire bɛ si, yeɛ bangora bangyire abusua bɔ befi nu ɔ, yeɛ bangora bangyire kyɛ bɛte Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. 62Bɛte mmenia hemɔ bɛ bosofoɛ: Delaya, Tobia ne Nekoda. Bɛ somaa te ɛyaa nzia aburanna ne nyɔ. 63Ebiemɔ koso bɛte asɔfo mɔ bɛ bosofoɛ: Bɛ ole Hobaya, Hakose, yeɛ Basilae (bɔ ogyale Gileadeniɛ Basilae ye mma mmrasua nemɔ nu ko, bɔ ɔnate so maa ɔfale bɛ dumaa ne bie ne). 64Sɔ mmenia nemɔ penane bɛ dumaa wɔ mmusua ngrataa nemɔ anu, nakoso né bɛ dumaa nne nu. Ye sɔ ne ati, bebuli bɛ kyɛ bɛ nwo nde, na bɛyele bɛ befili sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne anu. 65Na amrado ne sele bɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bedi aleɛ krongron paa ne bie, kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo bie kɔfa Yurim ne Tumim kobisa (konwu bɔ Nyameɛ kã fa bɛ nwo) ɔ.
66Mmenia bɔ besa bɛwale Yuda ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛte apee aburanna ne nyɔ ɛyaa nza aburasia, 67asora bɛ ngoaa ne b’afaneɛ mɔ, bɔ bɛ somaa te apee nzoo ɛyaa nza aburasa ne nzoo ne. Né besa bele edweintolɛfoɛ mmienzua ne mmrasua ɛyaa nyɔ aburanna ne nnu. 68Né bele mbɔngɔ ɛyaa nzoo aburasa ne nzia, afunum mbiri ɛyaa nyɔ aburanna ne nnu, 69afupɔngɔ ɛyaa nna aburasa ne nnu, yeɛ afunum apee nzia ɛyaa nzoo ne aburanyɔ.
70Afei bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi nemɔ, bɛ nu biemɔ bɛbokale adwuma ne yɔlɛ wɔ esikaa nu. Amrado ne yɛle ndoboa he maa bɛfa beguale fotoɛ ne anu: esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo ngona, ayaa aburannu ne asɔfo ndaadeɛ ɛyaa nnu aburasa. 71Na bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi nemɔ bie tuale ɛhe beguale adwuma ne nwo fotoɛ ne anu: esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo ɛyaa ko aburasoo, yeɛ ɛdwetɛ kilo apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ aburannu. 72Na maen ne ngaa ne tuale ɛhe bɛfa bɛbokale: esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo ɛyaa ko aburasia ne mmɔtwɛ, ɛdwetɛ kilo ɛyaa ko aburanna, yeɛ asɔfo ndaadeɛ aburasia ne nzoo.
73 Yiti asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ nemɔ, anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ, edweintolɛfoɛ, mmenia nemɔ anu bie, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, bɛtenatenane bɛ nguro mɔ so.

Title: NEHEMIA 8
Content:
Ɛsra kenga Nyameɛ Mmeraa ne
1 Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne dwuli, bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ baatenatena bɛ nguro nemɔ aso nen, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛbɔle nu bɛɛbɔle dwaa wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa wɔ Nzue Pambim ne anyunu. Na besele ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra kyɛ Mose mmeraa nwomaa bɔ AWURADE afa ama Yisrael ne, ɔfa bra. 2Yiti ɔsɔfo Ɛsra fale mmeraa ne wale badwa ne anyunu, wɔ mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa amukoraa bɔ bɛte dwirɛ a, bɛkɔhora bɛkɔte ye bo ɔ, bɛ nyunu, wɔ kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu. 3Ɛsra fale ye nye hyirele nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa ne wɔ Nzue Pambim ne anyunu berɛ, na ɔkengale nwomaa ne fili ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu oodwuli eyiagyina. Ɔkengale ye wɔ mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa bɔ bɛte dwirɛ bɛkɔhora bɛkɔte ye bo ɔ, bɛ nyunu. Na maen ne amukoraa bɛyɛle asoɛ betiele mmeraa nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ. 4Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra gyinane taboa simbini bie bɔ nyianu ne ati bahyɛ da babobɔ ɔ so. Na mmenia hemɔ gyinagyinane ye ngyɛnu: Matitia, Sema, Anaya, Yuria, Hilkia ne Maaseya gyinane ye sa famaa so, yeɛ Pedaya, Misael, Malkiya, Hasum, Hasbadana, Sakaria ne Mesulam koso begyinane ye sa bɛen so. 5Na Ɛsra bukyele nwomaa ne anu bɔ maen ne amukoraa bɛ nye tua ɔ, ofikyɛ né ogyi anwuro tra mmenia ne amukoraa. Na obukyele nwomaa ne anu nen, mmenia ne amukoraa bedwɔso begyinane. 6Na Ɛsra yele AWURADE, Nyameɛ piri ne ayɛ, na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛmomane bɛ sa so besurole so kyɛ, “Amen, Amen!” Na bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase bɛsɔnene AWURADE. 7Afei koso Yesua, Bani, Serebia, Yamin, Akubo, Sabetae, Hodia, Maaseya, Kelita, Asaria, Yosabade, Hanan ne Pelaya bɔ bɛte Lewifoɛ ne, behyirehyirele mmeraa ne anu behyirele mmenia ne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né mmenia ne bɛtɛgyigyi berɛ. 8Yiti bɛkengale befili Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu, na behyirehyirele nu pefee mane mmenia ne tele bɔ bɛkengale ne abo.
9Yeɛ Nehemia bɔ né ɔte amrado ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, bɛ ne Lewifoɛ bɔ behyirehyirele edwirɛ ne anu behyirele mmenia nemɔ ne, besele maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɔte krongron ma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ; nnɛma ɛmɔdi aworabɔlɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsu.” Ofikyɛ maen ne amukoraa bɛtele mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ ne, besuni. 10Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beeli naen bɔ walɔ ɔ, ná ɛmɔno nzaa bɔ ɔyɛ fɛɛ ɔ. Bɛ bɔ belle bie ne, ɛmɔɔma bɛ bie, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɔte krongron ma y’AWURADE. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE nu anigye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ anwoserɛ ɔ.” 11Yiti Lewifoɛ nemɔ hane sɔ dwirɛ he mane mmenia ne b’ahone tɔle bɛ kunu, “Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye te krongron: nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ.” 12Yeɛ mmenia ne amukoraa bɛhɔle beedidili bɛnone, na bɛfale bie bɛhyehyɛle. Bɛgyele bɛ nye paa, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ bɛkengale behyirele bɛ ne, bɛtele ye bo.
Bedi Asese aluolue
13Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nana mɔ bɛ sasofoɛ noa ne, bɛ ne asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ ne, bɛbɔle nu bɛhɔle ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra berɛ kyɛ bɛkwaasua mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ ne. 14Na AWURADE mmeraa bɔ ɔnate Mose so hyɛle ne, benwuni kyɛ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu kyɛ bosome nzoo aluolue ne anu, odi kyɛ maen Yisrael bɛtena asese nu, 15na afei odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye dawure bɛfa bɛto dwaa wɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ amukoraa ne Yerusalem nu kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso bɛɛfa olive mmaen, eburo olive mmaen, sesea mmaen, ɛberɛ ne mmakaa bɔ bebua kusuu ɔ bɛ mmaen, na ɛmɔɔfa besisi asese nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ne. 16Yiti mmenia ne hɔle bɛɛfale mmaen nemɔ bɛwale, na besisili b’asese mɔ wɔ bɛ sua nemɔ mmɔsoɛ so, b’awuro aluo, yeɛ Nyameɛ awuro aluo berɛ, yeɛ Nzue Pambim ne anwo nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa ɔne Efraim Pambim ne anwo nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa ne. 17Na bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu besa bɛwale ne, besisili asese bɛtenatenane nu. Ofi Nun awa Yesua aberɛ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu sɔ kyẽa ne, né Yisraelfoɛ bɛyyɔle sɔ le. Na belili ahurusi paa. 18Na daa biala, ofi kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne kɔpem kyẽa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne, ɔkengale Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne. Belili aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo. Na ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, bɛyɔle nyianu krongron kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne.

Title: NEHEMIA 9
Content:
Maen ne kã bɛ bɔne
1Sɔ bosome ne ala, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nna ne aso, Yisrael maen bɔle dwaa bɛyɔle akɔngyere. Bɛherale ɛsɛen tena bɛfale mbaen beguale bɛ ti so. 2Na Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili amanvrafoɛ amukoraa anwo, na begyinane bɛ gya so bɛhane bɛ bɔne ne bɛ nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ. 3Bɛhɔle so begyinane bɛ gya so bɛkengale AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne dɔnhwere nza, yeɛ bɛfale dɔnhwere nza bieku bɛhane bɛ bɔne, na bɛsɔnene AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ. 4Afei Yesua, Bani, Kadimiɛl, Sebania, Buni, Serebia, Bani ne Kenani begyinane Lewifoɛ b’atweleɛ ne aso, na bele komviɛ piri bɛteane nu bɛsrɛle AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ. 5Yeɛ Lewifoɛ hemɔ: Yesua, Kadimiɛl, Bani, Hasabeneya, Serebia, Hodia, Sebania ne Petahia besele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛye AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ. W’animnyam dumaa bɔ ɔbo animnyam ne ayɛyelɛ amukoraa so ne, yɛye ye ayɛ.”
6Na Ɛsra sele kyɛ, “Wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte AWURADE ɔ. Wɔ yeɛ abɔ nyameɛso, nyameɛso bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne nu abɔdeɛ amukoraa; aseɛ ɔne so nningyein amukoraa; ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa. Ɛma bɛ mukoraa ngoa, na nyameɛso abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɛsɔne wɔ. 7 Wɔ yeɛ ole AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔ ɛneaneane nu yele Abram fili Kaldeafoɛ kuro Yure so, ná ɛtole ye dumaa Abraham ɔ. 8 Enwuni kyɛ ye ahone nu te wɔ wɔ nyunu, na ɛne ye bɛyɛle apam kyɛ ɛkɔfa Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ ne Gɛgasifoɛ b’aseɛ kɔma ye boso ama; na wɔ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɛhyɛle ne, ali so, ofikyɛ ɛtengyɛ.
9 “Yɛ nana mɔ bɔ né bɛwɔ Misraim ne, enwuni amaneɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ nu ɔ, na etiele bɛ sufrɛ wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ noa. 10 Ɛyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tiale Faro ne ye mbanyi amukoraa ne ye aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa, ofikyɛ enwuni kyɛ bɛyɔle aniammɔwoho betiale yɛ nana mɔ. Elele dumaa, na sɔ dumaa ne watena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye. 11 Na ɛpakyele ɛpo ne anu wɔ bɛ nyunu, amaa ɔnate so bɛfale aseɛ wosee so bɛpɛle ɛpo ne, nakoso mmenia bɔ né bɛfoa yɛ nana mɔ ne de, egyili bɛ guale buma ne anu kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bagyi bagua asue piri nu ɔ. 12 Afei koso, ɛfale munungum ningɔnn lili bɛ nyunu eyia, yeɛ ɛfale see ningɔnn lili bɛ nyunu kɔngɔen maa ɔtale maa benwuni ase bɛhɔle nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ ɔ. 13 Edwu wale Sinai bokaa ne aso, na ɛne bɛ dwudwole fili nyameɛso, na ɛmane bɛ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ, mmeraa turoloo, yeɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ. 14Ɛmaa benwuni w’afofikyẽa krongron ne, yeɛ ɛnate wɔ somvoɛ Mose so mane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa. 15 Ɛmane bɛ aleɛ fili nyameɛso kyɛ bɛfa bɛho bɛ hɔen, yeɛ ɛmane bɛ nzue fili nyɔbotaen ne anu kyɛ bɛfa bɛho bɛ nzuhɔen, na ɛhã hyirele bɛ kyɛ aseɛ bɔ ɛtale ndaen kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne, bɛhɔ bɛɛfa.
16 “Nakoso bɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ bɛyɛle anwomasoɛ ne asoserɛ, na banni wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso. 17 Bɛyɛle b’adwene kyɛ bengoli so, na anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɛyɔle mane bɛ ne, bangaye, na mmom bɛyɛle asoserɛ, yeɛ bɛyele sona maa ɔlale bɛ noa kyɛ besa bɛkɔ ngoaasolɛ nu wɔ Misraim. Nakoso ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛfa bɔne kyɛ, ɛdo mmenia, yeɛ ɛse anwumvoin, w’ahone nhu ndɛ, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi sone, na anye wɔ sa amvi bɛ bo. 18 Ye po, mmerɛ bɔ behurole nikyee bɛyɔle nandwie ba amoen bɛfale ná besele kyɛ, ‘Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim wale ne, ye ɛhe’, ná bɛbɔle musue mbiri mbiri nen, 19 ɔnate w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne ati, anyakyi bɛ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Munungum ningɔnn bɔ olili bɛ nyunu wɔ atee ne aso ne, wanyakyi bɛ nu eyia; yeɛ see ningɔnn bɔ ɔtale kɔngɔen ne, ɔmaa benwuni ase bɛhɔle nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ ɔ. 20Ɛfale wɔ Sunzum paa ne mane bɛ kyɛ ohyirehyire bɛ mmeraa ne. Na mana bɔ ɛfa maa belili ne, anyakyi bɛ ye manɛ, yeɛ nzuhɔen ku bɛ ne, ɛmane bɛ nzue maa bɛnone. 21Ɛneane bɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna maa ɔnate ye sɔ ti, hwee anhia bɛ. Bɛ ndaadeɛ andete, yeɛ bɛ gya bo anwunwu. 22 Ɛfale ahennie ne maen maen mɔ mane bɛ, na ɛmane wɔ mmenia tenane aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala, maa ɔnate so bɛho bɛfale Hesebon hene Sihon aseɛ ne, yeɛ Basan hene Ogo aseɛ ne. 23Ɛmane bɛ boso ama bɛtale kyɛ ewienu nzramaa, na aseɛ bɔ ɛhã hyirele bɛ nana mɔ kyɛ bɛɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ deɛ ne, ɛfale bɛ wale so. 24 Yiti bɛ boso ama nemɔ, bɛhɔle aseɛ ne aso bɛɛfale, na Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ né bɛte aseɛ ne aso mmenia ne, ɛfale bɛ wurale Yisraelfoɛ bo. Na ɛfale bɛ ne b’ahemvo ne aseɛ ne aso ama wurale Yisraelfoɛ sa kyɛ bɔ bekuro ne, bɛfa bɛyɔ bɛ. 25 Na bɛho bɛfale nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ. Na bɛfale awuro mɔ bɔ nningyein paa ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ, abura mɔ bɔ batutu ɔ, bobe boo mɔ, olive boo mɔ ne mmakaa bɔ basu biribiraa ɔ bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ. Yiti bedidili ma bɛ ko yili na bɛyɛle mbiri, na wɔ paa kandinga bɔ ɛyɛle bɛ ne ati bɛgyele bɛ nye.
26 “Nakoso bɛyɛle asoserɛ, na bɛyɛle wɔ nwo lɔen, bɛfale wɔ mmeraa ne bɛtole ahameɛ, na wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ besa beeli wɔ si ne, behuhuni bɛ maa ɔnate so bɛbɔle musue mbiri mbiri paa. 27Yiti ɛfale Yisraelfoɛ wurale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa maa bɛhyɛle bɛ so. Na b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu ne, besu bɛfrɛle wɔ, na etiele bɛ mbaeɛ fili nyameɛso. Na kyɛbɔ w’anwumvoinnwunɛ piri ne te ne, ɛyele defoɛ mɔ mane bɛ maa bɛpepɛ belele bɛ befili bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu. 28Nakoso bɛ nwo tɔle bɛ ne, besa bɛyɔle bɔne betiale wɔ, na ɛfale bɛ wurale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa maa belili bɛ so. Na bɛsesane b’adwene besa besu bɛfrɛle wɔ ne, etiele bɛ fili nyameɛso, na kyɛbɔ w’anwumvoinnwunɛ te ne, ɛpepɛ lele bɛ mmerɛ pee. 29 Na ɛbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ bɔ ɔnate so bekosa bekooli wɔ mmeraa ne aso ɔ. Nakoso bɛyɛle anwomasoɛ, yeɛ banni wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ so, na mmom wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ sona di so a onya ngoa ne, bɛyɔle bɔne bebuli so. Bɛpemone b’awaen beguale wɔ so, bɛsoale bɛ kɔm so kyeinn, na bandie wɔ dwirɛ. 30 Afoɛ pee yeɛ enyane bɛ nwo aboterɛ ɔ, na ɛnate wɔ Sunzum so fale wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ; nakoso bandie. Yiti ɛfale bɛ wurale aseɛ nemɔ aso ama bɛ sa. 31Nakoso ɔnate w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne ati, annua bɛ boso, yeɛ anye wɔ sa amvi bɛ bo, ofikyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛdo sona ná ɛse anwumvoin ɔ.
32 “Yiti afei, yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛte piri bɔ wɔ nwo yɛ suro, bɔ edi apam so ná ekyire ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ, amaneɛ amukoraa bɔ wato yɛ ne y’ahemvo, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, y’asɔfo mɔ, yɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, yɛ nana mɔ, ɔne wɔ mmenia amukoraa, ofi Asiria ahemvo mɔ aberɛ so bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, nnebu ye nikyee ba. 33Amaneɛ bɔ wato yɛ ne amukoraa, edi be, ofikyɛ edi nahorɛ, na yɛ de yayɔ bɔne. 34Yɛ ahemvo mɔ, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, y’asɔfo mɔ ne yɛ nana mɔ banni wɔ mmeraa ne aso, yeɛ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne wɔ dwirɛ bɔ ɛfa mane bɛ ne, banni so. 35Mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hene mɔ di bɛ so ne po, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ehyirele ɔdɔ kandinga hyirele bɛ, na ɛmane bɛ aseɛ kandinga bɔ ɔkye aleɛ de, nakoso banzo wɔ, yeɛ banyakyi bɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔ ne koso. 36Bɔ wato yɛ ɛhe oo! Ɛne de yayɛ nganga. Aseɛ bɔ ɛfa mane yɛ nana mɔ kyɛ bɛfa so aleɛ ne so nningyein paa ne, yayɛ nganga wɔ so. 37Ahemvo mɔ bɔ ɔnate yɛ bɔne bɔ yayɔ ti amaa bali yɛ so ne, bɛ mmom yeɛ bedi aseɛ ne aso aleɛ paa ne ɔ. Bele yɛ nipadua ne y’ayɛmmoa mɔ so tumi. Bɔ bekuro yeɛ bɛfa bedi yɛ ɔ, na edwirɛ piri paa yeɛ wato yɛ ɔ.”
Maen ne de apam ne to nu
38“Ɔnate ɛhe amukoraa ti, yahyɛ bɔ kitii yahyerɛ yagua nwomaa so. Sɔ nwomaa ne, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, yɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ ne y’asɔfo mɔ yeɛ bafa bɛ nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa ɔ.

Title: NEHEMIA 10
Content:
1Nwomaa ne, mmenia hemɔ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ nzɔanoɛ bɛsɔle ye noa ɔ: Hakalia awa Nehemia bɔ ɔte amrado ne, ɔne Sedekia; 2Seraya, Asaria, Yeremia, 3Pasure, Amaria, Malkiya, 4Hatuse, Sebania, Maluke, 5Harim, Meremote, Obadia, 6Daniel, Gyineton, Baruku, 7Mesulam, Abiya, Migyamin, 8Maasia, Bilgae, Semaya: sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛte asɔfo. 9Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Asania ne, Binuyi bɔ ɔte Henadade bosoniɛ ne, Kadimiɛl, 10ne bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanan, 11Mika, Rehobo, Hasabia, 12Sakure, Serebia, Sebania, 13Hodia, Bani, Beninu. 14Bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia nemɔ anoa ɛhe: Parose, Pahate Moabo, Elam, Satu, Bani, 15Buni, Asegade, Bebae, 16Adoniya, Bigiwae, Adin, 17Atɛ, Hesekia, Asure, 18Hodia, Hasum, Besae, 19Harife, Anatote, Nebae, 20Magepiase, Mesulam, Hesire, 21Mesesabɛl, Sadoke, Yadua, 22Pelatia, Hanan, Anaya, 23Hosea, Hanania, Hasubo, 24Halohese, Piliha, Sobeke, 25Rehum, Hasabena, Maaseya 26Ahia, Hanan, Anan, 27Maluke, Harim ne Baana.
Apam ne anu dwirɛ
28 Maen ne ngaa ne, asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ nemɔ, anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ, edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ, ɔne ebiala bɔ wahwe ye nwo wafi aseɛ ne aso ama nwo kyɛ okoli Nyameɛ mmeraa so ne, bɛ ne bɛ ye mɔ, bɛ mma mmienzua, bɛ mma mmrasua, ɔne ebiala bɔ ole nimdeɛ ne nworɛ ɔ, 29bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama ne b’atitire mɔ bɛnomane bɛtale ndaen, kyɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ Mose so ɔfa mane bɛ ne, bekoli so, kyɛ bekoli AWURADE, yɛ Mene ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa so. 30 Yɛngɔfa yɛ mma mmrasua ngɔma aseɛ ne aso ama agyaa, yeɛ yɛngɔma yɛ mma mmienzua ngogyigya bɛ mma mmrasua. 31 Na aseɛ ne aso ama, sɛ bɛfa bɛ nningyein anaa b’aleɛ biala bɛba kyɛ bɛbayɛ ye atɔen afofikyẽa a, yɛngɔtɔ ngofi bɛ brɛ afofikyẽa anaa kyẽa krongron biala. Afei, afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, yɛngɔyɛ boo wɔ aseɛ ne aso. Afei yɛkɔfa kerɛ biala bɔ ebiala ma yɛ ɔ yɛkɔhyɛ ye. 32 Afei koso, yɛde yɛto yɛ nwo so kyɛ, afoɛ biala yɛ nu biala kotua ɛtoɔ sekel ko nu ngyɛmuɛ nza maa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma hemɔ: 33paanoo krongron, daa daa aburoo afɔleɛ, daa daa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, afofingyẽa mɔ, ɛsraen foforɛ aluolue, aluolue bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ nemɔ, akyɛdeɛ krongron ne, bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ mbata bɛma Yisrael ne, yeɛ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne amukoraa. 34Afei koso, y’asɔfo, Lewifoɛ ne maen ne, yagua serewa yafa yaye mmerɛ bɔ afoɛ biala anu yɛ nu biala ye abusua kɔfa eyein kɔwa Nyameɛ awuro maa bɛkɔyera ye wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa ne anu ne. 35 Yale yato yɛ nwo so kyɛ afoɛ noa biala, yɛ fieso aleɛ bɔ yɛkoli moa yɛkɔfa biala, yeɛ aseɛ ne aso bakaa biala, ye mmaa bɔ yɛkoli moa yɛkɔte ne, yɛkɔfa yɛkɔwa AWURADE awuro. 36 Afei koso, yɛkɔfa yɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua mɔ ne yɛ nandwie mɔ, mmoaen mɔ ne abɔngye mɔ bɛ mma mɔ bɔ oli moa ne yɛkɔhɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro yɛkɔɔma asɔfo bɔ bɛyɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa ne anu ne. 37 Yɛkɔfa ɛhemɔ yɛkɔbrɛ asɔfo nemɔ maa bɛkɔfa bekogua Nyameɛ awuro berɛ pumbu nemɔ anu: yɛ mɔle nu paa paa ne, y’akyɛdeɛ mɔ, bakaa biala so mmaa, nzaa ne ngoo. Yɛ fieso aleɛ wora, yɛkɔfa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko yɛkɔbrɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ Lewifoɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne befi yɛ nguraa nemɔ amukoraa nu ɔ. 38 Na ɔsɔfo ne, bɔ ɔte Aarɔn bosoniɛ ne, sɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne a, odi kyɛ ɔboka bɛ so. Na buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛfa nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛba yɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ pumbu mɔ bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu nemɔ anu. 39Ofikyɛ odi kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ ne Lewi bosofoɛ ne bɛfa b’akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔte aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo bɛba pumbu mɔ bɔ bɛfa nningyein krongron besie nu nemɔ anu, ɔne nekaa bɔ asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, anoa wɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛwɔ ne. Yɛngobu yɛ nye ngogua yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne aso.

Title: NEHEMIA 11
Content:
Mmenia batena Yerusalem
1Né maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛtete Yerusalem. Na maen ne anu ama ngaa ne guale serewa kyɛ bɛfa so bɛyeye mmenia ne anu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko maa bɛbatena kuro krongron Yerusalem nu, ná buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ngona koso bɛtena nguro ngaa nemɔ aso. 2Na maen ne yirale bɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ deinn bɛyele bɛ kunu kyɛ bɛkɔɔtena Yerusalem ne.
3 Mbɔtam mbanyi ne, né bɛtete Yerusalem. Nakoso Yuda nguro ngaa nemɔ aso de, Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, asɔfo, Lewifoɛ, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ ne Solomon somvoɛ nemɔ bɛ boso ama nemɔ, né ebiala te ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so. 4Yuda abusua kure ne, yeɛ Benyamin abusua kure ne ne bɛ nu biemɔ tete Yerusalem. Yuda abusua kure ne anu ama nemɔ bɛ ɛhe: Ataya bɔ ye baba ole Yusia bɔ ye baba ole Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Amaria bɔ ye baba ole Sefatia bɔ ye baba ole Mahalaleel bɔ ɔte Pɛrɛse bosoniɛ ne; 5yeɛ Maaseya bɔ ye baba ole Baruku bɔ ye baba ole Kol Hose bɔ ye baba ole Hasaya bɔ ye baba ole Adaya bɔ ye baba ole Yoaribo bɔ ye baba ole Sakaria bɔ ɔse te Silonniɛ ne. 6Pɛrɛse boso ama amukoraa bɔ né bɛtete Yerusalem ne, bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ɛyaa nna aburasia ne mmɔtwɛ.
7Na Benyamin abusua kure ne anu ama nemɔ, bɛ ɛhe: Salu bɔ ye baba ole Mesulam bɔ ye baba ole Yode bɔ ye baba ole Pedaya bɔ ye baba ole Kolaya bɔ ye baba ole Maaseya bɔ ye baba ole Yitiɛl bɔ ye baba ole Yesaya ne. 8Na Salu nwo ama ole Gabae ne Salae: bɛte ɛyaa ngona, aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ. 9Sikri awa Yowel yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ, na sɛ ɔne berɛ a, Hasenua awa Yuda yeɛ ɔnea kuro ne aso ɔ.
10Na asɔfo nemɔ ɛhe: Yedaya bɔ ye baba ole Yoaribo, Yakin, 11Seraya bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia, bɔ ye baba ole Mesulam, bɔ ye baba ole Sadoke, bɔ ye baba ole Merayote, bɔ ye baba ole Ahitubo bɔ ɔnea Nyameɛ awuro ne aso ne, 12ɔne bɛ nwo ama bɔ bɛyɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne: bɛ somaa te ɛyaa mmɔtwɛ aburanyɔ ne nyɔ; ne Adaya bɔ ye baba ole Yehoram bɔ ye baba ole Pelalia bɔ ye baba ole Amisi bɔ ye baba ole Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Pasure bɔ ye baba ole Malkiya, 13ne ye nwo ama, bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ awuro mbanyi bɔ bɛ somaa te ɛyaa nyɔ aburanna ne nyɔ; ne Amasae bɔ ye baba ole Asarel bɔ ye baba ole Asae bɔ ye baba ole Mesilemote bɔ ye baba ole Yimere, 14ne bɛ nwo ama koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ ne mmɔtwɛ; Sabidiɛl bɔ ye baba ole Hagyedolim yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa.
15Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Semaya bɔ ye baba ole Hasubo bɔ ye baba ole Asrikam bɔ ye baba ole Hasabia bɔ ye baba ole Buni, 16ne Sabetae ne Yosabade bɔ bɛla Lewifoɛ noa, bɔ bɛnea Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo adwuma ne aso, 17yeɛ Matania bɔ olili bɛ nyunu maa bɛbɔle mbaeɛ bɛtole ayɛyelɛ dwein, bɔ ye baba ole Mika bɔ ye baba ole Sabidi bɔ ye baba ole Asafe ne, ɔne Bakebukia bɔ ye abusuafoɛ nemɔ anu, Matania nne berɛ a, ye yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, yeɛ Aboda bɔ ye baba ole Samua bɔ ye baba ole Galal bɔ ye baba ole Yedutun ne. 18Lewifoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ kuro krongron ne anu ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛte ɛyaa nyɔ aburawɔtwɛ ne nna.
19Pambim awɛmvoɛ bɔ bɛ ole Akubo, Talmon ne bɛ mmango pambim awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne, bɛ somaa te ɛyaa ko aburasoo ne nyɔ. 20Na Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ ne asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ ngaa ne, né bɛwɔ Yuda nguro ne amukoraa so bɔ ebiala ɔte ye aseɛ deɛ so ɔ. 21Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ sua somvoɛ nemɔ de, né bɛte Ofel, na Siha ne Gisepa yeɛ né bɛnea asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ so ɔ.
22Lewifoɛ bɔ né bɛtete Yerusalem ne, Yusi yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ. Ɔse ole Bani bɔ ye baba ole Hasabia bɔ ye baba ole Matania bɔ ye baba ole Mika bɔ ɔte Asafe bosofoɛ edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ anu ko ne. Asafe bosofoɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ né bɛnea Nyameɛ awuro berɛ adwuma ne aso ɔ. 23Ofikyɛ ɛhene ne fale ahyɛdeɛ bie tole dwaa fale bɛ nwo wɔ nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma bɛ daa biala ɔ. 24Na Yuda awa Sera ye boso ama nemɔ, Petahia bɔ ye baba ole Mesesabɛl yeɛ né otu ɛhene ne foɛ wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa maen ne anwo ɔ.
Yerusalem nwo nguraa
25Na nguraa nemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ ne de, Yudafoɛ nemɔ bie tenane Kiriate Aba ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ nu, Dibɔn ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ nu, yeɛ Yekabeseel ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ nu, 26Yesua, Molada ne Bete Pelete, 27Hasa Soale, Beɛ Hyeba ye nwo nguraa mɔ, 28Siklage, Mekona ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ, 29Ɛn Rimon, Sora, Yamute, 30Sanoa, Adulam ne bɛ nwo nguraa mɔ, Lakise ne ye nwo aseɛ mɔ, yeɛ Aseka ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ. Yiti bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ fi Beɛ Hyeba beedwuli Hinom bɔnza ne anu. 31Benyaminfoɛ nemɔ koso bɛtenane nguro bɔ ofi Geba bɔ ɔkɔ nemɔ aso: Mikimase, Aiya, Betel ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ, 32Anatote, Nɔbo, Anania, 33Hasɔ, Rama, Gitaim, 34Hadidi, Seboyim, Nebalate, 35Lode ne Ono bɔ ɔte adwiililɛfoɛ bɔnza ne. 36Na Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne, bɛmane bɛ nu biemɔ bɛɛtenane Benyaminfoɛ nu.

Title: NEHEMIA 12
Content:
Asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ dumaa
1 Asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛ ne Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl, yeɛ Yesua bɛwale nemɔ ɛhe: Seraya, Yeremia, Ɛsra, 2Amaria, Maluke, Hatuse, 3Sekania, Rehum, Meremote, 4Yido, Gyinetoye, Abiya, 5Miyamin, Maadia, Bilega, 6Semaya, Yoaribo, Yedaya, 7Salu, Amoko, Hilkia, yeɛ Yedaya. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, né bɛlela asɔfo nemɔ ne bɛ mmango nemɔ noa wɔ Yesua aberɛ so.
8Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yesua, Binuyi, Kadimiɛl, Serebia, Yuda yeɛ Matania bɔ ɔne ye mmango Lewifoɛ mɔ yeɛ né bɛnea ayɛyelɛ edweintolɛ ne aso ɔ. 9Na sɛ bɛto ayɛyelɛ dwein a, b’eliɛma Bakebukia ne Yuno gyina bɛ ndendeneɛ so.
10Yesua awa ole Yoakim; Yoakim awa ole Eliasibo, Eliasibo awa ole Yowada, 11Yowada awa ole Yonatan, yeɛ Yonatan awa ole Yadua.
12(Ɔsɔfo panyi paa) Yoakim aberɛ so, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛte bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi mɔ ɛhe: Seraya boso ama deɛ ole Meraya; Yeremia boso ama deɛ ole Hanania; 13Ɛsra boso ama deɛ ole Mesulam; Amaria boso ama deɛ ole Yehohanan; 14Maluki boso ama deɛ ole Yonatan; Sebania boso ama deɛ ole Yosef; 15Harim boso ama deɛ ole Adena; Merayote boso ama deɛ ole Helkae; 16Yido boso ama deɛ ole Sakaria; Gyineton boso ama deɛ ole Mesulam; 17Abiya boso ama deɛ ole Sikri; Miniamin ne Moadia bɛ boso ama deɛ ole Piletae; 18Bilega boso ama deɛ ole Samua; Semaya boso ama deɛ ole Yehonatan; 19Yoaribo boso ama deɛ ole Matenae; Yedaya boso ama deɛ ole Yusi; 20Salae boso ama deɛ ole Kalae; Amoko boso ama deɛ ole Ebere; 21Hilkia boso ama deɛ ole Hasabia; yeɛ Yedaya boso ama deɛ ole Netanɛl.
22(Asɔfo mbanyi paa) Eliasibo, Yowada, Yohanan ne Yadua b’aberɛ so, bɛhyerɛle Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi bɛ dumaa, yeɛ bɛhyerɛle asɔfo nemɔ koso bɛ deɛ maa oodwuli Pɛsia hene Dario ye aberɛ so. 23Lewifoɛ nemɔ, bɔ bɛte bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi ne, bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa wɔ abakɔsɛm nwomaa ne anu maa oodwuli Yohanan bosoniɛ Eliasibo aberɛ so. 24Lewifoɛ mbanyi bɔ né bɛlela bɛ noa ɛhe: Hasabia, Serebia, yeɛ Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Kadimiɛl ne, bɛ ne b’eliɛma mɔ bɔ né begyina bɛ ndendeneɛ so besuro ayɛyelɛ ne asennaa dwein ne aso, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ sona Dawide hyɛle ne. Kure ko to ye deɛ yie a, né ko koso wato ye deɛ. 25Né Matania, Bakebukia, Obadia, Mesulam, Talmon ne Akubo bɛte pambim awɛmvoɛ bɔ bɛwɛne sua bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu nemɔ ɔ. 26Sɔ mmerɛ ne te Yoakim bɔ ye baba ole Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Yosadake ne, yeɛ amrado Nehemia ne ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne b’aberɛ so.
Betu fasue ne bewura AWURADE sa
27Mmerɛ bɔ betu Yerusalem fasue ne bewura Nyameɛ sa ne, bɛpenane Lewifoɛ nemɔ wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛtete amukoraa.
