3Ao AWURADE, me Nyameɛ, nea ná ma me mmuayɛɛ!
Ma me nwo sande me, nna manna ewue nnaa;
4nna me pɔfoɛ wanga kyɛ, “Mali ye so ngonim”,
nna mamvi ase amma me pɔfoɛ mɔ banni ahurusi.
5Na me de, mafa me nwo mato wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso;
na wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, ngoli ahurusi wɔ nu.
6 Ngɔto dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ,
ofikyɛ walo me paa.

Title: EDWEIN 14
Content:
Kwaseaa nwa Nyameɛ nne berɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
(Edwein 53)
1 Kwaseaa kã ye wɔ ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ.”
Olle adwene paa, na amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ,
ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ɔ.
2AWURADE to ye nye fi nyameɛso ɔnea adasa mmaa,
kyɛ aso okonwu ebie bɔ ɔse nworɛ,
bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.
3Nakoso bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu, bɛ mukoraa adwene paa ɔnne bɛ ti anu;
bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ,
daabi, ko po nne berɛ.
4Bɔnefoɛ amukoraa, aso nimdeɛ abɔ bɛ anaa;
bɛ yeɛ bedi me mmenia aminɛ kyɛbɔ bedi aleɛ,
ná bɛnzɔne AWURADE ɔ?
5Berɛ, ahunundetelɛ kandinga kɔtɔ bɛ so,
ofikyɛ Nyameɛ gyi teneneefoɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɛ si.
6Sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne, ɛmɔama ye nzusuleɛ ayɛ basaa,
nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔte ye afealeɛ ɔ.
7Ao, ahaa né Yisrael ngoalelɛ wafi Sion wawa!
Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE kosa kɔfa ye maen agyapadeɛ kɔma ye ne,
Yakob koli ahurusi; Yisrael nye kɔgye.

Title: EDWEIN 15
Content:
Sona bɔ ɔkɔtena Nyameɛ nekaa krongron berɛ ɔ
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, nwa yeɛ okosikye wɔ tena sua ne anu ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔtena wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso ɔ?
2Sana bɔ ye bra te sannwuu, bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ,
bɔ ofi ye ahone nu ɔkã nahorɛ,
3bɔ ɔmva ye noa ngeka mmenia nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ,
bɔ ɔnyɔ obiɛngo bɔne,
ná ommu obiɛngo animtia ɔ.
4Sɔ sona ne, amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛla ye nye so mbaen,
na ɔfa anidie ma bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ɔ.
Sɛ ɔta ndaen ma ye nwo kyere ye po a, ommu so;
5ɔmmɔ bosea mva nzihoɛ nzi ye nwo,
yeɛ onne fea-ase-ma mmua bɔ odi be ɔ ndɛengyea.
Ebiala bɔ odi sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ aso ne, ye bo ngotutu.

Title: EDWEIN 16
Content:
Me wora wura Nyameɛ nu
Dawide dwein
1Ao Nyameɛ, bɔ me nwo waen,
ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ.
2Meka mekyire AWURADE kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Mene ɔ;
nnne nikye paa biala, sana wɔ ngome.”
3Krongronfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ ne aso ne,
bɛ yeɛ bele animnyam ɔ,
ná bɛ nu yeɛ m’anigye amukoraa wɔ ɔ.
4Bɛ bɔ bɛso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ ne de,
bɛtwetwe aworabɔlɛ pee bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo;
mengɔbɔ mogya anonneɛ afɔleɛ mengɔma sɔ nyameɛ foforɛ nemɔ,
yeɛ mengɔbɔ bɛ dumaa mengɔsɔne bɛ.
5AWURADE te m’agyapadeɛ bɔ mafa ɔ, ɔne me ngrabea;
wɔ sa nu yeɛ me nwo amukoraa wura ɔ.
6Nningyein paa yeɛ afa ama me ɔ;
amba, agyapadeɛ paa yeɛ me sa ahã ɔ.
7AWURADE bɔ otu me foɛ ne, meye ye ayɛ;
meda kɔngɔen po a, me tiboa kyire me bɔ nyɔ ɔ.
8Metwe m’adwene mesie AWURADE so daa;
na ɔnate kyɛ ogyi me sa famaa so ne ati, mengofi ase.
9Yiti me nye agye, yeɛ me kra di ahurusi;
me nwo atɔ me fɔnwoo.
10Ofikyɛ ɛngɔma me kra ngɔha ɛborɔ,
yeɛ ɛngɔma w’anwoteeniɛ ne ngɔporɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu.
11Wɔ yeɛ ekyire me ngoa atee ɔ.
Wɔ nyunu yeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔyɛ ahomeka mu wɔ ɔ,
na wɔ sa famaa nu yeɛ anigye wɔ afebɔɔ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 17
Content:
Pepɛ de me fi ndaneanyeɛfoɛ sa nu
Dawide mbaeɛ
1Ao AWURADE, tie me dwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ, yeɛ tie me sufrɛ;
tie me mbaeɛ bɔ ofi noa bɔ nnakannaka ɔnne nu ɔ nu.
2Nea ná bua me be,
ma wɔ nye nwu edwirɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.
3Sɛ ɛneanea m’ahone nu, ná ɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ me ti anu dwirɛ nu kɔngɔen,
ná eso me nea a, engonwu bɔne biala wɔ me nu;
mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ mengɔfa me noa mengɔhã edwirɛ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ.
4Mmenia bɛ yɔleɛ ne, ngyi wɔ noa dwirɛ so
mahwe me nwo mafi basabasayɔlɛfoɛ bɛ yɔleɛ nwo.
5W’atee ne ala yeɛ nnate so ɔ,
yeɛ me gya koso ossotili offili so.
6Ao, Nyameɛ, mesu mefrɛ wɔ, ofikyɛ ekotie me;
yɛ asoɛ tie me, tie me dwirɛ.
7Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye ye ali kyire me wɔ atee bɔ ɔyɛ nwanwa ɔ so;
bɛ bɔ bɛnwati befi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu bɛbafea wɔ berɛ ne,
wɔ yeɛ ɛfa wɔ sa famaa ɛpepɛ ede bɛ ɔ.
8Bɔ me nwo waen kyɛ sona nye kyiremvua;
fa me fea wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu.
9Bɔnefoɛ bɔ badwɔso me so ne, pepɛ de me fi bɛ sa nu,
pɔfoɛ awudifoɛ bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia nemɔ, pepɛ de me fi bɛ sa nu.
10Bennwu sona anwumvoin koraa,
na bɛfa bɛ noa bɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ.
11Bahã me bamia, na bapɛ me nwo bayia;
bafa basie bɛ nye so kyɛ bɛkɔhã me bɛkɔto ase.
12Bɛte kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔpena kaka bie kye ye ɔ;
bɛte kyɛ gyata akrɔngrɔma bɔ wafea ɔtetɛ ɔ.
13Ao, AWURADE, dwɔso fa koɛ toa bɛ, ná di bɛ so ngonim!
Fa wɔ ngrandɛ ne pepɛ de me ngoa fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu.
14Ao AWURADE, fa wɔ tumi ne pepɛ de me fi adasa mmaa sa nu;
adasa mmaa bɔ b’akatuaa wɔ wiase wa ala ne, de me fi bɛ sa nu.
Akatuaa bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama bɛ ne, fa tua bɛ so kerɛ piri paa;
ma bɛ mma mɔ benya akatuaa ne mmorosoɛ,
ná bɛ́fa bie bɛ́yakyi bɛ nnomaa mɔ.
15Na me de, ɔnate kyɛ metengyɛ ne ati, ngonwu wɔ nyunu;
sɛ medafe metingye a, m’ahone kɔtɔ me kunu, kyɛ manwu wɔ nyunu ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 18
Content:
Ngonimlilɛ dwein
Dawide dwein, mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE pepɛ lele ye fili ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa ne Sɔɔlo sa nu ne
(2 Samuel 22.1-51)
1Ao AWURADE bɔ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ, mekuro wɔ dwirɛ.
2AWURADE te me nyɔbotaen, m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne me defoɛ,
me Nyameɛ, me nyɔbotaen bɔ mebɔ me nwo waen wɔ wɔ nu ɔ,
me buralɛ ataadeɛ ne me ngoalelɛ anwoserɛ ɔne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.
3AWURADE bɔ ɔfata ayɛyelɛ ne, ye yeɛ mesu mefrɛ ye ɔ,
na ɔpepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu.
4Ewue nyamaa brabrale me,
na ewue bu fale me so kyɛ asue;
5ɛborɔ dɔ nyamaa mendale me,
na ewue ngaen wale me so kyɛ ɔbaahye me.
6Nzu mvrɛle AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛ nu,
na ndeane nu mvrɛle me Nyameɛ kyɛ ɔboka me.
Ɔwɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu dɔ yeɛ ɔtele me komvi ɔ,
na me sufrɛ dwuli ye so anu.
7Yeɛ aseɛ pusuli, na ɔwosole;
mmokaa mɔ nyinasoɛ ye bo kekane,
na ɔwosole, ɔnate kyɛ ye ahone huli.
8Nwosina fili ye bonyi anu pu wale;
see wuronyiwuronyi fili ye noa nu wale,
na see bɔ wasɔ gonn fili ye nwo tutu guale.
9Ɔmoamoane ewienu, na odwuli ase,
na né awosii kabii wɔ ye gya bo.
10Ɔtenane kɛrubo so tuli,
na ɔnate mvrama ye ndaa so wale ndɛndɛ.
11Ɔfale awosii munduni ye nwo,
ɔfale munungum kusuu, bɔ ɔte esue bɔ wamuna ɔ katale ye nwo.
12Kanea hyireinn bɔ oli ye nyunu ne,
asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ ne see gonn
fili nu bɔ wurale ye munungum ne anu.
13AWURADE bɔle nu kurudududu wɔ nyameɛso,
na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne dwudwole nen,
asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ ne see gonn tete guale.
14Ɔtotole agyaen mane ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔle aya,
ye agralaa bɔ ɔtetele ne mane bɛ nye so tanene.
15Afei ɛpo ye bo dɔ aseɛ yele ye nwo ali,
na aseɛ nyinasoɛ nwo lale berɛ,
ofikyɛ, ao AWURADE, ɛhane bɛ nyunu,
yeɛ nwomeɛ koso fili wɔ bonyi anu tu wale ne ati ɔ.
16Ɔtengyɛle ye sa fili anwuro ɔɔsɔle me nu,
na ɔyele me fili buma nu.
17Olele me fili me pɔfoɛ anwoserɛniɛ sa nu,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bekyi me ɔ, bɛ sa nu;
ofikyɛ né bɛ nwo yɛ se tra me koraa.
18M’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu yeɛ bɛwale me so ɔ,
nakoso AWURADE gyinane me si.
19Ɔyele me fili amaneɛ nu mane me nwo tɔle me,
ɔpepɛ lele me, ofikyɛ okuro me dwirɛ.
20AWURADE neane kyɛbɔ mesi metengyɛ ɔ so mane me ye nwo akatuaa;
ogyinane kyɛbɔ me bra si te sannwuu ɔ so mane me ye nwo akatuaa.
21Ofikyɛ mali AWURADE dwirɛ so,
na nnyɔle bɔne nngakyili me si mmmane Nyameɛ.
22Mali ye nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa so,
yeɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ koso, nndwene me nwo mmvili ye nwo.
23M’atee tengyɛ wɔ ye nyunu,
na mate me nwo mafi bɔne nwo.
24Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE agyina me tengyɛlɛ so wama me ye nwo akatuaa;
wagyina kyɛbɔ me bra te sannwuu wɔ ye nyunu ɔ so.
25Sona bɔ odi nahorɛ ma wɔ ne, wɔ wora edi nahorɛ ma ye,
yeɛ sona bɔ mvomsoɛ nne ye nwo ne, wɔ wora ɛmaa onwu kyɛ mvomsoɛ nne wɔ nwo.
26Bɔ ye nwo te ne, wɔ wora ɛmaa onwu kyɛ wɔ nwo te,
nakoso sona bɔ ɔte kanda de, ɛmaa onwu kyɛ ɛse nworɛ tra ye.
27Ɛpepɛ de anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ,
nakoso anwomasoɛfoɛ de, ɛbrɛ bɛ ase.
28Wɔ yeɛ ɛsɔ me kanea ɔ,
AWURADE me Nyameɛ ɔta ma m’awosii yɛ hyereinn.
29Egyina me si maa medi ɛlɔen so ngonim,
me Nyameɛ gyina me si maa mehuru mefa fasue so.
30Sɔ Nyameɛ he, ye atee tengyɛ,
AWURADE bɔhyɛ te nahorɛ,
na ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ ye nwo waen wɔ Nyameɛ nu ne,
Nyameɛ te ye buralɛ ataadeɛ.
31Nwa yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ɔ? Sana AWURADE angome.
Nwa yeɛ ɔte nyɔbotaen ɔ? Sana yɛ Nyameɛ angome.
32Sɔ Nyameɛ he bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ne,
ɔma me brabɔlɛ tengyɛ.
33Ɔma me gya boso yɛ nyera kyɛ kɛtɛbɔɔ,
na ɔmaa megyina pindinn wɔ mmokaa so.
34Okyire me koɛhonɛ,
amaa ɔnate so mekora mekondo kɔɔbere agyaen nu.
35Afa wɔ ngoalelɛ akokyɛm ne ama me,
na wɔ mmokalɛ amaa mayɛ sona titire.
36Ɛbɔ atee pralaa maa mefa so bɔ ɔmaa menzoti ɔ.
37Mvoane me pɔfoɛ mɔ, na ngɔndole bɛ,
na manza me si kɔpem kyɛ ngukuni bɛ ɔ.
38Mmobɔle bɛ nguale berɛ bɔ bangora dwɔso ko ɔ,
na bɛtotɔle beguale me gya bo.
39Ɛmane me koɛ nu anwoserɛ,
na ɛmane me pɔfoɛ mɔ lili ngoguo wɔ me nyunu.
40Ɛmane me pɔfoɛ mɔ nwati fili me nyunu,
bɛ bɔ bekyi me ne, nnuane bɛ boso.
41Bɛteateane nu bɛpenane mmokalɛ, nakoso bannya defoɛ biala,
besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE, nakoso wandɛ bɛ so.
42Ndini bɛ muhumuhu kyɛ mvuture bɔ mvrama hu ye kɔ ɔ,
na mvindini bɛ nguale kyɛ dwaaso nnɛterɛ.
43Mmenia bɔ bɛyɔle me nwo lɔen ne, ɛpepɛ lele me fili bɛ sa nu.
Ɛfale me tuale maen maen mɔ noa,
na mmenia bɔ né menze bɛ ɔ bɛsole me.
44Bɛtele me nga pɛ yeɛ bɛyɛle sotie bɛmane me ɔ.
Maen maen so ama wale bɛɛkotole me.
45Ahunundetelɛ tɔle maen maen so ama so,
na bɛfale anwopopolɛ befili b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nu befite bɛwale.
46AWURADE te ase! Me nyɔbotaen, meye wɔ ayɛ!
Me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ, mekamvo wɔ!
47Nyameɛ bɔ ɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ so wereɛ ma me ɔ,
ye bɔ ɔbrɛ maen maen mɔ ase wura me bo ɔ,
48ye bɔ ode me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu ɔ;
amba, bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia me ne,
wɔ yeɛ ɛma me so maa bewura me bo ɔ,
na ede me fi mmenia bɔ awosii wɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ bɛ sa nu.
49Yiti, O AWURADE, ngɔkamvo wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ so,
ná mabɔ wɔ dumaa mato ayɛyelɛ dwein.
50Odi ngonim piri paa ma ye hene ne,
ɔye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ ali kyire sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne,
ɔye ye ali kyire Dawide ne ye boso ama afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 19
Content:
Yɛnwu Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ abɔdeɛ nu
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nyameɛso ye Nyameɛ animnyam kyire,
yeɛ ewienu bɔ ye sa noa adwuma nwo dawure.
2Kyẽa biala kã animnyam ne nwo dwirɛ kyire kyẽa bɔ ɔtoa ye so ɔ,
na alesaleɛ biala da nimdeɛ ne ali kyire alesaleɛ bɔ ɔtoa ye so ɔ.
3Bemmukye bɛ noa, bɛnga edwirɛ biala,
ebiala nde bɛ komvi;
4nakoso bɛ komvi dwu aseɛ ye aso nekaa biala,
na bɛ dwirɛ fi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti.
Wasi ɛtena sua wama eyia wɔ nyameɛso,
5eyia pukye kyɛ atɔmvorɛ biaa bɔ ofi ye sua nu ofite ɔ,
kyɛ bienzua anwoserɛniɛ bɔ ole anigye otu amirika ɔ.
6Eyia pukye fi nyameɛso ye ti dɔ,
ɔpɛ ye atee kɔka ye ti dɔ,
na hwee ngora mva ye nwo mvea mvi ye hyerɛ ne abo.
7AWURADE mmeraa ne te pɛpɛɛpɛ,
ɔkanyane sona kra;
AWURADE dwirɛ te nahorɛ,
na ɔma sona tetekwaa onwu nworɛ.
8AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ te turoloo,
ɔma sona ahone tɔ ye kunu;
AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ nwo te,
na obukye sona nye.
9AWURADE surolɛ te krongron,
na esurolɛ ne tena berɛ afebɔɔ.
AWURADE nhyehyɛleɛ te nahorɛ,
na ye mukoraa tengyɛ.
10Nhyehyɛleɛ ne di mu tra esikaa kɔkorɛ,
ɔtra esikaa kɔkorɛ paa po.
Ɔte menemene tra woɛ,
na ɔtra woɛ bɔ ofi nzasameɛ nu ɔpepe ɔ.
11Afei koso, ɔnate so yeɛ ɛbɔ wɔ somvoɛ kɔkɔ ɔ;
na sona di so a, onya akatuaa piri.
12Nwa yeɛ ye nye kora ba ye nwo so
wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye mvomsoɛ nwo ɔ?
Me mvomsoɛ bɔ wafea me ne, fa kyɛ me.
13Bɔne bɔ bɛboapa bɛyɔ ne, twe w’akoaa fi ye nwo.
Sɔ bɔne nemɔ, nnɛmaa bedi me so,
amaa ɔnate so mali be wɔ wɔ nyunu,
ná manni mmeraatolɛ piri ne anwo fɔ.
14Ao AWURADE, me nyɔbotaen ne me defoɛ,
edwirɛ bɔ ngɔte me noa ngɔhã,
ɔne bɔ ngosusu ye nwo wɔ me ti anu ne,
maa ɔsɔ wɔ nye.

Title: EDWEIN 20
Content:
Ngonimlilɛ nwo mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE otie wɔ sufrɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu!
Yakob Nyameɛ ne, ye dumaa ɔ́bɔ wɔ nwo waen!
2Ɔ́soma mmokalɛ ofi ye nekaa krongron berɛ ɔɔboka wɔ,
ná ófi Sion bokaa so oogyina wɔ si.
3AWURADE ɔ́kaye w’afɔleɛ amukoraa,
ná ɔ́ma ye nye sɔ wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ.
Sela
4Ɔ́ma wɔ sa hã bɔ w’ahone nu ɛpena ɔ,
ná ɔ́ma wɔ nzusuleɛ amukoraa ɔ́yɛ berɛ.
5Maa yɛfa ahurusililɛ yɛbɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ese,
ná yɛpagya yɛ frangaa wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu.
AWURADE ɔ́yɔ w’abisadeɛ amukoraa ɔ́ma wɔ.
6Afei, manwu kyɛ AWURADE boka ye sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne;
otie ye sufrɛ wɔ ye nyameɛso krongron dɔ,
na AWURADE ye anwoserɛ asaa famaa ne ɔpepɛ de ye.
7Ebiemɔ fa bɛ wora bewura teaseɛnam mɔ nu,
yeɛ ebiemɔ koso bɛfa bɛ deɛ bewura mbɔngɔ nu;
nakoso yɛ de, yɛ wora wura AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu.
8Bɛ de, besoti befifi ase,
nakoso yɛ de, yɛdwɔso yɛgyina berɛ kyirebeinn.
9Ao, AWURADE, pepɛ de ɛhene ne,
na sɛ yɛsu yɛfrɛ wɔ a, tie yɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 21
Content:
Ngonimlilɛ nwo asennaa
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao AWURADE, w’anwoserɛ ne ati ɛhene ne nye gye;
na wɔ ngoalelɛ ne ati, nea kyɛbɔ osi di ahurusi paa ɔ!
2Ama ye sa ahã bɔ ye ahone nu ɔpena ɔ,
na bɔ wate ye noa wabisa ne, amva ammɔ ye atianuserɛ.
3Ofikyɛ ɛfa saleɛ kandinga yia ye,
na ɛfa esikaa kɔkorɛ paa abotire bɔ ye.
4Ɔsrɛle wɔ berɛ ngoa, na ɛfa mane ye;
ɛmane ye ngoa tendenn afebɔɔ.
5Wɔ ngoalelɛ ti, ye animnyam te piri;
na afa anidie ne ahennie alo ye.
6Amba, ɛmaa onya saleɛ piri afebɔɔ,
na anika bɔ onya ye wɔ wɔ nyunu ne ati, ɛma ye nye gye.
7Ofikyɛ ɛhene ne wafa ye nwo wato AWURADE so,
na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ, ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ongofĩ ase.
8Wɔ sa kɔhã wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa.
Na bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, wɔ sa famaa kɔhyehye bɛ mukoraa.
9Sɛ ɛye wɔ nwo ali a,
ɛkɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ foonoo nu see.
AWURADE kohũhũ bɛ wɔ ye yaafɛlɛ ne anu,
na see kɔyera bɛ.
10Ekonua bɛ mma boso kofi aseɛ ye aso,
ɔne bɛ boso ama kofi adasa mmaa nu.
11Sɛ bɛbɔ wɔ nwo porɛ,
yeɛ sɛ bɛfa wɔ nwo adwene tɛɛ a, ɔngɔyɛ yé.
12Ofikyɛ ɛkɔfoa bɛ maa bɛkɔnwati;
ɛkɔfa w’agyaen ne kohyire bɛ so.
13Ao AWURADE, gyina w’anwoserɛ so ma wɔ nwo so!
Yɛkɔto dwein yɛkɔye wɔ tumi ne ayɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 22
Content:
Amaneɛnwunɛ nu mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Me Nyameɛ, me Nyameɛ, nzu ati yeɛ apo me ye?
Nzu ati yeɛ mepene mepena mmokalɛ, nakoso aye wɔ nye afi me so ye?
2Ao me Nyameɛ, alehyeleɛ biala mesu mefrɛ wɔ, nakoso ɛndɛ me so;
mesu mefrɛ wɔ kɔngɔen biala, nakoso me nwo ndɔ me.
3Nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛte krongron ɔ,
na Yisrael ayɛyelɛ yeɛ ɔte w’ahennie bia ɔ.
4Wɔ yeɛ yɛ nana mɔ bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole wɔ so ɔ;
bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole wɔ so, na ɛpepɛ lele bɛ.
5Wɔ yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle wɔ ɔ, na ɛpepɛ lele bɛ;
wɔ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole wɔ so ɔ, na bɛ nyunu angua ase.
6Nakoso me de, nde esuronyi, na nnde sona,
mmenia sere me, adasa bu me animtia.
7Ebiala bɔ onwu me ne, ɔgoro me nwo;
besobi bɛ noa begua me so, ná bawoso bɛ ti (bahã kyɛ):
8“Ɔfa ye nwo to AWURADE so; maa ɔpepɛ ole ye e;
maa ɔpepɛ ole ye, ofikyɛ ɔla ye ahone nwo.”
9Nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛyele me fili me ni akunu ɔ;
ndua me maame nyɔfone noa ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle me nwo waen ɔ.
10Wɔ yeɛ belele m’aworɛ bɛtole wɔ gya so ɔ,
na ofi me ni akunu, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ.
11Nnɛyakyi me nu,
ofikyɛ edwirɛ pena to me,
na nnne bokafoɛ biala.
12Nandwie nyii pee bapɛ me nwo bayia,
Basan nandwie nyii anwoserɛ nemɔ, bapɛ me nwo kango;
13babukye bɛ noa nu hambonnwu bawa me so,
kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔteatea nu ɔtete kaka bɔ wahye ye ɔ nu ɔ.
14Behwie me begua ase kyɛ nzue,
na me mmowue amukoraa bahodwo wɔ m’aporɛ so;
m’ahone akakyi kyɛ nguɛ,
wahuro wagua me kunu.
15Me komvi ayɛ wosee kyɛ nyangaa bue,
na me temverema amata me nnaalɔ;
afa me ato ewue kumaa nu.
16Ngyea apɛ me nwo bayia,
nzɛmmɔnefoɛ fekue bapɛ me nwo kango;
bafa nikyee basinasina me gya ne me sa.
17Mekora meka me mmowue amukoraa.
Mmenia bɛnea me haa, na bɛkã me anyinga.
18Bɛkyɛ me ndena bɛfa,
na begua serewa bɛkyɛ me ndaadeɛ.
19Nakoso, ao AWURADE, nnɛtwe wɔ nwo fi me nwo!
Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!
20Pepɛ de me kra fi ngrandɛ noa;
pepɛ de me ngoa fi ngyea ye mɔ sa nu!
21Pepɛ de me fi gyata noa nu!
Ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me afi torɔen mmɛen noa.
22Ngɔbɔ wɔ dumaa ngohyire nniɛma mɔ;
ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ badwa nu.
23Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ!
Ɛmɔ, Yakob boso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye animnyam;
Yisrael boso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE!
24Ofikyɛ amaneɛnwunɛniɛ ne, ye amaneɛ ne,
wammu ye nye wangua so,
yeɛ wanye ye nye wamvea ye,
na mmom osũ frɛle ye ne, otiele ye sufrɛ.
25Wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa mekora meye wɔ ayɛ wɔ badwa kandinga nu ɔ,
na bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bɛ nyunu yeɛ ngotua m’aboadeɛ ɔ.
26Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bekodidi bɛkɔma bɛ ko koyi;
bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔye ye ayɛ ɔ.
Nyameɛ ɔ́ma ɛ́mɔnya anika afebɔɔ!
27Ofi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti, bɛkɔkaye,
ná basa bawa AWURADE berɛ;
na maen maen mɔ so mmusua amukoraa,
bɛkɔkoto wɔ ye nyunu.
28Ofikyɛ ahennie te AWURADE deɛ,
na odi maen maen mɔ so hene.
29Amba, ye yeɛ aseɛ ye aso anwomasoɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔkoto ye ɔ;
adasa mukoraa, bɛ bɔ bɛngora bɛmma bɛ nwo ngoa ɔ,
ye yeɛ bɛkɔkoto ye ɔ.
30Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ kɔso ye,
bɛkɔhã AWURADE nwo dwirɛ bekohyire kyẽa bie ama.
31Bɛkɔhã ye ngoalelɛ nwo dwirɛ bekohyire bɛ bɔ bennya bɛwwole bɛ nemɔ kyɛ,
“AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ sɔ nikyee ye ɔ.”

Title: EDWEIN 23
Content:
AWURADE te me neafoɛ
Dawide dwein
1AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me neafoɛ ɔ, yiti hwee ngohia me.
2Ɔmaa meda nekaa bɔ menya nyaa monɛ medi ɔ.
Odi me nyunu fa me kɔ nzue bɔ ɔla berɛ dinn ɔ nwo,
3ɔma me kra nwo sande ye.
Odi me nyunu fa me fa tenenee atee so,
ye dumaa ne ati.
4Sɛ nnate ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu po a,
menzuro musue biala,
ofikyɛ ɛne me yeɛ yɛnate ɔ;
wɔ bakaa ne wɔ pɔmaa
yeɛ bɛkyekye me wora ɔ.
5Ɛto me poen
wɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu;
ɛfa ngoo popa me ti so;
me kulie yi bu fa so.
6Amba, saleɛ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ bekoli me si
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu amukoraa,
na ngɔtena AWURADE awuro afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 24
Content:
AWURADE awuro berɛ hɔlɛ
Dawide dwein
1Aseɛ ye, ɔne so nningyein amukoraa bɛte AWURADE deɛ;
ewiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa bɛte ye deɛ,
2ofikyɛ ye yeɛ wagyina ye wɔ ɛpo so,
ná wafa ye watimu asue mɔ so ɔ.
3Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfo AWURADE bokaa ne ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ okogyina ye nekaa krongron berɛ ɔ?
4Sana sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu, ná ye ahone nu koso te,
bɔ ye kra nye ngye ngondombo nwo,
ná ɔnda ngondombo ndaen ɔ.
5Ye yeɛ okonya AWURADE sa nu saleɛ ɔ,
na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ye ngoadefoɛ ne, okobua ye be.
6Bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne,
ao Yakob Nyameɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne wɔ ne, sɔ yeɛ bɛte ɔ.
7Ao pambim mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo so!
Ɛmɔ, tete anoa mɔ, ɛ́mɔpagya ɛmɔ nwo,
ná animnyam Hene ne oowura nu.
8Nwa yeɛ ɔte animnyam Hene ne ɔ?
AWURADE ɔ, anwoserɛniɛ ne tuminiɛ ne,
AWURADE bɔ ɔte koɛ nu katakyie ne.
9Ao pambim mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo so!
Ɛmɔ, tete anoa mɔ, ɛ́mɔpagya ɛmɔ nwo,
ná animnyam Hene ne oowura nu.
10Nwa yeɛ ɔte sɔ animnyam Hene ne ɔ?
Asafo AWURADE ɔ,
ye yeɛ ɔte animnyam Hene ne ɔ.
Sela

Title: EDWEIN 25
Content:
AWURADE, kyire me atee
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mefa me kra mewura wɔ sa nu ɔ.
2Ao me Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ me wora wura wɔ nu ɔ;
nnɛma me nyunu gua ase;
nnɛma me pɔfoɛ mɔ bedi m’asefinɛ nwo ahurusi.
3Nahorɛ nu, bɛ bɔ bɛ nye la wɔ so ne, nnɛma bɛ nyunu gua ase;
bɛ bɔ bɛnate ngondombo atee so bɛye bɛ biɛngo bɛma ne,
ma bɛ nyunu gua ase.
4Ao AWURADE, maa nwu w’atee ne;
fa me fa wɔ saa bɔ apɛ ato berɛ ne aso.
5Di me nyunu maa nnate wɔ nahorɛ ne anu, ná kyirekyire me,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ɔ;
wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so daa biala ɔ.
6Ao AWURADE, kaye w’anwumvoinnwunɛ
ɔne wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
ofikyɛ bɛwɔ berɛ fi tete.
7Ao AWURADE, ɔnate wɔ paayɛlɛ ne ati,
nnɛkaye me ngwadaa nu bɔne, ɔne me mmeraatolɛ;
gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ná kaye me!
8AWURADE te paa, na ɔtengyɛ;
yiti okyire bɔnefoɛ atee maa bɛfa so.
9Odi anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ nyunu maa bɛfa tenenee nu,
na okyirekyire anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ maa bɛfa ye atee so.
10AWURADE atee amukoraa te ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi
ne nahorɛ ma bɛ bɔ bedi ye apam ne ye dwirɛ so ɔ.
11Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti,
fa me bɔne kyɛ me, ofikyɛ ɔte piri.
12Nwa yeɛ ɔte sona bɔ osuro AWURADE ɔ?
Ye yeɛ AWURADE kohyire ye atee bɔ odi kyɛ ɔfa so ɔ.
13Ye kra kɔtena asomdwee nu,
na ye boso ama konya aseɛ ne maa ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ.
14AWURADE ne bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne yeɛ betu asure ɔ,
na ɔye ye apam ne ali kyire bɛ.
15Me nye la AWURADE so afebɔɔ,
ofikyɛ ɔkɔye me gya kofi ngaen nu.
16Pɛne wɔ nye baanea me, ná nwu me anwumvoin,
ofikyɛ waha me ngome, na menwu amaneɛ.
17Adwenedwene bɔ ɔla me so ne te piri,
ao, ye me fi m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.
18Nea yealɛ ne amaneɛ bɔ menwu ye ɔ,
ná fa me bɔne amukoraa kyɛ me.
19Nea me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ somaa,
ná nea ɛpɔen kandinga bɔ bɛpɔ me ɔ.
20Ao, bɔ me kra nwo waen ná pepɛ de me;
nnɛma me nyunu gua ase, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ menwati mebafea wɔ nu ɔ.
21Ma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ ɔnea me so,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mafa me nwo mato wɔ so ɔ.
22Ao Nyameɛ, pepɛ de Yisrael
fi ye amaneɛ amukoraati nu.

Title: EDWEIN 26
Content:
Teneneeniɛ mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, bua me be,
ofikyɛ mafa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ manate;
na mafa me nwo mato AWURADE so
bɔ mengɔnwɔngye mengɔtɔ ɔ.
2Neanea me nu ná so me nea,
pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ m’ahone nu ne me ti anu.
3Ofikyɛ daa biala mekaye wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
na wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anu yeɛ menate ɔ.
4Me ne asanzafoɛ yɛndu nu,
yeɛ me ne nyaatwomfoɛ yɛmva abiɛngoɛ.
5Mekyi kyɛ me ne bɔnefoɛ yɛkɔbɔ dwaa ɔ,
na me ne nzɛmmɔnefoɛ yɛngɔtena yɛngɔbɔ nu.
6Menwunzi me sa mefa mekyire kyɛ menni fɔ,
na mepɛ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo mebra meyia, ao AWURADE;
7metea nu meto asennaa dwein,
na mebɔ w’anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.
8Ao AWURADE, awuro bɔ ɛte nu ne, ɔla m’ahone nwo,
nekaa bɔ w’animnyam te ne.
9Nnɛpra me kra boka bɔnefoɛ so,
yeɛ nnɛpra me ngoa fra kodiawufoɛ so,
10mmenia bɔ bɔne nwo adwene ala yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ,
bɔ bɛyere bɛ nwo bede fea-ase-ma ɔ.
11Nakoso me de, nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ mefa menate ɔ;
pepɛ de me, ná nwu me anwumvoin.
12Me gya gyi berɛ pindinn wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so,
na badwa kandinga nu yeɛ ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 27
Content:
AWURADE te me kanea ne me ngoalelɛ
Dawide dwein
1AWURADE te me kanea ne me ngoalelɛ,
nwa yeɛ mesuro ye ɔ?
AWURADE te me ngoa ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ,
nwa nwo suronyi yeɛ ɔkɔtɔ me so ɔ?
2Sɛ nzɛmmɔnefoɛ ba me so kyɛ bɛbaatete me nu pasapasa a,
sɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛba me so a, bekosoti bekofifi ase.
3Sɛ ɛlɔen kyekye asikyeleɛ kyɛ bɛbaafa koɛ bɛtoa me po a,
me kunu ngɔtete me;
sɛ bɛfa koɛ bɛbateta me po a,
ngogyina pindinn.
4Nikyee komapɛ yeɛ masrɛ AWURADE ɔ,
sɔ nikyee ne yeɛ mepena ye si atee ɔ:
ye ole kyɛ ngɔtena AWURADE awuro
mmerɛ bɔ nde ase amukoraa,
ná manea AWURADE animnyam,
ɔne kyɛ me ne ye yɛkoli ngitahoɛ wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔ.
5Ofikyɛ ɔfa me sie ye afealeɛ ne anu
wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu;
ɔfa me fea ye tena sua afealeɛ ne anu,
na ɔfa me gyina nyɔbotaen so.
6Afei ɔmaa medi ngonim
wɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia ɔ so,
ná ngɔfa esebɔlɛ ngɔbɔ afɔleɛ
wɔ ye tena sua ne anu.
Ngɔto anigye dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ.
7Ao AWURADE, sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, tie me,
nwu me anwumvoin, ná tie me sufrɛ!
8Ahã ahyire me kyɛ, “Pena me si atee!”
Na mmuale kyɛ, “AWURADE,
wɔ si atee yeɛ mepena ɔ.”
9Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me,
nnɛfɛ yaa foa w’akoaa,
na wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ɔ.
Nnɛpo me, yeɛ nnɛyakyi me nu,
ao Nyameɛ, me ngoadefoɛ!
10Sɛ me baba ne me maame bɛpo me po a,
AWURADE de, okole me.
11Ao AWURADE, kyire me w’atee ne,
ná fa me fa atimbire frɛtɛɛ so,
ɔnate me pɔfoɛ mɔ ati.
12Nnɛmaa mekɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ ngaen nu,
ofikyɛ adanzefoɛ ngondombofoɛ badwɔso batia me,
na bɛpepɛ edwirɛ mbiri mbiri begua me so.
13Mede medi kyɛ ngonwu AWURADE paayɛlɛ ne
wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ ye aso.
14Ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so,
gyina pindinn ná ma wɔ hue yɛ se;
nahorɛ nu, ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so!

Title: EDWEIN 28
Content:
Mesu mefrɛ AWURADE
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ,
me nyɔbotaen, nnɛtuatua wɔ so bɔ ɛngɔtɛ me so ɔ,
ofikyɛ sɛ andɛ me so a,
ngɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawu bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne.
2Tie me sufrɛ
wɔ aberɛ bɔ mesu mefrɛ wɔ mepena mmokalɛ ye,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ mema me sa so mekɔ anwuro
mefa mekyire wɔ nekaa krongron paa berɛ ne.
3Nnɛfa me fra bɔnefoɛ
ne nzɛmmɔnefoɛ ɛtwe me so.
Bɛ yeɛ bɛkã asomdwee nwo dwirɛ bekyire bɛ mmango,
nakoso bɔne yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ.
4Nea bɛ yɔleɛ nwo ne b’amumuyɛɛ bra nwo
ná tua bɛ kerɛ;
nea bɛ sa noa adwuma nwo na tua bɛ kerɛ;
ma bɛ akatuaa bɔ ɔfata bɛ ɔ.
5Ɔnate kyɛ bemmu nningyein bɔ AWURADE wayɔ,
anaa ye sa noa adwuma nikyee titire biala ne ati,
ɔkɔhwe bɛ so bɔ ɔngɔma bɛ so ko ɔ.
6Animnyam hã AWURADE,
ofikyɛ watie me sufrɛ.
7AWURADE te m’anwoserɛ ne m’akokyɛm,
ye yeɛ me nye la ye so ɔ;
yiti ɔboka me, na me nye gye.
Ngɔfa me dweintolɛ ngɔla ye ase.
8AWURADE yeɛ ɔte ye mmenia b’anwoserɛ ɔ,
na ɔte ngoalelɛ afealeɛ ma bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne.
9Ao, pepɛ de wɔ maen, ná yira w’agyapadeɛ;
yɛ bɛ so neafoɛ, na nea bɛ so afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 29
Content:
AWURADE tumi te totohyia
Dawide dwein
1Ao nyameɛso ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ,
ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ kyɛ ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ ɔ.
2Animnyam bɔ ɔfata AWURADE dumaa ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́ma ye;
ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ animnyam krongron nu.
3Yɛte AWURADE komvi wɔ asue nemɔ aso,
animnyam Nyameɛ ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu,
AWURADE bobɔ nu wɔ asue mbiri mbiri nemɔ aso.
4AWURADE komvi ne, tumi wɔ nu;
AWURADE komvi ne, nu animnyam te totohyia.
5AWURADE komvi bubu sida mmakaa;
AWURADE bubu Lebanon sida mmakaa.
6Ɔma Lebanon huru pepe kyɛ nandwie ba,
yeɛ ɔma Sirion huru pepe kyɛ torɔen akrɔngrɔma.
7AWURADE komvi tete see yerɛmyerɛm.
8AWURADE komvi ma ɛserɛ so woso,
AWURADE ma Kadese ɛserɛ so woso.
9AWURADE komvi ma dabɔɔ mɔ bɛwo,
ɔma ɛhɔayeɛ mɔ nu da berɛ pralaa,
na ye asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ebiala tea nu kyɛ, “Animnyam hã Nyameɛ!”
10AWURADE te ye ahennie bia so wɔ asue mɔ bɔ bayi ɔ so,
na AWURADE te ye ahennie bia so odi hene afebɔɔ.
11AWURADE kɔma ye maen anwoserɛ!
AWURADE kɔfa asomdwee koyira ye maen!

Title: EDWEIN 30
Content:
Asennaa mbaeɛ
Dawide ayɛyelɛ dwein.
1Ao AWURADE, ngɔkamvo wɔ, ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me,
na amma me pɔfoɛ mɔ banni me nwo ahurusi.
2Ao AWURADE, me Nyameɛ, nzu mvrɛle wɔ kyɛ ɛboka me,
na asa me anwonyerɛ.
3Ao AWURADE, aye me kra afi ɛborɔ kumaa nu,
na amaa mafi ɛborɔ kumaa nu masa mawa ngoa nu.
4Ao ɛmɔ, AWURADE anwoteefoɛ, ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye ye ayɛ,
ná ɛmɔla ye dumaa krongron ne ase.
5Ofikyɛ ye ɛyaafɛlɛ ndena berɛ ngyɛ,
na ye anwumvoinnwunɛ wɔ berɛ ma sona mmerɛ bɔ sona ne te ase amukoraa.
Sona poro moen kɔngɔen amukoraa,
nakoso aleɛ kye a, onya anika.
6Me de, mmerɛ bɔ me so anu tɔle me ne, ngane kyɛ,
“Edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto me le.”
7Ao AWURADE, ɔnate kyɛ ɛlole me ne ati,
ɛmane me bo timuni serɛserɛ kyɛ bokaa;
nakoso ɛyele wɔ nye feale me ne,
me kunu tetele me.
8Ao AWURADE, nzu mvrɛle wɔ,
na AWURADE, ngoto nzrɛle wɔ kyɛ,
9“Sɛ mewu a, anaa sɛ mekɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu a,
nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ?
Aso mvuture kɔye wɔ ayɛ anaa?
Aso ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nwo dawure anaa?
10Ao AWURADE, tie, ná nwu me anwumvoin!
Ao AWURADE, mepena kyɛ ɛyɛ me bokafoɛ!”
11Ama m’aworabɔlɛlilɛ wakakyi ahurusililɛ;
aye me nwo ɛsɛen tena ne agua berɛ,
na afa anigye ahera me,
12amaa ɔnate so me kra wanga ye noa wandu nu,
na mmom waye wɔ ayɛ.
Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ngɔla wɔ ase afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 31
Content:
AWURADE, bɔ me nwo waen
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao AWURADE, wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ,
nnɛma me nyunu gua ase le;
wɔ tenenee ti, pepɛ de me.
2Yɛ asoɛ tie me, pepɛ de me ndɛndɛ.
Mepena kyɛ ɛyɛ me nyɔbotaen bɔ menwati mebafea nu ɔ,
anwoserɛ afealeɛ bɔ ɔpepɛ de me ɔ.
3Amba, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me nyɔbotaen ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ;
wɔ dumaa ti, di me nyunu ná kyire me atee ne.
4Ye me fi ngaen bɔ basua bafea me ne anu,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ.
5Wɔ sa nu yeɛ mefa me sunzum mewura ɔ;
ao AWURADE, nahorɛniɛ Nyameɛ, apepɛ ale me.
6Mekyi bɛ bɔ bɛso mmosoen bɔ bɛ nwo olle mvasoɛ biala ɔ,
nakoso me de, me wora wura AWURADE nu.
7Me nye kɔgye ná mali ahurusi, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
ofikyɛ anwu m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne,
na wɔ nye tua aworabɔlɛ bɔ me kra odi ɔ.
8Amva me anwura pɔfoɛ ne sa;
afa me agyina nekaa bɔ berɛ baye ɔ.
9Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ato me;
Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye ayɛ wusiwusi,
na aworabɔlɛ amaa me kra ne me nipadua baboto.
10Aworabɔlɛ piapia me kɔ ewue nu,
na m’afoɛ amukoraa wayɛ ɛpenenɛ ngome.
M’amumuyɛɛ ama m’anwoserɛ so ate,
na m’aporɛ nu ayɛ me hodwoo.
11Mayɛ sona bɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa bɛgoro me nwo ɔ,
na mayɛ nikyee suronyisuronyi wɔ me mmango mɔ nu.
Me manifoɛ mɔ besuro me;
mmenia nwu me wɔ dwaaso a né bɛnwati.
12Mmenia wora afi me kyɛ sona bɔ wawu ɔ;
mayɛ kyɛ nyangaa bue.
13Ofikyɛ mate nwuhunwuhu bɔ mmenia bɛyɔ ne,
anwunanwuna apɛ me nwo wayia:
bɔ bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ,
ná bɛpena me beku me ɔ.
14Nakoso ao AWURADE, mafa me wora mawura wɔ nu,
menwa, “Me Nyameɛ ole wɔ.”
15Wɔ sa nu yeɛ me hyɛberɛ wura ɔ;
me pɔfoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne,
pepɛ de me fi bɛ sa nu.
16Ma wɔ nyunu ɔta hyireinn ma wɔ somvoɛ!
Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso pepɛ de me.
17Ao AWURADE, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase,
ofikyɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ.
Ma amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ nyunu ogua ase,
ma bɛ noa omua maa bɛfa bɛhɔ ɛborɔ.
18Ma ngondombofoɛ bɛtɔ mumu,
bɛ bɔ bɛfa anwomasoɛ ne dwɛɛ
bɛkekã edwirɛ tɛɛ betia teneneefoɛ ne.
19Ao, wɔ lolɛ bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne,
ɔyɛ nwanwa soma!
Bɛ bɔ bɛnwati bɛbafea wɔ nu ne, ye yeɛ ɛfa bɔ bɛ nwo waen
bɔ adasa bɛ nye tua ɔ!
20Wɔ natelɛ bɔ ɛne bɛ nate ne, ɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen
fi mmenia bɛ porɛ bɔ babɔ ɔ nwo;
ɛfa wɔ ndaa butu bɛ so ede bɛ fi ngɔngɔnzaafoɛ sa nu.
21Animnyam hã AWURADE,
ofikyɛ waye ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali wahyire me,
mmerɛ bɔ me nwo hyerele me kyɛ kuro bɔ batua ye ɔ ne.
22Me kunu tele me ne, ngane kyɛ,
“Afoa me afi wɔ nyunu ahɔ dedeede.”
Nakoso nzu mvrɛle wɔ ne,
etiele me sufrɛ.
23Ɛmɔ, anwoteefoɛ amukoraa, ɛmɔhuro AWURADE dwirɛ.
AWURADE bɔ anwoteefoɛ nwo waen,
nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so ne,
otua ye so kerɛ piri paa.
24Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ hue yɛ se,
ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔ nye la AWURADE so ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 32
Content:
Bɔnefakyɛ nu anigye
Dawide dwein
1Sona bɔ Nyameɛ afa ye mmeraatolɛ wahyɛ ye,
ná wakyikyi ye bɔne ne, onya saleɛ.
2Sona bɔ AWURADE mva ye amumuyɛɛ mmɔ ye kwaadu,
bɔ nnakannaka suban biala nne ye nu ne, onya saleɛ.
3Mmerɛ bɔ ngane me noa ndole nu ne, m’aporɛ so yɛle me hodwoo,
ɔnate ɛpenenɛ bɔ né mepene daa biala ne ati.
4Ofikyɛ wɔ sa gyi me nwo eyia ne kɔngɔen;
m’anwoserɛ amukoraa yiele kyɛbɔ asue wewe wɔ wawa mmerɛ ɔ.
Sela
5Afei ngane me bɔne ngyirele wɔ,
na mangata m’amumuyɛɛ so.
Ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔhã me mmeraatolɛ ngohyire AWURADE,”
na ɛfale me bɔne nwo foɛlilɛ hyɛle me.
Sela
6Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne,
odi kyɛ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ okyire wɔ.
Amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, sɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ba ye so
kyɛ asue bɔ wayi bɔ ɔse wuruwuru a,
ye de ɔngoto ye.
7Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ,
wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔ me nwo waen fi amaneɛ nu ɔ;
ɛfa wɔ ngoalelɛ dwein ɛpɛ me nwo yia.
Sela
8(AWURADE nwa nyoo):
Ngohyirehyire wɔ ná mahyire wɔ atee bɔ ɛfa so ɔ;
me nye wɔ wɔ so, na ngotu wɔ foɛ.
9Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ pɔngɔ anaa afunum bɔ olle nimdeɛ,
bɔ odi kyɛ ɛfa nyamaa ne buralɛ ewura ye noa nu koraka né watena wɔ nwo ɔ.
10Amaneɛ pee yeɛ ɔtoto bɔnefoɛ ɔ,
nakoso sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo to AWURADE so ne de,
AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔpɛ ye nwo bra yia.
11Ao teneneeniɛ, di ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu, ná ma wɔ nye gye,
na ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu te ne amukoraa, ɛmɔli ahurusi bɛbɔ ese.

Title: EDWEIN 33
Content:
Nyameɛ te piri na ɔte paa
1Ao ɛmɔ, teneneefoɛ, ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu.
Ɔfata teneneefoɛ kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ ɔ.
2Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɛye AWURADE ayɛ;
ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru ne bɛto ye nwo anigye dwein.
3Ɛ́mɔto ye nwo edwein foforɛ;
ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo ne yé, ná ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛ́to dwein.
4Ofikyɛ AWURADE dwirɛ ne ɔtengyɛ,
na odi nahorɛ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ amukoraa nu.
5AWURADE nye gye teneneeyɛlɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo;
na AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wayi aseɛ ye aso tɛkyɛ.
6AWURADE noa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle ewienu ɔ,
na ye noa nu nwomeɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle nu nningyein ɔ.
7Ɔboaboa ɛpo nu nzue noa kyɛ esire,
na ɔboa buma mɔ noa gua sua nu.
8Odi kyɛ aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa besuro AWURADE,
ná mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ wiase amukoraa bɛ́fa ebuo bɛ́ma ye.
9Ofikyɛ odwudwole, na ɔyɛle berɛ;
ɔhyɛle, na ogyinane berɛ pindinn.
10AWURADE ma maen maen mɔ b’agyinatulɛ ɔyɛ mbaen,
na maen maen mɔ bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ yɛ basaa.
11Nakoso AWURADE agyinatulɛ de, ogyi berɛ afebɔɔ,
na ye ti anu nzusuleɛ wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.
12Maen bɔ AWURADE te ye Nyameɛ ne, wanya saleɛ.
Ɔte maen bɔ waneanea nu waye ye maa wayɛ ye agyapadeɛ ɔ.
13AWURADE to ye nye fi nyameɛso nea ase,
na onwu adasa mmaa amukoraa.
14Ɔte ye ahennie bia so wɔ ye atenaleɛ dɔ,
na ɔto ye nye nea aseɛ so ama amukoraa.
15Ye yeɛ ɔbɔle bɛ mukoraa b’adwene ɔ,
na onwu bɔ bɛyɔ amukoraa.
16Ɛhene biala, nna ye koɛhonɛfoɛ somaa yeɛ bɛkora bɛpepɛ bede ye ɔ;
yeɛ koɛhonɛniɛ koso, nna ye anwoserɛ kandinga yeɛ ɔpepɛ de ye ɔ.
17Sɛ ɛfa wɔ nye to pɔngɔ so wɔ koɛ nu a, ɔte mbaen;
ye anwoserɛ kandinga ne ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ.
18Amba, bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛ nye la ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ne,
bɛla ye ahone nwo,
19kyɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ kra kofi ewue nu,
na sɛ ɛhɔen piri ba a, ɔkɔmaa bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu.
20Yɛ kra nye la AWURADE so;
ɔte yɛ bokafoɛ ne y’akokyɛm.
21Yɛ nye agye wɔ ye nu,
ofikyɛ yɛ wora wura ye dumaa krongron ne anu.
22Ao AWURADE, ye wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali kyire yɛ,
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛ nye la wɔ so ye.

Title: EDWEIN 34
Content:
Dawide da Nyameɛ
Dawide dwein: Ɔyɛle ye nwo kyɛ bɔnamvoɛ wɔ Abimɛlɛke nyunu, na onyane ye ti didili nu nen, nziɛ ye ɔtole sɔ dwein he
1Ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ mmerɛ biala;
ye ayɛyelɛ kɔla me noa daa.
2AWURADE nu yeɛ me kra hoahoa ye nwo ɔ,
odi kyɛ anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ betie, ná bɛ nye gye.
3Ao, ɛ́mɔboka me so maa yɛkamvo AWURADE,
na ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ nu yɛbɔ ye abodin.
4Mbenane AWURADE si atee, na obuale me,
na ɔpepɛ lele me fili nikyee bɔ mesuro biala ɔ nu.
5Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye so ne, bɛ nye gye;
na bɛ nyunu ngua ase.
6Sɔ anwumvoinniɛ he, osuni, na AWURADE tiele ye sufrɛ,
ná ɔpepɛ lele ye fili ye amaneɛ amukoraa nu.
7Bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, ye abɔfo bɔ bɛ nwo waen bra yia,
na ɔpepɛ de bɛ.
8Ao, baafa wɔ nwo bɔ AWURADE nea,
na ekonwu kyɛ AWURADE te paa;
sona bɔ ɔnwati ɔkɔfea ye nu ne, onya saleɛ.
9Ao, AWURADE mmenia krongron, ɛ́mɔsuro ye,
ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne, hwee nhia bɛ.
10Gyata akrɔngrɔma mɔ po, nikyee hia bɛ, na ɛhɔen koso ku bɛ.
Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so ne de,
nikye paa biala nhia bɛ.
11Ao me mma mɔ, ɛmɔbra beetie me noa dwirɛ,
na ngohyire ɛmɔ AWURADE surolɛ ne.
12Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔpena ngoa,
ngoa tendenn bɔ nningyein kɔhɔ so yé kɔma ye ɔ?
13Nnɛte wɔ noa kã edwirɛ tɛɛ,
yeɛ nnebukye wɔ noa pɛ ngondombo.
14Twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo, ná yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ,
pena asomdwee si atee, na fa bɔ wɔ bra.
15AWURADE nye wɔ teneneefoɛ so,
na ɔyɛ asoɛ tie bɛ sufrɛ.
16AWURADE tu ye nye sie bɔnefoɛ so,
kyɛ okonua bɛ boso kofi aseɛ so.
17Sɛ teneneefoɛ besu bɛpena mmokalɛ a, AWURADE tie bɛ sufrɛ,
na ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi b’amaneɛ amukoraa nu.
18AWURADE pingye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ɔ,
na ɔpepɛ de bɛ bɔ bɛ kra aboto ɔ.
19Teneneeniɛ amaneɛ ɔsone,
nakoso AWURADE pepɛ de ye fi ye mukoraa nu.
20Ɔbɔ ye mmowue amukoraa nwo waen,
bɔ bɛ nu ko po nu mmu ɔ.
21Bɔne kohũ amumuyɛɛfoɛ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ teneneefoɛ ne, ongoyie bɛ yé.
22AWURADE de ye somvoɛ mɔ ngoa,
na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔɔfea ye nu, bɔ ongoyie ye yé ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 35
Content:
De me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, tu wɔ nye sie bɛ bɔ betu bɛ nye besie me so ɔ nemɔ aso,
na ko tia bɛ bɔ bɛko betia me ne!
2Fa akokyɛm ne buralɛ ataadeɛ,
ná dwɔso baaboka me!
3Twe pealɛɛ ne buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn ne
wɔ bɛ bɔ bɛfoa me nemɔ aso;
kã kyire me kra kyɛ,
“Me ole wɔ ngoalelɛ.”
4Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne,
maa bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná bɛfɛre.
Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ ne,
maa bɛfa animguaseɛ besa bɛ si bɛhɔ.
5Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama hu ye kɔ ɔ,
ma AWURADE abɔfo osumu bɛ gua.
6Ma b’atee so ɔyɛ awosii ne ndonondono,
ma AWURADE abɔfo ogu bɛ so.
7Ofikyɛ basua me ngaen wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnyɔle hwee ɔ;
bapɛ kumaa bama me kra wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnyɔle hwee ɔ.
8Ma b’ayieleɛ oyie bɛ mvum nu,
ná ma ngaen bɔ basua bafea me ne hye bɛ;
maa bɛtɔ nu ma b’ayieleɛ oyie bɛ.
9Na afei, me kra koli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu,
ná wama ye nwo asande ye wɔ AWURADE ngoalelɛ nu.
10Me mmowue amukoraa kɔhã kyɛ,
“Ao AWURADE, nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ?
Wɔ bɔ ɛpepɛ de sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo
fi ebie bɔ ɔkora ye ɔ sa nu ɔ;
wɔ bɔ ede sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne ehianiɛ fi ebie bɔ osisi ye ɔ sa nu ɔ.”
11Adanzewiafoɛ bedwɔso begyina,
na edwirɛ bɔ menze ye nwo hwee ɔ yeɛ bebisa me ɔ.
12Bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ,
na me kra aboto.
13Nakoso me de, anwonyerɛ bɔle bɛ ne,
ngerale ɛsɛen tena (nnili aworabɔlɛ);
ngyele ɛhɔen mva mmrɛle me kra ase.
Nzili me ti ase mmɔle mbaeɛ
14kyɛ ebiaa mesu me damvo anaa nniɛma bie;
nzili me ti ase nnili aworabɔlɛ,
kyɛ ebie bɔ osũ oni ɔ.
15Nakoso ngɔle anwokyere nu ne, bɛ nye gyele,
bɛyɛle ko bedwɔsole betiale me;
asanzafoɛ bie bɔ menze bɛ ɔ,
bɛhɔle so bɛsɛkyele me dumaa;
16asanzafoɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ ɔ
bɛgorole me nwo yea yea paa,
bɛnwosene bɛ gye behyirele me.
17Ao AWURADE, ɛnea alaa maa okodwu kyinzu?
Pepɛ de me kra fi bɛ nzɛmmɔnelilɛ nu,
de me ngoa fi gyata nemɔ sa nu!
18Na afei ngɔla wɔ ase wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu;
ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ ɛlɔen kandinga ne anyunu.
19 Pɔfoɛ ngondombofoɛ nemɔ,
nnɛmaa bedi me nwo ahurusi,
bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me mbaen ne, nnɛmaa bebu me kangyerɛ.
20Ofikyɛ bɛnga asomdwee dwirɛ,
na mmom bɛbɔ porɛ bɛpɛ edwirɛ
bɛto aseɛ so mmenia bɔ benguro bɛ nwo dwirɛ ɔ so.
21Bɛtrɛ bɛ noa nu bɛteatea nu bɛkã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ kyɛ,
“Ehee! Ehee!
yɛ nye anwu ye.”
22Ao AWURADE, naa anwu ye; nnɛkã wɔ noa to nu!
Ao AWURADE, nnɛyakyi me nu!
23Dwɔso ná ko ma me!
ao me Nyameɛ ne m’AWURADE, baali me dwirɛ ma me!
24Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ,
gyina wɔ tenenee so bua me be,
na nnɛmaa bedi me nwo ahurusi.
25Nnɛma bɛkekã ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ,
“Ehee, yɛ sa ahã bɔ yɛpena ɔ.”
Nnɛmaa bɛkã kyɛ, “Yayie ye pasaa.”
26Bɛ bɔ bedi ahurusi wɔ m’anwokyere mmerɛ nu ne,
ma bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná bɛfɛre;
bɛ bɔ bɛmoma bɛ bati so bekyire me ne,
maa bɛfa animguaseɛ ne nyanzoen bɛhera.
27Bɛ bɔ bɛ kunu a ahaa babua me be ne,
maa bɛbɔ ese beli ahurusi ná bɛ nye gye,
ná bɛhã ye daa kyɛ,
AWURADE te piri,
na ye nye gye ye somvoɛ ye yeeyɛlɛ nwo.”
28Afei ngɔte me noa ngɔbɔ wɔ tenenee
ne w’ayɛyelɛ nwo dawure daa amukoraa.

Title: EDWEIN 36
Content:
Nyameɛ te paa
Nyameɛ somvoɛ Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1 Amumuyɛɛ dwudwo kyire bɔnefoɛ
wɔ ye ti anu;
bɔnefoɛ nye so de,
Nyameɛ nwo nyɛ suro.
2Ofikyɛ ode ye nwo di alaa
maa ɔnate so ɔngora nwu ye amumuyɛɛ,
maa ɔnate so ɔngora ngyi ye amumuyɛɛ ne.
3Ye noa nu dwirɛ te bɔne ne nnakannaka;
na bra bɔ nworɛ wɔ nu ná ɔte paa de, wayakyi ye bɔlɛ.
4Ɔla ye bɛen so a, nzɛmmɔne yeɛ osusu ye nwo ɔ;
wape bɔne atee so, na ongyi bɔne.
5Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔkɔkã ewienu dɔ paa,
yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu.
6Wɔ tenenee kɔ anwuro anwuro te kyɛ Nyameɛ mmokaa,
na wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne, ye kuronn te kyɛ ɛpo buma.
Ao AWURADE, ɛpepɛ de kuro mmenia ne ngaka.
7Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, kyɛbɔ ye nwo osi le mvasoɛ ɔ!
Na adasa mmaa bɛnwati bɛbafea wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu.
8Bedi aleɛ bɔ wabu so wɔ w’awuro ne ma bɛko yi,
na ɛma bɛ nzue bɔ ofi w’anigye asue nu maa bɛno.
9Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte ngoa asue ti ɔ,
na wɔ kanea ne anu yeɛ yɛnwu kanea ɔ.
10Ao, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, kɔ so ye kyire bɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ ɔ,
na ye wɔ ngoalelɛ ne kyire bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ!
11Nnɛma anwomasoɛfoɛ betwi bɛfa me so,
yeɛ nnɛma amumuyɛɛfoɛ betu me bo.
12Nea, kyɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ batotɔ ɔ,
bafindifindi bɛ bagua ase, bɔ bɛngɔhora dwɔso ko ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 37
Content:
Teneneefoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ akatuaa
Dawide dwein
1Nnɛma bɔnefoɛ bɛ nwo adwenedwene tɔ wɔ so,
yeɛ nnɛma wɔ nye boro amumuyɛɛfoɛ,
2ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ né bapɛ bɛ bagua kyɛ ɛserɛ,
ná bakese kyɛ ndire.
3De AWURADE di, na yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ;
amaa ɔnate so anya aseɛ ne aso atena, ná wɔ nwo atɔ wɔ.
4Ma wɔ nye gye wɔ AWURADE nu,
na ɔkɔma wɔ sa kɔhã bɔ w’ahone bu ɛpena ɔ.
5Fa wɔ nwo ma AWURADE,
fa wɔ wora wura ye nu, na okoli kɔma wɔ.
6Na ɔkɔma wɔ tenenee kɔla ali kyɛ kanea,
ná wɔ belilɛ ne wata kyɛ eyiagyina.
7Yɛ konn wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná to wɔ bo ase nwondɛ ye.
Sona bɔ ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye atee so onya ye nwo,
yeɛ sona bɔ ɔdwene nikyee tɛɛ nwo, ná ɔyɔ ne,
nnɛma ye nwo adwenedwene tɔ wɔ so.
8Twe wɔ nwo fi ɛyaafɛlɛ nwo, yeɛ nnɛma w’ahone hu.
Nnɛma adwenedwene tɔ wɔ so; ɔne bɔne ngome yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.
9Ofikyɛ bekonua bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso,
nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ nye la AWURADE so ne de,
bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne.
10Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso konua;
ɛmɔkɔyere bɛ nwo bɛkɔpena bɛ boso, nakoso ɛmɔngonwu bɛ.
11Nakoso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne;
ɔnate asomdwee kandinga ne ati, bɛ nye kɔgye.
12Bɔnefoɛ bɛbɔ teneneefoɛ mɔ nwo porɛ,
na bɛnwose bɛ gye bekyire bɛ.
13Nakoso bɔnefoɛ nwo yɛ AWURADE sere,
ofikyɛ ɔse kyɛ ye kyẽa ne wapingye.
14Bɔnefoɛ twe ye ngrandɛ, na osina ye agyaen mɔ
kyɛ ɔfa kã ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ogua ase,
ná okũkũ teneneefoɛ.
15Ye ngrandɛ ne kɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ahone nu,
na ye agyaen nemɔ anu kobubu.
16Nikyee kãa biala bɔ teneneeniɛ ole ye ne,
odi mu tra bɔnefoɛ pee b’anwonya.
17Ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ b’abasa nu kobu,
nakoso teneneefoɛ de, AWURADE tira bɛ nu.
18Mmenia bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne,
bɛ ngyẽa la AWURADE nyunu;
na b’agyapadeɛ kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.
19Mmerɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee nu, bɛ nyunu ngogua ase,
na ɛhɔen piri ba a, aleɛ kobu bɛ so.
20Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bɛ boso konua,
na AWURADE pɔfoɛ mɔ, bɛte kyɛ ndire nyerɛen;
bekotu bekomini, bekotu bekomini kyɛ nwosina.
21Bɔnefoɛ bebisa bosea a, bendua,
nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛse anwumvoin, na bɛyɛ ayɛ.
22Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ AWURADE ayira bɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne ɔ;
nakoso bɛ bɔ wanoma bɛ ne de, bɛ boso konua.
23AWURADE yeɛ otutu sona gya siesie yé ɔ,
sɛ ye atee sɔ ye nye a, ɔmaa otindim.
24Sɛ ɔtɔ ase po a, ɔngɔtɔ ase tim,
ofikyɛ AWURADE tira ye sa.
25Mayɛ akwadaa le, na kekesaala ye de manyi,
nakoso nnwuni ye le kyɛ Nyameɛ apo teneneeniɛ ɔ,
anaakyɛ ye boso ama bɛsrɛsrɛ aleɛ ɔ.
26Onwu anwumvoin daa, na ofia ye kunu fa nikyee fɛmo,
na ye boso ama benya saleɛ.
27Twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo, ná yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ;
na ɛkɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.
28Ofikyɛ AWURADE kuro ndɛenbualɛ turoloo,
na ɔngɔpo ye anwoteefoɛ.
Ɔkɔbɔ anwoteefoɛ nwo waen afebɔɔ,
nakoso bɔnefoɛ boso ama de, bɛ boso konua.
29Teneneefoɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne,
na bɛkɔtena so afebɔɔ.
30Teneneeniɛ kã nworɛ dwirɛ,
na ye noa dwirɛ te nahorɛ turoloo.
31Ye Nyameɛ mmeraa ne wɔ ye ahone nu;
na onni ye nwo makyebu.
32Bɔnefoɛ bɛtetɛ teneneefoɛ,
kyɛ bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ.
33AWURADE ngɔyakyi teneneeniɛ ngowura bɔnefoɛ sa;
yeɛ bedi teneneeniɛ dwirɛ a, ɔngɔma bengobua ye fɔ.
34Ma wɔ nye la AWURADE so, ná nate ye atee so,
na ɔkɔpagya wɔ maa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ w’agyapadeɛ;
na wɔ nye konwu kyɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso onua ɔ.
35Manwu bɔnefoɛ atianuserɛniɛ,
bɔ wanyi tendenn kyɛ Lebanon sida ɔ.
36Nakoso tie, mbɛle nu berɛ nen, né ɔnne berɛ ko;
mbenane ye, nakoso mannwu ye.
37Hyɛ sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ɔ nzorɛ,
ná nea teneneeniɛ,
ofikyɛ sɔ sona ne, ye ayieleɛ te asomdwee.
38Nakoso mmeraatolɛfoɛ de, bɛ mukoraa bekowuwu;
bɔnefoɛ boso ama bɛ boso konua.
39Teneneefoɛ de, bɛ ngoalelɛ fi AWURADE,
na bɛkɔ amaneɛ nu a, ye yeɛ ɔte b’afealeɛ ɔ.
40AWURADE boka bɛ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ;
ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu, na ode bɛ ngoa,
ofikyɛ bɛnwati bɛkɔfea ye nu.

Title: EDWEIN 38
Content:
Nnuhoɛ mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein: bɛto ye ngayeɛ afɔleɛ mmerɛ
1Ao AWURADE, nnɛtwi me nyunu wɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ nu,
yeɛ nnɛtwe me so wɔ w’ahonehulɛ nu.
2Ofikyɛ w’agyaen nemɔ basinasina me,
na w’asohwenɛ awa me so.
3Ɔnate wɔ yaa bɔ afɛ ne ati,
me nwo ndɔ me wɔ me wereɛ nu;
ɔnate me bɔne ti,
me mmowue nu we me.
4Ofikyɛ m’amumuyɛɛ abungam afa me so;
na nu nonɛ obu me kɔme anu.
5Me nwo ngena batu, na bɛbo,
ɔnate me ngwaseasɛm bɔ mali ne ati.
6Me nu akondo, nna ayanga pakayaa,
na daa biala medi aworabɔlɛ.
7Me nwo yerayera me wuronyiwuronyi,
me nwo ndɔ me wɔ me wereɛ nu.
8Me nwo ayɛ me bɛtɛɛ, yeɛ mayɛ hodwoo;
mepene, ɔnate aworabɔlɛ bɔ medi ne ati.
9Ao AWURADE, bɔ mepena amukoraa la wɔ nyunu,
na me penelɛ ne ɔmvea wɔ.
10M’ahone bɔ palipali, m’anwoserɛ so ate,
na me nye so ayɛ me wusiwusi.
11M’adɔfo mɔ ne me mmango mɔ,
baye bɛ nye wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ ne anwo,
na m’abusuafoɛ mɔ bahwe bɛ nwo baagyina dedeede.
12Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, basunzua me ngaen;
bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne, m’asefinɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã ɔ,
na daa biala bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ.
13Nakoso mayɛ kyɛ asotiniwaaniɛ bɔ ɔnde dwudwolɛ ɔ;
mayɛ kyɛ emumu bɔ ɔngora dwudwo ɔ.
14Amba, mayɛ kyɛ sona bɔ ɔnde dwudwolɛ ɔ,
bɔ ɔngora nye edwirɛ noa ɔ.
15Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ;
ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ekobua me ɔ.
16Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ,
“Bɛ bɔ mesoti a, né ɔyɛ bɛ fɛ ne,
nnɛmaa bedi m’asefinɛ nwo ahurusi.”
17Ofikyɛ mayie ase tɔ,
na daa me nwo tutu me.
18Mefa m’amumuyɛɛ meto dwaa,
na medi yealɛ wɔ me bɔne nwo.
19Bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me mbaen ne, bɛ nye yɛ se paa;
bɛ bɔ bekyi me kɔkɔkɔkɔ ne, bɛsone pee.
20Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ ne,
bɛte me pɔfoɛ mɔ, ofikyɛ me de, meyɔ nikyee bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.
21Ao AWURADE, nnɛpo me,
ao me Nyameɛ, nnɛtwe wɔ nwo fi me nwo.
22Yɛ ndɛ baaboka me,
ao AWURADE, me ngoadefoɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 39
Content:
Sona ngoa te kyɛ nwomeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ Yedutun
1Ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔnea m’atee bɔ nnate so ɔ yé,
amaa mamva me noa mangekã edwirɛ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ;
ngɔfa krado ngɔto me noa nu,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɔnefoɛ begyigyi me nyunu ye.”
2Nyɛle dinn, na mandwudwo,
nyɛle konn bɔ nikye paa po mangã ye nwo hwee ɔ;
m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛle piri.
3Edwirɛ ne yɛle me ateetee,
na medwenedwene ye nwo ne, ɔhɔle so yɛle me ateetee,
na afei ndele me noa ngane kyɛ,
4“Ao AWURADE, maa nwu m’ayieleɛ,
ɔne me ngyẽa bɔ apɛ ama me kyɛ nni ɔ;
maa nwu kyɛbɔ me ngoa si te tikaa ɔ.
5Amba, ama me ngoa ayɛ tikaape bie,
na m’afoɛ mɔ bɛtte huu wɔ wɔ nye so.
Nahorɛ nu, kuro sona biala ye ngoa te kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen.
Sela
6Amba, ebiala nate berɛ kyɛ wawoɛ bie.
Amba, sona ha ye nwo mbaen,
sona pena agyapadeɛ pee, nakoso ɔnze sona bɔ okooli ye sa ɔ.
7Na afei AWURADE, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva me nye ndo so ɔ?
Wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ.
8De me fi me mmeraatolɛ amukoraa nu.
Nnɛmaa mekakyi ngwaseafoɛ sa nu ngorohoɛ nikye.
9Mayɛ konn; memmukye me noa,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ahyehyɛ ye sɔ ɔ.
10Nnɛfa wɔ mbire gyina me nwo ko;
wɔ sa bɔ afa agyina me nwo ne, wamaa mabubu.
11Ɛtwe adasa mmaa so,
sɛ ɛtwe sona so wɔ ye bɔne nwo a,
ɛsɛkye nikyee bɔ okuro ye paa ne, kyɛbɔ mvrɔlɔ sɛkye nikye ɔ;
amba, sona biala te kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen.
Sela
12“Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ,
ná tie me sufrɛ;
nnɛye wɔ nye fi me moenporolɛ ne anwo;
ofikyɛ nde kyɛ wɔ wɔfoɛ bɔ ɔngɔhyɛ ɔ,
nde amanvraniɛ kyɛ me nana mɔ amukoraa.
13Nnɛtu wɔ nye sie me so, amaa ɔnate so masa manya anigye
koraka né mafi wa mahɔ bɔ bengonwu me ko ɔ.”

Title: EDWEIN 40
Content:
Dawide da Nyameɛ ase
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nzili aboterɛ mvale me nye ndole AWURADE so,
na ɔyɛle asoɛ otiele me sufrɛ.
2Ɔyele me fili ewue kumaa nu,
ɔyele me fili asaa nu,
na ɔfale me gya siesiele nyɔbotaen so
mane me gya bo tindimuni.
3Ɔfale edwein foforɛ tuale me noa,
ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
Mmenia pee konwu ye ná basuro,
ná bafa bɛ wora bawura AWURADE nu.
4Sona bɔ ɔfa ye wora owura AWURADE nu ne,
onya saleɛ;
sɔ sona ne, ɔmva ye nwo ndo anwomasoɛfoɛ so,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bedi makyebu bɛkɔso mmosoen mɔ ɔ bɛ so.
5Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, w’anwanwadeɛ bɔ ayɔ ne,
ɔne adwene bɔ ele ye ma yɛ ne, bɛsone paa;
ebiala ngɔhora ngɔfa ye nwo ngɔtoto wɔ nwo.
Sɛ mekã kyɛ meka ná mebɔ ye nwo dawure a,
ɔsone bɔ mengɔhora ye ka ɔ.
6Nna ngaka afɔleɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ yeɛ wɔ nye gye ye nwo ɔ,
na mmom ama me asoɛ bɔ ɔte dwirɛ ɔ.
Nna naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ yeɛ ɛpena ɔ.
7Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Me ɛhe;
kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bafa me nwo wɔ nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu ne ala.
8Ao me Nyameɛ, bɔ mekuro ole kyɛ ngɔyɔ w’apɛdeɛ ɔ;
wɔ mmeraa ne wɔ me ti anu.”
9Mahã tenenee nwo ndɛenvɛen ne
wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu.
Ao AWURADE, kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse ne,
amba, mangã me noa mando nu.
10Wɔ tenenee nwo dwirɛ ne, mamva mamvea wɔ me ti anu;
mabɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo dawure.
Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne,
mamva ye nwo dwirɛ mamvea badwa kandinga ne.
11Ao AWURADE, nnɛyakyi anwumvoinnwunɛ bɔ enwu me ne.
Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne,
maa ɔbɔ me nwo waen afebɔɔ.
12Ofikyɛ amaneɛ bɔ bɛka a bennwu ye noa ɔ,
bapɛ me nwo bayia,
m’amumuyɛɛ mɔ babungam bafa me so,
bɔ ɔmma mengora mennwu nikye ɔ;
bɛsone bɛtra me ti nwiaa,
na wamaa ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so.
13Ao AWURADE, maa ɔyɛ wɔ fɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpepɛ kole me ɔ,
ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me.
14Bɛ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bede me ngoa befi me sa nu ne,
ma bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná bɛfɛre;
bɛ bɔ bɛpena me ne tɛɛ ne,
foa bɛ maa besa bɛ si, ná bɛ nyunu ogua ase.
15Bɛ bɔ bese me kyɛ, “Ehee, ehee!” ne,
ma b’animguaseɛ ne ɔma bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ.
16Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne de,
maa bɛ mukoraa beli ahurusi, ná bɛ nye gye wɔ wɔ nu;
bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ne,
maa daa bɛhã kyɛ, “AWURADE te piri!”
17Meyɛ anwumvo, yeɛ nde hianiɛ de,
nakoso AWURADE dwene me nwo.
Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ne me defoɛ ɔ;
ao me Nyameɛ, nnɛkyɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 41
Content:
Anwonyerɛsalɛ nwo mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Sona bɔ ɔdwene anwumvoinniɛ nwo ne,
onya saleɛ.
AWURADE pepɛ de ye wɔ ye amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu.
2AWURADE bɔ ye nwo waen, na ɔmaa onya ngoa,
oyira ye wɔ aseɛ so.
Bɔ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛpena kyɛ ɔto ye ne, ɛmma ɔndo ye.
3Anwonyerɛ kã ye to mba so a, AWURADE nea ye;
sɛ anwonyerɛ bɔ ye a, ɛma ye nwo sande ye.
4Ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin;
sa me anwonyerɛ, ofikyɛ mayɔ bɔne matia wɔ.”
5Me pɔfoɛ mɔ bele adwene tɛɛ bɛkekã me nwo dwirɛ kyɛ,
“Kyinzu yeɛ okowu ma ye dumaa boso konunu ɔ?”
6Sɛ ebie bapasa me nwo a, edwirɛ bɔ ɔkã ne, nna ye ahone nu yeɛ ofi ɔ,
nzɛmmɔne yeɛ osusu ye nwo wɔ ye ti anu ɔ;
na sɛ ofi me nwo berɛ kɔ a, ɔfa kotene.
7Me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa, bɛbɔ nu bedi me nwo nzekure,
ɔhale bɛ ngome a, ahaa edwirɛ tɛɛ ato me.
8Bɛkekã kyɛ, “Anwonyerɛ bɔ wabɔ ye ne ɔte piri,
ongodwɔso ngofi ye bɛen so ko.”
9Mmiɛngo bɔ mede ye medi paa,
bɔ yeɛ me ne ye yɛto asaa yɛdidi ne, ye yeɛ waye me wama ɔ.
10Nakoso, ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin,
maa nde apɔ, ná ngora ndua bɛ so kerɛ!
11Amma me pɔfoɛ wanni me so ngonim;
na ɛhe amaa manwu kyɛ ekuro me dwirɛ.
12Ɔnate me nahorɛlilɛ ti, atira me nu,
na afa me atena wɔ nyunu afebɔɔ.
13AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne,
animnyam hã ye ofi tete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ!
Amen ne Amen.

Title: EDWEIN 42
Content:
Nwomaa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ
Edwein 42—72
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ dabɔɔ ye komvi de asue ba bɔ ɔse ɔ nu nzue ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ me kra pena wɔ si atee ɔ.
2Me kra wora dɔ Nyameɛ,
ye wora dɔ Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne.
Kyinzu yeɛ ngɔwa
ngoodwu Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ?
3Me nye moen yeɛ wakakyi m’aleɛ eyia ne kɔngɔen ɔ;
daa biala mmenia bisa me kyɛ, “Wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”
4Mekaye sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ a,
né me kra wora abɔ:
kyɛbɔ me ne ɛlɔen ne yɛhɔle,
ɛlɔen kandinga bɔ bedi aluolue ne,
bɔ nne esebɔlɛ ne asennaa dwein,
nnili folii ne nyunu ngɔle Nyameɛ awuro ne.
5Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye,
nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu ye?
Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ.
Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.
6Me kra aboto wɔ me nu,
yiti mekaye wɔ mefi Yɔɔdan ne Hɛmɔn aseɛ so,
ɔne Misa bokaa so.
7Sɛ w’asue nemɔ bɛse wuruwuru a,
né buma frɛ buma;
w’asorɔkye ne wɔ nzue bɔ ɔse wuruwuru ne,
babu bafa me so.
8AWURADE ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
ɔye ye ali eyia,
na kɔngɔen meto ye dwein
mefa mebɔ mbaeɛ mekyire Nyameɛ bɔ otira me ngoa nyamaa nu ɔ.
9Mebisa AWURADE bɔ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne kyɛ,
“Nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora afi me e?
Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛhyɛlɛ bɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔhyɛ me so ti,
odi kyɛ menate berɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin ɔ?”
10Me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’anyinga bɔ bɛkã me ne,
ɔte kyɛ kena wɔ me wereɛ nu,
na daa bebisa me kyɛ,
“Wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”
11Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye,
nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu ye?
Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ.
Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 43
Content:
De me fi amaneɛ nu
1Ao Nyameɛ, bua me be, ná di me dwirɛ ma me fi amumuyɛɛ maen sa nu;
pepɛ de me fi nnakannakafoɛ ne ndɛengyeafoɛ bɛ sa nu!
2Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ menwati mebafea wɔ nu ɔ;
na nzu ati yeɛ apo me e?
Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛhyɛlɛ bɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔhyɛ me so ti,
odi kyɛ menate berɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin ɔ?
3Ao, soma wɔ kanea ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛ ne
maa beli me nyunu;
maa bɛfa me bɛbra wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso,
ɔne w’atenaleɛ berɛ.
4Na ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo,
ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte m’anigye mmorosoɛ ne berɛ;
ao Nyameɛ, me Nyameɛ,
ngɔbɔ sangoo ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
5Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye,
nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu e?
Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ.
Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 44
Content:
AWURADE bɔ me nwo waen
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Nyameɛ, anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɛyɔle ye daa tete ne,
wɔ yɛ nana mɔ b’aberɛ so ne,
yɛ nana mɔ bahã bahyire yɛ;
yɛ bɔbɔ yate ye wɔ yɛ so anu.
2Wɔ bɔbɔ deinn wɔ tumi yeɛ ɛfa foane maen maen nemɔ ɔ,
nakoso yɛ nana mɔ de, ɛfale bɛ ɛɛtenane aseɛ ne aso;
ɛpraprale amaneɛ guale maen maen nemɔ aso,
nakoso yɛ nana mɔ de, ɛbɔle bɛ atenaseɛ.
3Nna bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngrandɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛhone belele aseɛ ne ɔ,
yeɛ nna bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔmaa belili ngonim ɔ;
na mmom wɔ sa famaa ne, w’anwoserɛ ne,
ɔne wɔ nyunu kanea bɔ ɔbokale bɛ ne ɔ,
ofikyɛ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ.
4Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Hene ɔ;
wɔ yeɛ ɛma Yakob di ngonim ɔ.
5Wɔ tumi yeɛ yɛfa yɛdi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim ɔ,
na wɔ dumaa nu yeɛ yɛtiatia bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia yɛ ɔ so ɔ.
6Ofikyɛ memva me nwo mendo m’agyaen so,
yeɛ me ngrandɛ ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole me.
7Nakoso apepɛ ale yɛ afi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu,
na bɛ bɔ benguro yɛ dwirɛ ne, ama bɛ nye so atã.
8Na wɔ, Nyameɛ de, wɔ nu yeɛ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo daa amukoraa ɔ,
na yɛkɔye wɔ dumaa ne ayɛ afebɔɔ.
Sela
9Nakoso afei de, apo yɛ agua yɛ nyunu ase,
na ɛne yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛngɔ koɛ ko.
10Amaa yanwati yafi yɛ pɔfoɛ ne nyunu,
na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bafe yɛ nningyein bafa.
11Ayɛ yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛkwaahũ bɛ ɔ,
na abɔ yɛ asande aagua maen maen mɔ so.
12Atɔne wɔ mmenia bɔ anne huu ɔ,
amva bɛ anne nyɔboɛ serɛ biala.
13Amaa yɛ mmango mɔ bɛkã yɛ anyinga,
na maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne,
amaa bɛsere yɛ bɛgoro yɛ nwo.
14Amaa yakakyi ngorohoɛ dwirɛ wɔ maen maen mɔ bɛ noa nu,
bɛ bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne,
ɛmaa besobi bɛ noa begua yɛ so.
15Mmerɛ biala, me nwo nyanzoen li me nyunu,
na animguaseɛ abia me,
16ɔnate bɛ bɔ bɛkã me anyinga bɛpepɛ me nzoaa ne, bɛ noa dwirɛ ti,
yeɛ afei ɔnate pɔfoɛ ne ɔne wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ati.
17Nakoso ɛhe amukoraati ato yɛ,
ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛmmane yɛ wora offili wɔ,
yeɛ yɛllili w’apam ne nwo fɔ.
18Yambo wɔ wɔ y’ahone nu,
yeɛ yanni wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo makyebu,
19nakoso abubu yɛ pasaa wɔ nekaa bɔ ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛwɔ ɔ,
na afa awosii kabii akata yɛ so.
20Sɛ yɛ wora afi yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa a,
anaa sɛ yatrɛtrɛ yɛ sa nu yasɔne nyameɛ foforɛ bie po a,
21aso ahaa Nyameɛ ongonwu ye anaa?
Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔse sona ti anu mvealeɛ dwirɛ ɔ.
22Ɔnate wɔ ti beku yɛ daa biala,
na bebu yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ.
23Ao AWURADE, tingye! Nzu ati yeɛ ɛda e?
Dwɔso, na nnɛgyi yɛ to afebɔɔ!
24Nzu ati yeɛ aye wɔ nye afea e?
Nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora afi y’amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛ ndaneanyeɛ ye?
25Ofikyɛ babrɛ yɛ kra ase bawura mvuture nu;
na yɛ nipadua butu nnɛtefue nu.
26Dwɔso ná baaboka yɛ.
Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, pepɛ de yɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 45
Content:
Atɔmvorɛ dwein
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ndɛenvɛen ayi m’ahone nu tɛkyɛ,
na ɛhene ne nwo dwein yeɛ meto ɔ,
me temverema te kyɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ waboa ye nwo ɔ ye pɛn.
2Wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene tra sona biala; wɔ noa dwirɛ yɛ fɛ,
yiti Nyameɛ ayira wɔ afebɔɔ.
3Ao Tuminiɛ, fa wɔ ngrandɛ wura bɔha nu si wɔ taku so,
wɔ w’animnyam ne w’ahennie nu animnyam ne anu.
4Kɔ so di ngonim wɔ w’ahennie animnyam nu,
ɔnate nahorɛlilɛ, anwobrɛaseɛ ne tenenee ti;
wɔ nningyein suronyisuronyi nemɔ, ma wɔ sa famaa ne ohyirehyire wɔ.
5W’agyaen nemɔ noa yɛ nna,
besinasina nana pɔfoɛ mɔ b’ahone nu;
maen maen mɔ tete gua wɔ gya bo.
6“O Nyameɛ, w’ahennie bia wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!
W’ahennie hɔtɔ ne, ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ hɔtɔ.
7Ekuro tenenee, na ekyi amumuyɛɛ.
Ɛhe ati yeɛ Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ ne,
wafa anika ngoo wapopa wɔ maa wabo wɔ mmango mɔ deɛ so ɔ.
8Korobo, pɛprɛ ne kandanguru ma wɔ tena nu bo fona.
Ahemvie bɔ bafa ɛsoen gye baboro ye nwo ne,
nu yeɛ bɛbɔ dwein bɛgyegye wɔ nye ɔ.
9Ahemvo mma mmrasua nemɔ, bɛboka wɔ ndaluwa titire nemɔ aso,
na ahenyerɛ ne, ogyi wɔ sa famaa so bɔ wafa Ofire esikaa kɔkorɛ wasiesie ye nwo ɔ.
10Ao mma brasua, tie bɔ mekã ye, ná dwene ye nwo;
ma wɔ wora fi wɔ mmenia ne wɔ baba awuro ama,
11na ɛhene ne, ye nye kɔgye w’anwonyemene nwo.
Ɔnate kyɛ ɔte wɔ mene ne ati, bɔ wɔ nu ase ma ye.
12Tirofoɛ bɛkɔfa akyɛdeɛ pee bɛkɔwa,
bɛ nu sikafoɛ paa nemɔ po;
bɛkɔfa akyɛdeɛ ahoroɔ bɛkɔɔpena wɔ berɛ animnyam.
13Ɛhene awa brasua ne, ɔwɔ ye animnyam nu,
na owura ataadeɛ bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ batuatua nu ɔ.
14Wawura ataadeɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ɔ, na bɛfa ye bɛkɔ ɛhene ne berɛ;
ye mmango ndaluwa ababunu nemɔ beli ye si, na bɛfa ye bɛbrɛ wɔ.
15Bɛkwaawura Nana ahemvie berɛ,
na bele anigye ne ahurusi yeɛ bɛfa bɛ bɛba ɔ.
16Wɔ mma mɔ bekosi bɛ nana mɔ gya nu;
ɛkɔfa bɛ koli hene wɔ aseɛ ye aso amukoraa.
17Ngɔmaa bɛkɔkaye wɔ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu;
yiti maen maen mɔ kɔye wɔ ayɛ afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 46
Content:
Nyameɛ gyi yɛ si
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nyameɛ te yɛ nwo ɛwaenbɔlɛ ne y’anwoserɛ,
bokafoɛ paa bɔ opingye yɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu ɔ.
2Yiti sɛ aseɛ kakyi butu,
ná mmokaa tutu kogua ɛpo buma nu,
3ná ɛpo nu nzue yɛ wuruwuru obu fa so,
ná sɛ ye asorɔkye ma mmokaa bɛwoso po a, ɛserɛ ngɔhã yɛ.
Sela
4Asue bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ye sa mɔ fa anigye bɛba Nyameɛ kuro ɔ,
Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye atenaleɛ krongron berɛ.
5Nyameɛ wɔ kuro ne afia, yiti bɛngɔhora so ngonim di;
Nyameɛ kofi ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu kɔboka ye ndɛndɛ.
6Amaen maen mɔ bɛteatea nu, ahennie mɔ batete bapanzam;
ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu, na aseɛ woso.
7Asafo AWURADE gyi yɛ si;
Yakob Nyameɛ te y’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.
Sela
8Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa,
kyɛbɔ wasi wayɔ anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.
9Ɔmaa koɛ bo ɔpɛ alaa kɔka aseɛ noa dɔ;
obubu agyaen nu, na obubu pealɛɛ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ,
na ɔfa see yera teaseɛnam mɔ.
10“Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn, ná ɛ́mɔnwu kyɛ me ole Nyameɛ!
Medi hene wɔ maen maen mɔ so,
medi aseɛ ye aso hene.”
11Asafo AWURADE gyi yɛ si;
Yakob Nyameɛ te y’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.
Sela

Title: EDWEIN 47
Content:
AWURADE di wiase amukoraa so hene
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Amaenmaen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ sa nu;
ɛ́mɔbɔ se bɛto Nyameɛ nwo ahurusi dwein.
2Ofikyɛ AWURADE, Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne, ye nwo yɛ suro,
ɔte ɛhene piri bɔ odi wiase amukoraa so ɔ.
3Ɔbrɛ maen maen ase wura yɛ bo,
ɔfa maen maen mɔ wura yɛ gya bo.
4Ɔye y’agyapadeɛ sie berɛ ma yɛ,
Yakob bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ ne, agyapadeɛ ne te ye animnyam.
Sela
5Esebɔlɛ nu yeɛ Nyameɛ fa fo kɔ anwuro ɔ,
totorobɛndohulɛ nu yeɛ AWURADE ɔfa fo kɔ ɔ.
6Ɛ́mɔto Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein, ɛ́mɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein,
ɛ́mɔto yɛ Hene nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein, ɛ́mɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein!
7Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te aseɛ ye amukoraa so Hene,
ɛ́mɔfa ndeaseɛ bɛto ayɛyelɛ dwein.
8Nyameɛ di maen maen mɔ so hene,
Nyameɛ te ye ahennie bia krongron ne aso.
9Maen maen ahemvo baboa bɛ noa,
Abraham Nyameɛ ye maen ne.
Ofikyɛ aseɛ ye aso akokyɛm te Nyameɛ deɛ,
ɔte ɛhene piri paa wɔ ebiala so.

Title: EDWEIN 48
Content:
Sion te Nyameɛ kuro
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa
wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ kuro ne anu.
Ye bokaa krongron ne,
2bɔ ogyi berɛ tendenn nyemenenyemene ne,
ɔte aseɛ ye amukoraa anika;
Sion bokaa, bɔ ɔwɔ sorɔ dɔ dedeede ne,
ɔte Ɛhene piri ne, ye kuro.
3Nyameɛ wɔ kuro berɛ anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu,
na wahyire kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔ kuro ne anwo waen ɔ amba.
4Tie, ahemvo mɔ bɛboaboale bɛ noa,
bɛhane bɛ nwo bɛbɔle nu bɛwale Sion so.
5Bɛ nye bɔle kuro ne aso pɛ, bɛbɔle binim;
bɛ kunu tele bɛ, na bɛnwatili.
6Bɛ nwo wosowosole bɛ wɔ berɛ,
na bɛfale yealɛ nu kyɛ brasua bɔ aworɛ ahã ye ɔ.
7Ɛfale eyia afiteleɛ mvrama
ebubuli Tasise ɛlɛen nemɔ.
8Kyɛbɔ yate ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yanwu ye,
wɔ Asafo AWURADE ye kuro,
yɛ Nyameɛ ye kuro,
kuro bɔ Nyameɛ wafa watimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso ɔ.
Sela
9Ao Nyameɛ, yɛdwenedwene wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo,
wɔ w’asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.
10Ao Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ wɔ dumaa te ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ bɛye wayɛ kɔpem aseɛ ye noa dɔ paa ɔ.
Tenenee ayi wɔ sa famaa ne anu tɛkyɛ.
11Ɔnate wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ti,
odi kyɛ Sion bokaa nye gye,
ná Yuda mma mmrasua bedi ahurusi.
12Ɛ́mɔnate behyini Sion nwo bɛbra beyia,
ɛmɔha ye abandenden nemɔ;
13ɛ́mɔgyene ɛmɔ nye bɛnea ye fasue nemɔ yé,
ɛ́mɔneanea ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu yé,
amaa amɔahora bahã ye nwo dwirɛ
bahyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa nziɛ ye ne,
14kyɛ Nyameɛ he, ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ afebɔɔ.
Ye yeɛ okohyire yɛ atee kɔpem kyɛ ewue kɔfa yɛ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 49
Content:
Nnɛfa wɔ nwo to anwonyadeɛ so
Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he,
wiase mmenia amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie,
2kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire,
sikafoɛ ne ehiafoɛ amukoraa.
3Me noa kɔhã nworɛ dwirɛ,
na me ti anu nzusuleɛ te nimdeɛ.
4Ngɔyɛ asoɛ konn ngotie anyandera,
ngɔbɔ sangoo ngɔpena m’anyandera nwo ndeaseɛ.
5Sɛ amaneɛ to me,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, sɛ b’amumuyɛɛ pɛ me nwo bra yia a,
nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ mesuro ɔ?
6Nzu ati yeɛ nzuro bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto b’anwonyadeɛ so,
bɔ bɛfa b’anwonya bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ɔ?
7Amba, ebiala ngɔhora ngɔpɔ ye nwo;
yeɛ ɔngɔhora ngotua ye ngoa ti nyɔboɛ ngɔma Nyameɛ.
8Ofikyɛ sona kra nyɔboɛ yɛ se paa,
na esikaa biala ngɔso ye nwo kerɛ tua
9bɔ ɔkɔma sona kɔtena ase afebɔɔ,
bɔ ɔngɔhɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ.
10Ye nye tua kyɛ nworɛfoɛ bewu;
yeɛ ngwaseafoɛ ne gyiminiwaafoɛ koso bewu,
na bɛyakyi b’agyapadeɛ berɛ maa okodi mmeni foforɛ sa nu.
11Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛfale bɛ dumaa bɛtole b’aseɛ so de,
nakoso b’asieleɛ yeɛ ɔte b’awuro afebɔɔ ɔ,
na ɔte bɛ daberɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
12Dasaniɛ ngɔhora ngɔtena ye anwonya nu afebɔɔ,
owu kyɛ ngaka ne ala.
13Bɛ bɔ bede bɛ nwo bedi ne, sɔ yeɛ b’ayieleɛ te ɔ,
bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto b’anwonya so ne, b’ayieleɛ ɛne.
Sela
14Bɛte kyɛ mmoaen, na bɛ mukoraa bewu.
Ewue yeɛ odi bɛ nyunu fa bɛ kɔ ɔ;
teneneefoɛ koli bɛ so tumi ngyerɛmɔ,
na b’anwonyemene kɔsɛkye wɔ ewue kumaa nu;
na ɛborɔ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ b’awuro ɔ.
15Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔpɔ me kra kofi ɛborɔ sa nu,
ofikyɛ okole me.
Sela
16Sɛ ebie yɛ sikaniɛ,
sɛ onya ye nwo tam a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ anyeboro.
17Ofikyɛ sɛ owu a, ɔngɔfa hwee ngɔhɔ,
yeɛ ye sikaa ngoli ye si ngɔhɔ bie.
18Mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne, obuli ye nwo kyɛ wayie ye yé,
ofikyɛ sɛ sona nya ye nwo a, mmenia kamvo ye.
19Nakoso ye mbanyi mɔ bɔ bengonwu eyia ko le ne,
ɔkɔɔtoa bɛ.
20Dasaniɛ ngɔhora ngɔtena ye anwonya nu afebɔɔ,
owu kyɛ ngaka ne ala.

Title: EDWEIN 50
Content:
Nyameɛ solɛ paa
Asafe dwein
1Tuminiɛ ne, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE ne, wadwudwo,
wato ye sa wafrɛ aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa,
fi eyia afiteleɛ kɔka eyia atɔleɛ.
2Sion bɔ ye anwonyemene di mu ne,
Nyameɛ ta hyireinn fi berɛ.
3Yɛ Nyameɛ ɔba, na ɔngɔyɛ konn,
see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi li ye nyunu,
na mvrama piri apɛ ye nwo amukoraa wayia.
4Ɔfrɛ nyameɛso bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro,
ɔne aseɛ, kyɛ bɛɛnea kyɛ obua ye maen ndɛen ɔ.
5Ɔnwa, “M’anwoteefoɛ
bɔ bɛnate afɔleɛ so bɛ ne me ayɛ apam ne,
ɛ́mɔboaboa bɛ noa bɛma me!”
6Ewienu bɔ ye tenenee nwo dawure,
ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔbɔ te ndɛenbualɛniɛ.
Sela
7“Ao me maen, tie na mebaadwudwo.
Ao Yisrael, ngɔbɔ wɔ kwaadu.
Me ole Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ.
8Nna wɔ ngaka afɔleɛ ne ati yeɛ mekã wɔ nyunu ɔ;
wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔwɔ me nyunu daa.
9W’awuro nandwie nyii,
yeɛ wɔ tuin nu mbɔngye ne, menhia.
10Ofikyɛ eburo kaka biala te me deɛ,
yeɛ mmokaa apee apee so nandwie nemɔ, bɛte me deɛ.
11Mese ewienu nnomaa mukoraa,
na eburo kaka biala koso te me deɛ.
12“Sɛ ɛhɔen ku me a, ahaa nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ngosu hɔen ngohyire ɛmɔ ɔ,
ofikyɛ wiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa te me deɛ.
13Aso nandwie naen yeɛ medi ɔ,
anaa mbɔngye mogya yeɛ meno ɔ?
14Fa asennaa yɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ma AWURADE,
ná tua w’aboadeɛ ma Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne.
15Sũ frɛ me wɔ w’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu,
na ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ, amaa ɔnate so ahyɛ me animnyam.”
16Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, Nyameɛ kã kyire ye kyɛ,
“Atee beni yeɛ ele ye kyɛ ɛfa wɔ noa kekã m’ahyɛdeɛ,
anaa ɛfa wɔ noa bɔ m’apam so ɔ.
17Ofikyɛ ekyi kyɛ ngɔtea wɔ ɔ,
yeɛ afa me dwirɛ ato ahameɛ.
18Sɛ enwu awueniɛ a, ɛne ye betira abiɛngoɛ,
na ɛne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ yeɛ betu nu ɔ.
19Ɔnyɛ wɔ se kyɛ ɛte wɔ noa kekã musue dwirɛ ɔ,
na nnakannaka wɔ wɔ noa nu.
20Ɛtena ase ɛkekã eliɛma nwo dwirɛ;
na eni awa po, ɛpepɛ ye gya ndii nu.
21Ɛyɔle sɔ nningyein nemɔ bɔ mandɛ wɔ so ne ati,
ɛdwene kyɛ nde kyɛ wɔ ala.
Na afei de, mekã wɔ nyunu ná mebɔ wɔ kwaadu.
22“Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ wora ofi Nyameɛ ne, ɛ́mɔdwene ɛhe anwo,
ná mandete ɛmɔ nu pasapasa bɔ ɛmɔngonya defoɛ ɔ.
23Sona bɔ ɔfa asennaa ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ma me ne, ɔhyɛ me animnyam;
sona bɔ ye atee tengyɛ ne,
ngɔmaa okonwu Nyameɛ ngoalelɛ ne.”

Title: EDWEIN 51
Content:
Bɔnefakyɛ srɛlɛ
Dawide dwein. Dawide hyerɛle wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔne Bahyeba bɛlale ná Natan hwili ye nyunu wɔ ye nwo ne.
1Ao Nyameɛ, gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso
ná nwu me anwumvoin,
gyina w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne aso,
ná kyikyi me mmeraatolɛ.
2Nwunzi me nwo sannwuu fi m’amumuyɛɛ nwo,
ná pete me nwo fi me bɔne nwo.
3Ofikyɛ mede me mmeraatolɛ meto nu,
na me bɔne la me nyunu daa.
4Wɔ ngome, wɔ ngome twe, yeɛ mayɔ bɔne matia wɔ ɔ,
na mayɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ.
Yiti sɛ ebua me fɔ a, ɔte turoloo,
na sɛ ebua me ndɛen a, edi be.
5Amba, amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ bɛwole me ɔ,
na bɔne nu yeɛ me maame nwonzɛle me ɔ.
6Amba, ɛpena nahorɛlilɛ wɔ sona nu,
yiti maa nwu nworɛ wɔ me nu mvealeɛ nu dɔ.
7Fa sufiɛ pete me nwo, na me nwo kofi;
nwunzi me nwo, na me nwo kɔyɛ fufue kɔtra ewure.
8Maa nde ahurusi ne anigye dwirɛ,
mmowue bɔ agorɔgorɔ bɛ ne, maa beli ahurusi.
9Nnɛnea me bɔne bɔ mayɔ ɔ,
na mmom kyikyi m’amumuyɛɛ amukoraa.
10Ao Nyameɛ, bɔ ahone bɔ nu te ɔ wura me nu,
ná fa sunzum bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wura me nu.
11Nnɛfoa me fi wɔ nyunu,
yeɛ nnɛye wɔ krongronyɛlɛ sunzum ne fi me nu.
12Wɔ ngoalelɛ nu anigye ne, sa fa ma me,
ná fa sotie sunzum tira me nu.
13Na afei ngohyire mmeraatolɛfoɛ w’atee,
na bɔnefoɛ kosa kɔwa wɔ berɛ.
14Ao Nyameɛ, me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ,
pepɛ de me fi mogya nwo foɛlilɛ nu,
na ngɔfa me noa ngɔto wɔ tenenee nwo dwein serɛ paa.
15Ao AWURADE, bukye me noa,
na ngɔfa me noa ngɔbɔ dawure ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
16Ofikyɛ nna afɔleɛ yeɛ wɔ nye gye ye nwo ɔ.
Sɛ mebɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ a, wɔ nye ngɔgye ye nwo.
17Afɔleɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nye gye ye nwo ole ahone bɔ wabrɛ ye nwo ase ɔ;
ao Nyameɛ, ahone bɔ wabrɛ ye nwo ase, ná ye wora abɔ de, ɛngɔpo.
18Maa ɔyɛ wɔ anigye kyɛ ɛkɔma Sion konya ngɔsoɛ ɔ;
si Yerusalem fasue nemɔ.
19Na wɔ nye kɔsɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ nwo:
naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛ mumua yeralɛ nwo;
na bɛkɔbɔ nandwie nyii afɔleɛ wɔ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

Title: EDWEIN 52
Content:
Ngɔngɔnzaaniɛ ayieleɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔhyerɛle ye mmerɛ bɔ Edomniɛ Dɔɔgye ɔɔbɔle Sɔɔlo amaneɛ kyɛ Dawide ahɔ Ahimɛlɛke berɛ ne
1Wɔ, anwoserɛniɛ, nzu ati yeɛ ɛfa bɔne bɔ edi ɔ hoahoa wɔ nwo ye?
Nyameɛ nahorɛ wɔ berɛ daa.
2Wɔ noa kekã musue dwirɛ,
wɔ temverema te kyɛ dɛmaa nnaennaen.
3Wɔ nye gye bɔne nwo tra paa,
yeɛ ekuro anoanupɛlɛ tra nahorɛhanɛ.
Sela
4Wɔ, nnakannaka sona,
wɔ nye gye edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔsɛkye sona dumaa nwo.
5Nakoso Nyameɛ kobubu wɔ kogua berɛ afebɔɔ;
ɔkɔpra wɔ boso kɔhwe wɔ kofi wɔ tena sua nu;
okotu wɔ bo kofi teasefoɛ aseɛ so.
Sela
6Teneneefoɛ konwu ye kɔma bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ,
bɛkɔsere bɔnefoɛ ná bahã kyɛ,
7“Ɛ́mɔnea sona bɔ wamva Nyameɛ wanyɛ ye afealeɛ,
na mmom ɔfale ye wora wurale ye anwonya worawora nu,
ná ɔfale ye nwo tole ye agyapadeɛ so ne!”
8Nakoso me de, nde kyɛ olive bakaa monɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro;
me wora wura Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anu afebɔɔ.
9Ɔnate bɔ ayɔ ne ati,
ngɔla wɔ ase daa.
Ngɔfa me wora ngowura wɔ dumaa nu
wɔ w’anwoteefoɛ mɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔte paa.

Title: EDWEIN 53
Content:
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
(Edwein 14)
1Kwaseaa kã ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ.”
Belle adwene paa, na amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ,
ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.
2Nyameɛ to ye nye fi nyameɛso ɔnea kuro mmenia,
kyɛ aso okonwu ebie bɔ ɔse nworɛ,
bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.
3Bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu,
bɛ mukoraa adwene paa ɔnne bɛ ti anu,
bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ;
daabi, ko po nne berɛ.
4Aso nimdeɛ abɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ anaa?
Bɛ yeɛ bedi me maen aminɛ kyɛ bedi aleɛ ne ala,
ná bɛmbena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.
5Berɛ yeɛ esuronyi kandinga kɔtɔ bɛ so ɔ,
esuronyi bɔ ebie ɔhhane bɛ le ɔ.
Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛko betia wɔ ne, Nyameɛ kɔto bɛ mmowue kɔpete,
ɛkɔma bɛ nyunu kogua ase, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ aye ye sa wafi bɛ bo.
6Ao, ahaa né Yisrael ngoalelɛ wafi Sion wawa!
Na sɛ Nyameɛ ma ye maen bɛ sa kã b’agyapadeɛ bieku a,
Yakob koli ahurusi, na Yisrael nye kɔgye.

Title: EDWEIN 54
Content:
AWURADE, bɔ me nwo waen
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne mmerɛ bɔ Sifefoɛ bɛɛbɔle Sɔɔlo amaneɛ kyɛ Dawide waafea bɛ berɛ ne
1Ao Nyameɛ, fa wɔ dumaa pepɛ de me,
ná fa wɔ tumi di me dwirɛ ma me.
2Ao Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ;
yɛ asoɛ tie me noa dwirɛ.
3Ofikyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ badwɔso batia me,
atianuserɛfoɛ bɛpena me beku me;
bɛmva Nyameɛ bɛnyɛ huu.
Sela
4Nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte me bokafoɛ ɔ;
AWURADE yeɛ me kra wura ye sa ɔ.
5Ɔkɔfa me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ bɔne kotua bɛ so kerɛ.
Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ti, nua bɛ boso.
6Ngɔbɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ.
Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ dumaa, ofikyɛ ɔte paa.
7Ofikyɛ wapepɛ wale me wafi amaneɛ amukoraa nu,
na mafa me nye manwu me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ ngoguo.

Title: EDWEIN 55
Content:
Me damvo aye me ama
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto
1Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie me mbaeɛ;
nnɛma m’abisadeɛ ogua wɔ so asi.
2Tie me, ná bua me;
m’amaneɛnwunɛ abungam afa me so. Mahɔ ateetee nu,
3ɔnate me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ dede ne ati,
ɔne bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛ ndaneanyeɛ ne ati.
Ofikyɛ bɛmaa menwu amaneɛ,
na bele ɛyaa bɛpɔ me.
4M’ahone di aworabɔlɛ wɔ me nu,
ewue nwo suronyi atɔ me so.
5Esuronyi ne ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so,
na ɛserɛ akyekye me.
6Me dwirɛ ole kyɛ, “Ahaa né manya ndaa te kyɛ abubure!
Ahaa ngotu ngɔɔpena nekaa bie ngɔtena;
7nahorɛ nu, ahaa ngɔnwati ngɔhɔ dedeede,
ná maatena ɛserɛ so.
Sela
8Ahaa nne amirika ngɔɔpena nekaa ngɔbɔ me nwo adwaa
ngofi mvrama ne mvrama piri bɔ otu ne anu.”
9Ao AWURADE, sɛkye bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ɔ, ma bɛ noa ɔto fofo,
ofikyɛ kyɛ menwu basabasayɔlɛ ne ngondiihonɛ wɔ kuro ne anu.
10Eyia ne kɔngɔen bɛnate fasue nemɔ aso
bɛpɛ kuro ne anwo bɛbra beyia,
na amumuyɛɛ ne amaneɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ kuro ne anu ɔ.
11Nningyein ayɛ basaa wɔ kuro ne anu;
ndaneanyeɛ ne asisie ye bo ndu mvi kuro berɛ dwaaso.
12Nna me pɔfoɛ yeɛ ɔkã me anyinga ɔ,
ɛhene de, ahaa ngɔhora ye noa gyina;
nna sona bɔ okyi me yeɛ ɔbɔ me alapaa ɔ,
ye de, ahaa ngɔhora ngɔfa me nwo ngɔfea ye.
13Na mmom wɔ bɔ ɛte me tipɛen ɔ,
mmiɛngo bɔ me ne wɔ kɔ ba ɔ,
14wɔ bɔ né me ne wɔ yɛtu nu paa ɔ;
bɔ né me ne wɔ yɛbɔ nu yɛnate wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɔ.
15Ma ewue ɔte pe bɛ so;
maa bɛhɔ ɛborɔ anyekaenn so,
ofikyɛ bɔne wɔ b’awuro ne b’afia.
16Na me de, mesu mefrɛ Nyameɛ,
na AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole me.
17Nɔsoa, ngyerɛmɔ ne eyia,
mekã me yealɛ mesu,
na okotie me mbaeɛ.
18Ɔkɔpepɛ kole me kra
kofi koɛ bɔ bafa batoa me ye anu,
ofikyɛ mmenia pee badwɔso batia me.
19Nyameɛ bɔ odi hene fi tete ne,
okotie me, ná wali bɛ so ngonim,
ofikyɛ bɛnzakyera b’adwene,
na benzuro Nyameɛ.
Sela
20Mmiɛngo ne, odwɔso tiale ye mmango nemɔ,
na obuli ye apam ne aso,
21ye noa dwirɛ te menemene tra woɛ,
nakoso koɛ nwo adwene yeɛ ɔwɔ ye ti anu ɔ;
ye noa nu dwirɛ te bɛtɛɛ kyɛ aloko,
nakoso edwirɛ ne te ngrandɛ bɔ bahwe ɔ.
22Fa w’adesoa to AWURADE so,
na ɔkɔsɔ wɔ nu;
ɔngɔnea ngɔma teneneeniɛ ngofi ase.
23Nakoso wɔ, ao Nyameɛ, ekofindi bɛ kogua
ewue kumaa ne abo dɔ;
kodiawufoɛ ne ngondombofoɛ de,
bengoli b’aseɛ ye aso ngoa ye bue po.
Nakoso me de, mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu.

Title: EDWEIN 56
Content:
Fa wɔ nwo to AWURADE so
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne. Ɔhyerɛle fale mmerɛ bɔ Filistifoɛ bɛhyele ye wɔ Gate ne anwo.
1Ao Nyameɛ, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ mmenia bɛpena me beku me.
Mmerɛ biala me pɔfoɛ mɔ tane me nye,
2mmerɛ biala, me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛpena me beku me;
na mmeni pee bɛyɛ anwomasoɛ bɛko betia me.
3Sɛ esuronyi tɔ me so a,
mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu.
4Nyameɛ bɔ meye ye dwirɛ ne ayɛ ne,
Nyameɛ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura ye nu ɔ, yiti menzuro hwee;
nzikyɛ yeɛ kuro sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?
5Daa biala bɛpena kyɛ me noa tɔ,
me nwo porɛ alaa yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ.
6Bɛboa bɛ noa, bɛtetɛ me; beli me mvanvando,
na bɛpena me ne ewue.
7Yiti tua bɛ bɔne so kerɛ;
ao Nyameɛ, fɛ ɛyaa, ná bɔ maen maen nemɔ!
8Wɔ yeɛ anwu aworabɔlɛ worawora bɔ medi ɔ,
fa wɔ towaa ne sɔ me nye moen.
Aso ɔnne wɔ ngrataa nu anaa?
9Na afei kyẽa bɔ ngosu ngɔfrɛ wɔ ne,
me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔtete bekosa.
Mese ye sɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ gyi me si.
10Nyameɛ bɔ meye ye dwirɛ ne ayɛ ne,
AWURADE bɔ meye ye dwirɛ ne ayɛ ne,
11Nyameɛ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura ye nu ɔ, yiti menzuro hwee;
nzikyɛ yeɛ kuro sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?
12Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ metua m’aboadeɛ mema wɔ.
Ngɔbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ.
13Ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me kra afi ewue nu,
yeɛ amma manzoti mamvi ase,
amaa ɔnate so manate Nyameɛ nyunu,
wɔ ngoa kanea ne anu.

Title: EDWEIN 57
Content:
AWURADE baaboka me
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne. Ɔhyerɛ fale mmerɛ bɔ ɔnwati fili Sɔɔlo nyunu wɔ nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne anu ne anwo
1Nwu me anwumvoin, ao Nyameɛ, nwu me anwumvoin,
ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ me kra nwati bafea ɔ;
wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ,
kɔpem kyɛ asetena nu mvrama piri ne abo kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ ɔ.
2Mesu mefrɛ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ,
Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma ye nhyehyɛleɛ ba nu ma me ne.
3Ɔkɔsoma kofi nyameɛso kɔɔpepɛ kole me,
na bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, okogua bɛ nyunu ase.
Sela
Nyameɛ kɔsoma ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne ye nahorɛlilɛ ne.
4Gyata mɔ yeɛ me kra la b’afia ɔ.
Bɛ gye te pealɛɛ ne agyaen,
bɛ temverema te ngrandɛ nnaennaen.
5Ao Nyameɛ, kyire kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ wɔ anwuro anwuro!
Ma w’animnyam kata aseɛ ye aso amukoraa.
6Basua me ngaen,
me kra wora abɔ.
Betuli kumaa wɔ m’atee nu,
nakoso bapɛ bɛ nwo batete bagua nu.
Sela
7Ao Nyameɛ, m’ahone asiesie ye nwo,
m’ahone asiesie ye nwo!
Ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
8M’animnyam, tingye!
Sangoo ne adengum, ɛ́mɔtingye!
Me koso ngotingye alebahyene.
9Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu;
ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ maen nemɔ anu.
10Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye piri kɔka ewienu dɔ paa,
yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu.
11Ao Nyameɛ, kyire kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ wɔ anwuro anwuro.
Ma w’animnyam kata aseɛ so amukoraa.

Title: EDWEIN 58
Content:
Nyameɛ tɔ pɔfoɛ so wereɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne.
1Ɛmɔ, tumifoɛ mɔ, edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔka ne, aso ɔtengyɛ?
Ao kuro mmenia, aso ɛmɔbua ndɛen turoloo?
2Daabi, bɔne yeɛ ɛmɔsusu ye nwo ɛmɔ ti anu ɔ,
na nzɛmmɔne yeɛ ɛmɔdi ye wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.
3Bɔnefoɛ befi bɛ ni akunu yeɛ bedi makyebu ɔ;
befi b’aworɛ nu yeɛ bɛyɔ mvomsoɛ ɔ, na bɛnga nahorɛ.
4Bɛ noa borɔ te kyɛ ewoo deɛ ne ala,
bɛte kyɛ ɛbɔnaa asotiniwaa bɔ watuatua ye so,
5amaa sɛ bɛ bɔ bele ewoo ayire,
anaa bɛ bɔ bɛdwumva ewoo mɔ po bɛtea ye a ɔnde ɔ.
6Ao Nyameɛ, bubu bɛ gye bɔ ogua bɛ noa nu ɔ,
ao AWURADE, tutu gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ gye!
7Maa betu bemini kyɛ nzue bɔ ɔse ɔ,
maa betiatia bɛ so, ná bɛkese kyɛ ɛserɛ.
8Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ ebuhye bɔ ɔporɔ wɔ ye konguroma nu ɔ,
kyɛ baa bɔ bapɔ ye, bɔ wannwu eyia le ɔ.
9Ole ɛyaa kɔpra teasefoɛ kɔhɔ kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ,
na ɔkɔyɔ sɔ ndɛndɛ kɔtra kyɛbɔ wɔ kukue bɔ ogyi mmowue see so ɔ okosi kɔyɛ hye ɔ.
10Teneneeniɛ nwu kyɛ batɔ bɔnefoɛ so wereɛ a, ye nye gye;
okonwunzi ye gya bo wɔ bɔnefoɛ mogya nu.
11Mmenia kɔhã kyɛ, “Amba, akatuaa wɔ berɛ ma teneneefoɛ;
amba, Nyameɛ bɔ obua ndɛen wɔ aseɛ ye aso ne, ɔwɔ berɛ.”

Title: EDWEIN 59
Content:
De me fi pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne. Ɔto fale mmerɛ bɔ Sɔɔlo somane mmenia kyɛ beehu ye wɔ ye awuro ne anwo
1Ao me Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu,
na bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia me ne, bɔ me nwo waen fi bɛ sa nu.
2Pepɛ de me fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ mɔ sa nu,
ná de me ngoa fi kodiawufoɛ bɛ sa nu.
3Ao AWURADE, nndole mmeraa biala, yeɛ nnyɔle bɔne biala,
nakoso kekesaala ye po, bɛtetɛ me beku me;
nzɛmmɔnefoɛ bɛboa bɛ noa bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ.
4Nnyɔle tɛɛ biala, nakoso bɛpena me bepura me.
Dwɔso baanea me ná boka me!
5Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, ɛte Yisrael Nyameɛ.
Dwɔso twe maen maen amukoraa bɛ so;
amumuyɛɛfoɛ nnakannakafoɛ ne,
nnɛma bɛ nu biala fa ye nwo di tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
Sela
6Nɔsoa biala besa bɛba,
bepo kyɛ ngyea,
na bekyini kuro ne anu bɛbra beyia.
7Tie, edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ bele bɛ noa bɛkekã ɔ,
edwirɛ yealɛ bɔ otua bɛ noa ɔ,
B’adwene ole kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte yɛ nga ɔ.”
8Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ de, ɛsere bɛ,
na ɛgoro maen maen amukoraa bɛ nwo.
9Ao m’anwoserɛ, me nye la wɔ so,
ofikyɛ ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.
10Ɔnate me Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ɔkɔɔboka me;
me Nyameɛ koli me pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim maa ngonwu ye.
11Nnɛkũkũ bɛ: ɔba ye sɔ a, me maen bɛ wora kofi;
fa wɔ tumi maa bɛbɔ asesa, ná brɛ bɛ ase;
ao AWURADE, ɛte y’akokyɛm.
12Bɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte bɔne,
yeɛ edwirɛ bɔ otua bɛ noa ne ati,
ma b’anwomasoɛ ne kakyi ngaen ɔhye bɛ.
Ɔnate bɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte amoenwaa ne ngondombo ne ati,
13fɛ bɛ so yaa kũkũ bɛ;
kũkũ bɛ ma bɛ boso onua.
Na ɛhe kɔmaa ofi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti,
mmenia konwu kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ odi Yakob so hene ɔ.
Sela
14Nɔsoa biala besa bɛba,
bepo kyɛ ngyea,
na bekyini kuro ne anu.
15Bekyini bɛpena aleɛ,
na sɛ bɛ ko anyi a, bɛyɛ dede.
16Nakoso me de, ngɔto w’anwoserɛ nwo dwein;
na ngyerɛmɔ ngɔto wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dwein.
Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ
ne m’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa nu afealeɛ ɔ.
17Ao m’anwoserɛ, ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ,
ofikyɛ ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ,
Nyameɛ bɔ ɔye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali kyire me ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 60
Content:
Ngonimlilɛ nwo mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne. Ɔto fale koɛ bɔ ɔne Aram Naharaim ne Aram Soba bɛhone ne anwo, ɔne mmerɛ bɔ Yoabo huni Edomfoɛ apee buru ne nyɔ wɔ Ngyee Bɔnza nu ne anwo.
1Ao Nyameɛ, apo yɛ, abɔ yɛ asande;
afɛ yaa, ao yɛsrɛ wɔ, maa yɛpe yɛ daa nu!
2Ama aseɛ awoso, adwa aseɛ nu;
fa ye nekaa bɔ wadwudwa nemɔ siesie ye nye, ofikyɛ ɔkekã.
3Ama amaneɛ paa yeɛ wato wɔ maen ɔ,
ama yɛ nzaa maa yano bɔ yɛnate fofalifofali ɔ.
4Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, asi frangaa ama bɛ,
kyɛ bɛfa behyire, ɔnate nahorɛ ti.
Sela
5Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne ati,
fa wɔ sa famaa ne de yɛ ngoa, ná tie yɛ.
6Nyameɛ ahã ye wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ kyɛ,
“Ngoli ahurusi, ngɔhyehyɛ Sɛkem nu,
na ngosusu Sukote bɔnza ne.
7Gileade te me deɛ, yeɛ Manase koso te me deɛ;
Efraim te me buralɛ kyerɛ; Yuda te me hɔtɔ.
8Moabo te me nyanzɛen,
Edom so yeɛ mefindi me mbaboa megua ɔ;
na Filistia so yeɛ mebɔ ngonimlilɛ ese ɔ.”
9Kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa me kɔhɔ so ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ odi me nyunu fa me kɔ Edom ɔ?
10Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛppole yɛ anaa?
Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛyyakyili yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛ si gyinalɛ anaa?
11Ao, boka yɛ de yɛ fi amaneɛ nu,
ofikyɛ kuro sona mmokalɛ te mbaen!
12Sɛ AWURADE boka yɛ so a, yɛkoli ngonim;
ye yeɛ okotiatia yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 61
Content:
AWURADE bɔ yɛ nwo waen
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto
1Ao Nyameɛ, tie me sufrɛ,
tie me mbaeɛ.
2Sɛ m’abasa nu bu a, mvi aseɛ noa dɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ.
Di me nyunu fa me kɔ nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔwale tra me ne anwo,
3ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ,
abandenden serɛserɛ bɔ ɔko tia me pɔfoɛ ɔ.
4Ngɔtena wɔ tena sua ne anu afebɔɔ,
ná manya afealeɛ wɔ wɔ ndaa bo fɔnwoo ne abo.
Sela
5Ofikyɛ wɔ, Nyameɛ, ate me bɔhyɛ ne,
bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ dumaa ne, afa b’agyapadeɛ ama me.
6Ma ɛhene ne ye ngoa ɔyɛ tendenn,
na ye afoɛ mɔ ɔyɛ tendenn oodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu!
7Maa oli bia afebɔɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu;
ma ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne nahorɛlilɛ bɛbɔ ye nwo waen!
8Yiti ngɔto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein daa,
ná matua m’aboadeɛ daa biala.

Title: EDWEIN 62
Content:
Nyameɛ ngome twe yeɛ ɔbɔ yɛ nwo waen ɔ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nyameɛ ngome yeɛ me kra ayɛ konn bɔ ye nye la ye so ɔ,
na ye berɛ yeɛ me ngoalelɛ fi ba ɔ.
2Ye ngome yeɛ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne me ngoalelɛ ɔ,
m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɛne; hwee ngopusu me.
3Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ ɛmɔkotu ɛmɔ nye bekosie sona horɛ so ɔ,
bɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔpena ye beku ye ɔ,
kyɛbɔ ɛmɔdwiri fasue bɔ wahyea ɔ begua ase ɔ.
4Bɛ botaeɛ ala ole kyɛ bekotu ye bekofi bia so ɔ.
Bɛ nye gye ngondombo nwo;
bɛfa bɛ noa beyira sona,
nakoso bɛ ti anu de, bɛnoma ye.
Sela
5Me kra, Nyameɛ ngome yeɛ ma wɔ nye ɔla ye so ɔ,
na ye berɛ yeɛ m’anyelasoɛ fi ba ɔ.
6Ye ngome yeɛ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne me ngoalelɛ ɔ,
m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɛne; hwee ngopusu me.
7Nyameɛ sa nu yeɛ me ngoalelɛ ne m’animnyam wɔ ɔ;
Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte m’afealeɛ ɔ; me nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ɔ.
8Ao kuro mmenia, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye so mmerɛ biala,
ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahiasɛm bɛto ye nyunu,
ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te y’afealeɛ.
Sela
9Adasa mmaa te mvrama,
yeɛ kuro mmenia te nnakannaka nikye;
sɛ bɛkari bɛ wɔ tonyi so a, bɛ nu nyɛ no,
sɛ ɛfa bɛ munyɔ bɔ nu a, bɛ nu yɛ nyera tra mvrama.
10Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛto apoobɔlɛ so,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nye gye awue nwo;
sɛ ɛmɔ anwonyadeɛ sone po a, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto so.
11Nyameɛ dwudwole komapɛ,
na mate ye pɛen nyɔ so kyɛ, Tumi te Nyameɛ deɛ’.
12Na wɔ, ao AWURADE, ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne te wɔ deɛ,
na etua sona biala kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 63
Content:
Anwotɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu
Dawide dwein. Ɔtole ye mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ Yuda ɛserɛ so ne.
