1Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ, mepena wɔ serɛserɛ;
me kra wora adɔ wɔ,
me nwonaen ayɛ hodwoo ɔpena wɔ
kyɛ aseɛ wosee katerepee bɔ ɔpena nzue ɔ.
2Amba, manwu wɔ wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ,
bɔ menea wɔ tumi ne w’animnyam ɔ.
3Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔte paa tra ngoa;
ye sɔ ati, me noa kɔye wɔ ayɛ.
4Yiti mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu ye, ngɔye wɔ ayɛ,
na ngɔma me sa so ngɔbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ wɔ dumaa nu.
5Me kra ko koyi kyɛ ama ye aleɛ bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ ne bɔ naen bɔ walɔ ɔ,
na ngɔfa me noa ngɔto ahurusi dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
6Sɛ mekaye wɔ wɔ me bɛen so a,
medwenedwene wɔ nwo abunnamu;
7ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ɔ,
na wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu yeɛ medi ahurusi ɔ.
8Me kra te mata wɔ,
wɔ sa famaa ne tira me nu.
9Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena me kra beku ye ne,
bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa nu’.
10Bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
na bɛkɔyɛ ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛ naen.
11Nakoso ɛhene ne koli ahurusi wɔ Nyameɛ nu;
na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye dumaa ta ndaen ne, ɔkɔhoahoa ye nwo,
ofikyɛ bɛkɔhã ngondombofoɛ noa bɛkɔto nu.

Title: EDWEIN 64
Content:
AWURADE, bɔ me nwo waen
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ
wɔ me dwirɛ yealɛ bɔ mekã ye anu;
bɔ me ngoa nwo waen fi me pɔfoɛ nwo suronyi nu.
2Bɔnefoɛ bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye mvealeɛ nu ne,
bɔ me nwo adwaa fi nu,
de me fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ kanda atee nu.
3Bɛ yeɛ besi bɛ noa kyɛ ngrandɛ,
besina bɛ noa dwirɛ yeayea kyɛ agyaen;
4amaa ɔnate so batetɛ bato basina teneneeniɛ,
na bɛto bɛwɔ ye mvum nu bɔ benzuro ɔ.
5Bɛhyehyɛ bɛ nwo nguraen wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nu,
bɛbɔ porɛ besua mmenia ngaen wɔ mvealeɛ nu,
na bɛdwene kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ okonwu yɛ ɔ?”
6Bɛpena amumuyɛɛ bɛyɔ,
na bɛbɔ mmɔden bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ ne.
Nahorɛ nu, kuro sona ti anu adwene, ɔne adwene nu nzusuleɛ bɛ nu pi!
7Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔto ye agyaen ne kɔwɔ bɛ,
na bekopura mvum nu.
8Bɛ noa dwirɛ ti, ɔkɔmaa amaneɛ kɔto bɛ,
na ebiala bɔ okonwu bɛ ne, ye nwo kodwiri ye.
9Afei ɛserɛ kɔtɔ mmenia amukoraa so,
na bɛkɔbɔ bɔ Nyameɛ wayɔ ɔ nwo dawure,
ná badwene bɔ wayɔ ɔ nwo.
10Teneneefoɛ bekoli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu,
na bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nwo adwaa wɔ ye nu.
Bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te sannwuu ne, bɛkɔhoahoa bɛ nwo.

Title: EDWEIN 65
Content:
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Nyameɛ, ayɛyelɛ fata wɔ wɔ Sion,
na wɔ yeɛ bekotua aboadeɛ bɛkɔma wɔ ɔ’.
2Ao, wɔ bɔ etie mbaeɛ ɔ,
wɔ berɛ yeɛ mmenia amukoraa bɛkɔwa ɔ.
3Sɛ m’amumuyɛɛ bungam fa me so a,
wɔ yeɛ ekyikyi m’amumuyɛɛ efi me so ɔ.
4Bɛ bɔ ɛneanea nu ɛtwe bɛ bata wɔ nwo,
kyɛ bɛɛtena w’abrannaa nu ne,
benya saleɛ.
W’awuro bɔ yeɛ ole w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne,
nu nningyein paa ne, ɔma yɛ nwo tɔ yɛ.
5Ɛnate anwanwadeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔtengyɛ so ɛma yɛ mmuayɛɛ;
ao yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ,
wɔ yeɛ ɛte anyelasoɛ ma aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti amukoraa,
ɔne ɛpo nziɛ nziɛ dɔ paa ɔ.
6W’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔfale mmokaa penapenane berɛ ɔ,
afa tumi abɔ abɔsoɛ.
7Ɛpo bɔ obu fa so ne,
ye asorɔkye wuruwuru ne,
ɔne maen maen mɔ bagyabagyayɛle ne,
ɛmaa bɛyɛ konn.
8Bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ noa dɔ dedeede ne,
wɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ma ɛserɛ tɔ bɛ so.
Ɛma eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ maen maen mɔ
bele ahurusi bɛbɔ ese.
9Ɛba bapasa aseɛ ye anwo, na eguagua so nzue,
ɛmaa nningyein paa ba so.
Nyameɛ asue ne, nzue ayi ye to,
ɛmaa yɛnya aleɛ yɛdi,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ahyehyɛ ye sɔ ɔ.
10Ɛtɔ nzue gua ye ngofie nemɔ aso,
na etuatua aseɛ ngumaa nemɔ;
ɛma bosue doadoa aseɛ ne aso maa ɔyɛ mmerɛ,
na eyira so nningyein maa ɔyɛ yé.
11Sɛ afoɛ ne ba ayieleɛ a, ɛma bɛ sa noa adwuma yɛ yé,
na nekaa bɔ ɛkɔpɛ nu ne, né aleɛ poroporo gua.
12Bɛporoporo begua ɛserɛ so nekaa bɔ ngaka didi ɔ,
na pambaa nemɔ fa anigye bɛkera.
13Nekaa bɔ ngaka didi nemɔ, mmoaen ayi so tɛkyɛ,
bɔnza nemɔ anu, aburoo ayi bɛ nu tɛkyɛ,
na bɛbɔ ese bɛto dwein bedi ahurusi.

Title: EDWEIN 66
Content:
Nyameɛ te paa ma Yisrael
Edwein bɔ bɛfa bɛmane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛbɔ Nyameɛ nwo ese;
ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo animnyam dwein;
2ɛ́mɔfa ayɛyelɛ bɔ animnyam wɔ nu ɔ bɛ́ma ye.
3Ɛmɔhã behyire Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Wɔ nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa!
Ɔnate wɔ tumi kandinga ne ati, wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ koto wɔ gya bo.
4Aseɛ so nikyee biala sɔne wɔ;
bɛto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein,
bɛto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.”
Sela
5Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ:
ye nnwumaa bɔ ɔyɔ ye adasa mmaa nu ne, ɔyɛ suro.
6Ɔmane ɛpo kakyili aseɛ wosee
maa bɛnatele bɛ gya kunu bɛpɛle nzue ne.
Berɛ yeɛ yɛlili ahurusi wɔ ye nu ɔ,
7ye yeɛ ɔfa ye tumi ne di hene afebɔɔ ɔ,
ye yeɛ ye nye kɔ aporɔ wɔ wiase amukoraa ɔ,
nnɛma ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ bɛmoma bɛ nwo so.
Sela
8Ao maen maen, ɛ́mɔye yɛ Nyameɛ ayɛ,
ɛ́mɔma mmenia bɛte ayɛyelɛ bɔ ɛmɔye ye ne.
9Ye yeɛ wamaa yɛtɛ boka ateasefoɛ so,
bɔ wamma yanzoti ɔ.
10Ofikyɛ wɔ, ao Nyameɛ, aso yɛ anea;
aso yɛ anea kyɛbɔ bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo wɔ see nu ɔ.
11Ɛfale yɛ wurale ɛtɛen ne anu,
na ɛfale amaneɛnwunɛ adesoa tetale yɛ si.
12Amaa mmenia bahwi bafa yɛ ti so,
yɛfale see nu ne nzue nu,
nakoso aye yɛ afite afa yɛ awa nekaa bɔ anwonya pee wɔ ɔ.
13Ngɔfa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔwa w’awuro berɛ;
ngotua m’aboadeɛ mɔ ngɔma wɔ,
14bɔ ɔte bɔhyɛ bɔ ndele me noa nhyɛle,
bɔ ngane ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngɔle amaneɛ nu ne.
15Ngɔfa ngaka bɔ balɔ ɔ ngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔma wɔ,
ɔne mmoaen nyii afɔleɛ nwosina.
Ngɔbɔ nandwie nyii ne mbɔngye afɔleɛ.
Sela
16Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔsuro Nyameɛ ɔ, ɛmɔbra beetie,
na bɔ wayɔ wama me ne, ngɔhã ngohyire ɛmɔ.
17Ndeane nu nzu mvrɛle ye,
na mvale me noa ngamvole ye.
18Sɛ ndwenene bɔne nwo wɔ me ti anu a,
ahaa AWURADE andie me sufrɛ.
19Nakoso, amba, Nyameɛ atie me;
wayɛ asoɛ watie me mbaeɛ.
20Animnyam hã Nyameɛ ofikyɛ wambo me mbaeɛ,
yeɛ wamma ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wammɔ me.

Title: EDWEIN 67
Content:
Asennaa mbaeɛ
Sangoo dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto
1Ao Nyameɛ, nwu yɛ anwumvoin ná yira yɛ,
ma wɔ nyunu ɔta hyireinn ma yɛ,
Sela
2amaa ɔnate so banwu w’atee wɔ aseɛ ye aso,
ná banwu wɔ ngoalelɛ tumi ne wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu.
3Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ maen maen bɛye wɔ ayɛ,
odi kyɛ maen amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.
4Odi kyɛ maen maen bɛ nye gye ná bɛfa ahurusililɛ bɛto dwein,
ofikyɛ ɛfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ebua maen maen mɔ ndɛen,
na esa fa bu aseɛ ye aso maen maen mɔ.
Sela
5Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛye wɔ ayɛ,
amba, odi kyɛ maen amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.
6Aseɛ ahye aleɛ;
Nyameɛ, yɛ Nyameɛ ne, wayira yɛ.
7Nyameɛ koyira yɛ,
na odi kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so nekaa biala besuro ye.

Title: EDWEIN 68
Content:
Ayɛyelɛ ne asennaa mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nyameɛ, dwɔso, ná ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ aya;
bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, maa bɛnwati befi wɔ nyunu.
2Kyɛbɔ mvrama bɔ nwosina kɔ ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ foa bɛ maa bɛhɔ ɔ;
ao Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ sakyeɛ huro wɔ see nu ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ maa bɔnefoɛ bewuwu wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ.
3Nakoso teneneefoɛ de, ma bɛ nye ɔgye,
maa beli ahurusi wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu;
maa benya anigye mmorosoɛ.
4Ɛ́mɔto Nyameɛ nwo dwein,
ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein,
ɛ́mɔpɛ atimbire bɛ́ma bɔ ɔte nikyee so ɔnate munungum so ne;
ye dumaa ole AWURADE,
na ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ ye nyunu.
5Ayisiaafoɛ baba ne akunafoɛ neafoɛ,
ye ole Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye atenaleɛ krongron nu ne.
6Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔma sona bɔ olle bie ɔ awuro maa ɔtena nu ɔ;
ɔye kukunufoɛ fite maa oyie bɛ yé,
nakoso ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ de, bɛtena aseɛ katerepee so.
7Ao Nyameɛ, mmerɛ bɔ elili wɔ maen nyunu,
bɔ ɛnate fale ɛserɛ so ne,
Sela
8aseɛ wosole, na nyameɛso tɔle esue guale ase
wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Nyameɛ nyunu,
na Sinai wosole wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.
9Ao Nyameɛ, ɛmane esue tɔle pee guale nekaa biala;
ɛfa siesiele w’agyapadeɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔyɛle basaa ne.
10Wɔ mmenia nyane nekaa wɔ so bɛtenane;
ao Nyameɛ, wɔ paa ti ɛmane ehiafoɛ bɛ sa hane bɔ behia ɔ.
11AWURADE fa ye noa dwirɛ ne ɔma,
na bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ne, bɛsone pee.
12“Koɛhonɛfoɛ b’ahemvo mɔ bɛnwatinwati!”
Mmrasua bɔ bɛwɔ awuro yeɛ bɛkyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne ɔ,
13ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛlela mmoaennduin nu de,
nakoso bɛte kyɛ abubure bɔ ɛdwetɛ kata ye ndaa nwo,
ye ndɛkra te kyɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔte yerɛmyerɛm ɔ.
14Mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle ahemvo mɔ sandene wɔ berɛ ne,
ɔyɛle kyɛ asukɔtwea wɔ Salmon bokaa so.
15Nyameɛ bokaa, Basan bokaa;
mmokaa ndendenn, Basan bokaa!
16Mmokaa ndendenn, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ nye boro
bokaa bɔ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɔfa yɛ ye atenaleɛ ne ɔ?
Amba, nekaa bɔ AWURADE kɔtena afebɔɔ ne.
17Nyameɛ ye teaseɛnam mɔ bɛte apee aburanyɔ sɔ alaa buburugyaa,
AWURADE boka bɛ so, kyɛbɔ ɔboka bɛ so wɔ Sinai, nekaa krongron berɛ ne.
18Ɛfole bokaa tendenn ne,
elili bɛ bɔ ahye bɛ nnure ne nyunu
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ elele akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔte mmenia ɔ,
bɔ ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ po bɛboka so ɔ
amaa ɔnate so AWURADE Nyameɛ watena bɛ nu.
19Animnyam hã AWURADE
bɔ otira yɛ nu daa biala ne;
Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte yɛ ngoadefoɛ ɔ.
Sela
20Yɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔte ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ,
na Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte AWURADE ne, ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de sona fi ewue nu ɔ.
21Nakoso Nyameɛ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ de, ɔkɔpɛkyɛ bɛ ti,
bɛ bɔ bɛnate bɔne atee so ne, ɔkɔpakyepakye bɛ ti kwangoa.
22AWURADE nwa:
“Ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngofi Basan ngɔwa,
ngosa ngɔye bɛ ngofi ɛpo ye bo dɔ paa ngɔwa,
23amaa ɔnate so afa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ mogya anwunzi wɔ gya bo,
ná wɔ ngyea mɔ bɛ temverema anya mogya ne bie batafe.”
24Ao Nyameɛ, yanwu wɔ sandene krongron ne,
sandene bɔ me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte me hene ne, ɔto kɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne.
25Edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ li moa, sangoobɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ li nziɛ,
ndaluwa li bɛ nu bɛwoso akasaa kyɛ,
26“Ɛ́mɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu,
ɛmɔ bɔ Yisrael suli ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔhyɛ AWURADE animnyam!”
27Benyamin bɔ yeɛ ɔte abusua kure kaaba paa ne, ye yeɛ oli bɛ nyunu ɔ;
Yuda mbanyi baboa bɛ noa,
Sebulɔn mbanyi, Nafetali mbanyi.
28Ao Nyameɛ, kyire wɔ tumi,
ao Nyameɛ, kyire w’anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛyɛ mane yɛ daa ne.
29Ɔnate w’asɔneyɛɛ sua bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne ati,
ahemvo kɔbrɛ wɔ akyɛdeɛ.
30Ngaka aboyaa bɔ bɛwɔ nekaa bɔ elemmire wɔ ne,
nandwie nyii kure bɔ bafra maen maen nandwie mmaa mɔ nu ne, twi bɛ nyunu.
Bɛ bɔ ndɔlelɛ yɛ bɛ fɛ ne, fa bɛ wura wɔ gya bo,
bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye koɛ nwo ne, bɔ bɛ sande.
31Atitire kofi Misraim kɔwa;
Yitiopia kɔyɛ ndɛndɛ kɔma ye sa so kohyire Nyameɛ.
32Aseɛ so ahennie mɔ, ɛ́mɔto Nyameɛ nwo dwein;
ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
Sela
33Bɔ ɔnate ewienu anwuro anwuro, tetetete nyameɛso ne, ɛ́mɔto ye nwo dwein;
ɛ́mɔtie, ye komvi piri ne, ɔbɔ nu kurudududu.
34Nyameɛ bɔ odi Yisrael so hene,
bɔ ye tumi wɔ ewienu ne, ɛmɔhã kyɛ ole tumi.
35Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ suro wɔ w’atenaleɛ krongron berɛ.
Yisrael Nyameɛ ne,
ye yeɛ ɔma ye maen tumi ne anwoserɛ ɔ.
Animnyam hã Nyameɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 69
Content:
De me fi ndaneanyeɛ nu
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne.
1Ao Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me,
ofikyɛ nzue ne ayi waadwu me kɔme anu.
2Meme mekɔ aseɛnwo wɔ asaa pɛkyɛpɛkyɛ nu,
bɔ mennya nekaa memva me gya mendindim ɔ;
maadwu buma nu,
na asue ne wayi wabu wafa me so.
3Masu dee mayɛ mmerɛ;
me komvi ayɛ wosee.
Manea me Nyameɛ ate alaa
ama me nye ape atee bo.
4 Bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me mbaen ne,
bɛsone bɛtra me ti nwiaa;
bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me,
bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛpɛ edwirɛ bɛto me so ne, bɛ nwo yɛ se.
Nikyee bɔ nnwuale ɔ,
aso odi kyɛ mefa bie mesi ye gya nu?
5Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛse ngwaseasɛm bɔ mali ɔ;
me mvomsoɛ mvea wɔ wɔ nyunu.
6Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ,
bɛ bɔ bɛ wora wura wɔ nu ne,
nnɛmaa ɔnate me ti bɛ nyunu gua ase;
ao Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne,
nnɛmaa ɔnate me ti animguaseɛ kã bɛ.
7Ɔnate wɔ ti yeɛ male animguaseɛ ye,
animguaseɛ bɔ ɔmata me ye.
8Makakyi ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ nniɛma mɔ nu,
mayɛ amanvraniɛ wɔ me ni akunu mmaa mɔ nu.
9Ofikyɛ w’awuro nwo ɔdɔ bɔ nne ye ne,
ɔte see bɔ ogye wɔ me nu ɔ,
bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ wɔ alapaa ne, b’alapaa ne waagua me so.
10Mmerɛ bɔ nyɔle akɔngyere mva mmrɛle me kra ase ne,
ɔnate so maa bɛbɔle me alapaa.
11Mmerɛ bɔ mvale ɛsɛen tena nyɛle me tena ne,
ngakyili bɛ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.
12Bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anu ne, me nwo dwirɛ ala yeɛ bɛkã ɔ,
na me yeɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ bɛfa me bɛto dwein ɔ.
13Nakoso, ao AWURADE, me de, wɔ yeɛ mebɔ me mbaeɛ mekyire wɔ ɔ.
Ao Nyameɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu,
wɔ ɔdɔ totohyia bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, bua me.
Wɔ ngoalelɛ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
14pepɛ de me,
amaa ɔnate so mammi wɔ asaa pɛkyɛpɛkyɛ ne anu;
pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu,
ɔne buma ne anu.
15Nnɛma nzueyilɛ ne obungam fa me so,
nnɛma buma ne ɔme me,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛborɔ kumaa ne noa ɔkã tua sie me.
16Ao AWURADE,‘ tie me,
ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔte paa;
gyina w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne aso,
ná pɛne wɔ nye baanea me.
17Nnɛye wɔ nye fea wɔ somvoɛ,
ofikyɛ edwirɛ ato me, yiti yɛ ndɛ bua me.
18Twe pingye me kra, pepɛ de me,
me pɔfoɛ mɔ ati, maa nya me nwo ndete.
19Ɛse alapaa bɔ bɛbɔ me ɔ,
yeɛ m’animguaseɛ ne me ɛsopalɛ,
ɛse me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa.
20Alapaa ama me wora abɔ,
maa ɔnate so wabɔ me anwonyerɛ.
Ahaa mepena sona bɔ ɔkɔdodo me ɔ, nakoso mbaen ɔ;
yeɛ ahaa mepena aworakyekyerɛfoɛ, nakoso mannya ko po.
21Bɛfale ɛborɔ beguale m’aleɛ nu,
yeɛ nzuhɔen ku me ne,
bɛmane me nzaa kekarekekare kyɛ nno.
22 Bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ poen bɔ bato ne, maa ɔkakyi bɛ so ngaen;
ma bɛ nwo waenbɔlɛ ne, ɔkakyi bɛ so kafoli.
23Ma bɛ nye so yɛ tunn bɔ bennwu hwee ɔ,
ná ma bɛ sisia ɔpo bɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ daa.
24Ma wɔ nye boro bɛ so,
ná ma wɔ yaa bɔ afɛ ye hahii ne ɔhɔ bɛ so.
25Ma b’atenaleɛ ɔkakyi kurofoen,
yeɛ nnɛma ebiala tena b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.
26Ofikyɛ sona bɔ abɔ ye apura ye ne, bɛtane ye nye,
na bɛ bɔ apura bɛ ne, besa bɛmaa bɛfa yealɛ nu.
27Ma bɛ so hwenɛ ne, ɔtaataa so,
nnɛmaa bennya wɔ sa nu bɔnefakyɛ.
28Kyikyi bɛ dumaa fi ateasefoɛ nwomaa ne anu;
nnɛmaa bɛka bɛ bɛfra teneneefoɛ.
29Na me de, nwɔ amaneɛ nu, yeɛ medi aworabɔlɛ;
ao Nyameɛ, wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, maa ɔpagya me.
30Ngɔto dwein ngɔye Nyameɛ dumaa ayɛ,
ngɔfa asennaa ngɔhyɛ ye animnyam.
31AWURADE kohuro ɛhe kɔtra nandwie,
anaa nandwie nyii bɔ ole mmɛen bɔ ye gya nu apakye ɔ.
32Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bekonwu ye na bɛ nye kɔgye;
ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ne, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora ɔ́kyekye.
33Ofikyɛ AWURADE tie ehiafoɛ sufrɛ,
ná ye mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ amaneɛ nu ne, ommu bɛ animtia.
34Ma nyameɛso ne aseɛ,
yeɛ ɛpo ne nu ngaka amukoraa bɛye ye ayɛ.
35Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole Sion,
na okosa kɔkyekye Yuda nguro nemɔ,
na bɛkɔtena berɛ bɛkɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.
36Ye somvoɛ mɔ, bɛ mma mɔ kɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye ye dumaa nwo ne, bɛkɔtena so.

Title: EDWEIN 70
Content:
De me fi pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne kyɛ ɔte ngayeɛ afɔleɛ
(Edwein 40.13-17)
1Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ pepɛ de me.
Ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!
2Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne,
ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, ná bɛ nye so ɔtã.
Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me ne tɛɛ ne,
maa bɛtete besa bɛ si ná bɛ nyunu gua ase.
3Bɛ bɔ bɛkekã kyɛ, “Ehee, Ehee!” ne,
bɛ nwo nyanzoen ti, maa bɛtete besa bɛ si.
4Bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne amukoraa,
maa beli ahurusi, ná bɛ nye gye wɔ wɔ nu.
Bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ne,
maa bɛhã ye afebɔɔ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ te piri!”
5Nakoso wahia me, yeɛ meyɛ anwumvo.
Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ bra me berɛ!
Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ne me defoɛ ɔ;
Ao AWURADE, nnɛkyɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 71
Content:
AWURADE, nnɛye wɔ sa fi me bo
1Ao AWURADE, wɔ nu yeɛ mebɔ me nwo waen ɔ;
nnɛma me nyunu gua ase le.
2Wɔ tenenee ti, pepɛ de me,
ná maa nya me ti nnidi nu.
Yɛ asoɛ tie me, ná pepɛ de me.
3Yɛ me nyɔbotaen bɔ menwati mebafea wɔ nu daa ɔ.
Ayɛ nhyehyɛleɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpepɛ ekole me ngoa,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me nyɔbotaen ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.
4Ao me Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu,
pepɛ de me fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne atianuserɛfoɛ sa nu.
5Ofikyɛ ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anyelasoɛ ɔ,
ao AWURADE, ofi me ngwadaa nu, wɔ yeɛ me wora wura wɔ nu ɔ.
6Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole me ɔ, wɔ yeɛ mafa me nwo mato wɔ so ɔ;
wɔ yeɛ ɛfale me fili me ni akunu wale ɔ.
Ngɔye wɔ ayɛ daa biala.
7Mayɛ kyɛ anwanwadeɛ wɔ mmenia pee nye so,
nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.
8W’ayɛyelɛ ne w’animnyam
yeɛ mete me noa mekã ye daa biala ɔ.
9Me nworowaa nu, nnɛyakyi me nu;
sɛ menyi meyɛ mmerɛ a, nnɛpo me.
10Ofikyɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ kekã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛtetɛ me beku me ne, bɛbɔ nu betu asure.
11Bɛkekã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ apo ye,
yiti ɛ́mɔfoa ye bɛhye ye,
ofikyɛ ongonya defoɛ biala.”
12Ao Nyameɛ, nnɛyakyi me nu,
ao me Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!
13Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ me kwaadu ne,
ma bɛ nyunu gua ase ná bewuwu,
bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne,
ma nyanzoen ne animguaseɛ obia bɛ.
14Nakoso me de, ngonya anyelasoɛ daa,
na ngɔhɔ so ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
15Wɔ tenenee nnwumaa ne wɔ ngoalelɛ nnwumaa ne,
meka bɛ a, ɔbo me ndeaseɛ so de,
nakoso ngɔfa me noa ngɔbɔ bɛ nwo dawure mmerɛ biala.
16Ngɔwa wɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ anwoserɛ ne anu,
wɔ tenenee deɛ angome yeɛ ngɔye ye ayɛ ɔ.
17Ao Nyameɛ, ofi me mmerandeɛ nu yeɛ ahyirehyire me ɔ,
na mekɔ so mebɔ w’anwanwadeɛ nwo dawure.
18Yiti menyi meyɛ aworowaa ma me ti anu yɛ gyein a,
ao Nyameɛ, nnɛpo me,
kɔpem kyɛ ngɔbɔ w’anwoserɛ nwo dawure ngohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he,
ɔne wɔ tumi nwo dawure ngohyire ebiala bɔ ɔbaawa ɔ.
19Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ tenenee
kodwu anwuro anwuro.
Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ayɛ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ɔ;
nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ?
20Wɔ bɔ amaa manwu amaneɛ pee ye,
ekosa kɔmaa ngonya ngoa;
na ekosa kɔye me kofi aseɛ bo dɔ kɔwa.
21Ɛkɔmaa ngonya animnyam bɔ ɔte piri ɔ,
ná ekosa kɔkyekye me wora.
22Ao me Nyameɛ, ɔnate wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ti,
ngosa ngɔbɔ adengum ngɔye wɔ ayɛ;
Ao Yisrael Krongronniɛ,
ngɔfa sangoo ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
23Me noa kɔbɔ ese koli ahurusi
mmerɛ bɔ meto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ,
yeɛ me kra bɔ apepɛ ale ye ne koso, ɔkɔyɔ sɔ ala.
24Mmerɛ biala, me noa koso kɔhã wɔ tenenee nwo dwirɛ,
ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne,
bafɛre, na bɛ nyunu agua ase.

Title: EDWEIN 72
Content:
Dawide bɔ mbaeɛ ma Solomon ahennie
Dawide dwein. Ɔto mane Solomon
1Ao Nyameɛ, fa wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne ma ɛhene ne,
ná fa wɔ tenenee ne ma ɛhene awa ne.
2Maa ɔfa tenenee obu wɔ maen ne,
na ɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so.
3Ma mmokaa nemɔ bɛfa asomdwee bɛbrɛ wɔ maen,
ná ma pambaa nemɔ koso bɛfa tenenee bɛbra.
4Maa oli maen ne anu ehiafoɛ bɛ dwirɛ ɔma bɛ;
maa ɔpepɛ ole bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ,
ná obubu aminɛlilɛfoɛ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ.
5Kyɛ eyia tɛbɔ ye, ɔne kyɛ ɛsraen tɛta ye,
ma wɔ maen besuro wɔ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
6Ɛhene ne, maa ɔyɛ kyɛ esue
bɔ ɔtɔ gua ɛserɛ bɔ bapɛ so ɔ so,
kyɛ nyenyenzue bɔ ɔdoadoa aseɛ so ɔ.
7Ye aberɛ so, ma tenenee obu so,
ná asomdwee pee ɔbra, kɔpem kyɛ ɛsraen ɔnne berɛ ko ɔ.
8Ma ye ahennie ɔtrɛ fi ɛpo ɔɔhã ɛpo,
ofi asue ne ɔɔhã aseɛ noa.
9Ma bɛ bɔ bɛte ɛserɛ so ne bɛkoto wɔ ye nyunu,
ná ma ye pɔfoɛ mɔ beli mvuture.
10Tasise ahemvo ne dedeede aseɛ ahemvo nemɔ,
maa betua ndɔ bɛma ye;
ma Hyeba ne Seba ahemvo mɔ
bɛfa akyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ ye.
11Maa ahemvo amukoraa bɛkoto wɔ ye nyunu,
ná maen maen amukoraa bɛso ye.
12Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo, ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ belle bokafoɛ ne,
besu bɛfrɛ ye a, ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ.
13Okonwu ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ anwumvoin,
na okole ehiafoɛ kra ngoa.
14Okole bɛ ngoa kofi nhyɛsoɛ ne nzɛmmɔne nu,
na bɛ mogya koli mu wɔ ye nye so.
15Maa onyi ɔhyɛ!
Maa bɛfa Hyeba esikaa kɔkorɛ bɛma ye.
Maa bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ye daa,
ná bɛsrɛ saleɛ bɛma ye daa biala.
16Ma aleɛ obu so wɔ aseɛ ne aso,
maa aleɛ ɔhye wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso po,
ma ye aleɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon;
na ma mmenia benyi frɔmfrɔm wɔ nguro nemɔ aso
kyɛ aseɛ so ndire.
17Ma ye dumaa ɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ,
na kyɛ eyia wɔ berɛ ye, maa ɔhɔ so onya dumaa,
ma mmenia bɛfa ye so benya saleɛ,
na ma maen maen amukoraa bɛfrɛ ye sona bɔ wanya saleɛ ɔ.
18Animnyam hã AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ,
bɔ ye ngome yeɛ ɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ ne.
19Ye animnyam dumaa ne, odi kyɛ bɛye ye ayɛ daa,
na ma ye animnyam oyi aseɛ ye amukoraa so tɛkyɛ.
Amen, Amen.
20Yese awa Dawide ye mbaeɛ ne, ye ayieleɛ ɛne.

Title: EDWEIN 73
Content:
Nwomaa bɔ ɔtɔ so nza
Edwein 73—78
De me fi ndaneanyeɛfoɛ sa nu
Asafe dwein
1Amba, Nyameɛ te paa ma Yisrael,
ɔte paa ma bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te fufue ɔ.
2Nakoso me de, ahaa mesoti;
ɔhale sɔaa maa mvini ase.
3Ofikyɛ me nye borole mmeraatolɛfoɛ,
mmerɛ bɔ nwuni bɔnefoɛ bɛ ngɔsoɛ ne.
4Ofikyɛ nikye fee nha bɛ;
bɛte apɔ, yeɛ bɛ nwonaen te mmenanwo mmenanwo.
5Edwirɛ ndoto bɛ kyɛ mmenia ngaa nemɔ,
yeɛ ɛhawo ndoto bɛ kyɛ mmenia ngaa nemɔ.
6Yiti bafa anwomasoɛ baya kyɛ akomuade;
bahera basabasayɔlɛ kyɛ ɛtena.
7Bayɛ piri ma bɛ nye asi ayɛ kutukutuu,
ngwaseasɛm yeɛ wayi bɛ ti anu to ɔ.
8Bɛgoro mmenia nwo, na bɛ noa dwirɛ te bɔne,
bele anwomasoɛ benwunanwuna mmenia.
9Bedwudwo betia nyameɛso,
yeɛ bɛ noa tia ebiala wɔ aseɛ ye aso.
10Ɔnate sɔ ati, bɛ mmenia fa bɛ nwo kɔbɔ bɛ,
na benya bɛ nwo bedidi.
11Na bebisa kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Nyameɛ wanwu ye?
Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne, aso ɔse bɔ ɔkɔ so ɔ?”
12Nea, kyɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛte hɔ ɛne:
bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ daa, na bɛkɔ so benya bɛ nwo.
13Nahorɛ nu, m’ahone bɔ mate nu sannwuu ne,
ɔne me sa bɔ manwunzi mafa mahyire kyɛ medi be ne,
mafɛ magua mbaen.
14Daa biala, ɛhawo angome yeɛ ɔba me so ɔ,
na ngyerɛmɔ biala bɛtwe me so.
15Sɛ ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔma sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ kofite me noa” a,
ahaa né manni nahorɛ mamma wɔ mma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mɔ.
16Nakoso nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ mepena kyɛ mete sɔ nikyee ne abo ne,
nwuni kyɛ ɔte adwuma bɔ ɔyɛ se paa ɔ,
17kɔpem kyɛ ngɔle Nyameɛ nekaa krongron berɛ,
ná nwuni kyɛbɔ okosi koyie bɛ ɔ.
18Amba, ɛfa bɛ gyina nekaa bɔ ɔyɛ ndono ɔ,
ɛmaa befi ase ma b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ.
19Nea, b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ mvum nu,
bɔ amaneɛ ama bɛ boso anua koraa!
20Sɛ sona da dwɔso a, bɛte kyɛ laleɛ bie,
yeɛ wɔ AWURADE koso, sɛ ɛkekã wɔ nwo a, ebu bɛ kyɛ laleɛ bie.
21Mmerɛ bɔ me kra lili aworabɔlɛ ne,
mmerɛ bɔ mmotole ne,
22né nde kyɛ sona kwaseaa bɔ ɔnze hwee ɔ,
nyɛle kyɛ kaka bie wɔ wɔ nye so.
23Nakoso me de, ngɔtena wɔ nwo daa;
etira me sa famaa ne anu.
24Ɛfa wɔ foɛtulɛ ekyire me atee,
na ye si ye, ekole me kɔhɔ animnyam nu.
25Nwa yeɛ nne ye wɔ nyameɛso ɔ, sana wɔ ala?
Yeɛ membena hwee wɔ aseɛ ye aso, sana wɔ ala.
26Me nwonaen ne m’ahone kɔyɛ mmerɛ de,
nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte m’ahone anwoserɛ ne me kyɛfa afebɔɔ ɔ.
27Ofikyɛ amba, bɛ bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi wɔ nwo ne, bɛ boso konua,
na bɛ bɔ bɛyakyi wɔ si lilɛ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi wɔ nwo ne, enua bɛ boso.
28Nakoso me de, ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ngopingye Nyameɛ ɔ;
mafa AWURADE Nyameɛ mayɛ m’afealeɛ,
amaa ɔnate so mabɔ wɔ nnwumaa mukoraa nwo dawure.

Title: EDWEIN 74
Content:
De maen ne fi amaneɛ nu
Asafe dwein
1Ao Nyameɛ, nzu ati yeɛ apo yɛ afebɔɔ ye?
Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ mmoaen bɔ ɛma bɛ aleɛ ne,
nzu ati yeɛ afɛ yɛ so yaa kandinga ye?
2Kaye wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛtɔle bɛ tetetete ne,
bɛ bɔ ɛpɔle bɛ fale bɛ yɛle abusua kure bɔ ɔte w’agyapadeɛ ne.
Kaye Sion bokaa bɔ aatena so ne.
3Tu agyirɛ bra nekaa bɔ wakakyi kurofoen bɔkɔɔ ne;
pɔfoɛ ne wasɛkye nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein amukoraa.
4Bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, bɛbɔ ese wɔ wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ;
bafa bɛ ngonim frangaa mɔ bapenapena berɛ.
5Bɛte kyɛ mmenia bɔ betiratira akumaa,
bɔ bebu mmakaa wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ɔ.
6Na afei bele akumaa ne bɔsobaka
babubu nu nningyein bɔ base amukoraa.
7Bato wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu see;
bafa efiɛ bahã wɔ dumaa krongron atenaleɛ ne,
na badwiri bagua ase.
8Bɛhane ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ, “Yɛkoli bɛ so ngonim bɔkɔɔ,”
na bayera Nyameɛ nyianu nekaa biala wɔ aseɛ ne aso.
9Yɛnnwu yɛ frangaa nemɔ;
ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala nne berɛ ko;
na yɛ nu biala nze kyẽa bɔ ɛhe bo kɔpɛ ɔ.
10Ao Nyameɛ, bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, kyinzu koraa yeɛ bɛ ngorohoɛ ne okoodwu ɔ?
Pɔfoɛ ne, aso ɔkɔsɛkye wɔ dumaa afebɔɔ anaa?
11Nzu ati yeɛ ahwe w’anwoserɛ asaa ne asa ye?
Nzu ati yeɛ afa wɔ sa ne agua wɔ hue so ye?
12Nakoso Nyameɛ, ɛte me hene fi tete
bɔ ede ngoa wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.
13Wɔ tumi yeɛ ɛfa pakyepakyele ɛpo nu ɔ,
na wɔ yeɛ ɛpɛkyɛle sasrabɔnzam nemɔ ti wɔ nzue nemɔ anu ɔ.
14Ɛlɛngyɛen ne, ɛgorɔgorɔle ye ti nemɔ,
na ɛfa mane ɛserɛsofoɛ maa belili.
15Ebukyele asue mɔ ne asue ba mɔ maa bɛtengyɛle,
nakoso ɛmane asue mbiri mɔ bɛwewele.
16Alehyeleɛ te wɔ deɛ, yeɛ alesaleɛ koso te wɔ deɛ;
ɛsraen ne eyia koso, wɔ yeɛ ɛfale bɛ tuatuale berɛ ɔ.
17Wɔ yeɛ ɛtole aseɛ ye noa amukoraa ɛwɛen ɔ,
wɔ yeɛ ɛhyehyɛle ahuhuro ne prakasua mmerɛ ɔ.
18Ao AWURADE, kaye ɛhe: kyɛbɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔyɛ ngorohoɛ ɔ,
ɔne kyɛbɔ ngwaseafoɛ begua wɔ dumaa nwo fiɛ ɔ.
19W’aborɔma ne, nnɛfa ye kra wura ngaka aboyaa mɔ sa;
yeɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, nnɛma wɔ wora fi bɛ ngoa le.
20Kaye apam ne,
ofikyɛ aseɛ ne aso nekaa bɔ wayɛ awosii kabii ne,
nzɛmmɔnelilɛ ayi berɛ tɛkyɛ.
21Sona bɔ bɛhyɛ ye so ne, nnɛmaa ɔfa animguaseɛ osa ba,
yeɛ ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, odi kyɛ bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.
22Ao Nyameɛ, dwɔso, dwudwo nu maa benwu kyɛ edi be;
kaye kyɛbɔ ngwaseafoɛ bɛgoro wɔ nwo daa biala ɔ.
23Nnɛma wɔ wora fi bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkekã ɔ,
ɔne mmenia bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, bɛ gyegyegyegye bɔ ɔkɔ anwuro daa ne.

Title: EDWEIN 75
Content:
Nyameɛ yeɛ obua wiase amukoraa ndɛen ɔ
Asafe dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Yɛda wɔ ase, ao Nyameɛ, yɛda wɔ ase;
wɔ dumaa pingye.
Wɔ sa noa nnwumaa nwanwa ne, mmenia bɔ ye nwo dawure.
2Sɛ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ne ɔso a,
ngɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ngobua ndɛen ɔ.
3Sɛ aseɛ ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa bɛwoso a,
me yeɛ mema ye bonima mɔ begyina pindinn ɔ.
Sela
4Sona bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, mekã mekyire ye kyɛ, “Nnɛhoahoa wɔ nwo,”
yeɛ mekã mekyire bɔnefoɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛfa wɔ tumi hoahoa wɔ nwo;
5nnɛfa wɔ tumi hoahoa wɔ nwo koraa,
yeɛ nnɛdwudwo ahandaen so.”
6Ofikyɛ ngɔsoɛ mvi eyia afiteleɛ anaa eyia atɔleɛ yeɛ ɔba ɔ,
yeɛ omvi ngwaen koso,
7na mmom Nyameɛ yeɛ obua ndɛen ɔ:
ɔbrɛ ebie ase, ná wapagya ebie koso.
8Ofikyɛ AWURADE tira kwangoa bie wɔ ye sa nu,
bɔ nzaa bɔ ye noa yɛ hye, bɔ opu ahure wɔ nu ɔ;
okohwie nzaa ne bie,
na wiase bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔno bekotu ye bo.
9Nakoso me de, ngɔbɔ ye nwo dawure afebɔɔ;
ngɔto Yakob Nyameɛ ayɛyelɛ dwein.
10Ngotu bɔnefoɛ b’anwoserɛ amukoraa bo,
nakoso teneneefoɛ b’anwoserɛ de, ɔkɔhɔ anwuro.

Title: EDWEIN 76
Content:
Nyameɛ di ngonim ma Yisrael
Asafe dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto
1Ebiala se Nyameɛ wɔ Yuda,
na ye dumaa te piri wɔ Yisrael.
2Ye tena sua wɔ Salem,
na ye atenaleɛ wɔ Sion.
3Berɛ yeɛ obubuli agyaen bɔ bɛte see yerɛmyerɛm,
akokyɛm mɔ, ngrandɛ ne akodeɛ mɔ nu ɔ.
Sela
4Ele animnyam, ele ahennie nu animnyam
tra mmokaa bɔ betimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne.
5Bale ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ sa nu koɛ nzesadeɛ;
batotɔ, na koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ,
bɛ nu biala wangora wango.
6Ao Yakob Nyameɛ, ɛteateane bɛ ne,
pɔngɔhanɛniɛ ne ɔne ye pɔngɔ ne, bɛlale berɛ pakayaa.
7Nakoso wɔ de, wɔ nwo yɛ suro!
Sɛ ɛfɛ yaa a,
nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora wɔ nyunu gyina ɔ?
8Ebuale ndɛen wɔ nyameɛso maa yɛtele;
ɛserɛ hane aseɛ, na ɔyɛle dinn,
9mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ dwɔsole buale ndɛen,
kyɛ ɔfa pepɛ ode aseɛ ye aso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ amukoraa ne.
Sela
10“Amba, mmenia yaafɛlɛ po, ɔkakyi ayɛyelɛ ma wɔ;
wɔ yaafɛlɛ piri ne, ɛfa ye ngaa bɔ abɔsoɛ.
11Odi kyɛ ɛmɔhyehyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ, na ɛmɔtua,
bɛ bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne amukoraa, odi kyɛ ebiala ɔfa akyɛdeɛ
ɔbrɛ ye bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ne.
12Ye yeɛ ɔbrɛ ahemvo mɔ b’ahandaen ase ɔ,
na ye yeɛ ye nwo yɛ aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ suro ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 77
Content:
Yɛkaye Nyameɛ anwanwadeɛ bɔ wayɔ ɔ
Asafe dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Metea nu mesu mefrɛ Nyameɛ,
metea nu serɛ mefrɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔte me sufrɛ ɔ.
2M’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, mepena AWURADE si atee;
sɛ odwu kɔngɔen a, metrɛtrɛ me sa nu bɔ me sa onnya ɔ;
me kra mbene so kyɛ bɛkɔkyekye ye wora ɔ.
3Sɛ mekaye Nyameɛ a, me wora bɔ,
medwene ye dwirɛ nwo, na me sunzum boto.
Sela
4Ɛmma me nye ngo.
Menwu amaneɛ maa mengora dwudwo po.
5Mekaye daa tete mmerɛ ne,
tetetete afoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ nu bahɔ ne.
6Mekaye me kɔngɔen dwein;
medwenedwene ye nwo wɔ me ti anu, na me sunzum pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ nu.
7Aso AWURADE kɔpo me afebɔɔ
bɔ ongonwu me anwumvoin ko ɔ?
8Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, aso so apɛ koraa anaa?
Ye bɔhyɛ nemɔ, aso bɛ bo apɛ ama aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa anaa?
9Aso Nyameɛ wora afi kyɛ ɔkɔlo sona ɔ?
Aso wafɛ yaa maa wayakyi ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne anaa?
Sela
10Yeɛ menwa, “Sɔ dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔyɛ me yea ɔ,
nakoso ngɔkaye afoɛ mɔ bɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne ohyirele ye tumi ne.”
11Ngɔkaye AWURADE nnwumaa bɔ ɔyɔ ne;
amba, ngɔkaye wɔ daa tete anwanwadeɛ nemɔ.
12Ngɔdwenedwene wɔ nnwumaa amukoraa nwo,
ná masusu w’anwanwadeɛ mɔ nwo.
13Ao Nyameɛ, w’atee te krongron.
Nzikyɛ nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte piri kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ye ɔ?
14Wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛyɛ anwanwadeɛ mɔ ɔ,
bɔ ahyire wɔ tumi wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ.
15Wɔ maen bɔ ye ole Yakob ne Yosef boso ama ne,
ɛfale wɔ tumi asaa ne yeɛ ɛpepɛ lele bɛ ɔ.
Sela
16Ao Nyameɛ, nzue nemɔ bɛ nye bɔle wɔ so ne,
nzue nemɔ bɛ nye bɔle wɔ so ne, ɛserɛ hane bɛ;
amba, buma ne koso ahunundetelɛ tɔle ye so.
17Munungum hwiele esue guale tatatata,
ewienu bobɔle nu kurudududu;
na w’agyaen nemɔ koso tetele yerɛmyerɛm.
18Bɛtele w’agralaa ne nga wɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ nu;
w’agralaa tale wiase hyireinn,
na aseɛ wosole gigigigi.
19W’atimbire la ɛpo nu,
w’atee la asue mbiri mɔ nu,
nakoso bennwu wɔ gya boso.
20Ɛnate Mose ne Aarɔn so
elili wɔ maen nyunu kyɛbɔ bedi mmoaen kure nyunu ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 78
Content:
Yisrael yɛ Nyameɛ so asoserɛ
Asafe dwein
1Ao me maen, ɛ́mɔtie me ngyerɛkyerɛ;
ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie me noa dwirɛ!
2Ngobukye me noa ngobu anyandera.
Ngɔhã tete dwirɛ bɔ ye bo telɛ yɛ se ɔ,
3edwirɛ bɔ yate ná yanwu ye,
bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bahã bahyire yɛ ɔ.
4Yɛngɔfa yɛngɔfea bɛ mma mɔ,
na mmom aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔba ye, yɛkɔhã yɛkohyire bɛ:
AWURADE animnyam nnwumaa ne ye tumi,
ɔne anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wayɔ ɔ.
5Ɔhyehyɛle ahyɛdeɛ wɔ Yakob nu,
na ɔhyɛle mmeraa wɔ Yisrael nu.
Ɔfa yɛle ahyɛdeɛ mane yɛ nana mɔ,
kyɛ bɛfa behyirehyire bɛ mma mɔ,
6amaa ɔnate so aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ne,
bɔ bɛ ole ngwadaa bɔ bennya bɛwwole bɛ ne, banwu mmeraa ne,
ná badwɔso bahã bahyire bɛ maa mɔ,
7amaa ɔnate so bafa bɛ wora bawura Nyameɛ nu,
ná bɛ wora amvi Nyameɛ sa noa nnwumaa,
na mmom bali ye mmeraa dwirɛ so.
8Ɛhe kɔmaa bɛngɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ nana mɔ,
bɔ né bɛte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ asoserɛfoɛ bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ,
aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ bamva bɛ nwo bando Nyameɛ so,
bɔ bɛ sunzum wanni nahorɛ wamma Nyameɛ ɔ.
9Efraimfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ betiratira agyaen ɔ,
bɛnwati befili koɛ noa koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne.
10Banni Nyameɛ apam ne aso,
yeɛ bɛyɛle b’adwene kyɛ bengoli mmeraa ne aso.
11Bɛmane bɛ wora fili bɔ wayɔ ɔ,
ɔne anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wala ye ali wahyire bɛ ɔ.
12 Ɔyɔle anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ bɛ nana mɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ,
wɔ Misraim aseɛ so, wɔ Soan aseɛ pralaa ne aso.
13Ɔpakyele ɛpo nu maa bɛfale nu,
na ɔmane nzue ne boale ye noa gyinane berɛ kyɛ fasue.
14Alehyeleɛ nu, né ɔfa munungum di bɛ nyunu,
na alesaleɛ nu amukoraa, né ɔfa see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi yeɛ odi bɛ nyunu ɔ.
15Odwudwale nyɔbotaen mɔ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso,
na ɔmane bɛ nzue pee kyɛ buma nu nzue maa bɛnone.
16Ɔmane asue mɔ pukyele fili nyɔbotaen ne anu,
na ɔmane nzue tengyɛle kyɛ asue.
17Nakoso bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne betiale ye,
na bɛyɔle Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne nwo lɔen wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.
18Besole Nyameɛ bɛneane wɔ b’ahone nu,
ofikyɛ bebisale aleɛ bɔ bɛ komvi wɔ so ɔ kitii.
19Bedwudwo betiale Nyameɛ kyɛ,
“Aso Nyameɛ kɔhora kɔma yɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so?
20Ɔpakyele nyɔbotaen nu mane nzue pu wale,
na asue mɔ yi bu fale so de,
nakoso aso ɔkɔhora kɔma aleɛ,
anaa naen bɔ ɔkɔso ye maen ɔ?”
21Yiti AWURADE tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ye ahone huli paa,
ye yaa sɔle kyɛ see tiale Yakob,
ye ahone huli Yisrael so paa,
22ofikyɛ banne Nyameɛ banni,
na bamva bɛ wora banwura ye ngoalelɛ ne anu.
23Nakoso ɔhyɛle ewienu bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro,
na obukyele nyameɛso anoa nemɔ;
24na ɔtɔle manna kyɛ esue guale bɛ so kyɛ beli,
na ɔmane bɛ nyameɛso aleɛ.
25Adasa mmaa belili abɔfo aleɛ;
Nyameɛ mane bɛ aleɛ maa obuli bɛ so.
26Ɔmane eyia afiteleɛ mvrama bɔle wɔ ewienu,
na ɔnate ye tumi so mane ngwaen dɔ mvrama bɔle.
27Ɔtɔle naen guale bɛ so kyɛ mvuture,
ɔne nnomaa bɔ bele ndaa kyɛ mboanoa anweaa.
28Ɔmaa bɛtete beguale b’asikyeleɛ ne anu
bɛpɛle b’atenaleɛ nemɔ anwo bɛbra beyiale.
29Belili mane bɛ ko yili paa,
ofikyɛ ɔmane bɛ bɔ bɛ komvi wɔ so ɔ.
30Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ komvi tɛwɔ so,
bɔ né aleɛ ne tɛ wura bɛ noa nu ne,
31Nyameɛ fɛle bɛ so yaa,
ohuhuni bɛ nu anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ,
na ɔbobɔle Yisraelfoɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ guale berɛ.
32Nakoso ɛhe amukoraa si ne, bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne,
banne ye anwanwadeɛ ne banni.
33Yiti ɔpɛle bɛ ngoa so kyɛ nwomeɛ,
bɔ b’afoɛ bɔ wahã ne ɔɔyɛle ahunundetelɛ ɔ.
34Ohuhuni bɛ ne, bɛpenane ye si atee;
bɛsakyerale b’adwene bɛpenane Nyameɛ si atee yé paa.
35Afei bɛkayele kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ nyɔbotaen ɔ,
na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ Defoɛ ɔ.
36Nakoso bɛ noa yeɛ bɛfa bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛle ye ɔ,
nnakannaka dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã bekyire ye ɔ.
37B’ahone nu, banni nahorɛ bamma ye,
banni ye apam ne anwo nahorɛ.
38Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɔse anwumvoin ne ati,
ɔfale b’amumuyɛɛ hyɛle bɛ,
na wangukũ bɛ.
Né ɔtaa ɔtwe ye yaa sa nziɛ,
na wamva ye yaa ne amukoraa wangua bɛ so.
39Ɔkayele kyɛ bɛte kuro mmenia,
bɛte kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ bɔ onza mma ko ɔ.
40Amba, bɛyɛle ye nwo lɔen wɔ ɛserɛ so mmerɛ pee,
na bɛmane ye wora bɔle wɔ ɛserɛ so!
41Besole Nyameɛ bɛneane mmerɛ pee,
na bewurale Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne apue.
42Bangaye ye tumi ne,
anaa kyẽa bɔ olele bɛ fili pɔfoɛ ne sa nu ɔ,
43mmerɛ bɔ ɔyɔle ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ Misraim,
ɔne ye anwanwadeɛ wɔ Soan aseɛ pralaa so ne.
44Ɔkakyili b’asue mɔ mogya,
amaa ɔnate so bangora banno b’asue ba mɔ nu nzue.
45Ɔsomane atuin pembepembe paa wɔ bɛ berɛ maa bɛɛkekale bɛ,
ɔne mborohyɛen maa bɛɛteeteele bɛ.
46Ɔmane nduro mɔ lili bɛ fieso nningyein,
na ɔmane mmɛbɛ lili aleɛ bɔ bafɛ ye nwo banya ne koso.
47Ɔtɔle asukɔtwea fa sɛkyele bɛ bobe mɔ,
na ɔfale ɛborɔ sɛkyele b’akyea mmakaa mɔ.
48Ɔtɔle asukɔtwea huhuni bɛ nandwie mɔ,
yeɛ ɔtetele agralaa huhuni bɛ mmoaen mɔ.
49Ɔsomane ye ahonehulɛ piri,
ye yaafɛlɛ piri, anyeborolɛ ne amaneɛ,
yeɛ abɔfo kure bɔ bɛsɛkye nningyein ɔ maa bɛhɔle bɛ so.
50Ɔmane ye nye borole bɛ so,
wambepɛ wanne bɛ wamvi ewue sa nu,
na mmom ɔfale bɛ ngoa wurale ɛhawo piri ne sa.
51Misraimfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraa,
bɔ bɛte bɛ bienzua nu anwoserɛ bɔ oli moa ne,
ohuhuni bɛ wɔ Ham ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.
52Na afei olili ye mmenia nyunu kyɛ mmoaen,
na ohyirele bɛ atee kyɛ mmoaen kure wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.
53Olili bɛ nyunu wɔ asomdwee nu ma yiti banzuro,
nakoso bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ de, ɛpo ne bu fale bɛ so.
54Ɔfale bɛ wale ye aseɛ krongron ne aso,
bokaa bɔ ye tumi asaa ne waho wale ne aso.
55Ɔfoane maen maen mɔ fili bɛ nyunu;
ɔhyɛle b’aseɛ maa bɛfa bɛyɛle b’agyapadeɛ,
na ɔmane Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛtenatenane b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.
56Nakoso besole Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne bɛneane,
bɛyɛle ye nwo lɔen.
Banni ye noa dwirɛ so,
57na mmom belili ye nwo makyebu,
na banni nahorɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ yɔle ne ala;
bɛmane bɛ bra hyeale kyɛ agyaen bɔ wakondo ɔ.
58Ofikyɛ bɛfale b’asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ bewurale ye apue maa ɔfɛle yaa;
na b’amoen nemɔ ati, Nyameɛ hwene bɛ nwo nungunɛ.
59Nyameɛ nwuni ye sɔ ne, ɔfɛle yaa paa,
na ɔpole Yisrael koraa.
60Ye atenaleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Silo,
ɛtena sua bɔ ɔtenane nu wɔ adasa mmaa nu ne, ɔpole ye.
61Ɔmaa bɛhyele ye anwoserɛ ne nnure,
yeɛ ɔfale ye animnyam wurale ye pɔfoɛ sa.
62Ɔmane ye mmenia totɔle ngrandɛ noa,
na ɔfɛle ye agyapadeɛ so yaa piri paa.
63See yerale bɛ mmerandeɛ mɔ,
na ye sɔ ti, bɛ ndaluwa mɔ bannya ebiala maa wangya bɛ.
64B’asɔfo mɔ totɔle ngrandɛ noa,
bɔ bɛ kunafoɛ mɔ bangora banzu bɛ ɔ.
65Yeɛ AWURADE dwɔsole kyɛ sona bɔ ofi nnaa nu ɔ,
kyɛ anwoserɛniɛ bɔ nzaa maa ɔteatea nu ɔ.
66Ohuhuni ye pɔfoɛ mɔ pasapasa,
na oguale bɛ nyunu ase afebɔɔ.
67Ɔpole Yosef ɛtena sua ne,
na ɔneaneane nu ne, wanye Efraim abusua kure;
68na mmom ɔneaneane nu yele Yuda abusua kure,
bɔ ye ole Sion bokaa bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ ne.
69Osili ye nekaa krongron bɔ ɔte kyɛ nyameɛso anwuro anwuro ne,
bɔ ɔte kyɛ aseɛ bɔ wafa watimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne.
70Ɔneaneane nu yele ye somvoɛ Dawide,
ɔyele ye fili mmoaen so nealɛ nu,
71mmoaen bɔ bɛma bɛ mma nyɔfone ne, ɔmaa ɔyakyili bɛ so nealɛ,
kyɛ ɔɔnea ye maen Yakob,
bɔ ye ole Yisrael bɔ ɔte ye agyapadeɛ ne aso.
72Dawide yele ye ti anu fitaa neane bɛ so,
na ɔfale nimdeɛ atee so lili bɛ nyunu.

Title: EDWEIN 79
Content:
AWURADE, nwu wɔ maen anwumvoin
Asafe dwein
1 Ao Nyameɛ, maen maen mɔ bafa koɛ baateta w’agyapadeɛ,
bafa efiɛ bahã w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne,
babɔ Yerusalem kuro ne.
2Bafa wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɛ fuin
bama ewienu nnomaa maa bali,
bafa w’anwoteefoɛ bɛ naen
bama aseɛ so ngaka.
3Bahã bɛ mogya bagua kyɛ nzue
bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia,
na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okosie bɛ bɔ batotɔ nemɔ ɔ.
4Yayɛ ngorohoɛ nikyee wɔ yɛ mmango mɔ nye so,
bɛ bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne,
bɛsere yɛ bɛkã yɛ anyinga.
5Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaapem kyinzu?
Aso ɛkɔfɛ yɛ so yaa afebɔɔ anaa?
Wɔ nungunɛhwenɛ ne, aso okogye kyɛ see?
6Amaen maen mɔ bɔ bɛnze wɔ ne,
bɛ ne ahennie mɔ
bɔ bɛmmɔ wɔ dumaa ne,
ma w’ahone hu bɛ so paa.
7Ofikyɛ bayɛ Yakob pasapasa,
na bama ye atenaleɛ akakyi kurofoen.
8Yɛ nana mɔ amumuyɛɛ ne, nnɛfa ye nwo ngyeleɛ kye yɛ,
na nwu yɛ anwumvoin ndɛndɛ,
ofikyɛ babrɛ yɛ ase bɔkɔɔ.
9Ao, yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, boka yɛ,
ɔnate wɔ dumaa nwo animnyam ti;
pepɛ de yɛ, ná fa yɛ bɔne kyɛ yɛ,
ɔnate wɔ dumaa ti.
10Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bebisa kyɛ,
“Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua” ɔ?
Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɛ mogya so wereɛtɔlɛ ne,
ma maen maen mɔ benwu ye bɔ yɛ koso yɛ nye tua ɔ.
11Ma kukunufoɛ bɛ penenɛ bɔ bɛpene ne, odwu wɔ nyunu;
gyina wɔ tumi piri ne aso
pepɛ de bɛ bɔ bɛbaahu bɛ ne.
12Ao AWURADE, ngorohoɛ bɔ maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia bɛgoro wɔ nwo ne,
tua bɛ so kerɛ pɛen nzoo.
13Na ɔnate so yɛ bɔ yɛte wɔ maen,
mmoaen bɔ yɛdidi wɔ sa nu ne,
yɛkɔla wɔ ase afebɔɔ;
ofi aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ kɔka aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ,
yɛkɔhɔ so yɛkɔye wɔ ayɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 80
Content:
AWURADE, ma wɔ maen ɔpe ye daa nu
Asafe adanzeɛ ne ye dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Yisrael Neafoɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie,
wɔ bɔ eli Yosef nyunu kyɛ mmoaen kure ɔ!
Wɔ bɔ ɛte kɛrubim mɔ so ɔ, ta hyireinn
2wɔ Efraim, Benyamin ne Manase so.
Kyire wɔ tumi,
ná bra baapepɛ de yɛ!
3Ao Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ;
te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.
4Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ,
wɔ maen mbaeɛ ne, ɛkɔfɛ ye nwo yaa maa okoodwu kyinzu?
5Afa bɛ nye moen ayɛ aleɛ maa bali,
yeɛ ama bɛ moen pembepembe maa bano.
6Maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne,
amaa bedi yɛ nwo apereapereɛ,
na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛsere yɛ.
7Ao Asafo Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ;
te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.
8Etuli bobe bo fili Misraim wale,
ɛfoane amaen maen mɔ fili aseɛ ne aso, na eluale.
9Esiesiele aseɛ ne aso mane ye,
otirale ndii, na ɔtrɛtrɛ katale aseɛ ne aso.
10Ye bo fɔnwoo ne katale mmokaa nemɔ aso,
na ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm ne katale sida mbiri ne aso.
11Ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm trɛtrɛle alaa ooguale ɛpo nu,
yeɛ ye nyaa ne ɔɔhane Asue ne anwo.
12Na nzu ati yeɛ abubu ye nwo fasue mɔ agua ye
maa ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne, ɔtete ye mma ne bie e?
13Ɛhɔayeɛ nu kɔkɔte tiatia so,
na eburo ngaka amukoraa bɛtete bedi.
14Ao Asafo Nyameɛ, sa baanea yɛ;
to wɔ nye fi nyameɛso nea,
ná baanea bobe ye aso,
15bobe boo bɔ ɛnate wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ tumi so ayɛ ne,
ɔne mmaen bɔ afa atindim berɛ ama wɔ nwo ne.
16Bafa see bayera ye, bapɛ bato ase;
sɛ wɔ nye boro bɛ so a, bewuwu!
17Nakoso sona bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ sa famaa so ne,
sona awa bɔ wɔ ti amaa wanya anwoserɛ ne,
nea ye so, ná bɔ ye nwo waen.
18Ɔba ye sɔ a, yɛngɔkakyi yɛ si yɛngɔma wɔ.
Maa yɛnya ngoa, na yɛkɔbɔ wɔ dumaa.
19Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ;
te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.

Title: EDWEIN 81
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ asoserɛ
Asafe dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’anwoserɛ ne, ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛto ye nwo dwein;
ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛbɔ Yakob Nyameɛ ne nwo ese.
2Ɛ́mɔkenga edwein, ɛ́mɔwoso akasaa ne,
ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo fɛɛfɛɛ ne adengum ne.
3 Ɛmɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ ɛsraen foforɛ aluolue ne,
mmerɛ bɔ ɛsraen kɔyɛ mumua ne,
wɔ y’aluolue kyẽa ne.
4Ofikyɛ ɔte ahyɛdeɛ ma Yisrael,
ɔte Yakob Nyameɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ.
5Ɔmaa ɔyɛle ahyɛdeɛ mane Yosef,
mmerɛ bɔ ohwi fale Misraim aseɛ so hɔle,
nekaa bɔ ndele dwudwolɛ bie bɔ nndele bie le ne.
6“Nyele adesoa piri ne mvili ye bati so,
ye sa yakyili kɛndɛen kukulɛ.
7 Esu frɛle me wɔ w’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na mbepɛ nnele wɔ;
nekaa bɔ agralaa wɔ wɔ mvealeɛ nu ne,
berɛ yeɛ mmane wɔ mmuayɛɛ,
na nzole wɔ neane
wɔ Meriba asue anwo.
Sela
8Me maen, ɛ́mɔtie maa ndu ɛmɔ foɛ.
Ao Yisrael, sɛ ahaa ekotie me dwirɛ a!
9Onni kyɛ enya nyameɛ foforɛ biala wɔ wɔ nu;
nnɛso maenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ biala.
10Me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ,
bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne.
Bukye wɔ noa nu hambonnwu,
na ngɔfa nningyein ngowura ye tɛkyɛ.
11“Nakoso me maen bandie me dwirɛ,
Yisrael wammrɛ ye nwo ase wamma me.
12Yiti nyakyili maa bɛyɔle bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bekuro ɔ,
maa bɛyɔle bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ b’adwene ma bɛ ɔ.
13Ao, sɛ ahaa me maen kotie me dwirɛ a,
sɛ ahaa Yisrael kɔnate m’atee so a!
14Ahaa ngɔbrɛ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ase ndɛndɛ,
ná mafa me tumi mali bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim.
15Sɛ ahaa AWURADE pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔkoto ye nyunu a,
ahaa bɛ mmerɛ kɔyɛ afebɔɔ.
16Ahaa ngɔma bɛ aleɛ paa maa bekoli,
na ngɔma bɛ nyɔbotaen nu woɛ ma bɛ ko koyi.”

Title: EDWEIN 82
Content:
Ndɛen turoloo
Asafe dwein
1Nyameɛ atena ye bia nu wɔ nyameɛso badwa ne anu,
na obua nyameɛ mɔ ndɛen kyɛ,
2“Kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkobua ndɛengyea,
ná ɛmɔayɛ nyeyemuɛ bagyina bɔnefoɛ si maa waadwu ɔ.
Sela
3Ɛmɔli ehiafoɛ ne nyisiaafoɛ bɛ dwirɛ bɛma bɛ;
ɛ́mɔbua bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne bɛ bɔ belle bie ɔ ndɛen turoloo.
4Ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ne ehiafoɛ,
ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele bɛ befi bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa nu.”
5Belle nimdeɛ, yeɛ belle ndeaseɛ,
bɛnate awosii nu;
aseɛ fapem amukoraati ɔwoso.
6 Menwa nyoo, “Ɛmɔte nyameɛ mɔ,
ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛmɔte Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye mma mmɔ.
7Nakoso ɛmɔkowuwu kyɛ adasa mmaa,
na ɛmɔkɔtotɔ kyɛ ɛhene biala.
8Ao Nyameɛ, dwɔso ná bua aseɛ so ama ndɛen,
ofikyɛ maen maen amukoraa bɛte w’agyapadeɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 83
Content:
AWURADE bua Yisrael pɔfoɛ mɔ ndɛen
Asafe dwein
1Ao Nyameɛ, nnɛkã wɔ noa to nu;
ao Nyameɛ, nnɛmua wɔ noa, yeɛ nnɛyɛ konn!
2Ofikyɛ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛyɛ bagyabagya,
bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ nemɔ, bɛyɛ lɔen.
3Bɛbɔ wɔ maen nwo nwandanwona porɛ,
na bɛkɔ mmenia bɔ ɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne nwo agyina tɛɛ.
4Bɛnwa, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛnua bɛ maen ne aboso,
amaa ɔnate so ebiala wangaye Yisrael dumaa ko.”
5Bɛyɛ adwene ko bɛbɔ porɛ;
bɛyɛ apam betia wɔ:
6Edomfoɛ ne Yismaelfoɛ,
Moabo ne Hagritefoɛ,
7Gebal ne Amon ne Amalɛke,
Filistia ne Tirofoɛ.
8Asiria koso ɔɔbokale bɛ so,
bɛfale b’anwoserɛ beegyinane Lɔto boso ama nemɔ bɛ si.
Sela
9Bɔ ɛfa yɛle Midian,
Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asue Kison nwo ne,
fa sɔ alaa yɛ bɛ.
10Bɛ yeɛ ehuhuni bɛ wɔ Ɛn Dɔɔ
mane bɛ fuin porɔle wɔ aseɛ so ne.
11Ma bɛ mmenia titire mɔ bɛyɛ kyɛ Orebo ne Seebo,
ma b’ahemvo mɔ bɛyɛ kyɛ Seba ne Samuna
12bɔ bɛhane kyɛ, “Nyameɛ atenaleɛ ne,
ɛ́mɔma yɛho yɛfa yɛyɛ yɛ deɛ” ne.
13Ao me Nyameɛ, maa bɛyɛ kyɛ atendirehuo,
maa bɛyɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye ɔ.
14Kyɛbɔ see yera ɛhɔayeɛ too ne,
kyɛbɔ buruburugya yera mmokaa motoo ne,
15sɔ ala yeɛ wɔ mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ ne, fa foa bɛ,
ná fa wɔ mvrama piri ne nwunanwuna bɛ ɔ.
16Ao AWURADE, ma animguaseɛ bia bɛ,
amaa ɔnate so bapena wɔ dumaa si atee.
17Ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, ná bɛteetee daa,
maa bewu animguaseɛ wue.
18Maa benwu kyɛ
wɔ bɔ wɔ ngome yeɛ wɔ dumaa ole AWURADE ne,
wɔ yeɛ ɛte Anwuro Anwuro hene bɔ edi aseɛ amukoraa so ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 84
Content:
Nyameɛ sɔnenɛ nu saleɛ
Kora boso ama dwein. Bɛfa bɛmane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao Asafo AWURADE,
w’atenaleɛ ne, kyɛbɔ osi yɛ nyemene ɔ!
2Amba, me kra tena a ɔndena, na ye wora dɔ
AWURADE awuro aluo berɛ ne;
m’ahone ne me nwonaen bɛto
Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne anwo anigye dwein.
3Ao Asafo AWURADE,
me Hene ne me Nyameɛ,
akatipire po wanya atenaleɛ,
yeɛ nandwinoma anya ye saen
wɔ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo
bɔ ɔkɔfa ye mma kogua nu ɔ.
4Bɛ bɔ bɛtena w’awuro berɛ ne, benya saleɛ,
na bɛto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein daa.
Sela
5Bɛ bɔ wɔ nu yeɛ b’anwoserɛ wɔ ne, benya saleɛ,
na Sion atimbire wɔ b’ahone nu.
6Sɛ bɛnate Baka bɔnza nu a,
bɛmaa ɔkakyi mbombonzue aseɛ,
na asuso ma saleɛ ba so.
7Bɛnate a, befi anwoserɛ nu bɛkɔ anwoserɛ nu,
na bɛ nu biala bafite Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ Sion.
8Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ.
Ao Yakob Nyameɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie!
Sela
9Ao Nyameɛ, y’akokyɛm, tie,
ná bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne, do ye.
10Ofikyɛ ɛlɛhomapɛ bɔ ngoli ye wɔ w’aluo berɛ ne,
ɔte paa tra ngyẽa apee bɔ ngoli ye nekaa bie ɔ.
Mekuro kyɛ ngɔyɛ me Nyameɛ awuro berɛ anoa wɛmvoɛ
tra kyɛ ngɔtena bɔnefoɛ ɛtena sua nu ɔ.
11Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ te eyia ne akokyɛm;
ye yeɛ ɔdo sona ná ɔmaa onya animnyam ɔ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne,
ɔmva nikye paa biala mmɔ bɛ atianuserɛ.
12Ao Asafo AWURADE, ebiala bɔ ye wora wura wɔ nu ne,
onya saleɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 85
Content:
AWURADE, do yɛ
Kora boso ama dwein. Bɛfa bɛmane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1AWURADE, ɛlole wɔ maen;
ɛfale Yakob fili nnurehyelɛ nu sa wale.
2Ɛfale wɔ maen ye amumuyɛɛ hyɛle ye;
ɛfale bɛ bɔne amukoraa hyɛle bɛ.
Sela
3Ɛhwene wɔ yaa piri ne amukoraa sale,
ɛmane w’ahone tɔle nzue nu.
4Ao yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ,
na ɛyaa bɔ afɛ ye wɔ yɛ so ne, yakyi maa ɔha.
5Aso ɛkɔfɛ yɛ so yaa afebɔɔ?
Aso ɛkɔma wɔ yaa ne kɔhɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa bɛ so?
6Aso engosa ngɔpagya yɛ ko,
amaa ɔnate so wɔ maen bali ahurusi wɔ wɔ nu anaa?
7Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
ye ye ali kyire yɛ,
ná ma yɛ sa ɔhã wɔ ngoalelɛ ne.
8Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE ne, ngotie bɔ ɔkɔhã ɔ,
ofikyɛ ɔkɔhã asomdwee dwirɛ kohyire ye maen ne ye anwoteefoɛ,
nakoso onni kyɛ besa bekodi ngwaseasɛm.
9Amba, ye ngoalelɛ pingye bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ,
na ye animnyam ne kɔtena ye aseɛ ne aso.
10Ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne nahorɛlilɛ bekoyia;
tenenee ne asomdwee bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo awaawaatuu.
11Nahorɛlilɛ kopukye kofi aseɛnwo,
ná tenenee wato ye nye wafi nyameɛso wanea aseɛnwo.
12Amba, AWURADE kɔfa nningyein paa kɔma,
na y’aseɛ kɔhye aleɛ.
13Tenenee koli ye nyunu,
na ɔkɔbɔ atimbire bɔ ɔkɔfa so ɔ kɔma ye.

Title: EDWEIN 86
Content:
Do me ma me pɔfoɛ fɛre
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, yɛ asoɛ tie me, ná bua me,
ofikyɛ wahia me, yeɛ meyɛ anwumvo.
2Bɔ me ngoa nwo waen,
ofikyɛ me nwo te.
Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ;
pepɛ de wɔ somvoɛ bɔ wafa ye wora wawura wɔ nu ne.
3Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ daa mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ.
4Ma wɔ somvoɛ ye kra nye gye,
ofikyɛ ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mema me kra sũ frɛ wɔ ɔ.
5Ao AWURADE, ɛte paa, na ɛfa bɔne kyɛ;
wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne
ɔsone ma bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ wɔ ɔ.
6Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, tie me mbaeɛ;
tie me sufrɛ bɔ ofi me noa ne.
7M’anwokyere mmerɛ nu, mesu mefrɛ wɔ,
ofikyɛ ebua me.
8Ao AWURADE, ebiala ne wɔ bɛnzɛ wɔ nyameɛ mɔ nu,
na ebiala ngɔhora ngɔfa ye sa noa nnwumaa ngɔtoto wɔ deɛ nwo.
9Ao AWURADE, amaen maen amukoraa bɔ ɛyɔle ne,
bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔbɔ bɛ nu ase wɔ wɔ nyunu,
ná bahyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam.
10Ofikyɛ ɛte piri, na ɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ,
wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ.
11Ao AWURADE, kyire me w’atee ne,
amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ ne aso.
Maa nzi m’adwene pi mva nzuro wɔ dumaa.
12Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ,
ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngɔye wɔ ayɛ,
na ngɔhyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam afebɔɔ.
13Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi
bɔ ɛye ye ali kyire me ne, ɔte piri,
na apepɛ ale me kra afi ɛborɔ kumaa nu.
14Ao Nyameɛ, anwomasoɛfoɛ badwɔso batia me,
atianuserɛfoɛ bɛpena me beku me,
na bɛmva wɔ bɛnyɛ huu.
15Nakoso, ao AWURADE, ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛse anwumvoin ná ɛdo mmenia ɔ;
w’ahone nhu ndɛ,
na wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, ɔsone.
16Baanea me ná nwu me anwumvoin;
fa w’anwoserɛ ne ma wɔ somvoɛ,
ná pepɛ de w’afaneɛ awa ne.
17Kyire me wɔ ɛlolɛ ne nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ,
amaa ɔnate so me pɔfoɛ mɔ banwu ye ná bafɛre,
ofikyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ aboka me akyekye me wora ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 87
Content:
Sion tenalɛ maa benya saleɛ
Kora boso ama dwein
1AWURADE kuro bɔ wakyekye ne,
ye fapem gyi bokaa krongron ne aso.
2AWURADE kuro Sion pambim nemɔ dwirɛ
tra Yakob atenaleɛ amukoraa.
3Ao, Nyameɛ kuro,
animnyam dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã bɛfa wɔ nwo ɔ.
Sela
4Bɛ bɔ bɛse me ne, mebɔ Rahabo ne Babilɔn dumaa wɔ b’afia;
Filistia, Tiro yeɛ Yitiopia
bɛnwa, “Berɛ yeɛ bɛwole ɛhe ɔ.”
5Na bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa Sion nwo kyɛ,
“Sona he ne asomasi koso, kuro ne anu berɛ yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ”;
ofikyɛ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne bɔbɔ kɔmaa kuro ne kogyina.
6AWURADE hyerɛle tole berɛ
mmerɛ bɔ né ɔkyerɛkyerɛ maen maen mɔ dumaa ne kyɛ,
“Ɛhe, bɛwole ye wɔ berɛ.”
Sela
7Edweintolɛfoɛ ne abiliegolɛfoɛ bɛkã kyɛ,
“Wɔ nu yeɛ me saleɛ amukoraa wɔ ɔ.”

Title: EDWEIN 88
Content:
Amaneɛ kandinga nu mbaeɛ
Kora boso ama dwein. Bɛfa bɛmane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao AWURADE, me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ,
mesu wɔ wɔ nyunu eyia ne kɔngɔen.
2Ma me mbaeɛ odwu wɔ nyunu,
yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ.
3Ofikyɛ amaneɛ pee atoto me kra,
na me kra apingye ɛborɔ.
4Bebu me bɛfra bɛ bɔ bapingye ɛborɔ kumaa ne,
nde kyɛ sona bɔ olle mmokalɛ biala ɔ.
5Mayɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ bayakyi ye bato awufoɛ nu ɔ,
kyɛ bɛ bɔ bahu bɛ bagua asieleɛ kumaa nu ɔ,
kyɛ bɛ bɔ ɛngaye bɛ ko,
bɔ aye wɔ sa afi bɛ bo ɔ.
6Agyi me ato ɛborɔ kumaa kuronn ne anu,
wɔ nekaa kuronn tunn ne anu dɔ.
7Afɛ me so yaa piri,
na ɛma w’asorɔkye amukoraa bungam fa me so.
Sela
8Ama me mmango mɔ bapo me,
amaa makakyi bɛ nye so akyiwadeɛ bie.
Bato me nu bɔ mengora fite ɔ.
9Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye mmaa apakye.
Ao AWURADE, daa mesu mefrɛ wɔ;
metrɛ me sa nu mebɔ mbaeɛ mekyire wɔ.
10Aso ɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ ma awufoɛ?
Aso awufoɛ bɛkora bedwɔso bɛye wɔ ayɛ anaa?
Sela
11Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
aso asieleɛ kumaa nu yeɛ bɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ɔ,
anaa bɛbɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anwo dawure wɔ Abadɔn?
12Aso benwu w’anwanwadeɛ wɔ awosii ne anu,
anaa benwu wɔ ngoalelɛ mmokalɛ ne wɔ aseɛ bɔ bɛngaye mmenia wɔ so ne aso?
13Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ,
na me mbaeɛ dwu wɔ nyunu ngyerɛmɔ.
14Ao AWURADE, nzu ati yeɛ apo me kra ye?
Nzu ati yeɛ aye wɔ nye afea me ye?
15Ofi me ngwadaa nu yeɛ manwu amaneɛ,
bɔ ewue li me mvanvando ɔ;
manwu amaneɛ piri wɔ wɔ sa nu, na meteetee.
16Wɔ yaa piri ne wabungam wafa me so,
wɔ ɛteeteelɛ ne, wamaa mawu bɔkɔɔ.
17Daa biala bɛpɛ me nwo beyia kyɛ asue bɔ wayi ɔ;
bɛbɔ nu bɛpɛ me nwo beyia.
18Ama m’adɔfo mɔ ne me damvo mɔ bapo me;
na awosii yeɛ ɔte mmiɛngo ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 89
Content:
Nyameɛ ne Dawide bele apam
Ɛsraniɛ Etan dwein
1Ao AWURADE, ngɔto wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dwein daa,
na ngɔte me noa ngɔbɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anwo dawure ngohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.
2Ofikyɛ mahã kyɛ, Ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye bo atindim afebɔɔ;
wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, ama ye bo atimu wɔ nyameɛso.
3Me ne me sona bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ne yayɛ apam,
mata ndaen mahyire me somvoɛ Dawide kyɛ,
4‘Ngɔma wɔ boso ama bɛ bo kotimu afebɔɔ,
na ngɔma w’ahennie ne abo kotimu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.’
Sela
5Ao AWURADE, nyameɛso kɔkamvo w’anwanwadeɛ,
bɛkamvo wɔ nahorɛlilɛ wɔ krongronfoɛ badwa nu.
6Ofikyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔwɔ ewienu
bɔ bɛkɔfa ye bɛkɔtoto AWURADE nwo ɔ?
Nyameɛsofoɛ mɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ AWURADE ɔ?
7Ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ besuro ye wɔ krongronfoɛ badwa nu ɔ,
ɔte piri, na ye nwo yɛ suro tra bɛ bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia amukoraa.
8Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ,
nwa yeɛ ole anwoserɛ kyɛ wɔ ɔ, ao AWURADE?
Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ apɛ wɔ nwo ayia.
9Ɛpo bɔ ohu bu fa so ne, wɔ yeɛ ele ye so tumi ɔ;
sɛ ye asorɔkye bɔ a, wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa ɔyɛ dinn ɔ.
10Ɛpɛkyɛle Rahabo kyɛ naenmvuin,
na ele wɔ tumi ne mane wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔle aya.
11Nyameɛso te wɔ deɛ, yeɛ aseɛ koso te wɔ deɛ;
wiase ne nu nningyein amukoraa, wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ ɔ.
12Wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle sorɔ ne ngwaen ɔ,
Tabɔ ne Hɛmɔn bele anigye bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.
13Ele tumi asaa;
wɔ sa ne, anwoserɛ wɔ nu, apagya wɔ sa famaa ne aso.
14Tenenee ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo
te w’ahennie bia nyinasoɛ;
ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔne nahorɛlilɛ beli wɔ nyunu.
15Maen bɔ bɛse ayɛyelɛ nwo esebɔlɛ ne, benya saleɛ;
bɛ yeɛ bɛnate wɔ nyunu hyireinn ne anu ɔ.
16Bedi ahurusi wɔ wɔ dumaa nu daa,
na wɔ tenenee ne anu yeɛ oyie bɛ yé ɔ.
17Wɔ yeɛ ɛte b’anwoserɛ animnyam ɔ,
na w’adom yeɛ ɔmaa yɛdi ngonim ɔ.
18Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte y’akokyɛm ɔ,
Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne yeɛ ɔte yɛ Hene ɔ.
19Mmerɛ bie, ɛnate nyekyire so
dwudwo hyirele wɔ nahorɛniɛ ne kyɛ,
“Mafa mmokalɛ mama ebie bɔ ye nwo yɛ se ɔ,
na sona bɔ maneanea maen ne anu maye ye ne, mapagya ye.
20Manwu me somvoɛ Dawide,
mafa me ngoo krongron ne mapopa ye.
21Me tumi kogyina ye si,
na m’abasa ne kɔma ye anwoserɛ.
22Pɔfoɛ ne ngɔhora ngɔlakalaka ye,
na bɔnefoɛ ne ngɔhora ngoli ye so.
23Ngɔpɛkyɛ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ ye nyunu,
ná mahũhũ bɛ bɔ bekyi ye ɔ.
24Me nahorɛlilɛ ne me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
bekogyina ye si;
na me dumaa nu yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ so konya anwoserɛ ɔ.
25Ngɔmaa ye sa konya ɛpo so tumi,
ná mama ye sa famaa anya asue mɔ so tumi.
26Okose me kyɛ, ‘Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me baba,
me Nyameɛ ne me ngoalelɛ Nyɔbotaen ɔ!
27 Ngɔfa ye ngɔyɛ me bamuɛbaa,
aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa bɛ nu titire paa.
28Ngɔye me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali ngohyire ye afebɔɔ,
na m’apam ne bo kotindim kɔma ye.
29Ngɔma ye boso ama bekoli hene afebɔɔ,
na kyɛ nyameɛso tɛwɔ berɛ ye de, ye ahennie kɔtena berɛ.
30Na sɛ ye boso ama bɛpo me mmeraa ne,
ná bamva me nhyehyɛleɛ bammɔ bɛ bra,
31sɛ betwi bɛfa m’ahyɛdeɛ so,
ná bandie me mmeraa dwirɛ a,
32ye de ngɔfa mbire ngɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ mmeraatolɛ nwo,
ná mafa bakaa mahwe bɛ so wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo.
33Nakoso mengɔye me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne mengofi ye so,
yeɛ mengɔkakyi me si mengɔma me nahorɛlilɛ ne.
34Mengobu m’apam ne aso,
yeɛ mengɔsesã me noa.
35Mafa me krongronyɛlɛ mata ndaen komapɛ twe;
mengɔpɛ anoanu mengohyire Dawide.
36Ye boso ama koli hene afebɔɔ,
na kyɛ eyia tɛwɔ berɛ ye de,
ye ahennie kɔtena berɛ wɔ me nyunu.
37Okotimu afebɔɔ kyɛ ɛsraen,
bɔ ɔte adanzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu ɔ.
38Nakoso ato ye aye apo ye;
afɛ wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne aso ɛyaa piri paa.
39W’apam bɔ ɛne wɔ somvoɛ bayɛ ne, afa ato ahameɛ,
ye ahennie abotire ne, agyi ato ase agua ye nwo fiɛ.
40Abɔngyebɔngye ye fasue amukoraa nu ndokuro,
na adwiri ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ agua ase.
41Bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu berɛ bɛkɔ ne, bɛfẽ ye nningyein;
wayɛ ngorohoɛ dwirɛ wɔ ye mmango nu.
42Ama bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ye so ne bali ye so ngonim,
ama ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa bali ahurusi.
43Afei koso, ama ye ngrandɛ noa atiri,
na angyina ye si wɔ koɛ nu.
44Ale ɛhɔtɔ ne afi ye sa nu,
yeɛ afindi ye ahennie bia ne ato ase.
45Apɛ ye animnyam mmerɛ so;
yeɛ amaa animguaseɛ abia ye.
Sela
46Ao AWURADE, ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔfea maa okoodwu kyinzu?
W’ahone kohu kogye kyɛ see maa okoodwu kyinzu?
47Kaye kyɛbɔ me ngoa si te tikaape ɔ,
kyɛbɔ ɛbɔle adasa mmaa mane nningyein bɔ ɔte mbaen ɔ!
48Dasaniɛ beni yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔtena ase alaa bɔ ongowu ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kole ye kra kofi ɛborɔ sa nu ɔ?
Sela
49AWURADE, wɔ daa tete ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ nisua,
ɔdɔ bɔ ɛnate wɔ nahorɛlilɛ so ɛfa tale ndaen hyirele Dawide ne?
50Ao AWURADE, kaye kyɛbɔ besi bɛgoro w’akoaa nwo ɔ,
kyɛbɔ mesi mede maen maen amukoraa b’alapaa megua me wereɛ nu ɔ.
51Ao AWURADE, nea anyinga bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã ɔ,
kyɛ bɛsere wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne, ye agyirɛ bɔ otu ɔ.
52Animnyam hã AWURADE afebɔɔ,
Amen! Amen!

Title: EDWEIN 90
Content:
EDWEIN NWOMAA BƆ ƆTƆ SO NNA
90—106
Dasaniɛ ngyɛ ná watu wamini
Nyameɛ sona Mose mbaeɛ
1AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte y’afealeɛ
wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu ɔ.
2Anzana ɛbaabɔ mmokaa mɔ ne,
anaa ɛbaahyehyɛ aseɛ ne wiase ne,
ofi tete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ, ɛte Nyameɛ.
3Esa ma dasaniɛ kakyi mvuture,
na ɛkã kyɛ, “Adasa mmaa, ɛmɔsa bɛbra ɛmɔ mvuture nu.”
4 Ofikyɛ wɔ nye so de, afoɛ apee,
ɔte kyɛ anoma ala bɔ wapɛ nu ɔ,
anaakyɛ kɔngɔen abunnamu.
5Ɛpra adasa mmaa bo egyi bɛ gua; bɛte kyɛ laleɛ,
kyɛ ndire bɔ ofifi frɔmfrɔm ngyerɛmɔ ɔ;
6ofifi ngyerɛmɔ yɛ frɔmfrɔm,
nakoso odwu nɔsoa a, ɔkese, na ɔyera.
7Ofikyɛ wɔ yaafɛlɛ ne kũkũ yɛ,
na w’ahonehulɛ ne fa yɛ kɔ amaneɛ nu.
8Afa y’amumuyɛɛ agua wɔ nyunu,
na afa yɛ mvealeɛ nu bɔne awa wɔ nyunu hyireinn ne anu.
9Ofikyɛ yɛ ngyẽa amukoraa pɛ nu kɔ bɔ afɛ yɛ so yaa ɔ,
na y’afoɛ bɔ yɛdi ne ɔba ayieleɛ kyɛ ɛhoaa bie.
10Ngyẽa bɔ yɛdi ye aseɛ ye aso te afoɛ aburasoo,
anaa sɛ anwoserɛ wɔ nu po a, ɔte afoɛ aburawɔtwɛ,
na ɛhene po, nu fɛɛ ne amaneɛ!
Ɔngyɛ né wapɛ nu, ná yatu yamini.
11Nwa yeɛ ɔse wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ ne noa hyerɛ ɔ?
W’ahonehulɛ ne, ɔne esurolɛ bɔ odi kyɛ besuro wɔ ne, bɛte pɛ.
12Yiti kyire yɛ maa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ yɛkosi yɛkɔha yɛ ngyẽa ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so yafa nworɛ yabɔ yɛ bra.
13Ao AWURADE, sa baanea yɛ! Okoodwu kyinzu?
Nwu wɔ somvoɛ mɔ anwumvoin!
14Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, maa obu so ma yɛ ngyerɛmɔ,
amaa ɔnate so yali ahurusi ná yɛ nye agye
wɔ yɛ ngyẽa amukoraa nu.
15Maa yɛ nye gye,
kyɛbɔ ngyẽa bɔ afa ahwe yɛ so ne, ye somaa te ɔ,
kyɛbɔ afoɛ bɔ yanwu amaneɛ ne, ye somaa te ɔ.
16Ma wɔ somvoɛ mɔ benwu wɔ nnwumaa,
w’animnyam ne, ye ye ali kyire bɛ mma mɔ.
17Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ adom ne ɔbra yɛ so,
ma yɛ sa noa adwuma ɔ́yɛ yee ɔ́ma yɛ.
Ao, ma yɛ sa noa nnwumaa ɔ́yɛ yee!

Title: EDWEIN 91
Content:
Nyameɛ te y’afealeɛ
1Sona bɔ ɔtena Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’afealeɛ nu,
bɔ yeɛ ɔtena Tuminiɛ ne, ye fɔnwoo ne anu ne,
2okose AWURADE kyɛ, “Ɛte m’afealeɛ ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ,
me Nyameɛ bɔ me wora wura ye nu ɔ.”
3Amba, ye yeɛ okole wɔ kofi ngaensualɛniɛ ne ngaen nu,
ɔne ewue anwonyerɛ tɛɛ nu ɔ.
4Ɔkɔfa ye ndɛkra kɔkata wɔ so,
na ye ndaa ne abo yeɛ ekonya afealeɛ ɔ;
ye nahorɛlilɛ ne te akokyɛm ne buralɛ ataadeɛ.
5Engosuro nningyein bɔ onwunanwuna sona kɔngɔen ɔ,
anaa agyaen bɔ otu nate eyia ɔ,
6anaa ewue anwonyerɛ bɔ ɔnate awosii nu ɔ,
anaa anwonyerɛ bɔ okũkũ mmenia eyiagyina ɔ.
7Apee kɔtotɔ wɔ wɔ ngyɛnu,
yeɛ apee buru kɔtotɔ wɔ wɔ sa famaa so,
nakoso wɔ de, ebie ngɔto wɔ.
8Wɔ nye mbaen yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔnea ɔ,
na ekonwu bɔnefoɛ b’akatuaa.
9Ɔnate kyɛ afa AWURADE ayɛ w’afealeɛ,
ná afa Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne ayɛ w’atenaleɛ ne ati,
10edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto wɔ,
ɛhawo piri biala ngopingye w’awuro.
11Ofikyɛ ɔnate wɔ ti, ɔkɔfa ahyɛdeɛ kɔma ye abɔfo mɔ,
kyɛ bɛnea wɔ so wɔ w’atee amukoraa so.
12Bɛkɔsoa wɔ wɔ bɛ sa so,
amaa ɔnate so wɔ gya ambura nyɔboɛ.
13Ɛkɔnate gyata ne ɛbɔnaa so,
na ekotiatia gyata akrɔngrɔma ne sasrabɔnzam so.
14Ɔnate kyɛ wafa ye nwo wabata me ne ati, ngɔpepɛ ngole ye.
Ɔnate kyɛ ɔse me dumaa ne ati, ngɔpagya ye.
15Sɛ osũ frɛ me a, ngotie ye sufrɛ.
Ngogyina ye si wɔ ye amaneɛnwunɛ nu;
ngɔpepɛ ngole ye, ná mahyɛ ye animnyam.
16Ngɔma ye ngoa tendenn ma ye ahone kɔtɔ ye kunu,
na ngɔmaa okonwu me ngoalelɛ ne.

Title: EDWEIN 92
Content:
Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein
Afofikyẽa dwein
1Ɔte paa kyɛ bɛkɔfa asennaa bɛkɔma AWURADE ɔ,
kyɛ bɛkɔto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ, ao Anwuro Anwuroniɛ;
2kyɛ bɛkɔbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dawure ngyerɛmɔ,
ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anwo dawure kɔngɔen,
3mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru ɔne adengum ne,
odi kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto dwein.
4Ofikyɛ wɔ AWURADE, ɛnate bɔ ayɔ ɔ so ɛma me nye agye;
medi ahurusi meto wɔ sa noa adwuma ne anwo dwein.
5Ao AWURADE, wɔ nnwumaa te mbiri mbiri paa!
W’adwene nu pi paa!
6Sona kwaseaa de, ɔnze,
sona bɔ wagyimi de, ɔnde ɛhe abo:
7sɛ bɔnefoɛ befifi kama kyɛ ndire,
ná amumuyɛɛfoɛ benya ngɔsoɛ a,
ɔla berɛ ma bɛ kyɛ bekowu ewue afebɔɔ ɔ.
8Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ de, edi ebiala so hene afebɔɔ.
9Amba, ao AWURADE, wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ,
wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ de bekowuwu,
bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔbɔ aya.
10Nakoso amaa manya anwoserɛ kyɛ torɔen,
na ahwie ngoo foforɛ agua me so.
11Me nye anwu me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’asefinɛ;
bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne,
me so ate b’ayieleɛ bɔ wayie bɛ ɔ.
12Teneneefoɛ befifi kama kyɛ ayee,
na benyi kyɛ sida bɔ ɔwɔ Lebanon ɔ.
13Balua bɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro,
na befifi frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ aluo berɛ.
14Bɛkɔ so besu mmaa wɔ bɛ nworowaa nu,
daa bɛte frɔmfrɔm ne monɛ,
15bɛfa bekyire kyɛ AWURADE tengyɛ;
me Nyɔbotaen ɛne,
na bɔ ɔndengyɛ biala ɔnne ye nu.

Title: EDWEIN 93
Content:
AWURADE ahennie timu berɛ daa
1AWURADE di hene, wafa animnyam wahera;
AWURADE afa ahera, wafa anwoserɛ wabɔ abɔsoɛ.
Amba, wiase bo atimu, bɛngɔhora ye bo tutu.
2W’ahennie bia bo atimu fi tete;
ɛwɔ berɛ fi tete.
3Ao AWURADE, asue nemɔ ayi ahɔ anwuro,
asueyilɛ nemɔ ama bɛ komvi so,
asueyilɛ nemɔ ama bɛ dede bɔ bɛyɔ ne aso.
4Anwuro Anwuro AWURADE ole anwoserɛ,
ole anwoserɛ tra kyɛbɔ asue mbiri mbiri bebu bɛfa so ɔ,
ole anwoserɛ tra ɛpo asorɔkye!
5Wɔ noa dwirɛ te nahorɛ turoloo;
ao AWURADE, krongronyɛlɛ fata w’awuro afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 94
Content:
Nyameɛ tɔ bɔnefoɛ so wereɛ
1Ao AWURADE, wereɛtɔlɛ Nyameɛ,
wereɛtɔlɛ Nyameɛ, kyire wɔ tumi!
2Ao, aseɛ ye aso ndɛenbualɛniɛ, kekã wɔ nwo e,
ná tua anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛ so kerɛ!
3Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɔnefoɛ,
ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛ nye kɔgye ɔ?
4Bɛkekã b’anwomasoɛ dwirɛ nemɔ,
bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkekã ahandaen dwirɛ.
5Ao AWURADE, bɛtane wɔ maen nye,
bedi w’agyapadeɛ so anyandim.
6Bekũkũ akunafoɛ mmrasua ne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ,
yeɛ bedi nyisiaafoɛ awue,
7na bɛkekã kyɛ, “AWURADE onnwu ye,
yeɛ Yakob Nyameɛ ɛhemɔ mva ye nwo.”
8Ao, maen ne anu mmenia bɔ ɛmɔ adwene te nganga ɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔte ye bo,
ngwaseafoɛ, kyinzu yeɛ ɛmɔkonwu nworɛ ɔ?
9Bɔ ɔfale asoɛ tuale berɛ ne, aso ɔnde dwudwolɛ?
Bɔ ɔbɔle anyeɛ ne, aso onnwu nikye?
10Bɔ ɔtwe maen maen mɔ so ne,
aso ɔngɔhwe asoɛ?
Ye yeɛ okyire mmenia nimdeɛ ɔ.
11AWURADE se kuro sona ti anu adwene,
kyɛ ɔte kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen.
12Ao AWURADE, sona bɔ ɛtwe ye so,
ɔne bɔ ekyirekyire ye wɔ mmeraa ne,
onya saleɛ.
13Ɔnate so ɛmaa ode ye nwome fi amaneɛ mmerɛ nu,
kɔpem kyɛ bekotu kumaa maa bɔnefoɛ kɔtɔ nu ɔ.
14Ofikyɛ AWURADE ngɔye ye sa ngofi ye maen bo,
yeɛ ɔngɔpo ye agyapadeɛ.
15Na bekosa bɛkɔfa teneneeyɛlɛ bekobua ndɛen,
na bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ne, bekoli so.
16Nwa yeɛ okodwɔso kotia bɔnefoɛ kɔma me ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ okodwɔso kogyina kotia amumuyɛɛfoɛ kɔma me ɔ?
17Sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me bokafoɛ a,
ahaa ɔngɔhyɛ né me kra waatena nekaa bɔ berɛ te konn ne aso.
18Ao AWURADE, mmerɛ bɔ ngane kyɛ, “Mepena mesoti oo” ne,
wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne tirale me nu.
19Sɛ adwenedwene pee tɔ me so a,
w’aworakyekyerɛ ma me kra nye gye.
20Maenbulɛfoɛ atianuserɛfoɛ
bɔ bɛhyɛ mmeraa bɛfa bedi bɔne ne,
aso bɛkɔhora bɛ ne wɔ kotira abiɛngoɛ?
21Bɛbɔ nu bɛbɔ teneneefoɛ nwo porɛ kyɛ bekohu bɛ,
na bebua bɛ bɔ bedi be ɔ foɛ kyɛ behũ bɛ.
22Nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ,
ɔne me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte m’afealeɛ nyɔbotaen ɔ.
23Okotua bɛ b’amumuyɛɛ so kerɛ,
ná ɔnate bɛ bɔne ti wanua bɛ boso.
Amba, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ konua bɛ boso.

Title: EDWEIN 95
Content:
AWURADE nwo asennaa dwein
1Ɛmɔbra maa yɛto dwein yɛye AWURADE ayɛ;
ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ahurusi yɛ́bɔ yɛ ngoalelɛ nyɔbotaen ne nwo ese!
2Ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa asennaa yɛbra ye nyunu!
Ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ayɛyelɛ dwein yɛli ahurusi yɛbɔ ye nwo ese.
3Ofikyɛ AWURADE te Nyameɛ piri,
ɔte Ɛhene piri bɔ ɔtra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa ɔ.
4Ye sa nu yeɛ aseɛ bo dɔ kuronn ne wɔ ɔ;
na mmokaa mɔ so anwuro anwuro koso te ye deɛ.
5Ɛpo te ye deɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔle ɔ,
yeɛ aseɛ wosee koso, ye sa yeɛ ɔhyehyɛle ɔ.
6Ao, ɛmɔbra maa yɛbɔ yɛ nu ase yɛsɔne ye,
ɛ́mɔma yɛ́bu ndwerɛ wɔ AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle yɛ ne, ye nyunu!
7 Ofikyɛ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ,
na yɛte ye mmenia bɔ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ɔ,
ɔne ye sa nu mmoaen.
Ao, sɛ ahaa ɛnɛ ɛmɔkotie ye noa dwirɛ a!
8Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛle wɔ Meriba ne,
kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛle ye sɔ kyẽa ne wɔ Masa wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ne,
9mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole me bɛneane,
ná bɛgyegyele me ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né banwu me nnwumaa de.
10Afoɛ aburanna yeɛ sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne bɛ nwo yɛle me ahi ɔ,
na ngane kyɛ, “Bɛte maen bɔ b’adwene ali makyebu,
bɔ bɛnze m’atee ɔ.”
11Yiti mvɛle yaa ndale ndaen kyɛ,
“Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie.”

Title: EDWEIN 96
Content:
AWURADE di ebiala so hene
(1 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 16.23-33)
1Ao, ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ;
aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ.
2Ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ,
ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam,
ɛmɔhã ye ngoalelɛ nwo dwirɛ daa biala.
3Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye animnyam nwo dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ so;
ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ nwo dawure wɔ maen maen amukoraa so.
4Ofikyɛ AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa;
odi kyɛ sona suro ye tra nyameɛ biala.
5Ofikyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛte mmosoen mbaen,
nakoso AWURADE de, ye yeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ɔ.
6Anidie ne animnyam wɔ ye nyunu,
na tumi ne nyemene wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ.
7 Ao maen maen mɔ nu mmusua mmusua mɔ, ɛmɔhã;
ɛmɔhã kyɛ animnyam ne tumi te AWURADE deɛ.
8Ɛ́mɔfa animnyam bɔ ɔfata AWURADE dumaa ɔ bɛma ye;
ɛ́mɔfa afɔleɛ bɛbra ye awuro n’aluo berɛ.
9Ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ animnyam krongron nu,
aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE.
10Ɛmɔhã ye wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu kyɛ, “AWURADE di hene!
Amba, wiase timu berɛ pindinn, ye bo ngotutu le.
Ɔkɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ kobua maen maen nemɔ ndɛen.”
11Nyameɛso, ma wɔ nye gye, aseɛ koso, di ahurusi,
ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede.
12Eburo ne eburo nningyein amukoraa,
ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye,
yeɛ eburo mmakaa amukoraa bele anigye bɛkɔto dwein
13wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔ́ba,
ɔbaabua aseɛ so ama ndɛen.
Ɔkɔfa tenenee yeɛ okobua wiase ndɛen ɔ,
na ɔkɔfa ye nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 97
Content:
Nyameɛ te piri paa
1AWURADE di hene! Aseɛ, di ahurusi;
mboanoa worawora mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye!
2Munungum ne awosii kabii bapɛ ye nwo bayia;
tenenee ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo,
bɛte ye ahennie bia nyinasoɛ.
3See li ye nyunu,
na ɔyera ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bra yia.
4Ye agralaa ta wiase;
aseɛ nwu ye, na ye nwo wosowoso.
5Mmokaa huro kyɛ nguɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu,
wɔ aseɛ amukoraa AWURADE ye nyunu.
6Ewienu bɔ ye tenenee nwo dawure,
na maen maen amukoraa nwu ye animnyam ne.
7Mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne mmosoen,
bɔ bɛfa amoen mɔ bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ne,
bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu agua ase;
nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa,
odi kyɛ ɛmɔkoto ye.
8Ao AWURADE, Sion ɔte, na ye nye gye,
yeɛ Yuda mma mmrasua bedi ahurusi,
ɔnate wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nemɔ ati.
9Ofikyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte Anwuro Anwuroniɛ paa wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so ɔ;
ɛte totohyia tra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa.
10Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkuro AWURADE dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkyi bɔne;
ɔbɔ ye anwoteefoɛ bɛ kra nwo waen,
na ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa nu.
11Kanea ta ma teneneefoɛ,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ne koso, benya anigye.
12Ao ɛmɔ, teneneefoɛ, ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu,
ná ɛ́mɔkaye ye krongronyɛlɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa ye asennaa bɛma ye ɔ!

Title: EDWEIN 98
Content:
Di ahurusi ye AWURADE ayɛ
Edwein
1Ao, ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ,
ofikyɛ wayɛ anwanwadeɛ mɔ,
Ye anwoserɛ asaa ne ye sa krongron ne
yeɛ wafa wali ngonim ɔ.
2AWURADE amaa yanwu ye ngoalelɛ ne;
wala ye tenenee ali wɔ maenmaensofoɛ nyunu.
3Wakaye ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne ye nahorɛlilɛ
bɔ wala ye ali wahyire Yisrael awuro ama ne.
Aseɛ so nekaa amukoraa banwu
yɛ Nyameɛ ye ngoalelɛ ne.
4Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛ́bɔ AWURADE nwo ese;
ɛ́mɔtea nu beli ahurusi, ná ɛ́mɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein.
5Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɛ́to AWURADE nwo dwein,
ɛ́mɔfa sangoo ne edweintolɛ.
6Ɛ́mɔfa totorobɛndo ne awɛenhulɛ
beli ahurusi bɛbɔ ese wɔ AWURADE bɔ ɔte hene ne nyunu.
7Ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede;
ewiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede!
8Asue mbiri mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ sa nu;
mmokaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ nu bɛto dwein beli ahurusi
9wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔ́ba,
ɔbaabua aseɛ so ama ndɛen.
Ɔkɔfa tenenee yeɛ okobua wiase ndɛen ɔ,
yeɛ ɔkɔfa ye pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 99
Content:
Ye AWURADE bɔ ɔte krongronniɛ ne ayɛ
1AWURADE di hene,
maen maen mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo wosowoso!
Ɔte kɛrubim mɔ so;
aseɛ, woso!
2AWURADE te piri wɔ Sion,
na odi maen maen amukoraa so.
3Odi kyɛ bɛye wɔ dumaa piri ne wɔ dumaa nwanwa ne ayɛ.
Ɔte krongron!
4Ɛhene piri bɔ ekuro ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ɔ,
ama pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ bo atimu,
ama ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne tenenee
wagyina wɔ Yakob nu.
5Ɛ́mɔkamvo AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne,
ɛ́mɔsɔne wɔ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne anwo,
ofikyɛ ɔte krongron!
6Né Mose ne Aarɔn bɛboka ye asɔfo nemɔ aso;
né Samuel boka bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye dumaa bɛsɔne ye nemɔ aso.
Besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE, na otiele bɛ.
7Odwudwo hyirele bɛ fili munungum ningɔnn ne anu.
Belili ye noa dwirɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔfa mane bɛ ne aso.
8Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, ebuale bɛ;
ɛyɛle bɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛfa bɔne kyɛ ɔ,
nakoso ɛyɛle bɛ bɔne so wereɛtɔlɛniɛ.
9Ɛ́mɔkamvo AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne,
ná ɛ́mɔsɔne wɔ ye bokaa krongron ne aso,
ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔte krongron.

Title: EDWEIN 100
Content:
Wiase amukoraa ye AWURADE ayɛ
Asennaa dwein
1Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛ́bɔ AWURADE nwo ese.
2Ɛ́mɔfa anigye bɛ́so AWURADE;
ɛ́mɔfa edweintolɛ bɛbra ye nyunu.
3Ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ɔ,
ye yeɛ ɔbɔle yɛ ɔ, na yɛte ye deɛ;
yɛte ye maen ne ye mmoaen bɔ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ɔ.
4Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa béwura ye anoa piri ne anu,
ná ɛ́mɔfa ayɛyelɛ bɛbra ye aluo berɛ.
Ɛmɔla ye ase, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam!
5Ofikyɛ AWURADE te paa,
ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ,
na ye nahorɛlilɛ wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.

Title: EDWEIN 101
Content:
Nana Dawide bɔhyɛ
Dawide dwein
1Ngɔto anwumvoinnwunɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo dwein;
ao AWURADE, wɔ nwo dwein yeɛ ngɔto ɔ.
2Atee bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ ne, so yeɛ ngɔfa ɔ.
Ao, kyinzu yeɛ ɛkɔwa me nwo wa ɔ?
Ngɔfa ahone bɔ nu te ɔ ngɔnate m’awuro berɛ.
3Mengɔfa nikyee biala bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ
mengosie me nye so.
Bɛ bɔ bedi wɔ dwirɛ nwo makyebu ne, mekyi bɛ yɔleɛ;
mengɔma bɛ yɔleɛ ne ngɔte ngɔmata me.
4Ngondombo adwene de, mengɔmaa ongopingye me le.
Mengɔfa me nwo mengɔfɔlefɔle bɔne biala.
5Ebiala bɔ ɔfea toatoa obiɛngo ne,
ngɔmaa ɔkɔhã ye noa kɔto nu.
Sona bɔ ɔte nduhoɛ ne anwomasoɛ ne de,
mengɔpene ye.
6Maen ne anu nahorɛlilɛfoɛ nemɔ, ngɔlo bɛ,
amaa ɔnate so bɛ ne me atena.
Sona bɔ ɔnate atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ so ne,
ye yeɛ ɔkɔso me ɔ.
7Nnakannakaniɛ biala de, ɔngɔtena m’awuro berɛ;
yeɛ ngondomboniɛ biala koso, ongogyina me nyunu.
8Ngyerɛmɔ biala,
ngohũhũ aseɛ ne aso bɔnefoɛ amukoraa,
amaa ɔnate so matu amumuyɛɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛ bo mafi AWURADE kuro ne anu.

Title: EDWEIN 102
Content:
Nya anyelasoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nu
Sona bɔ wahɔ amaneɛ nu bɔ odi yealɛ ɔ, ye mbaeɛ
1Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ;
ma me sufrɛ oodwu wɔ nyunu.
2Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me
wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu.
Yɛ asoɛ tie me;
sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, bua me ndɛndɛ.
3Ofikyɛ me ngyẽa pɛ nu kɔ kyɛ nwosina,
na me mmowue nu yerayera me kyɛ see.
4M’ahone akese wayɛ twindwann kyɛ ndire,
na me wora afi kyɛ ngodidi ɔ po.
5Ɔnate kyɛ mepene serɛserɛ ne ati,
me nwo ayeye mmowue.
6Mayɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ so pɛtɛ,
mayɛ kyɛ kurofoen so patue.
7Nnakorɔkorɔ atɔ me so,
mayɛ kyɛ anomaa bɔ waha ye ngome wɔ sua so ɔ.
8Daa biala, me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã me anyinga;
bɛ bɔ bɛgoro me nwo ne, bɛfa me dumaa bɛwa amoen.
9Ofikyɛ medi nzoen kyɛ aleɛ,
na mefa me nye moen mefra me nzue,
10ɔnate wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ ne w’ahonehulɛ ne ati;
ofikyɛ apagya me afindi me ato.
11Me ngyẽa ba ayieleɛ kyɛ nɔsoa wawoɛ;
na mekese kyɛ ndire.
12Nakoso, ao AWURADE, ɛte w’ahennie bia so afebɔɔ;
wɔ dumaa timu berɛ daa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
13Ekodwɔso konwu Sion anwumvoin,
ofikyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛdo ye ɔ,
mmerɛ bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne waso.
14Ofikyɛ ye nyɔboɛ mɔ bedi mu ma wɔ somvoɛ mɔ,
na wɔ somvoɛ benwu ye mvuture anwumvoin.
15Maen maen mɔ bekosuro wɔ dumaa ne,
na aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa bekosuro w’animnyam ne.
16Ofikyɛ AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye Sion;
ɔkɔye ye nwo ali wɔ ye animnyam nu.
17Okotie sona bɔ olle bie ɔ ye mbaeɛ,
ná ɔngɔpo bɛ mbaeɛ.
18Odi kyɛ bɛkyerɛ ɛhe bɛto berɛ bɛma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔbaawa ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so mmenia bɔ bennya bɛwwole bɛ ne, baye AWURADE ayɛ kyɛ,
19Ɔtole ye nye fili ye nekaa krongron bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne, ɔneane ase,
AWURADE tole ye nye fili nyameɛso neane ase,
20kyɛ okotie kukunufoɛ bɛ penenɛ,
kyɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ bɛbaahu bɛ ɔ,
21amaa ɔnate so mmenia babɔ AWURADE dumaa nwo dawure wɔ Sion,
ná babɔ ye ayɛyelɛ nwo dawure wɔ Yerusalem,
22wɔ mmerɛ bɔ maen maen mɔ ne ahennie mɔ
bɛkɔboa bɛ noa kyɛ bɛsɔne AWURADE ɔ.
23Wama m’anwoserɛ so ate wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu,
na wapɛ me ngyẽa so.
24Menwa, “Ao me Nyameɛ,
wɔ bɔ ɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu ɔ,
nnɛde me ngoa fi me sa nu wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu.”
25 Daa tetetete yeɛ ɛtole aseɛ fapem ɔ,
na anwuro te wɔ sa noa adwuma.
26Bɛ boso konua, nakoso wɔ de, ɛwɔ berɛ daa;
amba, bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔtete kyɛ ɛtena.
Ɛkɔsesã bɛ kyɛ ndaadeɛ, na bɛ boso komini.
27Nakoso wɔ de, bɔ ɛte ala yeɛ ɛte ɔ,
wɔ ngyẽa olle ayieleɛ.
28Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ, bɛ mma mɔ kɔtena ase asomdwee nu,
bɛ boso ama mɔ, bɛ bo kotimu wɔ wɔ nyunu.

Title: EDWEIN 103
Content:
Me kra ye AWURADE ayɛ
Dawide dwein
1Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ,
yeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ me nu amukoraa,
ɛ́mɔye ye dumaa krongron ne ayɛ.
2Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ,
na nnɛma wɔ wora fi ye nningyein paa nemɔ anu biala.
3Ye yeɛ ɔfa w’amumuyɛɛ amukoraa kyɛ wɔ ɔ,
ye yeɛ ɔsa w’anwonyerɛ amukoraa ɔ;
4ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de wɔ ngoa fi ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ,
ye yeɛ ɔfa ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔbɔ w’abotire ɔ;
5ye yeɛ ɔmaa enya nningyein paa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ase ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so wɔ mmerandeɛ nu osa kakyi foforɛ kyɛ kɔleɛ deɛ.
6Bɛ bɔ ebiemɔ hyɛ bɛ so ne,
AWURADE di bɛ mukoraa bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ,
na obua ndɛen turoloo ma bɛ.
7Ɔlale ye atee ali hyirele Mose,
na ɔlale ye nnwumaa ali hyirele Yisraelfoɛ.
8AWURADE se anwumvoin, na ɔdo mmenia,
ye ahone nhu ndɛ, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔsone.
9Ɔngɔma ye ahone ngohu yɛ so daa,
yeɛ ɔngɔma ye yaa ne ngɔtena berɛ daa.
10Ɔnnea yɛ bɔne nwo ɔne yɛ nni,
yeɛ ɔnnea y’amumuyɛɛ nwo ndua yɛ so kerɛ.
11Na kyɛbɔ anwuro ne aseɛ b’afia si wale ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne
ɔte piri ma bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ.
12Kyɛbɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ b’afia si wale ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ wamaa yɛne yɛ mmeraatolɛ y’afia atete ɔ.
13Kyɛbɔ seɛ si nwu ye mma anwumvoin ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE nwu bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ anwumvoin ɔ.
14Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔse kyɛbɔ osi bɔle yɛ ɔ,
na ɔkaye kyɛ yɛte mvuture.
15Dasaniɛ de, ye ngyẽa te kyɛ ɛserɛ;
ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm kyɛ eburo bakaa nyerɛen.
16Nakoso sɛ mvrama bɔ ye a, né waporo,
na ye boso nekaa bɔ otua ne, ɔnze ye ko.
17Nakoso AWURADE ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
ɔwɔ berɛ ofi tetetete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ
ma bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ,
na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ ma bɛ mma ne bɛ nnomaa mɔ;
18ɔwɔ berɛ ma bɛ bɔ bedi ye apam ne aso,
ná bɛkaye ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne kyɛ bekoli so ɔ.
19AWURADE afa ye ahennie bia watimu anwuro,
na ye ahennie di nikyee biala so.
20Ao AWURADE abɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ:
ɛmɔ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ
ná ɛmɔyɔ sotie bɛma ye dwirɛ ɔ.
21AWURADE asafo amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ,
ye somvoɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ ɔ!
22AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ
wɔ nekaa biala bɔ odi hene ɔ.
Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 104
Content:
Nyameɛ ma ye abɔdeɛ mɔ bɛ noa aleɛ
1Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ.
Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ɛte piri paa.
Afa animnyam ne ahennie nu animnyam ahera.
2Afa kanea agurɔ wɔ nwo kyɛ ɛtena;
atrɛtrɛ ewienu nu kyɛ ɛtena sua.
3Wɔ sua mbuna mɔ, begyigyi nzue mɔ so,
ɛfa munungum yɛ wɔ teaseɛnam,
na mvrama ye ndaa so yeɛ ɛnate ɔ.
4Ɛfa mvrama yɛ wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ,
yeɛ ɛfa see wuronyiwuronyi yɛ wɔ somvoɛ mɔ.
5Ɛfale aseɛ gyinane ye nyinasoɛ mɔ so,
kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɔngɔwoso le ɔ.
6Ɛfale buma katale so kyɛ ɛtena,
na nzue mɔ katale mmokaa nemɔ aso.
7Na ɛteateane bɛ ne, bɛnwatili;
bɛtele kyɛ ɛbɔle nu kurudududu ne, bɛnwati bɛhɔle.
8Bebu bɛfale mmokaa nemɔ aso,
na bɛwale ase beeguale bɔnza nemɔ anu,
nekaa bɔ ɛhyehyɛle mane bɛ ne.
9Ɛtole wɛen bɔ onni kyɛ bɛtra ye ɔ,
kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bengosa bɛngɔkata aseɛ so ko ɔ.
10Ɛma mbombonzue pu nzue wɔ bɔnza nemɔ anu,
bɛtengyɛ bɛfa mmokaa nemɔ afia,
11bɛma eburo kaka biala nya bie no;
eburo afunum mɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ bɛ nzuhɔen noa.
12Asue nemɔ anoa yeɛ ɔte ewienu nnomaa b’atenaleɛ ɔ;
bɛto dwein wɔ ye mmaen nemɔ anu.
13Efi w’atenaleɛ berɛ yeɛ eguagua mmokaa nemɔ aso nzue ɔ;
na wɔ sa noa nnwumaa yi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.
14Ɛma ndire fifi ma nyɛmmoa,
yeɛ ɛma fieso nningyein fifi bɔ sona yɔ ye nwo adwuma ɔ,
kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ okonya aleɛ kofi aseɛ nu ɔ,
15ɔne nzaa bɔ ɔma sona nye gye ɔ,
ɔne sakyeɛ bɔ ɔma sona nyunu yɛ mmenanwo mmenanwo ɔ,
yeɛ aleɛ bɔ ɔma sona wora kyekye ɔ.
16AWURADE guagua ye mmakaa so nzue pee paa,
Lebanon sida bɔ olualuale ne.
17So yeɛ nnomaa bɛnwo bɛ saen ɔ;
na asia mmakaa nemɔ aso yeɛ ɔte akyemvona katakyie nemɔ b’awuro ɔ.
18Mmokaa ndendenn nemɔ bɛte gyane mɔ b’afealeɛ,
yeɛ nyɔbotaen nemɔ koso bɛte ngrande mɔ b’afealeɛ.
19Ɛbɔle ɛsraen kyɛ ɔma yɛnwu mmerɛ nu nzakyerayɛɛ,
na eyia se mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɔkɔtɔ ɔ.
20Ɛma awosii ba, na aleɛ sa,
na sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ngaka amukoraa befitefite ɔ.
21Gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bobɔ nu bɛpena ngaka bɛkye bɛ,
na bɛ nye la Nyameɛ so kyɛ ɔkɔma bɛ sa kɔhã bɛ noa aleɛ ɔ.
22Sɛ eyia fite a, bɛworoworo,
na bɛkɔlela b’afealeɛ mɔ nu.
23Sona fite ɔkɔ ye adwuma nu,
na ɔyɔ adwuma toonn ma aleɛ dwo.
24Ao, AWURADE wɔ sa noa nnwumaa sone paa!
Ɛfale nworɛ tole ye nwo yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ mukoraa ɔ;
w’abɔdeɛ mɔ bayi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.
25Ɛpo yeɛ ɔla dɔ kandinga tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne,
ngaka bɔ bɛkongo pembepembe wɔ nu bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa ɔ,
bɛte abɔdeɛ mbiri mbiri ne mmaa mmaa.
26So yeɛ ɛlɛen mɔ bɛnate ɔ,
na ɛbɔle Ɛlɛngyɛen suronyisuronyi ne kyɛ oli angorɛ wɔ nu.
27Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nye la wɔ so,
kyɛ ɛkɔma bɛ sa kɔhã bɛ noa aleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.
28Sɛ ɛfa ma bɛ a, bɛboaboa ye noa;
sɛ ɛtrɛ wɔ sa nu a, ɛma nningyein paa bu bɛ so.
29Sɛ ɛye wɔ nye fea bɛ a, bɛ kunu te bɛ,
sɛ etua bɛ nwomeɛ a, bewuwu,
na besa bɛkɔ bɛ mvuture nu.
30Ɛsoma wɔ nwomeɛ yeɛ ɛfa bɔ bɛ ɔ;
na ɛma aseɛ so nningyein yɛ foforɛ.
31AWURADE animnyam kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ;
AWURADE nye kɔgye ye nnwumaa nwo,
32Ɔto ye nye nea aseɛ a, aseɛ woso,
ná ɔte ye sa kã mmokaa a, betu nwosina ɔ!
33Mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu ye, ngɔto dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ,
Kyɛ nde ase ye, ngɔto me Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
34Mesrɛ kyɛ ɔma bɔ medwene ye nwo ne ɔsɔ ye nye,
ofikyɛ AWURADE nu yeɛ medi ahurusi ɔ.
35Ma bɔnefoɛ bewuwu befi aseɛ so,
nnɛma amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛtena ngoa nu ko.
Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ.
Kamvo AWURADE!

Title: EDWEIN 105
Content:
Nyameɛ di nahorɛ ma Yakob
(1 Aberɛso Dwirɛ 16.8-22)
1Ao, ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛma AWURADE,
ɛ́mɔsu bɛfrɛ ye dumaa,
ɛmɔhã ye anwanwadeɛ ne behyire maen maen mɔ!
2Ɛ́mɔto ye nwo dwein,
ɛ́mɔto ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.
3Ɛ́mɔfa ye dumaa krongron ne bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo.
Bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne, ma bɛ nye gye.
4Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE ne ye tumi.
Ɛ́mɔpena ye si atee daa biala.
5Ɛ́mɔkaye anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wayɔ ne,
ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mɔ ɔne ye ndɛen bɔ wabua ne.
6O, ye somvoɛ Abraham boso ama,
Yakob boso ama bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ.
7Ye yeɛ ɔte AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ;
obua aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa ndɛen.
8Ɔkaye ye apam ne daa,
bɔ ɔte edwirɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle
mane aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ apee ko ne,
9apam bɔ ɔne Abraham bɛyɛle ne,
bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔtale ndaen foale so fa mane Yisake ne,
10bɔ osili ye pi fa yɛle ahyɛdeɛ mane Yakob ne,
bɔ ɔyɛle apam afebɔɔ mane Yisrael ne,
11bɔ ɔhane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ,
“Wɔ yeɛ ngɔfa Kanaan aseɛ ne ngɔma wɔ
kyɛ ɛmɔ bue deɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ɔ.”
12Mmerɛ bɔ né banzo,
bɔ né bemmu bɛ, ná bɛte ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ ne aso,
13bɔ bekyinikyini maen maen mɔ so,
bɔ befi ahennie ko anu bɛkɔ maen foforɛ nu ne,
14wamma ebiala wandane bɛ nye;
na ɔnate bɛ ti ɔhwene ahemvo mɔ so.
15Ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mmenia bɔ mapopa bɛ ngoo ne,
nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛkã bɛ;
yeɛ me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ koso,
nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɛ bɔne biala!”
16Ɔmane ɛhɔen wale aseɛ ne aso,
ná ɔsɛkyele b’aleɛ amukoraa ne,
17 ɔyele biaa bie maa olili bɛ nyunu moa.
Ye ole Yosef bɔ bɛtɔnene ye maa ɔɔyɛle akoaa ne.
18Beguale ye gya ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ma omiane ye,
bɛfale ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɛsɔle ye kɔme,
19kɔpem kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu ɔ:
AWURADE dwirɛ ne mane ye nwo sale.
20Ɛhene ne somane maa bɛɛyele ye befili kuku nu;
bɔ odi maen maen mɔ so ne maa onyane ye ti odidili nu.
21Ɔmaa ɔyɛle ye awuro ne aso meneɛ,
ɔne bɔ ole ye amukoraa so neafoɛ,
22kyɛ ɔ́fa ahyɛdeɛ ma ye safohene mɔ kyɛbɔ okuro ɔ,
ná otu ye mbanyi mɔ foɛ.
23Afei Yisrael wale Misraim;
Yakob oosikyele Ham aseɛ so.
24Na AWURADE mane ye mmenia bɛtale pee,
na ɔmaa benyane anwoserɛ bɛtrale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ.
25Ɔmane pɔfoɛ nemɔ adwene sesane maa bɛpɔle ye mmenia nemɔ.
Na bɛfale nworɛ atee so bɛhyɛle ye somvoɛ nemɔ aso.
26Ɔsomane ye somvoɛ Mose,
yeɛ Aarɔn bɔ ɔneaneane nu yele ye ne.
27Bɛyɔle ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ bɛ nu,
ɔne ye anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham aseɛ so.
28 Ɔsomane awosii, na ɔmane aseɛ ne aso yɛle tunn;
nakoso bamva ye dwirɛ ne banyɛ huu.
29Ɔkakyili bɛ nzue mɔ mogya,
na ɔmane b’asue nu naen mɔ wuwuli.
30Mborohyɛen lele b’aseɛ ne fale,
maa belele b’ahemvo mɔ bɛ pumbu nu po bɛfale.
31Odwudwole, na atuin pembepembe paa
yeɛ ngondia wale bɛ maen ne anu nekaa biala.
32Ɔmane asukɔtwea tɔle kyɛ esue guale bɛ so,
na agralaa tetele wɔ bɛ maen ne anu amukoraa.
33Ɔsɛkyele bɛ bobe ne bɛ borɔdoma mmakaa,
na obubuli bɛ maen ne anu mmakaa.
34Odwudwole, na mmɛbɛ wale,
yeɛ nduro bɔ ɛka a ennwu bɛ noa ɔ;
35belili b’aseɛ ne aso nyaa amukoraa,
na belili b’aseɛ ne aso aleɛ.
36Ohuhuni bɛ maen ne anu bamuɛbaa amukoraa,
bɔ bɛte bɛ bienzua nu anwoserɛ amukoraa bɔ oli moa ne.
37 Yeɛ ɔmane Yisrael nyane ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ,
na ɔyele bɛ fili berɛ hɔle,
na ebiala nne ye mmusua kure nemɔ anu bɔ ɔyɛle mmerɛ ɔ.
38Befili berɛ ne, Misraim nye gyele,
ofikyɛ né bɛ nwo suronyi atɔ ye so.
39Ɔtrɛle munungum nu maa ɔyɛle ngatasoɛ,
yeɛ ɔmane see yɛle bɛ kanea kɔngɔen.
40Bebisale, na ɔfale ayenzii mɔ brɛle bɛ,
na ɔmane bɛ aleɛ fili nyameɛso mane bɛ ko yili.
41Ɔpakyele nyɔbotaen ne anu, na nzue pu wale,
na ɔtengyɛ fale ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ asue.
42Ofikyɛ ɔkayele ye bɔhyɛ krongron ne,
ɔne ye somvoɛ Abraham.
43Yiti ɔyele ye mmenia fili berɛ wɔ anigye nu,
bɛ yeɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ, na bɛfale edweintolɛ bɛhɔle.
44Ɔfale maen maen mɔ b’aseɛ mane Yisraelfoɛ,
ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ bɛ sa hane bɔ maen maen nemɔ bafɛ banya ɔ,
45amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ bali ye ahyɛdeɛ so,
ná bali ye mmeraa so.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 106
Content:
Yisrael kã ye bɔne
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa;
na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
2Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhã AWURADE nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ne ɔ,
anaa ɔkɔhora kɔbɔ ye ayɛyelɛ amukoraa nwo dawure ɔ?
3Bɛ bɔ bebua ndɛen turoloo ne,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ daa biala ne,
benya saleɛ.
4Ao AWURADE, sɛ ɛdo wɔ maen a, kaye me bie;
sɛ ɛpepɛ de bɛ a, de me bie;
5amaa ɔnate so manwu bɛ bɔ aneanea nu aye bɛ ne bɛ ngɔsoɛ,
ná mali ahurusi wɔ wɔ maen anigye ne anu,
ná me ne w’agyapadeɛ yahoahoa yɛ nwo.
6Yɛne yɛ nana mɔ yayɔ bɔne;
yayɔ amumuyɛɛ, na yayɔ bɔne piri.
7 Yɛ nana mɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Misraim ne,
bande w’anwanwadeɛ nemɔ abo,
yeɛ bangaye wɔ ɔdɔ kandinga bɔ onni ngasi ne,
na mmom bɛyɛle Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne aso lɔen wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anwo.
8Nakoso ɔnate ye dumaa ti, ɔpepɛ lele bɛ,
amaa ɔnate so wala ye tumi kandinga ne ali.
9Ɔhane Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anyunu maa ɔwewele koraa;
olili bɛ nyunu maa bɛfale buma ne anu kyɛ ɛserɛ so ahɔ ɔ.
10Yiti ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili mmenia bɔ bekyi bɛ ɔ nemɔ sa nu,
na olele bɛ fili pɔfoɛ nemɔ sa nu.
11Nzue ne mene bɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ
