bɔ bɛ nu ko po wanga ɔ.
12Afei Yisraelfoɛ lele ye dwirɛ ne belili,
na bɛtole ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.
13Nakoso wangyɛ yeɛ bɛ wora fili ye nnwumaa ɔ,
na banwondɛ bandie ye ahyɛdeɛ.
14 Na mmom benyane akɔnnɔ tɛɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso,
na besole Nyameɛ bɛneane wɔ aseɛ pralaa ne aso.
15Ɔfale bɔ bɛpena ɔ mane bɛ,
nakoso ɔtele anwonyerɛ tɛɛ guale bɛ so.
16Bɛ nye borole Mose wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu,
ɔne AWURADE krongronniɛ Aarɔn koso.
17Aseɛ nu pakyele, na ɔmene Datan,
na ɔkatale Abiram kure ne aso siele bɛ.
18See koso sɔle wɔ bɛ kure ne anu,
na buruburugya ne yerale bɔnefoɛ nemɔ.
19Bɛyɔle nandwie ba wɔ Horebo,
na bɛsɔnene amoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bayɔ ɔ.
20B’animnyam ne,
bɛfale nandwie bɔ odi ndire ɔ ye sɛso besili ye gya nu.
21Bɛ wora fili Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte bɛ Defoɛ ne,
bɔ ɔyɔle nningyein mbiri mbiri wɔ Misraim ne,
22bɔ ɔyɔle anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham aseɛ so ne,
ɔne nningyein suronyisuronyi wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ nwo ne.
23Yiti ɔhane kyɛ okohũhũ bɛ.
Nakoso Mose bɔ waneanea nu waye ye ne,
ɔpale kyerɛ mane bɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu,
kyɛ ɔma ye ahone ɔtɔ nzue nu, ná nnɛmaa okũkũ bɛ.
24Afei aseɛ kamakama ne, bɛtole ye nwo,
na bannya gyidie wɔ ye bɔhyɛ ne anu.
25Bɛyɛle nwuhunwuhu wɔ b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu,
na bandie AWURADE dwirɛ.
26Yiti ɔmane ye sa so tale ndaen guale bɛ so kyɛ,
ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso,
27 na ɔkɔbɔ bɛ boso ama kɔsande kɔhɔ maen maen mɔ so,
ɔkɔto bɛ kɔpete aseɛ nemɔ aso.
28Afei bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛɛbɔle bosoen Baal Peɔ,
na belili afɔleɛ mɔ bɔ babɔ bama awufoɛ ɔ.
29Bɛfale bɛ yɔleɛ bewurale AWURADE apue,
na amaneɛ pirikua tole bɛ.
30Yeɛ Finehase dwɔso gyinane lili bɛ ti dwirɛ mane bɛ,
na ewue anwonyerɛ ne abo pɛle.
31Ɔnate ɛhe ati bebuli ye kyɛ ɔtengyɛ
wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu afebɔɔ.
32 Behuli AWURADE ahone wɔ Meriba nzue ne anwo,
na ɔnate bɛ ti Mose nyane edwirɛ.
33Ofikyɛ bɛmane Mose ahone huli,
na ole ɛyaa dwudwole.
34Yisraelfoɛ banguku maen maen nemɔ so mmenia
bɔ AWURADE fale bɛ nwo ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ ne,
35na mmom bɛ ne bosoensolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane bɛbɔle nu,
na besuane bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ bɛyɔle bie.
36Bɛsɔnene bɛ mmosoen nemɔ,
na ɛhe yɛle bɛ so ngaen.
37Bɛfale bɛ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua
bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane sunzummɔne mɔ.
38Bɛhane mogya bɔ onni fɔ ɔ beguale,
bɔ ɔte bɛ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua bɛ mogya,
bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Kanaan mmosoen mɔ ɔ;
na mogya ne mane efiɛ hane aseɛ ne.
39Yiti bɛ yɔleɛ mane bɛ nwo guale fiɛ,
na bɛ yɔleɛ ne kakyili adwamanbɔlɛ.
40Yeɛ AWURADE fɛle ye maen ne aso yaa paa,
na ohyili ye agyapadeɛ ne.
41Ɔfale bɛ wurale maen maen mɔ sa
maa ɔnate so bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ lili bɛ so.
42Bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ hyɛle bɛ so,
na belili bɛ so tumi maa bewurale bɛ bo.
43AWURADE pepɛ lele bɛ mmerɛ pee,
nakoso bɛhyɛle da bɛhɔle so bɛyɛle ye so asoserɛ,
na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti, bɛbrɛle bɛ ase.
44Nakoso onwuni amaneɛ bɔ né benwu ye ne,
na otiele bɛ sufrɛ.
45Ɔnate bɛ ti, AWURADE kayele ye apam ne,
na onwuni bɛ anwumvoin,
kyɛbɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye piri si te ɔ.
46Na bɛ bɔ bɛhyele Yisraelfoɛ nnure amukoraa,
Nyameɛ maa benwuni Yisraelfoɛ anwumvoin.
47Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, pepɛ de yɛ,
ná boa yɛ noa fi maen maen nemɔ aso,
amaa ɔnate so yala wɔ dumaa krongron ne ase,
ná yahoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ w’ayɛyelɛ nu.
48AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne,
animnyam hã ye ofi tetetete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ!
Ma maen ne amukoraa bɛhã kyɛ, “Amen.”
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 107
Content:
Nwomaa bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu
Edwein 107—150
Nyameɛ nwu ye mma anwumvoin
1 Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa,
na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
2Bɛ bɔ AWURADE apepɛ ale bɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛkã sɔ;
bɛ bɔ wapepɛ wale bɛ wafi amaneɛ nu,
3ná waboaboa bɛ noa wafi aseɛ mɔ aso,
ofi eyia afiteleɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu eyia atɔleɛ,
ofi sorɔ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ngwaen ne.
4Behyinihyinini aseɛ pralaa so
wɔ atee bɔ ebiala mva so ɔ so,
bɔ bannwu kuro biala bandena so ɔ.
5Ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen huni bɛ,
na bɛ kra botole wɔ bɛ nu.
6Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.
7Olili bɛ nyunu fale bɛ fale atee tee so
maa benyane kuro bɛtenane so.
8Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.
9Ofikyɛ ɔma sona kra bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ɔ nzue,
na ɔfa aleɛ paa ma sona kra bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ ma ye ko yi.
10Ebiemɔ tenane awosii ne ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu,
kukunufoɛ bɔ benwuni amaneɛ ná beguale bɛ ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ɔ.
11Ofikyɛ bɛyɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo lɔen,
na bebuli Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ animtia.
12Ɔfale amaneɛ piri tole bɛ so brɛle b’ase,
befifini ase bɔ bannya bokafoɛ biala ɔ.
13Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.
14Ɔyele bɛ fili awosii ne ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu,
na obubuli ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɔ ogua bɛ ne anu.
15Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.
16Ofikyɛ wabubu kɔɔbere anoa mɔ,
na wapepɛ buralɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi.
17Ebiemɔ yɛle ngwaseafoɛ ɔnate bɛ mmeraatolɛ ti,
na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti benwuni amaneɛ.
18Bɛ kra noa nu tole wɔ aleɛ biala nwo,
na bepingyele ɛborɔ atee pambim.
19Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.
20Ɔsomane ye dwirɛ ne, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ,
na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.
21Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.
22Na odi kyɛ bɛbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ,
ná bɛfa ahurusi dwein bɛbɔ ye nnwumaa nwo dawure.
23Ebiemɔ fale ɛlɛen bɛhɔle ɛpo,
na belili dwaa wɔ asue mbiri nemɔ aso.
24Benwuni AWURADE nnwumaa,
ye anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa wɔ buma ne anu.
25Ofikyɛ ɔhyɛle mvrama piri maa otuli,
na mvrama ne mane ɛpo asorɔkye pagyale.
26Ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro, na osa ooguale buma nemɔ anu;
edwirɛ bɔ ɔtole bɛ ne ati, b’anwoserɛ tu minini.
27Nzue ne hwene bɛ hɔle faen, né wahwe bɛ wahɔ faen,
na bɛnatele fofalifofali kyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ;
b’adwene minini wɔ bɔ wato bɛ ne anwo.
28Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.
29Ɔmane mvrama piri ne yɛle konn,
na ɛpo asorɔkye ne yɛle dinn.
30Afei ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ kyɛ mvrama ne asorɔkye ne noa abrɛ ase ɔ,
na ɔfale bɛ hɔle b’ɛlɛen agyinaleɛ bɔ bɛpena ne anu.
31Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,
wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.
32Odi kyɛ bɛkamvo ye wɔ maen nyianu ne anu,
ná bɛye ye ayɛ wɔ mbanyi badwa ne anu.
33Ɔkakyi asue mɔ maa bɛyɛ ɛserɛ,
na ɔkakyi mbombonzue mɔ maa bɛyɛ aseɛ wosee,
34ɔkakyi aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ maa ɔyɛ ɛgyɛhyerɛ,
ɔnate aseɛ ne aso ama bɛ bɔne ti.
35Ɔkakyi ɛserɛ maa ɔyɛ ɛkwaa,
ɔkakyi aseɛ wosee maa ɔyɛ mbombonzue.
36Na berɛ yeɛ ɔma bɛ bɔ ɛhɔen ku bɛ ne bɛtena ɔ,
na bɛkyekye kuro bɛtena so;
37bɛyɔ boo, bedua bobe,
na benya fieso aleɛ pee.
38Oyira bɛ maa bɛta pee,
na ɔmma bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ bɛ somaa so nde.
39Bɛ somaa so te, na bedi bɛ so ngonim,
ɔnate nhyɛsoɛ, amaneɛ ne aworabɔlɛ ti.
40Obu atitirefoɛ animtia,
na ɔmaa bekyinikyini wɔ ɛserɛ so bɔ atee ɔnne so ɔ so.
41Nakoso ɔma bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so fi amaneɛ nu,
na ɔma bɛ mmusua yɛ pee kyɛ mmoaen kure.
42Teneneefoɛ nwu ye, na bɛ nye gye;
na amumuyɛɛ amukoraa bɛkã bɛ noa bɛto nu.
43Ebiala bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔdwene sɔ edwirɛ hemɔ anwo,
odi kyɛ ɔdwene AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo yee.

Title: EDWEIN 108
Content:
Ayɛyelɛ dwein
Dawide dwein
(Edwein 57.7-11)
1Ao Nyameɛ, m’ahone gyi berɛ pindinn,
m’ahone gyi berɛ pindinn!
Ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
Me kra, tingye!
2Sangoo ne adengum, ɛ́mɔtingye!
Me koso ngotingye alebahyene.
3Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu;
ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ maen nemɔ anu.
4Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne,
ye piri kɔ anwuro tra ewienu dɔ paa,
yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu dɔ.
5Ao Nyameɛ, kyire kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ wɔ anwuro anwuro.
Ma w’animnyam kata aseɛ so amukoraa.
(Edwein 60.5-12)
6Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne ati,
fa wɔ sa famaa ne de yɛ ngoa, ná tie me.
7Nyameɛ ahã ye wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ kyɛ,
“Ngɔfa ahurusililɛ nu
ngɔhyehyɛ Sɛkem nu,
ná mapakyepakye Sukote bɔnza ne anu.
8Gileade te me deɛ, yeɛ Manase koso te me deɛ;
Efraim te me buralɛ kyerɛ,
Yuda te me hɔtɔ.
9Moabo te me nyanzɛen,
Edom so yeɛ mefindi me mbaboa megua ɔ;
na Filistia so yeɛ mebɔ ngonimlilɛ ese ɔ.”
10Kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa me kɔhɔ so ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ okoli me nyunu kɔfa me kɔhɔ Edom ɔ?
11Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛppole yɛ anaa?
Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛyyakyili yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛ si gyinalɛ?
12Ao, boka yɛ de yɛ fi amaneɛ nu,
ofikyɛ kuro sona mmokalɛ te mbaen!
13Sɛ AWURADE boka yɛ so a, yɛkoli ngonim;
ye yeɛ okotiatia yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 109
Content:
Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔtɔ wereɛ ɔ
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao me Nyameɛ bɔ meye wɔ ayɛ ɔ, nnɛmua wɔ noa,
2ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ ne nnakannakafoɛ batu bɛ noa basie me so,
na bɛpepɛ anoanu dwirɛ begua me so.
3Bafa ɛpɔen dwirɛ babɔ me nwo mborɔkaa bayia,
na bɛfa ngondii bɛtoa me mbaen.
4Bɛ nwo ɔdɔ bɔ manya ye ne,
bɛto me soen bɛfa besi ye gya nu,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ mebɔ mbaeɛ (mema bɛ) po ɔ.
5Yiti bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ,
yeɛ bɛfa ɛpɔen betua me ɔdɔ so kerɛ.
6Ye bɔnefoɛ maa ɔho tia ye;
ma Abɔnzam ogyina ye sa famaa so.
7Ndɛenbualɛ nu, maa oli fɔ;
ma ye mbaeɛ ɔkakyi ye so bɔne.
8Ma ye ngoa ɔyɛ tika,
ma sona foforɛ ole ye dibea ne.
9Ma ye mma mɔ bɛyɛ nyisiaa,
ná ɔye koso ɔyɛ kunaniɛ.
10Ma ye mma mɔ bɛbɔ asesa ná bɛsrɛsrɛ;
maa betu bɛ befi b’awuro buburuwaa bɔ bɛte nu ne anu.
11Ma sona bɔ wabisa ye berɛ bosea ne, ole ye nwo nningyein amukoraa,
ná ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɛɛfẽ bɔ wafɛ wanya ye ɔ bɛfa.
12Nnɛma ebiala yɛ ye paa,
yeɛ nnɛma ebiala nwu ye mma ayisiaafoɛ nemɔ anwumvoin.
13Ma ye boso ama bɛ boso onua,
nnɛmaa bɛkaye bɛ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔtoa so ne anu.
14Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔkaye ye nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ wɔ ye nyunu,
yeɛ nnɛmaa okyikyi oni bɔne fi berɛ.
15Bɛ bɔne ne, ɔ́tena AWURADE nyunu daa,
na bɛ boso ngayeɛ okyikyi fi aseɛ ye aso.
16Ofikyɛ wangaye kyɛ okonwu anwumvoin ɔ,
na mmom ɔtanene ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo
ɔne bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ nye kyɛ ɔpena bɛ ne ewue.
17Ohurole amoenwaa, yiti maa obu osa ye.
Né ɔmbena saleɛ mma ye mmango, yiti maa saleɛ ɔbɔ ye.
18Ɔfale amoenwaa yɛle kyɛ ataadeɛ wurale,
yiti maa ɔmeme hɔ ye nwonaen nu kyɛ nzue,
kyɛ ngoo oowura ye mmowue nu.
19Maa ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛtena bɔ ɔkera ɔ,
kyɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔbɔ ye daa ɔ.
20Bɛ bɔ bɛto me soen ne bɛ bɔ bɛkã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ne,
maa ɛhe ɔyɛ b’akatuaa bɔ ofi AWURADE berɛ ɔ.
21Nakoso, ao Nyameɛ m’AWURADE,
wɔ dumaa ti, di me dwirɛ ma me;
pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔte paa.
22Ofikyɛ nde ehianiɛ, na meyɛ anwumvo,
na me kra aboto wɔ me nu.
23Me boso kyikyi kyɛ nɔsoa wawoɛ,
na mvrama bɔ me kɔ kyɛ abɛbɛ.
24Ɛhɔenhyelɛ ama m’aporɛ nu ayɛ hodwoo,
na mafɔ kangenaen.
25 Makakyi ngorohoɛ nikyee mama bɛ;
sɛ benwu me a, bɛwoso bɛ ti.
26Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, boka me!
Pepɛ de me kyɛbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne osi te ɔ.
27Maa benwu kyɛ wɔ tumi ɔ;
kyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ayɔ ɔ.
28Bɛ de bɛnoma, nakoso wɔ de eyira.
Sɛ bɛba me so a, ma bɛ nyunu gua ase,
nakoso wɔ somvoɛ de, ma ye nye gye.
29Ma me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛfa nyanzoen bɛhera,
ma bɛ bɔbɔ b’animguaseɛ owura bɛ kyɛ ataadeɛ.
30Ngɔfa me noa ngɔla AWURADE ase paa;
ngɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ɛlɔen kandinga nu.
31Ofikyɛ ogyi sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ ye sa famaa so,
kyɛ ode ye fi bɛ bɔ babua ye ewue foɛ ɔ bɛ sa nu.

Title: EDWEIN 110
Content:
Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ
Dawide dwein
1 AWURADE sele me mene kyɛ,
“Tena me sa famaa so
kɔpem kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.”
2Wɔ tumi hɔtɔ ne, AWURADE kɔtengyɛ kofi Sion.
Di hene wɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ b’afia.
3Kyẽa bɔ ekoli wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nyunu,
wɔ mmokaa krongron nemɔ aso ne,
wɔ maen kofia bɛ kunu bekotu bɛ nwo bekosie berɛ,
ofi ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, wɔ mmerandeɛ kɔwa wɔ berɛ kyɛ bosue.
4 AWURADE ata ndaen,
na ɔngɔsesã ye adwene:
“Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”
5AWURADE wɔ wɔ sa famaa so;
ye yaafɛlɛ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔtete ahemvo mɔ nu pasapasa.
6Okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen,
na ɔkɔmaa mmenia fuin koyi bɛ so to;
ɔkɔgorɔgorɔ mmenia ti wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa.
7Ɔkɔno atee noa asue nu nzue.
Ye sɔ ati, ɔkɔma ye ti so.

Title: EDWEIN 111
Content:
AWURADE nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ngofi m’ahone nu amukoraa ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma AWURADE
wɔ teneneefoɛ badwa nu, ɔne nyianu ne anu.
2AWURADE nnwumaa te mbiri mbiri,
na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛ nye gye nnwumaa ne anwo ne,
bɛdwenedwene ye nwo.
3Ye nnwumaa te anidie ne animnyam,
na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
4Wamaa bɛkaye ye anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa nemɔ;
AWURADE do mmenia, na ɔse anwumvoin.
5Bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne, ɔma bɛ aleɛ,
na ye nye wɔ ye apam so daa.
6Wala ye nnwumaa tumi ali wahyire ye maen,
ofikyɛ wafa maen maen mɔ b’agyapadeɛ wama ye maen.
7AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa te nahorɛ ne turoloo,
ye ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa timu berɛ pindinn.
8Betimu berɛ afebɔɔ,
kyɛ bɛ́fa atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ ná ɔte turoloo so beli so.
9Ɔpepɛ lele ye maen;
wahyɛ kyɛ ye apam tena berɛ afebɔɔ.
Ye dumaa te Krongron, na ɔyɛ suro!
10AWURADE surolɛ te nworɛnwunɛ ye bohyɛlɛ;
bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ ne, benya nimdeɛ paa.
Odi kyɛ bɛye ye ayɛ afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 112
Content:
Nyameɛ yira teneneeniɛ
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Sona bɔ osuro AWURADE,
ná ye nye gye ye mmeraa dwirɛ nwo paa ne, onya saleɛ.
2Ye boso ama kɔyɛ titire wɔ aseɛ ye aso;
teneneeniɛ ye aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ konya saleɛ.
3Anwonyadeɛ ne esikaa wɔ ye awuro,
na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
4Kanea pukye awosii nu ma teneneeniɛ;
ɔdo mmenia, ɔse anwumvoin, yeɛ ɔtengyɛ.
5Sona bɔ ye ti anu yɛ mmerɛ, ná ɔfa fɛmo ye mmango,
ná ɔfa nahorɛlilɛ bɔ ye bra ne, oyie ye yé.
6Ofikyɛ okogyina pindinn,
na ye nwo ngayeɛ kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.
7Onzuro ahunundetelɛ dwirɛ;
ye adwene si ye pi, na ye wora wura AWURADE nu.
8Ye adwene gyi berɛ pindinn, na ongosuro
kɔpem kyɛ bɔ ɔpena kyɛ ɔto ye pɔfoɛ mɔ ne, okonwu ye ɔ.
9 Ɔye ye kunu fa nningyein kyekyɛ, ɔyɛ ehiafoɛ paa;
ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ,
na ye anwoserɛ kɔhɔ so animnyam nu.
10Bɔnefoɛ nwu ye, na ɔyɛ ye ahi;
ɔkɔnwose ye gye ná waboto;
bɔ bɔnefoɛ wafa wasie ye nye so ne, ɔngɔyɛ berɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 113
Content:
Nyameɛ do sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ao AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ.
2Animnyam hã AWURADE dumaa,
ofi ɛnɛ kodwu afebɔɔ.
3Ofi eyia ye fitelɛ kodwu ye tɔlɛ,
odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ayɛ.
4AWURADE wɔ anwuro anwuro tra maen maen amukoraa,
na ye animnyam kɔ anwuro tra ewienu.
5Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ
bɔ ye atenaleɛ wɔ anwuro anwuro,
6bɔ ɔbere ye nye ase nea ewienu ne aseɛ so ɔ?
7Ɔma ehianiɛ so fi asefuo nu,
na ɔma sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ so fi fofoɛ so,
8kyɛ ɔmaa ɔtena atitirefoɛ nu,
ɔtena ye maen atitirefoɛ nu.
9Ɔmaa mmotaen brasua ɔbɔ taen,
maa ɔyɛ brataen bɔ ye nye agye ɔ.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 114
Content:
Abɔtra aluolue dwein
1 Mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael fili Misraim ne,
bɔ Yakob boso ama fili maen bɔ bɛkã dwudwolɛ foforɛ so ne,
2Yuda yɛle Nyameɛ nekaa krongron,
Yisrael yɛle ye maen bɔ odi so ɔ.
3 Ɛpo nwuni ye, na ɔnwatili;
asue Yɔɔdan sale ye si.
4Mmokaa nemɔ huruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen nyii,
pambaa nemɔ huruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen mmaa.
5Ao ɛpo, nzikyɛ yeɛ wayɔ wɔ maa anwati ye?
Ao asue Yɔɔdan, nzikyɛ yeɛ wamaa asa wɔ si ye?
6Ao mmokaa mɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔhuruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen nyii ye?
Ao pambaa mɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔma ɛmɔhuruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen mmaa ye?
7Ao aseɛ, ma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu,
ma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ wɔ Yakob Nyameɛ nyunu,
8ye bɔ ɔmane nyɔbotaen ne kakyili ɛkwaa,
ná ɔmane twerɛboɛ ne kakyili mbombonzue ne.

Title: EDWEIN 115
Content:
AWURADE ngome yeɛ ɔfata ayɛyelɛ ɔ
1Ao AWURADE, nna yɛ, nna yɛ,
na mmom wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔfata animnyam ɔ,
ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne ati.
2Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ maen maen bɛkã kyɛ,
“Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?” ɔ.
3Nahorɛ nu, yɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔwɔ anwuro,
na bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ.
4 Bɛ mmosoen nemɔ te ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ,
bɛte mmenia sa noa adwuma.
5Bele noa, nakoso bɛngora dwudwo,
bele anyeɛ, nakoso bennwu nikye.
6Bele asoɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ,
bele bonyi, nakoso bɛnde pambaen.
7Bele asaa, nakoso bɛngora bɛnzɔ nikyee nu;
bele agyirɛ, nakoso bɛngora nate,
yeɛ bɛngora bɛmva bɛ komvi bendwudwo.
8Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ mmosoen nemɔ ne,
bɛte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala;
na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura mmosoen nemɔ anu ne,
ɔte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala.
9Ao Yisrael, fa wɔ wora wura AWURADE nu!
Ye yeɛ ɔte wɔ bokafoɛ ne w’akokyɛm ɔ.
10Ao Aarɔn awuro ama, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora béwura AWURADE nu!
Ye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ bokafoɛ ne ɛmɔ akokyɛm ɔ.
11Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora béwura AWURADE nu!
Ye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ bokafoɛ ne ɛmɔ akokyɛm ɔ.
12AWURADE nye wɔ yɛ so, okoyira yɛ;
okoyira Yisrael awuro ama,
okoyira Aarɔn awuro ama;
13okoyira bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ɔ,
kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire mɔ.
14AWURADE kɔma ɛmɔ kɔta pee,
ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ bosofoɛ mɔ.
15AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne,
óyira ɛmɔ.
16Anwuro te Nyameɛ ye deɛ,
nakoso aseɛ de, wafa wama adasa mmaa.
17Awufoɛ bɛnye AWURADE ayɛ,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ dɔ konn nu ne, bɛ koso bɛnye ye ayɛ.
18Nakoso yɛ de, yɛkɔkamvo AWURADE,
ofi ɛnɛ kodwu afebɔɔ.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 116
Content:
Apɔtelɛ nwo asennaa
1Mekuro AWURADE dwirɛ,
ofikyɛ watie me mbaeɛ ne me sufrɛ.
2Wayɛ asoɛ watie me,
yiti ngosu ngɔfrɛ ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu ɔ.
3Ewue nyamaa brabrale me.
Ɛborɔ dɔ yealɛ sɔle me nu;
nwuni amaneɛ ne aworabɔlɛ.
4Yeɛ nzu mvrɛle AWURADE dumaa kyɛ,
“Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de me kra.”
5AWURADE do sona, ná ɔtengyɛ;
amba, yɛ Nyameɛ se anwumvoin.
6AWURADE bɔ awiɛmvoɛ nwo waen;
mmerɛ bɔ ngɔle amaneɛ nu ne, ɔpepɛ lele me.
7Ao me kra, sa kɔ nekaa bɔ ede wɔ nwome ne,
ofikyɛ AWURADE alo wɔ paa.
8Apepɛ ale me kra afi ewue nu,
akyikyi me nye moen,
na amma manzoti.
9Ngɔnate AWURADE nyunu
wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ ye aso.
10 Male mali, mmerɛ bɔ ngane kyɛ, “Nwɔ amaneɛ nu paa” ne po.
11Nne ahunundetelɛ ngane kyɛ,
“Kuro sona biala te ngondomboniɛ.”
12Ɛlolɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE alo me ye,
nzikyɛ yeɛ me wora ngɔyɔ ngɔma ye ɔ?
13Ngɔma ngoalelɛ kulie ne aso,
ná mabɔ AWURADE dumaa masɔne ye.
14Ngotua m’aboadeɛ ngɔma AWURADE,
wɔ ye mmenia amukoraa bɛ nyunu.
15AWURADE ye teneneefoɛ bɛ wue,
odi mu wɔ ye nyunu.
16Ao AWURADE, nde wɔ somvoɛ,
nde wɔ somvoɛ, w’afaneɛ awa ole me.
Asangye nyamaa bɔ wakyekye me ne.
17Ngɔbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ,
ná masu mafrɛ AWURADE dumaa.
18Ngotua m’aboadeɛ ngɔma AWURADE,
wɔ ye mmenia amukoraa bɛ nyunu,
19wɔ AWURADE awuro n’aluo berɛ,
wɔ w’afia, ao Yerusalem.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 117
Content:
Ɛ́mɔye Nyameɛ ayɛ
1 Maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Maen maen amukoraa ɛ́mɔkamvo ye!
2Ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ ole ye ma yɛ ne, ɔte piri,
na AWURADE nahorɛlilɛ ne ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 118
Content:
AWURADE ye ɔdɔ wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ
1Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa,
na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!
2Odi kyɛ Yisrael kã kyɛ,
“Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”
3Odi kyɛ Aarɔn awuro ama bɛkã kyɛ,
“Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”
4Bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ,
“Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”
5M’amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu, nzu mvrɛle AWURADE;
AWURADE buale me, na ɔyele me fili nu.
6 AWURADE gyi me si, yiti menzuro,
nzikyɛ yeɛ sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?
7AWURADE gyi me si kyɛ ɔboka me,
na ngonwu bɔ mepena kyɛ ɔto me pɔfoɛ mɔ ɔ.
8Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔto AWURADE so
tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ wora kowura sona nu ɔ.
9Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔto AWURADE so
tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ wora kowura ahemvo mɔ nu ɔ.
10Maen maen amukoraa bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale,
nakoso AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!
11Bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale,
amba, bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale,
nakoso AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!
12Bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale kyɛ ɛwommaa,
nakoso benuane kyɛ mmowue see,
ofikyɛ AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!
13Besumuni me serɛserɛ paa bɔ ahaa mete metɔ ɔ,
nakoso AWURADE bokale me.
14AWURADE te m’anwoserɛ ne me dwein,
na ɔte me ngoadefoɛ.
15Esebɔlɛ ne ngonim dwein
bɛgyegye wɔ teneneefoɛ ɛtena sua mɔ nu kyɛ,
“AWURADE sa famaa ne di ngonim;
16AWURADE ama ye sa famaa ne aso,
AWURADE sa famaa ne di ngonim.”
17Mengowu, na mmom ngɔtena ngoa nu,
ná mabɔ bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ nwo dawure.
18AWURADE ahwe me so paa,
nakoso wamva me wanwura ewue sa.
19Ɛ́mɔbukyebukye tenenee anoa mbiri nemɔ bɛ́ma me
maa mva nu ngɔmva ayɛyelɛ mma AWURADE.
20AWURADE anoa piri ne ɛhe,
teneneefoɛ kowura nu.
21Meda wɔ ase kyɛ abua me,
ná ɛte me ngoadefoɛ ɔ.
22 Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne,
ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ.
23AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe ɔ,
na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ yɛ nye so.
24Ɛnɛ ole kyẽa bɔ AWURADE wahyehyɛ ne,
ɛ́mɔma yɛli ahurusi ná yɛ́ma yɛ nye gye wɔ nu.
25Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de yɛ!
Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, maa yɛnya ngɔsoɛ!
26 Saleɛ hã bɔ ɔ́ba wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu ne,
yɛwɔ AWURADE awuro wa yeɛ yɛyira wɔ ɔ.
27AWURADE te Nyameɛ,
na wama kanea ata ama yɛ.
Ɛ́mɔfa ɛberɛ bɛ́pɛ aluoluefoɛ nemɔ anwo beyia
maa oodwu afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anwo.
28Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ, ngɔye wɔ ayɛ;
wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ, ngɔpagya wɔ.
29Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase,
ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 119
Content:
Nyameɛ dwirɛ
1Bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu,
ná bedi AWURADE mmeraa so ne, benya saleɛ.
2Bɛ bɔ bedi ye noa dwirɛ so,
ná bɛfa b’ahone amukoraa bedi ye si ne, benya saleɛ.
3Afei koso bɛnyɔ mvomsoɛ,
na mmom bɛnate ye atee so.
4Afa wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ayɛ ahyɛdeɛ,
kyɛ yɛli so nahorɛ nu.
5Ao, ahaa né me bra atengyɛ fɔngɔnn,
bɔ medi w’ahyɛdeɛ so ɔ!
6Ɔba ye sɔ a, me nyunu ngogua ase,
ofikyɛ me nye wɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne amukoraa so.
7Sɛ mesua wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne a,
ngɔfa ahone bɔ nu te sannwuu ɔ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.
8Ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so,
ao, nnɛpo me korakora.
9Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né aberandeɛ ama ye bra ayɛ sannwuu?
Sana ɔnea wɔ dwirɛ ne aso ɔbɔ ye bra.
10Ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngoli wɔ si;
nnɛmaa medi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne anwo makyebu.
11Mafa wɔ dwirɛ ne masie me ti anu,
amaa ɔnate so manyɔ bɔne mandia wɔ.
12Ao AWURADE, yɛye wɔ ayɛ,
kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
13Mepakye nu mefa me noa
mebɔ wɔ noa nu nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.
14Me nye gye kyɛ ngoli wɔ noa dwirɛ so
tra anwonyadeɛ amukoraa.
15Ngɔdwene wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ anwo,
ná mama me nye awa wɔ atee nemɔ aso.
16Ngɔma me nye kɔgye w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo,
na mengɔma me wora ngofi wɔ dwirɛ ne.
17Do wɔ somvoɛ paa,
amaa ɔnate so matena ngoa nu mali wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.
18Bukye me nye maa nwu
anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔ mmeraa ne anu.
19Nde ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso,
nnɛfa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne fea me.
20Me kra ngora tena,
na ye wora dɔ wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmerɛ biala.
21Anwomasoɛfoɛ bɔ banoma bɛ,
bɔ bedi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ nwo makyebu ne, etwi bɛ nyunu.
22Nnɛmaa bɛgoro me nwo, yeɛ nnɛmaa begua me nyunu ase,
ofikyɛ mali wɔ noa dwirɛ so.
23Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ahemvo bɛtena ase bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ,
nakoso wɔ somvoɛ kɔdwene w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo.
24Wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ me nye gye ye nwo ɔ,
na ɔte me foɛtulɛfoɛ.
25Me kra la mvuture nu pakayaa,
maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne kyire ne.
26Ngane m’atee bɔ nnate so nwo dwirɛ ne,
ɛmane me mmuayɛɛ;
kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
27Maa nde w’ahyɛdeɛ atee ne abo,
na ngɔbɔ w’anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa ne anwo dawure.
28Aworabɔlɛ ama me kra aboto;
hyɛ me nguraen kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.
29Ye ngondombo bra fi me so kɔ,
ná fa wɔ mmeraa ne do me.
30Maneanea nu maye nahorɛlilɛ atee ne,
na mafa wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ masie me nye so.
31Mafa me nwo mamata wɔ noa dwirɛ ne,
ao AWURADE, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase.
32Ngɔfa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ atee ne aso wɔ anwokekanɛ nu,
ofikyɛ ɛtrɛ me nimdeɛ nu.
33Ao AWURADE, kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ atee ne,
na ngoli so ngoodwu ye bo.
34Ma me nimdeɛ, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ mmeraa ne aso,
na ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngoli so.
35Di me nyunu fa me fa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ atee ne aso,
ofikyɛ me nye gye ye nwo.
36Ma m’ahone ooli wɔ noa dwirɛ si,
na nnɛmaa okodi anyeboroborolɛ si.
37Nningyein bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ne, ye me nye fi bɛ nealɛ so,
maa nya ngoa wɔ w’atee ne aso.
38Ma wɔ bɔhyɛ ne, ɔbra nu ma w’akoaa
bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ osuro wɔ ne.
39Animguaseɛ bɔ mesuro ne, pa gua ma me,
ofikyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ te paa.
40Amba, me wora adɔ wɔ mmeraa ne;
gyina wɔ tenenee ne aso maa nya ngoa.
41Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye ye ali kyire me,
yeɛ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ te ɔ,
42amaa ɔnate so manya mmuayɛɛ mama bɛ bɔ bɛgoro me nwo ne,
ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.
43Edwirɛ nahorɛ ne hanɛ ne, nnɛmaa ɔbɔ me koraa,
ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne anu.
44Ngoli wɔ mmeraa ne aso mmerɛ biala
maa okoodwu afebɔɔ.
45Ngɔnate bɔ hwee nha me ɔ,
ofikyɛ mapena w’ahyɛdeɛ ne si atee.
46Ngɔhã wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo dwirɛ ngohyire ahemvo mɔ koso,
na me nyunu ngogua ase.
47Menya anigye wɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ nwo,
ofikyɛ ɔla m’ahone.
48Mekuro wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne, na mefa anidie mema ye,
na ngɔdwene w’ahyɛdeɛ ne anwo.
49Kaye wɔ dwirɛ bɔ ahã ahyire wɔ somvoɛ ne,
bɔ amaa mafa me wora mawura nu ne.
50M’amaneɛnwunɛ nu aworakyekyerɛ ole kyɛ,
wɔ bɔhyɛ ne maa menya ngoa.
51Anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛgoro me nwo paa,
nakoso menni wɔ mmeraa ne anwo makyebu.
52Ao AWURADE, sɛ medwene wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ofi tete ne anwo a,
né me wora akyekye.
53Ɔnate bɔnefoɛ bɔ bɛpo wɔ mmeraa ne ati,
m’ahone ahu paa.
54Awuro bɔ mayɛ ɛwɔfoɛ maatena nu ne,
w’ahyɛdeɛ yeɛ ɔte me dwein ɔ.
55Ao AWURADE, odwu kɔngɔen a mekaye wɔ dumaa,
na medi wɔ mmeraa ne aso.
56Ɛhe ayɛ me deɛ,
ofikyɛ mali wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.
57Ao AWURADE wɔ yeɛ ɛte me kyɛfa ɔ;
mehyɛ bɔ kyɛ ngoli wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.
58Mefa m’ahone amukoraa mesrɛ kyɛ do me;
nwu me anwumvoin kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.
59Sɛ medwenedwene me bra nwo a,
mesa metu agyirɛ mebadi wɔ noa dwirɛ so.
60Mema me nwo yɛ nyera, na menyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ
kyɛ ngoli wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ.
61Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɔnefoɛ nyamaa abrabra me de,
nakoso me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.
62Medwɔso abunnamu meda wɔ ase,
ɔnate wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne ati.
63Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bedi w’ahyɛdeɛ so ne,
nde bɛ mukoraa bɛ biɛngo.
64Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, wayi aseɛ ye aso to;
kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
65Ao AWURADE, alo wɔ somvoɛ
kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.
66Kyirekyire me wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne wɔ nimdeɛ ne,
ofikyɛ mede wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne medi.
67Anzana ɛbaahwe me so ne, né mali makyebu,
nakoso afei de, medi wɔ dwirɛ so.
68Ɛte paa, na ɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ,
kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
69Anwomasoɛfoɛ bato me soen,
nakoso mefa m’ahone amukoraa medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.
70B’adwene ala kyɛ nguɛ,
nakoso me de, me nye gye wɔ mmeraa ne anwo.
71Ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ɛhwene me so ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so masua w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
72Wɔ noa nu mmeraa te paa ma me
tra esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ apee apee.
73Wɔ sa yeɛ ɛfa bɔle me ná esiesiele me ɔ;
ma me ndeaseɛ maa mva nzua wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.
74Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bekonwu me bekoli ahurusi,
ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.
75Ao AWURADE, mese kyɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo,
na ɛnate nahorɛlilɛ so ahwe me so.
76Ma wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔkyekye me wora,
kyɛbɔ ahyɛ wɔ somvoɛ bɔ ne ala.
77Ma w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ne odwu me so maa nya ngoa,
ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte m’anigye ɔ.
78Ma anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛ nyunu ogua ase,
ofikyɛ bafa kanda nworɛ banwo me bo;
nakoso me de, ngɔdwenedwene w’ahyɛdeɛ ne anwo.
79Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ noa dwirɛ ne,
maa bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛɛbɔ me.
80Maa m’ahone nu ɔyɛ sannwuu wɔ w’ahyɛdeɛ so lilɛ nwo,
amaa ɔnate so me nyunu wangua ase.
81Me kra wora dɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne paa;
mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.
82Manea wɔ bɔhyɛ ate alaa ama me nye ayɛ samoo,
na mebisa kyɛ, “Kyinzu yeɛ ɛkɔkyekye me wora ɔ?”
83Ofikyɛ mayɛ kyɛ kɔndoa bɔ osinze nwosina nu ɔ,
nakoso me wora mvi w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
84Wɔ somvoɛ kɔnwondɛ maa okoodwu kyinzu?
Bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, kyinzu yeɛ ekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ?
85Anwomasoɛfoɛ batutu ngumaa kyɛ ndɔ nu;
bɛte mmenia bɔ benni wɔ mmeraa so ɔ.
86Wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne amukoraa te turoloo.
Bɛtane me nye mbaen, yiti boka me!
87Bayie me boso nua wɔ aseɛ ye aso,
nakoso mmbole wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.
88Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, maa nya me ti nnidi nu,
amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ noa dwirɛ ne aso.
89Ao AWURADE, wɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ,
ye bo atimu wɔ nyameɛso.
90Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa;
afa aseɛ atimu berɛ, na ogyi berɛ pindinn.
91Ɔnate wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ti yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɛnɛ ɔ,
ofikyɛ nikyee biala te wɔ somvoɛ.
92Sɛ nna wɔ mmeraa yeɛ me nye gye ye nwo a,
ahaa mawu wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.
93Me wora ngofi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ le,
ofikyɛ ɔnate so yeɛ amaa manya ngoa ɔ.
94Nde wɔ deɛ; pepɛ de me,
ofikyɛ medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.
95Bɔnefoɛ bɛtetɛ me bɛpena me beku me,
nakoso me de, wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ medwenedwene ye nwo ɔ.
96Manwu nekaa bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ amukoraa ye noa kɔpem ɔ,
nakoso wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne de, nu trɛ paa.
97Ao, kyɛbɔ mesi mekuro wɔ mmeraa ne ɔ!
Ye nwo yeɛ medwenedwene daa ɔ.
98Wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ maa menwu nworɛ metra me pɔfoɛ mɔ,
ofikyɛ ɔte me nu daa.
99Me nimdeɛ tra bɛ bɔ bekyire me nikyee amukoraa,
ofikyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo yeɛ medwenedwene ɔ.
100Me nimdeɛ tra mbanyi mɔ,
ofikyɛ medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.
101Metwe me nwo mefi bɔne atee biala so,
amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.
102Nnnili wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ nwo makyebu,
ofikyɛ ahyirehyire me.
103Wɔ dwirɛ ne, kyɛbɔ osi yɛ me fɛ ɔ!
Ɔyɛ me noa nu fɛ tra woɛ!
104Wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ nu yeɛ menya nimdeɛ ɔ;
yiti mekyi ngondombo atee biala.
105Wɔ dwirɛ ne te me gya bo kanea,
yeɛ ɔte hyireinn wɔ m’atee so.
106Mata ndaen, na ngoli so,
kyɛ ngoli wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne aso.
107Manwu amaneɛ paa;
ao AWURADE, maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.
108Ao AWURADE, de m’ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ ne to nu,
ná kyirekyire me wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.
109Ahaa me kra kora yɔ bɔ okuro ɔ daa,
nakoso memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.
110Bɔnefoɛ basua me ngaen,
nakoso menni w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo makyebu.
111Wɔ noa dwirɛ ne te m’agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ;
na ɔma me anigye wɔ m’ahone nu.
112Masiesie m’ahone kyɛ ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so
daa ngoodwu ayieleɛ.
113Mekyi mmenia bɔ b’adwene yɛ bɛ ndaa ndaa ɔ,
nakoso wɔ mmeraa ne de, mekuro.
114Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ne m’akokyɛm ɔ;
mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.
115Bɔnefoɛ, ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ
maa nni me Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso.
116Tira me nu kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ te ɔ maa nya ngoa;
na nnɛmaa me nyunu gua ase wɔ m’anyelasoɛ nu.
117Sɔ me nu ma nya me ti nnidi nu,
na daa biala ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ ne aso.
118Bɛ bɔ bedi w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo makyebu ne, ɛpo bɛ mukoraa,
ofikyɛ bɛ nnakannaka ne ɔte mbaen.
119Aseɛ ye aso bɔnefoɛ amukoraa, ebu bɛ kyɛ ewura,
yiti me nye gye wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo.
120Ɔnate wɔ nwo suronyi ti, me nwonaen wosowoso me,
na mesuro wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne.
121Mayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ná ɔte nahorɛ ɔ;
nnɛyakyi me wura bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ me so ɔ nemɔ sa.
122Gyina wɔ somvoɛ si maa onya ngɔsoɛ;
nnɛma ahandaenfoɛ besisi me.
123Wɔ ngoalelɛ ne wɔ tenenee bɔhyɛ ne,
manea bɛ ate alaa ama me nye ayɛ samoo.
124Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso boka wɔ somvoɛ,
ná kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
125Wɔ somvoɛ ole me; ma me nimdeɛ,
amaa ɔnate so manwu wɔ noa dwirɛ ne.
126AWURADE, mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛkɔkekã wɔ nwo ɔ,
ofikyɛ babu wɔ mmeraa ne aso.
127Amba, me nye gye wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne anwo
tra esikaa kɔkorɛ, tra esikaa kɔkorɛ paa.
128Yiti megyina wɔ dwirɛ so yeɛ mebɔ me bra ɔ;
na mekyi ngondombo atee biala.
129Wɔ noa dwirɛ ne yɛ nwanwa,
yiti yeɛ me kra di so ɔ.
130Wɔ dwirɛ nu ngyirekyiremuɛ ma kanea;
ɔma sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ɔ nya nimdeɛ.
131Mebukye me noa nu metee so,
ofikyɛ me wora adɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.
132Pɛne wɔ nye baanea me, ná do me,
kyɛbɔ ɛyɔ ma bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dumaa dwirɛ ne.
133Gyina wɔ dwirɛ so tutu me gya siesie yé,
na nnɛma amumuyɛɛ biala di me so.
134Pepɛ de me fi kuro sona nhyɛsoɛ nu,
amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.
135Ye w’adom ne ali kyire wɔ somvoɛ,
ná kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
136Mebɔ me nye a, ɛmoen ngome tatatata,
ofikyɛ mmenia nni wɔ mmeraa ne aso.
137Ao AWURADE, ɛtengyɛ,
na wɔ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo.
138Tenenee nu ne nahorɛlilɛ amukoraa nu
yeɛ ahyehyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ ɔ.
139Me mmɔdenbɔlɛ ogye wɔ me nu kyɛ see,
ofikyɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ wora afi wɔ dwirɛ ne.
140Wɔ dwirɛ ne, efiɛ biala nne ye nwo,
yiti wɔ somvoɛ nye gye ye nwo.
141Nde kãa, yeɛ mmenia mmu me,
nakoso memma me wora mvi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.
142Wɔ tenenee ne, ɔte tenenee afebɔɔ,
na wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte nahorɛ ɔ.
143Amaneɛ ne ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so,
nakoso wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔma me anika ɔ.
144Wɔ noa dwirɛ te tenenee daa;
ma me nimdeɛ, amaa ɔnate so manya ngoa.
145Mefa m’ahone amukoraa mesu;
ao AWURADE, bua me,
ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so.
146Mesu mefrɛ wɔ; pepɛ de me,
amaa ɔnate so mali w’ahyɛdeɛ so.
147Mepɛ aleɛ medwɔso mesu mepena mmokalɛ;
mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.
148Me nye gua so kɔngɔen amukoraa,
na ɔnate so medwenedwene wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo.
149Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso tie me mbaeɛ;
ao AWURADE, bɔ me ngoa nwo waen kyɛbɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne te ɔ.
150Bɛ bɔ bedi bɔne asi ne, bɛtwe bepingye;
bɛ ne wɔ mmeraa afia atee wale.
151Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ, epingye,
na wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa te nahorɛ.
152Nzua mvili wɔ noa dwirɛ ne anu dadadada,
kyɛ afa ahyɛdeɛ ne atimu berɛ afebɔɔ.
153Nea m’amaneɛ bɔ menwu ye ɔ, ná pepɛ de me,
ofikyɛ memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.
154Di me dwirɛ ma me, ná pepɛ de me;
ma me ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.
155Bɔnefoɛ bɛ ne ngoalelɛ b’afia atee wale,
ofikyɛ bɛmbena w’ahyɛdeɛ si atee.
156Ao AWURADE, w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ne te piri;
maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne te ɔ.
157Bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me ne, bɛsone,
nakoso menni wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo makyebu.
158Menwu bɛ bɔ benni wɔ dwirɛ ne aso ne a, né bɛ nwo yɛ me ahi,
ofikyɛ benni wɔ mmeraa so.
159Ao AWURADE, nea kyɛbɔ me nye si gye w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo ɔ!
Bɔ me ngoa nwo waen kyɛbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne si te ɔ.
160Wɔ dwirɛ te nahorɛ fi tetetete,
wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne anu biala wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
161Maen mbanyi bɛtane me nye mbaen,
nakoso mesuro kyɛ mengotie wɔ dwirɛ ɔ.
162Medi ahurusi wɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo,
kyɛ ebie bɔ wanya koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee ɔ.
163Mekyi ngondombo, mepɔ ye,
nakoso me nye gye wɔ mmeraa nwo.
164Ɛlɛho biala, meye w’ayɛ pɛen nzoo,
ɔnate wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne ati.
165Bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ mmeraa nwo ne,
benya asomdwee kandinga;
hwee ngɔtoatoa bɛ gya nu.
166Ao AWURADE, menea wɔ ngoalelɛ ate,
na medi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ so.
167Me kra di wɔ noa dwirɛ so,
me nye gye ye nwo paa.
168Medi w’ahyɛdeɛ ne wɔ noa dwirɛ so,
ofikyɛ m’atee amukoraa la wɔ nyunu.
169Ao AWURADE, ma me sufrɛ odwu wɔ nyunu,
ma me nimdeɛ kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.
170Ma me mbaeɛ oodwu wɔ nyunu;
pepɛ de me kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.
171Me noa kɔhã ayɛyelɛ dwirɛ,
ofikyɛ ekyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.
172Me temverema kɔto wɔ dwirɛ nwo dwein,
ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa tengyɛ.
173Ma wɔ tumi ne ɔɔboka me,
ofikyɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ yeɛ maneanea nu mafa ɔ.
174Ao AWURADE, me wora adɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne,
ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte m’anigye ɔ.
175Ma me kra ɔtena ngoa nu ná ɔye wɔ ayɛ,
ná ma wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne ɔboka me.
176Mali makyebu kyɛ boaen bɔ wamini ɔ; pena wɔ somvoɛ,
ofikyɛ memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.

Title: EDWEIN 120
Content:
De me fi ngɔngɔnzaafoɛ sa nu
1Mesu mefrɛ AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu,
na otie me.
2Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me kra
fi ngondombofoɛ bɛ sa nu
ɔne nnakannakafoɛ bɛ sa nu.
3Wɔ, nnakannakaniɛ,
nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma wɔ ɔ?
Nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ wɔ ɔ?
4Koɛhonɛniɛ agyaen anoa tworɔntworɔn kɔwɔ wɔ,
ná esaa see gonn wayera wɔ!
5Edwirɛ ato me oo, kyɛ nde amanvraniɛ wɔ Meseke,
kyɛ nde Kedare ɛtena sua nemɔ anu ɔ!
6Mmenia bɔ bekyi asomdwee ne,
me kra ne bɛ atena ahyɛ paa.
7Me de mekuro asomdwee,
nakoso sɛ medwudwo a,
né bɛbaafa ngondii bɛtoa me!

Title: EDWEIN 121
Content:
Nyameɛ kɔbɔ yɛ nwo waen
1Mema me ti so mefa me nye mekyire mmokaa nemɔ.
Nisua yeɛ me mmokalɛ fi ba ɔ?
2Me mmokalɛ fi AWURADE
bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne berɛ.
3Ɔngɔma wɔ gya ngosoti;
ye bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ne, ɔngɔtɔ ngosie.
4Tie, bɔ ɔnea Yisrael so ne,
ɔngɔtɔ ngosie, yeɛ ɔngɔla.
5AWURADE yeɛ ɔte wɔ neafoɛ ɔ;
AWURADE yeɛ ɔte wɔ fɔnwoo ɔ, wɔ wɔ sa famaa so.
6Eyia ngɔyera wɔ eyia,
yeɛ ɛsraen ngɔyɔ wɔ huu kɔngɔen.
7AWURADE kɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen kofi musue amukoraa nu;
ɔkɔbɔ wɔ kra nwo waen.
8AWURADE kɔbɔ wɔ hɔlɛ ne wɔ walɛ nwo waen
ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 122
Content:
Yerusalem nwo mbaeɛ ne ayɛyelɛ
Dawide dwein
1Besele me kyɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ” nen,
me nye gyele.
2Ao Yerusalem, yɛ gya gyigyi
wɔ pambim nemɔ anu.
3Yerusalem, bakyekye ye kyɛ kuro
bɔ bakyekye bama nu amia ɔ.
4Berɛ yeɛ mmusua kure nemɔ bɛkɔ ɔ,
AWURADE mmusua kure nemɔ;
kyɛ bɛkwaafa asennaa bɛma AWURADE dumaa,
kyɛbɔ wahyehyɛ wama Yisrael ne.
5Ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ bafa ndɛenbualɛ ahennie bia nemɔ basiesie ɔ,
Dawide awuro ama mɔ b’ahennie bia nemɔ.
6Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyɛ Yerusalem onya asomdwee:
“Bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dwirɛ ne, mesrɛ kyɛ oyie bɛ yé.
7Asomdwee ɔ́tena wɔ nu,
ná ngɔsoɛ ɔtena w’ahemvie nemɔ anu.”
8Nniɛma mɔ ne me mmango mɔ ati,
ngɔhã kyɛ, “Asomdwee ɔ́tena wɔ nu.”
9Ɔnate AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ye awuro ne ati,
ngɔpena wɔ yeeyɛlɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 123
Content:
Nyameɛ te m’anyelasoɛ
11 Wɔ yeɛ mema me ti so menea wɔ ɔ,
ao wɔ bɔ ɛte w’ahennie bia so wɔ nyameɛso ɔ!
2Amba, kyɛbɔ ngoaa
bɛ nye la bɔ bɛ mene ɔfa ma bɛ so,
ɔne kyɛbɔ afaneɛ
ye nye la bɔ ye mene brasua ɔfa ma ye so ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ nye la AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ so ɔ,
kɔpem kyɛ okonwu yɛ anwumvoin ɔ.
3Nwu yɛ anwumvoin, ao AWURADE, nwu yɛ anwumvoin,
ofikyɛ animguaseɛ ato yɛ maa wafono yɛ.
4Mmenia bɔ bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ ne,
bagoro yɛ kra nwo maa wafono yɛ,
yeɛ anwomasoɛfoɛ bagua yɛ kra nyunu ase maa wafono yɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 124
Content:
AWURADE pepɛ de yɛ
Dawide dwein
1Sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ogyinane yɛ si a,
afei, Yisrael kã e:
2sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ogyinane yɛ si a,
mmerɛ bɔ mmenia bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale yɛ ne,
3mmerɛ bɔ b’ahone huli yɛ so paa ne,
ahaa bɛmemene yɛ anyekaenn so;
4ahaa asue ayi apia yɛ wahɔ,
ahaa asorɔkye wabungam wafa yɛ kra so;
5ahaa nzue bɔ ɔse wuruwuru ɔ,
opiane yɛ hɔle.
6Animnyam hã AWURADE,
ye bɔ wamma bamva yɛ banyɛ naen
bammɔ bɛ gye so ɔ!
7Yɛ kra anya ye ti wadidi nu kyɛ anomaa
wafi ngaensualɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ ngaen nu,
ngaen ne anu abubu,
na yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu.
8AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne,
ye dumaa nu yeɛ yɛ mmokalɛ wɔ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 125
Content:
Nyameɛ bɔ ye mma nwo waen
1Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura AWURADE nu ne,
bɛte kyɛ Sion bokaa bɔ ɔnwoso,
ná mmom otimu berɛ daa ne.
2Kyɛbɔ mmokaa apɛ Yerusalem nwo ayia ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE apɛ ye maen nwo wayia,
ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.
3Ahemvo bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛ hɔtɔ ngɔhɔ so ngoli tumi
wɔ aseɛ bɔ bafa bama teneneefoɛ ne aso,
kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ teneneefoɛ
bɛngɔfa bɛ nwo bɛngɔfɔlefɔle amumuyɛɛ ɔ.
4Ao AWURADE, yɛ mmeni paa
ne bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ɔ paa.
5Nakoso mmenia bɔ bedi makyebu bɛfa b’atee bɔ ɔndengyɛ so ne de,
AWURADE kɔfa bɛ kɔfra amumuyɛɛfoɛ so kɔfoa bɛ kofi berɛ.
Asomdwee ɔ́tena Yisrael!

Title: EDWEIN 126
Content:
AWURADE ye yɛ fi nnurehyelɛ nu
1Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE fale Sion fili nnurehyelɛ nu sa wale ne,
edwirɛ ne yɛle yɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkye laleɛ ɔ.
2Ɛserelɛ yili yɛ noa nu to,
na anigye dwein yili yɛ temverema so.
Na bɛkekane ye wɔ maen maen mɔ nu kyɛ,
AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri wama bɛ.
3AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri wama yɛ,
na yɛ nye agye.
4Ao AWURADE, sa fa yɛ fi nnurehyelɛ nu bra,
kyɛ ngwaen dɔ aseɛ asue.
5Bɛ bɔ bele ɛmoen bedua nningyein ne,
bele anigye yeɛ bɛkɔte ɔ.
6Sona bɔ ole esuɛ fite kɔ, bɔ otira mmakaammaa paa kyɛ ɔkwaalua ne,
nahorɛ nu, ɔkɔfa ahurusi kosa kɔwa awuro,
bɔ otiratira ye fieso aleɛ bɔ bakyekye ye tire tire ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 127
Content:
Nyameɛ nne nu a sona fɛ mbaen
Solomon dwein
1Sɛ AWURADE anzi sua ne a,
suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛfɛ ye nwo mbaen.
Sɛ AWURADE wanwɛne kuro ne a,
wɛmvoɛ ne osiri ye nwo pɛ mbaen.
2Ɔte mbaen kyɛ ɛmɔkɔpɛ aleɛ bekodwɔso,
ná ɛmɔanna ndɛ,
ná ɛmɔfɛ tetanwuu bɛpena ɛmɔ noa aleɛ ɔ;
ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ okuro bɛ dwirɛ ne,
sɛ bɛda po a, ɔma bɛ bɔ behia ɔ.
3Amba, mmaa te AWURADE sa nu agyapadeɛ,
na aworɛ te ye sa nu saleɛ.
4Kyɛbɔ agyaen te wɔ koɛhonɛniɛ ye sa nu ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ sona ye mmerandeɛ mmerɛ nu mmaa bɛte ɔ.
5Sona bɔ sɔ agyaen nemɔ ayi ye ndokue nu tɛkyɛ ne,
onya saleɛ.
Sɛ ɔne ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã edwirɛ
wɔ kuro berɛ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ a,
ye nyunu ngua ase.

Title: EDWEIN 128
Content:
AWURADE surolɛ ma saleɛ
1Ebiala bɔ osuro AWURADE,
ná ɔnate ye atee so ne,
onya saleɛ.
2Ofikyɛ ekoli wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma nwo mvasoɛ;
wɔ nye kɔgye, na okoyie wɔ yé.
3Ɛye kɔyɛ kyɛ bobe bɔ osu biribiraa ɔ wɔ w’awuro,
na wɔ mma kɔyɛ kyɛ olive mmaen,
bɔ wapɛ wɔ poen nwo wayia ɔ.
4Amba, sona bɔ osuro AWURADE ne,
sɔa yeɛ onya saleɛ ɔ.
5AWURADE kofi Sion koyira wɔ,
na ekonwu Yerusalem ngɔsoɛ,
mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ngoa nu amukoraa.
6Amba, ekonwu wɔ nana nganzowa mɔ.
Asomdwee ɔhã Yisrael!

Title: EDWEIN 129
Content:
Ongoyie Sion pɔfoɛ mɔ yé
1“Ofi me ngwadaa nu, mmerɛ pee yeɛ bafa koɛ baateta me ɔ,
afei, Yisrael kã e:
2Ofi me ngwadaa nu, mmerɛ pee yeɛ bafa koɛ baateta me ɔ,
nakoso bangora banni me so ngonim.
3Nhyɛsoɛfoɛ babo me bama me si apakyepakye;
bamaa wabeabea berɛ ndendenn ndendenn.”
4AWURADE te teneneeniɛ,
wapepɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛ nyamaa nu.
5Bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ Sion amukoraa,
ma bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná besa bɛ si.
6Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ ndire bɔ wafifi sua so,
bɔ ɔkese ná onnyi ɔ,
7ye aleɛ ne, ondwu sona bɔ ɔpɛ fieso aleɛ ɔ ye sa bum,
yeɛ ondwu sona bɔ ɔkyekye ye tire tire ɔ ye sa bum;
8yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ ne, bɛnga kyɛ,
“AWURADE óyira ɛmɔ oo!
Yɛyira ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu oo!”

Title: EDWEIN 130
Content:
Me nye la Nyameɛ so
1Ao AWURADE, mvi kumaa kuronguronn nu yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ.
2AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ!
Yɛ asoɛ ná tie me,
tie me sufrɛ.
3 AWURADE, sɛ ɛsesẽ amumuyɛɛ a,
ao Yɛ Mene, ahaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ɔ?
4Nakoso wɔ de bɔnefakyɛ wɔ wɔ nu,
amaa ɔnate so yasuro wɔ.
5Me nye la AWURADE so, me kra nye la ye so,
na ye dwirɛ nu yeɛ me wora wura ɔ.
6Me kra nye la AWURADE so
tra awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛnea alehyeleɛ ate ɔ,
yoo, ɔtra awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛnea alehyeleɛ ate ɔ.
7Ao Yisrael, fa wɔ wora wura AWURADE nu!
Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ole ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ,
na ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de sona mmorosoɛ ɔ.
8Ye yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole Yisrael
kofi ye amumuyɛɛ amukoraa nu ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 131
Content:
Nyameɛ te me kra anyelasoɛ
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, m’ahone nyɛ anwomasoɛ,
me nye ndra me ndo nwiaa,
yeɛ menha me nwo nningyein mbiri mbiri nwo,
anaa anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔbo me so ɔ nwo.
2Amba, mama me kra anya asomdwee maa wayɛ konn,
kyɛ baa bɔ bapɛ ye nyɔfone bɔ ɔte oni so ɔ:
me kra ayɛ kyɛ baa bɔ bapɛ ye nyɔfone ɔ.
3Ao Yisrael, ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so,
ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 132
Content:
1Ao AWURADE, kaye Dawide
ɔne ye amaneɛnwunɛ amukoraa,
2kyɛbɔ ɔtale ndaen hyirele AWURADE,
ná ɔhyɛle Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne bɔ kyɛ,
3“Amba, mengowura m’awuro ɛtena sua ne anu,
yeɛ mengɔla me bɛen so.
4Mengɔla,
yeɛ mengɔhã me nye mengogua so,
5kɔpem kyɛ ngɔpena nekaa ngɔma AWURADE,
Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne, ye atenaleɛ koraka ɔ.”
6Amba, yɛtele ye wɔ Efrata;
yɛnwuni ye wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ aseɛ ne aso.
7“Ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ ye atenaleɛ berɛ;
ɛ́mɔma yɛsɔne wɔ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne anyunu.”
8Ao AWURADE, dwɔso ná kɔ wɔ nekaa bɔ ede wɔ nwome ne,
ɛne wɔ tumi alaka ne.
9Ma w’asɔfo mɔ bɛfa tenenee bɛhera,
ná ma w’anwoteefoɛ mɔ bɛfa ahurusi bɛbɔ ese.
10Ɔnate wɔ somvoɛ Dawide ti,
nnɛye wɔ sa fi wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne abo.
11 AWURADE tale ndaen kitii hyirele Dawide,
bɔ ongoli ye nwo ngasi ɔ, kyɛ,
“Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ kunu mmaa nemɔ anu ko
yeɛ ngɔmaa okoli wɔ bia ɔ.
12Sɛ wɔ mma mɔ bedi m’apam
ne me noa dwirɛ bɔ ngohyirehyire bɛ ne aso a,
bɛ mma mɔ koso bekoli wɔ bia afebɔɔ.
13Ofikyɛ AWURADE aneanea nu waye Sion;
wahuro kyɛ ɔkɔfa berɛ kɔyɛ ye atenaleɛ:
14“Ɛwa yeɛ ɔte me nekaa bɔ mede me nwomeɛ ɔ afebɔɔ;
ɛwa yeɛ ngɔtena ɔ, ofikyɛ mekuro ɛwa.
15Ngoyira Sion ye nningyein so paa,
na ngɔma ye ehiafoɛ mɔ aleɛ ma bɛ ko koyi.
16Ye asɔfo mɔ, ngɔfa ngoalelɛ ngɔhera bɛ,
na ye teneneefoɛ bɛkɔfa ahurusi bɛkɔbɔ ese.
17Berɛ yeɛ ngɔmaa mmɛen bie kofifi kɔma Dawide ɔ;
masiesie kanea mama me sona bɔ mapopa ye ngoo ne.
18Ngɔfa animguaseɛ ngɔhera ye pɔfoɛ mɔ,
nakoso ye de, ye ahennie abotire bɔ ɔbɔ ye ne,
ɔkɔta hyireinn.”

Title: EDWEIN 133
Content:
Koyɛlɛ nwo dwein
1Nea kyɛbɔ osi te paa ná ɔyɛ nyemene ɔ,
kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ bɛkɔtena bɛkɔyɛ ko ɔ!
2Ɔte kyɛ ngoo nyɔboɛ serɛ bɔ ogua sona ti so,
bɔ osongyi gua ye kanza nu,
ɔte kyɛ bɔ osongyi gua Aarɔn kanza nu,
bɔ ɔtengyɛ gua ye ataadeɛ kɔme anu ɔ.
3Ɔte kyɛ Hɛmɔn bosue
bɔ ɔtɔ gua Sion mmokaa so ɔ.
Ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ AWURADE ahyehyɛ saleɛ,
bɔ ɔte ngoa afebɔɔ ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 134
Content:
Kɔngɔen ayɛyelɛ dwein
1Ɛmɔ, AWURADE somvoɛ amukoraa,
ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ kɔngɔen ɔ,
ɛmɔbra bɛɛye AWURADE ayɛ!
2Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ sa so behyire nekaa krongron berɛ,
ná ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ.
3AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne,
ófi Sion oyira wɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 135
Content:
Nyameɛ tumi te piri
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ!
O AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ,
2ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ,
wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro n’aluo berɛ ɔ!
3Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE te paa;
ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo dwein, ofikyɛ ɔyɛ fɛ.
4Ofikyɛ AWURADE aneanea nu waye Yakob wama ye nwo,
wafa Yisrael wayɛ ye bɔbɔ ye agyapadeɛ.
5Na me de, mese kyɛ AWURADE te piri;
yɛ Mene ne tra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa.
6Bɔ AWURADE kuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ,
wɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so,
wɔ ɛpo nu ne buma mɔ amukoraa nu.
7Ye yeɛ ɔma munungum fi aseɛ noa dɔ kɔ anwuro ɔ;
esue tɔ a, ɔma agralaa tete,
na ɔma mvrama tu fi nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein ne.
8Ye yeɛ ohuhuni Misraimfoɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ ɔ:
mmenia ne ngaka bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ.
9Ao Misraim, ɔsomane nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ maa ɔwale wɔ nu,
ɔfa tiale Faro ne ye somvoɛ mɔ amukoraa.
10Ɔsɛkyele maen maen mɔ pee,
na ohuhuni ahemvo tumifoɛ mɔ:
11Amorifoɛ hene Sihon,
ne Basan hene Ogo,
ne Kanaan ahennie amukoraa,
12na ɔfale b’aseɛ ne kakyili agyapadeɛ,
ɔfa kakyili agyapadeɛ mane ye maen Yisrael.
13Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa timu berɛ daa,
Ao AWURADE, wɔ nwo ngayeɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
14Ofikyɛ AWURADE kobua ye maen be,
na okonwu ye somvoɛ mɔ anwumvoin.
(Edwein 115.4-8)
15Amaen maen mɔ bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, bɛte ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ,
bɛte mmenia sa noa adwuma.
16Bele noa, nakoso bendwudwo,
bele anyeɛ, nakoso bennwu nikye,
17bele asoɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ,
na nwomeɛ biala nne bɛ nu.
18Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ mmosoen nemɔ ne,
bɛte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala;
na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura mmosoen nemɔ anu ne,
ɔte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala.
19Ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ao Aarɔn awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
20Ao Lewi awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
21AWURADE bɔ ɔte Yerusalem ne,
animnyam hã ye wɔ Sion,
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 136
EDWEIN 137
Content:
Yisraelfoɛ sũ wɔ Babilɔn asue noa
1Babilɔn asue mɔ noa,
berɛ yeɛ yɛtenane ase yɛsuni ɔ,
mmerɛ bɔ yɛkayele Sion ɔ.
2Asue noa mmakaa nemɔ aso
yeɛ yɛfale yɛ sangoo mɔ yɛsinzele ɔ.
3Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛhyele yɛ nnure ne,
berɛ yeɛ besele yɛ kyɛ yɛto dwein ɔ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛteetee yɛ ne,
besele yɛ kyɛ yɛgyegye bɛ nye. Bɛnwa:
“Sion dwein ne, ɛ́mɔto ko behyire yɛ!”
4Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yato AWURADE nwo dwein,
wɔ maen foforɛ bie aso?
5Ao Yerusalem, sɛ mema me wora fi wɔ a,
ma me sa famaa ɔnwenwe!
6Sɛ mangaye wɔ a,
ma me temverema ɔmata me nnaalɔ,
sɛ manguro Yerusalem dwirɛ mandra
nikyee biala bɔ ɔma me anigye paa hɔ a!
7Ao AWURADE, kaye bɔ Edomfoɛ bɛyɔle ye kyẽa bɔ Yerusalem bɔle ne,
na tua bɛ so kerɛ;
kyɛbɔ bɛhane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase! ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase!
Ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase maa ɔɔhã ye fapem!” ne.
8Ao Babilɔn awa brasua bɔ bɛbaasɛkye wɔ pasapasa ɔ,
bɔ okotua wɔ so kerɛ wɔ bɔ afa ayɛ yɛ ne anwo ne,
okonya saleɛ!
9Bɔ ɔkɔhye wɔ mma mmaa mmaa kɔte bɛ ti kɔbɔ nyɔbotaen so ne,
okonya saleɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 138
Content:
Asennaa ne ayɛyelɛ dwein
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngɔla wɔ ase;
nyameɛ mɔ anyunu yeɛ meto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ.
2Mebɔ me nu ase
mefa me nye mekyire w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne,
na mefa asennaa mema wɔ dumaa,
ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne ati;
ofikyɛ apagya wɔ dumaa ne wɔ dwirɛ
maa batra nikyee biala.
3Kyẽa bɔ nzu mvrɛle wɔ ne, etiele me sufrɛ,
na ɛmane me kra hɔle so nyane anwoserɛ.
4Ao AWURADE, aseɛ ye aso ahemvo amukoraa kɔye wɔ ayɛ,
ofikyɛ bate wɔ noa nu dwirɛ.
5Amba, bɛkɔto AWURADE atee mɔ nwo dwein,
ofikyɛ AWURADE animnyam te piri.
6Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ AWURADE wɔ anwuro anwuro de,
nakoso ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ;
na anwomasoɛfoɛ de,
ɔbrɛ bɛ ase fi dedeede.
7Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mefa amaneɛ nu de,
nakoso ɛbɔ me ngoa nwo waen.
Ɛtengyɛ wɔ sa fa tia me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’ɛyaafɛlɛ,
na wɔ sa famaa ne yeɛ ɔpepɛ de me ɔ.
8AWURADE kɔma bɔ wahyehyɛ wafa me nwo ne kɔwa nu;
ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ:
nnɛpo wɔ sa noa nnwumaa.

Title: EDWEIN 139
Content:
Bɛnnwati Nyameɛ bo
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao AWURADE, aneanea me nu, na anwu me.
2Ɛse m’asetenalɛ ne me dwɔsolɛ mmerɛ;
na enwu me ti anu adwene fi dedeede.
3Ɛneanea m’atee bɔ nnate so ɔ, ɔne me nnaa nu,
na wɔ nye tua bɔ meyɔ amukoraa.
4Anzana mebaabukye me noa medwudwo ne po,
ao AWURADE, né ɛse bɔ mebaahã amukoraa.
5Abɔ me nyunu ne me si nwo waen,
na afa wɔ sa ato me so.
6Sɔ nimdeɛ ne, ɔyɛ me nwanwa soma;
ɔwɔ anwuro soma, bɔ me sa ngora ndwu so ɔ.
7Nisua yeɛ ngɔhora ngofi wɔ Sunzum nyunu ngɔhɔ ɔ?
Anaakyɛ nisua yeɛ ngɔnwati ngofi wɔ nyunu ngɔhɔ ɔ?
8Sɛ mefo mekɔ nyameɛso a, ɛwɔ dɔ;
sɛ mesɛ me bɛen wɔ ɛborɔ a, yieee, ɛwɔ dɔ.
9Sɛ mefa ngyerɛmɔ ye ndaa metu,
na mekɔtena ɛpo ye noa nziɛ nziɛ dɔ a,
10dɔ po, wɔ sa koli me nyunu,
na wɔ sa famaa kotira me nu.
11Sɛ mekã kyɛ, “Amba, awosii ɔbra ɔɔkata me so,
ná kanea bɔ wapɛ me nwo wayia ne, ɔkakyi kɔngɔen” a,
12amba, awosii po ɔnyɛ alesaleɛ mma wɔ;
kɔngɔen ta hyireinn kyɛ eyia,
ofikyɛ awosii te kyɛ kanea ma wɔ.
13Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle me kunu nningyein ɔ;
wɔ yeɛ ɛfale m’akwaa mɔ toatoale so wɔ me ni akunu ɔ.
14Meye wɔ ayɛ, ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ asi abɔ me ne,
ɔyɛ suro yɛ nwanwa.
Wɔ sa noa nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa,
na me kra se ye sɔ paa.
15Mmerɛ bɔ ɛbɔle me wɔ mvealeɛ nu ne,
bɔ ɛtole wɔ bo ase ɛhyehyɛle me wɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ne,
me mmowue mɔ bamvea wɔ.
16 Mmerɛ bɔ né nde mogya kokrobetoa ne, wɔ nye nwuni me.
Me ngyẽa bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama me ne,
bɛhyerɛle ye mukoraa wɔ wɔ nwomaa ne anu,
koraka yeɛ nu ko po ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔ.
17Ao Nyameɛ, w’adwene ne, kyɛbɔ osi bo me ndeaseɛ so ɔ!
Ɛkã bɔ nu a, kyɛbɔ osi te totohyia ɔ!
18Sɛ meka a, ye somaa tra anweaa;
sɛ meda medwɔso a, né ndɛwɔ wɔ nwo berɛ.
19Ao Nyameɛ, sɛ ahaa ekohũhũ bɔnefoɛ,
ná kodiawufoɛ bahwe bɛ nwo bafi me nwo a,
20bɛ bɔ bɛkekã musue dwirɛ betia wɔ,
ɔne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛbɔ wɔ dumaa mbaen mbaen ɔ!
21Ao AWURADE, bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ wɔ ne, aso membɔ bɛ?
Na bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia wɔ ne, aso bɛ nwo nyɛ me ahi?
22Mekyi bɛ kɔkɔkɔkɔ;
mebu bɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ.
23Ao Nyameɛ, neanea me nu, ná nwu m’ahone nu dwirɛ;
so me nea, ná nwu me ti anu adwene.
24Nea sɛ bra tɛɛ bie wɔ me nu a,
na di me nyunu fa me fa atee bɔ ɔla berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso.

Title: EDWEIN 140
Content:
De me fi pɔfoɛ sa nu
Dawide dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne
1Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu,
bɔ me nwo waen fi patapaafoɛ nwo,
2bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ wɔ bɛ ti anu,
ná bɛtwetwe koɛ bɛba daa ɔ.
3Basi bɛ gye nnaennaen kyɛ ewoo deɛ,
na ɛbɔnaa borɔ yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ noa nu ɔ.
Sela
4Ao AWURADE, nea me so ye me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu;
patapaafoɛ bɔ bɛpena m’asefinɛ ne,
bɔ me nwo waen fi bɛ nwo.
5Anwomasoɛfoɛ basua me ngaen bafea,
na bafa nyamaa bayɛ ɛtɛen,
basunzua me kafoli wɔ atee noa.
Sela
6Nzele AWURADE kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ;
ao AWURADE, yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ.”
7Ao AWURADE, me Mene, me Defoɛ anwoserɛniɛ,
ɛfa akokyɛm wura me ti wɔ koɛ kyẽa.
8Ao AWURADE, nnɛyɔ bɔnefoɛ b’apɛdeɛ ma bɛ;
nnɛmaa bɛ porɛ tɛɛ ne ɔba nu
ná banhoahoa bɛ nwo.
Sela
9Bɛ bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia ne, bamoma bɛ nwo so;
ma bɛ noa nu musue dwirɛ ne ɔbɔ bɛ ti so!
10Ma see gonn ogua bɛ so!
Maa befindi bɛ begua see nu,
kumaa kuronn nu bɔ bengodwɔso ko ɔ!
11Sona bɔ ɔkekã mmenia nwo dwirɛ ne,
nnɛma oyie ye yé wɔ aseɛ ne aso,
ma musue oli patapaaniɛ si yerɛlɛlɛlɛ!
12Mese kyɛ AWURADE di bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ,
na obua ndɛen turoloo ma ehiafoɛ.
13Amba, teneneefoɛ kɔla wɔ dumaa ase,
na bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, bɛkɔtena wɔ nyunu.

Title: EDWEIN 141
Content:
Nɔsoa mbaeɛ
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, mesu mefrɛ wɔ; yɛ ye ndɛ baaboka me;
sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, tie me sufrɛ.
2Ma me mbaeɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu,
ná me sa bɔ mema so ne, ɔ́yɛ kyɛ nɔsoa afɔleɛ.
3Ao AWURADE, kyire me bɔ nga ɔ,
ná maa nwu bɔ odi kyɛ mefa me noa mekã ɔ.
4Nnɛmaa mekakyi m’adwene mekɔ bɔne nwo,
nnɛmaa mefa me nwo mebɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ,
nnɛfa mefa bɔne meyɛ me nwo buru ne nnu,
nnɛmaa medi b’akɔnnɔdeɛ ne bie.
5Ma teneneeniɛ ɔbo me,
ná ohwi me nyunu wɔ ɔdɔ nu.
Nnɛmaa bɔnefoɛ bɛfa bɛ ngoo bɛpopa me ti so,
ofikyɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ daa metia b’amumuyɛɛ ne.
6Sɛ bɛ mbanyi mɔ bɛfa bɛ bewura bɛ bɔ bekobua bɛ foɛ mɔ sa a,
ye de bekonwu kyɛ me dwirɛ yɛ fɛ paa.
7Kyɛbɔ bebubu nyɔbotaen nu bɛto bɛpete aseɛnwo ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ bapete yɛ mmowue bagua ɛborɔ kumaa noa ɔ.
8Nakoso, ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ,
wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ;
nnɛyakyi me nwo waenbɔlɛ.
9Bɔ me nwo waen fi ngaen bɔ basunzua me ne anu,
ɔne bɔnefoɛ kafoli nemɔ anwo.
10Ma bɔnefoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngaen ɔhye bɛ,
na me de, maa nya atee nwati.

Title: EDWEIN 142
Content:
De me fi ndaneanyeɛfoɛ mɔ sa mu
Dawide mbaeɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu ne
1Metea nu mesu mefrɛ AWURADE;
metea nu mefa m’abisadeɛ meto AWURADE nyunu.
2Meprapra me dwirɛ yealɛ megua ye nyunu;
mefa m’amaneɛ meto ye nyunu.
3Sɛ me kra boto a,
wɔ yeɛ ɛse m’atee ɔ.
Atee bɔ mefa so ne,
basua me ngaen bafea wɔ so.
4Sɛ menea me sa famaa so a, menwu ye kyɛ
me nwo nhia ebiala;
mennya afealeɛ biala,
sona biala ndwene me ngoa nwo.
5Ao AWURADE, mesu mefrɛ wɔ.
Menwa, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ,
ɛte me bue deɛ wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so.”
6Tie me sufrɛ,
ofikyɛ maboto paa.
Pepɛ de me fi bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ɔ bɛ sa nu,
ofikyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se tra me.
7Ye me kra fi kuku nu,
amaa ɔnate so maye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.
Teneneefoɛ bɛkɔpɛ me nwo bekoyia,
ofikyɛ alo me paa.

Title: EDWEIN 143
Content:
AWURADE, pepɛ de me
Dawide dwein
1Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ; yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ;
wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ɔne wɔ tenenee ti, tie m’abisadeɛ.
2W’akoaa, nnɛfa me wura ndɛenbualɛ nu,
ofikyɛ teasefoɛ biala nni be wɔ wɔ nyunu.
3Ofikyɛ pɔfoɛ ne atu ye nye wasie me kra so,
wabɔ me ngoa wato ase,
na wamaa matena awosii nu kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawuwu dada ɔ.
4Yiti me sunzum aboto wɔ me nu;
m’ahone bɔ ɔla me kunu ɔ, ye wora abɔ.
5Mekaye daa tete ne,
medwenedwene wɔ nnwumaa amukoraa nwo.
Mekayekaye wɔ sa noa nnwumaa.
6Metrɛ me sa nu mekyire wɔ;
wɔ nwo nzuhɔen ku me kra kyɛ aseɛ bɔ wayɛ wosee ɔ.
Sela
7Ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ bua me;
me sunzum wora abɔ.
Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me;
ɔba ye sɔ a, ngɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawu bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne.
8Maa nde wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne nga ngyerɛmɔ,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu ɔ.
Maa nwu atee bɔ mva so ɔ;
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mepagya me kra mekyire wɔ ɔ.
9Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu;
wɔ berɛ yeɛ menwati mebabɔ me nwo adwaa ɔ.
10Kyirekyire me maa nyɔ w’apɛdeɛ,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ.
Ma wɔ Sunzum paa ne oli me nyunu,
maa ɔfa me fa atimbire frɛtɛɛ so.
11Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti, bɔ me ngoa nwo waen,
wɔ tenenee ti, ye me kra fi amaneɛ nu.
12Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, nua me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ boso,
ná kũkũ bɛ bɔ bekyi me ɔ amukoraa,
ofikyɛ nde wɔ somvoɛ.

Title: EDWEIN 144
Content:
AWURADE, pepɛ de yɛ maen ne
1Animnyam hã AWURADE me Nyɔbotaen ne
bɔ okyire me koɛhonɛ, ɔne me sa mmaa kyɛbɔ besi bɛko ɔ.
2Me nyɔbotaen ne m’afealeɛ,
m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne me defoɛ,
m’akokyɛm bɔ mebɔ me nwo adwaa wɔ nu ɔ,
bɔ ɔfa maen maen mɔ wura me bo ɔ.
3Ao AWURADE, dasaniɛ te nzu koraa bɔ wɔ nye ku ye nwo ye,
yeɛ kuro sona te nzu bɔ ɛdwene ye nwo ye?
4Sona te kyɛ nwomeɛ;
ye ngyẽa te kyɛ wawoɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ.
5Ao AWURADE, wɔ ewienu ne, bobɔ ná dwu bra ase;
fa wɔ sa kã mmokaa maa betu nwosina.
6Tete agralaa yerɛmyerɛm, ná bɔ bɛ pete;
soma w’agyaen nemɔ maa behũhũ bɛ pasaa.
7Tengyɛ wɔ sa fi anwuro dɔ;
maa nya me ti nnidi nu, ná pepɛ de me fi asue mbiri nu,
fi amanvrafoɛ bɛ sa nu.
8Bɛfa bɛ noa bɛkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen,
na bɛ sa famaa ne te ngondombo asaa.
9Ao Nyameɛ, ngɔto edwein foforɛ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ;
sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru yeɛ ngɔbɔ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ ɔ.
10Wɔ yeɛ ɛma ahemvo bedi ngonim ɔ;
wɔ yeɛ ɛpepɛ de wɔ somvoɛ Dawide fi ngrandɛ bɔ odi awue noa ɔ.
11Pepɛ de me, ná de me fi ɛwɔfoɛ mma mɔ sa nu,
bɛ yeɛ bɛ noa kekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen,
ná bɛ sa famaa te ngondombo asaa ɔ.
12Ahaa né yɛ mma mmienzua mɔ
bɛ mmerandeɛ nu wayɛ kyɛ mmakaa bɔ bahye ɔ,
ná yɛ mma mmrasua mɔ koso bayɛ kyɛ ndweasoɛ bonima,
bɔ bapakye ye kyɛ bɛfa besi ahemvie ɔ.
13Ahaa né yɛ pata mɔ so ayi to
bɔ aleɛ ahoroɔ gua so ɔ;
ahaa né yɛ mmoaen bawo apee apee,
apee buru apee buru wɔ yɛ aseɛ mɔ aso.
14Ahaa né yɛ nandwie mɔ banwonzɛnwonzɛ
bɔ bɛngɔpɔ baa anaa bengoli abawuo ɔ.
Nnɛmaa yɛte aworabɔlɛ esuɛ wɔ yɛ dwaa mɔ so.
15Maen bɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ wɔ so ne, benya saleɛ,
maen bɔ AWURADE te bɛ Nyameɛ ne, benya saleɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 145
Content:
Dawide ayɛyelɛ dwein
1Me Nyameɛ ne me Hene, ngɔkamvo wɔ,
na ngɔhyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam afebɔɔ.
2Daa biala ngɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam,
na ngɔye wɔ dumaa ayɛ afebɔɔ.
3AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa;
ye piri ne bo sona ndeaseɛ so.
4Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ko kɔkamvo wɔ nnwumaa kohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ foforɛ,
ná wabɔ wɔ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ne anwo dawure.
5W’ahennie animnyam bɔ ɔta hyireinn ne w’anwanwadeɛ nemɔ,
bɛ yeɛ medwenedwene bɛ nwo ɔ.
6Wɔ nnwumaa suronyisuronyi ne, wɔ tumi ne,
mmenia kɔbɔ ye nwo dawure,
na ngɔfa kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ ngɔto dwaa.
7Wɔ paayɛlɛ piri nwo ngayeɛ ne, bɛkɔbɔ ye nwo dawure,
na bɛkɔto wɔ tenenee nwo dwein.
8AWURADE do mmenia, na ɔse anwumvoin;
ye ahone nhu ndɛ, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔsone.
9AWURADE te paa ma sona biala,
na ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne, ɔkata ye nnwumaa mukoraa so.
10Ao AWURADE, wɔ sa noa nnwumaa amukoraa bɛda wɔ ase,
yeɛ w’anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.
11Bɛka w’ahennie nwo animnyam nwo dwirɛ,
na bɛkã wɔ tumi ne anwo dwirɛ,
12kyɛ bɛkɔma adasa mmaa bekonwu wɔ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri nemɔ,
ɔne w’ahennie animnyam hyireinn ne.
13W’ahennie ne te daa ahennie,
na wɔ tumi ne wɔ berɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
[AWURADE di nahorɛ wɔ ye dwirɛ amukoraa nu,
na onwu anwumvoin wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nu].
14AWURADE sɔ bɛ bɔ bɛtete begua ɔ amukoraa nu,
na ɔma bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ so.
15Mmenia amukoraa bɛ nye la wɔ so,
na ɛma bɛ bɛ noa aleɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.
16Ebukye wɔ sa nu,
na ɛma teasefoɛ amukoraa benya bɔ bɛpena ɔ.
17AWURADE tengyɛ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ amukoraa nu,
na ɔte krongron wɔ ye nnwumaa amukoraa nu.
18AWURADE pingye bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye ɔ amukoraa,
amba, bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye nahorɛ nu amukoraa.
19Ɔyɔ bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ b’apɛdeɛ ma bɛ;
afei koso otie bɛ sufrɛ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ.
20AWURADE bɔ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ɔ amukoraa nwo waen,
nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, okohũhũ bɛ.
21Me noa kɔhã AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwirɛ,
odi kyɛ abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɛye ye dumaa krongron ne ayɛ afebɔɔ.

Title: EDWEIN 146
Content:
Bokafoɛ Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ!
2Mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu amukoraa, ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ;
ngɔto Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein
mmerɛ bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ me nu ye.
3Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ wora bewura ahemvo mɔ nu,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfa wora bewura adasa mmaa bɔ mmokalɛ biala mvi bɛ berɛ mma ɔ, bɛ nu.
4Sɛ sona nwomeɛ fi ye nu a, sona sa kɔ ye nnɛterɛ nu;
sɔ kyẽa ne ala, ye nhyehyɛleɛ ye bo pɛ.
5Sona bɔ ye bokafoɛ ole Yakob Nyameɛ,
bɔ ye wora wura AWURADE ye Nyameɛ nu ne, onya saleɛ.
6Nyameɛ bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so afebɔɔ ne,
ye yeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ,
ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa ɔ.
7Sona bɔ besisi ye ne, ye yeɛ odi ye dwirɛ ma ye ɔ,
na ye yeɛ ɔma bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ aleɛ ɔ.
AWURADE ma kukunufoɛ benya fawɔnwodi.
8AWURADE te anyesiniwaafoɛ bɛ nye,
AWURADE ma bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ so,
AWURADE kuro teneneefoɛ bɛ dwirɛ.
9AWURADE yeɛ ɔbɔ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ nwo waen ɔ;
ɔnea nyisiaafoɛ ne akunafoɛ,
nakoso bɔnefoɛ atee de, ɔmaa ɔyɛ basaa.
10AWURADE koli hene afebɔɔ,
ao Sion, wɔ Nyameɛ di hene aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 147
Content:
Nyameɛ tumi nwo ayɛyelɛ
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔto yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ;
ɔse anwumvoin, na ayɛyelɛ dwein fata ye.
2AWURADE yeɛ ɔkyekye Yerusalem ɔ,
na Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ ne,
ɔboaboa bɛ noa.
3Ɔkyekye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ɔ wora,
na ɔteta bɛ ngena nu.
4Ye yeɛ ɔse nzramaa mɔ bɛ somaa ɔ,
na ɔtoto bɛ mukoraa bɛ dumaa.
5Y’AWURADE te piri, na ye tumi te piri,
ye nimdeɛ ne, sona nze ye ti ne ye bo.
6AWURADE ma anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ so,
nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ofindi ye to ase.
7Ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo asennaa dwein;
ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo beli yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ahurusi!
8Ye yeɛ ɔfa munungum kata ewienu ɔ,
ɔboaboa esue noa maa ɔtɔ gua aseɛ so,
na ɔma ndire fifi mmokaa so.
9Ɔma eburo ngaka aleɛ,
bɛ ne adene mma bɔ besu nemɔ.
10Nna pɔngɔ anwoserɛ yeɛ ye nye gye ye nwo ɔ,
yeɛ nna sona amirika yeɛ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ;
11na mmom AWURADE nye gye bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ nwo,
bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ne.
12Ao Yerusalem, ye AWURADE ayɛ;
Ao Sion, ye wɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ!
13Ofikyɛ wamiamia wɔ pambim si mmuralɛ nemɔ anu,
wayira wɔ mma bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ nu ne.
14Ɔma asomdwee ba w’aseɛ so,
na ɔma wɔ atokoɔ paa ma wɔ ko yi.
15Ɔsoma ye mmeraa dwirɛ maa ɔba aseɛ so,
na ye dwirɛ ne tu amirika ndɛndɛ.
16Ɔtɔ asukɔtwea kyɛ gyese,
ɔpete ɛborɔ kyɛ nzoen.
17Ɔto ye asukɔtwea gua kyɛ nyɔboseka.
Ye ɛyerɛ ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye noa gyina ɔ?
18Ɔsomane ye noa dwirɛ, na ɔmaa behurole,
ɔma ye mvrama bɔ, na nzue tengyɛ.
19Ɔlale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yakob,
ɔfale ye ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ mane Yisrael.
20Wanyɔ sɔ wamma maen foforɛ,
bɛnze ye nhyehyɛleɛ.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 148
Content:
Abɔdeɛ amukoraa ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ béfi anwuro dɔ.
Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ anwuro dɔ!
2Ye abɔfo mɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ;
ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ!
3Eyia ne ɛsraen, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ;
nzramaa mɔ bɔ bɛta amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ!
4Ɛmɔ, nyameɛso anwuro anwuro, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ,
yeɛ ɛmɔ, nzue nzue bɔ ɛmɔwɔ ewienu anwuro ɔ,
ɛmɔ koso sɔ ala.
5Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ayɛ,
ofikyɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ ne yeɛ ɔfa bɔle bɛ ɔ.
6Ɔfale bɛ tindimuni berɛ afebɔɔ;
na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔngɔpɛ nu le ɔ.
7Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ béfi aseɛ ye aso:
ɛmɔ, ɛpo nu ngaka mbiri ne buma amukoraa,
8see ne asukɔtwea nyɔboɛ, asukɔtwea ne ɛborɔ,
mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ di Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so ɔ,
9mmokaa ne pambaa amukoraa,
mmakaa bɔ besu ne sida amukoraa,
10eburo ngaka ne nyɛmmoa amukoraa,
ngaka bɔ bɛkongo ne nnomaa bɔ betu ɔ,
11aseɛ ye aso ahemvo ne maen maen amukoraa,
atitire ne aseɛ ye aso maenbulɛfoɛ amukoraa,
12mmerandeɛ ne ndaluwa mɔ,
mbanyi ne ngwadaa!
13Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ,
ofikyɛ ye ngome yeɛ ye dumaa te piri ɔ;
ye animnyam trɛ ɔbo aseɛ ne nyameɛso so.
14Wama ye maen anya anwoserɛ,
amaa ɔnate so ye anwoteefoɛ amukoraa baye ye ayɛ,
Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bepingye ye ne.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 149
Content:
Ayɛyelɛ dwein
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ,
ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ anwoteefoɛ badwa nu.
2Odi kyɛ Yisrael nye gye, ɔnate (Nyameɛ) bɔ yeɛ ɔbɔle ye ne ati,
odi kyɛ Sion mma bɛ nye gye, ɔnate bɛ Hene ne ati.
3Odi kyɛ bɛfa abilie bɛye ye dumaa ayɛ,
odi kyɛ bɛfa akasaa ne adengum bɛto ye nwo dwein.
4Ofikyɛ AWURADE nye gye ye maen nwo,
na ɔfa ngoalelɛ ɔbɔ anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ abotire.
5Odi kyɛ anwoteefoɛ bedi ahurusi wɔ animnyam nu;
odi kyɛ bɛfa anigye bɛto dwein wɔ bɛ bɛen so.
6Odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛ noa bɛbɔ Nyameɛ nzabranoa,
ná bétira sɛpɔ wɔ bɛ sa nu,
7bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔtɔ amaen maen mɔ so wereɛ,
bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔhwe amaen maen mɔ bɛ so,
8ná bafa buralɛ bakyekye b’ahemvo mɔ,
ná bafa ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bagua b’atitire mɔ,
9ná bafa ndɛenbualɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne babua bɛ ndɛen.
Ɛhe te animnyam ma AWURADE anwoteefoɛ amukoraa.
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: EDWEIN 150
Content:
Ye AWURADE ayɛ!
1Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛ́mɔye Nyameɛ ayɛ wɔ ye nekaa krongron ne anu.
Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ye tumi ewienu ne anu.
2Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ye nnwumaa mbiri mbiri nemɔ anwo;
ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ, kyɛbɔ osi te totohyia ɔ!
3Ɛ́mɔfa totorobɛndo dwein bɛ́ye ye ayɛ;
ɛ́mɔfa adengum ne sangoo bɛ́ye ye ayɛ!
4Ɛ́mɔfa akasaa ne abilie bɛ́ye ye ayɛ;
ɛ́mɔfa sangoo ne awɛen bɛ́ye ye ayɛ!
5Ɛ́mɔbɔ dawure mɔ nu bɛ́ye ye ayɛ,
ɛ́mɔfa dawuta bɔ ɔgyegye serɛserɛ ɔ bɛ́ye ye ayɛ!
6Nikyee biala bɔ ode nwomeɛ ne,
odi kyɛ ɔye AWURADE ayɛ!
Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

Title: ANYANDERA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Anyandera Nwomaa ne te bra paa bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye nwo dwirɛ, ɔne Nyameɛ solɛ paa nwo dwirɛ. Anyandera ne anu pee fa sona daa daa asetena nu dwirɛ, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nwo. Odi moa bɔ kɔkɔ kyɛ: sɛ ɛpena kyɛ enya nimdeɛ a, di moa suro AWURADE ná fa anidie ma ye (1.7). Na afei ɔtoa so kã suban paa ne nworɛ nwo dwirɛ. Nu anyandera ndika ndika nemɔ, ɔmaa yɛnwu daa tete Yisrael akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ nworɛ, ɔne bɔ odi kyɛ nworɛniɛ biala ɔyɔ ye wɔ tebea biala nu ɔ. Anyandera ne bie fa ɛhemɔ anwo: abusua, agyaa, sona ne obiɛngo b’asetena nu dwirɛ, aboterɛ, anwohyɛsoɛ, anwobrɛaseɛ ne anwomasoɛ, abiɛngoɛfalɛ nu nahorɛlilɛ, ɔne anidie bɔ odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛma ehiafoɛ ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Ɔkamvo Nworɛ 1.1—9.18
Solomon anyandera mɔ10.1—29.27
Agure noa dwirɛ 30.1-33
Anyandera ahoroɔ 31.1-31

Title: ANYANDERA 1
Content:
1 Yisrael hene Solomon, Dawide awa ne, ye anyandera mɔ bɔ obuli ne ɛhe.
Anyandera nemɔ botaeɛ
2Anyandera nemɔ botaeɛ ole kyɛ:
sona kɔfa so konwu nworɛ, ná okonya ngyerɛkyerɛ,
ná ɔkɔte edwirɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ bo;
3kyɛ ɔkɔfa konya nworɛ dwirɛ nu ngyerɛkyerɛ,
yeɛ tenenee, ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ.
4Ɔma sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ɔ onwu nworɛ,
na ɔma mmerandeɛ nimdeɛ ne adwene nu bukyelɛ.
5Odi kyɛ nworɛfoɛ betie benya nimdeɛ pee,
ná nimdeɛfoɛ koso fa so bɛma b’adwene nu pi,
6amaa ɔnate so bate anyandera ne nworɛ dwirɛ bo,
nworɛfoɛ dwirɛ ne b’anyandera bo.
7 AWURADE surolɛ yeɛ ɔte nimdeɛnyanɛ ye bohyɛlɛ ɔ,
na ngwaseafoɛ de, bɛmva nworɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ bɛnyɛ huu.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ
8Mma, tie wɔ baba dwirɛ,
yeɛ nnɛpo wɔ maame foɛtulɛ,
9ofikyɛ bɛte animnyam abotire bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ ti ɔ,
ɔne akomuade bɔ ɔya wɔ ɔ.
10Mma, sɛ bɔnefoɛ mɔ diedie wɔ kɔ bɔne nu a,
nnɛpene so.
11Sɛ bɛkã kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛɛtetɛ yɛli awue,
bɛ bɔ bedi be ne, maa yɛɛtɛ atunu yɛhu bɛ mbaen;
12maa yɛhu bɛ anyekaenn so kyɛbɔ asieleɛ ɔme sona ɔ,
maa yɛsie bɛ mumua ne kyɛbɔ mmenia kɔda ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ;
13yɛkonya nningyein bɔ bɛ nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ,
na yɛkɔfa sɔ nzesadeɛ nemɔ yɛkogua yɛ awuro maa berɛ koyi tɛkyɛ;
14yiti fa wɔ nwo bɔ yɛ,
na yɛ mukoraa yɛkɔhyɛ nningyein bɔ yɛkonya ye ne” a,
15mma, nnɛne bɛ bɔ afɛ.
Nekaa bɔ bekotia ne, nnɛtia berɛ bie;
16ofikyɛ amirika yeɛ betu bekodi bɔne ɔ,
na bɛma bɛ nwo yɛ nyera bedi awue.
17Ofikyɛ, sɛ anomaa biala nye tua kyɛ asua ye ngaen a,
asua ngaen ne mbaen.
18Nakoso sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛtetɛ bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo awue,
na bɛtetɛ bekuku bɛ nwo.
19Sɔ yeɛ oyie mmenia mukoraa bɔ bɛpena anwonya wɔ atee tɛɛ so ɔ,
na anwonya tɛɛ ne ɔpɛ ye nwo okũkũ bɛ.
Tie foɛtulɛ
20 Nworɛ tea nu serɛserɛ wɔ mmorɔnoɛ mɔ so,
wama ye komvi so wɔ dwaa nemɔ aso.
21Ɔtea nu wɔ nekaa bɔ mmenia ayɛ birikabirika,
ɔtea nu wɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anu kyɛ,
22“Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ adwene te nganga ɔ,
ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔ adwene yɛ nganga kodwu kyinzu?
Ngorohoɛfoɛ nye kɔgye bɛ ngorohoɛ nwo koodwu kyinzu?
Yeɛ ngwaseafoɛ kohyi nimdeɛ koodwu kyinzu?
23Metwi ɛmɔ nyunu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtie,
ngɔhã m’ahone nu dwirɛ ngohyire ɛmɔ,
na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu me ti anu dwirɛ.
24Na ɔnate kyɛ ndeane nu mvrɛle, ná ɛmɔammua me,
mabɔ ɛmɔ ba, ná ebiala andɛ me so,
25bɔ me foɛtulɛ amukoraa gua ɛmɔ so asi,
ná ɛmɔmva ɛmɔ nyunu bɔ metwi ne bɛnyɛ huu ne ati,
26me koso ngɔsere ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ amaneɛnwunɛ nu;
ahunundetelɛ tɔ ɛmɔ so a, ngɔgoro ɛmɔ nwo;
27mmerɛ bɔ ahunundetelɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ mvrama piri kɔto ɛmɔ ne,
mmerɛ bɔ amaneɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo kɔto ɛmɔ ne,
mmerɛ bɔ aworabɔlɛ ne yealɛ kɔto ɛmɔ ne.
28Afei bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me, nakoso mengɔtɛ bɛ so,
bɛkɔpena me paa, nakoso bengonwu me.
29Ofikyɛ behyili nimdeɛ,
banguro kyɛ bekosuro AWURADE,
30bandie me foɛtulɛ ne anu biala,
na bɛpole bɛ nyunu hwilɛ bɔ ndwili ne amukoraa.
31Yiti, bɛ yɔleɛ nwo akatuaa yeɛ bɛ sa kɔhã ye ɔ,
na bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ne, ɔkɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.
32Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ b’adwene te nganga ne, foɛtulɛ nwo asoserɛ yeɛ okohu bɛ ɔ,
na ngwaseafoɛ bɛ yeeyɛlɛ yeɛ okohu bɛ ɔ.
33Nakoso ebiala bɔ otie me dwirɛ de, ɔkɔtena asomdwee nu,
okonya anwotɔ, na ye kunu ngɔtete ye kyɛ musue kɔto ye ɔ.”

Title: ANYANDERA 2
Content:
Nworɛ nwo mvasoɛ
1Mma, sɛ etie me dwirɛ,
ná ɛma me mmeraa dwirɛ nemɔ ka wɔ ti anu,
2sɛ ɛyɛ asoɛ tie nworɛ dwirɛ,
ná ɛma w’adwene nya ndeaseɛ,
3amba, sɛ ɛtea nu frɛ kyɛ ɛpena adwene bɔ nu pi,
ná ɛma wɔ komvi so kyɛ ɛpena ndeaseɛ,
4sɛ ɛpena ye si atee kyɛbɔ ɛpena ɛdwetɛ,
ná ɛpena ye kyɛ agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bafea ɔ hɔ a,
5ye de ɛkɔte kyɛbɔ AWURADE surolɛ osi te ɔ bo,
na ekonya Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ.
6Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔma nworɛ ɔ,
na ye noa nu yeɛ nimdeɛ ne ndeaseɛ fi ba ɔ.
7Ɔfa nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ osie ma teneneefoɛ,
ɔte akokyɛm ma bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ɔ;
8ɔbɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo waen,
na ɔnea ye anwoteefoɛ b’atee bɔ bɛnate so ɔ so.
9Na afei ɛkɔte tenenee, nahorɛlilɛ,
pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne atee bɔ ɔte paa biala bo.
10Ofikyɛ ekonwu nworɛ,
nimdeɛ kɔma wɔ kra nye kɔgye,
11adwene nu bukyelɛ kɔnea wɔ so,
na ndeaseɛ kɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen;
12ɔkɔpepɛ kole wɔ kofi bɔne atee so,
kofi mmenia bɔ bɛ noa dwirɛ te kanda ɔ bɛ sa nu,
13kofi bɛ bɔ bali nahorɛ atee nwo makyebu
baafa awosii atee so ɔ bɛ sa nu.
14Sɔ mmenia ne, bɛ nye gye bɔneyɔlɛ nwo,
na bɛ kanda bra tɛɛ ne yeɛ ɔma bɛ anika ɔ.
15B’atee te kanda atee,
na bɛ suban te nnakannaka.
16Nworɛ kole wɔ kofi brasua sanzaniɛ sa nu,
kofi gyanderaniɛ bɔ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ sa nu.
17Ye bɔ wapo ye ndaluwa nu biaa,
ná wama ye wora afi ye Nyameɛ apam ne ɔ.
18Ofikyɛ ye awuro diedie sona kɔ ewue nu,
na ye atee fa sona kɔ ɛborɔ.
19Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ sɔ braa ne nekaa ne, onza mma ko,
yeɛ ɔmbe ngoa atee so ko.
20Yiti agyirɛ bɔ mmeni paa betu ne, tu bie,
ná fa teneneefoɛ b’atee ne aso bie.
21Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne yeɛ bɛkɔtena aseɛ ne aso ɔ,
bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te ne yeɛ bɛkɔtena so ɔ;
22nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bekonua bɛ boso bekofi aseɛ so,
na amumuyɛɛfoɛ wora, bɛkɔprapra bɛ boso bekofi so.

Title: ANYANDERA 3
Content:
Nyameɛ surolɛ nwo foɛtulɛ
1Mma, nnɛma wɔ wora fi me foɛtulɛ ne,
na mmom fa me mmeraa dwirɛ nemɔ sie wɔ ti anu;
2ofikyɛ bɛkɔmaa ekonyi kɔhyɛ,
ekonya ngoa tendenn, ná wayie wɔ yé.
3Nnɛma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ bɛpa wɔ nwo,
kyekye fa ya wɔ kɔme,
ná kyerɛ ye wɔ w’ahone nu.
4 Na ɛhe kɔmaa Nyameɛ ne mmenia
bɛkɔlo wɔ, ná babɔ wɔ dumaa paa.
5Fa wɔ wora amukoraa wura AWURADE nu,
na nnɛfa wɔ nwo to wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nworɛ so.
6Wɔ bra mukoraa, maa Nyameɛ bra nu,
na okohyire wɔ atee maa ɛkɔfa so.
7 Nnɛbu wɔ nwo nworɛniɛ,
suro AWURADE, ná twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo.
8Ɔkɔyɛ aporɛnuserɛ kɔma wɔ nwonaen,
ɔne wɔ mmowue nu anwoserɛ.
9Fa bɔ ele ye ɔ hyɛ AWURADE animnyam,
wɔ fieso aleɛ bɔ ekoli moa kɔfa amukoraa koso,
10amaa ɔnate so aleɛ ayi wɔ pata mɔ so tɛkyɛtɛkyɛɛ,
na wɔ kumaa bɔ etwi nzaa nu ne,
nzaa koyi kobu kɔfa so.
11 Mma, ɔyɛ a nnɛpo AWURADE tealɛ bɔ ɔfa tengyɛtengyɛ wɔ ne,
yeɛ sɛ ɔkã wɔ nyunu a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ ahi,
12 ofikyɛ sona bɔ AWURADE kuro ye dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔkã ye nyunu ɔ,
kyɛbɔ seɛ ɔyɛ ɔwa bɔ ɔla ye ahone nwo ne ala.
13Sona bɔ wapena nworɛ si atee wanwu ye ne,
yeɛ sona bɔ onya ndeaseɛ ne,
saleɛ te ye deɛ.
14Ofikyɛ bɔ enya ye fi nu ne, ɔte paa tra ɛdwetɛ,
yeɛ so mvasoɛ ne ɔte paa tra sikaa kɔkorɛ.
15Nworɛ nyɔboɛ yɛ se tra agudeɛ,
na bɔ wɔ nye gye ye nwo biala, ɛngɔhora ngɔfa ngɔtoto nworɛ nwo.
16Ngoa tendenn wɔ ye sa famaa nu,
yeɛ anwonya ne animnyam wɔ ye sa bɛen nu.
17Ye atee te anika atee,
na ye saa amukoraa te asomdwee.
18Ɔte ngoa bakaa ma bɛ bɔ betira ye nu ɔ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛsɔ ye nu bum ne, benya saleɛ.
19AWURADE nate nworɛ so yeɛ ɔbɔle aseɛ bo ɔ,
ɔnate ndeaseɛ so yeɛ ɔfale ewienu sɛle berɛ ɔ;
20ɔnate ye nimdeɛ so yeɛ buma mɔ nu nzue pu wale ɔ,
yeɛ ɔnate so yeɛ munungum mɔ koso bɛpepe bosue begua ase ɔ.
21Mma, fa nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ, ɔne adwene bɔ nu abukye ɔ sie,
nnɛmaa befi wɔ nye so,
22amaa ɔnate so bayɛ ngoa bama wɔ kra,
ɔne animnyam bɔ ɔla wɔ kɔme ɔ.
23Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛkɔfa w’atee so asomdwee nu,
na wɔ gya ngopoli.
24Sɛ ɛkɔda a, engosuro,
yeɛ sɛ ɛda a, wɔ nnaa kɔyɛ wɔ fɛ.
25Nnɛsuro mvum nu ahunundetelɛ,
anaa asane bɔ ɔto bɔnefoɛ ɔ.
26Ofikyɛ AWURADE kɔyɛ w’anyelasoɛ,
na ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen bɔ ɛngɔtɔ ngaen biala nu ɔ.
27Sona bɔ ohia mmokalɛ ne, nnɛfa paayɛlɛ bɔ ye atianuserɛ,
na sɛ ɛkɔhora kɔboka a, boka.
28Nnɛkã kyire ebiɛngo kyɛ,
“Kɔ bra, na ngɔfa ngɔma wɔ ɛhema,”
wɔ aberɛ bɔ ele nikyee ne bie wɔ berɛ ɔ.
29Nnɛbɔ ebiɛngo anwo porɛ tɛɛ,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔne wɔ bɛte ye asomdwee nu ɔ.
30Nnɛne ebiala benya edwudwolɛ mbaen mbaen,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔyyɔle wɔ tɛɛ biala ɔ.
31Nnɛma wɔ nye boro asisiefoɛ,
yeɛ esaa bɔ bapɛ bato berɛ ne, nnɛfa nu biala so.
32Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɔte kanda ne, ɔte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
nakoso teneneeniɛ de, AWURADE kã ye ti anu dwirɛ kyire ye.
33AWURADE ɛnomalɛ wɔ bɔnefoɛ awuro nu,
nakoso nekaa bɔ teneneeniɛ te de, oyira berɛ.
34 Nahorɛ nu, ɔgoro ngorohoɛfoɛ nwo,
nakoso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ de, ɔdo bɛ.
35Animnyam kooli nworɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu,
nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, animguaseɛ kɔmata bɛ.

Title: ANYANDERA 4
Content:
Awofoɛ foɛtulɛ
1Mmaa, ɛ́mɔtie ɛmɔ baba mɔ foɛtulɛ,
ná ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie,
amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔsua nworɛ.
2Ofikyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ paa yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ,
na nnɛma ɛmɔpo me foɛtulɛ ne.
3Me ngwadaa nu bɔ né me ne me baba yɛwɔ berɛ ne,
bɔ né nde kãa,
ná me ni di me bahorɛ ne,
4me baba tuli me foɛ sele me kyɛ,
“Fa me dwirɛ bɔ mekã ne to wɔ ti anu,
di me mmeraa dwirɛ so, ná nya ngoa.
5Sua nworɛ, sua nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ.
Nnɛma wɔ wora fi, yeɛ nnɛyakyi me noa dwirɛ so lilɛ.
6Nnɛpo nworɛ, na ɔkɔnea wɔ so,
kuro ye dwirɛ, na ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen.
7Nworɛ te nikye titire, yiti sua nworɛ,
w’anwonya mukoraa si ne, pena ndeaseɛ.
8Nwu ye kyɛ odi mu, na ɔkɔpagya wɔ;
na sɛ ɛtɔ ye nu ɛyɛ ye atuu a, ɔkɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam.
9Ɔkɔfa animnyam abotire kɔbɔ wɔ,
ɔkɔfa abotire nyemenenyemene kɔbɔ wɔ.”
10Mma, tie me dwirɛ ná di so,
amaa ɔnate so anya ngoa tendenn.
11Mahyirehyire wɔ nworɛ atee ne,
mafa wɔ mafa atimbire turoloo ne aso.
12Yiti sɛ ɛnate a, wɔ gya ngɔto ngɔbrabra nu,
yeɛ etu amirika koso a, engosoti.
13Sɔ foɛtulɛ nu yé, nnɛyakyi nu,
fa sie yé, ofikyɛ wɔ ngoa ɛne.
14Bɔnefoɛ atee ne, nnɛfa so bie,
yeɛ nnɛfa amumuyɛɛfoɛ atee so.
15Twe wɔ nwo fi so, nnɛfa so bie,
makye fi so, ná pɛ nu kɔ.
16Ofikyɛ bɛ de bɛnna, sana bayɔ bɔne koraka,
nnakorɔkorɔ tɔ bɛ so, sana bama ebie afi ase koraka.
17Ofikyɛ bɔne yɔleɛ te be gye aleɛ,
yeɛ basabasayɔlɛ te bɛ nzaa bɔ bɛno ɔ.
18Nakoso teneneefoɛ de, b’atee te kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ yia bɔ wapukye ɔ,
na ɔbɔ toonn kodwu eyia ketee.
19Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, b’atee te kyɛ awosii tunn,
bennwu nikyee bɔ bɛfofo so ɔ.
20Mma, tie me dwirɛ,
yɛ asoɛ tie edwirɛ bɔ mekã ne.
21Nnɛmaa befi wɔ nye so,
fa sie w’ahone nu dɔ paa.
22Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ onwu bɛ ne, bɛte ngoa ma ye,
na ɔma ye aporɛ nu amukoraa sande ye.
23Adwene bɔ ɛkɔfa ne, dwene ye nwo yé paa,
ofikyɛ nu yeɛ ngoa ofi ba ɔ.
24Nnɛfa wɔ noa kekã nnakannaka dwirɛ,
twe wɔ nwo fi ngondombo dwirɛ kekanɛ nwo.
25Ma wɔ nye nea wɔ nyunu tee,
ná ma wɔ ndo nwiaa ɔnea wɔ nyunu tee.
26 Dwene nekaa bɔ ekotu wɔ gya kotia ɔ nwo,
amaa ɔnate so w’atee amukoraa ayie wɔ yé.
27Nnɛmakye kɔ famaa anaa bɛen,
twe wɔ gya fi bɔne nwo.

Title: ANYANDERA 5
Content:
Adwamanbɔlɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Mma, tie me nworɛ dwirɛ ne,
yɛ asoɛ tie me nworɛ bɔ nu pi ne,
2amaa ɔnate so w’adwene nu abukye,
ná wɔ noa ahã nimdeɛ dwirɛ.
3Ofikyɛ brasua sanzaniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te kyɛ woɛ bɔ ɔpepe ɔ,
na ye noa te menemene tra aloko;
4nakoso ɔkwaayie ye bo ne, ɔyɛ wee te kyɛ awɔwee,
na ɔyɛ nna te kyɛ sɛpɔ.
5Ye gya diedie sona kɔ ewue nu,
na ye agyirɛtulɛ fa sona kɔ ɛborɔ.
6Ɔmva atee bɔ ɔkɔ ngoa nu ɔ so,
na ye atee te makyebu bɔ ɔnze ɔ.
7Afei, me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me,
nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi me noa dwirɛ so lilɛ.
8Twe wɔ nwo fi sɔ brasua ne anwo,
na nnɛpingye ye awuro anoa ne;
9amaa ɔnate so amva w’animnyam amma ebiemɔ,
ná amva wɔ ngoa anwura atianuserɛniɛ bie sa;
10ná ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ banzesa wɔ nningyein,
ná bɔ afɛ anya ye ne, wangɔanni amanvrafoɛ sa nu;
11ná wɔ ngoa ayieleɛ ne, wando wɔ ne ɛpenenɛ,
mmerɛ bɔ anwonyerɛ adidi wɔ sonaluwaa ne anwoɔnaen ne,
12ná anga kyɛ, “Ao, ɔyɛle me ahi kyɛ ngotie foɛtulɛ ɔ,
na me kra hyili ye kɔkɔkɔkɔ kyɛ bekohwi me nyunu ɔ!
13Mandie m’akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ dwirɛ,
yeɛ mamva me foɛtulɛfoɛ bɛ dwirɛ manyɛ huu.
14Ao, ɔhale kãa mane m’ayieleɛ yiele me
wɔ mmenia badwa nyunu.”
15No wɔ bɔbɔ w’abura nu nzue,
nzue bɔ opu fi wɔ bɔbɔ w’asue ti ɔ.
16Aso odi kyɛ wɔ mbombonzue obu fa so kogua nekaa bie,
anaakyɛ w’asueba tengyɛ kɔfa dwaaso?
17Maa bɛyɛ wɔ ngome wɔ deɛ,
nnɛma ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɛno bie bɛboka wɔ so.
18Ma wɔ mbombonzue ne ɔyɛ saleɛ,
ná nya wɔ mmerandeɛ nu braa nwo anigye.
19Ɔte dabɔɔ beleɛ anwonyemene ne wanzane beleɛ bɔ ole animnyam ɔ,
ma wɔ nye gye ye nyɔfone nwo mmerɛ biala,
ná ma ye hurolɛ oli wɔ ti mmerɛ biala.
20Mma, nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛma brasua sanzaniɛ ye hurolɛ di wɔ ti
maa ɛsosɔ brasua foforɛ nyɔfone nu ɔ?
21Ofikyɛ bɔ sona yɔ ne, ɔla AWURADE nyunu,
na ɔneanea ye atee bɔ ɔnate so amukoraa nu.
22Bɔnefoɛ ye bɔbɔ ye amumuyɛɛ yeɛ osua ye ngaen kye ye ɔ,
na ye bɔne nyamaa yeɛ ɔkyekye ye ɔ.
23Ɔnde fo, yiti okowu,
na ɔnate ye gyiminɛ somaa ti, okomini kofi atee ne aso.

Title: ANYANDERA 6
Content:
Asetena nu kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Mma, sɛ ali eliɛngo agyinamuɛ,
sɛ afa wɔ nwo asie kerɛ nu ama ɛwɔfoɛ,
2maa ɔnate so wɔ noa dwirɛ asua wɔ ngaen
wahye wɔ a,
3ye de mma, yɔ ɛhe fa tete wɔ nwo,
ofikyɛ atɔ eliɛngo ngaen nu:
kɔ kɔkoto eliɛngo ne, ná pa ye kyerɛ.
4Nnɛma nnaa ba wɔ nye so,
yeɛ nnɛtɔ ngosie.
5De wɔ nwo kyɛbɔ ɛwanzane ode ye nwo fi bɔfoɛ sa nu ɔ,
kyɛbɔ anomaa ode ye nwo fi sona bɔ osua nnomaa ngaen sa nu ɔ.
6 Ɛfoen sona, kɔ ngyiregyiraa berɛ,
nea kyɛbɔ ɔyɔ ye nningyein ɔ, ná sua nworɛ.
7Olle ebiala mma ɔnnea ye so,
olle adwuma so neafoɛ anaa panyi biala,
8nakoso wawa pe a, ɔpena ye aleɛ sie,
yeɛ fieso aleɛ falɛ dwu a, ɔboaboa ye noa aleɛ noa.
9O, ɛfoen sona, ɛkɔla maa okoodwu kyinzu?
Mmerɛ beni yeɛ ekofi wɔ nnafelɛ nu kodwɔso ɔ?
10 ‘Maa nna kãa, maa ndɔ ngosie kãa,
maa ndengyɛ me nu kãa.’
11Na ehiaa kɔwa wɔ so kyɛ awerɔm awueniɛ,
yeɛ anwokyere kɔwa wɔ so kyɛ koɛhonɛniɛ bɔ otira akokyɛm ɔ.
12Sona mbaen, busueniɛ,
ɔnate kekã nnakannaka dwirɛ,
13ɔbɔ ye nye kyire, ɔfa ye gya dwudwo,
yeɛ ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka dwudwo.
14Ye ti anu adwene te tɛ,
ɔbɔ nzɛmmɔne porɛ daa,
na ɔkekã mmenia ti bobɔ nu.
15Yiti musue kɔto sɔ sona ne mvum nu,
na ɔkɔto ye mvum nu bɔ ongonya ye sɔbea ɔ.
16Sɔ nningyein nzia hemɔ bɛyɛ AWURADE tɛ,
amba, nningyein nzoo hemɔ bɛte ye akyiwadeɛ:
17anyeɛ bɔ ɔtra ye ndo nwiaa, noa bɔ ɔnga nahorɛ ɔ,
asaa bɔ ɔkã mogya bɔ odi be gua ɔ,
18sona bɔ adwene tɛɛ ali ye ti ɔ,
agyirɛ bɔ ye nwo yɛ nyera wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nwo,
19sona bɔ odi adanzewia ɔ,
yeɛ sona bɔ ɔkekã aliɛmaa mɔ bɛ ti bobɔ nu ɔ.
20 Mma, di wɔ baba mmeraa dwirɛ so,
yeɛ nnɛpo wɔ maame foɛtulɛ.
21Bɔ ye borɛ fa to wɔ ti anu daa,
ná kyekye fa ya wɔ kɔme.
22Ɛnate a, bekohyire wɔ atee,
ɛda a, bɛkɔnea wɔ so,
yeɛ sɛ edwɔso a, bɛ ne wɔ kotu asure.
23Ofikyɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne te kanea, yeɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne te hyireinn,
na betwi wɔ nyunu bɛtengyɛtengyɛ wɔ a,
ɔte asetena nu esaa bɔ ɔla berɛ ɔ;
24bɔ ɔtwe wɔ fi musue brasua nwo,
ofi adwaman brasua ye noa dwirɛ menemene nwo ɔ.
25Nnɛdi ye anwonyemene si ekuro ye,
yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa ye ndo nwiaa ne ɔkye w’adwene.
26Ofikyɛ paanoo sii ko yeɛ bɛfa benya brasua adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ɔ,
nakoso ebie aye de, ɛfa wɔ ngoa yeɛ ɛpɛ so ɔ.
27Aso sona kɔhora kɔfa see kowura ye hue so
bɔ ye ndaadeɛ ngɔyera ɔ?
28Aso sona kɔhora kotiatia see gonn so
bɔ ye gya ngɔyera ɔ?
29Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ ebie aye nwo ɔ,
na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ sɔ braa ne nwo ne, ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.
30Sɛ ɛhɔen ku awueniɛ maa owua aleɛ kyɛ odi ma ye ko yi a,
ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛbu ye animtia.
31Nakoso sɛ bɛkye ye a, okotua ye nwo mmɔhoɛ nzoo,
ɔkɔhwere ye awuro nningyein amukoraa.
32 Nakoso bienzua bɔ ɔne ebie aye bɛda ne de, adwene nne ye ti anu,
sona bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ɔfa sɛkye ye bɔbɔ ye kra.
33Ye sa kɔhã epuralɛ ne animguaseɛ,
na ye nyanzoen ne ngofi ye so.
34Ofikyɛ nungunɛ ma bienzua fɛ yaa piri paa,
na kyẽa bɔ ɔkɔtɔ sɔ biaa ne so wereɛ ne, ongonwu ye anwumvoin.
35Ongole mbata biala,
yeɛ sɛ ɛma ye akyɛdeɛ pee po a, ɔngɔpene.

Title: ANYANDERA 7
Content:
Brasua adwamanbɔlɛniɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Mma, di me dwirɛ so,
ná fa me mmeraa dwirɛ ne sie wɔ ti anu.
2Di me mmeraa dwirɛ so ná nya ngoa;
ma me ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo hia wɔ kyɛ wɔ nye kyiremvua;
3kyekye fa bɔ wɔ sa mmɛseka,
ná kyerɛ ye wɔ w’ahone nu.
4Kã kyire nworɛ kyɛ, “Ɛte nniɛma brasua,”
ná frɛ adwene bɔ nu pi ɔ kyɛ wɔ busuaniɛ;
5amaa ɔnate so babɔ wɔ nwo waen bafi brasua sanzaniɛ sa nu,
bafi brasua sanzaniɛ bɔ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ sa nu.
6Né ngyi m’awuro berɛ mboma ne anu,
ndole me nye nneane me mboma nu,
7na nwuni ebie wɔ bɛ bɔ b’adwene te nganga nemɔ anu,
nwuni ebie bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ɔ
kyɛ ɔboka mmerandeɛ nemɔ aso.
8Né ɔnate dwaaso nekaa bie bɔ opingye braa n’awuro ɔ,
ɔfale atee bɔ ɔkɔ braa n’awuro so,
9mmerɛ bɔ né aleɛ adwo, bɔ né maen nu apinipini ɔ,
kɔngɔen ne awosii nu.
10Na yieee, braa bie wale ooyiale ye.
Né wahera ye tena kyɛ gyanderaniɛ, na né otira nnakannaka adwene.
11Braa ne te sona bɔ wasɛkye, na ɔnze nyanzoen,
na ɔndena ye awuro.
12Odi mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso ne dwaaso akɔneaba,
na ɔtetɛ wɔ ahameɛ biala.
13Yeɛ braa ne to brale ye, na ɔfele ye noa,
na braa ne totone ye nye lili sele ye kyɛ,
14“Mabɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ,
yeɛ matua m’aboadeɛ ɛnɛ;
15ye sɔ ati, mafite mawa kyɛ mebaayia wɔ,
mepena wɔ paa, na manwu wɔ.
16Mafa bomo masɛ me bɛen,
yeɛ Misraim mbasotam bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ɔ.
17Mafa korobo, pɛprɛ ne ayirefona
mapete me mba so fonafona.
18Bra ma yɛɛgye yɛ nye mba so toonn kɔpem ngyerɛmɔ,
