Yeɛ ehianiɛ bɔ ye koso ɔse asetena bɔ odi kyɛ ɔne ateasefoɛ bɛtena ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya ye ɔ? 9Bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ bɔ wɔ nye tua ye ne, ɔte paa tra bɔ w’akɔnnɔ susu kyɛ ekonya ye ɔ. Ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.
10Nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, bato ye dumaa dadadada. Ebiala se kyɛbɔ kuro sona osi te ɔ. Ebiala se kyɛ, sona ngora nne ebie bɔ ye nwo yɛ se tra ye ɔ benni apereapereɛ. 11Edwudwo pee a, wɔ dwudwolɛ ne yɛ mbaen; mvasoɛ beni yeɛ sona nya ɔ? 12Kuro sona ngoa tikaape bɔ ɔte mbaen, bɔ ɔsẽ kɔ kyɛ wawoɛ ne, nwa yeɛ ɔse bɔ ɔte paa ma kuro sona wɔ nu ɔ? Bɔ okosi sona ye wue asi wɔ wiase ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔla ye ali kohyire ye ɔ?

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 7
Content:
1 Dumaa paa te paa tra ayirefona bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ,
yeɛ ewue kyẽa te paa tra aworɛ kyẽa.
2Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔhɔ awuro bɔ bɛyɛ sɛen wɔ nu
tra kyɛ ɛkɔhɔ awuro bɔ bato poen bedidi wɔ nu ɔ nu;
ofikyɛ sona biala ye ayieleɛ ɛne,
na ateasefoɛ fa sɔ dwirɛ ne sie bɛ ti anu.
3Aworabɔlɛ te paa tra ɛserelɛ,
wɔ nyunu yɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin de, nakoso wɔ wora kyekye.
4Awuro bɔ bɛyɛ sɛen wɔ nu ne, berɛ yeɛ nworɛfoɛ b’adwene kɔ ɔ,
nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, b’adwene kɔ awuro bɔ bɛgye bɛ nye wɔ nu ɔ nu.
5Nworɛniɛ twi wɔ nyunu a, ɔte paa kyɛ ekotie
tra kyɛ ekotie ngwaseafoɛ edweintolɛ ɔ.
6Ɛfa agurɛ gua see nu a, kyɛbɔ osi yɛ titetite ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ kwaseaa serelɛ te ɔ;
na ɛhe koso ɔte mbaen.
7Nahorɛ nu, nhyɛsoɛ ma nworɛfoɛ bɛbɔ laen,
yeɛ fea-ase-ma koso ɔma sona bu ye nye gua nahorɛ so.
8Edwirɛ ayieleɛ te paa tra ye bohyɛlɛ;
aboterɛ nyanɛ te paa tra anwomasoɛ.
9 Nnɛma w’ahone hu ndɛndɛ,
ofikyɛ ngwaseafoɛ yeɛ ahonehulɛ wɔ bɛ so ɔ.
10Nnɛbisa kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ne, nzu ati yeɛ ɔte paa tra ɛnɛ mmerɛ ye ɔ?”
Ofikyɛ nworɛ biala nne nu kyɛ ekobisa ɛhe ɔ.
11Nworɛ te paa kyɛ agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bayakyi wɔ ɔ,
ɔte mvasoɛ ma bɛ bɔ bɛte ngoa nu ɔ.
12Ofikyɛ nworɛ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen kyɛbɔ sikaa ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ne,
na nimdeɛ nwo mvasoɛ ole kyɛ, nworɛniɛ ye nworɛ maa onya ngoa.
13Bɔ Nyameɛ ayɔ ne, fa kɔ adwenedwene nu:
Nikyee bɔ wakondo nu ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye tengyɛ ɔ?
14Mmerɛ bɔ okoyie wɔ yé ne, ma wɔ nye gye, nakoso sɛ mmerɛ tɛɛ to wɔ a, fa kɔ adwenedwene nu. Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmane sɔ tebea ne wale ne, ye ala yeɛ wama ɛhe koso wawa ɔ, amaa ɔnate so kuro sona wannwu nikyee biala bɔ okosi wɔ ye si ɔ.
15M’asetena mbaen ye anu, manwu nikyee biala: Teneneeniɛ bɔ owu wɔ ye tenenee nu, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ koso bɔ onya ngoa tendenn wɔ ye bɔne nu ɔ. 16Nnɛyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ wɔ de ɛtengyɛ tra so, yeɛ nnɛyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ wɔ de ɛse nworɛ tra so. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛpɛna kyɛ eku wɔ nwo ɔ? 17Nnɛma awosii ba wɔ ti anu tra so, yeɛ nnɛyɛ kwaseaa. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛpe wu ɔ? 18Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔsɔ foɛtulɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu, bɔ ɛngɔyakyi bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne koso anu ɔ. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ osuro Nyameɛ ne, ɔkɔhwe ye nwo kofi ye mukoraa nwo.
19Nworɛ ma nworɛniɛ nya tumi tra mbanyi buru bɔ bɛnea kuro so ɔ.
20Nahorɛ nu, sona biala nne aseɛ ye aso bɔ ye de ɔtengyɛ, ɔyɔ paa ngome, bɔ ɔnyɔ bɔne ɔ.
21Nnɛma w’adwene kɔ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mmenia kekã ɔ so, amaa ɔnate so ande kyɛ wɔ somvoɛ ɔnoma wɔ ɔ. 22Ofikyɛ, ɛse kyɛ mmerɛ pee ne ala yeɛ wɔ koso anoma ebiemɔ ɔ.
23Mafa nworɛ mapɛnzɛpɛnzɛ ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu manea; na ngane kyɛ, “Ngonwu nworɛ,” nakoso ɔne m’afia atee wale. 24Sɔ nikyee ne bɔ ɔwɔ dededede, nziɛ nziɛ, kumaa kuronguronn nu ne, nwa yeɛ okonwu ye ɔ? 25Mvale m’adwene nziele so kyɛ ngonwu nworɛ, ɔne kyɛ ngɔfeefee nu ngɔpena nworɛ ne nningyein bɛ bo telɛ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ngonwu amumuyɛɛ kyɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm, ná ngonwu ngwaseasɛm kyɛ ɔte ɛlaenbɔlɛ ɔ. 26Na nwuni bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro tra ewue ɔ: Ye ole brasua bɔ ye adwene te ngaen ne ɛtɛen ɔ, bɔ ye sa te ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ɔ. Sona bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ne, ode ye nwo fi sɔ braa ne sa nu, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔtɔ braa ne ngaen nu. 27Tie, bɔ manwu ye hɔ ɛhe: Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne. Mvale edwirɛ ne ndotole ye nwo ngoko ngoko kyɛ ngonya ye nwo ndeaseɛ ɔ. 28Ngɔle so alaa mbenane ndeaseɛ ne, nakoso mannwu bɔ mepena ne. Nwuni bienzua ko wɔ mmienzua apee ko nu, nakoso mmrasua mɔ nu de, mannwu brasua. 29Tie, ɛhe angome yeɛ manwu ye ɔ: Nyameɛ bɔle kuro sona ferengyemm, nakoso kuro sona ama nningyein pee bo telɛ ali ye ti.

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 8
Content:
1Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ nworɛniɛ ne ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ ɔse edwirɛ bo kyire ɔ:
Sona nworɛ ma ye nyunu yɛ gyenegyene,
na ye nyunu kusuu ne sesã.
Yɛ sotie ma wɔ hene
2Menwa, yɛ sotie ma ɛhene n’ahyɛdeɛ, ofikyɛ ata ndaen ahyire Nyameɛ, [na nnɛmaa ɔha wɔ]. 3Sɛ edwirɛ ne ɔtte mayee a, nnɛtwetwe wɔ gya ase, fi ye nyunu berɛ kɔ, ofikyɛ bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ. 4Ɔnate kyɛ, ɛhene noa dwirɛ te tumi, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kobisa ye kyɛ, “Na nzu yeɛ ɛyɔ ye?” 5Sona biala bɔ odi mmeraa so ne, edwirɛ ndo ye, amba, nworɛniɛ adwene ɔse mmerɛ ne ne ndɛenbualɛ ne. 6Ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ wɔ berɛ ma nikyee biala, na amaneɛ ayɛ adesoa piri wɔ kuro sona so. 7Ɔnze edwirɛ bɔ okosi ɔ, ofikyɛ atee bɔ ɔkɔfa so kosi ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔla ye ali kohyire ye ɔ? 8Sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ole nwomeɛ so tumi, bɔ ɔkora si nwomeɛ ate maa ɔtena ye nu ɔ, anaa ole ye wue kyẽa so tumi ɔ? Ɛsrɛ atee wɔ koɛ nu a, engonya ye, yeɛ amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ mbepɛ nne bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ ɔ. 9Manwu ɛhemɔ amukoraa, na medwene nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛyɔ ye wiase ne anwo: Mmerɛ bie wɔ berɛ a, sona fa ye tumi sisi obiɛngo maa ɔkakyi ye so amaneɛ.
10Afei nwuni amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɔ besiele bɛ ɔ. Mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase ne, né bedi nekaa krongron berɛ akɔneaba. Na kuro bɔ né bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ wɔ so ne, mmenia wora fili bɛ yɔleɛ ne. Ɛhe koso te mbaen. 11Na ɔnate kyɛ bɔne yɔleɛ nwo akatuaa ɔmma ndɛndɛ so ne ati, kuro sona ama bɔne yɔleɛ ali ye ti. 12Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɔnefoɛ ɔyɔ bɔne yɔleɛ sɔ alaa ɛyaa, ná onya ngoa tendenn de; nakoso nahorɛ nu, me de mese kyɛ bɛ bɔ besuro Nyameɛ ná bebu ye ne yeɛ okoyie bɛ yé ɔ. 13Bɔnefoɛ de, ongoyie ye yé, yeɛ ye ngoa bɔ ɔte kyɛ wawoɛ ne, ɔngɔyɛ tendenn, ɔnate kyɛ onzuro Nyameɛ.
14Nikyee mbaen bie ɔkɔ so wɔ aseɛ so. Edwirɛ bɔ ɔfata bɔnefoɛ ne yeɛ bɛfa bedi teneneefoɛ ɔ; yeɛ bɔ ɔfata teneneefoɛ ne yeɛ bɛfa bedi bɔnefoɛ ɔ. Na ngane kyɛ, ɛhe koso te mbaen. 15Yiti me de, menwu ye kyɛ anigye te paa, ofikyɛ nikye paa biala nne berɛ mma sona wɔ wiase ndra kyɛ okodidi, ɔkɔno, ná ɔkɔgye ye nye ɔ. Ye ngoa bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye wɔ wiase ne, ɛfɛɛ bɔ ɔfɛ wɔ nu ne, bɔ odi kyɛ ɔfa bata ye nwo hɔ ɛne. 16Yiti mva nziele me nye so kyɛ ngɔpena nworɛ si atee, ɔne kyɛ ngonwu ɛfɛɛ adwuma bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ aseɛ so ɔ, kyɛbɔ sona onnya nnaa nna eyia ne kɔngɔen ne; 17na nwuni Nyameɛ adwuma bɔ ɔyɔ amukoraa, kyɛ sona biala ngɔte bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ wiase ɔ bo. Sona kɔfɛ ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔfeefee nu, nakoso ɔngɔte ye bo. Nworɛfoɛ nwa nzɛ bɛse, nakoso bɛngɔhora bengonwu ye.

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 9
Content:
Ewue ma yɛ mukoraa yɛyɛ pɛ
1Ɛhe amukoraa, madwene ye nwo, mapɛnzɛpɛnzɛ ye mukoraa nu manea, na manwu ye kyɛ, teneneefoɛ ne nworɛfoɛ, yeɛ afei bɔ bɛyɔ ne, owura Nyameɛ sa nu: kyɛ ɔdɔ oo, kyɛ ɛpɔen oo, sona biala nze bɔ ɔkɔto ye ɔ; 2ofikyɛ ayieleɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma bɛ mukoraa ɔ: teneneeniɛ ne bɔnefoɛ, sona paa ne sona bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ, sona bɔ ye nwo te ne bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ, bɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne bɔ ɔmmɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Sona paa ne amumuyɛɛniɛ b’ayieleɛ te ko, yeɛ bɔ ɔta ndaen ne bɔ osuro ndaentalɛ koso b’ayieleɛ te ko. 3Bɔ ɔkɔ so amukoraa wɔ wiase ne, bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa ɛne, kyɛ ayieleɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma kuro sona biala ɔ. Afei koso, bɔne ayi sona biala ti anu tɛkyɛ, ɛlaenbɔlɛ ali bɛ ti wɔ mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛte ngoa nu ɔ, na ɛhe asi ne, bɛkɔ bɛ kra si. 4Nakoso sona biala bɔ ɔboka ateasefoɛ so ne, anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma ye, ofikyɛ kyea bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne, ɔte paa tra gyata bɔ wawu ɔ. 5Ofikyɛ ateasefoɛ bɛse kyɛ bekowu, nakoso awufoɛ de, bɛnze huu; belle akatuaa biala ko, na bɛ nwo ngayeɛ atu amini. 6Ɔdɔ bɔ benyane ye oo, ɛpɔen bɔ bɛpɔle oo, b’anyeboro oo, watu wamini dadadada, na nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ wiase ne, belle kyɛfa biala wɔ nu ko.
7Yiti kɔ so, di w’aleɛ wɔ anigye nu, ná fa anwosɛpɛ no wɔ nzaa, ofikyɛ bɔ ɛyɔ ne, Nyameɛ ale ato nu dadadada. 8Mmerɛ biala, wura anigye ataadeɛ, yeɛ nnɛma sakyeɛfona pa wɔ ti so. 9Wɔ ngoa amukoraa bɔ ɔte mbaen bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama wɔ wɔ wiase ne, ɛne ɛye bɔ ekuro yeɛ ɔ ɛmɔtena anigye so, ofikyɛ ɛfɛɛ bɔ ɛfɛ wiase ne, wɔ bue nu deɛ bɔ anya ye hɔ ɛne. 10Adwuma biala bɔ wɔ sa kɔsɔ nu kyɛ ɛyɔ ne, fa w’anwoserɛ yɔ, ofikyɛ ɛborɔ dɔ bɔ ɛbaahɔ ne, adwuma anaa adwene anaa nimdeɛ anaa nworɛ nne dɔ.
11Nza nwuni kyɛ ewiase wa, nna bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ nyera ɔ yeɛ bedi amirikatulɛ nu ngonim ɔ; nna anwoserɛfoɛ yeɛ bedi koɛ nu ngonim ɔ; nna nworɛfoɛ yeɛ benya bɛ noa aleɛ ɔ, nna badwemma mɔ yeɛ benya bɛ nwo ɔ; yeɛ nna nimdeɛfoɛ yeɛ benya animnyam ɔ; nakoso mmerɛ ne mmerɛ tɛɛ la berɛ ma bɛ mukoraa.
12Sona biala nze ye mmerɛ deɛ. Na kyɛbɔ bɛfa asawu atianuserɛserɛ bɛkye egyein, ná besua ngaen bɛkye nnomaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mmerɛ tɛɛ te ngaen bɔ ɔkye adasa mvum nu ɔ.
13Masa manwu sɔ nworɛ he koso wɔ wiase, na ɔte nikyee bɔ ɔte piri wɔ me nye so ɔ. 14Né kuro kaaba bie wɔ berɛ bɔ mmenia kaaba bie wɔ so ɔ. Yeɛ ɛhene tuminiɛ bie hɔle ootuale kuro ne, na ɔkyekyele nyinasoɛ bɔ okogyina so kɔfo fasue ne ɔkɔhɔ kuro ne anu ɔ. 15Né biaa ehianiɛ nworɛniɛ bie wɔ kuro ne anu, na ɔfale ye nworɛ pepɛ lele kuro ne. Nakoso ebiala ngaye sɔ ehianiɛ ne. 16Na ye sɔ ne ati, ngane kyɛ, “Nworɛ nwo hia tra anwoserɛ, nakoso bemmu ehianiɛ nworɛ, yeɛ ɔkã dwirɛ a bɛmva.”
17Nworɛfoɛ bɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ mmenia tie ye konn ne, bede bɛto nu bɛtra ngwaseafoɛ hene ye ndeateamuɛ. 18Nworɛ nwo hia tra akodeɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ komapɛ sɛkye paa pee.

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 10
Content:
1Kyɛbɔ nwɔsea fuin ma sona bɔ ɔyɔ sakyeɛfona ye sakyeɛ ne bo mvamva ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ ngwaseasɛm kãa bie sɛkye nworɛ ne animnyam ɔ.
2Nworɛniɛ adwene maa ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ,
nakoso kwaseaa adwene de, ɔmaa ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ.
3Sɛ kwaseaa nate atee so po a, nworɛ bɔ ye,
na ye yɔleɛ ma ebiala nwu ye kyɛ ɔte kwaseaa.
4Sɛ wɔ hene fɛ wɔ so yaa a, nnɛfi ye nyunu berɛ,
ofikyɛ sɛ ɛbrɛ wɔ nwo ase a, ɔmaa bɛfa wɔ bɔne mbiri mbiri bɛkyɛ wɔ.
5Edwirɛ yealɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ manwu ye wɔ wiase ɔ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ mvomsoɛ bɔ maen panyi wayɔ ɔ; 6bama ngwaseasɛm dibea maa wanya animnyam piri, na sikafoɛ dibea de, wahɔ ase. 7Manwu nganga bɔ bɛtete mbɔngɔ so ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnehyeɛ bɛnate ase kyɛ nganga ɔ.
8 Sona biala bɔ ofu kumaa ne, ye bɔbɔ ɔkɔtɔ nu,
yeɛ bɔ okodwiri ɛwaen kogua ne, ewoo kɔha ye.
9Ebiala bɔ odwa nyɔboɛ ne, nyɔboɛ pura ye;
yeɛ bɔ ɔpakye mmakaa ne wora, nu yeɛ opura ɔ.
10Sɛ ebie dadeɛ tiri ná wanzi a,
ye de sana ɔfa anwoserɛ pee ɔyɔ adwuma,
yiti nworɛ yeɛ ɔma sona adwuma yɛ yé ɔ.
11Sona bɔ ole ewoo ayire ne, sɛ ɔma ewoo ka ebie yie koraka né wahye ye a,
ye de mvasoɛ biala nne bɔ ole ewoo ayire ne aso.
12Nworɛniɛ noa dwirɛ maa onya animnyam,
nakoso kwaseaa de, ye noa dwirɛ maa onya dwirɛ.
13Ngwaseasɛm yeɛ ɔfa hyɛ ye dwirɛ bo ɔ,
na ye dwirɛ n’ayieleɛ te gyimikekã.
14Kwaseaa dwudwo pee bɔ ye noa mbe ɔ,
nakoso sona nze bɔ ɔbaasi ɔ,
bɔ kyẽa bie okosi wɔ ye si ne,
nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔla ye ali kohyire ye ɔ?
15Adwuma bɔ kwaseaa yɔ ne, ɔmaa ɔfɛ,
na ɔnze atee po bɔ ɔfa so kɔ kuro nu ɔ.
16Maen bɔ wɔ hene adwene te ngwadaa adwene ɔ,
bɔ wɔ nnehyeɛ bɛto poen ngyerɛmɔ ɔ, wɔ yaakɔ o!
17Ɔte saleɛ ma wɔ, maen bɔ wɔ hene te dehyeɛ baa ɔ,
bɔ wɔ nnehyeɛ bɛto poen wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ɔ,
kyɛ bɛfa bɛpena anwoserɛ, ná mmom bɛnno bɛmmo ɔ!
18Ɔnate ɛfoen ti sua kwatena bu gua nu,
yeɛ anyeɛhalɛ ma sua nwi.
19Ɛpoentolɛ ma sona sere,
nzaa ma sona nye gye,
na sikaa yeɛ ɔyɔ nikyee biala ɔ.
20Ɛhene ne, wɔ ti anu po, nnɛnoma ye,
yeɛ nnɛfea wɔ pumbu nu noma sikafoɛ,
ofikyɛ ewienu anomaa bie kɔfa wɔ noa dwirɛ ne kɔhɔ,
anaa kaka bie bɔ ole ndaa ɔ kɔɔbɔ amaneɛ.

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 11
Content:
Nworɛ nwo mvasoɛ
1Gyi wɔ paanoo gua nzue nye,
na kyẽa bie wɔ sa kɔhã ye.
2Kyekyɛ nu ma nzoo anaa mmɔtwɛ po,
ofikyɛ ɛnze edwirɛ tɛɛ bɔ ebiaa ɔbaasi aseɛ ye aso ɔ.
3Sɛ esue yi munungum nu tɛkyɛ a,
ɔtɔ gua aseɛ so;
sɛ bakaa bu tɔ ngwaen anaa sorɔ a,
nekaa bɔ bakaa ne tɔle ne, berɛ ala yeɛ ɔkɔla ɔ.
4Sona bɔ ɔnea kyɛbɔ mvrama si bɔ ne, ongolua ye nningyein;
yeɛ bɔ ɔnea kyɛbɔ ewienu ayɛ kusuu ne koso, ɔngɔfa ye fieso aleɛ.
5Kyɛbɔ ɛnze mvrama atee, anaa kyɛbɔ mmowue si nyi wɔ pemvoɛ kunu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyɔ nikyee biala ne, ɛnze atee bɔ ɔpe so yɔ ye adwuma ɔ.
6Dua wɔ fieso nningyein ngyerɛmɔ, yeɛ nnɛte wɔ sa fi ye lualɛ nwo nɔsoa, ofikyɛ ɛnze bɛ nu horɛ bɔ ɔkɔyɛ paa ɔ; kyɛ ɛhe anaa ɛhene, anaakyɛ bɛ munyɔ bɛkɔyɛ paa ɔ.
Ngwadaa nu ne mmerandeɛ nu
7Hyireinn yɛ ahomeka, na anyeɛ nye gye kyɛ onwu eyia ɔ. 8Yiti sɛ sona di afoɛ pee a, odi kyɛ ɔma ye nye gye wɔ ye mukoraa nu. Nakoso odi kyɛ osa kaye kyɛ, awosii ngyẽa bɔ bɛbaawa ne, ɔsone pee. Bɔ ɔkɔwa ne amukoraa te mbaen.
9Aberandeɛ, ma wɔ nye gye wɔ wɔ mmerandeɛ nu, nya anigye wɔ wɔ nu wɔ wɔ mmerandeɛ nu. Yɔ bɔ wɔ nye gye ye nwo ɔ ɔne bɔ ɔte wɔ nye so akɔnnɔ ɔ, nakoso nwu ye kyɛ, Nyameɛ kobua wɔ ndɛen wɔ bɔ ɛkɔyɔ amukoraa nwo.
10Ye aworabɔlɛ fi w’ahone nu, ná ye anwoɔnaen nu ateetee fi wɔ so, ofikyɛ ngwadaa nu ne mmerandeɛ nu po te mbaen.

Title: NWORƐ DWIRƐHANƐNIƐ 12
Content:
1Kaye Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ ne wɔ wɔ mmerandeɛ nu koraka né mmerɛ tɛɛ ne awa; anyɔ sɔ ná afoɛ nemɔ pingye a, ɛkɔhã kyɛ, “Mennya bɛ nu anigye biala”; 2koraka né eyia, hyireinn, ɛsraen ne nzramaa bakakyi awosii, ɔne kyɛ esue tɔ a osa muna ɔ; 3kyẽa bɔ awuro berɛ awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɛ nwo kɔwosowoso bɛ, bɔ mmienzua anwoserɛfoɛ bɛ nu kokundu, bɔ mmrasua bɔ besi aburoo ɔ bɛkɔyakyi ye silɛ, ɔnate kyɛ bɛnzone, mmerɛ bɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnea mboma nu ɔ bɛ nye so kɔyɛ bɛ wusiwusi; 4kyẽa bɔ bɛkɔtoto mmorɔnoɛ mɔ so anoa nemɔ anu, bɔ bɛngɔte aburoo silɛ nga ɔ, bɔ anomaa suɛ maa ekotingye kofi nnaa nu ɔ, bɔ edweintolɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛ bo kɔpɛ ɔ; 5kyẽa bɔ sona kosuro nningyein bɔ so kɔ anwuro ɔ, bɔ atee so kɔyɛ suro ɔ, bɔ atonwaa kɔbɔ nyerɛen ɔ, bɔ torɔka kɔhwe ye nwo ase ɔ, bɔ akɔnnɔ bo kɔpɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ sona kɔ ye awuro afebɔɔ ne anu, bɔ ɛsɛenvoɛ bekyinikyini mmorɔnoɛ so ɔ; 6koraka né ɛdwetɛ nyamaa ne ate, koraka né sikaa kɔkorɛ talie ne abɔ, koraka né bua ne abɔ wɔ asue noa, koraka né nyamaa bɔ bɛfa bɛto nzue ne ate; 7koraka né nnɛterɛ asa ahɔ nnɛterɛ nu kyɛbɔ né ɔte daa ne ala, koraka né nwomeɛ wasa wahɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔfa mane ne berɛ.
8“Mbaen nu mbaen.” Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne nwa nyoo, “Ye mukoraa te mbaen!”
Edwirɛ n’ayieleɛ
9Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne, nna nworɛ angome yeɛ ɔse ɔ, na mmom ohyirehyirele mmenia nimdeɛ bokale so. Otiele anyandera pee, ɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛle nu, na obuli anyandera pee. 10Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne, ɔbɔle mmɔden kyɛ ɔkɔpena edwirɛ mɔ bɔ bɛtɔ asoɛ nu ɔ, na edwirɛ bɔ wahyerɛ wato berɛ ne, ɔte nahorɛ ne turoloo.
11Nworɛniɛ ye noa dwirɛ ɔte kyɛ nandwiehanɛniɛ ye pɔmaa noa buralɛ; yeɛ ye anyandera bɔ waboaboa ye noa ne koso, ɔte kyɛ mberɛgoo bɔ mmoaenneafoɛ komapɛ wafa wabɔ berɛ pindinn ɔ. 12Mma, bɔ waha wɔ ɛhemɔ asi ne, mebɔ wɔ kɔkɔ kyɛ, nwomaa pembepembe hyerɛlɛ olle ayieleɛ, yeɛ nikyeesualɛ pee koso fa ɛfɛɛ wura sona nwonaen nu.
13Edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ yate ne, sɔa yeɛ yɛbɔ ye porɛ ɔ: Suro Nyameɛ ná di ye mmeraa dwirɛ so, ofikyɛ bɔ odi kyɛ kuro sona biala ɔyɔ hɔ ɛne. 14Ɔnate kyɛ, Nyameɛ kobua yɔleɛ biala nwo ndɛen, bɔ yayɔ ye mvealeɛ nu boka so, kyɛ paa oo, kyɛ tɛɛ oo, okobua ye nwo ndɛen.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Edwein nu Dwein te ehurolɛ nwo dwirɛ bɔ bɛboaboale bɛ noa daa tetetete wɔ Yisrael maen nu ɔ. Ɔfa nwomaa ne anu bienzua ne brasua bie anwo. Ye porɛ paa ne, ogyi ehurolɛ dwein bɔ bienzua ne to frɛfrɛ brasua, ɔne bɔ brasua ne koso to frɛfrɛ bienzua ne nwo.
Tete Ahyerɛlɛ ne biemɔ frɛ nwomaa ne Solomon Edwein, ofikyɛ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Hebrifoɛ abakɔsɛm nu kyɛ Solomon yeɛ ɔhyerɛle ɔ.
Mmerɛ pee, Yudafoɛ kyire kyɛ, nwomaa ne te abiɛngoɛfalɛ bɔ ɔla Nyameɛ ne ye maen b’afia nwo mvonini. Yeɛ Akristofoɛ koso bekyire kyɛ, ɔte abiɛngoɛfalɛ bɔ ɔla Kristo Yesu ne ye asɔre ne b’afia nwo mvonini.
Nu Dwirɛ
Edwein bɔ oli moa 1.1—2.7
Edwein bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ 2.8—3.5
Edwein bɔ ɔtɔ so nza 3.6—5.1
Edwein bɔ ɔtɔ so nna 5.2—6.3
Edwein bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu 6.4—8.4
Edwein bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia 8.5-14

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 1
Content:
1 Edwein nu dwein bɔ ɔte Solomon deɛ ne.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
2Maa ɔfa ye noa ɔfe me noa!
Ofikyɛ wɔ hurolɛ ne, ɔyɛ fɛ tra bobe nzaa.
3Wɔ sakyeɛ ne bo fona paa,
yeɛ wɔ dumaa te kyɛ sakyeɛfona bɔ béhwie ɔ;
ye sɔ ati yeɛ ndaluwa kuro wɔ ye.
4Twetwe me bra wɔ nwo, ma yɛ nwo ɔyɛ nyera.
Ao, ɛhene ne afa me awa ye pumbu nu.
Yɛ nye kɔhã, ná yali wɔ nwo ahurusi,
wɔ hurolɛ ne, yɛkɔkamvo ye yɛkɔtra bobe nzaa.
Ɔnyɛ nwanwa kyɛ bekuro wɔ ɔ.
5O Yerusalem ndaluwa,
nde bire, na me nwo yɛ nyemene
kyɛ Kedare ɛtena sua mɔ,
kyɛ Solomon mbɛmuɛ tena.
6Nnɛma ɛmɔnea me haa, kyɛ nde bire ne ati,
ofikyɛ eyia yeɛ wapini me sɔ ɔ.
Me ni mma mmienzua mɔ fɛle me so yaa,
bɛmaa nneane bobe boo nemɔ aso,
nakoso me bɔbɔ me bobe boo deɛ de, mayakyi mato berɛ.
7Ao, wɔ bɔ me kra kuro wɔ ɔ, kã kyire me,
nisua yeɛ ɛfa wɔ mmoaen kɔ adidie ɔ,
nisua yeɛ eyia bɔ a ɛmaa bede bɛ nwome ɔ?
Ofikyɛ, nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ meyɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ
okyinikyini wɔ wɔ mmango mɔ bɛ mmoaen so ɔ?
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
8O, wɔ bɔ ɛtra mmrasua mukoraa b’anwonyemene ɔ,
sɛ ɛnze berɛ a,
fa mmoaen nemɔ bɛ gya bo so,
ná ma wɔ mbɔngye nemɔ bedidi
wɔ mmoaenneafoɛ mɔ bɛ tena sua nemɔ anwo.
9O wɔ bɔ mekuro wɔ ɔ, mefa wɔ metoto
Faro teaseɛnam mbɔngɔ nemɔ anwo.
10Mbembenanneɛ fata wɔ so taa nu,
yeɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ akomuade fata wɔ kɔme.
11Yɛkɔyɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ asomade
bɔ ɛdwetɛ tuatua nu ɔ yɛkɔma wɔ.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
12Me hene ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye didipono nwo ne,
me nwo sakyeɛfona lele berɛ.
13Me kurofoɛ ne, ɔte korobo mumua ma me;
me kurofoɛ ne, ɔkɔla me nyɔfone afia kɔngɔen amukoraa.
14Me kurofoɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ bakaa bɔ ye nyerɛen bo fona
bɔ ɔwɔ Ɛn Gɛdi bobe boo nu ɔ ma me.
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
15Ah, me kurofoɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene,
ah, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene!
Wɔ nye mmaa dabadabaa kyɛ abubure nye!
16Ah, me kurofoɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene,
nahorɛ nu, anwonyemene ɛhe!
Yɛ bɛen ne, ye anwosue te nyaa monɛ,
17yɛ sua mbuna te sida,
na yɛ nzenyene bɔ ɔbɔ so ne te ɛtena bakaa.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 2
Content:
Braa ne dwein deɛ
1Nde Saron nyerɛen,
bɔnza nu sukooko.
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
2Kyɛbɔ sukooko te wɔ ɛfone mɔ nu ne,
sɔ yeɛ me kurofoɛ ne ɔte wɔ ndaluwa mɔ nu ɔ.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
3Kyɛbɔ aprɛ te wɔ eburo mmakaa mɔ nu ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ me kurofoɛ ne ɔte wɔ mmerandeɛ mɔ nu ɔ.
Ndenane ye bo fɔnwoo ne anu wɔ anika nu,
na ye mma ne, wabie wagua me gye abo.
4Wafa me wawa ɛpoentolɛ sua ne anu,
na ye frangaa bɔ ogyi me so ne ɔte ehurolɛ.
5Ɛ́mɔma me bobe mmaa taterɛ ma nya anwoserɛ,
ɛ́mɔma me aprɛ maa me nwo sande me,
ofikyɛ ehurolɛ abɔ me anwonyerɛ.
6Me ti la ye sa bɛen so,,
wafa ye sa famaa wato wabra me.
7O Yerusalem ndaluwa, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kitii,
mefa ɛwanzane mɔ ne dabɔɔ meta ndaen kyɛ,
nnɛma ɛmɔtingye ehurolɛ,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔperepere ye nwo
kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ okuro ɔ.
8Me kurofoɛ ne, ye komvi ɛhe!
Nea, ye yeɛ ɔba ye,
ohuruhuru wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso,
ɔbɔ apendengwa wɔ pambaa nemɔ so.
9Me kurofoɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ wanzane,
anaa dabɔɔ akrɔngrɔma.
Nea, ye yeɛ ogyi yɛ fasue ne asi dɔ ne,
wato ye nye ɔnea mboma ne anu haa,
wafa ye nye wafa mboma nu ngandanganda ne anu.
10Me kurofoɛ ne, odwudwole me nwo kyɛ,
“Dwɔso, me kurofoɛ, me kurofoɛ anwonyemene,
bra e!
11Ofikyɛ prakasua ne apɛ nu,
yeɛ asuso ne ayakyi, na wapɛ nu.
12Nyerɛen awa aseɛ ne aso,
edweintolɛ mmerɛ ne adwu,
na yɛte aborɔma suɛ wɔ yɛ aseɛ ye aso.
13Borɔdoma ahyɛ ye bo osu,
bobe nemɔ abɔ nyerɛen,
bɛbo fonafona.
Dwɔso, me kurofoɛ, me kurofoɛ anwonyemene,
bra e!
14O m’abubure bɔ ɛwɔ tokuro bɔ ɔla nyɔbotaen nu ɔ,
bɔ aafea nyɔbotaen si ɔ,
maa nwu wɔ nyunu e,
maa nde wɔ komvi e,
ofikyɛ wɔ komvi yɛ fɛ,
na wɔ nyunu yɛ nyemene.
15Ɛ́mɔhyehye safuboa nemɔ bɛ́ma yɛ,
safuboa mmaa mmaa mɔ bɔ bɛsɛkye bobe boo ne,
ofikyɛ yɛ bobe nemɔ asu.”
16Me kurofoɛ ne, ɔte me deɛ, yeɛ me wora nde ye deɛ,
ɔfa ye mmoaen kɔ adidie wɔ sukooko mɔ nu.
17Me kurofoɛ, sa wɔ si bra e,
yɛ kyɛ ɛwanzane anaa mmokaa so dabɔɔ akrɔngrɔma,
kɔpem kyɛ aleɛ kodwo ná wawoɛ komini ɔ.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 3
Content:
Braa ne dwein deɛ
1Kɔngɔen bɔ nna me bɛen so ne,
me wora lɔle me kurofoɛ bɔ me kra kuro ye paa ne,
me wora lɔle ye, nakoso mannwu ye,
[mvrɛle ye, nakoso wanzuro.]
2Nzaade, ngodwɔso ngoohyinihyini kuro nu dɔ,
wɔ dwaaso ne mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso,
ngɔɔpena me kurofoɛ bɔ me kra kuro ye ne;
mbenane ye, nakoso mannwu ye.
3Awɛmvoɛ bɔ bekyinikyini bɛwɛne kuro berɛ ne,
beyiale me.
“Aso ɛmɔanwu biaa bɔ me kra kuro ye ne?”
4Nzane bɛ nwo ne ala,
yeɛ nwuni bɔ me kra kuro ye ne ɔ.
Ndo mmrale ye, kyɛ mengɔma ɔngɔhɔ,
kɔpem kyɛ mvale ye mmale me ni awuro,
sona bɔ ɔnwonzɛle me ne, ye pumbu ne anu ɔ.
5O Yerusalem ndaluwa, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kitii,
mefa ɛwanzane mɔ ne dabɔɔ mɔ meta ndaen kyɛ,
nnɛma ɛmɔtingye ehurolɛ,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔperepere ye nwo
kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ okuro ɔ.
6Nwa yeɛ ofi ɛserɛ so dɔ ɔba ye,
bɔ ɔba kyɛ nwosina ningɔnn ye,
bɔ korobo ne ɛyɛɛ ayɛ ye nwo fonafona ye,
bɔ watutu dwadifoɛ sakyeɛfona amukoraa wagua ye nwo ye?
7Nea ye sɛko ne, Solomon deɛ ne ɔ!
Mmienzua anwoserɛfoɛ aburasia yeɛ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ɔ,
befi Yisrael mmienzua anwoserɛfoɛ nu.
8Bɛ mukoraa betiratira ngrandɛ,
bɛse koɛ ko paa,
ebiala ngrandɛ wura ye taku so,
ɔnate esurolɛ bɔ besuro kɔngɔen ti.
9Nana Solomon fale Lebanon mmakaa
yɔle ye bɔbɔ ye sɛko.
10Ɔfale ɛdwetɛ yɔle ye mbuna nemɔ,
ye si ne te sikaa kɔkorɛ, ye bia ne te koogyan,
na ye kunu ne koso,
Yerusalem ndaluwa mɔ bɛ hurolɛ yeɛ bafa badwura nu ɔ.
11O Sion mma mmrasua, ɛ́mɔfite bɛbra
bɛɛnea Nana Solomon,
kyɛ owura abotire bɔ ye maame fa bɔle ye
wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔfale atɔmvorɛ ne,
ɔne kyẽa bɔ ye nye gyele paa ne.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 4
Content:
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
1Ah, me kurofoɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene,
ah, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene!
Wɔ nye mmaa bɔ owura wɔ ngatanyunu nu ne,
ɔte kyɛ abubure nye!
Wɔ ti nwiaa te kyɛ mbɔngye kure
bɔ bɛtorotoro Gileade bokaa ɔ.
2Wɔ gye te kyɛ mmoaen mmeleɛ
bɔ bekye ala yeɛ babia bɛ ɔ bɛ nwo,
bɔ bɛ mukoraa bawo ndaa,
bɔ ko po nne bɛ nu bɔ ɔnwo ɔ.
3Wɔ noa te kyɛ nyamaa kɔkorɛ,
wɔ noa dwudwolɛ yeɛ oku me ye,
wɔ mvoka bɔ ɔtetɛ berɛ wɔ wɔ ngatanyunu nu ne,
ɔte kyɛ akengaa bɔ bapakye nu nyɔ ɔ.
4Wɔ kɔme te kyɛ Dawide abandenden ne,
bɔ besili ye kyɛ bɛfa akodeɛ begua nu,
bɔ akokyɛm apee ko sinzesinze so,
bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ b’akokyɛm ɔ.
5Wɔ nyɔfone nyɔ ne,
bɛte kyɛ dabɔɔ akrɔngrɔma nyɔ bɔ bɛte ndaa ɔ,
bɔ bedidi wɔ sukooko mɔ nu ɔ.
6Ngɔhɔ korobo bokaa ne aso,
ɔne ɛyɛɛ pambaa ne aso,
kɔpem kyɛ aleɛ kodwo ná wawoɛ komini ɔ.
7Me kurofoɛ, anwonyemene abia wɔ,
na ɛndɔ sii wɔ wɔ neka fee.
8M’atɔmvorɛ braa, maa yɛfi Lebanon yɛhɔ,
maa yɛfi Lebanon yɛhɔ.
Fi Amana bokaa ti afia dwu bra,
fi Seniri ne Hɛmɔn bokaa ti afia dwu bra,
fi gyata mɔ bɛ bue nu bra,
fi aboa mmokaa ne aso dwu bra.
9Nniɛma brasua, m’atɔmvorɛ braa, amaa mede me nwo a onne,
wɔ nye bɔ afa anea me ne,
yeɛ akomuade ko bɔ ɔla wɔ kɔme ne,
amaa mede me nwo a onne.
10Ao, nniɛma brasua, m’atɔmvorɛ braa,
wɔ hurolɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye fɛɛ osi te ne,
wɔ hurolɛ yɛ fɛ tra nzaa,
na wɔ nwo sakyeɛfona ne, ɔbo fona tra ayirefona biala.
11M’atɔmvorɛ braa, wɔ noa pepe woɛ,
woɛ ne nyɔfonesue wɔ wɔ temverema bo,
wɔ tena nu fona te kyɛ Lebanon fona.
12Nniɛma brasua ne, m’atɔmvorɛ braa ne,
ɔte turo bɔ bato ye nwo waen ɔ,
mbombonzue bɔ bato ye nwo waen ɔ,
abura bɔ bafa nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa ɔ.
13Wɔ mmaen nemɔ, bɛte turo bɔ akengaa wɔ nu,
bɔ mmakaammaa paa wɔ nu ɔ,
kandanguru ne mmakaa fonafona,
14mmakaa fonafona ne ɛsaa, hwendea ne ɛmanyire
ne ɛyɛɛ mmakaa mukoraa,
korobo ne pɛprɛ
ne ayirefona paapaa mukoraa.
15Ɛte turo nu abura, mbombonzue
ne asue mmaa mmaa bɔ bɛtengyɛ befi Lebanon so ɔ.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
16O, sorɔ dɔ mvrama, dwɔso,
O, ngwaen dɔ mvrama, bra e!
Baatu fa me turo ye anu
ma ye fona ne ɔto pete.
Me kurofoɛ ne, mepena kyɛ ɔba ye turo ne anu
ɔbadi nu mmakaammaa paapaa ne.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 5
Content:
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
1Nniɛma brasua, m’atɔmvorɛ braa, mawa me turo ne anu,
méboaboa me korobo ne m’ayirefona ne noa,
médi me woɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye nzasameɛ nu ɔne me woɛ ne,
méno me nzaa ne me nyɔfonesue ne.
Me mmango mɔ, ɛ́mɔdidi ná ɛ́mɔno,
adɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔno ma ɛmɔ ko yi.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
2Nnale, nakoso m’ahone nu de, né nnnale.
Ndele kyɛ me kurofoɛ ne ɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ kyɛ,
“Bukye me, nniɛma brasua, me kurofoɛ,
m’abubure, me kurofoɛ bɔ odi mu ɔ,
ofikyɛ ebosue aloaloa me ti so,
ɛborɔ bɔ ogua kɔngɔen ne,
waloa me ti nwiaa mbɛsɛmbɛsɛ ne.”
Braa ne dwein deɛ
3Mapuro m’ataadeɛ magua berɛ dadadada,
ngɔyɛ sɛɛ né mawura?
Manwunzi me gya bo,
ngɔyɛ sɛɛ né mayɛ ye fiɛ?
4Me kurofoɛ ne sɔle daakoo ne anu,
na me kunu yɛle me nufaa.
5Yeɛ ndwɔsole kyɛ mekwaabukye me kurofoɛ ne,
na me sa nwo korobo ne, ɔpepe guale,
me sa mmɛseka nwo korobo nzue ne, ɔpepe guale,
bɛpepe beguale daakoo ne aso.
6Mmukyele me kurofoɛ ne,
nakoso né me kurofoɛ ne akakyi ye nwo wasa wahɔ.
Me wora bɔle kyɛ wahɔ ɔ,
mbenane ye, nakoso mannwu ye,
mvrɛle ye, nakoso wanzuro.
7Awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bekyinikyini bɛwɛne kuro berɛ ne,
beyiale me,
bedufudufuli me, bepurale me;
na sɔ awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɛne fasue ne,
belele me ngatanyunu ne.
8O Yerusalem ndaluwa, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kitii,
sɛ ɛmɔnwu me kurofoɛ ne a,
ɛmɔhã behyire ye kyɛ,
ehurolɛ abɔ me anwonyerɛ.
Yerusalem ndaluwa suro edwein ne aso
9O, wɔ bɔ w’anwonyemene tra mmrasua mukoraa ɔ,
nzu yeɛ wɔ kurofoɛ ne ɔfa tra kurofoɛ biemɔ,
bɔ ɔmaa ɛsrɛ yɛ kitii sɔa ɔ?
Braa ne dwein deɛ
10Me kurofoɛ ne, ɔte toburoo, na ɔgyegye,
ɔda nzorɛ wɔ mmienzua apee buru nu.
11Ye ti te sikaa kɔkorɛ paa,
ye ti nwiaa mbɛsɛmbɛsɛ te pusaa,
na enwiaa ne bire te kyɛ adene.
12Ye nye mmaa ne,
ɔte kyɛ asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ ye nwo abubure
bɔ wabia nyɔfonesue nu ɔ,
na otuatua berɛ nyemenenyemene.
13Ye mvoka te kyɛ ngofie bɔ balualua ayirefona wɔ so
bɔ otu fona ɔ.
Ye noa te kyɛ sukooko
bɔ ɔpepe korobo nzue ɔ.
14Ye sa te kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ pɔmaa,
bɔ mbembenanneɛ tuatua nu ɔ.
Ye ko te kyɛ ɛsoen gye
bɔ bafa safire nyɔboɛ badwura ye nwo ɔ.
15Ye gya te kyɛ nyɔboɛ fufue mbuna
bɔ ogyigyi sikaa kɔkorɛ paa nyinasoɛ so ɔ.
Ye anwonyemene te kyɛ Lebanon,
na ɔda nzorɛ kyɛ Lebanon sida mmakaa mɔ.
16Ye noa dwudwolɛ yɛ fɛ paa,
ye nwo nekaa biala yɛ nyemene.
Ao Yerusalem ndaluwa,
me kurofoɛ ne, me damvo ne, ye ɛne.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 6
Content:
Yerusalem ndaluwa suro edwein ne aso
1O, wɔ bɔ w’anwonyemene tra mmrasua mu ɔ,
nisua yeɛ wɔ kurofoɛ ne wahɔ ɔ?
Nisua yeɛ ɔfale ye nye hyirele ɔ,
ná yɛne wɔ yɛɛpena ye?
Braa ne dwein deɛ
2Me kurofoɛ ne, watorotoro wahɔ ye turo ne anu,
ngofie bɔ balua ayirefona wɔ so nemɔ anwo dɔ,
kyɛ ɔkɔ turo nemɔ anu dɔ okodidi
ná ɔtete sukooko.
3Nde me kurofoɛ ne deɛ, yeɛ me kurofoɛ ne wora ɔte me deɛ,
ɔkɔ sukooko nemɔ anu okodidi.
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
4O me kurofoɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene kyɛ kuro Tisa,
wɔ nwo yɛ akɔnnɔ kyɛ Yerusalem,
w’anwonyemene ne, watɔ me so kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ betiratira frangaa ɔ.
5Nnɛfa wɔ nye nea me ko,
ofikyɛ mede me nwo a onne!
Wɔ ti nwiaa te kyɛ mbɔngye kure
bɔ bɛtorotoro Gileade bokaa ɔ.
6Wɔ gye te kyɛ mmoaen mmeleɛ
bɔ bekye ala yeɛ babia bɛ ɔ bɛ nwo,
bɔ bɛ mukoraa bawo ndaa,
bɔ ko po nne bɛ nu bɔ ɔnwo ɔ.
7Wɔ mvoka bɔ ɔtetɛ berɛ wɔ wɔ ngatanyunu nu ne,
ɔte kyɛ akengaa bɔ bapakye nu nyɔ ɔ.
8Ahenyerɛ aburasia ne sómaa aburawɔtwɛ wɔ berɛ,
yeɛ ndaluwa pee bɔ bɛnze bɛ noa ɔ wɔ berɛ de,
9nakoso m’abubure bɔ odi mu ne, ɔte komapɛ twe,
oni di ye bahorɛ,
bɔ ɔwole ye ne, okuro ye dwirɛ.
Ndaluwa nwuni ye, na bɛfrɛle ye sona bɔ ye nye agye ɔ,
ahenyerɛ mɔ ne sómaa mɔ koso nwuni ye, na bɛkamvole ye.
10“Nwa ɛne, bɔ ɔba kyɛ alehyeleɛ e,
bɔ ye anwonyemene te kyɛ ɛsraen,
bɔ ɔta kyɛ eyia,
bɔ ye anwonyemene atɔ me so kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ betiratira frangaa e?”
Braa ne dwein deɛ
11Ndwu ngɔle kube turo ne anu,
kyɛ mekwaanea bɔnza ne anu mmakaa frɔmfrɔm nemɔ,
kyɛ mekwaanea sɛ bobe nemɔ bafefɛ a,
kyɛ mekwaanea sɛ akengaa nemɔ babɔ nyerɛen a.
12Na me nye wale me nwo so ne,
né me kra amaa mayɛ kyɛ Aminadabo teaseɛnam nemɔ.
Yerusalem ndaluwa suro so
13O Sulamniɛ, sa bra, sa bra!
Sa bra, sa bra maa yɛnea wɔ.
Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnea Sulamniɛ ye haa,
kyɛ ɛmɔnea mmeni kure nyɔ b’abilie ɔ?

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 7
Content:
Biaa ne dwein deɛ
1O, dehyeɛ awa brasua,
wɔ gya ne mbaboa yɛ nyemene!
Wɔ sɔ ne, ye aporɛ so te kyɛ agudeɛ,
ɔte dwumvoɛ paa ye sa noa adwuma.
2Wɔ kotoa te kyɛ ngomvo kurukuru
bɔ nzaa bɔ bafrafra ɔ ɔmba nu le ɔ.
Wɔ ko sɛen te kyɛ atokoɔ kure
bɔ bafa sukooko bapɛ ye nwo bayia ɔ.
3Wɔ nyɔfone nyɔ ne,
bɛte kyɛ dabɔɔ akrɔngrɔma nyɔ bɔ bɛte ndaa ɔ.
4Wɔ kɔme te kyɛ abandenden bɔ
bafa ɛsoen gye bayɔ ɔ,
wɔ nye mma te kyɛ Hesebon ɛkwaa
bɔ ɔwɔ Bate Rabim pambim ne anwo ɔ.
Wɔ bonyi te kyɛ Lebanon abandenden
bɔ ye nye kyire Damasko ne.
5Wɔ ti bɔ otua so ne, ɔte kyɛ Kamɛl bokaa,
wɔ ti nwiaa te kyɛ serekye,
na ye mmɛsa ne, ɔma ɛhene ne tena a ɔndena.
6O, me kurofoɛ bɔ ɛgyegye me nye ɔ,
kyɛbɔ wɔ nwo si yɛ nyemene, ná ɔyɛ akɔnnɔ ɔ!
7Ɛbɔ pe kyɛ ayee,
na wɔ nyɔfone te kyɛ ye betire nemɔ.
8Menwa, ngɔfo ayee ne
ngɔɔsɔ ye mbapaa nemɔ anu.
O, wɔ nyɔfone te kyɛ bobe betire mɔ,
wɔ nwomeɛ fona te kyɛ aprɛ,
9na wɔ noa nwo felɛ te kyɛ bobe nzaa paa
bɔ ɔfa bɛ komvi yɔɔ,
bɔ ɔnate bɛ noa ne bɛ gye so yɔɔ ɔ.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
10Nde me kurofoɛ ne deɛ,
me yeɛ ye wora dɔ me ɔ.
11Me kurofoɛ, bra,
maa yɛhɔ mmakaa mmakaa nemɔ anu dɔ
yɛɛla namue nemɔ anu dɔ kɔngɔen.
12Maa yɛpɛ aleɛ yɛhɔ bobe boo nemɔ anu
yɛɛnea sɛ bobe nemɔ bafefɛ a,
sɛ bapakye nyerɛen a,
sɛ akengaa nemɔ babɔ nyerɛen a.
Dɔ yeɛ ngohyire me hurolɛ ngohyire wɔ ɔ.
13Nwonzɛenyire nemɔ betu fona,
mmakaammaa paapaa mukoraa,
monɛ ne daa,
begua yɛ anoa nu berɛ.
O me kurofoɛ, mafa masie berɛ mama wɔ.

Title: EDWEIN NU DWEIN 8
Content:
Braa ne dwein deɛ
1Me kunu a, ahaa ɛte nniɛma bienzua,
bɔ ɔnone me ni nyɔfone ɔ!
Sɛ meyia wɔ dwaaso a, ahaa ngɔfe wɔ noa,
bɔ ebiala ngosobi ye noa ngogua me so ɔ.
2Ahaa ngoli wɔ nyunu
ngɔfa wɔ ngɔwa me ni awuro
maa ekohyire me ehurolɛ.
Ahaa ngɔmaa ɛkɔno nzaa bɔ nningyein fonafona wɔ nu ɔ
bɔ ɔte m’akengaa nzue bɔ bahwi ɔ.
3Me ti la ye sa bɛen so,
wafa ye sa famaa wato wabra me.
4O Yerusalem ndaluwa, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kitii,
kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔtingye ehurolɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔperepere ye nwo
kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ okuro ɔ.
Yerusalem ndaluwa suro edwein ne aso
5Brasua beni yeɛ ofi ɛserɛ so dɔ ɔba e,
bɔ wate wamata ye kurofoɛ ye?
Ndingyele wɔ wɔ aprɛ ne abo,
nekaa bɔ wɔ maame wole wɔ ne,
bɔ ɔwole wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ aworɛ hane ye ɔ.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
6Fa me yɛ w’ahone nwo nzɔanoɛ,
fa me yɛ wɔ sa nwo nzɔanoɛ,
ofikyɛ ehurolɛ nu yɛ se te kyɛ ewue,
nungunɛ ti anu yɛ se te kyɛ asieleɛ kumaa.
Ehurolɛ nzramaa te see nzramaa
bɔ ɔsɔ wuronyiwuronyi ɔ.
7Nzue pee ngɔhora ngonua ehurolɛ,
yeɛ asue mɔ ngɔhora ngɔma ɔngɔmono.
Sɛ sona fa ye anwonya mukoraa po
kyɛ ɔfa tɔ ehurolɛ a,
bekosobi bɛ noa bekogua ye so.
Braa n’aliɛma mmienzua mɔ dwein
8Yɛle aliɛmaa brasua bie bɔ ɔte kãa ɔ,
onnya ɔbbobɔle nyɔfone.
Kyẽa bɔ bienzua bie kɔɔsrɛ ye agyaa ne,
nzu yeɛ yɛkɔyɔ yɛkɔma y’eliɛma brasua ye ɔ?
9Sɛ y’eliɛma ne ɔte fasue a,
ahaa yɛkɔto ɛdwetɛ abandenden yɛkosie so,
yeɛ sɛ ɔte anoa a,
ahaa yɛkɔfa sida yɛkɔma ye nwo yɛkoyia.
Braa ne dwein deɛ
10Nde fasue,
na me nyɔfone te kyɛ abandenden,
na mayɛ kyɛ sona bɔ ɔne asomdwee yeɛ bɛnate ɔ
wɔ me kurofoɛ n’anye so.
11Né Solomon le bobe boo wɔ Baal Hamon;
ɔfale bobe boo ne wurale hwɛsofoɛ sa,
bɛ nu biala te bobe mmaa ne a, né odi kyɛ ɔbrɛ ye ɛdwetɛ apee ko.
12Me bobe boo bɔ me bɔbɔ me deɛ ahɔ ne,
me bɔbɔ yeɛ menea so ɔ.
O Solomon, ɛdwetɛ apee ko ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ,
yeɛ bobe mmaa so hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ bɛ deɛ ɛyaa nyɔ.
13O, wɔ bɔ ɛte turo nemɔ anu ɔ,
wɔ mmango mɔ bɛnwondɛ kyɛ bɛkɔte wɔ komvi ɔ,
maa nde wɔ komvi e.
14Me kurofoɛ, bra ndɛndɛ,
yɛ kyɛ ɛwanzane,
anaakyɛ dabɔɔ akrɔngrɔma
wɔ ayirefona mmokaa nemɔ aso.

Title: YESAYA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya Nwomaa ne, bɛfa bɛtole Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ titire bie bɔ mmerɛ bie ɔtenane Yerusalem ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né waha afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nzoo ne aburannu koraka yeɛ bɛbaawo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Bahyɛ sɔ nwomaa ne anu nza.
(1) Ye ti 1—39 ne, ɔkã mmerɛ bɔ né anwoserɛ maen Siria ɔfa koɛ nwunanwuna Yisrael ngwaen dɔ maen bɔ oli Yuda ne nwo dwirɛ. Yesaya nwuni kyɛ, koɛ bɔ Asiriafoɛ bɛfa benwunanwuna Yudafoɛ ne, nna Asiriafoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwoserɛ ɔ, na mmom Yuda maen ne bɔbɔ ye bɔne, b’asoserɛ bɔ bayɛ, ɔne bɛ wora bɔ bamva banwura Nyameɛ nu yeɛ wama Asiria wanya sɔ tumi ne ɔ. Yesaya sili ye hue ɔfa sili Yuda maen ne anu ama ne bɛ mbanyi mɔ bɛ nyunu kyɛ, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ wɔ nu ɔ. Ɔbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ, sɛ banni Nyameɛ dwirɛ so a, ye de bɛ maen ne kɔbɔ. Yesaya hyɛle ngɔm koso kyɛ, mmerɛ bie baawa bɔ asomdwee kɔwa wiase amukoraa, bɔ Dawide bosoniɛ bie kɔwa kooli hene, bɔ ye ahennie deɛ de, odi mu paa tra ahennie biala ɔ.
(2) Ye ti 40—55 te mmerɛ bɔ né Babilɔn wahye Yudafoɛ pee nnure wahɔ, bɔ né Yudafoɛ b’anyelasoɛ ayie ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yesaya hane kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole ye maen, na okosa kɔfa bɛ kɔwa Yerusalem maa bɛkɔɔhyɛ bra foforɛ bo. Osa kã “AWURADE Akoaa” ne nwo dwirɛ.
(3) Ye ti 56—66 te mmerɛ bɔ Yudafoɛ befili nnurehyelɛ nu besa bɛwale Yerusalem ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né bɛ nye la ate kyɛ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ bɔ wahyɛ ye maen ne, okoli so ɔ. Né afei, wato kyɛ bɛkɔma tenenee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ, afofikyẽa so lilɛ, afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne mbaeɛbɔlɛ kɔwa bɛ bra nu ɔ. Na nziɛ ye bɔ Yesu bɔle ye adwuma bo ne, ɔfale Yesaya 61.1-2 hyirele kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ wasoma ye kyɛ ɔfa sɔ ndɛenvɛen ne ɔbra wiase ɔ. Yɛnwu sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Luka 4.16-21.
Nu Dwirɛ
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne bɔhyɛlɛ nemɔ 1.1—12.6
Amaenmaen mɔ b’asotwe 13.1—23.18
Nyameɛ kobua wiase ndɛen 24.1—27.13
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne bɔhyɛlɛ mɔ bieku 28.1—35.10
Asiria hene fa koɛ nwunanwuna Yuda hene Hesekia 36.1—39.8
Bɔhyɛlɛ ne anyelasoɛ ngraa mɔ 40.1—55.13
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne bɔhyɛlɛ mɔ 56.1—66.24

Title: YESAYA 1
Content:
1 Nyekyire he yeɛ Amoso awa Yesaya onwuni ye fale Yuda ne Yerusalem nwo wɔ Yuda ahemvo Yusia, Yotam, Ahase ne Hesekia b’aberɛ so ɔ.
Yuda bɔne nwo asotwe
2O nyameɛso, ɛ́mɔtie, O aseɛ, ma wɔ so bra wa!
Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo:
“Matete ngwadaa manea bɛ so maa banyi,
nakoso bayɛ me nwo lɔen.
3Nandwie se ye mene,
yeɛ afunum se nekaa bɔ ye mene ma ye aleɛ ɔ,
nakoso Yisrael de, ɔnze,
me maen ne ɔnde ye bo.”
4Ao, maen bɔ bɔne ayi nu tɛkyɛ ɔ!
Mmenia bɔ amumuyɛɛ ali bɛ ti ɔ!
Bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛ bosofoɛ!
Mmaa bɔ basɛkye ɔ!
Bɔ bapo AWURADE,
bɔ babu Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne animtia,
ná bakakyi bɛ si bama ye ɔ!
5Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ mekɔ so mebo ɛmɔ ɔ?
Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔtɛyɛ lɔen ye?
Tire ne amukoraa nde apɔ,
yeɛ ahone ne amukoraa ayɛ hodwoo.
6Ofi ɛmɔ gya kunu kɔkã ɛmɔ ti so,
nekaa biala nde apɔ,
wapepɛ wapuropuro
wayɛ ngenangena bɔ otu mogya ɔ;
ngena bɔ bemmia, bɔ bɛngyekye so,
bɔ bɛmva ayire bɛnda nu ɔ.
7Ɛmɔ maen ne abɔ,
bafa see bayera ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ,
amanvrafoɛ bɛfẽ ɛmɔ fieso aleɛ bɛfa
bɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ɔ;
wabɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ basɛkye ye ne.
8Waha Sion awa brasua ne angome berɛ,
kyɛ bobe boo nu asese,
kyɛ ferɛ eboo nu pata,
kyɛ kuro bɔ batua ye ɔ.
9 Sɛ Asafo AWURADE anyakyi yɛ
mmenia kãa bie ma bannya bɛ ti bannidi nu a,
ahaa yayɛ kyɛ Sodom,
ahaa yakakyi kyɛ Gomora.
10Mbanyi bɔ bedi Sodom so ɔ,
ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ!
Ɛmɔ Gomorafoɛ,
ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie yɛ Nyameɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ!
11 Ɛmɔ afɔleɛ worawora ne, mefa meyɛ nzu?
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Mmoaen nyii naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ
ɔne nyɛmmoa mɔ bɛ loe ne, mali maa wabɔ me;
yeɛ nandwie mogya
anaa mmoaen mogya, anaa mbɔngye mogya ɔnzɔ me nye.
12Sɛ ɛmɔba me nyunu a,
nwa yeɛ osele ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ ɔ,
kyɛ ɛ́mɔtiatia m’aluo berɛ basabasa ɔ?
13Ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mbaen mbaen ne, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛba ko,
ɛyɛɛ ne te m’akyiwadeɛ.
Ɛsraen foforɛ ne afofikyẽa aluolue ne, ɔne ɛmɔ dwaabɔlɛ ne,
nyianu krongron ne po, ɔte amumuyɛɛ,
mengɔhora ngɔgyegye so.
14Ɛmɔ ɛsraen foforɛ aluolue ne aluolue nemɔ,
me kra kyi,
ɔte ɛhawo ma me,
bɔ bayɛ me so adesoa ɔ.
15Sɛ ɛmɔtrɛtrɛ ɛmɔ sa nu (kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a,)
ngɔye me nye ngɔto buro bɔ mengɔtɛ ɛmɔ so ɔ.
Ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ pee de,
nakoso mengotie,
ofikyɛ ɛmɔahã mogya bagua paa.
16Ɛ́mɔnwunzi ɛmɔ nwo, ɛ́mɔpete ɛmɔ nwo,
ɛ́mɔye ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ ne
béfi me nye so,
ɛ́mɔyakyi bɔne yɔlɛ.
17Ɛ́mɔsua bɔ ɔte paa ɔ bɛyɔ,
ɛ́mɔpena pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ si atee,
ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ,
ɛ́mɔhã bie bɛma nyisiaafoɛ,
ná ɛmɔgyina akunafoɛ mmrasua si.
18AWURADE nwa nyoo:
“Ɛmɔbra ma yɛsiesie yɛ afia.
Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔne te kyɛ adaabene de,
nakoso bɛkɔyɛ fufue kyɛ nwera,
ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛboro kyɛ koogyan,
nakoso bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ gyese.
19Sɛ ɛmɔpene so ná ɛmɔyɛ sotie a,
ye de aseɛ ne aso nikye paa yeɛ ɛmɔkoli ɔ.
20Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔtwi bɛfa so, ná ɛmɔyɛ lɔen a,
ye de ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”
Yerusalem
21Kuro bɔ né odi nahorɛ ne,
nea kyɛbɔ wasi wakakyi gyanderaniɛ ɔ!
Ye bɔ ahaa né pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ wayi ye nu tɛkyɛ ne,
bɔ ahaa né ɔte tenenee kuro ne,
afei de kodiawufoɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ nu ɔ!
22Wɔ dwetɛ ne akakyi nikyee fiɛ,
wɔ nzaa paa ne, bafa nzue bayuro ye.
23Wɔ mbanyi ayɛ lɔen,
na bafa awuefoɛ abiɛngoɛ.
Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nye gye fea-ase-ma nwo,
na bɛpere bɛpena akyɛdeɛ.
Bɛnga bie bɛmma nyisiaafoɛ,
na akunafoɛ mmrasua dwirɛ ba bɛ nyunu a bɛmvrɛ.
24Yiti AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE,
Yisrael Tuminiɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo:
Aa, bɛ bɔ bekyi me ne, ngɔfɛ bɛ so yaa piri paa,
yeɛ ngɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ so wereɛ!
25Ngɔfa me tumi ngɔhwe wɔ so,
ngohuro wɔ ngɔye wɔ nwo fiɛ ne,
ná maye wɔ nwo wohyee ne amukoraa magua.
26Ngosa ngɔma wɔ maenbulɛfoɛ kyɛ daa ne ala,
yeɛ foɛtulɛfoɛ koso, kyɛbɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne né ɔte ne ala.
Na ɛhe asi ne, bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ tenenee kuro
ne nahorɛlilɛ kuro.
27Ɔnate ndɛenbualɛ turoloo so ngole Sion,
yeɛ ɔnate pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ so ngole nu mmenia bɔ basakyera b’adwene ɔ.
28Nakoso mmeraatolɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ de, ngohũ bɛ ngɔbɔ nu,
na bɛ bɔ bɛpo AWURADE ne wora, ngohũhũ bɛ.
29Na eluii mɔ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne bɛ, bɔ ɛmɔ nye gye ye nwo ne,
sɔ nikyee ne kɔyɛ ɛmɔ nya;
yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛre
kyɛ ɛmɔaye turo mɔ basie berɛ bɛsɔne (ɛmɔ nyameɛ mɔ wɔ nu) ɔ.
30Ɛmɔkɔyɛ kyɛ eluii bɔ ye nyaa kese,
anaakyɛ turo bɔ nzue ngua so ɔ.
31Anwoserɛniɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ mmɛyeram worowaa,
ye sa noa adwuma kɔyɛ kyɛ see nzramaa,
na ɔne ye sa noa adwuma ne bɛkɔyera bɛkɔbɔ nu,
bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okonua ye ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 2
Content:
Nyameɛ hyɛ asomdwee nwo bɔ
(Mika 4.1-3)
1Nyekyire he yeɛ Amoso awa Yesaya nwuni ye fale Yuda ne Yerusalem nwo ɔ:
2 Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne,
bokaa bɔ AWURADE awuro ne gyi so ne,
ye bo kotimu maa ɔkɔware kɔtra bokaa biala,
ɔkɔyɛ tendenn kɔtra pambaa biala,
na maen maen mukoraa bekobiri bɛkɔwa so.
3Na mmenia pee bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔbra ma yɛfo yɛhɔ AWURADE bokaa ne aso,
ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ Yakob Nyameɛ awuro ne anu,
amaa ɔnate so wahyirehyire yɛ ye atee ne,
ná yanate ye atimbire ne aso.”
Ofikyɛ Sion yeɛ mmeraa ne kofi kɔwa ɔ,
na Yerusalem yeɛ AWURADE dwirɛ ne kofi kɔwa ɔ.
4 Okoli maen maen mɔ so,
okosiesie mmenia pee b’afia,
bɛkɔboro bɛ ngrandɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ kona,
ná baboro bɛ pealɛɛ bafa babɔ asɔsɔaa.
Maen bie ngɔhwe obiɛngo maen so ngrandɛ,
na bengosua koɛhonɛ ko.
5O, Yakob awuro ama,
ɛmɔbra ma yɛnate AWURADE kanea ne anu!
AWURADE kyẽa ne
6Amba, apo wɔ mmenia,
Yakob boso ama nemɔ,
ofikyɛ eyia afiteleɛ ahɔmeɛ
bɛ ne Filisti ngonyaayelɛfoɛ bayi maen ne anu tɛkyɛ,
na Yakob boso ama nemɔ,
bɛ ne maen maen mɔ nu ama yeɛ bɛbɔ afɛ ɔ.
7Ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ayi b’aseɛ ne aso tɛkyɛ,
b’anwonya ne, bɛka a bennwu ye noa,
mbɔngɔ ayi b’aseɛ ne aso tɛkyɛ,
na bɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ, bɛka a bennwu ye noa.
8Mmosoen ayi b’aseɛ ne aso tɛkyɛ;
bɛsɔne bɛ sa noa adwuma,
nningyein bɔ bafa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sa bayɔ ɔ.
9Ye sɔ ne ati, adasa mmaa nyunu agua ase,
na kuro sona asopa ye nwo.
O, nnɛfa bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ!
10 Na ɔnate AWURADE nwo suronyi,
ɔne ye animnyam totohyia ne ati,
kowura nyɔbotaen nu,
fa wɔ nwo kɔfea mvuture nu.
11Bɛkɔbrɛ ahandaen anyeɛ ase,
yeɛ bekogua mmenia b’anwomasoɛ nyunu ase,
na AWURADE angome yeɛ bɛkɔma ye so sɔ kyẽa ne ɔ.
12Na Asafo AWURADE ole ye kyẽa
bɔ ɔkɔwa ebiala bɔ ɔte anwomasoɛ ne ahandaen ɔ so,
ɔne ebiala bɔ wama ye nye atra ye ndo nwiaa ɔ so,
na ɔkɔbrɛ ye ase;
13ɔkɔwa Lebanon sida mukoraa
bɔ bahɔ anwuro tendetende ɔ so,
ɔne Basan eluii amukoraa so;
14ɔkɔwa mmokaa ndendenn amukoraa so,
ɔne pambaa bɔ wahɔ anwuro amukoraa so;
15ɔkɔwa abandenden bɔ wahɔ anwuro anwuro amukoraa so,
ɔne kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue amukoraa ɔ so;
16ɔkɔwa Tasise ɛlɛen amukoraa so,
ɔne nu nningyein bɔ bali adwii bayɔ ye nyemene amukoraa so.
17Bɛkɔbrɛ sona ye ahandaen ase,
yeɛ bekogua mmenia b’anwomasoɛ nyunu ase,
na AWURADE angome yeɛ bɛkɔma ye so sɔ kyẽa ne ɔ.
18Amoen amukoraa bɛ boso komini.
19Na sɛ AWURADE dwɔso woso aseɛ serɛserɛ a,
ɔnate AWURADE nwo suronyi,
ɔne ye animnyam totohyia ne ati,
mmenia koowurawura nyɔbotaen ndokuro nu,
ɔne aseɛnwo ngumaa nu.
20Sɔ kyẽa ne, mmenia
b’ɛdwetɛ amoen ne bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen
bɔ bayɔ bama bɛ nwo, bɔ bɛsɔne bɛ ne,
bekogyi bekogua bɛkɔma
mmurokuruwa ne mbena.
21Na sɛ AWURADE dwɔso woso aseɛ serɛserɛ a,
bekoowurawura nyɔbotaen ndokuro nu,
ɔne mmokaa so bɔen mɔ nu,
ɔnate AWURADE nwo suronyi,
ɔne ye animnyam totohyia ne ati.
22Kuro sona bɔ ode nwomeɛ fa ye bonyi anu ne,
nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye so.
Kuro sona te nzu?

Title: YESAYA 3
Content:
Basabasayɔlɛ wɔ Yerusalem
1Ɛ́mɔtie! AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE
ɔbaaye ɛhemɔ fi Yerusalem ne Yuda:
pɔmaa ne bakaa biala bɔ bekisa ye ɔ,
aleɛ biala ne nzue biala,
2katakyie ne koɛhonɛniɛ,
ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ,
nworɛniɛ ne panyi,
3aburannu so safohene ne animnyamniɛ,
foɛtulɛniɛ ne ngonyaayelɛniɛ bɔ wabe,
yeɛ ndafowayelɛniɛ.
4Ngɔmaa mmɛɛmaa koli bɛ so mbanyi,
na nnɔma koli bɛ so.
5Mmenia kɔhyɛ bɛ mmango so,
bɛkɔhyɛ bɛ biɛngo so,
ebiala kɔhyɛ obiɛngo so.
Mmerandeɛ ne ndaluwa bɛ nye ngɔsɔ mbanyi,
yeɛ kwahweabaa koso ye nye ngɔsɔ animnyamniɛ.
6Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ebie kɔsɔ oliɛma bɔ ofi ɔse abusua nu ɔ nu,
na okose ye kyɛ,
“Wɔ yeɛ ele tena ɔ,
yiti da yɛ noa yɛ yɛ so panyi,
ná fa sɔ anwokyere kandinga he to wɔ nwo so.”
7Nakoso ko ne kɔtea nu sɔ kyẽa ne kose kyɛ,
“Daabi, mengonya ɛhawo he anwo sɔbea oo,
aleɛ anaa ɛtena biala nne m’awuro,
yiti nnɛma ɛmɔfa me bedi mmenia ne aso panyi.”
8Yerusalem asoti,
yeɛ Yuda afi ase,
ofikyɛ bɛfa bɛ dwudwolɛ ne bɛ yɔleɛ bedwɔso betia AWURADE,
kyɛ bɛfa bebu ye animnyam anyunuɛ ne animtia.
9Kyɛbɔ basi bayɛ bɛ nyunu ne, odi adanzeɛ tia bɛ,
bɛbɔ bɛ bɔne nwo dawure kyɛ Sodom,
bɛmva bɛmvea.
Bɛ kra yaakɔ!
Ofikyɛ bahwehwe musue babrɛ bɛ nwo.
10Ɛmɔhã behyire teneneefoɛ kyɛ okoyie bɛ yé,
ofikyɛ bɛ sa kɔhã bɛ yɔleɛ paa nwo akatuaa.
11Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye yaakɔ!
Ye ayieleɛ te musue,
ofikyɛ ye bɔne yɔleɛ ne, bɛkɔyɔ bie bekotua ye so kerɛ.
12Ngwadaa yeɛ bɛhyɛ me maen so ɔ,
na mmrasua yeɛ bedi bɛ so panyi ɔ.
O me maen, wɔ mbanyi mɔ lakalaka wɔ
maa edi makyebu fi w’atimbire so.
13AWURADE adwɔso bɔ ɔbɔ kwaadu,
wagyina berɛ obua maen ne ndɛen.
14AWURADE baabua
ye maen mbanyi ne ahemvo ndɛen, kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔ, ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔali bobe boo ne ɔ,
ehiafoɛ nningyein bɔ ɛmɔasisi bɛ bale ne,
ogua ɛmɔ awuro.
15Ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛmɔadufudufu me mmenia sɔa,
bɔ ɛmɔadwiridwiri ehiafoɛ bɛ nyunu sɔa e?”
AWURADE, Asafo NYAMEƐ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.
16Asa koso, AWURADE hane kyɛ,
Ɔnate kyɛ Sion mma mmrasua te ahandaen,
bɛ kɔme la bɛ nwo,
bɛtwetwe bɛ nye asi bɛnate,
bɛyeye bɛ gya ngoko ngoko,
ná bɛma ngaa bɔ ogua bɛ gya wosowoso ne ati,
17AWURADE kɔma Sion mma mmrasua
bɛ ti so kotutu ngena,
na AWURADE kɔpa bɛ nwo.
18Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kopuropuro bɛ gya ngaa nyemenenyemene ne, bɛ duku, b’afire, 19bɛ mbembenanneɛ, bɛ sa kɔm ngaa, yeɛ bɛ kɔme anu duku ne; 20b’abotire, bɛ mbɛteaa, b’abɔsoɛ, sakyeɛfona towaa, ɔne b’asomade ne; 21bɛ mbɛteaa ne bɛ bonyi anu mbɔkoaa; 22bɛ kende, bɛ ndena, b’aguasoɛ, ɔne sikaa kotoku ne; 23bɛ neanu, bɛ nwera, bɛ ti so ngatasoɛ ne, ɔne ngatanyunu ne.
24Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, bɛ nwo fona ne kɔkakyi mvamva,
bɛkɔfa nyamaa bɛkɔkakyi b’abɔsoɛ,
bɛ ti bɔ babɔ ye nyemenenyemene ne, ɔkɔkakyi tikwa,
bɛ kende ne kɔkakyi ɛsɛen tena,
na bɛ nwonaen nyemene ne, okotwindwam.
25Wɔ mmienzua kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
yeɛ wɔ mmienzua ahoneserɛfoɛ kɔtotɔ wɔ koɛ nu.
26Ye pambim nemɔ kosũ kɔbɔ awuye,
bɛkɔla berɛ too, na kuro ne kɔtɔ ase.

Title: YESAYA 4
Content:
1Sɔ kyẽa ne, mmrasua nzoo kɔte kɔmata bienzua ko, na bekose kyɛ, “Yɛkɔpena yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ noa aleɛ ɔne ɛtena bɔ yɛkɔhera ɔ. Wɔ de, fa wɔ dumaa to yɛ so, ná ye yɛ animguaseɛ ne fi yɛ so.”
Yerusalem kosa kosi ye gya nu
2 Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE (bakaa) mmaen ne kɔyɛ nyemene, okonya animnyam, na aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa kɔyɛ anwohoahoa nikyee ne animnyam kɔma Yisrael mmenia bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne. 3Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, bɛ bɔ bayakyi bɛ berɛ wɔ Sion bɔ baha Yerusalem ne, ebiala bɔ baha ye baboka ateasefoɛ so wɔ Yerusalem ne, bɛkɔfrɛ ye krongron, 4mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔfa ndɛenbualɛ sunzum so ne ɛyeralɛ sunzum so kobia Sion mma mmrasua nwo fiɛ kogua, ná wanwunzi mogya bɔ Yerusalem ahã agua ne. 5 Na afei Sion bokaa ne, ye nekaa biala, ɔne mmenia bɔ beyia berɛ ne, AWURADE kɔyɛ munungum eyia, ɔne nwosina ne see gonn kɔngɔen komundu bɛ so. Ofikyɛ animnyam ne kɔyɛ ngatasoɛ kɔkata bɛ mukoraa bɛ so. 6Ɔkɔyɛ ɛtena sua bɔ eyia bɔ a nu te fɔnwoo ɔ, afealeɛ ne nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen bɔ ɔmma mvrama piri ne esue nga bɛ ɔ.

Title: YESAYA 5
Content:
AWURADE bobe boo nwo anyandera
1 Maa ndo me dɔfo nwo dwein,
me dɔfo dwein bɔ ɔfa ye bobe boo nwo ɔ:
Né me dɔfo ne ole bobe boo
wɔ bokaa bie bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ so.
2Olele ye nwo waen, ɔyeyele so nyɔboɛ ne,
oluale bobe mmaa paa wɔ nu,
osili abandenden siele eboo n’afia,
otuli nu kumaa bɔ okohwi bobe mmaa ne anu kɔyɔ nzaa ɔ,
ɔnwondɛle kyɛ bobe ne kosu mmaa paa ɔ,
nakoso ye mma bɔ osuli ne te bisii.
3Afei, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte Yerusalem, yeɛ Yudafoɛ,
mesrɛ ɛmɔ,
me ne me bobe boo dwirɛ ne, ɛ́mɔbua.
4Nzikyɛ bieku yeɛ ahaa odi kyɛ meyɔ ye me bobe boo ne anu
bɔ manyɔ ɔ?
Mvale me nye ndole so kyɛ okosu mmaa paa,
nzu ati yeɛ wasu mmaa bisii ɔ?
5Afei de, bɔ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ me bobe boo ne,
mebaahã mekyire ɛmɔ.
Ngotutu ye nwo waen ne
maa ngaka kooli;
ngodwiri ye nwo fasue ne ngogua
maa bekotiatia bobe ne aso.
6Ngɔmaa ɔkɔkakyi adangasa,
mengɔdwaadwaa ye nwo, yeɛ mengɔbɔ ye nwo,
nu kofu agurɛ ne mmowue.
Asa koso, ngɔhyɛ munungum
kyɛ nnɛmaa ɔtɔ esue gua so.
7Hmmm, Asafo AWURADE bobe boo ne,
ye ole Yisrael awuro ama,
yeɛ Yudafoɛ wora bɛte ye boo bɔ ɔyɛ ye nyemene ɔ.
Ahaa né ɔpena kyɛ onwu ndɛenbualɛ turoloo,
nakoso onwu aminɛlilɛ,
ahaa né ɔpena kyɛ onwu tenenee,
nakoso awuyebɔlɛ yeɛ ɔte ɔ!
AWURADE dwudwo tia asisie
8Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ basesa sua mɔ babɔ so,
bɔ basesa eboo mɔ babɔ so,
kɔpem kyɛ bɛkɔkandam ye mukoraa so,
kɔpem kyɛ bɛ ngome bɛkɔha wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ.
9Asafo AWURADE ahã agua me so anu kyɛ,
“Nahorɛ nu, awuro pee kɔbɔ,
awuro mbiri mbiri nyemenenyemene mɔ kɔkakyi dandue.
10Ofikyɛ bobe boo eka buru kɔma wɔ nzaa bua ko pɛ,
yeɛ edua aburoo angora ko a, ekonya olonka buru.”
11Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ aleɛ bedwɔso
bekodi nzaa serɛ si,
bɛ bɔ besiri pɛ
bɛno nzaa toonn bɛbo ɔ!
12Bɛ yeɛ bɛfa sangoo, adengum, akasaa, awɛen ne nzaa
bɛkɔ bɛ poentolɛ bo ɔ,
nakoso bɛmva nningyein bɔ AWURADE yɔ ɔ bɛnyɔ huu ɔ,
yeɛ ye sa noa adwuma koso bennwu ye.
13Ye sɔ ne ati, bɛkɔhye me maen nnure bɛkɔhɔ,
ɔnate nimdeɛ bɔ belle bie ti;
ɛhɔen kohũ b’atitirefoɛ maa bekowu,
yeɛ nzuhɔen kohũ mmenia wora ne maa bekowu.
14Ye sɔ ne ati, ɛborɔ ye komvi ode ye tekɔtekɔ paa,
wabukye ye noa nu fakaa,
na Yerusalem animnyamfoɛ ne ye mmenia worawora
ne ye lɔen ne bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye ye nu ne,
bekoowura nu.
15Babrɛ kuro sona ase, adasa nyunu agua ase,
babrɛ mmenia b’anwomasoɛ ase.
16Nakoso Asafo AWURADE de, bɛma ye so wɔ ye ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nu,
na Krongronniɛ Nyameɛ ɔda ye krongronyɛlɛ ali wɔ tenenee nu.
17Afei mmoaen mmaa konya aleɛ bekoli, kyɛ bedidi eburo ne ala,
na ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ konya aleɛ bekoli wɔ kuro bɔ wabɔ ne anu.
18Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛfa nnakannaka nyamaa bɛtwetwe amumuyɛɛ ɔ,
bɛ bɔ bɛtwetwe bɔne kyɛ teaseɛnam nyamaa yeɛ bɛfa bɛtwe ne,
19bɛ bɔ bɛnwa, “Ma ye nwo yɛ nyera e,
maa ɔyɔ ye adwuma ne ndɛndɛ ma yɛnea e;
Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, ma ye botaeɛ ne opingye
ma yɛnea e!”
20Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛkã kyɛ bɔne te paa,
ɔne kyɛ paa te bɔne ɔ;
bɛ bɔ bɛfa awosii bɛyɛ kanea,
ná bafa kanea bayɛ awosii ɔ;
bɛ bɔ bɛnwa nikyee weewee te menemene,
ná nikyee menemene koso yɛ wee ɔ!
21Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛdwene kyɛ bɛte nworɛfoɛ,
ná bɛdwene kyɛ bɛte badwemma ɔ!
22Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bale dumaa wɔ nzaanonɛ nu ɔ,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ mmɔden wɔ nzaa serɛ frafralɛ nu ɔ.
23Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bede fea-ase-ma bebua sona bɔ odi fɔ be ɔ,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bebua sona bɔ odi be ndɛengyea ɔ!
24Yiti kyɛbɔ see osi yera ngyɛngyɛma motoo,
ɔne kyɛbɔ see wuronyiwuronyi osi yera ndire worowaa ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛ ndii kɔporɔ ɔ,
na mvrama kɔporo bɛ nyerɛen kogua kyɛ mvuture,
ofikyɛ bapo Asafo AWURADE mmeraa ne,
na babu Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne dwirɛ animtia.
25Yiti AWURADE fɛle ye maen so yaa piri paa,
odwɔso tiale bɛ huhuni bɛ,
mmokaa mɔ wosole,
na bɛ fuin mɔ to petene kyɛ fofoɛ bɔ ogua dwaaso ɔ.
Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu po ne, wanyakyi bɛ so yaafɛlɛ,
na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.
26AWURADE kɔpagya frangaa kohyire dedeede maen maen mɔ,
ɔkɔbɔ mvrɛma kɔfrɛ bɛ kofi aseɛ noa dɔ;
na nea, bele amirika bɛkɔwa ndɛndɛ!
27B’ɛlɔen ne, bɛ nu biala mvɛ, ebiala nzoti,
ebiala ndɔ ngosie anaa ɔnnafe,
b’abɔsoɛ nu ngoho,
yeɛ bɛ mbaboa nyamaa ndete;
28b’agyaen mɔ yɛ nna,
basinasina b’agyaen ne amukoraati,
bɛ mbɔngɔ nemɔ gya boen te kyɛ twerɛboɛ,
na bɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ betu amirika kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ.
29Kyɛbɔ besi bɛbobɔ nu ne, ɔte kyɛ gyata deɛ,
na bepo kyɛ gyata akrɔngrɔma mɔ,
bɛyɛ bɛ komvi hooo bɛkye bɛ naen,
na bɛfa bɛkɔ bɔ ebiala ngora nnne mvi bɛ sa nu ɔ.
30Bekopo bɛ sɔ kyẽa ne,
kyɛbɔ ɛpo yɛ wuruwuru ɔ.
Na sɛ ɛto wɔ nye nea aseɛ a,
awosii ne aworabɔlɛ yeɛ ekonwu ye ɔ,
na munungum komundu hyireinn so maa ɔkɔyɛ tunn.

Title: YESAYA 6
Content:
Nyameɛ ye ye nwo ali kyire Yesaya
1 Afoɛ bɔ Nana Yusia wuli ne anu, nwuni AWURADE kyɛ ɔte ahennie bia bɔ so ma paa ɔ so. Né ye ataadeɛ ne noa wayi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu tɛkyɛ. 2Né Serafim mɔ bɛwɔ ye ti so anwuro. Bɛ nu biala le ndaa nzia: bɛ nu biala fa nyɔ kata ye nyunu, ɔfa nyɔ kata ye gya nwo, yeɛ ɔfa nyɔ tu. 3 Na ebiala tea nu se obiɛngo kyɛ,
“Krongron, krongron, Asafo AWURADE te krongron;
ye animnyam ayi aseɛ so amukoraa tɛkyɛ.”
4 Bɛ komvi bɔ bɛfa bɛteane nu ne, ɔmane anoa nemɔ bɛ nyinasoɛ ne wosole, na nwosina yili sua ne anu tɛkyɛ. 5Na ngane kyɛ, “Edwirɛ ato me oo! Mawu oo! Ofikyɛ nde sona bɔ me noa kekã amumuyɛɛ dwirɛ, yeɛ nde maen bɔ nu ama kekã amumuyɛɛ dwirɛ ɔ nu; ɔnate kyɛ me nye anwu Ɛhene ne, bɔ ye ole Asafo AWURADE!”
6Yeɛ Serafim nemɔ anu ko tu wale me nwo berɛ. Né otira see bɔ ogye bɔ wafa akapɛ waye wafi afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ɔ. 7Ɔfa hane me noa, na osele kyɛ, “Tie, sɔ nikyee ye ahã wɔ noa; baye w’amumuyɛɛ ne bafi wɔ so, na bate wɔ nwo bafi wɔ bɔne nwo.” 8Na ndele AWURADE komvi kyɛ obisa kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ nzoma yeɛ ɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ kɔma yɛ ɔ?” Na nzele kyɛ, “Me ɛhe, soma me.” 9 Na osele kyɛ, “Kɔ, kɔhã kyire maen he kyɛ,
“ ‘Etielɛ de ɛmɔtie, nakoso ɛmɔnde ye bo;
ɛnealɛ de ɛmɔnea, nakoso ɛmɔnnwu ye.’
10Ma maen he b’adwene ɔla,
ma bɛ so anu yɛ se,
ná ma bɛ nye si;
wamma ye sɔ a, bɛkɔfa bɛ nye bekonwu nikye,
bɛkɔfa bɛ so bɛkɔte dwirɛ,
bɛkɔfa b’adwene bɛkɔte dwirɛ bo,
ná basakyera maa masa bɛ anwonyerɛ.”
11Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, “O AWURADE, ɛhe kɔhɔ so alaa maa okoodwu kyinzu?” Na obuale kyɛ,
“Kɔpem kyɛ nguro kɔkakyi kurofoen
bɔ sona nne so ɔ,
ɔne kyɛ awuro mɔ kɔkakyi dandue bɔ sona nne nu ɔ,
ɔne kyɛ aseɛ ne kɔsɛkye bɔkɔɔ kɔla berɛ mbaen ɔ,
12kɔpem kyɛ AWURADE kɔpɛ mmenia ne asue kɔhɔ dedeede
maa kurofoen nemɔ kɔyɛ pee wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ.
13Na sɛ ɔka buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko wɔ nu po a,
bekosa bekowuwu,
kyɛ esaa anaa eluii bɔ babu ye bato,
bɔ ye dosii tɛ gyi berɛ ɔ.”
Bɛ bosofoɛ krongron ne ole dosii ne.

Title: YESAYA 7
Content:
Yesaya fa ngraa kɔma Nana Ahase
1 Yusia awa Yotam ɔwa Ahase bɔ ɔte Yuda hene ne, ye aberɛ so, Siria hene Resin ne Yisrael hene Peka bɔ ɔse ole Remalia ne, bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Yerusalem, nakoso bangora banni so ngonim. 2Na bɛbɔle Dawide awuro ama mɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, “Siria ne Efraim bayɛ apam” nen, Yuda hene Ahase ne ye mmenia bɛ nwo wosole bɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ kyɛ ɛhɔayeɛ nu mmakaa bɔ mvrama woso bɛ ɔ.
3Nakoso AWURADE sele Yesaya kyɛ, “Kɔ ná koyia Ahase, ɛne ɛwa Sea-Yasubo wɔ anwuro dɔ ɛkwaa ne noa, wɔ atapoɛ atee ne aso dɔ, 4ná se ye kyɛ, Gyina pindinn, yɛ konn, nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ wɔ gyetia nyɔ hemɔ bɔ begye monɛɛmonɛɛ ne anwo, bɔ bɛ ole Sirianiɛ Resin ɔne Remalia awa ne bɛ yaa hahii bɔ bafɛ ne. 5Ofikyɛ Siria ne Efraim ne Remalia awa ne babɔ wɔ nwo porɛ, na bɛnwa: 6Ɛ́mɔma yɛɛtua Yuda ma ahunundetelɛ tɔ ye so, ná yɛli so ngonim, ná yɛfa Tabeel awa bienzua ne yɛli so hene.” 7Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo:
Sɔ porɛ ne ngogyina,
yeɛ ɔngɔyɔ adwuma.
8Ofikyɛ Siria ahenguro ole Damasko,
yeɛ Resin yeɛ ɔla Damasko noa ɔ.
(Na toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu afoɛ aburasia ne nnu ne, Efraim kɔbɔ bɔkɔɔ bɔ ɔngɔyɛ maen ko ɔ.)
9Efraim ahenguro ole Samaria,
yeɛ Remalia awa ne yeɛ ɔla Samaria noa ɔ.
Na sɛ ɛmɔanne banni a,
nahorɛ nu, ɛmɔngɔhora ɛmɔ gya nu gyina.”
Yimanuel ne te sɛngyerɛnneɛ
10AWURADE sa sele Ahase kyɛ, 11“Bisa sɛngyerɛnneɛ bie fi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ; kyɛ ɔkɔ kuronn kyɛ ɛborɔ dɔ oo, anaa ɔkɔ anwuro anwuro kyɛ nyameɛso oo.” 12Nakoso Ahase buale kyɛ, “Mengobisa, yeɛ mengoso AWURADE mengɔnea.” 13Yeɛ Yesaya sele kyɛ, “O Dawide awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie! Ɛmɔnwa nzɛ ɔte edwirɛ baa kyɛ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo yɛ mmenia ahi, bɔ yeɛ ɛmɔama ɛmɔ nwo ayɛ me Nyameɛ koso ahi ye? 14 Yiti AWURADE bɔbɔ kɔma ɛmɔ sɛngyerɛnneɛ. Ɛ́mɔtie! taluwa bie kɔnwonzɛ kɔwo baa bienzua, na ɔkɔto ye dumaa Yimanuel. 15Mmerɛ bɔ onwu bɔne a ɔkɔpo ye, ná wafa paa ne, nandwie nyɔfonesue nye loe ɔne woɛ yeɛ okoli ɔ. 16Ofikyɛ, aseɛ bɔ so ahemvo nyɔ bama ahunundetelɛ atɔ wɔ so ne, ɔkɔkakyi kurofoen koraka né akwadaa ne anwu kyɛ ɔkɔpo bɔne, ɔne kyɛ ɔkɔfa paa ɔ.
17“AWURADE kɔma mmerɛ bie kɔto wɔ ne wɔ maen ne wɔ baba awuro ama, bɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne ɔttole ɛmɔ le, ofi mmerɛ bɔ Efraim tele ye nwo fili Yuda nwo ɔ. Ɔkɔfa Asiria hene so.
18“Sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE kɔbɔ mvrɛma kɔfrɛ nwɔsea bɔ bɛwɔ Misraim asue mɔ bɛ sorɔ dɔ, ɔne ɛwommaa bɔ bɛwɔ Asiria aseɛ so ɔ. 19Bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔtenatena kongonyi nemɔ anu, nyɔbotaen ndokuro nemɔ anu, ndire mmowue mmowue ne nzenzaen amukoraa so.
20“Sɔ mmerɛ ne, dɛmaa bɔ AWURADE abɔ ye paa wafi asue Yufreti si dɔ, bɔ ye ole Asiria hene ne, ɔkɔfa kopia ɛmɔ ti nwiaa ne ɛmɔ nwo nwiaa, na ɔkɔye ɛmɔ kanza koso.
21“Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ne, sona kosie nandwie beleɛ akrɔngrɔma ko ne mmoaen nyɔ, 22na ɔnate nyɔfonesue pee bɔ okonya ye ne ati, okoli nandwie nyɔfonesue nye loe; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔha aseɛ ne aso ne, nandwie nyɔfonesue nye loe ne woɛ yeɛ okoli ɔ.
23“Sɔ mmerɛ ne, nekaa biala bɔ bobe mmakaa apee ko wɔ, bɔ ye nyɔboɛ te ɛdwetɛ apee ko ne, ɔkɔkakyi agurɛ ne mmowue. 24Agyaen ne agyaen mmakaa yeɛ mmenia kɔfa kɔwa berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne amukoraa kɔkakyi agurɛ ne mmowue. 25Na pambaa amukoraa bɔ né bɛfa kona bɛyɔ so boo ne, agurɛ ne mmowue nemɔ ati ebiala ngɔhɔ berɛ; na mmom bɛkɔkakyi nekaa bɔ bɛyakyi nandwie ne mmoaen maa bɛkɔ adidie ɔ.”

Title: YESAYA 8
Content:
Yesaya awa ne dumaa
1Afei AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Fa nyɔboɛ pirikua taataa bɔ bɛkyerɛ so ɔ, ná twerɛ bɔ sona kɔkenga kɔte ye bo ɔ, kyɛ, ‘Maheri Sala Hasibase’. 2Na mmane ɔsɔfo Yuria ne Yeberekia awa Sakaria bɛhyerɛ bɛmane me bɛyɛle ye nwo adanzefoɛ nahorɛfoɛ.”
3Afei me ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ braa ne yɛlale, ɔnwonzɛle, na ɔwole bienzua. Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Maheri Sala Hasibase, 4ofikyɛ, anzana akwadaa ne konwu ‘Baba anaa Mooni’ kã ne, né Asiria hene wasoa Damasko anwonya ne Samaria koɛ nu nzesadeɛ wahɔ.”
5Yeɛ AWURADE sa sele me kyɛ, 6“Ɔnate kyɛ maen he apo Siloa asue bɔ ɔsẽ dinn ne, ná bama Resin ne Remalia awa ne nwo suronyi atɔ bɛ so ne ati, 7yiti tie, AWURADE kɔfa asue Yufreti nu nzue worawora bɔ ye noa yɛ hye, bɔ ɔte Asiria hene ne ye animnyam amukoraa ne, na okoyi kobu kɔfa ye boo ne ye noa amukoraa. 8Okoyi kɔɔsẽ kɔfa Yuda, okobu kɔfa ye so, ɔkɔla bɛ kɔme anu, na ɔkɔtrɛ ye ndaa nu kɔfa w’aseɛ ne amukoraa so, O Yimanuel!”
Maen maen mɔ koli ngoguo
9Maen maen mɔ, ɛmɔ de, ɛ́mɔhã ɛmɔ nwo bɛbɔ nu, nakoso ɛmɔkoli ngoguo,
dedeede maen mɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie,
ɛ́mɔyɛ koɛ nu anwoboa, nakoso ɛmɔkoli ngoguo,
ɛ́mɔyɛ koɛ nu anwoboa, nakoso ɛmɔkoli ngoguo.
10Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔhɔ agyina, nakoso ɔkɔyɛ mbaen,
ɛ́mɔbɔ porɛ, nakoso ɔngɔyɛ yee,
ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ne yɛ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ.
11AWURADE dwudwo hyirele me wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ye tumi wɔ me so serɛserɛ, na ɔbɔle me kɔkɔ kyɛ, maen he atee bɔ ɔnate so ne, nnɛmaa mefa so bie. Ɔnwa: 12 “Nikyee biala bɔ maen he frɛ ye ‘bɛ ti so porɛbɔlɛ’ nen, nnɛma ɛmɔfrɛ ye sɔ bie; yeɛ bɔ besuro ne koso, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bie, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsuro. 13Asafo AWURADE ngome yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ye yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔsuro ye, ye yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ye nwo suronyi tɔ ɛmɔ so ɔ. 14 Ɔkɔyɛ nekaa krongron, sundidua nyɔboɛ, ɔne nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔmaa besoti ɔ kɔma Yisrael abusua nyɔ ne, na ɔkɔyɛ atodum ne ngaen kɔma Yerusalemfoɛ. 15Bɛ nu pee kosoti wɔ so, bekofi ase, bekopura; bɛkɔtɔ ngaen nu, na bɛkɔhye bɛ bɛkɔhɔ.”
16Bobɔ adanzeɛ ne, na ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ mefa mema m’asuafoɛ ne, fa nzɔanoɛ sɔ ye noa. 17 AWURADE bɔ waye ye nye wato buro wafea Yakob boso ama ne, ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu, ngɔpena ye si atee. 18Ɛ́mɔtie, me ne me mma bɔ AWURADE afa bɛ ama me ne, yɛte sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ bɔ ofi Asafo AWURADE bɔ ɔte Sion bokaa so ne berɛ yɛma Yisrael. 19Na sɛ mmenia kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ bɔ bɛ dwudwolɛ te katekate ne boborɔboborɔ ne, ɛmɔhɔ bɛ so abisa” a, aso nna maen bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bebisa nikye ɔ? Aso odi kyɛ bebisa ateasefoɛ ti wɔ awufoɛ berɛ anaa? 20Odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena mmeraa ne ne adanzeɛ ne si atee! Nahorɛ nu, sɛ banga ye kyɛbɔ edwirɛ ne ɔte ne a, ye de né nahorɛ biala nne bɛ nu. 21Bɛkɔfa ɛhɔen ne aworabɔlɛ bekohyinihyini aseɛ ne aso. Na sɛ ɛhɔen ku bɛ a, b’ahone kohu, na bɛkɔwa bɛ hene ne bɛ Nyameɛ amoen. Bɛkɔto bɛ nye bɛkɔnea anwuro, 22bɛkɔto bɛ nye bɛkɔnea aseɛ so, nakoso aworabɔlɛ, awosii ne amaneɛ yeɛ bekonwu ye ɔ; na bekogyi bɛ bekogua awosii kabii nu.

Title: YESAYA 9
Content:
Asomdwee Hene n’aworɛ
1 Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ne, b’amaneɛnwunɛ ne ngɔha berɛ. Daa ne, obuli Sebulɔn aseɛ ne Nafetali aseɛ animtia, nakoso kyẽa bie de, atee bɔ ɔla mboanoa ne, yeɛ aseɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, ɔne Galilea bɔ ɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ mbɔtam ne, ɔkɔhyɛ bɛ animnyam.
2Maen bɔ né ɔnate awosii nu ne,
wanwu kanea piri ne,
bɛ bɔ né bɛte awosii kabii aseɛ so ne,
kanea ata bɛ so.
3Ama maen ne anu mmenia bata bayɛ pee,
amaa banya anika piri,
benya ahurusi wɔ wɔ nyunu
kyɛbɔ mmenia nya anigye wɔ fieso aleɛ falɛ nu ɔ,
kyɛbɔ mmenia di ahurusi wɔ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ hyɛlɛ nu ɔ.
4Ofikyɛ b’adesoa bɔ ɔso bɛ ne,
bakaa bɔ ɔla bɛ kɔme anwo ne,
yeɛ mmenia bɔ bɛhyɛ bɛ so nemɔ b’abopura ne,
abubu nu kyɛ kyẽa bɔ elili Midian so ngonim ne.
5Ofikyɛ mbaboa biala bɔ koɛhonɛniɛ wafa watia ase kum kum ne,
ɔne ataadeɛ biala bɔ bafa bafɔrefɔre mogya ne,
bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ eyein bɛkɔsɔ see.
6Ofikyɛ bawo akwadaa bama yɛ,
bama yɛ baa bienzua,
ye yeɛ ahennie ne kowura ye sa ɔ,
na ye dumaa ne, bɛkɔfrɛ ye kyɛ,
“Foɛtulɛniɛ Nwanwaniɛ, Nyameɛ Tuminiɛ,
Seɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ Afebɔɔ, Asomdwee Hene.”
7 Ye ahennie, yeɛ ye asomdwee kɔhɔ so kɔtrɛ
bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ;
ɔkɔtena Dawide ahennie bia ne aso, okoli ye ahennie ne aso,
na ɔkɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne tenenee
koli bia ne maa okotindim kogyina,
ofi kekesaala ye maa okoodwu afebɔɔ.
Asafo AWURADE ye nungunɛhwenɛ sonongo ne yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɛhe ɔ.
AWURADE afɛ Yisrael so yaa
8AWURADE ato Yakob ngraa,
na ndɛenbualɛ ne awa Yisrael so.
9Na maen ne anu ama mukoraa,
bɔ bɛ ole Efraim ne Samariafoɛ ne, bekonwu ye,
bɛ yeɛ bɛkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɛmoma bɛ nwo so kyɛ,
10“Mmerekese sua nemɔ adwiri agua,
nakoso yɛkɔfa nyɔboɛ bɔ base ɔ yɛkosi;
babubu akyea nemɔ bagua,
nakoso yɛkɔfa sida yɛkosi bɛ gya nu.”
11Yiti AWURADE kɔma bɛ bɔ bekyi Resin ne bekodwɔso bekotia ye,
na ɔkɔkanyane ye pɔfoɛ mɔ.
12Siriafoɛ kofi eyia afiteleɛ, yeɛ Filistifoɛ kofi eyia atɔleɛ,
na bɛkɔbaye bɛ noa nu bɛkɔme Yisrael.
Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, ye ahone andɔ nzue nu,
na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.
13Nakoso maen ne anza angɔ ye bɔ ɔhwene bɛ so ne berɛ,
yeɛ bambena Asafo AWURADE si atee.
14Yiti AWURADE kɔpɛ Yisrael ye ti ne ye dua,
ye ɛberɛ ne elemmire ɛlɛho komapɛ kofi berɛ.
15Panyi titireniɛ ne, ye ole tire ne,
yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ te nnakannaka ne, ye ole dua ne.
16Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bekyire maen he atee ne, bɛmaa bemini,
na bediedie mmenia bɔ bekyire b’atee ne maa bɛkɔ ewue nu.
17Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE nye ngɔgye bɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ nwo,
yeɛ ongonwu bɛ nyisiaa ne b’akunafoɛ mmrasua anwumvoin;
ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa benzuro Nyameɛ, bɛte bɔnefoɛ,
na ebiala kekã ngwaseasɛm.
Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, AWURADE ahone andɔ nzue nu,
na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.
18Nahorɛ nu, amumuyɛɛ ogye kyɛ see,
ɔyera agurɛ ne mmowue,
ɔyera ɛhɔayeɛ too,
na bɛyɛ nwosina ningɔnn bɛkɔ anwuro.
19Asafo AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne,
wama aseɛ ne ayera,
na mmenia ne ayɛ kyɛ eyein bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ see ɔ,
na ebiala wannwu obiɛngo anwumvoin.
20Befoti aleɛ wɔ famaa so, nakoso ɛhɔen tɛ ku bɛ,
bedidi wɔ bɛ sa bɛen so, nakoso bɛ ko nyi,
na ebiala keka ye bɔbɔ ye sa nwo naen di.
21Manase keka Efraim di, yeɛ Efraim koso keka Manase di,
na bɛ munyɔ bɛko betia Yuda,
Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, wanyakyi bɛ so yaa fɛlɛ,
na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.

Title: YESAYA 10
Content:
1Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ mmeraa tɛɛ ɔ,
ɔne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkyerɛ nhyɛsoɛ mmeraa ɔ,
2kyɛ bɛfa bebua ehiafoɛ ndɛengyea,
kyɛ bɛfa bedi me mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ aminɛ,
bɔ ɔnate so bɛfa akunafoɛ mmrasua bɛkakyi bɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ,
ɔne kyɛ bedi nyisiaa aminɛ ɔ.
3Nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ye wɔ asohwenɛ kyẽa ne
ɔne amaneɛnwunɛ bɔ okofi dedeede kɔwa ne anu ɔ?
Nwa berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔnwati bɛkɔɔpena mmokalɛ ɔ,
nisua yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyakyi ɛmɔ anwonya ne ɔ?
4Ɛmɔkokundukundu berɛ wɔ kukunufoɛ nemɔ anu,
anaakyɛ bekohu ɛmɔ bɛkɔfra bɛ bɔ batotɔ ne.
Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, AWURADE ahone ngɔtɔ nzue nu,
na okodwɔso kotia bɛ.
5 Aa, Asiria, me yaafɛlɛ mbire,
pɔmaa bɔ otira bɛ sa nu ne, ɔte m’ahonehulɛ piri!
6Maen bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ yeɛ masoma ye kyɛ ɔɔhwe bɛ so ɔ,
mahyɛ ye kyɛ ɔɔhwe maen bɔ mafɛ ye so yaa piri paa ne so,
kyɛ ɔɔfẽ ye nningyein ɔfa yɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ,
ná otiatia bɛ so te kyɛ dwaaso nnɛterɛ.
7Nakoso Asiria hene de, nna sɔ yeɛ ɔwɔ ye ti anu ɔ,
nna sɔ yeɛ ɔdwene ɔ,
na mmom, wayɛ ye adwene kyɛ okohũhũ mmenia,
ná wasa wasɛkye maen maen pee.
8Ofikyɛ ɔnwa:
“Me safohene mɔ, aso bɛtte hene hɔ ɔ?
9Bɔ mva nnili Kalno ne, aso nna ye ala yeɛ mva nnili Kakemise ɔ?
Bɔ mva nnili Hamate ne, aso nna ye ala yeɛ mva nnili Apade ɔ?
Bɔ mva nnili Samaria ne, aso nna ye ala yeɛ mva nnili Damasko ɔ?
10Ngonim bɔ mali ye wɔ ahennie mɔ bɔ bɛ wora wura mmosoen nu
bɔ b’amoen mɔ yɛ se tra bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne Samaria ne,
11aso mengɔfa sɔ mengoli Yerusalem ne ye mmosoen,
kyɛbɔ mafa mali Samaria ne ye amoen mɔ ne?”
12Sɛ AWURADE yɔ ye adwuma mukoraa wɔ Sion bokaa so ne Yerusalem yie a, ɔkɔhwe Asiria hene so wɔ ye anwomasoɛ mvamva ne ye dwɛɛ ne anwo. 13Ofikyɛ Asiria hene nwa:
“Me bɔbɔ m’anwoserɛ ne me nworɛ yeɛ mafa mayɔ ɛhe ɔ,
ofikyɛ m’adwene nu pi;
matutu maen maen nemɔ bɛ wɛen magua,
mafẽ bɛ nningyein mafa;
mayɛ kyɛ katakyie
bɔ mapemo bɛ hene mɔ maa batete bagua ase ɔ.
14Me sa ahã maen maen mɔ b’agyapadeɛ mɔ,
kyɛbɔ sona ye sa kã anomaa saen ɔ.
Na kyɛbɔ sona sesa saen nu ngyiremvua bɔ anomaa atu ayakyi ye berɛ ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ masesa aseɛ amukoraa mabɔ so ɔ;
ebiala angora ye ndaa nu bɔ,
wangora ye noa nu bukye,
anaa wangora sũ kyee kyee.”
15Aso odi kyɛ akumaa ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔfa ye bu bakaa ne so anwomasoɛ,
anaakyɛ sralaa ɔmoma ye nwo so kyire sona bɔ ɔfa ye pakye mmakaa ɔ?
Aso mbire kɔhora kɔhyɛ sona bɔ otira ye ne so,
anaa pɔmaa kɔhora kɔpagya ye nwo kyɛ ye de nna bakaa ahɔ ɔ.
16Yiti AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE
ɔkɔte ɛfɔen anwonyerɛ kogua ye koɛhonɛfoɛ pindipindinn nemɔ aso,
na ɔkɔsɔ see wɔ Asiria hene animnyam ne abo
kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ.
17Yisrael kanea ne kɔkakyi see,
ye Krongronniɛ ne kɔkakyi see wuronyiwuronyi;
na okogye kɔyera
ye agurɛ ne ye mmowue nemɔ ɛlɛhomapɛ.
18Ɔkɔsɛkye ye hɔayeɛ nyemene ne ɔne ye aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ,
okohu ɛkra ne anwoɔnaen bɔkɔɔ,
na ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ yarefoɛ bɔ ɛfɔen ala yeɛ ɔfɔ ɔ.
19Ye hɔayeɛ ne anu mmakaa bɔ bɛkɔha ne, ɔkɔyɛ kaaba bie
bɔ akwadaa po ɔkɔhora kɔha kɔhyerɛ ye somaa ɔ.
Yisraelfoɛ kãa bie kosa kɔwa
20Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ ne Yakob awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛngɔfa bɛ nwo bɛngɔto bɔ ɔbole bɛ ne aso ko, na mmom bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔto AWURADE, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne aso nahorɛ nu. 21Bɛ ngaa ne kosa kɔwa, Yakob bosofoɛ ngaa ne, bekosa bɛkɔwa tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ne berɛ. 22 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wɔ maen Yisrael bɛsone pee kyɛ mboanoa anweaa de, nakoso bɛ nu kaaba bie yeɛ bekosa bɛkɔwa ɔ. Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ bɔ ɔbaato bɛ ne wato berɛ, na ɔnate pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ mmorosoɛ so yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ. 23Ofikyɛ AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ kyɛ ɔkɔsɛkye aseɛ amukoraa ne, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔwa nu.
24Yiti AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “O me maen bɔ ɛte Sion ɔ, nnɛsuro Asiria. Ɔkɔfa bakaa kɔbo wɔ, yeɛ ɔkɔfa pɔmaa kɔwa wɔ so kyɛbɔ Misraim yɔle ne. 25Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ɛyaafɛlɛ ne bo kɔpɛ, na m’ahone kohu bɛ so kohũhũ bɛ. 26Asafo AWURADE kofi ye mbire, kyɛbɔ ohuni Midian wɔ Orebo nyɔbotaen ne anwo ne, na ɔkɔma ye pɔmaa ne aso kohyire ɛpo ne aso, kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye Misraim ne. 27Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ne, ye adesoa bɔ ɔfa tole wɔ kɔme anwo ne ɔkɔye kofi berɛ, na ye kɔnnua ne anu kobubu kɔye kofi wɔ kɔme. Na ɔnate nomenome bɔ ɛkɔyɛ ne ati, kɔnnua ne anu kobubu.”
28Wawa Ayate,
waapɛ nu wɔ Migron,
wayakyi ye nningyein wɔ Mikimase.
29Baafa kongonyi ne anu dɔ,
baasikye kɔngɔen wɔ Geba.
Ahunundetelɛ atɔ Rama so,
Sɔɔlo kuro Gibea so ama banwati.
30O Galim awa brasua, sũ serɛserɛ!
O Laisa, tie!
O Anatote, bua ye!
31Mademena anwati,
Gebimfoɛ banwati bɛkwaabɔ bɛ nwo adwaa.
32Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, Asiria koogyina wɔ Nɔbo,
ɔkɔkoakoa twɔleɛ
kohyire Sion awa brasua bokaa ne,
Yerusalem pambaa ne.
33Tie, AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE kɔfa tumi bɔ ɔyɛ suro ɔ kɔpomba bakaa mmaen ne kogua,
okobubu mmakaa ndendenn nemɔ kogua,
na ɔkɔbrɛ bɔ wama ye nwo so ne ase.
34Ɔkɔfa akumaa kobu ɛhɔayeɛ too kogua,
na tumi piri kɔma Lebanon ɛhɔayeɛ nu mmakaa kobubu.

Title: YESAYA 11
Content:
Asomdwee hene ne
1 Bakaa ye nye bie kopukye kofi Yese dosii ne anu,
na mmaen bie kofifi kofi ye ndii nemɔ anu kosu mmaa.
2 AWURADE Sunzum kɔwa ye so,
nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ sunzum,
foɛtulɛ ne tumi sunzum,
nimdeɛ ne AWURADE surolɛ sunzum.
3Ye nye kɔgye AWURADE surolɛ nwo.
Nna bɔ ye nye nwu ye ɔ yeɛ okogyina so kobua ndɛen ɔ,
yeɛ nna bɔ ye so te ɔ so yeɛ okogyina kɔyɛ ye adwene ɔ,
4 na mmom tenenee yeɛ ɔkɔfa kobua anwumvoinfoɛ ndɛen ɔ,
na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa koli anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bɛ dwirɛ kɔma bɛ ɔ.
Ye noa nu dwirɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ mbire kofi aseɛ ɔ,
na ɔkɔfa ye noa nu nwomeɛ kohũhũ bɔnefoɛ.
5 Tenenee kɔyɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔbɔ ye nu ɔ,
yeɛ nahorɛlilɛ kɔyɛ abɔsoɛ kɔbɔ ye yaase.
6 Pataku ne boaen ba bɛkɔtena,
aboa ne abɔngye ba bɛkɔla neka horɛ,
nandwie ba ne gyata ne nandwie bɔ walɔ ɔ bɛkɔla neka horɛ,
na akwadaa ba yeɛ okoli bɛ nyunu ɔ.
7Nandwie beleɛ ne kwabrafo bɛkɔbɔ nu bekodidi,
bɛ mma mɔ kɔla neka horɛ,
na gyata koli ndire kyɛ nandwie ala.
8Akwadaa bɔ otua nyɔfone noa ne, okoli angorɛ wɔ ɛkyenebene bɔen noa,
yeɛ bɔ wapɛ nyɔfone ne wora, ɔkɔfa ye sa kowura ewobire bɔen nu.
9Ebiala ngohũ anaa ongopura ebiala
wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso amukoraa;
ofikyɛ AWURADE nwo nimdeɛ koyi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ,
kyɛbɔ nzue ayi ɛpo nu tɛkyɛ ne.
Bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne kosa kɔwa
10 Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yese ndii ne kogyina berɛ kɔyɛ frangaa kɔma maen ne; maen maen kɔpena ye si atee, na nekaa bɔ ɔte ne kɔyɛ animnyam nekaa.
11Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔtengyɛ ye sa ye pɛen nyɔ so kole ye mmenia bɔ baha ne kofi Asiria, Misraim, Patrose, Yitiopia, Elam, Sinari, Hamate nu, yeɛ mboanoa supɔ mɔ so.
12Ɔkɔfa frangaa kɔpena berɛ kɔma maen maen mɔ,
bɛ bɔ bapɛ b’asue bafi Yisrael ne, ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ babɔ aya bafi Yuda ne, ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa
kofi aseɛ ndweasoɛ nna ne aso.
13Efraim anyeboroborolɛ ne bo kɔpɛ,
Yuda pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ boso komini,
Efraim nye ngɔboro Yuda ko,
yeɛ Yuda ngɔpɔ Efraim ko.
14Na mmom bɛkɔhɔ Filistifoɛ so wɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ,
bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔfẽ eyia afiteleɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ nningyein.
Bekoli Edom ne Moabo so ngonim,
na Amonfoɛ kɔbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bekowura bɛ bo.
15 Misraim ɛpo ne noa bɔ wadidi wahɔ nu ne,
AWURADE kɔwewe ye bɔkɔɔ.
Ɔkɔfa ye mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ ne
kɔnwaha ye sa wɔ asue Yufreti so,
ɔkɔpakyepakye nu maa ɔkɔyɛ asue mmaa mmaa nzoo,
bɔ sona pɛ ye a ye gya bo ngɔloa ɔ.
16Yiti ye mmenia ngaa bɔ baha ne,
atimbire kɔla berɛ kofi Asiria kɔma bɛ,
kyɛbɔ ɔlale berɛ mane Yisrael
mmerɛ bɔ ofili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne.

Title: YESAYA 12
Content:
Ngoalelɛ nwo asennaa dwein
1Sɔ kyẽa ne, ekose kyɛ,
“O AWURADE, meda wɔ ase,
ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛfɛle me so yaa,
nakoso w’ahone tɔle nzue nu,
na ɛkyekyele me wora.
2 Amba, Nyameɛ te me ngoalelɛ,
ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu, na mengosuro,
ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ te m’anwoserɛ ne me dwein,
na wayɛ me ngoalelɛ.”
3Ɛmɔkɔfa anigye yeɛ bɛkɔto nzue bekofi ngoalelɛ abura mɔ nu ɔ. 4Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔkose kyɛ,
“Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma AWURADE,
ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dumaa,
ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ ne dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ nu,
ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure kyɛ ye dumaa ne te piri.
5“Ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein,
ofikyɛ wayɔ anwanwadeɛ nningyein;
ɛ́mɔma bénwu sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so.
6O ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte Sion ɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ese bɛ́to dwein anigye so,
ofikyɛ Yisrael Krongronniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ afia ne, ɔte piri.”

Title: YESAYA 13
Content:
Babilɔn nwo nyekyire
1 Babilɔn nwo nyekyire bɔ Amoso awa Yesaya nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe:
2Ɛ́mɔfa frangaa bɛ́pena bokaa pralaa ti afia,
ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛ́frɛ bɛ,
ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ ba ma beewurawura
atitirefoɛ nemɔ b’anoa nu.
3Me yeɛ mafa ahyɛdeɛ mama me mmenia krongron nemɔ ɔ;
masa mato me sa mafrɛ me koɛhonɛfoɛ,
bɔ bedi me ngonim nwo ahurusi ne,
kyɛ bégyina me yaafɛlɛ ne aso bɛ́yɔ bɔ mepena ɔ.
4Ɛ́mɔtie! Esebɔlɛ bie ɔkɔ so wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso
kyɛ ɛlɔen pirikua bie komvi.
Ɛ́mɔtie! Ɔte ahennie mɔ b’esebɔlɛ piri,
maen maen mɔ bɔ baboaboa bɛ noa ɔ!
Asafo AWURADE ɔ́boaboa ye lɔen noa
maa bɛkɔ koɛ.
5Befi dedeede aseɛ bie aso ne
ewienu noa dɔ paa yeɛ bɛ́ba ɔ,
AWURADE ne ye ahonehulɛ akodeɛ ne,
kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye aseɛ amukoraa.
6 Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye;
kyẽa ne kɔwa, bɔ Tuminiɛ ne kɔfa kohũhũ mmenia ɔ!
7Yiti asaa mukoraa nu kohodwo,
ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ sona biala so,
8na bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ.
Yealɛ ne aworabɔlɛ kotira bɛ,
na bɛkɔte yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ.
Ebiala kɔfa anwodwiri kɔnea obiɛngo nyunu,
na bɛ nyunu kɔyɛ bosabosaa.
9Tie, AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba,
ɔ́ba ye atianuserɛ ne ahonehulɛ ne anyeborolɛ so,
kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye aseɛ ye bɔkɔɔ,
ná okũkũ so bɔnefoɛ fi so.
10 Ofikyɛ ewienu nzramaa ne nzramaa kure kure mɔ bɛngɔta,
eyia pukye a, ɔkɔyɛ tunn,
yeɛ ɛsraen koso ngɔta.
11Mebaahwe ewiase so wɔ ye bɔne nwo,
ngɔhwe bɔnefoɛ so wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo,
ngɔpɛ ahandaenfoɛ b’anwomasoɛ ne aso,
yeɛ ngɔbrɛ atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ nduhoɛ ne ase.
12Ngɔma adasa mmaa bɛ nwo kɔyɛ se kɔtra kyɛbɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ paa ye nyanɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ,
yeɛ kuro mmenia wora, bɛ nwo kɔyɛ se kɔtra kyɛbɔ Ofire sikaa kɔkorɛ ye nyanɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ.
13Yiti ngɔwoso anwuro,
aseɛ kopusu kofi ye boso,
wɔ Asafo AWURADE ahonehulɛ ne anu,
ɔne ye ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kyẽa ne.
14Sona biala kɔhɔ ye nwo ama berɛ,
bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ bɛ maen nu,
na bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ɛwanzane bɔ bɛfoa ye ɔ,
anaa mmoaen bɔ babɔ aya ɔ.
15Ebiala bɔ bekonwu ye ne, bɛkɔwɔ ye dadeɛ,
yeɛ bɔ bɛkɔhye ye ne koso, ɔkɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa.
16Bɛkɔtete bɛ mma mmaa mmaa mɔ nu pasapasa
bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ.
Bɛkɔfẽ b’awuro nningyein,
na bɛkɔhyɛ bɛ ye mɔ bɛkɔto bɛ mmɔnaa.
17Tie, ngɔkanyane Medesefoɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia bɛ,
Medesefoɛ de, bemmu dwetɛ,
yeɛ bɛ nye ngye sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo.
18B’agyaen kohũhũ mmerandeɛ nemɔ,
bengonwu nnɔma mɔ anwumvoin,
yeɛ ngwadaa koso ngɔyɛ bɛ anwumvo.
19 Na Babilɔn bɔ ɔte ahennie mɔ nu animnyam ne,
Kaldeafoɛ b’anwohoahoa piri ne,
ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Sodom ne Gomora
bɔ Nyameɛ huhuni bɛ ne.
20Sona biala ngɔtena nu le,
yeɛ ebiala ngɔtena nu wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mukoraa nu.
Arabofoɛ tutenafoɛ ne, bɛ nu biala ngosi ɛtena sua wɔ berɛ,
yeɛ mmoaenneafoɛ biala ngɔma ye mmoaen ngɔla berɛ.
21 Ɛserɛ so ngaka aboyaa yeɛ bɛkɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ dabea ɔ,
patue mɔ koyi bɛ sua nemɔ anu tɛkyɛ,
soholi mɔ kɔfa berɛ kɔyɛ b’awuro,
na berɛ yeɛ eburo mbɔngye kogo abilie ɔ.
22Kangane mɔ kopo wɔ ye abandenden nemɔ anu,
ɛserɛ so ngyea kopo wɔ ye ahemvie nyemenenyemene nemɔ anu.
Ye mmerɛ ne apingye,
na ɔngɔhyɛ biala né wato ye.

Title: YESAYA 14
Content:
Yuda kofi nnurehyelɛ nu kosa kɔwa
1Amba, AWURADE konwu Yakob anwumvoin. Okosa kɔneanea nu kɔye Yisrael, na ɔkɔfa bɛ koolua bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so. Na amanvrafoɛ kɔɔboka bɛ so bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔbɔ Yakob boso ama. 2Maen maen mɔ kɔfa Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔwa Yisraelfoɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so, na Yisrael awuro ama kɔfa maen maen nemɔ kɔyɛ nganga ne afaneɛ mɔ wɔ AWURADE aseɛ ne aso. Na mmenia bɔ bɛhyele Yisrael nnure ne, Yisrael koso kɔhye bɛ nnure, na bekoli sɔ mmenia bɔ bɛhyɛle bɛ so ne aso.
Babilɔn hene ayieleɛ
3Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, kyẽa bɔ AWURADE kɔye wɔ kofi wɔ yealɛ, amaneɛ ne kanga adwuma bɔ bɛhyɛle wɔ maa ɛyɔle ne anu ne, 4kã ngorohoɛ dwirɛ he fa Babilɔn hene nwo:
“Anyandimlilɛniɛ ne, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ye ayieleɛ ayie ye ɔ!
Ye ahandaen ne, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ye bo apɛ ɔ!
5AWURADE abubu bɔnefoɛ pɔmaa ne anu,
wabubu maenbulɛfoɛ b’ɛhɔtɔ nemɔ anu.
6Ye bɔ ye ahone hu a ɔnyakyi mmenia hunɛ ne,
bɔ ɔfale ɛyaafɛlɛ lili maen maen mɔ so ne,
bɔ ɔmaa bɛhɔle anwokyere ndoatoasoɛ nu ne.
7Aseɛ amukoraa so adwo, asomdwee awa,
bɛto dwein anigye so.
8Bɔ wato wɔ ne, ɔyɛ ɛframmire mɔ fɛ,
ɔne Lebanon sida mɔ koso fɛ, na bɛkã kyɛ,
‘Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛbrɛle wɔ ase ɔ,
sona biala ɔmma kyɛ ɔbaabu yɛ gua.’
9Ɛborɔ bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ne, waboaboa ye nwo
kyɛ ɛba a ɔbaayia wɔ.
Wakanyane awufoɛ
bɔ né mmerɛ bie bɛte aseɛ so mbanyi amukoraa.
Wama bɛ bɔ né bɛte maen maen ahemvo amukoraa
badwɔso bafi b’ahennie bia so kyɛ bɛɛyɛ wɔ akwaaba.
10Na bɛ mukoraa bekobukye bɛ noa bekose wɔ kyɛ,
‘Eh, wɔ koso ayɛ mmerɛ kyɛ yɛ ala!
Ɛne yɛ yayɛ pɛ!’
11W’anwomasoɛ ne, ye bo aapɛ wɔ ɛborɔ,
w’adengum bɔ bɛbɔ ne koso sɔ ala;
bɛen bɔ ɛla so ne te nnɔboakoma,
na esuronyi yeɛ bafa bagurɔ wɔ nwo ɔ.
12 “O, Alehyeleɛ Nzramaa, Alebahyene ɔwa,
ɛtetɔlɛ yeɛ efi nyameɛso ate atɔ ase sɔaa e!
Wɔ bɔ elili maen maen mɔ so ngonim ne,
aseɛnwo yeɛ bafindi wɔ bato sɔaa ye!
13 Ɛhane ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ,
‘Ngɔfo ngɔhɔ nyameɛso,
ngɔfa m’ahennie bia ngoosie anwuro anwuro
maa ɔkɔtra Nyameɛ nzramaa mɔ.
Bokaa ne aso nyianu ne, ngɔɔtena nu
wɔ sorɔ dɔ paa aseɛ ne aso.
14Ngɔfo ngɔhɔ munungum nemɔ ti afia dɔ,
na ngɔyɛ kyɛ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne.’
15Nakoso bagyi wɔ bato ɛborɔ,
ɛborɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne abo paa.
16Bɛ bɔ benwu wɔ ne, bɛkɔnea wɔ haa,
na bɛkɔdwene bɔ wato wɔ ne anwo bɛkɔhã kyɛ,
‘Eh, biaa bɔ ɔmane aseɛ wosole
ná opusuli ahennie mɔ ne, aso ye ɛhe anaa?
17Ye bɔ ɔkakyili ewiase kyɛ ɛserɛ so,
bɔ ɔbɔle nu nguro mɔ pasaa,
bɔ wanyakyi nu kukunufoɛ ate ma bangɔ b’awuro ne, aso ye ɛhe anaa?’
18Maen maen ahemvo amukoraa balela wɔ animnyam nu,
ebiala la ye asieleɛ nu;
19nakoso wɔ de, bafindi wɔ bato bafi w’asieleɛ nu
kyɛ bakaa mmaen bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ,
kyɛ bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nyɔboɛ nu,
kyɛ efuin bɔ batiatia ye so ɔ.
20Bengosie wɔ ne bɛ ngɔbɔ nu,
ofikyɛ asɛkye w’aseɛ,
yeɛ ahũhũ wɔ mmenia.
“Bɔnefoɛ bɛ bosofoɛ de,
bɛngɔbɔ bɛ dumaa paa ko le!
21Ɔnate bɛ se mɔ amumuyɛɛ ti,
ɛ́mɔsiesie akumyɛɛ bɔ bekohu ye mma wɔ berɛ ɔ;
amaa ɔnate so bandwɔso bamva aseɛ ne banni so tumi
ná bangyekye nguro wɔ ewiase nekaa biala.”
22Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ngodwɔso ngotia bɛ, na ngonunu ɛhemɔ bɛ boso ngofi Babilɔn: dumaa, bɛ bɔ baha ne, mmaa, yeɛ bɛ boso ama. AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 23Ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ mbɛsɛ mɔ b’agyapadeɛ, na ɛkwaa kɔtaataa so, na ngɔfa ɛsɛkyelɛ saen ngɔsɛkye ye ngɔpra ye boso, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”
Asiria nwo ngɔm
24 Asafo AWURADE ata ndaen kyɛ,
“Kyɛbɔ masusu ye nwo ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ okosi ɔ,
kyɛbɔ mayɛ m’adwene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ:
25kyɛ ngɔsɛkye Asiria pasaa wɔ m’aseɛ so,
yeɛ ngotiatia ye so wɔ me mmokaa nemɔ aso,
ye kɔnnua ne kɔye kofi bɛ kɔme anu,
na ye adesoa bɔ ɔla bɛ bati ne kɔye kofi berɛ.”
26Nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ fa
aseɛ amukoraa nwo ɛne;
na ɛhe te asaa bɔ watengyɛ ye
wɔ maen maen mukoraa so ɔ.
27Asafo AWURADE ayɛ ye adwene,
na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔbɔ kogua ɔ?
Watengyɛ ye sa nu,
na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhwe ye sa ne kosa nziɛ ɔ?
Filistia nwo ngɔm
28 Afoɛ bɔ Nana Ahase wuli ne, nu ala yeɛ sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛ he wale ɔ:
29 Filistia amukoraa, nnɛdi ahurusi,
kyɛ mbire bɔ ofini wɔ ne, nu abubu ɔ,
ofikyɛ ewoo ne, ye ndii nu yeɛ ɛkyenebene kofi kɔwa ɔ,
na ɔwa ne kɔyɛ see ewoo bɔ otu ɔ.
30Ehiafoɛ bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ konya aleɛ koli,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne wora, bɛkɔla berɛ asomdwee nu,
nakoso wɔ de, ngɔfa ɛhɔen ngonua wɔ mma bɛ boso,
yeɛ ngohũhũ wɔ boso ama koso.
31O pambim, bɔ awuye; kuro piri, sũ serɛserɛ,
O Filistia amukoraa, ma wɔ kunu tete wɔ!
Ofikyɛ nwosina fi sorɔ dɔ ótu ba,
na ye lɔen ne, ebiala ngɔte ye nwo ngɔha nziɛ.
32Ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ befi sɔ maen ne aso ne,
nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma bɛ ɔ?
Yɛkobua kyɛ, ‘AWURADE akyekye Sion,
na ye maen ne anu mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne,
bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nwo adwaa wɔ nu.’

Title: YESAYA 15
Content:
Moabo nwo nyekyire
1 Moabo nwo nyekyire.
Kɔngɔen komapɛ yeɛ bɛsɛkyele Are kuro ne ɔ,
yiti Moabo abɔ ayɛ kurofoen;
Kɔngɔen komapɛ yeɛ bɛsɛkyele Kire kuro ne ɔ,
yiti Moabo abɔ ayɛ kurofoen.
2Dibɔn awa brasua ne afo ahɔ
asɔneyɛɛ sua nemɔ anu kyɛ ɔkwaasu,
Moabo bɔ awuye wɔ Nebo ne Medeba,
bɛ mukoraa babɔ tikwa,
ebiala apoa ye kanza;
3baherahera ɛsɛen tena wɔ bɛ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso,
ebiala ɔbɔ awuye osũ hahii
wɔ bɛ sua nemɔ ti afia ne dwaaso.
4Hesebon ne Eleale besu serɛserɛ,
bɛte bɛ suɛ alaa kodwu Yahase,
yiti Moabo koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛteatea nu,
na ye nwo ngaka anwati.
5Medi Moabo nwo aworabɔlɛ,
ye mmenia bɔ bɛnwati ne, banwati baadwu Soa,
baadwu Eglate Selisiya.
Ofikyɛ Luhite pambaa ne,
bele esuɛ yeɛ bɛfo ɔ;
na atee bɔ ɔkɔ Horonaim ne,
awuye yeɛ bɛbɔ bɛfa so ɔ.
6Nimrim asue nemɔ babɔ mvuture,
ɛserɛ ne akese, ndire nemɔ ayera,
na ndire monɛ nne berɛ ko.
7Yiti anwonya bɔ banya ye,
ɔne nningyein bɔ baboaboa ye noa basie ne,
bɛsoa bɛfa bɛpɛ asuenoa mmakaa bɔnza ne.
8Ofikyɛ esuɛ ne adwu
Moabo aseɛ so amukoraa,
ye awuyebɔlɛ ne adwu Eglaim,
awuyebɔlɛ ne adwu Beɛ Elim.
9Ofikyɛ Dimon nzue amukoraa akakyi mogya,
na ngɔma bɔ ɔtra so ɔ kɔto Dimon:
gyata kɔhye Moabofoɛ bɔ bɛkɔnwati ne,
ɔkɔhye bɛ bɔ bɛkɔha aseɛ ne aso ne.

Title: YESAYA 16
Content:
1Ɛ́mɔfa mmoaen mmaa
bɛɛma aseɛ ne aso hene,
ɛ́mɔfa bɛ béfi Sela bɛɛfa ɛserɛ atee ne aso
bɛhɔ Sion awa brasua bokaa ne aso.
2Kyɛbɔ nnomaa mmaa bɔ bafoa bɛ bafi bɛ saen nu
bɔ bekyinikyini ne bɛte ne,
sɔ yeɛ Moabo mma mmrasua nemɔ
bɛkɔyɛ wɔ Anɔn apɛleɛ ɔ.
3“Ɛ́mɔtu yɛ foɛ,
ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo,
na eyia ketee po,
ma wɔ waenbɔlɛ fɔnwoo ne anu ɔyɛ kyɛ kɔngɔen;
fa bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue nemɔ fea,
mmenia bɔ bɛnwati ne, nnɛye bɛ ma.
4Mmenia bɔ bafoa bɛ bafi Moabo ne,
maa beesikye wɔ berɛ,
bɔ bɛ nwo waen fi
bɔ ɔpena bɛ ku bɛ ne sa nu.”
Sɛ nhyɛsoɛniɛ nne berɛ,
ná mmenia hunɛ bo apɛ,
ná apaabɔlɛfoɛ betu bemini befi aseɛ ne aso a,
5yeɛ bɛkɔfa ahennie bia ne bekotimu berɛ wɔ ɔdɔ nu ɔ,
na ɔkɔtena so nahorɛlilɛ nu wɔ Dawide ɛtena sua nu,
ɔte ebie bɔ ɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ obu maen ɔ,
na okobua ndɛen turoloo ndɛndɛ.
6Moabo anwomasoɛ ne, yate ye nga,
ɔte anwomasoɛ paa,
ye ahandaen, ye anwomasoɛ ne ye ahonehulɛ ne:
ɔbobɔ ye noa nu mbaen.
7Yiti ma Moabo osũ Moabo,
ma ebiala osũ,
Kire Haresete bobe mmaa taterɛ ne ati,
ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye paa.
8Ofikyɛ Hesebon eboo nemɔ asɛkye,
Sibima bobe nemɔ koso sɔ ala.
Maen maen mbanyi mɔ bapomba
bɛ mmaen nemɔ bagua.
Mmaen nemɔ bɛtrɛ bekodwu Yasere,
na bɛkondokondo alaa bɛkɔ ɛserɛ so.
Ye mmaen ne, bɛtrɛ bɛkɔ dedeede,
na bɛpɛ ɛpo bɛkɔ ye si.
9Yiti Yasere esuɛ bɔ osũ ne,
ebie yeɛ mefa mesũ Sibima bobe ne ɔ.
Meporo me nye moen megua wɔ so,
O Hesebon ne Eleale,
ofikyɛ ese bɔ wɔ mmakaammaa telɛ dwu a bɛbɔ,
ɔne bɔ bebu w’aburoo a bɛbɔ ne,
ye bo apɛ.
10Baye anika ne anigye
bafi eboo bɔ aleɛ wɔ nu ne anu,
yeɛ bobe boo nemɔ anu koso,
bɛndo anigye dwein wɔ nu ko,
bɛmmɔ ese wɔ nu ko,
kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ne, bendwi nzaa berɛ ko,
mmakaammaa telɛ nwo esebɔlɛ ne, mama ye bo apɛ.
11Yiti me kra di Moabo nwo aworabɔlɛ kyɛ aworabɔlɛ dwein bɔ bɛto bɛfa ye nwo ɔ,
yeɛ me kunu tete me ma Kire Herese.
12Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ Moabo kɔ asɔneyɛɛ so kɔsɔne ɔfɛ ye nwo, ná ɔkɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔkɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, ongosi huu.
13Daa ne, edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE hã fale Moabo nwo ɛne. 14Nakoso kekesaala ye de, AWURADE nwa, “Kyɛ odwu afoɛ nza, kyɛbɔ paaniɛ osi ka ye afoɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne, Moabo animnyam nyunu kogua ase. Ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ ye lɔen ne sone pee ɔ; na bɛ bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, bɛkɔyɛ kaaba bie bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se ɔ.”

Title: YESAYA 17
Content:
Damasko nwo nyekyire
1 Damasko nwo nyekyire.
Tie, Damasko ngɔyɛ kuro ko,
ɔkɔkakyi esire.
2Aroye nguro nemɔ kɔkakyi kurofoen,
bɛkɔyɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ deɛ,
na bɛkɔlela berɛ bɔ ebiala ngɔma bengosuro ɔ.
3Bɛkɔsɛkye Efraim abandenden ne,
bɛkɔbɔ Damasko ahennie ne tɔɔ,
na Siriafoɛ bɔ bɛkɔha ne,
b’animnyam kɔhɔ ase kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ deɛ ne ala,
Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
4Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne,
Yakob animnyam kɔhɔ ase,
na ye nwo naen bɔ walɔ ɛloe ne, ɔkɔfɔ.
5Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ aburoo bɔ ogyi berɛ bɔ kuaniɛ
ɔfa ye sa pomba ye aleɛ ne ɔ,
ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ɛmo bɔ kuaniɛ ɔte ye si ne wɔ
Refaim bɔnza nu ɔ.
6Nakoso ɛte bobe a ebie ka nu,
kyɛbɔ bɛwoso olive bakaa a ebie ka so ne,
mmaa nyɔ anaa nza
ka bakaa mmaen frɔmfrɔm ne aso anwuro,
bɔ nna anaa nnu ka ye mmaen bɔ wasu dɔsɔɔ ne aso ɔ,
AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
