2Sɔ mmerɛ ne, me Daniel, né medi aworabɔlɛ dapɛn nza. 3Manni aleɛ fɛɛ biala, naen anaa nzaa biala anga me noa, yeɛ mambopa toonn dapɛn nza mumua. 4Na bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye eleburanyɔ ɛlɛnna ne aso, né ngyi asue piri Tigrise noa. 5 Ndole me nye anwuro nneane, na nwuni biaa bie bɔ ɔhera nwera bɔ wafa Yufase sikaa kɔkorɛ wayɛ abɔsoɛ ɔ. 6Ye sonaluwaa ne, ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye bɛrile, ye nyunu te kyɛ agralaa, ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi ɔ, ye sa ne ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo ɔ, na odwudwo a ye komvi te kyɛ ɛlɔen komvi. 7Me, Daniel, me ngome yeɛ nwuni nyekyire ne ɔ; ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ né bɛboka me so ne, bannwu nyekyire ne bie, nakoso ɛserɛ kandinga hane bɛ, na bɛnwatili bɛɛfeale. 8Yiti ɔhale me ngome twe wɔ berɛ bɔ né menea nyekyire ne ɔ. Me nwo ngaka tu minini, mmɔle fuin bɔkɔɔ, na me nwo yɛle me hodwoo. 9Afei ndele ye komvi, na ndele ye komvi nen, nde ndɔle berɛ nnafele hatee bɔ né me nyunu butu berɛ ɔ.
10Na yieee, asaa bie sɔle me nu, na ɛhe maa ngongone me sa ne me nangoroma so. 11Na osele me kyɛ, “O Daniel, bɔ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ paa ɔ, tie edwirɛ bɔ mekã mekyire wɔ ye, ná dwɔso gyina berɛ, ofikyɛ basoma me wɔ berɛ.” Na ye noa wɔ so bɔ ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ ne kyire me nen, ndwɔso ngyinane berɛ bɔ né me nwo wosowoso me ɔ.
12Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Daniel, nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ ofi kyẽa bɔ ɛyɛle w’adwene kyɛ ɛkɔte ye bo, ná ɛbrɛle wɔ nwo ase wɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu nen, wate wɔ sufrɛ ne, na wɔ sufrɛ ne ati yeɛ mawa ɔ. 13 Nakoso Pɛsia ahennie nu katakyie ne, osili me ate eleburanyɔ ɛlɛho; yeɛ Mikayɛl bɔ ɔte abɔfo titire nemɔ anu ko ne, ɔɔbokale me, na nyakyili ye wɔ Pɛsia ahennie nu katakyie ne nwo berɛ. 14Na bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ maen ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu ne, mawa kyɛ mebaamaa ɛte ye bo. Ofikyɛ sɔ nyekyire he, ɔfa mmerɛ bie bɔ ɔbaawa ɔ nwo.”
15Na ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele me nen, mvale me nyunu mutuli berɛ, na ndɔle mumu. 16Na yieee, ebie bɔ ɔte kyɛ mmenia mmaa sɛso ɔ ɔfale ye sa hane me noa, na mmukyele me noa ndwudwole. Na nzele bɔ ogyi me nyunu berɛ ne kyɛ, “O me mene, nyekyire ne ama me nwo ngaka atu amini, na mabɔ fuin. 17Me mene, wɔ somvoɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né me ne me mene yahora yadwudwo? Ofikyɛ afei de, me nwo ngaka atu amini, na me nwomeɛ ayie.”
18Na ebie bɔ ye sɛso te kyɛ kuro sona ɔ ɔfale ye sa hane me, na ɔmane me nwo yɛle me se. 19Na osele me kyɛ, “O, wɔ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ paa ɔ, nnɛsuro, asomdwee hã wɔ, gyina pindinn, ná ma w’ahone yɛ se.” Na odwudwo hyirele me nen, me nwo yɛle me se, na ngane kyɛ, “Me mene, dwudwo, ofikyɛ ama me nwo ayɛ me se.” 20Yeɛ obisale kyɛ, “Aso ɛse nikyee bɔ yiti yeɛ mawa wɔ berɛ ye? Afei de, ngosa ngɔhɔ me ne Pɛsia katakyie ne yɛkɔɔho, na sɛ mesi nu mekɔ a, tie, Hela katakyie ne kɔwa. 21Nakoso ngɔla bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nahorɛ nwomaa ne anu ali ngohyire wɔ: ebiala ngo bie mmoka me so ndia ɛhemɔ, sana Mikayɛl, ɛmɔ katakyie ne ngome.

Title: DANIEL 11
Content:
1Na me de, Medeseniɛ Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu, ngyinane ye si kyɛ memaa otindim.
2“Afei, ngohyire wɔ nahorɛ ne: Tie, ahemvo nza bieku kodwɔso wɔ Pɛsia, na bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne, okonya ye nwo kɔtra bɛ mukoraa. Na sɛ ɔnate ye anwonya ne ati onya anwoserɛ a, okosi ebiala adua maa okodwɔso kotia Hela ahennie maen ne. 3Afei ɛhene katakyie bie kodwɔso, ɔkɔfa tumi piri koli hene, na bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ. 4Na sɛ onya nyinasoɛ yie a, afei ye ahennie ne kɔbɔ, na nu kɔhyehyɛ kɔhɔ nyameɛso mvrama nna nemɔ anu; nakoso ongooli ye bosofoɛ mɔ sa, yeɛ tumi bɔ bɛkɔfa bekoli hene ne ɔngɔyɛ kyɛ ye deɛ ne; ofikyɛ ye ahennie ne kogyigya, na okooli ebiemɔ mbaen bɛ sa nu.
5“Na ngwaen dɔ hene ne konya tumi, nakoso ye safohene nemɔ anu ko konya tumi kɔtra ye, na ye tumi ne kɔyɛ tumi piri. 6Na afoɛ biemɔ asi ne, bɛkɔyɛ apam, na ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ɔwa brasua kɔwa sorɔ dɔ hene ne berɛ kyɛ ɔne ye bɛbaayɛ asomdwee apam; nakoso braa ne, ye tumi ne ngoli gyina, yeɛ biaa ne ne ye tumi koso ngoli gyina. Bɛkɔye braa ne bɛkɔma, ɔne sona bɔ ɔwole ye ɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔhyɛle ye nguraen wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ne.
7“Nakoso braa ne boso ndii ne bie ye nye kofifi kosi ye gya nu, na ɔkɔfa ɛlɔen kɔwa, ɔkɔhɔ sorɔ dɔ hene n’ahemvie, ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔteta bɛ, na okoli bɛ so ngonim. 8Okosa kɔsesa bɛ mmosoen, b’amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ɔ, b’ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ kɔhɔ Misraim. Na afei afoɛ pee kɔpɛ nu bɔ ɔngɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa sorɔ dɔ hene ne ɔ. 9Yiti ɔkɔhɔ ngwaen dɔ hene n’ahennie ne anu, na afei okosa kɔhɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.
10“Ye mma mɔ bekodwɔso kyɛ bɛkɔ koɛ, bɛkɔboaboa ɛlɔen kandinga yuu noa. Bɛ nu ko kɔwa wii kyɛ asue bɔ wayi ɔ, na okosa kɔho koɛ ne alaa koodwu ye ahemvie. 11Ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ole ɛyaa kɔwa, na ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta sorɔ dɔ hene ne. Na ɛhe kɔma sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔboaboa ɛlɔen kandinga noa, nakoso okoli ngoguo wɔ ye nyunu. 12Na sɛ ɔkye ɛlɔen ne nnure ɔfa bɛ kɔ a, anwomasoɛ kɔwa ye nu, na okohũhũ mmenia apee buru pee, nakoso ongoli ngonim ngɔhyɛ. 13Ofikyɛ sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔboaboa ɛlɔen pee noa bɔ ye somaa tra daa deɛ ne ɔ, na okosa kɔwa; na afoɛ biemɔ asi ne, ɔkɔfa ɛlɔen kandinga ne koɛhonɛ nningyein pee kɔwa.
14“Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, mmeni pee kodwɔso kotia ngwaen dɔ hene ne, na wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ maen ne anu patapaafoɛ nemɔ, bɛkɔmoma bɛ nwo so kyɛ bɛma nyekyire ne ɔba nu, nakoso bekoli ngoguo. 15Afei, sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔwa, ɔkɔkyekye nyinasoɛ bɔ begyina so bɛfo fasue ɔ, na okoli nguro mɔ bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ so ngonim. Ngwaen dɔ lɔen nemɔ ngɔhora ye noa gyina, koɛhonɛfoɛ paa paa nemɔ po bengonya anwoserɛ bengogyina ye noa. 16Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔtoa ye nen, bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ, ebiala ngɔhora ye nyunu gyina, okoogyina aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne aso, na ɔkɔfa ye tumi kɔsɛkye aseɛ ne. 17Ɔkɔfa kosie ye nye so kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye ahennie ne amukoraa nu tumi kɔwa; na ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ kɔwa, ɔkɔma ye brasua maa okogya, amaa ɔnate so wanya atee wabɔ ahennie maen ne; nakoso apam ne ngogyina, yeɛ so ngɔwa mvasoɛ ngɔma ye. 18Ye si ye, ɔkɔfa ye nye kohyire nzuenoa maen nemɔ, na okoli bɛ nu pee so ngonim; nakoso safohene bie kɔbrɛ ye ahandaen ne ase, na ɔkɔma ye ahandaen ne kɔsa ye noa nu. 19Afei ɔkɔkakyi ye nye kohyire ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne, nakoso okosoti kofi ase, na bengonwu ye ko.
20“Na ebie kodwɔso kosi ye gya nu bɔ ɔkɔsoma ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ bie maa ɔkɔfa ɛtoɔ kɔtaataa ahennie n’animnyam, nakoso mmerɛ kãa bie asi ne, bekohu ye bɔ ɔngɔyɛ ɛyaa so anaa koɛ nu ɔ.”
Siria hene busueniɛ ne
21“Busueniɛ bie kodwɔso kosi ye gya nu, bɔ ɔte sona bɔ bamva ahennie animnyam bia ne bamma ye ɔ. Okofu bɛ nu kɔwa, na ɔnate ye noa dwirɛ menemene so okole ahennie ne. 22Ɔkɔprapra ye pɔfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ, okohũhũ bɛ ne apam ne anu sona titire ne. 23Na sɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ ne ye bɛyɛ apam beyie a, ɔkɔfa nnakannaka atee so; na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mmenia kãa bie yeɛ bekoli ye si ɔ de, nakoso okonya tumi. 24Mvum nu, ɔkɔwa aseɛ ne aso nekaa mɔ bɔ aseɛ ne kye aleɛ ɔ, na ɔkɔyɔ bɔ ye baba mɔ ne ye nana mɔ banyɔ ye le ɔ. Ɔkɔhyɛ koɛ nu nningyein, koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne anwodeɛ kɔma ye mmenia. Ɔkɔbɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nwo porɛ, nakoso ɛhe kɔhɔ so mmerɛ kãa bie. 25Na ɔkɔfa koɛhonɛfoɛ pee kɔkanyane ye tumi ne ye ahoneserɛ kotia ngwaen dɔ hene ne. Ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ɔkɔfa koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ pee kɔhɔ koɛ, nakoso ɔngɔhora gyina, ofikyɛ bɛkɔbɔ ye ti so porɛ. 26Bɛ bɔ ye yeɛ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ne po, bɛkɔpena ye asefinɛ, bekopia ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ boso bɛkɔhɔ, na bekohũhũ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ pee. 27Nakoso ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ de, nzɛmmɔne yeɛ ɔkɔwa bɛ ti anu ɔ, na bɛkɔtena didipono ko anwo bɛkɔhã ngondombo dwirɛ; nakoso bɛ porɛbɔlɛ ne kɔyɛ mbaen, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne dwu a, yeɛ b’ayieleɛ kɔwa ɔ. 28Ɔkɔfa nningyein bɔ wasesa ɔ pee kosa kɔhɔ ye aseɛ so, na okotu ye nye kosie apam krongron ne aso, bɔ okuro yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ, ná afei okosa kɔhɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.
29“Na mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne dwu a, okosa kɔwa ngwaen dɔ, nakoso sɔ mmerɛ he de, ɔngɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye daa ne. 30Ofikyɛ Kitim ɛlɛen mɔ kɔho kotia ye, na ye abasa nu kobu maa okosa ye si. Osa ye si a, ɔkɔfa ye anyeborolɛ kogua apam krongron ne aso. Osa ye si a, ɔne mmenia bɔ bayakyi apam krongron ne aso lilɛ ne bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔyɛ ko. 31 Ɔkɔma ye koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔfa efiɛ bɛkɔhã nekaa krongron ne, bɔ ɔte anwoserɛ ne; bɛkɔbera daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, na bekogyina akyiwadeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ maen ne. 32Na bɛ bɔ bebu apam ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa ye noa dwirɛ menemene kɔhwehwe bɛ kɔsɛkye b’adwene; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛse bɛ Nyameɛ ne de, bekosi bɛ hue bɛkɔho bekotia sɔ nikyee ne. 33Na maen ne anu mmenia bɔ b’adwene nu pi ne, bekohyirehyire nu bekohyire mmeni pee maa bɛkɔte ye bo; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa de, bɛkɔyera bɛ, bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure, yeɛ bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nningyein apaa mmerɛ kãa. 34Na sɛ bɛtotɔ a, mmokalɛ kãa bie yeɛ bekonya ɔ, na mmeni pee bɔ bɛ noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ bɛkɔɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔbɔ bɛ. 35Bɛ bɔ bɛte badwemma ne, nu biemɔ kɔtotɔ, maa ɔnate so bɛkɔfa bekosale bɛ nwo, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔte bɛ nwo, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma bɛ nwo kɔyɛ fitaa koodwu ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne; ofikyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne kɔwa kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne ala.
36 “Ɛhene ne kɔyɔ bɔ okuro ɔ; ɔkɔmoma ye nwo so kɔyɛ ye nwo konguronn kohyire kyɛ ɔtra nyameɛ biala, na ɔkɔhã edwirɛ nwanwa kotia nyameɛ mɔ nu Nyameɛ ne, na okonya ngɔsoɛ koodwu kyɛ ahonehulɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ, ofikyɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne, ɔkɔwa nu. 37Ɔngɔfa ye nana mɔ nyameɛ nemɔ ngɔyɛ huu, ongobu bɔ mmrasua kuro ye dwirɛ ne, yeɛ ɔngɔfa nyameɛ foforɛ biala ngɔyɛ huu, ofikyɛ ɔkɔmoma ye nwo so kɔtra bɛ mukoraa. 38Ɔkɔfa anidie kɔma nyameɛ bie bɔ ɔbɔ nguro mɔ nwo waen ɔ mmom okosi bɛ gya nu. Na nyameɛ bie bɔ ye nana mɔ bɛnze ye ne, ɔkɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ, nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ, ɔne mbembenanneɛ yeɛ okoli ye ni ɔ. 39Sɛ ɔkwaateta kuro bɔ ye nwo yɛ se a, maen bie aso nyameɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa ye wora kowura ye nu ɔ; na bɛ bɔ bekole ye bɛkɔto nu ne, ɔkɔfa anidie kɔhyɛ bɛ animnyam. Ɔkɔmaa bekoli mmeni pee so tumi, na ɔkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne anu kɔma bɛ maa ɔkɔyɛ b’akatuaa.
40“Na ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ngwaen dɔ hene ne kɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta ye. Nakoso sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔfa teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ ne ɛlɛen pee kɔhɔ ye so kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, na ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔteta maen maen pee kohwi kɔfa bɛ so kyɛ asue bɔ wayi ɔ. 41Ɔkɔwa aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne aso, na mmenia pee kɔtotɔ, nakoso ɛhemɔ de, bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu bekofi ye sa nu: Edom, Moabo ne Amonfoɛ atitirefoɛ nemɔ. 42Ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta maen maen mɔ, na Misraim aseɛ ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli. 43Ɔkɔsesa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ mbembenanneɛ ne Misraim mbembenanneɛ amukoraa, na Libiafoɛ ne Yitiopiafoɛ bekoowura ye bo. 44Nakoso ngraa bɔ ɔkɔte kofi eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ ɔne sorɔ dɔ ne, ɔkɔma ye kunu kɔtete ye, na okotu kɔtengyɛ kɔhɔ mmenia pee so anyeborolɛ so, kyɛ ɔkwaahũhũ bɛ onua bɛ boso. 45Na okosisi ye ahemvie ɛtena sua mɔ wɔ ɛpo ne, ɔne bokaa krongron nyemenenyemene ne b’afia; nakoso ye ayieleɛ kɔto ye bɔ ongonya ebiala ma ɔngɔboka ye ɔ.”

Title: DANIEL 12
Content:
Animnyam ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne
1 “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Mikayɛl, bɔ ɔte abɔfo safohene bɔ ogyi wɔ maen mmaa nemɔ asi ne, okodwɔso. Amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ kɔwa, bɔ ofi mmerɛ bɔ maen wale bɔ ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ ne ɔ, ebie ɔwwale le ɔ. Nakoso sɔ mmerɛ ne, bɛkɔpepɛ bekole wɔ maen ne, ebiala bɔ bekonwu kyɛ bahyerɛ ye dumaa wɔ nwomaa ne anu ɔ. 2 Na bɛ bɔ balela wɔ aseɛnwo nnɛterɛ nu ne, bɛ nu pee kotingye, ebiemɔ kɔhɔ daa ngoa nu, yeɛ ebiemɔ wora bɛkɔhɔ animguaseɛ ne nyanzoen bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ nu. 3 Bɛ bɔ bɛte mmadwemma ne, bɛkɔta kyɛbɔ ewienu ta ɔ; yeɛ bɛ bɔ behyirehyirele mmeni pee maa bɛfale tenenee atee so ne, bɛ wora bɛkɔta kyɛ nzramaa afebɔɔ. 4 Nakoso wɔ, Daniel, nnɛbɔ edwirɛ ne aso, na fa nzɔanoɛ sɔ nwomaa ne noa kɔpem kyɛ ayieleɛ ne kɔwa ɔ. Mmeni pee kɔpere bɛ nwo bekoli akɔneaba, na nimdeɛ kɔsone.”
5Afei me, Daniel, nneane, na yieee, né mmienzua nyɔ foforɛ begyigyi berɛ. Ko wɔ asue ne noa bue ko, yeɛ ko wora ɔwɔ asue ne noa bue ko. 6Na ko bisale biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ ɔwɔ asue ne anye ne kyɛ, “Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ sɔ anwanwadeɛ hemɔ bɛkɔwa ayieleɛ ɔ?” 7 Na biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ ɔwɔ asue ne anye ne, ndele ye mmuayɛɛ ne. Ɔpagyale ye sa famaa ne ye sa bɛen hyirele nyameɛso, na ɔfale Ɛdangama bɔ ɔte ase daa ne tale ndaen kyɛ, “Okoodwu afoɛ nza ne bue; na sɛ bede maen krongron ne tumi befi ye sa nu beyie a, yeɛ ɛhemɔ amukoraa kɔwa nu ɔ. 8Ndele, nakoso mande ye bo, yiti mmisale kyɛ, “O me mene, sɛɛ yeɛ ɛhemɔ bekooyie ɔ?” 9Na obuale kyɛ, “Daniel, wɔ de kɔ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ nemɔ te mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ, na bafa nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa kɔpem ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne. 10 Bɛkɔte mmeni pee nwo bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo fitaa kɔma bɛ nwo kɔyɛ sannwuu; nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ bɛkɔyɔ ɔ, na bɔnefoɛ nemɔ anu biala ngɔte ye bo; nakoso badwemmafoɛ de, bɛkɔte ye bo. 11 Na ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔbera daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne mmerɛ bɔ bekogyina akyiwadeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ maen ne nen, ɔkɔyɛ ngyẽa apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburahona. 12Na sona bɔ ɔkɔnwondɛ toonn okoodwu ngyẽa apee ko ɛyaa nza ne aburasa ne nnu ne aso nen, ɔte saleɛ ma ye. 13Nakoso wɔ de, kɔ w’atee maa oodwu ayieleɛ ne; ekole wɔ nwome, na ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ekodwɔso konya wɔ kyɛfa bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ bama wɔ ne.”

Title: HOSEA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Amose bɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure ne, ye si ye, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hosea bɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure wɔ Yisrael maen ne bue bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro dɔ ne anu. Sɔ maen ne bue ne, né besa bɛfrɛ ye Samaria. Ɛhe sili koraka yeɛ Samaria baabɔ ɔ. Samaria bɔle ɔ, afoɛ 721 pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Nikyee titire bɔ Hosea nwomaa ne kã ye nwo dwirɛ ole: maen ne anu bosoensolɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ benne ye benni ɔ. Hosea sili ye hue fale ye agyaa bɔ Nyameɛ maa ogyale gyanderaniɛ Gomɛre ne yɛle mvandoho. Ɔfa hyirele kyɛbɔ maen ne benne Nyameɛ benni ɔ. Kyɛbɔ ɔye Gomɛre wanni agyaa nu nahorɛ wamma ye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ mmenia koso banni nahorɛ bamma Nyameɛ ɔ. Ɔnate ɛhe ati Nyameɛ kobua Yisrael ndɛen kɔhwe ye so. Nakoso ayieleɛ ne, Nyameɛ ye dɔ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ daa ma ye maen ne, ɔkɔyɛ adwuma, na okosa kɔhwe maen ne kɔbata ye nwo. Yɛnwu sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Hosea 11.8: “Ao Efraim, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye wɔ mama? Ao Yisrael, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye me sa mafi wɔ bo?”
Nu Dwirɛ
Hosea agyaa ne ye abusua 1.1—3.5
Hosea kã Yisrael yɔleɛ tɛɛ nwo dwirɛ 4.1—13.16
Adwene sakyeralɛ ne bɔhyɛ nwo dwirɛ 14.1-9

Title: HOSEA 1
Content:
1Yuda ahemvo Yusia, Yotam, Ahase ne Hesekia, yeɛ Yoase awa Yisrael hene Yeroboam, b’ahennie aberɛ so ne, AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Beeri awa Hosea ne, ye ɛhe.
2Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye bo fale Hosea so dwudwole ne, AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “Kɔ ná kogya braa gyanderaniɛ, ná ɛne ye bɛwo gyanderafoɛ mmaa, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne wabɔ adwaman kandinga paa, na wali AWURADE nwo makyebu.” 3Yiti ɔhɔle oogyale Diblaim awa brasua Gomɛre. Ɔne ye bɛnwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa bienzua. 4Na AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Yesreel; ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ngɔtɔ Yehu awuro ama so wereɛ wɔ Yesreel mogya nwo, na ngɔma Yisrael awuro ama ahennie so kɔpɛ.” 5Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngobubu Yisrael agyaen nu wɔ Yesreel bɔnza ne anu.” 6 Osa nwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa brasua. Na AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Lo Ruhama, ofikyɛ mengonwu Yisrael awuro ama anwumvoin ko bɔ ɔkɔmaa ngɔfa bɛ bɔne ngɔhyɛ bɛ bieku ɔ. 7Nakoso ngonwu Yuda awuro ama anwumvoin, na ngɔfa AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ so ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ. Mengɔfa agyaen anaa ngrandɛ, anaa koɛ, anaa mbɔngɔ, anaa mbɔngɔhanɛfoɛ so yeɛ ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ ɔ.” 8Na ɔpɛle Lo Ruhama nyɔfone ne, ɔnwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa bienzua. 9Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Lo Ami, ofikyɛ nna me maen ole ɛmɔ, yeɛ me wora nnde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.
10 Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ bɛ somaa kɔyɛ kyɛ mboanoa anweaa, bɔ bɛngora ye susu anaa bɛngora ye ka ɔ. Na nekaa bɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Nna me maen ole ɛmɔ” nen, berɛ yeɛ bɛkɔhã bekohyire bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ teasefoɛ mma ole ɛmɔ” ɔ. 11Yudafoɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔbɔ nu bekoyia, ná bɛkɔye panyi ko maa okotua bɛ noa. Na bekofi aseɛ ne aso bɛkɔwa, ofikyɛ Yesreel kyẽa ne kɔyɛ kyẽa piri.

Title: HOSEA 2
Content:
1Ɛmɔhã behyire ɛmɔ aliɛma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ, “Ami” yeɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mmrasua mɔ kyɛ, “Ruhama.”
Yisrael te braa bɔ ɔfa ohu asi ɔ
2Ɛ́mɔdwudwo behyire ɛmɔ ani, ɛ́mɔdwudwo behyire ye,
ofikyɛ nna me ye ɔ,
yeɛ ye koso nna ohu ole me.
Odi kyɛ ɔye ye gyanderabɔlɛ ne fi ye nye so,
na ɔye ye agyaasɛkyelɛ ne fi ye nyɔfone mɔ b’afia.
3Wamma ye sɔ a, ngɔpa ye nwo
maa ye nwo kɔla so kyɛ kyẽa bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ;
ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ aseɛ pralaa so,
ná wayɛ kyɛ aseɛ katerepee,
na ngɔmaa nzuhɔen kohũ ye maa okowu.
4Na mengonwu ye mma mɔ anwumvoin kaala,
ofikyɛ bɛte gyandera mmaa.
5Ofikyɛ bɛ maame abɔ gyandera;
bɔ ɔnwonzɛle bɛ ne wabɔ nyanzoen bra,
ofikyɛ ɔnwa, ‘Me kurofoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛma me me noa aleɛ,
me nzue, me boaen nwiaa ne me gyese,
me ngoo ne me nzaa ne, ngogu bɛ so.’
6Yiti, tie, ngɔfa mmowue ngotua w’atee.
Ngɔto waen ngɔfa ye nwo, amaa ɔnate so wannwu ye atee nemɔ.
7Ɔkɔpo ye kurofoɛ nemɔ aso,
nakoso ɔngɔto bɛ;
ɔkɔpena bɛ,
nakoso ongonwu bɛ.
Na ɔkɔhã kyɛ,
‘Ngosa ngɔhɔ ngoogya me hu daa ne,
ofikyɛ né nningyein kɔ so yé ma me tra ɛnɛ.’
8Hmmm, né ɔnze kyɛ me yeɛ mane ye aburoo ne nzaa ne ngoo,
kyɛ me yeɛ mmaa onyane ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ pee,
bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Baal ne ɔ.
9Yiti ngosa ngɔwa
ngoole m’aburoo wɔ ye buberɛ nu,
yeɛ me nzaa wɔ ye mmerɛ nu,
na ngosa ngole me kundu ne me gyese bɔ mva ngatale ye nwo ne.
10Na afei ngɔla ye nyanzoen bra ne ali
wɔ ye kurofoɛ nemɔ nyunu,
na ebiala ngɔpepɛ ngole ye ngofi me sa nu.
11Ngɔma ye ahurusililɛ ne amukoraa bo kɔpɛ,
yeɛ ye aluolue ngyẽa mɔ, ye ɛsraen foforɛ mɔ,
ye afofingyẽa ne ye aluolue bɔ bahyehyɛ amukoraa.
12Ngɔsɛkye ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma mmakaa nemɔ,
bɔ wahã wafa bɛ nwo kyɛ,
‘M’akatuaa bɔ me kurofoɛ mɔ bafa bama me ne, ye ɛhe’ ne;
ngɔkakyi bɛ ɛhɔayeɛ,
na eburo ngaka koli.
13Ngyẽa bɔ ɔfa sɔnene Baal mɔ ne, ngɔhwe ye so wɔ ye nwo,
mmerɛ bɔ ɔyerale ɛyɛɛ mane bɛ,
bɔ ɔfale ye asomade ne ye mbembenanneɛ mɔ siesiele ye nwo,
oolili ye kurofoɛ nemɔ asi mane ye wora fili me ne,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
14Yiti tie, ngɔma me hurolɛ kɔwa ye nu,
ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ ɛserɛ so,
na ngɔhã ɛkorɔkorɔlɛ dwirɛ ngohyire ye.
15 Ngɔfa ye bobe boo mɔ ngɔma ye wɔ berɛ,
na ngɔma Akɔre bɔnza ne kɔyɛ anyelasoɛ anoa’.
Berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔma mmuayɛɛ kyɛ ye ndaluwa nu ɔ,
kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ofi Misraim aseɛ so wale ne.
16Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛkɔfrɛ me ‘Yisi’, na ɛngɔfrɛ me ‘Baali’ ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 17Ofikyɛ ngɔye Baal mɔ dumaa ngofi ye noa nu, na bɛngɔbɔ bɛ dumaa bɛngɔkaye bɛ ko. 18Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔyɛ apam ngɔma bɛ, me ne eburo ngaka, ewienu nnomaa, yeɛ ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ. Ngobubu agyaen, ngrandɛ ne koɛhonɛ nu ngofi aseɛ ye aso, na ngɔmaa bɛkɔlela berɛ asomdwee nu.
19Na ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo afebɔɔ; amba, ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo wɔ tenenee nu, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu, ɔdɔ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ nu. 20Ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nu, na ekonwu AWURADE.
21“Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngotie,
ngɔfa mmuayɛɛ ngɔma nyameɛso,
na bɛ koso bɛkɔfa mmuayɛɛ bɛkɔma aseɛ,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
22Na aseɛ kɔfa mmuayɛɛ kɔma aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo,
na bɛ koso bɛkɔfa mmuayɛɛ bɛkɔma Yesreel.
23 Ngolua ye ngɔma me nwo wɔ aseɛ ne aso.
Ngonwu bɔ mannwu ye anwumvoin ne anwumvoin,
na ngose bɔ ɔtte me maen ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛte me maen,’
na bɛ koso bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Ɛte me Nyameɛ.’ ”

Title: HOSEA 3
Content:
Hosea sa kɔfa Gomɛre ba
1Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sa kohuro braa adwamanbɔlɛniɛ bɔ ɔte agyaasɛkyelɛniɛ ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE kuro Yisraelfoɛ dwirɛ, nakoso bɛso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ, ná bekuro borɔdoma bɔ babobɔ ye kunguma ɔ.” 2Yiti nduale ɛdwetɛ sekel buru ne nnu, yeɛ ayuo angora ko ne ayuo angora bue mva ndɔle ye. 3Na nzele ye kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ ɛne me tena mmerɛ tendenn; nnɛbɔ gyandera, yeɛ nnɛfa wɔ nwo ma biaa foforɛ, na me koso sɔ yeɛ ngɔyɔ ngɔma wɔ ɔ.”
4Ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ kɔtena mmerɛ tendenn bɔ belle hene, bɔ belle dehyeɛ, bɔ bɛmmɔ afɔleɛ, bɔ belle amoen, bɔ belle asɔfo ataadeɛ ne abusua amoen ɔ, 5na ye si, Yisraelfoɛ kosa kɔwa bɛkɔɔpena AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ ne bɛ hene Dawide si atee, na bekosuro AWURADE ne ye anwumvoinnwunɛ wɔ ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ nemɔ anu.

Title: HOSEA 4
Content:
Nyameɛ bɔ Yisrael kwaadu
1Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ; ofikyɛ AWURADE ne aseɛ ne aso ama banya dwirɛ, ɔnate kyɛ nahorɛlilɛ, anwumvoinnwunɛ, ɔne Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ biala nne aseɛ ne aso. 2Ndaentalɛ, anoanupɛlɛ, awuelilɛ, awue ne adwamanbɔlɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ’. Bebu mmeraa so, na mogya alaa yeɛ bɛkã begua ɔ. 3Yiti aseɛ ne di aworabɔlɛ, na bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa ayɛ hodwoo: eburo ngaka, ewienu nnomaa, yeɛ ɛpo nu naen po bekoyie. 4Nakoso nnɛma ebiala odwudwodwudwo, anaa ofu obiɛngo: ofikyɛ wɔ maen te kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ ne ɔsɔfo banya dwudwolɛ ɔ. 5Yiti ekosoti eyia, na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne koso ɔne wɔ bekosoti kɔngɔen, na ngonua wɔ maame boso.
6Nimdeɛ bɔ wabɔ me maen ne ati, bɛ boso konua; ɔnate kyɛ apo nimdeɛ ne ati, me koso mapo wɔ, kyɛ ɛngɔyɛ me sɔfo. Ɔnate kyɛ wɔ wora afi wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne ati, me koso me wora kofi wɔ mma mɔ. 7Kyɛbɔ bɛhɔle so bɛsonene ne, sɔ alaa yeɛ bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne betiale me ɔ; yiti b’animnyam ne, ngɔkakyi ye animguaseɛ. 8Me maen, bɔne yeɛ ɔte b’aleɛ ɔ, na b’amumuyɛɛ yeɛ wali bɛ ti ɔ. 9Na bɔ ɔkɔto maen ne nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ɔsɔfo ɔ; ngɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ bɔne nwo, na ngotua bɛ kerɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ.
10Bekodidi, nakoso bɛ ko ngoyi;
bɛkɔbɔ gyandera, nakoso bɛngɔta pee,
ofikyɛ bapo AWURADE.
11Gyanderabɔlɛ ne nzaa, yeɛ nzaa foforɛ
yeɛ owua sona adwene ɔ.
12Me maen kɔ bɛ mmakaa berɛ abisa,
na bɛ pɔmaa yeɛ ɔye bɛ musue ɔ,
ofikyɛ gyanderabɔlɛ sunzum amaa bali makyebu,
na bafi bɛ Nyameɛ nwo baabɔ gyandera.
13Bɛbobɔ afɔleɛ wɔ mmokaa ti afia,
bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ pambaa mɔ so,
yeɛ eluii, tanure ne ɛmee mɔ abo,
ofikyɛ bɛ bo te fɔnwoo.
Yiti ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ kɔbɔ gyandera, na ɛmɔ aye mɔ kɔsɛkye agyaa.
14Sɛ ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ bɛbɔ gyandera,
anaa sɛ ɛmɔ aye mɔ bɛsɛkye agyaa a, mengɔhwe bɛ so;
ofikyɛ mmienzua nemɔ bɔbɔ deinn bɛkɔ gyanderafoɛ nemɔ nekaa,
na bɛ ne asɔneyɛɛ so gyanderafoɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ.
Yiti maen bɔ nimdeɛ abɔ ye ne, ɔkɔbɔ.
15Wɔ, Yisrael, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛbɔ gyandera de,
nakoso Yuda de, onni kyɛ ɔyɔ sɔ bie.
Nnɛma ɛmɔba Gilgal, nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Bete Awen,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen kyɛ, “Kyɛ AWURADE te ase ye.”
16Yisrael so yɛ se
kyɛ nandwie beleɛ akrɔngrɔma bɔ ye so yɛ se ɔ.
Afei AWURADE kɔma bɛ aleɛ
kyɛ boaen ba bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɔ ndire wɔ so ɔ so.
17Efraim afa ye nwo wabɔ mmosoen,
yiti po ye bra ma ye.
18Bɛno bɛ nzaa ngapealaa ne a, gyandera alaa yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ;
animguaseɛ yeɛ bɛ mbanyi mɔ bekuro ɔ.
19Mvrama bie amoa ye awura ye ndaa nu,
na ɔnate bɛ bosoen sɔnenɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ ati, bɛ nyunu kogua ase.

Title: HOSEA 5
Content:
Nyameɛ bɔ asɔfo ne ahemvo kwaadu
1Ao asɔfo, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he,
ɛmɔ, Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie.
Ao, ɛhene awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie,
ofikyɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne, ɔ́ba ɛmɔ so;
ofikyɛ ɛmɔakakyi ngaen wɔ Misepa,
ɔne ɛtɛen bɔ batrɛtrɛ nu wɔ Tabɔ so ɔ.
2Ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ́pena kyɛ bédi awue piri paa,
nakoso ngɔhwe bɛ mukoraa bɛ so.
3Mese Efraim,
na Yisrael koso ɔmvea me;
afei, ao Efraim, abɔ gyandera,
na Yisrael nwo agua fiɛ.
4Bɛ yɔleɛ mma bɛ ate
mma benza bɛmma bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ;
ofikyɛ gyanderabɔlɛ sunzum wɔ bɛ nu,
na bɛnze AWURADE.
5Yisrael anwomasoɛ di adanzeɛ tia ye.
Yiti Yisrael ne Efraim bekosoti wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nu;
Yuda koso ɔne bɛ yeɛ bekosoti ɔ.
6Bɛkɔfa bɛ mmoaen kure ne bɛ nandwie kure
bɛkɔhɔ kyɛ bɛkwaapena AWURADE.
Nakoso bengonwu ye;
wahwe ye nwo wafea bɛ.
7Banni nahorɛ bamma AWURADE,
ofikyɛ bawowo somaa mmaa.
Bosome foforɛ ne kɔsɛkye bɛ ne bɛ boo mɔ.
8Ɛ́mɔhu awɛen wɔ Gibea,
yeɛ ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Rama.
Ɛ́mɔbɔ dawure wɔ Bete Awen,
yɛli wɔ si, ao Benyamin.
9Efraim kɔkakyi kurofoen
wɔ asohwenɛ kyẽa ne anu;
mafa edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa nu amba ɔ mato dwaa
wɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anu.
10Yuda ahemvo mɔ, bayɛ kyɛ
mmenia bɔ betutu wɛen ɔ,
yiti m’ahone kohu bɛ so kyɛ nzue.
11Bɛhyɛ Efraim so, babua ye fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu,
ofikyɛ ɔhyɛle da lili mmeraa mbaen mbaen si.
12Yiti nde kyɛ mvrɔlɔ mema Efraim,
na nde kyɛ nikyee porɔlowaa mema Yuda awuro ama.
13Mmerɛ bɔ Efraim nwuni ye anwonyerɛ,
ná Yuda nwuni ye kena ne
yeɛ Efraim hɔle Asiria ɔ,
na ɔsomane maa bɛhɔle Nana Yarebo berɛ.
Nakoso wangora wanza ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ,
yeɛ wangora wamma ɛmɔ kena ne wangɔ.
14Ofikyɛ ngɔyɛ kyɛ gyata ngɔma Efraim,
yeɛ ngɔyɛ kyɛ gyata ba ngɔma Yuda awuro ama.
Me, me yeɛ ngɔtete bɛ nu pasapasa ngɔhɔ ɔ;
ngɔfa ngɔhɔ, na ebiala ngɔpepɛ ngole ye.
15Ngosa ngɔhɔ m’atenaleɛ berɛ,
kɔpem kyɛ bekole bɛ bɔne bɛkɔto nu, ná bɛkɔpena me si atee ɔ.
B’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, bɛkɔpena me si atee ndɛndɛ.

Title: HOSEA 6
Content:
Adwenesakyera bɔ nahorɛ nne nu ɔ
1“Ɛmɔbra, ɛ́mɔma yɛsa yɛhɔ AWURADE berɛ,
ofikyɛ ye yeɛ watete yɛ nu pasapasa ɔ, na ɔkɔsa yɛ anwonyerɛ;
wapura yɛ, na okosa kɔkyekye yɛ ngena nemɔ aso.
2Elenyɔ asi, ɔkɔmaa yɛkosa yɛkonya ngoa,
yoo, ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔkɔpagya yɛ, na yɛkɔtena ngoa nu wɔ ye nyunu.
3Ɛ́mɔma yɛnwu ye, ɛ́mɔma yɛpere yɛpena AWURADE nwo nimdeɛ.
Ye walɛ ne, osi pi kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ;
na ɔkɔwa yɛ berɛ kyɛ esue,
kyɛ bamborɔ bɔ ɔtɔ gua aseɛ so ɔ.”
4Ao Efraim, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva nyɔ wɔ ɔ?
Ao Yuda, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva nyɔ wɔ ɔ?
Ɛmɔ nahorɛlilɛ te kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ munungum,
na ɔte kyɛ bosue bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ndɛndɛ ɔ.
5Yiti nnate me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so mapɛ bɛ magua,
mafa me noa nu dwirɛ mahũhũ bɛ,
na me ndɛenbualɛ te kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔ́ta ɔ.
6 Ofikyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ yeɛ mépena ɔ, na nna afɔleɛbɔlɛ ɔ;
na Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ mmom yeɛ mekuro metra naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ɔ.
7Na mmom babu apam ne aso kyɛ Adam ala,
berɛ yeɛ banni nahorɛ bamma me ɔ.
8Gileade te amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ kuro,
mogya agua wɔ nu maa efiɛ ahã ye.
9Kyɛbɔ awerɔm awuefoɛ kure bɛtetɛ sona ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ asɔfo kure bɛbɔ porɛ bedi awue ɔ.
Bedi awue wɔ Sɛkem atee so,
amba, bɛbɔ musue.
10Manwu anwodwiri nikyee wɔ Yisrael awuro ama nu.
Berɛ yeɛ Efraim gyanderabɔlɛ ne wɔ ɔ;
Yisrael nwo agua fiɛ.
11Ao Yuda, wɔ koso wahyehyɛ buberɛ wama wɔ,
mmerɛ bɔ ngosa ngɔfa me maen ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa ɔ.

Title: HOSEA 7
Content:
1Mésa Yisrael anwonyerɛ a,
né Efraim amumuyɛɛ ne Samaria bɔne yɔleɛ ɔ́da ali,
ofikyɛ benni nahorɛ.
Awueniɛ abɔ awura nu,
na awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛbɔ apaa wɔ dwaaso.
2Na bɛndwene ye nwo wɔ bɛ ti anu
kyɛ mekaye bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa ɔ.
Afei bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ apɛ bɛ nwo ayia,
na me nye tua.
3Bɛfa bɔne yɔleɛ bɛma ɛhene ne nye gye,
na bɛfa bɛ ngondombo bɛma atitirefoɛ mɔ koso bɛ nye gye.
4Bɛ mukoraa bɛte agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ,
bɛte kyɛ foonoo bɔ paanootonɛniɛ ne wasɔ nu see maa wayɛ hye ɔ;
na ɔyakyi see ne anu hualɛ,
ofi mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔfete paanoo ne kɔpem kyɛ okotu ɔ.
5Yɛ hene ne, ye kyẽa ne,
ye mbanyi mɔ bɛnone nzaa bɛyɛle tendaenn;
ɔne ngorohoɛfoɛ yeɛ betu nu ɔ.
6Ofikyɛ basiesie b’ahone kyɛ foonoo,
wɔ nnakannaka atee so,
b’ahone kɔ so hu kɔngɔen amukoraa,
na ngyerɛmɔ ɔsɔ kyɛ see bɔ ógye ɔ.
7Bɛ mukoraa bayɛ hye kyɛ foonoo,
bekũkũ bɛ maenbulɛfoɛ mɔ;
b’ahemvo amukoraa batotɔ,
na bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ osũ frɛ me ɔ.
8Efraim afa ye nwo wabɔ maen maen mɔ;
Efraim te apiti bɔ bangakyi ɔ.
9Ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ ale ye anwoserɛ ne,
nakoso ɔnze,
amba, ye ti so amukoraa afu gyein,
nakoso ɔnze.
10Yisrael anwomasoɛ di adanzeɛ tia ye,
nakoso benza bɛmma AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ,
yeɛ ɛhe amukoraa si ne, bɛmbena ye si ate.
11Efraim te kyɛ abubure kwaseaa
bɔ olle adwene ɔ;
bɛpena mmokalɛ befi Misraim berɛ, yeɛ bɛkɔ Asiria berɛ.
12Sɛ bɛkɔ a, ngɔtrɛ me tɛen nu ngɔkata bɛ so,
ngɔtete bɛ ngogua ase kyɛ ewienu nnomaa;
ngɔhwe bɛ so, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmenia bate ne ala.
13Bɛ yaakɔ oo! Ofikyɛ banwati bafi me nwo bahɔ.
Amaneɛ ato bɛ, ofikyɛ bayɛ me nwo lɔen.
Ahaa mekuro kyɛ mepepɛ mede bɛ, nakoso bɛpepɛ me nwo ngondombo.
14Bemvi b’ahone nu benzu bɛmvrɛ me,
na mmom bɛbɔ awuye wɔ bɛ bɛen so;
bɛpepɛ bɛ nwo naen bɛpena aburoo ne nzaa,
na bɛyɛ me nwo lɔen.
15Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me yeɛ mama bɛ ndeteyɛɛ, yeɛ mamaa banya anwoserɛ ɔ,
nakoso bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ.
16Besa bɛ si, nakoso bɛmma Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne berɛ,
bayɛ kyɛ nnakannaka agyaen,
b’atitirefoɛ mɔ kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa;
ɔnate bɛ noa dwirɛ mvamva ne ati,
mmenia kɔfa ɛhe kɔgoro bɛ nwo wɔ Misraim aseɛ so.

Title: HOSEA 8
Content:
Yisrael yakyi Nyameɛ fa Asiria
1“Fa totorobɛndo ne tua wɔ noa!
Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ kɔleɛ kɔwa AWURADE awuro ne aso,
ofikyɛ babu m’apam ne aso,
na bato me mmeraa ne.
2Bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me kyɛ,
‘Me Nyameɛ, yɛ Yisraelfoɛ, yɛse wɔ.’
3Yisrael agyi nikye paa ne wato,
na pɔfoɛ ne kɔfoa ye.
4Basisi ahemvo bɔ nna me yeɛ nzili ɔ,
babobɔ mbanyi bɔ menze ye nwo hwee ɔ;
bafa b’ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ mmosoen bama bɛ nwo,
bɔ ɔnate so ɔngɔma ongoyie bɛ yé ɔ.
5Ao Samaria, wapo wɔ nandwie ba ne,
m’ahone ahu bɛ so;
ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɛngɔbɔ anwotelɛ bra ɔ?
6Ofikyɛ ye koso ofi Yisrael:
dwumvoɛ yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ,
yiti nna Nyameɛ ɔ.
Samaria nandwie ba ne,
bekobubu ye nu pasapasa.
7Ofikyɛ bedua mvrama,
na mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ yeɛ bɛkɔpɛ ɔ.
Aburoo ne wambɛnzɛ,
na ɔngɔfa mmaa.
Sɛ ɔfa mmaa po a,
ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ yeɛ bekoli ɔ.
8Bahye Yisrael bame;
afei bɛte kyɛ kukue bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ,
wɔ maen maen mɔ nu.
9Ofikyɛ baapena mmokalɛ wɔ Asiria,
eburo afunum bɔ ye ngome okyinikyini ɔ.
Efraim abɔ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye ɔ mɔ paa.
10Amba, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛbɔ abiɛngoɛ mɔ paa wɔ maen maen nemɔ nu de,
nakoso ngɔboa bɛ noa;
na ahemvo mmaa mmaa mɔ hene ne, ye nhyɛsoɛ ne ati,
bekoli aworabɔlɛ kãa.
11Efraim asisi bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mmokyea pee,
nakoso bakakyi ye so bɔneyɔlɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea.
12Mahyerɛ me mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ apee apee pee mama ye,
nakoso bebuli bɛ kyɛ amanvrafoɛ nikye.
13M’ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ ne, bɛfa naen bɛbɔ,
bedi, nakoso AWURADE onne bɛ ndo nu.
Afei ɔkɔkaye b’amumuyɛɛ,
ɔkɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ bɔne nwo,
na bekosa bɛkɔhɔ Misraim.
14 Ofikyɛ Yisrael wora afi (Nyameɛ) bɔ ɔbɔle ye ɔ,
wasisi asɔneyɛɛ sua mɔ;
Yuda akyekye nguro pee bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ,
nakoso ngɔtɔ see ngogua ye nguro nemɔ aso,
na ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.

Title: HOSEA 9
Content:
Bɛkɔhwe Yisrael so
1Ao Yisrael, nnɛdi ahurusi!
Nnɛma wɔ nye gye kyɛ maen maen nemɔ,
ofikyɛ afi wɔ Nyameɛ si aabɔ gyandera.
Ahuro gyanderaniɛ akatuaa,
wɔ nekaa amukoraa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ.
2Nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ne nekaa bɔ betwi nzaa ɔ, ɔngɔma bɛ bɛ noa aleɛ,
yeɛ nzaa foforɛ ne ngɔpe ngɔma bɛ.
3Bɛngɔtena AWURADE aseɛ ne aso,
na mmom Efraim kosa kɔhɔ Misraim,
na bekoli nningyein bɔ bɛ nwo nde ɔ wɔ Asiria.
4Bɛngɔbɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛngɔma AWURADE,
yeɛ b’afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔsɔ ye nye.
B’afɔleɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ ɛsɛenvoɛ aleɛ kɔma bɛ;
ebiala bɔ okoli bie ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ,
ofikyɛ b’aleɛ ne, bɛ bɔbɔ yeɛ bekoli ɔ,
na ɔngɔwa AWURADE awuro berɛ.
5Aluolue kyẽa bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne,
AWURADE poentolɛ kyẽa ne dwu a,
nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ?
6Ofikyɛ, tie, ɔnate ehuhunɛ ne ati, mmenia nemɔ banwati bahɔ.
Misraim kɔboa bɛ noa, na Memfise kosie bɛ.
Ndetema kofifi nekaa bɔ bɛ dwetɛ nningyein paa gua ne,
na agurɛ kofifi bɛ tena sua nemɔ anu.
7 Asohwenɛ ngyẽa ne adwu berɛ,
akatuaa ngyẽa ne adwu berɛ.
Yisrael kobu ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne kyɛ ɔte kwaseaa,
yeɛ sunzum nu sona ne kyɛ wabɔ laen,
ɔnate w’amumuyɛɛ somaa ne, ɔne ɛpɔen piri ne ati.
8Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne te Efraim wɛmvoɛ,
me Nyameɛ maen ne,
nakoso ngaensualɛniɛ asua ye ngaen wɔ ye atee amukoraa nu,
na bɛpɔ ye wɔ ye Nyameɛ awuro.
9Bɛ bɔbɔ bagua bɛ nwo fiɛ paa,
kyɛ Gibea mmerɛ ne anu ala;
yiti ɔkɔkaye b’amumuyɛɛ,
na ɔkɔhwe bɛ so bɛ bɔne nwo.
10 Nwuni Yisrael kyɛ ɛserɛ so bobe mma.
Nwuni ɛmɔ nana mɔ kyɛ bobe mma bɔ wali moa wasu
wɔ ye sulɛ mmerɛ bɔ oli moa nu ɔ.
Nakoso bedwuli Baal Peɔ nen,
beguale bɛ nwo fiɛ bɛbɔle nyanzoen bra,
na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛkakyili akyiwadeɛ te kyɛ nningyein bɔ né bekuro ne ala.
11Efraim de, b’animnyam kotu kɔhɔ kyɛ anomaa,
aworɛ nne berɛ ko, nwonzɛen nne berɛ ko, yeɛ ebiala mva koɛ ko!
12Sɛ bɛtete mmaa po a,
ngɔmaa bekoli abawuo bɔ baa ko po ngɔha ɔ;
amba, sɛ meyakyi bɛ nu a,
bɛ yaakɔ!
13Nwuni Efraim kyɛ Tiro bɔ balua ye wɔ aseɛ paa so ɔ,
nakoso Efraim kɔfa ye mma kɔɔma kodiawuniɛ ne.
14Ao AWURADE, fa ma bɛ e!
Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔma bɛ ɔ?
Ma bɛ koɛ bɔ ɔpɔ baa,
ɔne nyɔfone bɔ nzue nne nu ɔ.
15Bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa wɔ Gilgal,
ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ nhyɛle ye bo mbɔle bɛ ɔ.
Ɔnate bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne ati,
ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi m’awuro,
mengohuro bɛ dwirɛ ko;
b’atitire amukoraa bɛte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ.
16Bafa nikyee babɔ Efraim,
bɛ ndii akese, bengosu mmaa.
Sɛ bɛwo mmaa po a,
ngohũ bɛ mma mɔ bɔ b’ahone la bɛ nwo paa ne.
17Me Nyameɛ kɔpo bɛ,
ofikyɛ banyɛ sotie bamma ye,
na bekohyinihyini maen maen mɔ so.

Title: HOSEA 10
Content:
1Yisrael te bobe paa
bɔ osu ye mma ɔ;
kyɛbɔ ye mma begu so bɛsone ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ ye afɔleɛ mmokyea begu so bɛsone ɔ;
kyɛbɔ ye aseɛ ne osi yɛ nyemene ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɛle b’amoen mɔ nyemenenyemene ɔ.
2B’adwene ayɛ ndaa ndaa,
afei odi kyɛ bɛsoa bɛ mvomsoɛ;
AWURADE kobubu b’afɔleɛ mmokyea mɔ,
na ɔkɔsɛkye b’amoen nemɔ.
3Na afei de, bɛkɔhã kyɛ,
“Yɛlle hene biala,
ofikyɛ yanzuro AWURADE,
na ɛhene de, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔyɔ kɔma yɛ ɔ?”
4Bɛkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen;
bɛta ndaen mbaen mbaen bɛfa bɛyeyɛ apam;
yiti ndɛenbualɛ fifi wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ anafranaku,
bɔ ofifi kofie so wɔ fieso ɔ.
5Bete Awen nandwie mmaa nemɔ ati,
ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ Samariafoɛ so.
Ofikyɛ ye mmenia koli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ,
yeɛ ye ahɔmeɛ mɔ bɔ né bedi ye animnyam nwo ahurusi ne, bɛ koso sɔ ala,
ɔnate kyɛ ye animnyam ne watu wamini wafi ye nu.
6Bɛkɔsoa bɛkɔhɔ Asiria
bɛkɔɔyɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛkɔma Nana Yarebo;
Efraim nyunu kogua ase,
na Yisrael kɔfɛre ye bɔbɔ ye agyirɛ bɔ watu ɔ nwo.
7Samaria de, bɛkɔpɛ ye hene asue
kyɛ asue nye ahure.
8 Yisrael bɔne, bɔ ye ole Awen asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ ne,
bɛkɔsɛkye bɛ.
Mmowue ne ɛfone kofifi b’afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ aso;
na bekose mmokaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔkata yɛ so”,
ná base pambaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwiri begua yɛ so.”
9 Ao Yisrael, ayɔ bɔne fi Gibea mmerɛ ne;
berɛ yeɛ bɛtoale bɔne ne aso ɔ.
Aso koɛ ammu amva amumuyɛɛfoɛ nemɔ aso wɔ Gibea?
10Mepena kyɛ metwe bɛ so,
na maen maen mɔ bɛkɔboa bɛ noa, bekodwɔso bekotia bɛ,
ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ mmɔhoɛ ne ati.
11Né Efraim te nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ batete ye
bɔ aburoo borolɛ yeɛ okuro ɔ.
Nakoso ngɔfa kɔnnua ngɔto ye kɔme nyemenenyemene ne anu,
ngɔma Efraim kɔhwe nningyein ne,
Yuda kofundam aseɛ ne,
na Yakob kofurofuro nnɛterɛ ne anu.
12 Ɛmɔlua tenenee bɛ́ma ɛmɔ nwo,
ɛ́mɔbu ye wɔ anwumvoinnwunɛ nu,
ɛ́mɔso ɛmɔ hɔayeɛ too ne.
Ofikyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛmɔpena AWURADE si atee ɔ,
kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔwa kɔɔtɔ tenenee nzue kogua ɛmɔ so ɔ.
13Ɛmɔafundam bɔne yɔleɛ,
ɛmɔapɛ amumuyɛɛ;
ɛmɔali ngondombo mmaa.
Ofikyɛ ɛfale wɔ nwo tole w’anwoserɛ so,
wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ somaa so.
14Yiti koɛ nu bagyabagya kodwɔso wɔ wɔ maen ne anu,
na bɛkɔsɛkye w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne amukoraa,
kyɛbɔ Salman sɛkyele Bete Arabel wɔ koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne anu ne;
bɛtele niɛ mɔ beefini mmaa mɔ so maa niɛ nemɔ anu tetele pasapasa.
15Ao Betel, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekoli ɛmɔ ɔ,
ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne kandinga ne ati.
Ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu yeɛ bɛkɔpɛ Yisrael hene asue koraa ɔ.

Title: HOSEA 11
Content:
Nyameɛ kuro ye maen dwirɛ
1 Yisrael te akwadaa nen, né mekuro ye dwirɛ,
na Misraim yeɛ mvrɛle mma bienzua ne mvili ɔ.
2Na ngu so bɔ mefrɛ bɛ ne,
né me nwo ala yeɛ befi bɛkɔ ɔ.
Bɛbobɔle afɔleɛ mɔ bɛmane Baal mɔ,
na bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ bɛmane amoen mɔ.
3Me yeɛ ngyirekyirele Efraim natelɛ ɔ,
ngyili ye wɔ me sa so,
nakoso né bɛnze kyɛ me yeɛ nzale bɛ anwonyerɛ ɔ.
4Mvale anwumvoinnwunɛ nyamaa yeɛ ndwetwene bɛ ɔ,
mvale ɔdɔ nyamaa;
na nyɛle kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔsangye b’awogyee kɔnnua ɔ mmane bɛ,
na ngunduni bɛ nwo berɛ mmane bɛ aleɛ.
5Ongosa ngɔhɔ Misraim aseɛ so,
na mmom Asiria koli ye so hene,
ofikyɛ bapo kyɛ bekosa bɛkɔwa me berɛ ɔ.
6Ɔnate b’agyirɛ bɔ batu ne ati,
ngrandɛ kohũhũ mmenia wɔ ye nguro nemɔ aso,
na okobubu mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye anoa nemɔ asi ne.
7Me maen asi bɛ hue kyɛ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi me nwo,
ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛfrɛle bɛ kyɛ bɛhã bɛhɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne anwo,
nakoso bɛ nu biala wangamvo ye.
8 Ao Efraim, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye wɔ mama?
Ao Yisrael, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye me sa mafi wɔ bo?
Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né masɛkye wɔ kyɛ Adema?
Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né mabɔ wɔ tɔɔ kyɛ Seboyim?
Me nyaa woso wɔ me kunu,
ao, m’anwumvoinnwunɛ ayɛ piri paa.
9Me yaafɛlɛ kandinga ne, mengɔye mengofite,
mengosa mengɔsɛkye Efraim ko,
ofikyɛ nde Nyameɛ, na nnde sona;
nde Krongronniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ɔ,
na mengɔwa mengɔsɛkye kuro ne.
10Bekoli AWURADE si.
Afei ɔkɔbobɔ nu kyɛ gyata, na sɛ ɔbobɔ nu a,
ye mmaa mɔ kofi eyia atɔleɛ bɛkɔwa
bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ ɔ.
11Bekofi Misraim bɛkɔwa bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ kyɛ anomaa ɔ,
ɔne Asiria aseɛ so bɛkɔwa bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ kyɛ abubure ɔ,
na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔtena b’awuro mɔ nu,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
12Efraim afa ngondombo wapɛ me nwo wayia,
yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama koso, bafa nnakannaka bapɛ me nwo bayia.
Nakoso Yuda de, ɔtɛ ne Nyameɛ nate;
na odi nahorɛ ma Krongronniɛ ne.

Title: HOSEA 12
Content:
1Efraim li mvrama si,
na ogu eyia afiteleɛ mvrama so daa biala.
Ɔma ye anoanupɛlɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ ɔkɔ so yɛ pee,
bɛ ne Asiria bɛyɛ apam,
na bɛsoa ngoo bɛkɔ Misraim.
2AWURADE le dwirɛ tia Yuda.
Ɔkɔhwe Yakob so kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ,
na okotua ye kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.
3Ɔsɔle oliɛma gya si wɔ bɛ kunu,
na ole ye anwoserɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛfa bɛtetale so.
4 Amba, ɔne abɔfo ne bɛtetale so, na olili ngonim,
osuni, na ɔkoto srɛle ye.
Onwuni Nyameɛ wɔ Betel,
na berɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ ne yɛ dwudwole ɔ.
5AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ,
ye dumaa bɔ bɛfa bɛkaye ye ole AWURADE.
6“Yiti sa kɔ wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ,
sɔ ɔdɔ ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu yé,
ná fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu daa.”
7Kanaan tira ngondombo tonyi,
na okuro aminɛlilɛ.
8 Efraim nwa, “Aa, manya me nwo,
manya anwonyadeɛ.”
M’adwumayɔlɛ amukoraa nu,
bannwu amumuyɛɛ biala wɔ me nu, bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ.
9 Ofi Misraim aseɛ so,
me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ.
Ngɔmaa ekosa kɔtena ɛtena sua mɔ nu,
kyɛ aluolue ngyẽa bɔ mahyehyɛ mato berɛ ne ala.
10Mafa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so madwudwo,
mama nyekyire asone,
na mafa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ so mabubu anyandera.
11Aso amumuyɛɛ wɔ Gileade?
Amba, bɛte mbaen.
Bɛfa nandwie nyii mɔ bɛbobɔ afɔleɛ wɔ Gilgal,
amba, b’afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ, bɛte kyɛ nyɔboɛ kure
bɔ ɔwɔ eburo ngofie mɔ b’afia ɔ.
12 Yakob nwati hɔle Siria maen nu,
Yisrael sole maa ɔfa nyane braa gyale,
na braa ti, ɔneane mmoaen so.
13 Na AWURADE nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so yele Yisrael fili Misraim,
na ɔnate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so ɔbɔle ye nwo waen.
14Efraim wurale ye apue maa ɔfɛle yaa paa,
yiti AWURADE kɔma ye mogya bɔ wahwie wagua ne kɔbɔ ye ti so,
na ye AWURADE kɔma ye animguaseɛ kosa kɔto ye.

Title: HOSEA 13
Content:
Nyameɛ twe bosoensolɛfoɛ so
1Sɛ né Efraim odwudwo a, mmenia nwo wosowoso bɛ;
ɔmane ye nwo so wɔ Yisrael,
na ɔnate kyɛ ɔsɔnene Baal ne ati,
ɔyɔle bɔne, na owuli.
2Afei de, bɛkɔ so bɛyɔ bɔne,
na behuro bɛ dwetɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ amoen bɛma bɛ nwo,
amoen mɔ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bali adwii bayɔ,
bɔ ye mukoraa te dwumvoɛ sa noa adwuma ɔ.
Bɛkã bɛfa bɛ nwo kyɛ,
“Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne,
odi kyɛ bɛfe nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nemɔ noa.”
3Yiti bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ munungum,
kyɛ bosue bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ndɛndɛ ɔ,
kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, ɔbɔ ye fi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ,
kyɛ nwosina bɔ otu fa mboma nu kɔ ɔ.
4Nakoso ofi Misraim aseɛ so,
me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ;
onni kyɛ ɛso nyameɛ biala, sana me,
na defoɛ biala nne berɛ, sana me.
5Me, me yeɛ nwuni wɔ wɔ ɛserɛ so ɔ,
wɔ aseɛ bɔ nzue nne so ɔ so.
6Ndire bɔ belili ne, kyɛbɔ né ye paa si te nen, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ ko yili ɔ;
bɛ ko yili, na bɛyɛle anwomasoɛ,
yiti bɛ wora fili me.
7Yiti ngɔyɛ bɛ so kyɛ gyata,
ngɔyɛ kyɛ aboa ngɔtetɛ bɛ wɔ atee noa.
8Ngɔto ngɔhye bɛ kyɛ kwabrafo bɔ basesa ye mma mɔ bahɔ ɔ,
na ngɔtete bɛ hue bɔ obutu b’ahone so ne anu;
berɛ yeɛ ngohũhũ bɛ kyɛ gyata,
kyɛbɔ kaka aboyaa kɔtete bɛ nu ɔ.
9Ao Yisrael, afrɛfrɛ w’asefinɛ ama wɔ nwo,
nakoso me nu yeɛ wɔ mmokalɛ wɔ ɔ.
10 Me yeɛ ngɔyɛ wɔ hene ɔ,
na ebie bieku bɔ ɔkɔpepɛ kole wɔ wɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so ne,
ɔwɔ nisua?
Yeɛ wɔ maenbulɛfoɛ bɔ ɛhã fale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Si ɛhene ne mbanyi ma me” ne,
bɛwɔ nisua?
11 Mvɛle yaa nzili hene mane ɛmɔ,
na nyele ye mvili berɛ wɔ m’ahonehulɛ nu.
12Babɔ Efraim amumuyɛɛ ne borɛ;
ye bɔne nwo dwirɛ la berɛ.
13Yealɛ bɔ brasua fo aworɛ so a onwu ye ne, ebie kɔto ye,
nakoso ɔte baa bienzua bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ɔ;
ofikyɛ odwu mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛwo ye a,
ɔmva ye ti ndua awodeɛ ne anoa.
14 Aso mbɔ bɛ mvi ɛborɔ tumi nu anaa?
Aso mbepɛ nne bɛ mvi ewue nu anaa?
Wɔ, ewue, wɔ yealɛ ne wɔ ni?
Wɔ, ɛborɔ, wɔ sɛkyelɛ ne wɔ ni?
Anwumvoinnwunɛ atu afi me nye so.
15Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ okonya ngɔsoɛ wɔ oliɛma mɔ nu,
nakoso eyia afiteleɛ mvrama
bɔ ɔte AWURADE mvrama ne, okotu kofi ɛserɛ so dɔ kɔwa,
ye asue ti kɔwewe,
yeɛ ye mbombonzue kɔwewe,
na mvrama ne kɔsesa nningyein nyɔboɛ serɛ biala
kofi nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein ɔ.
16Samaria kɔsoa ye foɛlilɛ,
ofikyɛ wayɛ ye Nyameɛ nwo lɔen.
Bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
bɛkɔtete bɛ mma nnɔma mɔ ti bɛkɔbobɔ berɛ,
na bɛkɔpakyepakye bɛ pemvoɛ mɔ kunu.

Title: HOSEA 14
Content:
Yisrael, sa bra Nyameɛ berɛ nahorɛ nu
1Ao Yisrael, sa bra AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ,
ofikyɛ w’amumuyɛɛ amaa afi ase.
2 Ɛ́mɔpena edwirɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã ɔ,
ná ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra AWURADE berɛ;
ɛmɔhã behyire ye kyɛ,
“Kyikyi amumuyɛɛ amukoraa;
nwu yɛ anwumvoin de yɛ,
na yɛkɔfa yɛ noa dwirɛ yɛkɔyɛ nandwie nyii yɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ yɛkɔma wɔ.”
3Asiria ngɔpepɛ ngole yɛ,
yɛngɔtenatena mbɔngɔ so,
yeɛ yɛngɔhã ngohyire yɛ sa noa nnwumaa ko kyɛ,
‘Ɛmɔte yɛ nyameɛ mɔ’, ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ ayisiaaniɛ onya anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔ.
4Ngɔsa bɛ nahorɛ bɔ benni ne anwonyerɛ,
ngofia me kunu ngohuro bɛ dwirɛ,
ofikyɛ me yaafɛlɛ ne, maye mafi bɛ so.
5Ngɔyɛ kyɛ bosue ngɔma Yisrael:
ɔkɔfefɛ kyɛ sukooko,
na okonya ndii kyɛ Lebanon.
6Ye mmaen mɔ kɔtrɛtrɛ,
ye anwonyemene kɔyɛ kyɛ olive bakaa,
na ye nwo fona kɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon.
7Bɛ bɔ bɛte ye fɔnwoo ne abo ne, bekosa bɛkɔwa,
bekosa bekonyi puronn kyɛ aburoo,
bɛkɔfefɛ kyɛ bobe,
na bɛ nwo fona kɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon bobe nzaa.
8Ao Efraim, nzikyɛ yeɛ me ne mmosoen yɛle ye yɛyɔ bieku ɔ?
Me yeɛ mema ye mmuayɛɛ, ná menea ye so ɔ;
nde kyɛ ɛframmire monɛ bɔ ye nyaa mboro ɔ,
na me so yeɛ enya wɔ mmakaammaa ɔ.
9 Nwa yeɛ ɔse nworɛ bɔ ɔte edwirɛ hemɔ abo ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ ye adwene nu pi bɔ ole bɛ nwo nimdeɛ ɔ?
Ofikyɛ AWURADE atee tengyɛ,
teneneefoɛ kɔfa so,
nakoso mmeraatolɛfoɛ de, bekofi ase wɔ so.

Title: YOEL BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
Bɔ oli moa
Bɔ yɛse yɛfa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yowel nwo te kãa bie, na bɛngora bengyire mmerɛ pɔtee bɔ ɔtenane ase ɔ. Nakoso ye nwomaa ne, osoma kyɛ bɛhyerɛle ye wɔ Pɛsia ahennie mmerɛ ne anu. Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, né bɛhyerɛle ne, afoɛ 400 anaa 500 pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Kristo ɔ. Yowel nwomaa ne maa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ mmɛbɛ mbiri koole Yisraelfoɛ bɛ maen ne amukoraa kɔfa maa ɛhɔen kandinga kɔwa aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Sɔ nningyein nemɔ te sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ okyire kyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne, ɔte mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔhwe bɛ bɔ bayɛ ye so asoserɛ ne amukoraa bɛ so ɔ. Yowel bɔ maen ne kɔkɔ kyɛ AWURADE nwa bɛsakyera b’adwene. Afei ɔhyɛ bɛ nguraen kyɛ AWURADE koyira bɛ maa bekosa bɛkɔpe bɛ daa nu. Bɔhyɛ titire bɔ ɔwɔ nwomaa ne anu ole kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔsoma ye Sunzum maa ɔkɔwa mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ so bɔ mmienzua ne mmrasua, mbanyi ne ngwadaa amukoraa bɛboka so ɔ (2.28-32).
Nu Dwirɛ
Mmɛbɛ mbiri di bɛ fieso nningyein 1.1—2.17
AWURADE kɔmaa bekosi bɛ daa nu 2.18-27
AWURADE kyẽa ne 2.28—3.21

Title: YOEL 1
Content:
Bedi fieso nningyein sɛkyelɛ nwo aworabɔlɛ
1AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Petuel awa Yowel ne, ye ɛhe.
2Ɛmɔ, mbanyi mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe,
ɛmɔ, aseɛ ne aso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie!
Aso sɔ dwirɛ he, wasi ɛmɔ aberɛ so le,
anaa ɛmɔ nana mɔ b’aberɛ so po le?
3Ɛ́mɔhã ye nwo dwirɛ behyire ɛmɔ mma mɔ,
ná ɛmɔ mma mɔ bɛhã behyire bɛ mma mɔ,
ná bɛ mma mɔ koso bɛhã behyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ɔ.
4Bɔ aketekyire ali maa waha ne, mmɛbɛ ali;
bɔ mmɛbɛ bali maa waha ne, mmɛbɛ mbiri ali;
bɔ mmɛbɛ mbiri bali maa waha ne, ɛsaa ali.
5Ɛmɔ, akɔnomnzafoɛ, ɛ́mɔdwɔso ná ɛmɔsu,
ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔno nzaa ɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye,
ɔnate nzaa foforɛ ne ati,
ofikyɛ batu bafi ɛmɔ noa.
6 Ofikyɛ maen bie wafa koɛ waateta m’aseɛ ne,
bɛ nwo yɛ se, na bɛka bɛ a, bennwu bɛ noa.
Bɛ gye te gyata gye,
na b’awogyee te kyɛ gyata beleɛ.
7Wasɛkye me bobe ne pasaa,
wapomba me borɔdoma mmaen nemɔ:
wawɔngyewɔngye ye si boen ne wagua;
ye maen nemɔ nwo ayɛ hoyaa.
8Bɔ awuye kyɛ ababunu bɔ wahera ɛsɛen tena,
bɔ odi ye ndaluwa nu biaa nwo kuna ɔ.
9Bayakyi aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔlɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro.
Asɔfo bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ ne, bedi aworabɔlɛ.
10Eboo mɔ asɛkye, aseɛ di aworabɔlɛ,
ofikyɛ fieso nningyein asɛkye, nzaa foforɛ bo apɛ, yeɛ ngoo so ate.
11Ɛmɔ, akuafoɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛre,
ɛmɔ, bobe boo so neafoɛ, ayuo ne atokoɔ ti odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ awuye,
ofikyɛ fieso aleɛ mɔ asɛkye.
12Bobe ne akese,
borɔdoma bakaa ne atwindwam,
yeɛ akengaa, ayee ne aprɛ bakaa nemɔ koso sɔ ala;
eburo mmakaa amukoraa bakese;
ofikyɛ anigye atu amini
afi adasa mmaa mɔ nu.
AWURADE kyẽa ne
13Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔhera ɛsɛen tena ná ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye;
ɛmɔ, afɔleɛ bokyea nwo somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔsu.
Ɛmɔ, me Nyameɛ somvoɛ mɔ,
ɛmɔbra nu, ɛ́mɔhera ɛsɛen tena kɔngɔen ne amukoraa,
ofikyɛ bayakyi aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔlɛ wɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro.
14Ɛ́mɔyɛ akɔngyere krongron,
ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron.
Ɛ́mɔboaboa mbanyi ne aseɛ ne aso mma amukoraa bɛ noa
wɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro,
ná ɛ́mɔsu bɛfrɛ AWURADE.
15 Eh, sɔ kyẽa ne! Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye,
na ɔkɔwa kyɛ ɛsɛkyelɛ bɔ ofi Tuminiɛ ne berɛ ɔ.
16Aso aleɛ omminini bɔ yɛ nye tua ɔ,
aso anigye ne ahurusi omminini offili yɛ Nyameɛ awuro anaa?
17Nningyein bɔ balua ne, bakese wɔ aseɛ nwo,
pata nemɔ lela berɛ too,
aburoo pata nemɔ badwiri bagua,
ofikyɛ aburoo anyɛ yé.
18Nea kyɛbɔ nyɛmmoa nemɔ bɛpenepene ɔ!
Nandwie kure nemɔ bɛteetee,
ofikyɛ bennya aleɛ benni;
amba, mmoaen kure nemɔ benwu amaneɛ.
19Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ,
ofikyɛ see ayera ngaka aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so,
na see bɔ ogye ne wayera eburo mmakaa amukoraa.
20Eburo ngaka koso besu bɛfrɛ wɔ,
ofikyɛ asue mɔ nu nzue awewe,
na see ayera ngaka aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so.

Title: YOEL 2
Content:
AWURADE kyẽa ne nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Sion,
ɛ́mɔbɔ ese wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso!
Aseɛ ne aso ama amukoraa,
odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo wosowoso ɛmɔ,
ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba,
na wapingye.
2Ɔte awosii ne (ewienu) kusuuyɛlɛ kyẽa,
munungum ne awosii kabii kyẽa;
koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ pee bɛkɔwa,
bɔ ɔte kyɛ awosii bɔ wakata mmokaa nemɔ aso ɔ;
bɛ sɛso ɔwwale le, ná bɛ si koso, ebie ngɔwa ko,
wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ pee bɛ mmerɛ so.
3See bie yera nningyein di bɛ nyunu,
na see bɔ ogye ɔ wɔ bɛ si.
Aseɛ ne te kyɛ Eden turo ne wɔ bɛ nyunu,
nakoso bɛ si de, ɔkakyi ɛserɛ pralaa.
Amba, nikye fee ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ wɔ bɛ sa nu.
4 Bɛ nwo te kyɛ mbɔngɔ,
na betu amirika kyɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ mɔ.
5Behuruhuru kyɛ teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ bɛyɛ dede wɔ mmokaa so ɔ,
kyɛ see bɔ ɔyera ngyɛngyɛma bɔ ɔyɛ tetɛtetɛ ɔ,
kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ begyi koɛ noa ɔ.
6Amaenmaen mɔ, bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu,
mmenia amukoraa nyunu yɛ bosaa.
7Betu amirika kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ,
bɛfo fasue kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ;
ebiala fa ye atimbire so,
na bɛmmakye bɛmvi b’atee so’.
8Ebiala nzumu obiɛngo,
na ebiala nate ye atee so;
bɛbɔ bewura akodeɛ mɔ nu
bɔ nikye fee nzi bɛ ate ɔ.
9Betwi bɛfa kuro ne aso,
betu amirika wɔ fasue nemɔ aso,
bɛfo bɛkɔ awuro mɔ nu,
na bɛfa mboma nu bewura nu kyɛ awuefoɛ.
10 Aseɛ woso wɔ bɛ nyunu,
anwuro kekã;
eyia ne ɛsraen yɛ tunn,
na nzramaa yakyi talɛ.
11 AWURADE tea nu serɛserɛ wɔ ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nyunu,
ofikyɛ ye lɔen ne te piri paa,
na bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so ne, ye nwo yɛ se.
Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne te piri, ɔyɛ suro paa,
na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye noa gyina ɔ?
12“Na afei, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa
ne akɔngyere ne esuɛ ne aworabɔlɛlilɛ
besa bɛba me berɛ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
13Ɛ́mɔsunzua ɛmɔ ahone nu, na nna ɛmɔ ndaadeɛ nu ɔ,
ná ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ berɛ.
Ofikyɛ ɔdo mmenia na ɔse anwumvoin;
ye ahone nhu ndɛ, ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔsone,
na ɔsesã ye adwene ɔtwe bɔne nwo asohwenɛ sa.
14Nwa yeɛ ɔse ɔ? Ebiaa okosa ye si kɔsesã ye adwene,
ná wayakyi saleɛ wama ɛmɔ
bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ
bɛkɔma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ.
15Ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Sion,
ɛ́mɔyɛ akɔngyere krongron,
ɛ́mɔfrɛ nyianu krongron;
16ɛ́mɔboaboa maen ne anoa,
ɛ́mɔte mmenia nemɔ anwo,
ɛ́mɔboaboa mbanyi nemɔ noa,
ɛ́mɔboaboa ngwadaa nemɔ noa,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ betua nyɔfone noa ne koso.
Odi kyɛ atɔmvorɛ biaa ofi ye pia nu ba,
ná atɔmvorɛ braa koso ofi ye pumbu nu ba.
17Asɔfo nemɔ, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ ne,
odi kyɛ besu wɔ abrannaa ne, ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne b’afia,
ná bɛkã kyɛ,
“Ao AWURADE, nwu wɔ maen anwumvoin,
nnɛma w’agyapadeɛ yɛ nikyee bɔ bebu ye animtia,
maen maen mɔ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.
Nzu ati yeɛ bɛkekã ye wɔ maen maen mɔ nu kyɛ,
‘Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?’ ɔ.”
18Afei AWURADE hwene ye aseɛ nwo nungunɛ,
na onwuni ye maen anwumvoin.
19Amba, AWURADE buale ye maen sele ye kyɛ,
“Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo,
na bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ko koyi;
mengɔma ɛmɔngɔyɛ nikyee bɔ bebu ye animtia wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ ko,
20na mmom ɛlɔen bɔ ofi sorɔ dɔ ne, ngɔye ye ngofi ɛmɔ so ngɔhɔ dedeede,
na ngɔfoa ye ngɔhɔ aseɛ pralaa katerepee bie aso,
bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ɛpo,
ná ye si kyire eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo;
ye nwo pambaen kotu kɔwa,
na ye mvaa ne kɔbɔ kɔwa,
ofikyɛ wayɔ bɔne mbiri mbiri.
21Ao aseɛ, nnɛsuro;
ma wɔ nye gye, ná di ahurusi,
ofikyɛ AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri.
22Ɛmɔ, eburo ngaka, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro,
ofikyɛ ɛserɛ so ngaka aleɛ afefɛ;
mmakaa su bɛ mma,
borɔdoma ne bobe su biribiraa.
23Ɛmɔ, Sion mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye,
ná ɛmɔli AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nu ahurusi,
ofikyɛ wama asuso atikye wama ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu,
na wama bamborɔ watɔ wama ɛmɔ,
asuso ɔne bamborɔ kyɛ daa ne ala.
24Nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ne, aburoo koyi berɛ to,
na nzaa ne ngoo koyi angora nemɔ maa okobu kɔfa so.
25Na afoɛ mɔ bɔ nzomane mmɛbɛ, mmɛbɛ mbiri, ɛsaa ne aketekyire,
bɔ bɛte me koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ maa bɛwale ɛmɔ berɛ bɛɛsɛkyele nningyein ne,
ngosa ngɔfa ngosi ɛmɔ gya nu.
26Na ɛmɔkodidi paa kɔma ɛmɔ ko koyi,
ná ɛmɔaye AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dumaa ayɛ,
ofikyɛ wayɔ anwanwadeɛ wama ɛmɔ,
na me maen nyunu ngogua ase le ko.
27Ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ nwɔ Yisrael nu,
na me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ,
ebiala nne berɛ ko,
na me maen nyunu ngogua ase le.
28 Na ɛhe asi ne,
ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua anwoɔnaen amukoraa so,
na ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne ɛmɔ mma mmrasua kɔhyehyɛ ngɔm;
ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ kɔhyehye laleɛ,
na ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ konwu nyekyire;
29yeɛ ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua ngoaa mɔ ne afaneɛ mɔ so wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu.
30Ngɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ wɔ anwuro ne aseɛ so, mogya ne see ne nwosina ningɔnn. 31 Eyia kɔkakyi awosii, na ɛsraen kɔkakyi mogya koraka né AWURADE kyẽa kandinga bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne wawa. 32 Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto AWURADE dumaa so ne, okonya ye ti kodidi nu, ofikyɛ Sion bokaa so ne Yerusalem yeɛ bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne bɛkɔtena ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahã ne ala, na bɛ bɔ AWURADE frɛ bɛ ne, bɛkɔboka bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne aso.”

Title: YOEL 3
Content:
AWURADE kobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen
1Yiti tie, sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ anu ne sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bɔ ngosa ngɔfa Yuda ne Yerusalem ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa ne, 2ngɔboaboa maen maen amukoraa bɛ noa, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa Yehosafate bɔnza ne anu, na berɛ yeɛ ngɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu ɔ, ɔnate me maen ne m’agyapadeɛ Yisrael bɔ babɔ bɛ basande maen maen mɔ so, ɔne m’aseɛ bɔ bahyɛ ne ati. 3Bagua serewa bahyɛ me maen, bafa abɛɛmaa bale gyanderaniɛ, yeɛ batɔne abaayaa bale nzaa bano.
4 Ɛmɔ, Tiro ne Sidon ne Filistia mboanoa amukoraa, nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛmɔafa bali me e? Aso ɛmɔtua me nikyee bie so kerɛ anaa? Na sɛ ɛmɔtua me so kerɛ a, ye de ngɔma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ ne kɔbɔ ɛmɔ ti so ndɛndɛ so ne amirika so, 5ofikyɛ ɛmɔafa me dwetɛ ne me sikaa kɔkorɛ, na ɛmɔasoa me nningyein paa paa nyemene nemɔ baagua ɛmɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua mɔ nu. 6Ɛmɔatɔne Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ bama Helafoɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kofi b’aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ dedeede ɔ. 7Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔkanyane bɛ ngofi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔaatɔne bɛ maa bahɔ ne, na ngɔma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ ne kɔbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so. 8Ngɔtɔne ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne ɛmɔ mma mmrasua nemɔ ngɔfa bɛ ngowura Yudafoɛ sa, na bɛ koso bɛkɔtɔne bɛ bɛkɔma Sabeafoɛ bɔ bɛte maen bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede ne, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã hɔ ɛne.”
9“Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛhe dawure wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ nu kyɛ,
Ɛ́mɔhyehyɛ koɛ,
ɛ́mɔkanyane koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ.
Ɛ́mɔma koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛbɔ bepingye;
ɛ́mɔma bɛfo bɛbra.
10 Ɛ́mɔboro ɛmɔ kona mɔ bɛbɔ ngrandɛ,
ná ɛ́mɔboro ɛmɔ asɔsɔaa mɔ bɛbɔ pealɛɛ;
sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, ɔhã kyɛ, Nde anwoserɛniɛ.
11Maen maen amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔapɛ ye nwo babra bayia ɔ,
ɛ́mɔyɛ ndɛ bɛbra, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa wɔ berɛ.
Ao AWURADE, ma wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bedwu bɛbra.
12Odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛkanyane bɛ nwo
bɛba Yehosafate bɔnza ne anu,
ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ ngɔtena ngobua maen maen amukoraa
bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne ndɛen ɔ.
13 Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔfa dadeɛ koateɛ bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ buberɛ ne adwu;
ɛ́mɔdwu bɛhɔ nu, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ betwi nzaa ne wayi;
angora nemɔ bayi babu bafa so,
ofikyɛ b’amumuyɛɛ ne te piri.
14Ɛlɔen, ɛlɔen
wɔ ndɛenbualɛ bɔnza ne anu;
ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye wɔ ndɛenbualɛ bɔnza ne anu.
15Eyia ne ɛsraen bakakyi awosii,
ná nzramaa nemɔ bayakyi talɛ.
16 AWURADE bobɔ nu fi Sion,
na ɔma ye komvi so fi Yerusalem;
anwuro ne aseɛ bɛwoso,
nakoso AWURADE te ye maen anyelasoɛ,
ɔne ye mma Yisrael b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.
17“Ɔnate so ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ,
bɔ nde Sion, me bokaa krongron ne aso ne.
Afei, Yerusalem kɔyɛ nekaa krongron,
na ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔpɛ nu berɛ ko.
18 “Na sɔ kyẽa ne,
mmokaa nemɔ kɔpepe nzaa monɛ,
nyɔfonesue kɔtengyɛ wɔ pambaa nemɔ aso,
nzue kɔtengyɛ wɔ Yuda asue amukoraa nu,
na asue ti kofite wɔ AWURADE awuro ne anu
kɔɔloaloa Sitim bɔnza ne anu.
19“Misraim kɔbɔ,
na Edom kɔyɛ ɛserɛ pralaa,
ɔnate akakabenzɛm bɔ bali ye wɔ Yudafoɛ so ne ati,
ofikyɛ bahã mogya bɔ odi be ɔ bagua wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso.
20Nakoso Yuda de, ɔkɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ,
yeɛ Yerusalem kɔtena berɛ
aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.
21Bɛ mogya bɔ mandɔ so wereɛ ne, ngɔtɔ so wereɛ,
ofikyɛ AWURADE te Sion.”

Title: AMOSE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Amose fi Yuda maen nu. Né ɔte mmoaenneafoɛ ne akyea boo so hwɛsoniɛ. Yisrael hene Yeroboam bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye aberɛ so yeɛ Nyameɛ somane Amose maa ɔɔhyɛle ngɔm wɔ Yisrael maen nu ɔ. Ɛhe sili ɔ, afoɛ kɔyɛ 760 pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisrael maen ne le asomdwee, ofikyɛ né Asiria ɔmva koɛ mmandeta ye. Asa koso, né sikaa wɔ Yisrael maen ne anu, ofikyɛ né nu dwaalilɛ kɔ so yé paa. Né nu mmenia bɛso bɛ nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ. Nakoso Amose nwuni kyɛ sikafoɛ ne angome yeɛ bayɛ yé ɔ, na né sikafoɛ bɛbɔ ehiafoɛ apoo besisi bɛ. Né bemvi b’ahone nu yeɛ bɛso Nyameɛ ɔ. Amose sili ye hue bɔle ye dawure kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe Yisrael maen ne so. Osa hane kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ Yisrael nwo bayia nemɔ so. Osili ye pi kyɛ odi kyɛ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo tengyɛ wɔ Yisrael kyɛ asue bɔ ɔse ɔ (5.24). Amose hyɛle ngɔm wɔ Yisrael ahenguro Samaria, nekaa bɔ né bedi dwaa titire paa ne. Afei ɔhyɛle ngɔm wɔ Betel bɔ né ɔte bɛ Nyameɛ solɛ kuro bɔ odi mu paa ne.
Nu Dwirɛ
Nyameɛ kobua maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ Yisrael nwo bayia ne ndɛen 1.1—2.5
Nyameɛ kobua Yisrael ndɛen 2.6—6.14
Nyekyire nnu nemɔ 7.1—9.15

Title: AMOSE 1
Content:
Nyameɛ kɔhwe maen maen mɔ so
1Yuda hene Yusia aberɛ so, yeɛ Yisrael hene Yoase awa Yeroboam aberɛ so, afoɛ nyɔ koraka yeɛ aseɛ baawoso ne, Amose bɔ ɔboka Tekoa mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ aso ne, edwirɛ bɔ onwuni ye fale Yisrael nwo ne, ye ɛhe.
2Na osele kyɛ,
“AWURADE bobɔ nu fi Sion,
na ɔma ye komvi so fi Yerusalem,
aseɛ bɔ mmoaenneafoɛ benya ngaka aleɛ wɔ so ne,
odi aworabɔlɛ,
yeɛ bokaa Kamɛl ti afia ayɛ pralaa.”
Damasko nwo ngɔm
3AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Damasko ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ bafa buralɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛboro aburoo ɔ
bapɛkyɛ Gileade.
4Yiti ngɔto Hasael awuro nu see
maa ɔkɔyera Ben Hadade anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.
5Ngobubu buralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram Damasko pambim nemɔ asi ne,
na bɛ bɔ bɛte Awen bɔnza ne anu ne,
ngɔpɛ bɛ asue ngofi berɛ.
Bɔ otira hɔtɔ ne, ngotu ye ngofi Bete Eden,
na bɛkɔhye Siriafoɛ nnure bɛkɔhɔ Kire,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Gasa nwo ngɔm
6AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Gasa ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ bɛsoale mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne amukoraa
bɛfale bɛ beewurale Edom sa.
7Yiti ngɔto Gasa fasue nu see
maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.
8Ngɔpɛ Asedɔdefoɛ asue ngofi berɛ,
na bɔ otira hɔtɔ ne, ngɔpɛ ye asue ngofi Asekelɔn.
Ngɔhwe Ekron so,
na Filistifoɛ ngaa nemɔ kowuwu,”
AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Tiro nwo ngɔm
9AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Tiro ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ bɛfale mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne amukoraa beewurale Edom sa,
na bangaye aliɛmaa apam ne.
10Na ngɔto Tiro fasue nu see
maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.”
Edom nwo ngɔm
11AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Edom ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ ɔfale ngrandɛ guli oliɛma so.
Wanyɛ ye anwumvo,
ɔmane ye ahone hɔle so huli,
na ɔmane ye yaafɛlɛ piri ne hɔle so afebɔɔ.
12Yiti ngɔto Teman nu see
maa ɔkɔyera Bosra anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.”
Amon nwo ngɔm
13AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Amonfoɛ b’amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe bɛ so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛko bɛtrɛtrɛ bɛ wɛen nu ne,
bɛpakyepakyele Gileade pemvoɛ mɔ kunu.
14Yiti ngɔto Raba fasue nu see
maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ;
na gyegyeegye kɔhɔ so wɔ koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne,
ná mvrama piri atu wɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ kyẽa ne.
15Na bɛkɔhye bɛ hene ne nnure bɛkɔhɔ,
ɔne ye mbanyi mɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: AMOSE 2
Content:
Moabo nwo ngɔm
1AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Moabo ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ ɔyerale Edom hene mmowue
maa ɔtɔle nzoen.
2Yiti ngɔto Moabo nu see
maa ɔkɔyera Kiriote anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ,
na Moabo kowu wɔ bagyabagya nu,
wɔ esebɔlɛ ne totorobɛndohulɛ nu.
3Ngɔpɛ ye maenbulɛniɛ ne asue ngofi ye nu,
na ngohũhũ atitire nemɔ amukoraa ngɔboka ye so,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Yuda nwo ngɔm
4AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Yuda ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ bapo AWURADE mmeraa,
banni ye mmeraa dwirɛ so.
Bɛ nnakannaka bɔ ɔte atee bɔ bɛ nana mɔ fale so ne,
wamaa bali makyebu.
5Yiti ngɔto Yuda nu see
maa ɔkɔyera Yerusalem anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.”
Yisrael nwo ngɔm
6AWURADE nwa nyoo,
“Ɔnate Yisrael ye amumuyɛɛ nza,
eh, ɔne nna ne ati,
mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa;
ofikyɛ bɛtɔne teneneeniɛ bɛfa bede ɛdwetɛ,
yeɛ bɛtɔne ehianiɛ bɛfa bede mmaboa.
7Bɛ yeɛ betiatia ehiafoɛ ti so bɛkã bɛ ti bewura nnɛterɛ nu,
ná besisi mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ;
ebie ne ɔse bɛ ne afaneɛ ko bɛda
bɛfa begua me dumaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ.
8Ndena bɔ bafa basi bɛ berɛ awowaa ne,
bɛfa bɛsesɛ afɔleɛ bokyea biala anwo bɛda so,
na bɛtɔ mmenia bedi a, nu nzaa ne,
bɛno ye wɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ awuro.
9Nakoso Amoriniɛ bɔ ye tendenn te kyɛ sida bakaa ne,
bɔ ye nwo yɛ se kyɛ eluii ne,
nguni ye wɔ bɛ nyunu.
Nzɛkyele ye mmakaammaa wɔ anwuro,
yeɛ nzɛkyele ye ndii wɔ ye bo.
10Afei koso, nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so,
na nnili ɛmɔ nyunu mvale ɛmɔ mvale ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna,
kyɛ ɛmɔɔfa Amoriniɛ n’aseɛ ne bɛyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
11Na nyeyele ɛmɔ mma nemɔ bie nyɛle bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ,
yeɛ ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ nemɔ bie nyɛle bɛ nasiritefoɛ.
Ao Yisraelfoɛ, aso nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte ɔ?,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
12“Nakoso ɛmɔmane nasiritefoɛ nemɔ nzaa maa bɛnone,
na ɛmɔhyɛle ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ ngɔm!’
13Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔnyema ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ ase,
kyɛbɔ teaseɛnam bɔ aburoo ayi ye to ne ɔnyema kɔ ase ɔ.
14Yiti ɛnwatilɛ kɔbɔ anwonyeralɛniɛ,
anwoserɛniɛ ye anwoserɛ kotu komini,
yeɛ katakyie ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo.
15Agyaentolɛniɛ ngɔhora ngogyina ye gya so;
sona bɔ ye gya bo so yɛ nyera ne, ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo,
yeɛ pɔngɔhanɛniɛ ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo.
16Na sɔ kyẽa ne, anwoserɛfoɛ nu ahoneserɛniɛ ne,
ɔkɔnwati bɔ ye nwo la so ɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: AMOSE 3
Content:
Nyameɛ bɔ Yisrael kɔkɔ
1Ao Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he bɔ AWURADE wahã wafa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ: bɔ mahã mafa abusua amukoraa bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne nwo ɔ, kyɛ,
2“Aseɛ ye aso mmusua amukoraa,
ɛmɔ angome yeɛ mese ɛmɔ ɔ;
yiti ɔnate ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ amukoraa ne ati,
ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so.
3“Aso mmenia nyɔ bɛkora betu nu,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛnyɛ adwene ɔ?
4Aso gyata opo wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ onnyane kaka biala bɔ ɔkye ye di ɔ?
Aso gyata akrɔngrɔma kɔtea nu wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔla ɔ,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ onnyane kaka biala bɔ wahye ye ɔ?
5Aso anomaa kɔtɔ ngaen nu wɔ ase,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ aleɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ bafa basua ye ngaen ɔ?
Aso ngaen fandi fi aseɛnwo,
wɔ aberɛ bɔ wangye hwee ɔ?
6Aso behu totorobɛndo wɔ kuro so,
bɔ ɛserɛ nga berɛ ama ɔ?
Aso amaneɛ to kuro,
bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ wamaa wawa ɔ?
7Amba, AWURADE Nyameɛ ngɔyɔ nikyee biala,
bɔ ɔngɔla ye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ali ngohyire ye somvoɛ mɔ
ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ɔ.
8Gyata bobɔ nu,
na nwa yeɛ ongosuro ɔ?
AWURADE Nyameɛ adwudwo,
nwa yeɛ ɔngɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ?”
9Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure wɔ Asedɔde anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu,
yeɛ Misraim aseɛ so anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu,
ná ɛmɔhã kyɛ,
“Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa wɔ Samaria mmokaa nemɔ aso,
ɛ́mɔnea basabasa mbiri mbiri bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ nu ɔ,
ɔne nhyɛsoɛ bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ nu ɔ.”
10“Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛboaboa atianuserɛ ne awerɔm awue noa
wɔ b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ anu ne,
bɛnze kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
11Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo,
“Pɔfoɛ bie kɔpɛ aseɛ ne anwo koyia,
okole w’anwoserɛ kofi wɔ sa nu,
na ɔkɔfẽ w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu nningyein.”
12Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Kyɛbɔ mmoaenneafoɛ ɔpepɛ de agyirɛ nyɔ anaa asoɛ bue fi gyata noa nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔpepɛ bekole Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛtete Samaria wɔ mba ndweasoɛ so ne bɛen bue so ɔ.
13AWURADE Nyameɛ, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ Yakob awuro kɔkɔ kyɛ,
14“Kyẽa bɔ ngɔhwe Yisrael so wɔ ye mmeraatolɛ nwo ne,
ngɔhwe Betel afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ koso bɛ so,
na bɛkɔpepɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea mmɛen nemɔ
maa bekogua ase.
15Ngobubu prakasua mmerɛ sua ne ahuhuro mmerɛ sua nemɔ ngogua ase,
ɛsoen gye sua nemɔ kɔsɛkyesɛkye,
na awuro mbiri mbiri nemɔ kobubu kogua ase gyirigorɔɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: AMOSE 4
Content:
Samaria mmrasua
1Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔtie, Basan nandwie mmeleɛ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Samaria bokaa so ɔ,
ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so, ná ɛmɔsisi ehiafoɛ ɔ;
ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkã bekyire ɛmɔ ahu mɔ kyɛ, ‘Fa bra maa yɛno’ ɔ.
2AWURADE Nyameɛ afa ye krongronyɛlɛ wata ndaen kyɛ,
Ɛ́mɔtie, ngyẽa bie ɔba ɛmɔ so,
bɔ bɛkɔfa buralɛ koateɛ bɛkɔhwe ɛmɔ bɛkɔhɔ,
yeɛ bɛkɔfa koaa bɛkɔhwe ɛmɔ si ama mɔ bɛkɔhɔ.
3Fasue ndokuro mɔ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekofite ɔ;
ebiala kɔfa atee bɔ ɔla ye nyunu tee ɔ so,
na bekofindi ɛmɔ bekogua Hamɔn,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
4Ɛmɔbra Betel bɛɛto mmeraa,
ɛmɔbra Gilgal bɛma ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ɔyɛ pee;
ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ afɔleɛ bɛbra ngyerɛmɔ biala,
ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛbra ɛlɛsa biala.
5Ao ɛmɔ, Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔfa paanoo harewaa bɛ́bɔ asennaa afɔleɛ.
Ɛ́mɔbɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ nwo dawure,
ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́to dwaa,
ofikyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ hɔ ɛne,”
AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
6“Mmane ɛmɔ noa aleɛ bɔle ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so,
yeɛ ɛhɔen wale ɛmɔ atenaleɛ nemɔ amukoraa nu,
nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
7“Asa koso, mama esue ayakyi tɔlɛ wama ɛmɔ
wɔ aberɛ bɔ wahã bosome nza koraka né buberɛ adwu ɔ;
mama esue watɔ wagua kuro ko aso,
yeɛ mamma wandɔ wangua kuro ko aso.
Esue tɔ guale eboo ko aso,
na eboo bɔ esue wandɔ wangua so ne, nu nningyein yerale.
8Yiti nguro nyɔ anaa nza so ama behyinihyinini bɛhɔle kuro ko aso bɛɛnone nzue,
nakoso nzue ne wande bɛ;
nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
9“Mafa fieso nningyein kesenɛ ne asukuo nwo amaneɛ mato ɛmɔ so.
Mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ turo mɔ, ɛmɔ bobe boo mɔ, ɛmɔ borɔdoma mmakaa ne ɛmɔ olive mmakaa yɛle pee ne,
mmɛbɛ sɛkyele bɛ,
nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
10“Anwonyerɛ mɔ bɔ mva mmɔle Misraim ne, nzomane maa ɔɔbɔle ɛmɔ;
mvale ngrandɛ ngukuni ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ mɔ;
nzesale ɛmɔ mbɔngɔ mɔ ngɔle,
mmane ɛmɔ asikyeleɛ nu pambaen ne wurale ɛmɔ bonyi anu,
nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
11“Nnuane ɛmɔ nu biemɔ boso
kyɛbɔ me, Nyameɛ, nnuane Sodom ne Gomora bɛ boso ne.
Na né ɛmɔte kyɛ gyetia bɔ baye bafi see bɔ ogye nu ɔ,
nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
12“Ao Yisrael, yiti bɔ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ wɔ ɛhe;
ao Yisrael, ɔnate kyɛ ngɔfa ɛhe ngɔyɔ wɔ ne ati,
boaboa wɔ nwo koyia wɔ Nyameɛ.”
13Ofikyɛ tie, bɔ ɔhyehyɛle mmokaa mɔ, ná ɔbɔle mvrama ne,
ye bɔ ɔye ye ti anu adwene kyire adasa mmaa,
ɔma ngyerɛmɔ kakyi awosii,
ná otiatia aseɛ ye aso asɔneyɛɛ mɔ so ne,
ye dumaa ole AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ.

Title: AMOSE 5
Content:
Odi kyɛ Yisrael pena Nyameɛ si ate
1Ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he bɔ mékã mefa ɛmɔ nwo, bɔ ɔte awuyebɔlɛ ye.
2“Ababunu Yisrael wafi ase
bɔ ongodwɔso ko ɔ;
bapo ye wɔ ye aseɛ so,
bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔma ye so ɔ.”
3Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo,
“Kuro bɔ ɔfale koɛhonɛfoɛ apee ko hɔle koɛ ne,
ɛyaa ko yeɛ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ɔ;
yeɛ kuro bɔ ɔfale koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛyaa ko hɔle koɛ ne,
buru yeɛ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu bɛkɔha Yisrael awuro ama mɔ nu ɔ.”
4Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã kyire Yisrael awuro ama ɛhe,
“Ɛ́mɔpena me si ate, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa.
5Nnɛma ɛmɔpena Betel si ate,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Gilgal,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔpɛ nu bɛkɔ Beɛ Seba;
ofikyɛ bɛkɔhye Gilgal nnure bɛkɔhɔ amba,
yeɛ Betel kɔbɔ.”
6“Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE si ate, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa;
wamma ye sɔ a, ɔkɔwa Yosef awuro ama so kyɛ see,
na ɔkɔyera ye, bɔ ebiala nne Betel bɔ okonua ye ɔ.
7Ah, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkakyi ndɛenbualɛ turoloo maa ɔyɛ kyɛ abɔwee,
ná ɛmɔgyi tenenee bɛto ase ɔ!
8Ye bɔ ɔbɔle nzramaa kure ne Akɔtaen-ne-ye-mma,
ye bɔ ɔkakyi awosii tunn maa ɔyɛ ngyerɛmɔ,
ná ɔma eyia yɛ tunn kyɛ kɔngɔen,
ye bɔ ɔfrɛfrɛ ɛpo nu nzue,
ná ohwie gua aseɛ nyunu ne, ye dumaa ole AWURADE.
9Ye bɔ obubu anwoserɛfoɛ maa bɛyɛ mmerɛ ndɛndɛ so,
ná obubu anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ ɔ.
10Bekyi bɔ ɔtengyɛtengyɛ mmenia wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ,
bɛpɔ bɔ ɔkã nahorɛ ɔ.
11Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔsisi bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo,
ná ɛmɔbɔ bɛ apoo bede atokoɔ befi bɛ berɛ ne ati,
nyɔboɛ bɔ badwa ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔafa basisi sua ɔ,
nakoso ɛmɔngɔtena nu.
Ɛmɔayɔ bobe boo nyemene mɔ de,
nakoso ɛmɔngɔno nu bobe nzaa ne bie.
12Ofikyɛ mese ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ worawora ne,
ɔne ɛmɔ bɔne mbiri mbiri ne.
Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔteetee teneneefoɛ, ná ɛmɔde fea-ase-ma,
ná ɛmɔbua bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ndɛengyea wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ.
13Ɔnate sɔ ati, nworɛfoɛ komua bɛ noa wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu,
ofikyɛ ɔte mmerɛ tɛɛ.
14Bɔ ɔte paa mmom yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena ye si atee ɔ, na nna bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ngoa,
na AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ kogyina ɛmɔ si,
kyɛbɔ ɛmɔahã ne.
15Ɛmɔhyi bɔne ná ɛmɔhuro bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.
Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ne.
Ebiaa AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ,
okonwu Yosef boso ama ngaa nemɔ anwumvoin.
16Yiti AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, AWURADE, ɔnwa,
“Bɛkɔbɔ awuye wɔ dwaa nemɔ amukoraa so,
yeɛ bɛkɔkekã ye wɔ atimbire nemɔ amukoraa so kyɛ, ‘Ayaa! Ayaa!’
Na bɛkɔfrɛ kuafoɛ maa bekoosu,
ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛse sũ ɔ maa bɛkɔɔbɔ awuye.
17Na bɛkɔbɔ awuye wɔ bobe boo nemɔ amukoraa nu,
ofikyɛ ngɔɔpɛ nu ngɔfa wɔ nu,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
18Ɛmɔ yaakɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔnea AWURADE kyẽa ne ate ɔ!
Nzikyɛ yeɛ kyẽa ne kɔyɔ kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ?
AWURADE kyẽa ne, ɔte awosii, na ɔtte hyireinn.
19Wayɛ kyɛ sona bɔ wanwati gyata
bɔ kwabrafo waayia ye ɔ;
anaa wahɔ awuro waafa ye sa wafua fasue so,
ná ewoo aha ye ɔ.
20Aso AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔngɔyɛ awosii?
Aso ɔngɔyɛ awosii tuu bɔ hyireinn nne nu ɔ?
21Mekyi ɛmɔ aluolue nemɔ, na mebu bɛ animtia,
na me nye ngye ɛmɔ aluolue nyianu nemɔ anwo.
22Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aleɛ afɔleɛ bɛma me,
nakoso menne mendo nu;
yeɛ ɛmɔ nandwie sayɛɛ asomdwee afɔleɛ ne,
mengɔfa me nye mengɔnea.
23Fa wɔ dweintolɛ nwo gyegyegyegye ne fi me so kɔ;
ofikyɛ mengotie wɔ sangoo dwein ne.
24Na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ndɛenbualɛ turoloo tengyɛ kyɛ asue,
ná tenenee ɔsẽ kyɛ asue piri.
25“Ao Yisrael awuro ama, afoɛ aburanna bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ne, aso ɛmɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aleɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane me? 26Nakoso ɛmɔsoale ɛmɔ hene Sakute, ɔne ɛmɔ nzramaa amoen Kiyun bɔ ɛmɔayɔ bama ɛmɔ nwo ne. 27Yiti ngɔpɛ ɛmɔ asue ngɔhɔ Damasko si dɔ,”
AWURADE bɔ ye dumaa ole Asafo Nyameɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: AMOSE 6
Content:
Yisrael ahandaen nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1“Bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ wɔ Sion,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura Samaria bokaa nu ɔ,
maen maen mbanyi mɔ nu atitire mɔ
bɔ Yisrael awuro ama bɛbapena mmokalɛ befi ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ,
ɛmɔ yaakɔ!
2Ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ Kalene bɛɛnea,
na ɛmɔfi berɛ a, ɛmɔhɔ kuro piri Hamate;
afei ɛ́mɔtoro bɛhɔ Filistifoɛ kuro Gate.
Aso bɛte paa bɛtra sɔ ahennie hemɔ?
Anaa b’aseɛ te piri tra ɛmɔ aseɛ anaa?
3Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔtu kyẽa tɛɛ ne bɛhyɛ dedeede,
nakoso ɛmɔ yɔleɛ de, basabasa yeɛ ɔfa ba ɔ!
4“Ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔla mba bɔ bafa ɛsoen gye bayɔ ɔ so,
bɔ ɛmɔtwe ɛmɔ nu wɔ ɛmɔ bɛen so,
bɔ ɛmɔku mmoaen kure ne anu mmoaen akrɔngrɔma mɔ,
ɔne tuin ne anu nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bedi ɔ;
5ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔto dwein basabasa bɛfa besuro sangoo so,
ná ɛmɔyɔ edweintolɛ nningyein bɔ ɔte kyɛ Dawide deɛ ne ɔ;
6ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔno nzaa awaa bɔ wayi to,
bɔ ɛmɔfa sakyeɛfona paa bɛpopa,
nakoso ɔmva ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ Yosef ɔbɔ ɔ!
7Yiti bɛ yeɛ bekoli moa bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bɛkɔhɔ ɔ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ bɛ nu ne,
b’anigye mmorosoɛ ne ye bo kɔpɛ.”
8AWURADE Nyameɛ wata ye nwo ndaen,
(AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa),
“Yakob ye anwomasoɛ ne yɛ me tɛ,
yeɛ mekyi ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ;
yiti ngɔfa kuro ne, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa ngowura pɔfoɛ mɔ sa.
9Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ mmenia buru bɛka awuro ko anu a, bekowuwu. 10Na sɛ abusuaniɛ, bɔ ye yeɛ odi kyɛ osie fuin ne, okuku fuin ne fi awuro ne anu, na obisa ebie wɔ awuro ne akunu dɔ kyɛ, “Aso sona bieku tɛ boka wɔ so wɔ berɛ anaa” a, okobua kyɛ, “Daabi.” Na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, “Mua wɔ noa. Onni kyɛ yɛbɔ AWURADE dumaa.”
11Tie, AWURADE afa ahyɛdeɛ wama,
na bekobubu awuro piri ne bekogua gyirigorɔɔ,
ná babu sua ba ne bagua ase bɔkɔɔ.
12Aso mbɔngɔ betu amirika wɔ nyɔbotaen so anaa?
Aso bɛfa nandwie befundam berɛ anaa?
Nakoso ɛmɔama ndɛenbualɛ akakyi ɛborɔ,
yeɛ tenenee mma bakakyi anafranaku.
13Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ anwo kyɛ ɛmɔali Lodeba kuro ne aso ngonim,
bɔ ɛmɔkekã kyɛ, “Aso nna yɛ bɔbɔ y’anwoserɛ yeɛ yafa yali Karenaim so ngonim ɔ?”
14“Nakoso ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie,
ngɔma maen bie kodwɔso kotia ɛmɔ,”
AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
“Bɛkɔhyɛ ɛmɔ so fi Hamate tiwaa
koodwu Araba bɔnza ne anu.”

Title: AMOSE 7
Content:
Mmɛbɛ nwo nyekyire
1Edwirɛ he yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: Yieee, né ɔnwo mmɛbɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nningyein bɔ beluale ye nziɛ ne ɔhyɛ ye bo ofifi ɔ. (Ɔte mmerɛ bɔ sɛ bɛpɛ ngaka aleɛ bɛkɔma Nana ngaka mɔ beyie a, ndire ne bie fifi ye si ɔ). 2Na belili aseɛ ne aso ndire amukoraa beyiele nen yeɛ ngane kyɛ,
“Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, fa kyɛ!
Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Yakob wahora wagyina ye noa?
Ofikyɛ ɔte kãa paa.”
3AWURADE hwe sale,
“Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
4Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: Tie, AWURADE Nyameɛ fale see kyɛ ɔbaafa bua ndɛen. Ɔyerale buma piri ne, na ɔyerale aseɛ nekaa bie koso. 5Yeɛ ngane kyɛ,
“Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, nnɛma ɛhe ba nu!
Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Yakob wahora wagyina ye noa?
Ofikyɛ ɔte kãa paa.”
6AWURADE hwe sale:
“Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ,”
AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa ne
7Ɛhe yeɛ ɔye hyirele me ɔ: Tie, né AWURADE gyi fasue bie bɔ bafa ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa basusu bato ɔ so. Né otira ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa. 8Na AWURADE bisale me kyɛ, “Amose, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa.” Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ,
“Tie, ngɔfa ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa ngɔto me maen Yisrael b’afia,
mengobu me nye mengogua bɛ bɔne so ko.”
9Yisake asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ kɔkakyi kurofoen,
Yisrael nekaa krongron nemɔ kɔkakyi aseɛ pralaa,
na ngɔfa ngrandɛ ngɔho ngotia Yeroboam awuro ama.”
Amose ne Amasia benya dwudwolɛ wɔ Betel
10Afei Betel sɔfo Amasia tole ngraa ɔɔmane Yisrael hene Yeroboam kyɛ, “Amose abɔ wɔ nwo porɛ wɔ Yisrael awuro ama mɔ nu’. Ye noa dwirɛ ne amukoraa kɔbɔ maen ne. 11Ofikyɛ Amose nwa:
‘Yeroboam kɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa,
na bɛkɔhye Yisrael nnure bekofi bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ amba.’ ”
12Yeɛ Amasia sele Amose kyɛ, “Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛse ase ɔ, nwati kɔ Yuda aseɛ so, ma wɔ sa hã wɔ noa aleɛ wɔ dɔ, ná hyɛ ngɔm wɔ dɔ, 13na mmom nnɛhyɛ ngɔm wɔ Betel ko. Ofikyɛ berɛ te Nana nekaa krongron, na osa te ahemvie.”
14Yeɛ Amose buale Amasia kyɛ, “Me de, nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ oo, yeɛ nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ awa oo; na mmom nde mmoaenneafoɛ ne akyea mmakaa so hwɛsoniɛ, 15na AWURADE yele me maa nyakyili mmoaen so nealɛ, na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Kɔ ná kɔhyɛ ngɔm kyire me maen Yisrael.’ 16“Na afei tie AWURADE noa dwirɛ. Ɛnwa,
‘Nnɛhyɛ ngɔm tia Yisrael,
yeɛ Yisake boso ama nwo dwirɛ bɔ ɔte mayee ne, nnɛbɔ ye dawure.’
17Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo,
‘Ɛye kɔyɛ gyanderaniɛ wɔ kuro ne anu,
na wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa,
bɛkɔfa ɛwɛen bɛkɔto w’aseɛ nu bɛkɔhyɛ bɛkɔfa,
ekowu wɔ aseɛ bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ɔ so,
na amba, bɛkɔhye Yisrael nnure bekofi ye aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ.’ ”

Title: AMOSE 8
Content:
Mmakaammaa kɛndɛen nwo nyekyire
1Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: na tie, né ɔte borɔdoma bɔ waboro ɔ kɛndɛen ko. 2Obisale me kyɛ, “Amose, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Borɔdoma bɔ waboro ɔ kɛndɛen ko.” Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ,
“Me maen Yisrael, b’ayieleɛ ato bɛ.
Mengobu me nye mengogua bɛ bɔne so ko.”
3Na asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu dwein kɔkakyi awuyebɔlɛ sɔ kyẽa ne,
AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Efuin pee kogua nekaa biala;
na bekogyi bɛ bekogua nekaa biala konn!”
4Ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsisi mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ,
kyɛ ɛmɔfa so ma aseɛ ne aso ehiafoɛ bedi amia,
5ná ɛmɔkã kyɛ, “Kyinzu yeɛ ɛsraen foforɛ ne kɔpɛ nu
maa yɛkɔtɔne aburoo ɔ;
yeɛ mmerɛ beni yeɛ afofikyẽa ne kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ,
maa yɛkobukyebukye atokoɔ pata anoa nemɔ ɔ?
Yɛkosi olonka ne abo, ná yama sekel ne ayɛ piri,
ná yafa tonyi bɔ bawura nu ɔ yasisi mmenia ɔ.
6Ɛhe kɔmaa yɛkɔfa ɛdwetɛ yɛkɔtɔ ehiafoɛ,
yɛkɔfa mmaboa yɛkɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ,
ná yatɔne atokoɔ boso bɔ ɔtte mayee ne.
7AWURADE ata Yakob anwomasoɛ ne anwo ndaen kyɛ,
“Amba, me wora ngofi bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ anu biala.
8Ɔnate sɔ ati, aso aseɛ ngɔwoso anaa,
na so ama amukoraa, aso bengoli aworabɔlɛ anaa?
Aseɛ ne amukoraa kohuhu kyɛ asue Naele bɔ wayi ɔ,
bekohuruhuru ye, na afei ɔkɔhwe kyɛ Misraim asue Naele.
9Na AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne,
ngɔma eyia kɔɔtɔ eyiagyina,
na ngɔma awosii kɔwa aseɛ so eyia petee.
10Ngɔkakyi ɛmɔ poentolɛ nemɔ aworabɔlɛlilɛ,
yeɛ ɛmɔ dwein amukoraa awuyebɔlɛ;
ngɔma ebiala kɔhera ɛsɛen tena,
ná mama ebiala abɔ tikwa.
Ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ bahorɛ wue nwo aworabɔlɛlilɛ,
ayieleɛ ne kɔyɛ kyɛ aworabɔlɛ kyẽa.
11“Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba,
bɔ ngɔma ɛhɔen kandinga bie kɔwa aseɛ ne aso,
bɔ nna aleɛ hɔen ɔ, yeɛ nna nzuhɔen ɔ,
na mmom AWURADE dwirɛ tiele nwo hɔen ɔ”,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
12Mmenia kohyini kofi mboanoa bɛkɔɔhã mboanoa,
bekofi sorɔ bekoodwu eyia afiteleɛ;
bekoli akɔneaba bɛkɔpena AWURADE dwirɛ si atee,
nakoso bengonwu ye.
13Sɔ kyẽa ne, nzuhɔen kɔma ndaluwa anwonyemene ne mmerandeɛ bɛ nye so koburu bɛ.
14Bɛ bɔ bɛfa Samaria mmosoen bɛteta ndaen
bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ao Dan, kyɛ wɔ nyameɛ te ase ye e’,
yeɛ ‘Kyɛ Beɛ Seba atee te ase ye’ ne,
bekofifi ase bɔ bengodwɔso ko ɔ.”

Title: AMOSE 9
Content:
AWURADE kɔhwe ye maen so
1Nwuni AWURADE kyɛ ogyi afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, na ɔhane kyɛ,
“Bonima abotire ne, fa nikyee bɔ so maa aponnwaa nemɔ bɛwoso,
ná dwiri gua bɛ mukoraa bɛ ti so,
na ngɔfa ngrandɛ ngohũhũ bɛ bɔ baha ne’.
Bɔ ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ɔnwati biala, ɔngɔhora nwati,
yeɛ bɔ okofi nu kofite biala, ongonya ye ti ngodidi nu.
2“Sɛ betu bɔen bekodwu ɛborɔ po a,
dɔ yeɛ me sa kɔye bɛ kofi ɔ.
Sɛ bɛfo bɛkɔ nyameɛso po a,
dɔ yeɛ ngɔye bɛ ngofi ngɔwa ase ɔ.
3Sɛ bɛkɔfea Kamɛl ti afia dɔ po a,
ngɔpena bɛ ngɔye bɛ ngofi dɔ,
na sɛ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛfea me bekowura ɛpo ye bo dɔ po a,
dɔ yeɛ ngɔfa ahyɛdeɛ ngɔma ewoo maa ɔkɔkekã bɛ ɔ.
4Sɛ bɛkye bɛ nnure bɛkɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu po a,
dɔ yeɛ ngɔhyɛ ngrandɛ maa okohũhũ bɛ ɔ;
na ngotu me nye ngosie bɛ so ngɔfa bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ ngoli bɛ,
na mmom nna paa ɔ.”
AWURADE yeɛ obua wiase ndɛen ɔ
5AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ,
ye yeɛ ɔfa ye sa kã aseɛ maa ohuro,
maa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bedi aworabɔlɛ,
ná aseɛ ne amukoraa huhu kyɛ asue Naele,
ná ɔtwe kyɛ Misraim asue Naele ɔ.
6Ye bɔ osi ye aborɔsaen wɔ ewienu,
ná ɔfa ye ngatasoɛ obutu aseɛ so;
ye bɔ ɔfrɛfrɛ ɛpo nu nzue,
ná ohwie bɛ gua aseɛ ye aso ne,
ye dumaa ole AWURADE.
7“Ao Yisraelfoɛ,
ɛmɔ, aso ɛmɔ bɛtte kyɛ Yitiopiafoɛ bɛmma me anaa?
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Aso manye Yisrael mamvi Misraim aseɛ so anaa?
Aso manye Filistifoɛ mamvi Kafito,
yeɛ manye Siriafoɛ mamvi Kire anaa?
8Tie, AWURADE Nyameɛ watu ye nye wasie ahennie bɔ bɔne ali ye ti ne aso,
na ngonua ye boso ngofi aseɛ ye aso.
Nakoso mengonua Yakob awuro ama boso bɔkɔɔ,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
9“Ofikyɛ tie, ngɔfa ahyɛdeɛ ngɔma,
na ngohuhu Yisrael awuro ama so wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu,
kyɛbɔ behuhu aburoo so wɔ huhuamoa nu ɔ,
nakoso aburoo ne kaaba ko po ngɔtɔ ase.
10Me maen nu bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa;
bɛ yeɛ bɛkekã kyɛ, ‘Musue biala ngɔto yɛ anaa ɔngɔhora yɛ’ ne.
AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye ye maen Yisrael
11“Sɔ kyẽa ne, Dawide ɛtena sua bɔ watɔ ase ne,
ngɔpagya ngosie berɛ,
na ngɔpomba ye nekaa bɔ wasunzua nemɔ;
ngɔpagya bɔ wabubu wagua ase ne ngogyina berɛ,
ná masa masi ye kyɛbɔ né ɔte daa tete ne ala;
12amaa ɔnate so bafa Edom ngaa ne bayɛ bɛ deɛ,
ɔne maen maen amukoraa bɔ me dumaa la bɛ so ne bayɛ bɛ deɛ,”
AWURADE bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.
13“Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ sona bɔ ofundam aseɛ ne,
ye nwo kɔyɛ nyera kɔtra bɔ ɔte nnɔbaeɛ ɔ;
bɔ otwi bobe nzaa ne, ye nwo kɔyɛ nyera kɔtra bɔ odua mmakaammaa ɔ;
mmokaa nemɔ kɔpe nzaa menemene,
na ɔkɔtengyɛ kɔfa pambaa nemɔ amukoraa so,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
14Ngosa ngɔfa me maen Yisrael ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa,
na bekosa bɛkɔkyekye kurofoen nemɔ bɛkɔtenatena so,
bɛkɔyɛ bobe boo mɔ bɛkɔno bobe nzaa,
na bɛkɔyɛ turo mɔ bekoli nu mmakaammaa ne.
15Ngolua bɛ wɔ b’aseɛ so,
na bɛ bo ngotutu ko le ngofi b’aseɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ ne aso,”
AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: OBADIA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Obadia nwomaa he, ebiala ngora ngyire mmerɛ pɔtee bɔ bɛhyerɛle ɔ. Nakoso Babilɔnfoɛ lili Yerusalem so ngonim bɛbɔle kuro ne nen, ye si ye yeɛ bɛhyerɛle Obadia nwomaa ne ɔ. Bɛbɔle kuro ne ɔ, afoɛ 586 koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu ɔ. Nwomaa ne maa yɛnwu kyɛ Nyameɛ hwene Edom so. Edomfoɛ bɛte Yisɔ bɔ oliɛma ole Yakob ne ye boso ama (Gye 36. 9, 43). Yiti Obadia nwomaa ne anu, besa bɛfrɛ Edom maen ne Yisɔ. Ɔnate edwirɛ bɔ osili Yakob ne oliɛma Yisɔ b’afia wɔ Gyenesise nwomaa ne anu ne ati, ɛpɔen ɔɔlale bɛ boso ama nemɔ b’afia. Yiti Babilɔnfoɛ lili Yerusalem so ngonim nen, Edom lili ye nwo ahurusi, yeɛ afei bɛ ne Yerusalem pɔfoɛ nemɔ bɛyɛle ko bɛfene Yerusalem nningyein. Asa koso, Yerusalemfoɛ bɔ né bɛnwati befi koɛ ne anu ne, Edomfoɛ sili bɛ ate, yeɛ besa bɛfale Yuda aseɛ ne bie wɔ maen ne ngwaen dɔ bɛtenane so (nea Hesekiel 35). Ye sɔ ne ati, Nyameɛ bɔle Edom kwaadu kyɛ waye oliɛma Yuda wama (nea 10-11). Obadia hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ Edom koli ngoguo, na Nyameɛ kɔhwe ye ne Yuda pɔfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛ so.
Nu Dwirɛ
Nyameɛ kɔhwe Edom so 1-9
Bɔ yiti yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe Edom so ɔ 10-16
Yuda koli ngonim 17-21

Title: OBADIA 1
Content:
Nyameɛ kɔhwe Edom so
1 Nyekyire bɔ Obadia nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe:
Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ kã fa Edom nwo ole kyɛ,
Yate ngunga bie yafi AWURADE dɔ,
na wasoma ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ berɛ kyɛ,
“Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ɛ́mɔma yɛdwɔso yɛɛfa koɛ yɛteta ye.”
2Tie, mamaa ayɛ kaaba wɔ maen maen mɔ nu;
bebu wɔ animtia paa.
3W’ahone nu anwomasoɛ ne alakalaka wɔ,
wɔ bɔ ɛte nyɔbotaen ndokuro nu,
bɔ w’atenaleɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ɔ,
wɔ bɔ ɛkã ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ,
“Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhwe me kɔto ase ɔ?”
4Sɛ etu kɔ anwuro kyɛ kɔleɛ po,
ná ɛkyekye wɔ saen wɔ nzramaa mɔ anu po a,
berɛ yeɛ ngɔhwe wɔ ngofi ngɔto ase ɔ,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
5Sɛ awuefoɛ bɛba wɔ so,
sɛ awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛba wɔ so kɔngɔen a, (nea kyɛbɔ basi bayɛ wɔ pasaa ɔ!)
aso bengowua alaa bɔ bɛ kunu kuro ɔ?
Sɛ bobe telɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛba wɔ bobe boo nu a,
aso ahaa bɛngɔyakyi bobe si ne bie wɔ so?
6Kyɛbɔ basi bafẽ Yisɔ nningyein ɔ!
Kyɛbɔ basi bayɛ ye anwonyadeɛ bɔ wafa wafea ɔ dosodoso ɔ!
7Bɛ bɔ bɛ ne wɔ ayɛ apam ne amukoraa, baye wɔ bama,
bafoa wɔ baadwu ɛwɛen ne aso;
bɛ bɔ bɛ ne wɔ tu nu ne, bali wɔ so ngonim;
wɔ mmango bɔ bedi wɔ aleɛ ne, basua wɔ ngaen,
nakoso annya ye nwo adwene biala.
8Sɔ kyẽa ne, aso mengohũhũ nworɛfoɛ mengofi Edom,
yeɛ nimdeɛfoɛ mengofi Yisɔ bokaa so?
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
9Ao Teman, w’anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ bɛ so,
amaa ɔnate so sona biala bɔ ofi Yisɔ bokaa so ne, ɔkɔtɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa.
Bɔ yiti yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe Edom so ɔ
10Ɔnate atianuserɛ bɔ ɛbɔle eliɛma Yakob ne ati,
animguaseɛ kobia wɔ,
na wɔ boso konua afebɔɔ.
11Sɔ kyẽa ne, egyinane nekaa bie yele wɔ nye,
sɔ kyẽa bɔ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ sesale ye anwonyadeɛ bɛhɔle ne,
bɔ amanvrafoɛ bewurale ye pambim mɔ nu,
ná beguale serewa bɛhyɛle Yerusalem bɛfale ne,
wɔ koso eli tole bɛ so.
12Nakoso ahaa onni kyɛ wɔ nye gye wɔ eliɛma n’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne anwo,
yeɛ ahaa onni kyɛ edi ahurusi wɔ Yuda mma
bɔ né bekũkũ bɛ ne anwo.
Afei ahaa onni kyɛ ɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ,
wɔ b’aworabɔlɛ kyẽa ne anwo.
13Ahaa onni kyɛ ewura me maen pambim ne anu,
wɔ kyẽa bɔ edwirɛ tole bɛ ne anu;
amba, ahaa onni kyɛ edi ahurusi ɛnea b’aworabɔlɛlilɛ ne
wɔ kyẽa bɔ edwirɛ tole bɛ ne anu,
yeɛ ahaa onni kyɛ ɛfẽ bɛ nningyein fa
wɔ kyẽa bɔ edwirɛ tole bɛ ne anu.
14Ahaa onni kyɛ egyina ngwandaa ne aso,
kyɛ ekũkũ ye mmenia bɔ bɛnwatili nemɔ;
yeɛ ahaa onni kyɛ ɛye bɛ bɔ baha nemɔ ma bɛ,
wɔ aworabɔlɛ kyẽa ne anu.
15Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye wɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛ so.
Kyɛbɔ ayɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ wɔ ɔ;
wɔ yɔleɛ kɔbɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ ti so.
16Ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔano nzaa wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso ne,
sɔ ala yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔno ɔ;
