amba, bɛkɔno, bɛkɔbo sram,
na bɛ boso konua bɔkɔɔ.
17Nakoso Sion bokaa so yeɛ bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne bɛkɔtena ɔ;
berɛ kɔyɛ krongron,
na Yakob boso ama bɛ sa kɔhã b’agyapadeɛ.
18Yakob boso ama kɔyɛ see,
Yosef boso ama kɔyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ,
na Yisɔ boso ama de, bɛkɔyɛ ngyɛngyɛma,
na bɛkɔsɔ wɔ bɛ nu bɛkɔyera bɛ.
Yisɔ boso ama biala ngɔha,
ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã hɔ ɛne.
19Ngwaen dɔ ama kɔfa Yisɔ bokaa ne bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ,
na aseɛ pralaa ne aso ama kɔfa Filistifoɛ aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ;
bɛkɔfa Efraim aseɛ ne Samaria aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ,
na Benyamin kɔfa Gileade kɔyɛ ye deɛ.
20Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle ne,
bɛ lɔen ne kɔɔfa Kanaan aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ koodwu Sarefate;
na Yerusalemfoɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle bɔ bɛwɔ Sefarade ne,
bɛkɔɔfa ngwaen dɔ nguro nemɔ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.
21Na defoɛ mɔ kɔfo kɔhɔ Sion bokaa so
bɛkɔɔyɛ Yisɔ bokaa ne aso maenbulɛfoɛ,
na ahennie ne kɔyɛ AWURADE deɛ.

Title: YONA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Yona Nwomaa ne, nzonzoleɛ la ye ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwomaa ngaa nemɔ b’afia. Ofikyɛ yɛnwu kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yona yɛle Nyameɛ so asoserɛ. Nyameɛ somane ye kyɛ ɔɔbɔ ye dwirɛ ne dawure wɔ Asiriafoɛ ahenguro Ninewe, nakoso wanguro kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ ɔ. Afei koso ɔhale ye ngome a, ahaa Ninewefoɛ bandie Nyameɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa somane ye ne. Nwomaa ne kã edwirɛ bɔ ɔtole ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yona bɔ ɔyɛle Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo asoserɛ ne. Ɛhe sili ɔ, afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nzoo pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Asiriafoɛ baho bali ahennie pee so ngonim, bɔ Yisrael boka so ɔ. Né bɛhyɛ maen maen nemɔ so. Yona anguro kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ kɔɔbɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure wɔ Ninewe ɔ, ofikyɛ né ode di kyɛ Ninewefoɛ bɛte edwirɛ ne ná bɛsakyera a, Nyameɛ ngɔhwe bɛ so. Nziɛ ye, ole ɛyaa hɔle Ninewe ɔɔhane Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne. Ninewefoɛ bɛsakyerale. Ɛhe yɛle Yona yea paa maa ɔfɛle yaa hahii.
Nwomaa ne anu, yɛnwu kyɛ Nyameɛ hyirehyirele Yona maa onwuni kyɛ bɛnnwati Nyameɛ bo. Yɛsa yɛnwu kyɛ Nyameɛ le ɔdɔ, ɔse anwumvoin, na onguro kyɛ kuro sona biala kowu wɔ ye bɔne nu ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Nyameɛ soma Yona, na Yona yɛ asoserɛ 1.1-17
Yona nu ye nwo, na Nyameɛ pepɛ de ye 2.1-10
Yona kã Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne wɔ Ninewe 3.1-10
Nyameɛ nwu Ninewefoɛ anwumvoin 4.1-11

Title: YONA 1
Content:
Yona yɛ Nyameɛ somanɛ nwo asoserɛ
1 Na AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Amitae awa Yona kyɛ, 2“Dwɔso kɔ Ninewe, sɔ kuro piri ne aso, ná bɔ ye dawure kyire bɛ kyɛ b’amumuyɛɛ wafo waadwu me nyunu.” 3Nakoso Yona dwɔsole kyɛ ɔnwati fi AWURADE nyunu ɔkɔ Tasise. Ɔhɔle Yopa, na onwuni ɛlɛen bie bɔ ɔkɔ Tasise ɔ. Yiti otuale ye ɛlɛen sikaa ne, na ɔfo ɔtenane nu kyɛ ɔnwati fi AWURADE nyunu ɔne bɛ kɔ Tasise.
4Nakoso AWURADE somane mvrama bie bɔ ye noa yɛ hye ɔ maa otu fale ɛpo ne aso, na mvrama piri tu fale ɛpo ne aso, bɔ né ɛlɛen ne ɔpena odwudwa ɔ. 5Afei né ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ besuro. Yiti bɛ nu biala sũ frɛle ye nyameɛ, na befindini ɛlɛen ne anu nningyein beguale ɛpo ne anu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛlɛen ne anu kɔyɛ nyera ɔ. Nakoso Yona de, né wadwu wahɔ ɛlɛen ne akunu dɔ paa waala hatee. 6Yiti ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ so panyi ne wale ye berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, Hei! Wɔ bɔ alafe hatee ɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena kyire ye? Dwɔso, sũ frɛ wɔ nyameɛ, na ebiaa nyameɛ ne kɔdwene yɛ nwo ná yanwuwu. 7Yeɛ besisele bɛ nwo bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛgua serewa, amaa ɔnate so yanwu sona horɛ bɔ ye ti yeɛ sɔ musue he wato yɛ ye.” Yiti beguale serewa, na serewa ne yele Yona. 8Yeɛ besele ye kyɛ, “Yɛsrɛ wɔ, nikye horɛ bɔ ye ti yeɛ musue he ato yɛ ne, kã kyire yɛ. Nzikyɛ adwuma yeɛ ɛyɔ ɔ? Efi nisua? Efi maen beni aso? Wɔ si fi ni?” 9Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Me, nde Hebriniɛ. Mesɔne AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ɛpo ne aseɛ wosee ne.’” 10Na afei mmenia nemɔ surole paa, na besele ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ayɔ sɔ nikyee ye?” Né mmenia nemɔ banwu kyɛ wanwati wafi AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ né wahã wahyire bɛ.
11Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ wɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛpo ne kɔla dinn kɔma yɛ ɔ? Ofikyɛ né ɛpo ne tɛ gu so obu fa so. 12Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me so, ɛ́mɔfindi me bɛto ɛpo ne anu, na ɛpo ne kɔla dinn kɔma ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɔnate me ti yeɛ mvrama piri he otu fa ɛmɔ ti anwo ye.” 13Nakoso mmenia nemɔ bɔle bɛ nwo mmɔden biala kyɛ bɛkã ɛlɛen ne bekodwu etii so, nakoso bangora, ofikyɛ né ɛpo ne tɛ gu so obu fa so oyia bɛ. 14Yiti bɛteane nu besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, akoaa he wue ne, nnɛmaa yiti yɛwuwu, yeɛ nnɛmaa yɛdi mogya bɔ odi be ɔ nwo fɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ, AWURADE, bɔ ekuro yeɛ ayɔ ɔ.” 15Yiti bɛmane Yona so begyili ye bɛtole ɛpo ne anu, na ɛpo ne yakyili ebulɛ bɔ obu fa so ne. 16Yeɛ mmenia nemɔ surole AWURADE paa, na bɛbobɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE, na bɛbobɔle ye anohoba.
17 Na AWURADE siesiele tiré kandinga bie maa ɔmene Yona. Na Yona lili ɛlɛsa eyia ne kɔngɔen wɔ tiré ne kunu.

Title: YONA 2
Content:
Yona bɔ mbaeɛ
1Yeɛ Yona bɔle mbaeɛ hyirele AWURADE ye Nyameɛ wɔ tiré ne akunu dɔ kyɛ,
2“Nzu mvrɛle AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu,
na otiele me;
ndeane nu mvili ɛborɔ kunu dɔ,
na etiele me sufrɛ.
3Ofikyɛ egyili me tole buma nu, wɔ ɛpo afia,
na nzue bɔ wayi ne pɛle me nwo yiale;
w’asorɔkye amukoraa ne wɔ nzue wuruwuru ne,
obu fale me so.
4Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, ‘Afoa me afi wɔ nyunu,
nakoso ngosa ngɔto me nye ngɔnea w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne.’
5Nzue ne pɛle me nwo bra yiale oodwuli me kra po,
buma ne mene me,
yeɛ ɛpo nu ndire brabrale me ti.
6Ndwu ngɔle mmokaa nemɔ abo dɔ paa,
ndwu ngɔle aseɛ ne aso;
aseɛ bɔ ye mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye pambim mɔ asi ne,
ɔhane me miane afebɔɔ ne.
Nakoso ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ,
ɛyele me ngoa fili ɛborɔ kumaa nu dɔ fite wale.
7Na mmerɛ bɔ me kra botole wɔ me nu ne,
ngayele AWURADE,
na me mbaeɛ dwuli wɔ berɛ,
wɔ w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu.
8Bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne mmosoen bɔ bɛtte huu ne,
bɛpo bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwumvoinnwunɛ.
9Nakoso ngɔfa asennaa komviɛ
ngɔbɔ afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ.
Ngotua m’aboadeɛ bɔ maboa ne.
AWURADE berɛ yeɛ ngoalelɛ fi ɔ!”
10Yeɛ AWURADE dwudwo hyirele tiré ne, na ɔɔfele Yona tole etii so.

Title: YONA 3
Content:
Ninewefoɛ nya adwenesakyera
1Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yona ye pɛen nyɔ so kyɛ, 2“Dwɔso kɔ Ninewe, sɔ kuro piri ne aso, ná kɔbɔ edwirɛ bɔ méka mékyire wɔ ne dawure kyire bɛ.” 3Yiti Yona dwɔsole sili nu hɔle Ninewe, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hã hyirele ye ne ala. Né Ninewe te kuro piri paa, bɔ ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛfa bɛnate befi ye ti bɛkɔka ye ti ɔ. 4 Yona hyɛle ye bo owurale kuro ne anu, ɔnatele ɛlɛho, na ɔteane nu sele kyɛ, “Waha eleburanna né Ninewe abɔ oo!” 5Yeɛ Ninewefoɛ belele Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne belili. Bɛfa bɛtole dwaa kyɛ odi kyɛ ebiala obua da, na bɛherale ɛsɛen tena, ofi atitirefoɛ mɔ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu kwahweabaa mɔ so.
6Na Ninewe hene tele edwirɛ bɔ wasi nen, ofili ye ahennie bia so dwɔsole, odwale ye ataadeɛ aguasoɛ guale, ɔfale ɛsɛen tena herale, na ɔtenane nzoen nu. 7Afei ɔmaa bɛbɔle ye dawure bɛfa bɛtole dwaa wɔ Ninewe kyɛ, “Nana ne ye mbanyi mɔ bahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ, Nnɛma kuro sona anaa kaka, nandwie anaa boaen biala ɔfa nikye fee kã ye noa. Onni kyɛ bedidi, anaa bɛno nzue. 8Ɔsɛ kyɛ mmenia ne ngaka bɛkera ɛsɛen tena, ná bɛyere bɛ nwo besu bɛfrɛ Nyameɛ. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala yakyi ye bɔne yɔleɛ ɔne ye aminɛlilɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye so ne. 9 Ebie nze, ebiaa Nyameɛ kɔsesã ye adwene ná wayakyi ye yaafɛlɛ piri ne, amaa ɔnate so yɛ boso wannua.”
10Na Nyameɛ nwuni bɔ bɛyɔle ne, kyɛ bayakyi bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne, yiti Nyameɛ sesane ye adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɔhane kyɛ ɔkɔprapra kogua bɛ so ne anwo, na wamma wando bɛ.

Title: YONA 4
Content:
Yona ɛyaafɛlɛ ne Nyameɛ mmuayɛɛ
1Nakoso edwirɛ ne anyɛ Yona fɛ koraa, na ɔfɛle yaa hahii. 2 Na ɔbɔle mbaeɛ bisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né nwɔ me maen nu ne, aso nna edwirɛ he yeɛ ngane ɔ? Ye sɔ ti yeɛ nwatili kyɛ ahaa mekɔ Tasise ne, ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛdo mmenia ná ɛse anwumvoin ɔ, w’ahone nhu ndɛ, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔte piri, na ɛsesã w’adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɛbaafa ba ɔ nwo. 3 Na afei, ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, de me ngoa fi me sa nu, ofikyɛ ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ngowu tra kyɛ ngɔtena ngoa nu ɔ.” 4Yeɛ AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Aso ɔte paa kyɛ ɛfɛ yaa ɔ?” 5Yiti Yona fili kuro ne anu, na ɔɔtenane kuro ne eyia afiteleɛ so. Ɔbɔle asese wɔ berɛ, na ɔtenane ye bo fɔnwoo ne abo, kyɛ ɔnea bɔ ɔkɔto kuro ne ɔ.
6Na AWURADE Nyameɛ siesiele ngomvo bakaa bie maa onyi katale Yona so, kyɛ ɔyɛ fɔnwoo ɔkata ye ti so, ná ɔye ye ofi ye amaneɛ ne anu. Yiti Yona nye gyele ngomvo bakaa ne anwo paa. 7Nakoso aleɛ hyene bɔ eyia opukye ne, Nyameɛ siesiele anyinaboa bie maa olili ngomvo bakaa ne maa bakaa ne wuli. 8Na eyia pukyele ne, Nyameɛ somane eyia afiteleɛ mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ bie; eyia ne bɔle Yona ti afia maa ɔyɛle mmerɛ, bɔ ɔhale ye ngome a ahaa né wawu ɔ. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ngowu tra kyɛ ngɔtena ngoa nu ɔ.”
9Yeɛ Nyameɛ bisale Yona kyɛ, “Aso ɔte paa kyɛ ngomvo bakaa ne ati ɛfɛ yaa ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Yoo, odi kyɛ mefɛ yaa bɔ mewu po a ahaa mekuro ɔ.” 10Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Ngomvo bakaa bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛfɛle ye nwo, bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa onyini ɔ, bɔ oogyinane berɛ kɔngɔen, ná owuli kɔngɔen ne, ye po anwu ye anwumvoin. 11Na Ninewe, sɔ kuro piri ne, bɔ nu mmenia bɛ somaa bo apee ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ, bɔ bɛnze bɛ sa bɛen ne bɛ sa famaa nu nzonzoleɛ, kuro bɔ nyɛmmoa pee wɔ nu ne, aso onni kyɛ menwu ye anwumvoin anaa’?”

Title: MIKA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Mika hyɛle ngɔm mmerɛ bɔ Yesaya hyɛle ngɔm ne ala, kɔyɛ afoɛ 700 bɔ ɔkɔ 740 koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Asiriafoɛ bɛ́fa koɛ benwunanwuna Yisrael ne Yuda. Belili Yisrael so ngonim bɛsɛkyele ye ahenguro Samaria. Né Yuda ahenguro Yerusalem koso wakakyi bɔnefoɛ kuro. Mika nwa musue ne amaneɛ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Amose hyɛle ye nwo ngɔm bɔ ɔtole Yisrael ne, sɛ Yudafoɛ banzakyera b’adwene a, ebie kɔto bɛ (4.10). Nwomaa ne anu, Nyameɛ bɔ ye mmenia kwaadu (6.1-4). Kwaadu titire ne bie ole asisie, nhyɛsoɛ, fea-ase-ma lelɛ ɔne ndɛengyea bualɛ. Né maenbulɛfoɛ, ndɛenbualɛfoɛ, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne asɔfo yeɛ bedi kwaadu ne nwo fɔ titire paa ɔ (3.1-12). Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ biemɔ koso bedwɔso betiale Mika.
Mika hyɛ ngɔm kyɛ kyẽa bie, Ɛhene piri bie kɔwa bɔ ɔte Dawide bosoniɛ, bɔ bɛkɔwo ye wɔ kuro kaaba Betlehem so ɔ. Na sɔ hene ne kɔma maen ne konya asomdwee (5.2-5a).
Nu Dwirɛ
Nyameɛ kobua Yisrael ne Yuda ndɛen 1.1—3.12
Maen ne kosa konya asomdwee 4.1—5.15
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne anyelasoɛ 6.1—7.20

Title: MIKA 1
Content:
Nyameɛ baabua wiase ndɛen
1 AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Moreseteniɛ Mika, wɔ Yuda ahemvo Yotam, Ahase ne Hesekia b’aberɛ so, bɔ onwuni ye fale Samaria ne Yerusalem nwo ne, ye ɛhe.
2 Ɛ́mɔtie, maen maen mɔ amukoraa;
ao aseɛ ne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa,
ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie,
mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ooli adanzeɛ otia ɛmɔ;
kyɛ AWURADE ófi ye asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu yeɛ ɔ́yɔ sɔ ɔ.
3Ofikyɛ tie, AWURADE fi ye atenaleɛ berɛ ɔ́ba,
na okodwu kɔwa kootiatia aseɛ so asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.
4Mmokaa nemɔ kohuro wɔ ye gya bo,
na bɔnza nemɔ nu kodwudwa
kyɛ amena bɔ ɔla see nye ɔ,
kyɛ nzue bɔ bahwie bagua nekaa bɔ ɔtorotoro ɔ.
5Ɛhe amukoraa ɔnate Yakob mmeraatolɛ ti ɔ,
yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama bɛ bɔne ti ɔ.
Yakob mmeraatolɛ ole beni?
Aso nna Samaria ɔ?
Yeɛ Yuda asɔneyɛɛ mɔ ole beni?
Aso nna bɛ ole Yerusalem?
6Yiti ngɔma Samaria kɔkakyi kurofoen wɔ eburo,
ɔne aseɛ bɔ bɛyɛ so bobe boo ɔ.
Ngodwiri ye nyɔboɛ mɔ ngogua bɔnza ne anu,
ná mama ye fapem mɔ nwo alela berɛ.
7Bɛkɔnyoko ye amoen nemɔ amukoraa pasapasa,
ná bafa see bayera ye adwuma akatuaa amukoraa.
Ngɔsɛkyesɛkye ye mmosoen amukoraa bɔkɔɔ,
ofikyɛ gyanderafoɛ akatuaa yeɛ ɔfa onyane bɛ ɔ,
na bekosa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ gyanderafoɛ akatuaa.
8Na ɛhe ati, ngosu ngɔbɔ awuye;
ngɔye me gya ngogua ase ngɔye me nwo ngɔto so;
ngɔbɔ awuye kyɛ ɛserɛ so ngyea,
ná mali aworabɔlɛ kyɛ patue.
9Ofikyɛ ye ngena nemɔ te kenangɔ;
waadwu Yuda,
waadwu me maen bɛ pambim ne anoa,
waadwu Yerusalem.
10Nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ so wɔ Gate,
nnɛma ɛmɔsu koraa;
ɛ́mɔmunumunu bɛ nwo wɔ mvuture nu wɔ Bete Leafra.
11Ɛmɔ, Safirefoɛ, ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ
bɔ ɛmɔ nwo so ná animguaseɛ ahã ɛmɔ ɔ;
Saananfoɛ de, bamvite bamma;
Bete Esel bɔ awuye, na ɔkɔye ye sa kofi ɛmɔ bo.
12Ofikyɛ Marotefoɛ
bɛtole bɛ bo ase bɛnwondɛle mmerɛ paa;
nakoso amaneɛnwunɛ yeɛ ofili AWURADE berɛ
wale Yerusalem pambim ne anwo berɛ ɔ.
13Lakisefoɛ,
ɛ́mɔfa teaseɛnam bɛsosɔ kaka anwonyeralɛ ne:
ye yeɛ ɔte bɔne bohyɛlɛ ma Sion awa brasua ne ɔ,
ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ benwuni Yisrael mmeraatolɛ ɔ.
14Yiti odi kyɛ ɛfa akyɛdeɛ ma Moresete Gate,
na Akisibofoɛ kɔyɛ nnakannaka mmenia kɔma Yisrael ahemvo.
15Na ɛmɔ, Maresafoɛ,
ngosa ngɔfa koliagyaa ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ;
na Yisrael animnyam ne kɔwa Adulam.
16Tete wɔ ti ná bɔ tikwa,
ɔnate wɔ mma bɔ bɛmaa enya anika ne ati;
ma wɔ tikwa ne ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛpɛtɛ deɛ,
ofikyɛ bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bekofi wɔ nwo bɛkɔhɔ.

Title: MIKA 2
Content:
Nhyɛsoɛfoɛ, bɛ yaakɔ
1Bɛ bɔ besusu amumuyɛɛ nwo,
ná bɛdwene bɔne nwo wɔ bɛ bɛen so ne, bɛ yaakɔ!
Aleɛ kye a, bɛyɔ sɔ,
ofikyɛ ye nwo tumi wura bɛ sa.
2Bɛ nye boro eboo mɔ, na bɛfa bɛ tumi bedide,
yeɛ bɛ nye boro awuro mɔ, na bede bɛfa,
yiti bɛhyɛ ebie ne ye awuro ama so,
yeɛ ebie ne ye agyapadeɛ koso so.
3Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo:
Tie, medwene kyɛ ngɔprapra musue ngogua abusua he aso,
bɔ ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔye ye nyamaa bengofi ɛmɔ kɔme ɔ;
yeɛ ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔnate bɛngɔmoma bɛ bati so,
ofikyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne te mmerɛ tɛɛ.
4Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekobu anyandera bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ nwo,
ná basu babɔ awuye yeayea bahã kyɛ,
“Edwirɛ piri ato yɛ oo!
Wafa me maen agyapadeɛ ne bie oo!
Nea kyɛbɔ wale wafi me sa nu ɔ!
Wahyɛ yɛ boo mɔ wama bɛ bɔ bahye yɛ nnure ne.
5Yiti ɛmɔngonya ebiala bɔ okogua serewa kɔfa nyamaa kɔhyɛ aseɛ ne
wɔ AWURADE asafo nu ɔ.
6Bese bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm nemɔ kyɛ,
“Nnɛma ɛmɔhyehyɛ ngɔm,
nnɛma ebiala hyɛ ɛhemɔ nwo ngɔm kyire bɛ,
amaa ɔnate so animguaseɛ anga yɛ.”
7Ao Yakob boso ama, aso odi kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ,
AWURADE Sunzum ne, aso olle aboterɛ anaa?
Aso ye sa noa adwuma ɛhe?
Aso me dwirɛ onziezie sona bɔ ye bra tengyɛ ɔ?
8Na ɛlɛsa ye, ɛmɔadwɔso batia me maen kyɛ pɔfoɛ,
na bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu konn, bɔ bɛte mmenia bɔ benguro koɛ ne,
ɛmɔpuro bɛ ndaadeɛ aguasoɛ.
9Me maen mmrasua nemɔ, ɛmɔatu bɛ bafi b’awuro nyemenenyemene nemɔ anu,
na ɛmɔale m’animnyam
bafi bɛ mma mɔ sa nu afebɔɔ.
10Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ná ɛmɔhɔ,
ofikyɛ nna ɛwa yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔde bɛ nwome ɔ;
ofikyɛ ɛwa nwo agua fiɛ,
na okohũ ɛmɔ ewue yealɛ paa.
11Sɛ ebie nate ɔkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen ne ngondombo dwirɛ
kyɛ, “Ngɔhyɛ nzaa ne nzaa serɛ nwo ngɔm ngohyire wɔ” a,
ye yeɛ bekobu ye kyɛ ɔte maen ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ɔ.
12Ao, Yakob, ngɔboa ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔ noa amba,
amba, ngɔboa Yisrael ngaa ne bɛ noa;
ngɔhã bɛ ngɔbɔ nu kyɛ Bosra mmoaen,
kyɛ mmoaen kure bɔ begua bɛ tuin nu ɔ,
na bɛkɔyɛ dede pee,
ɔnate kyɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛsone ne ati.
13Bɔ odwiri ɛwaen gua ne, ɔkɔfo koli bɛ nyunu moa;
bele amirika yiridididi bɛkɔfa pambim ne anu,
bɛkɔfa nu bekofite bɛkɔhɔ.
Bɛ hene ne, ɔkɔsẽ koli bɛ nyunu,
na AWURADE yeɛ okotua bɛ noa ɔ.

Title: MIKA 3
Content:
Nyameɛ bua Yisrael mbanyi ndɛen
1Na ngane kyɛ,
Ao, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔtie oo, Yakob atitire
ne Yisrael awuro ama mbanyi.
Aso nna ɛmɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea kyɛ ndɛen turoloo kɔyɛ adwuma ɔ?
2Nakoso ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkyi paa, ná ɛmɔkuro bɔne ɔ,
ɛmɔwɔngye me maen bɛ nwo wereɛ,
ɔne bɛ nwonaen fi bɛ mmowue nwo ɔ;
3ɛmɔdi me mmenia nwonaen,
na ɛmɔpuro bɛ nwonaen befi bɛ nwo,
ɛmɔbubu bɛ mmowue nu,
ɛmɔpepɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi,
kyɛ bɛfa begua kukue nu ɔ,
kyɛ naen bɔ ogua turonzemaa nu ɔ.
4Afei bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ AWURADE,
nakoso ɔngɔtɛ bɛ so.
Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔkɔye ye nye kɔfea bɛ,
ofikyɛ bɛ yɔleɛ te bɔne.
5Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛma me maen di makyebu,
bɔ ɛma bɛ aleɛ maa bedi a bɛkekã kyɛ, “Asomdwee oo, asomdwee oo”,
nakoso sɛ ebie amma bɛ aleɛ maa banni a, bɛfa koɛ bɛtoa ye ne,
bɔ AWURADE kã fa bɛ nwo ɛne.
6Yiti aleɛ kɔsã ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔngonwu nyekyire biala ɔ,
awosii kɔto ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔngɔhyɛ ngɔm biala ɔ.
Eyia bɔ ɔta ma ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne ɔkɔɔtɔ,
na alehyeleɛ kɔkakyi bɛ so awosii tunn.
7Bɛ bɔ bɛse ase ne, bɛ nyunu kogua ase,
na ngonyaayelɛfoɛ kɔfɛre;
amba, bɛ mukoraa bekomua bɛ noa,
ofikyɛ mmuayɛɛ biala mvi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔmma.
8Nakoso me de, AWURADE Sunzum ama me tumi,
wama ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne anwoserɛ ayi me tɛkyɛ,
kyɛ mva Yakob ye mmeraatolɛ ndo ye nyunu,
ná mva Yisrael koso ye bɔne ndo ye nyunu.
9Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔtie, Yakob awuro atitire,
yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama mbanyi
bɔ ɛmɔkyi ndɛenbualɛ turoloo,
ná ɛmɔkyea pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ amukoraa ɔ,
10ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔnate mogya hã gualɛ so bɛkyekye Sion,
ná ɛmɔfa amumuyɛɛ so bɛkyekye Yerusalem ɔ.
11Bɛ nu mbanyi mɔ bede fea-ase-ma bebua ndɛengyea,
nu asɔfo mɔ koso bɛyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bede paa,
yeɛ nu ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛhyɛ ngɔm bede sikaa’.
Nakoso bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so bɛkã kyɛ,
“Aso AWURADE oggyi yɛ si?
Musue biala ngɔto yɛ.”
12 Yiti ɔnate ɛmɔ ti,
bekofundam Sion kyɛ eboo;
Yerusalem kɔkakyi esire sire,
na bokaa bɔ awuro ne gyi so ne, ɔkɔkakyi ɛhɔayeɛ nu asɔneyɛɛ.

Title: MIKA 4
Content:
Nyameɛ gyi Yerusalem si
(Yesaya 2.2-4)
1Nakoso ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu,
bokaa bɔ AWURADE awuro ne gyi so ne,
okotimu kɔyɛ tendenn paa wɔ mmokaa nemɔ anu,
na ɔkɔhɔ anwuro kɔtra pambaa nemɔ.
Mmenia kotu bi bɛkɔhɔ so,
2na maen maen pee kɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔbra maa yɛfo yɛhɔ AWURADE bokaa ne aso,
yɛhɔ Yakob Nyameɛ n’awuro berɛ,
amaa ɔnate so wahyirehyire yɛ ye atee,
ná yanate ye atimbire so.”
Ofikyɛ Sion yeɛ mmeraa ne kofi kɔwa ɔ,
na AWURADE dwirɛ ne kofi Yerusalem yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ.
3 Okoli maen maen pee b’afia dwirɛ,
na okohwi maen maen anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede ɔ bɛ nyunu.
Bɛkɔboro bɛ ngrandɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ kona,
ná baboro bɛ pealɛɛ bafa babɔ asɔsɔaa.
Maen bie ngɔhwe obiɛngo maen so ngrandɛ,
yeɛ bengosua koɛhonɛ ko.
4 Ebiala kɔtena ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma bakaa bo,
na ebiala ngonwunanwuna bɛ,
ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE bɔbɔ yeɛ wate ye noa wahã ɔ.
5Ofikyɛ amaen maen amukoraa, bɛ nu biala
nate wɔ ye nyameɛ dumaa nu,
nakoso yɛ de, yɛkɔnate AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu afebɔɔ.
6Na sɔ kyẽa ne,
ngɔboaboa mmubuafoɛ mɔ noa,
na ngɔboaboa bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue mɔ noa,
ɔne bɛ bɔ mafa bɛ mafa yealɛ nu ɔ bɛ noa,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
7Na ngɔma mmubuafoɛ nemɔ kɔyɛ mmenia bɔ baha ɔ,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ anwoserɛ maen;
na AWURADE koli bɛ so hene wɔ Sion bokaa so kekesaala ye ne afebɔɔ.
8Na wɔ, mmoaen kure abandenden,
Sion awa brasua anwoserɛ afealeɛ,
wɔ berɛ yeɛ tumililɛ bɔ oli moa ne kɔwa ɔ;
ahennie ne kɔwa Yerusalem awa brasua berɛ.
9Na afei, nzu ati yeɛ esu serɛserɛ ye?
Aso ɛhene biala nne wɔ nu anaa?
Aso wɔ foɛtulɛniɛ wawu anaa,
bɔ enwu yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ aworɛ ahã ye e?
10Ao Sion awa brasua,
pene ná twe wɔ nwo kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ,
ofikyɛ afei de, ekofi kuro ne anu kɔhɔ kɔɔtena eburo;
na ɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn,
berɛ yeɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole wɔ ɔ;
berɛ yeɛ AWURADE kɔpɔ wɔ kofi wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu ɔ.
11Na afei koso, maen maen pee
baboa bɛ noa badwɔso batia wɔ.
Bɛnwa, “Yɛpena kyɛ ye nwo gua fiɛ,
ná yɛbɔ yɛ nye afɔleɛ wɔ Sion amaneɛnwunɛ ne anwo.”
12Nakoso bɛ de,
bɛnze AWURADE adwene,
yeɛ bɛnde ye nhyehyɛleɛ bo,
ofikyɛ ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa kyɛ ɛmo bɔ bakyekye ye tire tire bagua nekaa bɔ bɛboro ɛmo ɔ.
13Ao Sion awa brasua,
dwɔso ná boro,
ofikyɛ wɔ mmɛen ne, ngɔyɛ ye buralɛ,
yeɛ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya mmaboa ne koso kɔɔbere,
na ɛkɔfa kɔsɛkye maen pee pasapasa.
Ngotu b’anwonyadeɛ ngosie berɛ ngɔma AWURADE,
yeɛ ngotu b’agyapadeɛ ngosie berɛ ngɔma aseɛ amukoraa Mene ne.

Title: MIKA 5
Content:
1Ao koɛhonɛfoɛ awa brasua,
afei boa wɔ noa koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure;
watua yɛ kuro ne;
Yisrael maenbulɛniɛ ne, bɛkɔfa bakaa bɛkɔbɔ ye mvoka.
Defoɛ ne kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem
2 Nakoso wɔ, ao Betlehem Efrata,
ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛte kãa wɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ anu de,
nakoso bɔ ɔkɔyɛ Yisrael maenbulɛniɛ ne,
bɔ ye ahyɛaseɛ fi tete, bɔ ofi mmerɛ bɔ olle ahyɛaseɛ ne,
wɔ yeɛ okofi wɔ nu kɔwa kɔma me ɔ.
3Yiti ɔkɔyakyi bɛ nu kɔɔpem
mmerɛ bɔ braa bɔ wafo aworɛ so ne kɔwo ɔ.
Na afei oliɛma ngaa nemɔ,
bekosa bɛkɔɔboka Yisrael mma nemɔ aso.
4Na ɔkɔfa AWURADE anwoserɛ kogyina berɛ kɔma ye mmoaen kure aleɛ,
wɔ AWURADE ye Nyameɛ animnyam ahennie dumaa nu.
Bɛ bo kotimu,
ofikyɛ afei ɔkɔyɛ titire koodwu aseɛ so nekaa biala.
5Na ye yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ asomdwee ne ɔ.
Sɛ Asiria ɔba y’aseɛ ne aso,
ná otiatia y’ahemvie nemɔ aso a,
yɛkɔye neafoɛ nzoo ne atitirefoɛ mmɔtwɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia ye.
6 Na bɛkɔfa ngrandɛ bekoli Asiria aseɛ ne aso ngonim,
yeɛ Nimrode aseɛ ne aso pambim mɔ anu;
sɛ Asiria ɔba y’aseɛ ne aso,
ná otiatia y’aseɛ nemɔ aso a,
okole yɛ kofi ye sa nu.
7Na Yakob boso ama ngaa ne,
bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ bosue bɔ ofi AWURADE berɛ ɔ wɔ maen maen pee bɛ nu,
kyɛ nyenyenzue bɔ ogua ndire so ɔ,
bɔ ɔmva ye nwo ndo sona so,
anaa ɔnnwondɛ adasa mmaa ɔ.
8Na Yakob boso ama ngaa ne,
bɛkɔtena amaenmaensofoɛ nu wɔ maen maen pee bɛ nu,
kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔwɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ngaka mɔ nu ɔ,
kyɛ gyata ba bɔ ɔwɔ mmoaen kure mɔ nu ɔ,
bɔ sɛ ɔbaasẽ kɔ a, otiatia bɛ so,
ná ɔtete bɛ nu pasapasa bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ ɔ.
9Ɛkɔma wɔ sa so kotia bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ɔ,
na wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa bɛ boso konua.
10Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne,
ngonua wɔ mbɔngɔ mɔ boso ngofi wɔ nu,
na ngɔsɛkye wɔ teaseɛnam mɔ,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
11Ngɔbɔ w’aseɛ ne aso nguro mɔ,
na ngodwiri w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne amukoraa ngogua.
12Ngonyaayelɛ bɔ ɛye ne, ngotu ye bo,
na engonya ahɔmeɛ ko.
13Ngɔsɛkye w’amoen mɔ pasaa,
yeɛ ngɔsɛkye w’amoen bɔ agyinagyina nemɔ koso ngofi wɔ nu,
na ɛngɔsɔne wɔ sa noa adwuma ko.
14Ngotutu w’Asera dosii nemɔ abo ngofi wɔ nu,
na ngɔbɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ pasaa.
15Na maen maen mɔ bɔ banyɛ sotie bamma me ne,
nne ɛyaa ne ahonehulɛ ngɔtɔ bɛ so wereɛ.

Title: MIKA 6
Content:
AWURADE le dwirɛ tia Yisrael
1Afei, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ɔkã ɔ.
Dwɔso ná bɔ wɔ kuro wɔ mmokaa nemɔ nyunu,
ná ma pambaa mɔ betie bɔ ɛkã ɔ.
2Ɛmɔ, mmokaa mɔ, yeɛ aseɛ nyinasoɛ pindinn mɔ,
ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE kwaadu bɔ ɔbɔ ne,
ofikyɛ AWURADE ne ye maen banya edwudwolɛ,
na ɔne Yisrael kɔbɔ nguro.
3“Ao me maen, mayɔ wɔ nzu?
Nzikyɛ anwo yeɛ mayɛ wɔ so tɔsom ɔ? Bɔ me kwaadu e!
4 Ofikyɛ nyele wɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale,
mbɔle wɔ mvili ngoaasolɛ nu,
na nzomane Mose, Aarɔn ne Miriam
maa belili wɔ nyunu.
5 Ao me maen, kaye porɛ bɔ Moabo hene Balake bɔle ɔ,
ɔne mmuayɛɛ bɔ Beɔ awa Balaam ɔfa mane ye,
ofi Sitim bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gilgal ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so anwu AWURADE tenenee ne.”
Bɔ AWURADE pena ɔ
6“Nzikyɛ yeɛ mva mmra AWURADE nyunu,
ná mmamɔ me nu ase wɔ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne nyunu ɔ?
Mva naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ yeɛ mmra ye nyunu ɔ,
bɔ ɔte nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ko anaa?
7Aso AWURADE nye kɔgye mmoaen nyii apee apee nwo,
anaakyɛ ngoo asue apee buru apee buru nwo?
Aso mva me bamuɛbaa ndua me mmeraatolɛ nwo kerɛ,
anaakyɛ mva me bɔbɔ me kunu ba ndua me kra bɔne nwo kerɛ anaa?
8Ao kuro sona, wala bɔ ɔte paa ɔ ali wahyire wɔ,
nzikyɛ yeɛ AWURADE pena fi wɔ berɛ ɔ?
Bɔ ɔpena ala ole kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ, ekonwu anwumvoin,
ɔne kyɛ ɛne wɔ Nyameɛ bɛkɔnate anwobrɛaseɛ nu ɔ.
9AWURADE komvi tea nu frɛ kuro ne,
na bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ dumaa ne yeɛ bɛte nworɛfoɛ ɔ.
Ɛ́mɔtie asohwenɛ ne, ɔne ye bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne.
10Nzɛmmɔne nu anwonyadeɛ, yeɛ tonyi bɔ bawura nu bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ,
bɛtɛ wɔ bɔnefoɛ awuro anaa?
11Aso sona bɔ otira bɔne asusudeɛ,
ɔne nnakannaka tonyi ne,
aso odi kyɛ mebua ye be anaa?
12Ofikyɛ basabasayɔlɛ wali sikafoɛ nemɔ bɛ ti,
kuro ne anu ama bɛpɛ ngondombo,
na bɛ noa nu dwirɛ te nnakannaka.
13Yiti ngɔbɔ wɔ maa ɛkɔbɔ anwonyerɛ,
wɔ bɔne ti ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ pasapasa.
14Ekodidi, nakoso wɔ ko ngoyi;
ɛhɔen kandinga kɔwa wɔ wɔ nu,
ɛkɔfa nningyein kosie, nakoso ɛngɔhora ngɔbɔ ye nwo waen;
nakoso bɔ ɛkɔbɔ ye nwo waen ne,
ngɔmaa okofi wɔ sa wɔ koɛ nu.
15Ekolua, nakoso engonya so aleɛ;
ekohwi olive mma, nakoso engonya ye ngoo ne bie ngɔfa ngɔpopa;
ekohwi bobe mma, nakoso engonya ye nzaa ne bie ngɔno.
16 Ofikyɛ edi Omri ahyɛdeɛ so,
ɔne Ahabo boso ama yɔleɛ amukoraa so,
yeɛ ɛmɔdi bɛ foɛtulɛ so.
Ɔnate so ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ pasapasa,
na ngɔma wɔ nu ama bɛkɔkakyi ngorohoɛ nikye.
Yiti ɛmɔkɔsoa me maen animguaseɛ.

Title: MIKA 7
Content:
Mika di Yuda bɔne nwo aworabɔlɛ
1Edwirɛ ato me oo! Ofikyɛ mayɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ bate borɔdoma bayie,
bɔ bate bobe si ne bayie, bɔ bennya ye mma biribiraa ne bie benni ɔ.
Borɔdoma mma bɔ wali moa wasu, bɔ me komvi wɔ so ne,
ebie nne berɛ.
2Mmeni paa boso amini afi aseɛ ye aso,
na teneneeniɛ biala nne mmenia nu;
bɛ mukoraa bɛtetɛ bɛpena mogya bɛkã begua,
na ebiala sua oliɛma ngaen ɔpena ye ɔkye ye.
3Bɛ sa nyɔ ne, ɔbɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nwo mmɔden,
mbanyi ne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bede fea-ase-ma,
na tumifoɛ nemɔ bɛkã nikyee tɛɛ bɔ bɛ kra kuro ɔ nhyɛsoɛ so;
sɔ yeɛ bɛbɔ nu bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ ɔ.
4Bɛ nu sona paa ne po ɔte kyɛ ɛfone,
bɛ nu teneneeniɛ paa ne, ɔte mmowue anoa tworɔntworɔn;
w’awɛmvoɛ mɔ kyẽa ne, ɔne w’asohwenɛ kyẽa ne ɔ́ba,
bɛ basabasayɔlɛ mmerɛ ne wadwu.
5Nnɛma ɛmɔde abiɛngoɛ bedi,
yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ wora bewura adamvoa nu.
Ɛye bɔ ɔla wɔ kunu ne,
ye po nea yé wɔ ngɔmɔ bɔ ɛne ye bedi ɔ nwo.
6 Ofikyɛ baa bienzua bu seɛ animtia,
yeɛ baa brasua dwɔso tia oni;
sia brasua dwɔso tia ye sia brasua,
sona ye pɔfoɛ mɔ ole ye bɔbɔ deinn ye awuro ama.
7Yiti me de, AWURADE yeɛ me nye la ye so ɔ;
ngɔfa me wora ngowura me ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ nu;
me Nyameɛ kotie me.
8Wɔ, me pɔfoɛ, nnɛdi me nwo ahurusi;
sɛ mefi ase a, ngodwɔso,
sɛ nde awosii nu a,
AWURADE yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ me kanea ɔ.
9AWURADE ahonehulɛ ne, mede meto nu,
ofikyɛ mayɔ bɔne matia ye,
kɔpem kyɛ okoli me dwirɛ kɔma me,
ná okobua ndɛen turoloo kɔma me ɔ.
Ɔkɔye me kofite kɔwa hyireinn nu,
na ngonwu ye tenenee ne.
10Afei, me pɔfoɛ ne konwu ye,
na animguaseɛ kɔhã ye,
ye bɔ obisa me kyɛ,
“AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ ni?” ne.
Ngɔfa me nye ngɔnea ye,
na afei bekotiatia ye so kyɛ dwaaso asaa.
11Kyẽa bɔ odi kyɛ besi wɔ fasue nemɔ nen,
sɔ kyẽa ne yeɛ bɛkɔtrɛ ɛwɛen ne anu bɛkɔhɔ dedeede ɔ.
12Na sɔ kyẽa ne koso, okofi Asiria ne Misraim nguro nemɔ aso kɔwa wɔ berɛ,
okofi Misraim koodwu asue ne,
okofi ɛpo kɔɔhã ɛpo,
yeɛ okofi bokaa koodwu bokaa.
13Nakoso aseɛ ne kɔkakyi kurofoen,
ɔnate so ama nemɔ ati,
ɔnate bɛ yɔleɛ ti.
14Wɔ pɔmaa ne, fa nea wɔ maen so,
mmoaen kure bɔ bɛte w’agyapadeɛ,
bɔ bɛ ngome bɛte ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu,
wɔ Kamɛl so ne;
maa bedidi wɔ Basan ne Gileade,
kyɛ daa tete ne ala.
15Ngɔye anwanwadeɛ ali ngohyire ye,
kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ efili Misraim aseɛ so ɛwale ne ala.
16Maen maen mɔ konwu ye, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase,
b’anwoserɛ amukoraa si ne.
Bɛkɔfa bɛ sa bɛkɔto bɛ noa,
na bɛ so koti.
17Bɛkɔtafe nnɛterɛ kyɛ ewoo,
kyɛ ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ.
Bele anwopopolɛ bekofi b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nu bekofite;
bɛkɔfa esuronyi bɛkɔwa AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ berɛ,
na ɔnate wɔ ti bekosuro.
18Nwa yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ kyɛ wɔ, bɔ ɔfa amumuyɛɛ kyɛ,
bɔ obu ye nye gua ye agyapadeɛ ngaa bɛ mmeraatolɛ so ɔ?
Ɔmma ye yaafɛlɛ ndena berɛ afebɔɔ,
ofikyɛ ye nye gye anwumvoinnwunɛ nwo.
19Okosa konwu yɛ anwumvoin,
okoli y’amumuyɛɛ so ngonim;
na ekofindi bɛ bɔne amukoraa
kogua ɛpo buma ne anu.
20 Ɛkɔye nahorɛlilɛ ali kohyire Yakob,
ɔne anwumvoinnwunɛ ali kohyire Abraham,
kyɛbɔ ata ye nwo ndaen ahyire yɛ nana mɔ fi daa tete ne.

Title: NAHUM BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Nahum Nwomaa ne, ɔte anwenzɛm bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛfale Asiria ahenguro Ninewe sɛkyelɛ ɔne Asiria maen ne bɔlɛ nwo ɔ. Ɛhe sili ne, ye si ye kɔyɛ afoɛ ɛyaa nzoo koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Né Asiria di maen mmaa mmaa bɔ bɛwowɔ eyia afiteleɛ nemɔ aso ahandaen so ne nhyɛsoɛ so. Ɔnate bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne atianuserɛ ti, Nyameɛ hwene bɛ so. Nahum maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ tumi amukoraati wura ye sa ɔ, na sɛ ɔkã kyɛ ɔkɔhwe ebie so a, ebiala ngɔhora ngosi ye ate. Ɔnate ye tumi ne aso ɔkɔhwe Ninewe so ná wapepɛ wale Yuda. Bɔ ɔmaa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne di ahurusi ole kyɛ, kuro sona tumi biala ole ayieleɛ, na Nyameɛ ngɔma bɔne ngɔhɔ so afebɔɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Nyameɛ bua Ninewe ndɛen 1.1-15
Ninewe kuro ne kɔbɔ 2.1—3.19

Title: NAHUM 1
Content:
1Nyekyire bɔ ɔfa Ninewe nwo ɛhe. Elkoseniɛ Nahum ye nyekyire nwomaa ne ɛhe.
Nyameɛ fɛ Ninewe so yaa
2Nyameɛ ɔtwe nungunɛ, na ɔte AWURADE bɔ ɔtɔ wereɛ ɔ.
AWURADE tɔ wereɛ, na ye yaafɛlɛ te piri;
AWURADE tɔ bɛ bɔ bekyi ye ɔ so wereɛ,
na ye ahonehulɛ wɔ berɛ ma ye pɔfoɛ mɔ.
3 AWURADE ahone onhu ndɛ, ye tumi te piri;
na ongobua bɔ odi fɔ ɔ be le.
AWURADE atee la mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo, ɔne mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ ɔ nu,
na munungum te ye gya bo mvuture.
4Ɔkã ɛpo nyunu, na ɔmaa ɔwewe,
ɔwewe asue amukoraa;
Basan ne Kamɛl kese,
na Lebanon nyerɛen twindwam.
5Mmokaa nemɔ woso wɔ ye nyunu,
na pambaa nemɔ behuro,
aseɛ yera wɔ ye nyunu,
amba, wiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa.
6Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye ahonehulɛ ne nyunu ɔ?
Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye yaa noa hyerɛhyerɛ ne noa ɔ?
Ye yaafɛlɛ ne hwie gua kyɛ see,
na ɔma nyɔbotaen mɔ nu dwudwa.
7AWURADE te paa,
ɔte amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu anwoserɛ afealeɛ,
na ɔse bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura ye nu ɔ.
8Nakoso bɛ bɔ bekyi ye de, ɔkɔfa nzue bɔ oyi bu fa so ɔ konua bɛ boso,
na ɔkɔfoa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔhɔ awosii nu.
9Nzikyɛ porɛ yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛfa AWURADE nwo ye?
Okonua ɛmɔ boso bɔkɔɔ,
ye de, onua nikye boso bɔkɔɔ bɔ onnua ye ye pɛen nyɔ so ɔ.
10Mmerɛ bɔ batoatoa nu kyɛ mmowue,
ná babobo kyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ nen,
ɔkɔyera bɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ worowaa.
11Ebie bɔ ɔdwene AWURADE nwo tɛɛ, bɔ ɔte foɛtulɛniɛ bɔnefoɛ ɔ,
wɔ nu yeɛ wafi wawa ɔ.
12“Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se, yeɛ bɛsone de,
nakoso bekohũhũ bɛ bekogua ma bɛ boso konua.
Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mamaa afa yealɛ nu de,
nakoso mengɔma ɛngɔfa yealɛ nu ko,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
13Afei, ngobubu ye kɔnnua ne anu ngofi wɔ so,
na ngɔtete wɔ nyamaa bɔ ɔkyekye wɔ nemɔ anu.”
14AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ nwo mmeraa kyɛ,
“Wɔ dumaa komini kofi aseɛ ye aso:
Na mmosoen bɔ base ne mmosoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ne,
ngɔpra bɛ bo ngofi wɔ nyameɛ mɔ b’awuro.
Ngofu w’asieleɛ, ofikyɛ wɔ nwo ayɛ fitii.”
15 Nea mmokaa nemɔ aso dɔ kyɛ ɔba ɔ,
bɔ ɔso ndɛenvɛen, bɔ ɔbɔ asomdwee nwo dawure ne!
Ao Yuda, di w’aluolue krongron nemɔ,
tua w’aboadeɛ nemɔ,
ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ ne ngɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa wɔ ko,
bama ye boso amini bɔkɔɔ.

Title: NAHUM 2
Content:
Bɛkɔbɔ Ninewe tɔɔ
1Bɔ ɔsɛkye nikyee pasapasa ne, ɔ́ba wɔ so.
Wɛne ɛwaen nemɔ, fa wɔ nye sra atee ne,
bɔ w’abɔsoɛ, ná mia w’anwoserɛ nu paa.
2(Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɔ́ma Yakob osa onya ye ahennie animnyam
kyɛ Yisrael ahennie animnyam ne,
ofikyɛ apaabɔlɛfoɛ bafe bɛ nningyein bafa,
yeɛ basɛkye bɛ bobe mmaen nemɔ.)
3Ye anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ b’akokyɛm nwo aboro kɔɔ,
na ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ baherahera kɔbene.
Teaseɛnam nemɔ, bɛte see yerɛmyerɛm
wɔ ye kyẽa bɔ ɔboaboa ye nwo kɔ koɛ ne,
na ɛframmire nemɔ bɛwoso paa.
4Teaseɛnam nemɔ betu amirika kikikiki wɔ dwaa nemɔ aso,
bedi akɔneaba wɔ mandamu nemɔ anu,
bɛ nwo te kyɛ ɛtɛen,
betu amirika kyɛ agralaa.
5Ɔto ye sa frɛ ye atitire mɔ,
bɛkɔ a, bɛnate fofalifofali;
bɛma bɛ nwo yɛ nyera bɛkɔ fasue ne anwo,
na bɛhyehyɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne.
6Babukyebukye asue nemɔ bɛ pambim nemɔ,
na ahemvie ne kodwiri kogua.
7Babɔ ye hemmaa kwaterekwa, bahye ye nnure bahɔ;
ye ndaluwa mɔ bɛbɔ awuye,
bɛpene kyɛ abubure,
na bɛfa bɛ sa befi b’ahone.
8Ninewe te kyɛ ɛkwaa fi tetetete,
nakoso bɛkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ.
Bɛkɔtea nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔgyina berɛ oo! Ɛ́mɔgyina berɛ oo!”
Nakoso ebiala ngɔpɛne ye nye ngɔnea ye si.
9“Ɛ́mɔfẽ ɛdwetɛ ne,
ɛ́mɔfẽ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne.
Anwonyadeɛ ne, ye bo ngotu,
yeɛ nningyein nyɔboɛ serɛ biala wɔ nu!”
10Ninewe abɔ tɔɔ, wabɔ tɔɔ, wasɛkye bɔkɔɔ!
Mmenia nwo ngaka atu amini, nangoroma mɔ bayɛ hodwoo,
bɛ sisia amukoraa yɛ bɛ yea,
yeɛ bɛ nyunu amukoraa ayɛ hoyaa!
11Gyata mɔ b’atenaleɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?
Nisua yeɛ gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bedidi ɔ,
nekaa bɔ gyata nyii ne gyata beleɛ bɛnate,
nekaa bɔ ye mma mɔ bɛwɔ bɔ ebiala ɔnha b’adwene ɔ?
12Gyata nyii tetele naen nu bɔ ɔkɔso ye mma mɔ di ɔ;
na obumane naen kɔme ohuni ye mane ye gyata mmeleɛ nemɔ;
ɔfale naen bɔ wahũ ye ne yili ye nekaa bɔ ɔla nemɔ,
na ɔfale naen bɔ watete ye nu ne yili ye tuin nemɔ anu.
13Tie, meko metia wɔ, na ngɔyera ye teaseɛnam nemɔ wɔ nwosina ne anu. Ngrandɛ kohũhũ wɔ gyata mmaa nemɔ, ngɔma wɔ noa aleɛ komini kofi aseɛ ye aso, na bɛngɔte wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ komvi ko, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: NAHUM 3
Content:
Ninewe konya asohwenɛ
1Awuelilɛ kuro, wɔ yaakɔ oo!
Ngondombo ne awerɔm awue yeɛ wayi ye to ɔ,
apaabɔlɛ bo ɔngɔpɛ wɔ ye nu.
2Mbirefinɛ pralalala, yeɛ teaseɛnam gya kirikirikiri,
mbɔngɔ bɔ behuru bɛpepe, teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ behuruhuru.
3Pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɛko bɛkɔ bɛ nyunu,
bɛ ngrandɛ te yerɛmyerɛm, yeɛ bɛ pealɛɛ te hyɛmhyɛm,
bɛ bɔ batotɔ ɔ bɛte pee,
efuin mɔ bahonhɔn bɛ bahɔ anwuro,
efuin mɔ somaa bɔ bɛka a bennwu ye noa ɔ,
na bɛfofo efuin mɔ so besoti.
4Na gyanderaniɛ ne, ɔnate ye gyanderabɔlɛ somaa ne ati,
sɔ ngonyaayelɛfoɛ hemmaa anwonyemene ne,
bɔ ɔfa ye adwamanbɔlɛ ɔtɔne maen maen mɔ,
ná ɔfa ngonyaayelɛ ɔtɔne mmusua ɔ.
5Tie, meko metia wɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Ngopuro w’ataadeɛ ngɔfa wɔ nyunu,
ngɔma maen maen mɔ bekonwu w’adagya,
na ahennie mɔ bekonwu w’animguaseɛ.
6Ngogyi akyiwadeɛ fitii ngogua wɔ so,
ngobu wɔ animtia,
ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi nikyee bɔ mmenia tu bɛ nye begua ye so ɔ.
7Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ye nye kɔbɔ wɔ so ne, ɔkɔnwati kofi wɔ nwo,
na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, Ninewe akakyi kurofoen! Nwa yeɛ okoli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ ɔ?
Nisua yeɛ ngonya aworakyekyerɛfoɛ ngɔma ye ɔ?
8Aso ɛte paa tra No Amon
bɔ ɔla asue piri ne noa,
bɔ asue mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia,
bɔ ɛpo te ye ɛwaen, ná asue mɔ bɛte ye fasue ne?
9Yitiopia ne Misraim bɛte ye anwoserɛ,
anwoserɛ bɔ ye bo ɔmbɛ ɔ.
Né Pute ne Libiafoɛ bɛte wɔ bokafoɛ mɔ.
10Nakoso bɛhyele ye nnure bɛhɔle,
na ɔhɔle ngoaasolɛ nu;
ye ngwadaa mɔ koso, bɛtele bɛ ti bɛbɔle mane bɛ nu tetele nzɔkanzɔka
wɔ borɔnoɛ biala ngwandaa;
beguale serewa bɛfa bɛhyɛle ye animnyamfoɛ nemɔ bɛfale,
na beguale ye atitirefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ.
11Wɔ koso, ɛkɔno nzaa kɔbo,
na ɛkɔɔfea,
na ɔnate pɔfoɛ ne ati ɛkɔpena afealeɛ.
12W’anwoserɛ afealeɛ amukoraa kɔyɛ kyɛ borɔdoma mmakaa
bɔ borɔdoma mmaa bɔ wali moa wasu ɔ wɔ so ɔ.
Sɛ bɛwoso ye a,
ɔtete gua sona bɔ odi ne noa nu.
13Nea! Wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ nu ne,
bakakyi mmrasua.
W’aseɛ ne aso pambim nemɔ,
bɛlela berɛ hambonnwu ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ,
na see ayera mmuralɛ bɔ bɛbrambram wɔ pambim mɔ asi ne.
14Ɔnate kuro ne tualɛ ne ati, sesa nzue sie;
miamia w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu,
dɔne nnɛterɛ fa pɛ mmerekese,
ná miamia bɔ bɛfa bɛpɛ mmerekese ne anu yé.
15Berɛ yeɛ see kɔyera wɔ ɔ,
ngrandɛ ne konua wɔ boso,
ɔkɔpesa wɔ kyɛ abɛbɛ piri,
Wɔ de, ta pee kyɛ mmɛbɛ mbiri, ta pee kyɛ torɔka.
16Ama wɔ dwaalilɛfoɛ nemɔ basone
batra ewienu nzramaa;
ɛsaa ne odi nningyein, na ɔnwati kɔ.
17W’atitire mɔ bɛte kyɛ mmɛbɛ,
wɔ safohene mɔ bɛte kyɛ torɔka
bɔ ɛyerɛ ba a, bɛtenatena ɛwaen so ɔ.
Nakoso sɛ eyia pukye a, betu bɛkɔ,
na ebiala nze nekaa bɔ bɛwɔ ɔ.
18Ao Asiria hene, wɔ neafoɛ nemɔ balela,
w’atitire nemɔ bɛtɔ ngosie,
wɔ mmenia nemɔ babɔ aya wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso
bɔ ebiala ɔmmoaboa bɛ noa ɔ.
19Wɔ ngena nemɔ bɛte kenangɔ,
na wɔ ngena nemɔ batu.
Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte wɔ nga ne, ɔkɔbɔ ye sa nu kogua wɔ so,
ofikyɛ wɔ bɔne yɔleɛ bɔ ye bo mbɛ ne,
nwa yeɛ amva angɔ ye so ɔ?

Title: HABAKUKU BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Habakuku hyɛle ngɔm ne, ye si ye kɔyɛ afoɛ ɛyaa nzia pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Babilɔn ahennie ne wama Yuda maen ne wafa yealɛ paa nu. Babilɔnfoɛ lili Yuda so ngonim bɔkɔɔ ɔ, afoɛ 586 pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu ɔ, na bɛsɛkyele Yerusalem kuro ne ɔne ye asɔneyɛɛ sua ne pasaa. Kyɛbɔ Babilɔnfoɛ besi bɛhyɛle Yudafoɛ so ne, ɔhale Habakuku paa. Né ɔnde ye bo kyɛ sɔ bɔnefoɛ atianuserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛkɔ so benya ngɔsoɛ ɔ. Afei koso, né ɔnde ye bo kyɛ Nyameɛ ayɛ konn wɔ bɛ bɔne ne anwo, bɔ ɔndwe bɛ so ɔ. Yiti obisale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Wɔ nye te krongron paa bɔ yiti ɛngora nnea bɔne, ná ɛngora nnea amumuyɛɛ ɔ. Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛnea nnakannakafoɛ, bɔ ahã wɔ noa ato nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɔnefoɛ oku sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ tra bɔnefoɛ ne ɔ?” (1.13) Nyameɛ buale ye kyɛ okotua bɔnefoɛ nemɔ so kerɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu. Nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ (2.4).
Nu Dwirɛ
Habakuku adwobisa ne Nyameɛ mmuayɛɛ 1.1—2.4
Bɔnefoɛ akatuaa 2.5-20
Habakuku mbaeɛ 3.1-19

Title: HABAKUKU 1
Content:
1Nyekyire bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Habakuku nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe.
Habakuku adwobisa
2Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ ngosu ngɔpena mmokalɛ,
nakoso ɛngɔtɛ me so ɔ?
Metea nu mekyire wɔ kyɛ, “Nhyɛsoɛ oo”,
nakoso ɛngɔpepɛ ngole yɛ!
3Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmaa me nye nwu amumuyɛɛ,
ná ɛma me nye nwu nhyɛsoɛ e?
Basabasayɔlɛ ne nhyɛsoɛ yeɛ me nye tua ɔ;
apereapereɛ ne ngondii badwɔso.
4Yiti mmeraa ne, ɔnyɛ adwuma,
yeɛ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nne berɛ,
ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ bapɛ teneneefoɛ nwo babra bayia,
na ndɛengyea yeɛ ɔkɔ so ɔ.
Nyameɛ ye Habakuku adwobisa ne noa
5 Ɛ́mɔto ɛmɔ nye bɛ́nea maen maen nemɔ anu,
ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa ná ɛmɔ nwo dwiri ɛmɔ,
ofikyɛ mebaayɔ nikyee bie wɔ ɛmɔ aberɛ so,
bɔ sɛ bɛkã bekyire ɛmɔ po a, ɛmɔngole bengoli ɔ.
6 Ofikyɛ tie, mékanyane Kaldeafoɛ,
sɔ atianuserɛ maen bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ nyera ne,
bɔ bɛnate bɛfa aseɛ ye aso amukoraa
bɛfa atenaleɛ mɔ bɔ nna bɛ deɛ ahɔ ɔ.
7Bɛ nwo yɛ suro, yeɛ bɛ nye yɛ se,
na bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛdwene kyɛ ɔte turoloo, ná ɔte paa ma bɛ ne yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ.
8Bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ koso bɛ nwo yɛ nyera tra aboa,
bɛte awerɔm bɛtra nɔsoa mbataku;
bɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ behuru bɛpepe;
amba, bɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ befi dedeede yeɛ bɛba ɔ;
betu kyɛ kɔleɛ bɔ ɔpe ndɛen kɔkye naen di ɔ.
9Bɛ mukoraa bɛba ye atianuserɛ so,
bɛ nyunu ogye kyɛ eyia afiteleɛ mvrama,
na bɛboaboa bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ noa kyɛ anweaa.
10Bɛsere ahemvo mɔ,
yeɛ bɛgoro atitirefoɛ mɔ anwo;
bɛsere anwoserɛ afealeɛ biala,
ofikyɛ bɛhonhɔn nnɛterɛ bɛfo so bɛfa kuro.
11Na afei, bɛsɛkye nningyein bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ kyɛ mvrama piri,
awudifoɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ nyameɛ ɔ!
12Ao, AWURADE me Nyameɛ, me Krongronniɛ,
aso nna wɔ yeɛ ɛwɔ berɛ fi tetetete bɔ olle ahyɛaseɛ ɔ? Yɛngowu.
Ao AWURADE, atu bɛ asie berɛ kyɛ bebua yɛ ndɛen;
ao Nyɔbotaen, ama bɛ bo atimu kyɛ bɛhwe yɛ so.
13Wɔ nye te krongron paa bɔ yiti ɛngora nnea bɔne,
ná ɛngora nnea amumuyɛɛ ɔ.
Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛnea nnakannakafoɛ,
bɔ ahã wɔ noa ato nu,
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɔnefoɛ oku sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ tra bɔnefoɛ ne ɔ?
14Ayɛ mmenia kyɛ ɛpo nu naen,
kyɛ abɔdeɛ bɔ bɛkongo bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.
15Bɛfa koaa bɛkye bɛ mukoraati,
bɛfa b’asawu ne bɛtwe bɛ befite,
bɛboa bɛ noa wɔ bɛ tɛen ne anu,
yiti bedi ahurusi, na bɛ nye gye.
16Yiti bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma b’asawu ne,
bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛma bɛ tɛen ne;
ofikyɛ ɔnate bɛ so yeɛ bɛtena ase wɔ anwotɔ nu ɔ.
17Yiti odi kyɛ bɛkɔ so bɛporoporo b’asawu ne anu,
ná bɛkɔ so bekũkũ maen maen mɔ wɔ atianuserɛ nu daa anaa?

Title: HABAKUKU 2
Content:
Ongoyie bɔnefoɛ yé
1Ngogyina m’apa bɔ megyina so mesra ne aso,
ná magyina ndende wɔ abandenden ne aso.
Ngɔwɛne ngɔnea bɔ ɔkɔhã kohyire me ɔ,
ɔne mmuayɛɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔma me wɔ m’adwobisa ne anwo ɔ.
2Yeɛ AWURADE buale me kyɛ,
“Kyerɛ nyekyire ne,
ná kyerɛ ye pefee gua nyɔboɛ taataa nemɔ aso,
amaa ɔnate so mmenia bahora bakenga ye ndɛndɛ so.
3 Ofikyɛ nyekyire ne, ɔ́nwondɛ mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ bama ye ɔ;
ɔpe ndɛen kyɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ, na ɔngɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ.
Sɛ ɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ po a, nwondɛ;
ofikyɛ ɔkɔwa nu amba, ɔngɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ.
4 Tie, sona bɔ ɔte anwomasoɛ ne, ye kra ɔndengyɛ wɔ ye nu,
nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ.
5Afei koso, nzaa te nnakannaka,
anwomasoɛniɛ ne ngɔtena berɛ daa.
Ye akɔnnɔ nu trɛ kyɛ ɛborɔ,
ɔte kyɛ ewue bɔ ye ko nyi le ɔ.
Ɔko boaboa maen maen amukoraa noa ma ye nwo,
na ɔkye mmenia amukoraa nnure ɔfa.”
6Aso sɔ maen nemɔ amukoraa bɛngɔhã ye anyinga,
aso bɛngɔhã ngorohoɛ dwirɛ bɛngɔfa ye nwo kyɛ,
“Bɔ ɔsesa nningyein bɔ nna ye deɛ ahɔ ɔ ɔbɔ so ne,
ye yaakɔ!
Apoobɔlɛ nningyein bɔ ode ye, ɔkɔhɔ so koodwu kyinzu?”
7Bɛ bɔ bɛma wɔ kerɛ ne, aso bengodwɔso bengotia wɔ mvum nu,
na bɛ bɔ bekodwɔso wɔ so ne, bɛkɔma wɔ nwo kɔwosowoso wɔ.
Na ɛkɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ kɔma bɛ.
8Ɔnate kyɛ afẽ maen maen pee afa ne ati,
maen ngaa nemɔ amukoraa koso bɛkɔfẽ wɔ bɛkɔfa,
ofikyɛ ahã mmenia mogya agua,
yeɛ ayɛ nhyɛsoɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso,
kuro ne aso, ɔne nu ama amukoraa bɛ so.
9“Sona bɔ ɔnate atee tɛɛ so ɔpena anwonyadeɛ ma ye awuro,
kyɛ ɔfa nwo ye saen wɔ anwuro,
kyɛbɔ musue biala ngɔto ye ne, ye yaakɔ!”
10Ɛnate mmenia pee bɔ ahũhũ bɛ ne aso
ahwehwe animguaseɛ abrɛ w’awuro,
ayɔ bɔne atia wɔ kra.
11Ofikyɛ nyɔboɛ ne kofi fasue ne anu kɔtea nu,
na mbuna ne kofi ndaboa ne anu kosuro so.
12Sona bɔ ɔnate mogya hãgualɛ so ɔkyekye kuro,
ná ɔnate amumuyɛɛ so ɔma kuro bo tindim ne, ye yaakɔ!
13Tie, aso nna Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wahyehyɛ
kyɛ mmenia bɛfɛ bɛyɔ adwuma ma see ɔyera ye,
ná maen maen bɛfɛ bɛma nningyein bɔ ɔte mbaen ɔ.
14 Ofikyɛ AWURADE animnyam nwo nimdeɛ koyi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ,
kyɛbɔ nzue ayi ɛpo nu tɛkyɛ ne.
15Ebiala bɔ ɔma obiɛngo nzaa maa ɔno,
bɔ adwene tɛɛ li ye si,
bɔ ɔnate so ɔmaa ɔbo,
amaa wanya atee wanea ye nwo ne, ye yaakɔ!”
16Animguaseɛ yeɛ wabia wɔ ɔ, nna animnyam ɔ;
wɔ koso, no nzaa bo ma wɔ bienzua bɔ bambɛ ne ɔla so.
AWURADE sa famaa nu kwangoa kɔkakyi kɔwa wɔ so,
na animguaseɛ kɔkata w’animnyam ne aso.
17Ofikyɛ nzɛmmɔne bɔ ayɔ atia Lebanon ne,
ɔne ngaka mɔ huhunɛ bɔ ɔmaa besurole ne, okobu kosa wɔ,
ofikyɛ ahã mmenia mogya agua,
yeɛ ayɛ nhyɛsoɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso, kuro ne aso, ɔne nu ama amukoraa bɛ so.
18Amoen bɔ adwiililɛniɛ wase ne,
nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ?
Amoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ɔ, bɔ okyirekyire nnakannaka ɔ;
adwiililɛniɛ ne, ɔfa ye wora owura ye bɔbɔ ye adwii bɔ wali, bɔ ɔte emumu amoen ne anu.
19Sona bɔ ɔkã kyire bakaa kyɛ, “Tingye”,
ná ɔkã kyire nyɔboɛ mumu kyɛ, “Dwɔso! Ɔbaahyirehyire” ne, ye yaakɔ!
Tie, bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ ne dwetɛ baboro ye nwo,
nakoso nwomeɛ biala ɔnne ye nu.
20 Nakoso AWURADE wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu,
na odi kyɛ aseɛ amukoraa yɛ konn wɔ ye nyunu.

Title: HABAKUKU 3
Content:
Habakuku mbaeɛ
1Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Habakuku mbaeɛ bɔ ɔfale Sigyionote edweintolɛ so bɔle ne, ye ɛhe:
2Ao AWURADE, mate wɔ nga, na nzurole.
Ao AWURADE, kanyane w’adwuma wɔ mmerɛ ye anu,
wɔ mmerɛ ye anu maa benwu ye,
na wɔ yaafɛlɛ nu po, nwu anwumvoin.
3Nyameɛ fi Teman wale,
amba, Krongronniɛ ne fi bokaa Paran so wale.
Sela
Ye animnyam katale nyameɛso,
yeɛ ye nwo ayɛyelɛ yili aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.
4Ye nwo hyireinn ne te kyɛ agralaa;
né mmɛen nyɔ fi ye sa nu,
ná nu yeɛ né ye tumi ne ɔfea ɔ.
5Né ewue anwonyerɛ li ye nyunu,
na né ɛhawo nate ye gya bo.
6Ɔte gyinane, na ɔwosole aseɛ.
Ɔtole ye nye neane, na ɔbɔle maen maen mɔ sandene;
mmokaa bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ne, bedwiri beguale,
na daa tete pambaa nemɔ, bɛbɔle bɛ nu ase.
Ye atee mɔ wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.
7Nwuni kyɛ Kusan ɛtena sua mɔ bɛwɔ amaneɛ nu,
yeɛ Midian aseɛ so mbɛmuɛ tena mɔ bɛwosowoso.
8Ao AWURADE, aso asue mɔ yeɛ w’ahone huli bɛ so ne anaa?
Asue mɔ yeɛ ɛfɛle bɛ so yaa ne anaa?
Ɛpo yeɛ wɔ nye borole ye so ne anaa,
mmerɛ bɔ né ɛte wɔ mbɔngɔ so,
ne wɔ ngoalelɛ teaseɛnam mɔ nu ne?
9Ɛhwene w’agyaen fili wɔ ndokue nu,
kyɛbɔ mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ ndaen,
bɔ ye ole wɔ dwirɛ ne, ɔte ɔ.
Sela
Afa asue mɔ ahyehyɛ aseɛ nu.
10Mmokaa mɔ nwuni wɔ, na bɛ nwo wosowosole bɛ.
Asue bɔ ɔsẽ wuruwuru ɔ pɛle nu hɔle,
buma mane ye komvi so teateane nu,
na ɔmane ye sa so hɔle anwuro.
11Eyia ne ɛsraen begyinagyinane seinn wɔ b’atenaleɛ,
mmerɛ bɔ w’agyaen nemɔ bɛ nwo tete yerɛmyerɛm bɛkɔ,
bɔ wɔ pealɛɛ nwo hyɛmhyɛm ne ɔ́ta hyireinn ɔ.
12Ele ɛyaa piri yeɛ ɛnate fale aseɛ so ɔ.
Etiatiale maen maen mɔ so wɔ ahonehulɛ nu.
13Efite hɔle kyɛ ɛfa ngoalelɛ brɛ wɔ maen,
kyɛ ɛfa brɛ wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne.
Nzɛmmɔneniɛ n’awuro ne aso panyi ne, ɛpɛkyɛle ye,
na ɛmane ye nwo lale so fi ye gya bo kodwu ye ti so.
14Ɛfale ye bɔbɔ ye pealɛɛ sinane bɔ ɔla ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne;
bɛwale kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, kyɛ bɛbabɔ me bɛpete.
Bɔ bɛ nye gye ye nwo ole kyɛ
bekohu anwumvoin mmenia wɔ mvealeɛ nu ɔ.
15Ɛfale wɔ mbɔngɔ natele ɛpo nu,
ɛfale nzue buma mbiri nemɔ anu.
16Ndele nen, me kunu tele me;
komviɛ ne mane me noa kekã bɔle so.
M’aporɛ nu yɛle me hodwoo,
na me nwo wosowosole me.
Nakoso ngɔyɛ konn ngɔnwondɛ amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne,
kyɛ ɔkɔwa maen bɔ wafa koɛ waateta yɛ ne aso ɔ.
17Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ borɔdoma mmɔ nyerɛen,
bobe nemɔ benzu mmaa,
olive sulɛ wali ngasi,
eboo mɔ bɛngye aleɛ,
mmoaen nemɔ bɛ boso ayera wɔ tuin ne anu,
yeɛ nandwie biala nne tuin nemɔ anu,
18nakoso me de, ngoli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu.
Ngɔma me nye kɔgye wɔ me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ nu.
19 AWURADE Nyameɛ te m’anwoserɛ.
Ɔma me gya tindim kyɛ kɛtɛbɔɔ deɛ,
na ɔmaa menate m’asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.
Mefa mema edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne, kyɛ ɔ́fa me sangoo ne ɔ́to.

Title: SEFANIA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sefania bɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né waha afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nzia koraka yeɛ bɛbaawo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yosia yeɛ odi hene wɔ Yuda ɔ. Osoma kyɛ ɔbɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure koraka yeɛ Nana Yosia ɔbaayɔ Nyameɛ solɛ nu nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ odi mu ne ɔ. Nwomaa ne anu, yɛnwu Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛ botaeɛ ne bie. Ebie ole kyɛ: AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye, ɔte ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa (1.7-8). Kyẽa bie baawa bɔ ɔte aworabɔlɛ kyẽa, bɔ Nyameɛ kɔhwe Yudafoɛ so ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ bambena AWURADE si atee (1.6 ne 3.2), na mmom bɛsole mmosoen (1.4-5, 8-9). Asa koso, b’anwonya (1.11-12, 18) ne anwomasoɛ (3.11) maa bɛnyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. Nyameɛ kɔhwe maen maen mɔ koso bɛ so. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ amaneɛ kɔto Yerusalem de, nakoso nziɛ ye, Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ kosa kofi maen maen mɔ so kɔwa. Ɔkɔma kuro ne kosa kosi ye daa nu, bɔ nu mmenia kɔyɛ anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ ne teneneefoɛ ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
AWURADE ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne 1.1—2.3
AWURADE kɔhwe maen maen mɔ bɛ so 2.4-15
AWURADE kɔhwe Yerusalem so, na okosa kole ye 3.1-20

Title: SEFANIA 1
Content:
AWURADE ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne
1 Yuda hene Yosia bɔ ɔte Amon awa ne, ye aberɛ so, AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Sefania bɔ ye baba ole Kuse bɔ ye baba ole Gedalia bɔ ye baba ole Amaria bɔ ye baba ole Hesekia ne, ye ɛhe:
2“Ngɔpra nikyee biala boso bɔkɔɔ
ngofi aseɛ so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
3“Ngonua mmenia ne ngaka boso;
ngonua ewienu nnomaa ne
ɛpo nu naen boso,
bɛ ne sundidua mɔ ne bɔnefoɛ mɔ.
Ngonua kuro sona boso ngofi aseɛ so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
4“Ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhwe Yuda so,
yeɛ Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa bɛ so;
na ngokyikyi Baal nwo nikyee biala bɔ waha ɔ ye boso,
ɔne ahɔmeɛ ne asɔfo bɔ bɛso bosoen ɔ bɛ dumaa boso ngofi wa;
5yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne anwuro abɔdeɛ mɔ
wɔ sua ti afia;
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne AWURADE bɛfa ye bɛta ndaen,
nakoso bɛfa bosoen Milkom bɛta ndaen ɔ;
6yeɛ bɛ bɔ bayakyi AWURADE sililɛ,
bɛ bɔ bɛmbena AWURADE si atee
bɔ bɛmva bɛ dwirɛ bɛndo ye nyunu ɔ.”
7 Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn wɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ nyunu!
Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye,
yoo, AWURADE asiesie afɔleɛ,
na wate bɛ bɔ wato ye sa wafrɛ bɛ nemɔ anwo.
8AWURADE afɔleɛ kyẽa ne dwu a,
ngɔhwe atitirefoɛ mɔ ne ɛhene mma nemɔ bɛ so,
bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bewura maen bie sofoɛ mɔ bɛ ndaadeɛɔ.
9Sɔ kyẽa ne, ebiala bɔ ohuru fa aponnwaa so ne, ngɔhwe ye so,
bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛfa aminɛ ne apoo nningyein
beyi bɛ mene awuro to ɔ.”
10AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Sɔ kyẽa ne,
bɛkɔte esuɛ bekofi Tire Pambim ne anu,
bɛkɔte awuye bekofi borɔnoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne aso,
yeɛ bɛkɔte nningyein sɛkyelɛ piri paa bekofi pambaa nemɔ aso.
11Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔtete nekaa bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Mɔɔta ɔ,
ofikyɛ banua dwadifoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛ boso,
banua bɛ bɔ bɛkari ɛdwetɛ ne amukoraa bɛ boso.
12Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔfa kanea ngohyini ngɔneanea Yerusalem nu,
na ngɔhwe bɛ bɔ bafa bɔne bayɛ
bɛ nwo buru ne nnu nemɔ bɛ so,
bɛ bɔ bɛkã ye bɛ ti anu kyɛ,
‘AWURADE ngɔyɔ ye nwo huu,
kyɛ paa oo, anaa tɛɛ oo.’
13Yiti bɛ nningyein kɔkakyi nningyein bɔ mmenia kɔfẽ kɔfa ɔ,
na b’awuro mɔ kɔkakyi dandue.
Bekosisi sua de,
nakoso bɛngɔtena nu;
bɛkɔyɔ bobe boo mɔ de,
nakoso bɛngɔno ye nzaa ne bie.”
14AWURADE kyẽa piri ne wapingye,
wapingye, na ɔpe ndɛen paa;
esuɛ bɔ bɛkɔte ye AWURADE kyẽa ne nen, ɔkɔyɛ aworabɔlɛ kyɛ!
Katakyie mɔ kosũ hahii.
15Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔte ahonehulɛ kyẽa,
amaneɛ ne ahunundetelɛ kyẽa,
ɛsɛkyelɛ ne ehunɛ kyẽa,
awosii ne aworabɔlɛ kyẽa,
munungum ne awosii kabii kyẽa,
16totorobɛndohulɛ ne koɛ nu ndeateamuɛ kyẽa
bɔ ɔ́ba nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue
ɔne abandenden ndendenn mɔ so ɔ.
17Ngɔma aworabɔlɛ kɔto mmenia
bɔ ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔnate kyɛ anyesiniwaafoɛ ɔ,
ofikyɛ bayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE;
bekogyi bɛ mogya bekogua kyɛ mvuture,
na bekogyi bɛ nwonaen ne bekogua kyɛ bondua.
18B’ɛdwetɛ anaa bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ,
ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ wɔ
AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne.
Aseɛ amukoraa kɔyera wɔ
ye nungunɛhwenɛ see ne anu,
ofikyɛ ɔbaanua aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bɛ boso mvum nu.

Title: SEFANIA 2
Content:
Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene
1Ɛmɔ, nyanzoen maen,
ɛ́mɔhã ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́bɔ nu, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa!
2Nnɛma ɛmɔtena berɛ maa ɔhyehyɛ sɔ koraka,
kyẽa bɔ ɔsẽ kɔ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye kɔ ne, nnɛmɔma ɔba koraka,
nnɛmɔma AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne ɔba ɛmɔ so koraka,
nnɛmɔma AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne ɔba ɛmɔ so koraka.
3Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE,
aseɛ ne asofoɛ bɔ ɛmɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase ɔ,
bɔ ɛmɔdi AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ!
Ɛ́mɔpena tenenee si atee, ɛ́mɔpena anwobrɛaseɛ si atee;
ebiaa né wamaa ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu wɔ
AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne.
Filistifoɛ
4 Gasa kɔkakyi kuro bɔ batu bafi so ɔ,
yeɛ Asekelɔn kɔkakyi kurofoen,
bekotu Asedɔde bekofi berɛ eyiagyina,
yeɛ bekotutu Ekron bo bɔkɔɔ.
5Mboanoafoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ oo,
Keretifoɛ maen ne!
AWURADE dwirɛ ne obua ɛmɔ foɛ;
O Kanaan bɔ ɔte Filistifoɛ aseɛ ɔ,
ngɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ, na bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu biala ngɔha wɔ wɔ nu.
6Mboanoa aseɛ ne kɔkakyi nekaa bɔ ngaka didi ɔ,
ɔne mmoaenneafoɛ bɛ namue
ne mmoaennduin.
7Mboanoa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ
Yuda awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ɔ bɛ deɛ,
bɔ bɛkɔfa ngaka bɛkɔhɔ so adidie ɔ,
na Asekelɔn awuro mɔ nu yeɛ bekobutubutu nɔsoa ɔ;
ofikyɛ AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ kɔpɛ ye nye kɔnea bɛ,
na ɔkɔfa bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ kosa kɔwa.
Moabo ne Amon
8 “Mate Moabo anyingahanɛ ne,
yeɛ alapaa bɔ Amonfoɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ me maen ne,
ɔne kyɛ bele anwomasoɛ bede me maen aseɛ ne ɔ.
9Yiti, kyɛbɔ nde ase ye,
amba, Moabo kɔkakyi kyɛ Sodom,
yeɛ Amonfoɛ bɛkɔkakyi kyɛ Gomora,
ndetema ne ngyee ngumaa aseɛ
ne aseɛ pralaa afebɔɔ.
Na me maen mmaa bɔ bɛkɔha ne, bɛkɔfẽ bɛ bɛkɔfa,
yeɛ me maen mmaa bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne,
bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ,
Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”
10B’anwomasoɛ ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne,
ɔnate alapaa bɔ babɔ, ɔne anwomasoɛ
bɔ bayɛ ye wɔ Asafo AWURADE maen ne aso ne ati.
11AWURADE nye kɔboro bɛ so,
ofikyɛ okonua aseɛ so mmosoen amukoraa bɛ boso,
na asue noa maen maen ne amukoraa,
sona biala kɔsɔne ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.
Yitiopia ne Asiria
12 “Ɛmɔ, Yitiopiafoɛ, ɛmɔ koso,
me ngrandɛ noa yeɛ ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ɔ.
13 Ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta sorɔ dɔ maen ne,
na ɔkɔbɔ Asiria tɔɔ;
ɔkɔkakyi Ninewe kurofoen
maa ɔkɔyɛ pralaa kyɛ ɛserɛ so.
14Ngaka kure kure kɔɔlela nu,
maen maen mɔ nu ngaka mukoraa:
nandwinoma ne mbɛsɛ kɔtena ye sua buburuwaa nemɔ aso,
bɛkɔte nnomaa suɛ wɔ ye mboma nemɔ anu,
ye aponnwaa nemɔ kodwiri kogua,
ofikyɛ ye sida bakaa mbuna nemɔ nwo kɔlela berɛ.
15Anwomasoɛ kuro
bɔ né ye so anu atɔ ye ne, ye ɛne oo,
ye bɔ osele ye nwo kyɛ,
“Me ɛne, ebiala nne berɛ ko bɔ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ” ne.
Nea kyɛbɔ wasi wakakyi kurofoen ɔ,
kyɛbɔ wakakyi ngaka dabea ɔ!
Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpɛ nu berɛ ne,
ɔkɔwoso ye ti kosobi ye noa.

Title: SEFANIA 3
Content:
Yerusalem, wɔ yaakɔ!
1Ye yaakɔ, kuro bɔ wayɛ lɔen bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ɔ,
nhyɛsoɛ kuro ne!
2Wandie AWURADE dwirɛ ne,
wandie foɛtulɛ,
wamva ye wora wanwura AWURADE nu,
wandwe wambingye ye Nyameɛ.
3Nu mbanyi mɔ
bɛte gyata mɔ bɔ bɛbobɔ nu ɔ;
ye maenbulɛfoɛ bɛte nɔsoa mbataku
bɔ bɛnyakyi bowue po mma aleɛ ngye so ɔ.
4Ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛte anwohoahoafoɛ, nnakannaka mmenia,
ye asɔfo mɔ begua nekaa krongron berɛ nwo fiɛ,
na bɛmva mmeraa ne bɛnyɛ huu.
5AWURADE bɔ ɔwɔ ye nu de, ɔte teneneeniɛ,
ɔnyɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ,
ngyerɛmɔ biala ɔda ye pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ali,
bɔ ɔnyakyi ye yɔlɛ koraa ɔ;
nakoso bɔnefoɛ mɔ de, bɛnze nyanzoen.
6“Mabɔ maen maen mɔ pasaa,
b’abandenden nemɔ adwiri agua,
mama bɛ dwaa nemɔ so ayɛ bɔfonn
bɔ ebiala mva so ɔ;
mabɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ tɔɔ
bɔ sona biala anga, bɔ ebiala ɔtte nu ɔ.
7Ngane kyɛ, ‘Esurolɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ esuro me ɔ,
me ngyerɛkyerɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ etie ɔ,
amaa ɔnate so mannua wɔ boso
wɔ bɔ mahyehyɛ mama wɔ amukoraa nwo;
nakoso ɛmɔkɔ so bɛma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ amukoraa yɛ bɔne.”
Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem
8“Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea me ate
maa okodwu kyẽa bɔ ngodwɔso ngɔɔbɔ kwaadu ne,
ofikyɛ ɔte me nhyehyɛleɛ kyɛ ngɔboaboa maen maen mɔ noa,
kyɛ ngɔboaboa ahennie mɔ noa,
ná ngɔma me yaafɛlɛ
ne m’ahonehulɛ amukoraa kɔwa bɛ so ɔ;
ofikyɛ me nungunɛ see ne,
ɔkɔyera aseɛ amukoraa motoo,”
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
9“Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔma maen maen mɔ
bɛ noa dwirɛ kɔyɛ krongron,
amaa ɔnate so bɛ mukoraa babɔ AWURADE dumaa,
ná bayɛ ko baso ye.
10Na me mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne me,
bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ Yitiopia asue mɔ si dɔ ne,
bɛkɔfa m’afɔleɛ bɛkɔbrɛ me.
11“Sɔ mmerɛ ne, w’animguaseɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa
bɔ ɛfa tole me mmeraa ne, ngɔye ngofi berɛ,
na bɛ bɔ bedi anwomasoɛ nu ahurusi ne, ngotu bɛ bo ngofi wɔ nu,
na ɛngɔyɛ ahandaen ko
wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso.
12Anwumvoin mmenia ne awiɛmvoɛ mmenia
yeɛ ngɔmaa bɛkɔha wɔ wɔ nu ɔ,
na AWURADE dumaa yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ wora bekowura nu ɔ.
13 Na mmenia bɔ bɛkɔha wɔ Yisrael ne,
bɛngɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ biala,
bɛngɔhã ngondombo dwirɛ biala,
yeɛ nnakannaka dwirɛ biala ngofi bɛ noa;
ofikyɛ bɛ de, bekoodidi ná balela berɛ,
bɔ ebiala ngonwunanwuna bɛ ɔ.”
Sion ngoalelɛ ahurusi dwein
14O Sion awa brasua, to ahurusi dwein,
O Yisrael, bɔ ese!
Ma wɔ nye gye ná fa w’ahone amukoraa di ahurusi,
O Yerusalem awa brasua!
15AWURADE aye ndɛenbualɛ ne wafi wɔ so,
wapia wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ wagua dɔ.
AWURADE, Yisrael hene ne, ɔte wɔ nu,
engosuro amaneɛ biala ko.
16Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bekose Yerusalem kyɛ,
“O Sion, nnɛsuro,
nnɛma w’abasa nu yɛ hodwoo.
17AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne ɔte wɔ nu,
ɔte katakyie ne defoɛ,
ɔkɔfa anigye koli wɔ nwo ahurusi,
ɔkɔfa ye ɔdɔ ne kɔyɛ wɔ foforɛ,
na ɔkɔfa anigye kɔto wɔ nwo dwein.
18Bɛ bɔ bedi aworabɔlɛ ne,
ngɔboaboa bɛ noa maa bekosa bekoli aluolue ne,
amaa ɔnate so animguaseɛ anga wɔ ko.
19Tie, sɔ mmerɛ ne,
me ne bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ so ne yɛkoli.
Ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ mmubuafoɛ nemɔ,
ngɔboaboa bɛ bɔ babɔ aya nemɔ noa,
na ngɔmaa bekonya animnyam ne dumaa
wɔ aseɛ amukoraa bɔ bagua bɛ nyunu ase wɔ so ne aso.
20Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngosa ngɔwa,
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ne anu.
Ngɔma ɛmɔ konya dumaa ne animnyam
wɔ aseɛ so maen maen amukoraa nu,
mmerɛ bɔ ngɔfa ɛmɔ mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ngosa ngɔwa
bɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ne,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: HAGAE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae nwomaa ne, ɔte edwirɛ porɛ porɛ biemɔ bɔ Nyameɛ fale ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so lale bɛ ali ɔ. Ɛhe sili ne, afoɛ 520 pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yudafoɛ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu basa bawa baatena Yerusalem afoɛ pee, nakoso AWURADE awuro ne de, né ɔla berɛ mbaen, bɔ wabubu wagua ɔ. Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae dwirɛ ne, ɔbɔ maen mbanyi nemɔ kɔkɔ, na osa hyɛ bɛ nguraen kyɛ besa besi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne. Hagae dwirɛ ne kyire kyɛ, odi kyɛ Nyameɛ mmenia bɛma Nyameɛ batena bɛ nu, yiti asɔneyɛɛ sua ne te nikyee bɔ ye nwo hia paa wɔ b’asetena nu ɔ. Afei Nyameɛ fale asomdwee ne ngɔsoɛ hyɛle bɛ bɔ kyɛ, sɛ bɛbɔ bra krongron a, bɛ sa kɔhã ye.
Nu Dwirɛ
Ɔhyɛ bɛ nguraen kyɛ besi Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne 1.1-15
Aworakyekyerɛ ne ngɔsoɛ dwirɛ 2.1-23

Title: HAGAE 1
Content:
Ɛ́mɔsa bési m’asɔneyɛɛ sua ne
1Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, bosome nzia ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE fale ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so hã hyirele Yuda amrado Serubabɛl bɔ ye baba ole Sɛtiɛl ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ ye baba ole Yehosadake ne kyɛ, 2“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Maen he nwa: Mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ yɛsa yɛsi AWURADE awuro ne, onnya oddwuli.” 3Yeɛ AWURADE nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so hane kyɛ, 4“Ɛmɔ de, aso mmerɛ adwu kyɛ ɛmɔtenatena ɛmɔ awuro mɔ bɔ bafa nikyee badwura ye kunu ɔ nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ awuro he de wabubu wagua ɔ? 5Yiti Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Bɔ ɔ́toto ɛmɔ ye, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn ɛ́mɔfa bɛhɔ adwenedwene nu! 6Ɛmɔalua pee, nakoso kaaba bie yeɛ ɛmɔanya bafi nu ɔ; ɛmɔdidi, nakoso ɛmɔ ko nyi; ɛmɔno nzaa, nakoso ɔmmo ɛmɔ; ɛmɔkera ɛtena, nakoso ebiala nwo nyɛ ye hye; yeɛ bɔ ode akatuaa ne, ode gua bɔtɔ bɔ ye bo atofitofi ɔ nu.
7“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Bɔ ɔ́toto ɛmɔ ye, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn ɛ́mɔfa bɛhɔ adwenedwene nu! 8Yiti ɛmɔhɔ bokaa ne aso bɛɛfa mmakaa bɛbra beesi awuro ne. Me nye kɔgye ye nwo, na ngɔla m’animnyam ali, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 9Né ɛmɔ nye la ate kyɛ ɛmɔkonya fieso nningyein pee, nakoso, ɛ́mɔnea, ɔyɛle aleɛ kaaba bie. Na ɛmɔfa bɛwale awuro nen, nhu nguale. Nzu ɔ? Bɔ Asafo AWURADE bisa hɔ ɛne. M’awuro ne bɔ wabubu wagua ne ati ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔ de, ebiala nye aboro osi ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ɔ. 10Ɔnate sɔ ati, nyameɛso mma bosue ngua mma ɛmɔ ko, yeɛ aseɛ koso ngye aleɛ ko. 11Na mato me sa mafrɛ wawa kandinga paa maa wape aseɛ so, mmokaa so, aburoo so, nzaa monɛ so, ngoo so, nikyee biala bɔ benya befi aseɛ so ɔ so, mmenia so, nyɛmmoa so, ɔne ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraa so.”
12Yeɛ Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne Yehosadake awa ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua ne maen mmaa ngaa ne amukoraa belili AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ so, ɔne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ somane ye maa ɔhane ne; na maen ne surole wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 13Yeɛ Hagae bɔ ɔte AWURADE bɔfoɛ ne, ɔhane AWURADE ngraa ne hyirele maen ne kyɛ, “Ngyi ɛmɔ si, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.” 14Na AWURADE kanyane Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl bɔ ɔte Yuda amrado ne ye sunzum, ɔne Yehosadake awa ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua sunzum, yeɛ maen mmaa ngaa ne amukoraa bɛ sunzum. Yiti bɛwale bɛɛyɔle Asafo AWURADE, bɛ Nyameɛ n’awuro ne nwo adwuma, 15wɔ bosome nzia ne anu, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nna ne, wɔ Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu.

Title: HAGAE 2
Content:
Asɔneyɛɛ sua foforɛ n’animnyam
1Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu, ye eleburanyɔ ne ko ne aso, AWURADE fale ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so lale ye dwirɛ ali kyɛ, 2“Kã kyire Yuda amrado Serubabɛl bɔ ye baba ole Sɛtiɛl ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ ye baba ole Yehosadake ne, ɔne maen mmaa ngaa ne amukoraa kyɛ, 3 ‘Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔaha ne, sua he ye daa nu animnyam ne, ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ onwuni ye ɔ? Na kekesaala ye koso, ɛmɔnwu ye sɛ? Sɛ ɛmɔfa bɛtoto ye nwo a, aso ɔtte ɛmɔ nye so nikyee mbaen bie? 4Nakoso afei de, Serubabɛl, si wɔ hue, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; Yehosadake awa ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua, si wɔ hue; yeɛ aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa, ɛ́mɔsi ɛmɔ hue, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ɛ́mɔyɔ adwuma ne, ofikyɛ ngyi ɛmɔ si, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 5 Na kyɛbɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛyɛle apam wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔfili Misraim bɛwale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu ɔ, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro. 6 Na Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ngosa ngɔwoso anwuro ne aseɛ, ɛpo ne aseɛ wosee; 7ngɔwoso maen maen mukoraa; na maen maen mukoraa b’anwonya kɔwa wa, na ngɔfa animnyam ngoyi awuro he tɛkyɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 8Ɛdwetɛ te me deɛ, yeɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ koso te me deɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 9Na awuro he, ye nziɛ ye animnyam ne, ɔkɔyɛ piri kɔtra ye daa deɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na ɛwa yeɛ ngɔma asomdwee ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’ ”
10Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, bosome ngona ne anu, ye eleburanyɔ ne nna ne aso, AWURADE fale ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so lale ye dwirɛ ali kyɛ, 11“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Adwobisa bɔ ɔfa mmeraa he anwo ne, bisa asɔfo nemɔ ma bɛye ye noa: 12‘Sɛ ebie fa naen bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ owura ye tena nu, ná ɔfa ye tena ne kã paanoo, anaa aleɛ bɔ bato, anaa nzaa, anaa ngoo, anaa aleɛ biala a, aso sɔ nikyee ne kɔyɛ krongron anaa?’ ” Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Daabi.” 13 Yeɛ Hagae bisale kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie fa ye nwo kã efuin maa ɔnate so ye nwo gua fiɛ, ná ɔfa ye nwo kã sɔ nningyein nemɔ anu bie a, aso sɔ nikyee ne nwo agua efiɛ anaa?” Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Yoo, ye nwo agua fiɛ.” 14Yeɛ Hagae toale so sele kyɛ, “Sɔ ala yeɛ mmenia hemɔ bɛte ɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ maen he te wɔ me nyunu ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ sa noa adwuma biala te ɔ; yeɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma me wɔ dɔ ne koso, ye nwo nde. 15Na ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene bɔ okosi ɔ nwo. Na mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnnya bɛttole nyɔboɛ ko bessiele nyɔboɛ ko aso wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, 16ɛmɔ asetena nu te ɛmɔ sɛ? Sɛ ebie ba kyɛ ɔbaabu aburoo kɛndɛen aburanyɔ a, onya buru; sɛ ebie ba nekaa bɔ bekyi mmakaammaa nu bɛyɔ nzaa kyɛ ɔbaafa nzaa bua aburannu a, aburanyɔ yeɛ onya ɔ. 17Mvale fieso nningyein kesenɛ, asukuo ne asukɔtwea nzɛkyele ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraa; nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 18Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔdwene ye nwo bɛnea, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ofi bosome ngona ne anu ye eleburanyɔ ne nna ne aso, bɔ ɔte kyẽa bɔ bɛtole AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne fapem ne. Ɛ́mɔdwene ye nwo! 19Aso aburoo ne bie waha wɔ pata so? Bobe ne borɔdoma ne akengaa ne olive mmakaa nemɔ, benzu mmaa. Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ngoyira ɛmɔ.”
20AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali ye pɛen nyɔ so hyirele Hagae wɔ bosome ne anu, ye eleburanyɔ ne nna ne aso kyɛ, 21“Kã kyire Yuda amrado Serubabɛl kyɛ: Mebaawoso anwuro ne aseɛ. 22Ngogu ahennie mɔ bɛ bia mɔ bɔkɔɔ; ngɔsɛkye maen maen mɔ b’ahennie anwoserɛ; ngɔhã teaseɛnam mɔ ne teaseɛnamhanɛfoɛ mɔ ngogua; mbɔngɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ kofifi ase, na ebiala kɔtɔ wɔ obiɛngo ngrandɛ noa. 23Sɔ kyẽa ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ me deɛ, me somvoɛ Serubabɛl bɔ ɛte Sɛtiɛl awa ne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ kyɛ nzɔanoɛ pɛteaa; ofikyɛ maneanea nu maye wɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

Title: SAKARIA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria Nwomaa ne, ɔte bue nyɔ, bɔ ebiala te sonongo ɔ.
Ofi ye ti 1—8 ne, ɔte Nyameɛ dwirɛ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔle ye nwo dawure ɔ. Ɔbɔle ye nwo dawure nen, afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nnu pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛbaawo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Nu dwirɛ ne pee te nyekyire, na ɔfa kyɛbɔ AWURADE kɔma Yerusalem kosa kosi ye daa nu ɔ nwo. Osa fa Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne silɛ bieku wɔ Yerusalem nwo, kyɛbɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae bɔle ye nwo dawure ne ala; yeɛ afei Nyameɛ mmenia nwotelɛ ɔne MƐSAYA ne walɛ nu.
Ye ti 9—14 ne, ɔte edwirɛ bɔ baboaboa ye noa bɔ ɔfa MƐSAYA ne nwo, ɔne ye ndɛenbualɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne anwo. Nwomaa ne bue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne 9—14, ɔkã kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole ye maen Yisrael nwo dwirɛ. Ɔkã bɔ Nyameɛ kɔsoma ye maa ɔkɔfa asomdwee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ kɔwa ne nwo dwirɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ anwobrɛaseɛ ne ngonimlilɛ HENE (9.9); afei ɔkɔyɛ mmoaenneafoɛ paa.
Nu Dwirɛ
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne anyelasoɛ nwo dwirɛ 1.1—8.23
Nyameɛ kobua maen maen bɔ bapɛ Yisrael nwo bayia ne ndɛen 9.1-8
Kyẽa bie anyelasoɛ ne asomdwee 9.9—14.21

Title: SAKARIA 1
Content:
1 Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, ye bosome mmɔtwɛ ne anu, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Berekia bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne kyɛ, 2“AWURADE ahone huli paa wɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ so. 3Yiti se bɛ kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔsa bɛbra me berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na me koso ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 4Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ, bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ belili moa nemɔ bɔle edwirɛ ne dawure behyirele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ɛmɔ bɔne atee ne ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ nwo,’ ne. Nakoso bandie, yeɛ bandɛ me so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 5Ɛmɔ nana nemɔ, bɛwɔ nisua? Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ koso, aso bɛte ngoa nu afebɔɔ? 6Nakoso me dwirɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ mva nduale me somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne, aso bɛ nwo asohwenɛ wamma ɛmɔ nana mɔ so anaa? Yiti bɛsakyerale b’adwene, na besele kyɛ, ‘Kyɛbɔ Asafo AWURADE yɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔne yɛ koli wɔ yɛ atee ne yɛ yɔleɛ nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wamaa wato yɛ ɔ.’ ”
Nyameɛ twe Sion ne Yerusalem nwo nungunɛ
7Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, ye bosome buru ne ko ne, bɔ oli Sebate ne, ye eleburanyɔ ne nna ne aso, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Berekia bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne kyɛ, 8 “Nyane nyekyire kɔngɔen, na yieee, né biaa bie te pɔngɔ kɔkorɛ so! Né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu wɔ bɔnza ne anu, na né mbɔngɔ kɔkorɛ, kyerekyerɛɛ ne fufue begyigyi biaa ne si dɔ. 9Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, ‘Me mene, na ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?’ Yeɛ abɔfo bɔ né ɔne me dwudwo ne buale me kyɛ, ‘Ngohyire wɔ bɔ bɛte ɔ.’ 10Yiti biaa bɔ né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu dɔ ne, obuale kyɛ, ‘Ɛhemɔ yeɛ AWURADE asoma bɛ kyɛ beehyinihyini aseɛ so ɔ.’ 11Na bebuale AWURADE abɔfo bɔ né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu dɔ ne kyɛ, ‘Yahyinihyini aseɛ so, na yieee, né aseɛ amukoraa la berɛ dinn bɔ ode ye nwome ɔ.’ 12Yeɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne bisale kyɛ, ‘O Asafo AWURADE, Yerusalem ne Yuda nguro bɔ w’ahone ahu bɛ so afoɛ aburasoo ɛhe ne, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ engonwu bɛ anwumvoin ɔ?’ 13Na AWURADE le ndɛenvɛen ne aworakyekyerɛ dwirɛ buale abɔfo bɔ né ɔne me dwudwo ne. 14Yiti abɔfo bɔ né ɔne me yɛdwudwo ne, osele me kyɛ, ‘Bɔ ye dawure kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Metwe Yerusalem ne Sion nwo nungunɛ piri paa, 15nakoso maen maen mɔ bɔ bɛ so anu atɔ bɛ ne de, mafɛ bɛ so yaa piri paa; ofikyɛ mvɛle yaa kaaba bie, nakoso maen maen nemɔ de, bɛmane amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛle piri paa. 16Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Anwumvoin yeɛ mafa mapɛ me nye maanea Yerusalem ɔ; berɛ yeɛ bekosi m’awuro ne ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na bɛkɔfa nyamaa bɔ bɛfa besusu nikyee ne yeɛ bekosusu Yerusalem ɔ. 17Bɔ ye dawure bieku kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Me nguro nemɔ kosa konya ngɔsoɛ mmorosoɛ, na AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye Sion wora, na okosa kɔneanea nu kɔye Yerusalem.’ ”
Mmɛen nna nemɔ
18Afei, ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni mmɛen nna. 19Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, “Na ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na obuale me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole mmɛen bɔ bɛbɔle Yuda, Yisrael ne Yerusalem bɛsandele ne.” 20Afei AWURADE hyirele me tomvoɛ nna. 21Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛbaayɔ ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Mmɛen hemɔ yeɛ bɛbɔle Yuda bɛsandele bɔ ɔmaa ebiala wangora ye ti so ma ne. Nakoso tomvoɛ hemɔ bawa kyɛ bɛbaanwunanwuna bɛ, kyɛ maen maen bɔ bɛfale bɛ mmɛen bedwɔso betiale Yuda aseɛ bɛbɔle bɛ bɛsandele ne, bɛbaatutu bɛ mmɛen ne begua.”

Title: SAKARIA 2
Content:
Biaa bɔ ɔbaasusu Yerusalem ne
1Ndole me nye anwuro bieku nneane, na yieee, nwuni biaa bie bɔ otira nyamaa bɔ bɛfa besusu nikye ɔ. 2Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛkɔ ɔ?” Na obuale me kyɛ, “Mekwaasusu Yerusalem menea kyɛbɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne ye tendenn nu osi te ɔ.” 3Yieee, abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne hɔle ye nyunu, na abɔfo foforɛ hɔle ooyiale ye, 4na osele ye kyɛ, “Tu amirika kɔhã kyire aberandeɛ he kyɛ, ‘Yerusalem kɔyɛ kyɛ nguraa nguraa bɔ fasue nne bɛ nwo ɔ, ɔnate nu mmenia somaa ne nu nyɛmmoa somaa ti. 5Ofikyɛ me bɔbɔ, ngɔyɛ ye see fasue ngɔpɛ ye nwo ngɔbra ngoyia, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na ngɔyɛ ye nu animnyam.’ ”
6Huuu, huuu! Ɛ́mɔnwati béfi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso oo, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; ofikyɛ mabɔ ɛmɔ masande kyɛ anwuro mvrama nna ne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 7Huuu, Sion ee, pepɛ de wɔ nwo oo, wɔ bɔ ɛne Babilɔn awa brasua bɛte ɔ. 8Ofikyɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: Ye animnyam ne ati yeɛ ɔsomane me wɔ maen maen bɔ bɛfene ɛmɔ bɛfale nemɔ berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye sa kɔhã ɛmɔ ne, né wafa ye sa wahã AWURADE nye kyiremvua. 9“Tie, ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhɔ bɛ so, na bɛ koso bɛkɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɛkɔma bɛ ngoaa mɔ, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɔ. 10O Sion awa brasua, to dwein ná di ahurusi; ofikyɛ tie, méba, na ngɔɔtena wɔ nu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 11Na sɔ kyẽa ne, maen maen pee bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo kɔɔbɔ AWURADE, na bɛkɔyɛ me maen. Ngɔtena wɔ nu, amaa ɔnate so anwu ye kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me wɔ berɛ ɔ. 12AWURADE kɔfa Yuda kɔyɛ ye agyapadeɛ kyɛ ye kyɛfa deɛ wɔ aseɛ krongron ne aso, na okosa kɔfa Yerusalem kɔyɛ ye deɛ.”
13 Adasa mukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ konn wɔ AWURADE nyunu; ofikyɛ wawoso ye nwo wɔ ye atenaleɛ krongron berɛ.

Title: SAKARIA 3
Content:
Ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua
1 Afei ohyirele me ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ né ogyi AWURADE abɔfo ne nyunu berɛ ɔ, na né Satan gyi ye sa famaa so berɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ ye kwaadu. 2 Yeɛ AWURADE sele Satan kyɛ, “Wɔ, Satan, AWURADE ohwi wɔ nyunu! AWURADE bɔ waneanea nu waye Yerusalem ne, ohwi wɔ nyunu! Ɛhe, aso nna gyetia bɔ baye bafi see nu ɔ?” 3Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yosua wura ndaadeɛ fiɛ ogyi abɔfo ne nyunu berɛ. 4Na abɔfo ne sele bɛ bɔ begyigyi ye nyunu berɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpuropuro ye nwo ndaadeɛ fiɛ ne!” Na afei osele Yosua kyɛ, “Tie, maprapra w’amumuyɛɛ ne mafi wɔ so, na ngɔfa ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene ngowura wɔ.” 5Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Maa bɛfa abotire bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛbɔ ye.” Yiti bɛfale abotire bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛbɔle ye, na bɛfale ndaadeɛ bewurale ye. Né AWURADE abɔfo ne ogyi berɛ.
6Na AWURADE abɔfo ne fa tole Yosua nyunu kyɛ, 7“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ ɛfa m’atee so ná edi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ye de ngɔfa m’awuro ne ngowura wɔ sa, na ɛkɔnea m’aluo berɛ so, na ngɔmaa ekonya atee ɛkɔboka bɛ bɔ begyigyi ɛwa nemɔ aso. 8 Afei tie, ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua, ɛne wɔ mmango bɔ bɛtete wɔ nyunu berɛ ne, ofikyɛ bɛte anwanwafoɛ. Na tie, mebaafa MMAEN bɔ ɔte me somvoɛ ne meba. 9Tie, nyɔboɛ bɔ mafa mato Yosua nyunu, nyɔboɛ komapɛ bɔ ye nye nzoo ne. Tie, so yeɛ ngokolikoli ye ahyerɛlɛ ne ngogua ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na ngokyikyi aseɛ he amumuyɛɛ ne ngofi berɛ ɛlɛhomapɛ. 10 Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔ nu biala kɔfrɛfrɛ ye mmango kɔwa ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma bakaa bo, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

Title: SAKARIA 4
Content:
Sikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa ne
1Abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne, osa wale bieku, na otingyele me kyɛ sona bɔ betingye ye befi ye nnafelɛ nu ɔ. 2Na obisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ enwu ye e?” Yeɛ mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu kanea bakaa bɔ ye mukoraa te sikaa kɔkorɛ, bɔ bua gyi ye ti afia, bɔ ye nganea nzoo wɔ so, bɔ dodobɛen nzoo wɔ kanea biala bɔ ɔwɔ ye ti afia ne aso ɔ. 3 Né olive mmakaa nyɔ gyigyi ye nwo berɛ, ko wɔ bua ne famaa so, yeɛ ko wora ɔwɔ ye bɛen so.” 4Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, ‘Me mene, ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?’ 5Na abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne buale me kyɛ, “Aso ɛnze kyɛbɔ ɛhemɔ bɛ bo kyire ɔ?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Daabi, me mene.” 6Na obuale me kyɛ, “AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔkã kyire Serubabɛl ole kyɛ: Nna anwoserɛ ɔ, yeɛ nna tumi ɔ, na mmom me Sunzum ɔ. Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 7Ao bokaa piri, wɔ ole nwa? Ɛkɔkakyi aseɛ frɛtɛɛ wɔ Serubabɛl nyunu. Na ɔkɔfa nyɔboɛ titire ne kɔwa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ese kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ lo ye oo, Nyameɛ lo ye oo!’ ” 8AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali bieku hyirele me kyɛ, 9“Serubabɛl sa yeɛ wato awuro he fapem ɔ, na ye sa yeɛ okosi koyie ɔ. Na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. 10 Na adwuma ne bohyɛlɛ kaaba ne, ebiala bɔ wabu ye animtia ne, okoli ahurusi, mmerɛ bɔ okonwu kyɛ Serubabɛl otira nyamaa bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ sua wɔ ye sa nu ne. Na kanea nzoo hemɔ te AWURADE nye mɔ bɔ bɛbɔ mborɔkaa wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.” 11Yeɛ mmisale ye kyɛ, “Olive mmakaa nyɔ hemɔ bɔ begyigyi kanea bakaa ne famaa so ne ye bɛen so ne, bɛte nzu?” 12Na nza mmisale ye pɛen nyɔ so kyɛ, “Olive mmakaa mmaen nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ dodobɛen nyɔ bɔ behwie sikaa kɔkorɛ ngoo befi nu ne, bɛte nzu?” 13Yeɛ obisale me kyɛ, “Yiti ɛnze bɔ ɛhemɔ bɛte ɔ?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Me mene, daabi oo.” 14Afei osele kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole abɔdeɛ nyɔ bɔ bapopa bɛ ngoo bɔ begyigyi aseɛ amukoraa Mene ne nwo berɛ ne.”

Title: SAKARIA 5
Content:
Nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne
1Nza ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni nwomaa bie bɔ babobɔ bɔ otu ɔ! 2Yeɛ abɔfo ne bisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ enwu ye e?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu nwomaa bɔ babobɔ bɔ otu ɔ; ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ buru.” 3Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhe te ɛnomalɛ bɔ okyinikyini fa aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ. Ebiala bɔ okowua ne, bɔ ɔwɔ ye bue faen ne yeɛ bekogyina so bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi wa ɔ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔta ndaen mbaen ne, bɔ ɔwɔ ye bue faen ne yeɛ bekogyina so bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi wa ɔ. 4Ngɔsoma ye maa ɔkɔhɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na okowura awueniɛ n’awuro, yeɛ bɔ ɔfa me dumaa ta ndaen mbaen ɔ awuro; okosikye ye awuro berɛ, na ɔkɔyera awuro ne, nu mmakaa ne nu nyɔboɛ.”
Braa bɔ ɔte asusudeɛ kɛndɛen nu ne
5Yeɛ abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne wale moa oosele me kyɛ, “To wɔ nye anwuro ná nea nikye horɛ bɔ ɔ́kɔ ne.” 6Na mmisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nikyee ɛne?” Yeɛ obuale kyɛ, “Ɛhe te asusudeɛ kɛndɛen bɔ ofi wa kɔ ɔ.” Osa sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe te b’amumuyɛɛ wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so.” 7Na yieee, bebukyele kɛndɛen ne ti bɔ ɔte sum ne aso, na né braa bie te kɛndɛen ne anu. 8Yeɛ abɔfo ne sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe te Amumuyɛɛ.” Na ɔnyemane braa ne aso wurale asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne anu, na ɔfale ye ti sum nonɛnonɛ ne butuli so. 9Afei ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni mmrasua nyɔ kyɛ bɛba ɔ. Né mvrama wɔ bɛ ndaa nu. Né bele ndaa te kyɛ akyemvona katakyie ndaa, na bɛmane kɛndɛen ne aso bɛfale aseɛ ne nyameɛso b’afia. 10Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛhemɔ bɛfa asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne bɛkɔ e?” 11Na obuale me kyɛ, “Bɛfa bɛkɔ Sinari aseɛ so, ná bekosi sua bɛma ye wɔ berɛ; na beyie a, bɛkɔfa asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne bekosie ye nyinasoɛ ne aso.”

Title: SAKARIA 6
Content:
Teaseɛnam nna nemɔ
1Nza ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni teaseɛnam nna kyɛ befi mmokaa nyɔ b’afia bɛba ɔ. Né mmokaa nemɔ te kɔɔbere mmokaa. 2 Teaseɛnam bɔ oli moa ne, mbɔngɔ bɔ bɛsosɔ ye ne bɛte kɔkorɛ; teaseɛnam bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, mbɔngɔ bɔ bɛsosɔ ye ne bɛte bire; 3 teaseɛnam bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne, mbɔngɔ bɔ bɛsosɔ ye ne bɛte fufue; yeɛ teaseɛnam bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne koso, mbɔngɔ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te kyerekyerɛɛ yeɛ bɛsosɔ ye ɔ. 4Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, “Me mene, na ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?” 5 Na abɔfo ne buale me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole nyameɛso sunzum nna ne, bɔ begyinagyina aseɛ amukoraa Mene ye nyunu berɛ beyie a befi berɛ bɛkɔ ne. 6Teaseɛnam bɔ mbɔngɔ bire bɛsosɔ ye ne, befi berɛ bɛkɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu; yeɛ fufue nemɔ koso befi berɛ bedi bɛ si, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te kyerekyerɛɛ ne koso bɛkɔ ngwaen dɔ maen ne anu.” 7Na anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ wale nen, né bɛpe ndɛen bekyinikyini aseɛ so. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beehyinihyini aseɛ so.” Na beehyinihyinini aseɛ so. 8Na ɔteane nu sele me kyɛ, “Nea, bɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu ne, bama me Sunzum kunu adwo ye fɔnwoo wɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu.”
Yerusalem foforɛ ne
9Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ, 10“Heldae, Tobiya ne Yedaya bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle bɔ bafi Babilɔn bawa ne, de (ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne) fi bɛ berɛ; ná kɔ Sefania awa Yosia awuro sɔ kyẽa ne ala. 11Fa ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ yɛ abotire mɔ, ná fa bɔ Yohosadake awa ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua, 12 ná se ye kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, biaa bɔ ye dumaa li ‘MMAEN’ ne, ye ɛhe. Ɔkɔfefɛ kofi ye boso, na okosi AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne. 13Amba, ye yeɛ okosi AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɔ, okonya ahennie animnyam ne, ɔkɔtena ye ahennie bia so koli hene, okoli sɔfo wɔ ye ahennie bia ne aso, na asomdwee bɔ odi mu ɔ kɔwa bɛ munyɔ b’afia.” 14Na abotire nemɔ kɔyɛ ngayeɛ nikyee kɔma Helem, Tobiya, Yedaya ne Sefania awa Hen wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.
15“Na bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nziɛ nziɛ ne, bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔboka wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne silɛ nu, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. Na sɛ ɛmɔyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo sotie bɔkɔɔ a, sɔ dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu.”

Title: SAKARIA 7
Content:
Akɔngyere nwo adwobisa
1Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne anu, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Sakaria wɔ bosome ngona bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kislewi ne anu, ye ɛlɛnna ne aso. 2Né Betelfoɛ bali moa basoma Saresa ne Regyem Meleke ne bɛ mmenia maa bawa kyɛ bɛɛsrɛ AWURADE ma onwu bɛ anwumvoin, 3ná bebisa Asafo AWURADE awuro berɛ asɔfo mɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Aso nni aworabɔlɛ ná ngye hɔen wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne anu, kyɛbɔ mayɔ ye afoɛ worawora ye anu ye anaa?” 4Yeɛ Asafo AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ, 5“Bisa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa ne asɔfo nemɔ kyɛ: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔhyele hɔen ná ɛmɔlili aworabɔlɛ wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu, ɔne nzoo ne anu, bɔ afoɛ aburasoo ɛhe ne, aso me ti yeɛ ɛmɔhyele hɔen ne ɔ? 6Na sɛ ɛmɔdidi ná ɛmɔno koso a, aso nna ɛmɔ bɔbɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdidi bɛno bɛma bɛ nwo ɔ? 7Mmerɛ bɔ né mmenia tete Yerusalem bɔ né wanya ngɔsoɛ, bɔ né ye nguro mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia, bɔ né mmenia tete ye ngwaen dɔ ne aseɛ pralaa ne aso ne, aso nna sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ yeɛ AWURADE fale daa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ aso bɔle ye dawure ɔ?”
8Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Sakaria kyɛ, 9“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo, ná ebiala ɔla anwumvoinnwunɛ ne adɔeɛ ali ohyire obiɛngo; 10nnɛma ɛmɔsisi kunafoɛ, ayisiaa, ɛwɔfoɛ ne ehianiɛ; yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala dwene obiɛngo nwo adwene tɛɛ.” 11Nakoso bɛpole kyɛ bekotie ɔ, bɛpemone b’awaen, yeɛ betuatuale bɛ so, kyɛbɔ bɛngɔte ɔ. 12Bɛyɛle bɛ so serɛ kyɛ twerɛboɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛngɔte mmeraa ne ne edwirɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE nate ye Sunzum so mane daa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛbɔle ye dawure ne ɔ. Yiti Asafo AWURADE ahone huli piri paa. 13Na kyɛbɔ ɔfrɛle ná bandie ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛfrɛle bɔ me koso mandie ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 14Na mvale mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ mmɔle bɛ nzandele maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛnze bɛ ɔ so. Na aseɛ bɔ bɛyakyili ye bɛ si ne ɔlale berɛ mbaen, bɔ sona biala wambɛ nu berɛ, kyɛ ɔkɔ oo, anaa ɔba oo, na aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne lale berɛ mbaen.”

Title: SAKARIA 8
Content:
Yerusalem kosa kosi ye gya nu
1Na Asafo AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me bieku kyɛ, 2“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Metwe Sion nwo nungunɛ piri paa, ɛyaa piri paa yeɛ mefa metwe ye nwo nungunɛ ɔ. 3AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ngosa ngɔwa Sion, na ngɔɔtena Yerusalem, na bɛkɔfrɛ Yerusalem kyɛ: Nahorɛ Kuro; yeɛ Asafo AWURADE bokaa ne koso kyɛ, Bokaa Krongron. 4Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mmienzua nworowaa ne mmrasua nworowaa kɔhɔ so kɔtenatena Yerusalem dwaaso, na bekotiratira pɔmaa, ɔnate kyɛ bɛkɔyɛ nworowaa posoposo. 5Kuro ne, mmɛɛmaa ne mmaayaa koyi ye dwaa nemɔ aso to, bɔ bekoli angorɛ wɔ ye dwaa nemɔ aso ɔ. 6Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Maen he anu mmenia bɔ baha ne, sɛ ɔyɛ bɛ nye so nwanwa wɔ mmerɛ he anu a, aso me koso ɔkɔyɛ me nye so nwanwa anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 7Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, ngɔpepɛ ngole me maen ngofi eyia afiteleɛ maen ne sa nu, ɔne eyia atɔleɛ maen ne sa nu; 8na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa maa bɛkɔɔtena Yerusalem; bɛkɔyɛ me maen, na me koso mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, wɔ nahorɛ ne tenenee nu.”
9Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔasi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, ɛmɔ bɔ sɔ mmerɛ ye anu ɛmɔate edwirɛ hemɔ bafi ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ noa ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ofi kyẽa bɔ bɛtole Asafo AWURADE awuro ne fapem nen. 10Ofikyɛ, anzana sɔ mmerɛ ne baawa ne, né akatuaa biala nne berɛ mma sona, yeɛ né ebie koso nne berɛ mma kaka. Na sɛ né ebie ɔkɔ oo, anaa ɔba oo, pɔfoɛ ne ati, né olle asomdwee biala, ofikyɛ nganyane sona biala maa odwɔso tiale obiɛngo. 11Nakoso kekesaala ye de, maen he mmenia bɔ baha ne, me ne bɛ ngoli ye kyɛbɔ nyɔle ye daa ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 12Ofikyɛ nningyein lualɛ kɔyɛ asomdwee nu, bobe kosu ye mma, aseɛ kɔhye aleɛ, anwuro kɔtɔ ye bosue, na maen he mmenia bɔ baha ne, ngɔmaa bekonya ɛhemɔ amukoraa. 13O Yuda awuro ama ne Yisrael awuro ama, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔakakyi amoenwaa dwirɛ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngole ɛmɔ ngoa ɔ, na ɛmɔkɔyɛ saleɛ. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, na mmom ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye.”
14Ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Kyɛbɔ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛkoli ye weewee, mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ huli m’ahone, bɔ manzesã m’adwene ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, 15sɔ ala koso yeɛ mayɛ m’adwene sɔ mmerɛ ye anu kyɛ ngɔyɛ Yerusalem ne Yuda awuro ama paa ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! 16 Ɛhemɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ: Odi kyɛ ebiala kã nahorɛ kyire obiɛngo; nekaa bɔ ɛmɔdi dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbua ndɛen turoloo bɔ ɔfa asomdwee ba ɔ; 17nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala nya obiɛngo nwo adwene tɛɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔ nye gye ngondombo ndaentalɛ nwo, ofikyɛ mekyi sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”
18Yeɛ Asafo AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ, 19“Asafo AWURADE nwa: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne anu akɔngyere ne, nnu ne anu akɔngyere ne, nzoo ne anu akɔngyere ne, ɔne buru ne anu akɔngyere ne, bɛkɔyɛ ahurusililɛ, anwosɛpɛlɛ ne anigye aluolue kɔma Yuda awuro ama. Yiti ɛmɔhuro nahorɛ ne asomdwee.
20“Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Okosa kosi bieku kyɛ, maen maen nemɔ bɛ nguro pee nufoɛ kɔwa; 21kuro ko anu ama kɔhɔ kuro ko aso koose kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛhã yɛ nwo yɛɛkoto yɛsrɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná yɛpena Asafo AWURADE si atee; me koso ngɔhɔ bie.’ 22Amba, maen maen pee ne maen maen bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔpena Asafo AWURADE si atee wɔ Yerusalem, na bɛkɔkoto bɛkɔsrɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 23Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: sɔ mmerɛ ne, edwudwolɛ biala nu mmenia buru bɔ befi maen maen mɔ nu ɔ bɛkɔsosɔ Yudaniɛ ko ataadeɛ noa, na bekose kyɛ, ‘Yɛne ɛmɔ kɔhɔ, ofikyɛ yate kyɛ Nyameɛ gyi ɛmɔ si.’ ”

Title: SAKARIA 9
Content:
1AWURADE dwirɛ ne ɔko tia Hadrake aseɛ,
na ɔkɔho kotia Damasko koso.
Na adasa mmaa bɛ nye kɔkakyi kɔwa AWURADE berɛ,
kyɛbɔ Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa bɛ nye kɔkakyi kɔwa ye berɛ ne.
2Hamate bɔ ɔwɔ ɛwɛen so dɔ ne koso edwirɛ ne ko tia ye;
Tiro ne Sidon koso sɔ ala, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ besusu kyɛ bɛse nworɛ.
3Tiro sili anwoserɛ afealeɛ fale,
ɔboaboale ɛdwetɛ noa kyɛ mvuture,
ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ paa noa kyɛ mmorɔnoɛ so nnɛterɛ.
4Tie, AWURADE kole ye anwodeɛ ne kofi ye sa nu,
ɔkɔsɛkye ye tumi ne wɔ ɛpo nu,
na see yeɛ ɔkɔyera ye motoo ɔ.
5Asekelɔn konwu ye, na ɛserɛ kɔhã ye,
Gasa koso sɔ ala, na ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ye so,
yeɛ Ekron, ofikyɛ ye anyelasoɛ kɔyɛ basaa.
Ɛhene ne kowu kofi Gasa,
na Asekelɔn kɔkakyi kurofoen.
6Mmenia firaman firaman yeɛ bɛkɔtena Asedɔde ɔ,
na ngotu Filistia b’anwomasoɛ ne abo.
7Ngɔye ye naen mogya mogya ne ngofi ye noa nu,
ɔne ye nikyee bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ne ngofi ye gye nemɔ b’afia.
Na mmenia bɔ bɛkɔha ne, bɛkɔyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ye deɛ,
bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ Yuda nu mbanyi nemɔ bie,
na Ekron kɔyɛ kyɛ Yebusifoɛ.
8Afei ɔnate ɛlɔen ne ati, ngɔto waen ngɔfa m’awuro ne anwo,
ɔnate mmenia bɔ bɛpɛ nu berɛ bɛkɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔ besa bɛba ne ati,
na nhyɛsoɛniɛ biala ngɔpɛ nu ngɔfa bɛ nu berɛ ko,
ofikyɛ afei de, mefa me nye menea.
9 O Sion awa brasua, di ahurusi paa!
O Yerusalem awa brasua, bɔ ese!
Tie, wɔ Hene ne ɔ́ba wɔ berɛ,
ɔtengyɛ, na ye yeɛ ngoalelɛ wɔ ye berɛ ɔ,
odwo, na ɔte afunum so,
afunum akrɔngrɔma so, bɔ ɔte afunum beleɛ ɔ.
10 Ngonua teaseɛnam mɔ boso ngofi Efraim,
ngonua mbɔngɔ boso ngofi Yerusalem,
yeɛ ngonua koɛhonɛ agyaen boso.
Ɔkɔhã asomdwee dwirɛ kohyire maen maen mɔ,
