ye ahennie kofi ɛpo kɔɔhã ɛpo,
okofi asue ne kɔɔhã aseɛ noa dɔ.
11 Na wɔ koso, ɔnate w’apam mogya ne ati,
wɔ mmenia bɔ begua kuku nu ne,
ngɔye bɛ ngofi kumaa bɔ nzue nne nu ne anu.
12O, ɛmɔ, kukunufoɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya anyelasoɛ ɔ,
ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu;
na ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mefa meto dwaa kyɛ,
ngɔfa ye mmɔhoɛ nyɔ ngosi wɔ gya nu.
13Ofikyɛ makondo Yuda mayɛ m’agyaen,
mafa Efraim mayɛ agyaen bakaa mawura nu,
O Sion, ngɔkanyane wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ
maa bekodwɔso bekotia Hela mma mmienzua mɔ,
na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie ngrandɛ.
14Afei AWURADE kɔye ye nwo ali wɔ bɛ so,
ye agyaen ne kɔhɔ kyɛ agralaa,
AWURADE Nyameɛ kohu totorobɛndo,
na ɔkɔfa ngwaen dɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne anu yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ ɔ.
15Asafo AWURADE kɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen,
bekoli ngonim, bekohwi bɛkɔfa taya nyɔboɛ so,
bɛkɔno, na bɛkɔbɔ ese kyɛ ebiaa babobo ne,
bɛ ko koyi kyɛ talie,
kyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ndweasoɛ nemɔ.
16Na sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ kole bɛ ngoa,
ɔnate kyɛ bɛte ye maen mmoaen kure,
ofikyɛ bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mbembenanneɛ bɔ betuatua abotire nu
bɔ bɛta wɔ ye aseɛ so ɔ.
17Ah, kyɛbɔ osi te paa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye nwo si yɛ nyemene ɔ!
Aburoo kɔma mmerandeɛ mɔ kɔyɛ tukutukuu,
na nzaa monɛ koso kɔma ndaluwa kɔyɛ sɔ ala.

Title: SAKARIA 10
Content:
1Odi kyɛ ɛmɔsrɛ AWURADE maa ɔtɔ esue wɔ bamborɔ mmerɛ nu;
AWURADE bɔ ɔma esue muna ne,
ye yeɛ ɔma esue tɔ pee ma mmenia ɔ,
na ɔtɔ ma ebiala maa onya fieso aleɛ.
2Ofikyɛ abusua amoen nemɔ kekã ngwaseasɛm,
ahɔmeɛ nemɔ benwu nnakannaka dwirɛ,
na bɛ laleɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ bɛkekã ne, ɔte ngondombo;
bɛkyekye ɛmɔ wora mbaen.
Yiti maen ne kyinikyini kyɛ mmoaen,
bɛyɛ anwumvo, ofikyɛ neafoɛ biala nne berɛ.
3“M’ahone ahu mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ so,
na ngɔhwe mbɔngye nemɔ so;
ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE kɔɔpasa ye mmoaen kure
bɔ ye ole Yuda awuro ama ne anwo,
na ɔkɔfa bɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ ye anidie pɔngɔ wɔ koɛ nu.
4Ye nu yeɛ ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ ne kofi ɔ,
ye nu yeɛ pɛmbɛen ne kofi ɔ,
ye nu yeɛ koɛhonɛ agyaen ne kofi ɔ,
ye nu yeɛ maenbulɛniɛ biala kofi ɔ.
5Na bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie mɔ
bɔ betiatia bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so wɔ mmorɔnoɛ so nnɛterɛ nu wɔ koɛ nu ɔ.
Bɛkɔho koɛ,
ofikyɛ AWURADE gyi bɛ si,
na pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɔ bɛtete pɔngɔ so ɔ bɛ nyunu kogua ase.
6“Ngɔma Yuda awuro ama b’ahone kɔyɛ se,
na ngɔpepɛ ngole Yosef awuro ama.
Ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa ngɔɔbɔ bɛ atenaseɛ,
ofikyɛ manwu bɛ anwumvoin,
ngɔyɛ bɛ kyɛ nna bɛ yeɛ mbole bɛ ne,
ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ,
na ngotie bɛ sufrɛ.
7Efraim kɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie,
na bɛ ti anu kɔyɛ bɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ kyɛ bano nzaa ɔ.
Amba, bɛ mma konwu ye, na bekoli ahurusi,
na bɛ ti anu kɔyɛ bɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ wɔ AWURADE nu.
8“Ngɔbɔ mvrɛma ngɔfrɛ bɛ ngɔboaboa bɛ noa,
ofikyɛ mapɔ bɛ male bɛ,
na bɛkɔta pee kyɛbɔ bɛtale pee ne.
9Ngolualua bɛ wɔ maen maen mɔ so,
na bɛkɔkaye me wɔ maen maen mɔ so dedeede dɔ,
na bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ bekonya ngoa ná basa bawa.
10Ngosa ngɔye bɛ ngofi Misraim aseɛ so ngɔwa,
yeɛ ngɔboaboa bɛ noa ngofi Asiria;
na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa Gileade ne Lebanon aseɛ so,
na berɛ aseɛ po, ɔkɔyɛ kãa kɔma bɛ.
11Ɔkɔɔfa anwokyere ɛpo ne anu,
okoli ɛpo nu asorɔkye ne aso ngonim,
na asue Naele nu buma mukoraa kɔwewe.
Ɔkɔbrɛ Asiria anwomasoɛ ne ase,
na Misraim ɛhɔtɔ ne, ye boso komini.
12Ngɔmaa bekogyina pindinn wɔ AWURADE nu,
na ye dumaa nu yeɛ bɛkɔnate ɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: SAKARIA 11
Content:
1Wɔ, Lebanon, bukyebukye w’anoa nemɔ
ma see ne ɔyera wɔ sida nemɔ.
2Wɔ, ɛframmire, bɔ awuye, ofikyɛ sida atutu atɔ ase,
ofikyɛ animnyam mmakaa nemɔ basɛkye.
Basan eluii mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye,
ofikyɛ babu ɛhɔayeɛ too ne bagua.
3Ɛ́mɔtie mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ b’awuyebɔlɛ ne,
ofikyɛ b’animnyam ne atɔ ase.
Ɛ́mɔtie gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ bobɔlɛ bɔ bɛbobɔ nu ne,
ofikyɛ asue Yɔɔdan nwo ɛhɔayeɛ ne wayɛ pralaa.
4AWURADE me Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Mmoaen kure bɔ bɛ́fa bɛ bɛ́kɔ akumyɛɛ ne, yɛ bɛ so neafoɛ. 5Bɛ bɔ bɛtɔ bɛ ne, bekuku bɛ bɛfa bɛ nwo bedi. Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ bɛ atɔen ne koso, bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Animnyam hã AWURADE, ofikyɛ manya me nwo’; yeɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ neafoɛ nemɔ koso bennwu bɛ anwumvoin. 6Ofikyɛ mengonwu aseɛ ne aso ama anwumvoin ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Tie, ngɔma mmenia kɔtotɔ, bɔ ebiala kɔtɔ wɔ obiɛngo sa nu, ɔne ye hene sa nu ɔ. Bɛkɔyɛ aseɛ ne pasaa, na mengɔpepɛ mengole bɛ nngofi bɛ sa nu.”
7Na ngɔyɛ akumyɛɛ mmoaen kure ne aso neafoɛ, nganga, bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo wɔ mmoaen kure ne anu ne. Mvale pɔmaa nyɔ. Ndole ko dumaa: Ɛlolɛ, yeɛ ko ne wora ndole ye dumaa: Koyɛlɛ, na nneane mmoaen kure ne aso. 8Na bosome ko anu, nnuane mmoaenneafoɛ nza nemɔ bɛ boso mvili berɛ. Bɛ nwo yɛle me kra ahi, na me koso me nwo yɛle bɛ kra tɛ. 9Yeɛ nzele kyɛ, “Mengɔyɛ ɛmɔ neafoɛ ko. Bɔ odi kyɛ owu ne, ówu; bɔ odi kyɛ ye boso nua ne, ye boso ónua; na bɛ bɔ baha ne, ebiala óli obiɛngo naen.”
10Afei mvale me pɔmaa bɔ oli Ɛlolɛ ne, na mmuli nu, kyɛ mefa mepɛ m’apam bɔ me ne maen amukoraa yayɛ ne anu. 11Yiti nu pɛle sɔ kyẽa ne, na mmoaen kure ne anu biemɔ bɔ né bɛyɛ anwumvo, bɔ né bɛ nye tua me ne, benwuni kyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 12 Yeɛ nzele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔte paa ma ɛmɔ a, ye de ɛ́mɔtua me kerɛ; nakoso sɛ ɔtte mayee mma ɛmɔ a, ye de ɛ́mɔyakyi.” Yiti bɛkarili ɛdwetɛ sekel aburasa bɛfa bɛyɛle m’akatuaa. 13Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Gyi gua ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne berɛ.” Nyɔboɛ bɔ odi mu bɔ bɛbɔle kyɛ bɛfa bɛtɔ me hɔ ɛne. Yiti mvale ɛdwetɛ aburasa ne, na ngyi nguale ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne berɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ. 14Yeɛ mmuli me pɔmaa bɔ oli Koyɛlɛ ne anu, kyɛ mefa mepɛ aliɛmaayɛlɛ bɔ ɔla Yuda ne Yisrael b’afia ne anu.
15Afei AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sa fa mmoaenneafoɛ kwaseaa ye nningyein bɔ ɔfa nea mmoaen so ɔ tira. 16Tie, mebaama mmoaenneafoɛ bie odwɔso wɔ aseɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔngɔdwene bɛ bɔ bamini ne anwo, bɔ ɔngɔpena akrɔngrɔma nemɔ si atee, bɔ ɔngɔyɛ bɛ bɔ bapura nemɔ ayire, bɔ ɔngɔma bɛ bɔ bɛte apɔ ne aleɛ ɔ; na mmom okohu bɛ bɔ balɔ ne koli, ná watete bɛ gya boen nu pasapasa.
17Mmoaenneafoɛ tɛɛ bɔ
ɔto mmoaen nemɔ asaworam ne, ye yaakɔ!
Ngrandɛ kɔpɛ ye sa,
yeɛ okotu ye nye famaa.
Ye sa kowu bɔkɔɔ,
na ye nye famaa kosi bɔkɔɔ.”

Title: SAKARIA 12
Content:
Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem
1AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Yisrael nwo ɛhe: AWURADE bɔ ɔtrɛtrɛle ewienu nu, bɔ ɔtole aseɛ fapem, bɔ ɔnwone sona sunzum wɔ ye nu ne, ɔnwa nyoo: 2“Tie, mebaafa Yerusalem meyɛ nzaabolɛ kulie mema maen maen bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia amukoraa; na bekotua Yuda wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bekotua Yerusalem ne anu. 3Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa Yerusalem ngɔyɛ nyɔboɛ nonɛnonɛ ngɔma maen maen amukoraa, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpagya ye ne, okopura piri paa, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ aseɛ so maen maen amukoraa bɛkɔboa bɛ noa bekodwɔso bekotia ye de. 4AWURADE nwa nyoo, sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔte anyesotanɛ ngogua pɔngɔ biala so, yeɛ ngɔte ɛlaenbɔlɛ ngɔto bɔ ɔte ye so ne aso. Nakoso Yuda awuro ama de, ngɔlo bɛ, na ngɔprapra anyesiniwaa ngogua maen maen mɔ bɛ pɔngɔ biala so. 5Na Yuda mbanyi mɔ kɔkekã ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Yerusalemfoɛ bɛte m’anwoserɛ wɔ Asafo AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ nu.’
6“Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa Yuda mbanyi ngɔyɛ kyɛ see bɔ ogye wɔ eyein mɔ b’afia ɔ, kyɛ ɛtɛen bɔ ogye wɔ aburoo nyaa b’afia ɔ. Bɛkɔyera maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia ɔ, wɔ famaa so ne bɛen so, na mmenia kosa kɔtena Yerusalem wɔ ye boso, wɔ Yerusalem.
7“AWURADE koli moa kɔpepɛ kole Yuda ɛtena sua mɔ, amaa ɔnate so Dawide awuro ama animnyam ne Yerusalemfoɛ b’animnyam bambagya bandra Yuda. 8Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔbɔ Yerusalemfoɛ nwo waen; na bɛ nu biala bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Dawide; yeɛ Dawide awuro ama kɔyɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo bɔ oli bɛ nyunu ne. 9Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa ngosie me nye so kyɛ ngɔbɔ maen maen amukoraa bɔ bafa koɛ baateta Yerusalem ɔ.
Awuyebɔlɛ kyẽa
10 “Ngohwie ɛlolɛ ne sufrɛ sunzum ngogua Dawide awuro ama ne Yerusalemfoɛ so, amaa ɔnate so bafa bɛ nye bato me bɔ basina me ne aso; na bekosu ye kyɛbɔ sona su ye bahorɛ ɔ, yeɛ bekosu ye hahii kyɛbɔ sona sũ ye bamuɛbaa ɔ. 11Sɔ kyẽa ne, awuyebɔlɛ piri paa kɔwa Yerusalem bɔ ɔte kyɛ Hadadrimon awuyebɔlɛ wɔ Megido bɔnza nu ne. 12Aseɛ ne kɔbɔ awuye, abusua biala kɔbɔ ye deɛ, Dawide awuro ama b’abusua ne kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ; Natan awuro abusua, bɛkɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ; 13Lewi awuro abusua, bɛkɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ; Simei abusua ne bɛkɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ; 14mmusua ngaa ne amukoraa, abusua biala kɔbɔ ye deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ.

Title: SAKARIA 13
Content:
AWURADE kɔte ye maen nwo
1“Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekobukye mbombonzue bɛkɔma Dawide awuro ama ne Yerusalemfoɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔte bɛ nwo bekofi bɔne ne efiɛ nwo.
2“Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngonunu mmosoen dumaa boso ngofi aseɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔnate so bɛngɔkaye bɛ ko ɔ; yeɛ ngotu ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne sunzum tɛɛ bo ngofi aseɛ ne aso, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 3Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ ebie kɔso ɔhyɛ ngɔm a, ɔse ne oni bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ bekose ye kyɛ, ‘Onni kyɛ ɛtena ngoa nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛkã ngondombo dwirɛ wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu.’ Na sɛ ɔhyɛ ngɔm a, ɔse ne oni bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ bɛkɔfa nikyee bekosina ye. 4Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala hyɛ ngɔm a, ye nyunu kogua ase wɔ ye nyekyire nwo, yeɛ bengowura enwiaa ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ngɔfa ngɔlakalaka mmenia. 5Na mmom ɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, nde kuaniɛ; ofikyɛ mayɛ kua fi me ngwadaa nu.’ 6Na sɛ ebie bisa ye kyɛ, ‘Ngena ngena bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ sa nu ye koso ɛ?’ a, okobua kyɛ, ‘Epuralɛ bɔ bepurale me wɔ me damvo mɔ awuro ne, ye ɛne.’ ”
7 O ngrandɛ, dwɔso tia me mmoaenneafoɛ ne,
ɔne sona bɔ ɔte me nwoniɛ ne,”
Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
“Pura mmoaenneafoɛ ne, na mmoaen ne kɔbɔ aya,
na ngɔkakyi me sa ngɔhɔ mmaa mmaa nemɔ aso.
8Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, aseɛ ne aso amukoraa,
bekohũhũ nza nu ngyɛmuɛ nyɔ,
nakoso nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne de, bɛkɔyakyi bɛ wɔ so,
AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
9Na ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko ne, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔfa see nu,
ngɔpɔ bɛ nwo kyɛbɔ bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo ɔ,
na ngohwi bɛ nwo kyɛbɔ betwi sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo ɔ.
Bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me dumaa,
na me wora ngotie bɛ.
Ngɔhã kyɛ, ‘Bɛte me maen’
na bɛ wora bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me Nyameɛ ɔ.’ ”

Title: SAKARIA 14
Content:
AWURADE koli ngonim kɔma Yerusalem
1Tie, AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba, bɔ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ basesa ye wɔ wɔ nu ne, bɛkɔhyɛ ye wɔ wɔ nu ɔ. 2Ofikyɛ ngɔboaboa maen maen mukoraa bɛ noa maa bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔteta Yerusalem, bɛkɔho bɛkɔfa kuro ne, bɛkɔfẽ awuro nemɔ anu nningyein, ná bato mmrasua nemɔ mmɔnaa. Kuro ne anu ama ne, bɛkɔhye nu bue nnure bɛkɔhɔ, nakoso maen ne ngaa de, bengohu bɛ ngofi kuro ne anu. 3Na afei AWURADE kotu kɔtengyɛ ɔne sɔ maen maen nemɔ bɛkɔɔho, kyɛbɔ ɔhone koɛ wɔ koɛ kyẽa ne ala. 4Sɔ kyẽa ne, ye gya kogyinagyina Olive bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ndendeneɛ so wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne aso. Olive bokaa ne anu kodwa nyɔ kofi eyia afiteleɛ koodwu eyia atɔleɛ maa ɔkɔyɛ bɔnza kandinga paa, maa ɔnate so bokaa ne bue kɔhwe kɔhɔ sorɔ dɔ, ná ye bue koso wahwe wahɔ ngwaen dɔ. 5Ɛmɔkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ me mmokaa nemɔ bɛ bɔnza ne anu, ofikyɛ mmokaa nemɔ bɔnza ne kɔtrɛ alaa koodwu Asal. Amba, ɛmɔkɔnwati, kyɛbɔ aseɛwosolɛ maa ɛmɔnwatili wɔ Yuda hene Yusia aberɛ so ne. Na afei AWURADE me Nyameɛ kɔwa, bɔ krongronfoɛ amukoraa bɛboka ye so ɔ.
6Na sɔ kyẽa ne, kanea ngɔta, ɛyerɛ ngɔwa, yeɛ ɛborɔ ngogua. 7Ɔkɔyɛ kyẽa sonongo bɔ AWURADE yeɛ ɔse ɔ. Nna alehyeleɛ ɔ, yeɛ nna alesaleɛ ɔ; na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, nɔsoa ne, ɔkɔyɛ hyireinn. 8 Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngoa nzue kɔtengyɛ kofi Yerusalem; ye bue kɔhɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɛpo ne anu, yeɛ ye bue kɔhɔ eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo ne anu; na ɔkɔtengyɛ ahuhuro ne prakasua mmerɛ.
9AWURADE koli hene wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so; na sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔyɛ sonongo, yeɛ ye dumaa kɔyɛ sonongo.
10Aseɛ ne amukoraa kɔkakyi aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ofi Geba okoodwu Rimon wɔ Yerusalem ngwaen. Nakoso Yerusalem de, ɔkɔha bokaa so wɔ ye boso, ofi Benyamin pambim ne maa okoodwu pambim bɔ oli moa ne, maa okoodwu ndweasoɛ pambim ne; na okofi Hananel abandenden ne okoodwu ɛhene ne kumaa bɔ betwi nu nzaa ne. 11 Mmenia kɔtenatena Yerusalem nu, ofikyɛ ɔngɔbɔ ko, na kuro ne kɔtena berɛ anwotɔ nu.
12Na maen maen amukoraa bɔ bafa koɛ baatoa Yerusalem ne, ɛhawo he yeɛ AWURADE kɔprapra kogua bɛ so ɔ: Bɛ nwonaen kɔporɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛtɛ gyigyi bɛ gya so ɔ, bɛ nye kɔporɔ wɔ bɛ nye tokuro ne anu, yeɛ bɛ temverema kɔporɔ wɔ bɛ noa nu. 13Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔma ahunundetelɛ piri kɔtɔ bɛ so, maa ɔnate so ebiala kɔpari kɔsɔ obiɛngo sa, na bɛkɔbobɔ bɛ nwo. 14Yuda koso kɔho koɛ wɔ Yerusalem. Na bɛkɔboaboa maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia nemɔ b’anwonya worawora ne noa. Ɔte sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ ne ndena. 15Na mbɔngɔ, yoma, afupɔngɔ, afunum ne ngaka mukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asikyeleɛ nemɔ anu ne, ɛhawo bɔ ɔkɔto bɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ sɔ hawo ne ala.
Maen maen mukoraa bɛkɔsɔne AWURADE
16Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Yerusalem ne, bɛ nu ama bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, afoɛnoa biala bɛkɔɔsɔne Ɛhene Asafo AWURADE, ná bali Asese aluolue ne. 17Na aseɛ so mmusua mukoraa, bɛ nu biala bɔ wamma Yerusalem wammanzɔne Ɛhene Asafo AWURADE nen, esue ngɔtɔ ngɔma bɛ. 18Na sɛ Misraim abusua wammanzɔne a, ye de ɔngɔtɔ ngɔma bɛ; na maen maen bɔ bɛmma nni Asese aluolue nen, ɛhawo bɔ AWURADE kɔprapra kogua bɛ so nen, sɔ hawo ne ala yeɛ ɔkɔto bɛ ɔ. 19Sɔ asohwenɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔwa Misraim so ɔ, na maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛmma nni Asese aluolue ne nen, sɔ asohwenɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔto bɛ ɔ.
Krongronyɛlɛ mmerɛ
20Sɔ kyẽa ne, adɔma mɔ bɔ bɛlela mbɔngɔ kɔme ne, bɛkɔhyerɛ so kyɛ, “ƆTE KRONGRON MA AWURADE.” Na AWURADE awuro berɛ ngukue nemɔ bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anyunu berɛ ndalie nemɔ. 21Nahorɛ nu, kukue biala bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne Yuda ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma Asafo AWURADE, na sona biala bɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ nen, ɔkɔɔfa nu bie kɔtõ afɔleɛ naen ne wɔ nu; na sɔ kyẽa ne, Kanaanniɛ ngɔtena Asafo AWURADE awuro berɛ ko.

Title: MALAKI BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Malaki Nwomaa ne, bɛhyerɛle ɔ, afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa nna ne aburannu pɛle nu koraka yeɛ bɛwo Yesu Kristo ɔ. Yudafoɛ befili Babilɔn nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, begyinane ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ Hagae ne Sakaria bɛ dwirɛ so besa besili Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne bieku. Na besili sua ne beyiele ne, ye si ye yeɛ bɛhyerɛle ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Malaki nwomaa ne ɔ.
Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Malaki fa siele ye nye so kyɛ ɔkɔma asɔfo nemɔ ne maen ne anu ama bekosa bekoli nahorɛ bɛkɔma Nyameɛ apam bɔ ɔne bɛ bayɛ ne aso. Né wala ali pefee kyɛ bɛnzo Nyameɛ mma ɔnyɛ Nyameɛ nyemene, ofikyɛ né bɛnzo ye wɔ tenenee nu. Né asɔfo nemɔ ne maen ne anu ama bedi Nyameɛ ndurum wɔ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛma ye ne anu. Né benni ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne aso koso.
Na Malaki maa benwuni kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ obua adasa ndɛen ɔ, na kyẽa bie baawa bɔ okobua ye maen ndɛen, ná ɔkɔte ye mmenia nwo ɔ. Na anzana ɔbaayɔ sɔ ne, ɔkɔma ye somafoɛ koli ye nyunu kosiesie ye atee nu ɔkɔbɔ ye apam ne anwo dawure.
Nu Dwirɛ
Yisraelfoɛ bɛ bɔne 1.1—2.16
Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne ye anwumvoinnwunɛ 2.17—4.6

Title: MALAKI 1
Content:
Nyameɛ kuro Yisrael dwirɛ
1AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Malaki so ɔfa brɛle Yisrael ne, ye ɛhe. 2 AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Mahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ.” Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Atee beni aso yeɛ ahuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ?” Yisɔ, aso nna Yakob aliɛma ɔ?” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. “Nakoso ngurole Yakob dwirɛ, 3yeɛ mbɔle Yisɔ ɔ. Mama ye mmokaa nemɔ aso ayɛ pralaa, yeɛ mafa ye agyapadeɛ ne mawura ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛ sa.” 4Na sɛ Edom kã kyɛ, “Babɔ yɛ maen ne de, nakoso yɛkosa yɛkosi bɔ badwiri bagua ne” a, bɔ Asafo AWURADE ɔkã ole kyɛ, “Bekosi de, nakoso ngodwiri ngogua. Na mmenia kɔto bɛ dumaa kyɛ, “Amumuyɛɛfoɛ maen,” ne “Maen bɔ AWURADE afɛ bɛ so yaa afebɔɔ ɔ.” 5Ɛmɔ nye konwu ye, na ɛmɔkose kyɛ, “AWURADE ye piri ne, ɔtrɛ kɔ Yisrael wɛen ne asi dɔ!”
6Baa di ɔse ni, yeɛ akoaa di ye mene ni. Na sɛ nde Seɛ de a, né nzaade m’anidie wɔ nisua? Na sɛ nde meneɛ de a, né nzaade esurolɛ bɔ besuro me ne ɔwɔ nisua? Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ bɔ ɛmɔbu me dumaa animtia ɔ, bɔ Asafo AWURADE ose ɛmɔ hɔ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yabu wɔ dumaa animtia ɔ?’ 7Ɛmɔfa aleɛ bɔ ye nwo agua efiɛ ɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea so, nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yagua wɔ nwo fiɛ ɔ?’ Ye ole kyɛ, ɛmɔdwene kyɛ AWURADE poen ne de, ɛkora bu ye animtia. 8 Sɛ ɛmɔfa kaka anyesiniwaa bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ a, aso ɔtte bɔne hɔ ɔ? Yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔfa kaka agyabuburuwaa anaa bɔ ɔnde apɔ ɔ bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ a, aso ɔtte bɔne hɔ ɔ? Nzaade fa kɔma w’amrado nea! Aso ɛkɔsɔ ye nye, anaa ɔkɔnea wɔ nyunu anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 9Nzaade, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔsrɛ Nyameɛ ma ɔlo yɛ e! Na sɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ otira ɛmɔ sa nu hɔ ɛne a, ye de ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né walo ɛmɔ? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 10O, ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔkɔɔtoto anoa nemɔ anu ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔangɔ anzɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso see mbaen. Me kunu ndwo wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ mengole ɛmɔ sa nu afɔleɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 11Ofikyɛ, ofi eyia fitelɛ kodwu ye tɔlɛ, me dumaa te piri wɔ maen maen mɔ nu, na bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma me dumaa nekaa biala, yeɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛma me; ofikyɛ me dumaa te piri wɔ maen maen mɔ nu, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 12Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔagua ye nwo fiɛ, bɔ ɛmɔnwa: AWURADE poen ne anwo agua efiɛ, ɛkora bu so nningyein ne so aleɛ po animtia. 13Ɛmɔsa bɛkã kyɛ, Eh, nzikyɛ ɛfɛɛ ɛhe? Na ɛmɔsobi bɛ noa begua so, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Kaka bɔ ɛmɔali aminɛ banya ye, anaa kaka bɔ wabubu, anaa bɔ ɔnde apɔ ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Aso odi kyɛ mede ɛhe mefi ɛmɔ berɛ anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 14Musue to nnakannaka sona bɔ ɔfa kaka nyii bɔ ɔwɔ ye mmoaen kure nu ɔ ɔhyɛ bɔ, nakoso ɔfa bɔ wali nnɛen ɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɔ. Ofikyɛ nde Ɛhene piri, na me dumaa nwo suronyi tɔ maen maen mɔ so, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

Title: MALAKI 2
Content:
Nyameɛ bɔ asɔfo mɔ kɔkɔ
1“Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ, sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he, ɔkɔ ma ɛmɔ. 2Sɛ ɛmɔanyɛ sotie, yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔamva banzie ɛmɔ ahone nu kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa animnyam bɛkɔma me dumaa a, ngɔprapra musue ngogua ɛmɔ so, na ngɔnoma ɛmɔ saleɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; yoo, manoma bɛ dada, ofikyɛ ɛmɔmva benzie ɛmɔ ahone nu. 3 Tie, ngohwi ɛmɔ bosofoɛ bɛ nyunu, na ngɔfa bondua ngɔpete ɛmɔ nyunu, ɛmɔ aluolue ngaka bondua ne, na bekogyi ɛmɔ ne bondua ne bekogua. 4 Na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me yeɛ nzomane maa bɛfale sɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne bɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so me ne Lewi apam ne watindim, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 5 M’apam ne yɛle ngoa ne asomdwee mane ye, na mva mane ye kyɛ osuro. Osurole me, na me dumaa nwo suronyi tɔle ye so. 6Nahorɛ mmeraa ne yɛle ye noa dwirɛ, na amumuyɛɛ biala wamvite ye noa. Asomdwee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu yeɛ ɔne me natele ɔ, na ɔmane mmeni pee bɛyakyili amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ. 7Ofikyɛ, bɔ odi kyɛ ofite ɔsɔfo noa ole nimdeɛ, na ye noa dwirɛ nu yeɛ odi kyɛ mmenia bɛpena mmeraa ne ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte Asafo AWURADE bɔfoɛ. 8Nakoso ɛmɔali makyebu bafi atee ne aso; ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ noa dwirɛ bama mmeni pee basoti bafi mmeraa ne anwo; ɛmɔagua Lewi apam ne anwo fiɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 9Yiti, me koso, maprapra animguaseɛ magua ɛmɔ so, yeɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ ase wɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛ nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔmva m’atee so, ná mmom ɛmɔbua ndɛengyea ne ala.”
Yisrael anni nahorɛ amma Nyameɛ
10Aso nna Seɛ komapɛ yeɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛle ye ɔ? Aso nna Nyameɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔbɔle yɛ ɔ? Na ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ebiala pepɛ ngondombo okyire obiɛngo, bɔ yɛfa yɛgua yɛ nana mɔ apam ne anwo fiɛ ɔ? 11Yuda anni nahorɛ, na bɛbɔ akyiwadeɛ bra wɔ Yisrael ne Yerusalem; ofikyɛ AWURADE nekaa krongron bɔ ɔla ye ahone nwo ne, Yuda agua ye nwo fiɛ, na wagya bosoen ɛwɔfoɛ bie ɔwa brasua. 12Na bienzua biala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ, kyɛ okyirekyire oo, anaa osua oo, AWURADE konua ye boso ama mukoraa bɛ bo kofi Yakob ɛtena sua nu, bɔ ebiala ngɔha bɔ ɔkɔfa afɔleɛ kɔbrɛ Asafo AWURADE ɔ. 13Nikyee bieku bɔ ɛmɔsa bɛyɔ ɛhe: ɛmɔfa ɛmoenporolɛ, esuɛ ne awuyebɔlɛ bɛkata AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; ofikyɛ onne afɔleɛ ne ndo nu ko, yeɛ ye nye nzɔ bɔ ofi ɛmɔ berɛ ne ko. 14Na ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Nzu ati ɔ?” Hmmm, ofikyɛ, ɛne wɔ mmerandeɛ nu braa ɛmɔ agyaa ne, AWURADE te nu danzeniɛ. Nakoso anni nahorɛ amma ye, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte w’anwokaniɛ ne w’apam braa de. 15Aso Nyameɛ wanyɔ ɛmɔ sona komapɛ bɔ ngoa sunzum wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ? Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔpena ɔ? Kyɛ ɛmɔkɔwo mmaa bɔ Nyameɛ surolɛ wɔ bɛ nu ɔ. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ɛmɔ sunzum nwo, na nnɛma ebiala fa ye mmerandeɛ nu braa ɔfa nnakannaka atee so. 16Ofikyɛ mekyi agyaayiralɛ, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne; yeɛ sona bɔ ɔfa nzɛmmɔne kata ye tena so ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ɛmɔ sunzum nwo, ná ɛmɔammɔ sɔ nnakannaka bra ne. 17Ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ dwirɛ bedwane AWURADE so anu. Nakoso ɛmɔnwa, “Atee beni aso yeɛ yadwane ye so anu ɔ?” Bɔ ɛmɔkã ne, ye ɛhe: “Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔte paa wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na ode ye to nu.” Yeɛ ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Nyameɛ bɔ obua ndɛen ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”

Title: MALAKI 3
Content:
Nyameɛ kɔsoma ye bɔfoɛ ne
1 “Tie, mebaasoma me bɔfoɛ maa odi me nyunu osiesie atee nu. Na AWURADE bɔ ɛmɔpena ye ne, bɔ ye ole apam bɔfoɛ bɔ ɔla ɛmɔ ahone nwo ne, ɔkɔhɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu mvum nu. Tie, ɔ́ba, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 2 Nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔ́ba ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye noa ɔ? Ɔye ye nwo ali a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye nyunu ɔ? “Ofikyɛ ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ohuro buralɛ ɔ ye see ne, ɔne bɔ ɔkɔ atapoɛ ɔ ye saminaen; 3ɔkɔtena ase kyɛ dwumvoɛ bɔ ohuro ɛdwetɛ ɔye ye nwo fiɛ ɔ: ɔkɔte Lewi boso ama mɔ bɛ nwo, okohwi bɛ nwo kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ, amaa ɔnate so bafa tenenee afɔleɛ babrɛ AWURADE. 4Na afei, Yuda ne Yerusalem b’afɔleɛ kɔsɔ AWURADE nye kyɛ daa tete mmerɛ afoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ nu bahɔ deɛ ne ala.
5“Na afei ngɔhwe ngopingye ɛmɔ ngobua ndɛen. Ngoli adanzeɛ ndɛndɛ so ngotia ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛta ngondombo ndaen, bɛ bɔ besisi paafoɛ wɔ b’akatuaa nwo, bɛ bɔ bedi kunafoɛ ne nyisiaa aminɛ, bɛ bɔ besisi ɛwɔfoɛ ná benzuro me ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
6“Ofikyɛ me, AWURADE, menzesã; yiti ɛmɔ, Yakob boso ama, ɛmɔ boso ngonua.
7Ofi ɛmɔ nana mɔ aberɛ so yeɛ ɛmɔali me nhyehyɛleɛ nwo makyebu bɔ ɛmɔanni so ɔ. Ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra me berɛ, na me koso ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔnwa: ‘Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yasa yawa?’ 8Aso odi kyɛ sona di Nyameɛ ndurum anaa? Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔdi me ndurum. Na ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yɛdi wɔ ndurum ɔ?’ Ɛmɔdi ye wɔ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔne afɔleɛbɔlɛ nu. 9Ɛnomalɛ yeɛ mafa manoma ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔdi me ndurum, mekyire maen ne amukoraa. 10 Ɛ́mɔfa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne amukoraa bɛbra nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne, amaa ɔnate so aleɛ awa m’awuro. Ɛ́mɔfa béso me bɛ́nea, sɛ mengobukye nyameɛso mboma mengɔma ɛmɔ a, sɛ mengohwie saleɛ ngogua ɛmɔ so ma ongobu ngɔfa so a, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 11Ɛmɔ ti ngosi sɛkyefoɛ ne ate, amaa ɔnate so wanzɛkye ɛmɔ aseɛ so aleɛ ne; yeɛ ɛmɔ fieso bobe amui ne ngɔporo ngogua, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 12Na afei, maen maen amukoraa bɛkɔfrɛ ɛmɔ Bɛ bɔ Banya Saleɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ anika maen, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
13“Ɛmɔkekã edwirɛ yeayea betia me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yealɛ yeɛ yahã yatia wɔ ɔ?’ 14Ɛmɔahã kyɛ, ‘Ɔte mbaen kyɛ sona kɔso Nyameɛ ɔ. Mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so kyɛ yɛkoli ye nhyehyɛleɛ so, ɔne kyɛ yɛkɔnate Asafo AWURADE nyunu wɔ nnuhoɛ nu ɔ? 15Na afei de, yɛbu ahandaenfoɛ kyɛ bɛ yeɛ banya saleɛ ɔ; amba, bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bra tɛɛ ne yeɛ benya ngɔsoɛ ɔ; amba, bɛ bɔ beso Nyameɛ bɛnea ne yeɛ benya bɛ ti bedidi nu ɔ.’ ”
16Yeɛ bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, bedwudwo behyirehyirele bɛ nwo. AWURADE yɛle asoɛ tiele, na ɔtele; na bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ná bedi ye dumaa ni ne, bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa wɔ ngayeɛ nwomaa nu wɔ AWURADE nyunu. 17Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyẽa bɔ ngobua ndɛen ne, bɛkɔyɛ me bɔbɔ me deɛ, na ngonwu bɛ anwumvoin kyɛbɔ seɛ onwu ɔwa bɔ ɔso ye ɔ anwumvoin ɔ. 18Na afei ɛmɔkosa bɛkɔwa, na ɛmɔkonwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla teneneeniɛ ne bɔnefoɛ b’afia ɔ, yeɛ bɔ ɔla sona bɔ ɔso Nyameɛ ne bɔ ɔnzo ye ɔ b’afia ɔ.

Title: MALAKI 4
Content:
AWURADE kyẽa ne
1Tie, kyẽa ne ɔ́ba bɔ ɔkɔyera kyɛ foonoo ɔ; na amba, ahandaenfoɛ amukoraa, bɛ ne bɔnefoɛ biala bɛkɔyɛ ngyɛngyɛma. Na kyẽa bɔ ɔbaawa ne, ɔkɔyera bɛ, bɔ ɔngɔyakyi bɛ ndii anaa bɛ mmaen ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. 2Nakoso ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro me dumaa ne de, tenenee eyia bɔ anwonyerɛsalɛ wɔ ye ndaa nu ɔ okopukye kɔma ɛmɔ; na ɛmɔkofite bekohuru bɛkɔpepe kyɛ nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bɔ babukye bɛ bafi bɛ tuin nu ɔ. 3Na ɛmɔkotiatia bɔnefoɛ mɔ so; ofikyɛ kyẽa bɔ ngɔyɔ sɔ ne, bɛkɔyɛ nzoen wɔ ɛmɔ gya bo, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne bɔhyɛlɛ
4“Me somvoɛ Mose mmeraa, nhyehyɛleɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ bɔ nhyɛle ye wɔ Horebo mva mane Yisrael amukoraa ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkaye. 5 Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Elia wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ koraka né AWURADE kyẽa piri bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne wawa. 6 Na ɔkɔma mmaa mɔ bɛkɔla seɛ mɔ b’ahone nwo, ná seɛ mɔ koso bala mmaa mɔ b’ahone nwo, amaa ɔnate so mamma mambrapra ɛnomalɛ mangua aseɛ ne aso.”

Title: MATEO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Mateo nzɛmba ne ka kyɛ Yesu ole Ngoadefoɛ ne bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle ye nwo anohoba ne. Ɔnate Yesu so yeɛ Nyameɛ mane ye anohoba bɔ ɔbɔle Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Apam Daa ne anu wale nu ɔ. Sɔ nzɛmba ye ɔtte Yudafoɛ ngome bɛ deɛ, na mmom ɔte ewiase amukoraa deɛ.
Mateo ahyehyɛ ye nzɛmba ne pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yesu aworɛ yeɛ oli moa ɔ. Na afei ɔka ye asubɔlɛ ne ye nzɔhwɛ nwo dwirɛ. Na ɔtoa so ka Yesu nzɛmbahanɛ, ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anwonyerɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɔsale ye wɔ Galilea nwo dwirɛ. Afei ɔka Yesu ateetulɛ fi Galilea kɔ Yerusalem, ɔne bɔ osili Yesu dapɛn bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo aseɛ he aso ɔ, ye wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo dwirɛ.
Mateo nzɛmba ne kyire kyɛ Yesu te kyerɛkyerɛniɛ titire bɔ ole tumi kyirekyire Nyameɛ mmeraa ne anu, na okyirekyire Nyameɛ ahennie nwo dwirɛ. Bahyehyɛ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anu nnu:
1. Bokaa ne aso ngyerɛkyerɛ ne bɔ ɔfa nyameɛso Ahennie ne anu mma nwo, bɛ nnwumaa, bɛ mvasoɛ, ɔne b’ayieleɛ (Ti 5-7).
2. Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔfa asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne dwumadie nwo (Ti 10)
3. Anyandera bɔ ɔfa Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo (Ti 13)
4. Ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔfa suaniɛyɛlɛ nwo (Ti 18)
5. Ewiase ayieleɛ ne nyameɛso Ahennie bɔ ɔba ne nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ (Ti 24-25)
Nu Dwirɛ
Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne Yesu aworɛ 1.1—2.23
Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane adwumayɔlɛ 3.1-12
Yesu asubɔlɛ ne ye nzɔhwɛ 3.13—4.11
Yesu dwaaso ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Galilea 4.12—18.35
Yesu fi Galilea hɔle Yerusalem 19.1—20.34
Yesu di ye dapɛn bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo wɔ Yerusalem ne ye mbɔtam 21.1—27.66
Yesu wue, ye tingyelɛ ne ye nwo aliyelɛ 28.1-20

Title: MATEO 1
Content:
Yesu Kristo aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ
(Luka 3.23-38)
1 Yesu Kristo, Dawide bosoniɛ, Abraham bosoniɛ ne, ye afilie nu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ɛhe: 2Abraham wole Yisake, Yisake wole Yakob, na Yakob wole Yuda ne oliɛma mɔ. 3 Yuda wole Pɛrɛse ne Sera (bɛ ni ole Tamar), Pɛrɛse wole Hesron, na Hesron wole Ram. 4Ram wole Aminadabo. Aminadabo wole Nason bɔ ɔwole Salmon ne. 5Salmon ne Rahabo wole Boase. Boase ne Rutu wole Obɛde bɔ ɔwole 6Yese bɔ ɔwa ole Nana Dawide ne.
Dawide ne Yuria aye ne wole Solomon. 7Solomon wole Rehoboam, na Rehoboam wole Abiya. Abiya wole Asa. 8Asa wole Yehosafate. Yehosafate wole Yoram. Yoram wole Yusia. 9Yusia wole Yotam. Yotam wole Ahase. Ahase wole Hesekia. 10Hesekia wole Manase. Manase wole Amose. Amose wole Yosia. 11 Yosia wole Yekonia ne oliɛma mɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛhyele Yudafoɛ nnure bɛhɔle Babilɔn nen.
12Bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle Babilɔn ne asi ne, Yekonia wole Sɛtiɛl. Sɛtiɛl wole Serubabɛl. 13Serubabɛl wole Abihude. Abihude wole Eliakim, na Eliakim wole Asore. 14Asɔre wole Sadoke; Sadoke wole Akim, na Akim wole Elihude. 15Elihude wole Eleasa. Eleasa wole Matan, na Matan wole Yakob. 16Yakob wole Yosef bɔ ɔye ole Maria bɔ ɔwole Yesu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kristo ne.
17Yiti aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ofi Abraham so bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dawide so ne amukoraa, ɔte buru ne nna; ofi Dawide so bɔ ɔkwaadwu kyɛ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle Babilɔn nen, ɔte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ buru ne nna; yeɛ ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle Babilɔn ne bɔ ɔbaadwu Kristo so ne, ɔte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ buru ne nna.
Yesu aworɛ
(Luka 2.1-7)
18Kyɛbɔ besi bɛwole Yesu Kristo nwo dwirɛ ɛhe: Bɛfale oni Maria bɛbɔle Yosef asiwa. Wangɔ agyaa bo, na benwuni kyɛ ɔnate Sunzum Krongron so ɔnwonzɛ. 19Né ohu Yosef te sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, na né onguro kyɛ okogua Maria nyunu ase ne ati, ɔyɛle ye adwene kyɛ okoyira ye kudɛɛ. 20Na ogu so ɔfa ɛhe nwo adwene ne, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali hyirele ye wɔ laleɛ nu, na osele ye kyɛ, “Yosef, Dawide bosoniɛ, nnɛsuro kyɛ ɛkɔfa ɛye Maria ɛkɔwa w’awuro ɔ; ɔnate kyɛ bɔ ɔnwonzɛ ye ne ofi Sunzum Krongron nu. 21 Ɔkɔwo baa bienzua, né ato ye dumaa Yesu, ɔnate kyɛ ye yeɛ okole ye mmenia kofi bɛ bɔne nu ɔ.” 22Na ɛhe amukoraa sili maa bɔ Awurade nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne aso hane ne wale nu. Ɔhane kyɛ,
23 “Tie, ababunu ne kɔnwonzɛ kɔwo baa bienzua,
na bɛkɔto ye dumaa Yimanuel,
(bɔ ye bo kyire kyɛ, Nyameɛ ne yɛ wɔ berɛ).”
24Na Yosef tingyele fili nnaa nu ne, ɔyɔle bɔ Awurade abɔfo ne hyɛle ye kyɛ ɔyɔ ne, na ɔɔfale ɔye ne wale awuro. 25Nakoso Yosef ne ye banna maa odwuli kyɛ ɔwole bamuɛbaa bienzua ɔ, na Yosef tole ye dumaa Yesu.

Title: MATEO 2
Content:
Nworɛfoɛ nemɔ
1 Mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole Yesu wɔ Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yudea, wɔ ɛhene Herode aberɛ so nen, nworɛfoɛ biemɔ fili eyia afiteleɛ maen nu dɔ bɛwale Yerusalem, 2 na bebisale kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ hene bɔ bawo ye ne, nisua yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ? Ofikyɛ yanwu ye nzramaa wɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ, na yawa kyɛ yɛbaasɔne ye.”
3Na ɛhene Herode tele edwirɛ he nen, ɔhale ye, Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa koso sɔ ala. 4Yiti ɔfrɛfrɛle maen ne anu asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa maa beeyiale, na obisale bɛ penane neka horɛ bɔ bɛkɔwo Kristo ne ɔ. 5 Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yudea; na sɔ yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne wahyerɛ ɔ, kyɛ,
6 ‘Wɔ, Betlehem bɔ ɛwɔ Yuda aseɛ so ɔ,
wɔ dibea wɔ Yuda atitirefoɛ nu ɔtte ba;
ɔnate kyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ maenbulɛniɛ
bɔ ɔbaanea me maen Yisrael so ne okofi kɔwa ɔ.’ ”
7Yeɛ Herode frɛle nworɛfoɛ nemɔ kudɛɛ, na obisale bɛ mmerɛ deinn bɔ nzramaa ne fitele ɔ. 8Afei ɔsomane bɛ Betlehem, na osele kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye boro bɛpena akwadaa ne; na sɛ ɛmɔnwu ye a, ɛmɔɔbɔ me amaneɛ, ná me koso ngɔnzɔne ye bie.”
9Betiele ɛhene ne dwirɛ ne beyiele, ná besili nu kyɛ bɛkɔ nen, yieee, nzramaa bɔ benwuni ye wɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne lili bɛ nyunu moa alaa oogyinane nekaa bɔ adɔma ne la ne ye anwuro. 10Na benwuni nzramaa ne nen, ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ soma. 11Na bɛworole awuro ne anu nen, benwuni adɔma ne ne oni Maria, na bɛkotole bɛsɔnene ye. Afei bɛsangyele bɛ nningyein nu, na bɛhyɛle ye esikaa kɔkorɛ, ayirefona ne korobo. 12 Né babɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ laleɛ nu kyɛ nnɛmaa besa bɛkɔ Herode dɔ ko, yiti bɛfale atee foforɛ so besa bɛhɔle bɛ maen nu.
Yosef fa adɔma ne nwati kɔ Misraim
13Nworɛfoɛ nemɔ hɔle ne asi ne, yieee, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali wɔ laleɛ nu hyirele Yosef, na osele ye kyɛ, “Herode pena akwadaa ne ku ye, yiti dwɔso fa akwadaa ne ne oni nwati kɔ Misraim, ná tena dɔ maa oodwu kyɛ ngose wɔ kyɛ esa bra ɔ.” 14Na odwɔsole nen, ɔfale akwadaa ne ne oni bokale ye nwo so, na ofili berɛ hɔle Misraim. 15 Ɔtenane dɔ maa oodwuli kyɛ ɛhene Herode wuli ɔ. Na ɛhe mane bɔ Awurade nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne so hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Mafrɛ mma bienzua mafi Misraim.”
Herode kuku ngwadaammaa wɔ Betlehem
16Na Herode nwuni kyɛ nworɛfoɛ nemɔ balakalaka ye nen, ɔfɛle yaa hahii. Na ɔsomane maa beehuhuni ngwadaa mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali afoɛ nyɔ ne bɛ bɔ bendwu ɔ, bɔ bɛwɔ Betlehem ne ye mbɔtam amukoraa; kyɛbɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔtele dwirɛ ne fili nworɛfoɛ nemɔ berɛ ne osi kyire ne. 17Na ɛhe mane ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu kyɛ,
18 “Bɛtele komviɛ bie wɔ Rama,
awuye ne esuɛ hahii,
Rahɛl sũ ye mma;
Bɛkyekye ye wora a ondie,
ofikyɛ bɛnne berɛ ko.”
Yosef fi Misraim sa ba Nasarɛte
19Herode wue asi ne, yieee, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali wɔ laleɛ nu hyirele Yosef wɔ Misraim 20sele kyɛ, “Dwɔso, fa akwadaa ne ne oni sa kɔ Yisrael aseɛ so, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ né bɛpena akwadaa ne beku ye ne, bawu.” 21Yiti Yosef dwɔsole fale akwadaa ne ne oni bokale ye nwo so, na osa wale Yisrael aseɛ so. 22Nakoso Yosef tele kyɛ Arkelao yeɛ wali ɔse Herode bia wayɛ Yudea hene nen, osurole kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ berɛ ɔ. Nyameɛ ye hyirele ye wɔ laleɛ nu, yiti ɔhɔle Galilea manzini nu. 23 Na ɔhɔle kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nasarɛte so ɔɔtenane berɛ. Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Bɛkɔfrɛ ye Nasarɛteniɛ.”

Title: MATEO 3
Content:
Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane nzɛmbahanɛ
(Marko 1.1-8; Luka 3.1-18; Yohane 1.19-28)
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane wale Yudea ɛserɛ so kyɛ ɔkã nzɛmba. 2 Ɔnwa, “Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene, ofikyɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne apingye!” 3 Ye yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ,
“Ebie tea nu wɔ ɛserɛ so kyɛ,
Ɛ́mɔsiesie Awurade atee,
ná ɛ́mɔma ye atimbire tengyɛ.”
4 Né Yohane wura afupɔngɔ nwiaa ataadeɛ, na né ɔbɔ nwomaa abɔsoɛ. Aleɛ bɔ né odi ole mmɛbɛ mbiri ne woɛ. 5Mmenia bɔ befi Yerusalem, Yudea amukoraa ne bɛ bɔ befi Yɔɔdan nwo amukoraa bebiri bɛwale ye berɛ; 6na bɛhane bɛ bɔne maa ɔbɔle bɛ asu wɔ asue Yɔɔdan nu.
7 Na onwuni kyɛ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ nemɔ anu pee bɛba maa ɔbɔ bɛ asu nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ewoo mmaa bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ ɔ! Nwa yeɛ otuli ɛmɔ foɛ paa kyɛ ɛ́mɔnwati béfi ahonehulɛ bɔ ɔba ne anu ɔ? 8Odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ okyire kyɛ ɛmɔasakyera ɛmɔ adwene amba ɔ. 9 Na nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka ɛmɔ nwo bɛka kyɛ, ‘Abraham bosofoɛ ole yɛ’; na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Nyameɛ kɔhora kɔkakyi nyɔboɛ hemɔ maa bɛkɔyɛ Abraham bosofoɛ. 10Bafa akumaa ne babɔ bakaa ne ndii nu dada. Yiti bakaa biala bɔ onzu mmaa paa ne, bekobu ye, ná bagyi bato see nu. 11Me de, mebɔ ɛmɔ asu wɔ nzue nu maa okyire kyɛ ɛmɔasakyera ɛmɔ adwene, nakoso bɔ oli me si ɔ́ba ne de, odi mu tra me; na memvata kyɛ ye mbaboa po ngotira ɔ. Ye de, ɔkɔfa Sunzum Krongron ne see yeɛ ɔkɔbɔ ɛmɔ asu ɔ. 12 Otira ye huhuamoa nu; ɔkɔprapra ye nekaa bɔ ɔboro aburoo ne monomono. Ɔkɔboaboa ye aburoo ne noa kogua pata so, nakoso afafu ne de, ɔkɔfa see bɔ onnua le ɔ yeɛ ɔkɔyera ye ɔ.”
Yohane bɔ Yesu asu
(Marko 1.9-11; Luka 3.21-22)
13Yeɛ Yesu fili Galilea wale Yohane berɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan noa kyɛ ɔbɔ ye asu. 14Yohane yɛle kyɛ ahaa osi ye ate, Ɔnwa, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛfata kyɛ ɛbɔ me asu ɔ, na afei wɔ yeɛ ɛ́ba me berɛ ɔ?” 15Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Ma ate maa yɛyɔ ye sɔ kekesaala ye, na yɛyɔ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ne.” Yiti Yohane penene so. 16Mmerɛ bɔ ɔbɔle Yesu asu yiele nen, Yesu fili nzue ne anu fitele pɛ, yieee, anwuro bukyele (mane ye), na onwuni Nyameɛ Sunzum ne kyɛ abubure odwu ba ye so, 17 na yieee, edwudwolɛ bie fili nyameɛso wale kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe.”

Title: MATEO 4
Content:
Abɔnzam so Yesu nea
(Marko 1.12-13; Luka 4.1-13)
1Afei Sunzum ne fale Yesu hɔle ɛserɛ so kyɛ abɔnzam ooso ye nea. 2 Ɔhyele hɔen eleburanna, eyia ne kɔngɔen, na ɛhɔen huni ye. 3Na bɔ oso mmenia nea ne wale ye berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne a, hyɛ nyɔboɛ hemɔ ma paanoo.” 4 Nakoso obuale kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ kyɛ,
‘Nna paanoo ngome so yeɛ sona nate nya ngoa ɔ,
na mmom ɔnate edwirɛ biala bɔ ofi Nyameɛ noa ba ɔ so.’ ”
5 Afei abɔnzam fale ye hɔle kuro krongron ne anu, na ɔfale ye oogyinane asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ti afia, 6 na osele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne a, to wɔ nwo ye aseɛnwo dɔ, ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
‘Wɔ ti, ɔkɔfa ahyɛdeɛ kɔma ye abɔfo mɔ,
na bɛkɔsoa wɔ wɔ bɛ sa so,
amaa ɔnate so wɔ gya ambura nyɔboɛ.’ ”
7 Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ ye bieku kyɛ, ‘Nneso Awurade wɔ Nyameɛ nea!’ ” 8Yeɛ abɔnzam fale ye bieku hɔle bokaa tendenn bie aso, na ohyirele ye ewiase ahennie amukoraa ne nu animnyam; 9na osele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛkɔkoto kɔsɔne me a, ahaa ngɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa ngɔma wɔ.” 10 Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso berɛ kɔ dɔ, Satan! Ofikyɛ Bahyerɛ kyɛ,
‘Sɔne Awurade wɔ Nyameɛ,
na ye ngome twe yeɛ so ye ɔ!’ ”
11Yeɛ abɔnzam yakyili ye berɛ, na yieee, abɔfo mɔ wale bɛɛsole ye.
Yesu bɔ ye adwuma bo wɔ Galilea
(Marko 1.14-15; Luka 4.14-15)
12 Yesu tele kyɛ bafa Yohane bato kuku nu nen, ofili Galilea. 13 Otu fili Nasarɛte ɔɔtenane Kapanɔm bɔ ɔwɔ mboanoa, wɔ Sebulɔn ne Nafetali mbɔtam. 14Na ɛhe mane ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu kyɛ,
15 “Sebulɔn aseɛ ne Nafetali aseɛ,
bɔ ɔwɔ ɛpo atee ne aso dɔ, wɔ Yɔɔdan si,
Galilea bɔ ɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ aseɛ;
16maen bɔ ɔte awosii nu ne,
wanwu kanea hyireinn;
na bɛ bɔ bɛte ewue aseɛ awosii kabii so ne,
kanea bie apukye ama bɛ.”
17 Ofi mmerɛ sɔ ne yeɛ Yesu hyɛle ye bo hane nzɛmba ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene, ofikyɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne apingye!”
Yesu frɛ asuafoɛ nna
(Marko 1.16-20; Luka 5.1-11)
18Né Yesu nate Galilea mboanoa, na onwuni aliɛmaa nyɔ bɔ bɛ ole Simɔn bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Petro, ɔne oliɛma Andrea kyɛ begua asawu ɛpo nu ɔ, ofikyɛ né bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛkɔ po ɔ. 19Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔli me si, na ngɔma ɛmɔkɔhwehwe mmenia bɛkɔbrɛ me.” 20Na berɛ ne ala, bɛyakyili b’asawu nemɔ berɛ beelili ye si. 21Ɔhɔle moa kãa nen, onwuni aliɛmaa nyɔ bieku, bɔ bɛ ole Sebedeo awa Yakobo ɔne oliɛma Yohane, kyɛ bɛ ne bɛ baba Sebedeo bɛte ɛlɛen nu bɛpomba b’asawu ɔ. Na ɔfrɛle bɛ. 22Na berɛ ne ala, bɛyakyili ɛlɛen ne ne bɛ baba berɛ beelili ye si.
Yesu ka nzɛmba na osa sa anwonyerɛ
(Luka 6.17-19)
23 Yesu hyinini Galilea amukoraa yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nemɔ anu, ɔhane ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba ne, na ɔsale anwonyerɛ ne anwommerɛlɛ ahoroɔ wɔ maen ne anu. 24Ye nwo dwirɛ trɛ hɔle Siria amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ amukoraa bɔ anwonyerɛ ne anwondutuo ahoroɔ ayɛ bɛ ɔ, bɛ bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔ ɛpɛlɛ ne apreprɛ wɔ bɛ so ɔ bɛbrɛle ye, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ. 25Na mmenia pee fili Galilea ne Dekapoli, Yerusalem, Yudea, yeɛ Yɔɔdan si dɔ beelili ye si.

Title: MATEO 5
Content:
Yesu yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ bokaa so
1Yesu nwuni ɛlɔen ne nen, ɔhɔle bokaa bie aso, na ɔtenane ase nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye nwo berɛ, 2na ɔtele ye noa ohyirehyirele bɛ kyɛ,
Sunzum nu saleɛ
(Luka 6.20-23)
3 “Sunzum nu ehiafoɛ banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne te bɛ deɛ ɔ.
4 “Bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔkyekye bɛ wora ɔ.
5 “Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonya aseɛ ne maa ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɔ.
6 “Bɛ bɔ tenenee nwo hɔen ne nzuhɔen ku bɛ ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔma bɛ ko koyi ɔ.
7“Bɛ bɔ benwu bɛ mmango anwumvoin ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonwu bɛ anwumvoin ɔ.
8 “Bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te fufue ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonwu Nyameɛ ɔ.
9“Bɛ bɔ bɛte patafoɛ ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfrɛ bɛ Nyameɛ mma ɔ.
10 “Bɛ bɔ tenenee ti bɛtane bɛ nye ne, banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne te bɛ deɛ ɔ.
11 “Ɛmɔanya saleɛ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔnate me ti mmenia pepɛ ɛmɔ nzoaa, bɛtane ɛmɔ nye, ná bɛpɛ ngondombo bɛkeka edwirɛ tɛɛ ahoroɔ bɛto ɛmɔ so ɔ. 12 Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye ná ɛ́mɔli ahurusi, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ akatuaa sone wɔ nyameɛso. Ofikyɛ sɔ ala yeɛ bɛtanene ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ belili ɛmɔ nyunu moa nemɔ nye ɔ.
Ewiase ngyee ne kanea
(Marko 9.50; Luka 14.34-35)
13“Ɛmɔte aseɛ ye aso ngyee. Nakoso sɛ ngyee nu fɛɛ tu a, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekowura ye maa okosa kɔkakyi ngyee ɔ? Bɛfa bɛyɔ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee ko, sana begyi begua maa mmenia tiatia so.
14 “Ɛmɔte wiase kanea. Kuro bɔ ɔla bokaa so ne, ɔngora mvea. 15Sɔ ala yeɛ bɛnzɔ kanea ná bafa bawura ɛkorɛ bo ɔ; na mmom bɛfa besie kanea bakaa so, amaa wata wama ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ awuro berɛ anwu ase. 16Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ kanea ɔta ma mmenia nwu ye, amaa ɔnate so banwu ɛmɔ yɔleɛ paa ne, ná bakamvo ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne.
Mmeraa ne nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
17“Nnɛma ɛmɔsusu kyɛ mmale kyɛ mebaatu Mose mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne megua. Mamma kyɛ mebaatu megua, na mmom mmale kyɛ mebaasi bɛ pi. 18 Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, kɔpem kyɛ anwuro ne aseɛ kɔpɛ nu ɔ, mmeraa ne anu kaaba ko anaa kaaba pɔtrepɔɔ ko po ngofi nu, sana ye mukoraa awa nu koraka. 19 Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔkɔto mmeraa ne anu kaaba ko bɔ ɔwɔ nu po, ná okohyirehyire mmenia kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ bie nen, bɛkɔfrɛ ye kwahweabaa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. Nakoso sona bɔ okoli so, ná okohyirehyire mmenia maa bekoli so bie nen, ɔkɔyɛ titire wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. 20Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ tenenee andra ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ deɛ a, ye de ɛmɔ gya baa ngotia nyameɛso ahennie ne anu.
Ɛyaafɛlɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Luka 12.57-59)
21 “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bɛhã behyirele mbanyi mɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛdi awue, na ebiala bɔ okoli awue ne okoli fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu.’ 22Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfɛ oliɛma so yaa nen, okoli fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu; ebiala bɔ okose oliɛma kyɛ ɔte sona mbaen nen, okoli fɔ badwa nyunu. Ebiala bɔ okose kyɛ, ‘Wɔ kwaseambane’ nen, okoli fɔ, na ɔkɔhɔ abɔnzam see nu. 23Yiti sɛ ɛfa w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ba afɔleɛ bokyea nwo, ná berɛ ɛkaye kyɛ eliɛma ne wɔ le dwirɛ a, 24yakyi w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne to afɔleɛ bokyea ne nyunu berɛ, ná kɔ ɛne eliɛma ne bɛɛbɔ nu koraka né afa w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne aabɔ afɔleɛ ne.
25 “Sona bɔ wasama wɔ ne, ɛne ye bésiesie ɛmɔ afia ndɛndɛ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛne ye bɛ gya gyi atee so bɛkɔ mbanyi nyunu ɔ. Anyɔ a, sona bɔ wasama wɔ ne kɔfa wɔ kowura ndɛenbualɛniɛ sa, ná ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne koso wafa wɔ wawura wɛmvoɛ ne sa, ná bafa wɔ bato kuku nu. 26Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, sɛ andua kerɛ ne amu pɛsɛɛ a, bɛngɔye wɔ ma engofite ngɔhɔ le.
Agyaasɛkyelɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
27 “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bɛhane kyɛ, ‘Nnɛsɛkye agyaa.’ 28Nakoso me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔnea brasua ná ye nwo kɔyɛ ye akɔnnɔ ne, né wafa ye dada ye wɔ ahone nu. 29 Yiti sɛ wɔ nye famaa diedie wɔ kɔ bɔne nu a, tu ná gyi to! Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔtɔ bue tra kyɛ bekogyi wɔ mumua ne amu bɛkɔto abɔnzam see nu ɔ. 30 Sɛ wɔ sa famaa diedie wɔ kɔ bɔne nu a, pɛ na gyi to! Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔyɛ abasini tra kyɛ bekogyi wɔ mumua ne bɛkɔto abɔnzam see nu ɔ.
Agyaayiralɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Mateo 19.9; Marko 10.11-12; Luka 16.18)
31 “Bahã ye bieku kyɛ, ‘Ebiala bɔ okoyira ɔye ne, odi kyɛ ɔkyerɛ agyaayiralɛ krataa ma ye.’ 32 Na me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ wanyɛ adwamanbɔlɛ ti, ná ebie yira ɔye a, ye de né wama braa ne asɛkye agyaa. Na ebiala bɔ okogya braa bɔ bayira ye nen, né sɔ biaa ne koso wasɛkye agyaa.
Ndaen nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
33 “Ɛmɔate ye bieku kyɛ bɛhã behyirele tetefoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛta ndaen mbaen, na mmom fa bɔ aboa Awurade ne ma ye!’ 34 Na me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen koraa. Nnɛma ɛmɔfa anwuro bɛta ndaen, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ahennie bia, 35 anaa aseɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte ye gya ndiasoɛ; anaa Yerusalem, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Ɛhene berembɔn ne kuro. 36Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ti bɛta ndaen, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔngɔhora tire nwiaa komapɛ po bire anaa fufue yɔ. 37Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ‘Yoo’ yɛ ‘Yoo’ ná ɛmɔ ‘Daabi’ yɛ ‘Daabi.’ Ɛhe pa ye nwo a, bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã biala fi bɔne nu.
Nnɛfa bɔne tua bɔne so
(Luka 6.29-30)
38 “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bɛnwa: ‘Anyeɛ si anyeɛ gya nu, na agyee si agyee gya nu.’ 39Nakoso me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua ebie bɔ wayɔ ɛmɔ bɔne ɔ so kerɛ. Sɛ ebie pakye wɔ nye famaa so a, kakyi bɛen ne koso ma ye. 40Sɛ ebie sama wɔ kyɛ ode w’ataadeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye bo ne a, maa ɔfa w’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ne ɔboka so. 41Sɛ ebie hyɛ wɔ so kyɛ ɛnate pɛ kwanzii ko a, ɛne ye bɛhɔ kwanzii nyɔ. 42Sɛ ebie srɛ wɔ dɔ nikyee a, fa ma ye; yeɛ sɛ ebie pena kyɛ ɔfɛmo wɔ dɔ nikyee a, nnɛfa bɔ ye atianuserɛ.
Kuro wɔ pɔfoɛ dwirɛ
(Luka 6.27-28, 32-36)
43 “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bahã ye kyɛ, ‘Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ, ná pɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ.’ 44Nakoso me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔhuro ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ dwirɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma bɛ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye ɔ; 45amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔayɛ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne mma. Ɔnate kyɛ ɔma ye yia bɔ bɔnefoɛ mmenia ne mmeni paa so, na ɔtɔ esue gua teneneefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ ɔ so. 46Na sɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkuro bɛ dwirɛ de a, ye de nzu akatuaa yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ɔ? Ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ po, aso nna sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ? 47Na sɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ ngome yeɛ ɛmɔbisa bɛ ahye a, nzu yeɛ ɛmɔayɔ maa wabo so ɔ? Ewiasefoɛ po, aso nna sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ? 48Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo te, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ye nwo te ne.

Title: MATEO 6
Content:
Adɔeɛyɛlɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
1 “Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔanyɔ ɛmɔ tenenee yɔleɛ wɔ mmenia nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bekonwu ɛmɔ ɔ. Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔngonya akatuaa biala ngofi ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne berɛ. 2Yiti sɛ ɛyɔ adɔeɛ a, nnɛbɔ ye nwo dawure, kyɛbɔ nyaatwomfoɛ bɛyɔ ye nyianu sua mɔ nu ne dwaaso, kyɛbɔ mmenia kɔkamvo bɛ ne. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛ sa ahã b’akatuaa dada. 3Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛyɔ adɔeɛ a, nnɛma wɔ sa bɛen nwu bɔ wɔ sa famaa yɔ ɔ, 4 ama w’adɔeɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ; na wɔ Baba bɔ onwu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, ɔkɔma wɔ so akatuaa.
Mbaeɛbɔlɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Luka 11.2-4)
5“Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ nyaatwomfoɛ nemɔ; ofikyɛ bɛ de, bekuro kyɛ begyinagyina ndende wɔ nyianu sua nemɔ nu ne mmorɔnoɛ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ mmenia konwu bɛ ɔ. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, banya b’akatuaa dada. 6Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ a, kɔ wɔ sua nu, to w’anoa ne anu, ná bɔ mbaeɛ kyire wɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne, na wɔ Baba bɔ onwu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, ɔkɔma wɔ so akatuaa.
7 “Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ndoatoa kyɛ bosoensolɛfoɛ bɛyɔ ne; ofikyɛ bɛdwene kyɛ bɛ dwudwolɛ tendetende ne yeɛ ɔkɔmaa bekotie bɛ ɔ. 8 Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Baba ɔse bɔ ɛmɔhia ɔ koraka ná ɛmɔabisa ye. 9 Yiti sɔaa yeɛ ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ:
‘Yɛ Baba bɔ ɛwɔ nyameɛso ɔ,
Wɔ dumaa nwo te.
10W’ahennie ɔbra,
Maa yɛyɔ w’apɛdeɛ wɔ aseɛ so,
kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ nyameɛso ne.
11Ma yɛ yɛ daa dada aleɛ ɛnɛ;
12Na fa yɛ mvomsoɛ kyɛ yɛ,
kyɛbɔ yɛfa yɛkyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfõ yɛ ne.
13 Nnɛfa yɛ kɔ nzɔhwɛ nu,
Na mmom ye yɛ fi bɔne nu.’
[Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ahennie ne tumi ne animnyam
ɔte wɔ deɛ daa daa ɔ. Amen.]
14 “Sɛ ɛmɔfa mmenia mvomsoɛ bɛkyɛ bɛ a, ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne koso kɔfa ɛmɔ deɛ kɔhyɛ ɛmɔ. 15Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔamva mmenia mvomsoɛ bangyɛ bɛ a, ye de ɛmɔ Baba ne koso ɔngɔfa ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ.
Akɔngyere nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
16 “Sɛ ɛmɔyɛ akɔngyere a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nyunu bosaa kyɛ nyaatwomfoɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ benyinya bɛ nyunu kyɛbɔ mmenia konwu kyɛ bɛyɛ akɔngyere ɔ. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, banya b’akatuaa dada. 17Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛyɛ akɔngyere a, toli wɔ ti anu, ná nwunzi wɔ nyunu, 18 ná mmenia bannwu kyɛ ɛyɛ akɔngyere ɔ; sana wɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne; na wɔ Baba bɔ onwu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, ɔkɔma wɔ so akatuaa.
Nyameɛso agyapadeɛ
(Luka 12.33-34)
19 “Nnɛma ɛmɔboaboa agyapadeɛ noa bɛma bɛ nwo wɔ aseɛ ye aso, nekaa bɔ mvrɔlɔ di ná odi naakye, ná awuefoɛ bubu kɔ nu bekowua ne. 20Na mmom ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ noa bésie nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ mvrɔlɔ nni, ná onni naakye, ná awuefoɛ mmubu ngɔ nu ngonwua ɔ. 21Ɔnate kyɛ, nekaa bɔ w’agyapadeɛ wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ w’ahone koso wɔ ɔ.
Nipadua kanea
(Luka 11.34-36)
22 “Anyeɛ te nipadua kanea. Yiti sɛ wɔ nye nwu nikyee yé a, wɔ nipadua ne amukoraa kɔyɛ hyireinn. 23Nakoso sɛ wɔ nye te wusiwusi a, wɔ nipadua ne amukoraa kɔyɛ awosii. Yiti sɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne te awosii a, né ye awosii ne te kabii paa!
Nyameɛ ne anwonyadeɛ
(Luka 12.22-31; 16.13)
24“Sona biala ngora nzo meneɛ nyɔ; ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ɔkɔpɔ ko, né wahuro ko dwirɛ; anaakyɛ ɔkɔso ko nahorɛ nu, né wabu ko animtia. Ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔso Nyameɛ ne anwonyadeɛ.
25“Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ asetena nu adwenedwene tɔ ɛmɔ so, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkoli ɔ; anaakyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔno ɔ, anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua nwo, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhera ɔ. Aso ngoa nwo nhia ndra aleɛ? Aso nipadua nwo nhia ndra ɛtena anaa? 26 Ɛ́mɔnea ewienu nnomaa: bɛnyɔ boo, bɛngɔmva eboo so aleɛ, yeɛ bɛmmoaboa aleɛ bengua pata so; nakoso ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ɔma bɛ aleɛ. Aso ɛmɔ nwo nhia ndra bɛ? 27 Ɛmɔ nu beni yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔfa adwenedwene so kɔfa ɛlɛho po kɔtoa ye ngoa so ɔ?
28“Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene ndena nwo ɔ? Ɛ́mɔnea eburo sukooko, ɔne kyɛbɔ besi benyi ɔ. Bɛnyɔ adwuma, yeɛ bɛndo gyese. 29 Nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Solomon animnyam amukoraa nu ne po, ye anwosiesie ne ando ɛhemɔ anu ko po. 30 Na sɛ Nyameɛ siesie eburo ndire bɔ ogyi berɛ ɛnɛ maa ɔyɛ nyemene, ná ɛhema bapɛ bayera ye foonoo nu po a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ongosiesie ɛmɔ ma ɔngɔbo so ɔ? Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ!
31“Yiti nnɛmaa ɛmɔdwenedwene bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkoli ɔ, anaa nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔno ɔ, anaa nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔhera ɔ. 32Ofikyɛ ewiasefoɛ yeɛ bedi ɛhemɔ amukoraa si ɔ. Na ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, ɔse kyɛ ɛmɔhia ɛhemɔ amukoraa. 33Na ɛ́mɔli moa bɛ́pena Nyameɛ ahennie ne ye tenenee ne mmom, na ɔkɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔkɔboka so kɔma ɛmɔ. 34Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔdwene ɛhema deɛ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛhema bɔbɔ deinn ɔkɔdwene ye nwo. Kyẽa biala nu adwenedwene sone ma sɔ kyẽa ne.”

Title: MATEO 7
Content:
Nnɛbua wɔ mmango ndɛen
(Luka 6.37, 38, 41, 42)
1 “Nnɛma ɛmɔbua ndɛen, ná Nyameɛ koso wammua ɛmɔ ndɛen, 2ɔnate kyɛ ndɛen horɛ bɔ ɛmɔkobua ne, ye ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekobua ɛmɔ ɔ; na nikye horɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bekosusu ne, ye ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekosusu bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ɔ. 3 Na nzu ati yeɛ enwu baka sii bɔ ɔla eliɛma nye so, nakoso mbuna bɔ ɔla wɔ nye so de ennwu ye ɔ? 4Anaakyɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ahã ahyire eliɛma kyɛ, ‘Maa nye wɔ nye so baka sii mma wɔ,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ wɔ koso mbuna la wɔ nye so ɔ? 5Nyaatwomniɛ! Di moa ye wɔ nye so mbuna ne koraka, na ɔkɔmaa ekonwu nikyee yé, na ahora aye baka sii bɔ ɔla eliɛma nye so ne.
6“Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ bɛma ngyea, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔto ɛmɔ mbembenanneɛ paa begua mbrako nyunu, ná bamva bɛ gya bandiatia so, ná bambɛ bɛ nwo bangeka ɛmɔ.
Bisa, pena, bɔ nu
(Luka 11.9-13)
7 “Ɛ́mɔbisa, na ɛmɔ sa kɔha ye; ɛmɔpena, na ɛmɔkonwu ye; ɛ́mɔbɔ nu, na bekobukye ɛmɔ. 8Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ obisa ne, ye sa ka ye; na bɔ ɔpena ne, onwu ye; yeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ nu ne, bebukye ye. 9Anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔwa bisa ye paanoo a, ɔkɔma ye nyɔboɛ ɔ? 10Anaakyɛ obisa ye tiré a, ɔkɔma ye ewoo ɔ? 11Na ɛmɔ po bɔ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ ɔ, sɛ ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ mma mɔ nningyein paa a, nzaade ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɔngɔfa nningyein paa ngɔma bɛ bɔ bebisa ye ɔ? 12 Yiti nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ mmenia yɔ ma ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɔ sɔ ala bɛ́ma bɛ; ofikyɛ porɛ bɔ mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ gyi so hɔ ɛne.
Anoa kaaba ne anoa piri
(Luka 13.24)
13 “Ɛ́mɔwura anoa bɔtɔfee ne anu; ɔnate kyɛ anoa bɔ ɔte piri ɔne atee bɔ ɔte tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔ ewue nu ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bewura nu ne bɛsone pee. 14Anoa bɔ ɔte bɔtɔfee ne atee bɔ ɔte kyenɔnn ne yeɛ ɔkɔ ngoa nu ɔ, na mmenia kaaba bie yeɛ benwu ye ɔ.
Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ
(Luka 6.43-44)
15 “Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ngondombo ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwo; bɛfa boaen nwomaa bedwira bɛ nwo bɛba ɛmɔ berɛ, nakoso bɛ nu de, bɛte pataku adifuufoɛ. 16 Bɛ yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekonwu bɛ ɔ. Aso bɛtete bobe wɔ mmowue so, anaakyɛ bɛtete borɔdoma wɔ ɛfone so? 17Sɔ ala yeɛ bakaa paa biala osu mmaa paa ɔ, nakoso bakaa tɛɛ de osu mmaa tɛɛ. 18Bakaa paa ngɔhora ngosu mmaa tɛɛ, yeɛ bakaa tɛɛ koso ngɔhora ngosu mmaa paa. 19Bakaa biala bɔ onzu mmaa paa nen, bɛpɛ bɛto, na begyi bɛto see nu. 20Yiti bɛ yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekonwu bɛ ɔ.
Menze wɔ
(Luka 13.25-27)
21 “Nna ebiala bɔ ose me kyɛ ‘Awurade, Awurade’ ne, yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ, na mmom sana bɔ ɔyɔ me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ye apɛdeɛ ɔ. 22 Na sɔ kyẽa ne, mmenia pee yeɛ bekose me kyɛ, ‘Awurade, Awurade, aso yamva wɔ dumaa yanhyɛ ngɔm; aso yamva wɔ dumaa yandu sunzummɔne mɔ; aso yamva wɔ dumaa yanyɔ anwanwadeɛ pee?’ 23Na ɛhe yeɛ ngɔpakye nu ngose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Menze ɛmɔ koraa, ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ!’
Nyɔbotaen ne anweaa so suasilɛ
(Luka 6.47-49)
24“Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔte me dwirɛ he ná odi so nen, ngɔfa ye ngɔtoto nworɛniɛ bie bɔ osili ye sua wɔ nyɔbotaen so ɔ nwo. 25Esue piri bie tɔle, na nzue yili, mvrama tuli oofini sua ne, nakoso wammu, ɔnate kyɛ bɛtole ye fapem ne wɔ nyɔbotaen so.
26“Na ebiala bɔ ɔte me dwirɛ he na onni so nen, ngɔfa ye ngɔtoto kwaseaa bie bɔ osili ye sua siele anweaa so ɔ nwo. 27Esue piri bie tɔle, na nzue yili, mvrama tuli oofini sua ne, na obuli, na obuli gyirigorɔɔ.”
Yesu le tumi
28 Yesu yiele sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ kã nen, ɛlɔen ne nwo dwirili bɛ wɔ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anwo, 29ofikyɛ ohyirehyirele bɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ole tumi ɔ, na mmom nna kyɛ b’ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ.

Title: MATEO 8
Content:
Yesu sa kwataniɛ bie anwonyerɛ
(Marko 1.40-45; Luka 5.12-16)
1Yesu fili bokaa ne aso dwuli nen, mmenia pee lili ye si. 2 Na yieee, kwataniɛ bie wale ooguale ndwerɛ wɔ ye nyunu berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ ekuro a, ɛkɔhora kɔma me nwo kofi.” 3Na Yesu tengyɛle ye sa fa hane ye, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mekuro, wɔ nwo fi!” Na berɛ ne ala ye kwata ne hɔle. 4 Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Tie, nnɛbɔ so kyire ebiala, na mmom kɔ, ná fa wɔ nwo kohyire ɔsɔfo, ná fa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɔ Mose hyɛle ne kɔ, ná ɔyɛ adanzeɛ ma bɛ.”
Yesu sa akoaa bie anwonyerɛ
(Luka 7.1-10)
5Yesu dwuli Kapanɔm nen, asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi bie wale ye berɛ, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ, 6“Awurade, m’akoaa nde apɔ, wabubu ɔla awuro, na onwu amaneɛ soma.” 7Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ngɔwa ngɔɔsa ye anwonyerɛ.” 8Na asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne buale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, memvata kyɛ ɛkɔwa m’awuro ɔ; wɔ de kã edwirɛ ne ala, na m’akoaa ne nwo kɔtɔ ye. 9Ofikyɛ me koso nde sona bɔ nwura tumi bo, na asraafoɛ wura me bo, na mekã mekyire ɛhe kyɛ, ‘Kɔ!’ a, ɔkɔ; yeɛ mekã mekyire ko koso kyɛ, ‘Bra!’ a, ɔba; na mekã mekyire m’akoaa kyɛ, ‘Yɔ ɛhe!’ a, ɔyɔ.”
10Na Yesu tele bɔ ɔhane nen, ɔyɛle ye nwanwa, na osele mmenia bɔ beli ye si ne kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Yisrael po, nnwuni gyidie piri bɔ ɔte sɔaa ɔ. 11 Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia pee kofi eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ bɛkɔwa, na bɛ ne Abraham ne Yisake ne Yakob bɛkɔtena bekodidi wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. 12Nakoso Ahennie mma nemɔ de, bekogyi bɛ bekogua nziɛ dɔ awosii nu; na berɛ yeɛ esuɛ ne agyeenwosenɛ wɔ ɔ.” 13Na Yesu sele asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne kyɛ, “Kɔ, na kyɛbɔ ale ali ne, ɔ́yɛ sɔ ma wɔ!” Na sɔ mmerɛ ne ala, ye akoaa ne nwo sandene ye.
Yesu sa Petro sia anwonyerɛ
(Marko 1.29-34; Luka 4.38-41)
14Yesu wale Petro awuro, na onwuni kyɛ ebunu ahye ye sia brasua wato berɛ. 15Na ɔɔsɔle ye sa, na ebunu ne tu fili ye nwo, na odwɔsole sole ye.
16Na odwuli nɔsoa nen, bɛfale mmenia pee bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ɔ bɛwale Yesu berɛ. Ɔfale ye noa dwirɛ tutuli sunzummɔne nemɔ, na ɔsale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ ne amukoraa anwonyerɛ. 17 Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Ye yeɛ ɔfale yɛ anwommerɛlɛ, ná ɔsoale yɛ anwonyerɛ mɔ.”
Bɛ bɔ bekuro kyɛ bedi Yesu si
(Luka 9.57-62)
18Yesu nwuni mmenia pee bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia nen, ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔhɔ asue ne asi dɔ. 19Na ahyerɛlɛniɛ bie wale oosele Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔhɔ ne, me ne wɔ yɛkɔhɔ.” 20Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Safuboa mɔ bele bɔen mɔ, yeɛ ewienu nnomaa bele saen mɔ; nakoso Sona Awa ne de, olle nekaa bɔ ɔfa ye ti to ɔ.” 21 Na sona foforɛ bɔ né ɔboka asuafoɛ nemɔ so ɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, ma me ate ma ngonzie me baba koraka.” 22 Nakoso Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Di me si, ná ma awufoɛ bésie b’awufoɛ!”
Yesu brɛle mvrama piri bie ase
(Marko 4.35-41; Luka 8.22-25)
23Yesu tenane ɛlɛen nu nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ lili ye si. 24Na yieee, mvrama piri bie hyɛle ye bo tuli ɛpo ne aso, maa ɔnate so asorɔkye bɔ katale ɛlɛen ne aso; nakoso ye de, né walafe. 25Na bɛhɔle ye berɛ beetingyele ye besele kyɛ, “Awurade, de yɛ, na yawu yayie!” 26 Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “O ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa, nzu ati yeɛ ɛserɛ ahã ɛmɔ sɔa e?” Afei odwɔsole, na ɔteateane mvrama ne ne asorɔkye ne, na bɛyɛle dinn. 27Ɔyɛle mmenia nemɔ nwanwa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Sona beni koraa ɛhe, bɔ mvrama ne ɛpo po betie ye e!”
Yesu tutu sunzummɔne
(Marko 5.1-20; Luka 8.26-39)
28Yesu dwuli Gadarafoɛ aseɛ so wɔ asue ne asi dɔ nen, mmenia nyɔ bie bɔ bele sunzummɔne ɔ befili asieleɛ ngumaa nu befitele beeyiale ye. Na ɔnate b’awerɔm ne ati, né ebiala ngora mva atee ne aso. 29 Na yieee, bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛne wɔ le yɔ ɔ, wɔ, Nyameɛ Awa? Ɛwale wa kyɛ ɛbaateetee yɛ koraka ná mmerɛ ne adwu anaa?”
30Né mbrako kure pee bie bedidi wɔ nziɛ nziɛ dɔ. 31Na sunzummɔne nemɔ srɛle ye kyɛ, “Sɛ etu yɛ a, foa yɛ ma yɛɛwura mbrako kure ye anu.” 32Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ!” Yiti befili bɛ nu befitele, na beewurale mbrako nemɔ anu. Na yieee, mbrako kure ne amukoraa bepiane bɛ nwo wii bɛtorotorole bokaa twɔndworɔnn ne beeguale ɛpo ne anu, na bewuwuli wɔ nzue ne anu.
33Mmenia bɔ bɛnea mbrako nemɔ so ne bɛnwatili, na bɛhɔle kuro ne anu bɛɛhane edwirɛ bɔ wasi ne amukoraa, ɔne bɔ ɔfa bɛ bɔ né sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ne anwo. 34Na yieee, kurotue ne amukoraa bɛbɔle twi beeyiale Yesu, na benwuni ye nen, bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ ofi bɛ mbɔtam berɛ hɔ.

Title: MATEO 9
Content:
Yesu sale bubuaniɛ bie anwonyerɛ
(Marko 2.1-12; Luka 5.17-26)
1Yesu tenane ɛlɛen nu pɛle asue ne, na osa wale ye bɔbɔ ye kuro. 2 Eh, bɛfale bubuaniɛ bie bɔ ɔla bɛen so ɔ bɛwale ye berɛ, na Yesu nwuni bɛ gyidie nen, osele bubuaniɛ ne kyɛ, “Mma, ma w’ahone tɔ wɔ kunu! Bafa wɔ bɔne bahyɛ wɔ.” 3Na ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bie sisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa he ɔkã musue dwirɛ.” 4 Nakoso Yesu nwuni b’adwene, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwene adwene tɛɛ sɔ ɔ? 5Na beni yeɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Bafa wɔ bɔne bahyɛ wɔ,’ anaa kyɛ ɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Dwɔso ná nate’? 6Na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Sona Awa ne ole tumi wɔ aseɛ so, kyɛ ɔfa bɔne kyɛ ti ɔ,” na afei osele bubuaniɛ ne kyɛ, “Dwɔso, fa wɔ bɛen ne ná kɔ awuro!” 7Na odwɔsole sili nu hɔle ye awuro. 8Na ɛlɔen ne nwuni ye sɔ nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa, na bɛhyɛle Nyameɛ bɔ wafa sɔ tumi ne wama mmenia ne animnyam.
Yesu frɛle Mateo
(Marko 2.13-17; Luka 5.27-32)
9Yesu fili berɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ nen, onwuni biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Mateo kyɛ ɔte nekaa bɔ bedide ɛtoɔ ɔ, na osele ye kyɛ, “Di me si.” Na odwɔsole lili ye si.
10Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔtenane ase kyɛ odidi wɔ awuro nen, yieee, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ pee bɛwale, na bɛ ne Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane ase kyɛ bedidili. 11 Na Farasiifoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye sɔ nen, bebisale ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne ɔne ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ bedidi ye?” 12Yesu tele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛte apɔ ne, benhia safoɛ, na mmom bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ yeɛ behia ye ɔ. 13 Ɛmɔhɔ beesua kyɛbɔ edwirɛ he ye bo kyire ɔ, ‘Anwumvoinnwunɛ yeɛ mekuro ɔ, na nna afɔleɛbɔlɛ ɔ.’ Ofikyɛ mamma kyɛ mebaafrɛ teneneefoɛ, na mmom bɔnefoɛ.”
Akɔngyere nwo adwobisa
(Marko 2.18-22; Luka 5.33-39)
14Yeɛ Yohane asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ yɛne Farasiifoɛ yɛtaa yɛyɔ akɔngyere, ná w’asuafoɛ nemɔ de bɛnyɔ akɔngyere ɔ?” 15 Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né atɔmvorɛ bo ama bɛ wora abɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ atɔmvorɛ biaa ne ɔne bɛ wɔ berɛ ɔ? Mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ bɛkɔfa atɔmvorɛ biaa ne bekofi bɛ nwo bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, na afei bekoli abuadaa. 16Na ebiala mva ɛtena monɛ sii nda ataadeɛ daa nu, ofikyɛ ndetamuɛ ne te fi ataadeɛ ne anu, na ye tetelɛ ne yɛ piri. 17Yeɛ bɛmva nzaa monɛ bengua nwomaa ngotoku daa nu. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ngotoku nemɔ kote, na nzaa ne kohwie kogua, na ngotoku nemɔ kɔsɛkye. Na mmom bɛfa nzaa monɛ begua nwomaa ngotoku monɛ nu, ná bɛ munyɔ banzɛkye.”
Yairo awa brasua ne braa bie bɔ mogya tu ye ne
(Marko 5.21-43; Luka 8.40-56)
18Yesu gu so bɔ ɔkã ɛhemɔ kyire bɛ nen, yieee, panyi bie wale ɔɔkotole ye nyunu berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mma brasua awu kekesaala ye, nakoso bra baafa wɔ sa gua ye so, na okonya ngoa.” 19Yiti Yesu dwɔsole ɔne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ belili ye si.
20 Na yieee, braa bie bɔ mogya atu ye afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ɔ fale Yesu si, na ɔfale ye sa hane ye ataadeɛ noa bɔ banwo ne. 21Ofikyɛ ɔhane ye ye ti anu kyɛ, “Sɛ mefa me sa mekã ye ataadeɛ ne ngome po a, ngɔte apɔ.” 22 Yeɛ Yesu kakyili ye nwo, na onwuni braa ne nen, osele kyɛ, “Mma brasua, ma w’ahone tɔ wɔ kunu! Wɔ gyidie ale wɔ.” Na berɛ ne ala braa ne tele apɔ.
23Na Yesu dwuli panyi n’awuro berɛ, ná onwuni awɛenhulɛfoɛ ne mmenia bɔ bɛteatea nu nen, 24osele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me ate, ofikyɛ abaayaa ne owwuli, na mmom walafe.” Na bɛserele ye. 25Na ɔmaa mmenia ne fitele nen, owurale nu ɔɔsɔle abaayaa ne sa, na odwɔsole. 26Na sɔ dwirɛ ne trɛ hɔle mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa.
Yesu sa anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ anwonyerɛ
27 Yesu fili berɛ kyɛ ɔkɔ nen, anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ lili ye si bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Dawide Awa, nwu yɛ anwumvoin!” 28Odwuli awuro nen, anyesiniwaafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ, na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔde bedi kyɛ ngɔhora ngɔsa ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yoo, Awurade.” 29Yeɛ Yesu fale ye sa hane bɛ nye, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te ne, ɔ́yɛ sɔ ala ma ɛmɔ!” 30 Na bɛ nye tetele. Na Yesu bɔle bɛ noa kitii kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala ande!” 31Nakoso befili berɛ ne, bɛbɔle Yesu nwo dawure wɔ mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa.
Yesu sa emumu bie anwonyerɛ
32 Mmerɛ bɔ befitele bɔ bɛkɔ ne, ebiemɔ fale emumu bie bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ ye so ɔ bɛbrɛle Yesu. 33Yesu tuli sunzummɔne ne nen, emumu ne dwudwole; na ɔyɛle ɛlɔen ne nwanwa maa bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛnnwuni ɛhe bie le wɔ Yisrael!” 34Nakoso Farasiifoɛ nemɔ hane kyɛ, “Sunzummɔne mɔ panyi ye tumi yeɛ ɔfa tutu sunzummɔne mɔ ɔ.”
Yesu nwu mmenia nemɔ anwumvoin
35 Yesu hɔle nguro ne nguraa ne amukoraa so aporɔ yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nemɔ anu, ɔhane ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba, na ɔsale anwonyerɛ ne anwommerɛlɛ amukoraa. 36 Na onwuni mmenia pembepembe ne, bɛyɛle ye anwumvo, ofikyɛ né bafɛ, na né bɛsamo berɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ. 37 Yeɛ osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Nnɔbaeɛtelɛ adwuma ne sone, nakoso adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛte kãa. 38Yiti ɛ́mɔsrɛ nnɔbaeɛtelɛ Mene ne, ná ɔma adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɛbra ye nnɔbaeɛtelɛ adwuma ne anu.”

Title: MATEO 10
Content:
Yesu ye asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne
(Marko 3.13-19; Luka 6.12-16)
1Ɔfrɛle ye asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne maa beyiale, na ɔmane bɛ sunzummɔne mɔ so tumi bɔ bɛkɔfa bekotutu bɛ ɔ, ɔne tumi bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsa anwonyerɛ ne anwommerɛlɛ amukoraa ɔ. 2Asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Bɔ oli moa, Simɔn bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Petro, yeɛ oliɛma Andrea; Yakobo bɔ ye baba ole Sebedeo ne, yeɛ oliɛma Yohane. 3Filipo ne Batolomeo; Tɔmase ne Mateo bɔ ɔte ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ ne; Yakobo bɔ ye baba ole Alfeo ne, yeɛ Tadeo; 4Kanaanniɛ Simɔn, yeɛ Yudase Yiskariote bɔ ɔyele Yesu mane ne.
Asomafoɛ nemɔ adwuma
(Marko 6.7-13; Luka 9.1-6)
5 Sɔ mmenia buru ne nyɔ nemɔ yeɛ Yesu somane bɛ ɔ, na ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ berɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Samariafoɛ kuro biala so; 6 na mmom ɛmɔhɔ mmoaen bɔ bamini bɔ bɛ ole Yisrael awuro ama ne berɛ. 7 Na ɛmɔkɔ a, ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛso ahennie ne apingye.’ 8Ɛ́mɔsa ayarefoɛ anwonyerɛ, ɛ́mɔtingye awufoɛ, ɛ́mɔma kwatafoɛ nwo fi, ná ɛ́mɔtu sunzummɔne mɔ. Ɛmɔnyane ye mbaen, yiti ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́ma mbaen. 9Nnɛma ɛmɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ, anaa ɛdwetɛ, anaa kɔɔbere bɛbɔ ɛmɔ abɔsoɛ nu, 10 nnɛma ɛmɔfa ateetulɛ bɔtɔ, anaa ndaadeɛ nyɔ, anaa mbaboa, anaa pɔmaa, ofikyɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ fata kyɛ ye sa kã ye aleɛ ɔ.
11“Kuro anaa akuraa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔhɔ nu ne, ɛ́mɔpena sona bɔ okole ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɛmɔ ne ye bɛ́tena berɛ kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔkofi berɛ bɛkɔhɔ ɔ. 12 Sɛ ɛmɔwura awuro bie anu a, ɛ́mɔbisa berɛ ama ahye. 13Sɛ awuro berɛ ama bede ɛmɔ nyemene so a, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ asomdwee ne ɔbra awuro ne aso; nakoso sɛ banne ɛmɔ nyemene so de a, ye de ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ asomdwee ne osa bra ɛmɔ berɛ. 14 Na sɛ ebiala ngole ɛmɔ anaa ongotie ɛmɔ dwirɛ a, ye de sɛ ɛmɔfi awuro anaa kuro ne aso bɛ́kɔ a, ɛ́mɔporoporo ɛmɔ gya bo mvuture bégua berɛ. 15 Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne, amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔto Sodom ne Gomora aseɛ ne nen, ongodwu bɔ ɔkɔto sɔ kuro ne.
Ndaneanyeɛ nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛ
(Marko 13.9-13; Luka 21.12-17)
16 “Ɛ́mɔtie! mésoma ɛmɔ kyɛ mmoaen maa ɛmɔkɔ mbataku nu. Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ kyɛ ewoo, ná ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase kyɛ mmubure. 17 Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ kuro sona nwo, ɔnate kyɛ bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ bɛkɔhɔ mbanyi badwa nu, ná bafi ɛmɔ mbire wɔ bɛ nyianu sua mɔ nu. 18Ɔnate me ti bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ bekogyina amrado mɔ ne ahemvo nyunu, na ɔkɔyɛ adanzeɛ kohyire bɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ. 19Na sɛ bɛfa ɛmɔ bɛkɔ a, nnɛma ɛmɔdwenedwene kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkodwudwo anaa bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã ɔ nwo; ofikyɛ nyameɛ kɔfa bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔkã ɔ kɔma ɛmɔ wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne ala nu. 20Ɔnate kyɛ, nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdwudwo ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ Baba Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔfa ɛmɔ so dwudwo ɔ.
21 “Aliɛmaa kɔye aliɛmaa kɔma maa bekohu ye, seɛ kɔye baa kɔma, na mmaa kodwɔso kotia awofoɛ maa bekohu bɛ. 22 Ɔnate me dumaa ti, mmenia mukoraa kɔpɔ ɛmɔ; nakoso bɔ okotindim koodwu ayieleɛ nen, ye yeɛ bekole ye ngoa ɔ. 23 Na sɛ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye wɔ kuro ko aso a, ɛ́mɔnwati bɛhɔ foforɛ so. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔngoyie Yisrael nguro amukoraa so kyini koraka né Sona Awa ne awa.
24 “Suaniɛ ndra ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, yeɛ akoaa ndra ye mene. 25 Yiti sɛ suaniɛ yɛ kyɛ ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ a, odi kyɛ ɔma ye nye sɔ; yeɛ akoaa koso sɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ye mene a, odi kyɛ ɔma ye nye sɔ. Na sɛ bafrɛ awuro mene ne Beɛsebul de a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ bɛngɔfa dumaa tɛɛ pee bɛngɔfrɛ ye awuro ama ɔ?
Bɔ odi kyɛ yɛsuro ye ɔ
(Luka 12.2-7)
26 “Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ so akata bɔ ye nwo ngɔla berɛ ɔ, anaa bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu bɔ bengonwu ye ɔ. 27Na bɔ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ awosii nu ne, ɛmɔhã ye eyia ketee; yeɛ bɔ batu ye nwo asure maa ɛmɔate ne, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure wɔ sua ti afia. 28 Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ bɔ beku anwoɔnaen ne, ná koso bɛngora bengu ɛkra ne; na mmom ɛ́mɔsuro bɔ ɔkora sɛkye anwoɔnaen ne ɛkra ne amunyɔ wɔ abɔnzam see nu ne. 29Aso bɛndɔne akatipire nyɔ pɛsaa? Nakoso bɛ nu ko po nde ndɔ ase bɔ ɛmɔ Baba ne ɔnze ye nwo bie ɔ. 30Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ ti nwiaa po baha ye mukoraa. 31 Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Ɛmɔ nwo hia tra ngatipire pee.
Kyɛ ɛkɔbɔ Yesu dumaa, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔpo ye ɔ
(Luka 12.8-9)
32 “Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbɔ me dumaa wɔ mmenia nyunu ne, me koso ngɔbɔ ye dumaa me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne nyunu. 33 Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpo me wɔ mmenia nyunu ne, me koso ngɔpo ye me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne nyunu.
Nna asomdwee, na mmom koɛ
(Luka 12.51-53; 14.26-27)
34 “Nnɛma ɛmɔdwene kyɛ mvale asomdwee mmale aseɛ so. Nna asomdwee yeɛ mva mmale ɔ, na mmom ngrandɛ. 35Ofikyɛ mmale kyɛ mebaatete nu ma baa bienzua dwɔso tia ɔse; ná baa brasua adwɔso atia oni, ná sia brasua adwɔso atia ohyireni. 36Na sona awuro ama kɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ.
37 “Na ebiala bɔ okuro ɔse anaa oni dwirɛ tra me ne, ɔmvata me; yeɛ bɔ okuro ɔwa bienzua anaa ɔwa brasua dwirɛ tra me ne, ɔmvata me. 38Na ebiala bɔ ɔmva ye mmeamudua ná onni me si nen, ɔmvata me. 39Ebiala bɔ okonya ye ngoa ne, ɔkɔhwere ye; na ebiala bɔ me ti ye ngoa kofi ye sa ne, okonya ye.
Akatuaa
(Marko 9.41)
40 “Bɔ ode ɛmɔ to nu nen, ode me koso to nu; yeɛ bɔ ode me to nu nen, ode bɔ ɔsomane me ne koso to nu. 41Na bɔ ode ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ to nu ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ati nen, ye sa kɔha ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ akatuaa. Yeɛ bɔ ode teneneeniɛ to nu ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte teneneeniɛ ne ati nen, ye sa kɔha teneneeniɛ akatuaa. 42 Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔma mmaa mmaa hemɔ anu ko nzue frɔlɔɔ kwangoa ko, ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte suaniɛ ne ati nen, nahorɛ nu mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ye akatuaa ngɔbɔ ye.”

Title: MATEO 11
Content:
Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane soma ye asuafoɛ Yesu berɛ
(Luka 7.18-35)
1 Mmerɛ bɔ Yesu dwudwo hyirele ye asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne yiele nen, ofili berɛ hɔle kyɛ ɔkwaayɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ná ɔkã nzɛmba wɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ aso. 2 Na Yohane la kuku nu nen, ɔtele nnwumaa bɔ né Kristo yɔ ɔ, na ɔsomane ye asuafoɛ maa 3 beebisale ye kyɛ, “Aso wɔ ole bɔ ɔ́ba ne, anaa odi kyɛ yɛnea foforɛ ate?”
4Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛhã bɔ ɛmɔte, ɔne bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye ɔ behyire Yohane: 5 anyesiniwaafoɛ nwu nikye, bubuafoɛ nate, kwatafoɛ nwo fi, asotiniwaafoɛ te dwudwolɛ, awufoɛ tingye, na bɛkã nzɛmba ne bekyire ehiafoɛ. 6Na sona bɔ nnde sundidua mma ye ne, wanya saleɛ.”
7 Na mmerɛ bɔ béfi berɛ bɛ́kɔ nen, Yesu hyɛle ye bo hane edwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Yohane nwo ɔ hyirele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔle ɛserɛ so dɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Elemmire bɔ mvrama wosowoso ye anaa? 8Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Sona bɔ owura ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene anaa? Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene ne de, ahemvo mɔ b’awuro yeɛ bɛte ɔ. 9 Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa? Yoo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔtra ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ po. 10 Ofikyɛ ye ole bɔ bahyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ,
‘Tie, mésoma me bɔfoɛ maa odi wɔ nyunu,
bɔ okoli wɔ nyunu moa kosiesie w’atee nu ɔ.’
11 Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛ bɔ mmrasua awo bɛ amukoraa, bɛ nu biala oddwɔsole bɔ odi mu tra Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ɔ. Nakoso bɔ ɔte kãa koraa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ne po odi mu tra ye. 12 Na ofi Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane aberɛ so bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, nyameɛso ahennie ne ɔ́ba anyeborolɛ so; na bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aboro ne bɛfa ye anyeborolɛ so. 13Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa ne mmeraa ne hyɛle ngɔm maa odwuli Yohane so; 14 na sɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔde bɛto nu a, ye ole Elia bɔ ɔ́ba ne. 15 Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie!
16“Na nwa mɔ nwo yeɛ ngɔfa ɛnɛmmafoɛ ngɔtoto ɔ? Bɛte kyɛ ngwadaa bɔ bɛtete dwaaso, bɔ bɛ́frɛfrɛ bɛ mmango kyɛ,
17‘Yɛhuli awɛen yɛhyirele ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔango;
yɛbɔle awuye yɛhyirele ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔ wora ammɔ’
18 Yohane wale ne, onnidi, yeɛ ɔnno, na bɛnwa: ‘Ole sunzummɔne.’ 19Na Sona Awa ne wale ne, odidi, yeɛ ɔno, na bɛnwa: ‘Ɛ́mɔnea, adifuu ne akɔnomnzaniɛ, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ adamvo!’ Nakoso nworɛ nate ye nnwumaa so di be.”
Korasin, Betesaeda ne Kapanɔm
(Luka 10.13-15)
20Nguro bɔ Yesu yɔle ye nnwumaa mbiri mbiri pee wɔ nu ne, banzakyera b’adwene, yiti ɔhyɛle ye bo hwili bɛ nyunu kyɛ, 21 “Wɔ, Korasin, wɔ yaakɔ! Wɔ, Betesaeda, wɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, nnwumaa mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛyɔle ye wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, sɛ bɛyɔle bɛ wɔ Tiro ne Sidon a, ahaa bahera ɛsɛen tena bafa nzoen bayɛ bɛ nwo basakyera b’adwene dada. 22Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne, amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔto Tiro Sidon nen, ongodwu bɔ ɔkɔto ɛmɔ ne. 23 Na wɔ, Kapanɔm, bɛkɔma wɔ so bɛkɔhɔ nyameɛso anaa? Daabi. Bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto abɔnzam see nu. Ofikyɛ, nnwumaa mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛyɔle bɛ wɔ wɔ nu ne, sɛ bɛyɔle bɛ wɔ Sodom a, ahaa ɔtɛwɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ. 24 Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne, amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔto Sodom aseɛ ne, ongodwu bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ ne!”
Yesu ye Baba ne kyire
(Luka 10.21-22)
25 Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Yesu hane kyɛ, “Baba, anwuro ne aseɛ Mene, meda wɔ ase kyɛ afa edwirɛ hemɔ afea nworɛfoɛ ne nimdeɛfoɛ, ná aye ahyire ngokwaammaa ɔ. 26Yoo, Baba, sɔ yeɛ ɔte nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ. 27 Me Baba afa nningyein amukoraa awura me sa; na ebiala nze Baa ne, sana Baba ne; yeɛ ebiala nze Baba ne, sana Baa ne ne ebiala bɔ Baa ne kuro kyɛ ɔda ye adi kyire ye ɔ.
28 “Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔayɔ adwuma bafɛ ná bafa adesoa nonɛnonɛ basoa ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔbra me berɛ, na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkole ɛmɔ nwome. 29 Ɛ́mɔfa me kɔnnua ne bɛ́to bɛ nwo so, na ɛ́mɔsua me, ofikyɛ medwo na mebrɛ me nwo ase wɔ ahone nu, na ɛmɔkonya nwomelelɛ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ kra. 30Ofikyɛ me kɔnnua ne yɛ mmerɛ, yeɛ m’adesoa ne anu yɛ nyera.”

Title: MATEO 12
Content:
Afofikyẽa nwo adwobisa
(Marko 2.23-28; Luka 6.1-5)
1 Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Yesu hɔle ɔɔfale aburoo boo bie anu. Né ɔte afofikyẽa. Né ɛhɔen ku ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛpombale aburoo ne bie belili. 2Na mmerɛ bɔ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ nwuni sɔ ne, besele ye kyɛ, “Nea, w’asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛ́yɔ bɔ otia mmeraa kyɛ bɛyɔ ye afofikyẽa ɔ!” 3 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔkkenngale bɔ Dawide yɔle, mmerɛ bɔ ɛhɔen huni ye ne bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne? 4Kyɛbɔ ɔhɔle Nyameɛ awuro, ná oolili paanoo krongron ne, bɔ né otia mmeraa kyɛ ye anaa bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne bekoli ɔ; sana asɔfo ngome yeɛ bedi ɔ? 5 Anaakyɛ ɛmɔkkenngale ye wɔ mmeraa ne anu, kyɛbɔ afofingyẽa nemɔ, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu bɛtõ afofikyẽa mmeraa ne, ná koso benni ye nwo fɔ ɔ? 6 Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɔ odi mu tra asɔneyɛɛ sua ne wɔ wa. 7 Na sɛ ɛmɔte edwirɛ he abo, kyɛ, ‘Anwumvoinnwunɛ yeɛ mekuro ɔ, na nna afɔleɛbɔlɛ ɔ’ a, ahaa ɛmɔammua bɛ bɔ benni fɔ ne fɔ. 8 Ofikyɛ Sona Awa ne te afofikyẽa ne Mene.”
Yesu sa anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa
(Marko 3.1-6; Luka 6.6-11)
9Yesu fili berɛ hɔle bɛ nyianu sua nu. 10Na yieee, né biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ye sa ko awu ɔ. Na bebisale Yesu kyɛ, “Aso mmeraa ma ate kyɛ bɛsa anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa anaa?” Né bɛpena edwirɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ ye kwaadu. 11 Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ sɛ ole boaen komapɛ ná ɔtɔ kumaa nu afofikyẽa a, ɔngɔsɔ ye nu ngɔye ye ɔ? 12 Aso sona ye nwo nhia ndra boaen anaa? Yiti mmeraa ma ate kyɛ yɛyɔ paa afofikyẽa.” 13Na osele biaa ne kyɛ, “Tengyɛ wɔ sa ne anu.” Ɔtengyɛle nu, na ɔyɛle paa kyɛ ko ne ala. 14 Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ fili berɛ bɛhɔle aluo dɔ, na bɛbɔle ye ti so porɛ bɛpenane atee bɔ bɛkɔfa so bekohu ye ɔ.
15Nakoso Yesu nwuni ye sɔ nen, ofili berɛ hɔle. Mmenia pee lili ye si, na ɔsale bɛ mukoraa anwonyerɛ; 16na ɔberale bɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ ye nwo dawure. 17Na ɛhe mane ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu kyɛ,
18 “Tie, Ɛhe ole me somvoɛ bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ne,
bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ, bɔ me kra nye gye ye nwo paa ne.
Ngɔfa me Sunzum ngogua ye so,
na ɔkɔbɔ ndɛen turoloo nwo dawure kohyire Amaenmaensofoɛ.
19Ɔngɔho, yeɛ ɔngɔteatea nu,
yeɛ ebiala ngɔte ye komvi wɔ dwaaso.
20Elemmire bɔ ɔte fɛngyɛfɛngyɛ ne, ongobu nu,
yeɛ kanea nyamaa bɔ ogye monɛɛmonɛɛ ne, ongonua ye,
maa okoodwu kyɛ okobua ndɛen turoloo ngonim nu ɔ;
21na ye dumaa nu yeɛ maen maen mɔ bekonya anyelasoɛ ɔ.”
Bɛto Yesu soen
(Marko 3.20-30; Luka 11.14-23)
22 Yeɛ mmenia biemɔ fale biaa bie bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ ye so ná osa te anyesiniwaaniɛ ne emumu ɔ bɛbrɛle Yesu. Na ɔsale biaa ne anwonyerɛ maa ɔhora dwudwole, na osa nwuni nikye. 23Ɔyɛle mmenia ne amukoraa nwanwa, na besele kyɛ, “Aso nna Dawide Awa ne ɛhe?” 24 Nakoso Farasiifoɛ nemɔ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa he, sunzummɔne mɔ panyi Beɛsebul tumi yeɛ ɔfa tutu sunzummɔne mɔ ɔ.”
25Yesu nwuni b’adwene, yiti obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ahennie biala bɔ ɔne ye nwo ko ne, ogu; yeɛ kuro anaa awuro biala bɔ ɔne ye nwo ko ne, ɔbɔ. 26Na sɛ Abɔnzam tu Abɔnzam de a, né nzaade ɔne ye nwo bɛko; na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ye ahennie ne agyina? 27Na sɛ Beɛsebul tumi yeɛ mefa metu sunzummɔne mɔ de a, né nzaade nwa tumi yeɛ ɛmɔ mma mɔ bɛfa betutu bɛ ɔ? Bɛ bɔbɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ ɛmɔ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ. 28Nakoso sɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum yeɛ mefa metu sunzummɔne mɔ de a, né nzaade Nyameɛ ahennie ne anya awa ɛmɔ so.
29 “Anaakyɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ebie ahora ahɔ katakyie bie awuro waafẽ ye nningyein wahɔ, sana odi moa ɔfa nyamaa kyekye katakyie ne koraka, ná afei wahora wafẽ ye awuro nningyein ne.
30 “Ebiala bɔ ɔbboka me so nen, né otia me; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔne me mmoaboa ye noa nen, né ɔsande nu. 31Ɛhe ati yeɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛkɔfa bɔne ne musue dwirɛ amukoraa bɛkɔhyɛ mmenia, nakoso musue dwirɛ bɔ otia Sunzum ne de, bɛngɔfa ngɔhyɛ mmenia. 32 Ebiala bɔ okodwudwo kotia Sona Awa ne nen, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔhyɛ ye; nakoso bɔ okodwudwo kotia Sunzum Krongron ne de, bɛngɔfa ngɔhyɛ ye, wɔ ewiase wa ne ewiase bɔ ɔ́ba ne anu.
Bakaa biala ne ye mma
(Luka 6.43-45)
33 “Ɛ́mɔma bakaa ne ɔ́yɛ bakaa paa, ná ye mma ne ayɛ mmaa paa. Anaakyɛ, ɛ́mɔma bakaa ne ɔ́yɛ bakaa tɛɛ, ná ye mma ne ayɛ mmaa tɛɛ; ofikyɛ bakaa ye mma yeɛ bɛfa benwu ye baka sue ɔ. 34 Ɛmɔ, ewoo mmaa! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛmɔahora bahã edwirɛ paa, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ ɔ? Ofikyɛ bɔ wayi ahone nu maa wabu wafa so ne yeɛ noa ɔkã ɔ. 35Sona paa fi nningyein paa bɔ waboaboa ye noa wɔ ye ahone nu ɔ nu yeɛ ɔda nningyein paa ali ɔ; yeɛ sona bɔnefoɛ fi bɔne nningyein bɔ waboaboa ye noa wɔ ye ahone nu ɔ nu yeɛ ɔda bɔne nningyein ali ɔ.
36“Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, edwirɛ mbaen biala bɔ mmenia kɔhã ne, bekobu ye nwo ngondaa ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne. 37Ofikyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ so yeɛ bekogyina bekobua wɔ be ɔ; yeɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ so yeɛ bekogyina bekobua wɔ fɔ ɔ.”
Ɛnɛmmafoɛ pena sɛngyerɛnneɛ
(Marko 8.11-12; Luka 11.29-32)
38 Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ ne, bɛ nu biemɔ sele Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, yɛpena kyɛ yɛnwu sɛngyerɛnneɛ bie yɛfi wɔ berɛ.” 39 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛnɛmmafoɛ bɔnefoɛ ne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ bɛpena sɛngyerɛnneɛ, nakoso bɛngɔma bɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ biala, sana ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yona deɛ ne ala. 40 Na kyɛbɔ Yona lili bonzu kunu ɛlɛsa eyia ne kɔngɔen ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne koli aseɛ bo ɛlɛsa eyia ne kɔngɔen ɔ. 41 Ninewefoɛ ne ɛnɛmmafoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne anu, na bɛkɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu, ofikyɛ Ninewefoɛ tele Yona nzɛmba nen, bɛsakyerale b’adwene; na tie, bɔ odi mu tra Yona wɔ wa! 42 Ngwaen dɔ hemmaa ne, ɔne ɛnɛmmafoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne anu, na ɔkɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu, ofikyɛ ofili aseɛ noa dɔ paa wale ootiele Solomon nworɛ dwirɛ; na tie, bɔ odi mu tra Solomon wɔ wa!
Sunzummɔne sa ba ye si
(Luka 11.24-26)
43 “Sɛ sunzummɔne tu fi sona nu a, okokyinikyini aseɛ katerepee mɔ so pena nekaa bɔ okole ye nwome ɔ, na onnya bie. 44Na afei ɔkã kyɛ, ‘Ngosa ngɔhɔ me sua bɔ mvili nu mmale ne anu.’ Na ɔba a, ɔbato ye kyɛ ɔla berɛ too, bɔ bapoapoa nu, ná basiesie nu ɔ. 45Na ɔkɔ kɔfa sunzum nzoo foforɛ bɔ bedi bɔne bɛtra ye ɔ ɔboka ye nwo so ɔne bɛ ba, na bɛbawura nu bɛtena berɛ. Na sɔ sona ne, ye asetena bɔ oli nziɛ ne te bɔne asetena tra daa ne. Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ɛnɛmmafoɛ bɔnefoɛ he ɔ.”
Yesu abusuafoɛ kaenn
(Marko 3.31-35; Luka 8.19-21)
46 Yesu gu so bɔ odwudwo kyire ɛlɔen ne nen, yieee, ye maame ne oliɛma mɔ beegyinane bondua, na né bɛpena kyɛ bɛ ne ye dwudwo. [47Na ebie hã hyirele ye kyɛ, “Nea, wɔ maame ne eliɛma mɔ begyigyi bondua dɔ, na bɛpena kyɛ bɛ ne wɔ dwudwo.”] 48Yeɛ Yesu buale sona bɔ ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele ye ne kyɛ, “Nwa ole me maame? Nwa ole nniɛma mɔ?” 49Yeɛ ɔtengyɛle ye sa hyirele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ so hane kyɛ, “Nea, me maame ne nniɛma mɔ ɛhe! 50Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso n’apɛdeɛ nen, ye yeɛ ɔte nniɛma bienzua ne nniɛma brasua ne me maame ɔ.”

Title: MATEO 13
Content:
Kuaniɛ bie nwo anyandera
(Marko 4.1-9; Luka 8.4-8)
1Ɛlɛho ne ala, Yesu fili awuro ɔɔtenane ase wɔ mboanoa. 2Mmenia pee bɛɛpɛle ye nwo beyiale, yiti ɔfo tenane ɛlɛen nu; na mmenia wora ne amukoraa begyinagyinane mboanoa berɛ. 3Na ɔhane edwirɛ pee wɔ anyandera nu hyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, kuaniɛ bie hɔle kyɛ ɔkwaapete ye bakaammaa. 4Na ɔpete nen, bakaammaa ne bie ooguale atee noa, na nnomaa wale beesusole. 5Ebie koso ooguale ayɔboɛ so, nekaa bɔ nnɛterɛ pee nne berɛ ɔ; na wangyɛ yeɛ befifili ɔ, ofikyɛ né nnɛterɛ nzone wɔ bɛ bo. 6Na eyia pukyele nen, bɛkesene, na ɔnate kyɛ bandira ndii ne ati, bɛyerale. 7Bakaammaa ne bie ooguale mmowue nu; mmowue ne nyini, na bemiamiane bɛ. 8 Bakaammaa ne bie koso ooguale aseɛ paa so; na besuli mmaa, ebie ɛyaa, ebie aburasia, ebie aburasa. 9Bɔ ole asoɛ kotie ne, maa otie!”
Bɔ yiti yeɛ Yesu dwudwo anyandera nu ɔ
(Marko 4.10-12; Luka 8.9-10)
10Afei, asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ edwudwo kyire bɛ wɔ anyandera nu ye?” 11 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ de, bafa bama ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔnwu nyameɛso ahennie nu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ, nakoso bɛ de, bɛffa bɛmmane bɛ. 12Na ebiala bɔ ole bie ne, bɛkɔfa ebieku bɛkɔboka ye so, ná wanya ye mmorosoɛ; nakoso ebiala bɔ olle bie ne de, bɔ ole ye ne po, bekole bekofi ye sa nu. 13Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa medwudwo mekyire bɛ wɔ anyandera nu ɔ: ofikyɛ benwu ye de, nakoso bennwu ye; bɛte de, nakoso bɛnde, yeɛ bɛnde ye bo. 14 Na Yesaya ngɔm ne wawa nu wafa bɛ nwo kyɛ,
‘Etielɛ de, ɛmɔkotie,
nakoso ɛmɔngɔte ye bo;
enwunɛ de, ɛmɔkonwu ye,
nakoso ɛmɔngonwu nu.
15Ofikyɛ maen he b’adwene ala;
bɛ so anu ayɛ se,
yeɛ bamuamua bɛ nye.
Wamma ye sɔ a, bɛ nye konwu nikye,
bɛ so kɔte dwirɛ,
bɛkɔfa b’adwene bɛkɔte ye bo,
ná basa bawa me berɛ maa masa bɛ anwonyerɛ.’
16“Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ nye anya saleɛ kyɛ benwu nikye ɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ so koso kyɛ bɛte dwirɛ ɔ. 17Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ pee ne teneneefoɛ pee behurole kyɛ ahaa bekonwu bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye ye, nakoso bannwu ye, ɔne kyɛ bɛkɔte bɔ ɛmɔte ye, nakoso bande.”
Yesu kyire anyandera ne bo
(Marko 4.13-20; Luka 8.11-15)
18“Kuaniɛ ne nwo anyandera ne, ɛ́mɔtie ye bo hyirelɛ. 19Ebiala bɔ ɔte ahennie ne nwo dwirɛ, ná ɔnde ye bo nen, bɔnefoɛ ne ba ɔbafoti bɔ balua ye wɔ ye ahone nu ne ɔkɔ; na ɛhe gyi berɛ ma mmakaammaa bɔ beguale atee noa ne. 20Na mmakaammaa bɔ beguale ayɔboɛ so ne, ogyi berɛ ma sona bɔ sɛ ɔte edwirɛ ne a, ode to nu anigye so berɛ ne ala ɔ; 21nakoso sɔ sona ne ondira ndii, na mmom ɔkora gyina mmerɛ kãa bie. Na sɛ ɔnate edwirɛ ne ati amaneɛnwunɛ anaa ndaneanyeɛ ba ye so a, berɛ ne ala ɔkakyi sundidua ma ye. 22 Na mmakaammaa bɔ beguale mmowue nu ne, ogyi berɛ ma ebiala bɔ ɔte edwirɛ ne, nakoso ewiase asetena nu adwenedwene ne anwonyadeɛ nnakannaka bemiamia edwirɛ ne, na onzu mmaa. 23Na mmakaammaa bɔ beluale bɛ wɔ aseɛ paa so ne, ogyi berɛ ma ebiala bɔ ɔte edwirɛ ne ná ɔte ye bo ɔ; na ye yeɛ osu mmaa ɔ: ebie su ɛyaa, ebie su aburasia, yeɛ ebie su aburasa.”
Atokoɔ ne ngyɛngyɛma nwo anyandera
24Yesu buli bɛ anyandera foforɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ biaa bie bɔ oluale mmakaammaa paa wɔ ye fieso ɔ. 25Na mmerɛ bɔ mmenia bɛlelale ne, ye pɔfoɛ wale ooluale ngyɛngyɛma forale atokoɔ ne, na ofili berɛ hɔle. 26Atokoɔ ne nyini ná ɔfale mmaa nen, ngyɛngyɛma ne koso yele ye ti. 27Yiti biaa ne, ye ngoaa wale ye berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, ‘Yɛ mene, aso nna mmakaammaa paa yeɛ eluale ye wɔ wɔ fie ne aso ɔ? Na ngyɛngyɛma ye de, ofi nisua?’ 28Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, ‘Pɔfoɛ bie yeɛ wayɔ sɔ ne oo.’ Yeɛ ngoaa nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, ‘Ekuro kyɛ yɛkɔ ná yɛkotutu ngyɛngyɛma ne anaa?’ 29Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, ‘Daabi, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔtutu ngyɛngyɛma ne a, annea a né ɛmɔatutu atokoɔ ne baboka so. 30Ɛ́mɔma bɛ munyɔ benyi bɛbɔ nu maa oodwu ye telɛ mmerɛ ne. Na ye telɛ mmerɛ ne yeɛ ngose mmenia bɔ bɛte ne kyɛ: Ɛ́mɔli moa betutu ngyɛngyɛma ne, ná ɛmɔkyekye bɛ tiretire bɛyera bɛ; nakoso atokoɔ ne de, ɛ́mɔboaboa ye noa bɛ́fa beegua me pata so.’ ”
Sinapi baa nwo anyandera
(Marko 4.30-32; Luka 13.18-19)
31Yesu buli bɛ anyandera bieku kyɛ, “Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ sinapi baa ko bɔ biaa bie fa ooluale ye wɔ ye fieso ɔ. 32Ye yeɛ ɔte mmakaammaa mukoraa nu kãa ɔ, nakoso sɛ onyi a, ɔyɛ piri tra kwaanzusuaa sɛso mmakaa mukoraa, na onyi yɛ bakaa ma ewienu nnomaa bayɛ bɛ saen wɔ ye mmaen nemɔ so.”
Mɔle harewaa nwo anyandera
(Luka 13.20-21)
33Yesu buli bɛ anyandera foforɛ bieku kyɛ, “Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ mɔle harewaa bɔ braa bie fa forale esam kongo nza maa odwuli kyɛ ye mukoraa tuli ɔ.”
Yesu dwudwo anyandera nu
(Marko 4.33-34)
34 Yesu fale anyandera nu hane ɛhemɔ amukoraa hyirele ɛlɔen ne; na wangwati anyandera wanga edwirɛ biala wangyire bɛ. 35Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne hane ne wale nu kyɛ,
“Anyandera nu yeɛ ngodwudwo ɔ,
na edwirɛ bɔ wafea fi mmerɛ bɔ
Ɛdangama bɔle wiase ɔ, ngɔhã.”
Yesu kyire ngyɛngyɛma anyandera ne bo
36Yesu yakyili ɛlɔen ne ate, na ɔhɔle awuro.
