Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Kyire yɛ ngyɛngyɛma anyandera ne abo.” 37Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ odua mmakaammaa paa ne ole Sona Awa ne; 38 eboo ne ole ewiase, na mmakaammaa paa ne ole ahennie ne mma; yeɛ ngyɛngyɛma ne ole bɔnefoɛ ne mma. 39Pɔfoɛ bɔ oluale ne ole abɔnzam; ye telɛ mmerɛ ne ole ewiase ayieleɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛte ne ole abɔfo mɔ. 40Na kyɛbɔ betutuli ngyɛngyɛma ne ná bɛfale see bɛyerale bɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ewiase ayieleɛ ne ɔ. 41Sona Awa ne kɔsoma ye abɔfo mɔ, na bɛkɔboaboa bɔ ɔte sundidua amukoraa ne bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bekofi ye ahennie ne anu; 42na bekogyi bɛ bekogua see wuronyiwuronyi nu, nekaa bɔ mmenia kosũ ná banwose bɛ gye ɔ. 43 Na teneneefoɛ kɔta kyɛ eyia wɔ bɛ Baba ahennie ne anu. Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie!
Agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bafea ne nwo anyandera
44“Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ agyapadeɛ bie bɔ bafa bafea fie bie aso, bɔ ebie oonwuni ye fa feale, ná ye fɛɛ bɔ ɔyɛle ye ne ati, ɔɔtɔnene ye agyapadeɛ amukoraa fa tɔle fie ne ɔ.
Afire paa bie nwo anyandera
45“Afei koso, nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ dwadiniɛ bie bɔ ɔpena afire paa ɔ; 46na onwuni afire paa ko bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se nen, ɔɔtɔnene ye agyapadeɛ amukoraa fa tɔle afire ne.
Asawu ne nwo anyandera
47“Asa koso, nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ asawu bɔ bɛto beguale ɛpo nu ná obungamone naen ahoroɔ pee ɔ; 48na oyili nen, bɛtwetwe bɛwale etii so, na bɛtenane ase bɛsesale paa ne beguale ngɛndɛen nu; nakoso bɔ ɔtte mayee ne de, begyi beguale. 49Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ewiase ayieleɛ ne ɔ. Abɔfo mɔ kɔwa bɛkɔɔpa nu bɛkɔye bɔnefoɛ bekofi teneneefoɛ nu, 50ná bagyi bɛ bagua see wuronyiwuronyi nu, na berɛ yeɛ mmenia kosũ ná banwose bɛ gye ɔ.”
Agyapadeɛ foforɛ ne daa deɛ
51Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔate ɛhemɔ amukoraa bo anaa?” Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yoo, AWURADE.” 52Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhe kyire kyɛ, ahyerɛlɛniɛ biala bɔ wanya ndeteyɛɛ wafa nyameɛso ahennie ne anwo ne, ɔte kyɛ awuro mene bie bɔ ɔye ye agyapadeɛ nu foforɛ ne daa deɛ fite ɔ.”
Bɛpo Yesu wɔ Nasarɛte
(Marko 6.1-6; Luka 4.16-30)
53Yesu yiele sɔ anyandera nemɔ bu nen, ofili berɛ hɔle. 54Na ɔhɔle ye bɔbɔ ye kuro nen, ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ hyirele bɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nu maa bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ, na bebisale kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ biaa he onyane sɔ nworɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tumi hemɔ fili ɔ? 55Bakaa dwumvoɛ ne, aso nna ɔwa ne ɛhe? Aso bɛmvrɛ ye maame Maria? Aso nna oliɛma mmienzua mɔ ole Yakobo ne Yosef ne Simɔn ne Yudase? 56 Aso nna oliɛma mmrasua mukoraa yeɛ yɛne bɛ wɔ ɛwa ye? Na nisua koraa yeɛ biaa he oonyane ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ?” 57Yiti bɛpole ye. Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Anidie mmɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, sana ye bɔbɔ ye kuro ne ye awuro.” 58Na wanyɔ anwanwadeɛ pee wɔ berɛ, ɔnate elelɛ bɔ banne banni ne ati.

Title: MATEO 14
Content:
Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane wue
(Marko 6.14-29; Luka 9.7-9)
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, manzini hene Herode tele Yesu nga; 2na osele ye somvoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ne, ye ɛne; watingye wafi awufoɛ nu, yiti yeɛ ɔmaa wanya tumi bɔ ɔkora yɔ anwanwadeɛ hemɔ ye?” 3Ofikyɛ né Herode wali moa wahye Yohane wakyekye ye wato kuku nu, ɔnate Herode aliɛma Filipo aye Herodiase ti. 4 Ɔnate kyɛ né Yohane ahã ahyire Herode kyɛ, “Mmeraa mma ate kyɛ egya ye ɔ.” 5Ye sɔ ne ati, né Herode kuro kyɛ oku Yohane, nakoso né osuro mmenia ne, ofikyɛ né bebu Yohane kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.
6Na Herode krakyẽa dwuli nen, Herodiase awa abaayaa gole abilie hyirele bɛ bɔ bayia berɛ ne maa ɔyɛle Herode nyemene. 7Yiti ɔbɔle anohoba tale ndaen foale so kyɛ ɔkɔfa nikyee biala bɔ okobisa ɔ kɔma ye. 8Na oni mane ye adwene tɛɛ kyɛ ɔhã kyɛ, “Fa Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ye ti bɔ ɔla prɛte nu ɔ ma me ɛwa ala!” 9Na ɔyɛle ɛhene ne yea, nakoso ɔnate ye ndaen bɔ wata ɔne mmenia bɔ né ɔne bɛ didi ne ati, ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ bɛma abaayaa ne. 10Yiti ɔsomane maa bɛɛpɛle Yohane ti wɔ kuku nu dɔ. 11Bɛfale ye ti ne bɔ ɔla prɛte nu ɔ bɛbrɛle abaayaa ne, na ye koso ɔɔfa mane oni. 12Yeɛ Yohane asuafoɛ nemɔ wale bɛɛfale ye fuin ne besiele ye, na bɛɛbɔle Yesu amaneɛ.
Yesu ma mmenia apee nnu aleɛ
(Marko 6.30-44; Luka 9.10-17; Yohane 6.1-14)
13Yesu tele edwirɛ bɔ wasi nen, ɔfale ɛlɛen ofili berɛ hɔle nekaa bie bɔ berɛ te dinn ɔ. Nakoso ɛlɔen ne tele nen, bɛfale ase befili nguro nemɔ aso bɛpole ye. 14Ofili ɛlɛen ne anu dwuli ná onwuni mmenia wora nen, bɛyɛle ye anwumvo, na ɔsale bɛ nu ayarefoɛ nemɔ anwonyerɛ.
15Na odwuli nɔsoa nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Ɛwa te ɛserɛ so, yeɛ aleɛ koso adwo, yiti ma ɛlɔen ne bɛhɔ nguraa nemɔ anu bɛɛtɔ aleɛ bie beli.” 16Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Onhia kyɛ bɛkɔ ɔ, ɛ́mɔma bɛ nikyee ma beli!” 17Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yɛlle aleɛ biala wɔ wa, sana paanoo nnu ne tiré nyɔ.” 18Na osele kyɛ, “Ɛmɔfa bɛbrɛ me wa.” 19 Afei ɔmane ɛlɔen ne bɛtenatenane ase wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Na ɔfale paanoo nnu ne tiré nyɔ ne, ɔtole ye nye neane nyameɛso, oyirale so, obubuli nu, na ɔfale paanoo ne mane ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na asuafoɛ nemɔ koso bɛfa bɛmane ɛlɔen ne. 20Bɛ mukoraa bedidili bɛmane bɛ ko yili; na ye bo mboporoka ne, asuafoɛ nemɔ boaboa guale ngɛndɛen buru ne nyɔ nu maa beyili fokyefokyee. 21Na bɛ bɔ belili ne, bɛkɔyɛ mmienzua apee nnu, mmrasua ne ngwadaa de banga bɛ bammoka so.
Yesu nate nzue nye so
(Marko 6.45-52; Yohane 6.15-21)
22Berɛ ne ala, Yesu hyɛle asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ bɛ́fo ɛlɛen nu beli moa bɛhɔ asue ne asi dɔ, ná ye de ogua ɛlɔen ne ate koraka. 23Na oguale ɛlɔen ne ate yiele nen, ye ngome ɔhɔle bokaa bie so kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ mbaeɛ. Na aleɛ dwole nen, né ye ngome yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ. 24Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛlɛen ne adwu ɛpo n’afia dɔ bɔ asorɔkye ohuruhuru ye ɔ, ofikyɛ né mvrama ne ɔbɔ yia bɛ. 25Na alebahyene ne, Yesu natele ɛpo n’anye so hɔle bɛ dɔ. 26Na asuafoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye kyɛ ɔnate ɛpo n’anye so nen, besurole, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛnwomee ɔ!” Na ɛserɛ hane bɛ maa bɛteateane nu. 27Na berɛ ne ala, Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone tɔ ɛmɔ kunu, me ɔ; nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!”
28Na Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ wɔ ahɔ a, nzaade maa mva nzue n’anye so mmra wɔ dɔ.” 29Na obuale kyɛ, “Bra!” Yiti Petro fili ɛlɛen ne anu dwuli natele nzue n’anye so kyɛ ɔkɔ Yesu nwo dɔ. 30Nakoso onwuni mvrama bagyabagya ne nen, ɛserɛ hane ye; na ɔhyɛle ye bo kyɛ ɔmono nen, ɔteane nu kyɛ, “Awurade, de me!” 31Na ndɛndɛ, Yesu tengyɛle ye sa sɔle ye nu, na osele ye kyɛ, “O, wɔ bɔ wɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ! Nzu ati yeɛ esuli aporowaa ɔ?” 32Na bɛtenane ɛlɛen ne anu nen, mvrama ne yakyili tulɛ. 33 Na bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ɛlɛen ne anu ne, bɛɛsɔnene ye, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Amba, wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne.”
Yesu sa anwonyerɛ wɔ Gɛnesarɛte
(Marko 6.53-56)
34Bɛpɛle nzue ne, na beedwuli Gɛnesarɛte aseɛ so. 35Na berɛ ama nwuni ye sona horɛ nen, bɛsomane mmenia maa bɛhɔle mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ amukoraa bɛbrɛle ye; 36na bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔma bɛfa bɛ sa bɛhã ye ataadeɛ noa ala; na mmenia wora bɔ bɛfale bɛ sa bɛhane ye ne, bɛtele apɔ.

Title: MATEO 15
Content:
Tetefoɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Marko 7.1-13)
1Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ befili Yerusalem bɛwale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, 2“Nzu ati yeɛ w’asuafoɛ nemɔ benni mbanyi mɔ b’amammerɛ ne aso ɔ? Ofikyɛ bennwunzi bɛ sa koraka né badidi.”
3Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ amammerɛ ti ɛmɔbu Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ? 4 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ hyɛle kyɛ, ‘Di ɛse ne eni ni,’ yeɛ, ‘Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhã edwirɛ tɛɛ kotia ɔse anaa oni ne, ehunɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ’? 5Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Sɛ ebie kã kyire ɔse anaa oni kyɛ, ‘Nikyee biala bɔ ahaa ekonya kofi me berɛ nen, mafa mama Nyameɛ’ a, ye de onhia kyɛ sɔ sona ne odi ɔse anaa oni ni ɔ. 6Ɛmɔ tete amammerɛ ne ati ɛmɔasɛkye Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne. 7Nyaatwomfoɛ! Odi sɔ kyɛ Yesaya hyɛle ngɔm fale ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ,
8 ‘Maen he bele bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bedi me ni ɔ,
nakoso b’ahone de, ombingye me.
9 Bɛsɔne me mbaen,
na mmenia nhyehyɛleɛ yeɛ bekyirekyire ɔ!’ ”
Bɔ ogua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ
(Marko 7.14-23)
10Yesu frɛle ɛlɔen ne wale ye nwo berɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie ná ɛ́mɔte ye bo!” 11“Nna bɔ ɔkɔ sona noa nu yeɛ ogua ye nwo fiɛ ɔ, na mmom bɔ ofi sona noa nu ba ne yeɛ ogua ye nwo fiɛ ɔ.”
12Yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale beesele ye kyɛ, “Farasiifoɛ nemɔ bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, aso ɛse kyɛ wanyɛ bɛ fɛ ɔ?” 13Na obuale kyɛ, “Bakaa biala bɔ nna me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne yeɛ oluale nen, bekotutu ye bo. 14Nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ bɛ so! Bɛte anyesiniwaafoɛ bɔ bekyire anyesiniwaafoɛ atee ɔ. Na sɛ anyesiniwaaniɛ kyire anyesiniwaaniɛ atee a, bɛ munyɔ bɛkɔtɔ kumaa nu.” 15Na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Anyandera he, kyire yɛ ye bo.”
16Na obuale kyɛ, “Na ɛmɔ koso, ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ɛmɔnde ye bo anaa? 17Aso ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔ bɛ noa nu ne okogua bɛ kunu, ná afei ɔsẽ kogua yaen nu ɔ? 18Nakoso bɔ ofi bɛ noa nu ba ne de, ofi b’ahone nu yeɛ ɔba ɔ, na ye yeɛ ogua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ. 19 Ofikyɛ ahone nu yeɛ adwenemmɔne, awuelilɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ, awue, adanzewia ne musue dwirɛ fi ba ɔ. 20 Sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ begua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ, na sɛ annwunzi wɔ sa ná edidi a, ongua sona nwo fiɛ.”
Amaenmaensoniɛ braa bie gyidie
(Marko 7.24-30)
21Afei Yesu fili berɛ hɔle Tiro ne Sidon mbɔtam. 22Na yieee, Kanaanniɛ braa bie bɔ ofi mbɔtam berɛ ɔ wale, na ɔteane nu kyɛ, “O Awurade, Dawide Awa, nwu me anwumvoin, na sunzummɔne bie ɔha mma brasua paa.”
23Nakoso Yesu andɛ ye so. Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale bɛɛsrɛle ye kyɛ, “Maa ɔhɔ, ofikyɛ ɔteatea nu di yɛ si!” 24Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Mmoaen bɔ bamini bɔ bɛ ole Yisrael awuro ama ne, bɛ ngome bɛ berɛ yeɛ bɛsomane me ɔ.” 25Na braa ne wale ooguale ndwerɛ wɔ Yesu nyunu berɛ srɛle ye kyɛ, “Awurade, boka me!”
26Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɔtte mayee kyɛ bɛkɔfa mmaa mɔ b’aleɛ bekogyi bekogua ngyea berɛ ɔ.”
27Na braa ne hane kyɛ, “Amba, Awurade, nakoso ngyea mmaa nemɔ bedi aleɛ ne boso bɔ ɔporo fi bɛ mene poen so gua ase ne.” 28Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, wɔ gyidie te piri! Ɔ́yɛ sɔ ma wɔ kyɛbɔ ɛpena ɔ.” Na berɛ ne ala, ɔwa brasua ne tele apɔ.
Yesu sa mmenia pee anwonyerɛ
(Marko 7.31-37)
29Afei Yesu fili berɛ ɔɔfale Galilea ɛpo ne noa. Na ɔhɔle bokaa bie so ɔɔtenane ase. 30Na mmenia pee fale mbakye, mmubuafoɛ, anyesiniwaafoɛ, emumu mɔ ne ayarefoɛ foforɛ pee bɛwale ye berɛ; na bɛfale bɛ beeguale ye gya bo, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ. 31Yiti ɔyɛle ɛlɔen ne nwanwa, mmerɛ bɔ benwuni kyɛ emumu dwudwo, ná mbakye nwo asa, ná mmubuafoɛ nate, ná anyesiniwaafoɛ benwu nikye ne; na bɛhyɛle Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam.
Yesu ma mmenia apee nna aleɛ
(Marko 8.1-10)
32Afei Yesu frɛle ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ bɛyɛ me anwumvo, ofikyɛ bali me nwo wa ɛlɛsa ɛhe, bɔ nikye fee nne berɛ bɔ bekoli ɔ; na menguro kyɛ ngɔmaa bɛkɔfa ɛhɔen bekosa bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, anyɛ a, né bapepɛ bafi atunu.” 33Na asuafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ yɛkonya aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso wa, bɔ ɔkɔso mmenia wora he di ɔ?” 34Na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Paanoo nyɛɛ yeɛ ɛmɔle ye wɔ berɛ ɔ?” Bebuale kyɛ, “Nzoo, ɔne tiré mmaa mmaa kãa bie.”
35Yeɛ Yesu mane ɛlɔen ne tenatenane ase. 36Afei ɔfale paanoo nzoo ne ne tiré ne, ɔlale ase, na obubuli nu, ɔfa mane ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na asuafoɛ nemɔ koso bɛfa bɛmane ɛlɔen ne. 37Na bɛ mukoraa bedidili bɛmane bɛ ko yili; na bɛsesale ye bo mboporoka ne beguale ngɛndɛen nzoo nu maa beyili fokyefokyee. 38Na bɛ bɔ belili ne, bɛte mmienzua apee nna, banga mmrasua ne ngwadaa bammoka so. 39Na oguale ɛlɔen ne atee nen, ɔtenane ɛlɛen nu hɔle Magadan mbɔtam.

Title: MATEO 16
Content:
Bɛpena sɛngyerɛnneɛ
(Marko 8.11-13; Luka 12.54-56)
1Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ wale kyɛ bɛbaaso Yesu bɛnea, yiti besele ye kyɛ ɔyɔ sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ofi nyameɛso ɔ ma bɛnea. 2[Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ odwu nɔsoa a, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Ewienu kɔte, ofikyɛ ewienu ayɛ kɔɔ.’ 3Na ngyerɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Mvrama kotu ɛnɛ, ofikyɛ ewienu ayɛ kɔɔ ne kusuu.’ Ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ besi bekyire ewienu dwirɛ bo ɔ, nakoso mmerɛ ne nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ de, ɛmɔngora nu kyire.] 4Ɛnɛmmafoɛ bɔnefoɛ ne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ bɛpena sɛngyerɛnneɛ, nakoso bɛngɔma bɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ biala, sana Yona sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne ala.” Na Yesu yakyili bɛ berɛ hɔle.
Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ mɔle harewaa
(Marko 8.14-21)
5Na asuafoɛ nemɔ dwuli asue ne asi dɔ nen, né bɛ wora afi kyɛ bɛkɔfa paanoo ɔ. 6Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea yé; ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ mɔle harewaa nwo!” 7Na bɛdwenedwenene ye nwo bɛhane kyɛ, “Yamva paanoo yamma ne ati ɔ.” 8Yesu nwuni b’adwene, na ɔhane kyɛ, “O, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene ye nwo kyɛ ɛmɔamva paanoo ɔ? 9Ɛmɔnnya bɛttele ye bo? Ɛmɔngaye paanoo nnu bɔ mmenia apee nnu belili ne, ɔne ye bo mboporoka ngɛndɛen somaa bɔ ɛmɔsesale ne? 10Anaa paanoo nzoo bɔ mmenia apee nna belili ne, ɔne ye bo mboporoka ngɛndɛen somaa bɔ ɛmɔsesale ne? 11Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ nna paanoo yeɛ mekã ye nwo dwirɛ ɔ? Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ mɔle harewaa nwo!”
12Afei bɛtele ye bo kyɛ nna paanoo harewaa yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ bɛ́nea bɛ nwo yé wɔ ye nwo ɔ, na mmom Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo.
Petro kyire sona horɛ bɔ Yesu te ɔ
(Marko 8.27-30; Luka 9.18-20)
13Na mmerɛ bɔ Yesu dwuli Kaesarea Filipi mbɔtam nen, obisale ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Mmenia nwa Sona Awa ne ole nwa?” 14Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ebiemɔ nwa: Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane; ebiemɔ koso nwa: Elia; yeɛ ebiemɔ nwa Yeremia anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nu ko.” 15Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Na ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔnwa nwa ole me?” 16 Na Simɔn Petro buale kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Kristo ne, Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’Awa ne.”
17 Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Anya saleɛ, Yona awa, Simɔn! Ofikyɛ nna anwoɔnaen ne mogya yeɛ baye he bahyire wɔ ɔ, na mmom me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ɔ. 18 Na me, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ: Wɔ ole Petro, na nyɔbotaen he aso yeɛ ngosi m’asɔre ngosie ɔ, na ewue tumi ngɔhora ngoli so ngonim. 19 Ngɔfa nyameɛso ahennie nzafoaa ngowura wɔ sa, na nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔkyekye ye wɔ aseɛ so nen, bɛkɔkyekye ye wɔ nyameɛso; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔsangye nu wɔ aseɛ so nen, bɛkɔsangye nu wɔ nyameɛso.” 20Na ɔhyɛle asuafoɛ nemɔ kitii kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ so bekyire ebiala kyɛ ye ole Kristo ne.
Yesu hyɛ ye wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo ngɔm
(Marko 8.31—9.1; Luka 9.22-27)
21 Ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yesu hyɛle ye bo hyirele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, odi kyɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem ná okonwu amaneɛ pee wɔ maen mbanyi ne asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ mɔ bɛ sa nu, ná beku ye, ná ye ɛlɛsa so otingye. 22Yeɛ Petro fale ye hɔle ahameɛ, na ɔhyɛle ye bo ohwili ye nyunu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ pa gua, Awurade! Ɛhe ngɔto wɔ le!” 23Na ɔkakyili ye nwo sele Petro kyɛ, “Dwɔso berɛ kɔ dɔ, Abɔnzam! Ɛte sundidua ma me; ofikyɛ nna Nyameɛ adwene yeɛ ɛdwene ɔ, na mmom ɛdwene kuro sona adwene.”
24Na Yesu sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie kuro kyɛ odi me si a, maa ɔpa ye nwo si, ná ɔfa ye mmeamudua, ná oli me si. 25 Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ode ye kra ngoa nen, ɔkɔhwere ye; nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔnate me ti ɔkɔhwere ye ngoa nen, ye sa kɔhã ye. 26Na sɛ sona nya ewiase amukoraa ná ɔhwere ye kra a, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ okonya ɔ? Anaakyɛ, nzikyɛ yeɛ sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔsesã ye kra ngoa ɔ? 27 Ɔnate kyɛ, Sona Awa ne ɔne ye abɔfo mɔ bɛkɔwa ye Baba animnyam nu, na okotua ebiala kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ si te ɔ. 28Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia biemɔ gyigyi wa bɔ bengonwu ewue kɔpem kyɛ bekonwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ɔ́ba ye ahennie nu ɔ.”

Title: MATEO 17
Content:
Yesu animnyam ta hyireinn
(Marko 9.2-13; Luka 9.28-36; 2 Petro 1.16-18)
1Na ye elesia asi ne, Yesu fale Petro ne Yakobo ne oliɛma Yohane bokale ye nwo so, na ɔfale bɛ hɔle bokaa tendenn bie aso. 2Na ɔsesane wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ, ye nyunu tale kyɛ eyia, na ye ndaadeɛ yɛle hyɛnn kyɛ kanea. 3Na yieee, Mose ne Elia bɛyele bɛ nwo ali behyirele bɛ, na bɛ ne Yesu dwudwole. 4Na Petro sele Yesu kyɛ, “Awurade, ɔte paa kyɛ yɛtena wa ɔ; na sɛ ekuro a, ngɔbɔ asese nza wɔ wa, wɔ deɛ ko, Mose deɛ ko, yeɛ Elia deɛ ko.”
5Ogu so odwudwo ne ala, yieee, munungum hyɛnhyɛnn bie ɔɔkatale bɛ so, na edwudwolɛ bie fili munungum ne anu hane kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe; ɛ́mɔtie ye!” 6Na asuafoɛ nemɔ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli berɛ, na ɛserɛ hane bɛ paa. 7Na Yesu wale ɔɔsosɔle bɛ nu hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, na nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!” 8Na bɛpagyale bɛ ti so nen, bannwu ebiala, sana Yesu ngome.
9Na befi bokaa ne aso bɛtorotoro bɛba nen, Yesu hyɛle bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ bɔ ɛmɔanwu ye ne aso bekyire ebiala kɔpem kyɛ Sona Awa ne kotingye kofi awufoɛ nu ɔ.”
10Na asuafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛnwa odi kyɛ Elia di moa ba koraka ɔ?” 11Na obuale kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ Elia di moa ba amba, ná ɔbatoto nningyein mukoraa yé; 12nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Elia awa dada, na bannwu ye, na bɛfale bɔ bekuro biala belili ye. Na sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne koso konwu amaneɛ wɔ bɛ sa nu ɔ.” 13Afei asuafoɛ nemɔ nyane ndeaseɛ kyɛ Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane nwo dwirɛ yeɛ né ɔkã kyire bɛ ɔ.
Yesu tu sunzummɔne fi abɛɛmaa bie nu
(Marko 9.14-29; Luka 9.37-43)
14Bedwuli ɛlɔen ne anwo berɛ nen, biaa bie wale Yesu berɛ, oguale ndwerɛ wɔ ye nyunu, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ, 15“Awurade, nwu mma bienzua ye anwumvoin, ofikyɛ ɔpɛ, na onwu amaneɛ paa; na ɔtaa pɛ tɔ see nu, yeɛ ɔtaa pɛ tɔ nzue nu. 16Mvale ye mmrɛle w’asuafoɛ nemɔ, nakoso bangora banza ye anwonyerɛ.”
17Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “O ɛnɛmmafoɛ asoserɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔlle gyidie ɔ! Me ne ɛmɔ yɛtena maa odwu kyinzu? Nya ɛmɔ nwo aboterɛ maa odwu kyinzu? Ɛ́mɔfa ye bɛbrɛ me wa!” 18Yeɛ Yesu teateane sunzummɔne ne, na ofili ye nu fitele, na akwadaa ne tele apɔ berɛ ne ala.
19Na asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ bɛ ne ye beetuli asure bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ yɛ de yangora yandu ye ɔ?” 20 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ti ɔ. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔle gyidie bɔ ye piri te kyɛ sinapi baa ko a, ahaa ɛmɔkɔhã bekohyire bokaa he kyɛ, ‘Tutu fi wa kɔ dɔ,’ na ye bo kotutu; na ahaa nikyee biala ngɔyɛ se ngɔma ɛmɔ.” [ 21Na sɔ nikyee he de, kyɛbɔ osi te ne, ye bo ngora tu, sana mbaeɛ ne ɛhɔenhyelɛ yeɛ otu ye ɔ.]
Yesu wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo ngɔm
(Marko 9.30-32; Luka 9.43-45)
22Na bɛboale bɛ noa wɔ Galilea nen, Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Bɛkɔye Sona Awa ne bekowura mmenia sa; 23na bekohu ye, na ye ɛlɛsa so okotingye.” Na ɔyɛle bɛ aworabɔ paa.
Yesu tua asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo toɔ
24 Mmerɛ bɔ beedwuli Kapanɔm nen, asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ wale Petro berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne, aso ondua ɛtoɔ ne anaa?” 25 Na obuale kyɛ, “Otua.” Na Petro wale awuro nen, Yesu lili moa bisale ye kyɛ; “Simɔn, ɛdwene ye nwo sɛ? Nwa mɔ dɔ yeɛ aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bedide ndɔ anaa ɛtoɔ ɔ? Bɛ mma mɔ dɔ, anaa amanvrafoɛ mɔ dɔ?” 26Na Petro buale kyɛ, “Amanvorafoɛ mɔ dɔ.” Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Nzaade né mmaa nemɔ bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ. 27Nakoso, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛngɔyɛ sundidua yɛngɔma bɛ ne ati, kɔ ɛpo nu kɔto koaa; na tiré bɔ ekoli moa kɔhye ye ne, sɛ ebukye ye noa nu a, ekonwu sikaa prɛnprɛn wɔ nu, na fa kotua me ne wɔ yɛ deɛ.”

Title: MATEO 18
Content:
Anwobrɛaseɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Marko 9.33-37; Luka 9.46-48)
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne ala nu yeɛ asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔte titire paa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ?” 2Yeɛ Yesu frɛle akwadaa bie maa ɔwale, na ɔfale ye oogyinane b’afia berɛ, 3na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔanzesã ná ɛmɔanyɛ kyɛ ngwadaa a, ɛmɔngɔhɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu le. 4Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbrɛ ye nwo ase kyɛ akwadaa he nen, ye yeɛ ɔte titire paa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ. 5Na ebiala bɔ okole akwadaa bɔ ɔte kyɛ he kɔto nu wɔ me dumaa nu nen, né wale me wato nu.”
Sundiduatolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
(Marko 9.42-48; Luka 17.1-2)
6“Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔto ngwadaammaa hemɔ bɔ bede me bedi ye anu ko sundidua nen, ahaa ɔte paa ma sɔ sona ne kyɛ bɛkɔfa nyɔboɛ kandinga bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo bekosinze ye kɔme, ná bagyi ye bato ɛpo buma nu maa wamono ɔ. 7Ɔnate sundiduatolɛ ti, ewiase ye yaakɔ! Ɔyɛ sɛɛ ala a sundiduatolɛ kɔwa; nakoso sona bɔ ɔnate ye so sundiduatolɛ kɔwa ne de, ye yaakɔ!
8“Sɛ wɔ sa anaa wɔ gya to wɔ sundidua a, pɛ ná gyi to! Na ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa asaa ko anaa agyirɛ ko ɛkɔhɔ ngoa nu tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa asaa nyɔ anaa agyirɛ nyɔ, ná bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto daa see nu ɔ. 9Yeɛ sɛ wɔ nye to wɔ sundidua a, tu ná gyi to! Ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa anyeɛ ko kɔhɔ ngoa nu tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa anyeɛ nyɔ, ná bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto amaneɛnwunɛ see nu ɔ.
Boaen bɔ wamini ne nwo anyandera
(Luka 15.3-7)
10“Ɛmɔnea yé ná ɛmɔammu ngwadaa ye anu biala animtia; na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nyameɛso dɔ, b’abɔfo mɔ benwu me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne nyunu daa.” 11[Ɔnate kyɛ, Sona Awa ne wale kyɛ ɔbaale bɛ bɔ bamini nemɔ ngoa.]
12“Edwirɛ he, ɛmɔdwene ye nwo sɛ? Sɛ ebie le mmoaen ɛyaa, ná bɛ nu ko mini a, aso ɔnyakyi aburahona ne ngona ne wɔ mmokaa ne aso berɛ, ná ɔngɔhɔ ngɔɔpena ko bɔ wamini ne anaa? 13Na sɛ onwu ye a, nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, onya anika wɔ boaen ko ne nwo tra aburahona ne ngona bɔ bɛ de bammini ne nwo. 14Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, onguro kyɛ ngwadaa hemɔ nu ko po komini ɔ.
Sɛ ebie yɛ wɔ tɛɛ a
15 “Sɛ eliɛma yɛ wɔ tɛɛ a, kɔhã ye mvomsoɛ kyire ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛne ye bɛ munyɔ pɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. Sɛ otie wɔ a, anya eliɛma. 16 Nakoso sɛ wandie a, fa sona ko anaa nyɔ boka wɔ nwo so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ mmenia nyɔ anaa nza kɔyɛ edwirɛ ne nwo adanzefoɛ ɔ. 17 Na sɛ wandie bɛ koso a, kɔhã kyire asɔre ne. Na sɛ wandie asɔre ne koso a, ye de bu ye kyɛ bosoensolɛniɛ ne ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ.
18“Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔkyekye ye wɔ aseɛ ye aso nen, bɛkɔkyekye ye nyameɛso; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔsangye nu wɔ aseɛ ye aso nen, bɛkɔsangye nu nyameɛso.
19“Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ bieku kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu nyɔ yɛ adwene ko aseɛ ye aso wɔ nikyee biala bɔ bekobisa nwo a, me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne kɔyɔ kɔma bɛ. 20Ofikyɛ nekaa biala bɔ mmenia nyɔ anaa nza koyia nu me dumaa nu nen, né nwɔ b’afia wɔ berɛ.”
Yesu bu bɔnefakyɛ nwo anyandera
21Yeɛ Petro wale Yesu berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ nniɛma yɛ me tɛɛ a, mva ngyɛ ye ɔ? Pɛen nzoo anaa?” 22Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Menga mengyire wɔ kyɛ pɛen nzoo, na mmom aburasoo sɔ alaa nzoo. 23Ye sɔ ati, nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛhene bie bɔ né ɔpena kyɛ ɔne ye ngoaa bebu ngondaa ɔ. 24Na ɔhyɛle ngondaabulɛ ne abo nen, bɛfale ko bɔ ɔma ye kerɛ talɛnde apee buru ɔ bɛwale ye berɛ. 25 Né ɔngɔhora kerɛ ne tua, yiti ye mene ne hyɛle kyɛ bɛtɔne ye, ɔne ɔye ne ye mma, yeɛ bɔ ole ye amukoraa, ná bɛfa betua kerɛ ne. 26Yiti akoaa ne yakyili ye nwo tole aseɛnwo berɛ wɔ ye nyunu berɛ, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ, ‘Me mene, nya me nwo aboterɛ kãa, na ngotua ye mukoraa ngɔma wɔ.’ 27Na akoaa ne mene ne nwuni ye anwumvoin, ɔyakyili ye, na ɔfale kerɛ ne hyɛle ye.
28“Na sɔ akoaa ne ala fili berɛ bɔ ɔkɔ nen, onwuni obiɛngo akoaa ko bɔ ɔma ye kerɛ denare ɛyaa ko; yeɛ obumane ye komvi sele ye kyɛ, ‘Tua me kerɛ!’ 29Yiti obiɛngo akoaa ne guale ndwerɛ srɛle ye kyɛ, ‘Nya me nwo aboterɛ kãa, na ngotua ye mukoraa ngɔma wɔ.’ 30Nakoso wambene, na ɔmaa bɛhyele ye bɛtole kuku nu kɔpem kyɛ okotua kerɛ ne ɔ. 31Na ye mmango ngoaa nemɔ nwuni bɔ wasi nen, ɔyɛle bɛ yea paa, na bɛɛhane bɔ wasi ne amukoraa behyirele bɛ mene. 32Yeɛ ye mene ne frɛle ye sele ye kyɛ, ‘Wɔ, akoaa atianuserɛniɛ! Mvale wɔ kerɛ ne amukoraa ngyɛle wɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛpale me kyerɛ. 33Aso onni kyɛ ahaa wɔ koso enwu ebiɛngo akoaa anwumvoin kyɛbɔ nwuni wɔ anwumvoin ne anaa?’ 34Na ye mene ne fɛle yaa, na ɔfale ye wurale kukunufoɛ so neafoɛ mɔ bɛ sa, kɔpem kyɛ okotua ye kerɛ ne amukoraa ɔ.
35 “Na sɛ ɛmɔanye ɛmɔ kunu fitaa bamva ɛmɔ aliɛma mvomsoɛ bangyɛ ye a, sɔ ala yeɛ me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne koso kɔyɛ ɛmɔ ɔ.”

Title: MATEO 19
Content:
Yesu yɛ agyaayiralɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ
(Marko 10.1-12)
1Na Yesu hane sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ yiele nen, ofili Galilea hɔle Yudea mbɔtam, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si; 2na mmenia pee belili ye si, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ wɔ berɛ.
3Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ wale ye berɛ beesole ye bɛneane, na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Aso mmeraa ma ate kyɛ ɔnate edwirɛ biala so, ebie kora yira ɔye anaa?” 4 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔkkenngale kyɛ ahyɛaseɛ ne, Ɛdangama bɔ ɔbɔle sona nen, bienzua ne brasua yeɛ ɔbɔle bɛ ɔ? 5Na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛhe ati yeɛ bienzua kɔyakyi ɔse ne oni berɛ, ná wafa ye nwo waabata ɔye nwo, ná bɛ munyɔ bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko.’ 6Yiti bɛtte nyɔ ko, na mmom bɛte anwoɔnaen ko. Ye sɔ ati, bɔ Nyameɛ ahã abɔ nu ne, nnɛma sona biala tete nu.”
7 Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Na nzu ati yeɛ Mose hyɛle kyɛ odi kyɛ biaa ne ma agyaayiralɛ krataa, ná oyira braa ne ɔ?” 8Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛmɔ asoserɛ ti yeɛ Mose mane ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛ́mɔyira ɛmɔ aye mɔ ɔ; nakoso ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne de, ahaa né nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte sɔ. 9Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ wamma kyɛ adwamanbɔlɛ ti, ná bienzua yira ɔye kogya braa foforɛ a, né biaa ne asɛkye agyaa.” (Na bienzua bɔ okogya braa bɔ bayira ye ne, ye koso wasɛkye agyaa.)
10Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ sɔ yeɛ bienzua ne ɔye b’afia dwirɛ te de a, né nzaade ɔtte mayee kyɛ begya braa ɔ.” 11 Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nna mmenia mukoraa yeɛ bɛkɔhora bekole sɔ dwirɛ ne bɛkɔto nu ɔ, sana bɛ bɔ bafa balo bɛ ɔ. 12Ebiemɔ ngora ngya braa, ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ; ebiemɔ koso de, sona yeɛ wayɛ bɛ sɔ ɔ; yeɛ ebiemɔ wora, nyameɛso ahennie ne ati yeɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bayɛ bɛ nwo sɔ ɔ. Bɔ ɔkɔhora kole sɔ dwirɛ ne kɔto nu ne, maa ole to nu.”
Yesu yirayira ngwadaa
(Marko 10.13-16; Luka 18.15-17)
13Yeɛ bɛfale ngwadaa bɛbrɛle Yesu kyɛ ɔfa ye sa gua bɛ so ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ma bɛ; nakoso asuafoɛ nemɔ dwudwole bɛ bɔ bɛfale bɛ bɛwale ne. 14Nakoso Yesu sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ngwadaa nemɔ ate ma bɛbra me berɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔsi bɛ ate; ofikyɛ ɛhemɔ sɔa ye yeɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne ɔte bɛ deɛ ɔ.” 15Yeɛ ɔfale ye sa guale bɛ so yirayirale bɛ, na afei ofili berɛ hɔle.
Esikaniɛ bie ne daa ngoa
(Marko 10.17-31; Luka 18.18-30)
16Na yieee, biaa bie wale Yesu berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, nikyee paa beni yeɛ nyɔ ná manya daa ngoa ɔ?” 17 Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ebisa me paa nwo dwirɛ ɔ? Nyameɛ ngome twe yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ. Sɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛkɔ daa ngoa nu a, di mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso.”
18 Na obisale ye kyɛ, “Nu beni?” Yeɛ Yesu buale kyɛ, “Nnɛdi awue, nnɛsɛkye agyaa, nnɛwua, nnɛdi adanzewia. 19 Di ɛse ne eni ni; yeɛ kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo.”
20Na aberandeɛ ne sele ye kyɛ, “Mali ɛhe amukoraa so; na nzikyɛ bieku yeɛ ohia kyɛ meyɔ ɔ?” 21Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ekuro kyɛ ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ye de kɔ, ná kɔtɔne w’anwonyadeɛ, ná fa sikaa ne ma ehiafoɛ, na ekonya agyapadeɛ wɔ nyameɛso; ná afei bra baali me si.”
22Na aberandeɛ ne tele edwirɛ he nen, ole aworabɔlɛ sili nu hɔle; ofikyɛ né ole anwonyadeɛ pee. 23Yeɛ Yesu sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔkɔyɛ se kɔma sikaniɛ kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ. 24Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ bieku kyɛ, ɔyɛ mmerɛ ma afupɔngɔ kyɛ okowura drɔwaa bɔen nu tra kyɛ esikaniɛ kɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ɔ.”
25Na asuafoɛ nemɔ tele edwirɛ he nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa pee, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ye de nwa yeɛ bɛkɔhora bekole ye ngoa ɔ?” 26 Na Yesu neane bɛ haa sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sona bue nu de, ɛhe ngɔhora ngɔyɛ berɛ; nakoso Nyameɛ bue nu de, nningyein mukoraa kɔhora kɔyɛ berɛ.”
27Yeɛ Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Eh, yayakyi nikyee biala berɛ yaali wɔ si oo; na nzikyɛ koraa yeɛ yɛkonya ɔ?” 28 Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ewiase foforɛ ne anu, mmerɛ bɔ Sona Awa ne kɔtena ye animnyam ahennie bia so ne, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔaali me si ne, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔtena ahennie bia buru ne nyɔ so bekobua Yisrael mmusua kure buru ne nyɔ ne ndɛen. 29Na ebiala bɔ me dumaa ti wayakyi awuro mɔ, anaa aliɛmaa mmienzua, anaa aliɛmaa mmrasua, anaa seɛ, anaa niɛ, anaa mmaa, anaa aseɛ mɔ berɛ nen, okonya ye nwo mmɔhoɛ ɛyaa, na okonya daa ngoa. 30Nakoso mmenia pee bɔ bali moa ne, bɛkɔha nziɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ baha nziɛ ne bekoli moa.”

Title: MATEO 20
Content:
Bobe boo nu adwumayɔlɛfoɛ
1“Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ eboo mene bie bɔ ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu ɔhɔle kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ paa maa bɛyɔ adwuma wɔ ye bobe boo nu ɔ. 2Na ɔne adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ belili ye noa kyɛ ɛlɛho te denare ko, na ɔmaa bɛhɔle ye bobe boo ne anu. 3Na osa hɔle kɔyɛ ngyerɛmɔ nnɔngono nen, onwuni mmenia biemɔ bɔ begyigyi dwaaso bɔ bɛnyɔ hwee ɔ. 4Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔɔyɔ adwuma wɔ me bobe boo ne anu, na ngotua ɛmɔ kerɛ bɔ ɔfata ɔ.’ Yiti bɛhɔle. 5Osa hɔle dwaaso dɔ kɔyɛ eyia duabien ne nnɔnmmiɛnza ɔɔyɔle sɔ ala. 6Na kɔyɛ nɔsoa nnɔnnum, ɔhɔle dwaaso dɔ oonwuni mmenia biemɔ kyɛ begyigyi berɛ mbaen ɔ; na obisale bɛ kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔgyigyi wa ɛnɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔnyɔ hwee ɔ?’ 7Bebuale ye kyɛ, ‘Ofikyɛ ebiala ɔbbɔle yɛ paa’. Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔhɔ me bobe boo ne anu bɛɛyɔ adwuma’.
8 “Na aleɛ dwole nen, bobe boo mene ne sele ye hwɛsoniɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Frɛ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ ná tua bɛ kerɛ; hyɛ ye bo fi bɛ bɔ bɛwale nziɛ nemɔ aso kɔpem bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛwale ne aso.’ 9Na bɛ bɔ ɔbɔle bɛ paa kɔyɛ nɔsoa nnɔnnum ne, bɛwale ne, ɔmane ebiala denare ko. 10Na bɛ bɔ olili moa bɔle bɛ paa ne, bɛwale ne, besusuli kyɛ bekonya bɔ ɔtra sɔ ɔ; nakoso ebiala nyane denare ko sɔ ala. 11Na bɛ sa hane b’akatuaa nen, bɛyɛle eboo mene ne so nwuhunwuhu 12kyɛ ‘Ɛhemɔ bɔ bɛwale nziɛ ye, bɛyɔle adwuma dɔnhwere komapɛ, nakoso yɛ bɔ yafite ngyerɛmɔ yayɔ adwuma maa eyia ayera yɛ ne, atua yɛ ne bɛ kerɛ pɛ.’
13“Na obuale bɛ nu ko kyɛ, ‘Damvo, nnzisili wɔ; aso ɛne me yanni ye noa kyɛ ekole denare ko anaa? 14Wɔ de, de wɔ deɛ ná kɔ. Mekuro kyɛ bɔ ɔwale nziɛ ye ne, mema ye ne wɔ akatuaa pɛ. 15 Nikyee bɔ me bɔbɔ me deɛ ahɔ ne, asoɛ nnne ye nwo ate kyɛ mefa meyɔ bɔ mekuro anaa? Anaakyɛ, nde paa ti yeɛ wɔ nye aboro ye?’ 16(Na Yesu hã toale so kyɛ,) “Yiti bɛ bɔ beli nziɛ ne, bekoli moa, yeɛ bɛ bɔ beli moa ne, bekoli nziɛ.” [Ofikyɛ bafrɛ pee, nakoso kãa bie yeɛ baneanea nu baye bɛ ɔ.]
Yesu hyɛ ngɔm bɔ ɔtɔ so nza fa ye wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo
(Marko 10.32-34; Luka 18.31-34)
17Mmerɛ bɔ né Yesu ɔfo kɔ Yerusalem nen, ɔfale asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne ngome hɔle ahameɛ wɔ atunu, na osele bɛ kyɛ, 18“Ɛ́mɔtie, yɛ́fo yɛ́kɔ Yerusalem, na bɛkɔye Sona Awa ne bekowura asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ sa, na bekobua ye ewue foɛ, 19na bɛkɔfa ye bekowura Amaenmaensofoɛ sa kyɛ bɛgoro ye nwo, ná befi ye mbire, ná bɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu; na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso okotingye.”
Yakobo ne Yohane maame abisadeɛ
(Marko 10.35-45)
20Yeɛ Sebedeo mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ maame, ɔne ye mma nemɔ bɛwale Yesu berɛ, na oguale ndwerɛ srɛle ye kyɛ ɔlo ye. 21Na Yesu bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena ɔ?” Obuale ye kyɛ, “Hyɛ me bɔ kyɛ me mma nyɔ hemɔ, ko kɔtena wɔ sa famaa so, ná ko wora watena wɔ sa bɛen so wɔ w’ahennie ne anu.” 22 Nakoso Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnze bɔ ɛmɔbisa ɔ. Kulie bɔ mebaano (ye noa) ne, aso ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔno anaa? [Yeɛ, asubɔlɛ bɔ bɛbaafa bɛbɔ me ne, ɛmɔkɔhora maa bɛkɔfa ebie bɛkɔbɔ ɛmɔ anaa?”] Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yɛkɔhora.” 23 Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Amba, ɛmɔkɔno me kulie ne (noa) de, [yeɛ asubɔlɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ me ne, ɛmɔkɔmaa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ ɛmɔ de,] nakoso bɔ ɔtena me sa famaa so ne me sa bɛen so de, nna me deɛ ɔ bɔ mefa mema ɔ; na mmom bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma bɛ bɔ me Baba asiesie ama bɛ ɔ.”
24Na asuafoɛ buru ne tele edwirɛ he nen, bɛfɛle aliɛmaa nyɔ nemɔ so yaa. 25Yiti Yesu frɛle bɛ wale ye nwo berɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔse kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ ahemvo mɔ bɛhyɛ bɛ so, yeɛ bɛ mbanyi mɔ koso bedi bɛ so tumi. 26Nakoso ɛmɔ nu de, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔba ye sɔ ɔ. Na mmom ebiala bɔ ɔpena kyɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ so panyi nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ somvoɛ; 27yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔpena kyɛ odi moa wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ akoaa, 28 kyɛbɔ Sona Awa ne wamma kyɛ bɛso ye, na mmom kyɛ ɔbaaso, ná ɔfa ye ngoa ɔto berɛ ode mmenia pee ngoa ne.”
Yesu te anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ nye
(Marko 10.46-52; Luka 18.35-43)
29Na befili Yeriko bɔ bɛkɔ nen, mmenia pee lili ye si. 30Na yieee, né anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ bɛtete atee ne noa berɛ. Na bɛtele kyɛ Yesu ɔpɛ nu ne, bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “O Awurade, Dawide Awa, nwu yɛ anwumvoin!” 31Na ɛlɔen ne dwudwole bɛ kyɛ bemua bɛ noa. Nakoso bekye po yeɛ bɛteateane nu serɛserɛ bieku kyɛ, “O Awurade, Dawide Awa, nwu yɛ anwumvoin oo!” 32Yeɛ Yesu gyinane, na ɔfrɛle bɛ bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu yeɛ ɛmɔpena kyɛ meyɔ mema ɛmɔ ɔ?” 33Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, maa yɛnwu nikye.” 34Yiti Yesu nwuni bɛ anwumvoin, ɔfale ye sa hane bɛ nye, na berɛ ne ala benwuni nikye, na belili ye si.

Title: MATEO 21
Content:
Yesu kɔ Yerusalem ngonim nu
(Marko 11.1-11; Luka 19.28-40; Yohane 12.12-19)
1Na mmerɛ bɔ bepingyele Yerusalem, ná bedwuli Betefage bɔ ɔwɔ Olive Bokaa ne anwo nen, Yesu somane asuafoɛ nemɔ nyɔ 2sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ akuraa bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nyunu dɔ ne anu, na ɛmɔdwu berɛ pɛ a, ɛmɔkonwu afunum bɔ bamenda ye ɔ, ɔne ɔwa; ɛ́mɔsangye bɛ ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛbrɛ me. 3Na sɛ ebie bisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ biala a, ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Awurade hia bɛ,’ na berɛ ne ala, ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔwa.”
4Na ɛhe sili maa bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne hane ne wale nu kyɛ,
5 “Ɛmɔhã behyire Sion awa brasua ne kyɛ:
Nea, wɔ hene ɔ́ba wɔ berɛ,
odwo, na ɔte afunum so,
ɔne afunum akrɔngrɔma so, bɔ ɔte afunum beleɛ ɔ.”
6Yiti asuafoɛ nemɔ hɔle bɛɛyɔle kyɛbɔ Yesu hyɛle bɛ ne ala. 7Bɛfale afunum ne ne ɔwa ne bɛwale, na bɛfale bɛ ndaadeɛ beguale bɛ so, na Yesu tenane so. 8 Na ɛlɔen ne, bɛ nu pee fale bɛ ndaadeɛ bɛsesɛle atee ne anu, yeɛ ebiemɔ koso bebubuli nyaa bɛsesɛle atee ne anu. 9 Na ɛlɔen bɔ beli ye nyunu ne, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ beli ye si ne, bɛbɔle ese kyɛ, “Hosana hã Dawide Awa ne! Saleɛ ole bɔ ɔnate Awurade dumaa nu ɔ́ba ye! Hosana wɔ anwuro anwuro!”
10Na odwuli Yerusalem nen, kurotue ne amukoraa bɛbɔle twi bebisale kyɛ, “Na nwa ɛhe?” 11 Na ɛlɔen ne buale kyɛ, “Ɛhe ole Yesu, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne bɔ ofi Nasarɛte bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea ne.”
Yesu foa dwadifoɛ fi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu
(Marko 11.15-19; Luka 19.45-48; Yohane 2.13-22)
12 Yesu wurale [Nyameɛ] asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na ɔfoane bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne nningyein ne bɛ bɔ bɛtɔ amukoraa fili asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ. Na obutubutuli sikaasesãlɛfoɛ bɛ poen nemɔ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne mmorɔnoma ɔ bɛ bia mɔ. 13Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɛkɔfrɛ m’awuro mbaeɛbɔlɛ awuro’; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔafa bakakyi awuefoɛ afealeɛ!”
14Na anyesiniwaafoɛ ne mbakye wale ye berɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ. 15Nakoso asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwuni anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ ɔyɔle ne, ɔne ngwadaa bɔ bɛteatea nu wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ kyɛ, “Hosana hã Dawide Awa ne” nen, wanyɛ bɛ fɛ koraa. 16Yiti bebisale ye kyɛ, “Aso ɛte bɔ ɛhemɔ bɛ́kã ne?” Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Yoo, aso ɛmɔkkenngale ye le kyɛ,
‘Ngwadaa ne nnɔma bɔ bɛno nyɔfone bɛ noa nu
yeɛ asiesie ayɛyelɛ ɔ’ anaa.”
17Na ɔyakyili bɛ berɛ fili kuro ne anu hɔle Betania ɔɔlale berɛ.
Yesu paye borɔdoma bakaa bie
(Marko 11.12-14, 20-24)
18Na ngyerɛmɔ ne, bɔ né Yesu osa ba kuro ne anu nen, né ɛhɔen ku ye. 19 Na onwuni borɔdoma bakaa bie wɔ atee ne noa, ɔhɔle ye nwo berɛ, na wannwu hwee wɔ so, sana nyaa ngome. Na osele bakaa ne kyɛ, “Engosu mmaa ko le!” Na berɛ ne ala, borɔdoma bakaa ne wuli.
20Na asuafoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye sɔ nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔyɛle sɛɛ yeɛ kekesaala ye borɔdoma bakaa ye wawu ye?” 21 Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔle gyidie ná ɛmɔanzu aporowaa a, nna bɔ wato borɔdoma bakaa he angome yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ, na mmom, sɛ ye po ɛmɔkã bekyire bokaa he kyɛ, ‘Tutu kɔtɔ ɛpo nu’ a, ɔkɔyɛ berɛ. 22Na nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkobisa ye wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu, ná ɛmɔde bedi nen, ɛmɔ sa kɔhã ye.”
Yesu tumi nwo adwobisa
(Marko 11.27-33; Luka 20.1-8)
23Yesu wurale asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na ogu so ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ nen, asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi bɛwale ye berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Tumi beni yeɛ egyi so bɔ ɛyɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ye? Na nwa yeɛ ɔmane wɔ sɔ tumi ne ɔ?”
24Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Me koso ngobisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ ko, na sɛ ɛmɔma me mmuayɛɛ a, ye de, me koso ngɔhã tumi horɛ bɔ ngyi so meyɔ nningyein hemɔ ɔ ngohyire ɛmɔ. 25Yohane asubɔlɛ ne, ofi nisua? Ofi nyameɛso anaa ofi mmenia berɛ?” Na bɛdwenedwenene ye nwo besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ofi nyameɛso’ a, okobisa yɛ kyɛ, ‘Nzaade, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔanne ye banni ɔ?’ 26Yeɛ sɛ yɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ofi mmenia berɛ’ a, yɛsuro mmenia worawora ne, ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa bebu Yohane kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.” 27Yiti bebuale Yesu kyɛ, “Yɛnze.” Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade me koso mengɔhã tumi horɛ bɔ ngyi so meyɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ɔ mengohyire ɛmɔ.”
Sotie ne asoserɛ nwo anyandera
28“Ɛmɔdwene ye nwo sɛ? Né biaa bie le mmaa mmienzua nyɔ; na ɔhɔle bɔ oli moa ne berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, ‘Mma, ɛnɛ kɔyɔ adwuma wɔ me bobe boo ne anu.’ 29Na obuale kyɛ, ‘Mengɔhɔ.’ Nakoso nziɛ ye ɔsesane ye adwene, na ɔhɔle. 30Na ɔhɔle bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne koso berɛ ɔɔhane sɔ ala hyirele ye. Na obuale kyɛ, ‘Me mene, ngɔhɔ.’ Nakoso wangɔ. 31Bɛ munyɔ ne, bɛ nu beni yeɛ ɔyɔle ye baba apɛdeɛ ɔ?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Bɔ oli moa ne ɔ.” Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ bédi ɛmɔ nyunu moa bɛkɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu. 32Ofikyɛ Yohane fale tenenee atee so yeɛ ɔwale ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, na ɛmɔanne ye banni. Nakoso ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ de, belele ye belili; na ɛmɔnwuni ye sɔ ne po, ye si ye ɛmɔanzesã ɛmɔ adwene banne ye banni.”
Hwɛsofoɛ bɔnefoɛ biemɔ nwo anyandera
(Marko 12.1-12; Luka 20.9-19)
33 “Ɛ́mɔtie anyandera bieku! Eboo mene bie yɔle bobe boo. Olele ye nwo bra yiale, ɔpɛle nu kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ɔ, osili abandenden wɔ nu, na ɔfa wurale hwɛsofoɛ biemɔ sa, na otuli atee hɔle maen bie aso. 34Na mmerɛ bɔ bobe telɛ dwuli nen, ɔsomane ye somvoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ berɛ kyɛ beele ye mmakaammaa deɛ bɛbrɛ ye. 35 Nakoso hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ hyele ye somvoɛ nemɔ, bɛbole ko, behuni ko, yeɛ bɛborole ko wora nyɔboɛ. 36Osa somane somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛsone bɛtra bɛ bɔ beli moa ne ɔ; na sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɛle bɛ ɔ. 37Ye si ye, ɔsomane ɔwa bienzua maa ɔhɔle bɛ berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Mma ne de, bɛkɔfa anidie bɛkɔma ye.’ 38 Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ nwuni ɔwa ne nen, besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘Bɔ odi ye bia ne ɛhe; ɛmɔbra ma yɛhu ye, ná yɛfa ye agyapadeɛ ne!’ 39Yiti bɛhyele ye, bɛhwene ye befili bobe boo ne anu, na behuni ye. 40Yiti kyẽa bɔ bobe boo mene ne kɔwa ne, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa kɔyɔ sɔ hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ ɔ?” 41 Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Okohu sɔ awudifoɛ nemɔ ewue yealɛ, ná wafa bobe boo ne wawura hwɛsofoɛ foforɛ mɔ sa, bɔ bobe telɛ dwu so a bɛkɔfa ye mmakaammaa deɛ bɛkɔma ye ɔ.”
42 Yeɛ Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔkkenngale Ahyerɛlɛ ne le, kyɛ,
‘Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne,
ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ.
Awurade yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe ɔ,
na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ yɛ nye so?’
43“Ɛhe ati, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bekole Nyameɛ ahennie ne bekofi ɛmɔ sa nu bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma maen bɔ bekosu ahennie ne anu mmaa ɔ. [44Na ebiala bɔ okofi ase kɔtɔ nyɔboɛ he aso ne, okobubu ye nu ahuronzi ahuronzi; yeɛ sɛ ɔte tɔ ebie so a, okonuku ye nyokonyoko.”]
45Na mmerɛ bɔ asɔfo mbanyi ne Farasiifoɛ nemɔ bɛtele ye anyandera ne nen, benwuni kyɛ ɔne bɛ. 46Yiti bɛyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔhye ye, nakoso né besuro ɛlɔen ne; ofikyɛ né ɛlɔen ne bu ye kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.

Title: MATEO 22
Content:
Atɔmvorɛ poentolɛ nwo anyandera
(Luka 14.15-24)
1 Na Yesu dwudwo hyirele bɛ wɔ anyandera nu bieku kyɛ, 2“Nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛhene bie bɔ ɔtole atɔmvorɛ poen mane ɔwa bienzua ɔ. 3 Na ɔsomane ye somvoɛ mɔ kyɛ bɛɛfrɛfrɛ bɛ bɔ wato ye sa wafrɛ bɛ kyɛ bɛbra atɔmvorɛ ne abo ne, nakoso bambene so kyɛ bɛkɔwa ɔ. 4Yiti osa somane somvoɛ foforɛ mɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔɔhã behyire bɛ bɔ mato me sa mafrɛ bɛ ne kyɛ: Ɛ́mɔtie, masiesie m’aleɛ ne mayie, mahu me nandwie nyii mɔ ne me nyɛmmoa bɔ balɔ ɔ, na mayie nikyee biala, yiti ɛmɔbra atɔmvorɛ ne abo.’ 5Na bɛ wora, bamva banyɛ dwirɛ, na besili nu bɛhɔle b’atee; ko hɔle ye fieso, ko oolili ye dwaa, 6yeɛ bɛ ngaa ne wora bɛhyele ye somvoɛ nemɔ beguale bɛ nyunu ase, na behuni bɛ. 7Na ɛhene ne tele ne, ye ahone huli, na ɔsomane ye asraafoɛ maa beehuhuni sɔ awudifoɛ nemɔ, na bɛyerale bɛ kuro. 8Afei osele ye somvoɛ mɔ kyɛ, ‘Basiesie atɔmvorɛ ne bayie de, nakoso bɛ bɔ ndole me sa mvrɛle bɛ ne, bɛmvata. 9Yiti ɛmɔhɔ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso, na mmenia somaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkonwu bɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfrɛfrɛ bɛ ma bɛbra atɔmvorɛ ne abo.’ 10Na sɔ somvoɛ nemɔ besili nu bɛhɔle dwaa nemɔ aso bɛɛboaboale mmenia bɔ benwuni bɛ amukoraa noa, bɔne mmenia ne mmeni paa; na mmenia beeyili atɔmvorɛ sua ne anu tɛkyɛ.
11“Na ɛhene ne wurale nu kyɛ ɔkwaanea bɛ bɔ bawa atɔmvorɛ ne abo nen, onwuni biaa bie wɔ berɛ, bɔ né ye de owwura atɔmvorɛfalɛ ataadeɛ ɔ. 12Na obisale ye kyɛ, ‘Damvo, ɛyɛle sɛɛ yeɛ ɛwale wa ɔ, bɔ wɔ de nna atɔmvorɛfalɛ ataadeɛ yeɛ ewura e?’ Na wangora wammukye ye noa. 13Yeɛ ɛhene ne sele somvoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔkyekye ye gya ne ye sa, ná ɛmɔfindi ye bɛto bondua dɔ awosii ne anu; dɔ yeɛ mmenia kosũ ná banwose bɛ gye ɔ.’ 14Ofikyɛ, bafrɛ pee, nakoso kãa bie yeɛ baneanea nu bayɛ bɛ ɔ.”
Ɛtoɔtualɛ nwo adwobisa
(Marko 12.13-17; Luka 20.20-26)
15Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ mɔ bɛhɔle bɛɛbɔle porɛ kyɛbɔ bɛkwafa edwirɛ bɛkɔtetɛ Yesu noa ɔ. 16Na bɛsomane b’asuafoɛ mɔ ne Herodefoɛ maa bɛwale ye berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, yɛse kyɛ ɛte nahorɛniɛ, na ekyirekyire Nyameɛ atee ne turoloo, ɛnyɛ nyeyemuɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmva wɔ nye ndo mmenia bɛ dibea. 17Yiti kyire yɛ w’adwene. Aso mmeraa ma ate kyɛ yɛtua ɛtoɔ yɛma Kaesare, anaakyɛ ɔmma ate?”
18Nakoso Yesu nwuni b’adwenemmɔne ne, na obuale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ, nyaatwomfoɛ! Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbaatetɛ me noa ɔ? 19Ɛ́mɔfa sikaa bɔ bɛfa betua ɛtoɔ ne bie behyire me!” Na bɛfale denare ko bɛbrɛle ye. 20Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nwa mvonini ne dumaa yeɛ ɔwɔ so ye?” 21 Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Kaesare deɛ ɔ!” Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade ɛ́mɔfa Kaesare deɛ bɛ́ma Kaesare, ná ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ deɛ bɛ́ma Nyameɛ.”
22Na bɛtele edwirɛ he nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa, na befili ye nwo berɛ besili nu bɛhɔle.
Ewutingyelɛ nwo adwobisa
(Marko 12.18-27; Luka 20.27-40)
23 Ɛlɛho ne ala, Sadusiifoɛ bɔ bɛnwa awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ nne berɛ ne, bɛwale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, 24 “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, Mose hane kyɛ, ‘Sɛ bienzua bɔ wanwo ba owu a, odi kyɛ oliɛma bienzua gya kunaniɛ ne, ná ɔwo mmaa ma oliɛma ne.’ 25Tie, né aliɛmaa mmienzua nzoo bie bɛ ne yɛ wɔ wa. Bɔ oli moa ne gyale braa, na owuli bɔ wanwo mmaa ɔ, na ɔyakyili ɔye ne berɛ mane oliɛma bienzua. 26Sɔ ala koso yeɛ ɔtole aliɛmaa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne ɔ, maa odwuli bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne aso ɔ. 27Na bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, braa ne koso wuli. 28Yiti awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ ne anu, mmenia nzoo nemɔ anu beni yeɛ braa ne kɔyɛ ɔye ɔ? Ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa begyale ye.”
29Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, Ɛmɔafõ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔnze Ahyerɛlɛ ne, anaa Nyameɛ tumi ne. 30Ofikyɛ awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ ne anu, bengya, yeɛ bɛmva ebie bɛmma agyaa, na mmom bɛte kyɛ nyameɛso abɔfo mɔ. 31Bɔ ɔfa awufoɛ etingyelɛ nwo de, aso ɛmɔkkenngale bɔ Nyameɛ hã hyirele ɛmɔ ne, 32 kyɛ ‘Me ole Abraham Nyameɛ, Yisake Nyameɛ ne Yakob Nyameɛ’? Nyameɛ ɔtte awufoɛ Nyameɛ, na mmom ɔte ateasefoɛ Nyameɛ.” 33 Na ɛlɔen ne tele ɛhe nen, ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne yɛle bɛ nwanwa.
Mmeraa titire ne
(Marko 12.28-34; Luka 10.25-28)
34Na mmerɛ bɔ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ bɛtele kyɛ Yesu noa abɔ Sadusiifoɛ nemɔ nen, beeyiale neka horɛ, 35na bɛ nu ko bɔ ɔte mmeraa nwo nimdeɛniɛ ɔ obisale Yesu dwirɛ fa suale ye ngaen kyɛ, 36“Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, mmeraa dwirɛ beni yeɛ ɔte piri paa wɔ mmeraa ne anu ɔ?”
37 Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Fa w’ahone amukoraati, wɔ kra mukoraati, ɔne w’adwene amukoraati kuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ! 38Mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte piri paa bɔ oli moa hɔ ɛne. 39 Na bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne koso ɔte kyɛ ɛhene ala: Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo! 40Mmeraa dwirɛ nyɔ hemɔ aso yeɛ mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa begyi ɔ.”
Kristo ne nwo adwobisa
(Marko 12.35-37; Luka 20.41-44)
41 Na Farasiifoɛ nemɔ beyiale neka horɛ nen, Yesu bisale bɛ 42kyɛ, “Kristo ne, ɛmɔdwene ye nwo sɛ? Nwa awa ɛne?” Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Dawide awa ɛne.”
43Yeɛ Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Na afei ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ Dawide nate Sunzum Krongron so frɛ ye me Mene ɔ, kyɛ,
44 ‘Awurade sele me Mene kyɛ:
Tena me sa famaa so,
kodwu kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.’?
45Na sɛ Dawide frɛ ye me Mene a, né ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ ɔte ɔwa ɔ?”
46Na ebiala angora amma ye mmuayɛɛ, na ofi sɔ kyẽa ne, ebiala angora ammisa ye dwirɛ biala ko.

Title: MATEO 23
Content:
Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
(Marko 12.38-39; Luka 11.43, 46; 20.45-46)
1Afei Yesu sele ɛlɔen ne ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, 2“Mose bia so yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ mɔ ne Farasiifoɛ mɔ bɛtena ɔ; 3yiti bɔ bɛkɔhã bekohyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ biala, ɛ́mɔli so ná ɛ́mɔyɔ. Nakoso bɛ yɔleɛ de, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bie; ofikyɛ bɛmmɔ edwirɛ bɔ bɛkã ne anwo bra. 4 Bɛkyekye nningyein nonɛnonɛ bɛto mmenia bati so; nakoso bɛ de, bɛmva bɛ sa mmɛseka ko po bɛnzɔ nu ma bɛmma so. 5 Bɔ bɛyɔ amukoraa te bɔ mmenia konwu bɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛyɛ bɛ ngayeɛ nwomaa ne tɛtrɛtɛɛ, yeɛ bɛyɛ bɛ ndaadeɛ noa bɔ banwo ne ndendenn. 6 Bekuro mbanyi bia wɔ ɛpoentolɛ bo, ɔne mbanyi bia wɔ nyianu sua mɔ nu, 7ɔne kyɛ mmenia kobisa bɛ ahye wɔ dwaaso ɔ, ɔne kyɛ mmenia kɔfrɛ bɛ ‘kyerɛkyerɛniɛ’ ɔ. 8 Nakoso ɛmɔ de, onni kyɛ bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ: ‘kyerɛkyerɛniɛ’ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ te komapɛ, na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛte aliɛmaa. 9Yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfrɛ ebiala ɛmɔ baba wɔ aseɛ ye aso, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔle Baba komapɛ, na ye yeɛ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne. 10Afei koso, nnɛmɔma bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ ‘meneɛ mɔ,’ ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔ Mene te komapɛ, bɔ ye ole Kristo ne. 11 Bɔ ɔte titire wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ somvoɛ. 12 Na ebiala bɔ ɔmoma ye nwo so ne, bɛkɔbrɛ ye ase; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ne, bɛkɔma ye so.
Nyaatwomyɛlɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
(Marko 12.40; Luka 11.39-42, 44, 52; 20.47)
13“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔto nyameɛso ahennie ne anu betia mmenia. Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ a ɛmɔngɔ nu, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ nu ne, ɛmɔmma bɛ ate mma bɛngɔ nu. [ 14Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔbɔ akunafoɛ mmrasua apoo bede bɛ nningyein, nakoso ɛmɔpati bɛbɔ mbaeɛ tendenn bekyire. Ɛhe ati, bekobua ɛmɔ foɛ piri paa!]
15“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔkyini ɛpo ne aseɛ so kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkonya sona ko maa ɔkɔɔboka ɛmɔ fekue ne aso ɔ, na sɛ ɛmɔnya ye a, ɛmɔmaa ɔyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ kuroniɛ mmɔhoɛ nyɔ tra ɛmɔ bɔbɔ.
16 “Ɛmɔ yaakɔ, anyesiniwaafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔkyire atee ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔnwa: ‘Sɛ ebie fa asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɔta ndaen a, ɔndo ndaen; nakoso sɛ ebie fa asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu sikaa kɔkorɛ ɔta ndaen de a, ɔto ndaen.’ 17 Ɛmɔ, ngwaseafoɛ ne anyesiniwaafoɛ! Beni yeɛ odi mu ɔ? Esikaa kɔkorɛ ne, anaakyɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne bɔ ɔma sikaa kɔkorɛ ne nwo te ne? 18Yeɛ ɛmɔnwa, ‘Sɛ ebie fa afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔta ndaen a, ɔndo ndaen; nakoso sɛ ebie fa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɔ ogua so ne ɔta ndaen de a, ɔto ndaen.’ 19Anyesiniwaafoɛ! Beni yeɛ odi mu ɔ? Ayɛyɛdeɛ ne, anaakyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne bɔ ɔma ayɛyɛdeɛ ne nwo te ne? 20Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔfa afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔta ndaen ne, ɔfa ye ne bɔ ogua so amukoraa yeɛ ɔta ndaen ɔ; 21yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔfa asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɔta ndaen ne, ɔfa ye ne bɔ ɔte nu ne yeɛ ɔta ndaen ɔ. 22Na ebiala bɔ ɔfa nyameɛso ta ndaen ne, ɔfa Nyameɛ ahennie bia ne, ɔne bɔ ɔte so ne yeɛ ɔta ndaen ɔ.
23“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔtua ɛmeɛ, ɛmanyire ne ɛkaberɛ so buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko, nakoso ɛmɔnni mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ bɔ ohia paa ne aso, bɔ ye ole pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne gyidie. Na ɛhemɔ yeɛ ahaa odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔnyakyi ye ngaa nemɔ koso yɔlɛ ɔ. 24Anyesiniwaafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔkyire atee ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔsongyi anonneɛ so bɛye nwɔsea bɛto, nakoso ɛmɔme afupɔngɔ ɔ!
25“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔnwunzi kwangoa ne prɛte nwo, nakoso bɛ kunu de, apoo ne adifuu ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ. 26Farasiiniɛ anyesiniwaaniɛ! Wɔ, di moa nwunzi kwangoa ne prɛte ne anu koraka, na ye nwo koso kofi.
27“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔte kyɛ asieleɛ bɔ bafa ewure bahura ye nwo ɔ, bɔ ye nwo bɔ enwu ye ne ɔyɛ nyemene, nakoso nu dɔ de, efuin mmowue ne efiɛ amukoraa ayi ye tɛkyɛ. 28Na ɛmɔ koso, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ wɔ mmenia nyunu ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔ nu de, nyaatwom ne amumuyɛɛ ayi ye to.
Nyaatwomyɛlɛ nwo asotwe
(Luka 11.47-51)
29“Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔto ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ b’asieleɛ so, yeɛ ɛmɔsiesie teneneefoɛ b’asieleɛ so kama, 30na ɛmɔkã kyɛ, ‘Sɛ né yɛte ase yɛ mbanyi mɔ aberɛ so a, ahaa yɛngɔboka bɛ so ma bengohwie ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ bɛ mogya bengogua.’ 31Yiti ɛmɔdi adanzeɛ betia ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛ ɛmɔte bɛ bɔ behuhuni ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne bɛ bosofoɛ. 32Ɛmɔ nana mɔ b’asusudeɛ ne, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔhɔ so bewura ma oyi tɛkyɛ! 33 Ewoo, ɛkyenebene mmaa! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛmɔahora banwati bafi amaneɛnwunɛ kuro ndɛenbualɛ ne anu? 34 Yiti, ɛ́mɔtie, mésoma ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne nworɛfoɛ ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ maa bɛba ɛmɔ berɛ, na ɛmɔkohũ bɛ nu biemɔ bɛkɔbɔ bɛ mmeamudua nu, yeɛ ɛmɔkofi bɛ nu biemɔ mbire wɔ ɛmɔ nyianu sua mɔ nu, ná ɛmɔatane bɛ nye bafi kuro so bahɔ kuro so. 35 Ye sɔ ne ati, mogya tenenee amukoraa bɔ bahwie bagua aseɛ so, ofi teneneeniɛ Abel mogya so kodwu Barakia awa Sakaria, bɔ ɛmɔhuni ye wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne b’afia ne, bɛ mogya ne nwo asotwe kɔwa ɛmɔ so. 36 Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛhemɔ amukoraa nwo asotwe kɔwa ɛnɛmmafoɛ so!
Yesu kuro Yerusalem dwirɛ
(Luka 13.34-35)
37 “O, Yerusalem, Yerusalem, wɔ bɔ eku ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ná ɛboro bɛ bɔ basoma bɛ wɔ berɛ nyɔboɛ ɔ! Mmerɛ pee yeɛ mbenane kyɛ ahaa meboaboa wɔ mma noa, kyɛbɔ akɔtaen boaboa ye mma noa wura ye ndaa bo ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔambene so! 38 Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛkɔyakyi ɛmɔ awuro ne berɛ dandue kɔma ɛmɔ. 39 Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ɛmɔgonwu me ko kodwu kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Saleɛ ole bɔ ɔnate Awurade dumaa nu ɔ́ba ye!’ ”

Title: MATEO 24
Content:
Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne sɛkyelɛ nwo ngɔm
(Marko 13.1-2; Luka 21.5-6)
1Na Yesu fili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu fitele bɔ ɔkɔ nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye nwo berɛ beelili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne nwo ngɔmɔ behyirele ye. 2 Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Yeɛ ɛmɔnwu ɛhemɔ amukoraa? Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛngɔyakyi nyɔboɛ bɔ ogyi nyɔboɛ so ɔ wɔ wa bɔ bengodwiri bengogua ase ɔ.”
Ndaneanyeɛ ne amaneɛnwunɛ
(Marko 13.3-13; Luka 21.7-19)
3 Né Yesu te Olive Bokaa ne aso, na asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ ahameɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Kã kyire yɛ, kyinzu yeɛ ɛhemɔ bɛkɔwa nu ɔ? Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ walɛ ne ne ewiase ayieleɛ ne nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ?”
4Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala annakalaka ɛmɔ. 5 Ofikyɛ mmenia pee bele me dumaa bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ, ‘Me ole Kristo ne,’ na bɛkɔlakalaka mmenia pee. 6 Ɛmɔkɔte koɛ mɔ ne koɛ mɔ nwo ngunga. Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ odi kyɛ ɛhemɔ besi, nakoso né ayieleɛ ne onnya oddwuli. 7Na maen kodwɔso kotia maen, ahennie kodwɔso kotia ahennie, yeɛ ɛhɔen ne [anwonyerɛ] ne aseɛwosolɛ kɔwa nekaa ahoroɔ. 8Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa bɛte aworɛ nu yealɛ bɔ oli moa ne.
9 “Afei bɛkɔye ɛmɔ bɛkɔma maa ɛmɔkonwu amaneɛ, bekohũhũ ɛmɔ, na ɔnate me dumaa ti maen maen amukoraa bɛkɔpɔ ɛmɔ. 10Na afei, ɛhe kɔto mmenia pee sundidua; na bɛkɔyeye bɛ nwo ne bɛ nwo bɛkɔma, ná bapopɔ bɛ nwo ne bɛ nwo. 11Na ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ pee bekodwɔso, ná balakalaka mmenia pee. 12Na ɔnate kyɛ amumuyɛɛ kɔsone pee ne ati, mmenia pee b’ehurolɛ bɔ bekurokuro bɛ nwo dwirɛ ne, ye noa kodwo. 13 Nakoso bɔ okotindim koodwu ayieleɛ nen, ye yeɛ bekole ye ngoa ɔ. 14 Na bɛkɔhã ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba he wɔ ewiase amukoraa maa ɔkɔyɛ adanzeɛ kɔma maen maen amukoraa; koraka ná afei ayieleɛ ne awa.
Akyiwadeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ maen ne
(Marko 13.14-23; Luka 21.20-24)
15 “Yiti sɛ ɛmɔnwu akyiwadeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ maen ne, bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Daniel hane ye nwo dwirɛ ne, kyɛ ogyi nekaa krongron berɛ a, (bɔ ɔkenga ne, maa ɔte ye bo), 16ye de, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne, odi kyɛ bɛnwati bɛkɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso; 17 sona bɔ ɔwɔ sua ti afia ne, onni kyɛ odwu ase kyɛ ɔkwaafa nikyee biala fi ye awuro; 18yeɛ sona bɔ ɔwɔ fieso ne koso, onni kyɛ osa ye si kɔ kyɛ ɔkwaafa ye tena. 19Na pemvoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛma mmaa nyɔfone wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu de, bɛ yaakɔ! 20Na ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ, ná ɛmɔ nwatilɛ ne wamma prakasua mmerɛ anaa afofikyẽa! 21 Ɔnate kyɛ, amaneɛnwunɛ piri bɔ ɔkɔwa ne, ofi mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle wiase bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, ye sɛso ɔwwale le, na sɔ bieku koso ngɔwa le. 22Na sɛ bande sɔ ngyẽa ne aso a, ahaa bengole sona biala ngoa; nakoso ɔnate bɛ bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ne ati, bɛkɔte sɔ ngyẽa ne aso.
23“Na sɛ ebiala kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Nea, Kristo ne wɔ wa!’ anaakyɛ ‘Ye yeɛ ɔwɔ dɔ ne!’ a, nnɛma ɛmɔde bedi. 24Ɔnate kyɛ, kristo ngondombofoɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ kodwɔso, na bɛkɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri, bɔ ɔkɔhora kɔwa kyɛ, bɛkɔlakalaka bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye bɛ ne po. 25Ɛ́mɔtie! Mali moa mahã mahyire ɛmɔ dada.
26 “Yiti, sɛ bɛkã bekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Nea, ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so dɔ’ a, nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ dɔ; yeɛ sɛ bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nea, ɔwɔ pumbu nemɔ anu dɔ’ a, nnɛma ɛmɔde bedi. 27Na kyɛbɔ agralaa tete fi eyia afiteleɛ, ná ɔta kodwu eyia atɔleɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne walɛ ne koso ɔkɔyɛ ɔ. 28 Na nekaa bɔ efuin la ne, berɛ yeɛ mbɛtɛ bɛboa bɛ noa ɔ.
Sona Awa ne walɛ
(Marko 13.24-27; Luka 21.25-28)
29 “Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu amaneɛnwunɛ ne asi ne, berɛ ne ala, eyia kɔkakyi awosii, na ɛsraen ngɔta, na nzramaa mɔ kotutu kofi anwuro kogua ase, na anwuro tumi mɔ kɔwoso; 30 na afei Sona Awa ne, ye sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔla ali wɔ ewienu; na aseɛ so mmusua kure amukoraa bɛkɔbɔ awuye, na bekonwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ɔ́ba wɔ nyameɛso munungum nu wɔ tumi ne animnyam kandinga nu ɔ. 31 Na ɔkɔsoma ye abɔfo mɔ maa bɛkɔfa totorobɛndohulɛ akomvi piri bɛkɔwa, na bɛkɔboaboa bɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ nemɔ noa bekofi mvrama nna nemɔ anu, kofi anwuro noa koodwu ye noa.
Borɔdoma bakaa ne nwo nikyeesualɛ
(Marko 13.28-31; Luka 21.29-33)
32“Borɔdoma bakaa nwo anyandera ne, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ nikyeesualɛ ma ɛmɔ: Sɛ ye mmaen nemɔ nya yɛ frɔmfrɔm, ná ɔfefɛ a, né ɛmɔse kyɛ ahuhuro mmerɛ apingye. 33Sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔnwu sɔ nningyein nemɔ amukoraa a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ wapingye, na wadwu anoa nu berɛ. 34 Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he ngɔpɛ nu, sana ɛhemɔ amukoraa bawa nu koraka. 35 Anwuro ne aseɛ kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ, nakoso me dwirɛ de, ɔngɔpɛ nu le.
Kyẽa ne ne dɔnhwere ne
(Marko 13.32-37; Luka 17.26-30, 34-35)
36“Na kyẽa ne ne dɔnhwere ne de, ebiala nze; nyameɛso abɔfo mɔ [anaa Baa ne] po nze, sana Baba ne ngome twe. 37 Na kyɛbɔ Nowa aberɛ so deɛ ne yɛle ne, sɔ ala koso yeɛ Sona Awa ne walɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɔ. 38Sɔ mmerɛ ne, anzana nzueyilɛ ne baawa ne, mmenia didili na bɛnone, begyigyale, na bɛmane agyaa maa odwuli kyẽa bɔ Nowa fole ɛlɛen ne anu ɔ; 39na né bɛnze bɔ ɔbaasi ɔ maa oodwuli kyɛ nzueyilɛ ne wale oopiane bɛ mukoraa hɔle ɔ; na sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne walɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɔ. 40 Sɔ mmerɛ ne, mmienzua nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ fieso ɔ, bɛkɔfa ko, né bayakyi ko berɛ. 41Mmrasua nyɔ bɔ besi aburoo ɔ, bɛkɔfa ko, né bayakyi ko berɛ. 42 Yiti ɛ́mɔwɛne, ofikyɛ ɛmɔnze kyẽa horɛ bɔ ɛmɔ Awurade kɔwa ɔ. 43 Na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, sɛ né awuro mene ne ɔse kɔngɔen mmerɛ horɛ bɔ awueniɛ ne kɔwa a, ahaa ɔkɔwɛne, bɔ ahaa ɔngɔma ongootu ye anoa bo ongoowua ye ɔ. 44Yiti ɛmɔ koso, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ nwo bésie, ɔnate kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnzusu ɔ nu yeɛ Sona Awa ne kɔwa ɔ.
Akoaa nahorɛniɛ ne akoaa bɔnefoɛ ne
(Luka 12.41-48)
45 “Na nwa koraa ole akoaa nahorɛniɛ ne nworɛniɛ, bɔ ye mene afa ye awuro berɛ ngoaa mɔ wawura ye sa, kyɛ ɔma bɛ aleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ɔ? 46Akoaa bɔ ye mene ba banwu ye kyɛ sɔ ala yeɛ ogu so ɔyɔ ne, onya saleɛ. 47Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔkɔfa ye nningyein amukoraa kowura ye sa. 48Nakoso sɛ akoaa bɔnefoɛ ne de, ɔkã ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Me mene kɔhyɛ koraka ná wawa,’ 49 ná ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔbo ye mmango ngoaa nemɔ, ná ɔne akɔnomnzafoɛ bedidi bɛno a, 50ye de, sɔ akoaa ne mene kɔwa kyẽa bɔ okoofu ye nu ɔ, ɔne dɔnhwere bɔ ɔnze ɔ nu; 51 na ɔkɔpepɛ akoaa ne nu ahuronzi ahuronzi, ná wamaa wanya nyaatwomfoɛ bɛ kyɛfa ne bie; na berɛ yeɛ mmenia kosũ ná banwose bɛ gye ɔ.

Title: MATEO 25
Content:
Mmabunu buru biemɔ nwo anyandera
1 “Afei nyameɛso ahennie ne, yɛkɔfa yɛkɔto mmabunu buru biemɔ bɔ bɛfale bɛ nganea besili nu bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaayia atɔmvorɛ biaa ne nwo. 2 Bɛ nu nnu te nworɛfoɛ, yeɛ nnu wora bɛte ngwaseafoɛ. 3Ngwaseafoɛ nemɔ fale bɛ nganea ne, na bamva ngoo bandira. 4Nakoso nworɛfoɛ nemɔ de, bɛfale ngoo beguale ndowaa nu bɛbokale bɛ nganea nemɔ aso. 5Na ɔhyɛle bɔ né atɔmvorɛ biaa ne ɔmma ɔ, yiti bɛ mukoraa bɛ nye hone, na bɛlafelafele.
6“Na abunnamu yeɛ ebie teane nu kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie, atɔmvorɛ biaa ne awa oo! Ɛmɔbra beeyia ye oo!’ 7Na sɔ mmabunu nemɔ amukoraa bedwɔsole, na bɛyɔle bɛ nganea nyamaa nemɔ yé. 8Na ngwaseafoɛ nemɔ sele nworɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛ ɛmɔ ngoo ne bie, ofikyɛ yɛ nganea nemɔ bénua.’ 9Nakoso nworɛfoɛ nemɔ buale kyɛ, ‘Daabi oo, ɔngɔso yɛ ne ɛmɔ; yiti ɛmɔhɔ bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne bie nemɔ dɔ bɛɛtɔ ɛmɔ deɛ.’ 10Na bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaatɔ bie nen, atɔmvorɛ biaa ne wale; na bɛ bɔ né baboaboa bɛ nwo basie ne, bɛ ne ye hɔle atɔmvorɛ ne abo, na bɛtole anoa ne anu.
11 “Na nziɛ ye, mmabunu ngaa nemɔ koso bɛwale, na bɛhane kyɛ, ‘Yɛ mene, Yɛ mene, bukye ma yɛbra nu oo!’ 12Nakoso obuale kyɛ, ‘Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, menze ɛmɔ!’
13 “Yiti ɛ́mɔwɛne, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔnze kyẽa ne anaa dɔnhwere ne [bɔ Sona Awa ne kɔwa ɔ.]”
Ngoaa nza nemɔ nwo dwirɛ
(Luka 19.11-27)
14“Afei koso, [nyameɛso ahennie ne,] ɔte kyɛ biaa bie bɔ né ɔbaatu atee kɔ nekaa bie, bɔ ɔfrɛle ye bɔbɔ ye ngoaa mɔ, ná ɔfale ye nningyein wurale bɛ sa ɔ. 15Na ɔmane ko talɛnde nnu, ɔmane ko wora talɛnde nyɔ, yeɛ ko wora ɔmane ye talɛnde ko; kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biala ye mmɔdenbɔlɛ osi te ɔ, na afei otuli atee ne. 16Na berɛ ne ala, ko bɔ onyane talɛnde nnu ne, ɔfale ye sikaa ne ɔɔyɔle adwuma, na onyane mvasoɛ talɛnde nnu. 17Sɔ ala yeɛ bɔ onyane talɛnde nyɔ ne koso onyane nyɔ bokale so ɔ. 18Nakoso bɔ onyane ko ne de, ootuli kumaa, na ofuni ye mene sikaa ne wurale.
19 “Na ɔhyɛle dee ne, ngoaa nemɔ bɛ mene ne osa wale, na ɔne bɛ beebuli ngondaa. 20Na ko bɔ onyane talɛnde nnu ne wale, ɔfale talɛnde nnu yeɛ ɔbokale so wale ɔ, na osele kyɛ, ‘Me mene, ɛmane me talɛnde nnu. Na nea, manya ye nwo talɛnde nnu.’ 21 Yeɛ ye mene ne sele ye kyɛ, ‘Mmo, akoaa paa ne nahorɛniɛ! Ali kaaba bie nwo nahorɛ, ngɔfa bɔ ɔsone ɔ ngowura wɔ sa; bra baanya wɔ mene anigye ne anu kyɛfa!’
22“Na ko bɔ onyane talɛnde nyɔ ne koso wale, na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Me mene, ɛmane me talɛnde nyɔ. Na nea, manya ye nwo talɛnde nyɔ.’ 23Yeɛ ye mene ne sele ye kyɛ, ‘‘Mmo, akoaa paa ne nahorɛniɛ! Ali kaaba bie nwo nahorɛ, ngɔfa bɔ ɔsone ɔ ngowura wɔ sa; bra baanya wɔ mene anigye ne anu kyɛfa!’
24“Afei, ko bɔ onyane talɛnde ko ne koso wale, na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Me mene, mese kyɛ ɛte sona bɔ wɔ dwirɛ yɛ se ɔ, ebu nnɔbaeɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ elluale hwee ɔ, yeɛ ɛboaboa aleɛ noa wɔ nekaa bɔ elluale hwee ɔ; 25yiti né mesuro, na mvale wɔ talɛnde ne ngɔmveale aseɛnwo. Wɔ nikyee ɛhe, de!’
26“Yeɛ ye mene ne buale ye kyɛ, ‘Akoaa atianuserɛniɛ ne ɛfoen sona! Yiti né ɛse kyɛ mebu nnɔbaeɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ nnnuale hwee ɔ, yeɛ meboaboa aleɛ noa wɔ nekaa bɔ nnnuale hwee ɔ? 27Nzaade, ahaa né ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛfa me sikaa ne kɔma sikakorabeafoɛ. Na mmale ye, ahaa me sa kɔhã me sikaa ne ne ye nwo nzihoɛ! 28Yiti ɛ́mɔle talɛnde ne befi ye sa nu, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́ma bɔ ole talɛnde buru ne. 29 Ɔnate kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ole bie ne, bɛkɔfa bie bɛkɔboka ye so maa ɔkɔbo so; nakoso bɔ olle bie ne, bɔ ole ye ne po, bekole bekofi ye sa nu. 30Akoaa bɔ mvasoɛ nne ye so ye, ɛ́mɔgyi ye bɛ́to bondua dɔ awosii ne anu, na berɛ yeɛ mmenia kosũ ná banwose bɛ gye ɔ.’
Ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne
31 “Sona Awa ne kɔwa ye animnyam nu bɔ ye abɔfo amukoraa bɛboka ye so ɔ, na ɔkɔtena ye animnyam ahennie bia so. 32 Na ɔkɔboaboa maen maen amukoraa noa wɔ ye nyunu. Na ɔkɔhyɛ bɛ nu kyɛbɔ mmoaenneafoɛ yeye mmoaen fi mbɔngye nu ɔ. 33Ɔkɔfa mmoaen ne kogyina ye sa famaa so, ná wafa mbɔngye ne wagyina ye bɛen so. 34 Na afei Ɛhene ne kose bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ye famaa so ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ bɔ me Baba ayira ɛmɔ ɔ, ɛmɔbra bɛɛfa ahennie bɔ basiesie bama ɛmɔ fi ewiase ahyɛaseɛ ne bɛyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. 35 Ofikyɛ ɛhɔen huni me, na ɛmɔmane me nikyee maa nnili; nzuhɔen huni me, na ɛmɔmane me nzue maa nnone; nyɛle wɔfoɛ, na ɛmɔsikyele me ɛmɔ awuro; 36me nwo lale so, na ɛmɔherale me tena; me nwo yɛle me yea, na ɛmɔɔneane me; ngɔnale kuku nu, na ɛmɔɔsrale me.’
37“Na teneneefoɛ nemɔ kobua ye kyɛ, ‘Awurade, kyinzu yeɛ yɛnwuni wɔ kyɛ ɛhɔen huni wɔ ná yɛmane wɔ nikyee maa elili ɔ, anaa nzuhɔen huni wɔ ná yɛmane wɔ nzue maa ɛnone ɔ? 38Na kyinzu yeɛ yɛnwuni wɔ kyɛ ayɛ wɔfoɛ ná yɛɛsikyele wɔ wɔ yɛ awuro, anaa wɔ nwo la so ná yɛherale wɔ tena ɔ? 39Kyinzu yeɛ yɛnwuni wɔ kyɛ wɔ nwo yɛ wɔ yea anaa ɛla kuku nu bɔ yɛɛneane wɔ ɔ?’ 40 Na Ɛhene ne kobua bɛ kyɛ, ‘Amba, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛmane nniɛma hemɔ anu kaaba ko po nen, me yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛmane me ɔ!’
41 “Na afei okose bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ye sa bɛen so ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ bɔ banoma ɛmɔ ɔ! Ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ see afebɔɔ bɔ basiesie bama abɔnzam ne ye abɔfo mɔ ne anu! 42Ofikyɛ ɛhɔen huni me, nakoso ɛmɔamma me nikyee ma manni; nzuhɔen huni me, nakoso ɛmɔamma me nzue ma manno; 43nyɛle ɛwɔfoɛ, nakoso ɛmɔanzikye me ɛmɔ awuro; me nwo lale so, nakoso ɛmɔangera me tena; me nwo yɛle me yea, yeɛ ngɔnale kuku nu, nakoso ɛmɔammannea me.’
44“Na bɛ koso bekobua kyɛ, ‘Awurade, kyinzu yeɛ yɛnwuni wɔ kyɛ ɛhɔen ku wɔ anaakyɛ nzuhɔen ku wɔ, anaa ayɛ wɔfoɛ, anaa wɔ nwo la so, anaa wɔ nwo yɛ wɔ yea, anaa ɛla kuku nu bɔ yammoka wɔ ɔ?’ 45Na okobua bɛ kyɛ, ‘Amba, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔanyɔ bamma ɛhemɔ nu kaaba ko po ne, me yeɛ ɛmɔanyɔ bamma me ɔ.’ 46 Na ɛhemɔ kofi berɛ kɔhɔ asohwenɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ nu; nakoso teneneefoɛ nemɔ de, bɛkɔhɔ daa ngoa nu.”

Title: MATEO 26
Content:
Bɛbɔ Yesu ti so porɛ
(Marko 14.1-2; Luka 22.1-2; Yohane 11.45-53)
1Na ɔwale kyɛ Yesu yiele edwirɛ he amukoraa kã nen, osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, 2 “Kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse ne, waha elenyɔ né Abɔtra aluolue ne adwu, na bɛkɔye Sona Awa ne bɛkɔma maa bɛkɔbɔ ye mmeamudua nu.”
3Yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi beeyiale ɔsɔfo panyi paa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kaifa n’ahemvie, 4na bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bɛkɔhye Yesu kudɛɛ ná bahu ye. 5Na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛngɔyɔ sɔ wɔ aluolue ne abo, anyɔ a né mmenia ayɔ basabasa wɔ maen ne anu.”
Braa bie tutu sakyeɛfona fa gua Yesu ti so
(Marko 14.3-9; Yohane 12.1-8)
6Na mmerɛ bɔ né Yesu wɔ Betania, wɔ Simɔn kwataniɛ n’awuro berɛ nen, 7 braa bie bɔ otira towaa nyɔboɛ serɛ bɔ sakyeɛfona nyɔboɛ serɛ wɔ nu ɔ wale Yesu nwo berɛ. Na Yesu tenane ase bɔ odidi nen, otutuli sakyeɛfona ne fa guale Yesu ti so. 8Nakoso asuafoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye sɔ nen, wanyɛ bɛ fɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛhe bɔ asɛkye ye e, ye bo ole sɛɛ? 9Ahaa bɛkɔhora bɛkɔtɔne sakyeɛfona he nyɔboɛ serɛ, ná bafa sikaa ne bama ehiafoɛ!”
10Na Yesu nwuni ye sɔ nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔha braa ye ɔ? Bɔ wayɔ wama me ne, ɔte nikyee piri paa. 11 Ɛmɔ ne ehiafoɛ wɔ berɛ daa, nakoso me de, nna ɛmɔ ne me yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ daa ɔ. 12 Sakyeɛfona he bɔ watutu wagua me nipadua so ye, wayɔ sɔ wafa wasiesie me wama me sielɛ. 13Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ewiase nekaa biala bɔ bɛkɔhã nzɛmba he nen, bɔ braa he ayɔ ne koso, bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ ye ngayeɛ.”
Yudase pene so kyɛ ɔkɔye Yesu kɔma
(Marko 14.10-11; Luka 22.3-6)
14Yeɛ asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ anu ko bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yudase Yiskariote ne, ɔhɔle asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ berɛ 15 oobisale kyɛ, “Sɛ meye ye mema ɛmɔ a, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔma me ɔ?” Na bɛhale ɛdwetɛ aburasa bɛfa bɛmane ye. 16Na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔpenane atee bɔ ɔkɔfa so kɔye ye kɔma ɔ.
Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ di Abɔtra aluolue aleɛ
(Marko 14.12-21; Luka 22.7-13, 21-23; Yohane 13.21-30)
17 Na Paanoo kabrɛdi aluolue kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ekuro kyɛ yɛkosiesie maa ekodi Abɔtra aleɛ ne ɔ?”
18 Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ kuro nu dɔ asomasi berɛ, ná ɛmɔhã behyire ye kyɛ, ‘Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne nwa: Me mmerɛ ne apingye, na w’awuro yeɛ me ne m’asuafoɛ yɛkooli Abɔtra (aluolue) ne ɔ.’ ” 19 Na asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛɛyɔle kyɛbɔ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ ne ala, na besiesiele Abɔtra aleɛ ne.
20Na odwuli nɔsoa nen, ɔne asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛtenane ase kyɛ bedidi. 21Na bedidi nen, ɔhane kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔ nu ko kɔye me kɔma.” 22Na bɛ wora bɔle paa, na bɛhyɛle ye bo bebisale ye ngoko ngoko kyɛ, “Awurade, me ahɔ anaa?” 23Na obuale kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔne me to asaa didi wɔ talie ko anu ne, ye ala yeɛ ɔkɔye me kɔma ɔ. 24 Sona Awa ne ɔ́kɔ kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bafa ye nwo ne, nakoso kuro sona bɔ ɔkɔye Sona Awa ne kɔma ne de, ye yaakɔ! Sɛ banwo sɔ sona ne po a, ahaa ɔte paa ma ye!” 25Yeɛ Yudase bɔ ɔyele ye mane ne, obisale kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, me ahɔ anaa?” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Ye ala yeɛ ahã ne.”
Awurade Adidie Krongron ne bohyɛlɛ
(Marko 14.22-26; Luka 22.14-20; 1 Korintofoɛ 11.23-25)
26 Bɛwɔ so bɔ bedidi nen, Yesu fale paanoo, oyirale so, obubuli nu, ɔfa mane asuafoɛ nemɔ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔle beli; ɛhe te me nwonaen.” 27Yeɛ ɔfale kulie, ɔlale ase, ɔfa mane bɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ́no bie; 28 ofikyɛ ɛhe yeɛ ɔte me mogya bɔ ogyi berɛ ma apam bɔ mmenia pee ti béhwie bégua bɛ́ma bɔnefakyɛ ɔ. 29Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, mengɔno bobe nzaa he ko kodwu kyẽa bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛkɔno ye foforɛ wɔ me Baba ahennie nu ɔ.” 30 Afei bɛtole ayɛyelɛ dwein, na befili berɛ bɛhɔle Olive Bokaa ne aso.
Yesu hyɛ Petro nzano nwo ngɔm
(Marko 14.27-31; Luka 22.31-34; Yohane 13.36-38)
31Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me nwo kɔyɛ sundidua kɔma ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye, ofikyɛ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Ngopura mmoaenneafoɛ ne, na mmoaen bɔ bɛwɔ kure ne anu ne, bɛkɔbɔ aya.’ 32 Nakoso me wutingyelɛ asi ne, ngoli ɛmɔ nyunu moa ngɔhɔ Galilea.”
33Yeɛ Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ nwo kɔyɛ sundidua kɔma bɛ mukoraa po a, me de, ɔngɔyɛ sundidua ngɔma me le!”
34 Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye, akɔ ngɔbɔ né ahã ye pɛen nza kyɛ ɛnze me.”
35 Na Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔba kyɛ me ne wɔ yɛwu po a, mengɔhã kyɛ menze wɔ!” Na sɔ ala yeɛ asuafoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛhane ɔ.
Yesu bɔ mbaeɛ wɔ Getsemane
(Marko 14.32-42; Luka 22.39-46)
36Yeɛ Yesu ne bɛ bɛhɔle nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Getsemane, na osele asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtena wa maa ngɔ dɔ ngɔmɔ mbaeɛ.” 37Na ɔfale Petro ne Sebedeo mma nyɔ nemɔ ɔbokale ye nwo so, na aworabɔlɛ ne ahunundetelɛ hyɛle ye bo tɔle ye so. 38Afei osele bɛ kyɛ, “Me kra wora abɔ paa kɔ ewue nu. Ɛmɔtena wa, ná ɛmɔ ne me wɛne.”
39Na ɔhɔle ye nyunu moa kãa nen, ɔfale ye nyunu butuli berɛ bɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, “Me Baba, sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yee a, ma sɔ kulie he ofi me so hɔ! Nakoso nna bɔ mepena hɔ ɔ, na mmom bɔ ɛpena ɔ.”
40Osa wale asuafoɛ nemɔ anwo berɛ; onwuni bɛ kyɛ balela, na osele Petro kyɛ, “Yiti ɛmɔangora bɛ ne me anwɛne dɔnhwere ko po? 41 Ɛ́mɔwɛne ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ, ná ɛmɔangɔ nzɔhwɛ nu. Sunzum ne kuro de, nakoso anwoɔnaen ne yɛ mmerɛ.”
42 Osa hɔle ye pɛen nyɔ so ɔɔbɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, “Me Baba, sɛ sɔ kulie he ngɔhora ngofi me so ngɔhɔ, ná sana meno a, ye de, bɔ ekuro yeɛ ɔyɛ berɛ ɔ.” 43Na ɔwale bɛ nwo berɛ oonwuni kyɛ balela bieku, ofikyɛ né bɛ nye twaa so.
44 Osa yakyili bɛ berɛ hɔle bieku ɔɔbɔle mbaeɛ ye pɛen nza so, na ɔhane edwirɛ komapɛ ne ala. 45 Yeɛ osa wale asuafoɛ nemɔ nwo berɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Yiti ɛmɔtɛda, ɛmɔtɛde ɛmɔ nwome? Ɛ́mɔnea! Mmerɛ ne adwu bɔ bɛbaaye Sona Awa ne bewura bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa ɔ. 46Ɛ́mɔdwɔso! Ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ! Ɛ́mɔnea, bɔ ɔbaaye me ma ne, wawa!”
Bɛhyele Yesu
(Marko 14.43-50; Luka 22.47-53; Yohane 18.3-12)
47Na Yesu gu so bɔ odwudwo nen, Yudase bɔ ɔte asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ anu ko ne, ɔwale. Na né ɛlɔen bɔ betiratira ngrandɛ ne mmopura, bɔ befi asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi mɔ berɛ ɔ bɛboka ye so. 48Na sona bɔ ɔyele ye mane ne, né wali moa wamaa bate ye bo kyɛ, “Sona bɔ ngɔfe ye noa ne, ye ɛne; ɛ́mɔhye ye!” 49Na berɛ ne ala, ɔwale Yesu nwo berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Rabi, asomdwee ha wɔ oo!” Na ɔfele ye noa.
50Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Me damvo, ɛwale wa kyɛ ɛbaayɔ nzu?” Yeɛ bɛwale Yesu so bɛfale bɛ sa bɛsosɔle ye nu bɛhyele ye. 51Na yieee, bɛ bɔ né bɛ ne Yesu wɔ berɛ ne, bɛ nu ko tengyɛle ye sa hwene ye ngrandɛ, na ɔfa bɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’akoaa pɛle ye so. 52 Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Fa wɔ ngrandɛ ne wura nekaa bɔ owura ɔ; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔtwe ngrandɛ ne, ngrandɛ noa yeɛ okowu ɔ. 53Ɛdwene kyɛ mengɔhora ngɔsrɛ me Baba maa ɔngɔsoma abɔfo asafokure bɔ bɛbo buru ne nyɔ kekesaala ye maa bɛngɔɔboka me anaa? 54Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Ahyerɛlɛ ne awa nu kyɛ, odi kyɛ sɔ yeɛ osi ɔ?”
55 Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ala, Yesu sele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Yiti ngrandɛ ne mmopura yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbakye me ɔ, kyɛ awerɔm awueniɛ bɔ ɛmɔba ye so ɔ? Ndenane asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu nyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ daa biala, nakoso ɛmɔangye me. 56 Na ɛhe amukoraa asi, amaa ɔnate so bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bahã ye wɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu ne wawa nu.” Yeɛ asuafoɛ nemɔ amukoraati bɛyakyili ye berɛ bɛnwatili.
Yesu gyi Yuda badwa nyunu
(Marko 14.53-65; Luka 22.54, 55, 63-71; Yohane 18.13, 14, 19-24)
57Bɛ bɔ bɛhyele Yesu ne, bɛfale ye bɛhɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa Kaifa berɛ, nekaa bɔ né ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne maen mbanyi mɔ bayia ɔ. 58Nakoso Petro de, olili ye si wɔ nziɛ nziɛ oodwuli ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’aluo berɛ, owurale nu, na ɔne somvoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane ase kyɛ ɔnea edwirɛ n’ayieleɛ. 59Na asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ ne badwafoɛ ne amukoraa bɛpenane edwirɛ bɔ bɛkɔfa bekoli Yesu nwo adanzewia ɔ, amaa ɔnate so banya ye bahu ye; 60nakoso bannya bie, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ adanzewiafoɛ pee bɛwale de. Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, mmenia nyɔ dwɔso gyinane, 61 na bɛhane kyɛ, “Sɔ akoaa he hane kyɛ, ‘Ngɔhora ngobubu Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, ná mafa ɛlɛsa masi.’ ” 62Na ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne dwɔso gyinane sele Yesu kyɛ, “Engobua ye nwo bie? Nzikyɛ anwo yeɛ mmenia hemɔ bédi adanzeɛ bétia wɔ ye?” 63 Nakoso Yesu yɛle dinn. Yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Mefa Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne meta ndaen megua wɔ so kyɛ, sɛ wɔ ole Kristo ne, Nyameɛ Awa ne a, kã kyire yɛ.”
64 Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Ye ala yeɛ ahã ne, nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ɛmɔkonwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ɔte Tumi sa famaa so, na ɔ́ba anwuro munungum so ɔ!”
65 Yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne sunzuale ye ndaadeɛ nu hane kyɛ, “Wahã musue dwirɛ! Adanzefoɛ bieku de, yɛhia yɛyɛ ye sɛ? Eh, afei de, ɛmɔate ye musue dwirɛ ne! 66 Ɛmɔdwene ye nwo sɛ?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ɔfata kyɛ beku ye ɔ.”
67 Afei bɛfefele nwɔserɛ beguale ye nyunu, bɛbobɔle ye, yeɛ ebiemɔ bobɔle ye nye so 68hane kyɛ, “Kã kyire yɛ e, Kristo! Nwa yeɛ ɔbɔle wɔ ne?”
Petro po Yesu
(Marko 14.66-72; Luka 22.56-62; Yohane 18.15-18, 25-27)
69Na Petro de, né ɔte aluo berɛ. Na afaneɛ bie wale ye nwo berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Wɔ koso, né ɛne Yesu Galileaniɛ ne yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.” 70Na ɔsale wɔ bɛ mukoraati bɛ nyunu berɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ ɛ́ka ne, menze ye nwo hwee.” 71Na ofili berɛ hɔle ngurolo ne anu dɔ ne, afaneɛ foforɛ nwuni ye, na osele bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ ne kyɛ, “Akoaa he, né ye koso ɔne Yesu Nasarɛteniɛ ne yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.” 72Na Petro tale ndaen sale bieku kyɛ, “Biaa ne, menze ye oo!”
73Wangyɛ biala, mmenia bɔ né begyigyi berɛ ne, bɛwale beesele Petro kyɛ, “Ɔte nahorɛ, wɔ koso ɛboka bɛ so, na wɔ dwudwolɛ koraa kyire sɔ!” 74Na Petro hyɛle ye bo lili amoen tale ndaen kyɛ, “Biaa ne, menze ye oo!” Na berɛ ne ala, akɔ bɔle. 75 Na Petro kayele edwirɛ bɔ Yesu hã hyirele ye ne, kyɛ, “Akɔ ngɔbɔ né ahã ye pɛen nza kyɛ ɛnze me.” Na ofite hɔle oosuni hahii.

Title: MATEO 27
Content:
Bɛfa Yesu begyina amrado Pilato nyunu
(Marko 15.1; Luka 23.1-2; Yohane 18.28-32)
1 Na aleɛ hyene ne, asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi amukoraa bɛhɔle Yesu nwo agyina bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bekohu ye. 2Bɛkyekyele ye, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔ beewurale amrado Pontio Pilato sa.
Yudase bɔ ye kɔme wu
(Asomafoɛ 1.18-19)
3 Yudase bɔ ɔyele ye mane ne, mmerɛ bɔ onwuni kyɛ babua Yesu ewue foɛ nen, onuni ye nwo, na ɔfale ɛdwetɛ aburasa ne sa brɛle asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi nemɔ, 4na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mayɔ bɔne kyɛ maye mogya bɔ odi be ɔ mama ɔ.” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛ de, ɔfa yɛ nwo nzu? Wɔ yeɛ ɔte wɔ dwirɛ ɔ!”
5 Na ɔtole ɛdwetɛ ne guale asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu berɛ, ofili berɛ hɔle, na ɔɔbɔle ye kɔme. 6 Yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ sesale ɛdwetɛ ne, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Mmeraa mma ate kyɛ yɛkɔfa yɛkogua fotoɛ alaka ne anu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte mogya sikaa.” 7Yiti bɛhɔle agyina, na bɛfa bɛtɔle ngukuenwonɛniɛ aseɛ ne, kyɛ so yeɛ bekosie amanvrafoɛ ɔ. 8 Yiti bɛfrɛ sɔ aseɛ ne Mogya Aseɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
9 Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Na belele ɛdwetɛ aburasa ne, nyɔboɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛbɔle kyɛ sɔ yeɛ odi ɔ, bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛle ye ti nyɔboɛ bɛtɔle ye ɔ, 10na bɛfa bɛtɔle ngukuenwonɛniɛ aseɛ, kyɛbɔ Awurade fale ahyɛdeɛ mane me ne.”
Pilato bisa Yesu dwirɛ
(Marko 15.2-5; Luka 23.3-5; Yohane 18.33-38)
11Né Yesu gyi amrado ne nyunu berɛ; na amrado ne bisale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Yudafoɛ Hene ne anaa?” Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Ye ala yeɛ ahã ne.” 12 Nakoso kwaadu bɔ asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛbɔle ye ne de, wammua ye nwo bie. 13Yeɛ Pilato bisale ye kyɛ, “Aso ɛnde kwaadu worawora bɔ bɛ́bɔ wɔ ye?” 14 Nakoso wamma ye mmuayɛɛ wɔ kwaadu komapɛ po anwo, na ɛhe yɛle amrado ne nwanwa paa.
Bebua Yesu ewue foɛ
(Marko 15.6-15; Luka 23.13-25; Yohane 18.39—19.16)
15Na aluolue ne anu, né ɔyɛ a amrado ne ɔyakyi kukununiɛ ko bɔ ɛlɔen ne bekuro ɔ ɔma bɛ. 16Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, né kukununiɛ bie bɔ oli Baraba bɔ wale dumaa paa ɔ ɔla nu. 17Yiti beyiale nen, Pilato bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ meyakyi ye mema ɛmɔ ɔ? Baraba anaa Yesu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kristo ne?” 18 Ofikyɛ, né Pilato se kyɛ ɛpɔen ti yeɛ baye Yesu bama ye ɔ.
19Asa koso, mmerɛ bɔ ɔtenane ndɛenbualɛ bia nu ne, ɔye somane maa bɛɛhã behyirele ye kyɛ, “Nnɛma ndoto biala ba wɔ ne sɔ biaa teneneeniɛ ne b’afia, ofikyɛ, ɔnate ye ti manwu amaneɛ pee wɔ laleɛ nu ɛnɛ kɔngɔen.”
20Yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛyele bɛ nye bewurale ɛlɔen ne kyɛ bɛsrɛ ma ɔyakyi Baraba, ná behũ Yesu. 21Yeɛ amrado ne sa bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia nyɔ ye, bɛ nu beni yeɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ meyakyi ye mema ɛmɔ ɔ?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Baraba!” 22Na Pilato bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade nzikyɛ yeɛ mva nyɛ Yesu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kristo ne ɔ?” Na bɛ mukoraa bɛhane kyɛ, “Maa bɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu!” 23Yeɛ Pilato bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ɔ, nzikyɛ bɔne yeɛ wayɔ ɔ?” Na bɛteateane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Maa bɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu!”
24 Na Pilato nwuni kyɛ ɔngɔhora ngɔyɔ ye nwo hwee, ná mmom basabasayɔlɛ yeɛ ɔpena ba ne, ɔfale nzue nwunzini ye sa wɔ ɛlɔen ne anyunu berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Sona teneneeniɛ he, medi be wɔ ye mogya nwo. Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ!” 25 Na maen ne amukoraa bebuale kyɛ, “Ye mogya ɔ́bɔ yɛ ne yɛ mma mɔ ti so!” 26Yeɛ ɔyakyili Baraba mane bɛ ɔ, na ofini Yesu mbire, na ɔyele ye mane bɛ kyɛ bɛɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu.
Asraafoɛ goro Yesu nwo
(Marko 15.16-20; Yohane 19.2-3; Luka 23.11)
27Yeɛ amrado n’asraafoɛ fale Yesu bɛhɔle amrado n’aluo berɛ, na bɛmane asraafoɛ ne amukoraa bɛpɛle ye nwo kango. 28Bɛyele ye ataadeɛ ne, na bɛfale ataadeɛ kɔkorɛ bie bɔ ɔkɔta bɛ kɔme anu ɔ beguale ye so; 29bɛfale mmowue bɛnwone abotire bɛbɔle ye, na bɛfale elemmire bewurale ye sa famaa nu; yeɛ bebuli ndwerɛ wɔ ye nyunu bɛgorole ye nwo kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ Hene, wɔ ngoa so oo!” 30 Bɛfefele nwɔserɛ beguale ye nwo, na belele ye sa nu elemmire ne bɛfa befifini ye ti anu. 31Na bɛgorole ye nwo beyiele nen, bɛyele ataadeɛ bɔ bafa bakata ye kɔme anu ne befili ye nwo, na bɛfale ye bɔbɔ ye ataadeɛ ne bewurale ye; na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaabɔ ye mmeamudua nu.
Bɛbɔ Yesu mmeamudua nu
(Marko 15.21-32; Luka 23.26-43; Yohane 19.17-27)
32Na befili berɛ bɔ bɛkɔ nen, beyiale Kireneniɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Simɔn; na bɛhyɛle ye maa ɔsoale Yesu mmeamudua ne. 33Beedwuli nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Golgota, bɔ ye bo kyire: “Tire Kokuroka so” nen, 34 bɛmane ye nzaa kekarekekare bɔ bafa abɔwee bafra nu ɔ kyɛ ɔno; nakoso ɔhane ye noa nen, wanguro kyɛ ɔno.
35 Na bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu nen, beguale serewa bɛhyɛle ye ndaadeɛ ne, [amaa ɔnate so, bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne hane ne wawa nu kyɛ: bɛhyɛle me ndena nu bɛfale, na beguale serewa bɛhyɛle me ndaadeɛ.] 36Afei bɛtenane ase bɛwɛnene ye. 37Na kwaadu bɔ bɛbɔle ye ne, bɛhyerɛ bɛfa bɛbɔle ye ti anwuro kyɛ, “Yesu Yudafoɛ Hene Ne Ɛhe!” 38 Yeɛ bɛbɔle awerɔm awuefoɛ nyɔ mmeamudua nu bɛbokale ye so, ko wɔ ye sa famaa so, yeɛ ko wɔ ye sa bɛen so.
39 Na bɛ bɔ bɛɛpɛle nu berɛ ne, bɛwosole bɛ ti bɛkekane dwirɛ betiale ye 40 kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔ edwiri asɔneyɛɛ sua ne gua, ná ɛfa ɛlɛsa si ne, de wɔ nwo e! Sɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne ole wɔ a, fi mmeamudua ne aso dwu ase!” 41Na sɔ ala koso yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi, ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne maen mbanyi bɛgorole ye nwo ɔ, 42kyɛ, “Olele ebiemɔ, nakoso ɔngora nne ye nwo! Sɛ ye yeɛ ɔte Yisraelfoɛ Hene ne a, maa odwu ase fi mmeamudua ne aso kekesaala ye, na yɛkole ye yɛkoli. 43 Ɔfale ye nwo tole Nyameɛ so; sɛ okuro ye dwirɛ a, maa ɔpepɛ ole ye e; ofikyɛ ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Me ole Nyameɛ Awa ne!’ ” 44Na awerɔm awuefoɛ bɔ bɛbɔle bɛ mmeamudua nu bokale ye so ne koso, bɛpepɛle ye nzoaa sɔ ala.
Yesu wue
(Marko 15.33-41; Luka 23.44-49; Yohane 19.28-30)
45Na ofi eyia duabien mmerɛ ne, awosii katale aseɛ so amukoraa maa ɔɔbɔle eyia nnɔnmmiɛnza. 46 Na ɔbɔle kɔyɛ eyia nnɔnmmiɛnza ne, Yesu teane nu serɛserɛ hane kyɛ, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Bɔ ye bo kyire kyɛ, “Me Nyameɛ, Me Nyameɛ, nzu ati yeɛ apo me ye?”
47Na mmenia bɔ né begyigyi berɛ ne bie tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔ́frɛ Elia!” 48 Na berɛ ne ala, bɛ nu ko tuli amirika ɔɔfale eminaen, ɔfa bɔle nzaa kekarekekare bie anu, na ɔfa tuale elemmire noa mane ye kyɛ ɔno. 49Nakoso bɛ ngaa ne hane kyɛ, “Yakyi, maa yɛnea sɛ Elia kɔwa koole ye a.”
50Na Yesu teane nu serɛserɛ bieku, na ɔyakyili ye sunzum nu. 51 Na yieee, ɛtena bɔ ɔpɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, nu suale nyɔ fili anwuro oodwuli ase; na aseɛ wosole, na nyɔbotaen mɔ nu dwudwale; 52asieleɛ mɔ so bukyebukyele, na mmenia krongron bɔ né balela nemɔ, bɛ nu pee tingyetingyele; 53 na ye wutingyelɛ asi ne, befili asieleɛ nemɔ anu bɛhɔle kuro krongron ne anu, na bɛyele bɛ nwo ali behyirele mmenia pee.
54 Na asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so, bɔ bɛwɛne Yesu ne, benwuni aseɛwosolɛ ne ne nningyein bɔ osisili nen, besurole paa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Amba, Nyameɛ Awa ne ɛhe!”
55 Né mmrasua pee wɔ berɛ bɔ begyigyi nziɛ bɛnea, na bɛ yeɛ belili Yesu si fili Galilea bɛsole ye ɔ; 56 né Maria Magdalene, Maria bɔ ye mma ole Yakobo ne Yosef, yeɛ Sebedeo mma nemɔ bɛ maame boka bɛ so.
Besie Yesu
(Marko 15.42-47; Luka 23.50-56; Yohane 19.38-42)
57 Odwuli nɔsoa nen, esikaniɛ bie bɔ ofi Arimatea, bɔ oli Yosef, bɔ ye koso ɔte Yesu suaniɛ ɔ ɔwale. 58Ɔhɔle Pilato berɛ ɔɔsrɛle Yesu fuin ne; na Pilato hyɛle kyɛ bɛfa efuin ne bɛma ye. 59Yiti Yosef fale efuin ne, ɔfale nwera kama kyekyele ye nwo, 60 na ɔfale ye tole ye bɔbɔ (Yosef) asieleɛ kumaa foforɛ bɔ wapɛ ye nyɔbotaen nu wato berɛ ɔ nu. Omununi nyɔboɛ pirikua bie katale asieleɛ ne noa, na ofili berɛ hɔle. 61Né Maria Magdalene ne Maria ko ne koso bɛwɔ berɛ, bɔ bɛtete asieleɛ ne ndendeneɛ so ɔ.
Asraafoɛ wɛne asieleɛ ne
62Aleɛ hyene ne, bɔ ɔte kyẽa bɔ ɔtoa anwoboaboa kyẽa ne aso nen, asɔfo mbanyi ne Farasiifoɛ beeyiale nu Pilato nyunu, 63 na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, yɛkaye kyɛ sɔ nnakannakaniɛ ne ɔte ase ne, ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛlɛsa asi ne, ngotingye’ 64Yiti maa bɛwɛne asieleɛ ne yé maa odwu ɛlɛsa ne aso, na anyɔ a, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ koowua ye [kɔngɔen] kɔhɔ, ná bahã bahyire maen ne kyɛ, ‘Watingye wafi awufoɛ nu;’ na ahaa sɔ nnakannaka bɔ oli nziɛ ne kɔtra daa deɛ ne.” 65Na Pilato sele bɛ kyɛ, “Asraafoɛ ɛhe! Ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛhɔ bɛɛwɛne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkɔhora ɔ.” 66 Yiti bɛhɔle bɛɛfale nikyee bɛtale nyɔboɛ ne noa, na bɛmane wɛmvoɛ mɔ wɛnene asieleɛ ne.

Title: MATEO 28
Content:
Yesu wutingyelɛ
(Marko 16.1-10; Luka 24.1-12; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Afofikyẽa ne pɛle nu, na dapɛn ne anu kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ye alebahyene, Maria Magdalene ne Maria ko ne bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaanea asieleɛ ne. 2 Na yieee, aseɛ wosole serɛserɛ; ofikyɛ Awurade abɔfo fili nyameɛso dwuli ase oomununi nyɔboɛ ne fili asieleɛ ne noa, na ɔtenane so. 3 Né ye nwo ta te kyɛ agralaa, na ye ataadeɛ ne te fufue kyɛ asukɔtwea. 4 Na ye nwo suronyi ne ati, awɛmvoɛ nemɔ nwo wosowosole bɛ, na bɛbɔle fuin.
5Na abɔfo ne sele mmrasua ne kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Na mese kyɛ ɛmɔpena Yesu bɔ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ne. 6 Ɔnne wa; ofikyɛ watingye, kyɛbɔ ɔhane ne ala. Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea nekaa bɔ né ɔla ne. 7 Yiti ɛmɔhã ɛmɔ nwo bɛhɔ, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ amaneɛ kyɛ watingye wafi awufoɛ nu. Na ɛ́mɔtie, ódi ɛmɔ nyunu moa kɔ Galilea, na berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkonwu ye ɔ!’ Ɛ́mɔtie, mahã mahyire ɛmɔ.”
8Yiti bele esuronyi ne anigye befili asieleɛ ne aso ndɛndɛ bɛhɔle; na betuli amirika bɛɛbɔle ye asuafoɛ nemɔ amaneɛ.
9 Na mvum nu, Yesu yiale bɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Asomdwee hã ɛmɔ oo!” Na bɛwale ye nwo berɛ bɛɛsosɔle ye gya, na bɛsɔnene ye. 10 Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro; na ɛmɔɔhã behyire nniɛma nemɔ kyɛ bɛhɔ Galilea, na dɔ yeɛ bekonwu me ɔ.”
Awɛmvoɛ nemɔ anga nahorɛ
11 Na mmerɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ nen, yieee, awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bie wale kuro ne anu bɛɛfale bɔ wasisi ne amukoraa bɛbɔle asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ amaneɛ. 12Na bɛ ne maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛhɔle agyina bɛfale ye nwo adwene, na bɛmane asraafoɛ nemɔ sikaa bɔ ɔsone ɔ; 13 na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Kɔngɔen ne bɔ yɛlale ne, yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale beewuale ye bɛhɔle ɔ.’ 14Na sɛ amrado ne te sɔ dwirɛ ne a, yɛkohyirehyire nu yɛkohyire ye, ná ɛmɔ nwo angyere ɛmɔ.” 15Yiti belele sikaa ne, na bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ ne ala. Na sɔ dwirɛ ne atrɛ wɔ Yudafoɛ nu maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
Yesu ye ye nwo ali kyire ye asuafoɛ nemɔ
(Marko 16.14-18; Luka 24.36-49; Yohane 20.19-23; Asomafoɛ 1.6-8)
16 Na asuafoɛ buru ne ko ne sili nu bɛhɔle Galilea, bokaa bɔ Yesu hyirele bɛ kyɛ bɛhɔ so ne aso. 17Na mmerɛ bɔ benwuni ye nen, bɛsɔnene ye, nakoso bɛ nu biemɔ anne anni. 18 Yeɛ Yesu pingyele bɛ nwo berɛ sele bɛ kyɛ: “Bafa nyameɛso ne aseɛ so tumi amukoraati bawura me sa. 19 Yiti ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛyɛ maen maen mukoraa m’asuafoɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ asu wɔ Baba ne, Baa ne ne Sunzum Krongron ne dumaa nu, 20 ná ɛmɔhyirehyire bɛ maa beli nikyee biala bɔ mahyɛ ɛmɔ ne aso. Na ɛ́mɔtie, me ne ɛmɔ wɔ berɛ mmerɛ biala kodwu ewiase ayieleɛ.”

Title: MARKO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Marko hyerɛle ye nzɛmba ne ɔɔmane Amaenmaensofoɛ, ɔnate kyɛ né ɔpena kyɛ benwu ye kyɛ Yesu ole Ngoadefoɛ ne bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kristo nen. Ye ala ole Nyameɛ Awa bɔ ɔfale ye bɔle Yisraelfoɛ anohoba bɔ ɔbaale bɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ mukoraa ngoa ne.
Afei Marko kyire kyɛ Yesu Kristo le tumi bɔ ɔfa yɔ anwanwa dwuma ɔ. Yɛnwu ye tumi ne wɔ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ nu, sunzummɔne so, anwonyerɛsalɛ nu, tumi bɔ ɔkora fa bɔne kyɛ ɔ, ɔne anwanwadeɛ pee yɔlɛ.
