13Na ebie fili ɛlɔen ne anu sele Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, dwudwo kyire nniɛma ná ɔma yɛhyɛ agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bayakyi yɛ ne.” 14Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Ngyabiaa, nwa yeɛ ɔfale me sili ndɛenbualɛniɛ anaa kyɛfoɛ wɔ ɛmɔ so ɔ?” 15Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ anyeboroborolɛ nwo; ofikyɛ nna agyapadeɛ somaa bɔ sona wanya ye ɔ yeɛ otira ye ngoa nyamaa nu ɔ.”
16Na obuli bɛ anyandera he: “Esikaniɛ bie ye aseɛ hyene aleɛ pee. 17Na osusuli ye nwo wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Ɛhe de, ngɔyɛ ye sɛ koraa, ofikyɛ nnne nekaa bɔ ngɔfa me nnɔbaeɛ ne ngosie ɔ?’ 18Na osele kyɛ: ‘Mese bɔ ngɔyɔ ɔ: Ngobubu me pata nemɔ ngogua, ná masisi bɔ bɛte mbiri ɔ, na berɛ yeɛ ngɔfa me nnɔbaeɛ ne me nningyein amukoraa ngosie ɔ; 19ná afei mahã mahyire me kra kyɛ: Ɛkra, ele nningyein paa pee bɔ bafa basie berɛ bama wɔ bɔ okoli afoɛ pee ɔ; yiti de wɔ nwome, didi ná no, ná gye wɔ nye.’ 20Nakoso Nyameɛ sele ye kyɛ, ‘Kwaseambane! Kɔngɔen ye ala ngole wɔ kra ngofi wɔ sa nu; na nningyein bɔ apena agua berɛ ne, nwa yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ ye deɛ ɔ?’ 21Na sɔ ala yeɛ sona bɔ ɔboaboa agyapadeɛ noa ma ye nwo, nakoso olle anwonyadeɛ huu wɔ Nyameɛ nu ne ɔte ɔ.”
Fa wɔ nwo to Nyameɛ so
(Mateo 6.25-34)
22Afei Yesu sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ asetena nu adwenedwene tɔ ɛmɔ so, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkoli ɔ; anaa ɛmɔ nipadua nwo, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhera ɔ. 23Ɔnate kyɛ ngoa nwo hia tra aleɛ, yeɛ nipadua koso nwo hia tra ɛtena. 24Ɛ́mɔnea adene mɔ, bɛnyɔ boo, bɛngɔmva eboo so aleɛ, yeɛ belle aleɛ bɔ bafa basie ɔ anaa pata; nakoso Nyameɛ ma bɛ aleɛ. Aso ɛmɔ nwo nhia ndra nnomaa hɔ ɔ! 25Na ɛmɔ nu beni yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔdwenedwene kɔfa ɛlɛho kɔtoa ye ngoa so ɔ? 26Na sɛ ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔyɔ bɔ ɔte kaaba he po a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene bɔ ɔboka so nemɔ nwo ɔ? 27 Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛbɔ sukooko mɔ besi benyi ɔ: bɛnyɔ adwuma, bɛnnwo tena, nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Solomon animnyam amukoraa nu ne po, ye anwosiesie ne ando ɛhemɔ anu ko po. 28Na sɛ Nyameɛ siesie eburo ndire bɔ ogyi berɛ ɛnɛ maa ɔyɛ nyemene, ná ɛhema bapɛ bayera ye foonoo nu po a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ongosiesie ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔ nwo ngɔyɛ nyemene ngɔtra so ɔ? Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ! 29Sɔ ala yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔpena bɔ ɛmɔkoli ɔ, anaa bɔ ɛmɔkɔno ɔ; yeɛ nnɛmɔmaa ɔyɛ ɛmɔ so adwenedwene. 30Ofikyɛ ewiasefoɛ yeɛ bɛdwenedwene ɛhemɔ amukoraa nwo ɔ. Na ɛmɔ Baba se kyɛ ɛmɔhia sɔ nningyein nemɔ. 31Yiti ɛ́mɔpena Nyameɛ ahennie ne mmom, na ɔkɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa kɔboka ɛmɔ so.
Nyameɛso agyapadeɛ
(Mateo 6.19-21)
32“Fekue kaaba, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Ofikyɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ Baba ne fɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa ahennie ne kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ. 33Ɛ́mɔtɔne bɔ ɛmɔle ye ɔ ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɛ adɔeɛ; ɛ́mɔyɔ sikaa bɔtɔ mɔ bɔ bɛnyɛ daa ɔ bɛfa, ɔne agyapadeɛ bɔ benyie le ɔ wɔ nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ awuefoɛ bɛmma berɛ, ná mvrɔlɔ koso benni ɔ. 34Ɔnate kyɛ, nekaa bɔ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔ ahone koso wɔ ɔ.
Ɛ́mɔwɛne
35“Ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ abɔsoɛ nu ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ kanea ogye, 36ná ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛnwondɛ kyɛ bɛ mene kofi atɔmvorɛ bo kɔwa ɔ; amaa sɛ ɔba babɔ anoa nu a, babukye ye berɛ ne ala! 37Na ngoaa bɔ bɛ mene ba a, ɔbato bɛ kyɛ bɛwɛne ne, benya saleɛ! Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔkɔbɔ ye abɔsoɛ, ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔtena poen nwo, ná wawa waaso bɛ. 38Sɛ ɔba abunnamu anaa alebahyene, ná ɔbato bɛ sɔ a, sɔ ngoaa nemɔ benya saleɛ. 39 Na ohia kyɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ, sɛ awuro mene ne ɔse mmerɛ bɔ awueniɛ ne kɔwa a, [ahaa ɔkɔwɛne], ahaa ɔngɔma ongonya ate ngootu ye anoa bo. 40Yiti ɛmɔ koso, ɛ́mɔsiesie ɛmɔ nwo bésie; ɔnate kyɛ Sona Awa ne kɔwa mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nye ɔlla so ɔ nu.”
Akoaa nahorɛniɛ ne akoaa bɔnefoɛ ne
(Mateo 24.45-51)
41Yeɛ Petro bisale Yesu kyɛ, “Awurade, anyandera he, ebu ma yɛ, anaakyɛ ebu ma mmenia mukoraa?” 42Na Awurade buale kyɛ, “Nwa ole awuro so neafoɛ nahorɛniɛ ne nworɛniɛ ne, bɔ ye mene kɔfa ye awuro berɛ ngoaa mɔ kowura ye sa, kyɛ ɔma bɛ b’aleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ɔ? 43Akoaa bɔ ye mene ba banwu ye kyɛ sɔ ala yeɛ ogu so ɔyɔ ne, onya saleɛ. 44Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔkɔfa ye nningyein amukoraa kowura ye sa. 45Nakoso sɛ sɔ akoaa ne kã ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Me mene onnya ɔwwale,’ ná ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔbo ngoaa mmienzua ne ngoaa mmrasua nemɔ, ná odidi ná ɔno nzaa bo a, 46ye de, sɔ akoaa ne mene kɔwa kyẽa bɔ okoofu ye nu ɔ, ɔne dɔnhwere bɔ ɔnze ɔ nu; na ɔkɔpepɛ akoaa ne nu ahuronzi ahuronzi, ná wamaa wanya asobrakyeɛfoɛ bɛ kyɛfa ne bie.
47“Akoaa bɔ ɔse bɔ ye mene kuro, nakoso wammoaboa ye nwo wanzie, anaa wanyɔ ye mene apɛdeɛ nen, ɔkɔbo ye botorɔ. 48Nakoso akoaa bɔ ɔnze, ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔfata ɛborɛ nen, bɛkɔbo ye kãa bie. Na ebiala bɔ bama ye somaa ne, bekobisa somaa bekofi ye berɛ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ mmenia afa somaa bawura ye sa ne, bekobisa somaa bɔ ɔbo so ɔ bekofi ye berɛ.
Yesu ti ndetemuɛ kɔwa
(Mateo 10.34-36)
49“Mmale kyɛ mebaafa see meto aseɛ nu, na me kunu a, ahaa see la nu! 50 Asubɔlɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛbaafa bɛbɔ me ɔ, na sɛ bɛffa bɛbbɔle me beyyiele a, nnyane anwotɔ. 51Ɛmɔdwene kyɛ asomdwee yeɛ mafa mawa aseɛ so ɔ? Daabi oo, na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndetemuɛ ɔ. 52Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, mmenia nnu bɔ bɛwɔ awuro ko anu ɔ, bɛ nu kɔtete. Nza kɔyɛ ko kotia nyɔ, né nyɔ ayɛ ko atia nza. 53 Bɛ nu kɔtete, seɛ kɔho kotia baa bienzua, yeɛ baa bienzua kɔho kotia seɛ; niɛ kɔho kotia baa brasua, yeɛ baa brasua kɔho kotia niɛ; hyireni kɔho kotia sia brasua, né sia brasua aho atia ohyireni.”
Mmerɛ nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bo hyirelɛ
(Mateo 16.2-3)
54Na Yesu sele ɛlɔen ne koso kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ esue amuna eyia atɔleɛ a, ndɛndɛ so ɛmɔkã kyɛ, ‘Esue baatɔ’; na ɔtɔ koso amba. 55Yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ mvrama ɔbɔ fi ngwaen dɔ a, ɛmɔnwa, ‘Ahuhuro baawa’; na ɔba koso amba. 56Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ɛmɔkora bekyire aseɛ ne ewienu nzesãleɛ bo, nakoso nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔngora bengyire mmerɛ ye anu bo ɔ?
Ɛ́mɔli ɛmɔ afia dwirɛ
(Mateo 5.25-26)
57“Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔmmu bɔ ɔtengyɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ? 58Sɛ ɛne ebie bɔ wabɔ wɔ kwaadu begu so bɛ́kɔ tuminiɛ nyunu a, ɛmɔwɔ atunu bɔ ɛ́mɔkɔ ne, bɔ mmɔden ɛne ye besiesie ɛmɔ afia, ná wandwe wɔ wangɔ ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne nyunu, ná ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne wamva wɔ wanwura kuku nu wɛmvoɛ ne sa, ná wɛmvoɛ ne amva wɔ wando kuku nu. 59Na mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, sɛ andua kerɛ ne amukoraa pɛsɛɛ a, bɛngɔye wɔ ma ɛngɔhɔ.”

Title: LUKA 13
Content:
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Sɔ mmerɛ ne ala nu, né mmenia biemɔ wɔ berɛ, na bɛhane Galileafoɛ bɔ Pilato fale bɛ mogya frafrale b’afɔleɛ mɔ ne nwo dwirɛ behyirele ye. 2Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Galileafoɛ bɔ benwuni sɔ amaneɛ ne, ɛmɔdwene kyɛ né bɛte bɔnefoɛ bɛtra Galileafoɛ ngaa ne amukoraa ti ɔ? 3Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, daabi. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanzakyera ɛmɔ adwene a, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔkowu ɔ. 4Anaa mmenia buru ne mmɔtwɛ bɔ Siloam abandenden bu guale bɛ so huni bɛ ne, ɛmɔdwene kyɛ né bɛte bɔnefoɛ bɛtra mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛte Yerusalem anaa? 5Daabi, na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔanzakyera ɛmɔ adwene a, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔkowu ɔ.”
Borɔdoma bakaa bɔ onzu mmaa ne
6Na Yesu buli bɛ anyandera he: “Né biaa bie walua borɔdoma bakaa wɔ ye bondua boo nu. Ɔhɔle kyɛ ɔkwaapena so mmaa ne bie, na wannya bie. 7Yiti osele borɔdoma boo so hwɛsoniɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Nea, afoɛ nza mumua ɛhe yeɛ mawa kyɛ mebaatete bakaa he aso mmaa bɔ mannya bie ɔ. Bu ye to! Nzu ati yeɛ ɔsɛkye aseɛ mbaen ɔ?’ 8Na obuale ye kyɛ, ‘Me mene, maa ogyina berɛ afoɛ he koso, kɔpem kyɛ ngofumvu ye bo, ná ngɔfa fofoɛ ngoguagua ye bo ɔ. 9Sɛ osu mmaa afoɛ bieku a, ye de né ye paa nu ɔ; nakoso sɛ wanzu de a, né abu ye mato.’ ”
Yesu sa anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa
10Afofikyẽa bie, né Yesu ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ nyianu sua nemɔ ko anu. 11Né braa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ sunzum bie afa anwonyerɛ ato ye so afoɛ buru ne mmɔtwɛ ɔ; né ye nu akondo bɔ ɔngora ye nu tengyɛ koraa po ɔ. 12Na Yesu nwuni ye ne, ɔfrɛle ye sele ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, wɔ nwo asande wɔ afi w’anwonyerɛ ne anu!” 13Na ɔfale ye sa guale ye so, na berɛ ne ala ye nu tengyɛle, na ɔyele Nyameɛ ayɛ.
14 Nakoso nyianu sua ne anu panyi ne fɛle yaa kyɛ Yesu asa anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa ɔ, na osele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Elesia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ adwuma ɔ. Sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ yeɛ ɛmɔbra ma bɛsa ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ ɔ, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ afofikyẽa.”
15Yeɛ Awurade buale ye kyɛ, “Nyaatwomfoɛ! Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔnzangye ye nandwie anaa ye afunum mvi nekaa bɔ odidi ɔ afofikyẽa, ná ɔmva ye ngɔ maa ɔngɔno nzue ɔ? 16Sɔ braa he, ɔte Abraham bosoniɛ bɔ Abɔnzam akyekye ye afoɛ buru ne mmɔtwɛ mumua ɛhe; aso ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛsangye ye befi ɛkyekyelɛ he anu afofikyẽa anaa?” 17Na ɔhane sɔ nen, ye pɔfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛfɛrele; na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nye gyele animnyam nningyein bɔ ɔyɔle ne amukoraa nwo.
Sinapi baa nwo anyandera
(Mateo 13.31-32; Marko 4.30-32)
18Na Yesu bisale kyɛ, “Nyameɛ ahennie ne, sɛɛ yeɛ ɔte ɔ, na nzikyɛ anwo yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔtoto ɔ? 19Ɔte kyɛ sinapi baa ko bɔ biaa bie fa ooluale ye wɔ ye bondua boo nu ɔ. Onyini yɛle bakaa piri, na ewienu nnomaa bɛnwone bɛ saen wɔ ye mmaen nemɔ aso.”
Mɔle harewaa nwo anyandera
(Mateo 13.33)
20Yesu bisale bieku kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nwo yeɛ ngɔfa Nyameɛ ahennie ne ngɔtoto ɔ? 21Ɔte kyɛ mɔle harewaa bɔ braa bie fa forale esam kongo nza maa odwuli kyɛ ye mukoraa tuli ɔ.”
Anoa bɔtɔfee ne
(Mateo 7.13, 14, 21-23)
22Yesu hyinini nguro ne nguraa mɔ nu yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ, na ɔfale so kyɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem. 23Na ebie bisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, mmenia kãa bie yeɛ bekole bɛ ngoa hɔ anaa?” Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, 24“Ɛ́mɔpere béwura anoa bɔtɔfee ne anu! Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia pee bɛkɔpena kyɛ bekowura nu ɔ, na bɛngɔhora. 25Na sɛ awuro ne mene dwɔso to anoa ne anu pɛ a, yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ye bo bekogyina ye si ɔ, na ɛmɔkɔbɔ anoa ne anu bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Yɛ Mene, Yɛ Mene, bukye anoa ne ma yɛ.’ Na okobua ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Menze nekaa bɔ ɛmɔfi ɔ.’ 26Yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ye bo bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Yɛdidili ná yɛnone wɔ wɔ nyunu, na ɛyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ yɛ mmorɔnoɛ so.’ 27 Na okose kyɛ, ‘Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, menze nekaa bɔ ɛmɔfi ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ!’ 28 Na sɛ ɛmɔnwu Abraham, Yisake, Yakob ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa kyɛ bɛwɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu, ná ɛmɔ de bafoa ɛmɔ bafi nu a, ɛmɔkɔbɔ awuye ná ɛmɔanwose ɛmɔ gye. 29Na mmenia kofi eyia afiteleɛ, eyia atɔleɛ, sorɔ ne ngwaen bɛkɔɔtena ɛpoentolɛ bo wɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu. 30 Na ɛ́mɔtie, ebiemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ baha nziɛ bɔ bekoli moa ɔ; yeɛ ebiemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ bali moa bɔ bɛkɔha nziɛ ɔ.”
Yesu kuro Yerusalem dwirɛ
(Mateo 23.37-39)
31Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Farasiifoɛ biemɔ wale beesele ye kyɛ, “Fi wa kɔ, ofikyɛ Herode pena wɔ ku wɔ!” 32Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔhã behyire sɔ safuboa ne kyɛ, ‘Tie, métutu sunzummɔne mɔ ná mesa anwonyerɛ ɛnɛ ne ɛhema, na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso ngoyie m’adwuma.’ 33Nakoso ɛnɛ ne ɛhema ne ye alehyeleɛ de, ɔsɛ kyɛ metoa m’ateetulɛ ne aso; ofikyɛ ɔkɔyɛ se kyɛ bekohu ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ wɔ nekaa bie, sana Yerusalem.
34“O, Yerusalem, Yerusalem, wɔ bɔ eku ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ná ɛboro bɛ bɔ basoma bɛ wɔ berɛ nyɔboɛ ɔ! Mmerɛ nyɛɛ ɛhe yeɛ mbenane kyɛ ahaa meboaboa wɔ mma noa, kyɛbɔ akɔtaen boaboa ye mma noa wura ye ndaa bo ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔambene so! 35 Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛkɔyakyi ɛmɔ awuro ne berɛ dandue bɛkɔma ɛmɔ. Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔngonwu me ko maa okoodwu mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Saleɛ ole bɔ ɔnate Awurade dumaa nu ɔ́ba ye!’ ”

Title: LUKA 14
Content:
Yesu sa biaa bie anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa
1Na ɔwale kyɛ afofikyẽa bie, ɔhɔle Farasiiniɛ panyi bie awuro kyɛ ɔkwaadidi nen, né bɛtetɛ ye bɛnea. 2Na yieee, né biaa bie bɔ ye nwo anwunwu ɔ ɔwɔ ye nyunu berɛ. 3Na Yesu bisale mmeraa nwo nimdeɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Aso yɛ mmeraa ma ate kyɛ yɛsa anwonyerɛ afofikyẽa anaakyɛ ɔmma ate?” 4Na bɛyɛle dinn. Na ɔsɔle ye nu sale ye anwonyerɛ, na ɔmaa ɔhɔle. 5 Afei obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ sɛ ye afunum anaa nandwie tɔ kumaa nu afofikyẽa a, ɔngɔyɛ ndɛndɛ ngɔɔye ye berɛ ne ala ɔ?” 6Na bangora ɛhe noa ye.
Anwobrɛaseɛ ne adɔeɛyɛlɛ nwo dwirɛ
7Na bɛ bɔ bato bɛ sa bafrɛ bɛ ne, Yesu nwuni kyɛ mbanyi bia yeɛ bɛpere bɛtena so ɔ, yiti obuli bɛ anyandera sele bɛ kyɛ, 8 “Sɛ ebie to ye sa frɛ wɔ atɔmvorɛ bo a, nnɛkɔtena mbanyi bia so! Ebiaa né wato ye sa wafrɛ ebie bɔ ɔte titire tra wɔ ɔ. 9Na bɔ ɔtole ye sa frɛle wɔ ne ye ne, ɔkɔwa koose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Fa wɔ bia ne ma ɛhe!’ Na afei ele ɛfɛrelɛ ɛkɔɔtena ahameɛ bia bie aso. 10Yiti sɛ ebie to ye sa frɛ wɔ a, kɔ ná kɔtena ahameɛ bia bie so, amaa sɛ bɔ ɔtole ye sa frɛle wɔ ne ba a, wahã wahyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Me damvo, kɔtena anwuro dɔ bie.’ Na ɛhe kɔmaa ekonya animnyam wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛne bɛ bɛte poen nwo bedidi ne anyunu. 11 Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so ne, bɛkɔbrɛ ye ase; na bɔ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ne, bɛkɔma ye so.”
12Afei osele bɔ ɔtole ye sa frɛle ye ne kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛto poen eyia anaa nɔsoa a, nnɛfrɛfrɛ wɔ mmango mɔ anaa eliɛma mɔ anaa w’abusuafoɛ anaa wɔ mandamu berɛ sikafoɛ. Ebiaa né bɛ koso bato bɛ sa bafrɛ wɔ bie bafa basi ye gya nu. 13Yiti sɛ ɛto poen a, to wɔ sa frɛ ehiafoɛ, mmubuafoɛ, abafaen mɔ ne anyesiniwaafoɛ, 14na ekonya saleɛ; ofikyɛ bɛ de, bɛngɔhora bie yɔ ma wɔ ngɔfa ngosi ye gya nu. Na teneneefoɛ edwɔsolɛ ne anu yeɛ wɔ sa kɔhã ye nwo akatuaa ɔ.”
Ɛpoentolɛ piri ne nwo anyandera
(Mateo 22.1-10)
15Na bɛ bɔ né bɛ ne Yesu bɛte poen nwo bedidi ne, nu ko tele edwirɛ he nen, osele Yesu kyɛ, “Bɔ okodidi wɔ Nyameɛ ahennie nu ne, wanya saleɛ!” 16Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Biaa bie tole poen piri bie, na ɔtole ye sa frɛle mmenia pee. 17Na adidie mmerɛ dwuli nen, ɔsomane ye somvoɛ kyɛ oose bɛ bɔ wato ye sa wafrɛ bɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔbra, na m’anwoboa atotɔ nu!’ 18Na bɛ mukoraa bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛyeyele ye noa. Bɔ oli moa ne sele ye kyɛ, ‘Matɔ aseɛ bie, na ɔsɛ kyɛ mekɔnea; mesrɛ wɔ, mengɔhora ba.’ 19Bɔ ɔtoa berɛ ne nwa: ‘Matɔ nandwie nyii nyɔ nyɔ bɔ bafa kɔnnua basosɔ bɛ babɔ nu ɔ sɔ alaa nnu, bɔ mekwaafa bɛ meyɔ adwuma menea ɔ, mesrɛ wɔ, mengɔhora ba.’ 20Na foforɛ koso nwa: ‘Magya braa kekesaala ye, yiti mengɔhora ba.’
21“Yiti somvoɛ ne sa wale ɔɔbɔle ye mene amaneɛ. Yeɛ ye mene ne fɛle yaa, na osele ye somvoɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera, ná kɔ kuro nu dɔ dwaa nemɔ aso ne mandamu, ná fa ehiafoɛ, mmubuafoɛ, anyesiniwaafoɛ ne abafaen mɔ bra!’ 22Yeɛ somvoɛ ne hane kyɛ, ‘Me mene, mayɔ bɔ ɛhyɛle ne, nakoso nekaa bieku tɛwɔ berɛ.’ 23Na meneɛ ne sele somvoɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Kɔ atimbire mɔ ne fie atee mɔ so, ná hyɛ mmenia ma bɛbra nu,‘ ná m’awuro wa oyi to. 24Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia bɔ ndole me sa mvrɛle bɛ ne, bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ m’aleɛ ye kaala kɔhã ye noa ɔ!’ ”
Yesu si lilɛ nwo dwirɛ
(Mateo 10.37-38)
25Né mmenia pee yeɛ bɛne Yesu bɛ́kɔ ɔ, na ɔkakyili ye nwo sele bɛ kyɛ, 26 “Sɛ ebie ba me berɛ, ná ɔmbɔ ɔse ne oni, ɔye ne ye mma, oliɛma mmienzua ne oliɛma mmrasua, ɔne ye bɔbɔ ye ngoa a, ngɔhora ngɔyɛ me suaniɛ. 27 Yeɛ ebiala bɔ wanzoa ye mmeamudua ná wanni me si nen, ɔngɔhora ngɔyɛ me suaniɛ.
28“Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ sɛ ɔpena kyɛ osi abandenden a, ongoli moa ngɔtena ase ngɔsese kerɛ bɔ ɔkɔbɔ ɔ koraka, sɛ ole bɔ ɔkɔsõ ye si yie a? 29Sɛ wanyɔ sɔ a, ɔto ye bo fapem yie, ná wangora ye si yie a, ebiala bɔ okonwu ye sɔ ne, ɔkɔhyɛ ye bo kɔsere ye 30kyɛ, ‘Biaa he hyɛle ye bo kyɛ osi, nakoso wangora wanyie.’
31“Anaakyɛ ɛhene beni yeɛ ɔne ɛhene bie bɛkwaaho koɛ, bɔ ongoli moa ɔngɔtena ase ngɔfa ye nwo adwene, sɛ ɔkɔhora kɔfa asraafoɛ apee buru okooyia ɛhene bɔ ole asraafoɛ apee aburanyɔ ɔbaafa koɛ toa ye ne a? 32Na sɛ ɔnea ná ɔngɔhora a, mmerɛ bɔ ko ne ɔwɔ nziɛ nziɛ ne, otu ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛkɔsrɛ ye kyɛ ɔma besiesie b’afia. 33Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ nu biala bɔ ɔnyakyi bɔ ole ye amukoraa berɛ ne, ɔngɔhora ngɔyɛ me suaniɛ ɔ.
Ngyee bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ
(Mateo 5.13; Marko 9.50)
34“Ngyee te nikye paa, nakoso sɛ nu fɛɛ tu a, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekowura ye maa okosa kɔkakyi ngyee ɔ? 35Ɔmvata eboo aseɛ anaa fofoɛ bɔ bɛfa bedua nningyein ɔ, na mmom begyi begua. Bɔ ole asoɛ tie ne, maa otie!”

Title: LUKA 15
Content:
Boaen bɔ wamini ne
(Mateo 18.12-14)
1 Afei, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bepingyele Yesu nwo berɛ kyɛ bɛbaatie ye noa dwirɛ. 2Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛyɛle nwuhunwuhu kyɛ, “Biaa he ode bɔnefoɛ to nu, na osa ne bɛ bedidi.” 3Yiti obuli bɛ anyandera kyɛ, 4“Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ sɛ ole mmoaen ɛyaa ko, ná nu ko mini a, ɔngɔyakyi aburahona ne ngona ne wɔ ɛserɛ so berɛ, ná ɔngɔɔpena ko bɔ wamini ne kɔpem kyɛ okonwu ye ɔ? 5Na sɛ onwu ye a, ɔfa ye to ye kɔme anwo, na odi ahurusi. 6Na sɛ ɔba awuro a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ye mmango mɔ ne ye mandamu berɛ ama maa bɛbayia, na ose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛgye yɛ nye, ofikyɛ manwu me boaen bɔ ominini ne.’ 7Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ bɔnefoɛ ko sakyera ye adwene a, ye nwo anigye ba nyameɛso tra bɔ ɔba mmenia tenenee aburahona ne ngona bɔ benhia adwenesakyera nwo ɔ.
Esikadwetɛ bɔ wamini ne
8“Anaakyɛ brasua beni yeɛ ole sikadwetɛ buru, ná nu ko mini a, ɔngɔsɔ kanea ngɔpoa sua nu berɛ, ná ɔngɔyere ye nwo ngɔpena kɔpem kyɛ okonwu ye ɔ? 9Na sɛ onwu ye a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ye mmango mɔ ne ye mandamu berɛ ama maa bɛbayia, na ose kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛgye yɛ nye, ofikyɛ manwu sikadwetɛ bɔ ominini ne.’ 10Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ bɔnefoɛ ko sakyera ye adwene a, ye nwo anigye ba Nyameɛ abɔfo mɔ bɛ nyunu ɔ.”
Baa sɛkyefoɛ ne nwo anyandera
11Yeɛ Yesu sele kyɛ, “Né biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ole mmaa mmienzua nyɔ ɔ. 12Bɛ nu kãa ne sele ye baba kyɛ, ‘Baba, agyapadeɛ ne, fa me kyɛfa deɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nu ɔ ma me!’ Yiti baba ne hyɛle ye nningyein nu mane bɛ. 13Na wangyɛ biala yeɛ baa kãa ne boaboale ye agyapadeɛ deɛ amukoraa noa ɔ, na otuli atee hɔle maen bɔ ɔwɔ dede bie aso, na dɔ yeɛ ɔbɔle asanzabra mane ye anwodeɛ ne fili ye sa ɔ. 14Na ye mukoraa fili ye sa yiele nen, ɛhɔen piri bie pene sɔ maen ne anu, na ye nwo hyɛle ye bo hyerele ye. 15Yiti ɔfale ye nwo ɔɔbɔle kuromani bie wɔ maen ne anu, na ɔmaa ɔhɔle nekaa bɔ osie ye mbrako ɔ kyɛ ɔɔnea bɛ so. 16Na ye komvi wale so kyɛ onya aleɛ bɔ mbrako nemɔ bedi ne bie a ahaa okoli kɔma ye ko koyi; nakoso ebiala amma ye bie. 17Afei ye nye wale ye nwo so, na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Apaafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ me baba awuro ɔ bedidi bɛma bɛ ko yi ma ebie ka, yeɛ me de, ɛhɔen dosa me wɔ wa ye! 18Ngodwɔso ngɔhɔ me baba berɛ, ná mahã mahyire ye kyɛ: Baba, mayɔ nyameɛso ne wɔ nyunu bɔne; 19memvata kyɛ ɛkɔfrɛ me ɛwa ko ɔ, fa me yɛ kyɛ w’apaafoɛ nemɔ anu ko.’
20Yiti odwɔsole sili nu kyɛ osa kɔ ye baba berɛ. Na ɔwɔ dedeede nen, yeɛ ye baba nwuni ye ɔ, na ɔyɛle ye anwumvo, na baba ne tuli amirika ɔɔfale ye sa tole ye kɔme anu, na ɔyɛle ye awaawaatuu. 21Na ɔwa ne sele ye kyɛ, ‘Baba, mayɔ nyameɛso ne wɔ nyunu bɔne, na memvata kyɛ ɛkɔfrɛ me ɛwa ko ɔ.’ 22Yeɛ ye baba ne sele ye ngoaa nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔhã bɛ nwo bɛɛfa ataadeɛ paa beewura ye; ɛ́mɔfa pɛteaa bewura, ná ɛ́mɔfa mbaboa bewura ye; 23ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ walɔ ɔ bɛbra beehu ye, ná ɛ́mɔma yɛgye yɛ nye; 24ofikyɛ mma he owuli, na watingye; ominini, na manwu ye.’ Na bɛhyɛle ye bo kyɛ bɛgye bɛ nye.
25“Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɔwa panyi ne wɔ fieso. Na osa ba ná opingyele awuro nen, ɔtele edwein ne abiliegolɛ. 26Yiti ɔfrɛle ngoaa nemɔ nu ko, na obisale ye penane bɔ ye ti yeɛ sɔ nikyee ne ɔkɔ so ne. 27Na obuale ye kyɛ, ‘Eliɛma ne awa, na wɔ baba ahu nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ walɔ ne, ɔnate kyɛ ye sa ahã ye wɔ asomdwee nu.’
28“Nakoso ɔfɛle yaa, na wanguro kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ awuro berɛ ɔ. Yiti ye baba fite wale ɔɔkorɔkorɔle ye kyɛ ɔbra awuro. 29Na obuale ye baba kyɛ, ‘Tie, afoɛ worawora he yeɛ mafa maso wɔ ɔ, yeɛ wɔ dwirɛ koso nnyɛle ye nwo asoserɛ le; nakoso abɔngye ba po, ɛmmane me bie le kyɛ me ne me mmango mɔ yɛfa yɛgye yɛ nye. 30Nakoso ɛwa he bɔ wasɛkye w’agyapadeɛ wɔ gyanderafoɛ nwo ne, ɔwale ye ala pɛ, ahu nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ walɔ ne ama ye!’ 31Na osele ye kyɛ, ‘Mma, wɔ de, ɛwɔ me nwo wa mmerɛ biala, na me nikyee biala te wɔ deɛ. 32Ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛgye yɛ nye ná yɛmaa ɔyɛ yɛ fɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ eliɛma ye, owuli, na watingye; ominini, na manwu ye.’ ”

Title: LUKA 16
Content:
Hwɛsoniɛ anyeteɛ ne nwo anyandera
1Na Yesu sa sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Né sikaniɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ole hwɛsoniɛ bɔ ɔnea ye agyapadeɛ so ɔ. Na bɛɛbɔle ye kwaadu behyirele ye kyɛ ɔ́sɛkye ye agyapadeɛ ne. 2Yiti ɔfrɛle ye bisale ye kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ metete mefa wɔ nwo ye? Wɔ nhwɛsoɛ adwuma ne, bra baabu ye nwo ngondaa, ofikyɛ mengɔma ɛngɔyɛ hwɛsoniɛ adwuma ne ko.’ 3Na hwɛsoniɛ ne hane ye ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Na ɛhe de, meyɛ ye sɛ, ofikyɛ me mene ɔbaale nhwɛsoɛ adwuma ne ofi me sa nu. Me nwo nyɛ se bɔ ngɔhora adwuma serɛ yɔ ɔ, yeɛ mefɛre koso kyɛ ngɔsrɛsrɛ ɔ. 4Mese bɔ ngɔyɔ ɔ, na sɛ ode me nhwɛsoɛ adwuma ne ofi me sa a, ngonya mmenia bɔ bekole me b’awuro mɔ nu ɔ.’
5“Yiti ɔfrɛfrɛle bɛ bɔ bɛma ye mene kerɛ ne maa bɛwale ye berɛ ngoko ngoko, na obisale bɔ oli moa ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛma me mene kerɛ sɛɛ?’ 6Obuale kyɛ, ‘Ngoo graa ɛyaa ko.’ Na osele ye kyɛ, ‘Wɔ kerɛ ne, ye nwo krataa ne ɛhe, tena ase ndɛndɛ na kyerɛ aburannu!’ 7Yeɛ obisale ko ne koso kyɛ, ‘Wɔ koso, ɛma kerɛ sɛɛ?’ Na obuale kyɛ, ‘Atokoɔ ngotoku ɛyaa ko.’ Na osele ye kyɛ, ‘Wɔ kerɛ ne, ye nwo krataa ɛhe, kyerɛ aburawɔtwɛ!’ 8Na meneɛ ne kamvole hwɛsoniɛ bɔ onni nahorɛ ne, kyɛ wafa nworɛ wato bɔ wayɔ ne anwo. Ofikyɛ, wiase he anu ama bɛfa nworɛ atee so bɛyɔ bɛ nningyein wɔ bɛ mmango mɔ nu bɛtra kanea mma nemɔ.”
Anwonyadeɛ fiɛ
9Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔ de, ɛ́mɔfa anwonyadeɛ fiɛ ne so bie bénya abiɛngoɛ mɔ, amaa sɛ ohia ɛmɔ a, bafa ɛmɔ bahɔ atenaleɛ afebɔɔ nemɔ anu.
10“Ebiala bɔ odi nahorɛ wɔ nningyein mmaa mmaa nu ne, odi nahorɛ wɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri nu koso; yeɛ ebiala bɔ onni nahorɛ wɔ nningyein mmaa mmaa nu ne, onni nahorɛ wɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri nu koso. 11Na sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ wɔ anwonyadeɛ fiɛ nu a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa anwonyadeɛ paa ne kowura ɛmɔ sa ɔ? 12Na sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ wɔ ebie nikyee nwo a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ?
13 “Akoaa biala ngɔhora ngɔso meneɛ nyɔ; ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ɔkɔpɔ ko, né wahuro ko dwirɛ, anaakyɛ ɔkɔso ko nahorɛ nu, né wabu ko animtia. Ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔso Nyameɛ ne anwonyadeɛ.”
Yesu twi Farasiifoɛ nyunu
(Mateo 11.12-13; 5.31-32; Marko 10.11-12)
14Na Farasiifoɛ bɔ bɛ nye boro sikaa ne, bɛtele edwirɛ hemɔ amukoraa nen, bɛserele ye. 15Yiti Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ ɛmɔbu bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛtengyɛ wɔ mmenia nyunu, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɛmɔ ti anu ɔ. Ofikyɛ, bɔ ɔmoma ye nwo so wɔ mmenia nu ne, ɔte akyiwadeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.
16 “Mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛpem Yohane so; na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, bɛ́ka Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba ne, na ebiala pere kɔ nu. 17 Na ɔyɛ mmerɛ kyɛ anwuro ne aseɛ kɔpɛ nu tra kyɛ mmeraa ne anu kaaba pɔtrepɔɔ ko po ɔngɔyɛ adwuma ɔ.
18 “Bienzua biala bɔ okoyira ɔye ná okogya braa foforɛ nen, ɔsɛkye agyaa; yeɛ bienzua biala bɔ okogya brasua bɔ ohu ayira ye nen, ɔsɛkye agyaa.
Esikaniɛ bie ne Lasarɔso nwo dwirɛ
19“Esikaniɛ bie tenane ase bɔ né ɔkera kende ne ago, ná odi aleɛ fɛɛ ɔgye ye nye daa biala ɔ. 20Na ehianiɛ bie koso bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Lasarɔso bɔ ngena atutu ye nwo amukoraa ɔ ɔtenane ase. Né bɛfa ye bɛkɔto sikaniɛ n’anoanu berɛ. 21Né ɔpena aleɛ boso bɔ ɔporoporo fi sikaniɛ ne didipono so gua ase ne odi; asa koso, né ngyea bɛbatafe ye ngena nemɔ anu.
22“Na ɔwale kyɛ ehianiɛ ne wuli, na abɔfo mɔ bɛɛfale ye maa ɔhɔle Abraham berɛ. Esikaniɛ ne koso wuli, na besiele ye. 23Na ɔwɔ abɔnzam see nu, ná onwu amaneɛ nen, ɔtole ye nye anwuro, na onwuni Abraham wɔ dedeede ɔne Lasarɔso kyɛ ɔwɔ ye berɛ ɔ. 24Na ɔteane nu kyɛ, ‘Ngya Abraham ee, nwu me anwumvoin oo, ná soma Lasarɔso maa ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka noa ɔbɔ nzue nu, ná ɔɔfa hã me temverema so ma so yɛ fɔnwoo; ɔnate kyɛ me nwo yerayera me wɔ see wuronyiwuronyi he anu!’
25“Nakoso Abraham sele ye kyɛ, ‘Mma, kaye kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛte ase ne, elili wɔ mmerɛ, na Lasarɔso de, onwuni amaneɛ; nakoso kekesaala ye de, ye wora akyekye, na wɔ koso de, wɔ nwo yerayera wɔ. 26Na ɛhe amukoraa si ne, bɔnga pirikua bie la yɛne ɛmɔ afia, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛ bɔ bekuro kyɛ befi wa bɛba ɛmɔ dɔ ne, bɛngɔhora ba ɔ. Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ dɔ ne koso, bɛngora bɛndra bɛmma yɛ wa.’ 27Yeɛ osele kyɛ, ‘Nzaade, baba, mesrɛ wɔ, soma ye maa ɔhɔ me baba awuro; 28ofikyɛ nniɛma mmienzua mɔ bɛte nnu, ná ɔɔbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ, ná bɛ koso bamma ɛwa amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu bie.’
29“Nakoso Abraham buale ye kyɛ, ‘Bele Mose ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ wɔ dɔ; odi kyɛ betie bɛ!’ 30Na osele kyɛ, ‘Daabi, Ngya Abraham; nakoso sɛ ebie fi awufoɛ nu kɔ bɛ berɛ a, yeɛ bɛkɔsakyera b’adwene ɔ.’ 31Na obuale ye kyɛ, ‘Sɛ bengotie Mose ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ a, ye de sɛ ebie fi awufoɛ nu dwɔso po a, bengole ngoli.’ ”

Title: LUKA 17
Content:
Sundiduatolɛ
(Mateo 18.6, 7, 21, 22; Marko 9.42)
1Na Yesu sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɔyɛ sɛɛ ala a, sundiduatolɛ kɔwa, nakoso sona bɔ ɔnate ye so ɔkɔwa ne de, ye yaakɔ! 2Ahaa ɔte paa ma ye kyɛ bɛkɔfa nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo bekosinze ye kɔme, ná bagyi ye bato ɛpo nu, tra kyɛ ɔkɔto ngwadaammaa hemɔ anu ko sundidua ɔ. 3 Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé! Sɛ eliɛma yɛ wɔ tɛɛ a, kã ye nyunu, na sɛ ɔsakyera ye adwene a, fa kyɛ ye. 4Na sɛ ɔyɛ wɔ tɛɛ pɛen nzoo ɛlɛho, ná osa ba wɔ berɛ pɛen nzoo bakã kyɛ, ‘Masakyera m’adwene’ a, odi kyɛ ɛfa kyɛ ye.”
Tumi wɔ gyidie nu
5Na asomafoɛ nemɔ sele Awurade kyɛ, “Ma yɛ gyidie onyi!” 6Na Awurade buale kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔle gyidie bɔ ye piri te kyɛ sinapi baa ko a, ahaa ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔhã bekohyire akyea he kyɛ, ‘Wɔ bo tutu, ná kogyina ɛpo nu!’ Na okotie ɛmɔ.
Akoaa asɛdeɛ
7“Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ole akoaa bɔ ɔyɔ fieso adwuma, anaakyɛ ɔnea mmoaen so, ná akoaa ne fi eburo ba a, ɔkɔhã kohyire akoaa ne kyɛ, ‘Ka wɔ nwo bra baadidi’ ɔ? 8Aso ongose ye kyɛ, ‘To m’aleɛ, ná bɔ w’abɔsoɛ so me, na medidi ná meno meyie a, ye si ye né wɔ koso adidi ná ano.’? 9Aso ɔda akoaa ne ase kyɛ wayɔ bɔ ɔhyɛle ye kyɛ ɔyɔ ne? 10Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ koso, sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ bafa bama ɛmɔ ne a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkã kyɛ ‘Yɛte ngoaa bɔ mvasoɛ biala nne yɛ so ɔ, na bɔ ɔte y’asɛdeɛ yeɛ yayɔ ɔ.’ ”
Yesu sa kwatafoɛ buru anwonyerɛ
11Na ɔwale kyɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem nen, ɔɔfale Samaria ne Galilea ɛwɛen so. 12Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔkwaawura akuraa bie anu nen, mmienzua buru bie bɔ bɛte kwatafoɛ ɔ beeyiale ye, bɔ né baagyinagyina dedeede ɔ, 13na bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Yesu, Yɛ mene, nwu yɛ anwumvoin oo!” 14 Na onwuni bɛ nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo beehyire asɔfo nemɔ.” Na ɔwale kyɛ bɛ́kɔ nen, bɛ nwo fili. 15Na bɛ nu ko nwuni kyɛ ye nwo asa nen, osale ye si teateane nu yele Nyameɛ ayɛ; 16na ɔfale ye nyunu butuli ase wɔ Yesu gya bo lale ye ase. Né ye de, ɔte Samarianiɛ. 17Yeɛ Yesu sele kyɛ, “Aso nna mmenia buru yeɛ bɛ nwo fili ɔ? Na ngona ne de, bɛwɔ nisua? 18Bannwu bɛ nu biala kyɛ wasa ye si wawa kyɛ ɔbaafa animnyam ma Nyameɛ ɔ, sana amanvraniɛ he ngome?” 19Na osele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso kɔ, wɔ gyidie ale wɔ.”
Nyameɛ ahennie ne walɛ
(Mateo 24.23-28, 37-41)
20Farasiifoɛ nemɔ bisale Yesu mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne kɔwa ɔ, na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ ahennie ne, ɔmma bɔ mmenia bɛ nye tua ɔ; 21yeɛ bɛngɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nea, ye ɛhe!’ Anaakyɛ: ‘Nea, ye yeɛ ɔwɔ dɔ ne!’ Na ɛ́mɔtie, Nyameɛ ahennie ne, ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu.”
22Na osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ Sona Awa ne, ɛmɔkohuro kyɛ ɛmɔkonwu ye ngyẽa nemɔ anu ko ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔngonwu ye. 23Na bekose ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Nea dɔ!’ anaa ‘Nea wa!’ Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdi bɛ si. 24Na kyɛbɔ agralaa bɔ frɛ, ná ɔta ewienu fi ye bue ko kɔkã ye bue ko ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne kɔyɛ wɔ ye kyẽa ne anu ɔ. 25Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ onwu amaneɛ pee ná ɛnɛmmafoɛ he bɛpo ye koraka. 26 Na kyɛbɔ Nowa mmerɛ ne yɛle ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne mmerɛ koso kɔyɛ ɔ. 27 Bedidili, bɛnone, begyigyale mmraa, na bɛmane agyaa maa oodwuli kyẽa bɔ Nowa fole ɛlɛen ne anu, ná nzueyilɛ ne wale oohuni bɛ mukoraa ɔ. 28 Sɔ ala koso yeɛ Lɔto mmerɛ ne yɛle ɔ. Bedidili, bɛnone, bɛtɔle nningyein, bɛyɛle nningyein atɔen, beluale nningyein, na besisili sua mɔ. 29Na kyẽa bɔ Lɔto fili Sodom hɔle nen, see ne sɔfe tɔ fili nyameɛso oohuhuni bɛ mukoraa. 30Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɔ wɔ kyẽa bɔ Sona Awa ne kɔye ye nwo ali ne.
31 “Sɔ kyẽa ne, sona bɔ ɔwɔ sua ti afia, bɔ ye nningyein wɔ sua nu ne, onni kyɛ odwu ba kyɛ ɔbaafa kɔ; yeɛ sona bɔ ɔwɔ fieso ne koso, onni kyɛ osa ye si ba. 32 Ɛ́mɔkaye Lɔto aye ne! 33 Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpere kyɛ okole ye bɔbɔ ye ngoa ne, ɔkɔhwere ye; nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhwere ye ngoa ne, okonya ye ngoa. 34Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɔ kɔngɔen ne, mmenia nyɔ bɔ bɛla bɛen ko aso ɔ, bɛkɔfa ko bɛkɔhɔ, né bayakyi ko berɛ. 35Mmrasua nyɔ bɔ bési aburoo bɛ́bɔ nu ɔ, bɛkɔfa ko bɛkɔhɔ, né bayakyi ko berɛ. 36[Mmienzua nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ fieso ɔ, bɛkɔfa ko bɛkɔhɔ, né bayakyi ko berɛ.”]
37Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nisua ɔ?” Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nekaa bɔ efuin la ne, berɛ yeɛ mbɛtɛ bɛboa bɛ noa ɔ!”

Title: LUKA 18
Content:
Nnɛma w’abasa nu bu wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nwo
1Afei Yesu buli bɛ anyandera he fa hyirele kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ sona bɔ mbaeɛ daa biala, bɔ onni kyɛ ɔma ye abasa nu bu ɔ. 2Osele kyɛ, “Ndɛenbualɛniɛ bie tenane kuro bie aso, bɔ né onzuro Nyameɛ ná ɔmvɛre sona ɔ. 3Né braa kunaniɛ bie koso wɔ sɔ kuro ne aso, bɔ né ɔtaa ba ye berɛ bafa ye dwirɛ to ye nyunu kyɛ, ‘Di me dwirɛ ma me, ná pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ sa nu.’ 4Na wandɛ ye so alaa maa ɔhyɛle kãa, nakoso nziɛ ye, ɔhane ye ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ menzuro Nyameɛ ná memvɛre sona de, 5nakoso ɔnate ɛhalɛ bɔ braa kunaniɛ he ɔha me ne ati, ngɔnea ngoli ye dwirɛ ne ngɔma ye, ná wandɔ wangɔ so wammandwane me nwo.’ ”
6 Na Awurade toale so hane kyɛ, “Ndɛenbualɛniɛ bɔ ɔndengyɛ ne, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ bɔ ɔkã! 7 Na bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye bɛ, bɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye eyia ne kɔngɔen ne, sɛ ɔto ye bo ase ɔkyɛ kãa wɔ bɛ nwo a, aso ongoli bɛ dwirɛ ngɔma bɛ anaa? 8Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, okoli bɛ dwirɛ kɔma bɛ ndɛndɛ. Nakoso, Sona Awa ne ba a, aso okonwu gyidie wɔ aseɛ ye aso?”
Farasiiniɛ ne ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ ne
9Na ebiemɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo so kyɛ bɛtengyɛ, ná bebu bɛ mmango animtia ne, obuli bɛ anyandera he: 10“Mmenia nyɔ hɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua nu bɛɛbɔle mbaeɛ; ko te Farasiiniɛ, yeɛ ko wora ɔte ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ. 11Na Farasiiniɛ ne gyinane berɛ bɔle mbaeɛ ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘O Nyameɛ, meda wɔ ase kyɛ me de, nnde kyɛ mmenia ngaa ne ɔ: apoobɔlɛfoɛ, ngondombofoɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ, anaakyɛ ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ he po. 12Dapɛn biala meyɛ akɔngyere pɛen nyɔ, na bɔ menya biala, meye so buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko mema.’
13“Nakoso ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ ne de, oogyinane nziɛ nziɛ, na wanguro kyɛ ɔkɔma ye nye so kɔnea nyameɛso po ɔ, na mmom ɔfale ye sa guale ye ahone so hane kyɛ, ‘O Nyameɛ, nde bɔnefoɛ, na nwu me anwumvoin!’ 14 Na Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɔ sona he mmom yeɛ Nyameɛ buale be maa ɔhɔle ye awuro ɔ, na nna ko ne ɔ; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so ne, bɛkɔbrɛ ye ase, nakoso bɔ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ne de, bɛkɔma ye so.”
Yesu yirayira ngwadaammaa
(Mateo 19.13-15; Marko 10.13-16)
15Bɛfale ngwadaammaa koso bɛbrɛle Yesu kyɛ ɔfa ye sa hã bɛ. Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye sɔ nen, bedwudwole bɛ. 16Nakoso Yesu frɛle ngwadaa nemɔ maa bɛwale ye nwo berɛ, na osele asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ngwadaa nemɔ ate ma bɛbra me berɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔsi bɛ ate; ofikyɛ ɛhemɔ sɔa ye yeɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne ɔte bɛ deɛ ɔ. 17Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ wanne Nyameɛ ahennie ne wando nu kyɛ akwadaa ne, ɔngɔhɔ nu le.”
Esikaniɛ bie ne daa ngoa
(Mateo 19.16-30; Marko 10.17-31)
18Yeɛ panyi bie bisale Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ paa, nzu yeɛ nyɔ ná manya daa ngoa ɔ?” 19Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛfrɛ me sona paa ɔ? Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, sana Nyameɛ ngome twe. 20 Ɛse mmeraa dwirɛ ne: ‘Nnɛsɛkye agyaa, Nnɛdi awue, Nnɛwua, Nnɛdi adanzewia, Di ɛse ne eni ni!’ ” 21Na biaa ne buale kyɛ, “Mvi me ngwadaa nu yeɛ mali ɛhemɔ amukoraa so ɔ.”
22Na Yesu tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, osele ye kyɛ, “Waha wɔ nikyee ko: Tɔne bɔ ele ye amukoraa, ná kyɛ sikaa ne ma ehiafoɛ, na ekonya agyapadeɛ wɔ nyameɛso; na afei bra baali me si.” 23Na ɔtele edwirɛ he nen, ye wora bɔle; ofikyɛ né ye sa nu le bie paa.
24Yesu nwuni kyɛ ye wora abɔ paa, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔyɛ se ma bɛ bɔ banya bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛkɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ɔ! 25Ofikyɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ma afupɔngɔ kyɛ okowura drɔwaa bɔen nu tra kyɛ esikaniɛ kɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ɔ.”
26Na bɛ bɔ bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Nzaade, nwa yeɛ bɛkɔhora bekole ye ngoa ɔ?” 27Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Bɔ sona bue nu ɔngɔhora ngɔyɛ berɛ ne, Nyameɛ bue nu de, ɔkɔhora kɔyɛ berɛ.” 28Yeɛ Petro sele kyɛ, “Eh! Yayakyi bɔ yɛle ye amukoraa yaali wɔ si oo.” 29Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sona biala nne berɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne ati wayakyi awuro, anaa ɔye, anaa aliɛmaa, anaa awofoɛ, anaa mmaa berɛ, 30bɔ ongonya ye mmɔhoɛ pee sɔ mmerɛ ye anu, ɔne daa ngoa wɔ wiase bɔ ɔbaawa ne anu ɔ.”
Yesu hyɛ ngɔm bɔ ɔtɔ so nza fa ye wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo
(Mateo 20.17-19; Marko 10.32-34)
31Yesu fale asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ hɔle ahameɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, yɛ́fo yɛ́kɔ Yerusalem, na nikyee biala bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bahyerɛ bafa Sona Awa ne anwo ne, ɔkɔwa nu. 32Ofikyɛ bɛkɔye ye bekowura Amaenmaensofoɛ sa, na bɛkɔgoro ye nwo, bɛkɔbɔ ye alapaa, ná bafefe nwɔserɛ bagua ye nwo. 33Bekofi ye mbire, ná bahu ye, na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso okotingye.” 34Nakoso bɛ de, bande edwirɛ hemɔ nu biala bo; né ɔbo b’adwene so, na bɔ ɔhane ne po, né bɛnze nikye horɛ.
Yesu te anyesiniwaaniɛ bie nye
(Mateo 20.29-34; Marko 10.46-52)
35Yesu pingyele Yeriko nen, né anyesiniwaaniɛ bie ɔte atee ne noa berɛ ɔsrɛsrɛ nikye. 36Ɔtele ɛlɔen bɔ bɛpɛ nu berɛ ne nga nen, obisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ ɔ?” 37Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yesu bɔ ofi Nasarɛte ne yeɛ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ.” 38Na ɔteane nu kyɛ, “Dawide Awa Yesu, nwu me anwumvoin oo!” 39Na mmenia bɔ né beli moa ne, behwili ye nyunu kyɛ omua ye noa. Nakoso bekye po yeɛ ɔhɔle so teateane nu serɛserɛ paa kyɛ, “Dawide Awa ee, nwu me anwumvoin oo!”
40Yiti Yesu gyinane, na ɔhyɛle bɛ kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛbrɛ ye. Na opingyele Yesu nwo berɛ nen, Yesu bisale ye kyɛ, 41“Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ meyɔ mema wɔ ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Awurade, mepena kyɛ menwu nikye.” 42Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Nwu nikye! Wɔ gyidie ale wɔ.” 43Na berɛ ne ala, onwuni nikye, na olili Yesu si hyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam. Na ɛlɔen ne amukoraa benwuni bɔ wasi nen, bɛ bɛyele Nyameɛ ayɛ.

Title: LUKA 19
Content:
Yesu ne Sakeo
1Yesu dwuli Yeriko, na né ɔpɛ nu berɛ kɔ. 2Na yieee, né biaa bie bɔ ye dumaa li Sakeo ɔ ɔwɔ berɛ, bɔ ɔte ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ panyi bɔ ye sa nu le bie ɔ. 3Né ɔpena kyɛ onwu Yesu ná onwu ye sona horɛ, nakoso ɔnate ɛlɔen ne ati wannwu ye, ofikyɛ ɔte sona tikaa. 4Yiti otuli amirika lili moa ɔɔfole akyea bie aso kyɛbɔ okonwu ye ɔ, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ né ɔkwaafa ɔ. 5Na Yesu dwuli berɛ nen, ɔtole ye ti anwuro, onwuni ye, na osele ye kyɛ, “Sakeo, dwu bra ndɛndɛ! Ofikyɛ w’awuro yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ mesikye ɛnɛ ɔ.” 6Yiti odwuli ase ndɛndɛ, na olele Yesu wɔ anigye nu. 7Na ɛlɔen ne nwuni ye sɔ nen, bɛ mukoraa bɛyɛle nwuhunwuhu kyɛ, “Biaa bɔnefoɛ he yeɛ wahɔ waasikye ye awuro ɔ.” 8Yeɛ Sakeo dwɔso gyinane, na osele Awurade kyɛ, “Ao, Awurade, mefa m’anwonyadeɛ bue mekyɛ ehiafoɛ; na sɛ mafa aminɛlilɛ so male ebie nikyee a, ngɔbɔ ye nwo pɛen nna ngotua ye kerɛ.” 9Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ngoalelɛ awa awuro he anu, ofikyɛ ye koso ɔte Abraham bosoniɛ. 10 Na Sona Awa ne wale kyɛ ɔbaapena ná ode bɛ bɔ bamini ɔ.”
Mina buru ne nwo anyandera
(Mateo 25.14-30)
11Na mmerɛ bɔ begu so betie sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ nen, ɔtoale so buli bɛ anyandera, ofikyɛ né wapingye Yerusalem, yeɛ afei ɛlɔen ne susuli kyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne ɔbaaye ye nwo ali berɛ ne ala. 12Yiti osele bɛ, “Dehyeɛ bie tuli atee hɔle dedeede maen bie aso kyɛ ɔkwaamaa bɛfa ye besi hene, ná afei osa ba. 13Na ɔfrɛle ye ngoaa nemɔ anu buru, na ɔmane bɛ mina buru, na osele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa he bɛ́yɔ adwuma kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ɔ.’ 14Nakoso ye maen ne anu ama de, né bɛpɔ ye, yiti betuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛpole ye so bɛɛhane kyɛ, ‘Yɛmbena kyɛ sɔ biaa he odi yɛ so hene.’
15“Na ɔwale kyɛ bɛfale ye besili hene, ná osa wale nen, ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛfrɛ ngoaa bɔ ɔfale sikaa ne mane bɛ ne bɛbrɛ ye, ná onwu bɔ ebiala afa ayɔ adwuma wanya ɔ. 16Bɔ oli moa ne wale, na osele kyɛ, ‘Me mene, wɔ mina ne, mvasoɛ mina buru awa ye nwo.’ 17Yeɛ osele ye kyɛ, ‘Mmo, akoaa paa! Ɔnate kyɛ ali kãa bie nwo nahorɛ ne ati, nea nguro buru so.’ 18Na bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne wale oosele kyɛ, ‘Me mene, wɔ mina ne, mvasoɛ mina nnu awa ye nwo.’ 19Na osele ye koso kyɛ, ‘Wɔ koso, nea nguro nnu so.’
20“Yeɛ ko bieku koso wale ɔɔhane kyɛ, ‘Me mene, wɔ mina ne ɛhe. Mvale eduku ngyekyele ye nwo. 21Né mesuro wɔ, ofikyɛ ɛte sona bɔ wɔ dwirɛ yɛ se ɔ; ɛfa bɔ amva ando berɛ ɔ, yeɛ ebu bɔ elluale ɔ.’ 22Na osele ye kyɛ, ‘Wɔ akoaa atianuserɛniɛ! Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ ngogyina so ngobua wɔ foɛ ɔ! Ɛse kyɛ nde sona bɔ me dwirɛ yɛ se ɔ, bɔ mefa bɔ mamva mando berɛ ɔ, yeɛ mebu bɔ nnuale ɔ. 23Na nzu ati yeɛ amva me sikaa ne ando sikakorabea ɔ, kyɛ meba a, me sa kɔhã me nikyee ne ye nwo nzihoɛ ɔ?’
24“Na osele bɛ bɔ begyigyi berɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔle mina ne befi ye sa nu, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́ma ko bɔ ole mina buru ne.’ 25(Na besele ye kyɛ, ‘Yɛ mene, naa ole mina buru dada!’) 26 ‘Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ole bie ne, bɛkɔfa somaa bɛkɔboka ye so; nakoso bɔ olle bie ne, bɔ ole ye ne po, bekole bekofi ye sa nu. 27Na me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ né bɛmbene so kyɛ medi bɛ so hene ne de, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛbra wa beehu bɛ me nyunu wa!’ ”
Yesu kɔ Yerusalem ngonim nu
(Mateo 21.1-11; Marko 11.1-11; Yohane 12.12-19)
28Na Yesu hane ɛhe yiele nen, ɔsẽ lili moa kyɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem. 29Na opingyele Betefage ne Betania, bɔ ɔwɔ bokaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Olive Bokaa ne anwo nen, ɔsomane ye asuafoɛ nemɔ nyɔ 30sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ akuraa bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nyunu dɔ ne anu. Sɛ ɛmɔwura akuraa ne anu a, ɛmɔkonwu afunum akrɔngrɔma bɔ bamenda ye, bɔ sona biala ɔttenane ye so le ɔ. Ɛ́mɔsangye ye bɛ́fa ye bɛbra wa. 31Na sɛ ebie bisa ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔsangye ye ɔ?’ a, ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Awurade hia ye.’ ”
32Yiti bɛ bɔ ɔsomane bɛ ne, besili nu hɔle, na benwuni nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ kyɛbɔ ɔhã hyirele bɛ ne ala. 33Na begu so bɔ bɛsangye afunum akrɔngrɔma ne nen, ye mene mɔ bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔsangye afunum akrɔngrɔma ne ɔ?” 34Na bebuale kyɛ, “Awurade hia ye!” 35Na bɛfale ye bɛbrɛle Yesu; bɛfale bɛ ndaadeɛ aguasoɛ beguale afunum akrɔngrɔma ne aso, na bɛfale Yesu bɛtenane so. 36Ɔte so ná ɔ́kɔ nen, bɛfale bɛ ndena bɛsesɛle atee ne anu.
37Na opingyele berɛ, nekaa bɔ atee ne torotoro kɔ Olive Bokaa ne anwo nen, asuafoɛ ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛhyɛle ye bo belili ahurusi, na bɛbɔle ese bɛyele Nyameɛ ayɛ wɔ anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri amukoraa bɔ banwu ye ne anwo, 38 kyɛ, “Saleɛ ole Ɛhene bɔ ɔnate Awurade dumaa nu ɔba ye! Asomdwee wɔ nyameɛso, na animnyam wɔ anwuro anwuro!”
39Na Farasiifoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ ɛlɔen ne anu ne, bɛ nu biemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, dwudwo w’asuafoɛ nemɔ!” 40Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ bemua bɛ noa a, nyɔboɛ mɔ po bɛkɔteatea nu.”
Yesu sũ ma Yerusalem
41Na opingyele kuro ne, ná ɔtole ye nye neane ye nen, osũ mane ye kyɛ, 42“Wɔ, sɛ ɛnɛ ye po yeɛ wɔ bɔbɔ ala ɛse bɔ ɔfa asomdwee ba a, ahaa ɔte paa! Nakoso kekesaala ye de, bafa bafea wɔ. 43Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bie baawa wɔ so, bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔyɔ nyinasoɛ bɛkɔfo so bɛkɔwa wɔ nu, bɔ bɛkɔpɛ bɛkɔbra wɔ nwo bekoyia, ná batua wɔ bahã wɔ bamia; 44bekodwiri wɔ bekogua ase, ɛne wɔ mma bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ nu ne, na bɛngɔyakyi nyɔboɛ bɔ ogyi nyɔboɛ so ɔ wɔ wɔ nu; ɔnate kyɛ annwu mmerɛ bɔ ɔlole wɔ ɔɔneane wɔ ne.”
Yesu foa dwadifoɛ fi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu
(Mateo 21.12-17; Marko 11.15-19; Yohane 2.13-22)
45Yesu wurale asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na ɔhyɛle ye bo foane bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ nningyein atɔen ne fili berɛ; 46 na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ kyɛ, ‘M’awuro te mbaeɛbɔlɛ awuro’; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔafa bakakyi awuefoɛ afealeɛ.”
47 Na daa biala ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu. Né asɔfo mbanyi, ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne maen mbanyi bɛpena kyɛ ahaa beku ye ɔ, 48nakoso bannya ye nwo ate, ofikyɛ né mmenia ne amukoraa bayɛ asoɛ betie edwirɛ bɔ ɔkã ne.

Title: LUKA 20
Content:
Yesu tumi nwo adwobisa
(Mateo 21.23-27; Marko 11.27-33)
1Na ɔwale kyɛ ɛlɛho bie, bɔ né Yesu ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ kyire mmenia wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ná osa kã nzɛmba nen, asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne maen mbanyi bɛwale ye berɛ, 2na besele ye kyɛ, “Kã kyire yɛ, tumi beni yeɛ egyi so bɔ ɛyɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ye? Anaakyɛ, nwa yeɛ ɔmane wɔ sɔ tumi ne ɔ?” 3Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Me koso ngobisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ ko, na ɛ́mɔma me mmuayɛɛ: 4Yohane asubɔlɛ ne, ofi nyameɛso anaakyɛ ofi mmenia berɛ?” 5Na bɛdwenedwenene ye nwo besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ofi nyameɛso’ a, okobisa kyɛ, ‘Nzaade, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔanne ye banni ɔ?’ 6Yeɛ sɛ yɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ofi mmenia berɛ’ a, mmenia ne amukoraa bɛkɔboro yɛ nyɔboɛ; ofikyɛ bede bedi amba kyɛ Yohane te ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.” 7Yiti bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛnze nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ.” 8Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade me koso mengɔhã tumi horɛ bɔ ngyi so meyɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ɔ mengohyire ɛmɔ.”
Hwɛsofoɛ bɔnefoɛ biemɔ nwo anyandera
(Mateo 21.33-46; Marko 12.1-12)
9 Na Yesu hyɛle ye bo buli anyandera he hyirele mmenia nemɔ kyɛ, “Biaa bie yɔle bobe boo, ɔfa wurale hwɛsofoɛ biemɔ sa, na otuli atee hɔle maen bie aso dedeede ɔɔhyɛle. 10Na bobe mmaa telɛ dwuli ne, ɔsomane ye somvoɛ ko maa ɔhɔle hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ berɛ, kyɛ bɛ́ma ye bobe boo ne anu mmaa ne bie. Nakoso hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ bole ye, na bɛmaa osa hɔle nzanza. 11Na ɔsomane somvoɛ foforɛ; na ye koso bɛbole ye beguale ye nyunu ase, na bɛmaa osa hɔle nzanza. 12Na ɔsomane bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ɔ; na ye koso bepurapurale ye bɛfoane ye befili berɛ. 13Yeɛ bobe boo mene ne sele kyɛ, ‘Ɛhe de, ngɔyɛ ye sɛ? Ngɔsoma mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ; ebiaa ye de bɛkɔfa anidie bɛkɔma ye!’ 14Nakoso hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye nen, besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘Bɔ odi ye bia ne ɛhe; ɛmɔma yɛhu ye, ná agyapadeɛ ne ɔyɛ yɛ deɛ.’ 15Yiti bɛhwene ye befili bobe boo ne anu beehuni ye. “Yiti nzikyɛ yeɛ bobe boo mene ne ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ bɛ ɔ? 16Ɔkɔwa koohu sɔ hwɛsofoɛ nemɔ, ná wafa bobe boo ne wawura mmenia foforɛ sa.” Na bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, besele kyɛ, “Nyameɛ pa gua!”
17 Nakoso ɔneane bɛ haa, na obisale kyɛ, “Né nzaade, ye bo kyire sɛɛ, ɛhe bɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ,
‘Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne,
ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ.’
18Ebiala bɔ okofi ase kɔtɔ sɔ nyɔboɛ ne aso ne, okobubu ye nu ahuronzi ahuronzi; yeɛ sɛ ɔte tɔ ebie so a, okonuku ye nyokonyoko.”
Ɛtoɔtualɛ nwo adwobisa
(Mateo 22.15-22; Marko 12.13-17)
19Na ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ benwuni kyɛ anyandera he bɔ Yesu buli ne, ɔne bɛ, yiti ahaa bɛpena kyɛ bɛkye ye berɛ ne ala, nakoso né besuro ɛlɔen ne. 20Yiti bɛtetɛle ye. Na bɛsomane mmenia biemɔ bɔ bayɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛte mmeni paa ɔ maa bɛhɔle ye berɛ, kyɛ bɛɛfa dwirɛ besua ye ngaen, ná bagyina so baye ye bawura amrado tumi ne ye mmeraa sa. 21Yiti bebisale ye kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, yɛse kyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ ne wɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ te turoloo, yeɛ ɛmva wɔ nye ndo sona ye dibea, na mmom ekyirekyire Nyameɛ atee ne nahorɛ nu. 22Aso otia mmeraa kyɛ yɛtua ɛtoɔ yɛma Kaesare, anaakyɛ ondia?”
23Na Yesu nwuni b’adwenemmɔne nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “[Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔso me bɛnea ɔ] 24Ɛ́mɔma me denare ko maa nnea! Nwa mvonini ne dumaa yeɛ ɔwɔ so ye?” Bebuale kyɛ, “Kaesare deɛ ɔ!” 25Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade ɛ́mɔfa Kaesare deɛ bɛ́ma Kaesare, ná ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ deɛ bɛ́ma Nyameɛ.” 26Na bangora bannya ye noa dwirɛ nu mvomsoɛ bangyina so wɔ mmenia n’anyunu berɛ, na mmom ye mmuayɛɛ ne yɛle bɛ nwanwa maa bɛhane bɛ noa bɛtole nu.
Ewutingyelɛ nwo adwobisa
(Mateo 22.23-33; Marko 12.18-27)
27 Na Sadusiifoɛ bɔ bɛnwa awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ nne berɛ ne, bɛ nu biemɔ wale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye 28 kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, Mose hyerɛ mane yɛ kyɛ, ‘Sɛ bienzua bie oliɛma bienzua bɔ ogya braa ɔ owu, ná wanwo ba a, odi kyɛ oliɛma ne gya sɔ braa ne ná ɔwo mmaa ma bɔ wawu ne.’ 29Tie, né aliɛmaa mmienzua nzoo bie wɔ berɛ. Bɔ oli moa ne gyale braa, na owuli bɔ wanwo ba ɔ. 30Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne gyale braa ne, 31yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne koso gyale ye; na sɔ alaa yeɛ aliɛmaa nzoo ne amukoraa begyale braa ne bɔ banwo ba ɔ, na bewuwuli. 32Na bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, braa ne koso wuli. 33Yiti awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ ne anu, bɛ nu nwa yeɛ braa ne te ɔye ɔ? Ofikyɛ aliɛmaa nzoo ne gyale ye.”
34Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ewiase he anu mmenia begya, na bɛfa bɛ bɛma agyaa; 35nakoso bɛ bɔ bekobu bɛ kyɛ bɛfata kyɛ benya kyɛfa wɔ wiase bɔ ɔ́ba ne ne awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ nu ne de, bengya, yeɛ bɛmva bɛ bɛmma agyaa, 36na bɛngora benwu ko; ofikyɛ bɛtɛ kyɛ abɔfo mɔ, na bɛte Nyameɛ mma, ofikyɛ bɛte ewutingyelɛ nu mmaa. 37 Na ɔfa awufoɛ dwɔsolɛ nwo de, Mose koso maa yɛnwu ye wɔ ngyɛkyerɛ ne nwo dwirɛ ne anu, mmerɛ bɔ ɔfrɛ Awurade kyɛ: Abraham Nyameɛ, Yisake Nyameɛ ne Yakob Nyameɛ’ ne. 38Yiti, ɔtte awufoɛ Nyameɛ, na mmom ɔte ateasefoɛ Nyameɛ; ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛte ase bɛma ye.”
39Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ anu biemɔ buale kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, aye ye noa yé.” 40Yiti bangora bammisa ye dwirɛ biala ko.
Kristo ne nwo adwobisa
(Mateo 22.41-46; Marko 12.35-37)
41Na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ bɛnwa Kristo ne te Dawide awa ɔ? 42 Ɔnate kyɛ Dawide bɔbɔ kã ye wɔ Edwein Nwomaa ne anu kyɛ,
‘Awurade sele me Mene kyɛ,
Tena me sa famaa so,
43kodwu kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.’
44Na sɛ Dawide frɛ ye me Mene a, né ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɔɔyɛle ɔwa ɔ?”
Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
(Mateo 23.1-36; Marko 12.38-40)
45Na mmenia ne amukoraa begu so bɔ betie Yesu nen, osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, 46“Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ anwo. Bɛ yeɛ bekuro ndaadeɛ ndendenn wuralɛ bɛnate, ɔne kyɛ mmenia kobisa bɛ ahye wɔ dwaaso ɔ, ɔne mbanyi bia wɔ nyianu sua mɔ nu, ɔne mbanyi bia wɔ ɛpoentolɛ bo ɔ; 47bɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ akunafoɛ mmrasua apoo bede bɛ nningyein ɔ, nakoso bɛpati bɛbɔ mbaeɛ tendenn bekyire. Na bɛ yeɛ bekobua bɛ foɛ piri paa ɔ.”

Title: LUKA 21
Content:
Braa kunaniɛ hianiɛ bie afɔleɛ
(Marko 12.41-44)
1Yesu mane ye ti so, na onwuni esikafoɛ bɔ bɛ́fa b’ayɛyɛdeɛ begua fotoɛ alaka ne anu ɔ. 2Na onwuni braa kunaniɛ ehianiɛ bie koso bɔ ɔfale mbɛsaa nyɔ oogua nu ɔ. 3Na Yesu hane kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, braa kunaniɛ ehianiɛ he, wafa somaa waagua nu watra bɛ mukoraa. 4Ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa, bɔ bele ye maa wabu bɛ so ne bie yeɛ bafa baagua nu ɔ; nakoso ye de, ofili ye hiaa nu fale bɔ wanya ye wɔ ye asetena nu amukoraa yeɛ ooguale nu ɔ.”
Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne sɛkyelɛ nwo ngɔm
(Mateo 24.1-2; Marko 13.1-2)
5Né ebiemɔ begu so bedi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne nwo ngɔmɔ bɛfa kyɛbɔ bafa nyɔboɛ nyemenenyemene ne ayɛyɛdeɛ bahyehyɛ ye ɔ, na Yesu hane kyɛ, 6“Ɛhemɔ bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye e, mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ bɛngɔyakyi nyɔboɛ bɔ ogyi nyɔboɛ so ɔ wɔ wa bɔ bengodwiri bengogua ase ɔ.”
Ndaneanyeɛ ne amaneɛnwunɛ
(Mateo 24.3-14; Marko 13.3-13)
7Na bebisale Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, kyinzu yeɛ ɛhemɔ kosi ɔ? Na sɛ ɛhemɔ bɛbaasi a, sɛɛ yeɛ ye nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔyɛ ɔ?” 8Yeɛ Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔla ɛmɔ nwo so ná bannakalaka ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ mmenia pee bele me dumaa bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ, ‘Me ole ye,’ ɔne kyɛ ‘Mmerɛ ne adwu!’ Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔdi bɛ si. 9Na sɛ ɛmɔte koɛ mɔ ne basabasayɔlɛ nwo dwirɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro; ofikyɛ, odi kyɛ ɛhemɔ bedi moa besisi, nakoso ayieleɛ ne ngɔwa berɛ ne ala.”
10Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Maen kodwɔso kotia maen, yeɛ ahennie kodwɔso kotia ahennie; 11aseɛwosolɛ serɛserɛ kɔwa nekaa ahoroɔ, ɛhɔen ne anwonyerɛ ahoroɔ kɔwa; na nningyein suronyisuronyi ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mbiri mbiri kofi nyameɛso kɔwa. 12Nakoso anzana ɛhemɔ amukoraa bekosisi ne, bekoli moa bɛkɔhye ɛmɔ, ná batane ɛmɔ nye, bɛkɔhye ɛmɔ bɛkɔhɔ nyianu sua mɔ nu ne kuku nu, na ɔnate me dumaa ti bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ bekogyina ahemvo ne amrado mɔ nyunu. 13Na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔkoli me nwo adanzeɛ! 14 Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa he bɛto ɛmɔ ti anu, ná ɛmɔandwenedwene bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔye ɛmɔ noa ɔ nwo koraka; 15ofikyɛ me yeɛ ngɔma ɛmɔ noa ne nworɛ, bɔ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛngɔhora ngotu ngogua anaa bɛngɔhora ngogyina ye noa ɔ. 16Ɛmɔ awofoɛ ne aliɛmaa mɔ ne abusuafoɛ ne damvo mɔ koso bɛkɔye ɛmɔ bɛkɔma, na bɛkɔmaa bekohu ɛmɔ nu biemɔ. 17Na ɔnate me dumaa ti, mmenia mukoraa bɛkɔpɔ ɛmɔ; 18nakoso ɛmɔ ti nwiaa nu ko po ongomini. 19Na ɛmɔ pindinn gyinalɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ɛmɔ kra ɔ.
Yerusalem sɛkyelɛ nwo ngɔm
(Mateo 24.15-21; Marko 13.14-19)
20“Na sɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia a, ye de ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ ye bɔlɛ apingye. 21Ye de, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne, odi kyɛ bɛnwati bɛkɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne, odi kyɛ befi nu bɛkɔ; na bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nguraa nemɔ anu ne, onni kyɛ bekoowura kuro ne anu ɔ, 22 ofikyɛ sɔ ngyẽa ne te wereɛtɔlɛ ngyẽa, bɔ ɔma bɔ bahyerɛ ne amukoraa ba nu ɔ. 23Na pemvoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛma mmaa nyɔfone wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu de, bɛ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ piri kɔwa aseɛ ne aso, na ahonehulɛ kɔwa maen he aso. 24 Bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bɛkɔhɔ maen maen mukoraa so; na Amaenmaensofoɛ kotiatia Yerusalem so koodwu kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ bɛ mmerɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ.
Sona Awa ne walɛ
(Mateo 24.29-31; Marko 13.24-27)
25 “Na nzɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔwa eyia ne ɛsraen ne nzramaa mɔ nu; na kyɛbɔ ɛpo ne asorɔkye bekosi bekobu bɛkɔfa so ne, ɔkɔfa aworabɔlɛ ne ahunundetelɛ kɔto maen maen mɔ so wɔ aseɛ so. 26Na ahunundetelɛ, ɔne nningyein bɔ bɛnea a ɔbaasisi wiase ne, ɔkɔma mmenia nye so koburu bɛ; ofikyɛ bɛkɔwoso anwuro tumi mɔ. 27 Na afei mmenia konwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ole tumi ne animnyam piri ɔ́ba wɔ munungum nu ɔ. 28Na sɛ sɔ nningyein nemɔ bɛhyɛ ye bo kyɛ besisi a, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ti so bɛ́nea anwuro, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ lelɛ ne, né wapingye.”
Borɔdoma bakaa ne nwo nikyeesualɛ
(Mateo 24.32-35; Marko 13.28-31)
29Na Yesu buli bɛ anyandera kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea borɔdoma bakaa, ɔne mmakaa mukoraa! 30Sɛ onya fefɛ ná ɛmɔnea a, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ ahuhuro mmerɛ ne anya apingye. 31Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso, sɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ sɔ nningyein hemɔ besisi a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne apingye.
32“Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he ngɔpɛ nu, sana ye mukoraa awa nu koraka. 33Anwuro ne aseɛ kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ, nakoso me dwirɛ de, ɔngɔpɛ nu le.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ
34“Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, ná poentolɛ ndrasoɛ ne nzaabolɛ ne asetena nu dadwene wanni ɛmɔ ti, ná sɔ kyẽa ne ammamvu ɛmɔ nu kyɛ ngaen; 35ofikyɛ ɔkɔwa bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ ye aso amukoraa so. 36Yiti ɛmɔwɛne ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ daa, amaa ɛmɔanya anwoserɛ bafa banwati bafi bɔ ɔbaasisi ne amukoraati nu, ná ɛmɔahora bagyina Sona Awa ne nyunu.”
37Ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ daa biala wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na aleɛ dwo a, né ofi berɛ kɔtena bokaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Olive Bokaa ne aso. 38Na né ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛpɛ aleɛ bɛba ye berɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu bɛbatie ye.

Title: LUKA 22
Content:
Bɛbɔ Yesu ti so porɛ
(Mateo 26.1-5; Marko 14.1-2; Yohane 11.45-53)
1 Né Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Abɔtra ne wapingye. 2Né asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛpena atee bɔ bɛkɔfa so bekohu Yesu ɔ, ofikyɛ né besuro ɛlɔen ne.
Yudase pene so kyɛ ɔkɔye Yesu kɔma
(Mateo 26.14-16; Marko 14.10-11)
3Na Abɔnzam oowurale Yudase bɔ oli Yiskariote, bɔ ɔte asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛ nu ko ne anu. 4Yiti osili nu hɔle asɔfo mbanyi ne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu awɛmvoɛ mbanyi nemɔ berɛ, na ɔne bɛ besusuli atee horɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa so kɔye Yesu kɔma bɛ ɔ nwo. 5Ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ, na bɛ ne ye bɛhyehyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔfa ye nwo sikaa bɛkɔma ye. 6Yiti Yudase penene so, na ɔbɔle ye nwo aporɔ kyɛ okonya atee bɔ ɔkɔfa so kɔye Yesu kɔma bɛ, bɔ ɛlɔen ne bɛnne berɛ ɔ.
Abɔtra aleɛ ne
(Mateo 26.17-25; Marko 14.12-21; Yohane 13.21-30)
7Afei Paanoo kabrɛdi kyẽa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku Abɔtra boaen ne dwuli. 8Na Yesu somane Petro ne Yohane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beesiesie Abɔtra aleɛ ne bɛma yɛ, ná yɛɛli.” 9Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ekuro kyɛ yɛkosiesie aleɛ ne ɔ?” 10Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, sɛ ɛmɔdwu kuro berɛ a, biaa bie bɔ ɔso bua bɔ nzue wɔ nu ɔ koyia ɛmɔ. Ɛ́mɔli ye si bɛhɔ awuro bɔ okoowura nu ne anu, 11ná ɛmɔhã behyire awuro ne mene kyɛ, ‘Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne, bɔ ɔkã kyire wɔ hɔ ɛhe: Ɛwɔfoɛ sua bɔ nu yeɛ me ne m’asuafoɛ yɛkoli Abɔtra aleɛ nen, ɔwɔ ni?’ 12Na okohyire ɛmɔ aborɔsaen so asaso pirikua bɔ basiesie nu ɔ; na berɛ yeɛ ɛ́mɔsiesie Abɔtra aleɛ ne ɔ.” 13Bɛhɔle beenwuni nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ kyɛbɔ ɔhã hyirele bɛ ne; na besiesiele Abɔtra aleɛ ne.
Awurade adidie ne
(Mateo 26.26-30; Marko 14.22-26; 1 Korintofoɛ 11.23-25)
14Na mmerɛ ne dwuli nen, ɔɔtenane poen nwo, na né asomafoɛ nemɔ bɛboka ye so. 15Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Mayɛ m’adwene paa kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛkoli Abɔtra aleɛ he koraka né manwu amaneɛ. 16Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mengoli bie ko maa okoodwu kyɛ ɔkɔwa nu wɔ Nyameɛ ahennie nu ɔ.”
17Afei Yesu fale kulie ne, ɔlale ase, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔle he, ná ebiala no bie. 18Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, mengɔno bobe nzaa he ko kɔpem kyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne kɔwa ɔ.”
19Afei ɔfale paanoo, ɔlale ase, obubuli nu fa mane bɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛhe te me nwonaen bɔ ɛmɔ ti bɛ́fa bɛ́ma ɔ; ɛ́mɔyɔ he bɛ́fa bɛ́kaye me.” 20 Sɔ ala yeɛ bedidili beyiele ne, ɔfale kulie, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kulie he bɔ ɛmɔ ti béhwie bégua ye, ɔte apam foforɛ wɔ me mogya nu.
21 “Nakoso ɛ́mɔnea! Sona bɔ ɔ́ye me ma ne, ɔne me te poen nwo yɛdidi. 22Nahorɛ nu, Sona Awa ne ɔ́kɔ kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ ne, nakoso sona bɔ ɔkɔye ye kɔma ne de, ye yaakɔ!” 23Yeɛ bɛhyɛle ye bo bebisabisale bɛ nwo bɛpenane bɛ nu horɛ bɔ ɔbaayɔ sɔ nikyee ne ɔ.
Yesu dwudwo tia anwomasoɛ
24 Na edwudwolɛ bie wale b’afia kyɛ, bɛ nu nwa yeɛ odi kyɛ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte titire paa ɔ. 25 Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Amaenmaensofoɛ b’ahemvo mɔ bedi bɛ mmenia so ahenzɛm; na bɛ bɔ tumi wura bɛ sa bɔ bedi bɛ so tumi ne, bɛfrɛ bɛ ‘Adaworoma.’ 26Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔba ye sɔ ɔ; na mmom bɔ ɔte titire wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ɔte kãa; yeɛ bɔ ɔla ɛmɔ noa ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔso ɔ. 27 Na bɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɔte titire ɔ: bɔ ɔte poen nwo odidi ne, anaakyɛ bɔ ɔso ne? Aso nna bɔ ɔte poen nwo odidi ne ɔ? Nakoso me de, nwɔ ɛmɔ nu kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔso ɔ.
28“Ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔ ne me banate alaa wɔ me nzɔhwɛ nu ɔ; 29na kyɛbɔ me Baba afa ahennie ne wama me ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me koso mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ, 30 amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔadidi ná ɛmɔano wɔ me poen so wɔ m’ahennie nu, ná ɛmɔatenatena ahennie bia so babua Yisrael mmusua kure buru ne nyɔ ne ndɛen.”
Yesu hyɛ ngɔm kyɛ Petro kɔpo ye
(Mateo 26.31-35; Marko 14.27-31; Yohane 13.36-38)
31[Na Awurade sele kyɛ,] “Simɔn, Simɔn, tie, ahaa Abɔnzam kuro kyɛ ye sa kã ɛmɔ, ná ohuhu ɛmɔ so kyɛ aburoo. 32Nakoso mabɔ mbaeɛ mama wɔ, kyɛbɔ wɔ gyidie ngɔtɔ ase ɔ, amaa sɛ esa gyina wɔ gya so a, ahyɛ eliɛma mɔ nguraen.”
33Na Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, maboaboa me nwo kyɛ me ne wɔ yɛkɔhɔ kuku nu ne ewue nu.” 34Na Yesu sele kyɛ, “Petro, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, ɛnɛ, anzana akɔ kɔbɔ ne, né asa ye pɛen nza kyɛ ɛnze me.”
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ bieku
35 Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ nzomane ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔamva sikaabɔtɔ, anaa ateetulɛ bɔtɔ, anaa mbaboa ne, nikyee bie hiane ɛmɔ anaa?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Daabi, yanhia hwee.” 36Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nakoso afei de, ebiala bɔ ole sikaabɔtɔ ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa, yeɛ ye ateetulɛ bɔtɔ koso sɔ ala; na ebiala bɔ olle ngrandɛ ne de, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔtɔne ye tena fa tɔ ngrandɛ. 37 Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɔ dwirɛ he bɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔkã ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔba nu wɔ me nwo kyɛ, ‘Bɛhale ye bɛfrale mmeraatolɛfoɛ.’ Ofikyɛ bɔ ɔfa me nwo ne, ye mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔba nu ne wadwu.” 38Yeɛ besele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nea! Ngrandɛ nyɔ wɔ wa.” Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpɛ dwirɛ he aso!”
Yesu di aworabɔlɛ wɔ Getsemane
(Mateo 26.36-46; Marko 14.32-42)
39Yesu fili berɛ, na kyɛbɔ né ɔtaa yɔ ne, ɔhɔle Olive Bokaa ne aso, na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ belili ye si. 40Na odwuli berɛ nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ ná ɛmɔangɔ nzɔhwɛ nu!” 41Na ɔhwene ye nwo fili bɛ nwo berɛ hɔle ye nyunu moa kãa nen, obuli ndwerɛ bɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, 42“Baba, sɛ ekuro a, ye sɔ kulie he fi me so; nakoso nna kyɛbɔ mekuro hɔ ɔ, na mmom bɔ ekuro ne yeɛ ɔyɛ berɛ ɔ.” [ 43Na abɔfo fili nyameɛso ɔɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele ye, na ɔhyɛle ye nguraen. 44Né Yesu wora abɔ soma, na ɔhɔle so mane ye mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu yɛle se. Na ye nwo mvifire ne yɛle kyɛ mogya bɔ ɔpepe gua ase ɔ.]
45Na odwɔsole fili mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne anu nen, ɔwale asuafoɛ nemɔ nwo dɔ, na onwuni kyɛ aworabɔlɛ amaa balafelafe. 46Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdafe ye? Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ ná ɛmɔangɔ nzɔhwɛ nu.”
Bɛhyele Yesu
(Mateo 26.47-56; Marko 14.43-50; Yohane 18.3-11)
47Na Yesu gu so odwudwo nen, yieee, ɛlɔen bie wale berɛ. Né asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne anu ko bɔ oli Yudase yeɛ oli bɛ nyunu ɔ. Ɔwale Yesu nwo berɛ, na ɔfele ye noa. 48Na Yesu bisale ye kyɛ, “Yudase, aso ele bɛ noafelɛ yeɛ ɛfa ɛye Sona Awa ne ma ɔ?”
49Na mmenia bɔ né bɛwɔ ye nwo berɛ ne, benwuni bɔ ɔbaasi nen, bebisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, yɛ́fa ngrandɛ yɛ́pepɛ bɛ anaa?” 50Na bɛ nu ko bɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’akoaa, na ɔpɛle ye so famaa tole. 51Na Yesu hane kyɛ, “Daabi, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ sɔ ko!” Na ɔfale ye sa hane ye so ne maa ɔyɛle kyɛ ye daa ne ala.
52Afei Yesu sele asɔfo mbanyi ne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne maen mbanyi bɔ bɛwale kyɛ bɛbaahye ye ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔwale kyɛ ɛmɔbaahye awerɔm awueniɛ hɔ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔtiratira ngrandɛ ne mmopura ye? 53 Daa biala bɔ né me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu nen, ɛmɔangye me. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ mmerɛ ne awosii tumi ɔ.”
Petro po Yesu
(Mateo 26.57, 58, 69-75; Marko 14.53, 54, 66-72; Yohane 18.12-18, 25-27)
54Afei bɛhyele Yesu, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’awuro. Na Petro de, olili bɛ si nziɛ nziɛ. 55Behuane see wɔ aluo berɛ bɛtenane ye nwo, na Petro ɔɔtenane bɛ nwo berɛ bie. 56Yeɛ afaneɛ abaayaa bie nwuni ye kyɛ ɔte see ne anwo berɛ, na ɔneane ye haa sele kyɛ, “Akoaa he koso, né ɔne ye yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.” 57Nakoso ɔsale kyɛ, “Mmobraa, menze ye oo!”
58Na ɔhyɛle kãa nen, sona foforɛ nwuni ye, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Wɔ koso ɛboka bɛ so!” Nakoso Petro hane kyɛ, “Ngyabiaa, mmmoka bɛ so oo!”
59Na kɔyɛ dɔnhwere ko asi ne, sona foforɛ bieku sili so kyɛ, “Ɔte nahorɛ, akoaa he, né ɔne ye yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte Galileaniɛ.” 60Nakoso Petro buale kyɛ, “Ngyabiaa, bɔ ɛkã ye, menze ye nwo hwee oo!” Na ye noa wɔ so bɔ odwudwo nen, berɛ ne ala akɔ bɔle. 61Na Awurade pɛle ye nye neane Petro nyunu, na Petro kayele Awurade dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele ye kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ, akɔ ngɔbɔ né ahã ye pɛen nza kyɛ ɛnze me” ne. 62Na Petro fite hɔle oosuni hahii.
Bɛgoro Yesu nwo besa bɛbo ye
(Mateo 26.67-68; Marko 14.65)
63Na mmenia bɔ né betiratira Yesu nu ne, bɛgorole ye nwo, na bɛbole ye. 64Bɛkyekyele ye nye, na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Hyɛ ngɔm! Nwa yeɛ ɔbɔle wɔ ne?” 65Na musue dwirɛ pee boka so yeɛ bɛkekã betiale ye ɔ.
Yesu gyi badwa nyunu
(Mateo 26.59-66; Marko 14.55-64; Yohane 18.19-24)
66Na aleɛ hyene ne, maen mbanyi ne asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ beyiale, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle bɛ badwa ne anyunu, na besele ye kyɛ, 67“Wɔ ole Kristo ne anaa? Kã kyire yɛ!” Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ a, ɛmɔngole ngoli, 68yeɛ sɛ mebisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ koso a, ɛmɔngɔma me mmuayɛɛ. 69Na ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, Sona Awa ne kɔtena Nyameɛ tumi ne sa famaa so.” 70Yeɛ bɛ mukoraa bebisale kyɛ, “Yiti wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne anaa?” Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ye ala yeɛ ɛmɔahã ne. Me ole ye!” 71Na bɛhane kyɛ, “Adanzeɛ beni bieku yeɛ yɛhia ɔ? Yɛ bɔbɔ yate yafi ye noa nu.”

Title: LUKA 23
Content:
Bɛfa Yesu begyina Pilato nyunu
(Mateo 27.1, 2, 11-14; Marko 15.1-5; Yohane 18.28-38)
1Afei mmenia worawora ne amukoraa bedwɔsole, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle Pilato nyunu. 2Na bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛbɔle ye kwaadu kyɛ, “Akoaa he, yɛhyele ye kyɛ ɔbɔ yɛ maen ne anwo tokuro, na ɔbera mmenia kyɛ nnɛmaa betua toɔ bɛma Kaesare; afei koso, ɔnwa ye ala ole Ɛhene Kristo ne.” 3Yeɛ Pilato bisale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Yudafoɛ Hene ne anaa?” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Ye ala yeɛ ahã ne.” 4Na Pilato sele asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ ne ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Biaa he, me de, mennwu foɛ biala bɔ odi ɔ.” 5Nakoso bɛhane ye serɛserɛ so kyɛ, “Ɔma mmenia yɛ maen ne anwo lɔen; ɔyɛ sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne wɔ Yudea maen nu amukoraa, na ɔhyɛle ye bo Galilea, yeɛ afei wafa waadwu ɛwa po.”
Bɛfa Yesu bɛkɔ Herode nyunu
6Na Pilato tele dumaa Galilea nen, obisale kyɛ, “Biaa he te Galileaniɛ anaa?” 7Na ɔtele kyɛ ofi Herode manzini nu nen, ɔmaa bɛfale ye bɛɛmane Herode, bɔ né sɔ mmerɛ ne, ye koso ɔwɔ Yerusalem ɔ. 8Na ɔyɛle Herode fɛ paa kyɛ wanwu Yesu ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ né wate ye nga, na ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔpena kyɛ onwu ye ɔ, né wahyɛ. Na né ye nye la so kyɛ ɔkɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bie maa okonwu ye. 9Yiti Herode bisale ye dwirɛ pee, nakoso wamma ye mmuayɛɛ biala. 10Né asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ begyigyi berɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye kwaadu yeayea paa. 11Na Herode ne ye asraafoɛ bɛpepɛle ye nzoaa, bɛgorole ye nwo; na afei ɔfale ataadeɛ nyemenenyemene bie wurale ye, na ɔmaa besa bɛfale ye bɛɛmane Pilato. 12Na sɔ kyẽa ne ala, Herode ne Pilato bɛfale abiɛngoɛ; ofikyɛ daa ne de, né bɛyaka.
Bebua Yesu ewue foɛ
(Mateo 27.15-26; Marko 15.6-15; Yohane 18.39—19.16)
13Afei Pilato frɛle asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ, maen mbanyi ne ɛlɔen ne maa beyiale, 14na ɔfa tole bɛ nyunu kyɛ, “Ɛmɔfale biaa he bɛbrɛle me, kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔma mmenia bɛyɔ basabasa wɔ maen ne anu ɔ. Na ɛ́mɔtie, mabisabisa ye dwirɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nyunu wa, nakoso kwaadu bɔ ɛmɔafa babɔ biaa he ne, mennwu kyɛ odi nu biala nwo fɔ ɔ. 15Na sɔ ala yeɛ Herode koso wannwu kyɛ odi fɔ ɔ; yiti ɔmaa besa bɛfale ye bɛbrɛle yɛ. Na ɛ́mɔtie, ɔyyɔle nikye fee bɔ ɔfata kyɛ beku ye ɔ. 16Yiti ngofi ye mbire, ná mayakyi ye.” 17[Na aluolue ne anu, né odi kyɛ ɔyakyi kukununiɛ ko ɔma bɛ.]
18Na bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle nu bɛteane nu kyɛ, “Ye akoaa he fi berɛ, ná yakyi Baraba ma yɛ!” 19(Ɔte ebie bɔ né wayɛ lɔen watia awaen ne wɔ kuro ne anu ɔ; afei koso né wali awue; yiti né bafa ye bato kuku nu.)
20Né Pilato pena kyɛ ɔyakyi Yesu, yiti obisale bɛ bieku; 21nakoso bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Bɔ ye mmeamudua nu! Bɔ ye mmeamudua nu!” 22Obisale bɛ ye pɛen nza so kyɛ, “Nzu ɔ? Nzikyɛ bɔne yeɛ wayɔ ɔ? Me de, mennwu nikyee biala bɔ wayɔ bɔ ɔfata kyɛ beku ye ɔ; yiti ngofi ye mbire, ná mayakyi ye.” 23Na bɛhɔle so bɛteateane nu besele kyɛ, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu; na dede bɔ bɛyɔle ne, ɔbole ye deɛ ne aso. 24Yiti Pilato buale ndɛen, kyɛ bɔ bɛpena ne, wayakyi nu wama bɛ. 25Na ɔyakyili biaa bɔ ɔnate ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne awuelilɛ ti bafa ye bato kuku nu ne mane bɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛsrɛle ye ne ala; nakoso Yesu de, ɔyele ye mane bɛ kyɛbɔ bɛpena ne.
Bɛbɔ Yesu mmeamudua nu
(Mateo 27.32-44; Marko 15.21-32; Yohane 19.17-27)
26Na bɛ́fa ye bɛ́kɔ nen, bɛhyele Simɔn bie bɔ ofi Kirene, bɔ né ofi namue nu ɔba ɔ, na bɛfale mmeamudua ne bɛtole ye so, kyɛ ɔsoa li Yesu si.
27Na maen ne anu mmenia pee lili ye si, yeɛ mmrasua bɔ bɛbɔ awuye ná besu ye ɔ koso. 28Nakoso Yesu berele ye nye neane bɛ sele kyɛ, “Yerusalem mmaa mmrasua, nnɛma ɛmɔsu me, na mmom ɛ́mɔsu ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo ɔne ɛmɔ mma mɔ!. 29Na ɛ́mɔtie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Mmotaen mɔ, yeɛ koɛ mɔ bɔ banwo ba koraa, ɔne nyɔfone mɔ bɔ bɛnnone bɛ le ne, banya saleɛ!’ 30 Yeɛ bɛkɔhyɛ ye bo bɛkɔhã bekohyire mmokaa kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔdwiri bégua yɛ so!’ ɔne pambaa mɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa yɛ bɛ́fea!’ 31Na sɛ bɛfa ɛhemɔ bɛyɛ bakaa monɛ a, né bakaa wuruwaa de bɛkɔyɛ ye sɛ?”
32Na bɛfale bɔnefoɛ nyɔ koso bɛbokale ye so bɛhɔle, kyɛ bɛkwaahũ bɛ. 33Na bedwuli nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ “Tire Kokuroka so,” na berɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle ye ne bɔnefoɛ nemɔ mmeamudua nu ɔ: ko wɔ ye famaa so, yeɛ ko koso wɔ ye bɛen so. 34 Na Yesu hane kyɛ, “Baba, fa kyɛ bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛnze bɔ bɛyɔ ɔ!” Na beguale serewa bɛhyɛle ye ndaadeɛ ne bɛfale.
35Né mmenia nemɔ begyigyi berɛ bɛnea. Na mbanyi nemɔ gorole ye nwo kyɛ, “Olele ebiemɔ, sɛ ye ole Kristo ne bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu aye ye ne a, maa ole ye nwo e!” 36 Asraafoɛ nemɔ koso gorole ye nwo, na bɛwale ye nwo berɛ bɛɛmane ye nzaa kekarekekare bie, 37na besele kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛte Yudafoɛ hene a, de wɔ nwo e!” 38Na bɛhyerɛle edwirɛ bie bɛbɔle ye ti so anwuro kyɛ: Yudafoɛ Hene ne ɛhe.
39Bɔnefoɛ bɔ bɛbɔle bɛ mmeamudua nu ne, bɛ nu ko bɔle ye alapaa kyɛ, “Aso nna wɔ ole Kristo ne anaa? Pepɛ de wɔ nwo ná de yɛ koso e!” 40Nakoso ko ne buale ye hwili ye nyunu kyɛ, “Enzuro Nyameɛ hɔ ɔ, kyɛ foɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ bafa babua wɔ ɔ? 41Yɛ deɛ ne de, ɔfata yɛ; ofikyɛ bɔ yayɔ ne, ye nwo akatuaa yeɛ yanya ye ne; nakoso biaa he de, ɔyyɔle bɔne nikyee biala bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ.” 42Na osele kyɛ, “Yesu, sɛ ɛba w’ahennie nu a, kaye me.” 43Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɛkɔboka me so wɔ Paradise.”
Yesu wue
(Mateo 27.45-56; Marko 15.33-41; Yohane 19.28-30)
44Kɔyɛ eyiagyina ne, awosii katale aseɛ so amukoraa maa oodwuli nnɔnmmiɛnza. 45 Awosii katale eyia so, na ɛtena bɔ ɔpɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, nu suale nyɔ. 46 Afei Yesu teane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Baba, wɔ sa nu yeɛ mefa me sunzum mewura ɔ!” Na ɔhane ɛhe ne, ɔhale nu.
47Na asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne nwuni bɔ wasi nen, ɔyele Nyameɛ ayɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Amba, biaa he te teneneeniɛ!”
48Na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛwale berɛ kyɛ bɛbaanea bie ne, benwuni bɔ wasi nen, bɛfale bɛ sa befifini b’ahone befili berɛ bɛhɔle. 49 Na ye mmango amukoraa ne mmrasua bɔ belili ye si befili Galilea ne, begyinagyinane nziɛ nziɛ yeɛ bɛneane bɔ ɔhɔle so ne ɔ.
Besie Yesu
(Mateo 27.57-61; Marko 15.42-47; Yohane 19.38-42)
50Na tie, biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yosef bɔ ofi Yudafoɛ kuro Arimatea so, bɔ ɔte badwafoɛ nemɔ anu ko, bɔ ɔte sona paa ná ɔtengyɛ ɔ, 51bɔ ye de wambene bɛ porɛ ne bɛ yɔleɛ ne aso ɔ, né ye de ɔ́nwondɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne. 52Sɔ biaa ne hɔle Pilato berɛ ɔɔsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔfa Yesu fuin ne ma ye. 53Yeɛ ɔyele fuin ne wale ase, ɔfale nwera kyekyele ye nwo, na ɔfale ye ɔɔtole asieleɛ bɔ bapɛ ye nyɔbotaen nu ɔ nu. Né bɛffale ebiala bɛttole nu le. 54Né ɔte anwoboaboa kyẽa, bɔ afofikyẽa ne wapingye ɔ.
55Na mmrasua bɔ bɛ ne Yesu fili Galilea bɛwale ne, bɛhɔ bɛɛneane asieleɛ ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ bɛfale ye fuin ne bɛtole nu ɔ. 56 Afei besa bɛhɔle beesiesiele ayirefona ne sakyeɛfona. Na afofikyẽa ne, belele bɛ nwome kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne te ne.

Title: LUKA 24
Content:
Yesu tingye fi ewue nu
(Mateo 28.1-10; Marko 16.1-8; Yohane 20.1-10)
1Na dapɛn ne anu kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ye alebahyene, bɛfale ayirefona bɔ besiesiele ne bɛhɔle asieleɛ ne aso. 2Na benwuni kyɛ nyɔboɛ ne amunu afi asieleɛ ne noa, 3na bewurale nu, nakoso bannwu Awurade Yesu fuin ne berɛ. 4Na ɔwale kyɛ, ɛhe maa bɛyɛle basaa, na mvum nu, mmienzua nyɔ bɔ bɛ ndaadeɛ te fufue hyɛnhyɛnn ɔ beegyinane bɛ nwo berɛ. 5Na ɛserɛ hane bɛ maa bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli berɛ. Na mmienzua nemɔ bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔpena teasefoɛ wɔ awufoɛ nu ɔ? 6 [Ɔnne wa, watingye.] Ɛ́mɔkaye bɔ ɔhã hyirele ɛmɔ ne, mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ Galilea ne, 7kyɛ, ‘Ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa Sona Awa ne bewura bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa, ná bɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu, ná ye ɛlɛsa so watingye.’ ”
8Na bɛkayele ye dwirɛ ne, 9na besa befili asieleɛ ne aso bɛɛfale ye mukoraa nwo amaneɛ bɛbɔle asuafoɛ buru ne ko ne, ɔne bɛ ngaa ne amukoraa. 10Na Maria Magdalene, Yoana, Yakobo maame Maria, yeɛ afei mmrasua bieku mɔ boka so yeɛ bɛɛfale edwirɛ he bɛbɔle asomafoɛ nemɔ amaneɛ ɔ. 11Nakoso bɛ de, bebuli sɔ dwirɛ ne kyɛ ɛhoaa bie ɔ, na banne bɛ banni.
12[Na Petro dwɔsole, ole amirika hɔle asieleɛ ne aso, ɔkotole huli ye nye ase neane nu, na onwuni kyɛ nwera ne gua ahameɛ; na ofili berɛ hɔle awuro, na bɔ wasi ne yɛle ye nwanwa.]
Emawoso atee so
(Marko 16.12-13)
13Na sɔ kyẽa ne ala, né bɛ nu nyɔ bɛ́kɔ akuraa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Emawoso nu; bɔ efi Yerusalem ɛkɔ berɛ a ɔte kɔyɛ kwanzii nzoo ɔ. 14Né bedi edwirɛ hemɔ bɔ wasisi ne amukoraa nwo ngɔmɔ. 15Na ɔwale kyɛ begu so bedi ngɔmɔ ná bebisabisa bɛ nwo nen, Yesu bɔbɔ opingyele bɛ, na ɔne bɛ bɛbɔle agyirɛ bɛhɔle. 16Nakoso wamma bɛ nye ne wangora wannwu kyɛ ye ɔ. 17Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔdi ye nwo ngɔmɔ bɛkɔ bɔ ɛmɔ wora abɔ ye?” 18Yeɛ bɛ nu ko bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kleopa ne obuale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte wɔfoɛ wɔ Yerusalem ɔ, bɔ yeɛ ɛnze edwirɛ mɔ bɔ ɛlɛsa ye wasisi dɔ ye?” 19Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ ɔ?” Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Ɔfa Nasarɛteniɛ Yesu bɔ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ole tumi wɔ nnwumaa ne edwudwolɛ nu, wɔ Nyameɛ ne maen ne amukoraa nyunu nwo, 20ɔne kyɛbɔ yɛ asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi bɛyele ye bɛmane maa bebuale ye ewue foɛ, ná babɔ ye mmeamudua nu ɔ. 21Nakoso yɛ de, ahaa né yɛ nye la so kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbaale Yisrael ɔ. Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa asi ne, edwirɛ hemɔ sili ɔ ɛlɛsa ɛhe. 22Amba, yɛ nu mmrasua nemɔ bie bɛmane yɛ nwo dwirili yɛ. Bɛhɔle asieleɛ ne aso ɛnɛ alebahyene, 23nakoso bannwu ye fuin ne; na besa bɛwale bɛɛbɔle amaneɛ kyɛ abɔfo biemɔ yele bɛ nwo ali hyirele bɛ po, maa bɛhane kyɛ ɔte ase. 24Na yɛ nu mmenia ne biemɔ koso bɛhɔle asieleɛ ne aso, na beenwuni kyɛbɔ mmrasua nemɔ bɛhane ne ala; nakoso ye de, bannwu ye.”
25Afei osele bɛ kyɛ, “O ɛmɔ ndeaseɛ wɔ dede, ɛmɔ adwene te nganga kyɛ ɛmɔkole bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bahã ne amukoraa bekoli ɔ! 26Aso né onhia kyɛ Kristo ne onwu sɔ amaneɛ ne koraka ná wahɔ ye animnyam nu hɔ ɔ?” 27Na ɔhyɛle ye bo fili Mose ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa so ohyirehyire Ahyerɛlɛ ne amukoraa nu dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa ye nwo ɔ nu hyirele bɛ. 28Na bepingyele akuraa bɔ bɛ́kɔ so nen, ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔpɛ nu kɔ moa, 29na bɛsrɛle ye serɛserɛ so kyɛ, “Maa yɛla, na aleɛ adwo, ewienu pinipini.” Yiti ɔne bɛ bɛhɔle awuro kyɛ ɔne bɛ bɛkwaala berɛ. 30Na ɔwale kyɛ ɔne bɛ bɛtenane poen nwo kyɛ bedidi nen, ɔfale paanoo ne, oyirale so, na obubuli nu fa mane bɛ. 31Na afei bɛ nye ne bukyebukyele, na benwuni kyɛ ye ɔ; na otu minini. 32Na besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ né ɔne yɛ di ngɔmɔ wɔ atunu dɔ, bɔ né okyirekyire Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu kyire yɛ ne, aso yɛ kunu anyɛ yɛ nufaa?”
33Na bedwɔsole berɛ ne ala besa bɛhɔle Yerusalem; na beenwuni asuafoɛ buru ne ko ne, bɛne bɛ bɔ bɛboka bɛ so ne kyɛ bayia neka horɛ ɔ, 34bɔ begu so bɛkã kyɛ, “Awurade adwɔso amba, na waye ye nwo ali wahyire Simɔn.” 35Yeɛ mmenia nyɔ ne bɛhane bɔ osili atunu dɔ ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ bɛfale paanoo bubulɛ ne anu benwuni kyɛ ye ahɔ ɔ behyirele bɛ.
Yesu ye ye nwo ali kyire ye asuafoɛ nemɔ
(Mateo 28.16-20; Marko 16.14-18; Yohane 20.19-23; Asomafoɛ 1.6-8)
36Na begu so bɔ bɛkã sɔ dwirɛ nen, Yesu bɔbɔ oogyinane b’afia berɛ, [na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Asomdwee hã ɛmɔ oo!”] 37Na bɛbɔle binim, na ɛserɛ hane bɛ maa besusuli kyɛ ɛnwomee yeɛ banwu ye ɔ. 38Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛserɛ ahã ɛmɔ ye? Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔsu aporowaa ɛmɔ adwene nu ye? 39Ɛ́mɔnea me sa ne me gya, na me bɔbɔ ala ɔ. Ɛ́mɔsɔ me nu bɛ́nea; ofikyɛ ɛnwomee de olle anwoɔnaen ne mmowue kyɛbɔ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ nne ye ne.” 40[Na ɔhane sɔ nen, ɔfale ye sa ne ye gya hyirele bɛ.] 41Na anigye bɔ né banya ne, ɔne ye nwanwa bɔ ɔyɛ bɛ ne asi ne po, né begu so benne benni, na obisale bɛ kyɛ “Ɛmɔle aleɛ bie wɔ wa anaa?” 42Na bɛmane ye tiré bɔ batoto ɔ sii bie, 43na ole lili wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ.
44Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole me dwirɛ bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, mmerɛ bɔ né me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ ne, kyɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bafa me nwo amukoraa wɔ Mose mmeraa ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne Edwein Nwomaa ne anu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔba nu ɔ.”
45Afei obukyele b’adwene nu maa bɛtele Ahyerɛlɛ ne abo. 46Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Ɔsɛ kyɛ Kristo ne onwu amaneɛ, ná ye ɛlɛsa ne aso odwɔso fi awufoɛ nu, 47ná bafa ye dumaa so babɔ adwenesakyera ne bɔnefakyɛ nwo dawure wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu, na bɛkɔhyɛ ye bo wɔ Yerusalem.’ 48Ɛmɔte ɛhemɔ nwo adanzefoɛ. 49 Na ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔsoma me Baba bɔhyɛ ne maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ so; nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwondɛ wɔ Yerusalem kuro ye anu, kodwu mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ bekofi anwuro ɔ.”
Kristo nyameɛso hɔlɛ
(Marko 16.19, 20; Asomafoɛ 1.9-11)
50 Afei ɔfale bɛ fili berɛ oodwuli Betania, na ɔmane ye sa so yirayirale bɛ. 51Na ɔwale kyɛ ogu so bɔ oyirayira bɛ nen, ɔne bɛ lili ndetemuɛ, [na Nyameɛ mane ye so hɔle nyameɛso. 52Na bɛkotole bɛsɔnene ye,] na bele anigye pirikua besa bɛwale Yerusalem. 53Na daa biala né bɛwɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ bɛye Nyameɛ ayɛ.

Title: YOHANE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Ahyerɛlɛ Krongron nimdeɛfoɛ biemɔ dedi kyɛ Yesu suaniɛ Yohane yeɛ ɔhyerɛle sɔ nwomaa he ɔ. Yohane te suaniɛ bɔ né Yesu kuro ye dwirɛ paa ɔ. (Yoh 20.24; 21.20-24).
Yohane nzɛmba ne kyire kyɛ Yesu ole Kristo ne, Nyameɛ Awa ne; na ebiala bɔ okole ye koli ne konya daa ngoa (Yoh 20.31).
Yohane le Nyameɛ Dwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ne yeɛ ɔbɔ ye nzɛmba ne bo ɔ. Ɔkɔ so kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ Dwirɛ ne ole Yesu; na né ɔne Nyameɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ koraa yeɛ bɛbaabɔ wiase ɔ; na Edwirɛ ne ɔɔyɛle kuro sona ɔne yɛ ɔɔtenane (Yoh 1.44).
Nwomaa he ka nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ahoroɔ nwo dwirɛ bɔ okyire kyɛ Yesu ole Ngoadefoɛ ne ɔ. Ɛhe mane ebiemɔ lele Yesu lili, na ebiemɔ koso de, banne ye banni.
Yohane nzɛmba ne anu ngome yeɛ yɛkenga braa bɔ bɛhyele ye kyɛ wabɔ adwaman ne nwo dwirɛ ɔ (Yoh 8.1-11); ofikyɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne nne tete Ahyerɛlɛ Krongron bɔ bɛfale bɛ sa bɛhyerɛle ne biemɔ nu.
Yohane nzɛmba ne ka daa ngoa bɔ ɔnate Yesu adom so yɛnya ne nwo dwirɛ paa. Ɔte adom bɔ ebiala bɔ ode to nu kyɛ Yesu ole “atee ne, nahorɛ ne ɔne ngoa ne” onya ɔ. Na ebiala ngora ngɔ Baba ne berɛ, sana ɔnate Yesu so (Yoh 14.6).
Nwomaa n’ayieleɛ ne kyire kyɛ Yesu kuro ye asuafoɛ ne dwirɛ paa; otu bɛ foɛ, na ɔhyɛ bɛ nguraen kyɛ bɛyɛ ko, na begyina pindinn; ofikyɛ ɔbaayakyi bɛ berɛ kɔ ye Baba dɔ. Afei osa ka Yesu amaneɛnwunɛ, ye wutingyelɛ, ɔne ye nwo ali bɔ ɔye hyirele mmenia pee nwo dwirɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-18
Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ne Yesu asuafoɛ bɔ beli moa ne 1.19-51
Yesu badwa nu nnwumaa 2.1—12.50
Yesu di ye ngyẽa bɔ oli ayieleɛ ne wɔ Yerusalem ne ye mbɔtam 13.1—19.42
Yesu wutingyelɛ ne ye nwo aliyelɛ 20.1-31
Ayieleɛ: ye nwo aliyelɛ bieku wɔ Galilea 21.1-25

Title: YOHANE 1
Content:
Ngoa dwirɛ ne
1 Ahyɛaseɛ ne, né Edwirɛ ne wɔ berɛ, né Edwirɛ ne ne Nyameɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ, na Edwirɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ɔ. 2 Ahyɛaseɛ ne, né ɔne Nyameɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. 3 Ɔnate ye so yeɛ bɛyɔle nningyein amukoraa ɔ, na bangwati ye banyɔ nikyee biala bɔ bɛyɔle ɔ. 4 Ye nu yeɛ ngoa wɔ ɔ; na ngoa ne te mmenia kanea. 5 Na kanea ne ta awosii nu, na awosii ne angora angye kanea ne.
6 Na biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ Nyameɛ somane ye ɔ, bɔ ye dumaa li Yohane. 7Ye yeɛ ɔwale adanzeɛlilɛ, kyɛ ɔbaali kanea ne nwo adanzeɛ, amaa ɔnate ye so mmenia mukoraa bale bali. 8Nna ye bɔbɔ ole kanea ne, na mmom ɔwale oolili kanea ne nwo adanzeɛ. 9 Nahorɛ kanea bɔ ɔta ma sona biala ne yeɛ né ɔba wiase ɔ. 10Né ɔwɔ wiase dada, na ɔnate ye so yeɛ bɛbɔle wiase ɔ, nakoso wiase annwu ye 11 Ɔwale ye bɔbɔ ye deɛ nu, nakoso ye bɔbɔ ye mmenia banne ye bando nu. 12 Nakoso mmeni soma bɔ belele ye bɛtole nu, bɛ bɔ belele ye dumaa belili ne, ɔmane bɛ tumi maa bɛɛyɛle Nyameɛ mma; 13 bɔ bamva mogya so, anaakyɛ anwoɔnaen apɛdeɛ so, anaakyɛ sona apɛdeɛ so, na mmom Nyameɛ nu yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ.
14Na Edwirɛ ne ɔɔyɛle anwoɔnaen, na ɔne yɛ ɛɛtenane, na yɛnwuni ye animnyam kyɛ Baba n’Awa bɔ ɔwole ye komapɛ twe n’animnyam, na adom ne nahorɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛ. 15Yohane lili ye nwo adanzeɛ, na ɔteane nu hane kyɛ, “Ɛhe ole bɔ ngane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ oli me si ɔ́ba ne, odi mu tra me, ofikyɛ né ɔwɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ meba ɔ.’ ” 16Ɔnate ye adom totohyia ne aso yeɛ yɛ mukoraati yanya adom mmorosoɛ ɔ. 17Mmeraa ne de, bɛnate Mose so yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane ɔ; na adom ne nahorɛ ne de, ɔnate Yesu Kristo so yeɛ bɛwale ɔ. 18 Ebiala nnwuni Nyameɛ le; sana Baa komapɛ twe ne, bɔ ɔla Baba n’ahone nwo ne, na ye yeɛ wala ye ali wahyire ɔ.
Yohane di Yesu nwo adanzeɛ
(Mateo 3.1-12; Marko 1.1-8; Luka 3.1-18)
19 Na adanzeɛ he yeɛ Yohane lili ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ Yudafoɛ bɛsomane asɔfo mɔ ne Lewifoɛ befili Yerusalem maa beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nwa ole wɔ?” 20 Ɔhane ye pefee, na wanza; na ɔhane ye pefee kyɛ, “Nna me ole Kristo ne.” 21 Na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzaade, nwa ole wɔ? Wɔ ole Elia anaa?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Nna me ole ye.” Na besa bebisale kyɛ, “Wɔ ole ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne anaa?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Daabi.” 22Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzaade nwa ole wɔ? Na yɛnya mmuayɛɛ yɛɛma bɛ bɔ bɛsomane yɛ ne. Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛkã fa wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ɔ?” 23 Na obuale kyɛ, “Me ole komviɛ bie bɔ ɔtea nu wɔ ɛserɛ so kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtengyɛ Awurade atee,’ kyɛbɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hane ne.”
24Na ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ somane bɛ ne, 25bebisale ye kyɛ, “Na sɛ nna wɔ ole Kristo ne, anaa Elia, anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne a, né nzu ati yeɛ ɛ́bɔ asu ɔ?” 26 Yeɛ Yohane buale bɛ kyɛ, “Me de, mefa nzue yeɛ mebɔ asu ɔ; nakoso ebie bɔ ɛmɔnze ye ɔ ogyi ɛmɔ afia wa. 27 Ye ole bɔ oli me si ɔ́ba, bɔ memvata kyɛ mesangye ye mbaboa nyamaa po ɔ.” 28 Edwirɛ hemɔ sili wɔ Betania, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ, nekaa bɔ né Yohane ɔ́bɔ asu ne.
Nyameɛ Boaen Ba ne
(Mateo 3.13-17; Marko 1.9-11; Luka 3.21-22)
29 Aleɛ hyene ne, Yohane nwuni Yesu kyɛ ɔba ye berɛ ɔ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, Nyameɛ Boaen Ba ne, bɔ ɔye wiase bɔne fi berɛ ne! 30Ɛhe ole bɔ ngane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Biaa bie li me si ɔ́ba bɔ odi mu tra me ɔ, ofikyɛ né ɔwɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ meba ɔ.’ 31Me bɔbɔ de, ahaa menze ye; nakoso mmale kyɛ mebaafa nzue mebɔ asu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛkɔye ye bekohyire Yisrael ɔ.” 32 Na Yohane lili adanzeɛ kyɛ, “Nwuni Sunzum ne kyɛ ofi nyameɛso odwu ba ase kyɛ abubure ɔ, na ɔtenane ye so. 33Me bɔbɔ de, né menze ye, nakoso bɔ ɔsomane me kyɛ mmamva nzue mmɔ asu ne yeɛ ɔhã hyirele me kyɛ, ‘Bɔ ekonwu kyɛ Sunzum ne ódwu batena ye so nen, ye ole bɔ ɔbɔ asu Sunzum Krongron nu ne.’ 34Me bɔbɔ manwu ye, na medi adanzeɛ kyɛ ye ole Nyameɛ Awa ne.”
Yesu frɛ ye asuafoɛ bɔ beli moa
35 Aleɛ hyene bieku nen, né Yohane ne ye asuafoɛ nyɔ begyigyi berɛ. 36Na onwuni kyɛ Yesu nate berɛ nen, ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, Nyameɛ Boaen Ba ne ɛhe!” 37Asuafoɛ nyɔ ne tele bɔ ɔhane ne, na beelili Yesu si. 38 Yesu kakyili ye nwo, na onwuni kyɛ beli ye si nen, obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔpena nzu?” Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Rabi” (ye bo kyire Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ), “nisua yeɛ ɛte ɔ?” 39Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea.” Na bɛhɔ bɛɛneane nekaa bɔ ɔte ɔ, na bɛɛtenane ye berɛ sɔ kyẽa ne, ofikyɛ né wabɔ kɔyɛ nɔsoa nnɔnan. 40Mmenia nyɔ bɔ betele kyɛ Yohane ódwudwo ná beelili ye si ne, ko ole Andrea, Simɔn Petro aliɛma ne. 41Olili moa nwuni oliɛma Simɔn, na osele ye kyɛ, “Yanwu Mɛsaya ne” (bɔ ye bo kyire Kristo ne). 42 Ɔfale ye hɔle Yesu berɛ, na Yesu neane ye haa sele kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Simɔn, Yohane awa ne. Bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ Kefa.” (Ye bo kyire Petro).
Yesu frɛ Filipo ne Nataneɛl
43 Aleɛ hyene ne, Yesu yɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔ Galilea. Onwuni Filipo, na osele ye kyɛ, “Di me si!” 44Filipo fi Betesaeda, Andrea ne Petro bɛ kuro. 45 Filipo nwuni Nataneɛl, na osele ye kyɛ, “Bɔ Mose, wɔ mmeraa ne anu, ɔne bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛhyerɛle ye nwo dwirɛ ne, yanwu ye: Yesu bɔ ofi Nasarɛte, Yosef awa ne.” 46Na Nataneɛl bisale ye kyɛ, “Aso nikyee paa bie kɔhora kofi Nasarɛte kɔwa?” Yeɛ Filipo buale ye kyɛ, “Bra baanea.” 47 Na Yesu nwuni kyɛ Nataneɛl ɔba ye berɛ nen, ɔhã fale ye nwo kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, Yisraelniɛ turoloo bɔ ngondombo biala nne ye nu ɔ!” 48Na Nataneɛl bisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛse me ɔ?” Yesu buale kyɛ “Anzana Filipo baafrɛ wɔ, bɔ né ɛwɔ borɔdoma bakaa ne abo nen, yeɛ nwuni wɔ ɔ.” 49 Nataneɛl buale kyɛ, “Rabi, wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne! Wɔ ole Yisrael Hene ne!” 50Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ nga ngyirele wɔ kyɛ nwuni wɔ wɔ borɔdoma bakaa ne abo ne ati yeɛ ede di ye anaa? Ekonwu anwanwadeɛ mbiri bɔ ɔtra ɛhemɔ ɔ.” 51 Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ nyameɛso abukye, ná Nyameɛ abɔfo mɔ bɛ́fo na bédwu Sona Awa ne so ɔ.”

Title: YOHANE 2
Content:
Yesu kɔ Kana atɔmvorɛ bo
1 Na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, atɔmvorɛ bie hɔle sɔ wɔ Kana bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea; na né Yesu maame wɔ ye bo bie. 2Bɛtole bɛ sa bɛfrɛle Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ maa bɛwale atɔmvorɛ ne abo bie. 3Na bɛ nzaa ne yiele nen, Yesu maame sele ye kyɛ, “Bɛ nzaa ne ayie oo.” 4 Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, aso wɔ yeɛ ekyire me bɔ odi kyɛ meyɔ ɔ? Me mmerɛ ne onnya oddwuli.” 5 Na Yesu maame sele asomvoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔkɔhã kohyire ɛmɔ biala, ɛ́mɔyɔ.” 6 Né nyɔboɛ bua nzia gyigyi berɛ, na kyɛbɔ Yudafoɛ bɛ nwo petenɛ amanneɛ te ne, bua ko biala kora fa galɔn aburanyɔ anaa aburasa. 7Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa nzue bégua bua nemɔ anu ma beyiyi!” Na bɛsale nzue beguaguale nu maa beyiyili tɛkyɛtɛkyɛɛ. 8Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa bie, ná ɛmɔfa bɛɛma atɔmvorɛ bo aleɛ so neafoɛ ne!” Yiti bɛyɔle sɔ. 9Na atɔmvorɛ bo aleɛ so neafoɛ ne, ɔfale ye noa bɔle nzue bɔ wakakyi nzaa ne aso nen, né ɔnze nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ, (nakoso né asomvoɛ nemɔ de bɛse), yiti atɔmvorɛ bo aleɛ so neafoɛ ne frɛle atɔmvorɛ biaa ne, 10na osele ye kyɛ, “Sona biala, nzaa paa yeɛ odi moa fa basie berɛ maa besu ɔ; na sɛ bɛno maa ɔbo bɛ a, koraka yeɛ né afei wafa nzaa mbaen biala wawa ɔ; nakoso wɔ de, nzaa paa ne yeɛ afa asie maa wadwu bekye ɔ.” 11 Yesu nzɛngyerɛnneɛ nemɔ anu bɔ oli moa hɔ ɛne, na ɔyɔle ye wɔ Kana bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea; na ɔyele ye animnyam hyirele, na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ lele ye lili.
12 Na ɛhe asi ye, ɔhɔle Kapanɔm, ɔne ye maame ne oliɛma mɔ ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ; na belili ngyẽa kãa wɔ berɛ.
Yesu foa dwadifoɛ fi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu
(Mateo 21.12-17; Marko 11.15-19; Luka 19.45-48)
13 Né Yudafoɛ Abɔtra aluolue ne apingye, na Yesu hɔle Yerusalem. 14 Na asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu berɛ, onwuni bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne nandwie ne mmoaen ne mmorɔnoma, yeɛ afei sikaasesãlɛfoɛ kyɛ bɛtete berɛ ɔ. 15Na ɔfale nyamaa yɛle mbire foane bɛ mukoraa, bɛ ne mmoaen ne nandwie nemɔ fili asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ; na ohwiele sikaasesãlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ sikaa ne guale, na ɔfale bɛ poen nemɔ butubutuli berɛ. 16 Na osele bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne mmorɔnoma ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa ɛhemɔ befi wa! Nnɛma ɛmɔfa me Baba awuro bɛkakyi dwaalilɛ awuro!” 17 Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kayele kyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “W’awuro nwo ɔdɔ bɔ nne ye ne, ɔte see bɔ ogye wɔ me nu ɔ.” 18 Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzɛngyerɛnneɛ beni yeɛ ɛkɔyɔ kɔfa kohyire yɛ kyɛ ele ye nwo ate kyɛ ɛyɔ ɛhe ɔ?” 19 Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwiri asɔneyɛɛ sua he bégua, na ngɔfa ɛlɛsa ngɔpagya ye ngosie berɛ bieku.” 20Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Afoɛ aburanna ne nzia yeɛ bɛfa besili asɔneyɛɛ sua he ɔ, na wɔ de, ɛlɛsa yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔpagya ye kosie berɛ bieku ɔ?” 21 Nakoso ye de, ye nipadua asɔneyɛɛ sua yeɛ né ɔkã ye nwo dwirɛ ɔ. 22 Yiti, odwɔsole fili awufoɛ nu nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kayele kyɛ ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ ne, na belele Ahyerɛlɛ ne ne Yesu dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne belili.
Yesu se kuro sona suban
23Mmerɛ bɔ Yesu wɔ Yerusalem bɔ né bedi Abɔtra aluolue nen, mmeni pee lele ye dumaa lili, ɔnate nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ benwuni kyɛ ɔyɔ ne ati. 24Nakoso Yesu de wamva ye nwo wando bɛ so, ofikyɛ ɔse mmenia mukoraa; 25 yiti onhia kyɛ ebiala koli sona nwo adanzeɛ kohyire ye ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔse mmenia mukoraa ahone nu dwirɛ.

Title: YOHANE 3
Content:
Nikodemo kɔ Yesu berɛ
