1 Yiti kuro sona, wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen ɔ? Sɛ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen a, né ebua wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ndɛen. Ofikyɛ wɔ bɔ ebua sɔ ndɛen ne, wɔ koso ɛyɔ sɔ yɔleɛ ne bie. 2Na yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛen bɔ obua bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein ne te nahorɛ. 3Yiti sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ, na sɛ ebua bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bie ne ndɛen a, aso esusu kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne kɔpa wɔ ti? 4 Aso ɛmva Nyameɛ paayɛlɛ mmorosoɛ ne ye aboterɛ pee ne nyɛ hwee hɔ ɔ? Ɛnze kyɛ Nyameɛ paayɛlɛ ne ɔboka wɔ maa ɛsakyera w’adwene hɔ ɔ? 5 Ɛnze kyɛ ɛyɔ asoserɛ na epini w’ahone a, né ɛboaboa Nyameɛ yaa piri paa noa ma wɔ nwo wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kyẽa bɔ Nyameɛ baabua ye tenenee ndɛen ne ɔ? 6 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kotua sona biala nikyee bɔ wayɔ ɔ nwo kerɛ. 7Bɛ bɔ bemia bɛ nye bɛyɔ paa, na bɛpena animnyam, anidie ne daa ngoa nen, bɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔma bɛ daa ngoa ɔ. 8 Yiti Nyameɛ kɔfɛ bɛ bɔ bɛte pɛsɛmangomenya ná bɛyɛ nahorɛ ne nwo asoserɛ, ná afei bedi bɔne si ne aso yaa piri paa, ná wamaa banwu amaneɛ. 9 Amaneɛnwunɛ ne ahometrɛ kɔwa sona biala bɔ odi bɔne so; Yudafoɛ yeɛ beli moa ɔ, yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ toa berɛ ɔ. 10Na Nyameɛ kɔma bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ paa mukoraa animnyam, anidie ne asomdwee. Yudafoɛ yeɛ beli moa ɔ, yeɛ Helafoɛ toa berɛ ɔ. 11 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nnea sona nyunu mmua ndɛen.
12 Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ bɛnze Mose mmeraa ne, sɛ bɛyɔ bɔne a, nna Mose mmeraa so yeɛ bekogyina bekobua bɛ ndɛen maa bekomini ɔ. Nakoso Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛ de bɛse Mose mmeraa nen, sɛ bɛyɔ bɔne a, Mose mmeraa ne aso yeɛ bekogyina bekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ. 13 Ofikyɛ nna bɛ bɔ bɛse mmeraa ne yeɛ bɛte teneneefoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ, na mmom bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso yeɛ bekobua bɛ be ɔ. 14 Amaenmaensofoɛ de, bɛnze mmeraa ne; nakoso sɛ bɛ tiboa maa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛyɔ bɔ mmeraa ne kyire a, ɔte mmeraa ma bɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛnze mmeraa ne de. 15Bɛ yɔleɛ kyire kyɛ, bahyerɛ bɔ mmeraa ne hyɛ sona kyɛ ɔyɔ ne wɔ b’ahone nu, yeɛ bɛ tiboa koso di adanzeɛ kyɛ ɛhe te nahorɛ. Ofikyɛ ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie a, b’adwene bɔ bɛ kwaadu; na ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie koso a, b’adwene bua bɛ be. 16 Yiti kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne okyire ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, Nyameɛ kɔfa Yesu Kristo so kobua sona biala ye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ.
Yudafoɛ nni mmeraa ne so
17 Sɛ ɛfrɛ wɔ nwo Yudaniɛ, na ɛfa wɔ nwo to mmeraa ne aso, na ɛfa Nyameɛ hoahoa wɔ nwo; 18na sɛ ɛse Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ, na asua fi mmeraa ne anu anwu bɔ ɔte paa ɔ; 19na sɛ ede di kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛse anyesiniwaafoɛ atee kyire ɔ, na esa te bɛ bɔ bɛte awosii nu kanea, 20ɔne kyɛ ɛte bɛ bɔ bɛnze nworɛ ɔ bɛ foɛtulɛniɛ, ɔne ngokwaammaa kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, na sɛ w’adwene si wɔ pi kyɛ ɛse mmeraa ne anu nimdeɛ ne nahorɛ, 21 na afei esa kyire ebiemɔ nikyee a, nzu ati yeɛ engyire wɔ nwo nikye ɔ? Wɔ bɔ edwudwo tia awue ne, aso wɔ bɔbɔ ewua? 22 Wɔ bɔ ɛkã kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛsɛkye agyaa ne, aso ɛsɛkye agyaa? Wɔ bɔ ekyi mmosoen nen, aso ɛyɔ musue nikyee wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu? 23Wɔ bɔ ɛfa mmeraa ne hoahoa wɔ nwo ne, aso ebu mmeraa ne aso gua Nyameɛ nyunu ase anaa? 24 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛmɔ Yudafoɛ ti, Amaenmaensofoɛ bedwudwo betia Nyameɛ.”
25 Sɛ edi mmeraa ne aso de a, né wɔ bienzua bɔ bapɛ ne nwo le mvasoɛ, nakoso sɛ ebu mmeraa ne aso de a, né ɛte kyɛ ebie bɔ bɛppɛle ye bienzua koraa ɔ. 26 Sɛ Amaenmaensoniɛ bɔ bɛppɛle ye bienzua ɔ odi mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ so a, aso bengobu ye kyɛ bapɛ ye bienzua anaa? 27 Nzaade bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso ne, bekobua ɛmɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔse mmeraa ne ná koso ɛmɔbu mmeraa ne aso ne ndɛen. 28 Nna Yudaniɛ kaenn ole bɔ bapɛ ye bienzua anwoɔnaen nu ɔ. Yeɛ bienzuapɛlɛ paa koso ɔtte bɛ nye so nikye. 29 Na mmom Yudaniɛ kaenn ole sona bɔ ɔte Yudaniɛ wɔ ahone nu ɔ; ɔte sunzum nu nikye, na ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu nikye. Nna kuro sona, na mmom Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔye sɔ sona ne ayɛ ɔ.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 3
Content:
1Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, né nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔma Yudafoɛ bedi mu bɛtra Amaenmaensofoɛ ɔ? Anaa bienzuapɛlɛ nwo mvasoɛ ole sɛɛ? 2 Ye nwo le mvasoɛ atee pee so! Bɔ oli moa ɔ, Nyameɛ fale ye noa dwirɛ wurale Yudafoɛ bɛ sa. 3 Na sɛ bɛ nu biemɔ banni nahorɛ de ɛ? Aso ɛhe kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ koso nni nahorɛ anaa? 4 Dabida! Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ kuro sona biala te ngondomboniɛ de, nakoso Nyameɛ de ɔtte sɔ, odi nahorɛ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Kyɛbɔ bekonwu kyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ te nahorɛ,
na sɛ bebua wɔ ndɛen a, ali be ɔ.”
5 Sɛ yɛ bɔne boka ma Nyameɛ tenenee da adi petee a, ye de yɛkɔha ye sɛ? Yiti sɛ Nyameɛ fɛ yɛ so yaa a né wayɛ tɛɛ anaa? (Medwudwo kyɛ kuro sona). 6 Dabida! Sɛ Nyameɛ nga nahorɛ a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wabua wiase ndɛen? 7Na sɛ me ngondombo ma Nyameɛ nahorɛ da di petee maa onya animnyam a, né nzu ati yeɛ bebua me ndɛen kyɛ nde bɔnefoɛ ɔ? 8 Ebiemɔ to yɛ soen kyɛ yɛnwa, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ bɔne ná paa fi nu bra.” Na bekobua bɛ ye nwo ndɛen kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ.
Kuro sona biala ndengyɛ
(Edwein 14.1-3; 53.1-4)
9 Sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte hɔ a, né yɛ Yudafoɛ yɛte paa yɛtra Amaenmaensofoɛ anaa? Dabida! Ɔnate kyɛ yali moa yahyire kyɛ Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ mukoraa wura bɔne tumi bo. 10Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte teneneeniɛ ɔ, ko po nne berɛ;
11sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ole ndeaseɛ ɔ.
Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.
12 Bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu;
bɛ nu biala nwo olle mvasoɛ,
ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ paa ɔ,
ko po nne berɛ.
13 Bɛ noa dwirɛ te asieleɛ bɔ so abukye ɔ,
na bɛfa bɛ temverema bɛlakalaka mmenia,
ewoo noa borɔ wɔ bɛ noa nu.
14 Amoenwaa ne edwirɛ yealɛ ayi bɛ noa nu tɛkyɛ.
15Bɛ nwo yɛ nyera wɔ awuelilɛ nu,
16na nekaa biala bɔ bekotia ne, bɛma basabasayɔlɛ ne amaneɛnwunɛ ba berɛ.
17 Asomdwee atee de bɛnze,
18 yeɛ Nyameɛ surolɛ nne bɛ nu.”
19 Afei yɛse kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne, ɔkã kyire bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmeraa ne abo ɔ. Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ebiala ngɔhora ngɔhã ngɔtete ye nwo, na Nyameɛ kobua wiase amukoraa ndɛen. 20 Yiti bengogyina mmeraa nnwumaa so bengobua sona biala be wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ mmeraa ne de, ɔma sona nwu ye bɔne.
Kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ siesie ye ne sona afia ɔ
21 Nakoso afei de, Nyameɛ ala ye tenenee ali bɔ wamva mmeraa ne aso ɔ; na mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bedi ɛhe nwo adanzeɛ. 22 Nyameɛ nate sona gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu so yeɛ ɔfa siesie ye ne kuro sona afia ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ nyɛ nyeyemuɛ. 23Ofikyɛ mmenia mukoraa bayɔ bɔne, na Nyameɛ animnyam abɔ bɛ. 24 Nyameɛ nate ye adom bɔ ɔfa kyɛ mbaen ne aso obua bɛ be wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ngoalelɛ ne anu. 25 Ye yeɛ Nyameɛ afa ye wasie berɛ kyɛ mbata nikye bɔ ɔnate ye mogya nu gyidie so, bɔ wafa wahyire ye tenenee kyɛ bɔne bɔ bayɔ ye daa ne, wakyikyi wafi berɛ wɔ Nyameɛ aboterɛ nu; 26na ɔfa kyire wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ye anu kyɛ, ye bɔbɔ ɔte tenenee, na ebiala bɔ ode Yesu di ne, obua ye be.
27 Afei nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo ɔ? Yɛlle hwee! Kyɛ yɛdi mmeraa ne aso anaa? Anaakyɛ yɛ yɔleɛ paa ti ɔ? Daabi, na mmom ɔnate gyidie so. 28 Yiti bɔ yɛse ole kyɛ Nyameɛ nate gyidie so yeɛ ɔyɛ bɔnefoɛ teneneeniɛ ɔ, na nna kyɛ mmeraa ne bɔ odi so ti ɔ. 29Anaa Nyameɛ te Yudafoɛ ngome bɛ Nyameɛ? Aso ɔtte Amaenmaensofoɛ koso bɛ Nyameɛ? Ɔte bɛ koso bɛ Nyameɛ. 30Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe, na okogyina bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɛ gyidie so kobua bɛ be; yeɛ okogyina bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ koso bɛ gyidie so kobua bɛ be. 31Yiti ɔnate gyidie he ati yɛto mmeraa ne yɛgua anaa? Dabida! Na mmom yɛde mmeraa ne yɛto nu.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 4
Content:
Abraham gyidie te mvandoho ma yɛ
(Gyenesise 17.10)
1Yɛ anwoɔnaen nu nana Abraham, bɔ onyane ye ne, nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkã yɛfa ye nwo ɔ? 2Sɛ Nyameɛ nate Abraham nnwumaa so yeɛ obuale ye be de a, nzaade Abraham le nikyee fa hoahoa ye nwo, nakoso nna Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. 3 Na sɛɛ yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔkã ɔ? “Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili, na obuli ye gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye.” 4Sona bɔ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, bemmu ye akatuaa kyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom ɔte adwuma bɔ ɔyɔ ne nwo akatuaa. 5Na sona bɔ ɔmva ye nwo ndo nnwumaa paa so, na mmom ode Nyameɛ bɔ obua bɔnefoɛ be di nen, Nyameɛ bu sɔ sona ne gyidie kyɛ tenenee ma ye. 6 Ɛhe ati yeɛ Dawide hane kyɛ, sona bɔ Nyameɛ akwati nnwumaa paa na wabu ye teneneeniɛ ne, saleɛ te ye deɛ. Ɔnwa:
7 “Bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa b’amumuyɛɛ wahyɛ bɛ,
ná wakata bɛ bɔne so ne, banya saleɛ.
8 Sona bɔ Awurade ngɔfa ye bɔne nwo ngondaa ngogua ye so ne, wanya saleɛ.”
9 Na sɔ saleɛ ne, ɔba bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ ngome so, anaakyɛ bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ koso so? Ofikyɛ yɛkã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ buli Abraham gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye. 10Obuale ye be wɔ atee beni aso? Anzana bɛbaapɛ ye bienzua, anaakyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛpɛle ye bienzua ne? Bambɛ ye bienzua koraka, na mmom anzana bɛbaapɛ ye bienzua ne. 11 Na bɛpɛle ye bienzua maa ɛhe yɛle sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne nzorɛhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔnate gyidie so onyane ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né bennya bɛppɛle ye bienzua ɔ. Na ɛhe kyire kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔte gyidiniɛ bɔ bennya bɛppɛle ye bienzua ne, Abraham te ye nana, amaa ɔnate so babu bɛ tenenee. 12Sɔ ala yeɛ Abraham te bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ bienzua ne bɛ nana ɔ; nna bɛ bienzuapɛlɛ ne ngome po, na mmom bɛfa gyidie bɔ yɛ nana Abraham nyane ye koraka yeɛ bɛpɛ ye bienzua ne bɛyɛ nhwɛsoɛ.
Gyidie nu yeɛ yɛnya Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ɔ
13 Bɔhyɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Abraham ne ye bosofoɛ kyɛ ewiase kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ nen, sɔ bɔhyɛ ne wamva mmeraa ne aso yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, na mmom ɔnate gyidie nwo tenenee so. 14 Sɛ bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso yeɛ anohoba ne ɔte bɛ deɛ de a, nzaade né gyidie ɔtte hwee, na anohoba ne koso ayɛ mbaen. 15 Mmeraa ne twetwe ahonehulɛ piri ne ba, na nekaa bɔ mmeraa nne berɛ nen, mmeraatolɛ nne berɛ. 16 Yiti bɔhyɛ ne gyi gyidie so, amaa ɔnate so bɔhyɛ ne wagyina adom so, ná watindim berɛ wama ye bosofoɛ amukoraa. Bɔhyɛ ne ɔtte bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso ngome bɛ deɛ, na mmom ɔte ebiala bɔ wanya gyidie kyɛbɔ Abraham nyane ye ne koso deɛ; ofikyɛ ɔte yɛ mukoraa yɛ nana, 17 kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Mafa wɔ mayɛ amaenmaen pee bɛ nana.” Yiti Nyameɛ bɔ Abraham lele ye lili ne, ye bɔ otingye awufoɛ fi ewue nu, ná ɔfa ye noa dwirɛ ma nikyee bɔ ɔnne berɛ kora yɛ berɛ ne, ye nyunu de, Abraham te yɛ nana. 18 Ye bɔ mmerɛ bɔ anyelasoɛ nne berɛ ne, ogyinane anyelasoɛ so ole lili, amaa ɔnate so wayɛ amaenmaen pee bɛ nana, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hã hyirele ye kyɛ, “Sɔ yeɛ wɔ bosofoɛ bɛkɔyɛ ɔ.” 19 Onwuni kyɛ ye nipadua ne ayɛ mmerɛ, ofikyɛ né wali afoɛ kɔyɛ ɛyaa, afei né ɔse kyɛ Sara te mmotaen, nakoso wamma ye gyidie anhinhim. 20Wanzu aporowaa wamma ye adwene anyɛ ye naa wɔ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne anwo, na mmom ogyinane pindinn wɔ gyidie nu ɔhyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam. 21 Na ole lili paa kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔhora kɔma ye anohoba bɔ wabɔ ye ne kɔwa nu. 22Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ Nyameɛ buli ye gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye ɔ. 23Na sɔ dwirɛ he: “Nyameɛ buli ye gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye” ne, bangyerɛ bamma ye ngome. 24 Bɛhyerɛ bɛmane yɛ koso. Yɛ bɔ yɛde bɔ otingyele y’Awurade Yesu fili awufoɛ nu yɛdi ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bekobu yɛ gyidie bɛkɔma yɛ ɔ; 25 ye bɔ ɔnate yɛ bɔne ti behuni ye, ná ɔnate yɛ bebualɛ ti betingyele ye ɔ.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 5
Content:
Yɛnate gyidie so yɛ ne Nyameɛ abɔ nu
1 Afei de, ɔnate gyidie so yɛne Nyameɛ y’afia ayɛ ko ne ati, yɛnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so yanya asomdwee wɔ Nyameɛ nu. 2 Ɔnate ye so yeɛ yafa gyidie so yanya adom he bɔ yɛgyi so ye; na yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo Nyameɛ animnyam nwo anyelasoɛ nu. 3 Nna ɛhe angome, na mmom yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ yɛ amaneɛnwunɛ nu koso, ɔnate kyɛ yɛse kyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ma sona nya animia; 4na animia ma suahunu, yeɛ suahunu koso ma anyelasoɛ. 5 Na anyelasoɛ nni ngasi, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nate ye Sunzum Krongron bɔ ɔfa mane yɛ ne aso wafa ye ɔdɔ somaa ne wawura yɛ ahone nu.
6 Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛtɛ yɛ mmerɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne anu, Kristo wu mane bɔnefoɛ. 7Ɔyɛ se kyɛ ebie kowu kɔma teneneeniɛ ɔ. Bɔ ɔte teneneeniɛ de, ebiaa ebie kosi ye ahone kyɛ okowu kɔma ye. 8 Nakoso Nyameɛ hyirele kyɛbɔ osi kuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛtɛ te bɔnefoɛ ne yeɛ Kristo wu mane yɛ ɔ. 9 Yiti sɛ ɔnate ye mogya so wabua yɛ be de a, né nzaade ɔkɔfa Kristo so kole yɛ kofi ye ahonehulɛ ne anu maa ɔkɔbo so. 10Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛte Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ nen, Nyameɛ nate Ɔwa ne wue so siesiele yɛ ne ye afia. Na kekesaala ye bɔ yɛne Nyameɛ ayɛ ko ye de, ɔnate teasefoɛ Yesu so okole yɛ ngoa maa ɔkɔbo so. 11Nna ɛhe angome, na mmom yɛnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ wasiesie yɛ ne Nyameɛ afia ne so yanya anika wɔ Nyameɛ nu.
Ewue nate Adam so awa mmenia mukoraa so
12 Yiti kyɛbɔ bɔne nate sona ko so wale wiase, na ye bɔne fale ewue wale nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ewue to petene mmenia mukoraa so ɔ, ofikyɛ kuro sona biala ayɔ bɔne. 13Né bɔne wɔ wiase dada koraka yeɛ mmeraa ne ba ɔ, na mmom nekaa bɔ mmeraa nne berɛ nen, bemmu bɔne nwo ngondaa. 14Nakoso ofi Adam so kɔpem Mose so, ewue nyane tumi wɔ kuro sona biala so; na bɛ bɔ banyɔ bɔne kyɛ Adam deɛ ne po, onyane bɛ so tumi. Adam te bɔ ɔba ne mvandoho.
Sona fa Kristo so nya ngoa
15 Na kyɛbɔ mvomsoɛ ne ɔte ne, nna sɔ yeɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne ɔte ɔ. Ofikyɛ sɛ ɔnate sona ko bɔne so mmenia pee nyane ewue de a, nzaade né Nyameɛ adom, ɔne ye akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu ne sone maa ɔbo so ma mmenia pee. 16Afei adom akyɛdeɛ ne, ɔtte kyɛ musue bɔ sona ko bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ɔ fa wale ne. Ofikyɛ ndɛenbualɛ bɔ sona ko bɔne fa wale ole foɛbualɛ; nakoso Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne de, bɔne pee yɔlɛ si po ne, adom akyɛdeɛ ne abua yɛ be. 17 Na sɛ ɔnate sona ko bɔne so ewue nyane tumi wɔ sona ko ne so a, ye de bɛ bɔ banya adom mmorosoɛ ne tenenee akyɛdeɛ ne, bɛnate sona ko bɔ ye ole Yesu Kristo ne so bekoli ngonim.
18 Yiti kyɛbɔ sona ko bɔne fale foɛbualɛ brɛle mmenia mukoraa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ sona ko tenenee fale bebualɛ ne ngoa brɛle mmenia mukoraa ɔ. 19 Afei kyɛbɔ ɔnate sona ko asoserɛ so ti mmeni pee yɛle bɔnefoɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔnate sona ko sotie so mmeni pee kɔyɛ teneneefoɛ ɔ.
20 Mmeraa ne de ɔwale maa bɔne trɛle, nakoso nekaa bɔ bɔne trɛle nen, Nyameɛ adom ne trɛle maa ɔbole so. 21 Na kyɛbɔ bɔne nate ewue nu lili hene nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ adom koso kɔnate tenenee nu koli hene ɔ, na ɔkɔfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so kɔfa yɛ kɔhɔ daa ngoa nu.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 6
Content:
Bɔne olle yɛ so tumi ko
1Afei yɛkã ye sɛ? Yiti yɛhɔ so yɛyɔ bɔne, amaa yanya Nyameɛ adom ne mmorosoɛ anaa? 2 Dabida! Yɛ bɔ yawu yafi bɔne nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná yahɔ so yatena bɔne nu? 3 Anaa ɛmɔnze kyɛ yɛ bɔ bɛbɔle yɛ asu wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, bɛbɔle yɛ asu bɛhɔle ye wue nu ɔ? 4 Yiti basie yɛ ne ye wɔ asubɔlɛ nu bahɔ ye wue nu. Ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ Baba n’animnyam tumi ne tingyele Kristo fili awufoɛ nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛnate ngoa foforɛ nu ɔ.
5 Sɛ yɛne ye ayɛ ko wɔ ye wue nu de a, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛne ye kɔyɛ ko wɔ ye wutingyelɛ nu ɔ. 6 Yɛse kyɛ babɔ yɛ sona sue daa ne ne Kristo mmeamudua nu, kyɛbɔ yɛ bɔne nipadua ne kowu na yanyɛ bɔne ngoaa ko ɔ. 7Ofikyɛ sona biala bɔ wawu ne, wanya fawɔnwodi wafi bɔne tumi bo. 8Yiti sɛ yɛne Kristo awu de a, nzaade yɛde yɛdi kyɛ yɛne ye kɔtena ngoa nu koso. 9 Yɛse kyɛ batingye Kristo bafi awufoɛ nu, na ongowu ko le; ewue olle tumi wɔ ye so ko. 10 Na ye wue ne, owu lili bɔne so ngonim pɛen ko; na ase bɔ ɔte kekesaala ye ne, ɔte ma Nyameɛ. 11Sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ bɔne olle ɛmɔ so tumi ko ɔ, na ɛmɔte ase wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ma Nyameɛ.
12Yiti nnɛmɔma bɔne di ɛmɔ nipadua so hene bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔyɛ sotie kɔma ye akɔnnɔdeɛ ɔ. 13 Afei, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nipadua akwaa biala bɛma bɔne ná wamva wanyɔ amumuyɛɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́ma Nyameɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ befi ewue nu bahɔ ngoa nu ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amukoraa bɛ́ma ye, ná ɔfa yɔ tenenee nnwumaa. 14 Nnɛmɔma bɔne di ɛmɔ so hene, ofikyɛ nna mmeraa bo yeɛ ɛmɔwura ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔwura Nyameɛ adom bo.
Yɛte tenenee ngoaa
15Afei nzikyɛ bieku? Ɔnate kyɛ yɛwwura mmeraa bo, na mmom yɛwura adom bo ne ati, yiti odi kyɛ yɛyɔ bɔne anaa? Dabida! 16 Ɛmɔnze kyɛ sona bɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie bɛma ye ne, sɔ sona ne yeɛ ɛmɔte ye ngoaa ɔ, ɛmɔte ngoaa bɛma sona bɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie bɛma ye ɔ, kyɛ bɔne bɔ ɔfa wɔ kɔ ewue nu oo, anaakyɛ sotie bɔ ɔfa wɔ kɔ tenenee nu oo? 17 Ɛmɔma yɛla Nyameɛ ase! Ofikyɛ ɛmɔayɛ bɔne ngoaa le, na afei de ɛmɔafa b’ahone mukoraa bayɛ sotie bama nahorɛ, bɔ ɛmɔanya bafi ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane ɛmɔ ne anu ne. 18 Na afei ɛmɔanya fawɔnwodi bafi bɔne nu, na ɛmɔayɛ tenenee ngoaa. 19Ɔnate ɛmɔ anwoɔnaen mmerɛyɛlɛ ti yeɛ mafa kuro sona atee so madwudwo mahyire ɛmɔ ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ mmerɛ bie ɛmɔfale ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa bɛyɛle ngoaa bɛmane efiɛ ne amumuyɛɛ mbiri mbiri ne, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ afei ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa besie berɛ bɛma tenenee bɛkɔ krongronyɛlɛ nu ɔ.
20Mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔte bɔne ngoaa nen, né ɛmɔ ne tenenee afia atete. 21Daa bra bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ne, bɔ ɛnɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nya ye, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɛmɔnya befili nu ɔ? Sɔ nningyein nemɔ, b’ayieleɛ te ewue. 22 Na kekesaala ye de, bale ɛmɔ bafi bɔne nu amaa ɛmɔayɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa. Ye so mvasoɛ bɔ ɛmɔnya ole kyɛ, ɛmɔayɛ krongron bɔ ye ayieleɛ ole daa ngoa. 23 Ofikyɛ bɔne akatuaa ole ewue; na Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ole daa ngoa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nu.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 7
Content:
So Nyameɛ atee foforɛ so
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, aso ɛmɔnze anaa? Medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛse mmeraa ne ɔ. Sɛ sona te ase a, yeɛ mmeraa kyekye ye ɔ. 2 Yiti brasua bɔ ogya biaa nen, mmeraa kyekye ye bata ohu ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ohu ne te ase ɔ; na sɛ ohu ne wu de a, mmeraa ngyekye ye mmata ohu ne ko. 3 Yiti sɛ ohu te ase, ná ɔkɔ biaa foforɛ nwo a, né bɛfrɛ ye agyaasɛkyelɛniɛ. Nakoso sɛ ohu ne wu de a, sɔ mmeraa ne ngyekye ye ko, na afei sɛ okogya biaa foforɛ a, né ye de ɔssɛkyele agyaa. 4 Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso bɛnate Kristo nipadua so ɛmɔawu bama mmeraa ne ɔ, bɔ ɔnate so ebiala te obiɛngo deɛ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔte bɔ batingye ye bafi ewue nu ne deɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛkosu mmaa yɛkɔma Nyameɛ ɔ. 5 Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne de, yɛ bɔne akɔnnɔdeɛ bɔ mmeraa ne kanyane ye ne, ɔyɔle adwuma wɔ yɛ nwonaen akwaa nu osuli mmaa hɔle ewue. 6 Na afei de, bale yɛ bafi mmeraa ne abo, ofikyɛ bɔ daa ne ɔfale yɛ yɛle ngoaa nen, kekesaala ye de olle yɛ so tumi ko. Yiti yɛwwura daa mmeraa bɔ bɛhyerɛle ne abo ko, na mmom yɛwura Sunzum nu ngoa foforɛ ne abo.
Mmeraa ne bɔne
7 Afei yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Kyɛ mmeraa ne ɔtte mayee anaa? Dabida! Na sɛ nna mmeraa ne ahɔ a, ahaa menze bɔne. Sɛ mmeraa ne anga kyɛ, “Nnɛma wɔ nye boro ebie nikyee” a, ahaa menze kyɛbɔ besi bɛma bɛ nye boro nikye ɔ. 8 Nakoso bɔne nate mmeraa ne aso nyane atee fale anyeboroborolɛ ahoroɔ wurale me nu. Sɛ mmeraa ne nne berɛ a, bɔne te nikyee bɔ wawu ɔ. 9Makwati mmeraa ne matena ase le; nakoso mmeraa ne wale nen, bɔne tingyele na nwuli. 10 Afei mmeraa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa ngoa ba ne, ɔfale ewue brɛle me. 11Na bɔne fale mmeraa ne aso nyane atee lakalakale me huni me.
12Yiti mmeraa ne te krongron, na ahyɛdeɛ ne koso te krongron, ɔte tenenee, na ɔte paa. 13 Aso ɛhe kyire kyɛ nikyee bɔ ɔte paa ne ɔmaa nyane ewue anaa? Dabida! Nakoso kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na bekonwu bɔne pefee kyɛ ɔte bɔne ne ati, bɔne nate bɔ ɔte paa so maa nwuli, amaa ɔnate ahyɛdeɛ ne aso banwu ye kyɛ bɔne te nikyee bie bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa ɔ.
Paa ne bɔne di me nu apereapereɛ
14 Yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne te sunzum nu nikye, na me de, nde anwoɔnaen, bɔ batɔne me bama bɔne ɔ. 15 Bɔ me bɔbɔ meyɔ ne, mende ye bo. Ofikyɛ bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ ne, menyɔ, na mmom bɔ menguro ne yeɛ meyɔ ɔ. 16Na sɛ meyɔ bɔ menguro kyɛ meyɔ ne de a, né okyire kyɛ mepene so kyɛ mmeraa ne te paa. 17Né nzaade, né nna me yeɛ mekɔ so meyɔ sɔ nikyee ne ɔ, na mmom bɔne bɔ ɔte me nu ne yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ. 18 Mese kyɛ nikyee paa biala ɔtte me nu: mekyire me bɔne nipadua ne. Ofikyɛ ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa paa yeɛ meyɔ ɔ, nakoso mengora ye yɔ. 19Ɔnate kyɛ menyɔ paa bɔ mekuro ne, na mmom bɔne bɔ menguro ne yeɛ meyɔ ɔ. 20Afei sɛ meyɔ bɔ menguro ne de a, ye de nna me nye kaenn yeɛ mefa meyɔ ɔ, na mmom bɔne bɔ ɔte me nu ne ɔ.
21Yiti mete nga kyɛ mmeraa bie yɔ adwuma wɔ me nu: na mmerɛ biala bɔ mepena kyɛ meyɔ paa nen, né bɔne aye ye ti. 22 Ofikyɛ me nye gye Nyameɛ mmeraa nwo wɔ me nu paa. 23 Nakoso menwu mmeraa foforɛ bie wɔ me nwonaen akwaa nu, bɔ ɔko tia mmeraa bɔ ɔwɔ m’adwene nu ɔ, bɔ ɔkye me nnure ma bɔne mmeraa bɔ ɔwɔ me nwonaen akwaa nu ɔ. 24 Aa, meyɛ anwumvo! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole me kofi sɔ ewue nipadua he anu ɔ? 25 Mefa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so meda Nyameɛ ase! Yiti m’adwene nu de, nde Nyameɛ mmeraa n’akoaa, nakoso me nwonaen nu de, nde bɔne akoaa.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 8
Content:
Ngoa wɔ Sunzum ne anu
1 Afei de, foɛbualɛ biala nne berɛ mma bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu nu ne. 2 Ofikyɛ Kristo Yesu nu ngoa Sunzum mmeraa ne, wapepɛ wale me wafi bɔne ne ewue mmeraa ne anu. 3 Na bɔ mmeraa ne wangora wanyɔ, bɔ ɔnate kyɛ anwoɔnaen ne maa ɔyɛle mmerɛ ne ati, Nyameɛ ayɔ. Ɔsomane Ɔwa komapɛ ne maa ɔyɛle ye nwo kyɛ kuro sona, bɔ ole bɔne nwonaen ɔ, na ɔfa buale bɔne foɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, 4 amaa ɔnate so mmeraa ne nwo tenenee wawa nu wɔ yɛ nu, yɛ bɔ yɛnnate anwoɔnaen nu, na mmom yɛnate Sunzum nu ne. 5 Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne, bɛdwene anwoɔnaen nu nningyein nwo; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Sunzum nu ne de, bɛdwene Sunzum nu nningyein nwo. 6 Sɛ ɛma anwoɔnaen nu adwenedwene bada wɔ so a, ɔne ewue yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; nakoso Sunzum nu adwenedwene de, ɔma ngoa ne asomdwee. 7 Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen nu adwenedwene pɔ Nyameɛ, ɔngora mmerɛ ye nwo ase nwura Nyameɛ mmeraa bo, ɔngora nyɔ sɔ amba. 8Na bɛ bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen n’ahyɛdeɛ so ne, bɛngora bɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye.
9 Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnni anwoɔnaen nhyehyɛleɛ so, na mmom Sunzum nhyehyɛleɛ so, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu. Na ebiala bɔ olle Kristo Sunzum ne, ɔtte Kristo deɛ. 10 Na sɛ Kristo te ɛmɔ nu de a, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔnate bɔne ti ɛmɔ nipadua ne awu de, nakoso ɔnate tenenee ti ɛmɔ Sunzum ne le ngoa. 11 Na sɛ ye bɔ otingyele Yesu fili awufoɛ nu ne ye Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu a, ye bɔ otingyele Kristo Yesu fili awufoɛ nu ne, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ nipadua bɔ owu ne ngoa, na ɔkɔfa ye Sunzum bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ne aso yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ sɔ ɔ.
12Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛmma anwoɔnaen ne kerɛ, ná wawa kyɛ yatena ase yama anwoɔnaen ne. 13 Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛbɔ anwoɔnaen ne kuro a, ɛmɔkowu. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔfa Sunzum ne beku anwoɔnaen nnwumaa de a, ɛmɔkonya ngoa. 14 Ɔnate kyɛ sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ɔyɛ ye taataa ne, ɔte Nyameɛ awa. 15 Ofikyɛ ɛmɔannya ngoaayɛlɛ sunzum bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosa bekosuro ɔ; na mmom baayɛlɛ Sunzum yeɛ ɛmɔanya ɔ, bɔ ɔmaa yɛtea nu kyɛ: “Abba! Baba!” 16 Sunzum ne bɔbɔ ɔne yɛ sunzum bedi adanzeɛ kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ mma. 17 Na sɛ yɛte Nyameɛ mma de a, ye de yɛle agyapadeɛ, yɛle agyapadeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nu, yɛne Kristo yɛbɔ nu yɛle agyapadeɛ; nakoso sana yɛne ye nwu amaneɛ koraka, amaa ɔnate so bahyɛ yɛ ne ye animnyam.
Yɛkonya animnyam kyẽa bie
18 Mebu amaneɛ bɔ yɛnwu ye kekesaala ye ne kyɛ, yɛngora yɛngɔfa ngɔtoto animnyam bɔ bɛbaala ye ali bekyire yɛ ne anwo. 19Na abɔdeɛ ɔnwondɛ serɛserɛ kyɛ bɛkɔla Nyameɛ mma nemɔ ali ɔ. 20Ofikyɛ bɛfale abɔdeɛ bewurale nikyee mbaen bie abo, bɔ nna ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ ahɔ ɔ; na mmom bɔ ɔfale ye wurale sɔ nikyee ne abo wɔ anyelasoɛ nu ne, ye pɛ ɔ; 21 ofikyɛ abɔdeɛ ne bɔbɔ deinn, bɛkɔpepɛ bekole ye bekofi ngoaasolɛ porɔlowaa nu bɛkɔhɔ Nyameɛ mma fawɔnwodi animnyam ne anu. 22 Yɛse kyɛ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, abɔdeɛ amukoraa ɔpene, na wafo aworɛ so bɔ onwu amaneɛ ɔ. 23 Nakoso nna abɔdeɛ ngome, na mmom yɛ bɔbɔ koso bɔ yanya Sunzum nu mmaa bɔ oli moa ne, yɛpene wɔ yɛ nu, mmerɛ bɔ yɛnwondɛ kyɛ bɛkɔfa yɛ bɛkɔyɛ mmaa ɔ, bɔ ɔte ɛpepɛlɛ bɔ bɛkɔpepɛ bekole yɛ nipadua ne ɔ. 24 Ofikyɛ bɛnate anyelasoɛ so yeɛ belele yɛ ngoa ɔ; na anyelasoɛ bɔ bɛ nye nwu ye ne de, ɔtte anyelasoɛ. Ofikyɛ bɔ sona ye nye tua ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wanya ye nwo anyelasoɛ? 25Na sɛ yɛ nye la bɔ yɛnnwu ye so a, ye de yɛfa aboterɛ yɛwondɛ.
26 Sɔ ala yeɛ Sunzum ne boka yɛ wɔ yɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛnze kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛbɔ mbaeɛ ɔ. Nakoso Sunzum ne bɔbɔ ogyina yɛ gya nu, na ɔfa ɛpenenɛ bɔ bɛngora bɛmva edwudwolɛ bɛnga ɔ so ɔsrɛ ma yɛ. 27 Na bɔ ɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ mmenia ti anu adwene nu ne, ɔse Sunzum ne ti anu adwene, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne srɛ ma anwoteefoɛ kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ pɛ si te ɔ
28Yɛse kyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne, bɔ okosi biala ɔboka bɛ, bɛ bɔ ɔnate ye nhyehyɛleɛ so wafrɛ bɛ ne. 29 Bɛ bɔ onwuni bɛ siele ne, osa tuli bɛ siele berɛ, kyɛ benya Ɔwa ne sue ne bie, amaa ɔnate so wayɛ aliɛmaa mɔ pee nu bamuɛbaa. 30 Na bɛ bɔ otuli bɛ siele berɛ ne, osa frɛle bɛ; na bɛ bɔ ɔfrɛle bɛ ne, obuale bɛ be koso, na bɛ bɔ obuale bɛ be ne, ɔhyɛle bɛ animnyam koso.
Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu ɔ
31 Afei nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔhã kɔfa ɛhemɔ nwo ɔ? Sɛ Nyameɛ gyi yɛ si a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔho kotia yɛ ɔ. 32 Sɛ wamva ye bɔbɔ Ɔwa wammɔ atianuserɛ, na mmom yɛ mukoraa yɛ ti ɔyele ye mane a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɔngɔfa nningyein mukoraa ngɔboka ye so ngɔma yɛ ɔ? 33Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔbɔ bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne kwaadu ɔ? Nyameɛ yeɛ obua be ɔ. 34Nwa yeɛ obua foɛ ɔ? Yesu Kristo bɔ owuli ná otingyele fili awufoɛ nu ne, bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ sa famaa so, bɔ ɔsrɛ ma yɛ ne. 35Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte yɛ kofi Kristo ɔdɔ ne anwo ɔ? Amaneɛnwunɛ anaa anwokyere anaa ndaneanyeɛ anaa ɛhɔen anaa kwaterekwa anaa amaneɛnwunɛ anaa ngrandɛ? 36 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Ɔnate wɔ ti beku yɛ daa biala;
na bebu yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛkwaahũ bɛ ɔ.”
37 Nakoso ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, yɛfa bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ ne aso yɛdi ngonim mmorosoɛ. 38 Na mese ye pefee kyɛ ewue anaa ngoa, anaa abɔfo mɔ, anaa ewienu atumifoɛ, anaa nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, anaa nningyein bɔ ɔbaawa, anaa tumi, 39anaa anwuro, anaa kumaa kuronn, anaa abɔdeɛ nu nikyee biala ngɔhora ngɔtete yɛ ngofi Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ Awurade Kristo Yesu nu ne anwo le.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 9
Content:
Nyameɛ ne ye mmenia Yisraelfoɛ
1 Meka nahorɛ ne wɔ Kristo nu, membɛ ngondombo; na me tiboa koso di me adanzeɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron nu. 2kyɛ medi aworabɔlɛ pee ne yealɛ daa wɔ m’ahone nu. 3 Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa mayɛ abusudeɛ sona maa mahwere Kristo, ɔnate ngoalelɛ bɔ m’anwoɔnaen nu aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛte abusuafoɛ ne bekonya ye ne ati. 4 Bɛte Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baayɛlɛ, animnyam, apam nemɔ, mmeraahyehyɛlɛ, ɛsɔnenɛ ne bɔhyɛ nemɔ bɛte bɛ deɛ ɔ. 5 Bɛ yeɛ yɛ nana mbanyi mɔ bɛte bɛ deɛ ɔ; na anwoɔnaen nu, bɛ bosoniɛ ole Kristo bɔ ɔte nningyein mukoraa so Nyameɛ bɔ bayira ye afebɔɔ ne. Amen.
6Nna kyɛ ebiaa Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ayɛ mbaen ɔ, ofikyɛ nna bɛ bɔ befi Yisrael nu amukoraa yeɛ bɛte Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. 7 Anaa nna Abraham bosofoɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte Abraham mma kaenn ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ha hyirele Abraham kyɛ, “Ɔnate Yisake so yeɛ ekonya wɔ bosofoɛ ɔ.” 8 Ɛhe kyire kyɛ nna anwoɔnaen nu mma yeɛ bɛte Nyameɛ mma ɔ; na mmom bɔhyɛ ne mma yeɛ bebu bɛ kyɛ ye bosofoɛ kaenn ɔ. 9 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne hane kyɛ, “Afoɛ bieku bekye sɔa ngosa ngɔwa ne, né Sara awo baa bienzua.”
10 Nna kyɛ ɛhe ngome, na Rebɛka koso ɔne biaa ko bɛnwonzɛle, bɔ ye ole yɛ nana Yisake ne. 11Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né bennya bɛwwole bɛ de, na wawa kyɛ po bɛyɔ paa anaa tɛɛ biala ɔ. Nakoso kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ, bɔ oggyi nnwumaa so, na mmom ogyi bɛ nu ko frɛlɛ so kɔwa nu ne ati, 12 osele Rebɛka kyɛ, “Panyi ne kɔso kãa ne.” 13 Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Ngurole Yakob dwirɛ,
nakoso Yisɔ de, mbɔle ye.”
14 Afei, yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Aso Nyameɛ te nyeyemuɛ anaa? Dabida! 15 Ofikyɛ ɔhã hyirele Mose kyɛ,
“Bɔ ngonwu ye anwumvo ne yeɛ ngonwu ye anwumvoin ɔ,
yeɛ bɔ ye nwo kɔyɛ me aworabɔ ne yeɛ ye nwo kɔyɛ me aworabɔ ɔ.”
16 Yiti oggyi bɔ kuro sona okuro anaa bɔ ɔkɔyɔ so, na mmom ogyi Nyameɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ so. 17 Na ɛhe ati yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne sele Faro kyɛ, “Mapagya wɔ, kyɛbɔ ngɔfa wɔ so ngɔma me tumi kɔla ali wɔ wɔ nu, ná babɔ me dumaa wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.” 18 Na sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte de a, nzaade sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ye dwirɛ yeɛ onwu ye anwumvoin ɔ; yeɛ sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ne, yeɛ opini ye ahone ɔ.
Pɔɔlo kyire Nyameɛ yaa ne ye anwumvoin bo
19 Afei ebie kobisa me kyɛ, “Nzaade nzu ati yeɛ Nyameɛ tɛnwu sona nwo mvomsoɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kosi Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ nwo atee ɔ?” 20 Nzaade kuro sona, wɔ ole nwa bɔ ɛne Nyameɛ di nyeyeanoɛ ɔ? Bua ngora mmisa bɔ ɔnwone ye ne kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛnwone me sɔa ɔ?” 21 Ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne, aso olle ɛfaa so tumi, kyɛ ɔfa ɛfaa torɛ komapɛ ne ala ɔnwo bua ko maa ɔyɛ nyemenenyemene ná ɔnwo ko koso maa ɔyɛ bibirikyii ɔ?
22 Sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ ayɔ ɔ. Ɔyɛle kyɛ ahaa ɔkɔla ye yaafɛlɛ piri ne ye tumi ali. Nakoso onyane aboterɛ mane bɛ bɔ ɔfɛle bɛ nwo yaa bɔ b’ayieleɛ ole ewue ne. 23 Afei koso ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔkɔla ye animnyam mmorosoɛ ne ali kohyire bɛ bɔ wanwu bɛ anwumvoin ne, ofikyɛ wasiesie bɛ wasie berɛ dada kyɛ bɛfata ye animnyam ne. 24 Ofikyɛ wamvrɛ yɛ wamvi Yudafoɛ ngome nu, na mmom ɔfrɛle yɛ fili Amaenmaensofoɛ koso nu bie. 25 Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Hosea nwomaa ne anu kyɛ,
“Mmenia bɔ ahaa bɛtte me deɛ ne,
ngɔfrɛ bɛ ‘Me mmenia,’
na bɔ manguro ye dwirɛ ne,
ngɔfrɛ ye ‘Me dɔfo.’
26 Na nekaa bɔ besele bɛ kyɛ,
‘Ɛmɔtte me maen’ ne,
berɛ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfrɛ bɛ Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne mma ɔ.”
27 Yesaya koso pakyele nu ha fale Yisraelfoɛ nwo serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ sone pee kyɛ mboanoa anweaa de, nakoso bɛ nu kãa bie yeɛ bekole bɛ ngoa ɔ; 28 ofikyɛ Awurade kɔma ye dwirɛ kɔwa nu ndɛndɛ so ne nyeranyera so wɔ aseɛ so.” 29 Kyɛbɔ Yesaya hã tole berɛ kyɛ,
“Sɛ Asafo Awurade wanyakyi mmaa wamma yɛ a,
ahaa yayɛ kyɛ Sodom, ná yakakyi kyɛ Gomora.”
Yesu Kristo nu gyidie maa yɛyɛ teneneefoɛ
30 Afei, yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ bandwene ye nwo le kyɛ bɛkɔpena tenenee si atee nen, bɛnate gyidie so banya tenenee. 31 Nakoso Yisrael bɔ olili tenenee mmeraa ne asi ne de, wangora wandwu tenenee mmeraa ne anwo. 32 Nzu ati ɔ? Ofikyɛ bamva gyidie so bambere tenenee, na mmom bɛfale bɛ nnwumaa bɔ bɛyɔle ɔ so. Yiti besotili wɔ sundiboɔ ne aso, 33 kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Tie, méfa nyɔboɛ bie méto Sion bɔ ɔkɔyɛ sundiboɔ kɔma mmenia ɔ,
nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekofi ase ɔ;
nakoso ebiala bɔ okole ye koli ne,
ye nyunu ngogua ase.”

Title: ROMANFOƐ 10
Content:
Pɔɔlo bɔ mbaeɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ
1Nniɛma mɔ, m’ahone nu dwirɛ ne me mbaeɛ bɔ mebɔ mekyire Nyameɛ mema Yisrael ole kyɛ bekonya daa ngoa ɔ. 2Medi bɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ bele Nyameɛ nwo dɔ; nakoso bɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne oggyi nahorɛ nimdeɛ so. 3Ofikyɛ bɛnze atee bɔ Nyameɛ fa so siesie ye ne mmenia b’afia ɔ, na mmom bɛyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ tenenee atee so; yiti bammrɛ bɛ nwo ase bamma Nyameɛ atee bɔ ɔfa so yɛ kuro sona teneneeniɛ ne. 4 Na ɔnate kyɛ Kristo di mu tra mmeraa ne ati, amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ ode di ne babua ye be.
Daa ngoa wɔ berɛ ma ebiala
5 Mose hyerɛle fale tenenee bɔ ebie di mmeraa ne aso a ɔyɛ ne nwo kyɛ, “Sona bɔ odi mmeraa n’ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔkɔfa so konya nu ngoa.” 6 Na tenenee bɔ ogyi gyidie so ne, ɔkã kyɛ, “Nnɛkã ye wɔ w’ahone nu kyɛ, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfo kɔhɔ nyameɛso ɔ?” (Mekyire bɔ ɔkwaafa Kristo dwu ba ase ɔ); 7 anaakyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ okodwu kɔhɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne anu ɔ?” (Mekyire bɔ ɔkwaafa Kristo fi awufoɛ nu dɔ ba ɔ). 8 Nzikyɛ yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔkã ɔ?
“Edwirɛ ne apingye wɔ,
ɔwɔ wɔ noa ne w’ahone nu,”
(ye ole gyidie dwirɛ bɔ yɛbɔ ye dawure ne). 9 Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛfa wɔ noa kã ye pefee kyɛ Yesu te Awurade, ná ede di wɔ w’ahone nu kyɛ Nyameɛ atingye ye afi awufoɛ nu a, ekonya daa ngoa. 10Ɔnate kyɛ, sona fa ye ahone yeɛ ode di ɔkɔ tenenee nu ɔ; na ye noa yeɛ ɔfa kã ye pefee onya daa ngoa ɔ. 11 Na Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, ye nyunu ngogua ase.” 12 Ofikyɛ nzonzoleɛ biala nne Yudaniɛ ne Helaniɛ nu; Awurade komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔte bɛ mukoraa bɛ Mene ɔ, na oyira ebiala bɔ osũ frɛ ye ɔ. 13 Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ Awurade dumaa ne, okonya ngoa.
14Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná mmenia basu bafrɛ ye wɔ abrɛ bɔ benne ye benni ɔ? Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná bale bɔ bɛttele ye nwo dwirɛ le ɔ bali? Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná bate, wɔ abrɛ bɔ nzɛmbahanɛniɛ nne berɛ ɔ? 15 Na sɛ banzoma mmenia a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná babɔ edwirɛ ne dawure? Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛso ndɛenvɛen bɛnate ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ gya bo osi yɛ nyemene ɔ!” 16 Nakoso nna bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bayɛ sotie bama nzɛmba ne ɔ. Ofikyɛ Yesaya kã kyɛ, “Awurade, nwa yeɛ wale yɛ noa dwirɛ ne wali ɔ?” 17 Né nzaade, gyidie nate edwirɛ ne tielɛ nu yeɛ ɔba ɔ, na bɔ bɛte ne, ɔnate Kristo dwirɛ ne aso yeɛ ɔba ɔ.
18 Nakoso mebisa kyɛ, bennya bɛttele anaa? Amba, bate, ofikyɛ,
“Bɛ komvi adwu aseɛ so nekaa biala,
na bɛ dwirɛ adwu wiase nekaa biala.”
19 Mesa mebisa kyɛ, yiti Yisrael ande edwirɛ ne bo anaa? Mose lili moa hane kyɛ,
“Ngɔma ɛmɔ nye kɔboro mmenia bɔ bɛ de nna me maen ahɔ ɔ;
na ngɔfa maen bɔ b’adwene te nganga ɔ ngohu ɛmɔ ahone.”
20 Afei Yesaya sili ye ahone hane kyɛ,
“Bɛ bɔ bambena me si atee ne, banwu me,
na maye me nwo ali mahyire bɛ bɔ bammisa me boso ɔ.”
21 Na ɔfa Yisrael nwo de, ɔhane kyɛ, “Alehyeleɛ biala, matrɛ me sa nu kyɛ ngole asoserɛfoɛ mmenia bɔ bayɛ me so lɔen ɔ.”

Title: ROMANFOƐ 11
Content:
Nyameɛ nwu Yisrael anwumvoin
1Afei mebisa, aso Nyameɛ wapo ye maen anaa? Dabida! Ofikyɛ me bɔbɔ nde Yisraelniɛ, nde Abraham bosoniɛ, mvi Benyamin abusua kure nu. 2 Nyameɛ de, ɔppole ye maen bɔ onwuni bɛ siele dada ne. Aso ɛmɔnze edwirɛ bɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã fa Elia nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔbɔle Yisrael kwaadu hyirele Nyameɛ ne? 3 kyɛ, “Awurade, bahu wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, na badwiri w’afɔleɛ mmokyea koso bagua; na waha me ngome, na bɛpena me beku me.” 4 Na Nyameɛ buale ye sɛ? “Mafa mmenia apee nzoo masie bɔ bɛte me deɛ ɔ, bɔ bɛkkoto bɛssɔnene bosoen Baal le ɔ.” 5 Sɔ ala yeɛ kekesaala ye Nyameɛ nate ye adom so wasa nu waye bɛ ngaa ne ɔ. 6Na sɛ ɔnate adom so de a, nzaade Nyameɛ frɛlɛ ne oggyi nnwumaa so ko, na sɛ ogyi nnwumaa so de a, ahaa adom ne ɔtte adom ko.
7 Afei de nzikyɛ bieku? Yisrael sa anga nikyee bɔ né ɔpena ne. Bɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne, bɛ sa hane ye; nakoso bɛ ngaa ne de, bɛyɛle asoserɛ, 8 kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Nyameɛ ama bɛ adwene bɔ wala ɔ,
anyeɛ bɔ onnwu nikye ɔ,
asoɛ bɔ ɔnde dwirɛ ɔ
maa waadwu ɛnɛ kyẽa ye.”
9 Na Dawide kã kyɛ,
“Ma bɛ poentolɛ ɔyɛ kafoli ne ngaen,
sundidua ne asohwenɛ ma bɛ!
10Ma bɛ nye so ɔyɛ tunn bɔ bennwu hwee ɔ,
ná ma bɛ nu kundu daa.”
11 Yiti mebisa kyɛ, aso basoti bɔ bɛpena befi ase anaa? Dabida! Na mmom ɔnate b’asoserɛ ne aso yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ banya ngoalelɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔkɔma Yisrael kɔhwe ye nwo kora ɔ. 12Na sɛ b’asoserɛ fale saleɛ brɛle wiase, ná b’asefinɛ koso fale saleɛ brɛle Amaenmaensofoɛ a, ye de sɛ osa ode Yisrael to nu bɔkɔɔ a, saleɛ mmorosoɛ yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ!
Amaenmaensofoɛ daa ngoa
13Afei medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ; na ɔnate kyɛ nde Amaenmaensofoɛ somafoɛ ne ati, mefa me solɛ adwuma mehoahoa me nwo; 14kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ me bɔbɔ me mmenia Yudafoɛ bɛ nye kɔboro ɔ, bɔ ɔnate so bɛ nu biemɔ konya daa ngoa ɔ. 15Na sɛ ɔnate bɛ polɛ bɔ Nyameɛ pole bɛ ne ati Nyameɛ ne adasa mmaa benyane ngabonu a, nzaade sɛ besa bɛba Nyameɛ berɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ koraa? Ɔkɔyɛ daa ngoa bɔ ofi awufoɛ nu ɔ!
16Sɛ bakaammaa bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔte ne te krongron ma Nyameɛ a, nzaade ye ngaa bɔ waha ne amukoraa te krongron; na sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ bakaa ndii ne te krongron a, ye mmaen ne koso te krongron ɔ. 17Babubu olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua ne mmaen ne bie bagua, na bafa ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ ɛmɔte kyɛ olive bakaa bɔ ogyi ye buro ne basi bɛ gya nu, amaa ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanya kyɛfa wɔ bakaa ne ndii ne ye nzue nu. 18Yiti ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo bekyire bakaa mmaen bɔ bɛpɛle bɛ beguale ne. Sɛ ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo a, ɛmɔkaye kyɛ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔtira ndii ne anu ɔ, na mmom ndii ne yeɛ betira ɛmɔ nu ɔ.
19Afei ɛkɔha kyɛ, “Amba, bebubuli bakaa mmaen ne beguale kyɛbɔ bɛkɔfa me bekosi bɛ gya nu ɔ.” 20 Ɔte amba, bebubuli bɛ beguale, ofikyɛ né benne benni, nakoso wɔ de, wɔ gyidie ti yeɛ ɔmaa ɛtɛ mata bakaa ne nwo ɔ. Yiti nnɛhoahoa wɔ nwo, na mmom suro. 21Na sɛ Nyameɛ amva bakaa mmaen bɔ bɛhyɛle da beluale ne nwo wangyɛ bɛ a, nzaade ɔngɔfa wɔ koso wɔ nwo ngɔhyɛ wɔ. 22Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ enwu Nyameɛ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne ɔne ye anyeborolɛ ne. Ɔma ye nye boro bɛ bɔ bali makyebu ne aso; na wɔ de, Nyameɛ da ye paayɛlɛ ali kyire wɔ, nakoso sana ɛtena ye paayɛlɛ ne anu, na wamma ye sɔ de a, ɔkɔpɛ wɔ kɔto. 23 Na Yisraelfoɛ po, sɛ bɛyakyi elelɛ bɔ benne benni ne a, Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ kowura bɛ boso, ofikyɛ ole tumi kyɛ osa fa bɛ wura bɛ boso ɔ. 24 Na sɛ bapɛ ɛmɔ bafi olive bakaa bɔ ogyi eburo nwo, ná bakwati abɔdeɛ mmeraa bafa ɛmɔ bamata olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua nwo a, nzaade a ɔkɔyɛ mmerɛ kɔma Nyameɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua ne bɔbɔ mmaen kosa kɔmata ye bɔbɔ ye bakaa nwo.
Nyameɛ nwu mmenia mukoraa anwumvoin
25 Aliɛmaa mɔ, mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he yeɛ mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔammu ɛmɔ nwo nworɛfoɛ bandra so. Ye ole kyɛ, Yisrael ye bue bie bayɛ asoserɛ, maa okoodwu kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ somaa bɛkɔwa Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ. 26 Yiti bekole Yisrael amukoraa ngoa, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Defoɛ ne kofi Sion yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ,
na ɔkɔye amumuyɛɛ biala kofi Yakob nu.
27Na apam bɔ me ne bɛ yɛkɔyɛ hɔ ɛne,
mmerɛ bɔ ngɔye bɛ bɔne ngofi berɛ ne.”
28Na ɔfa Nzɛmba ne anwo de, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti bɛte pɔfoɛ mɔ; nakoso ɔfa bɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne anwo de, ɔnate bɛ nana mɔ ti, bɛla Nyameɛ ahone nwo; 29ofikyɛ Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne ye frɛlɛ ne, ɔnzesã ye adwene wɔ ye nwo. 30Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ koso mmerɛ bie ɛmɔanne Nyameɛ banni, nakoso afei de, ɔnate elelɛ bɔ banni ne aso wanwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin nen, 31sɔ ala koso yeɛ kekesaala ye bayɛ asoserɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate anwumvoin bɔ wanwu ɛmɔ ne aso, bɛ koso wanwu bɛ anwumvoin. 32 Nyameɛ abu mmenia mukoraa kyɛ bɛte asoserɛfoɛ, amaa ɔnate so wanwu bɛ mukoraa anwumvoin.
Pɔɔlo ye Nyameɛ ayɛ
33 O! Nyameɛ anwonya ne ye nworɛ ne ye nimdeɛ nu pi! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kohyirehyire ye porɛ bɔ wabɔ nu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔse ye atee bɔ ɔfa so yɔ ye nningyein, anaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte ye bo koyie ɔ? 34
“Nwa yeɛ ɔse Awurade adwene ɔ,
anaa nwa yeɛ ɔte ye foɛtulɛniɛ ɔ?
35 Anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ wali moa wahyɛ ye nikye,
bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɔ bie tua ye kerɛ ɔ?”
36 Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔle nikyee biala ɔ, na ye tumi yeɛ ɔma nikyee biala te ase ma ye ɔ. Animnyam hã Nyameɛ daa daa! Amen.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 12
Content:
Kristo nu brabɔlɛ foforɛ
1 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ngyi Nyameɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ so mesrɛ ɛmɔ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔtu ɛmɔ nipadua bésie berɛ kyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte ase ɔ, bɔ ɔte krongron ná ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ nyamesom bɔ ɔfata ɔ. 2 Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ wiase he, na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ adwene nu foforɛyɛlɛ ne ɔsakyera ɛmɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔte paa, ɔsɔ anyeɛ ná odi mu ɔ.
3 Ɔnate adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wama me ne ati, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala bu ye nwo kyɛ odi mu tra kyɛbɔ ɔte ɔ. Na mmom ɛmɔdwene anwobrɛaseɛ adwene kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ gyidie bɔ wafa wama ebiala ne si te ɔ. 4 Na kyɛbɔ yɛle akwaa pee wɔ nipadua ko nu, ná nzonzoleɛ wɔ akwaa nemɔ amukoraa b’adwuma nu ne, 5 sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso bɔ yɛsone ne, yɛte nipadua komapɛ wɔ Kristo nu ɔ. Ebiala te sonongo de, nakoso yɛ mukoraa yatoatoa nu yayɛ nipadua ko. 6 Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛfa yɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ahoroɔ ne yɛyɛ adwuma kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ alo yɛ ɔ. Sɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyɛ ngɔm kyɛbɔ yɛ gyidie te ɔ; 7sɛ ɔte ɛsolɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛso; sɛ ɔte ngyerɛkyerɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyirehyire; 8sɛ ɔte nguraenhyɛlɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyɛ. Sɛ ebie yɛ adɔeɛ a, maa ɔye ye kunu ɔyɛ; ebiala bɔ ɔnea mmenia so ne, maa ɔyere ye nwo; na bɔ ɔse anwumvoin ne, maa ɔte ye nyunu yɔ.
9 Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ɔdɔ ɔyɛ kaenn; ɛ́mɔhyi bɔne, ná ɛ́mɔtira bɔ ɔte paa ɔ nu serɛserɛ. 10Ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔli moa bɛ́fa anidie bɛ́moma bɛ nwo bɛ nwo. 11Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ɔkɔ ase, ɛ́mɔyɛ hye wɔ sunzum nu, ná ɛ́mɔso Awurade. 12 Ɛ́mɔnya anigye wɔ anyelasoɛ nu, ɛ́mɔnya aboterɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ nu, ná ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ daa. 13Ɛ́mɔboka anwoteefoɛ wɔ bɔ ohia bɛ ɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden wɔ ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ nwo. 14Ɛ́mɔyirayira bɛ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye ɔ, ɛ́mɔyirayira bɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔnoma bɛ. 15Ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aha ne nye ha, na ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ besu ne besu. 16 Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ́yɛ adwene ko; na nnɛma ɛmɔmoma ɛmɔ nwo so, na mmom ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase. Nnɛma ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nwo nworɛfoɛ.
17Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua ebiala bɔne kerɛ. Na mmom ɛ́mɔdwene bɔ ɔte paa wɔ mmenia mukoraa bɛ nye so ɔ nwo. 18Sɛ ɛmɔkɔhora a, ɛmɔ bue nu de, ɛmɔ ne ebiala bɛ́tena asomdwee nu. 19 Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔtotɔ ɛmɔ nwo wereɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔyakyi bɛ́ma Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne. Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Wereɛtɔlɛ te me deɛ, na ngotua so kerɛ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.” 20 Yiti sɛ ɛhɔen ku wɔ pɔfoɛ a, ma ye nikyee ma oli; yeɛ sɛ nzuhɔen ku ye a, ma ye nzue ma ɔno; ofikyɛ sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, ɛkɔboaboa see nzramaa noa ekogua ye ti afia. 21Nnɛma bɔne di wɔ so ngonim, na mmom fa paa di bɔne so ngonim.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 13
Content:
Akristofoɛ ne bɛ maen nu asodie
1 Ɔsɛ kyɛ sona biala brɛ ye nwo ase wura maen mbanyi tumi bo, ofikyɛ tumi biala nne berɛ, sana bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ; na tumi mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ ne, Nyameɛ yeɛ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ɔ. 2 Yiti ebiala bɔ odwɔso tia maen mbanyi nen, né wadwɔso watia bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne; na ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ nen, okonya ye nwo foɛbualɛ. 3 Bɛ bɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te paa ne, maen mbanyi nwo nyɛ suro mma bɛ, na mmom bɛ nwo yɛ suro ma bɛ bɔ benni dwirɛ paa ɔ. Aso enguro kyɛ ekosuro bɔ tumi wura ye sa anaa? Nzaade di dwirɛ paa, na ɔkɔkamvo wɔ. 4 Ofikyɛ wɔ yeeyɛlɛ ti bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ. Nakoso sɛ ɛyɔ bɔne de a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ esuro ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ bendira ɛhɔtɔ ne mbaen! Bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ bɔ bɛtɔ wereɛ bɛma bɛ yaafɛlɛ ba sona bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne so ɔ. 5Yiti, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bewura bɛ bo; nna kyɛ ɛmɔkɔnwati bekofi Nyameɛ yaafɛlɛ piri ne anu angome ti ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ tiboa koso ti ɔ.
6Ɛhe koso ati yeɛ ɛmɔtua toɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ mbanyi nemɔ bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ daa biala bɛyɔ sɔ adwuma ne ɔ. 7 Ɛ́mɔtua ebiala deɛ bɔ ɔfata ye ɔ bɛ́ma ye! Ɛ́mɔtua ɛtoɔ bɛ́ma bɔ ɛtoɔ fata ye ɔ; ɛ́mɔtua ndɔ bɛ́ma bɔ ndɔ fata ye ɔ; ɛ́mɔsuro bɔ odi kyɛ besuro ye ɔ; yeɛ ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma bɔ anidie fata ye ɔ.
Ɛmɔhurohuro bɛ nwo dwirɛ
8 Nnɛmɔma ebiala kerɛ, sana ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔfa bekurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ okuro obiɛngo dwirɛ nen, né wali mmeraa ne aso. 9 Mmeraa ne nwa, “Nnɛsɛkye agyaa, nnɛdi awue, nnɛwua, [nnɛdi adanzewia], nnɛma wɔ nye boro ebie nikye.” Na sɛ mmeraa dwirɛ biala boka so a, babɔ ye porɛ wɔ edwirɛ he anu kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo.” 10Sɛ ekuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ a, ɛnyɛ ye bɔne; yiti ɔdɔ yeɛ mmeraa ne gyi so ɔ.
11 Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, ɛmɔse mmerɛ ne, kyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛmɔtingye befi nnaa nu ɔ. Ofikyɛ yɛ ngoalelɛ ne wapingye watra mmerɛ bɔ yɛɛyɛle agyidifoɛ ɔ. 12 Aleɛ sane ɔ ahyɛ, na alehyeleɛ apingye. Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛgyi awosii nu yɔleɛ nemɔ yɛgua, ná yɛfa kanea nu akodeɛ yɛwura. 13 Ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ bra paa bɔ ɔfata alehyeleɛ ɔ, na nna kyɛ anigye mmorosoɛ ne nzaabolɛ nu, nna adwamanbɔlɛ ne ahohwie nu, ngondii ne anyeboroborolɛ nu. 14 Na mmom ɛ́mɔfa Awurade Yesu Kristo akodeɛ ne bewura, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ si bɛyɔ ye apɛdeɛ bɛma ye.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 14
Content:
Nnɛbua ebiɛngo ndɛen
1 Sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne, ɛ́mɔle ye bɛto nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye su aporowaa fa nikyee bɔ ɛmɔ ne ye nyɛ adwene nwo. 2Ebie de di kyɛ ɔkora odi nikyee biala, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne de, odi nyaanyaa ngome. 3 Sona bɔ odi ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ obu sona bɔ onni ne animtia; yeɛ sona bɔ onni ne koso, ɔnzɛ kyɛ obua sona bɔ odi ne ndɛen, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ale ye ato nu. 4 Wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebie akoaa ndɛen ɔ? Ye bɔbɔ ye mene yeɛ okohyire kyɛ ɔsɔ ye nye anaa ɔnzɔ ye nye ɔ. Na ɔkɔsɔ ye nye, ofikyɛ Awurade kora maa ɔsɔ ye nye.
5 Sona bie bu kyẽa ko kyɛ ɔte paa tra kyẽa foforɛ, yeɛ ebie koso dwene kyɛ ngyẽa mukoraa te pɛ. Ɛ́mɔma yɛ mukoraa yɛsi y’adwene pi. 6Sona bɔ ɔdwene kyɛ kyẽa bie te paa nen, ɔyɔ sɔ fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam. Yeɛ sona bɔ odi nikyee bie nen, odi fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam, ofikyɛ ɔda Nyameɛ ase. Sɔ ala yeɛ sona bɔ onni ne koso, ɔyɔ sɔ fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam ɔ, na ɔda Nyameɛ ase. 7 Yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte ase ma ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ owu ma ye nwo ɔ. 8 Na sɛ yɛte ase a, yɛte yɛma Awurade, yeɛ yɛwu koso a, yɛwu yɛma Awurade. Yiti sɛ yɛte ase oo, sɛ yɛwu oo, yɛte Awurade deɛ. 9 Ɛhe ati yeɛ Kristo wuli na otingyele ɔ, amaa wayɛ awufoɛ ne teasefoɛ b’Awurade. 10 Na wɔ, nzu ati yeɛ ebua eliɛma ndɛen ɔ? Anaakyɛ wɔ koso, nzu ati yeɛ ebu eliɛma animtia ɔ? Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkogyina Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ bia ne nyunu. 11 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Awurade nwa,
kyɛ nde ase ye de, nangoroma mukoraa bɛkɔkoto me,
na noa mukoraa kɔbɔ Nyameɛ dumaa.
12Yiti yɛ nu biala kobu ye bɔbɔ ye nwo ngondaa kohyire Nyameɛ.
Nnɛma ebiɛngo fi ase
13 Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi kyɛ yɛkobua yɛ nwo yɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ. Na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛyɛ y’adwene kyɛ yɛngɔfa pambim anaa sundidua yɛngɔto yɛ biɛngo atee nu ɔ. 14 Mese, na m’adwene koso si pi wɔ Awurade Yesu nu kyɛ, nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ; na mmom ye nwo nde ma sona bɔ obu aleɛ ne kyɛ ye nwo nde ɔ. 15 Sɛ aleɛ bɔ edi ne ma ebiɛngo di aworabɔlɛ a, ye de né engyire ɔdɔ ko. Nnɛfa w’aleɛ bɔ edi ne sɛkye ebiɛngo bɔ Kristo wu mane ye ne. 16 Yiti nnɛma bɔ ɔte paa ma wɔ ne nya dumaa tɛɛ maa bɛka ye nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. 17Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne ɔtte aleɛ ne anonneɛ, na mmom ɔte tenenee, asomdwee ne anika bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron ne berɛ ɔ. 18Na sona bɔ ɔso Kristo wɔ atee sɔ ne aso ne, ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye, na mmenia bu ye.
19 Yiti ɛmɔma yɛli nningyein bɔ bɛma asomdwee ɔne bɔ ɔfa ngɔsoɛ brɛ yɛ si. 20 Aleɛ ti nnɛsɛkye Nyameɛ adwuma. Nikyee biala nwo te amba de, nakoso ɔtte mayee kyɛ ekoli aleɛ bie bɔ ɔkɔma eliɛma kɔyɛ bɔne ɔ. 21 Ɔte paa kyɛ engoli naen anaa ɛngɔno nzaa anaa ɛngɔyɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔyɛ sundidua kɔma eliɛma ɔ. 22 Wɔ de, wɔ gyidie bɔ ele ye fa sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo ne, maa ɔha wɔ ne Nyameɛ b’afia. Sona bɔ ye tiboa mmua ye foɛ wɔ nikyee bɔ ɔyɔ a ɔse kyɛ ɔte paa nwo ne, wanya saleɛ. 23Na sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye naa ne, sɛ odi a, babua ye foɛ, ofikyɛ wamvi gyidie nu yeɛ olili ɔ. Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ nna gyidie nu yeɛ ofi ne, ɔte bɔne.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 15
Content:
Ɛ́mɔsuasua Yesu
1 Yɛ bɔ yɛ nwo yɛ se wɔ gyidie nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛsoa bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se nemɔ bɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma yɛ nwo kɔtɔ yɛ angome. 2 Na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛ nu biala ɔyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma obiɛngo nwo kɔtɔ ye ɔ, bɔ ɔte paa ma ye, bɔ ɔkɔmaa okonyi gyidie nu ɔ. 3 Ofikyɛ Kristo koso wanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma ye ngome ye nwo kɔtɔ ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔle wɔ alapaa ne, b’alapaa ne waagua me so.” 4 Na nikyee biala bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛtole berɛ tetetete ne, bɛhyerɛle maa ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ mane yɛ, kyɛ yɛfa aboterɛ ne Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu aworakyekyerɛ so yɛnya anyelasoɛ. 5Me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ aboterɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔma ɛmɔfa adwene ko bɛtena, kyɛbɔ ɔfata Kristo Yesu ɔ, 6 amaa ɛmɔabɔ nu bafa noa ko bahyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne animnyam.
Nzɛmba ne te Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ deɛ
7 Yiti ɛ́mɔle ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo bɛto nu, kyɛbɔ Kristo ale ɛmɔ ato nu ne, amaa Nyameɛ anya animnyam. 8 Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Kristo yɛle somvoɛ mane bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ fa hyirele Nyameɛ nahorɛlilɛ, kyɛ ɔma bɔhyɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle yɛ nana mɔ ne otindim, 9 kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛkɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ nwo ɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ,
“Yiti ngɔkamvo wɔ wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu;
na ngɔto edwein ngɔye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.”
10 Na osa kã ye kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ, ɛmɔ ne ye maen beli ahurusi.”
11 Ɔkã ye bieku kyɛ,
“Ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa,
ɛ́mɔye Awurade ayɛ,
maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔkamvo ye!”
12 Yesaya kã ye bieku kyɛ,
“Yese ndii ne kɔwa,
ye yeɛ okodwɔso kooli Amaenmaensofoɛ so hene ɔ,
na ye so yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ kɔfa bɛ nye bɛkɔto ɔ.”
13 Na mesrɛ kyɛ, anyelasoɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔfa gyidie nu anigye ne asomdwee amukoraa owura ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ, amaa ɔnate Sunzum Krongron tumi so ɛmɔanya anyelasoɛ mmorosoɛ.
Pɔɔlo krataa ne botaeɛ
14Aliɛmaa mɔ, me bɔbɔ mede meto nu kyɛ paayɛlɛ ali ɛmɔ ti, kyɛ ɛmɔle nimdeɛ amukoraa, na ɛmɔkora betutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ. 15Nakoso atee bie aso de, masi m’ahone mahyerɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ, kyɛ mefa mebɔ ɛmɔ ngayeɛ; ɔnate adom bɔ Nyameɛ wafa walo me ne ati, 16 kyɛ nyɛ Kristo Yesu somvoɛ mma Amaenmaensofoɛ, ná nyɛ Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne nwo asɔfodwuma, ná Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛ́yɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ, bɔ Sunzum Krongron wate bɛ nwo ɔ. 17Ɔnate kyɛ mafa me nwo mabɔ Kristo Yesu nwo ti, mefa m’adwuma bɔ meyɔ mema Nyameɛ ne mehoahoa me nwo. 18 Mengosi me hue mengɔhã nikyee biala nwo dwirɛ, sana bɔ Kristo nate me so wayɔ bɔ ɔma Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛyɛ sotie wɔ bɛ dwirɛ ne bɛ nnwumaa nu, 19 nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tumi so, Sunzum Krongron tumi so. Yiti mabɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne amukoraa nwo dawure mafi Yerusalem ne ye nwo nguro mɔ so maadwu Yilirikum. 20 Ɛhe ati me botaeɛ ole kyɛ ngɔbɔ nzɛmba ne dawure nekaa biala bɔ bennya bɛttele Kristo dumaa le ɔ, amaa ɔnate so mandoa ebie fapem bɔ wato ɔ so, 21 na mmom kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Bɛ bɔ bɛhhane ye nwo dwirɛ behhyirele bɛ le ne, bekonwu ye
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛttele ye nwo dwirɛ le ne, bɛkɔte ye bo.”
Pɔɔlo kuro kyɛ ɔkɔ Rome
22 Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔtaa si me atee bɔ yiti ɔmma mennya atee memma ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. 23 Nakoso kekesaala ye de, mayie m’adwuma wɔ manzini hemɔ anu wa, yeɛ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ afoɛ pee awa, 24 Na mekuro kyɛ mebaasẽ mekɔ Sepania a, ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná manya ɛmɔ nwo anika mmerɛ kãa, ná afei ɛmɔaboka me maa matoa m’ateetulɛ ne aso mahɔ berɛ. 25 Kekesaala ye de, mékɔ Yerusalem mekɔfa ndoboa mema anwoteefoɛ nemɔ. 26 Ofikyɛ Makedonia ne Akaia asɔremma banya anika bakekã bɛ sa ase kyɛ ngɔmva mmoka anwoteefoɛ ehiafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne. 27 Ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ sɔ ɔ; nahorɛ nu, ɔte b’asɛdeɛ kyɛ bɛboka bɛ ɔ. Ofikyɛ sɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ banya Yudafoɛ sunzum nu saleɛ ne bie de a, nzaade ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ koso bɛfa b’anwoɔnaen nu saleɛ ne bie bɛboka bɛ. 28Yiti sɛ meyie sɔ adwuma ye, ná mefa ndoboa bɔ baye ne mema bɛ a, ngɔfa ɛmɔ berɛ ná matoa so mahɔ Sepania. 29 Na mese kyɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ a, ngɔfa Kristo nzɛmba ne anu saleɛ mmorosoɛ yeɛ ngɔwa ɔ.
30Aliɛmaa mɔ, méfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ɔne Sunzum ne dɔ mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔboka me wɔ mbaeɛ bɔ ɛmɔbɔ bekyire Nyameɛ bɛma me ne anu, 31 ná ɔpepɛ le me fi bɛ bɔ benne nni bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne bɛ sa nu, ná me dwumadie bɔ mekwaali ye wɔ Yerusalem ne wasɔ anwoteefoɛ nemɔ nye; 32amaa ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so mafa anigye mawa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná ɛmɔakyekye me wora. 33 Asomdwee Nyameɛ ne ɔne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena. Amen.

Title: ROMANFOƐ 16
Content:
Pɔɔlo bisa Roman Akristofoɛ ahye
1Medi y’eliɛma brasua Fobi bɔ ɔte asɔre somvoɛ wɔ Kɛnkrea ne mekyire ɛmɔ, 2kyɛ ɛ́mɔle ye bɛto nu wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ anwoteefoɛ bɛyɔ ɔ. Afei ɛ́mɔfa mmokalɛ biala bɔ ohia fi ɛmɔ berɛ bɛboka ye; ofikyɛ ɔte sona bɔ waboka mmeni pee ne me bɔbɔ koso.
3 Ɛ́mɔbisa Prisika ne Akwila ahye bɛ́ma me, bɛte nniɛma adwumayɔlɛfoɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu; 4bɛ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ ngoa bɛtole serewa bɛmane me ɔ. Nna me ngome yeɛ meda bɛ ase ɔ, na mmom Amaenmaensofoɛ asɔre ne amukoraa koso bɛda bɛ ase. 5 Ɛ́mɔbisa asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ b’awuro ne ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa me dɔfo Ɛpaneto bɔ olili moa lele Kristo lili wɔ Asia ne ahye bɛ́ma me. 6Ɛ́mɔbisa Maria bɔ wayere ye nwo wayɔ adwuma wama ɛmɔ ne ahye bɛ́ma me. 7Ɛ́mɔbisa Androniko ne Yunia bɔ bɛte m’abusuafoɛ ne mmiɛngo kukunufoɛ ɔ ahye bɛ́ma me; bele dumaa wɔ asomafoɛ nemɔ nu, na belili moa bɛyɛle Akristofoɛ bɛyakyili me.
8Ɛ́mɔbisa Ampliato, bɔ ɔte me dɔfo wɔ Awurade nu ahye bɛ́ma me. 9Ɛ́mɔbisa Yubano, bɔ ɔte yɛ biɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ wɔ Kristo nu, ɔne me dɔfo Setaki ahye bɛ́ma me. 10Ɛ́mɔbisa Apele bɔ bale ye bato nu kyɛ odi nahorɛ ma Kristo ne ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa Aristobulo abusuafoɛ ahye bɛ́ma me. 11Ɛ́mɔbisa m’abusuaniɛ Herodion ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa Nakisu abusuafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Awurade nu ne ahye bɛ́ma me.
12Mébisa Trifana ne Trifosa bɔ bɛte Awurade adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ ahye. Mébisa me dɔfo Pɛɛsi bɔ wayɔ Awurade adwuma pee ne ahye. 13Mébisa Rufu bɔ ɔbɔ mmɔden paa wɔ Awurade adwuma nu, ɔne ye maame bɔ wafa me wayɛ ɔwa ne ahye. 14Mébisa Asinkrito, Flɛgɔn, Hɛme, Patroba, Hɛma ne aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛboka bɛ so nemɔ ahye. 15Mébisa Filologo, Yulia, Nereuse ne oliɛma brasua, Olimpa ne anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛ ne bɛ wɔ berɛ ne amu ahye. 16 Ɛ́mɔyɛ bɛ nwo awaawaatuu krongron nu. Kristo asɔre ne amukoraa bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.
Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
17 Aliɛmaa mɔ, metu ɛmɔ foɛ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛfa mbakyembakyemuɛ ne sundidua bɛba, bɔ otia ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɛmɔasua ne. Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bɛ nwo! 18 Ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛnzo y’Awurade Kristo, na mmom bɛso bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ko. Na bɛfa bɛ noa dwirɛ fɛɛ ne anoanubobɔlɛ bɛlakalaka mmenia bɔ b’adwene te nganga ɔ. 19Ebiala ate ɛmɔ sotie bɔ ɛmɔayɛ bama nzɛmba ne ɔ, yiti me nye gye ɛmɔ nwo, nakoso mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu nworɛ bɛfa bɔ ɔte paa nwo, ná ɛmɔte ɛmɔ nwo béfi bɔ ɔte bɔne nwo. 20 Na ɔngɔhyɛ koraa asomdwee Nyameɛ ne kɔbɛtɛ Abɔnzam wɔ ɛmɔ gya bo. Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ɔlo ɛmɔ.
21 Mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ Timoteo ne Lukio ne Yason ne Sosipatro bɔ bɛte m’abusuafoɛ ɔ bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.
22Me, Tɛtio, bɔ ngyerɛle sɔ krataa he ne, mebisa ɛmɔ ahye wɔ Awurade nu.
23Gayɔso, bɔ nde ye awuro, ná afei koso asɔre ne yia wɔ ye awuro ne, obisa ɛmɔ ahye; Eraseto bɔ ɔte kuro wa fotoɛsoneafoɛ, ɔne y’eliɛma bienzua Kwato bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.
[24Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ deɛ.]
Pɔɔlo mbaeɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
25Bɔ ɔkora ma ɛmɔ tindim, kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne Yesu Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne ɔte ne, kyɛbɔ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛfeale daa tete ne ɔte ne, 26 nakoso afei de bala ye ali, na bɛnate bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛhyerɛle ne aso bala ye ali bahyire maen amukoraati, kyɛbɔ Ɛdangama Nyameɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ te ne, amaa ɔnate so maen maen amukoraa bale bali ná bayɛ sotie bama ye.
27Nyameɛ bɔ ye ngome twe yeɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ ne, animnyam ɔ́fa Yesu Kristo so ɔ́yɛ ye deɛ daa daa! Amen.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo krataa he, ɔhyerɛ ɔɔmane asɔre bɔ ye bɔbɔ ɔtele wɔ Korinto. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né edwudwolɛ pee ne aporowaa awa asɔre ne anu. Né Korinto te firaman firamanfoɛ kuro. Ɔte manzini bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Akaia ahenguro. Né wale dumaa wɔ dwaalilɛ, amammerɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ ne ɛsom ahoroɔ nu.
Edwirɛ bɔ né ɔyɛ Pɔɔlo ahomete paa ole mbakyembakyemuɛ ne adwamanbɔlɛ wɔ asɔre ne anu, agyaa nwo dwirɛ, tiboa, asɔre nu nhyehyɛleɛ, Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ, yeɛ ewutingyelɛ nwo dwirɛ. Ɔfale adwene bɔ nu pi hyirehyirele bɔ nzɛmba ne kã fa ɛhemɔ nwo ɔ.
Nwomaa he ti 13 ne kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔte paa tra so ole ɔdɔ bɔ wafa wama sona ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-9
Asɔre nu mbakyembakyemuɛ 1.10—4.21
Adwamanbɔlɛ ne awuro dwirɛ 5.1—7.40
Kristofoɛ ne bosoensolɛfoɛ 8.1—11.1
Asɔre nu abrabɔ ne Nyameɛ sɔnenɛ 11.2—14.40
Kristo wutingyelɛ ne agyidifoɛ wutingyelɛ 15.1-58
Akristofoɛ fa akyɛdeɛ kɔma Yudea Akristofoɛ 16.1-4
Pɔɔlo bɔbɔ ye ngɔmɔ, ɔne krataa n’ayieleɛ 16.5-24

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 1
Content:
1 Krataa he fi me Pɔɔlo, bɔ Nyameɛ nate ye pɛ so wafrɛ me kyɛ nyɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ɔ, ɔne aliɛmaa Sositene berɛ. 2 Yɛfa yɛbrɛ Nyameɛ asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Korinto, bɛ bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo ti bafrɛ bɛ maa baayɛ krongron; mekyire ɛmɔ bɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nekaa biala maa ɛmɔayɛ anwoteefoɛ, na ɛmɔ ne yɛ bɔ nu bɔ Yesu Kristo dumaa kyɛ y’Awurade ɔ. 3 Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Saleɛ wɔ Kristo nu
4 Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti daa meda me Nyameɛ ase, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nate Yesu Kristo so walo ɛmɔ. 5Na nikyee biala nu ɛmɔanya bɛ nwo wɔ Kristo nu, ebie te kyɛ edwudwolɛ amukoraa ne nimdeɛ mukoraa nu. 6Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne atira ndii wɔ ɛmɔ nu, 7bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔ ndɔ sii wɔ adom akyɛdeɛ biala nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwondɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo walɛ ne ɔ. 8 Ye yeɛ okogyina ɛmɔ si pindinn koodwu ayieleɛ, amaa ɛmɔanni nikyee biala nwo fɔ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo kyẽa ne. 9 Nyameɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ ne Ɔwa, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɛfa abiɛngoɛ ne, odi nahorɛ.
Asɔre nu mbakyembakyemuɛ
10Nniɛma mɔ, mefa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛ́mɔyɛ ko ná mbakyembakyemuɛ amma ɛmɔ nu; na ɛ́mɔyɛ ko wɔ adwene ko ne porɛ bɔlɛ ko nu. 11Nniɛma mɔ, Kloe awuro ama mɔ baatia me gya so kyɛ ɛmɔ afia nwo koraa. 12 Mekyire kyɛ, asora bɔ ɛmɔ nu biala kã ye deɛ fa ɔ. Ebie nwa, “Me de, nwɔ Pɔɔlo bue nu”, ebie wora nwa, “Me de, nwɔ Apolo bue nu”, ebie koso nwa, “Me de, nwɔ Kefa bue nu”, yeɛ ebie koso nwa, “Me de, nwɔ Kristo bue nu.” 13Aso bahyehyɛ Kristo nu hɔ ɔ? Pɔɔlo yeɛ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu bɛmane ɛmɔ ɔ, anaakyɛ Pɔɔlo dumaa nu yeɛ bɛbɔle ɛmɔ asu bewurale ɔ?
14 Meda Nyameɛ ase kyɛ mammɔ ɛmɔ nu biala asu, sana Krispo ne Gayɔso ngome, 15na ebiala anga kyɛ bɛbɔle ye asu wɔ me dumaa nu. 16 Mekaye kyɛ mmɔle Setefana awuro ama koso asu; na mengaye kyɛ mmɔle ebiala asu mmokale bɛ so ɔ. 17Ofikyɛ Kristo anzoma me kyɛ mmamɔ asu, na mmom ɔsomane me kyɛ mmanga nzɛmba ne, bɔ memva kuro sona nworɛ yeɛ mekã ɔ, amaa Kristo mmeamudua ne wanyɛ mbaen.
Kristo te Nyameɛ tumi ne ye nworɛ
18Kristo mmeamudua ne nwo dwirɛ te ngwaseasɛm ma bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ so bemini ne, nakoso ɔte Nyameɛ tumi ma yɛ bɔ ogu so ode yɛ ngoa ne.
19 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Ngɔsɛkye nworɛfoɛ nworɛ ne,
na mama nimdeɛfoɛ ndeaseɛ ayɛ mbaen.”
20 Nzaade, né nworɛfoɛ gyi ye sɛ? Nimdeɛfoɛ koso begyi ye sɛ? Bɛ bɔ babe aporowaasulɛ nu wɔ ewiase wa ne koso begyi ye sɛ? Aso Nyameɛ mmane wiase wa nworɛ ɔkkakyili ngwaseasɛm?
21Ɔnate Nyameɛ nworɛ (nhyehyɛleɛ) ne ati, adasammaa bangora bamva bɛ nworɛ so bannwu Nyameɛ. Yiti ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye kyɛ ɔkɔfa edwirɛ bɔ yɛkã, bɔ bebu ye ngwaseasɛm ne aso kole bɛ bɔ bede bedi ne ngoa. 22 Ofikyɛ Yudafoɛ bɛpena nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, yeɛ Helafoɛ koso bɛpena ewiase nworɛ. 23 Nakoso yɛ de, yɛbɔ Kristo bɔ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ne nwo dawure. Ɛhe te sundidua ma Yudafoɛ, yeɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm ma Helafoɛ. 24Na bɛ bɔ bafrɛ bɛ ne de, Yudafoɛ oo, Helafoɛ oo, Kristo te Nyameɛ tumi ne ye nworɛ ma bɛ. 25Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ bebu ye ngwaseasɛm ne, nworɛ wɔ nu tra adasammaa nworɛ; yeɛ bɔ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nen, anwoserɛ wɔ nu tra adasammaa anwoserɛ.
26Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔkaye ɛmɔ frɛlɛ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne. Sɛ ɛnea ye sona bue nu de a, ɛmɔ nu kãa bie yeɛ né bele dibea anaa bɛte nnehyeɛ ɔ. 27 Nakoso Nyameɛ fale bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm ne kyɛ ɔfa gua ewiase nworɛfoɛ nyunu ase; na ɔfale bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, kyɛ ɔfa gua anwoserɛfoɛ nyunu ase, 28 na ewiase nningyein bɔ ye nwo olle mvasoɛ, ɔne bɔ bemmu ye ne yeɛ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye ɔ, yeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔnne berɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɔfa sɛkye bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ye nwo hia ne, 29 amaa sona biala anhoahoa ye nwo wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 30 Ngoa bɔ ɛmɔle ye wɔ Yesu nu ne fi Nyameɛ berɛ, na Nyameɛ afa Kristo ayɛ yɛ nworɛ, yɛ tenenee, yɛ fawɔnwodi ne krongronyɛlɛ. 31 Ɛhe ati, bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, maa ɔhoahoa ye nwo wɔ Awurade nu.”

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 2
Content:
Kristo ne ye mmeamudua ne nwo dwirɛ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, mmale ɛmɔ berɛ kyɛ mebaali Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ mekyire ɛmɔ ne, mamma kyɛ sona bɔ ye noa ate anaakyɛ ɔse nworɛ ɔ. 2Ofikyɛ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ membena kyɛ menwu nikye fee wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, sana Kristo ne ye mmeamudua ne aso wue. 3 Na mvale anwobrɛaseɛ ne esuronyi ne anwopopolɛ yeɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛtenane ɔ. 4 Mamva sona nworɛ ne tetateta yeɛ ngane me dwirɛ ná nyɔle me ngyerɛkyerɛ ɔ; na mmom mvale Sunzum ne ɔne tumi yeɛ nyɔle adwuma ɔ, 5amaa ɛmɔ gyidie wanggyina sona nworɛ so, na mmom wagyina Nyameɛ tumi so.
Nyameɛ nworɛ
6 Nakoso nworɛ dwirɛ yeɛ yɛkã yɛkyire bɛ bɔ banyi sunzum nu ɔ. Ɔtte wiase he anu nworɛ, yeɛ ɔtte wiase atumifoɛ deɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne bie. 7 Na mmom mworɛ bɔ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ne te Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu nworɛ, bɔ kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná yanya animnyam ti, ɔhyehyɛ tole berɛ koraka yeɛ ɔbɔ wiase ɔ. 8 Ewiase atumifoɛ biala ande nworɛ he abo, ofikyɛ sɛ bɛtele ye bo a, ahaa bammɔ animnyam Hene ne mmeamudua nu. 9 Nakoso bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Bɔ anyeɛ nnwuni ye, anaa bɔ asoɛ ɔttele ye le,
anaa bɔ ebiala ɔddwenene ye nwo le ne,
yeɛ ɔte nikyee bɔ Nyameɛ asiesie
ama bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ɔ.”
10Nakoso yɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ nate ye Sunzum so waye wahyire yɛ ɔ. Ofikyɛ Sunzum ne pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ nikyee biala nu, ɔne Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu nhyehyɛleɛ po. 11Nwa yeɛ ɔse kuro sona ti anu dwirɛ ɔ? Sana sɔ sona ne sunzum bɔ ɔte ye nu ne. Sɔ ala yeɛ ebiala koso nze Nyameɛ ti anu dwirɛ ɔ, sana Nyameɛ Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔse ɔ. 12Nna ewiase wa sunzum yeɛ yanya ye ɔ, na mmom Sunzum bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ yanya ye ɔ; na ɛhe maa yɛte akyɛdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama yɛ ne bo.
13Bɔ yɛkã ne, yɛmva kuro sona nworɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛkyirekyire ɔ, na mmom bɔ Sunzum Krongron ne okyirekyire ɔ; na yɛfa sunzum nu nningyein yɛtoto sunzum nu nningyein nwo.
14Ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum nne ye nu ne, onnya akyɛdeɛ bɔ befi Sunzum ne berɛ ne, ofikyɛ akyɛdeɛ ne te sɔ sona ne nye so ngwaseasɛm; yeɛ ɔngora nde bɛ bo koso, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔboka sona maa ɔte akyɛdeɛ ne bo ɔ. 15Sona bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum wɔ ye nu ne, onwu nikye tɛɛ ne paa mukoraa, na ye de, ebiala ngora mmua ye ndɛen.
16 “Na nwa yeɛ ɔse Awurade ti anu dwirɛ ná watu ye foɛ ɔ?”
Nakoso yɛ de, yɛle Kristo adwene.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 3
Content:
Pɔɔlo ne Apolo te Awurade somvoɛ
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, mangora me ne ɛmɔ andwudwo kyɛ mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ anwoɔnaenufoɛ bɔ bɛte nnɔma wɔ Kristo nu ɔ. 2 Nyɔfonesue yeɛ mva maa ɛmɔnone ɔ; na mamma ɛmɔ aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ né ɛmɔnnya beddwuli kyɛ bedi aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ. Na kekesaala ye po, ɛmɔnnya beddwuli. 3Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ tɛte kyɛ ewiasefoɛ abrabɔ. Na aberɛ bɔ anyeboroborolɛ ne apindapinda wɔ ɛmɔ afia ye de, aso ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɛmɔte anwoɔnaenufoɛ bɔ ɛmɔ yɔleɛ te kyɛ ewiasefoɛ ɔ? 4 Sɛ ɛmɔ nu ko kã kyɛ, “Me de nwɔ Pɔɔlo bue nu” ná ko kã kyɛ, “Me de nwɔ Apolo bue nu” a, aso nna kuro sona yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ye?
5 Pɔɔlo te nzu? Apolo te nzu? Yɛte Nyameɛ ngoaa bɔ ɛmɔnate yɛ so bele belili ɔ, na yɛ nu ko biala le adwuma kyɛbɔ Awurade afa awura ye sa ɔ. 6 Me de nnuale, yeɛ Apolo wora oguaguale so nzue ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔmaa onyini ɔ. 7Yiti bɔ oluale ne, ɔne bɔ oguaguale so nzue ne, bɛ de bɛtte huu; na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmaa onyini ne yeɛ ɔte piri ɔ. 8Bɔ oluale ne, ɔne bɔ oguaguale so nzue ne, bɛ mukoraa pɛ, na bɛ nu biala sa kɔha ye akatuaa kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye adwuma si te ɔ. 9 Ofikyɛ yɛ de, yɛte Nyameɛ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ, bɔ yɛ ne ye bɔ nu yɛyɔ adwuma ɔ; na ɛmɔte ye boo, Nyameɛ sua. 10Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ ama me adom ne ati, ndole fapem kyɛ suasilɛniɛ nimdeɛniɛ, na sona foforɛ koso ɔ́to bie toa so. Na ebiala bɔ ɔto bie toa so ne, ɔnea kyɛ ɔkɔto ye yé ɔ. 11Ofikyɛ Yesu Kristo ole fapem bɔ bali moa bato ye dada ne, na ebiala ngora ndo fapem foforɛ ko. 12Na sɛ ebie fa sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, nyɔbosanyene, bakaa, ndondonyi anaa ɛserɛ toa fapem ne aso a, 13ebiala adwuma kɔye ye nwo ali. Ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne kɔmaa ɔkɔla ali, ofikyɛ see kɔma ebiala adwuma kɔla ali, na see ne koso ebiala adwuma bɔ wayɔ ɔ kɔnea. 14Sɛ ebie adwuma bɔ wayɔ wafa watoa fapem ne aso kora gyina see ne noa a, okonya ye nwo akatuaa. 15 Na sɛ see ne yera ebie adwuma a, ɔkɔhwere nikye; ye bɔbɔ de, Nyameɛ kole ye ngoa, nakoso ɔte kyɛ watutu wafa see nu ɔ.
16 Aso ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua na Nyameɛ Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu ɔ? 17Yiti sɛ ebie sɛkye Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua a, Nyameɛ koso kɔsɛkye ye, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua te krongron, na ɛmɔ ole ye Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne.
18 Nnɛma ebiala lakalaka ye nwo. Sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie dwene kyɛ ɔse wiase nworɛ a, maa ɔyɛ kwaseaa ná wanwu nworɛ. 19 Na ewiase nworɛ te ngwaseasɛm wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Nworɛfoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ kanda yeɛ ɔfa sua bɛ ngaen kye bɛ ɔ.” 20 Osa kã ye bieku kyɛ, “Awurade se kyɛ nworɛfoɛ bɛ nzusuleɛ te mbaen.” 21Yiti nnɛma ebiala fa kuro sona hoahoa ye nwo, ɔnate kyɛ nikyee biala te ɛmɔ deɛ. 22Pɔɔlo oo, Apolo oo, Kefa oo, ewiase oo, ngoa oo, ewue oo, ɛnɛ deɛ oo, anaa kyẽa bie deɛ oo, bɛ mukoraa bɛte ɛmɔ deɛ, 23na ɛmɔte Kristo deɛ, yeɛ Kristo koso te Nyameɛ deɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 4
Content:
Kristo asomafoɛ
1Odi kyɛ ebiala bu yɛ kyɛ yɛte Kristo asomvoɛ ne Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ so neafoɛ. 2Afei koso, bɔ bɛpena ye wɔ somvoɛ mɔ nwo ole kyɛ bekoli nahorɛ ɔ. 3Na me de, ɔmva me nwo kyɛ ɛmɔ anaa sona biala kobua me ndɛen ɔ; me bɔbɔ po memmua me nwo ndɛen. 4Ofikyɛ me tiboa mmua me foɛ, nakoso ɛhe ngyire kyɛ mendɔ sii. Na Awurade yeɛ obua me ndɛen ɔ. 5Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔbua ndɛen koraka ná mmerɛ ne wadwu, koraka né Awurade awa, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ awosii nu kofite ɔ, ná wasa mmenia ti anu nzusuleɛ wagua dwaaso. Na afei ebiala konya ɛkamvolɛ bɔ ɔfata ye ɔ kofi Nyameɛ berɛ.
6Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mafa me ne Apolo yɛ nwo mayɛ mvandoho ye, amaa ɛmɔasua yɛ, ná ɛmɔammu bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne aso, ná ɛmɔ nu biala wamva sona bie wanhoahoa ye nwo wambɛ sona foforɛ poa. 7Nwa yeɛ osele wɔ kyɛ asora wɔ ngome ɔ? Nzu yeɛ ele ye bɔ nna Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔfa mmane wɔ ɔ? Na sɛ ɔfa mane wɔ de a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛfa hoahoa wɔ nwo kyɛ nna akyɛdeɛ ahɔ ɔ?
8Nna ɛmɔ ɔ! Ɛmɔ sa ahã bɔ ɛmɔpena ɔ dada! Ɛmɔanya bɛ nwo bayie. Ɛmɔakwati yɛ bayɛ bɛ nwo ahemvo! Me kunu a, ahaa ɛmɔte ahemvo amba, amaa yɛne ɛmɔ abɔ nu yali hene. 9Ofikyɛ ɔyɛ me kyɛ Nyameɛ wafa yɛ asomafoɛ wasie berɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ babua bɛ kumfɔ ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yayɛ ahyerɛ yama ewiase ne abɔfo mɔ ne adasa mmaa. 10Kristo ti yayɛ ngwaseafoɛ, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔayɛ nworɛfoɛ wɔ Kristo nu! Yɛyɛ mmerɛ, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ nwo yɛ se. Ɛmɔ de, bedi ɛmɔ nni, nakoso yɛ de, bemmu yɛ. 11Ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen ku yɛ, yɛ nwo la so, bɛkã yɛ mbire, yeɛ yɛlle amandena, 12 na yɛyere yɛ nwo yɛfa yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ sa yɛyɔ adwuma. Bɛbɔ yɛ alapaa a, yɛyirayira bɛ. Bɛtane yɛ nye a, yɛgyina pindinn. 13Bɛsɛkye yɛ dumaa a, yɛne bɛ nyaka. Yayɛ kyɛ ewiase fiɛ, na yayɛ nningyein mukoraa boso wura maa waadwu ɛnɛ.
14Mengyerɛ ɛhe memma ngua ɛmɔ nyunu ase, nakoso mefa metu ɛmɔ foɛ kyɛ me mma bɔ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ. 15Na sɛ ɛmɔle foɛtulɛfoɛ apee buru wɔ Kristo nu po a, ɛmɔ baba mɔ de, bɛnzone, ofikyɛ ɔnate nzɛmba ne aso mayɛ ɛmɔ baba wɔ Yesu Kristo nu. 16 Yiti mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔsua me. 17Ɛhe ati, mésoma mma Timoteo bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ ná odi nahorɛ wɔ Awurade nu ne wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛ ɔɔkayekaye ɛmɔ me Kristo nu brabɔlɛ, kyɛbɔ mekyirekyire ye asɔre biala nu wɔ nekaa biala ne.
18Ɛmɔ nu biemɔ di tutureasɛm kyɛ gyamea mengɔɔsra ɛmɔ. 19Sɛ Awurade ma me ate a, ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná maanwu bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwomasoɛ nemɔ bɛ tumi, na nna bɔ bɛkekã hɔ ɔ. 20Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne oggyi edwudwolɛ mbaen so, na mmom ogyi tumi so. 21Beni yeɛ ɛmɔkuro ɔ? Kyɛ ngɔfa mbire, anaakyɛ ngɔfa ɔdɔ ne anwobrɛaseɛ ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ?

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 5
Content:
Adwamanbɔlɛ wɔ asɔre ne anu
1 Baahã ye susu amba kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ bɔ adwaman, bɔ ye sɛso nne ewiasefoɛ po nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ebie fa ye baba aye. 2Nakoso ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo! Ɛmɔ wora mmom yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ ɔ, ná ɛmɔye sona bɔ wabɔ sɔ musue ne befi ɛmɔ nu.
3Anwoɔnaen nu de, nna me ne ɛmɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ dɔ ɔ, nakoso me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ dɔ wɔ sunzum nu, na mabua sona bɔ wabɔ sɔ musue ne ndɛen dada te kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ dɔ ne ala. 4Sɛ me sunzum ne ɛmɔ beyia nu wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa nu, na y’Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi boka so a, 5odi kyɛ ɛmɔye sɔ sona ne bewura Abɔnzam sa maa ɔsɛkye ye nwoɔnaen ne, amaa ye sunzum anya daa ngoa wɔ Awurade Yesu kyẽa ne.
6 Ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo. Ɛmɔnze kyɛ mɔle harewaa kãa bie yeɛ ɔfra mɔle torɛ ne amukoraa nu maa ɔkeka ɔ. 7 Yiti ɛ́mɔye mɔle harewaa daa ne befi ɛmɔ nu amaa ɛmɔayɛ mɔle torɛ foforɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔte kabrɛdi ne ala. Ofikyɛ bafa Kristo bɔ ɔte y’Abɔtra boaen ne babɔ afɔleɛ bama yɛ. 8 Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛfa mɔle harewaa daa ne, bɔ ɔte bɔne ne amumuyɛɛ yɛdi aluolue ne, na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛfa mɔle kabrɛdi bɔ ɔte adwene bɔ nu te ɔne nahorɛlilɛ ne yeɛ yɛli ɔ.
9Krataa bɔ ngyerɛle ɛmɔ ne anu, ngane kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ ne adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ besã. 10Mangyire kyɛ ewiasefoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ adwaman anaa bɛte anyeboroborolɛfoɛ, anaa awuefoɛ, anaa bɛ bɔ bɛso bosoensolɛfoɛ ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ de a, né odi kyɛ ɛmɔtu befi wiase wa. 11Na afei bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ole kyɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ebiala bɔ ɔfrɛ ye nwo aliɛmaa bɔ ɔbɔ adwaman, anaa ɔte anyeboroborolɛ, anaa ɔte bosoensolɛniɛ, anaa ɔte tuture, anaa akɔnomnzaniɛ anaa awueniɛ besã, nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye to asaa bedidi po. 12Aso ɔte m’adwuma kyɛ mebua bɛ bɔ bɛnne yɛ fekue ye anu koso ndɛen ɔ? Aso nna bɛ bɔ bɛboka ɛmɔ so yeɛ ɛmɔbua bɛ ndɛen ɔ? 13 Na Nyameɛ yeɛ okobua bɛ bɔ bɛnne ɛmɔ fekue ne anu ndɛen ɔ. Yiti ɛmɔfoa amumuyɛɛniɛ ne béfi ɛmɔ nu.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 6
Content:
Akristofoɛ ne manzoen hwenɛ
1Ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nu bie ne oliɛma nya edwirɛ a, ɔkora fa kɔ ewiasefoɛ badwa nyunu na ɔmva ngɔ anwoteefoɛ mɔ nyunu ɔ? 2Ɛmɔnze kyɛ anwoteefoɛ yeɛ bɛbaabua wiase ndɛen hɔ ɔ? Na sɛ ɛmɔbaabua wiase ndɛen a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔngora benziesie edwirɛ mmaa mmaa hemɔ ɔ? 3Aso ɛmɔnze kyɛ yɛkobua abɔfo mɔ po ndɛen ɔ? Nzaade, nzu ati yeɛ yɛngora nziesie ɛwa asetena nu dwirɛ ɔ? 4Na sɛ asetena nu wɔndwiwɔndwi ba a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛkɔ mmenia bɔ asɔre ne mmu bɛ ɔ, bɛ gya so ɔ? 5Meka ɛhe ma ɛmɔfɛre. Aso nworɛniɛ komapɛ po nne ɛmɔ nu bɔ ɔkɔhora kosiesie aliɛmaa ne aliɛmaa b’afia dwirɛ ɔ, 6bɔ yeɛ aliɛmaa fa aliɛmaa kɔ bɛ bɔ benne nni gya so maa bebua bɛ ndɛen ɔ?
7Manzoen bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɛ nwo twe ne kyire kyɛ ɛmɔali ngoguo. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔmma bɛnyɔ ɛmɔ tɛɛ mmom ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔmma benzisi ɛmɔ mmom ɔ? 8Na mmom ɛmɔpɛ bɛ nwo bedi aminɛ na bɛyɛ asisie, na ɛmɔfa bedi ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ po.
9Ɛmɔnze kyɛ bɔnefoɛ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu hɔ ɔ? Nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka bɛ nwo: adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, bosoensolɛfoɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ, mmrasua bɔ bɛ ne mmrasua da, mmienzua bɔ bɛ ne mmienzua da, 10awuefoɛ, anyeboroborolɛfoɛ, akɔnomnzafoɛ, nzekurebɔlɛfoɛ ne apoobɔlɛfoɛ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu. 11Na sɔ yeɛ né ɛmɔ nu biemɔ bɛte ɔ, nakoso ɔnate Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa ne yɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ati, Nyameɛ abia ɛmɔ, wate ɛmɔ nwo, na wabua ɛmɔ be.
Fa wɔ nipadua hyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam
12 “Nne nikyee biala nwo ate.” Nakoso nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ. “Nne nikyee biala nwo ate.” Nakoso mengɔmaa nikyee fee ngɔfa me ngɔyɛ akoaa. 13“Bɛbɔle aleɛ bɛmane koɛ, yeɛ koɛ wora bɛbɔle ye bɛmane aleɛ.” Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔsɛkye bɛ munyɔ. Nipadua nne berɛ ma adwamanbɔlɛ, na mmom ɔwɔ berɛ ma Awurade, yeɛ Awurade koso wɔ berɛ ma nipadua. 14Na Nyameɛ tingyele Awurade, na ɔnate ye tumi ne aso okotingye yɛ koso.
15Ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua ne te Kristo akwaa anaa? Aso mva Kristo akwaa ne nyɛ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ akwaa anaa? Nyameɛ pa gua! 16 Gyamea ɛmɔnze kyɛ sona bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ne, né ɔne ye bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko hɔ ɔ? Ofikyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa, “Bɛ munyɔ bɛkɔyɛ anwoɔnaen ko.” 17Na sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo bata Awurade ne, ɔne ye bɛyɛ ko sunzum nu.
18Ɛmɔyakyi adwamanbɔlɛ! Bɔne biala bɔ sona yɔ ne nga ye nipadua, nakoso sona bɔ ɔbɔ adwaman ne yɔ bɔne tia ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua. 19 Anaa ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua ne te Sunzum Krongron bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ɛmɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu n’asɔneyɛɛ sua ɔ, na ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔlle bɛ nwo ɔ? 20Bɛtɔle ɛmɔ nyɔboɛ serɛ. Yiti ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nipadua bɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 7
Content:
Agyaa nwo dwirɛ
1Afei, ɔfa nningyein bɔ ɛmɔhyerɛle bɛbrɛle me nemɔ nwo de, ahaa ɔte paa kyɛ bienzua mva ye nwo nga brasua ɔ. 2Nakoso adwamanbɔlɛ nwo nzɔhwɛ ti, ɔsɛ kyɛ bienzua biala nya ye bɔbɔ ɔye, na brasua biala nya ye bɔbɔ ohu. 3Ɔsɛ kyɛ huɛ ne yɔ bɔ ɔfata ɔ ma ɔye, na yeɛ ne koso yɔ sɔ ala ma ohu. 4Ɔnate kyɛ yeɛ ne de, olle ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua so tumi, nakoso ohu le so tumi. Sɔ ala yeɛ huɛ ne koso olle ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua so tumi ɔ, nakoso ɔye le so tumi. 5 Nnɛma ɛmɔtua ɛmɔ nwo nnaa, sana ɛmɔ munyɔ ɛmɔapene so kyɛ ɛmɔtu mmerɛ kãa bie besie berɛ ma mbaeɛbɔlɛ; na ɛhe asi ye, ɛmɔasa bayia nu bieku, ná abɔnzam amva ɛmɔ anwohyɛsoɛ nu mmerɛyɛlɛ so wanzo ɛmɔ wannea. 6Bɔ mekã ye, ɔtte kyɛ mmeraa yeɛ mehyɛ mema ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom ɔte atee yeɛ mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ. 7Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa mmenia amukoraa bɛte kyɛ me, nakoso ebiala le ye ti anwo adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye ɔ; asora ebiala deɛ.
8Afei mekã mekyire asigyafoɛ ne akunafoɛ kyɛ, ahaa ɔte paa kyɛ bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔtena anwokwa nu kyɛbɔ nde ye. 9Nakoso sɛ bɛngɔhora bɛngɔhyɛ bɛ nwo so de a, maa begya bie. Ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ ekogya bie tra kyɛ wɔ nwo kɔhyere wɔ ɔ.
Agyaayiralɛ nwo dwirɛ
10 Na bɛ bɔ bagya bie ne de, bɔ mekã ye, nna me mmeraa ɔ, na mmom Awurade deɛ ɔ. Nnɛma brasua yira ohu. 11Nakoso sɛ braa ne yira a, ye ngome ɔtena anwokwa, anaakyɛ ɔne ohu besiesie b’afia na besa bɛbɔ nu. Huɛ koso, nnɛmaa oyira ɔye.
12Na ɛmɔ ngaa ne de, me yeɛ mekã ɔ, na nna Awurade ɔ: sɛ gyidiniɛ bienzua agya wiaseniɛ ná sɛ braa ne pene so kyɛ ɔne ye kɔtena a, nnɛma biaa ne yira ye. 13Yeɛ sɛ gyidiniɛ brasua agya wiaseniɛ ná sɛ biaa ne pene so kyɛ ɔne ye kɔtena a, nnɛma braa ne yira ye. 14Ofikyɛ wiaseniɛ huɛ ne, ɔnate ɔye so yeɛ ye nwo te ɔ; sɔ ala koso yeɛ wiaseniɛ yeɛ ne, ɔnate ohu so yeɛ ye nwo te ɔ. Na sɛ wamma ye sɔ de a, ahaa ɛmɔ mma mɔ nwo kogua fiɛ, nakoso kyɛbɔ ɔte ye de, bɛ nwo te wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 15Nakoso sɛ wiaseniɛ ne kuro kyɛ oyira a, atee wɔ berɛ. Na sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, mmeraa ngyekye gyidiniɛ bienzua anaa brasua ne, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ afrɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛtena asomdwee nu. 16 Gyidiniɛ braa, sɛ ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ bekole ehu ngoa a, aso ɛse? Wɔ gyidiniɛ biaa koso, sɛ ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ bekole ɛye ngoa a, aso ɛse?
Ma tebea bɔ ɛwɔ nu sɔ wɔ nye
17 Kyɛbɔ né ebiala si te bɔ Nyameɛ frɛle ye ne, ma sɔ sona ne ɔhɔ so bɔ ye bra kyɛbɔ Awurade ahyire ye ɔ. Nhyehyɛleɛ he yeɛ mayɔ mama asɔre biala ɔ. 18 Sɛ né ebie apɛ ye bienzua koraka yeɛ Nyameɛ frɛle ye a, nnɛmaa ɔha ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔkakyi ye ɔ. Yeɛ sɛ né ebie ɔppɛle ye bienzua koraka yeɛ Nyameɛ frɛle ye a, nnɛmaa ɔha ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔpɛ ɔ. 19Ofikyɛ bapɛ wɔ bienzua oo, bɛppɛle wɔ bienzua oo, onhia; na mmom Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ ohia ɔ. 20Ebiala hɔ so tena tebea bɔ né ɔwɔ nu koraka yeɛ Nyameɛ baafrɛ ye ne anu. 21Bɛfrɛle wɔ ne, sɛ né ɛte akoaa a, nnɛmaa ɔha wɔ. Nakoso sɛ ɛkɔhora konya wɔ fawɔnwodi de a, pere kyɛ ekonya ye ɔ. 22Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ né ɔte akoaa koraka yeɛ Awurade frɛle ye ne, wayɛ Awurade dehyeɛ. Sɔ ala yeɛ ebiala bɔ né ɔte dehyeɛ koraka yeɛ bɛfrɛle ye ne, wayɛ Kristo akoaa ɔ. 23Bɛtɔle ɛmɔ nyɔboɛ serɛ, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kuro sona ngoaa. 24Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, tebea biala bɔ bɛfrɛle ebiala nu ne, nu ala yeɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛtena ɔ.
Agyaa nwo foɛtulɛ
25Afei, ɔfa mmabunu nwo ne de, nnyane ahyɛdeɛ biala mmvili Awurade berɛ, nakoso mekyire m’adwene kyɛ ebie bɔ Awurade anwu ye anwumvoin ti ɔ́kã nahorɛ ɔ. 26Sɛ menea kekesaala ye anwokyere ye a, mesusu kyɛ ahaa ɔte paa ma sona biala kyɛ ɔkɔtena tebea bɔ ɔwɔ nu ye ala nu. 27Sɛ egya braa a, nnɛyɛ w’adwene kyɛ ekoyira ye. Sɛ eggya bie koso a, nnɛyɛ w’adwene kyɛ ekogya bie ɔ. 28Nakoso sɛ egya braa de a, ɛyyɔle bɔne, yeɛ sɛ ababunu koso gya biaa a, ɔyyɔle bɔne. Asetena nu dwirɛ fa asodie bɔ nu yɛ no ɔ to awarefoɛ so, na ɛhe yeɛ ahaa mekuro kyɛ ɔpa ɛmɔ ti ɔ.
29 Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekyire kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ waha ne te tika, yiti ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛ bɔ begya braa ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ beggya bie ɔ; 30bɛ bɔ besũ ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ benzũ ɔ; bɛ bɔ bɛ nye agye ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ bɛ nye ɔggyele ɔ; bɛ bɔ bɛtɔ nningyein ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ belle huu ɔ; 31na bɛ bɔ bedi wiase nningyein si ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo nhia ɔ. Ofikyɛ, ewiase bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne ɔpɛ nu kɔ.
32 Menguro kyɛ dadwene biala kɔha ɛmɔ ɔ. Bienzua sigyaniɛ dwene Awurade adwuma nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ. 33Nakoso bienzua bɔ ogya braa de, ɔdwenedwene wiase nningyein nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ ɔye nye ɔ, na ɔma ye adwene yɛ ndaa ndaa. 34Brasua sigyaniɛ anaa ababunu dwenedwene Awurade adwuma nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ krongron wɔ nipadua ne sunzum nu ɔ; nakoso brasua bɔ ogya biaa de, ɔdwenedwene wiase nningyein nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ kɔsɔ ohu nye ɔ. 35Ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa mekã he ɔ, mengã menhyɛ ɛmɔ so; na mmom mepena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, na ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amukoraa bɛso Awurade.
36Sɛ ebie bɔ asiwa ná asiwa ne so agyaa, ná sɛ biaa ne ngora nhyɛ ye nwo so wɔ ye asiwa ne anwo a, maa begya bɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ biaa ne pena ne ala. Ɔtte bɔne. 37Nakoso sɛ bienzua bie si ye adwene pi, bɔ ebie nhyɛ ye, na ɔkora hyɛ ye nwo so kyɛ onnya oggyale ye asiwa ne a, né wabɔ mmɔden. 38Yiti bɔ ogya ye asiwa ne, wabɔ mmɔden, nakoso bɔ wangya braa ne wabɔ mmɔden watra so.
39Sɛ brasua ahu te ase a, ɔngora nne ohu ndete nu; nakoso sɛ ohu ne wu de a, né ɔne ye batete nu, na ɔkora gya bienzua biala bɔ okuro ɔ, wɔ Awurade nu ngome. 40 Sɛ ɔtena berɛ anwokwa na wangya biaa ko a, ɔte paa ma ye. Ɛhe te me bɔbɔ me nzusuleɛ, na mede medi kyɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum boka me so.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 8
Content:
Bosoen so afɔleɛ nwo dwirɛ
1Afei, ɔfa bosoen so aleɛ nwo dwirɛ de, yɛse kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛle nimdeɛ. Nimdeɛ ma sona moma ye nwo so, nakoso ɔdɔ de ɔma ngɔsoɛ. 2Na sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ ole nimdeɛ a, né onnya nnyane nimdeɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ onya ɔ. 3Na sona bɔ okuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ nen, ye yeɛ Nyameɛ se ye ɔ.
4 Na ɔfa bosoen so aleɛlilɛ nwo de, yɛse kyɛ bosoen de, ɔtte huu wɔ wiase wa, na Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe. 5Ye po sɛ nikyee biemɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ nyameɛ wɔ berɛ a, sɛ bɛwɔ nyameɛso oo, anaa aseɛ so oo, kyɛbɔ nyameɛ pee ne meneɛ pee wɔ berɛ ne, 6 yɛ de, yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ komapɛ twe yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ. Ye ole Baba ne bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa ná yɛ koso yɛte ase yɛma ye ne; yeɛ Awurade komapɛ twe yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, ye ole Yesu Kristo, bɔ ɔnate ye so bɛbɔle nningyein mukoraa ne, na yɛ koso ɔnate ye so yeɛ yɛte ase ɔ.
7Nakoso nna mmenia mukoraa yeɛ bele nimdeɛ he ɔ. Mmenia biemɔ adwene ahɔ bosoensolɛ nu kyengyekyengye bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po, sɛ bedi sɔ aleɛ ne bie a, b’adwene yɛ bɛ kyɛ amba bedi bosoen so aleɛ, na ɔma bɛ tiboa bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne gua bɛ nwo fiɛ. 8Aleɛ ngora mma yɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye. Sɛ yanni a, yɛnhwere hwee, yeɛ sɛ yɛdi koso a, yɛnnya ngɔsoɛ biala.
9 Nakoso ɛ́mɔnea yé ná sɔ fawɔnwodi bɔ ɛmɔle ye wɔ ɛhe nwo ne, wanyɛ sundidua wamma bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ne. 10Na sɛ sona bie bɔ ye tiboa yɛ mmerɛ nwu wɔ bɔ ele nimdeɛ ne kyɛ edidi bosoen asɔneyɛɛ sua nu a, aso ɛhe ngɔwɔ ye kɔme asi ma ongoli bosoen so aleɛ ne bie? 11Na eliɛma bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ, bɔ Kristo wu mane ye ne, aso ɔnate wɔ nimdeɛ ti ɔsɛ kyɛ owu anaa? 12Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ sɔ bɔne ne bɛfa betia bɛ tiboa bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne a, né ɛmɔayɔ batia Kristo. 13 Yiti sɛ aleɛ to aliɛmaa sundidua a, nzaade mengoli sɔ aleɛ ne le, ná mamma wamvi ase.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 9
Content:
Asomvoɛ adwuma nwo dwirɛ
1Me bɔbɔ nnne me nwo hɔ ɔ? Aso nnde somafoɛ anaa? Nnwuni y’Awurade Yesu Kristo hɔ ɔ? Nna me sa noa adwuma wɔ Awurade nu ole ɛmɔ hɔ ɔ? 2Sɛ nnde somafoɛ mma ebiemɔ a, ɛmɔ de, nde somafoɛ ma ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔte me somafoɛyɛlɛ nzɔanoɛ wɔ Awurade nu.
3Sɔa yeɛ meye me noa mekyire bɛ bɔ bɛfeefee me bra nu ne ɔ: 4Aso yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛdidi ná yɛno anaa? 5Aso yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛne aliɛmaa brasua bɔ ɔte yɛ ye tu atee, kyɛbɔ asomafoɛ ngaa nemɔ ne Awurade aliɛma mɔ ne Kefa bɛyɔ ne? 6Anaakyɛ me ne Banaba de, yɛ ngome twe yeɛ onni kyɛ yɛyakyi kyɛ yɛyɔ adwuma yɛnea yɛ nwo ɔ? 7Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔ koɛ ná ye bɔbɔ yeɛ otua ye nwo kerɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔyɔ mmakaammaa boo bɔ onni ye mma ne bie ɔ? Anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔnea nandwie so ná ɔnno bɛ nyɔfonesue ne bie ɔ?
8Aso kuro sona tumi so yeɛ ngyi bɔ mekã he ɔ, anaakyɛ mmeraa ne koso nga sɔ? 9 Na bahyerɛ ye Mose mmeraa ne anu kyɛ, “Sɛ nandwie boro aburoo a, nnɛkyekye ye noa.” Aso nandwie yeɛ ye nwo hia Nyameɛ ɔ? 10Anaakyɛ nna yɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa ɔhane sɔ ɔ? Ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ yɛ ti yeɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, odi kyɛ sona bɔ ofundam aseɛ ne fundam ye anyelasoɛ nu, na bɔ ɔboro aburoo ne koso boro ye anyelasoɛ nu kyɛ okonya nu bie ɔ. 11Yalua sunzum nu mmaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu, na sɛ ɛmɔboka yɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu nningyein nu a, aso né ɛmɔayɔ bɔ ɔtra so anaa? 12Sɛ ebiemɔ le atee bɛkora benya nningyein befi ɛmɔ berɛ a, né yɛ de yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛnya bɔ ɔtra sɔ anaa? Nakoso yɛ de, yamva sɔ atee ne aso; na mmom yɛmiane yɛ nye yɛpenene nikyee biala so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na yanzi Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo atee ɔ. 13 Aso ɛmɔnze, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ nningyein krongron nemɔ nwo adwuma ne, benya bɛ noa aleɛ befi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ɔ? Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛso wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo ne, benya afɔleɛbɔlɛ nningyein ne bie ɔ? 14 Sɔ ala yeɛ Awurade ahyehyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkã nzɛmba ne, bekodidi nzɛmba ne nwo ɔ.
15Nakoso mmmisale ɛmɔ asɛdeɛ he nwo hwee; yeɛ mengyerɛ krataa he memmrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ asɛdeɛ ne bɛma me. Ofikyɛ, kyɛ ebie kɔma me nwo hoahoalɛ kɔyɛ mbaen de, nzaade maa nwu. 16Na sɛ mekã nzɛmba ne a, né ongyire kyɛ mva nhoahoa me nwo, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte adwuma bɔ odi kyɛ meyɔ ɔ. Na sɛ mangã nzɛmba ne a, me yaakɔ! 17Sɛ me bɔbɔ me pɛ yeɛ mefa mekã nzɛmba ne a, ye po mefata akatuaa, nakoso sɛ nna me bɔbɔ me pɛ yeɛ mefa mekã hɔ a, nzaade bɔ bafa bawura me sa ne ala yeɛ meyɔ ne. 18Yiti akatuaa beni yeɛ menya ɔ? M’akatuaa ole kyɛ ngɔhã Kristo nzɛmba ne bɔ memmisa ebie dɔ hwee ɔ, ná afei asɛdeɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma me wɔ nzɛmba ne anwo koso memmisa ɔ.
19Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebiala nni me so de, nakoso mayɛ me nwo akoaa mama mmenia mukoraa, amaa ɔnate so me sa ahã mmenia pee. 20Nyɛle me nwo Yudaniɛ mane Yudafoɛ amaa me sa ahã Yudafoɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nnwura mmeraa bo de, nakoso nyɛle me nwo kyɛ nwura mmeraa bo mane bɛ bɔ bewura mmeraa bo ne, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bewura mmeraa bo ne. 21Nyɛle me nwo kyɛ nne mmeraa bo mane bɛ bɔ bɛnne mmeraa bo ne. Nna kyɛ ebiaa menni Nyameɛ mmeraa so hɔ ɔ, na mmom nwura Kristo mmeraa bo, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bɛnne mmeraa bo ne. 22Nyɛle me nwo kyɛ meyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu mane bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne. Mayɛ mmenia mukoraa bɛ sona, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná atee biala aso, mama bɛ nu biemɔ banya daa ngoa ɔ. 23Nzɛmba ne ati yeɛ meyɔ ɛhe amukoraa ɔ, amaa me koso manya nu saleɛ ne bie.
24Ɛmɔnze kyɛ amirikatulɛfoɛ betu amirika a, ebiala pere kyɛ okoli ngonim ɔ, nakoso bɛ nu ko yeɛ onya ngonim abasobɔdeɛ ne ɔ? Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtu amirika ne kyɛ ɛmɔkonya abasobɔdeɛ ne ɔ. 25 Ebiala bɔ otu amirika pere ngonim ne, ɔhyɛ ye nwo so wɔ nikyee biala nu. Bɛyɔ sɔ ná banya abotire abasobɔdeɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye ɔ, nakoso yɛ de, yɛnya abotire abasobɔdeɛ bɔ ɔnzɛkye ɔ. 26Yiti me de, mendu amirika asunzumabo, yeɛ mendo me twɔleɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔto ye deɛ gua mvrama nu ɔ. 27Na mmom mehyɛ me nipadua ne anyeborolɛ maa odi yealɛ, ama nzɛmba bɔ mekã mekyire amanvoɛ ye, me bɔbɔ mambɛ me nwo manhwere nu saleɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 10
Content:
Bosoensolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye fa yɛ nana mɔ nwo kyɛbɔ munungum ne munduni bɛ mukoraa bɛ so, ná bɛ mukoraa bɛfale ɛpo ne anu ne. 2Bɛbɔle bɛ mukoraa asu wɔ Mose nu, wɔ munungum ne ɛpo ne anu. 3 Bɛ mukoraa belili sunzum nu aleɛ komapɛ ne ala, 4 na bɛ mukoraa bɛnone sunzum nu anonneɛ komapɛ ne ala.
