Ofikyɛ, sunzum nu Nyɔbotaen bɔ né oli bɛ si ne, nu nzue yeɛ bɛnone ɔ, na sɔ Nyɔbotaen ne ole Kristo. 5 Nakoso, Nyameɛ nye angye bɛ nu pee bɛ nwo, yiti bewuwuli wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.
6 Na ɛhemɔ te kɔkɔbɔlɛ ma yɛ, amaa yanni bɔne si kyɛbɔ belili ne. 7 Nnɛma ɛmɔso bosoen kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia ne tenane ase bedidili bɛnone ná bedwɔso begole.” 8 Nnɛmɔma yɛbɔ adwaman kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle na mmenia apee aburanyɔ ne nza totɔle ɛlɛhomapɛ ne. 9 Nnɛmɔma yɛso Kristo yɛnea kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ná ewoo kekale bɛ maa bewuwuli ne. 10 Yeɛ nnɛmɔma yɛpenepene yɛ komvi kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ná ewue abɔfo oohuhuni bɛ ne. 11Ɛhe amukoraa tole bɛ maa ɔyɛle kɔkɔbɔlɛ, na bɛhyerɛ bɛtole berɛ bɛfa betuli yɛ foɛ, yɛ bɔ wiase ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne wato yɛ ne. 12Yiti ma ebiala bɔ ɔdwene kyɛ ogyi berɛ ne ɔ́nea yé ná wamvi ase. 13Nzɔhwɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ wato ɛmɔ bɔ sona nnwuni bie le ɔ. Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ di nahorɛ ne ati, ɔngɔma ate ngɔma nzɔhwɛ bɔ ɔbo ɛmɔ anwoserɛ so ngɔto ɛmɔ. Na mmom, okohyire ɛmɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa so bekɔnwati bekofi nzɔhwɛ ne anu ɔ, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina ye noa.
14Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bosoensolɛ nwo. 15Medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛse nworɛ ɔ, yiti ɛmɔdwene bɔ mekã ye nwo. 16 Yɛda Awurade Adidie kulie bɔ bayira so ne nwo ase a, aso ongyire kyɛ yɛne Kristo mogya ne afa abiɛngoɛ anaa? Paanoo bɔ yɛbubu ne, aso ongyire kyɛ yɛne Kristo nipadua ne afa abiɛngoɛ anaa? 17Paanoo ne te komapɛ, na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛsone de, nakoso yɛte nipadua komapɛ, ofikyɛ paanoo komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛdi ɔ.
18 Ɛmɔnea Yisraelfoɛ! Aso bɛ bɔ bedi afɔlebɔdeɛ nen, bɛ ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne bennyane abiɛngoɛfalɛ anaa? 19Afei sɛɛ koraa yeɛ mekyire ɔ? Bosoen te nzu koraa, anaakyɛ bosoen so aleɛ te nzu koraa? 20 Mekyire kyɛ aleɛ bɔ bosoensolɛfoɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, bɛfa bɛma sunzummɔne mɔ, na bɛmva bɛmma Nyameɛ; yiti menguro kyɛ ɛmɔ ne sunzummɔne mɔ kɔbɔ afɛ ɔ. 21Ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔno Awurade kulie noa, ná ɛmɔano sunzummɔne mɔ koso bɛ kulie noa. Ɛmɔngɔhora bengodidi Awurade poen so, ná ɛmɔasa badidi sunzummɔne mɔ bɛ poen so. 22 Anaa yɛpena kyɛ yɛwura Awurade apue maa ɔtwe nungunɛ hɔ ɔ? Yɛbu ye kyɛ yɛ nwo yɛ se tra ye anaa?
Yɔ nningyein mukoraa hyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam
23 Bɛtaa bɛkã kyɛ, “Yɛle nikyee biala nwo ate”, nakoso nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ; yeɛ nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ. 24Ɔnzɛ kyɛ sona biala dwene ye ngome ye deɛ nwo, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma obiɛngo koso deɛ nwo hia ye.
25Ɛmɔli naen biala bɔ bɛtɔne ye dwaanu, na ɔnate sona tiboa ti nnɛma ɛmɔbisabisa ye nwo dwirɛ biala. 26 Ofikyɛ “Aseɛ ne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa te Awurade deɛ.” 27Sɛ ebie bɔ ɔtte gyidiniɛ frɛ ɛmɔ adidie, ná ɛmɔpene so kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhɔ a, bɔ ɔkɔfa kosie ɛmɔ nyunu biala, ɛmɔli. Sona tiboa ti nnɛma ɛmɔbisa ye nwo dwirɛ biala. 28Nakoso sɛ ebie kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Aleɛ he te bosoen so aleɛ” de a, ye de bɔ ɔbɔle ɛmɔ amaneɛ ne ti, ɔne kuro sona tiboa ti nnɛma ɛmɔdi. 29Mengyire ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ tiboa, na mmom mekyire sona bɔ ɔha hyirele ɛmɔ ne tiboa. Nzu ati yeɛ ebie tiboa bua bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ nwo ndɛen ɔ? 30Nakoso sɛ mefa asennaa medi a, nzu ati yeɛ ebie kã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ fa bɔ mala ye nwo ase nwo ɔ?
31Yiti sɛ ɛmɔdidi oo, sɛ ɛmɔno oo, nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔyɛ ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ ye mukoraa bɛfa bɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam. 32Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔkɔha Yudafoɛ anaa Helafoɛ anaa Nyameɛ asɔre ne; 33kyɛbɔ mebɔ mmɔden kyɛ ngɔsɔ mmenia mukoraa nye wɔ nikyee biala nu ne. Membena me ngome me yeeyɛlɛ, na mmom mmeni soma yeeyɛlɛ, kyɛbɔ bekonya daa ngoa ɔ.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 11
Content:
1 Ɛ́mɔsuasua me, kyɛbɔ me koso mesuasua Kristo ne.
Bɛ ti so katalɛ wɔ asɔre sua nu
2Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekamvo ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkaye me wɔ nikyee biala nu, na ɛmɔdi ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ ne aso. 3Na mepena kyɛ ɛmɔte ye bo kyɛ Kristo te bienzua biala mene, brasua koso ohu te ye mene, na Nyameɛ koso te Kristo mene. 4Bienzua biala bɔ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ anaa ɔhyɛ ngɔm ná ɔkata ye ti so ne, onni ye mene ni. 5Nakoso brasua biala bɔ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ anaakyɛ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ná wangata ye ti so ne, onni ye mene ni; na ɔte kyɛ wabɔ tikwa ne ala. 6Na sɛ brasua angata ye ti so de a, ye de maa ɔtete ye ti; nakoso sɛ ɔte animguaseɛ ma brasua kyɛ ɔkɔtete ye ti, anaakyɛ ɔkɔbɔ tikwa a, ye de maa ɔkata so. 7 Bienzua de, onhia kyɛ ɔkata ye ti so ɔ, ɔnate ɔte Nyameɛ animnyam ne ye sue; nakoso brasua de, ɔye bienzua animnyam kyire. 8 Ofikyɛ bammɔ bienzua bamvi brasua nu, na mmom brasua yeɛ bɛbɔle ye befili bienzua nu ɔ. 9Afei koso, nna brasua ti yeɛ bɛbɔle bienzua ɔ, na mmom bienzua ti yeɛ bɛbɔle brasua ɔ. 10Ye sɔ ti, odi kyɛ brasua nya ngatasoɛ wɔ ye ti so, ɔnate abɔfo mɔ ti. 11Nakoso Awurade nyunu de, bienzua ngɔ nyakyi brasua, yeɛ brasua koso ngɔ nyakyi bienzua; 12ɔnate kyɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛbɔle brasua befili bienzua nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ brasua koso wo bienzua ɔ, na nningyein mukoraa fi Nyameɛ nu.
13Sɛ ɔte paa kyɛ brasua bɔ mbaeɛ kyire Nyameɛ bɔ wangata ye ti so a, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bébua. 14Aso abɔdeɛ po ngyire ɛmɔ kyɛ sɛ bienzua ti fu gua ye nwo a ɔte animguaseɛ ma ye ɔ? 15Nakoso sɛ brasua de, ye ti fu gua ye nwo a ɔte ye animnyam. Ofikyɛ bɛfale nwiaa bɛmane ye kyɛ ɔfa kata ye ti so. 16Na sɛ ebie su ɛhe nwo aporowaa a, yɛ de yɛnne nhyehyɛleɛ foforɛ biala yɛndo nu, yeɛ Nyameɛ asɔre nemɔ koso benne bɛndo nu.
Awurade Adidie
(Mateo 26.26-29; Marko 14.22-25; Luka 22.14-20)
17Na ɛhe bɔ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ye, mengamvo ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔyia nu a, ɛmɔnyɔ nikye paa, na mmom bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ. 18Bɔ oli moa ɔ, sɛ ɛmɔyia nu kyɛ asɔre a, mete kyɛ mbakyembakyemuɛ ba ɛmɔ nu, na mede medi kyɛ bɛ nu bie te nahorɛ. 19Yoo, ye nwo kohia kyɛ fekue fekue kɔwa ɛmɔ nu ɔ, na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔ nu mmenia bɔ bɛnate nahorɛ atee so ne, bɛ nwo kɔla nzorɛ. 20Sɛ ɛmɔbayia nu neka horɛ a, nna Awurade adidie yeɛ ɛmɔbadi ɔ, 21ɔnate kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔdidi a, ebiala di ye aleɛ deɛ koraka; na ɛhɔen ku ebie ne, né ebie koso nzaa abo ye. 22Nzu ɔ! Ɛmɔlle awuro mɔ bɔ ɛmɔdidi nu ná ɛmɔno wɔ nu hɔ ɔ? Anaakyɛ Nyameɛ asɔre ne yeɛ ɛmɔbu ye animtia ná ɛmɔsa begua ehiafoɛ nyunu ase ɔ? Nzikyɛ koraa yeɛ nga ngyire ɛmɔ ɔ? Ngamvo ɛmɔ wɔ ɛhe anwo anaa? Daabi! Mengɔkamvo ɛmɔ.
23Ofikyɛ, bɔ nya mvili Awurade berɛ ne yeɛ me koso mva mane ɛmɔ ɔ: kyɛ, kɔngɔen ne bɔ bɛyele Awurade Yesu bɛmane ne, ɔfale paanoo, 24ɔlale ase, na obubuli nu, na ɔhane kyɛ, “[Ɛmɔle beli.] Ɛhe te me nipadua bɔ bébubu bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ɔ; ɛ́mɔyɔ he bɛ́fa bɛ́kaye me.” 25 Sɔ ala yeɛ bedidi beyiele nen, ɔfale kulie ne, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kulie he te apam foforɛ me mogya nu; mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔno ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ he bɛ́fa bɛ́kaye me.” 26 Na mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkoli paanoo he ná ɛmɔkɔno kulie he noa nen, ɛmɔbɔ Awurade wue ne dawure kodwu mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ɔ. 27Yiti sona biala bɔ okoli paanoo he, anaakyɛ ɔkɔno Awurade kulie ne noa wɔ atee bɔ ɔmvata so ne, okoli Awurade nipadua ne ye mogya nwo fɔ. 28Yiti sɛ ebiala ɔbaali paanoo ne bie, ná ɔno kulie ne noa bie a, maa ɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ ye nu ɔnea koraka. 29Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ odi ná ɔno ye wɔ atee bɔ ɔmvata so nen, odi ná ɔno ɔfa ndɛenbualɛ ɔbrɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo; ofikyɛ wammu [Awurade] nipadua ne. 30Ɛhe ati yeɛ ɛmɔ nu pee bayɛ mmerɛ ná bɛ nwo yɛ bɛ yea, na pee koso bawuwu ɔ. 31Na sɛ yɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ yɛ nu nahorɛ nu a, bengobua yɛ ndɛen. 32Nakoso sɛ Awurade bua yɛ ndɛen a, ɔtwe yɛ so, amaa ɔnate so bamva yɛ bamvra wiase so bammua yɛ ndɛen. 33Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔyia nu kyɛ ɛmɔbaadidi a, ɛ́mɔnwondɛnwondɛ bɛ nwo. 34 Sɛ ɛhɔen ku ebie a, maa odidi awuro koraka, ná ɛmɔammanyia nu bandwetwe ndɛenbualɛ bamma bɛ nwo. Edwirɛ bɔ wahã ne de, meba a yeɛ ngɔhã ye nwo bie ɔ.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 12
Content:
Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ nemɔ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔfa sunzum nu akyɛdeɛ nemɔ nwo de, membena kyɛ mefa nikyee biala mesie ɛmɔ. 2Ɛmɔse kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔte wiasefoɛ nen, ɛmɔmaa bɛlakalakale ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔhyinini mmosoen emumu mɔ so. 3 Yiti mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum fa ye so dwudwo ne ngora nga kyɛ, “Musue ha Yesu!” Yeɛ ebiala koso ngora nga kyɛ, “Yesu te Awurade,” sana Sunzum Krongron ne te ye nu.
4 Adom akyɛdeɛ gua ahoroɔ, nakoso Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔfa ma ɔ. 5Ɛsolɛ nnwumaa gua ahoroɔ, nakoso ofi Awurade komapɛ ne ala berɛ. 6Dwumadie koso gua ahoroɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔfa yɛ mukoraa so odi dwumaa ne ɔ. 7Nakoso yɛ mukoraa yɛ ngɔsoɛ ti, Sunzum ne ɔye ye nwo ali wɔ yɛ nu biala nu. 8Sunzum ne ma sona ko kã nworɛ dwirɛ, né Sunzum komapɛ ne ala abukye sona foforɛ adwene nu ama ye nimdeɛ. 9Ye komapɛ ne ala ɔma ebie gyidie, né wasa walo ebie koso wama ye anwonyerɛsalɛ tumi. 10Sunzum ne ma sona ko anwanwadeɛyɔlɛ tumi, né wama sona foforɛ koso ngɔmhyɛlɛ tumi. Ɔma ebie anyeɛ bɔ ɔfa nwu sunzum ahoroɔ nu nzonzoleɛ ɔ; ɔma ebie edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ tumi, né wama ebie koso tumi bɔ ɔfa kyire edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ bo ɔ. 11Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ, na ɔma ebiala akyɛdeɛ kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ okuro ɔ.
Nipadua akwaa gua ahoroɔ
12 Kyɛbɔ nipadua ne te ko, nakoso ole akwaa ahoroɔ; ná ɔwɔ nu kyɛ akwaa nemɔ sone de, nakoso bɛbɔ nu bɛyɛ nipadua ko ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Kristo te ɔ. 13 Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa: Yudafoɛ oo, Helafoɛ oo, ngoaa oo, nnehyeɛ oo, Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ bɛfa bɛbɔle yɛ asu maa yɛɛyɛle nipadua ko ɔ, na Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ wahwie wagua yɛ mukoraa yɛ so ɔ.
14Nipadua n’akwaa ɔtte ko, na mmom bɛsone. 15Sɛ agyirɛ kã kyɛ, “Me de, nnde asaa, yiti mmmoka nipadua ne aso” a, ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɔbboka nipadua ne aso. 16Na sɛ asoɛ kã kyɛ, “Me de, nnde anyeɛ, yiti mmmoka nipadua ne aso” a, ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɔbboka nipadua ne aso. 17Na sɛ nipadua ne amu te anyeɛ a, ahaa ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wate dwirɛ? Yeɛ sɛ nipadua ne amu te asoɛ a, ahaa ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wafofã nikye? 18Na nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ kuro biala yeɛ ɔfale nipadua akwaa biala tuale ɔ. 19Na sɛ ye mukoraa te akwaa komapɛ a, ahaa nipadua ne wɔ ni? 20Ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ nipadua n’akwaa sone de, nakoso nipadua ne te komapɛ. 21Yiti anyeɛ ngora nga ngyire asaa kyɛ, “Wɔ nwo nhia me.” Yeɛ tire wora ɔngora nga ngyire agyirɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ nwo nhia me.” 22Na mmom nipadua n’akwaa bɔ yɛ de yɛdwene kyɛ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ne, sɛ bɛnne nu a, yɛyɔ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee. 23Yeɛ nipadua n’akwaa bɔ yɛsusu kyɛ bɛmvata anidie somaa nen, bɛ po yeɛ yɛma bɛ anidie pee ɔ, na yɛsiesie nipadua n’akwaa bɔ bɛwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne yé. 24Ofikyɛ y’akwaa bɔ bɛnne mvealeɛ nu ne nhia sɔ nziesie ne. Nakoso kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ wasi wahyehyɛ nipadua nen, akwaa bɔ yɛmmu ye ne po yeɛ wama ye anidie pee ɔ, 25amaa mbakyembakyemuɛ amma nipadua ne anu, na mmom akwaa biala nwo ahia ama obiɛngo. 26Sɛ akwaa ko nwo kã a, ɔkã bɛ mukoraa. Yeɛ sɛ bɛhyɛ akwaa ko animnyam a, ɔyɛ ye ne akwaa ngaa ne amu fɛ.
27Ɛmɔte Kristo nipadua ne, na ɛmɔ nu ko biala te ye akwaa ne bie. 28 Na Nyameɛ atu ebiemɔ asie berɛ wɔ asɔre ne anu. Bɔ oli moa ɔ: kyɛ asomafoɛ, bɔ ɔtoa berɛ ɔ, kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, bɔ ɔtɔ nza, kyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ; yeɛ afei bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ, bɛ bɔ bele anwonyerɛsalɛ akyɛdeɛ, bokafoɛ, asɔre mbanyi, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ. 29Aso bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte asomafoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ ɔ? 30Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bele anwonyerɛsalɛ akyɛdeɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bekyire edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ bo ɔ? 31Ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nye besie akyɛdeɛ bɔ bɛ nwo hia paa nemɔ aso. Afei ɛ́mɔma ngyire ɛmɔ atee paa paa ne.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 13
Content:
Ɔdɔ nwo dwirɛ
1Sɛ mekã mmenia ne abɔfo mɔ dwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ná nnne ɔdɔ a, né nde kyɛ ayaa bɔ ɔgyegye mbaen anaakyɛ akasaa bɔ ɔwoso mbaen ɔ. 2 Sɛ nne ngɔmhyɛlɛ akyɛdeɛ, ná mete mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ amukoraa ne nimdeɛ mukoraa bo, ná nne gyidie mukoraa bɔ ɔmaa mekora metutu mmokaa bo, nakoso nnne ɔdɔ a, né nnde huu. 3Sɛ mefa me nwo nningyein mukoraa mekyɛ, na mefa me nipadua mema kyɛ bɛyera ye, na nnne ɔdɔ a, mennya mvasoɛ biala so.
4Ɔdɔ le aboterɛ, na ye ti anu yɛ mmerɛ; ɔdɔ de, ɔtte ahoɔyea, ongyire ye nwo, na ɔmmoma ye nwo so. 5Ɔdɔ mma ye nye ndra ye ndo nwiaa, ɔtte pɛsɛmangomenya, ɔmvɛ yaa mbaen mbaen, yeɛ ɔmva bɔne nzie ye ti anu. 6Ɔdɔ nye ngye bɔne nwo, na mmom ye nye gye nahorɛ nwo. 7Ɔdɔ abasanu mmu, ode nningyein mukoraa di, ole nningyein mukoraa nu anyelasoɛ, na ole nningyein mukoraa nu animia.
8Ɔdɔ bo ngɔpɛ le, nakoso ngɔmhyɛlɛ bo kɔpɛ, edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ, yeɛ nimdeɛ koso kotu komini. 9Ɔnate kyɛ yɛ nimdeɛ ne yɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ nni mu, 10nakoso bɔ odi mu ne ba a, bɔ onni mu ne kotu komini.
11Mmerɛ bɔ né nde akwadaa ne, ndwudwole kyɛ akwadaa, ndwenene kyɛ akwadaa, me ndeaseɛ yɛle kyɛ akwadaa. Nakoso nyɛle panyi ye de, mayakyi ngwadasɛm ne. 12Kekesaala ye de, yɛnwu nikyee wusiwusi wɔ neanu nu. Nakoso kyẽa bie yɛkonwu ye pefee. Kekesaala ye de, bɔ mese ne onni mu, nakoso kyẽa bie okoli mu kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ koso se me ne. 13Afei nningyein nza yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ: gyidie, anyelasoɛ, yeɛ ɔdɔ, nakoso ɔdɔ di mu tra bɛ mu.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 14
Content:
Ngɔmhyɛlɛ ne edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ
1Ɛ́mɔma ɔdɔ yɛ ɛmɔ botaeɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye boro bɛpena sunzum akyɛdeɛ, ye titire, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ. 2Ɔnate kyɛ sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo ne, ondwudwo ngyire mmenia, na mmom odwudwo kyire Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ ebiala nde ye dwirɛ ne bo; nakoso Sunzum ne nate ye so kã mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ. 3Nakoso sona bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm de, mmenia ngɔsoɛ, foɛtulɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ ti yeɛ ɔyɔ sɔ ɔ. 4Sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nen, ɔyɔ sɔ ma ye bɔbɔ ye ngɔsoɛ; nakoso bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ne de, ɔyɔ sɔ ma asɔre ne ngɔsoɛ.
5Mekuro kyɛ ahaa ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ, nakoso bɔ mekuro paa ole kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ne, ɔyɔ sɔ fa ngɔsoɛ brɛ asɔre ne tra bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ɔ; sana bekyire edwirɛ ne bo koraka né asɔre ne anya ngɔsoɛ. 6Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ ná mekã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ a, mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɛmɔkonya bekofi me nwo ɔ? Sana mefa nyekyire anaa nimdeɛ anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛ anaa ngyerɛkyerɛ so yeɛ medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ.
7Sɔ ala yeɛ nningyein bɔ belle ngoa te kyɛ awɛen anaa sangoo te ɔ. Kyɛbɔ sona bɔ bɛ a besi bɛgyegye ne, sɛ nu anna berɛ yé a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ebie ahora anwu edwein horɛ bɔ sona ne fa bɔ ɔ? 8Na sɛ behu totorobɛndo ná nu anna berɛ yé a, nwa yeɛ okosiesie ye nwo kɔhɔ koɛ ɔ? 9Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso sɛ ɛmɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo a, ebiala ngɔte bɔ ɛmɔkã ne bo ɔ. Ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔdwudwo bekyire mvrama ɔ. 10Nahorɛ nu, dwudwolɛ ahoroɔ pee yeɛ ɔwɔ ewiase ɔ, na bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ olle ndeaseɛ ɔ. 11Yiti sɛ mende dwudwolɛ bie bo a, sona bɔ ɔkã sɔ dwudwolɛ ne bu me pɔtɔniɛ, yeɛ me koso mebu ye pɔtɔniɛ. 12Na ɛmɔ koso, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔpere bɛpena Sunzum n’akyɛdeɛ ne ati, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma bɛ nye boro bɛpena akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔkɔma asɔre ne ngɔsoɛ ɔ.
13Yiti sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo ne, maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyɛ ɔkɔhora kohyire ye bo ɔ. 14Ofikyɛ sɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ wɔ edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nu a, me sunzum yeɛ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ne ɔ, nakoso m’adwene de, ɔnyɔ ye nwo hwee. 15Yiti ngɔyɛ ye sɛ? Ngɔfa sunzum ne ngɔbɔ mbaeɛ, ná mafa m’adwene koso mabɔ mbaeɛ. Ngɔfa sunzum ne ngɔto dwein ná mafa m’adwene koso mato dwein. 16 Na sɛ ɛbɔ asennaa mbaeɛ wɔ sunzum nu a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ebie bɔ ɔnde ye bo ɔ wasuro w’asennaa mbaeɛ ne aso “Amen”, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔnze bɔ ɛkã ɔ? 17Na sɛ w’asennaa mbaeɛ ne te paa sɛɛ ala po a, ɔngora mma sona foforɛ ngɔsoɛ. 18Meda me Nyameɛ ase kyɛ mekã dwudwolɛ ahoroɔ metra ɛmɔ amukoraa ɔ. 19Nakoso asɔre sua nu de, mekuro kyɛ ngɔfa m’adwene ngɔhã edwirɛ nnu bɔ ɔkɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ kɔma ebiemɔ tra kyɛ ngɔhã edwirɛ apee buru edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nu.
20Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔdwene kyɛ ngwadaa, bɔne nu de, ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ nnɔma na mmom adwene nu ɛ́mɔyɛ mbanyi. 21 Bahyerɛ ye mmeraa ne anu kyɛ,
“Ngɔfa mmenia bɔ bɛkã edwudwolɛ foforɛ
ne amanvrafoɛ mɔ dwudwolɛ so yeɛ
ngodwudwo ngohyire mmenia hemɔ ɔ;
nakoso po bengotie me dwirɛ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.”
22Yiti edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ de, ɔtte sɛngyerɛnneɛ mma agyidifoɛ, na mmom ɔte sɛngyerɛnneɛ ma bɛ bɔ benne nni ɔ; yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ wora ɔtte bɛ bɔ benne benni deɛ, na mmom ɔte agyidifoɛ deɛ.
23Na sɛ asɔremma ne amu beyia neka horɛ, na bɛ mukoraa bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ, na sɛ ebiemɔ mbaen anaa bɛ bɔ benne benni ba berɛ a, aso bɛngɔhã kyɛ ɛmɔabobɔ laen? 24Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔhyɛ ngɔm, ná sɛ ebie bɔ onne nni anaa ebie mbaen ba berɛ a, edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔte ne amu kobua ye ndɛen na wapusu ye. 25Ye ti anu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ kɔla ali, ɔkɔfa ye nyunu kobutu berɛ kɔsɔne Nyameɛ, ná wahã kyɛ Nyameɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu amba.
Asɔre nu sɔnenɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ
26Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekyire sɛɛ koraa? Sɛ ɛmɔyia nu a, ebie le edwein to, ebie le ngyerɛkyerɛ kyire, ebie le edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ kã, ebie le nyekyire, ebie le edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ nwo ngyerɛaseɛ. Ɛmɔma ebiala yɔ ye deɛ bɔ ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ. 27Sɛ ebie kã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo a, maa bɛyɛ mmenia nyɔ, anaakyɛ wabo so koraa ne, mmenia nza, na bɛha ye ngoko ngoko, na sona ko hyire ye bo. 28Na sɛ sona biala nne berɛ bɔ okyire ye bo de a, ye de maa omua ye noa wɔ asɔre ne anu, na ɔne ye ngome ne ye Nyameɛ beli ngitahoɛ. 29Na ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne de, ma mmenia nyɔ anaa nza bedwudwo, na bɛ ngaa ne bua edwirɛ ne nwo ndɛen. 30Na sɛ ebie wɔ berɛ ná onya nyekyire a, ye de ma bɔ ogu so odwudwo ne yakyi dwudwolɛ. 31Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔhyɛ ngɔm ngoko ngoko, ná ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔanya nu nikyeesualɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ. 32Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ sunzum mɔ wura ngɔmhyɛfoɛ nemɔ abo. 33Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de, ɔtte basabasayɔlɛ Nyameɛ, na mmom ɔte asomdwee Nyameɛ. Na kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye anwoteefoɛ asɔre mukoraa nu ne, 34 ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ mmrasua mɔ bemua bɛ noa wɔ asɔre mɔ nu. Ofikyɛ belle ye nwo ate kyɛ bedwudwo ɔ, na mmom bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kã ne. 35Sɛ bɛpena edwirɛ bie anu betie a, maa bebisa bɛ hu mɔ wɔ awuro; ofikyɛ ɔte animguaseɛ ma brasua kyɛ okodwudwo asɔre sua nu ɔ. 36Nzu ati ɔ! Ɛmɔ dɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne fi wale hɔ ɔ, anaakyɛ ɛmɔ ngome bɛ dɔ yeɛ wadwu ɔ? 37Sɛ ebie bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaakyɛ ole sunzum nu akyɛdeɛ a, maa ɔte ye bo kyɛ bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye te Awurade ahyɛdeɛ. 38Nakoso sɛ ebie nne ɛhe ndo nu a, (Nyameɛ) koso nne ye ndo nu. 39Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nye boro ngɔmhyɛlɛ nwo, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɛmɔsi edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ hanɛ nwo ate. 40Na ɛ́mɔfa atee paa so bɛ́yɔ nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 15
Content:
Kristo wutingyelɛ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, afei mekaye ɛmɔ nzɛmba bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔle bɛtole nu, ná ɛmɔ (gyidie) gyi so ne. 2Sɛ ɛmɔsɔ bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne anu yé a, ɔnate so ɛmɔkonya daa ngoa; na sɛ wamma ye sɔ de a, né ɛmɔale bali mbaen.
3 Ofikyɛ, edwirɛ bɔ ye nwo hia paa yeɛ nyane ɔ, ná me koso mva mmrɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ, yɛ bɔne ti yeɛ Kristo wuli ɔ, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ne. 4 Besiele ye, na ye ɛlɛsa so odwɔso fili ewue nu, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ne. 5 Ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele Kefa, na nziɛ ye buru ne nyɔ ne koso benwuni ye. 6Ɛhe asi ye, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛbo ɛyaa nnu mmerɛ komapɛ, bɔ bɛ nu pee tɛte ase, ná ebiemɔ koso balela ɔ. 7Ɛhe asi ye, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele Yakobo, na afei asomafoɛ ne amukoraa benwuni ye.
8 Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele me koso bɔ nde kyɛ ebie bɔ wandwu oni aworɛ ná wawo ye ɔ. 9 Ofikyɛ me yeɛ nde asomafoɛ nemɔ nu kãa paa ɔ; memvata kyɛ bɛfrɛ me somafoɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ndanene Nyameɛ asɔre ne nye. 10Nyameɛ adom ti yeɛ nde kyɛ bɔ nde ye, na ye adom bɔ ɔfa lole me ne wanyɛ mbaen. Mayɔ adwuma matra bɛ mukoraa, nakoso nna me mmɔdenbɔlɛ ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɔboka me ne ɔ. 11Yiti sɛ me ahɔ oo, sɛ bɛ ahɔ oo, nzɛmba komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛkã ɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ koso bele belili ɔ.
Ewutingyelɛ nwo dwirɛ
12Na sɛ yɛkã Kristo nwo nzɛmba kyɛ wadwɔso wafi ewue nu a, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kã kyɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ nne berɛ ɔ? 13Na sɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ nne berɛ de a, nzaade né bandingye Kristo. 14Na sɛ bandingye Kristo de a, nzaade yɛ nzɛmbahanɛ ne te mbaen, yeɛ ɛmɔ gyidie koso te mbaen. 15Né nzaade yato Nyameɛ soen, ofikyɛ yali Nyameɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ watingye Kristo, wɔ aberɛ bɔ wandingye ye ɔ, sɛ ɔtte nahorɛ kyɛ ewutingyelɛ wɔ berɛ de a. 16Ofikyɛ sɛ awufoɛ ndwɔso de a, né nzaade bandingye Kristo. 17Na sɛ bandingye Kristo de a, nzaade ɛmɔ gyidie te mbaen, na ɛmɔtɛte ɛmɔ bɔne nu. 18Né nzaade Kristo nu agyidifoɛ koso bɔ balela ne bamini. 19Na sɛ ngoa he ngome nu yeɛ yɛle anyelasoɛ wɔ Kristo nu de a, né nzaade yɛyɛ anwumvo yɛtra mmenia mukoraa.
Ewutingyelɛ nwo anyelasoɛ
20Nakoso ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ batingye Kristo bafi ewue nu amaa wayɛ bɛ bɔ balela ne anu bakaa mmaa bɔ oli moa ɔ. 21Na kyɛbɔ ewue nate sona ko so wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ koso nate sona ko so wawa ɔ. 22Na kyɛbɔ ɔnate Adam ti mmenia mukoraa nya ewue ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Kristo ti bɛ mukoraa bekonya ngoa ɔ. 23Nakoso bekotingye ebiala wɔ ye nnidisoɛ so: Kristo bɔ ɔte bakaa mmaa bɔ oli moa ne, na afei bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo deɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔye ye nwo ali ne, bɛ koso batoa so. 24Afei yeɛ né ayieleɛ ne awa ɔ, bɔ okoli ahennie ne anwoserɛ ne tumi mukoraa so, ná wafa Ahennie ne wawura Baba Nyameɛ sa. 25 Ofikyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi hene maa okodwu kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye pɔfoɛ mukoraa kɔyɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ. 26Pɔfoɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo koraa bɔ okoli ye so ngonim ole ewue. 27 Ofikyɛ wafa nningyein mukoraa wayɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ. Nakoso sɛ ɔkã kyɛ nningyein mukoraa ayɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ a, nu la pefee kyɛ bɔ ɔfale nningyein mukoraa yɛle ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne de, ɔbboka so. 28Na sɛ bɛfa nningyein mukoraa bewura ye bo beyie a, afei yeɛ né Baa ne bɔbɔ koso kɔfa ye nwo kowura bɔ ɔfale nningyein mukoraa wurale ye bo ne bo ɔ, ná afei Nyameɛ ali nningyein mukoraa so hene.
29Nzaade bɛ bɔ begyina awufoɛ gya nu maa bɛbɔ bɛ asu bɛma bɛ ne, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛpena bekyire ɔ? Na sɛ awufoɛ ndingye de a, nzu ati yeɛ mmenia gyina awufoɛ gya nu maa bɛbɔ bɛ asu ɔ? 30Sɛ nna sɔ ahɔ a, ahaa nzu ati yeɛ mmerɛ biala yɛha yɛ nwo yɛfa yɛ ngoa yɛto serewa ɔ? 31Mesi ye pi mekyire ɛmɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nyunu ne ati, ewue li me mvanvando daa biala. 32 Na sɛ anwoɔnaen nu mvasoɛ ti yeɛ me ne ngekaboa yɛhone Ɛfeso de a, né mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ngonya ɔ? Yiti sɛ awufoɛ ngodwɔso de a, nzaade “ɛmɔma yɛdidi na yɛno, ofikyɛ ɛhema né yawu.” 33Nnɛmɔma bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ, na “abiɛngoɛ tɛɛ sɛkye bra paa.” 34Ɛ́mɔfa adwene paa ná ɛ́mɔyakyi bɔne yɔlɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ belle Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ. Mekã he maa ɛmɔ nyunu gua ase.
Nipadua bɔ batingye ye ɔ
35Ebie kobisa kyɛ, “Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né batingye awufoɛ? Na nzikyɛ nipadua yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekodwɔso ɔ?” 36Kwaseaa! Sɛ edua nikyee a, ongofifi, sana owu koraka. 37Yeɛ bɔ ekolua ne koso, nna ye ole bakaa ne mumua bɔ okofifi kɔwa ne, na mmom ɔte kyɛ ayuo anaa aburoo bɔ batutu ɔ komapɛ twe. 38Nakoso Nyameɛ maa onyi yɛ bakaa horɛ kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ kuro ɔ, na edua aburoo a, omvifi ayuo.
39Anwoɔnaen mukoraa nzɛ. Kuro sona nwonaen ngome, ndɔteboa deɛ ngome, nnomaa deɛ ngome, yeɛ nzue nu naen koso deɛ ngome. 40Anwuro abɔdeɛ wɔ berɛ, yeɛ aseɛ so abɔdeɛ koso wɔ berɛ, nakoso asora anwuro abɔdeɛ animnyam, yeɛ asora aseɛ so abɔdeɛ animnyam. 41Eyia animnyam ngome, yeɛ ɛsraen animnyam koso ngome. Nzramaa mɔ koso b’animnyam gua ahoroɔ, ofikyɛ asora nzramaa biala ne ye animnyam.
42 Sɔ ala yeɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ ne koso te ɔ. Bɔ bedua ne porɔ, na bɔ betingye ye ne de, ɔmborɔ. 43Bedua ye animguaseɛ nu, na betingye ye animnyam nu. Bedua a, né ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na betingye ye tumi nu. 44Bedua ye anwoɔnaen nu, na betingye ye a, ɔte sunzum nu nipadua. Anwoɔnaen nu nipadua wɔ berɛ, yeɛ sunzum nu nipadua koso wɔ berɛ. 45 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Adam bɔ oli moa ne ɔɔyɛle ɛkra teasefoɛ;” na Adam bɔ oli nziɛ ne ɔɔyɛle sunzum bɔ ɔma ngoa ɔ. 46Nna bɔ ɔte sunzum ne yeɛ oli moa ɔ, na mmom anwoɔnaen deɛ ne ba koraa né sunzum deɛ ne awa. 47Bele nnɛterɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle sona bɔ oli moa ne ɔ, ofi nnɛterɛ nu. Sona bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ole Awurade bɔ ofi nyameɛso ne. 48Kyɛbɔ (Adam) bɔ ofi nnɛterɛ nu ne te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfale nnɛterɛ bɛbɔle bɛ ne bɛte ɔ; na kyɛbɔ nyameɛsoniɛ ne te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛte nyameɛso deɛ ne bɛte ɔ. 49Na kyɛbɔ yanya bɔ ofi nnɛterɛ nu ne sona sue nen, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛkonya bɔ ofi nyameɛso ne sue ɔ.
50Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ mekyire ole kyɛ, anwoɔnaen ne mogya ngɔhora ngonya Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu kyɛfa, yeɛ bɔ ɔporɔ ne koso ngonya bɔ ɔmborɔ ne anu kyɛfa. 51 Ɛmɔtie, mekã mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ; yɛ mukoraa yɛngɔlela, na yɛkɔkakyi. 52Na mvum nu, kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ nye perɛ ne, totorobɛndo bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne kohu. Ofikyɛ bekohu totorobɛndo ne, na bekotingye awufoɛ bɛkɔhɔ tebea bɔ bɛmborɔ ɔ nu, na yɛ de yɛkɔkakyi. 53Na odi kyɛ (nipadua he) bɔ ɔporɔ ne fa (nipadua) bɔ ɔmborɔ ne wura, na nipadua he bɔ owu ne afa nipadua bɔ onwu ne wawura. 54 Yiti sɛ nipadua he bɔ ɔporɔ ne fa nipadua bɔ ɔmborɔ ne wura, na nipadua he bɔ owu ne fa nipadua bɔ onwu ne wura a, afei yeɛ né bɔ bahyerɛ ne awa nu kyɛ,
“Basɛkye ewue bali ye so ngonim bɔkɔɔ!
55 Wɔ, ewue, wɔ noa borɔ wɔ ni?
Wɔ, ewue, wɔ ngonim wɔ ni?”
56Ewue noa borɔ ole bɔne, na bɔne koso tumi ole mmeraa ne. 57Nakoso yɛda Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so maa yɛdi ngonim ne ase. 58Yiti nniɛma mɔ, ɛmɔgyina pindinn, nnɛma ɛmɔhimhim, na daa biala ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ Awurade adwuma, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ fɛɛ wɔ Awurade adwuma nu ngɔyɛ mbaen.

Title: 1 KORINTOFOƐ 16
Content:
Yerusalem ehiafoɛ hia ndoboa
1 Ɔfa ndoboa bɔ bedide bɛkɔma anwoteefoɛ nwo nen, nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ mayɛ mama Galatia asɔre nemɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔli so ɔ. 2Dapɛn biala nu kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɛmɔ nu biala ɔ́fa bɔ Nyameɛ afa alo ye ne bie osie, amaa sɛ meba a, ye nwo anhia kyɛ ɛmɔkɔkekã bɛ sa ase ɔ. 3Sɛ meba a, mmenia bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kɔma bɛ adanzeɛ krataa ne, ngɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ ne bɛkɔhɔ Yerusalem. 4Na sɛ ohia kyɛ me ne bɛ kɔ a, me ne bɛ yɛkɔhɔ.
Pɔɔlo ateetulɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ
5 Ngɔfa Makedonia koraa né mawa ɛmɔ berɛ, ofikyɛ mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ ngɔfa Makedonia. 6Ebiaa ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ anwo berɛ kãa, anaa ngoli prakasua ne ɛmɔ berɛ, na afei nziɛ ye ɛmɔaboka me bagua me ate maa mahɔ nekaa bɔ mekɔ ɔ. 7Menguro kyɛ me nye bɔ ɛmɔ so ala a, né masa mahɔ ɔ, na mmom me nye la so kyɛ sɛ Awurade ma ate a, ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ nwo berɛ kãa. 8 Nakoso ngɔtena Ɛfeso wa maa okoodwu Pɛntekɔso. 9Atee piri bie bɔ ngɔfa so ngɔyɔ adwuma, bɔ ye nwo kɔwa mvasoɛ abukye ama me wɔ wa, nakoso me pɔfoɛ sone.
10 Sɛ Timoteo ba a, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɔnne ɛmɔ ngɔtena wɔ ahunudetelɛ nu ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɔyɔ Awurade adwuma kyɛbɔ meyɔ ne ala. 11Nnɛma ebiala bu ye animtia, na mmom ɛmɔgua ye ate asomdwee nu ma osa bra me wa, ofikyɛ menea ye ne aliɛmaa nemɔ ate.
12Ɔfa aliɛmaa Apolo nwo de, mahyɛ ye nguraen pee kyɛ ɔne aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛɛpasa ɛmɔ nwo, nakoso onnya ɔyyɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔwa kekesaala ye; na sɛ atee ba nu a, ɔkɔwa.
Ahyebisalɛ ne ngraa
13 Ɛmɔwɛne, ɛmɔgyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone yɛ se, ná ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye. 14Ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ bɛyɔ ɛmɔ nningyein mukoraa.
15 Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔse Setefana ne ye abusuafoɛ nwo dwirɛ; bɛ yeɛ belili moa bɛyɛle agyidifoɛ wɔ Akaia ɔ, na batu bɛ nwo basie berɛ bama anwoteefoɛ solɛ. 16Yiti ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛma sɔ mmenia ne, ɔne ebiala bɔ ɔne yɛ di sɔ dwumadie ne ɔ. 17Ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ Setefana ne Fotunato ne Akaiko bawa ɔ, ofikyɛ baasi ɛmɔ gya nu; 18na bama m’ahone atɔ me kunu kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ deɛ tɔlɛ ɛmɔ kunu ne. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea mmenia bɔ bɛte sɔ ne yé.
19 Asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Asia ne, bebisa ɛmɔ ahye. Akwila ne Prisika ne asɔremma bɔ beyia b’awuro ne koso bebisa ɛmɔ paa. 20Aliɛmaa nemɔ amu bebisa ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔfa awaawaatuu krongron bɛtotɔ ɛmɔ nwo nu.
21Me bɔbɔ, Pɔɔlo, me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ yeɛ mefa mebisa ɛmɔ ahye ɔ. 22Sɛ ebie nguro Awurade Yesu Kristo dwirɛ a, musue to ye! Y’Awurade bra! (Maranata). 23Yɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ bɛtena. 24Me dɔ ne ɛmɔ tena wɔ Kristo Yesu nu. Amen.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔne Korinto asɔre n’afia ayɛ basaa ɔ. Né akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ biemɔ ato Pɔɔlo soen wɔ Korinto. Né bɛpepɛ ye gya ndii nu kyɛ ye de ɔtte Kristo asomafoɛ ne bie. Nakoso Pɔɔlo kyire nu ma Korinto asɔre ne nwu ye kyɛ ɔte Kristo somafoɛ kaenn.
Pɔɔlo kyire kyɛ ye wora dɔ bɛ, bɛbata ye ahone nwo, na ye nye kɔgye kyɛ okosa kɔwa bɛ berɛ ɔ. Krataa ne maa yɛnwu abiɛngoɛfalɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Pɔɔlo ne Korinto asɔre n’afia ɔ. Ɔnwa ye krataa ne amaa banya adwenesakyera, na wasiesie bɛ ne Nyameɛ afia.
Afei osa srɛ asɔre mma ne kyɛ bɛyɛ ndoboa kãa maa bɛɛfa bɛboka Yudea Akristofoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwokyere nu ne. Krataa n’ayieleɛ kyire kyɛ Pɔɔlo ayɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo adwuma pee atra asomafoɛ ngondombofoɛ bɔ Korintofoɛ bu bɛ kyɛ bedi mu ne.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-11
Pɔɔlo ne Korinto asɔre ne 1.12—7.16
Yudea Akristofoɛ hia Korintofoɛ ndoboa 8.1—9.15
Pɔɔlo nwa ɔte somafoɛ kaenn 10.1—13.10
Krataa n’ayieleɛ 13.11-14

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 1
Content:
1 Krataa he fi me, Pɔɔlo, bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ berɛ. Me ne aliɛmaa Timoteo yeɛ yɛhyerɛle ɔ. Yɛ́fa yɛbrɛ Nyameɛ asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Korinto, ɔne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Akaia mukoraa ɔ. 2 Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Pɔɔlo da Nyameɛ ase
3 Animnyam hã Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, anwumvoinnwunɛ Baba ne aworakyekyerɛ mukoraa Nyameɛ ne, 4 bɔ ɔkyekye yɛ wora wɔ y’amaneɛnwunɛ mukoraa nu, amaa yɛ koso yahora yafa aworakyekyerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa kyekye yɛ wora ne yakyekye bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ ahoroɔ ɔ bɛ wora. 5Na kyɛbɔ yɛnwu Kristo amaneɛ worawora ne bie ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛnate Kristo so yɛnya aworakyekyerɛ mmorosoɛ ɔ. 6 Na sɛ yɛnwu amaneɛ a, né ɛmɔ aworakyekyerɛ ne ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ ti ɔ; yeɛ sɛ yɛnya aworakyekyerɛ a, né ɛmɔ aworakyekyerɛ ti ɔ, bɔ sɛ ɛmɔle aboterɛ begyina amaneɛ bɔ yɛ koso yɛnwu ye ne noa bie a, ɛmɔ sa kã ye ne. 7Yiti y’anyelasoɛ bɔ yele yɛma ɛmɔ ne gyi berɛ pindinn, ofikyɛ yɛse kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ ne yɛ nwu amaneɛ ye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ ne yɛ konya aworakyekyerɛ ɔ.
8 Aliɛmaa mɔ, kyɛbɔ yɛ nwo si hyerele yɛ wɔ Asia nen, yɛmbena kyɛ yɛfa yɛsie ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ nwo hyerele yɛ paa maa ɔbole yɛ so, na afei yɛ ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ mukoraa tu minini. 9Yɛ bɔbɔ ala yɛtele nga wɔ yɛ nu kyɛ yawu yayie, nakoso ɛhe maa yamva yɛ nwo yando yɛ nwo so; na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛtole Nyameɛ bɔ otingye awufoɛ ne so. 10 Ye yeɛ ɔyele yɛ fili ewue suronyisuronyi sɔa nu ɔ, na ɔkɔpepɛ kole yɛ; ye yeɛ yafa yɛ wora yawura ye nu ɔ, kyɛ okosa kɔpepɛ kole yɛ ɔ. 11Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔboka yɛ wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu, amaa mmeni pee bala Nyameɛ ase ama yɛ kyɛ wafa mmeni soma mbaeɛ so wafa sɔ adom ye walo yɛ ɔ.
Pɔɔlo anwohoahoa
12Bɔ yɛfa yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo ɛhe: yɛ tiboa di yɛ adanzeɛ kyɛ yafa nahorɛlilɛ ne nyamesuro yeɛ yabɔ yɛ bra wɔ wiase ɔ, nganga yɛ ne ɛmɔ asetena nu. Yamva ewiase nworɛ so yeɛ yɛbɔle yɛ bra ɔ, na mmom yɛnate Nyameɛ adom so. 13Na yɛngyerɛ hwee yɛmmrɛ ɛmɔ sana bɔ ɛmɔkɔhora ye kenga ná ɛmɔkɔte ye bo ɔ. Mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔkɔte ye bo bekoyie bɔkɔɔ, 14kyɛbɔ ɛmɔate yɛ bo bue bue ne, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔafa yɛ bahoahoa ɛmɔ nwo kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛkɔfa ɛmɔ yɛkɔhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Awurade Yesu kyẽa ne.
Pɔɔlo tu ye ateetulɛ hyɛ kyẽa
15Ɔnate kyɛ m’adwene si pi wɔ ɛhe anwo ne ati, nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ medi moa meba ɛmɔ berɛ, amaa ɛmɔanya saleɛ mmɔhoɛ. 16 Nyɛle kyɛ sɛ mesẽ mekɔ Makedonia a, ahaa ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ sɛ mvi dɔ mesa meba koso a, masa maapasa ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛmɔagua m’ate maa mahɔ Yudea. 17Nzusuleɛ he bɔ nyɛle ye, aso okyire kyɛ m’adwene yɛ me ndaa ndaa anaa? Aso meyɛ me nhyehyɛleɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, bɔ mekã “Yoo” a, né mesa mekyire “Daabi” ɔ? 18Na kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ di nahorɛ ngome ye de, yɛnga “Yoo” na yasa yahã “Daabi” yahyire ɛmɔ. 19 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ Awa Yesu Kristo bɔ me ne Silwano ne Timoteo yɛhane ye nwo dwirɛ yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne, ɔnga “Yoo” na wasa wahã “Daabi”; na mmom mmerɛ biala ɔma ye “Yoo” yɛ yoo. 20 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye nu amukoraa te “Yoo.” Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ye so yeɛ yɛfa yɛkã “Amen” yɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam ɔ. 21Nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ wamaa yɛ ne ɛmɔ yatindim wɔ Kristo nu ɔ, watu yɛ wasie berɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ye adwuma. 22 Wafa ye nzɔanoɛ wahyɛ yɛ nzorɛ, na wama ye Sunzum ne atena yɛ nu asi yɛ nzolɛhyɛlɛ ne agyinayɛɛ.
23Na afei mefrɛ Nyameɛ kyɛ oli me adanzeɛ; né membena kyɛ mebɔ ɛmɔ wora ti yeɛ manza mamma Korinto ɔ. 24Nna kyɛ yɛhyɛ ɛmɔ so wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie nwo ɔ, na mmom kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ nye kɔha ti yeɛ yɛ ne ɛmɔ yɔ adwuma yɛbɔ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie gyi berɛ pindinn.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 2
Content:
1 Yiti nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ mengɔfa aworabɔlɛ mengosa mengɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ ko. 2Na sɛ mema ɛmɔ wora bɔ a, nwa bieku yeɛ ɔkɔma me nye kɔha ɔ? Nna mmenia komapɛ bɔ mama ɛmɔ wora abɔ ye ala ɔ? 3Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa ngyerɛle ɛmɔ krataa hene ɔ, amaa sɛ meba a, mmenia bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛgyegye me nye ne, bamma me wora ammɔ. Ofikyɛ mede ɛmɔ amukoraa medi kyɛ sɛ me nye gye a, né ebiala nye agye. 4Mvale ahometrɛ ne aworabɔlɛ worawora nu, ɔne me nye moenporolɛ pee yeɛ ngyerɛle ɛmɔ ɔ. Manyɛ kyɛ mema ɛmɔ wora bɔ, na mmom né mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma.
Fa bɔne kyɛ
5Nakoso sɛ ebie ama aworabɔlɛ bie awa a, nna me ngome yeɛ wama me wora abɔ ɔ; na mmom atee bie aso, sɛ mékã ye kyɛbɔ medwudwolɛ noa ngɔyɛ hye a, ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔboka so. 6Na ɔte paa bɔkɔɔ ma sɔ sona ne kyɛ mmeni soma ahwi ye nyunu ɔ. 7Yiti ohia kyɛ ɛmɔfa ye nwo bɛkyɛ ye ná ɛmɔkyekye ye wora, amaa aworabɔlɛ ne ammu ye kɔme anu. 8Mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala kyɛ ɛmɔhɔ so behuro ye dwirɛ. 9Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa ngyerɛle krataa ye ɔ, amaa ɔnate so maso ɛmɔ manea sɛ ɛmɔayɛ sotie wɔ nningyein mukoraa nu a. 10Na sona bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa ye nwo bɛkɔhyɛ ye ne, me koso mefa mekyɛ ye. Na sɛ mafa edwirɛ bie mahyɛ a, sona bɔ mva ngyɛle ye ne, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mafa mahyɛ ye wɔ Kristo nyunu ɔ; 11amaa Abɔnzam anni yɛ aminɛ, ofikyɛ yɛse ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ.
Pɔɔlo fili Troase
12 Mmerɛ bɔ ngɔle Troase kyɛ mekwaahã Kristo nzɛmba nen, Awurade bukyele atee mane me. 13Nakoso wanyɛ me fɛ paa biala, ofikyɛ mannwu nniɛma Tito wɔ berɛ. Yiti ngrale berɛ ama, na nzili nu ngɔle Makedonia.
Ngonim wɔ Kristo nu
14Nyameɛ bɔ daa ɔmaa yɛdi ngonim wɔ Kristo nu, ná afei osa fa yɛ so ma ye nwo nimdeɛ woroworo nekaa biala kyɛ ayirefona ne, yɛda ye ase. 15Ofikyɛ yɛte Kristo ayirefona wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, na ye fona ne tu fa bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ gu so ode bɛ ngoa, ɔne bɛ bɔ begu so bemini so. 16Sɔ ayirefona ne te ewue pambaen bɔ ɔkɔ wue nu ma ebiemɔ; nakoso ebiemɔ de, ɔte ngoa fona bɔ ɔkɔ ngoa nu ɔ. Na nwa yeɛ ɔfata ɛhemɔ ɔ? 17Yɛ de, yɛtte kyɛ mmeni pee bɔ bɛnate besi Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne aso kongo ne. Na mmom yɛbɔ Kristo nwo dawure nahorɛ nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ asoma bɛ ɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 3
Content:
Apam foforɛ nwo asomvoɛ
1 Aso yɛsa yɛhyɛ ye bo yɛkamvo yɛ nwo yɛkyire anaa? Anaa ohia kyɛ yɛfa krataa bɔ odi yɛ nwo adanzeɛ yɛbakyire ɛmɔ, anaakyɛ yɛde bie yɛfi ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ de bɛyɔ ne? 2Ɛmɔ ole yɛ nwo adanzeɛ krataa bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ y’ahone nu ɔ, bɔ mmenia mukoraa nwu ye ná bɛkenga ɔ; 3 na ɔda ali pefee kyɛ ɛmɔte Kristo krataa bɔ ɔnate yɛ dwumadie so wahyerɛ ɔ. Wamva ayirebire, na mmom ɔfale Nyameɛ teasefoɛ Sunzum yeɛ ɔhyerɛle ɔ. Nna nyɔboɛ poen so, na mmom sona ahone poen so yeɛ ɔhyerɛle ɔ.
4Sɔ gyidie ne yeɛ ɔnate Kristo so yanya ye wɔ Nyameɛ nu ɔ; 5nna kyɛ yɛfata kyɛ yɛsusu kyɛ yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ nikyee bie ɔ, na mmom yeɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne fi Nyameɛ berɛ. 6 Ye yeɛ wamaa yafata kyɛ yɛyɛ apam foforɛ ne nwo asomvoɛ ɔ, nna mmeraa bɔ bahyerɛ ɔ nu, na mmom Sunzum nu, ofikyɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ne ma ewue, nakoso Sunzum ne de ɔma ngoa.
Apam foforɛ n’animnyam
7 Ewue nwo ɛsom bɔ bɛhyerɛ beguale nyɔboɛ so ne mane animnyam kandinga ma yiti Yisraelfoɛ bangora bannea Mose nyunu ɔnate kyɛ né ɔta hyireinn ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né sɔ animnyam ne okyikyi. Sɛ ye sɔ de a, 8ye de ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ Sunzum nu ɛsom ne ngonya animnyam bɔ ɔtra so ɔ? 9Na sɛ ɛsom bɔ obua mmenia foɛ ne le animnyam a, nzaade ɛsom bɔ ɔma mmenia yɛ tenenee n’animnyam kɔbo so koraa! 10Amba, ɛnea a, bɔ daa né ole animnyam ne, kekesaala de, olle animnyam biala po, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ deɛ n’animnyam tra daa deɛ ne bɔkɔɔ. 11Na sɛ bɔ ogu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne nyane animnyam a, nzaade bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ n’animnyam bo so koraa.
12Na ɔnate kyɛ yanya sɔ anyelasoɛ ne ati, yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛdwudwo. 13 Yɛ de, yɛtte kyɛ Mose bɔ ɔfale ngatanyunu katale ye nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná Yisraelfoɛ bangora bangyene bɛ nye bannea ye nyunu animnyam bɔ né okyikyi ne ɔ. 14Nakoso b’adwene lili naakye, bɔ ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye po sɛ bɛkenga apam daa ne a, ngatanyunu komapɛ ne ala tɛwɔ berɛ bɔ bennya bɛyyele ɔ, ofikyɛ sana Kristo nu angome yeɛ ngatanyunu ne ye fi berɛ ɔ. 15Na ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po, sɛ bɛkenga Mose nwomaa ne a, ngatanyunu ne tɛkata bɛ ndeaseɛ so. 16 Nakoso sɛ sona fa ye nwo bɔ Awurade a, ɔkɔye ngatanyunu ne kɔma ye. 17 Afei, Awurade ole Sunzum ne, na nekaa bɔ Awurade Sunzum wɔ ne, fawɔnwodi wɔ berɛ. 18Baye yɛ mukoraa yɛ nyunu ngatanyunu ne, yiti yɛnwu Awurade animnyam ne kyɛ yɛnea neanu nu ɔ, na Awurade Sunzum ne gu so ɔsesã yɛ maa yɛnya ye sue ne bie yɛfi animnyam nu yahɔ animnyam nu.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 4
Content:
Agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ngukue nu
1Ye sɔ ti, kyɛ Nyameɛ wanwu yɛ anwumvoin wafa ɛsom he wawura yɛ sa ye, yɛngɔpa aba. 2Na yagyi nyanzoen bra bɔ bɛbɔ ye mvealeɛ nu ne yagua; yɛmmɔ nnakannaka bra, yeɛ yɛngã Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne yɛngyea ye; na mmom yɛfa nahorɛ ne bɔ yɛye ye ali ne aso maa mmenia de yɛ to nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 3Na sɛ yɛ nzɛmba ne aso akata a, so akata ama bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ so bemini ne. 4 Bɛ yeɛ ewiase wa nyameɛ ama bɛ bɔ benne benni ne, b’adwene ali naakye, amaa Kristo bɔ ole Nyameɛ sue n’animnyam nzɛmba kanea ne, wanda bɛ so. 5Nna yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ nwo dawure yeɛ yɛbɔ ɔ, na mmom Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔte Awurade ne, ye nwo dawure yɛbɔ ɔ, na yɛsa yɛbɔ dawure kyɛ ɔnate Yesu ti yayɛ ɛmɔ ngoaa. 6 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmane kanea fili awosii nu tale ne, wata hyireinn wɔ y’ahone nu, kyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam nwo nimdeɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nyunu ne.
7Nakoso sɔ agyapadeɛ bɔ yanya ye ne wɔ ngukue nu, na ɛhe maa ɔda adi kyɛ sɔ tumi totohyia ne te Nyameɛ deɛ, na nna yɛ deɛ ɔ. 8Yɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, nakoso ommu y’abasa nu; yɛ nwo ahyere yɛ, nakoso yɛle anyelasoɛ. 9Bɛtane yɛ nye, nakoso Nyameɛ de ɔppole yɛ; babɔ yɛ bɛto ase, nakoso bɛsɛkyele yɛ. 10Daa biala, yɛsoa Awurade Yesu wue ne wɔ yɛ nipadua nu, amaa ɔnate so Yesu sue ne koso ala ali wɔ yɛ nipadua nu. 11Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛte ase ye de, ɔnate Yesu ti daa biala bɛma ewue di yɛ mvanvando, amaa ɔnate so Yesu ngoa ne koso ala ali wɔ yɛ nwonaen bɔ owu ne anu. 12Yiti ewue li yɛ mvanvando, nakoso ɛmɔ de ngoa wɔ ɛmɔ nu.
13 Ɔnate kyɛ yɛ koso yɛle sɔ gyidie sunzum ne ala bie, kyɛbɔ wahyerɛ kyɛ, “Male mali, yiti madwudwo” ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso yɛde yɛdi, yiti yɛdwudwo ɔ. 14 Ofikyɛ yɛse kyɛ, bɔ otingyele Awurade Yesu fili ewue nu ne kotingye yɛ kɔboka Yesu so, ná wafa ɛmɔ ne yɛ wahɔ ye nyunu. 15Ɛmɔ ti yeɛ sɔ nikyee ne wɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa mmeni pee bɔ Nyameɛ adom ɔtrɛ kɔ bɛ berɛ ne, bafa asennaa mmorosoɛ bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam.
Yɛte ase wɔ gyidie nu
16Ɔnate ɛhe ati, yɛmma y’abasa nu mmu. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwoɔnaen he bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ne gu so ɔsɛkye de, nakoso sunzum nu de, yɛnyi frɔmfrɔm alehyeleɛ biala. 17Ofikyɛ kekesaala ye amaneɛ kãa bɔ yɛnwu ye ne, osiesie yɛ ma animnyam kandinga bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔtra so ɔ. 18Yiti yɛmva yɛ nye yɛnzie nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye so, na mmom yɛfa yɛsie bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye so; ofikyɛ bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ne ngyɛ ná wapɛ nu, nakoso bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye ne de ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 5
Content:
Yɛ nyameɛso awuro
1Na yɛse kyɛ sɛ yɛ aseɛ ye aso ɛtena sua ne sɛkye a, yɛkonya awuro bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ, bɔ nna sona yeɛ osili ɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso afebɔɔ. 2Ɛtena sua he anu de, yɛpene, ofikyɛ yɛpere kyɛ bɛkɔfa nyameɛso awuro ne bekopuro bɔ yɛte nu ne aso. 3Na sɛ yɛfa nyameɛso deɛ ne yɛpuro so a, yɛ nwo ngɔla so. 4Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛwɔ ɛtena sua he anu ye de, yɛpene. Nna kyɛ ebiaa yɛpena kyɛ bepuro befi yɛ nwo ɔ, na mmom yɛpena kyɛ bɛfa nyameɛso deɛ ne bepuro so, amaa ngoa abungam bɔ owu so bɔkɔɔ. 5Nyameɛ yeɛ wasiesie yɛ wama sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ye ɔ, na wafa ye Sunzum ne wasi ye agyinayɛɛ.
6Yiti mmerɛ biala yɛle anyelasoɛ. Na yɛse kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛwɔ awuro wɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ye de, yɛ ne Awurade afia atee wale; 7ofikyɛ gyidie yeɛ yɛfa yɛnate ɔ, nna bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ɔ. 8Yɛle anyelasoɛ, na yɛkuro kyɛ yɛfi sɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ná yɛne Awurade yaatena. 9Yiti yafa yasie yɛ nye so kyɛ, sɛ yɛwɔ anwoɔnaen he anu oo, sɛ yɛnne nu oo, yɛkɔsɔ Awurade nye. 10 Ofikyɛ, odi kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkogyina Kristo ndɛenbualɛ bia ne nyunu. Na bɔ sona biala wayɔ ye wɔ sɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ne, kyɛ paa oo, anaa bɔne oo, okonya ye nwo akatuaa.
Yesu ahã yɛ ne Nyameɛ abɔ nu
11Ɔnate kyɛ yɛse kyɛbɔ Awurade nwo suronyi si te ɔ ne ati, yɛbɔ mmɔden kyɛ yɛkɔma mmenia kosuro ye ɔ. Nyameɛ se kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛte ɔ, na mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔ tiboa koso ma ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛte ɔ. 12 Yɛngamvo yɛ nwo ngyire ɛmɔ ko, na mmom yɛma ɛmɔnya atee ɛmɔfa yɛ bɛhoahoa ɛmɔ anwo, amaa ɛmɔanya nyeanoɛ bama mmenia bɔ bɛmva bɔ ɔwɔ ahone nu, na mmom bɛfa bɛ nye so nikyee bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ne. 13Sɛ y’adwene asɛkye a, wasɛkye wama Nyameɛ; yeɛ sɛ y’adwene nu la berɛ a, ɔla ma ɛmɔ. 14 Na Kristo dɔ ne di yɛ so, ofikyɛ yɛde yɛto nu kyɛ sɛ sona ko wu mane mmenia mukoraa a, nzaade mmenia mukoraa bawu. 15Owu mane mmenia mukoraa, amaa bɛ bɔ bɛte ase ne bandena bamma bɛ nwo ko, na mmom batena bama bɔ bɛ ti owuli ná otingyele ne.
Abɔdeɛ foforɛ
16Yiti ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, yɛmva dasaniɛ adwene yɛnzusu kyɛbɔ sona si te ɔ, na sɛ sɔ yeɛ daa ne yɛfa yɛsusuli Yesu a, ɛnɛ de yɛnyɔ ye sɔ ko. 17 Yiti sɛ ebie fa ye nwo bɔ Kristo a, né wayɛ abɔdeɛ foforɛ, nningyein daa ne apɛ nu; amba nningyein mukoraa ayɛ foforɛ. 18 Nyameɛ yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe amukoraa ɔ. Ɔnate Yesu Kristo so wafa yɛ wabata ye nwo, na wafa ngabonu he nwo dwumadie wawura yɛ sa: 19kyɛ, Nyameɛ nate Kristo so wahwe ewiase wabata ye nwo, wammu bɛ bɔne nwo ngondaa wandia bɛ, na wafa ngabonu he nwo dawurebɔlɛ wawura yɛ sa. 20 Yiti yɛte ɛbɔfoɛ ma Kristo bɔ Nyameɛ fa yɛ so tu foɛ ɔ; na yɛgyi Kristo gya nu yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo ate ma Nyameɛ fa ɛmɔ bata ye nwo. 21 Ofikyɛ bɔ wanyɔ bɔne ne, Nyameɛ maa fale ye kakyili bɔne mane yɛ, amaa ɔnate ye so yanya Nyameɛ tenenee ne bie.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 6
Content:
1 Yɛte bokafoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ adwuma nu, yiti yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne yɛ mbaen. 2 Ɔnate kyɛ ɔnwa:
“Mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ndiele wɔ,
na mmokale wɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ kyẽa ne.
Menwa ɛnɛ te adom mmerɛ,
ɛnɛ te ngoalelɛ kyẽa.”
Asomafoɛ amaneɛnwunɛ
3Yɛndo ebiala sundidua, ná ebiala angã yɛ som ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. 4 Na mmom yɛye yɛ nwo ali yekyire kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ asomvoɛ wɔ atee biala so: wɔ aboterɛ pee nu, amaneɛ nu, anwokyere nu, ateetee nu; 5 ɛbolɛ nu, kuku nu nnaa nu, basabasayɛlɛ nu, ɛfɛɛ nu, ɛpɛsilɛ nu, ɛhɔen hunɛ nu; 6anwotelɛ bra nu, nimdeɛ nu, animia nu, paayɛlɛ nu, Sunzum Krongron nu, ɔdɔ kaenn nu, 7 nahorɛ dwirɛ hanɛ nu, Nyameɛ tumi nu, yeɛ tenenee akodeɛ wɔ yɛ bɛen ne famaa so. 8Bedi yɛ ni ná basa bagua yɛ nyunu ase, bɛkã yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ná basa baye yɛ ayɛ; yɛkã nahorɛ nakoso bɛnwa yɛte nnakannaka, 9 bayɛ kyɛ bɛnze yɛ nakoso bɛse yɛ paa, yayɛ kyɛ yawu nakoso amba, yɛte ase, bɛhyɛ yɛ anyeborolɛ, nakoso behhuni yɛ; 10yayɛ kyɛ yɛ wora abɔ nakoso yɛ nye gye daa, yayɛ kyɛ ehiafoɛ nakoso yɛma mmeni pee benya bɛ nwo, yayɛ kyɛ yɛlle huu nakoso yɛle nningyein mukoraa.
11O Korintofoɛ, yapakyepakye nu yadwudwo yahyire ɛmɔ, yaye y’ahone nu dwirɛ mukoraa yahyire ɛmɔ. 12Yahyire kyɛ ɛmɔbata y’ahone nwo, nakoso ɛmɔ de ɛmɔngyire kyɛ yɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo. 13Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔmaa yɛnwu ye kyɛ yɛ koso yɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo. Ɛhe de medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ me mma oo.
Yɛte Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua
14Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛbɔ mmenia bɔ benne benni ɔ, ofikyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla tenenee ne amumuyɛɛ b’afia ɔ? Anaakyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla kanea ne awosii b’afia ɔ? 15Koyɛlɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ Kristo ne Belia b’afia ɔ? Anaakyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla gyidiniɛ ne sona bɔ onne nni b’afia ɔ? 16 Nzikyɛ ngitahoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne mmosoen b’afia ɔ? Ofikyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’asɔneyɛɛ sua, na Nyameɛ waha ne,
“Me ne bɛ kɔtena, na me ne bɛ yanate,
Ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, na bɛ wora bayɛ me maen.”
17 Yiti Awurade nwa nyoo:
“Ɛ́mɔfi bɛ nu befite, ná ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi bɛ nwo;
nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛkã nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ,
na ngole ɛmɔ.
18 Ngɔyɛ ɛmɔ Baba
na ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔayɛ me mma mmienzua ne mmrasua.
Bɔ Tuminiɛ Awurade kã hɔ ɛne.”

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 7
Content:
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yanya bɔhyɛ hemɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛte yɛ nwo yɛfi nikyee biala bɔ ogua anwoɔnaen ne sunzum nwo fiɛ nwo, ná yɛfa Nyameɛ surolɛ nu yɛma yɛ bra yɛ krongron.
Pɔɔlo wora kyekye
2 Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa yɛ bɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo; yɛyyɛle ebiala tɛɛ, yɛssɛkyele ebiala, yeɛ yɛllili ebiala aminɛ. 3 Menga he memmua ɛmɔ foɛ, ofikyɛ mali moa mahã kyɛ ɛmɔbata y’ahone nwo, bɔ sɛ ewue nu oo, ngoa nu oo, yɛne ɛmɔ ala. 4Mede ɛmɔ medi paa, na mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo koso paa. Me wora akyekye paa, na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛfa amaneɛ nu de, nakoso m’anika abu afa so koraa.
5 Mmerɛ bɔ yɛhɔle Makedonia nen, yɛfɛle yɛ nwonaen nu paa, na ɛhawo wale yɛ so wɔ nekaa biala: ngondii pɛle yɛ nwo yiale, na yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ nu koso ɛserɛ hane yɛ. 6 Nakoso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔkyekye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ wora ne, ɔfale Tito walɛ ne aso kyekyele yɛ wora. 7Nna ye walɛ ne angome, na mmom aworakyekyerɛ bɔ onya fili ɛmɔ berɛ ne koso boka so. Ofikyɛ ɔbɔle yɛ amaneɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora dɔ me, aworabɔlɛ aha ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔgyi me si, na ɛhe maa nyane anika mmorosoɛ.
8 Sɛ mvale me krataa ne mmamɔle ɛmɔ wora po a, nnuni me nwo, nakoso kekesaala ye de nnnuni me nwo. Ofikyɛ manwu kyɛ sɔ krataa ne mane ɛmɔ wora bɔle wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie ala. 9Na kekesaala ye de me nye ahã, nna kyɛ ɛmɔ wora bɔ ɔbɔle ne ati ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ aworabɔlɛ ne maa ɛmɔnyane adwenesakyera. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fale ɛmɔ aworabɔlɛ ne aso lili dwumaa, yiti yanyɛ ɛmɔ tɛɛ biala. 10Aworabɔlɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ surolɛ so ba ne ma adwenesakyera bɔ ɔfa sona kɔ ngoalelɛ nu ɔ, na ɔmma sona nnu ye nwo. Nakoso ewiase aworabɔlɛ de ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu. 11Na sɔ aworabɔlɛ he bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ surolɛ so wawa ye, ɛmɔnea dwumadie paa bɔ wali wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ: bɛ noa yelɛ nu, ahinzɛm nu, ɛserɛ nu, me nwo aworadɔlɛ, ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ɔne wereɛtɔlɛ nu. Na atee biala so ɛmɔahyire kyɛ ɛmɔnni fɔ wɔ ɛhemɔ nwo. 12 Nna bɔ wayɔ ebie tɛɛ, anaa bɔ ebie ayɔ ye tɛɛ ti yeɛ ngyerɛle krataa ne mmrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ; na mmom ngyerɛ mmrɛle ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná mmɔden bɔ ɛmɔbɔ wɔ yɛ nwo ne ala ali ama ɛmɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.
13Ye sɔ ne ati, yɛ wora akyekye. Nna yɛ wora ngome yeɛ wakyekye ɔ, na Tito anika ne koso ama yɛ anika mmorosoɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛbokale maa onyane aworakyekyerɛ. 14Na sɛ mvale ɛmɔ nhoahoale me nwo ngyirele ye a, ɛmɔamma me nyunu angua ase. Na kyɛbɔ edwirɛ biala bɔ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ te nahorɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ nwo bɔ yɛhoahoale yɛhyirele Tito ne koso ayɛ nahorɛ ɔ. 15Na sɛ Tito kaye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔyɛle sotie bɛmane ye, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi bɛfale esuronyi ne anwopopolɛ belele ye nyemene so ne a, né okuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma. 16Yiti ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ manya gyidie wɔ ɛmɔ nu wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 8
Content:
Makedoniafoɛ akyɛdeɛ
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu adom bɔ Nyameɛ afa alo Makedonia asɔre nemɔ ɔ. 2B’anwokyere ne nzɔhwɛ kandinga ne asi, benyane anika mmorosoɛ wɔ bɛ hiaa ne anu maa bɛyele bɛ kunu bɛyɔle adɔeɛ kandinga paa. 3 Ofikyɛ bɛyele bɛ kunu bɛyɔle adɔeɛ kyɛbɔ bɛkɔhora ɔ, na medi bɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ bɛmane bɔ ɔbo b’anwoserɛ so po. 4 Na bɛkoto bɛsrɛle yɛ pee kyɛ yɛle b’akyɛdeɛ ne, ná yɛma bɛ koso bɛɛboka anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bie. 5Nna bɔ yɛsusuli ne ngome po yeɛ bɛyɔle ɔ, na mmom ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so belili moa bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛmane Awurade, na afei bɛyɔle sɔ bɛmane yɛ koso. 6 Na yasrɛ Tito bɔ olili moa hyɛle adwuma ne abo ne kyɛ ɔɔtoa so ná oyie sɔ adom adwuma ne wɔ ɛmɔ nu. 7Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔbɔ mmɔden mmorosoɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu: gyidie nu, edwudwolɛ nu, nimdeɛ nu, mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi bekuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ nu ne, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ sɔ adɔeɛ adom he koso ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ adwuma mmorosoɛ ɔ.
8Mendwudwo nhyɛsoɛ so, na mmom mefa ebiemɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ metoto ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne anwo menea kyɛ sɛ ɔte kaenn a. 9 Ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne si te ɔ: né wanya ye nwo, nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti ɔyɛle hianiɛ, amaa ɛmɔafa ye hiaa ne aso banya bɛ nwo. 10 Nzusuleɛ bɔ meyɔ ɛhe, na ɔte paa ma ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔ yeɛ afoɛ hene ɛmɔlili moa benyane adwene kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka ɔ, na ɛmɔ koso ala yeɛ ɛmɔlili moa bɛkekane bɛ sa ase ɔ. 11Yiti ɛmɔbɔ mmɔden beyie sɔ adɔeɛ adwuma ne bɛfa bɛfoa adwene bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye ne aso, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ anwoserɛ kohyire ɔ. 12Na sɛ ɛmɔaye bɛ kunu kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka a, nikyee bɔ sona le ye fa ma ne yeɛ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ, na nna nikyee bɔ olle bie ne ɔ. 13Yɛngyire kyɛ ɛ́mɔma ebiemɔ nwo tɔ bɛ ná ɛmɔ de ɛmɔ nwo hyere ɛmɔ, 14na mmom kyɛ mmokalɛ ne kɔyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yeɛ yɛpena ɔ. Na kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔ sa nu le bie ye, ɔte paa kyɛ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kofi anwokyere nu, amaa sɛ ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔ nwo kyere ɛmɔ ná bele bie a, bɛ koso baboka ɛmɔ, amaa mmokalɛ ne ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 15 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔboaboale pee noa ne annya ye ma wammo so, yeɛ bɔ ɔboaboale kãa bie noa ne koso anhia nikye fee.”
Pɔɔlo soma Tito wɔ Korinto
16Yɛda Nyameɛ ase kyɛ wafa ɛmɔ nwo mmɔden bɔ yɛbɔ ne ala wawura Tito ahone nu ɔ. 17Nna yɛ nikyeesrɛlɛ ne ngome yeɛ wasɔ nu ɔ, na mmom ɔnate ye mmɔdenbɔlɛ ti ɔfa ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ ɔ́ba ɛmɔ berɛ. 18 Na yɛ́soma ye ne aliɛmaa bɔ ɔnate nzɛmbahanɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ti bɛkamvo ye wɔ asɔre ne amukoraa nu ne. 19 Asa koso, asɔre mma ne aneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɔne yɛ nate wɔ sɔ adom adwuma bɔ yafa yato yɛ nwo so ne anu, na yɛyɔ sɔ yɛfa yɛhyɛ Awurade animnyam, ná yɛsa yɛkyire yɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ.
20Yɛmbena kyɛ ebiala nya yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ kã fa sɔ adɔeɛ nningyein bɔ yɛnea so ye nwo. 21 Ofikyɛ yafa yasie yɛ nye so kyɛ yɛtoto nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ, nna Awurade ngome nyunu, na kuro sona koso nyunu.
22Na yɛ́soma y’eliɛma bɔ yanwu ye atee pee so kyɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden wɔ nningyein pee nu ne maa ɔboka bɛ so. Na kekesaala ye de po, okuro kyɛ ɔboka paa, ofikyɛ wanya gyidie piri paa wɔ ɛmɔ nu. 23Tito de, ɔte mmiɛngo ne nniɛma adwumayɔlɛniɛ ma ɛmɔ, na aliɛmaa nemɔ wora bɛte asɔre nemɔ somafoɛ, bɛte Kristo animnyam. 24Yiti ɛ́mɔye ɔdɔ ali behyire bɛ, na ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ adanzeɛ wɔ asɔre nemɔ nyunu kyɛ m’anwohoahoa wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ne te nahorɛ.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 9
Content:
Agyidifoɛ bokaboka bɛ nwo
1 Onhia po kyɛ mekyerɛ mmokalɛ bɔ yɛkwaafa yɛboka anwoteefoɛ ne nwo krataa mebrɛ ɛmɔ. 2 Ofikyɛ, mese kyɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka, na mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo mekyire Makedoniafoɛ kyɛ, ofi afoɛ hene yeɛ ɛmɔ, Akaiafoɛ, ɛmɔaboaboa bɛ nwo kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka ɔ, na ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne akanyane mmeni pee. 3 Nakoso mesoma aliɛmaa hemɔ amaa ɛmɔaboaboa ɛmɔ nwo ná y’anwohoahoa wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ne anyɛ mbaen; na kyɛbɔ ngane ne, mese kyɛ ɛmɔaboaboa ɛmɔ nwo. 4Na sɛ Makedoniafoɛ ne me ba ná benwu kyɛ ɛmɔyyɔle ye nwo hwee a, yɛ nyunu kogua ase wɔ sɔ anwohoahoa ye nwo, na ɛmɔ deɛ de bɛnga ye ko. 5Yiti madwene ye nwo kyɛ, ohia kyɛ mesrɛ aliɛmaa hemɔ maa bedi yɛ nyunu moa bɛbapasa ɛmɔ nwo, na bɛboaboa akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛmɔahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne noa; amaa wanyɛ kyɛ nhyɛsoɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom wafi ɛmɔ ahone nu.
Akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ
6Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɔ odua mmakaammaa kãa bie ne, okobu kãa bie; na bɔ odua pee ne, okobu pee. 7 Na kyɛbɔ ebiala asusu ye nwo wɔ ye adwene nu ne, maa ɔfa sɔ ma, na wanyɛ kyɛ ɔtwetwe ye gya ase anaakyɛ ɔyɛ ye nhyɛsoɛ nu; ofikyɛ bɔ ɔye ye kunu fitaa fa nikyee kyɛ ne yeɛ Nyameɛ kuro ye dwirɛ ɔ. 8 Nyameɛ kora ma ɛmɔnya saleɛ amukoraa mmorosoɛ, amaa mmerɛ biala ɛmɔ sa ahã nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔhia ɔ, na ɛmɔkonya ye mmorosoɛ na ɛmɔafa bie baboka adwuma paa. 9 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Ɔye ye kunu fa nningyein kyekyɛ paa,
ɔkyɛ ehiafoɛ nikye,
ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.”
10 Na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma kuaniɛ bakaammaa maa odua ná ɔma ye aleɛ maa odi ne, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ mmakaammaa mmorosoɛ ná wama ɛmɔ adɔeɛ ne asu mmaa pee. 11Ɛmɔkonya ɛmɔ nwo wɔ nikyee biala nu ná ɛmɔafa bie bayɔ adɔeɛ, na ɔnate yɛ so mmenia kɔla Nyameɛ ase wɔ ɛmɔ adɔeɛ ne nwo. 12Nna bɔ anwoteefoɛ ne hia ngome yeɛ ɛmɔ mmokalɛ ne ma bɛ sa kã ɔ, na mmom ɔmaa bɛfa asennaa pee koso bɛma Nyameɛ. 13 Sɔ mmokalɛ he di ɛmɔ nwo adanzeɛ, na ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ ɛmɔ sotie wɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo, ɔne mmokalɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa boka bɛ ne mmenia mukoraa nwo, 14na bɛkɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ná bɛ wora adɔ ɛmɔ, ɔnate Nyameɛ adom mmorosoɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ne ati. 15 Ɛ́mɔma yɛla Nyameɛ ase wɔ ye akyɛdeɛ bɔ olle kabea ne anwo.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 10
Content:
Pɔɔlo nwa ɔte somafoɛ turoloo
1 Me, Pɔɔlo, mefa Kristo anwobrɛaseɛ ne ye dwolɛ bɔ odwo ne aso metu ɛmɔ foɛ; me bɔ me nye bɔ ɛmɔ nyunu a meyɛ me nwo anwumvoin anwumvoin, nakoso mefi ɛmɔ berɛ a mema m’ahone yɛ se wɔ ɛmɔ so ne. 2 Mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ sɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ a, nnɛmɔyɛ maa meye m’ahoneserɛ ne ali; ofikyɛ mede medi kyɛ mekora mefa m’ahoneserɛ ne mekɔ mmenia biemɔ bɔ bebu yɛ kyɛ yɛnate anwoɔnaen nu atee so ne, bɛ so. 3Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛbɔ yɛ bra wɔ anwoɔnaen nu de, nakoso yɛngo anwoɔnaen nu koɛ. 4Ofikyɛ y’akodeɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛko ne ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu akodeɛ, na mmom ɔte Nyameɛ tumi akodeɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛdwiri anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ yɛgua ɔ. 5Yɛfa yɛdi ngonim wɔ aporowaasulɛ nu ne nikyee biala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so tia Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ so, na yɛkakyi sona biala adwene maa ɔyɛ sotie ma Kristo. 6 Na yasiesie yɛ nwo kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔ sotieyɛlɛ di mu bɔkɔɔ a, yɛkotua asoserɛ biala so kerɛ.
7 Ɛ́mɔma yɛnea bɔ yɛ nye tua ɔ: sɛ ebie bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔte Kristo deɛ a, maa ɔdwene ye nwo bieku kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔte Kristo deɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ wora yɛte Kristo deɛ ɔ. 8Awurade tumi bɔ ɔfa mane yɛ kyɛ yɛma ɛmɔnya ngɔsoɛ, na nna kyɛ yɛsɛkye ɛmɔ ne, sɛ mefa yɛ tumi ne mehoahoa me nwo maa ɔbo so kãa po a, ɔnyɛ me nya. 9Na menguro kyɛ meyɛ me nwo kyɛ mefa me ngrataa menwunanwuna ɛmɔ; 10 ofikyɛ mmenia kekã kyɛ, “Ye ngrataa te anwunanwuna na nu sa yɛ se, nakoso sɛ ɔba wa a, ye noa yɛ mmerɛ, yeɛ ye noa dwirɛ koso mbɛ asue.” 11Na méma sɔ mmenia ne bɛte ye bo kyɛ, bɔ yɛkyerɛ ye krataa nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛnne ɛmɔ berɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ a yɛyɔ ɔ.
12Ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛ nwo yɛsusu, anaa yɛtoto ebiemɔ bɔ bɛkamvo bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo ne, ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo besusu bɛ nwo bɛ nwo, na basa bafa batoto bɛ nwo bɛ nwo ne, bɛnze nworɛ. 13Nakoso yɛ de, yɛngɔhoahoa yɛ nwo ma ɔngɔbo so, na mmom kyɛbɔ asusudeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama yɛ kyɛ yɛdwu ɛmɔ berɛ ne ɔte ne ala. 14Na yɛndwe yɛ nu ma ɔndra so kyɛ ebiaa yandwu ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛlili moa yɛfale Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne yɛpɛle atee yɛtoale ɛmɔ ɔ. 15 Yɛ de, yɛnhoahoa yɛ nwo ma ɔndra so, yɛmva ebiemɔ adwuma bɔ bayɔ yɛnhoahoa yɛ nwo. Na mmom yɛle anyelasoɛ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ gyidie nyi a, ɔkɔma dwumadie bɔ Nyameɛ afa awura yɛ sa wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne kɔtrɛ, 16amaa yahora yaha nzɛmba ne wɔ nekaa foforɛ mɔ, na yamva ebie adwuma bɔ wayɔ ye dada wɔ nekaa bie yanhoahoa yɛ nwo. 17 “Ma ebiala bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, ɔfa Awurade hoahoa ye nwo.” 18Ofikyɛ nna sona bɔ ɔkamvo ye nwo ne yeɛ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ, na mmom bɔ Awurade kamvo ye ne yeɛ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 11
Content:
Pɔɔlo ne asomafoɛ ngondombofoɛ
1 Sɛ ɛmɔfa me ngwaseasɛm ne sɔ ala ma me a, ahaa mekuro. Mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala ɛmɔfa ye sɔ! 2 Nyameɛ nungunɛ ne bie yeɛ metwe wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ɔ. Ofikyɛ mafa ɛmɔ mabɔ asiwa mama biaa komapɛ, ye ole Kristo, na ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔma ye kyɛ ababunu bɔ ye nwo te ná onnwuni biaa le ɔ. 3 Nakoso mesuro kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ewoo ne fale anyeteɛ nworɛ lakalakale Hawa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔsɛkye ɛmɔ adwene maa ɛmɔkɔhwe bɛ nwo bekofi Kristo bɔ ɛmɔafa bɛ nwo bama ye nahorɛ nu ne anwo ɔ. 4 Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie ba ɛmɔ berɛ bakã Yesu foforɛ bie nwo dwirɛ bɔ yɛhhane, anaakyɛ sɛ ɛmɔnya sunzum foforɛ bɔ ɔne bɔ ɛmɔlili moa benyane ye ne bɛtte ko, anaakyɛ nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne bɔ ɛmɔale bato nu ne bɛtte ko a, naa ɛmɔfa anika bɛsɔ nu! 5 Nakoso menne menni kyɛ sɔ “asomafoɛ atitire” nemɔ bɛtra me ɔ. 6 Na sɛ me noa yeɛ ɔttele po a, nimdeɛ nu de mebɔ mmɔden; na nikyee biala nu yala ɛhe ali yahyire ɛmɔ wɔ atee biala so.
7 Na sɛ mmrɛle me nwo ase maa ɛmɔnyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngane Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne ngyirele ɛmɔ, bɔ mammisa ɛmɔ berɛ hwee ne a, né bɔne beni yeɛ mayɔ ɔ? 8 Asɔre biemɔ mmokalɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbokale me ne, mefa ye kyɛ mawua bɛ; ofikyɛ mvale sɔ akatuaa ne neane me nwo nzole ɛmɔ. 9Na mmerɛ bɔ me nwo hyerele me wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, mamva m’anwokyere mangua ebiala so, ofikyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ befi Makedonia bɛwale ne bɛfale nikyee biala bɔ mehia bɛbrɛle me. Yiti kyɛbɔ neane me nwo daa wɔ nikyee biala nu ne, ngɔhɔ so ngɔyɔ ye sɔ ala, na manyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom. 10 Kristo nwo nahorɛ dwirɛ wɔ me nu, yiti ebiala ngɔhora ngɔma mengɔyakyi me nwo hoahoalɛ wɔ Akaia manzini nu. 11 Nzu ati ɔ? Aso menguro ɛmɔ dwirɛ hɔ ɔ? Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɔ. 12 Ngɔhɔ so ngɔyɔ bɔ meyɔ ne ala, na ɛhe ngɔma mmenia ngonya edwirɛ biala ngogyina so ná bafa bahoahoa bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛyɔ b’adwuma kyɛ yɛ deɛ ne ala. 13Ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia ne te asomafoɛ ngondombofoɛ, adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nnakannakafoɛ bɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nwo kyɛ Kristo asomafoɛ ɔ. 14Na ɔnyɛ nwanwa! Ofikyɛ Abɔnzam po kakyi ye nwo kyɛ nahorɛ abɔfo. 15Yiti sɛ ye asomafoɛ mɔ koso bɛkakyi bɛ nwo kyɛ tenenee somvoɛ mɔ a, ɔnyɛ nwanwa, na b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ.
Pɔɔlo fa amaneɛnwunɛ hoahoa ye nwo
16Mesi so bieku, nnɛma ebiala dwene kyɛ nnne adwene. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔbu me kyɛ nnne adwene po a, ɛ́mɔfa me sɔ ala, ná me koso nhoahoa me nwo kãa. 17 Sɔ anwohoahoa ye nwo dwirɛ bɔ mekã ye, nna Awurade tumi yeɛ mefa mekã ɔ, na mmom mekã ye kyɛ sona bɔ nnne adwene ɔ. 18Mmeni pee hoahoa bɛ nwo wɔ anwoɔnaen atee so, yiti me wora ngɔhoahoa me nwo bie. 19 Ɛmɔle ngwaseafoɛ nwo aboterɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔte nworɛfoɛ. 20Na sɛ ebie fa ɛmɔ yɛ ngoaa, anaa odi ɛmɔ aminɛ, anaa osisi ɛmɔ, anaa ɔmoma ye nwo so, anaa ɔpakye ɛmɔ nye so po a, ɛmɔnya ye nwo aboterɛ.
21Ɔyɛ me nya kyɛ mekã kyɛ yɛ de yɛbrɛle yɛ nwo ase soma ɔ. Nakoso bɔ ebie kora fa hoahoa ye nwo ne, medwudwo kyɛ ebiaa nnne adwene de oo, me wora mekora mefa mehoahoa me nwo bie. 22Bɛte Hebrifoɛ anaa? Me wora nde bie. Bɛte Yisraelfoɛ anaa? Me wora nde bie. Bɛte Abraham boso ama anaa? Me wora nde bie. 23 Bɛte Kristo asomvoɛ anaa? Medwudwo kyɛ ebiaa nnne adwene de oo, metra bɛ: mayɔ adwuma serɛ matra bɛ, mala kuku nu somaa matra bɛ, babo me pee batra bɛ, yeɛ ewue ato afo me pee atra bɛ. 24 Yudafoɛ mbire bɔ befi ye aburanna ne, pɛen nnu mumua yeɛ bɛtetele so ngoko na bɛfale ye ngaa ne befini me ɔ. 25 Baha me mbire koso pɛen nza, baboro me nyɔboɛ ko, ɛlɛen abutu me pɛen nza, yeɛ ɛpo koso fale me lili akɔneaba alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ ko. 26 Matu atee pee na mali amia wɔ nzue so, awuefoɛ sa nu, me bɔbɔ me nwo ama bɛ sa nu, Amaenmaensofoɛ sa nu, kuro nu nningyein suronyi, ɛserɛ so suronyi, ɛpo so suronyi, yeɛ aliɛmaa ngondombofoɛ sa nu. 27 Mayɔ adwuma mafɛ, mmerɛ pee mennya nnaa menna, ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen ku me, metaa mekye hɔen, ɛyerɛ ku me, yeɛ ndaadeɛ bɔ ngowura abɔ me. 28Nna ɛhemɔ ngome, na mmom asɔre ne amukoraa nwo dadwene koso la me so ɛlɛho biala. 29 Nwa yeɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ a, ná me wora nnyɛle mmerɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ bɛmaa ɔkɔ bɔne nu a memvɛ yaa ɔ?
30Na sɛ odi kyɛ mehoahoa me nwo a, nningyein bɔ okyire kyɛ meyɛ mmerɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ. 31Na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba, bɔ ɛkamvolɛ te ye deɛ daa daa ne, ɔse kyɛ membɛ ngondombo.
32 Ngɔle Damasko nen, amrado bɔ owura Nana Aretase bo ne fale asraafoɛ gyinagyinane kuro ne anu kyɛ bɛhye me, 33nakoso bɛfale me besiele kɛndɛenmboho bie anu, na bedwurale me bɛfale mboma bɔ ɔwɔ fasue ne anu maa nwati mvili ye sa nu.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 12
Content:
Pɔɔlo kã ye nyekyire nwo dwirɛ
1Ye nwo nhia kyɛ ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ, nakoso ngɔhã Awurade nyekyire, ɔne bɔ waye wahyire me nwo dwirɛ. 2Mese ebie wɔ Kristo nu, na afoɛ buru ne nna ɛhe yeɛ behwimini ye bɛhɔle nyameɛso bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne aso ɔ. Sɛ ɛhe sili wɔ anwoɔnaen nu oo, sɛ nna anwoɔnaen nu ahɔ oo, me de menze, Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɔ. 3Mese kyɛ behwimini sɔ sona ne bɛhɔle Paradise. Nakoso sɛ ɛhe sili wɔ anwoɔnaen nu oo, sɛ nna anwoɔnaen nu ahɔ oo, me de menze, Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɔ. 4 Na berɛ yeɛ ɔtele edwirɛ bɔ kuro sona ngora nga bie, yeɛ atee koso nne berɛ kyɛ ɔkã ɔ. 5Sɔ sona ne yeɛ ngɔfa ye ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ, nakoso me bɔbɔ me nwo de mengɔhoahoa; sana me mmerɛyɛlɛ nwo yeɛ ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ. 6Na sɛ mekuro kyɛ mehoahoa me nwo po a, mengɔyɛ kwaseaa, ofikyɛ nahorɛ yeɛ ngɔhã ɔ. Nakoso mayakyi m’anwohoahoa ne po, anyɔ a né bɔ ebie nwu ye anaa bɔ ɔte fi me berɛ ne ati wabu me watra so.
7 Na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na mamva anwanwadeɛ nyekyire hemɔ mammoma me nwo so soma ne ati, bɛfale ɛhawo bie bawura me nwonaen nu, bɔ ɔte Abɔnzam bɔfoɛ, kyɛ ɔma nwu yealɛ, ná mammoma me nwo so. 8Ɔnate ɛhe ati, nzrɛle Awurade pɛen nza kyɛ ɔye sɔ nikyee ne fi me so. 9 Nakoso obuale me kyɛ, “M’adom ne ala sone ma wɔ, ofikyɛ sona mmerɛyɛlɛ nu yeɛ me tumi ne ye ye nwo ali paa paa ɔ.” Yiti ngɔfa anika piri paa ngɔhoahoa me nwo wɔ me mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, amaa Kristo tumi ne wawura me nu. 10 Na ɔnate Kristo ti, me nye gye wɔ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, alapaa bɔ bɛbɔ me nu, anwokyere nu, ndaneanyeɛ nu, aworabɔlɛ nu; ofikyɛ sɛ meyɛ mmerɛ a, yeɛ me nwo yɛ se ɔ.
Korintofoɛ nwo hia Pɔɔlo
11 Mayɛ kwaseaa mahoahoa me nwo, nakoso ɛmɔ yeɛ bamaa mayɛ sɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkamvo me bekyire ɔ. Na sɛ nnde huu po a, sɔ “asomafoɛ atitire” nemɔ de bɛndra me wɔ atee biala so. 12Nningyein bɔ bedi asomafoɛ paa nwo adanzeɛ ne, nyɔle ye wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ wɔ aboterɛ mukoraa ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, anwanwadeɛ ne tumi nnwumaa nu ɔ. 13 Nzikyɛ paa yeɛ nyɔ mane asɔre ngaa nemɔ bɔ mbɛle ɛmɔ nyakyili ɔ? Sana m’anwokyere ye ala bɔ mamva mangua ɛmɔ so ye. Na sɛ ɛhe nwo yeɛ mayɔ tɛɛ hɔ a, nzaade ɛmɔfa bɛhyɛ me.
14Ye pɛen nza ɛhe yeɛ maboaboa me nwo kyɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. Memmanyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom, ofikyɛ membena ɛmɔ dɔ nikye fee, na mmom mepena ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn. Ofikyɛ nna mmaa yeɛ bɛpena nikyee bɛyakyi awofoɛ ɔ, na mmom awofoɛ yeɛ bɛpena bɛyakyi mmaa ɔ. 15Na me de, ɔkɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ kra ti ngɔhwere me nikyee biala, ɔne me bɔbɔ me mumua ne. Na sɛ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ pee sɔa a, né nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ de ɛmɔkuro me dwirɛ kãa bie ɔ? 16 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ manyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom de, nakoso ɛmɔdwene kyɛ nde anyeteɛ sona, na nnakannaka yeɛ mafa manya ɛmɔ ɔ. 17Mmenia bɔ nzomane bɛ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, aso mafa bɛ so mali ɛmɔ aminɛ anaa? 18 Nzrɛle Tito, na nzomane ye ne aliɛmaa ne kyɛ bɛbra ɛmɔ berɛ. Aso Tito, olili ɛmɔ aminɛ anaa? Ɔne me yɛ dwumadie ne ɔtte ko anaa? Anaakyɛ nna agyirɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛtuli ɔ?
19Ɛmɔdwene kyɛ yɛ noa yeɛ yɛye yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ? Daabi. Yɛdwudwo Kristo dumaa nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; na aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa yɛkã ɛhe amukoraa ɔ. 20 Na mesuro ye si kyɛ sɛ meba a, ngoonwu ɛmɔ wɔ atee bɔ menguro so, ná ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanwu me wɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔnguro so. Ebiaa ngɔɔto ɛmɔ ne ngondii, ahoɔyea, ɛyaafɛlɛ, pɛsɛmangomenya, bɛ gya ndii nu pepɛlɛ, nzekure, anwomasoɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ nu. 21Ebiaa meba bieku a, me Nyameɛ kɔbrɛ me ase wɔ ɛmɔ nyunu maa ngoli ɛmɔ nu pee nwo aworabɔlɛ wɔ mmenia somaa bɔ daa bayɔ bɔne, ná kekesaala ye bɛtɛyɔ ná banzakyera b’adwene wɔ brabɔlɛ fiɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ ne ahuhubra nwo ti.

Title: 2 KORINTOFOƐ 13
Content:
Foɛtulɛ
1 Meba ɛmɔ berɛ he a, né ye pɛen nza so ɛne. Na kwaadu biala, odi kyɛ benya adanzefoɛ nyɔ anaa nza noa dwirɛ bɛfa bɛfoa so. 2Mmɔle bɛ bɔ daa ne bɛyɛle bɔne, ne bɛ bɔ baha ne amukoraa kɔkɔ, na kekesaala ye bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ye koso, mesi so bieku, kyɛbɔ nyɔle ye mmerɛ bɔ nzrale ɛmɔ ye pɛen nyɔ so ne kyɛ, sɛ meba berɛ bieku a, mengɔfa bɛ nwo ngɔhyɛ bɛ. 3Ofikyɛ ɛmɔpena adanzeɛ bɔ okyire kyɛ Kristo yeɛ ɔfa me so dwudwo ɔ. Kristo nyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ɛmɔ so, na mmom ye tumi yɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu. 4 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu wɔ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu de, nakoso ɔnate Nyameɛ tumi so ɔte ase. Yɛ koso, yɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ye nu, nakoso yɛnate Nyameɛ tumi so yɛne ye kɔtena ase.
5Ɛ́mɔneanea ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛnea sɛ ɛmɔtɛtira gyidie ne anu a. Ɛ́mɔso ɛmɔ nwo bɛnea. Aso ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ Yesu Kristo te ɛmɔ nu anaa? Sana ebiaa né ɛmɔabɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu. 6Nakoso mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔkonwu ye kyɛ yɛ de, yɛbbɔle ase wɔ gyidie nu. 7Na yɛsrɛ Nyameɛ kyɛ ɛmɔngɔyɔ bɔne. Yɛngyire kyɛ yɛ de yɛsɔ anyeɛ oo, daabi! na mmom ɛmɔ de yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebie a yayɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ babɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu ne. 8Ofikyɛ yɛngɔhora yɛngɔyɔ nikye fee ngotia nahorɛ ne, na mmom kyɛ yɛkogyina yɛkɔma nahorɛ ne yeɛ yɛkɔhora kɔyɔ ɔ. 9Na sɛ yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na ɛmɔ de ɛmɔyɛ se a, né yɛ nye agye; na yɛ mbaeɛ ole kyɛ ɛmɔkoli mu ɔ. 10 Yiti mekyerɛ krataa he mebrɛ ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa sɛ meba a, Awurade tumi bɔ wafa wama me ne, mamva so me ne ɛmɔ yanni ye weewee. Ofikyɛ nna ɛmɔ asefinɛ, na mmom ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ nyane sɔ tumi ne ɔ.
Ngraalilɛ ne mbaeɛ
11Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, mekra ɛmɔ oo! Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo te, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora kyekye, ɛmɔnya adwene ko, ɛmɔtena asomdwee nu, na ɔdɔ ne asomdwee Nyameɛ ɔne ɛmɔ kɔtena. 12 Ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo awaawaatuu krongron nu. 13 Anwoteefoɛ ne amu bebisa ɛmɔ ahye. 14 Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne, Nyameɛ dɔ ne, ɔne Sunzum Krongron abiɛngoɛfalɛ ne ɔne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena. Amen.

Title: GALATIAFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo yeɛ ɔfale Yesu nwo nzɛmba ne hɔle Galatia ɔ. Né Galatia te Roman manzini wɔ Asia mbɔtam. Galatiafoɛ pee lele nzɛmba ne lili. Na ɔnate kyɛ bɛte Amaenmaensofoɛ ne ati, Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛ ne bɛ wɔ berɛ ne hyɛle bɛ kyɛ beli Mose mmeraa ne aso, na bɛpɛ bɛ bienzua.
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he ɔɔmane bɛ kyɛ bienzuapɛlɛ nwo nhia, ofikyɛ nna bienzuapɛlɛ yeɛ ɔma sona nya Nyameɛ berɛ bɔnefakyɛ ɔ, na mmom gyidie. Yudafoɛ ne sa hane kyɛ Pɔɔlo de, nna Yesu somafoɛ ne bie ɔ, yiti yeɛ wakwati Mose mmeraa ne na wama Amaenmaensofoɛ ate kyɛ bɛyɛ Akristofoɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔmma bɛmbɛ bɛ bienzua ɔ.
Né Pɔɔlo afi Galatia sɔ mmerɛ ne. Yiti ɔhyerɛle sɔ krataa he ɔɔmane asɔrefoɛ ne fa hyirele bɛ kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ somafoɛ turoloo. Ɔmaa bɛtele ye bo kyɛ Nyameɛ nate Yesu Kristo so yeɛ ɔfrɛle ye wɔ Damasko atunu ɔ. Osa ha hyirele bɛ kyɛ ɔnate Yesu Kristo nu gyidie ngome so yeɛ Nyameɛ yɛ bɔnefoɛ teneneeniɛ ɔ, na ɔnnate bienzuapɛlɛ so.
Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, Pɔɔlo hyirele bɛ kyɛ sona gyidie wɔ Kristo nu yeɛ ɔmaa ɔbɔ bra foforɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ Kristo deɛ ne ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-10
Pɔɔlo te Yesu somafoɛ 1.11—2.21
Nzɛmba ne te Nyameɛ adom 3.1—4.31
Kristoniɛ fawɔnwodi ne ye asodie 5.1—6.10
Ayieleɛ 6.11-18

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 1
Content:
1 Me Pɔɔlo, offi kuro sona, yeɛ ɔnnate sona so; na mmom ɔnate Yesu Kristo ne Baba Nyameɛ bɔ otingyele ye fili awofoɛ nu ne so yeɛ maayɛ somafoɛ ɔ. 2 Me ne aliɛmaa mɔ mukoraa bɔ bɛboka me so yeɛ yɛfa krataa he yɛbrɛ Galatia asɔre nemɔ ɔ.
3 Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. 4 Ye yeɛ ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ bɔne ɔ, amaa ɔnate so waye yɛ wafi kekesaala ye bɔne wiase ye anu, kyɛbɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ te ne. 5 Ye yeɛ animnyam ɔhã ye afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen.
Nzɛmba ne te komapɛ twe
6 Ɔyɛ me nwanwa kyɛ wangyɛ biala yeɛ ɛmɔtwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo ɔ, ye bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ wale Kristo adom ne anu, ná ɛmɔkwaali nzɛmba foforɛ si ɔ. 7 Nakoso nzɛmba foforɛ biala nne berɛ; na mmom mmenia biemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛha ɛmɔ, bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bɛsesã Kristo nzɛmba ne ɔ. 8 Nakoso sɛ yɛ, anaa abɔfo bie fi nyameɛso po ba bakã nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne yɛ deɛ bɔ yahã yahyire ɛmɔ ne bɛnzɛ a, ye de ye yaakɔ! 9 Yahã ye daa, na mekã ye bieku, sɛ ebie bakã nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne yɛ deɛ bɔ ɛmɔale bato nu ne bɛnzɛ a, abue bu ye! 10 Afei, kuro sona, anaa Nyameɛ yeɛ mepena kyɛ ɔkamvo me ɔ? Anaa mepena kyɛ mesɔ adasa nye? Sɛ kuro sona yeɛ ngu so mesɔ ye nye a, ahaa nnde Kristo akoaa.
Kyɛbɔ Pɔɔlo yɛle Yesu Kristo somafoɛ ɔ
11 Aliɛmaa mɔ, mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ nzɛmba bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, nna kuro sona deɛ ɔ. 12 Ɔnate kyɛ mannya mamvi kuro sona berɛ, yeɛ bangyire me koso; na mmom Yesu Kristo yeɛ ɔyele ye ali hyirele me ɔ.
13 Ɛmɔate me daa brabɔlɛ bɔ né nwɔ nu wɔ Yudasom nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ndanene Nyameɛ asɔre ne nye anyeborolɛ so, na mmɔle mmɔden kyɛ ngɔsɛkye ye ɔ. 14 Na nyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ Yudasom nu ndrale Yudafoɛ pee bɔ me ne bɛ bɔ tipɛen, na nzɔle me nana mɔ amammerɛ ne anu serɛserɛ.
15 Nakoso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔneaneane nu yele me koraka yeɛ bɛbaawo me, na ɔlole me frɛle me ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɔle ye nye 16 kyɛ ɔkɔla Ɔwa ne ali kohyire me, amaa ɔnate so mahã ye nwo nzɛmba ne mahyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ne, berɛ ne ala manzusu ye nwo mangyire sona biala. 17Yeɛ mangɔ asomafoɛ bɔ belili me nyunu moa ne berɛ wɔ Yerusalem, na mmom ngɔle Arabia, na nziɛ ye nza male Damasko bieku.
18 Na afoɛ nza si ne, ngɔ nzrale Kefa wɔ Yerusalem, na nnili ye berɛ eleburu ne nnu. 19 Nakoso mannwu asomafoɛ ne anu biala, sana Awurade aliɛma Yakobo. 20 Na edwirɛ bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye, Nyameɛ nyunu, membɛ ngondombo. 21 Na ɛhe asi ne, ngɔle Siria ne Kilikia mbɔtam. 22 Né Kristo asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne bennwuni me nyunu le. 23 Bɔ né bate hɔ ala ɛhe: “Sona bɔ né daa ɔtane yɛ nye ne, afei de ɔbɔ gyidie bɔ ahaa ɔpena kyɛ ɔsɛkye ye ne nwo dawure.” 24 Na ɔnate me ti bɛhyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam.

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 2
Content:
Pɔɔlo ne asomafoɛ ngaa ne
1 Afoɛ buru ne nna si ne, me ne Banaba yɛhɔle Yerusalem bieku, na mvale Tito koso mmokale me nwo so. 2 Nyane nyekyire ti yeɛ ngɔle berɛ ɔ, na mvale nzɛmba bɔ mekã mekyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ne ndole bɛ nyunu; nakoso mbanyi nemɔ de, nga ngyirele bɛ wɔ ahameɛ, amaa adwuma bɔ meyɔ, ɔne bɔ mayɔ ye daa ne anyɛ mbaen. 3 Nakoso Tito po bɔ ɔte Helaniɛ na ɔboka me so ne, banhyɛ ye kyɛ ɔpɛ ye bienzua. 4 Na aliɛmaa mɔ ngondombofoɛ bɛfeafeale bɛ nwo bɛwale berɛ bie kyɛ bɛbaatetɛ bɛpena yɛ fawɔnwodi bɔ yanya ye wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne nwo ate, na bamaa yaawura ngoaasolɛ nu. 5Na yɛ de, yamma bɛ ate mmerɛ kaala po, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná nahorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzɛmba ne anu ahɔ so atena berɛ ama ɛmɔ daa ɔ.
6 Na bɛ bɔ bebu bɛ nwo kyɛ bedi mu ne, bɛte nzikyɛ mmenia koraa po a, me de ɔmva me nwo; ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de ɔnyɛ nyeyemuɛ, na bɛ bɔ bebu bɛ nwo kyɛ bedi mu ne bamva hwee bammoka so. 7 Na mmom benwuni kyɛ bafa bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ nu nzɛmbahanɛ ne bawura me sa, kyɛbɔ bafa bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nu deɛ bawura Petro sa ne. 8 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate Petro so yɔle asomafoɛ adwuma wɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nu ne, ye komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔnate me so lili dwumaa wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu ɔ. 9Na Yakobo, Kefa ne Yohane bɔ agyidifoɛ ne bu bɛ kyɛ bɛte bonima ma asɔre ne nwuni adom bɔ manya ye nen, besomane me ne Banaba sa nu bɛfa behyirele kyɛ bale yɛ bato nu: kyɛ yɛɛha nzɛmba ne yɛhyire Amaenmaensofoɛ, na bɛ wora bɛɛhã ye bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ dɔ. 10 Bɛsrɛle yɛ nikyee komapɛ, kyɛ yɛkaye ehiafoɛ; na né ɛhe te nikyee bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ ɔ.
Pɔɔlo twi Petro nyunu wɔ Antiokia
11 Na Petro wale Antiokia nen, ndwili ye nyunu, ofikyɛ né wayɔ mvomsoɛ bie. 12 Ofikyɛ, anzana ɛbɔfoɛ biemɔ bɛbaafi Yakobo berɛ bɛba nen, né Petro ne Amaenmaensofoɛ (agyidifoɛ) nemɔ to asaa bedidi. Nakoso bɛwale nen, ɔhwene ye nwo fili bɛ nwo, ofikyɛ né osuro bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ. 13 Na Yudafoɛ ngaa ne koso yɔle sɔ mvomsoɛ ne bie, na bɛ suban tɛɛ ne mane Banaba koso hwene ye nwo bie. 14 Na nwuni kyɛ bakwati nahorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzɛmba ne anu nen, nzele Petro wɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ bɔ ɛte Yudaniɛ ɛbɔ wɔ bra kyɛ Amaenmaensoniɛ, na ɛnyɛ kyɛ Yudaniɛ a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛhyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ kyengyekyengye maa bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ Yudafoɛ ɔ?”
Gyidie yeɛ ode Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ ngoa ɔ
15 Yɛ de, bɛwole yɛ Yudafoɛ, na bannwo yɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔnefoɛ. 16 Nakoso yɛse kyɛ ɔnate sona gyidie wɔ Yesu Kristo nu so yeɛ Nyameɛ bua ye be ɔ, na mmom ɔnnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ. Yɛ koso yale Kristo yali, amaa ɔnate sɔ gyidie ne aso Nyameɛ abua yɛ be, na nna kyɛ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ ti ɔ; ofikyɛ nna mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa kobua sona biala be ɔ. 17 Mmerɛ bɔ yɛbɔ mmɔden kyɛ ɔnate Kristo so bekobua yɛ be ye, na sɛ benwu yɛ kyɛ yɛte bɔnefoɛ a, né ɛhe kyire kyɛ Kristo te bɔne somvoɛ anaa? Nyameɛ pa gua! 18Yiti sɛ mesa mesi bɔ madwiri magua ne bieku a, nzaade né nde mmeraatolɛniɛ. 19 Na mede mvale mmeraa ne aso nwu mane mmeraa ne, kyɛbɔ ngɔtena ase ngɔma Nyameɛ ɔ. 20 Babɔ me ne Kristo mmeamudua nu; yiti nna me yeɛ nde ase ko ɔ, na mmom Kristo yeɛ ɔte ase wɔ me nu ɔ. Na m’ase bɔ nde ye kekesaala ye wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ye de, ɔnate gyidie wɔ Nyameɛ Awa, bɔ okuro me dwirɛ na ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane me ne anu yeɛ nde ase ɔ. 21 Membo Nyameɛ adom ne, ofikyɛ sɛ tenenee nate mmeraa ne aso yeɛ ɔba a, né nzaade Kristo awu mbaen!

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 3
Content:
Mmeraa ne anaa gyidie
1O Galatiafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔndwene ɔ! Nwa yeɛ odwumvale ɛmɔ sɔa ye; (bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔnne nahorɛ ne nni ɔ?) Aso nna ɛmɔ nyunu yeɛ behyirehyirele nu pefee kyɛ bɛbɔle Yesu Kristo mmeamudua nu ɔ? 2 Edwirɛ he yeɛ mepena kyɛ ɛmɔye ye noa ɔ: ɔnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ so yeɛ ɛmɔnyane Sunzum ne, anaakyɛ ɔnate nzɛmba bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔle belili ne aso? 3Sɔ yeɛ ɛmɔndwene ɔ? Ɛmɔfale Sunzum ne yeɛ bɛhyɛle ye bo ɔ, na nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfa anwoɔnaen beyie ɔ? 4Amaneɛ pee bɔ ɛmɔnwuni ye ne, aso wayɛ mbaen? Dabida, ɔngɔyɛ mbaen! 5 Yiti Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma ɛmɔ Sunzum ne ná ɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, anaa ɔnate nzɛmba bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔle lili ne aso?
Abraham te yɛ nhwɛsoɛ
6 “Na kyɛbɔ Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili ná obuli ye tenenee mane ye ne, 7sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɛ bɔ bele gyidie ne yeɛ bɛte Abraham bosofoɛ ɔ. 8 Na Ahyerɛlɛ ne hã tole berɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa gyidie so yeɛ okobua Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ be ɔ, na Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne lili moa sele Abraham kyɛ, “Ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ Nyameɛ koyirayira maen maen amukoraa ɔ.” 9 Abraham nyane gyidie, yiti ebiala bɔ ole gyidie ne, bayira ye ne Abraham.
10 Na ebiala bɔ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ so yeɛ ɔfa ye nwo to ne, ye yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ onni nikyee biala so kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu, ná ɔnyɔ ne, ye yaakɔ!.” 11 Afei ɔla berɛ pefee kyɛ ɔnate mmeraa ne aso de, ebiala nni be wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; ofikyɛ teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ. 12 Na mmeraa ne de, oggyi gyidie so; nakoso ebiala bɔ odi so ne okonya nu ngoa.”
13 Kristo ɔɔyɛle abusudeɛ mane yɛ, na ɔnate so wapɔ yɛ wafi mmeraa musue nu; ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Banoma sona biala bɔ basinze ye wɔ bakaa so ɔ.” 14 Na ɛhe sili kyɛbɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ kɔfa Kristo Yesu so bekonya Abraham saleɛ ne bie ɔ, amaa yafa gyidie so yanya Sunzum bɔ Nyameɛ fa bɔle anohoba ne.
Mmeraa ne ne bɔhyɛ ne
15Aliɛmaa mɔ, mefa asetena nu dwirɛ meyɛ mvandoho: sɛ ebie yɔ nzamanzeɛ na ɔfa ye sa wura ye bo a, sona biala ngora nzesã ye, yeɛ ɔngora mva bie mmoka so. 16 Abraham ne ye bosoniɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ hyɛle bɛ bɔ ɔ. Ɔnga kyɛ, “Wɔ bosofoɛ,” bɔ okyire mmeni pee; na mmom okyire sona horɛ: “Wɔ bosoniɛ,” bɔ ye ole Kristo. 17 Bɔ mekyire ɛhe: mmeraa bɔ afoɛ ɛyaa nna ne aburasa si yeɛ ɔwale ne, ɔngora mbɛ apam bɔ Nyameɛ nate Kristo so maa olili mu ne anu, na ɔmma bɔhyɛ ne nyɛ mbaen. 18 Ofikyɛ sɛ Nyameɛ agyapadeɛ ne gyi mmeraa ne aso a, nzaade oggyi bɔhyɛ so ko; nakoso Nyameɛ nate bɔhyɛ so yeɛ ɔfale agyapadeɛ ne hyɛle Abraham ɔ.
Mmeraa ne le botaeɛ
19 Afei mmeraa ne botaeɛ ole sɛɛ? Mmeraatolɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa bɛfa bɛbokale so ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ Abraham bosoniɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ bɛhyɛle bɔ ne ɔkɔwa ɔ. Nyameɛ hyehyɛle mmeraa ne, na ɔnate abɔfo mɔ so yeɛ ɔhyehyɛle ye wɔ ndamgyinaniɛ bie sa nu ɔ. 20 Ndamgyinaniɛ de ogyi mmenia nyɔ b’afia, nakoso Nyameɛ de ɔte komapɛ.
21 Aso ɛhe kyire kyɛ mmeraa ne tia Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ nemɔ anaa? Dabida! Ofikyɛ sɛ bɛmane sona mmeraa bie bɔ ɔkora ma daa ngoa de a, nzaade ahaa ɔte amba kyɛ sona nate mmeraa so yeɛ ɔyɛ tenenee ɔ. 22 Nakoso Ahyerɛlɛ ne kyire kyɛ abɔdeɛ mukoraa wura bɔne bo; kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná bafa bɔhyɛ bɔ ogyi Yesu Kristo nu gyidie so ne bama agyidifoɛ ɔ.
23 Na anzana gyidie baawa ne, bɛfale yɛ bewurale mmeraa bo bɛwɛnene yɛ bɛmane gyidie bɔ né bɛbaala ye ali bekyire ne. 24 Yiti mmeraa ne yɛle yɛ neafoɛ maa oodwuli kyɛ Kristo wale ɔ, amaa ɔnate gyidie so Nyameɛ abua yɛ be. 25 Nakoso kekesaala ye bɔ gyidie wɔ berɛ ye de, yɛwwura neafoɛ ne bo ko. 26 Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛnate gyidie so bɛte Nyameɛ mma wɔ Kristo Yesu nu. 27 Na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ babɔ ɛmɔ asu wɔ Kristo nu ne, ɛmɔafa Kristo bahera. 28 Yiti Yudaniɛ ne Helaniɛ oo, akoaa ne dehyeɛ oo, bienzua ne brasua oo, nzonzoleɛ biala nne bɛ nu ko; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛte ko wɔ Kristo Yesu nu. 29 Na sɛ ɛmɔte Kristo deɛ a, nzaade ɛmɔte Abraham bosofoɛ, na ɛmɔnate bɔhyɛ ne aso bɛte koliagyaa.

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 4
Content:
Nnɛma ɛmɔsa kɔyɛ ngoaa
1Ɛhe yeɛ mekyire ɔ: mmerɛ bɔ koliagyaa ne te akwadaa ne de, nzonzoleɛ biala nne ye ne akoaa bɛ nu, nakoso agyapadeɛ ne amukoraa te ye deɛ. 2Na ole mmenia bɔ bɛnea ye ne ye agyapadeɛ ne aso kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ye baba ne ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne. 3 Sɔ ala yeɛ né yɛte ɔ: mmerɛ bɔ né yɛte ngwadaa ne, bɛfale yɛ bɛyɛle ngoaa bewurale ewiase sunzum tumi bo. 4 Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne dwuli ne, ɔsomane Ɔwa ne maa ɔwale. Brasua yeɛ ɔwole ye ɔ, na bɛwole ye bewurale mmeraa ne abo, 5 kyɛ oole bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmeraa ne abo ne, na yɛɛyɛ Nyameɛ mma. 6 Na ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔte mmaa ne ati, Nyameɛ asoma Ɔwa ne Sunzum maa waatena ɛmɔ ahone nu, bɔ ɔtea nu kyɛ “Abba! Baba!” 7 Afei ɛtte akoaa ko, na mmom ɛte baa, na sɛ ɛte baa de a, nzaade ɔnate Kristo so ɛte Nyameɛ koliagyaa.
Galatiafoɛ nwo hia Pɔɔlo
8 Daa ne bɔ né ɛmɔnze Nyameɛ nen, ɛmɔyɛle ngoaa bɛmane abɔdeɛ mɔ bɔ nna nyameɛ mɔ ahɔ ɔ. 9 Nakoso kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔanwu Nyameɛ ye, anaa Nyameɛ anwu ɛmɔ ye de, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔsa bɛ si bieku bɛkɔ sunzum mɔ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ na bɛ nwo anwumvoin berɛ, na ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ bɛ ngoaa bieku ɔ? 10 Ɛmɔbu ngyẽa bie ne bosome biemɔ ne mmerɛ bie ne afoɛ biemɔ kyɛ bedi mu. 11 Mesuro kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ nwo fɛɛ bɔ mafɛ ne ayɛ mbaen.
12Aliɛmaa mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ me, kyɛbɔ me koso mayɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ ye. Ɛmɔyyɔle me tɛɛ biala. 13Ɛmɔse kyɛ né me nwo mva me ti yeɛ ɔmaa nnili moa ngane nzɛmba ne ngyirele ɛmɔ ɔ. 14 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ m’anwonyerɛ ne yɛle nzɔhwɛ mane ɛmɔ, nakoso ɛmɔammu me animtia, yeɛ ɛmɔambo me; na mmom ɛmɔlele me nyemene so kyɛ nyameɛso abɔfo, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ Kristo Yesu ne ala. 15Afei anika bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye ne wɔ ni? Ofikyɛ medi ɛmɔ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yé po a, ahaa ɛmɔtutuli ɛmɔ nye bɛmane me. 16 Na sɛ meka nahorɛ mekyire ɛmɔ a, nzu ati yeɛ mayɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ ɔ?
17 Sɔ mmenia nemɔ yɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ bekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ, nakoso belle ɛmɔ nwo adwene paa. Bɛpena kyɛ bɛtoto me ne ɛmɔ afia, na ɛmɔ nye aha bɛ nwo. 18Nakoso ɔte paa kyɛ mmenia konya ɛmɔ nwo adwene paa ná bahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ daa ɔ, ná nna kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ angome. 19Me mma ngwadaa, mesa medi ɛmɔ nwo yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ aworɛ aha ye ɔ kɔpem kyɛ Kristo sue ne kɔtena ɛmɔ nu ɔ. 20Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa nwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, na manwu kyɛbɔ nzi nga ye ɔ, ofikyɛ m’adwene nzi me pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo!
Pɔɔlo fa Hagar ne Sara yɛ mvandoho
21 Ɛ́mɔhã behyire me, ɛmɔ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bewura mmeraa bo ne, ɛmɔnde bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne anaa? 22 Bahyerɛ kyɛ né Abraham le mmaa mmienzua nyɔ; ko te afaneɛ awa, yeɛ ko koso te dehyeɛ awa. 23 Bɔ oni te afaneɛ ne bɛwole ye anwoɔnaen nu atee so, nakoso bɔ oni te dehyeɛ ne de, bɛnate bɔhyɛ so yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ. 24Ɛhemɔ te mvandoho, ofikyɛ mmrasua nyɔ ne gyi berɛ ma apam nyɔ. Ko bɔ ɔwo ye mma deɛ gua ngoaasolɛ nu ne ole Hagar, na ofi Sinai Bokaa ne aso. 25Hagar gyi berɛ ma Sinai bokaa ne bɔ ɔwɔ Arabia, na osa gyi berɛ ma ɛnɛ Yerusalem, ofikyɛ Yerusalem ne ye mma wɔ ngoaasolɛ nu. 26 Nakoso nyameɛso Yerusalem ne de, ɔnne ngoaasolɛ nu, na ɔte yɛ maame. 27 Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ,
“Ma wɔ nye gye, wɔ, mmotaen bɔ ɛnwo ɔ!
Di ahurusi né tea nu, wɔ bɔ ennwu aworɛ yealɛ ɔ!
Ofikyɛ brasua bɔ bɛpole ye ne,
ole mmaa pee tra brasua bɔ ogya biaa ne.”
28 Aliɛmaa mɔ, kyɛbɔ Yisake te bɔhyɛ ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso yɛte bɔhyɛ mma ɔ. 29 Na kyɛbɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne, akwadaa bɔ bɛnate anwoɔnaen nu atee so bɛwole ye ne osi tanene bɔ bɛnate Sunzum nu bɛwole ye ne nye nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛnɛ koso ɔte ɔ.
30 Nakoso Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa nzɛ? Ɔnwa, “Foa afaneɛ ne ne ɔwa ne; ofikyɛ afaneɛ n’awa ne, ɔne dehyeɛ n’awa ne, bɛngɔbɔ nu bengoli bia.” 31 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛtte afaneɛ ne mma, na mmom yɛte dehyeɛ ne mma.

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 5
Content:
Ɛ́mɔsɔ ɛmɔ fawɔnwodi nu yé
1 Kristo ama yɛ fawɔnwodi amaa yayɛ nnehyeɛ. Yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, na nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bewura ngoaasolɛ nu ko. 2 Ɛ́mɔtie! Me, Pɔɔlo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔmaa bɛpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua a, Kristo nwo ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma ɛmɔ. 3 Na mebɔ kɔkɔ bieku kyɛ, sona biala bɔ ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔpɛ ye bienzua ne, mmeraa ne kyekye ye, na ɔsɛ kyɛ odi ye mukoraa so. 4 Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ bɛfa mmeraa ne aso bebua ɛmɔ be nen, ɛmɔ ne Kristo afia atete, na Nyameɛ adom abɔ ɛmɔ. 5 Na yɛ de, gyidie yeɛ yɛfa yɛnate Sunzum ne so bɔ yanya tenenee nwo anyelasoɛ ɔ. 6 Ofikyɛ sɛ yɛne Kristo Yesu yɛ ko de a, bienzuapɛlɛ oo, nna bienzuapɛlɛ oo, ye nwo nhia, na mmom gyidie bɔ ɔnate ɔdɔ so yɔ adwuma yeɛ ohia ɔ.
7 Né ɛmɔtu amirika ne paa! Na afei nwa yeɛ osili ɛmɔ ate bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔyɛ nahorɛ ne nwo asoserɛ ɔ? 8Bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne, nna ye yeɛ osele ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ ɔ. 9 Mɔle harewaa kãa bie yeɛ ɔma mɔle torɛ ne amu keka ɔ. 10 Mede ɛmɔ medi wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ ɛmɔngonya adwene foforɛ biala. Na mmom ebiala bɔ ɔha ɛmɔ nen, sɛ ɔte nzikyɛ sona po a, okonya ye nwo akatuaa. 11 Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ mekɔ so mekã kyɛ bienzuapɛlɛ nwo hia a, nzu ati yeɛ bɛkɔ so bɛtane me nye ɔ? Nzaade ahaa mmeamudua ne sundidua ne ɔnne berɛ ko. 12Na sɛ ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa bɛ bɔ bɛsɛkye ɛmɔ adwene ne atutu bɛ bienzua bo bagua!
13 Aliɛmaa mɔ, bafrɛ ɛmɔ bawa fawɔnwodi nu; yiti nnɛmɔma fawɔnwodi ne diedie ɛmɔ kɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu, na mmom ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ so bɛso bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko. 14 Ofikyɛ babɔ mmeraa ne amukoraa porɛ komapɛ kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo.” 15Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔkeka ná ɛmɔpurapura ɛmɔ nwo de a, ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔangukũ ɛmɔ nwo.
Sunzum ne, ɔne sona sue
16 Bɔ mekã ɛhe: ɛ́mɔnate Sunzum nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔdi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ si. 17 Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ko tia Sunzum ne, na Sunzum koso ko tia anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ne. Bɛ munyɔ benyia, yiti ɔmaa ɛmɔngora nyɔ nikyee bɔ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ. 18 Nakoso sɛ Sunzum ne kyire ɛmɔ atee a, ye de nna mmeraa bo yeɛ ɛmɔwura ɔ.
19 Anwoɔnaen dwumadie bɔ odi da adi pefee.
