Bɛ ɛhe: agyaasɛkyelɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ, efiɛ, ahohwie, 20bosoensolɛ, bayie, ɛpɔen, ngondii, ahoɔyea, ɛyaafɛlɛ, pɛsɛmangomenya, ɛyakalɛ, ndoto, 21 anyeboroborolɛ, awuelilɛ, nzaabolɛ, ewiase anigye mbaen mbaen ɔne nningyein bɔ ɔtete sɔa ɔ. Mebɔ ɛmɔ ɛhemɔ nwo kɔkɔ, kyɛbɔ mabɔ ɛmɔ kɔkɔ daa ne, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu.
22 Nakoso Sunzum ne de, ɔma ɔdɔ, anigye, asomdwee, aboterɛ, adɔeɛyɛlɛ, paayɛlɛ, gyidie, 23anwobrɛaseɛ, anwohyɛsoɛ. Mmeraa biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔko tia ɛhemɔ ɔ. 24Na bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu deɛ ne, babɔ anwoɔnaen ne ne ye akɔnnɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔhyɛ anwoɔnaen ne aso mmeamudua nu. 25Sɛ Sunzum ne ama yɛ ngoa a, nzaade ɛmɔma Sunzum ne koso li yɛ nyunu wɔ asetena nu. 26 Nnɛmɔma yɛmoma yɛ nwo so, yɛfefɛ yɛ nwo yaa ná yɛma yɛ nye boro yɛ biɛngo.

Title: GALATIAFOƐ 6
Content:
Ɛ́mɔbokaboka bɛ nwo
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie yɔ bɔne a, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte sunzum nufoɛ ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa aboterɛ bɛtengyɛtengyɛ ye. Nakoso nea wɔ nwo yé ná wɔ wora angɔ nzɔhwɛ nu. 2 Ɛ́mɔbokaboka bɛ nwo, na sɔ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔdi Kristo mmeraa ne aso pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ. 3 Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ odi mu, nakoso ɔtte huu a, ɔlakalaka ye bɔbɔ ye nwo. 4 Yiti ma oso ye bɔbɔ ye adwuma nea, na ɛhe kɔmaa ɔkɔfa nikyee bɔ ye bɔbɔ wayɔ kɔhoahoa ye nwo, na ɔngɔfa ebie deɛ. 5 Ofikyɛ ebiala kɔsoa ye bɔbɔ ye adesoa. 6 Ma ebiala bɔ osua nzɛmba ne, ɔma ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ye nikyee paa biala bɔ ole ɔ bie.
7Nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka bɛ nwo, na bɛgoro Nyameɛ nwo. Ofikyɛ bɔ sona dua ne ala yeɛ okobu ɔ. 8 Na bɔ sona biala dua ye wɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu ne, okonya ewue kofi anwoɔnaen nu; nakoso bɔ odua ye wɔ Sunzum nu ne, okonya daa ngoa kofi Sunzum nu. 9 Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛfɛ paayɛlɛ nwo; ofikyɛ sɛ yamba aba a, yɛkonya ye nwo saleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu. 10 Yiti mmerɛ bɔ atee wɔ berɛ ma yɛ ye de, ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ mmenia amukoraa paa, nganga bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ agyidifoɛ abusua fekue ne anu ne.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne ahyebisalɛ
11 Ɛmɔnea ahyerɛlɛ mbiri bɔ mafa me bɔbɔ me sa mahyerɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ ye! 12 Mmenia bɔ bɛpena anwoɔnaen nu animnyam nen, bɛ yeɛ bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua ɔ. Na bɛyɔ sɔ kyɛbɔ Kristo mmeamudua ne ati mmenia ngɔtane bɛ nye ɔ. 13 Na bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ bienzua ne po, bɛ bɔbɔ benni mmeraa ne aso; nakoso bɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua, amaa ɔnate so bahoahoa bɛ nwo ɛmɔ nwonaen nu. 14 Na me de, Nyameɛ pa gua kyɛ ngɔfa nikyee bie ngɔhoahoa me nwo, sana y’Awurade Yesu Kristo mmeamudua ne ngome; ofikyɛ ɔnate mmeamudua ne aso babɔ wiase mmeamudua nu bama me, na me koso babɔ me mmeamudua nu bama wiase. 15 Sɛ ebie pɛ ye bienzua oo, wambɛ ye bienzua oo, nu biala nwo nhia; kyɛ bɛkɔwo wɔ foforɛ yeɛ ohia ɔ. 16Na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bedi nhyehyɛleɛ he aso ne, asomdwee ne anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔyɛ bɛ, ɔne Yisrael bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ deɛ ne ye deɛ.
17 Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, nnɛma ebiala ha me; ofikyɛ manya Yesu etwa wɔ me nipadua nwo.
18Aliɛmaa mɔ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ sunzum bɛtena. Amen.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo krataa bɔ ɔhyerɛ ɔɔmane Ɛfesofoɛ ne ka Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔfa abɔdeɛ mukoraati nwo dwirɛ. Ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne kyire kyɛ, ɔkɔma abɔdeɛ mukoraa kɔbɔ nu kɔyɛ ko, na wabɔ Kristo bɛ so panyi. Afei Pɔɔlo srɛ anwoteefoɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na ɔnate bɛ brabɔlɛ so Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ piri he ama adasa mmaa mukoraa ayɛ ko wɔ Kristo nu ɔ.
Pɔɔlo di moa ka koyɛlɛ nwo dwirɛ, kyɛbɔ Baba Nyameɛ aneanea nu aye ye mmenia, na ɔnate Ɔwa Yesu Kristo so wafa bɛ bɔne wahyɛ bɛ ɔ. Afei wafa Sunzum Krongron ne wasi bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔhyɛle bɛ ne agyinayɛɛ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, ɔsrɛ bɛ kyɛ bɛ koyɛlɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo nu ne, bɛma ɔla ali wɔ b’asetena nu.
Pɔɔlo fa edwirɛ to dwirɛ nwo kyirekyire anwoteefoɛ koyɛlɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo nu ɔ. Ebiemɔ ɛhe: Asɔre ne te kyɛ nipadua bɔ Kristo te ye ti ɔ; anaa ɔte kyɛ sua bɔ Kristo te ye nyinasoɛ nyɔboɛ; anaa ɔte kyɛ yeɛ bɔ Kristo te ohu ɔ.
Afei koso, Pɔɔlo ka Nyameɛ adom bɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ Kristo nu ne nwo dwirɛ. Krataa ne anu dwirɛ fa Kristo dɔ, ye afɔleɛbɔlɛ, ye bɔnefakyɛ, ye adom ɔne ye krongronyɛlɛ nwo.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Kristo ne asɔre ne 1.3—3.21
Brabɔlɛ foforɛ wɔ Kristo nu 4.1—6.20
Krataa n’ayieleɛ 6.21-24

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ne, mefa mebrɛ anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Ɛfeso bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu nu agyidifoɛ ne. 2Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Sunzum nu saleɛ wɔ Kristo nu
3 Animnyam hã Nyameɛ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, bɔ wafa sunzum nu saleɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso wayira yɛ wɔ Kristo nu ne, 4kyɛbɔ ɔneaneane nu yele yɛ wɔ ɔdɔ nu, Kristo nu koraka yeɛ bɛbaahyɛ wiase bo, kyɛ yɛyɛ krongron bɔ ngekalewa biala nne yɛ nwo wɔ ye nyunu ne. 5Na ɔneaneane nu yele yɛ siele berɛ kyɛ ɔnate Yesu Kristo so ɔkɔfa yɛ kɔyɛ ye mma, kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ botaeɛ te ne; 6 amaa ɔnate so yaye ye animnyam adom bɔ ɔnate ye ahone nu Ba ne aso wafa walo yɛ ne ayɛ. 7 Ɔnate ye mogya ne aso yeɛ wale yɛ ɔ, bɔ ye ole yɛ mvomsoɛ fahyɛlɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye adom mmorosoɛ ne te ne, 8na ɔmaa ɔbole so mane yɛ wɔ nworɛ ne nimdeɛ amukoraa nu. 9Ofikyɛ wamaa yanwu ye mvealeɛ nu apɛdeɛ, kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ botaeɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle ye wɔ Kristo nu ne ɔte ɔ. 10 Na sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne kyire kyɛ mmerɛ ne adwu kyɛ ɔkɔboaboa abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so noa ɔkɔbɔ nu wɔ Kristo nu.
11Na ye bɔ ɔyɔ ye nikyee biala kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye pɛ osi te ne, wafa Kristo so waneanea nu waye yɛ kyɛ yɛyɛ ye deɛ; 12kyɛ yɛ bɔ yɛlili moa yɛnyane Kristo nu gyidie ne yɛɛyɛ ye animnyam ne ayɛyelɛ. 13 Na ye nu yeɛ ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔtele nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ nwo nzɛmba ne ɔ. Ye ala nu koso yeɛ ɛmɔle belili ɔ, na ɔfale Sunzum Krongron bɔ wahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne hyɛle ɛmɔ nzorɛ kyɛ ɛmɔte ye deɛ, 14 bɔ osi yɛ agyapadeɛ ne agyinayɛɛ ɔ. Na ɛhe te elelɛ bɔ wafa wale bɛ bɔ wafa bɛ wayɛ ye deɛ wama ye animnyam ayɛyelɛ ne.
Pɔɔlo mbaeɛ
15 Yiti me koso, ofi mmerɛ bɔ ndele ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Awurade Yesu nu ɔne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa nwo dɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne, 16 nnyakyili ɛmɔ nwo asennaa, na mekaye ɛmɔ wɔ me mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu: 17kyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte animnyam Baba ne, ɔ́ma ɛmɔ nworɛ ne nyekyire sunzum wɔ ye nwo nimdeɛ nu, 18ná óbukye ɛmɔ adwene nu ma ɛmɔnya ndeaseɛ, amaa ɛmɔanwu anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye frɛlɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ ne anu, ɔne ye agyapadeɛ animnyam anwonya wɔ anwoteefoɛ nu. 19Mesrɛ kyɛ, ɔma ɛmɔnwu ye tumi totohyia bɔ ɔbo so ma yɛ bɔ yɛde yɛdi ne, kyɛbɔ ye anwoserɛ tumi nikyeeyɔlɛ 20 bɔ ɔfa lili dwumaa wɔ Kristo nu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ne ɔte ne. Ɔfale ye ɔɔtenane ye sa famaa so wɔ nyameɛso, 21 na ɔte ahennie, tumi, anwoserɛ ne meneɛ amukoraa so hene, ɔne dumaa biala bɔ bɛfa bɛfrɛ ɔ, bɔ nna wiase wa angome, na mmom ewiase bɔ ɔbaawa ne koso anu. 22 Na wafa nningyein amukoraa wawura Kristo gya bo, na wafa ye wayɛ nningyein amukoraa so tire wama asɔre ne, 23 bɔ ɔte ye nipadua ne, bɔ ɔma nningyein mukoraa di mu wɔ nningyein mukoraa nu ne.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 2
Content:
Ɔnate adom so yɛnya ngoa
1 Na ɛmɔ de, ahaa ɛmɔte awufoɛ wɔ mvomsoɛ ne bɔne nu, 2bɔ daa ne, ɛmɔbɔle ɛmɔ bra kyɛbɔ wiase brabɔlɛ te ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔlili ewienu tumi panyi ne si, bɔ ɔte sunzum bɔ kekesaala ye odi dwumaa wɔ asoserɛfoɛ nu ne. 3Na sɔ nningyein nemɔ anu yeɛ daa ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛfale so yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu, ná yɛlili anwoɔnaen ne adwene apɛdeɛ si ɔ; na kyɛbɔ yɛ sue te ne, yɛyɛle mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ ahone ahu bɛ so ɔ, kyɛ mmenia bɔ baha ne ala. 4Nakoso Nyameɛ bɔ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ sone ne, ɔnate ye hurolɛ bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ pee ne aso 5wama yɛ bɔ ahaa yɛte awufoɛ wɔ mvomsoɛ nu ne yɛne Kristo yanya ngoa, (adom yeɛ bafa bale ɛmɔ ngoa ɔ.) 6Na watingye yɛ ne ye, na wafa yɛ ne ye waatena nyameɛso dɔ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, 7kyɛ ewiase bɔ ɔ́ba ne anu ɔkɔla ye adom anwonya mmorosoɛ ne ali wɔ paayɛlɛ bɔ ɔyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu. 8 Na adom yeɛ bɛnate gyidie so bale ɛmɔ ngoa ɔ, nna bɔ ɛmɔayɔ hɔ ɔ, ɔte Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ; 9nna ɛmɔ nnwumaa ti ɔ, ná ebiala amva anhoahoa ye nwo. 10Ofikyɛ yɛte ye adwiililɛ bɔ wali ɔ, bɔ ɔbɔle yɛ Kristo Yesu nu mane nnwumaa paa bɔ Nyameɛ asiesie ato berɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛbɔ yɛ bra ɔ.
Yɛte ko wɔ Kristo nu
11Yiti ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, daa ne, ahaa né ɛmɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu. Na bɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ nwo bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ, bɔ bɛ sa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bɛpɛ ye anwoɔnaen nu ne, né bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ. 12 Ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛmɔ ne Kristo b’afia atete; né ɛmɔte amanvrafoɛ bɔ bɛnga ɛmɔ bɛmmoka Yisrael maen mmaa so ɔ; né ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ apam bɔhyɛ ahoroɔ ne anwo, bɔ né ɛmɔlle anyelasoɛ biala, bɔ né ɛmɔlle Nyameɛ wɔ wiase ɔ. 13Nakoso afei de, Kristo nu, ɛmɔ bɔ ahaa né ɛmɔwɔ dedeede ne, ɛmɔafa Kristo mogya ne aso bapingye. 14Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte yɛ asomdwee ɔ, wahã nyɔ ne wabɔ nu wayɛ ye ko, na wadwiri ɛpɔen fasue bɔ ɔla yɛ afia ne wagua, 15 ɔnate kyɛ waye ɛpɔen bɔ ɔte mmeraa dwirɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɔwɔ ahyɛdeɛ nu ne wafi berɛ wɔ ye nwonaen nu, na wahã bɛ munyɔ ne wabɔ nu wayɛ bɛ sona foforɛ ko, wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nu ama asomdwee awa, 16 na wafa mmeamudua ne aso wasiesie yɛ munyɔ ne ne Nyameɛ y’afia, wɔ nipadua ko nu, na ɔnate so watu ɛpɔen ne bo. 17 Na ɔwale ɔɔbɔle asomdwee nwo dawure hyirele ɛmɔ bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ dedeede ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bepingye ne; 18ofikyɛ ye so yeɛ yɛ munyɔ ne yɛnate Sunzum komapɛ nu yɛnya atee yɛkɔ Baba ne berɛ ɔ.
19Yiti afei de, ɛmɔtte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ ko, na mmom ɛmɔ ne anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bɛte maen mmaa ne Nyameɛ awuro ama. 20Bafa ɛmɔ basie asomafoɛ nemɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ fapem bɔ Yesu Kristo bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔte ye ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ne aso. 21Ye nu yeɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ ne ngorabata amukoraa basosɔ ɔ, na ɔpagya kɔ anwuro kɔyɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron wɔ Awurade nu; 22bɔ ye nu yeɛ bɛ́fa ɛmɔ koso besi maa ɔyɛ Nyameɛ atenaleɛ wɔ Sunzum nu ɔ.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 3
Content:
Pɔɔlo te Amaenmaensofoɛ somafoɛ
1Ɔnate ɛhe ati, me Pɔɔlo, nde Kristo Yesu kukununiɛ mema ɛmɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ. 2 Na mesusu kyɛ ɛmɔate Nyameɛ adwuma nwo adom bɔ ɛmɔ ti wafa walo me ne, 3kyɛbɔ ɔnate nyekyire so maa nwuni mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, kyɛbɔ mahyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ kãa dada ne. 4 Na sɛ ɛmɔkenga he a, ɛmɔkonwu kyɛbɔ mesi mete Kristo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne bo ɔ, 5mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ banna ye ali bangyire mmenia mmaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ biemɔ anu, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye de Sunzum ne waye wahyire ye asomafoɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron mɔ ne. 6Na ɛhe ma Amaenmaensofoɛ koso bele kyɛfa wɔ nu, bɛwɔ nipadua komapɛ ne ala nu bie, na bɛnate nzɛmba ne aso banya kyɛfa wɔ ye bɔhyɛ ne anu wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.
7Na nzɛmba he anwo yeɛ bayɛ me somvoɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate ye tumi adwumayɔlɛ so wafa walo me ne ɔte ne. 8Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me yeɛ nde kãa paa wɔ anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa nu ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ amaa manya sɔ adom he, kyɛ mmɔ Kristo anwonya bɔ ɔbo sona ndeaseɛ so ne dawure ngyire Amaenmaensofoɛ; 9 kyɛ mmukye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he aso ngyire adasa mmaa mukoraa, ofikyɛ ofi tete yeɛ wafea wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa ne anu ɔ; 10kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ afei ɔnate asɔre ne aso, Nyameɛ nworɛ ne kɔla ye nwo ali wɔ atee ahoroɔ so kohyire ahennie ne tumi ahoroɔ bɔ bɛwɔ anwuro dɔ ɔ. 11Na ɛhe te ye nhyehyɛleɛ afebɔɔ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so wawa nu ɔ. 12Na gyidie bɔ yanya ye wɔ Kristo nu ne ati, yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛkɔ Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ anyelasoɛ nu. 13Yiti mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ abasa nu bu wɔ amaneɛ bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti menwu ye ne anwo, ofikyɛ ɔte ɛmɔ animnyam.
Kristo dɔ
14Ɔnate ɛhe ati, mekoto mesrɛ [y’Awurade Yesu Kristo] Baba, 15bɔ ye nu yeɛ abusua biala bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so onya ye dumaa fi ne, 16kyɛ ófi ye animnyam anwonya nu ma ɛmɔfa ye Sunzum so benya tumi nu anwoserɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu, wɔ sona sue ne anu, 17amaa Kristo afa gyidie so watena ɛmɔ ahone nu, ná ɛ́mɔatira ndii batindim wɔ ɔdɔ nu, 18amaa ɛmɔahora bɛne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bate kyɛbɔ osi trɛ, osi te tendenn, osi wale, ɔne kyɛbɔ osi te kuronn ɔ bo, 19ná ɛmɔanwu Kristo ɔdɔ ne bɔ ɔbo nimdeɛ so ne, amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ sue ne amukoraa wayi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ.
20Afei ye bɔ ɔkora yɔ maa ɔtra nningyein amukoraa, maa ɔbo so tra bɔ yɛsrɛ anaa yɛsusu ne, kyɛbɔ ye tumi bɔ ɔyɔ yɛ nu adwuma te nen, 21animnyam hã ye wɔ asɔre ne anu ne Kristo Yesu nu wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu daa daa afebɔɔ. Amen.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 4
Content:
Koyɛlɛ wɔ nipadua ne anu
1Yiti afei me, Awurade kukununiɛ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔfata ɛfrɛlɛ bɔ bafa bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne, 2 anwobrɛaseɛ ne awiɛmvoɛyɛlɛ amukoraati nu, aboterɛ nu, ná ɛmɔhurohuro ebiala dwirɛ kyɛbɔ ebiala te ɔ wɔ ɔdɔ nu; 3ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ́ma Sunzum koyɛlɛ ne ɔ́tena berɛ wɔ asomdwee ngabonu nu. 4Ofikyɛ nipadua komapɛ ne Sunzum komapɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ koso wɔ anyelasoɛ komapɛ nu wɔ ɛmɔ frɛlɛ ne anu ne; 5Awurade komapɛ, gyidie komapɛ, asubɔlɛ komapɛ; 6yɛ mukoraa yɛ Nyameɛ ne Baba komapɛ bɔ odi yɛ mukoraa so ɔ, odi dwumaa wɔ yɛ mukoraa nu, na ɔte yɛ mukoraa nu.
Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ
7Nakoso bafa adom balo yɛ nu biala, kyɛbɔ Kristo asusu ye akyɛdeɛ wafa wama ɔ. 8 Yiti ɔnwa:
“Mmerɛ bɔ ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro nen;
ɔhyele pee nnure ɔne bɛ hɔle,
na ɔmane mmenia akyɛdeɛ.”
9(Na sɛ ɔkã kyɛ: Ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro a, aso né ongyire kyɛ olili moa odwu hɔle aseɛ bo dɔ koraka? 10Na bɔ odwu wale ne, ye ala yeɛ ɔfo hɔle anwuro trale nyameɛso amukoraa ne, amaa wayi nningyein amukoraa nu tɛkyɛ.) 11Na ye akyɛdeɛ ne ama ebiemɔ ayɛ asomafoɛ, ebiemɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, ebiemɔ nzɛmbahanɛfoɛ, ebiemɔ neafoɛ mɔ, yeɛ ebiemɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ, 12kyɛ bɛfa bɛtete anwoteefoɛ bɛma ɛsolɛ adwuma ne, amaa Kristo nipadua ne anya ngɔsoɛ, 13kodwu kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkonya Nyameɛ Awa ne nwo gyidie ɔne ye nwo nimdeɛ wɔ koyɛyɛlɛ nu, ná yayɛ mmenia bɔ yanyi yayie, bɔ yanya Kristo ye sue tebea ne tɛkyɛ ɔ, 14amaa ɔnate so yangɔ so yanyɛ ngwadaammaa bɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ mvrama biala ɔbɔ bɛ papapapa fa bɛ di akɔneaba ɔ, mmenia nnakannaka nu, bɔ bɛfa kanda nworɛ so bɛdɛɛdɛɛ ne. 15 Na mmom, ɛ́mɔma yɛli nahorɛ yɛfa ɔdɔ nu yɛnyi wɔ nningyein amukoraa nu, wɔ Kristo bɔ ye yeɛ ɔte tire ne anu, 16 ye bɔ ye nu yeɛ nipadua ne amukoraa ayɛ mumua, ɔnate akwaa ahoroɔ bɔ wahã watoatoa nu wasiesie so pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ ebiala ɔyɔ ye adwuma kyɛbɔ ɔfata ne ati, na ɔma nipadua ne nyi, na ɔpagya ye nwo wɔ ɔdɔ nu.
Brabɔlɛ foforɛ wɔ Kristo nu
17Yiti mesi ɛhe pi, ná medi adanzeɛ wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra ko kyɛbɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ b’adwene mbaen mbaen nu ne. 18Bɛ de, awosii akata bɛ ndeaseɛ so, na ɔnate ndeaseɛ bɔ belle bie, ná bayɛ asoserɛ ne ati, ngoa bɔ Nyameɛ fa ma ne wabɔ bɛ. 19Bɛnze nyanzoen ko, bama ahohwibra ali bɛ ti, na bɛbɔ bra fiɛ bɔ nikye fee nzi bɛ ate ɔ.
20Nakoso ɛmɔ de, nna sɔ yeɛ ɛmɔasuasua Kristo ɔ. 21Ɛmɔate ye nwo dwirɛ amba, yeɛ bayɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bahyire ɛmɔ wɔ ye nu, kyɛbɔ Yesu nu nahorɛ ne ɔte ne. 22 Brabɔlɛ daa bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ne, ɔte ɛmɔ sona sue daa, na ɔte porɔlowaa wɔ nnakannaka akɔnnɔ nu, yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bégua, 23ná ɛ́mɔma bɛyɛ ɛmɔ foforɛ wɔ ɛmɔ adwene sunzum nu, 24 ná ɛ́mɔfa sona sue foforɛ bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle ye kyɛ ye sɛso wɔ nahorɛ tenenee ne anwotelɛ nu ne bewura.
25 Yiti ɛ́mɔyakyi ngondombopɛlɛ, ná ebiala li nahorɛ ohyire obiɛngo; ofikyɛ yɛte yɛ nwo yɛ nwo akwaa. 26 Ɛ́mɔfɛ yaa, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔne! Nnɛmɔma eyia kɔtɔ ɛmɔ yaafɛlɛ so, 27nnɛmɔma abɔnzam ate! 28Nnɛma awueniɛ wua ko, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden ɔfa ye sa yɔ adwuma bɔ ɔfata ɔ; amaa wanya bie wafa waboka sona bɔ wahia ye ɔ. 29Nnɛmɔma edwirɛ fiɛ biala fi ɛmɔ noa, na mmom edwirɛ paa bɔ ɔfata ná ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ, ná walo bɛ bɔ betie ne. 30 Nyameɛ Sunzum Krongron bɔ bafa bahyɛ ɛmɔ nzorɛ bama ngoalelɛ kyẽa ne, nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ ye wora. 31Ɛ́mɔgyi amvamviri, ahonetɛɛ, ɛyaafɛlɛ, basabasayɔlɛ, ɛsoentolɛ ne bra fiɛ biala bégua. 32 Ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ, ɛ́mɔnwu ɛmɔ nwo anwumvoin, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛhyehyɛ ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ nate Kristo so wafa wahyɛ ɛmɔ ne.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 5
Content:
Ɛ́mɔbɔ anwotelɛ bra
1Yiti ɛ́mɔsua Nyameɛ, kyɛ ye mma bɔ ɛmɔla ye ahone nwo ɔ. 2 Ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso hurole yɛ dwirɛ ná ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ kyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ fonafona mane Nyameɛ ne. 3Na adwamanbɔlɛ, bra fiɛ amukoraa anaa anyeboroborolɛ nwo dwirɛ po, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ofite ɛmɔ nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔfata anwoteefoɛ ɔ. 4Nnɛmɔma nyanzoen dwirɛ, ngwaseasɛm anaa aseresɛm bɔ ɔmvata ɔ nwo dwirɛ fite ɛmɔ nu, na mmom asennaa. 5Ofikyɛ ɛmɔse ye dada kyɛ, adwamanbɔlɛniɛ anaa bra fiɛ bɔlɛniɛ anaa anyeboroborolɛniɛ (bɔ ɔte bosoensolɛniɛ) biala nne berɛ bɔ ole agyapadeɛ wɔ Kristo ne Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ɔ.
6Nnɛmɔma ebiala fa edwirɛ mbaen mbaen lakalaka ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ati yeɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ba asoserɛfoɛ so ɔ. 7Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɛbɔ afɛ; 8ofikyɛ daa ne, né ɛmɔte awosii, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔte kanea wɔ Awurade nu. Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ kanea mma, 9ofikyɛ kanea mmaa bɔ osu ne, ɔda ali wɔ bra paa ne tenenee ne nahorɛ amukoraa nu; 10na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔso bɔ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ne bɛnea. 11Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ awosii nnwumaa bɔ onzu mmaa ne bie, na mmom ɛ́mɔpa bɛ nwo tena! 12Ofikyɛ bra bɔ bɛbɔ ye mvealeɛ nu ne, ɔyɛ nya kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ noa bɛkɔbɔ so ɔ. 13Na nikyee biala bɔ kanea kɔpa ye nwo tena nen, ɔda ali pefee, ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ bɛda ye ali ne, ɔte kanea. 14 Ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔkã kyɛ,
“Wɔ bɔ alafe ne, tingye,
ná dwɔso fi awufoɛ nu,
na Kristo kɔta kɔma wɔ.”
15Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔnate so ɔ nwo; nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛnze nworɛ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ nworɛfoɛ. 16 Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ mmerɛ so yé, ofikyɛ ngyẽa ne te ngyẽa tɛɛ. 17Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ mmenia bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu ɔ, na mmom ɛ́mɔyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛte Awurade apɛdeɛ bo ɔ.
18Nnɛma ɛmɔbo nzaa, ofikyɛ ɔne basabasayɔlɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; na mmom ɛ́mɔma Sunzum ne oyi ɛmɔ tɛkyɛ. 19 Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo dwein, ayɛyelɛ dwein ne sunzum nu dwein bedwudwo behyirehyire ɛmɔ nwo; ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa bɛto Awurade nwo dwein; 20na mmerɛ biala ne nikyee biala nu, ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma Baba Nyameɛ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa nu. 21Na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa Kristo nu esurolɛ nu bɛbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛmoma bɛ nwo.
Yeɛ mɔ
22 Yeɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Awurade ne. 23Ofikyɛ huɛ ne ɔte yeɛ ne ti, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso ɔte asɔre ne ti ne, na ye yeɛ ɔte Ngoadefoɛ ma nipadua ne ɔ. 24Na kyɛbɔ asɔre ne brɛ ye nwo ase ma Kristo nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yeɛ mɔ koso bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase atee biala so bɛma bɛ hu mɔ ɔ.
Huɛ mɔ
25 Huɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔhuro ɛmɔ aye mɔ, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso hurole asɔre ne dwirɛ, ná ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane ye, 26kyɛbɔ ɔkɔfa nzue ebialɛ nu kɔte ye nwo wɔ edwirɛ ne anu kɔyɛ ye krongron ɔ, 27kyɛbɔ okosiesie asɔre ne animnyam nu kɔma ye nwo, bɔ ngekalewa anaa ɛpombonɛ, anaa nikyee fiɛ biala nne ye nwo, na mmom wayɛ krongron bɔ mvomsoɛ nne ye nwo ɔ. 28Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ huɛ mɔ bekuro bɛ ye mɔ dwirɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nipadua ɔ. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ okuro ɔye dwirɛ nen, okuro ye bɔbɔ ye nwo dwirɛ. 29Na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔpɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nwonaen ɔ, na mmom ɔma ye aleɛ, ɔnea so yé, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso ɔyɛ asɔre nen. 30Ofikyɛ yɛte ye nipadua n’akwaa. 31 Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ bienzua kɔyakyi ɔse ne oni berɛ, ná wafa ye nwo waabata ɔye nwo, ná bɛ munyɔ bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko. 32Ɛhe te mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ piri paa, na me de, Kristo ne asɔre ne nwo dwirɛ mmom yeɛ mekã ɔ. 33Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala kuro ɔye dwirɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo, na yeɛ ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa anidie ma ohu.

Title: ƐFESOFOƐ 6
Content:
Mmaa ne awofoɛ
1 Mmaa, ɛ́mɔtie ɛmɔ awofoɛ dwirɛ wɔ Awurade nu, ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ. 2 “Di ɛse ne eni ni” (ɛhe te mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ oli moa bɔ bɔhyɛ bata ye nwo ɔ), 3“amaa wayie wɔ yé, ná anyi ahyɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso.” 4 Seɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔhu ɛmɔ mma mɔ b’ahone, na mmom ɛ́mɔtete bɛ wɔ Awurade ndeteyɛɛ ne foɛtulɛ nu.
Ngoaa ne meneɛ
5 Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛ́fa esuronyi ne anwowosolɛ bɛ́yɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ anwoɔnan nu meneɛ mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Kristo ne; 6nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ solɛ ne ɔyɛ bɛ nye so nikyee mbaen, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ mmenia nye ɔ, na mmom kyɛ Kristo ngoaa bɔ baye b’ahone nu bɛyɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ, 7bɔ baye bɛ kunu sefaa bɛyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma, kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma Awurade, na nna kuro sona ɔ. 8Na ɛmɔse kyɛ nikye paa biala bɔ sona yɔ ne, sɛ ɔte akoaa oo, dehyeɛ oo, okonya ye nwo akatuaa kofi Awurade berɛ.
9 Meneɛ mɔ, ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɛ bɛ sɔ ala, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ bɛ so ahupoo; ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ ne bɛ Meneɛ ne ɔwɔ nyameɛso, bɔ ye de, ɔnyɛ mmenia nu nyeyemuɛ ɔ.
Nyameɛ akodeɛ
10Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo yɛ se wɔ Awurade nu, ɔne ye anwoserɛ tumi ne anu. 11Ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ akodeɛ ne amukoraa bewura, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina baho batia abɔnzam nnakannaka. 12Ofikyɛ nna yɛne anwoɔnaen ne mogya yeɛ yɛdi ahoɛ ɔ; na mmom yɛne mbanyililɛ ne tumi mɔ ne ewiase awosii nu tumifoɛ ne ewienu dɔ sunzummɔne mɔ. 13Yiti ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ akodeɛ ne amukoraa bewura, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina wɔ kyẽa tɛɛ ne anu; na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhe amukoraa beyie a, né ɛmɔagyina pirim. 14 Yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, ɛ́mɔfa nahorɛ bɛyɛ abɔsoɛ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ yaase, ná ɛ́mɔfa tenenee bɛyɛ buralɛ bɛkata ɛmɔ hue so, 15 ná ɛ́mɔfa asomdwee nzɛmba ne nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ bɛyɛ mbaboa bewura. 16Na ɛhe amukoraa si ne, ɛ́mɔfa gyidie akokyɛm bétira, na ye yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔfa bekonua bɔnefoɛ n’agyaen mɔ bɔ begye ne amukoraa ɔ. 17 Ɛ́mɔfa ngoalelɛ buralɛ kyerɛ, ɔne Sunzum ngrandɛ ne, bɔ ye ole Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne. 18Ɛ́mɔfa mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne ngotosrɛ amukoraa bɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ daa wɔ Sunzum nu. Yiti ɛ́mɔwɛne, ná ɛmɔhɔ so bɛsrɛ bɛma anwoteefoɛ amukoraa, 19yeɛ ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma me koso, amaa sɛ mebukye me noa kyɛ medwudwo a, bama me dwirɛ bɔ nga ɔ, ná mahora masi m’ahone mabɔ nzɛmba ne anu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne dawure; 20bɔ ye nwo bɔfoɛ bɔ nde ti yeɛ bagua me ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ye; amaa mahora masi m’ahone mahã, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekã ɔ.
Ngraalilɛ
21 Na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkonwu kyɛbɔ me nwo si te ɔ, ɔne bɔ meyɔ ne, aliɛmaa dɔfo Tihiko, bɔ ɔte Awurade nu somvoɛ nahorɛniɛ ne, ɔkɔfa ye mukoraa nwo amaneɛ kɔbɔ ɛmɔ. 22Na ɛhe ati yeɛ masoma ye ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛbɔ yɛ nwo si te ɔ, ná wakyekye ɛmɔ wora.
23Asomdwee ne ɔdɔ ne gyidie bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. 24Bɛ bɔ befi b’ahone nu bekuro y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dwirɛ amukoraa ne, adom ɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.

Title: FILIPIFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle nwomaa he ɔɔmane Filipi asɔre, bɔ yeɛ ɔte asɔre bɔ olili moa tele wɔ Roman manzini bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Makedonia nu ne. Ɔhyerɛle nwomaa ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔla kuku nu na ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛka Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne tane ye nye ɔ. Né ngondombo ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ebiemɔ yɔ wɔ Filipi asɔre ne anu koso ha ye paa. Nakoso anika ne awerɛhyɛm dwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nwomaa ne anu maa yɛnwu kyɛ Pɔɔlo gyidie bɔ ole ye Kristo nu ne te piri paa.
Edwirɛ deinn bɔ Pɔɔlo gyi so hyerɛle nwomaa he ne te asennaa bɔ né ɔpena kyɛ ɔfa kɔma Filipifoɛ asɔre ne ɔ. Filipi asɔre ne ɔɔhyɛle ye nningyein wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ye nwo hyerele ye ne anu. Osele bɛ kyɛ bɛma b’ahone tɔ bɛ kunu na benya aworakyekyerɛ wɔ ye anwokyere ɔne bɛ koso bɛ deɛ ne anu. Ɔsrɛle bɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ anwobrɛaseɛ kyɛbɔ Yesu yɛle ne, na nnɛma bɛfa nduhoɛ ne pɛsɛmangomenya bɛbɔ bɛ bra. Ɔkayele bɛ koso kyɛ yɛne Kristo abiɛngoɛfalɛ ne te Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate gyidie so wafa walo yɛ ɔ, na mmom ɔnnate Yudafoɛ mmeraa ne anu amanneɛ so lilɛ so. Afei koso ɔka anika ne asomdwee bɔ Nyameɛ fa ma bɛ bɔ bɛ ne Kristo nya abiɛngoɛfalɛ ne nwo dwirɛ.
Nwomaa he kyirekyire anika, awerɛhyɛm, koyɛlɛ ɔne Kristoniɛ gyidie ne ye brabɔlɛ nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ. Osa kyire ehurolɛ bɔ nu yɛ se bɔ Pɔɔlo fa kuro Filipi asɔremma ne dwirɛ ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-11
Pɔɔlo asetena nu dwirɛ 1.12-26
Kristo nu brabɔlɛ 1.27—2.18
Timoteo ne Epafrodito 2.19-30
Pɔfoɛ ne musue nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ 3.1—4.9
Pɔɔlo ne ye damvo mɔ Filipifoɛ 4.10-20
Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ 4.21-23

Title: FILIPIFOƐ 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Pɔɔlo ne Timoteo, bɔ yɛte Kristo Yesu ngoaa, yɛfa yɛbrɛ Kristo Yesu nu anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Filipi, bɔ neafoɛ mɔ ne asomvoɛ mɔ bɛboka so ɔ. 2Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Pɔɔlo bɔ mbaeɛ ma Filipi agyidifoɛ
3Ngayeɛ bɔ mekaye ɛmɔ amukoraa nu ne, meda me Nyameɛ ase. 4Daa biala, me mbaeɛbɔlɛ amukoraa nu, mebɔ mbaeɛ mema ɛmɔ amukoraa wɔ anigye so; 5ɔnate ɛmɔ abiɛngoɛfalɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ye wɔ nzɛmba ne anu fi kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ ne ati; 6na mede medi kyɛ, ye bɔ ɔhyɛle adwuma paa bo wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔyɔ koyie maa okoodwu Yesu Kristo kyẽa ne. 7Ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo, yiti ɔte paa kyɛ medwene ɛmɔ amukoraa nwo sɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔ ne me yanya kyɛfa wɔ adom ne anu, me kuku nu nnaa nu, ɔne mmerɛ bɔ ngyinane pindinn mane nzɛmba ne, ná nzili so ngane ne. 8Nyameɛ di me adanzeɛ, kyɛ Kristo Yesu nu ɔdɔ yeɛ ngyi so bɔ me wora dɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɔ.
9Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ, ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne ɔkɔhɔ so konyi wɔ nimdeɛ ne ndeaseɛ amukoraa nu, 10amaa ɛmɔahora banwu nningyein bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔayɛ mmenia bɔ ɛmɔ bra te sannwuu bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ɛmɔ nwo ɔ, maa waadwu Kristo kyẽa ne, 11ná tenenee mmaa bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo so yeɛ ɔba ne, wayi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ wayɛ animnyam ne asennaa wama Nyameɛ.
Yɛte ase yɛma Kristo
12Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɔ wato me ne, waboka wama nzɛmba ne atrɛ mmom, 13 na ɔnate so wala ali wɔ amrado ahemviefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa nu ne mmenia ngaa nemɔ anu kyɛ, Kristo ti yeɛ nna kukunu ɔ, 14na ɔnate me kukunu nnaa ne ati, aliɛmaa nemɔ nu pee bɔ bɛwɔ Kristo nu ne banya nguraenhyɛ, na bɛkora besi bɛ hue bɛkã Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne bɔ benzuro hwee ɔ.
15Ɔte amba kyɛ, ebiemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ bele sona nwo anyeboro ne apereapereɛ yeɛ bɛkã Kristo nwo dwirɛ ne ɔ, nakoso ebiemɔ de, bele adwene paa yeɛ bɛkã ɔ. 16Na bɛ bɔ bele adwene paa yeɛ bɛkã ne, befi ɔdɔ nu yeɛ bɛkã ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛse kyɛ nzɛmba ne nwo adanzeɛlilɛ ti yeɛ nna nu wa ye; 17nakoso ebiemɔ de, bɛkã Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne ngondii so, bɛnga ye nahorɛ nu, na bɛdwene kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ a bɛkɔma me nwo kɔhyere me wɔ me kukunu nna ye anu.
18Onhia po! Atee biala so, kyɛ bɛpati bɛyɔ oo, anaakyɛ bɛyɔ ye nahorɛ nu oo, Kristo nwo dwirɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ bɛkã ɔ; na ɛhe maa medi ahurusi, amba, ngɔhɔ so ngoli ahurusi. 19Ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne Yesu Kristo Sunzum mmokalɛ so, ɛhe kɔkakyi ngoalelɛ kɔma me, 20kyɛbɔ m’anyelasoɛ paa ne nikyee bɔ menea ye ate ne ɔte ne, kyɛ me nyunu ngogua ase wɔ nikyee biala nu, na mmom ngonya ahoneserɛ, kyɛbɔ daa ɔte ne, kekesaala ye koso, na sɛ nde ase oo, sɛ mewu oo, bɛkɔkamvo Kristo wɔ me nipadua nu. 21Na me de, nde ase ma Kristo, na ewue te mvasoɛ ma me. 22Na sɛ ase bɔ nde wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ye, yeɛ ɔmaa menya ngɔsoɛ wɔ m’adwuma nu a, ye de né mennwu bɛ nu horɛ bɔ mva ɔ. 23Ɛhe amaa mayɛ anianiani. Ahaa mekuro kyɛ ngofi wa me ne Kristo yɛkɔɔtena, ofikyɛ ɛhene mmom yeɛ ɔte paa koraa ɔ, 24nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti ohia kyɛ mekɔ so metena ase anwoɔnaen nu ɔ. 25Mesi pi wɔ ɛhe anwo, na mese kyɛ ngɔhɔ so ngɔtena ase, na me ne ɛmɔ amukoraa yɛkɔhɔ so yɛkɔtena, ná ɛmɔanya ngɔsoɛ ne gyidie nu anigye, 26amaa ɔnate me ti ɛmɔahoahoa ɛmɔ nwo mmorosoɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, ɔnate ɛwalɛ bɔ mebaawa ɛmɔ berɛ bieku ne ati.
27Nzaade ohia kyɛ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ fata Kristo nzɛmba ne, amaa sɛ mebapasa ɛmɔ nwo oo, sɛ mamma oo, mate ɛmɔ nga kyɛ ɛmɔagyina pindinn wɔ sunzum ko nu, bɔ ɛmɔayɛ adwene ko bɛpere bɛma nzɛmba ne nwo gyidie, 28bɔ ɛmɔmma ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bennwunanwuna ɛmɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ. Na ɛhe te eminilɛ bɔ bekomini ne nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ma bɛ; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɔte ngoalelɛ bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ma ɛmɔ. 29Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ de, bafa balo ɛmɔ kyɛ ɔnate Kristo ti, nna kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔde ye bedi ngome, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ye ti ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ koso; 30 ofikyɛ koɛ komapɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwuni kyɛ meko, ná afei ɛmɔkɔ so bɛte kyɛ nwɔ nu ne, ye ala yeɛ ɛmɔko ɔ.

Title: FILIPIFOƐ 2
Content:
Kristo anwobrɛaseɛ ne ye tumi
1Yiti sɛ Kristo nu nguraenhyɛlɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ ɔdɔ aworakyekyerɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ Sunzum nu abiɛngoɛfalɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ ahunundetelɛ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ bie wɔ berɛ a, 2ye de, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene adwene ko, ɛmɔnya ɔdɔ ko, ɛmɔnya koyɛlɛ ne adwene ko maa m’anigye osi pi. 3Nnɛma ɛmɔfa pɛsɛmangomenya anaa nduhoɛ bɛyɔ nikyee biala, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ adwene bebu ɛmɔ mmango mɔ bɛtra ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo. 4Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala pena ye ngome ye deɛ, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma ye mmango deɛ koso hia ye.
5Ɛ́mɔma adwene bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne ala yeɛ ɔ́tena ɛmɔ nu ɔ.
6Ye bɔ ɔwɔ Nyameɛ tebea nu de,
nakoso wambere wanyɛ ye nwo kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛte pɛ ɔ,
7na mmom ɔfale ye dibea tole berɛ
fale akoaa tebea tole ye nwo so,
na bɛwole ye maa ɔɔyɛle dasaniɛ ye sɛso.
8Benwuni ye kyɛbɔ kuro sona osi soma ɔ,
ɔbrɛle ye nwo ase,
na ɔyɛle asoɛmmerɛlɛ fa hɔle ewue nu,
mmeamudua ne aso wue nu po.
9Ye sɔ ati, Nyameɛ koso apagya ye piri paa,
na wama ye dumaa bɔ ɔbo dumaa biala so ɔ,
10 kyɛ Yesu dumaa nu yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ nangoroma mukoraa bɛkoto,
bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso, bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ so, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ɔ,
11na noa biala ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔkã ye pefee
kyɛ Yesu Kristo te Awurade
ná ɔfa hyɛ Baba Nyameɛ animnyam.
Ngoalelɛ nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ
12Yiti mmiɛngo paa mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie daa ne, nna kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ ne angome, na mmom afei bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ye de po, ɔtra so; ɛ́mɔfa esuronyi ne anwowosowolɛ béli ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ nwo dwumaa ma oli mu, 13ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ adwumaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu maa ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ, ná ɛmɔyɔ nnwumaa kyɛbɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.
14Nnɛma ɛmɔfa nwuhunwuhu ne aporowaasulɛ bɛyɔ nikyee biala, 15 amaa ɛmɔayɛ mmenia bɔ edwirɛ nne bɛ nwo bɔ bɛ nwo sonn, Nyameɛ mma bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ɛmɔ nwo wɔ bɔnefoɛ maen bɔ bali makyebu, bɔ ɛmɔta wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ wiase, 16wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔtira ngoa dwirɛ ne anu serɛserɛ ɔ; amaa wayɛ m’anwohoahoa wɔ Kristo kyẽa ne, kyɛ amirika bɔ nduli ne wanyɛ mbaen, yeɛ me fɛɛ adwumaa ne koso wanyɛ mbaen.
17Na sɛ ɔba kyɛ behwie me begua kyɛ afɔlebɔdeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie solɛ nwo a, ɔyɛ me fɛ, na me ne ɛmɔ amukoraa yɛdi ahurusi. 18Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nye gye, ná ɛmɔ ne me yɛdi ahurusi ɔ.
Pɔɔlo soma Timoteo ne Epafrodito
19Me nye la so wɔ Awurade Yesu nu, kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔsoma Timoteo maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, na sɛ ɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amaneɛ babɔ me a, ɔkɔma me wora kɔkyekye. 20Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔne m’adwene te ko, kyɛ ye bɔ ɛmɔ yeeyɛlɛ hia ye ɔ. 21Bɛ mukoraa bɛpena bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, na mmom nna bɔ ɔte Yesu Kristo deɛ ɔ. 22Nakoso ɛmɔ de, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔdi ye nwo adanzeɛ ne, ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ yasi yayɛ kyɛ seɛ ne baa bɔ yɛso wɔ nzɛmba ne nwo ɔ. 23Sɛ menya menwu kyɛbɔ me dwirɛ ne ɔkwaasi pɛ a, ye yeɛ me nye la ye so kyɛ ngɔsoma ye ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. 24Na m’anyelasoɛ wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala me bɔbɔ koso ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.
25Nakoso madwene ye nwo kyɛ ohia kyɛ mesoma nniɛma Epafrodito ɛmɔ berɛ. Ɔte mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ ne mmiɛngo asraaniɛ, ɛmɔ bɔfoɛ ne me bokafoɛ;. 26ofikyɛ ye wora dɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa, na ɔha ye kyɛ ɛmɔtele kyɛ anwonyerɛ bɔle ye ɔ. 27Amba, ewue anwonyerɛ bɔle ye. Nakoso Nyameɛ nwuni ye anwumvoin; nna ye ngome, na me koso onwuni me anwumvoin bie, na wamma me wora ammɔ somaa. 28Na ɛhe ati po yeɛ ɔmaa mabɔ mmɔden masoma ye ɔ, amaa sɛ ɛmɔnwu ye bieku a, ɛmɔ nye agye, ná me koso m’aworabɔlɛ ne so ate. 29Yiti ɛ́mɔle ye nyemene so wɔ Awurade nu, na ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma mmenia bɔ bɛte kyɛ ye ne amukoraa. 30Ofikyɛ, Kristo adwuma ne ati ɔhale kãa maa owuli, na ɔfale ye ngoa tole serewa gyinane ɛmɔ gya nu kyɛ ɔkɔso me.

Title: FILIPIFOƐ 3
Content:
Tenenee bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye wɔ Awurade nu. Ɔnha me kyɛ ngosa ngɔhyerɛ nikyee komapɛ ne ala ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na ye sɔ te paa ma ɛmɔ. 2Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ngyea nemɔ nwo; ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔnefoɛ nemɔ nwo, ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne. 3Ofikyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛte bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ ɔ, bɔ yɛsɔne Nyameɛ wɔ sunzum nu, bɔ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, ná yɛmva yɛ nwo yɛndo anwoɔnaen so ɔ. 4Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me bɔbɔ koso, ahaa nne anwoɔnaen nu nikyee bie bɔ mefa me nwo meto so ɔ. Na sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ ole anwoɔnaen nu nikyee bie bɔ ɔfa ye nwo to so a, me deɛ de ɔtra so. 5 Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso yeɛ bɛpɛle me bienzua ɔ. Mvi Yisrael bosofoɛ nu, mvi Benyamin abusua kure nu, Hebrifoɛ nu Hebriniɛ; na mmeraa ne aso lilɛ de, nde Farasiiniɛ; 6 mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ndanene asɔre ne nye; mmeraa ne anu tenenee koso, me nwo sonn. 7Nakoso nningyein bɔ ahaa ɔte mvasoɛ ma me ne, Kristo ti mebu ye kyɛ wafi me sa. 8Amba, ɔnate m’Awurade Kristo Yesu nwo nimdeɛ mmorosoɛ ne ati, mebu nningyein amukoraa kyɛ bafi me sa. Ɔnate ye ti nningyein amukoraa afi me sa, nakoso mebu bɛ kyɛ fofoɛ so wura mbaen, amaa ɔnate so manya Kristo; 9amaa wanwu me wɔ ye nu, kyɛ me de, nnne me bɔbɔ me tenenee bɔ ofi mmeraa ne anu ɔ, na mmom bɔ ɔnate Kristo nu gyidie so ɔba ɔ, tenenee bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ, bɔ ɔnate gyidie so ɔ. 10Me botaeɛ ole kyɛ ngonwu ye ne ye wutingyelɛ tumi ne, kyɛ ngonwu ye amaneɛ ne bie, kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ngɔyɛ kyɛ ye wɔ ewue nu, 11ná sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yee a, manya awufoɛ nu ewutingyelɛ ne.
Tu amirika kɔ botaeɛ ne nwo
12Nna kyɛ ebiaa me sa anya ahã ye, anaakyɛ mali mu mayie ɔ; na mmom mepere mekɔ me nyunu kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ me deɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ Kristo Yesu koso wafa me wayɛ ye deɛ ne. 13Aliɛmaa mɔ, menzusu kyɛ wanya wayɛ me deɛ; nakoso nikyee komapɛ yeɛ meyɔ ɔ: mema me wora fi bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ɔ, na metwe me nu kyɛ ngodwu bɔ ɔla me nyunu ne anwo ɔ. 14Mepere mekɔ me nyunu kyɛ ngodwu botaeɛ ne anwo ngonya ngonimlilɛ abasobɔdeɛ ne, bɔ ɔte anwuro frɛlɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nate Yesu Kristo so wafrɛ me ne.
15Yiti yɛ nu pee bɔ yanyi wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛnya sɔ adwene ne, na sɛ ɛmɔle adwene foforɛ wɔ nikyee bie nwo a, ye koso Nyameɛ kɔla ye ali kohyire ɛmɔ. 16Nakoso bɔ yanya ye dada ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ so yɛsɔ nu bum.
17 Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔsuasua me, ná ɛ́mɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sɔ ala ne, kyɛbɔ yɛte nhwɛsoɛ ma ɛmɔ ne. 18Mali moa mahã edwirɛ he mahyire ɛmɔ pee paa, na kekesaala ye koso, nne me nye moen mesi so bieku kyɛ, mmenia pee wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛ brabɔlɛ maa bɛyɛ Kristo mmeamudua ne pɔfoɛ ɔ. 19Bɛ yeɛ b’ayieleɛ te ɛsɛkyelɛ ɔ, bɛ nyameɛ ole bɛ ko, b’animguaseɛ nu yeɛ b’animnyam wɔ ɔ, na aseɛ so nningyein ngome yeɛ bɛdwene ye nwo ɔ. 20Nakoso yɛ de, nyameɛso yeɛ ɔte yɛ maen ɔ. Berɛ yeɛ yɛnwondɛ kyɛ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ bɔ ye ole Awurade Yesu Kristo ne okofi kɔwa ɔ; 21na tumi bɔ ɔkora maa ɔfa nnningyein amukoraa wura ye bo ne, ɔkɔfa kɔsakyera yɛ awiɛmvoɛ nipadua ne maa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ye animnyam nipadua ne.

Title: FILIPIFOƐ 4
Content:
Foɛtulɛ
1Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ná me wora dɔ ɛmɔ ɔ, m’anigyeɛ ne m’abotire; ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ Awurade nu.
2Mekoto mesrɛ Yiwodia, yeɛ mekoto mesrɛ Sintike kyɛ bɛma b’adwene yɛ ko wɔ Awurade nu. 3Yeɛ mesrɛ wɔ koso, mmiɛngo konnuasoalɛniɛ nohorɛniɛ, kyɛ boka mmrasua hemɔ, ofikyɛ bɛbokale me so yeɛ yɛyɔle nzɛmba ne nwo adwuma ɔ, bɛne Klɛmente ne mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ ngoa nwomaa ne anu ne.
4Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye wɔ Awurade nu daa. Mesi so bieku kyɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye! 5Ɛ́mɔma mmenia amukoraa bénwu ɛmɔ animia ne. Awurade apingye! 6Nnɛmɔma nikye fee ha ɛmɔ; na mmom nikyee biala nu, ɛ́mɔfa mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne ngotosrɛ ne asennaa bɛ́fa bɔ ohia ɛmɔ ɔ bɛ́to Nyameɛ nyunu. 7Na Nyameɛ asomdwee bɔ ɔbo ndeaseɛ amukoraa so ne, ɔkɔnea ɛmɔ ahone ne ɛmɔ adwene so wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.
8Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, medwura edwirɛ ne kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɔte nahorɛ, bɔ ɔte animnyam, bɔ ɔtengyɛ, bɔ ye nwo te, bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene, bɔ ole dumaa paa; sɛ bra paa bie wɔ berɛ a, sɛ ayɛyelɛ bie wɔ berɛ a, sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene bɛ nwo ɔ. 9Bɔ ɛmɔasua ne bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ɔne bɔ ɛmɔate ne bɔ ɛmɔanwu ye wɔ me nwo ne, ye ala ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ. Na asomdwee Nyameɛ ne ɛmɔ kɔtena.
Pɔɔlo da Filipifoɛ ase
10Ɔyɛ me fɛ paa wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ afei de ɛmɔasa bahyɛ ye bo bɛdwene me nwo bieku ɔ; ɛmɔdwene me nwo de, nakoso atee amma nu amma ɛmɔ. 11Mengyire kyɛ me nwo ahyere me ti ɔ, ofikyɛ me de, masua maa wakokwa me, bɔ tebea biala bɔ nwɔ nu ne mema me nye gye ɔ. 12Manwu anwokyere, yeɛ manwu anwonya koso. Nekaa biala ne nikyee biala nu, sɛ ɛhɔen yeɛ oku me oo, sɛ me ko yi oo; sɛ nne bie oo, sɛ nnne bie oo, wakokwa me, 13na mekora meyɔ nnningyein amukoraa wɔ Kristo bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ne anu.
14Nakoso ɔte paa kyɛ ɛmɔbokale me wɔ m’anwokyere nu ɔ. 15Na ɛmɔ Filipifoɛ koso, ɛmɔse kyɛ nzɛmba n’ahyɛseɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ mvili Makedonia ngɔle ne, asɔre biala wammoka me wɔ akyɛdeɛ manɛ ne ye lelɛ nu, sana ɛmɔ ngome ala. 16 Na mmerɛ bɔ né nwɔ Tɛsalonika ne po, ɛmɔsomane maa bɛfale bɔ ohia me ɔ bɛbrɛle me ye pɛen ko ne ye pɛen nyɔ so. 17Nna kyɛ mepena akyɛdeɛ hɔ ɔ; na mmom mepena mmaa bɔ ɔkɔma ɛmɔ ngondaa ne kɔsone ɔ. 18 Manya pee, na manya ye mukoraa maa wabo so, ɔsone. Epafrodito afa ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa manene ne wabrɛ me. Ɔte ayɛyɛdeɛ fonafona, afɔlebɔdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ná ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. 19Na me Nyameɛ kɔma ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhia amukoraa, kyɛbɔ ye anwonya ne te ɔ, animnyam nu, wɔ Kristo Yesu nu. 20Animnyam hã yɛ Baba Nyameɛ daa. Amen.
Ngraa
21Ɛ́mɔbisa anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa ahye wɔ Kristo Yesu nu bɛ́ma me. Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛne me wɔ wa ne koso bebisa ɛmɔ ahye. 22Anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bebisa ɛmɔ ahye, nganga bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Kaesare awuro ne. 23Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɔne ɛmɔ sunzum tena. Amen.

Title: KOLOSEFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle krataa he ɔɔmane Kolose asɔrefoɛ. Kolose pingye Ɛfeso. Nna Pɔɔlo yeɛ ɔɔtele Kolose asɔre ne ɔ. Na mmom ye mmango nzɛmbahanɛfoɛ ne bie yeɛ ɔfale nzɛmba ne hɔle berɛ ɔ. Pɔɔlo tele kyɛ ngondombo akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ biemɔ ahɔ Kolose baayɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ. Sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nemɔ bie ɛhe: Ɔsɛ kyɛ sona sɔne wiase sunzummɔne mɔ, ɔpɛ ye bienzua, okyi aleɛ biemɔ, ɔne kyɛ okobu kyẽa bie kyɛ odi mu tra ngyẽa biemɔ ɔ. Bekyire kyɛ sɛ sona di ɛhemɔ amu so a, yeɛ okonya ngoa bɔ odi mu ɔ.
Yiti Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he ootiale bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anu, kyɛ sɛ sona di sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ hemɔ so a, ongonya daa ngoa. Na mmom Yesu Kristo ngome twe yeɛ ɔte wiase amukoraa Ngoadefoɛ ɔ. Ofikyɛ Yesu Kristo yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ Awa ɔ, na Nyameɛ fale ye so yeɛ ɔbɔle wiase ɔ. Afei ɔnate ye so yeɛ ɔhane ewiase batale ye nwo ɔ (2 Kor 5.18).
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-8
Kristo sue ne ye adwuma 1.9—2.19
Kristo nu ngoa foforɛ 2.20—4.6
Ayieleɛ 4.7-18

Title: KOLOSEFOƐ 1
Content:
Pɔɔlo bisa Kolosefoɛ ahye
1 Me Pɔɔlo, ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ɔ. Krataa he fi me ne aliɛmaa Timoteo berɛ. 2Yɛfa yɛbrɛ anwoteefoɛ ne aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bedi nahorɛ wɔ Kristo nu bɔ bɛwɔ Kolose ɔ. Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ [ne Awurade Yesu Kristo] berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Asennaa
3Daa biala sɛ yɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ yɛma ɛmɔ a, yɛfa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne. 4Ofikyɛ yate ɛmɔ gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, ɔne ehurolɛ bɔ ɛmɔkuro anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɛ dwirɛ ne nga; 5ɔnate anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ma ɛmɔ wɔ nyameɛso. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔate ye dada wɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ye ole nzɛmba ne, 6bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ne anu. Na onyi, yeɛ osu mmaa wɔ wiase amukoraa, kyɛbɔ wasu mmaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu fi kyẽa bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔnwuni Nyameɛ adom wɔ nahorɛ nu ne, 7kyɛbɔ ɛmɔasua bafi y’eliɛma somvoɛ Epafra, bɔ ɔte Kristo somvoɛ nahorɛniɛ ma ɛmɔ ne berɛ ɔ. 8Na wasa wahã ɛmɔ ɔdɔ bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron berɛ ne nwo dwirɛ wahyire yɛ.
9 Ɔnate ɛhe ati, ofi kyẽa bɔ yɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne ɔ, yɛyyakyili ɛmɔ nwo mbaeɛbɔlɛ le. Na yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma ɛmɔnya ye apɛdeɛ nwo nimdeɛ mmorosoɛ wɔ sunzum nu nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ amukoraa nu. 10 Na ɛhe kɔmaa ɛmɔkɔhora kɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔfata Awurade, ná ɔsɔ ye nye wɔ atee biala so. Na ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosu mmaa wɔ nnwumaa paa mukoraati nu, ná ɛmɔanyi Nyameɛ nimdeɛ nu. 11 Yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma ɛmɔ tumi amukoraa ma ɛmɔgyina pindinn, kyɛbɔ ye animnyam tumi te ne, ná ɛmɔahora bafa aboterɛ ne animia amukoraa bagyina wɔ anigye nu, 12 ná yafa asennaa yama Baba ne bɔ wamaa yafata kyɛ yɛnya kyɛfa wɔ anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ kanea nu b’agyapadeɛ ne bie ɔ.
13 Wapepɛ wale yɛ wafi awosii tumi nu, na waasikye yɛ wɔ Ɔwa bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ n’Ahennie nu; 14 na ye nu yeɛ yanya ngoalelɛ bɔ ɔte bɔnefakyɛ ɔ.
Enwu Kristo a né anwu Nyameɛ
15 Ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ anyeɛ onnwu ye ne ye sɛso ɔ, abɔdeɛ amukoraa nu farebae. 16 Ofikyɛ ye nu yeɛ bɛbɔle nningyein amukoraa, bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so ɔ; bɔ benwu ye ɔ ne bɔ bennwu ye ɔ; ahennie oo, meneɛ oo, mbanyililɛ oo, tumililɛ oo, nningyein mukoraa bɛnate ye so yeɛ bɛbɔle ɔ, na bɛbɔle bɛ bɛmane ye. 17 Ye yeɛ né ɔwɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ bɛbɔ nikyee biala ɔ, na ye yeɛ otira bɛ mukoraa bɛ ngoa nyamaa nu ɔ. 18 Ɔte nipadua ne bɔ ye ole asɔre ne ti; ɔte nikyee biala ahyɛaseɛ, awufoɛ tingyelɛ nu farebae, na ɛhe maa ɔyɛ nningyein amukoraa nu bɔ oli moa ɔ. 19 Na ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye kyɛ ye sue ne amukoraa kɔtena Kristo nu ɔ. 20 Ɔnate ye so Nyameɛ ahwe nningyein mukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so ne nyameɛso wabata ye bɔbɔ ye nwo; na ɔnate ye mmeamudua nu mogya ne aso yeɛ wama sɔ asomdwee ye awa ɔ.
21 Na ɛmɔ de, ahaa né ɛmɔte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ ne pɔfoɛ mɔ, wɔ adwene nu ne bɔne nnwumaayɔlɛ mu. 22 Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɔnate Kristo wue ne aso wahwe ɛmɔ wabata ye nwonaen nipadua, amaa ɔnate so wafa ɛmɔ wawa ye nyunu kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛte krongron, bɔ ngekalewa nne bɛ nwo ná benni fɔ ɔ. 23 Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɔ gyidie ne anu serɛ na ɛmɔahora bagyina pindinn. Na afei ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtwe bɛ nwo befi nzɛmba ne anu anyelasoɛ nwo, na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔtele, bɔ babɔ ye nwo dawure bahyire abɔdeɛ mukoraa wɔ wiase, bɔ me Pɔɔlo nde ye nwo somvoɛ ye.
Pɔɔlo somvoɛ adwuma
24 Na afei, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti me nye gye wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu; na menya Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu kyɛfa wɔ me nwonaen nu mema ye nipadua ne, bɔ ɔte asɔre ne. 25 Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti Nyameɛ afa sɔ adwuma ye wawura me sa, na wamaa mayɛ somvoɛ mama asɔre ne, kyɛ mmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure ma ebiala te, 26 mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ ofi tete ne aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so bafa bafea ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de baye bahyire anwoteefoɛ. 27 Na Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ole kyɛ, ɔkɔma anwoteefoɛ konwu animnyam anwonya bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ dwirɛ ne anu wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu. Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ole Kristo bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, na ɔte animnyam ne nwo anyelasoɛ. 28 Ye yeɛ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ɔ, na yɛbɔ kuro sona biala kɔkɔ, yɛfa nworɛ mukoraa yɛkyirekyire sona biala, amaa ɔnate so yafa sona biala yawa Kristo nyunu wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu. 29 Na ɛhe anwo yeɛ meyɔ adwuma mefɛ ɔ, na mepere mekɔ me nyunu, kyɛbɔ ye anwoserɛ adwuma bɔ ɔyɔ ye me nu tumi so ne ɔte ɔ.

Title: KOLOSEFOƐ 2
Content:
1 Mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu mmɔden paa bɔ mebɔ mema ɛmɔ, yeɛ afei bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Laodikea, ɔne ebiala bɔ onnwuni me nyunu le ɔ. 2 Meyɔ ɛhe kyɛbɔ bɛ wora kɔkyekye ná bayɛ ko wɔ ɔdɔ nu, ná banya ndeaseɛ bɔ osi pi, ɔne kyɛ bekonwu Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, bɔ ye ole Kristo ɔ. 3 Na ye nu yeɛ bafa nworɛ ne nimdeɛ agyapadeɛ mukoraa basie ɔ.
4 Meka ɛhe kyɛbɔ ebie ngɔbobɔ ye noa nu ngɔfa ngɔlakalaka ɛmɔ ɔ. 5 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwoɔnaen nu de nna me ne ɛmɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ dɔ ɔ, nakoso me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ dɔ sunzum nu. Na ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ ɛmɔgyi berɛ pindinn ná ɛmɔ gyidie koso atindim wɔ Kristo nu ɔ.
Kristo nu brabɔlɛ
6 Yiti kyɛbɔ ɛmɔale Awurade Kristo Yesu bato nu nen, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛnate wɔ yde nu. 7 Ɛmɔtira ndii wɔ ye nu, ná ɛ́mɔnea ye so bɛbɔ bɛ bra, ná ɛ́mɔtindim wɔ gyidie nu kyɛbɔ behyirehyirele ɛmɔ ne, ná ɛ́mɔla Nyameɛ ase daa.
8 Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala amva ewiase nworɛ ne nnakannaka mbaen bɔ ɔnate tetesɛm ne wiase sunzum nu dwirɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ so, bɔ ɔnnate Kristo so ɔ wamva ɛmɔ wanyɛ ngoaa. 9Ofikyɛ ye nu yeɛ Nyameɛ sue mumua ne amukoraa ɔte ɔ wɔ nipadua nu ɔ. 10 Na ɛmɔali mu bɔkɔɔ wɔ ye nu, ye bɔ ɔte tumi ne ahennie amukoraa bɛ ti. 11 Na ye nu koso yeɛ bapɛ ɛmɔ bienzua bɔ bamva bɛ sa yeɛ bɛpɛle ɔ; na bɔ ɔwɔ anwoɔnaen nipadua nu bɔ bapuro bagua berɛ ne, bapuro bagua wɔ Kristo bienzuapɛlɛ nu. 12 Besiele ɛmɔ ne Kristo wɔ asubɔlɛ nu, na ɔnate ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Nyameɛ tumi dwumadie bɔ ɔfa tingyele ye fili ewue nu ne ati, batingye ɛmɔ ne ye koso. 13 Na ɛmɔ bɔ ahaa né ɛmɔte awufoɛ, ɔnate ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ ne ɛmɔ nwonaen bɔ né bienzuapɛlɛ nne nu ne ati nen, Nyameɛ amaa ɛmɔanya ye ngoa ne bie, na wafa yɛ mvomsoɛ amukoraa wahyɛ yɛ, 14 na wakyikyi ahyɛdeɛ ne anu ahyerɛlɛ bɔ otia yɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle yɛ kwaadu ne, na waye wafi berɛ wafa wabɔ mmeamudua ne anu. 15 Olele mbanyililɛ ne tumililɛ bɛ sa nu tumi, na ɔlale bɛ ali pefee wɔ badwa nu, na olili bɛ so ngonim wɔ mmeamudua ne aso.
16 Yiti nnɛmɔma ebiala bua ɛmɔ ndɛen fa aleɛ anaa anonneɛ, anaa aluolue, anaa ɛsraen foforɛ anaa afofingyẽa nwo. 17 Ɛhemɔ te nningyein bɔ ɔba nemɔ wawoɛ, nakoso ye paapaa ne ole Kristo. 18 Nnɛmɔma sona biala bɔ ɔpati brɛ ye nwo ase, bɔ ɔsɔne abɔfo mɔ, bɔ ɔnwa wanya nyekyire, bua ɛmɔ foɛ; ofikyɛ ye adwene mbaen yeɛ ɔfa tu ye nwo yɔ sɔ ɔ. 19 Sɔ sona ne wapo kyɛ okotira Tire ne bɔ nipadua ne fa ye aporɔ so ne ye ndii so onya aleɛ ná ɔtoatoa nu ne, na onyi wɔ enyinɛ bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ nu.
Pɔɔlo bɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔ
20 Sɛ ɛmɔ ne Kristo banya bawu bafi wiase sunzum nu ngyerɛkyerɛ nu a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ ɛmɔtɛwɔ wiase ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdi ahyɛdeɛ sɔaa mɔ so ɔ: 21“Bɛ nwo nga he, benni he, bɛnzɔ he anu?” 22 Na ɛhemɔ te nningyein bɔ bɛfa bedi dwumaa ɔsɛkye ɔ, yeɛ bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ; ofikyɛ bɛte kuro sona ahyɛdeɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ. 23 Osoma kyɛ nworɛ wɔ sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anu, bɔ ɔma sona sɔ ɛsom nu kateree ɔ, bɛpati bɛyɛ anwobrɛaseɛ, na bɛhyɛ nipadua ne anyeborolɛ; nakoso mvasoɛ biala nne ɛhemɔ so, yeɛ bɛngora benzi anwoɔnaen nu akɔnnɔ atee.

Title: KOLOSEFOƐ 3
Content:
1 Yiti sɛ ɛmɔ ne Kristo banya batingye de a, ɛ́mɔpena nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne si atee, nekaa bɔ Kristo te Nyameɛ sa famaa so ne. 2 Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso nwo, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene aseɛ so nningyein nwo. 3 Ofikyɛ ɛmɔawu, na bafa ɛmɔ ngoa ne Kristo basie Nyameɛ nu. 4 Na kyẽa bɔ Kristo bɔ ɔte yɛ ngoa ne ɔkɔla ye nwo ali nen, yeɛ bɛkɔla ɛmɔ koso ne ye ali wɔ animnyam nu ɔ.
Bra daa ne bra foforɛ
5 Yiti ɛ́mɔhu aseɛ so suban bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne: adwamanbɔlɛ, brabɔlɛ fiɛ, ahohwibra, akɔnnɔ bɔne bɔ ɔhyɛ sona so, ɔne anyeboroborolɛ; ofikyɛ anyeboroborolɛ te bosoensolɛ. 6 Ɔnate ɛhemɔ ati yeɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne ɔba asoserɛfoɛ so ɔ. 7 Na mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ sɔ tebea ne anu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔbɔle ɛmɔ bra ɔ.
8 Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛ́mɔgyi ɛhemɔ amukoraa bégua: ɛyaafɛlɛ, ahone tɛɛ, ɛpɔen, musue dwirɛ ne edwudwolɛ fiɛ. 9 Nnɛma ɛmɔpepɛ ngondombo bekyirekyire ɛmɔ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛmɔagyi ɛmɔ suban daa ne, ɔne ye yɔleɛ tɛɛ ne bagua, 10 na ɛmɔanya sona sue foforɛ, na ye bɔ ɔbɔle yɛ ne, ogu so ɔyɛ yɛ foforɛ ba nimdeɛ nu maa ye sɛso yɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ne ala. 11 Yiti Helaniɛ oo, Yudaniɛ oo; bienzuapɛlɛniɛ oo, bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ oo; pɔtɔniɛ oo, bɔ ye nye butu ase oo; akoaa oo, dehyeɛ oo, nzonzoleɛ biala nne b’afia, ofikyɛ Kristo wɔ berɛ ma bɛ mukoraa, na ɔte bɛ mukoraa bɛ nu.
12 Ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye ɛmɔ ɔ, anwoteefoɛ ne adɔfo, yiti ɛ́mɔfa anwumvoinnwunɛ, paayɛlɛ, awiɛmvoɛ yɔbea ɔne anwobrɛaseɛ ne aboterɛ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra. 13 Ɛ́mɔnya aboterɛ bɛmoma ɛmɔ nwo; ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ abiɛngo mvomsoɛ bɛhyɛ ye. Na sɛ ebie ne obiɛngo benya edwudwolɛ a, ɛ́mɔfa bɛhyehyɛ bɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ Awurade afa ahyɛ ɛmɔ ne. 14 Bɔ ɔtra so ɔ, ɛ́mɔye ɔdɔ behyire, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkã nningyein mukoraa bɔ nu maa bedi mu ɔ. 15 Afei ɛ́mɔma Kristo asomdwee ne oli ɛmɔ bra so, na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔɔyɛle nipadua ko ɔ. Na nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ boniayɛ. 16 Ɛ́mɔma Kristo dwirɛ ne oyi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ, ɛmɔhyirehyire ná ɛ́mɔfa nworɛ mukoraa betutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ. Ɛ́mɔto sangoo dwein, ayɛyelɛ dwein, ɔne sunzum nu dwein bɔ ɔte ahone nu asennaa bɛ́ma Nyameɛ. 17 Na nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔyɔ wɔ edwudwolɛ anaa yɔleɛ nu ne, ɛmɔyɔ ye mukoraa wɔ Awurade Yesu dumaa nu, na ɛmɔfa asennaa bɛfa ye so bɛma Baba Nyameɛ.
Gyidiniɛ asetena nu ngyerɛkyerɛ
18 Yeɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ahu mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ wɔ Awurade nu ɔ. 19Huɛ mɔ, ɛmɔhuro ɛmɔ aye mɔ, na nnɛma ɛmɔteetee bɛ.
20Ngwadaa, ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ awofoɛ mɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ.
21Seɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ ɛmɔ mma mɔ anyeborolɛ, ná b’abasanu ammu.
22Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ anwoɔnaen nu meneɛ mɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu. Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ ye bɛ nye so mbaen, kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ma sona kamvo ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom ɛ́mɔfia ɛmɔ kunu bɛyɔ ye kyɛ mmenia bɔ besuro Awurade ɔ. 23Na adwuma biala bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne, ɛ́mɔfi ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛ́yɔ ye kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Awurade, na nna kuro sona. 24 Ɔnate kyɛ, ɛmɔse kyɛ Awurade berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔte akatuaa ne ɔ, ofikyɛ Awurade Kristo yeɛ ɛmɔso ye ɔ. 25 Nakoso sona bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, okonya bɔne bɔ ɔyɔ ne nwo akatuaa, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nyɛ sona nu nyeyemuɛ

Title: KOLOSEFOƐ 4
Content:
1 Meneɛ mɔ, edwirɛ bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ ná ɔtengyɛ yeɛ ɛ́mɔfa beli ɛmɔ ngoaa mɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔle Meneɛ wɔ nyameɛso.
Pɔɔlo tu Kolosefoɛ foɛ
2 Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛwɛne wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne anu. 3 Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma yɛ koso, kyɛ Nyameɛ bukye edwirɛ ne nwo atee ma yɛ, ma yɛbɔ Kristo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne dawure, edwirɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ nna kukunu ye. 4Ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma me kyɛ ngyirekyire nu pefee kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekyire nu ɔ.
5 Bɛ bɔ bɛnne yɛ fekue ne anu ne, ɛ́mɔnate nworɛ nu wɔ bɛ nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔsɛkye ɛmɔ mmerɛ mbaen. 6 Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ noa dwudwolɛ yɛ fɛ kyɛ ngyee, amaa ɛmɔanwu mmuayɛɛ paa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bebua ebiala ɔ.
Ngraa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
7 Tihiko kɔɔfa me nwo dwirɛ kɔbɔ ɛmɔ amaneɛ. Ɔte aliɛmaa bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ paa ne nahorɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ, ɔne mmiɛngo somvoɛ wɔ Awurade nu. 8 Ɛhe ati yeɛ masoma ye ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛbɔ yɛ nwo si te ɔ, ná wakyekye ɛmɔ wora, 9 na masoma ye ne Onesimo, aliɛmaa nahorɛniɛ bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo, bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ko ne, Na bɛkɔhã bɔ wasi wa amukoraa bekohyire ɛmɔ.
10 Mmiɛngo kukununiɛ Aristako bisa ɛmɔ ahye; Banaba awosea Marko bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye nwo ngraa ne koso sɔ ala, (sɛ ɔba ɛmɔ berɛ a, ɛ́mɔle ye nyemene so). 11Yesu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yusto ne koso obisa ɛmɔ ahye. Ɛhemɔ ngome yeɛ bɛte bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛne me yɛyɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo adwuma ɔ, na bɛte aworakyekyerɛ ma me.
Epafra, Luka ne Dema
12Kristo Yesu akoaa Epafra bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ko ne, obisa ɛmɔ ahye. Daa biala ɔkaye ɛmɔ paa wɔ ye mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkogyina pindinn, ná ɛmɔ adwene asi pi wɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ mukoraa nu ɔ. 13 Medi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ wabɔ mmɔden paa wama ɛmɔ ne Laodikeafoɛ ne Hirapolifoɛ. 14 Yɛ dɔfo safoɛ Luka ɔne Dema bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.
15 Mebisa aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Laodikea; yeɛ afei Nimva ne asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro ne ahye. 16 Sɛ ɛmɔkenga krataa he wɔ ɛmɔ nu beyie a, ɛ́mɔma bɛkenga ye wɔ Laodikeafoɛ asɔre nu koso. Ɛmɔ koso odi kyɛ ɛmɔkenga Laodikeafoɛ krataa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ne. 17 Ɛmɔhã behyire Akipo kyɛ, “Nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma bɔ anya afi Awurade berɛ ne ekoyie pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ.”
18 Me Pɔɔlo, me bɔbɔ me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ he yeɛ mefa mebisa ɛmɔ bisabisa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ ndɛla kuku nu. Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Né Tɛsalonika te Roman manzini bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Makedonia n’ahenguro. Pɔɔlo fili Filipi nen, ɔɔtele asɔre wɔ berɛ. Wangyɛ biala yeɛ Yudafoɛ hyɛle ye bo bɛmane basabasa wale asɔre ne anu ɔ. Né bɛ nye boro Pɔɔlo ofikyɛ né ngɔsoɛ awa Kristosom nwo dwirɛ bɔ ɔha hyirele Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ basɔ Yudasom ne anu ne. Yiti bɛmane Pɔɔlo tuli putupuru fili Tɛsalonika hɔle Bɛrea. Nziɛ ye bɔ odwuli Korinto nen, obiɛngo Timoteo bɔ ɔne ye bɛyɔ Nyameɛ adwuma ne mane ye so tele edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ wasisi Tɛsalonika asɔre ne anu ne.
Yiti Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa bɔ oli moa he ɔɔhyɛle Tɛsalonika Akristofoɛ ne nguraen. Pɔɔlo lale Nyameɛ ase fale bɛ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nwo; ɔkayele bɛ wɔ bra bɔ ye, Pɔɔlo, ɔbɔle wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ bɛ kuro ne aso berɛ ne. Na afei ɔyele adwobisa bɔ né ɔha asɔre mma n’adwene wɔ Kristo walɛ nwo ne noa. Adwobisa ne biemɔ ɛhe: Aso gyidiniɛ bɔ okowu koraa né Kristo asa awa ne konya ngoa bɔ olle ayieleɛ, bɔ Kristo kɔfa kɔwa ne bie? Kyinzu koraa yeɛ Kristo kosa kɔwa ɔ? Pɔɔlo nwa bɛhɔ so bɛyɔ b’adwuma konn wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛnwondɛ Kristo walɛ anyelasoɛ nu ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1
Asennaa ne ayɛyelɛ 1.2—3.13
Kristoniɛ yɔleɛ nwo foɛtulɛ 4.1-12
Kristo walɛ ne nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ 4.13—5.11
Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ 5.12-22
Krataa n’ayieleɛ 5.23-28

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ 1
Content:
1 Krataa he fi Pɔɔlo, Silwano ne Timoteo berɛ. Yɛfa yɛbrɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Tɛsalonika ne. Adom ne asomdwee [bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ] ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Tɛsalonikafoɛ brabɔlɛ ne gyidie
2 Ɔnate ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ ti, mmerɛ biala yɛfa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ, na yɛbɔ ɛmɔ dumaa wɔ yɛ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu. 3 Na mmerɛ biala yɛkaye ɛmɔ gyidie adwuma, ɔne ɛmɔ adwumayɔlɛ bɔ ofi ɔdɔ nu, ɔne ɛmɔ anyelasoɛ bɔ ogyi berɛ pindinn wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nu ne, wɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu. 4 Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ, yɛse kyɛ waneanea nu waye ɛmɔ. 5 Ofikyɛ, nna yɛ noa dwirɛ ngome so yeɛ yɛnate yɛfale nzɛmba ne yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ; na mmom yɛnate tumi ne Sunzum Krongron koso so yeɛ yɛfa yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, na yɛse ye pefee kyɛ nzɛmba ne te nahorɛ. Na ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yɛsi yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne ɔ. 6 Ɛmɔsuasuane yɛ ne Awurade; na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔnwuni amaneɛ pee wɔ edwirɛ ne anwo de, nakoso ɛmɔfale anika bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron berɛ bɛsɔle nu. 7 Na ɛhe ama ɛmɔayɛ nhwɛsoɛ bama agyidifoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Makedonia ne Akaia ɔ. 8 Ofikyɛ, nna Awurade nwo dwirɛ ne ngome yeɛ wafi ɛmɔ berɛ waadwu Makedonia ne Akaia ɔ; na mmom ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Nyameɛ nu nwo dwirɛ koso watrɛ wahɔ nekaa biala, yiti onhia kyɛ yɛkɔhã ye nwo dwirɛ ko. 9Sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɔbɔ deinn bɛkã kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi belele yɛ nyemene so, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔasi bahwe bɛ nwo bafi mmosoen nwo bawa Nyameɛ berɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne nahorɛniɛ ne, 10 ná ɛmɔnwondɛ Ɔwa ne bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ne kyɛ okofi nyameɛso kɔwa ɔ; Yesu bɔ ɔpepɛ de yɛ fi ahonehulɛ bɔ ɔ́ba ne anu ne.

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ 2
Content:
Pɔɔlo dwumadie wɔ Tɛsalonika
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ yɛ walɛ bɔ yɛwale ɛmɔ berɛ ne wanyɛ mbaen. 2 Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛlili moa yɛnwuni amaneɛ, ná bɛbɔle yɛ alapaa wɔ Filipi, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse ne, nakoso yɛsili y’ahone wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ nu kyɛ yɛkɔhã Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne yɛkohyire ɛmɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛko betia yɛ ɔ. 3Yɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛhane ne, oggyi ngondombo anaa adwene tɛɛ biala so, yeɛ nnakannaka biala nne nu; 4na mmom kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ abu yɛ kyɛ yɛfata, ná wafa nzɛmba ne wawura yɛ sa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛdwudwo ɔ; nna kyɛ yɛfa yɛsɔ mmenia nye, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ ɔse yɛ ti anu dwirɛ ne yeɛ yɛfa yɛsɔ ye nye ɔ. 5 Ɛmɔse kyɛ yanga adɛfɛdɛfɛ dwirɛ biala; yeɛ yammutubutu edwirɛ so yamva yambena adifuu nikye, Nyameɛ te yɛ danzeniɛ! 6 Yanyɛ kyɛ yɛpena kuro sona nyunu animnyam, kyɛ ofi ɛmɔ berɛ oo, anaakyɛ ebiemɔ berɛ oo. Ahaa yɛkɔhora yɛkɔhyɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ bɛma yɛ, ofikyɛ yɛte Kristo asomafoɛ. 7 Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛdwole yɛ nwo ase te kyɛ brataen bɔ ɔnea ye mma ɔ. 8 Na ɔnate ɛmɔ nwo dɔ bɔ yɛle ye ne ati, nna Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne ngome yeɛ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛbɔle afɔleɛ koso yɛmane ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ yɛhurole ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma. 9Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔkaye kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛyɔle adwuma, ɔne yɛ fɛɛ bɔ yɛfɛle ɔ. Yɛyɔle adwuma eyia ne kɔngɔen kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na yanyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala so tɔsom, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛkã Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne yɛkyire ɛmɔ ne.
10Ɛmɔdi adanzeɛ, Nyameɛ koso sɔ ala, kyɛ yɛ suban bɔ yɛyele ye ali yɛhyirele ɛmɔ bɔ bɛte agyidifoɛ ne, ɔte krongron, ye nwo te, na ngekalewa biala nne ye nwo. 11 Ɛmɔse kyɛ yɛtuli ɛmɔ nu biala foɛ, yɛkyekyele ɛmɔ wora kyɛbɔ seɛ si yɛ ye mma ɔ, na yɛhyɛle ɛmɔ nguraen, 12kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya kyɛfa wɔ ye Ahennie ne ye animnyam nu ne nye.
Tɛsalonikafoɛ sɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anu
13 Na ɛhe koso ati yeɛ yɛda Nyameɛ ase daa ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛfale Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ nen, ɛmɔsɔle nu kyɛ nna kuro sona dwirɛ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ dwirɛ amba; na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte agyidifoɛ ne, ɔyɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ. 14 Aliɛmaa mɔ, Nyameɛ asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea wɔ Yesu Kristo nu ne, agyirɛ bɔ betuli ne, ebiala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔatu ne; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanwu amaneɛ wɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ mmenia bɛ sa nu, kyɛbɔ Yudafoɛ fa yɛle bɛ koso ne ala. 15 Bɛ yeɛ behuni Awurade Yesu ne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ɔ, ná bɛtanene yɛ nye maa yɛnwatili ɔ. Bɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye, yeɛ bɛko betia mmenia amukoraa. 16Na bɛberale yɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa yɛkã edwirɛ ne yɛkyire Amaenmaensofoɛ maa benya daa ngoa. Na ɛhe ma bɛ bɔne kwangoa ne oyi tɛkyɛ daa, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne wanya wawa bɛ so wayie!
Pɔɔlo wora dɔ Tɛsalonikafoɛ
17 Yɛ de, aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛfili ɛmɔ nwo berɛ mmerɛ kãa bie wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, na nna y’ahone nu ɔ; yiti yɛ wora dɔ ɛmɔ soma, na yɛpere kyɛ yɛkonwu ɛmɔ bieku ɔ. 18Ahaa yɛpena kyɛ yɛsa yɛba ɛmɔ berɛ. Me bɔbɔ, Pɔɔlo, mabɔ ye nwo mmɔden pee, nakoso Abɔnzam sili yɛ ate. 19 Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔte y’anyelasoɛ, anaa y’anigye, anaa yɛ ngonim abotire bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ne ɔ? Aso nna ɛmɔ ɔ? 20 Amba, ɛmɔte y’animnyam ne y’anigye.

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ 3
Content:
Pɔɔlo soma Timoteo wɔ Tɛsalonika
1 Afei de, né yɛsɔ nu a ɔnzɔ ko. Yiti yɛyɛle kyɛ yɛ ngome yɛkɔha Atense, 2 na yɛsomane aliɛmaa Timoteo bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ somvoɛ, ná ɔne yɛ yɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo adwuma ne, kyɛ ɔɔhyɛ ɛmɔ nguraen ná ɔma ɛmɔ gyidie gyina pindinn; 3 amaa sɔ amaneɛnwunɛ hemɔ ammo ɛmɔ nu biala so. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ bɔ odi kyɛ yɛnwu ye hɔ ala ɛne. 4 Ɔnate kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛlili moa yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ yɛkonwu amaneɛ, na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse nen, sɔ ala koso yeɛ wasi ɔ. 5 Ɔnate ɛhe ati, mmerɛ bɔ né mesɔ nu a ɔnzɔ ne, nzomane ye kyɛ ɔɔnea kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ gyidie si gyi ɔ; na mesuro kyɛ ebiaa né abɔnzam aso ɛmɔ anea ama y’adwuma bɔ yɛyɔle ne wayɛ mbaen.
6 Nakoso afei de, Timoteo afi ɛmɔ berɛ wasa wawa yɛ wa, na wafa ɛmɔ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nwo dwirɛ fɛɛ waabɔ yɛ amaneɛ kyɛ daa ɛmɔkaye yɛ paa, na ɛmɔ wora dɔ yɛ, kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛ wora dɔ ɛmɔ ne ala. 7Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, y’anwokyere ne amaneɛnwunɛ mukoraa nu ne, ɛmɔ gyidie ne amaa yanya ɛmɔ nwo aworakyekyerɛ; 8ofikyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔgyina pindinn wɔ Awurade nu a, né afei yanya ngoa. 9Anigye wora bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yanya ye wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu ye, nzikyɛ asennaa bieku yeɛ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔfa yɛkɔma Nyameɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ɔ? 10Yɛfa y’ahone amukoraa alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma yɛnwu ɛmɔ nyunu, ná yɛpagya bɔ ɔtɔ sii wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie nu ne.
11Yɛsrɛ kyɛ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne bɔbɔ ne y’Awurade Yesu bebukye ate bɛma yɛbra ɛmɔ berɛ. 12Yɛsrɛ kyɛ Awurade ɔma ehurolɛ bɔ ɛmɔkurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ, ɔne mmenia mukoraa nwo dɔ ne onyi mmorosoɛ so, kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛkuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ne ala, 13 amaa ɔnate so wasi ɛmɔ ahone pi, ná wayɛ ɛmɔ krongron bɔ ngekalewa biala nne nu wɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu, wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ne ye anwoteefoɛ amukoraa walɛ ne anu.

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ 4
Content:
Brabɔlɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, yɛ́srɛ ɛmɔ, ná yɛtu ɛmɔ foɛ wɔ Awurade Yesu nu kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsuane kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkosi bɛkɔbɔ bɛ bra bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye befili yɛ berɛ nen, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ ye mmorosoɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ala. 2Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔse ahyɛdeɛ bɔ yɛnate Awurade Yesu so yɛfa yɛmane ɛmɔ ne. 3 Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ɛhe: kyɛ ɛmɔ nwo kɔte, ná ɛmɔkɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo bekofi adwamanbɔlɛ nwo, 4 kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala konwu kyɛ okogya ɔye wɔ anwotelɛ ne anidie nu, 5na mmom ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔma akɔnnɔ tɛɛ hyɛ ɛmɔ so kyɛbɔ maen maen nufoɛ bɔ bɛnze Nyameɛ ɔ bɛyɔ ne. 6Na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ebiala yɔ oliɛma tɛɛ anaa osisi ye wɔ ɛhe anwo, ofikyɛ yali moa yabɔ ɛmɔ kɔkɔ kitii kyɛ Awurade kɔtɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa so wereɛ. 7Ɔnate kyɛ, Nyameɛ amvrɛ yɛ wamma efiɛ nu, na mmom anwotelɛ nu. 8Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔpo ngyerɛkyerɛ he nen, nna kuro sona yeɛ ɔpo ye ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ wafa ye Sunzum Krongron ne wama yɛ ne.
9Onhia kyɛ ngɔhyerɛ ngɔkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɛ dwirɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahyirehyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ. 10Na amba, sɔ suban ne ala koso yeɛ ɛmɔala ye ali bahyire aliɛmaa mɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Makedonia amukoraa ɔ. Nakoso, aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ ye mmorosoɛ, 11 ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden brɛbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase, ɛ́mɔdwene ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛyɔ adwuma, kyɛbɔ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne; 12amaa ɛmɔabɔ bɛ bra kyɛbɔ ɔfata wɔ ewiasefoɛ nu, ná nikye fee anhia ɛmɔ.
Awurade walɛ ne
13 Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛkuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu nahorɛ bɔ ɔfa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ anwo, ná ɛmɔ wora ammɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ baha bɔ belle anyelasoɛ ne. 14 Na sɛ yɛde yɛdi kyɛ Yesu wuli ná osa tingyele de a, nzaade Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ kɔfa Yesu so kɔboka ye so kɔwa.
15Na ɛhe de, yɛnate Awurade dwirɛ so yeɛ yɛkã yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ yɛ bɔ yɛte ase, ná yɛtena ngoa nu yɛkoodwu Awurade walɛ ne anu ne, yɛngosa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ anwo. 16 Ofikyɛ Awurade bɔbɔ kɔfa esebɔlɛ, abɔfo panyi komvi ne Nyameɛ totorobɛndo komvi kofi nyameɛso kodwu kɔwa, na Kristo nu awufoɛ bekoli moa bekodwɔso, 17na afei yɛ bɔ yɛte ase, bɔ yaha ne, ɔne bɛ koso, bɛkɔfa yɛ munungum nu maa yɛkooyia Awurade wɔ ewienu, na sɔ yeɛ yɛne Awurade kɔtena daa ɔ. 18Yiti ɛ́mɔfa edwirɛ hemɔ bɛ́kyekye ɛmɔ wora.

Title: 1 TƐSALONIKAFOƐ 5
Content:
Ɛ́mɔsiesie ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́ma Awurade walɛ ne
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, mmerɛ ne ne ngyẽa ne de, onhia kyɛ yɛkɔhyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ yɛkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. 2Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse ye pefee kyɛ Awurade kyẽa ne kɔwa kyɛbɔ awueniɛ ba kɔngɔen ɔ. 3Na mmerɛ bɔ mmenia kɔhã kyɛ, “Yɛle asomdwee ne anwotɔ” nen, yeɛ ewue kɔto bɛ mvum nu kyɛ koɛhalɛ bɔ ɔka brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ, na bengonya bɛ ti bengodidi nu. 4Nakoso aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ de ɛmɔnne awosii nu, ná kyẽa ne waafũ ɛmɔ nu kyɛ awueniɛ. 5Ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔte kanea mma ne alehyeleɛ mma. Yɛtte alesaleɛ anaa awosii mmaa. 6Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛdafe kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ bɛyɔ ne; na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛwɛne, ná yɛma yɛ nye la berɛ. 7Ɔnate kyɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛda ne, kɔngɔen yeɛ bɛda ɔ; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛno nzaa bɛbo ne, kɔngɔen yeɛ bɛbo ɔ. 8Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ yɛte alehyeleɛ mma ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛ nye la berɛ ná yɛfa gyidie ne ɔdɔ yɛyɛ koɛ buralɛ yɛkata yɛ hue so, na yɛfa ngoalelɛ nwo anyelasoɛ yɛyɛ koɛ buralɛ kyerɛ yɛwura. 9 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amvrɛ yɛ amma ye yaafɛlɛ nu, na mmom kyɛ yɛfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so yɛnya daa ngoa. 10Ye yeɛ owu mane yɛ ɔ, amaa sɛ yɛte ase oo, yɛwu oo, yɛne ye yaatena. 11Yiti ɛ́mɔtutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbokaboka ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ala.
Foɛtulɛ ne ngraalilɛ
12 Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu, ná bedi ɛmɔ so panyi wɔ Awurade nu, ná betu ɛmɔ foɛ ne; 13 na ɔnate b’adwuma ti ɛ́mɔfa anidie paa ne ɔdɔ bɛ́ma bɛ. Ɛ́mɔtena asomdwee nu. 14 Afei koso aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnate basabasa nemɔ kɔkɔ, ɛ́mɔkyekye bɛ bɔ b’abasa nu abu nemɔ wora, ɛ́mɔboka bɛ bɔ bayɛ mmerɛ ne, ná ɛ́mɔnya sona biala nwo aboterɛ. 15 Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala amva bɔne andua bɔne kerɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ daa biala ɛmɔkɔyɔ paa bɛkɔmoma ɛmɔ nwo ne mmenia amukoraa.
16 Ɛ́mɔli ahurusi daa; 17 nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi mbaeɛbɔlɛ le! 18 Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma Nyameɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, ofikyɛ ɛhe yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ma ɛmɔ ɔ. 19 Nnɛma ɛmɔnua Sunzum Krongron see ne; 20 nnɛma ɛmɔbu ngɔmhyɛlɛ animtia, 21 na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔso nningyein amukoraa bɛnea: na bɔ ɔte paa ne, ɛ́mɔsɔ nu yé, 22ná ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bɔne sue mukoraa nwo.
23 Na asomdwee Nyameɛ ne, yɛsrɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nwo bɔkɔɔ, ná ɔnea ɛmɔ sunzum ne ɛmɔ kra ne ɛmɔ nipadua so, bɔ ngekalewa biala ngɔwa ye nwo kɔpem kyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo kɔwa ɔ. 24Bɔ ɔfrɛ ɛmɔ ne odi nahorɛ, na ɔkɔyɔ koso amba.
25Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma yɛ. 26 Ɛmɔyɛ aliɛmaa nemɔ amukoraa awaawaatuu krongron nu. 27 Méfa ahyɛdeɛ mema ɛmɔ wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ, ɛ́mɔkenga krataa he behyire agyidifoɛ nemɔ amukoraati. 28 Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ bɛtena. Amen.

Title: 2 TƐSALONIKA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle krataa he ɔɔmane Tɛsalonikafoɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né b’asɔre ne anu ayɛ basabasa ɔ. Né asɔremma ne anu pee adwene himhim wɔ Kristo walɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anwo. Né ebiemɔ dedi kyɛ Awurade kyẽa bɔ ɔfa ba ne apɛ nu ahɔ dada. Pɔɔlo hyerɛle krataa he oohyirehyirele nu kyɛ nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte ɔ. Ohyirele nu kyɛ kodiawuniɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye “Atianuserɛniɛ” (2.3) koli moa kɔwa koodiedie adasammaa kɔhɔ bɔne ne amumuyɛɛ bɔ ye sɛso ɔwwale le nu koraka né Kristo asa awa. Sɔ kodiawuniɛ ne kɔho kotia Kristo.
Pɔɔlo ka ye serɛserɛ kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ Tɛsalonika asɔremma ne si b’adwene pi, na bɛsɔ bɛ gyidie nu yé wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ ne ndaneanyeɛ nu. Ɔnwa bɛyɔ adwuma bɛnea bɛ nwo kyɛ ye Pɔɔlo, ɔne ye mmango adwumayɔlɛfoɛ yɔle ne, na bɛbɔ paayɛlɛ nwo mmɔden.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Ɛkamvolɛ ne abasobɔlɛ 1.3-12
Kristo walɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ 2.1-17
Kristoniɛ brabɔlɛ nwo foɛtulɛ 3.1-15
Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ 3.16-18

Title: 2 TƐSALONIKA 1
Content:
1 Krataa he fi Pɔɔlo, Silwano ne Timoteo berɛ, na yɛfa yɛbrɛ Tɛsalonika asɔre ne bɔ ɔte yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo deɛ ne. 2 Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Ndɛenbualɛ wɔ Kristo walɛ ne anu
3 Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ ti daa yɛda Nyameɛ ase kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie kɔ so nyi mmorosoɛ, na ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ma bɛ nwo bɛ nwo ne ɔte piri. 4Na ɛmɔ animia ne gyidie wɔ ɛmɔ nye bɔ bɛtane ne anu, ɔne amaneɛ mukoraa bɔ ɛmɔmia bɛ nye benwu ye ne ati, yɛfa ɛmɔ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Nyameɛ asɔre nemɔ nu. 5Na ɛhe kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo, bɔ ɔkɔma ɛmɔ kɔfata Nyameɛ ahennie bɔ yiti yeɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ ne. 6Ofikyɛ ɔtengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ okotua bɛ bɔ bɛma ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ ne so kerɛ ɔ, 7ná ɔkɔma ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ amaneɛ nu ne, ɛmɔ ne yɛ yɛkonya nwomelelɛ, kyẽa bɔ bɛkɔla Awurade Yesu ne ye abɔfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ ali bekofi nyameɛso, wɔ see wuronyiwuronyi nu ne, 8 na ɔkɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnze Nyameɛ, ɔne bɛ bɔ bayɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo asoserɛ nemɔ so wereɛ. 9 Ɔkɔtɔ sɔ mmenia nemɔ so wereɛ kɔsɛkye bɛ pasapasa afebɔɔ, ná afei wahwe bɛ wafi Awurade nyunu ne ye animnyam tumi nwo. 10Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔwa ma ye anwoteefoɛ kɔhyɛ ye animnyam, na agyidifoɛ mukoraa anwu ye anwanwa adwuma; ofikyɛ ɛmɔale yɛ adanzeɛ bɔ yɛli yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne bali.
11Yiti daa yɛbɔ mbaeɛ yɛma ɛmɔ, kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ obu ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔfata ye frɛlɛ ne, ná ɔfa ye tumi so ma ɛmɔhora bɛyɔ paa biala bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ, ná ɔma ɛmɔ gyidie adwuma li mu; 12amaa ɔnate so bahyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa animnyam wɔ ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔ koso bahyɛ ɛmɔ animnyam wɔ ye nu, kyɛbɔ yɛ Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne te ɔ.

Title: 2 TƐSALONIKA 2
Content:
Amumuyɛɛniɛ ne
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo walɛ ne ne nwo, ɔne yɛ noa boalɛ bɔ yɛkwaafa yɛyia ye ne nwo de, yɛsrɛ kyɛ nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ ti anu kesenee, 2 Nyekyire, anaa edwirɛ anaa krataa bɔ ebiemɔ nwa ofi yɛ berɛ ne, bɔ okyire kyɛ Awurade kyẽa ne wawa nen, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ ti anu yɛ ɛmɔ kesenee ndɛndɛ wɔ ye nwo, anaa nnɛmɔma ɔha ɛmɔ. 3 Nnɛmɔma ebiala lakalaka ɛmɔ wɔ atee biala so; ofikyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne ngɔwa, sana ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne ba koraka; na afei bala amumuyɛɛniɛ ne ali koraka, baa bɔ wamini ne. 4 Ye yeɛ odwɔso tia, na osa ma ye nwo so tra nikyee biala bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nyameɛ ná bɛsɔne ye ɔ; na ɔkɔtena Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu kɔfrɛ ye nwo kyɛ ye ole Nyameɛ.
5 Aso ɛmɔngaye kyɛ ngane ɛhemɔ ngyirele ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né nwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen? 6Na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔse nikye horɛ bɔ kekesaala ye osi ye ate ɔ, amaa bala ye ali wɔ ye mmerɛ nu. 7Ofikyɛ mvealeɛ nu amumuyɛɛ wahyɛ ye adwuma bo dada, na bɔ osi ye ate kekesaala ye ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kosi ye ate, kɔpem kyɛ bɛkɔye bɔ osi ye ate ne bekofi berɛ ɔ. 8 Na ɛhe asi ye yeɛ bɛkɔma amumuyɛɛniɛ ne nwo kɔla ali ɔ. Na Awurade Yesu kɔfa ye noa nu nwomeɛ kohũ ye, ná afei wafa ye animnyam walɛ ne wasɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ. 9 Amumuyɛɛniɛ ne kɔfa abɔnzam dwumadie so yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ, na okonya tumi kɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne nnakannaka anwanwadeɛ mukoraa. 10Na ɔkɔfa nnakannaka ne amumuyɛɛ atee mukoraa so konya bɛ bɔ begu so bemini ne, ofikyɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ wɔ nahorɛ bɔ ɔma daa ngoa ne nwo. 11 Ɛhe ati Nyameɛ kɔsoma nnakannaka tumi maa okoli dwumaa wɔ bɛ nu, na bale ngondombo bali. 12Yiti bekobua bɛ bɔ banne nahorɛ ne banni, na mmom bɛ nye gye bɔ ɔndengyɛ nwo ne amukoraa ndɛen.
Baye ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔnya ngoa
13 Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ Awurade kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ, ɔte yɛ asɛdeɛ kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti daa yɛda Nyameɛ ase ɔ. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fi ahyɛaseɛ ne yeɛ waneanea nu waye ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔnya daa ngoa, bɔ ɔnate Sunzum nu anwotelɛ ne nahorɛ gyidie nu ɔ. 14Ɔnate yɛ nzɛmba ne aso yeɛ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya kyɛfa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo animnyam nu ɔ. 15Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔgyina pindinn, na ɛmɔsɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ yɛnate yɛ noa dwirɛ anaa krataa so yafa yahyire ɛmɔ ne anu yé.
16 Na afei, Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔbɔ ne yɛ Baba Nyameɛ, bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ, ná walo yɛ wama yɛ daa asomdwee ne anyelasoɛ paa ne, 17ɔ́kyekye ɛmɔ wora, ná ɔma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ edwirɛ ne adwuma paa mukoraa nu.

Title: 2 TƐSALONIKA 3
Content:
Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma yɛ
1 Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma yɛ, kyɛ Awurade nzɛmba ne onya atee trɛ ndɛndɛ ná onya animnyam, kyɛbɔ wanya ye wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne. 2 Ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma yɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ ole yɛ fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ sa nu, ofikyɛ nna mmenia mukoraa yeɛ bele gyidie ɔ. 3 Nakoso Awurade di nahorɛ; ɔkɔma ɛmɔ kogyina pindinn, ná wabɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen wafi bɔnefoɛ ne sa nu. 4Na y’adwene si pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ yɛfale ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ yɛmane ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔdi so, na ɛmɔkɔhɔ so bekoli so. 5Yɛsrɛ Awurade kyɛ obukye ɛmɔ adwene nu ma ɛmɔte Nyameɛ ɔdɔ ne Kristo aboterɛ ne bo.
Ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala yɔ adwuma
6Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛle y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa yɛhyɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, aliɛmaa biala bɔ ɔnatenate basabasa ná onni ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ onya fili yɛ berɛ ne aso ne, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo. 7 Na ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ ohia kyɛ ɛmɔsuasua yɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, yanyɛ foen; 8 yeɛ yanni ebiala aleɛ bɔ yandua ye kerɛ ɔ. Na mmom yɛyerele yɛ nwo yɛyɔle adwuma eyia ne kɔngɔen, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛngɔyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala so tɔsom ɔ. 9Ɛhe ngyire kyɛ yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛkobisa ɛmɔ dɔ nikyee biala ɔ, na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛyɛle mvandoho kyɛ ɛmɔsua yɛ. 10 Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛmane ɛmɔ ahyɛdeɛ kyɛ, sona biala bɔ onguro kyɛ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, onni kyɛ odidi ɔ. 11Ofikyɛ yatete ye kyɛ mmenia biemɔ wɔ ɛmɔ nu bɔ bɛnatenate basabasa, bɔ bɛnyɔ adwuma biala, na mmom bɛfa bɛ noa bɛtoto mmenia dwirɛ nu ɔ. 12 Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, yɛ́hyɛ bɛ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa nu, ná yɛtu bɛ foɛ kyɛ, odi kyɛ bɛyɔ b’adwuma konn bɛfa bɛpena bɛ noa aleɛ.
13Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma paayɛlɛ yɛ ɛmɔ yea. 14Na sɛ ebie ngotie bɔ yahã ye wɔ krataa ye anu a, ɛmɔhyɛ sɔ sona ne nzorɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye bɛbɔ afɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɔfɛre. 15Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔbɔ ye kɔkɔ kyɛ aliɛmaa.
Ngraalilɛ
16Yɛsrɛ kyɛ asomdwee Awurade ne bɔbɔ ɔma ɛmɔ asomdwee daa wɔ atee biala so. Awurade ne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena.
17Me bɔbɔ, Pɔɔlo, me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ yeɛ mefa mebisa ɛmɔ bisabisa ɔ, na ɛhe hyɛ me krataa biala bɔ mekyerɛ ne nzorɛ: kyɛbɔ mekyerɛ hɔ ɛne.
18 Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ɔlo ɛmɔ amukoraa.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Timoteo te Kristoniɛ aberandeɛ bɔ ofi Asia ɔ. Oni te Yudaniɛ, yeɛ ɔse koso te Helaniɛ. Ɔɔyɛle Pɔɔlo abiɛngo bɔ ɔbokale ye wɔ ye nzɛmbahanɛ ne anu. Pɔɔlo krataa bɔ oli moa bɔ ɔfa ɔɔmane Timoteo ne ka nningyein titire nza nwo dwirɛ.
Krataa ne di moa bɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔ wɔ asɔre ne anu. Sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne te Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ gyidie bie bɔ wali afra, bɔ okyire kyɛ efiɛ aha ewiase he. Ngyerɛkyerɛ ne bie gyi gyidie he aso: Bɛnwa ɔsɛ kyɛ sona nya mvealeɛ nu nimdeɛ, na okyi aleɛ biemɔ, ɔne kyɛ ɔpo agyaa koraa na wanya daa ngoa. Afei krataa ne ka ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔfa asɔre nu nhyehyɛleɛ ne asɔreyɛlɛ nwo, ɔne suban bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ asɔre mbanyi ne asomvoɛ benya ɔ. Ayieleɛ ne, Pɔɔlo tu Timoteo foɛ kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ Yesu Kristo somvoɛ paa ɔ, ɔne asodie bɔ ole ma agyidifoɛ fekue fekue amukoraa ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Asɔre ne ye mbanyi mɔ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ 1.3—3.16
Timoteo adwuma nwo foɛtulɛ 4.1—6.21

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Pɔɔlo, Kristo Yesu somafoɛ, kyɛbɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ anyelasoɛ ne hyɛle ne, 2 mefa mebrɛ Timoteo, bɔ ɔte me bɔbɔ mma wɔ gyidie nu ne. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne yɛ Awurade Kristo Yesu berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ.
Ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
3 Mmerɛ bɔ né mekɔ Makedonia nen, nzrɛle wɔ kyɛ ɛtena Ɛfeso, ná etu mmenia biemɔ foɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bekyirekyire ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ, 4 yeɛ nnɛmaa bɛha bɛ nwo wɔ ɛhoaa ne afilie nu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nwo dwirɛ bɔ ye bo mbɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔfa aporowaasulɛ ba tra nyamesom paa ne bɔ ɔwɔ gyidie nu ne. 5 Na kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne, ye botaeɛ ole ɔdɔ bɔ ofi ahone bɔ nu te ɔ nu, tiboa paa ne gyidie kaenn nu. 6Na ɛhe yeɛ mmenia biemɔ bali makyebu bafi ye nwo baali aporowaasulɛ mbaen mbaen si, 7 bɔ bekuro kyɛ bɛyɛ mmeraa akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ, nakoso edwirɛ bɔ bɛkã ne, ɔne nningyein bɔ besi bɛ hue bɛkã bɛ nwo dwirɛ ne, bɛnde bɛ bo ɔ.
8 Na yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne te paa, sɛ ebie di so kyɛbɔ ɔfata hɔ a. 9 Yeɛ yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne ɔnne berɛ mma teneneeniɛ, na mmom ɔwɔ berɛ ma mmeraatolɛfoɛ, asoserɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ, bɔnefoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo agua fiɛ ɔ, bɛ bɔ beku bɛ se ne bɛ ni, awudifoɛ, 10adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, mmienzua bɔ bɛne mmienzua bɛda ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne mmenia, ngondombofoɛ, ndaentolɛfoɛ, yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔboka so bɔ otia ngyerɛkyerɛ paa ɔ; 11 kyɛbɔ saleɛ Nyameɛ animnyam nzɛmba bɔ bafa bawura me sa ne ɔte ne.
Nyameɛ se anwumvoin
12Meda y’Awurade Kristo Yesu bɔ wama me anwoserɛ ne ase; ofikyɛ wabu me nahorɛniɛ wafa me wawura ɛsolɛ adwuma ne anu. 13 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ daa ne de, ngekane musue dwirɛ ndiale ye, ndanene ye nye, nyɛle ye so patapaa; nakoso onwuni me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ né menze bɔ meyɔ ɔ, na nyɔle ye wɔ elelɛ bɔ né menne menni ne anu. 14 Na y’Awurade adom ne wale me so mmorosoɛ, wɔ gyidie ne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ɔ. 15 Ɛhe te nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bede bɛto nu bɔkɔɔ ɔ, kyɛ Kristo Yesu wale wiase oolele bɔnefoɛ bɔ nde bɛ hene ne ngoa. 16 Nakoso ɛhe ati yeɛ onwuni me anwunvoin ɔ, kyɛ me bɔ nni moa ne anu, Yesu Kristo kɔla ye aboterɛ amukoraa ali maa ɔkɔyɛ nhwɛsoɛ kɔma bɛ bɔ bekole ye bekoli bɛkɔhɔ daa ngoa nu ne. 17 Afei, anidie ne animnyam hã daa daa Hene ne, bɔ ɔte ase daa, bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye, Nyameɛ komapɛ twe ne, afebɔɔ! Amen.
18 Mma Timoteo, ahyɛdeɛ he yeɛ mefa mewura wɔ sa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ngɔm dwirɛ bɔ mmerɛ bie bɛhã bɛfale wɔ nwo ne ɔte ne, kyɛ ɔ́hyɛ wɔ nguraen, ná fa ko koɛ paa ne, 19 ná nya gyidie ne tiboa paa bɔ ebiemɔ de bagyi bato nekaa bie, ná bafi ase wɔ gyidie nu ne. 20 Bɛ nu biemɔ ole Himeneo ne Aleksandro bɔ maye bɛ mama Satan, kyɛ besua kyɛbɔ bɛngɔkekã musue dwirɛ ɔ.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 2
Content:
Asɔre asodie
1 Afei, bɔ oli moa wɔ ye mukoraati nu ɔ, metu foɛ kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi ngotosrɛ, mbaeɛbɔlɛ, odima ne asennaa nwo dwumaa bɛma mmenia amukoraa, 2 ahemvo ne bɛ bɔ tumi wura bɛ sa amukoraati, amaa ɔnate so yatena ase konn, ná yɛ so anu atɔ yɛ, nyamesom paa ne anidie brabɔlɛ amukoraa nu. 3Na sɔ te paa, na ɔsɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ nye, 4 ye bɔ okuro kyɛ mmenia amukoraa benya daa ngoa ná bɛba nahorɛ nimdeɛ ne anu ne.
5 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe,
na Nyameɛ ne adasa mmaa b’afia ndamgyinaniɛ te komapɛ,
bɔ ye ole Kristo Yesu;
6 bɔ ɔfa yɛle mbata mane mmenia amukoraati,
adanzeɛ bɔ ɔwale nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bahyɛ bato berɛ ne anu ne.
7 Na ɛhe ati yeɛ batu me basie berɛ bayɛ me nzɛmbahanɛniɛ ne somafoɛ ɔ, (mekã nahorɛ [wɔ Kristo nu], na membɛ ngondombo), nde Amaenmaensofoɛ nu kyerɛkyerɛniɛ wɔ gyidie ne nahorɛ nu.
Asɔre nu nhyehyɛleɛ
8Yiti mekuro kyɛ mmienzua bɛbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ nekaa biala, bɛma asaa bɔ ye nwo te ɔ so, bɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ anaa aporowaasulɛ nne nu ɔ. 9Sɔ ala koso yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ mmrasua mɔ bɛfa anwobrɛaseɛ bewura ndaadeɛ bɔ ɔfata, bɔ ongua bɛ nyunu ase ɔ; bɔ nna tire bɔ babɔ ye mmɛsa, sikaa kɔkorɛ, afire paa anaa ndena nyɔboɛserɛ ahɔ ɔ; 10na mmom nnwumaa paa bɔ ɔfata mmrasua bɔ bɛda nyamesom ali ɔ. 11Ma brasua ɔyɛ konn osua edwirɛ ne wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ mukoraati nu. 12Brasua de, memma ye ate kyɛ ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ anaa oli bienzua so; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ omua ye noa. 13 Ofikyɛ belili moa bɛbɔle Adam koraka yeɛ bɛbɔ Hawa ɔ. 14 Nna Adam yeɛ bɛlakalakale ye ɔ; na mmom brasua ne yeɛ bɛlakalakale ye maa ɔtone mmeraa ɔ. 15Nakoso sɛ ɔtena gyidie ne ɔdɔ ne krongronyɛlɛ ne anwobrɛaseɛ nu a, bekole ye ngoa wɔ ye mmaaworɛ nu.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 3
Content:
Asɔre nu mbanyi
1 Edwirɛ nahorɛ ɛhe: Sɛ ebie kuro neafoɛ adwuma a, né wafa adwuma paa. 2 Ɔsɛ kyɛ neafoɛ ne ɔyɛ sona bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye bra nu ɔ, ɔye yɛ komapɛ, ye nye la berɛ, ye nye dwo ase, ye suban te paa, okuro ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ, ɔse ngyerɛkyerɛ yɛ, 3 ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, ahupoo, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ odwo; ɔnzɛ kyɛ okuro ngondii, anaa ɔma ye nye boro sikaa. 4 Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔkora bu ye bɔbɔ ye awuro yé, ná ɔtete ye mma maa bebu ye wɔ atee biala so ɔ. 5Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie nze kyɛbɔ osi bu ye bɔbɔ ye awuro yé a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wahora wanea Nyameɛ asɔre so? 6 Ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔte gyidiniɛ foforɛ ɔ, ná wammoma ye nwo so ma wannya abɔnzam foɛbualɛ ne bie. 7 Afei koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ ebie bɔ mmenia bɔ bɛnne yeɛ fekue ne anu ɔ bɛbɔ ye dumaa paa ɔ, ná ye nyunu angua ase ma wandɔ abɔnzam ngaen nu.
Asɔre nu asomvoɛ
8 Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ asɔre nu asomvoɛ mɔ bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ nyunu le animnyam ɔ, bɔ bɛkã nahorɛ, na mmom bɛtte akɔnomnzafoɛ ne adifuufoɛ ɔ; 9 ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa tiboa bɔ ommua bɛ foɛ ɔ bɛsɔ gyidie mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne anu. 10 Maa beli moa beso bɛ bɛnea koraka, na sɛ edwirɛ biala nne bɛ nwo a, né afei bamaa bayɛ asomvoɛ. 11 Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ ye mɔ koso bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ nyunu le animnyam ɔ, bɔ bɛmmɔ nzekure, na mmom bɛ nwo dwo, ná bedi nahorɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ. 12Asɔre nu asomvoɛ mɔ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala ɔye yɛ komapɛ, yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkora bɛ mma ne bɛ bɔbɔ b’awuro so nea ɔ. 13Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ somvoɛ adwuma ne yé ne, benya dumaa paa ne nyinasoɛ pindinn wɔ gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu.
Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ piri ne
14Me nye la so kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔwa wɔ berɛ, nakoso mekyerɛ ɛhemɔ mebrɛ wɔ koraka, 15amaa sɛ ɔba kyɛ mekyɛ ná mmmale a, anwu kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ bra wɔ Nyameɛ awuro, bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’asɔre, nahorɛ nyinasoɛ ne fapem ne anu. 16 Aporowaa biala nne ye nwo kyɛ nyamesom nu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ɔte piri:
Nyameɛ lale ye nwo ali anwoɔnaen nu,
olili be wɔ Sunzum nu;
abɔfo mɔ nwuni ye,
bɛbɔle ye nwo dawure wɔ maen maen nu;
belele ye belili wɔ wiase,
na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle nyameɛso animnyam nu.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 4
Content:
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ
1 Sunzum ne kã ye pefee kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ebiemɔ koli makyebu bekofi gyidie ne anwo bekooli ngondombo sunzum mɔ ne sunzummɔne mɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ si, 2 bɔ ɔnate ngondombo nnakannakafoɛ bɔ bɛ tiboa awu so ɔ. 3 Bɛ yeɛ bɛbera agyaa, ná bɛhyɛ kyɛ sona otua aleɛ bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle kyɛ bɛ bɔ bede bedi, ná banwu nahorɛ ne bɛfa asennaa beli ɔ. 4 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ abɔdeɛ biala te paa, na sɛ yɛfa asennaa yɛsɔ nu de a, ye de ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛkyi nikyee fee ɔ; 5 ofikyɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne mbaeɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛte ye nwo ɔ.
Kristo Yesu somvoɛ paa
6 Sɛ ɛfa sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ hemɔ ekyire aliɛmaa nemɔ a, ɛkɔyɛ Kristo Yesu somvoɛ paa bɔ bafa gyidie nwo dwirɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ paa bɔ eli ye si ne batete ye ɔ. 7 Nakoso daa tete dwirɛ mbaen mbaen mɔ bɔ bɛmmoka ne de, twe wɔ nwo fi ye nwo, ná bɔ nyamesom paa nwo mmɔden; 8 ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen nu mmɔdenbɔlɛ nwo le mvasoɛ kãa de, nakoso nyamesom paa nwo le mvasoɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, na ole kekesaala ye ngoa ɔne ngoa bɔ ɔbaawa ne nwo bɔhyɛ. 9 Ɛhe te nahorɛ dwirɛ, bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bede bɛto nu bɔkɔɔ ɔ. 10 Ɛhe ati yeɛ yɛyere yɛ nwo yɛyɔ adwuma serɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ yafa yɛ nye yato Nyameɛ teasefoɛ, bɔ ɔte mmenia amukoraa, nganga agyidifoɛ Ngoadefoɛ ne aso.
11 Fa ɛhemɔ tu foɛ paa, ná fa kyirekyire. 12 Nnɛma ebiala bu wɔ animtia kyɛ ɛte aberandeɛ ɔ, na mmom ma agyidifoɛ bɛyɛ nhwɛsoɛ wɔ edwudwolɛ nu, brabɔlɛ nu, ɔdɔ nu, gyidie nu ne anwotelɛ nu. 13 Tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ ma Ahyerɛlɛ ne kengalɛ wɔ badwa nu, nzɛmbahanɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ɔ. 14 Adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate ngɔmhyɛlɛ so ɔne mbanyi mɔ sa bɔ bɛfa beguale wɔ so bɛfa bɛmane wɔ ne, nnɛbu wɔ nye gua so. 15Bɔ mmɔden wɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ anwo, tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ ma bɛ bɔkɔɔ, amaa ɔnate so wɔ ngɔsoɛ ala ali ama ebiala anwu ye. 16 Nea wɔ nwo yé ɔne wɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo yé, kɔ so tira nu; ofikyɛ sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, ekole wɔ nwo ne w’atiefoɛ ngoa.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 5
Content:
Somvoɛ asɛdeɛ
1 Nnɛtwi panyi nyunu, na mmom tu ye foɛ kyɛ wɔ baba; yeɛ yɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ kyɛ eliɛma mmienzua; 2yɛ mmrasua mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ wɔ maame mɔ; yeɛ yɛ ndaluwa nemɔ kyɛ eliɛma mmrasua wɔ anwotelɛ amukoraa nu.
3Boka mmrasua akunafoɛ bɔ belle bie ɔ. 4 Na sɛ brasua kunaniɛ bie ole mmaa anaa nnomaa a, maa beli moa besua kyɛ bɛkɔla nyamesom paa ali wɔ awuro, kyɛ bɛkɔnea b’awofoɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ná ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ. 5 Brasua kunaniɛ bɔ olle bie, bɔ waha ye ngome ne, ɔfa ye nye to Nyameɛ so, na otu ye nwo sie berɛ ma ngotosrɛ ne mbaeɛ kɔngɔen ne eyia. 6 Nakoso brasua kunaniɛ bɔ wama ahohwibra ali ye ti ne de, ɔte teaseawuo. 7 Fa ɛhemɔ tu foɛ paa, ná bannya bɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ banga. 8Sɛ ebie nnea ye abusuafoɛ, nganga ye awuroama a, né wapo gyidie ne, na wafõ watra sona bɔ onne nni ɔ.
9Nnɛfa brasua kunaniɛ biala boka so, sana wali afoɛ aburasia bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ ogyale biaa komapɛ ɔ; 10 bɔ bedi ye ne ye nnwumaa paa nwo adanzeɛ: kyɛ watete mmaa, kyɛ waso ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, kyɛ wanwunzi anwoteefoɛ gya bo, kyɛ waboka bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwokyere nu, ɔne kyɛ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama nnwumaa paa mukoraa ɔ.
11Na akunafoɛ mmrasua bɔ bennyini ne, nnɛfa bɛ boka so; ofikyɛ sɛ b’akɔnnɔ ne ɔbo anwofama bɔ banya ye bama Kristo ne aso a, né bekuro kyɛ begya biaa, 12na ɔnate sɔ ti bedi b’anohoba bɔ belili moa bɛbɔle ne nwo fɔ. 13 Afei koso, besua akwadworɔ, na bekyinikyini awuro mɔ nu; nna kyɛ bɛyɛ foen ngome, na mmom bɛyɛ asɛmbɛ ne nzekure, na bɛkekã edwirɛ bɔ ɔmvata ɔ. 14 Yiti mekuro kyɛ akunafoɛ ndaluwa nemɔ begyigya mmiaa ná bɛwo, ná bɛnea b’awuro so yé, ná yamma pɔfoɛ ne ate ma wangekã yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ; 15ofikyɛ ebiemɔ ali makyebu baali Satan si. 16Sɛ brasua gyidiniɛ bie ole abusuafoɛ akunafoɛ mmrasua a, maa ɔnea bɛ; ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ adesoa da asɔre ne aso, amaa ɔnate so asɔre ne ahora anea akunafoɛ mmrasua bɔ belle bie ne.
