17 Mbanyi bɔ bɛte bɛ nye bɛnea asɔre ne aso ne, ɛ́mɔfa anidie mmɔhoɛ bɛ́ma bɛ, nganga, bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ mmɔden wɔ nzɛmbahanɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ nu ne; 18 ofikyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa, “Sɛ nandwie boro aburoo a, nnɛkyekye ye noa,” yeɛ “Adwumayɔlɛniɛ fata kyɛ ye sa kã ye akatuaa.” 19 Sɛ ebie bɔ asɔre panyi bie kwaadu a, nnede to nu, sana ate afi adanzefoɛ nyɔ anaa nza noa. 20 Na bɛ bɔ bɔne ali bɛ ti ne, kã bɛ nyunu wɔ asɔre mma ne amukoraa nyunu, amaa ɔnate so bɛ ngaa ne basuro.
21 Ngyi Nyameɛ ne Awurade Kristo Yesu ne abɔfo bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ne anyunu mehyɛ wɔ kyɛ, di nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ so, bɔ ɛnnea sona nyunu anaa ɛnyɛ nyeyemuɛ ɔ. 22 Nnɛpe ndɛen fa wɔ sa gua ebie so, yeɛ nnɛfa wɔ nwo dide ebiemɔ bɔne nu: Ma wɔ bra yɛ sannwuu! 23 Nnɛno nzue ngome ko, na ɔnate wɔ ko bɔ ɔha wɔ, ɔne fonɔnfonɔn bɔ ɛtaa yɛ ne ati, no bobe nzaa kãa.
24Mmenia biemɔ bɛ bɔne la dwaaso, na odi bɛ nyunu kɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu; nakoso ebiemɔ deɛ de, ɔda ali nziɛ ye. 25Na sɔ ala yeɛ nnwumaa paa bɛda ali pefee ɔ, na sɛ banna ali po a, bɛngora bɛmvea.

Title: 1 TIMOTEO 6
Content:
1 Bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ngoaasolɛ nu amukoraa, maa bebu bɛ mene mɔ kyɛ anidie amukoraa fata bɛ, amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ dumaa ne ngyerɛkyerɛ ne nwo angua fiɛ. 2Bɛ bɔ bɛ mene mɔ te agyidifoɛ nen, nnɛmaa bɛfa ye kyɛ bɛte aliɛmaa ti bebu meneɛ nemɔ animtia; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyere bɛ nwo bɛso bɛ yé; ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ benya bɛ solɛ ne nwo mvasoɛ ne, bɛte agyidifoɛ ne adɔfo. Sɔ nningyein hemɔ yeɛ kyirekyire, ná tu ye nwo foɛ ɔ.
Ngondombo ngyerɛkyerɛ
3 Sɛ ebie yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ, ná wambene y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nahorɛ dwirɛ ne ɔne ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔkɔ nyamesom paa nu ne aso a, 4 sɔ sona ne moma ye nwo so, na ɔnze huu, aporowaasulɛ ne aporowaasulɛ kyengyekyengye ali ye ti; na bɔ ofi nu ba ole anyeboroborolɛ, mbakyembakyemuɛ, nzekure, mmenia nwo adwenemmɔne, 5 manzoenhwenɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ b’adwene awu ɔ nu, bɔ bɛne nahorɛ abɔ nzahoɛ, bɔ besusu kyɛ nyamesom paa ma sona nya ye nwo ɔ.
6 Nakoso nyamesom paa bɔ ɔma wɔ kunu dwo wɔ ne, ɔte anwonya piri; 7 ofikyɛ yamva hwee yamma wiase, yeɛ yɛngɔhora ngɔfa hwee ngofi wiase ngɔhɔ. 8 Yiti sɛ yɛle bɔ yɛdi ɔne bɔ yɛfa yɛkata yɛ nwo a, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛma yɛ nye sɔ. 9 Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ benya bɛ nwo ne, bɛtɔ nzɔhwɛ ne ngaen ne ngwaseaa akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee mma sona, bɔ ɔfa bɛ kɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ ne eminilɛ nu ne anu ɔ. 10Ofikyɛ bɔne amukoraa ndii ole sikanyeboro, bɔ ebiemɔ ali ye si bali makyebu bafi gyidie ne anwo, bɔ yiti bahwehwe aworabɔlɛ pee babrɛ bɛ nwo ɔ.
Pɔɔlo tu Timoteo foɛ
11 Na wɔ, Nyameɛ sona, wɔ de, twe wɔ nwo fi ɛhemɔ anwo, ná fa tenenee, nyamesom paa, gyidie, ɔdɔ, animia ne anwobrɛaseɛ sie wɔ nye so. 12 Ko gyidie koɛ paa ne; sɔ daa ngoa bɔ bɛfrɛle wɔ bɛwale nu, bɔ ɛpakyele nu hane ye yé wɔ adanzefoɛ pee bɛ nyunu ne anu. 13 Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma nningyein amukoraa ngoa, ɔne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔpakyele nu hane ye yé, ná olili adanzeɛ wɔ Pontio Pilato nyunu ne, metu wɔ foɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu, 14 kyɛ, di ahyɛdeɛ ne aso bɔ ngekalewa anaa edwirɛ biala ngɔwa ye nwo, kɔpem y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ye nwo aliyelɛ ne. 15 Na bɔ ɔkɔma ɛhe kɔla ali wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ole saleɛniɛ ne Tuminiɛ komapɛ twe ne, ahemvo mɔ nu Hene ne meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ ne, 16 bɔ ye ngome twe yeɛ onwu, ná ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔte kanea bɔ ebie ngora mbingye ye nu, bɔ ebiala nnwuni ye le, ná ebiala ngɔhora ngonwu ye ne. Ye yeɛ anidie ne daa tumi te ye deɛ ɔ! Amen.
Pɔɔlo tu sikafoɛ foɛ
17 Dwudwo kyire sikafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ wiase, kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛmoma bɛ nwo so, anaakyɛ nnɛmaa bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto anwonyadeɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ so; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma yɛ nningyein amukoraa mmorosoɛ ma yɛ nye gye ne aso. 18 Bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ bɛ́yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, kyɛ bɛyɛ sikafoɛ wɔ nnwumaa paa nu, ná bɛye bɛ kunu bɛyɛ adɔeɛ, 19 ná bɛ́fa bɛ́to fapem paa besie berɛ bɛma bɛ nwo kyẽa bie; amaa ɔnate so bɛ sa ahã daa ngoa ne.
Ayieleɛ
20 O Timoteo, nea bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa ne aso yé. Twe wɔ nwo fi edwudwolɛ fiɛ ne aporowaasulɛ mbaen mbaen bɔ bɛyɛ mvomsoɛ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte nimdeɛ ne nwo. 21 Na ɛhe yeɛ ebiemɔ bale bato nu, ná bali makyebu bafi gyidie ne anwo ɔ. Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

Title: 2 TIMOTEO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he ɔɔmane Timoteo wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔla kuku nu ɔ. Né agyidifoɛ ne apo Pɔɔlo maa waha ye ngome wɔ kuku nu. Né ɔse kyɛ bekobua ye kumfɔ, yiti ɔnwa Timoteo ha ye nwo bra ndɛ.
Timoteo te Pɔɔlo bokafoɛ, yiti krataa ne tu ye foɛ kyɛ ogyina pindinn, kyɛ oli Yesu Kristo nwo adanzeɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu, kyɛ ɔsɔ nahorɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzɛmba ne ne Apam Daa ne anu, kyɛ ɔyɔ kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne nzɛmbahanɛniɛ adwuma wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mmenia ko tia ye ɔ.
Pɔɔlo nwa nnɛma Timoteo fa ye nwo wurawura ngwaseaa aporowaasulɛ nu. Okyire kyɛ mvasoɛ nne so, na mmom ɔsopa mmenia. Pɔɔlo fa ye bɔbɔ ye brabɔlɛ, ye gyidie, aboterɛ, ɔdɔ, animia, amaneɛnwunɛ ne ndaneanyeɛ bɔ wato ye yɛ mvandoho.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Ayɛyelɛ ne nguraenhyɛlɛ 1.3—2.13
Ngyerɛkyerɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ 2.14—4.5
Pɔɔlo fa ye nwo yɛ mvandoho 4.6-18
Ayieleɛ 4.19-22

Title: 2 TIMOTEO 1
Content:
1Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ, kyɛbɔ ngoa bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu te ne, 2 mefa mebrɛ mma Timoteo bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne y’Awurade Kristo Yesu berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ.
Asennaa ne nguraenhyɛlɛ
3Mefa asennaa mema Nyameɛ bɔ mefa tiboa paa meso ye, kyɛbɔ me nana mɔ bɛsole ye ne, kyɛ daa biala mekaye wɔ wɔ me mbaeɛ nu eyia ne kɔngɔen. 4Na mekaye wɔ nye moen ne a, ɔma me wora dɔ wɔ kyɛ ngonwu wɔ paa ɔ, ná ahaa me nye agye. 5 Na ɔmaa mekaye wɔ nahorɛ gyidie ne, gyidie bɔ wɔ nana Loyese ne wɔ maame Yunise belili moa benyane ye ne, na mede medi kyɛ wɔ koso ele bie. 6Yiti mékaye wɔ kyɛ, Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu, bɔ mvale me sa nguale wɔ so maa enyane ye ne, maa ɔyɛ hye wɔ wɔ nu; 7ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amma yɛ esurolɛ sunzum, na mmom tumi ne ɔdɔ ne anwohyɛsoɛ sunzum.
8Yiti nnɛma y’Awurade adanzeɛlilɛ ne ɔyɛ wɔ nya, anaa me bɔ nde ye kukununiɛ ne me nwo yɛ wɔ nya; na mmom nya kyɛfa wɔ nzɛmba ne nwo amaneɛnwunɛ nu, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ tumi ɔte ne. 9Ye yeɛ oolele yɛ ná ɔfale ɛfrɛlɛ krongron frɛle yɛ ɔ, nna kyɛ yɛ nnwumaa ti ɔ; na mmom kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne adom bɔ wafa walo yɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu fi tetetete ne ɔte ne. 10Na afei de, ɔnate yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ ne aso wala ye ali. Ye bɔ watu ewue bo, ná ɔnate nzɛmba ne aso wala ngoa ɔne tebea bɔ ewue nne nu ɔ ali wahyire ɔ. 11 Na nzɛmba he ati yeɛ babɔ me dumaa bayɛ me nzɛmbahanɛniɛ ne somafoɛ ne kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ɔ. 12Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ menwu amaneɛ hemɔ ye, nakoso ɔnyɛ me nya; ofikyɛ mese bɔ male ye mali ne, na mede medi kyɛ ɔkora ɔbɔ bɔ mafa mawura ye sa ne nwo waen maa okoodwu Kyẽa ne.
13Edwirɛ paa mɔ bɔ ate afi me berɛ ne, sɔ ye nwo nhwɛsoɛ nu yé, gyidie ne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu. 14Nahorɛ ne bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa ne, fa Sunzum Krongron bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ne aso nea so yé.
15Ɛse kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Asia amukoraa bayakyi me nu bahɔ; Figɛlo ne Hɛmogen koso bɛboka so. 16Mesrɛ Awurade kyɛ onwu Onesiforo awuro ama anwumvoin, ofikyɛ ɔkyekyele me wora mmerɛ pee, na me ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ne anyɛ ye nya. 17Ɔwale Rome nen, ɔpenane me dee fɛle koraa yeɛ onwu me ɔ. 18Mesrɛ Awurade kyɛ ɔma Awurade nwu ye anwumvoin wɔ Kyẽa ne. Na wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse ɛsolɛ worawora bɔ ɔsole me wɔ Ɛfeso ɔ.

Title: 2 TIMOTEO 2
Content:
Kristo nahorɛ asraaniɛ
1Yiti mma, ma wɔ nwo yɛ se wɔ adom bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu. 2Na bɔ ɛte fili me berɛ wɔ adanzefoɛ pee bɛ nyunu ne, fa wura mmenia bɔ bedi nahorɛ bɔ bɛkɔhora bekohyirehyire ebiemɔ koso ɔ bɛ sa.
3Na wɔ koso, mia wɔ nye nwu amaneɛ kyɛ Kristo Yesu sraaniɛ paa. 4Sraaniɛ bɔ ogyi koɛ noa nen, ɔmva daadaa asetena nu dwirɛ mɔ ngyekye ye nwo, ofikyɛ okuro kyɛ ɔsɔ bɔ ɔfale ye adwuma ne nye. 5Na bɛmva ngonim abotire ne bɛmmɔ amirikatulɛniɛ, sana odi amirikatulɛ ne nwo mmeraa so. 6Kuaniɛ bɔ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, ye yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi moa di nu aleɛ ne bie ɔ. 7Dwene bɔ mekã ne anwo, ofikyɛ Awurade kɔma wɔ nikyee biala nu ndeaseɛ.
8Kaye Yesu Kristo, Dawide bosoniɛ ne bɔ otingyele fili awufoɛ nu, kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne te ne, 9nzɛmba ne bɔ yiti yeɛ menwu amaneɛ ná babɔ me panwu kyɛ wudiniɛ ne; nakoso Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne de, bɛbbɔle ye panwu. 10Yiti ɔnate mmenia bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ne ati, memia me nye menwu amaneɛ mukoraa, amaa ɔnate so bɛ koso banya ngoalelɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne ɔne animnyam afebɔɔ ne. 11Nahorɛ dwirɛ ɛhe:
“Sɛ yɛne ye yawu a,
yɛne ye yɛkɔtena ase koso;
12 sɛ yɛmia yɛ nye yɛtindim a,
yɛne ye koli hene koso;
sɛ yɛpo ye a,
ye koso ɔkɔpo yɛ;
13sɛ yɛnni nahorɛ a,
ye de, odi nahorɛ daa,
ofikyɛ ɔngora mbɛ ngondombo.”
Adwumayɔlɛniɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ
14Kaye bɛ wɔ nningyein hemɔ nwo, ná bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ Awurade nyunu, kyɛ nnɛmaa besu edwirɛ mɔ nwo aporowaa bɔ mvasoɛ biala nne so ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔsopa bɛ bɔ betie ne. 15Bɔ mmɔden paa kyɛ ɛkɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye, kyɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ bɔ ye adwuma nwo nyɛ ye nya ɔ, kyɛ sona bɔ okyirekyire nahorɛ dwirɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ. 16Twe wɔ nwo fi edwirɛ mbaen mbaen bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ nwo, ofikyɛ odiedie mmenia fa bɛ kɔ musue nu. 17Bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne, ɔtrɛ kyɛ anwonyerɛ tɛɛ bɔ odidi anwoɔnaen ɔ, na bɛ nu biemɔ ole Himeneo ne Fileto, 18bɔ bali nahorɛ ne nwo makyebu bekyirekyire kyɛ ewutingyelɛ apɛ nu ahɔ dadaada, ná bɛfa bɛsɛkye ebiemɔ gyidie ɔ. 19 Nakoso Nyameɛ fapem ne, ogyi berɛ pindinn, bɔ nzɔanoɛ he sɔ ye noa ɔ: “Awurade se bɛ bɔ bɛte ye deɛ”, yeɛ “Ma ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ Awurade dumaa ne ɔhwe ye nwo fi amumuyɛɛ nwo.”
20Nna esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nningyein ngome yeɛ bɛwɔ awuro piri nu ɔ, na mmom mmakaa ne ɛfaa deɛ koso wɔ nu bie. Bɛfa anidie bɛma bɛ nu biemɔ, yeɛ ebiemɔ de bɛmva anidie bɛmma bɛ. 21Na sɛ sona te ye nwo fi bɔ bɛmva anidie bɛmma ye ne anwo a, ɔkɔyɛ nikyee bɔ bɛfa anidie bɛma ye ɔ, bɔ bate ye nwo, bɔ ye mene fa yɛ nikyee a ɔyɛ yé ɔ, ná wasiesie ye nwo wama adwuma paa biala. 22Yiti twe wɔ nwo fi mmerandeɛ nu akɔnnɔ nwo, ná fa wɔ nye sie tenenee, gyidie, ɔdɔ ne asomdwee so, ɛne bɛ bɔ befi ahone bɔ nu te ɔ nu bɛfrɛ Awurade bɛbɔ nu ne. 23Nakoso ngwaseaa aporowaasulɛ ne edwirɛ mbaen mbaen de, twe wɔ nwo fi ye nwo, ofikyɛ ɛse kyɛ bɛne ngondii yeɛ bɛnate ɔ. 24Ɔnzɛ kyɛ Awurade akoaa kuro ngondii, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ma ebiala, ɔkora yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ, ná onya aboterɛ, 25ná ɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ nu dwudwo kyire bɛ bɔ bɛne ye nyɛ adwene ɔ. Ofikyɛ ebiaa né Nyameɛ amaa basakyera b’adwene ná banwu nahorɛ ne, 26ná banya bɛ ti badidi nu bafi abɔnzam bɔ wahye bɛ nnure kyɛ bɛyɔ ye apɛdeɛ ne, ye ngaen nu.

Title: 2 TIMOTEO 3
Content:
Ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne
1Nakoso kaye kyɛ, ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ kɔwa. 2Ofikyɛ mmenia kɔyɛ pɛsɛmangomenya, sikanyeboro, anwohoahoa, anwomasoɛ, musue dwirɛ kekanɛfoɛ, bɛkɔyɛ awofoɛ so asoserɛ, boniayɛfoɛ, mmenia bɔ bɛmva krongronyɛlɛ bɛnyɛ huu, 3bengonya sona nwo dɔ, amvamvirifoɛ, ɛsoentolɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛnhyɛ b’akɔnnɔ so ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te awosii, bɛ bɔ bɛpo nikye paa biala, 4bɛ bɔ bɛye bɛ mmango mɔ bɛma, asobrakyeɛfoɛ, bekoli bɛ ti piri, ná bahuro anigye batra Nyameɛ; 5bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ basɔ nyamesom paa ne anu, nakoso bɛpo tumi bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne. Twe wɔ nwo fi sɔ mmenia nemɔ nwo.
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ
6Sɔ mmenia ne, bɛ nu biemɔ wurawura awuro mɔ nu, na bɛlakalaka mmrasua bɔ b’adwene te nganga, bɔ bɔne ayɛ bɛ so adesoa, ná akɔnnɔ ahoroɔ ahyɛ bɛ so ɔ benya bɛ; 7mmrasua bɔ bekuro kyɛ daa besua nikye, nakoso bɛngɔhora bengonwu nahorɛ ne le ɔ. 8 Na kyɛbɔ Yane ne Yambrɛ bedwɔso betiale Mose nen, sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ koso bɛko betia nahorɛ ne ɔ. Bɛte mmenia bɔ b’adwene ali naakye, ná babɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu ɔ. 9Nakoso bɔ bɛyɔ ne ongoosi pasiliwa biala, ofikyɛ bɛ ngwaseasɛm ne kɔla ali wɔ mmenia amukoraa nyunu, kyɛbɔ mmenia nyɔ ne deɛ yɛle ne.
Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
10Nakoso wɔ de, ɛse me ngyerɛkyerɛ ne paa, me brabɔlɛ, me botaeɛ, me gyidie, m’animia, me dɔ ne m’aboterɛ; 11 ndaneanyeɛ bɔ wato me, m’amaneɛ bɔ ɔtole me wɔ Antiokia, Yikoniom ne Lisetra, ɔne ndaneanyeɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɔtole me ne; nakoso Awurade lele me fili ye mukoraa nu. 12Amba, sona biala bɔ ɔpena kyɛ ɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, bɛkɔtane ye nye. 13Na amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne aminɛlilɛfoɛ bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔlɔ asukɔ wɔ bɔne nu; bɛkɔlakalaka mmenia, ná mmenia koso alakalaka bɛ. 14Nakoso wɔ de, bɔ asua ɔne bɔ ale ali ne, kɔ so sɔ nu yé, ofikyɛ sona bɔ esua fili ye berɛ ne, ɛse kyɛbɔ osi te ɔ, 15ɔne kyɛbɔ ofi wɔ ngwadaa nu yeɛ anwu Ahyerɛlɛ Krongron ne kyɛ ɔkora maa enwu nworɛ bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo nu gyidie so ɔfa wɔ kɔ ngoalelɛ nu ɔ. 16Ahyerɛlɛ ne amukoraa fi Nyameɛ nwomeɛ nu yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, na ɔte paa ma ngyerɛkyerɛ, ɔma sona nwu ye mvomsoɛ, bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ sona, na bɛfa bɛtete sona wɔ tenenee atee so, 17amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ sona wayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ bama ye ndeteyɛɛ bɔ odi mu ɔ bama nnwumaa paa amukoraa.

Title: 2 TIMOTEO 4
Content:
Bɔ edwirɛ ne dawure
1Na Nyameɛ ne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔbaabua ateasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ndɛen ne, ɔne ye nwo aliyelɛ ne ye ahennie ne, mefa mehyɛ wɔ kyɛ; 2bɔ edwirɛ ne dawure, ná kɔ so yɔ, kyɛ mmerɛ paa nu oo, anaa mmerɛ tɛɛ nu oo. Maa mmenia benwu bɛ mvomsoɛ, twi bɛ nyunu, tu foɛ, wɔ ndoboaseɛ ne aboterɛ amukoraa nu. 3Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ mmenia ngotie ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔte paa ne, na mmom bɛ so anu bɔ ɔyɛ bɛ fɛ ne ati, bɛkɔboaboa akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ noa maa bɛkɔhã edwirɛ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bɛte ɔ. 4Bekotuatua bɛ so wɔ nahorɛ ne anwo, ná baatie ɛhoaa mmom. 5Nakoso wɔ de, ma wɔ nye la berɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, mia wɔ nye fa amaneɛ nu, yɔ nzɛmbahanɛniɛ adwuma ne, ná yie wɔ solɛ adwuma ne bɔkɔɔ.
6Na me de, mmerɛ ne adwu bɔ bɛbaafa me bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ, na mmerɛ ne apingye kyɛ ngofi wa ɔ. 7Koɛ paa ne, maho; amirika ne, matu mayie; gyidie ne, masɔ nu. 8Na bɔ waha bɔ ɔla berɛ ma me ole tenenee abotire bɔ Awurade, ndɛenbualɛniɛ tenenee ne ɔkɔfa kɔbɔ m’aba so sɔ Kyẽa ne ɔ; bɔ nna me ngome, na mmom bɛ bɔ bekuro ye nwo aliyelɛ ne amukoraa koso ɔkɔbɔ b’aba so bie.
Pɔɔlo wora dɔ Timoteo
9Bɔ mmɔden bra me wa ndɛndɛ. 10 Ofikyɛ Dema ahuro kekesaala ye wiase ye dwirɛ, na wayakyi me nu wasi nu wahɔ Tɛsalonika; Kreseke ahɔ Galatia, yeɛ Tito ahɔ Dalmatia. 11 Luka ngome twe yeɛ ɔne me wɔ wa ɔ. Ɛba a, fa Marko boka wɔ nwo so bra, ofikyɛ ye nwo hia me paa wɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma ne anu. 12 Masoma Tihiko wɔ Ɛfeso. 13 Sɛ ɛba a, fa m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ bɔ mva nyakyili Kapuse wɔ Troase ne brɛ me, yeɛ nwomaa nemɔ koso, nganga nwomaa bɔ so te kokwakokwa nemɔ.
14 Kɔɔbere dwumvoɛ Aleksandro wafa edwirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa wali me. Awurade kotua ye kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ. 15Wɔ koso nea wɔ nwo yé wɔ ye nwo, ofikyɛ ɔho tiale yɛ dwirɛ ne anyeborolɛ so.
16Na mmerɛ bɔ né meye me noa bɔ oli moa mefa mesa me nwo ne, ebiala wammangyina me si; bɛ mukoraa bɛyakyili me nu bɛhɔle. Na mesrɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa benya ye nwo asohwenɛ. 17Nakoso Awurade gyinane me si mane me anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa me so kɔbɔ edwirɛ ne dawure bɔkɔɔ kɔma Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔte ɔ. Yiti ɔpepɛ lele me fili gyata noa nu. 18Awurade kɔpepɛ kole me kofi musue amukoraa nu, na okole me kɔhɔ ye nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. Ye yeɛ animnyam ɔte ye deɛ daa daa afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen.
Ngraalilɛ
19 Mebisa Prisika ne Akwila, yeɛ Onesiforo awuro ama ahye. 20 Eraseto hale Korinto, na Trofimo de, nyakyili ye Mileto bɔ né ɔnde apɔ ɔ. 21Bɔ mmɔden dwu wa koraka né prakasua ne awa. Yubulo ne Pudɛn ne Lino ne Klɔdia ne aliɛmaa nemɔ amukoraa bebisa wɔ ahye. 22Awurade [Yesu Kristo] ne wɔ sunzum bɛtena. Adom ɔ́yɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

Title: TITO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Tito te Amaenmaensoniɛ. Nziɛ ye ɔɔyɛle Kristoniɛ. Né ɔte Pɔɔlo damvo ne ye asɛmbatrɛ adwuma ne anu bokafoɛ. Pɔɔlo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he ɔɔmane Tito wɔ Krete. Né wayakyi Tito wɔ berɛ kyɛ ɔnea asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ne aso. Krataa he ka nningyein titire nza nwo dwirɛ.
Bɔ oli moa ɔ: Pɔɔlo kaye Tito suban bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ asɔre mbanyi mɔ nya ɔ, ofikyɛ né Kretefoɛ pee le suban tɛɛ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, Pɔɔlo tu Tito foɛ wɔ atee bɔ ɔfa so yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ hyire mmenia ahoroɔ bɔ bɛwɔ asɔre ne anu: mmienzua mbanyi, mmrasua mbanyi bɔ bɛ koso bekohyire ndaluwa nemɔ ɔ, mmerandeɛ ne ngoaa. Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, Pɔɔlo tu Tito foɛ fa ɛhemɔ nwo: Kristoniɛ suban nwo, nganga ehiaa bɔ ohia kyɛ okuro asomdwee ne sona ɔ, kyɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa sona nwo pɔen wura ye nu; afei ɔka aporowaasulɛ ne asɔre nu mbakyembakyemuɛ nwo dwirɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-4
Asɔre mbanyi mɔ 1.5-16
Asɔre nu dwumadie 2.1-15
Foɛtulɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ 3.1-11
Ayieleɛ 3.12-15

Title: TITO 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Pɔɔlo, bɔ nde Nyameɛ akoaa ne Yesu Kristo somafoɛ mema bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ bɛ gyidie ɔne nahorɛ ne nwo nimdeɛ bɔ ɔma nyamesom paa ɔ, 2 daa ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ nu, ngoa bɔ Ɛdangama Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmbɛ ngondombo ne ɔfa hyɛle bɔ koraka yeɛ ɔbɔ aleɛ ɔ; 3 na mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, ɔlale ye dwirɛ ne ali wɔ nzɛmbahanɛ bɔ ɔte yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wawura me sa ne; 4 na mékyerɛ mebrɛ Tito, bɔ ɛte me bɔbɔ mma wɔ gyidie komapɛ ne ala nu ɔ. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ.
Suban bɔ ɔfata asɔre so neafoɛ
5 Na ɛhe ati yeɛ nyakyili wɔ wɔ Krete ɔ, kyɛ ɛ́nea toto nningyein bɔ waha ne pɛpɛɛpɛ, ná ɛyeye mbanyi mɔ wɔ kuro biala so, kyɛbɔ ngane kyɛ ɛyɔ ne: 6 Bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye bra nu; bɔ ɔye te komapɛ, bɔ ye mma mɔ bɛte agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛnyɛ basabasa anaa asoserɛ ɔ. 7 Na bɔ ɔfata neafoɛ ɛhe: ɔnzɛ kyɛ benwu ngekalewa wɔ ye bra nu, ofikyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ awuro so neafoɛ; ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔmoma ye nwo so, onya ahone, ɔyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, patapaa, anaa adifuu sona; 8 na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma ye nye gye ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ nwo, okuro bɔ ɔte paa, ɔte ebie bɔ ye adwene nu pi, ɔtengyɛ, ye nwo te, ná ole anwohyɛsoɛ ɔ; 9 ɔsɛ kyɛ otira nahorɛ dwirɛ ne anu bum kyɛbɔ behyirele ye ne, amaa ɔnate so wahora wafa ngyerɛkyerɛ paa watu foɛ, ná wama aporowaasulɛfoɛ bɛ mvomsoɛ ala ali.
10 Ofikyɛ mmeni pee wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛte asoserɛfoɛ, nzekurebɔlɛfoɛ, nnakannakafoɛ, nganga bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, 11 bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛmaa bemua bɛ noa ɔ. Bɛ yeɛ mvasoɛ fiɛ ti bekyirekyire bɔ ɔnzɛ kyɛ bekyire ɔ, na bɛfa bɛsɛkye abusuafoɛ mukoraa b’adwene. 12 Bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nu sona ko, bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ɔ, ɔhane kyɛ, “Kretefoɛ bɛte ngondombofoɛ daa biala, ngaka amumuyɛɛfoɛ, ɛfoen mmenia bɔ bɛte adifuu ɔ.” 13 Sɔ adanzeɛ he te nahorɛ, yiti twi bɛ nyunu paa, amaa ɔnate so bagyina pindinn wɔ gyidie ne anu; 14 ná banyɛ asoɛ bamma Yudafoɛ tete dwirɛ bɔ nahorɛ nne nu ne, ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛpo nahorɛ ne ɔ b’ahyɛdeɛ. 15 Nikyee biala nwo te ma bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te ɔ; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde ná benne benni ne de, nikye fee nwo nde mma bɛ; ofikyɛ b’adwene ne bɛ tiboa nwo agua fiɛ 16 Bekyire kyɛ bɛse Nyameɛ, nakoso bɛfa bɛ yɔleɛ bɛpo ye; bɛte akyiwadeɛyɔlɛ mmenia, asoserɛfoɛ, bɔ bɛngora bɛnyɔ nikye paa biala ɔ.

Title: TITO 2
Content:
Ngyerɛkyerɛ paa
1 Na wɔ de, ngyerɛkyerɛ sannwuu yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ekyire ɔ. 2 Kyirekyire ngɔkoraa nemɔ ma bɛ nye la berɛ, bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛfata anidie ɔ, benya anwohyɛsoɛ, begyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu, ɔdɔ nu ne animia nu. 3 Sɔ ala yeɛ kyirekyire nworowaa nemɔ ma bɛbɔ bra bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ɔnzɛ kyɛ bedi nzekure anaa bɛyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bekyirekyire bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, 4 amaa ɔnate so bafa batete ndaluwa nemɔ maa bahuro bɛ hu mɔ, ɔne bɛ mma mɔ dwirɛ, 5 ná badwene adwene paa, banea bɛ nwo so yé, basiesie b’awuro, bayɛ paa, babrɛ bɛ nwo ase bama bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ, ná mmenia annya edwirɛ tɛɛ banga bamva Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anwo.
6 Na mmerandeɛ nemɔ koso, sɔ ala yeɛ tu bɛ foɛ ma benya anwohyɛsoɛ ɔ. 7 Na nningyein mukoraa nu, tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ yɛ yɔleɛ paa nwo nhwɛsoɛ: Wɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ nu, da nahorɛlilɛ ne ahoneserɛ ali, 8 edwirɛ paa bɔ bengonya ye nwo dwirɛ bɛngɔhã ɔ; amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ ɔne wɔ bɛnyɛ adwene ne ye nyunu agua ase, bɔ ongonya yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔhã ɔ.
9 Ngoaa mɔ koso, tu bɛ foɛ kyɛ bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bɛma bɛ mene mɔ, ná bɛ́sɔ bɛ nye wɔ atee biala so; ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ bɛ so nyeyeanoɛ, 10 anaa bɛyɛ bɛ so awue mmaa mmaa; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛda nahorɛ paa amukoraa ali, amaa ɔnate so bama yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne wanya anidie wɔ nikyee biala nu.
11 Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɔfa ngoalelɛ brɛ adasa mmaa mukoraa ne, waye ye nwo ali. 12 Na okyirekyire yɛ, kyɛ, yɛ́gyi bra fiɛ ne wiase akɔnnɔ yɛ́gua, kyɛ yɛ́nya anwohyɛsoɛ, ná yɛ́fa tenenee ne nyamesom paa yɛtena wiase he anu, 13 wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛnwondɛ anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔte saleɛ, bɔ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ piri ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo animnyam walɛ ne ɔ. 14 Ye yeɛ ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ okole yɛ kofi amumuyɛɛ amukoraa nu, ná wate yɛ nwo wafa yɛ wayɛ ye bɔbɔ ye mmenia sonongo bɔ bɛbɔ nnwumaa paa nwo mmɔden ɔ. 15Fa tumi amukoraa kã ɛhemɔ, tu ye nwo foɛ, ná twi bɛ nyunu. Nnɛma ebiala fa wɔ nyunu twitwi ase.

Title: TITO 3
Content:
Kristoniɛ suban
1 Kaye bɛ ma bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bɛma maen mbanyi ne bɛ bɔ tumi wura bɛ sa ɔ, kyɛ bɛyɛ sotie, ná bésiesie bɛ nwo bɛ́ma nnwumaa paa biala; 2 kyɛ, nnɛmaa bɛkã ebiala nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, nnɛmaa bɛyɛ tuturefoɛ; na mmom bédwo bɛ nwo ase, ná bɛfa anidie bɔ odi mu ɔ bɛma mmenia mukoraa. 3 Ofikyɛ daa ne de, né yɛ koso yɛte ngwaseafoɛ, asoserɛfoɛ, bɛmaa yɛlili makyebu, yɛyɛle anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ne anigye ahoroɔ ngoaa, yɛfale nzɛmmɔne ne anyeboroborolɛ yɛbɔle yɛ bra, mmenia pɔle yɛ, na yɛ wora yɛpɔle bɛ. 4 Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ɔlale ye paayɛlɛ ne ye ɔdɔ ali hyirele adasa mmaa ne, 5 bɔ nna kyɛ tenenee nnwumaa bie bɔ yayɔ ti ɔ; na mmom ye bɔbɔ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ti ɔ, na ɔfale aworɛ foforɛ ebialɛ nu ne foforɛyɛlɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron so olele yɛ ngoa. 6 Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔnate yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo so ohwie guale yɛ so mmorosoɛ ɔ, 7 amaa ɔnate ye adom so wabua yɛ be, bɔ ɔkɔma yɛ sa kɔhã daa ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ ne ɔ. 8 Ɛhe te edwirɛ nahorɛ, na mekuro kyɛ esi edwirɛ hemɔ so paa, amaa ɔnate so bɛ bɔ bale Nyameɛ bali ne badwene kyɛbɔ bɛkɔbɔ nnwumaa paa nwo mmɔden ɔ. Sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ, na mvasoɛ wɔ so ma sona. 9 Nakoso twe wɔ nwo fi ngwaseaa aporowaasulɛ nwo, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nwo dwirɛ nwo, mbakyembakyemuɛ nwo, yeɛ mmeraa ne nwo aporowaasulɛ nwo; ofikyɛ mvasoɛ nne so, na bɛte mbaen. 10 Na sona bɔ ɔfa mbakyembakyemuɛ ba ne, sɛ edwudwo kyire ye ko anaa ye pɛen nyɔ so yie a, nnɛne ye bɔ afɛ ko. 11Na nwu ye kyɛ, sona bɔ ɔte sɔ ne, wali makyebu, ɔte bɔnefoɛ, na obua ye bɔbɔ ye nwo foɛ.
Ngraalilɛ
12 Sɛ mesoma Atɛma anaa Tihiko maa ɔba wɔ berɛ a, bɔ mmɔden kyɛ ɛkɔwa me berɛ wɔ Nikopoli; ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ ngooli prakasua mmerɛ ne ɔ. 13Bɔ mmɔden kyɛ ekogua mmeraa nwo nimdeɛniɛ Sena ɔne Apolo ate; nea kyɛ bengohia hwee ɔ. 14 Ma yɛ mmenia besua nnwumaa paa nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ, ná bɛ́fa bɛ́boka bɛ bɔ behia mmokalɛ paa ɔ; na mmom ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ foen bɔ mvasoɛ nne bɛ so ɔ.
15 Bɛ bɔ bɛne me wɔ wa ne amukoraa bebisa wɔ ahye. Bisa bɛ bɔ bekuro yɛ dwirɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne ahye (ma me). Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ deɛ.

Title: FILEMƆN BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Né Filemon te Kristoniɛ bɔ ole dumaa ɔ. Bekyire kyɛ né ɔwɔ Kolose asɔre ne anu. Né ole kanganiɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Onesimo. Onesimo nwati fili ye mene sa nu, na Nyameɛ adom onwuni Pɔɔlo. Né wate Pɔɔlo nwo dwirɛ wɔ ye mene awuro dada. Né Pɔɔlo la kuku nu wɔ Rome sɔ mmerɛ ne, na ɔnate Pɔɔlo so Onesimo ɔɔyɛle Kristoniɛ.
Pɔɔlo hyerɛle krataa he ɔɔsrɛle Filemon kyɛ ɔma ye kanga ne osa ba ye berɛ, na ole ye to nu nyemene so. Pɔɔlo srɛ ye kyɛ ɔyakyi ma ɔha, ná ɔne ye bɛtena kyɛ aliɛmaa Kristoniɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1-3
Pɔɔlo kamvo Filemon 4-7
Onesimo ti dwirɛlilɛ 8-22
Ayieleɛ 23-25

Title: FILEMƆN 1
Content:
1Pɔɔlo, Kristo Yesu kukununiɛ, yeɛ aliɛmaa Timoteo, yɛ́fa yɛbrɛ yɛ damvo paa ne yɛ biɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ Filemon, 2 ɔne y’eliɛma brasua Apia, yɛ biɛngo sraaniɛ Akipo, ɔne asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ w’awuro ne.
3Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ!
Filemon ɔdɔ ne ye gyidie
4Mmerɛ biala bɔ mekaye wɔ wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu ne, mefa asennaa mema me Nyameɛ, 5ofikyɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ele ye ma anwoteefoɛ amukoraa ɔne wɔ gyidie wɔ Awurade Yesu nu ne, mete ye nga. 6Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ, nningyein paa amukoraa bɔ ɔnate Kristo so ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne, bɛ nwo nimdeɛ kɔma wɔ gyidie nnwumaa ne kɔla ali piri paa. 7Aliɛmaa, ɔdɔ bɔ ele ye ne, wamaa yanya anigye ne nguraenhyɛlɛ pee, ofikyɛ ama anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bɛ wora akyekye.
Pɔɔlo di Onesimo ti dwirɛ
8Ɔnate ɛhe ati, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ahaa mekora mesi m’ahone paa wɔ Kristo nu mehyɛ wɔ maa ɛyɔ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ɔ, 9nakoso ɔnate ɔdɔ ti, mekuro kyɛ mesrɛ wɔ mmom, me Pɔɔlo bɔ mayɛ akoraa, bɔ kekesaala ye nza nde Yesu Kristo kukununiɛ ɔ. 10 Mepa wɔ kyerɛ mema mma Onesimo bɔ mayɛ ye baba wɔ me kuku nu nnaa ye anu ɔ. 11(Daa ne de, né ye nwo olle mvasoɛ mma wɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ye nwo awa mvasoɛ ama wɔ ne me).
12Mésoma ye maa osa ba wɔ berɛ; ɔte sona bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ. 13Ahaa mekuro kyɛ memaa ɔtena me nwo wa, ná ogyina wɔ gya nu ɔso me, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nzɛmba ne ati nna kukunu ye; 14nakoso menguro kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ si ngɔyɔ nikyee biala ɔ, ná wɔ paayɛlɛ ne anyɛ kyɛ mehyɛ wɔ ɔ, na mmom wafi w’ahone nu.
15Ebiaa ɛhe ati yeɛ ofili wɔ nwo mmerɛ kãa bie ɔ, amaa ɔnate so afa ye ayɛ wɔ deɛ bɔkɔɔ; 16bɔ nna kyɛ kanganiɛ ko, na mmom ye dibea bo kanganiɛ so, kyɛ aliɛmaa bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo paa ɔ, na wɔ de, ɔte sɔ ma wɔ tra so koraa, wɔ anwoɔnaen ne Awurade nu.
17Yiti sɛ ebu me kyɛ ebiɛngo de a, nzaade de ye nyemene so kyɛbɔ ekole me ne ala. 18Sɛ wayɛ wɔ tɛɛ bie, anaakyɛ ɔma wɔ kerɛ a, bu kerɛ ne ma me. 19Me Pɔɔlo, me bɔbɔ me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ ɛhe: Ngotua wɔ kerɛ bɔ ɔma wɔ ɔ; na ahaa menguro kyɛ mefa me noa mebɔ so kyɛ wɔ sona mumua ne po ɔma me kerɛ. 20Yiti aliɛmaa, maa nya anigye bie mvi wɔ berɛ wɔ Awurade nu; kyekye me wora wɔ Kristo nu.
21Mede wɔ medi kyɛ ekotie me ti yeɛ mekyerɛ wɔ krataa ye ɔ, na mese kyɛ bɔ mebisa wɔ ye, ɛkɔyɔ maa ɔkɔbo so po. 22Afei koso, siesie ɛwɔfoɛ sua ma me, na me nye la so kyɛ, ɔnate ɛmɔ mbaeɛ so ngonya atee ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.
Ngraalilɛ
23 Epafra bɔ ɔte mmiɛngo kukununiɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, 24 yeɛ Marko, Aristako, Dema ne Luka bɔ bɛte mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne, bebisa wɔ ahye.
25Yɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ sunzum bɛtena.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Bɛhyerɛle krataa he bɛɛmane Akristofoɛ biemɔ. Né ɔnate amaneɛnwunɛ ti bɛpena bɛyakyi bɛ gyidie nu. Yiti sona bɔ ɔhyerɛle krataa ne hyɛ bɛ nguraen wɔ bɛ gyidie nu, na okyire nu maa benwu ye kyɛ Yesu Kristo te Nyameɛ sɔfo bɔ waye ye wahyire ne.
Ye dwirɛ ne gyi nningyein nza hemɔ so: Bɔ oli moa, Yesu te Nyameɛ Awa afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔfale ye amaneɛnwunɛ so brɛle ye nwo ase nahorɛ nu mane Baba ne ɔ. Yesu te Nyameɛ Awa, yiti odi mu tra Apam Daa ne anu ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, abɔfo mɔ, yeɛ Mose bɔbɔ deinn. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, Nyameɛ ayɛ Yesu ɔsɔfo afebɔɔ, bɔ odi mu tra Apam Daa ne anu asɔfo nemɔ ɔ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ɔ, ɔnate Yesu so Nyameɛ de gyidiniɛ fi bɔne, ɛserɛ, ne ewue nu. Yesu te ɔsɔfo panyi paa, yiti ɔma daa ngoa bɔ ɔnate Hebrifoɛ nyamesom so bebukyele so kãa behyirele yɛ ne.
Afei bɔ ɔhyerɛle krataa ne fa mmeni titire biemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yisrael abakɔsɛm nu gyidie yɛ mvandoho (Ti 11); na osa srɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkenga krataa ne kyɛ ɔhɔ so sɔ ye gyidie nu yé. Osa srɛ bɛ wɔ ye ti 12 ne anu kyɛ bɛnea Yesu, na bɛbɔ mmɔden begyina amaneɛ ne ndaneanyeɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔto bɛ noa. Krataa n’ayieleɛ te foɛtulɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa: Kristo ye Nyameɛ sue kyire 1.1-3
Kristo di mu tra abɔfo mɔ 1.4—2.18
Kristo di mu tra Mose ne Yosua 3.1—4.13
Kristo te sɔfo sonongo 4.14—7.28
Kristo apam ne di mu tra apam biala 8.1—9.22
Kristo afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne di mu tra afɔleɛ biala 9.23—10.39
Gyidie nwo hia paa 11.1—12.29
Kyɛbɔ yɛkɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ 13.1-19
Mbaeɛbɔlɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ 13.20-21
Ngraalilɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ 13.22-25

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 1
Content:
Nyameɛ fa Ɔwa ne so dwudwo
1Daa tete ne, mmerɛ pee nu ne atee ahoroɔ so yeɛ Nyameɛ nate ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so dwudwo hyirele yɛ nana mɔ ɔ; 2 nakoso ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu de, wafa Ɔwa ne aso yeɛ wadwudwo wahyire yɛ ɔ, ye bɔ wama agyapadeɛ amukoraa wayɛ ye deɛ, ye bɔ ɔnate ye so yeɛ ɔbɔle wiase amukoraa ɔ. 3Ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ animnyam hyireinn ne, ɔne ye sue kaenn, na ole ye tumi dwirɛ ne yeɛ otira nningyein mukoraa nu ɔ. Na ɔtele yɛ nwo fili yɛ bɔne nwo yiele nen, ɔɔtenane Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ sa famaa so wɔ nyameɛso.
Nyameɛ Awa ne tra abɔfo mɔ
4Nyameɛ mane Baa ne trale abɔfo mɔ, kyɛbɔ dumaa bɔ ye sa aha ye ne koso bo bɛ deɛ so ne. 5 Ɔnate kyɛ, abɔfo mɔ nu beni yeɛ Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye le kyɛ,
“Ɛte Mma,
na ɛnɛ mayɛ wɔ Baba” ɔ?
Anaakyɛ,
“Ngɔyɛ ye Baba,
na ye wora wayɛ Mma” ɔ?
6Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ baasoma ye bamuɛbaa ne maa ɔba wiase ne de, ɔhane kyɛ,
“Ɔsɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ abɔfo mukoraa bɛsɔne ye.”
7 Na bɔ Nyameɛ ha fale abɔfo mɔ nwo ɛhe:
“Nyameɛ yɛ ye abɔfo mɔ mvrama,
na ɔyɛ ye somvoɛ mɔ see bɔ ogye ɔ.”
8 Nakoso Ɔwa ne de, bɔ ɔha fale ye nwo ɛhe:
“O Nyameɛ, w’ahennie bia wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!
W’Ahennie hɔtɔ ne te teenenee hɔtɔ.
9Ekuro tenenee, na ekyi amumuyɛɛ.
Ɛhe ati Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ aye wɔ;
wafa anika ngoo wapopa wɔ maa wabo wɔ mmango mɔ deɛ so.”
10 Nyameɛ sa hane kyɛ yoo:
“Wɔ, Awurade, ahyɛaseɛ ne, ɛtole aseɛ fapem,
na anwuro te wɔ sa noa adwuma;
11bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔsɛkye, nakoso wɔ de, ɛwɔ berɛ daa;
bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔyɛ daa kyɛ ataadeɛ yɛ daa ɔ,
12ekobubu bɛ kyɛ ɛtena,
na bɛkɔsesã bɛ kyɛ ataadeɛ;
nakoso wɔ de, kyɛbɔ ɛte ne ala yeɛ ɛte ɔ,
na ɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.”
13 Na abɔfo mɔ nu beni yeɛ Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye le kyɛ,
“Tena me sa famaa so kodwu kyɛ
ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ?”
14Aso bɛ mukoraa bɛtte sunzum asomvoɛ mɔ, bɔ ɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔɔso mmenia bɔ bekonya ngoalelɛ ɔ?

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 2
Content:
Yɛfa Kristo so yɛnya daa ngoa
1Ye sɔ ne ati, odi kyɛ yɛsɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ yate ne anu yé ná yammini. 2Na sɛ edwirɛ bɔ abɔfo mɔ hane ne te nahorɛ, ná mmeraatolɛ biala ne asoserɛ biala nyane ye so akatuaa kyɛbɔ ɔfata hɔ a, 3nzaade sɛ yɛpo ngoalelɛ piri bɔ ɔte sɔa de a, yɛkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná yafa yɛ nwo yali? Awurade lili moa bɔle ngoalelɛ he nwo dawure, na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ne koso lili ye nwo adanzeɛ maa yɛnwuni kyɛ ɔte nahorɛ. 4Na Nyameɛ koso yɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne tumi nnwumaa ahoroɔ, na ɔmane Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye apɛdeɛ si te ɔ fa lili edwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ.
Kristo fa yɛ kɔ daa ngoa nu
5Ofikyɛ nna abɔfo mɔ bo yeɛ Nyameɛ fale ewiase bɔ ɔ́ba bɔ yɛkã ye nwo dwirɛ ne owurale ɔ. 6 Na mmom bahã ye nekaa bie kyɛ,
“Dasaniɛ te nzu koraa
bɔ ɛdwene ye nwo ɔ?
Anaakyɛ sona awa te nzu,
bɔ wɔ nye ku ye nwo ɔ?
7Ɛmaa ɔhɔle ase bie trale abɔfo mɔ,
ɛfale animnyam ne anidie bɔle ye abotire,
[ɛfale wɔ sa noa adwuma wurale ye sa,]
8na ɛfale nningyein mukoraa wurale ye gya bo.”
Na sɛ ɔkã kyɛ Nyameɛ fale “nningyein mukoraa wurale ye bo” a, né okyire kyɛ nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ wamva wanwura ye bo ɔ. Nakoso kekesaala ye de, yɛnnya yɛnnwuni kyɛ wafa nningyein mukoraa wawura ye bo. 9Nakoso yɛnwu Yesu kyɛ, (mmerɛ kãa bie anu) Nyameɛ maa ɔhɔle ase kãa trale abɔfo mɔ, amaa ɔnate Nyameɛ adom ti wawu wama adasa mukoraa. Na ɔnate ye wue bɔ owuli ne ati, Nyameɛ afa animnyam ne anidie wabɔ ye abotire.
10Ofikyɛ ye bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa na nningyein mukoraa te ye deɛ ne, bɔ ɔnate Yesu so fa ye mma kɔ animnyam nu ne, né ɔfata kyɛ ɔma bɛ ngoalelɛ safohene Yesu ɔfa amaneɛnwunɛ nu odi mu.
11Na bɔ ɔte mmenia nwo fi bɛ bɔne nwo ne, ɔne mmenia bɔ ɔte bɛ nwo ne amukoraa bɛ Baba te ko; na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ɔnyɛ ye nya kyɛ ɔkɔfrɛ bɛ oliɛma mɔ ɔ. 12 Ɔnwa yoo:
“Ngɔbɔ wɔ dumaa ngohyire nniɛma mɔ,
na ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ agyidifoɛ badwa nu.”
13 Osa hane kyɛ,
“Ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu.”
Na osa hane ye bieku kyɛ,
“Me ɛhe, me ne mmaa bɔ Nyameɛ afa bɛ ama me ne.”
14Na ɔnate kyɛ mmaa nemɔ te anwoɔnaen ne mogya ne ati, Yesu bɔbɔ yɛle ye nwo kyɛ bɛ ala, ɔfale sɔ sona sue ne bie, amaa ɔnate ye wue ne aso wasɛkye abɔnzam bɔ ye yeɛ ole ewue so tumi ne; 15ná wale bɛ bɔ ɔnate esurolɛ bɔ besuro ewue ti bayɛ ngoaa mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase mukoraa nu ne. 16 Na ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ nna abɔfo mɔ yeɛ oolele bɛ ɔ, na mmom Abraham boso ama yeɛ oolele bɛ ɔ. 17Ɛhe ati, né ohia kyɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ oliɛma nemɔ wɔ atee biala so, amaa wahora wayɛ sɔfo panyi paa bɔ odi nahorɛ, bɔ ɔse anwumvoin wɔ Nyameɛ dwumadie nu, ná wafa ye nwo wayɛ mbata wama adasa bɔne. 18Na ɔnate kyɛ ye bɔbɔ besole ye bɛneane ná onwuni amaneɛ ne ati, ɔkora boka bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nzɔhwɛ nu ɔ.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 3
Content:
Yesu tra Mose
1Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ anwoteefoɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, ɛ́mɔnea Somafoɛ Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛkã ne anwo ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne kyɛ, 2 olili nahorɛ mane bɔ otuli ye siele berɛ ne, kyɛbɔ Mose koso lili nahorɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro mukoraa nu ne. 3Na kyɛbɔ suasilɛfoɛ le animnyam paa tra sua nen, sɔ ala koso yeɛ Yesu le animnyam tra Mose ɔ. 4Ɔnate kyɛ, sua biala kuro sona yeɛ osi ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ nningyein mukoraa ɔ. 5 Mose de, olili nahorɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro mukoraa nu kyɛ somvoɛ, na olili nningyein bɔ né Nyameɛ baahã ye nwo dwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ. 6Nakoso Kristo de, odi Nyameɛ awuro so kyɛ Baa. Yiti yɛ ole ye awuro ne, nakoso sana yɛsɔ yɛ gyidie ne yɛ anwohoahoa bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ anyelasoɛ nu yé kodwu ayieleɛ.
Nyameɛ mmenia nwomelelɛ
7 Yiti kyɛbɔ Sunzum Krongron kã hɔ ɛhe:
“Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a,
8nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ,
kyɛbɔ bɛyɛle ye so lɔen,
wɔ mmerɛ bɔ besole ye bɛneane wɔ ɛserɛ so ne.
9Berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ gyegyele me besole me bɛneane,
na benwuni me nnwumaa afoɛ aburanna ɔ.
10Yiti mvɛle sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne so yaa,
na ngane kyɛ,
‘Daa biala bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri,
na bɛnze atee bɔ mefa so meyɔ me nningyein ɔ.’
11Yiti nne ɛyaa ndale ndaen kyɛ,
‘Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie le!’ ”
12Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔnea yé na ɛmɔ nu biala annya adwene tɛɛ bɔ ɔmma onne nni ɔ, na wandwe ye nwo wamvi Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne nwo. 13Na mmom ɛmɔtutu bɛ nwo foɛ kyẽa biala bɔ bɛfrɛ ye “Ɛnɛ” ne, na bɔne annakalaka ɛmɔ nu biala amma wanyɛ asoserɛ. 14Na sɛ yɛsɔ gyidie bɔ yɛlili moa yɛnyane ye ne anu yé yɛkɔ ayieleɛ a, ye de yɛle kyɛfa wɔ Kristo nu. 15 Kyɛbɔ bɛkã kyɛ,
“Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a,
nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ,
kyɛbɔ bɛyɛle ye so lɔen ne.”
16Nwa mɔ yeɛ bɛtele Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ, nakoso bɛyɛle ye so lɔen ne? Aso nna bɛ bɔ Mose yele bɛ fili Misraim ne amu ɔ? 17 Nwa mɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ fɛle bɛ so yaa afoɛ aburanna ne? Aso nna bɛ bɔ bɛyɔle bɔne na bɛtotɔle amono nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ne ɔ? 18Nyameɛ ndaen bɔ ɔtale kyɛ, “bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie le” nen, né ɔne nwa mɔ? Aso nna bɛ bɔ bɛyɛle asoserɛ ne ɔ? 19Na ɛhe maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ banwura nwomelelɛ ne anu, ɔnate kyɛ banne banni.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 4
Content:
1Yiti kyɛbɔ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔfa ye nwomelelɛ nu hɔlɛ nwo tɛwɔ berɛ ye de, ɛ́mɔma yɛnea yé ná wamma ye kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala sa anga ye. 2Bɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele yɛ kyɛbɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne ala, nakoso ye nwo amma mvasoɛ amma bɛ; ofikyɛ bamva gyidie banzɔ edwirɛ bɔ bɛtele ne anu. 3 Na yɛ bɔ yale yali ne yeɛ yɛwura sɔ nwomelelɛ ne anu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhane kyɛ,
“Yiti nne ɛyaa ndale ndaen kyɛ,
‘Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie!’ ”
Oyiele ye nnwumaa yɔle fi ewiase ahyɛaseɛ ne. 4 Ɔnate kyɛ wahã kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne nwo dwirɛ wɔ nekaa bie kyɛ, “Na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo nen, Nyameɛ lele ye nwome wɔ ye nnwumaa mukoraa nu.” 5 Na ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ he bieku wɔ wa kyɛ, “Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie!” 6Bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛtele nzɛmba ne, bannya sɔ nwomelelɛ bɔhyɛ ne, ofikyɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ; nakoso sɔ nwomelelɛ bɔhyɛ ne tɛwɔ berɛ ma ebiemɔ. 7 Yiti Nyameɛ asa ahyɛ kyẽa foforɛ ato berɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye “Ɛnɛ” ɔ. Na afoɛ pee asi ne, ɔfale Dawide so hane edwirɛ bɔ bali moa bahã ne kyɛ,
“Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a,
nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ.”
8 Na sɛ Yosua maa benyane nwomelelɛ ne a, ahaa nziɛ ye Nyameɛ wangã kyẽa foforɛ nwo dwirɛ ko. 9Nzaade afofikyẽalilɛ wɔ berɛ ma Nyameɛ mmenia; 10 ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ wawura Nyameɛ nwomelelɛ ne anu nen, ye koso wale ye nwome wɔ ye nnwumaa nwo, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ lele ye nwome wɔ ye deɛ nwo ne.
11Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ mmɔden yɛwura sɔ nwomelelɛ ne anu, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wanyɔ sɔ asoserɛ ne wamvi ase. 12Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne te ase na anwoserɛ wɔ nu, na ɔyɛ nna tra sɛpɔ biala. Ɔpɛ tonn kɔworo ɛkra ne sunzum b’afia, sona aporɛ so ne ye bowue nu fonyi b’afia, na ɔpɛnzɛpɛnze ahone ne adwene nu nzusuleɛ mukoraa nu. 13Abɔdeɛ biala mvea wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ye bɔ odi kyɛ yɛbu ngondaa yɛkyire ye ne, nikyee biala mvea ye, na ye nye tua nningyein mukoraa.
Yesu te yɛ sɔfo panyi paa
14Ɛmɔma yɛsɔ yɛ gyidie nu serɛ, ofikyɛ yɛle ɔsɔfo panyi paa, Nyameɛ Awa Yesu bɔ wafa ewienu wahɔ nyameɛso ɔ. 15Yɛ sɔfo panyi paa he de, ɔtte ebie bɔ ɔngora nnwu yɛ anwumvoin wɔ yɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu ɔ; na mmom ɔte ebie bɔ besole ye bɛneane wɔ atee biala so kyɛ yɛ ala, nakoso wanyɔ bɔne ɔ. 16Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛsi y’ahone yɛbra adom ahennie bia ne nyunu, amaa ɔnate so wanwu yɛ anwumvoin, ná yanya adom bɔ ɔkɔboka yɛ ɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 5
Content:
1Bɛye ɔsɔfo panyi paa biala befi mmenia nu maa ogyina bɛ gya nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, na ɔfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ srɛ bɔnefakyɛ. 2Na ɔnate kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔtɔ sii wɔ nningyein pee nu ne ati, ɔkora nwu bɛ bɔ bɛnze na bɛyɔ mvomsoɛ ne anwumvoin. 3 Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, nna mmenia bɛ bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ ngome yeɛ ɔbɔ ɔ; na mmom odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye deɛ koso. 4 Ebiala ngora mva sɔ dibea ne ndo ye nwo so, na mmom sana Nyameɛ afrɛ ye kyɛbɔ ɔfrɛle Aarɔn nen. 5 Sɔ ala koso yeɛ Kristo amva sɔ dibea ne wando ye nwo so kyɛ ɔte sɔfo panyi paa ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔbɔ hã hyirele ye kyɛ,
“Ɛte Mma,
ɛnɛ mayɛ wɔ Baba.”
6 Na Nyameɛ asa aha ye nekaa foforɛ kyɛ,
“Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”
7 Mmerɛ bɔ né Yesu wɔ aseɛ ye aso wa nen, ɔfale esuɛ ne ye nye moen teateane nu fale ye mbaeɛ ne nikyeesrɛlɛ tole Nyameɛ bɔ ɔkora ye ye fi ewue nu ne nyunu, na ɔnate ye nyamesuro ti Nyameɛ tiele ye. 8Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte Baa de, nakoso osuane sotie fili ye amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu; 9 na olili mu yiele nen, ɔɔyɛle ngoa bɔ olle ayieleɛ ti mane bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sotie bɛma ye nemɔ amukoraa, 10 na Nyameɛ yɛle ye sɔfo panyi paa kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ
11Yɛle ɛhe nwo dwirɛ pee paa yɛkã, nakoso nu hyirehyirelɛ kɔyɛ se; ofikyɛ ɛmɔkyɛ koraa né ɛmɔate dwirɛ bo. 12 Wahyɛ bɔ ahaa odi kyɛ kekesaala ye ɛmɔyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔtɛhia sona bɔ ɔkɔhyɛ ye bo kosa kohyirehyire ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ɔ. Ɛmɔnhia aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔtɛhia nyɔfonesue. 13Na ebiala bɔ nyɔfonesue te ye aleɛ nen, ye nimdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ tenenee nwo te kãa, ofikyɛ ɔte akwadaa. 14Nakoso bɛ bɔ banyi (sunzum nu) ne de, aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ no yeɛ ɔfata bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ basua banwu ye, na bɛkora benwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ paa ne tɛɛ nu ɔ.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 6
Content:
1Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi Kristo nwo ngwadaa ngwadaa ngyerɛkyerɛ ne, ná yɛfa yɛ ti yɛwura mbanyi nikyeesualɛ nu. Ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛkɔhyɛ ye bo bieku yɛpena yɔleɛ basabasa nwo adwenesakyera ne Nyameɛ nu gyidie ko; 2asubɔlɛ ahoroɔ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ, asaa bɔ bɛfa begua sona so, awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ ne. 3Na ɛhe yeɛ sɛ Nyameɛ ma ye nwo ate a, yɛkɔyɔ ɔ.
4 Na ɔngɔhora ngɔwa kyɛ bɛ bɔ mmerɛ bie bɛwale kanea ne anu, bɔ benyane nyameɛso akyɛdeɛ ne, bɔ bɛ sa hane Sunzum Krongron ne bie, 5ná benwuni Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne nwo mvasoɛ, ɔne ewiase foforɛ bɔ ɔbaawa ne anu tumi ne, 6sɛ bedi gyidie ne anwo makyebu a, bekosa bɛkɔsakyera b’adwene ko ɔ; ofikyɛ besa bɛbɔ Nyameɛ Awa ne mmeamudua nu bɛma bɛ nwo, na begua ye nyunu ase wɔ mmenia nu.
7Aseɛ bɔ ɔmeme nzue bɔ ɔtaa tɔ gua so, na ofifi aleɛ bɔ ye nwo hia ma mmenia bɔ bɛ ti yeɛ bɛyɔ so boo nen, Nyameɛ yira ye. 8 Nakoso sɛ ofifi mmowue ne ɛfone de a, ye de mvasoɛ biala nne ye so; ɔngyɛ né Nyameɛ apaye ye, na ye ayieleɛ ole kyɛ ɔfa see sɛkye ye.
9Nakoso aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ yɛkã sɔ po a, y’adwene si yɛ pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛ atee paa bɔ ɔkɔ ngoalelɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔnate so ɔ. 10Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de, ɔtte asisie bɔ ɔkobu ye nye kogua ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ, ɔne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔnate ye dumaa ti ɛmɔaye ye ali bahyire anwoteefoɛ, ná ɛmɔtɛyɔ ɔ. 11Na yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala kɔ so bɔ mmɔden sɔ ala kɔ ayieleɛ, amaa ɛmɔ sa ahã bɔ ɛmɔ nye la so ne. 12Yɛnguro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ nyaanyaa, na mmom yɛkuro kyɛ ɛmɔsua bɛ bɔ bɛnate gyidie ne aboterɛ so benya Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne.
Nyameɛ hyɛ Abraham bɔ
13 Mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle Abraham bɔ nen, ɔnate kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔtra ye (Nyameɛ) bɔbɔ bɔ ɔkɔfa ye kɔta ndaen ne ati, ɔtale ye bɔbɔ ye nwo ndaen 14kyɛ, “Amba, ngoyira wɔ ná mama wɔ boso ama bata pee.” 15Abraham nyane aboterɛ nwondɛle, na ye sa hane bɔhyɛ ne. 16Ofikyɛ amba, sona fa ebie bɔ odi mu tra ye ɔ, ye dumaa yeɛ ɔta ndaen ɔ, na ndaen bɔ ɔfa foa so ne ma aporowaasulɛ biala so pɛ. 17Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ yɛle kyɛ ɔkɔma bɛ bɔ bɔhyɛ ne te bɛ deɛ konwu ye pefee kyɛ ɔnzesã ye adwene nen, ɔfale ndaen foale so. 18Yiti ɔnate nningyein nyɔ bɔ ɔnzesã, bɔ okyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ngɔhora ngɔpɛ ngondombo ne wamaa yɛ bɔ yanwati yaafea ye nu ne yanya nguraenhyɛlɛ mmorosoɛ, na yasɔ anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔla yɛ nyunu ne anu yé. 19 Na anyelasoɛ he te sɛkyɛ bɔ otira yɛ kra nu ɔ; ɔnde, na ɔkɔworo ɛtena bɔ onwi nyameɛso Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu kɔ Krongron nu Krongron ne anu. 20 Berɛ yeɛ Yesu ali moa ahɔ ama yɛ ɔ, na waayɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa afebɔɔ kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 7
Content:
Ɔsɔfo Mɛlkisɛdɛke
1 Sɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke ne, ɔte Salem hene, na osa te Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne ye sɔfo. Mmerɛ bɔ Abraham fi koɛ bɔ oohuhuni ɛhene biemɔ na osa ba nen, Mɛlkisɛdɛke ooyiale ye, na oyirale ye; 2na Abraham buli ye nningyein mukoraa nu buru tuli ko mane ye. Sɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke he dumaa ne bo kyire “Tenenee hene,” yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Salem hene ne ati, ye bo sa kyire “asomdwee hene.” 3Olle niɛ, olle seɛ, olle abusua biala, ye ngyẽa olle ahyɛaseɛ, yeɛ ye ngoa koso olle ayieleɛ. Ɔte kyɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne, na ɔte sɔfo afebɔɔ.
Mɛlkisɛdɛke tra Abraham
4Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛbɔ ye sona titire si te ɔ! Abraham bɔ ɔte yɛ nana ne po, koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ onyane ye ne, ɔmane ye buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko. 5 Né Lewi abusua bɔ betira asɔfo dwumadie ne anu ne, bele ahyɛdeɛ wɔ mmeraa ne anu kyɛ béle buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko befi b’eliɛma mɔ Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ koso bɛte Abraham bosofoɛ kyɛ bɛ ala ɔ. 6Na biaa bɔ ye abusua ɔtte bɛ deɛ ne bie ne, olele buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko fili Abraham berɛ, na osa yirale bɔ né bɔhyɛ ne te ye deɛ ne. 7Na aporowaa biala nne ye nwo kyɛ bɔ odi mu ne yeɛ oyira bɔ ɔte kãa ɔ. 8Na ɛwa, mmenia bɔ bewu ɔ yeɛ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne ɔ; nakoso dɔ de, bɔ bedi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ ɔte ase ne yeɛ ode ɔ. 9Na yɛkɔhora yɛkɔhã kyɛ, Lewi bɔbɔ po bɔ ode buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, ye koso ɔfale Abraham so tuale buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne bie; 10ofikyɛ, né bennya bɛwwole ye de, nakoso né ɔwɔ ye nana Abraham mogya nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke yiale Abraham ne.
11 Ɔnate Lewi abusua kure asɔfo dwumadie ne aso yeɛ maen ne nyane mmeraa ne ɔ. Na sɛ bɛ dwumadie bɔ ɔte kyɛ Aarɔn deɛ ne lili mu a, ahaa bɛ nu bie yeɛ bɛyele ye maa ɔyɛle sɔfo ɔ. Nzaade ahaa ye nwo nhia kyɛ ɔsɔfo foforɛ bieku kɔɔyɛ kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ɔ. 12Ɔnate kyɛ, sɛ bɛsesã asɔfolilɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ne a, né ohia kyɛ bɛsesa mmeraa ne koso. 13Sona bɔ sɔ dwirɛ he fa ye nwo ne, ofi abusua kure foforɛ nu, yeɛ ye abusuaniɛ biala koso ɔyyɔle afɔleɛ bokyea nwo adwuma le. 14Na ebiala se ye pefee kyɛ y’Awurade fi Yuda abusua nu; yeɛ Mose koso ammɔ sɔ abusua kure he dumaa wammata sɔfolilɛ nwo.
Mɛlkisɛdɛke sɛso sɔfo
15 Bɔ ɔma edwirɛ ne nye la berɛ pefee ole kyɛ, ɔsɔfo foforɛ adwɔso bɔ ye sɛso te kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke ɔ. 16Nna kuro sona abusua nu nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye mmeraa so yeɛ bɛfa bɛyele ye ɔ; na mmom ɔnate ngoa bɔ ye bo ngɔpɛ le tumi so yeɛ ɔyɛle sɔfo ɔ. 17 Ofikyɛ odi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ,
“Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”
18Atee ko aso de, batu daa nhyehyɛleɛ ne bagua; ɔtɔ sii, yeɛ mvasoɛ koso nne so 19ofikyɛ mmeraa ne amma nikyee biala anni mu. Nakoso atee foforɛ so de, anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔte paa tra daa deɛ ne wɔ berɛ, bɔ yɛfa so yɛpingye Nyameɛ ɔ.
20Ɛhe deɛ ne de, Nyameɛ angwati ndaen yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ, nakoso asɔfo hene mɔ deɛ de, wamva ndaen wamvoa so, 21 na mmom ɛhe deɛ de, ɔtale ndaen hane kyɛ yoo:
“Awurade ata ndaen,
na ɔngɔkakyi ye adwene le, kyɛ,
‘Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ.’ ”
22Na ɛhe ma Yesu di apam bɔ odi mu tra so ɔ nu agyinamuɛ.
Kristo te sɔfo afebɔɔ
23Asa koso, né asɔfo nemɔ sone, ofikyɛ ewue amma bɛ ate amma bandoa b’adwuma so; 24nakoso ɔnate kyɛ Yesu te ase afebɔɔ ne ati, ye sɔfolilɛ dwumadie ne koso wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ. 25Yiti ɔkora de bɛ bɔ bɛfa ye so bɛba Nyameɛ berɛ ne ngoa bɔkɔɔ; ofikyɛ ɔte ase afebɔɔ, na odi bɛ ti dwirɛ ma bɛ.
26Yiti ɔsɔfo panyi paa bɔ ɔte sɔa yeɛ ɔfata kyɛ yɛnya ɔ. Ɔte krongron, mvomsoɛ anaa bɔne biala nne ye nwo, baye ye basie ahameɛ bafi bɔnefoɛ nu, na babɔ ye panyi paa wɔ nyameɛso. 27 Ye de, ɔtte kyɛ asɔfo mbanyi paa hene mɔ, onhia kyɛ ɛlɛho biala odi moa bɔ ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne nwo afɔleɛ koraka na wabɔ maen deɛ, na mmom ɔfale ye nwo bɔle afɔleɛ pɛnko. 28 Mmeraa ne de, ɔyɛ mmenia bɔ mvomsoɛ wɔ bɛ nwo asɔfo mbanyi paa, nakoso Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ndaen la so, bɔ mmeraa ne asi yeɛ ɔwale ne de, ɔyɛ Baa bɔ odi mu bɔkɔɔ ne ɔsɔfo panyi paa afebɔɔ.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 8
Content:
Yesu te yɛ sɔfo panyi paa
1 Edwirɛ bɔ yɛkã ne, porɛ bɔ ogyi so paa ɛhe: ɔsɔfo panyi paa sɔaa yeɛ yɛle ye ɔ, na ɔte Tuminiɛ n’ahennie bia ne famaa so wɔ nyameɛso. 2Na odi ye sɔfo ne wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu, ɔne ɛtena sua kaenn bɔ nna dasaniɛ, na mmom Awurade yeɛ osili ɔ nu.
3Bɛye ɔsɔfo panyi paa biala kyɛ ɔfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔlebɔdeɛ ma Nyameɛ; na ye sɔ ne ati, ohia kyɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa he koso nya nikyee fa bɔ afɔleɛ. 4Na sɛ ɔwɔ aseɛ ye aso a, ahaa ɔngɔyɛ sɔfo po, ofikyɛ asɔfo mɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ begyina mmeraa ne aso bɛfa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛma ɔ. 5 Na bɛ dwumadie ne, ɔte nyameɛso deɛ ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ, ɔne wawoɛ; ofikyɛ anzana Nyameɛ baama Mose si ɛtena sua nen, osele ye kyɛ, “Nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ nikyee biala maa ye sɛso kɔyɛ kyɛ bɔ mva ngyirele wɔ wɔ bokaa ne aso nen pɛpɛɛpɛ.” 6Nakoso kekesaala ye de, Kristo sa ahã sɔfodwuma bɔ odi mu bɔkɔɔ tra bɛ deɛ ne, ofikyɛ apam bɔ odi mu, na afei ogyi bɔhyɛ bɔ odi mu so yeɛ ɔte nu ndamgyinaniɛ ɔ.
Apam foforɛ nwo bɔhyɛ
7Na sɛ apam bɔ oli moa ne ɔndɔ sii a, ahaa né ye nwo nhia kyɛ yɛkonya apam bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ. 8 Nyameɛ nwuni mvomsoɛ wɔ ye mmenia nwo, yiti ɔhane kyɛ,
“Tie, mmerɛ bie kɔwa,
bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama
yɛkɔhyehyɛ apam foforɛ ɔ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne;
9na ɔngɔyɛ kyɛ apam bɔ me ne bɛ nana mɔ hyehyɛle wɔ kyẽa
bɔ nzɔle bɛ sa nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ne;
ɔnate kyɛ bangɔso banni m’apam ne aso,
na me koso nyele me nye mvili bɛ so,
Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.
10Na sɔ ngyẽa ne asi ne,
apam bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama yɛkɔhyehyɛ hɔ ɛhe,
Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne:
Ngɔfa me mmeraa ngowura b’adwene nu,
na mahyerɛ ye wɔ b’ahone nu,
ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ,
na bɛ wora bayɛ me mmenia.
11Na bɛ nu biala ngohyirehyire obiɛngo,
anaa ɔngɔhã ngohyire oliɛma kyɛ ‘Nwu Awurade,’
ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa, fite ngwadaa so
kodwu mbanyi so bekonwu me.
12Ngonwu b’amumuyɛɛ nwo anwumvoin,
na mengɔkaye bɛ bɔne ne bɛ mvomsoɛ ko.”
13Na sɛ Nyameɛ kã kyɛ “Apam foforɛ” a, né obu bɔ oli moa ne kyɛ wayɛ daa; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ye mmerɛ ogu so ɔpɛ nu ná ɔyɛ daa nen, ɔngyɛ né watu wamini.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 9
Content:
Apam daa ne anu afɔleɛ
1 Na afei, né apam bɔ oli moa ne le ɛsɔnenɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ, ɔne aseɛ he aso nekaa krongron bɔ bɛsɔne ɔ. 2 Ɔnate kyɛ, besili ɛtena sua; bɔ bedi moa befite so ne bɛfrɛ ye Nekaa Krongron. Né kanea bakaa, ɛpoen ne paanoo krongron wɔ sɔ pumbu ne anu. 3 Né ɛtena sua bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Krongron nu Krongron wɔ mbɛmuɛ tena bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne asi. 4 Né sɔ nningyein hemɔ wɔ nu: esikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ so, apam alaka bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ baboro ye nwo amu ɔ, sikaa kɔkorɛ kutusi bɔ mana wɔ nu ɔ, Aarɔn pɔmaa bɔ ɔfefɛle ne, ɔne nyɔboɛ nyɔ bɔ bahyerɛ apam ne bagua so ne. 5 Né animnyam kɛrubim mɔ batrɛtrɛ bɛ ndaa nu wɔ mbata bia ne aso wɔ alaka ne aso. Nakoso kekesaala ye de, yɛngɔhora yɛngɔhã sɔ nningyein hemɔ nwo dwirɛ ngoko ngoko.
6 Kyɛ bahyehyɛ berɛ nningyein hɔ ɛne, na asɔfo nemɔ kɔ ɛtena sua bɔ oli moa ne anu ɛlɛho biala bɛkɔyɔ b’adwuma. 7 Nakoso bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu de, ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne ngome yeɛ afoɛnoa biala ɔkɔ berɛ komapɛ twe ɔ; na ɔfa kaka mogya kɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ, ɔne maen ne amu bɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. 8Na Sunzum Krongron kyire nu pefee kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ né ɛtena sua ne tɛwɔ berɛ ne de, né bennya bebbukyele atee bɔ bɛfa so bɛkɔ krongron nu krongron ne anu ɔ. 9Na ɛhe te mvandoho ma ɛnɛ mmerɛ ye, bɔ mmenia fa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ bɛma, nakoso ɔngora mma sona bɔ ɔsɔne Nyameɛ ne tiboa mmua ye be. 10Ofikyɛ ɔfa aleɛ, anonneɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo petenɛ ahoroɔ ngome nwo; na ɛhemɔ te anwoɔnaen nu nziesie bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kodwu mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kɔhyehyɛ nikyee biala foforɛ ɔ.
Kristo afɔleɛ ne di mu
11Nakoso Kristo de, wawa kyɛ nningyein paa bɔ ɔbaawa ne nwo sɔfo panyi paa, na wafa ɛtena sua bɔ ɔte titire na odi mu tra so ɔ nu. Ɛhe de, nna kuro sona yeɛ osili ɔ, yeɛ ɔbboka ewiase abɔdeɛ so koso, 12na wawura Krongron nu Krongron ne anu berɛ komapɛ. Wamva mbɔngye ne nandwie mmaa mogya yeɛ ɔɔbɔle afɔleɛ ɔ, na mmom ye bɔbɔ ye mogya yeɛ ɔfa bɔle afɔleɛ nyane daa ngoa mane yɛ ɔ. 13 Na sɛ nandwie nyii mogya ne mbɔngye mogya ne nandwie ba nzoen bɔ bɛfa bɛpete mmenia bɔ efiɛ aha bɛ nwo ne, ɔkora ma bɛ nwo te anwoɔnaen nu de a, 14nzaade Kristo bɔ ɔnate Sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso fale ye nwo bɔle afɔleɛ bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye nwo mane Nyameɛ nen, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ye mogya ngɔte yɛ tiboa nwo ngofi yɔleɛ mbaen mbaen nwo ma yɛngɔso Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne ɔ?
Kristo te yɛ ndamgyinaniɛ
15Ye sɔ ne ati, Yesu te apam foforɛ ne anu ndamgyinaniɛ. Ɔnate kyɛ, ɔfale ye wue bɔ owuli ne yele adasa fili bɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔle ye wɔ apam bɔ oli moa ne anu; amaa bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afrɛ bɛ ne banya agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ bɔhyɛ ne.
16Sɛ ebie yɔ nzamanzeɛ a, sana benwu ye pefee kyɛ sona bɔ ɔyɔle ne wawu; 17ofikyɛ sɛ sona bɔ ɔyɔle sɔ nzamanzeɛ ne tɛte ase de a, ye de nzamanzeɛ ne nyɔ adwuma, sana owu koraka. 18Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ apam bɔ oli moa ne po anyɛ adwuma kɔpem kyɛ bɛfale mogya bɛbɔle ye atenaseɛ ɔ. 19 Ofikyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ Mose kengale ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ mmeraa ne anu hyirele maen ne amukoraa yiele nen, ɔfale nandwie mmaa ne mbɔngye mogya frale nzue, na ɔfale sufiɛ ne adaabene bɔle nu fa petene mmeraa nwomaa ne, ɔne mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ so. 20Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛhe te mogya bɔ osi apam bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ama ɛmɔ ne agyinayɛɛ ɔ.” 21 Sɔ ala koso yeɛ ɔfale mogya ne petene ɛtena sua ne, ɔne nningyein mukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne Nyameɛ nwo ɔ. 22 Na kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kyire ne, ɔpena yɛ kyɛ mogya yeɛ bɛfa bɛte nningyein amukoraa nwo ɔ, na sɛ mogya angua a, bɔnefakyɛ nne berɛ.
Kristo afɔleɛ ne kyikyi bɔne biala
23Nzaade, nningyein bɔ bɛte nyameɛso deɛ ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ ne, né ohia kyɛ bɛte bɛ nwo wɔ atee sɔa so; nakoso nyameɛso deɛ nemɔ de, afɔleɛ bɔ odi mu tra so yeɛ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ɔ. 24Ɔnate kyɛ, Kristo anwura nekaa krongron bɔ kuro sona sili, ná osa te nyameɛso deɛ paa ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ ne anu; na mmom wahɔ nyameɛso berɛ deinn, na kekesaala ye odi yɛ ti dwirɛ ma yɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 25Nakoso Kristo de, wangɔ berɛ kyɛ ɔkwaafa ye nwo bɔ afɔleɛ mmerɛ pee, kyɛbɔ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne de afoɛnoa biala ɔfa mogya bɔ nna ye deɛ ahɔ ɔkɔ Krongron nu Krongron ne anu nen. 26Na sɛ ɔtte sɔ de a, ahaa ɔsɛ kyɛ Kristo taa nwu amaneɛ fite kyɛ Ɛdangama bɔle aleɛ ɔ. Nakoso waye ye nwo ali komapɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ewiase kɔ ye ayieleɛ ye, na wafa ye bɔbɔ ye nwo wabɔ afɔleɛ wakyikyi bɔne. 27Na kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro sona wu komapɛ twe na ye si ye Nyameɛ bua ye ndɛen nen, 28 sɔ ala yeɛ Kristo bɔ bɛfale ye bɛbɔle afɔleɛ komapɛ kyɛ ɔsoa mmeni pee bɛ bɔne ne, okosa kɔwa ye pɛen so ɔ; ɔmmangyikyi bɔne, na mmom ɔbaale bɛ bɔ bɛ́nea ye ate nemɔ ngoa.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 10
Content:
Yesu bɔle afɔleɛ komapɛ twe
1Mmeraa ne de, ole nningyein paa bɔ bɛbaawa ne wawoɛ, na nna bɛ bɔbɔ deinn ɔ. Yiti ɔngora mma bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Nyameɛ ne, bɛmva afoɛnoa afoɛnoa afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne aso benni mu. 2Na sɛ afɔleɛ ne te mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne Nyameɛ nwo pɛnko de a, ahaa bɛ tiboa mmua bɛ foɛ ko kyɛ bedi bɔne nwo fɔ; afei koso ahaa afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne amukoraa bo apɛ. 3Nakoso sɔ afɔleɛbɔlɛ nemɔ ma mmenia kaye bɛ bɔne afoɛnoa biala, 4ofikyɛ nandwie nyii mogya ne mbɔngye mogya ngora ngyikyi bɔne.
5 Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Kristo wale wiase nen, osele kyɛ,
“Anguro afɔleɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ,
na mmom asiesie nipadua ama me.
6Wɔ nye angye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ
ne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nwo.
7Na afei ngane kyɛ, ‘O Nyameɛ, mawa kyɛ mebaayɔ w’apɛdeɛ,
kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bafa me nwo wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu nen.’ ”
8Olili moa hane kyɛ, “Anguro, yeɛ afei koso wɔ nye angye afɔleɛ, anaa ayɛyɛdeɛ, anaa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, anaa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nwo.” Nakoso mmeraa ne kyire kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ. 9Na osa hane kyɛ, “O Nyameɛ, mawa kyɛ mebaayɔ w’apɛdeɛ.” Yiti Nyameɛ apɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu wafa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne wasi ye gya nu. 10Na ɔnate apɛdeɛ he aso bafa Yesu Kristo nipadua afɔleɛ ne aso bate yɛ nwo pɛnko.
11 Ɔsɔfo biala gyina ndende daa biala yɔ ye sɔfodwuma ne, na afɔleɛ ko ne ala bɔ ɔbɔ ye daa daa ne ngora ngyikyi bɔne. 12 Nakoso Yesu de, ɔbɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ komapɛ twe bɔ odi mu afebɔɔ yiele nen, ɔtenane Nyameɛ sa famaa so, 13na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔnwondɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔyɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ. 14Ofikyɛ ɔnate afɔleɛ komapɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ne aso wama bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ te bɛ nwo ne ali mu afebɔɔ. 15Na Sunzum Krongron ne koso di adanzeɛ kyire yɛ, ofikyɛ olili moa hane kyɛ,
16 “Awurade nwa nyoo:
Sɛ sɔ ngyẽa ne pɛ nu a,
apam bɔ me ne bɛ kɔhyehyɛ hɔ ɛhe:
Ngɔfa me mmeraa ngowura b’ahone nu,
na mahyerɛ ye wɔ b’adwene nu.”
17 Na osa hane kyɛ,
“Mengɔkaye bɛ bɔne ne b’amumuyɛɛ ko.”
18Yiti sɛ bafa ɛhemɔ bahyɛ de a, nzaade bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ nne berɛ ko.
Twe pingye Nyameɛ
19Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yanya nguraenhyɛlɛ kyɛ ɔnate Yesu mogya ne ati yɛkora yɛkɔ nekaa krongron ne anu berɛ; 20ofikyɛ wafa ɛtena bɔ onwi pumbu n’anoa nu, bɔ ɔte ye nwonaen ne aso wabukye ngoa atee foforɛ wama yɛ, 21ná asa koso yɛle ɔsɔfo panyi paa bɔ ɔnea Nyameɛ awuro ne aso ɔ ne ati, 22 yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛfa nahorɛ ahone ne gyidie bɔ osi pi, ɔne ahone bɔ bate ye nwo bafi bɔne tiboa nu, ɔne nipadua bɔ bafa nzue gyengɔgyengɔ babia ye ɔ yɛhwe yɛpingye Nyameɛ. 23Ɛ́mɔma yɛsɔ anyelasoɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛgyi so ne anu serɛ, ofikyɛ bɔ ɔhyɛle bɔ ne, odi nahorɛ. 24Ɛ́mɔma yɛpena atee bɔ yɛkɔfa so yɛkɔbokaboka yɛ nwo bɔ ɔkɔmaa yɛkohyire ɔdɔ ná yayɔ nnwumaa paa ɔ. 25Nnɛmɔma yɛyakyi yɛ nwo yɛ nwo nyianuyɛlɛ, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ de bayakyi ye yɔlɛ nen; na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ so yɛtutu yɛ nwo yɛ nwo foɛ, nganga kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ Kyẽa ne apingye ye.
Bɛnnwati Nyameɛ bo
26Na sɛ yɛnya yɛnya nahorɛ ne nwo nimdeɛ, na ye si ye yɛ nye la ye nwo yɛkɔ so yɛyɔ bɔne de a, ye de bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ biala nne berɛ ko; 27 na mmom bɔ waha ala ole kyɛ yɛkɔnwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne, ɔne see bɔ ɔbaayera Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ne. 28 Sɛ ebie to Mose mmeraa ne ná mmenia nyɔ anaa nza di adanzeɛ tia ye a, bɛfa anwumvoin bɛto ahameɛ beku ye. 29 Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, nzaade sona bɔ okobu Nyameɛ Awa ne animtia, ná wabu apam mogya bɔ bafa bate ye nwo ne kyɛ ye nwo nde, ná wafa adom Sunzum ne nyunu watwitwi ase ne, nzikyɛ asohwenɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsusu kyɛ ɔfata ye ɔ? 30 Ofikyɛ, yɛse bɔ ɔhane kyɛ, “Wereɛtɔlɛ te me deɛ, na ngotua so kerɛ;” na ye ala yeɛ osa hane kyɛ, “Awurade kobua ye mmenia ndɛen.” 31Na ɔyɛ suro kyɛ ɛkɔma Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne sa kɔsɔ wɔ nu ɔ!
32Ɛ́mɔkaye mmerɛ bie bɔ wapɛ nu ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔɔyɛle agyidifoɛ nen, ɛmɔmiane bɛ nye bɛfale amaneɛ pee nu ne. 33Né ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie a, begua ɛmɔ nyunu ase na bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ anyeborolɛ wɔ badwa nu; né ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie koso a, ɛmɔfa bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mmango. 34Ofikyɛ ɛmɔnwuni bɛ bɔ begua kuku nu anwumvoin, na mmerɛ bɔ bɛfene ɛmɔ nningyein bɛfale ne, ɛmɔle anigye bɛpenene so, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔle nningyein paa bɔ ɔtra so wɔ nyameɛso afebɔɔ. 35Yiti nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ abasanu bu, ofikyɛ ye nwo akatuaa piri bie wɔ berɛ. 36Odi kyɛ ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye, amaa ɛmɔahora bayɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ná ɛmɔ sa ahã ye bɔhyɛ ne.
37 “Ofikyɛ waha kãa bie,
né bɔ ɔ́ba ne wawa;
na ɔngɔhyɛ biala.
38Na teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ;
nakoso sɛ osa ye si de a,
me kra nye ngɔgye ye nwo.”
39Nakoso yɛ de, yɛbboka mmenia bɔ besa bɛ si bɛkɔ sɛkyelɛ nu ne aso; na mmom yɛboka bɛ bɔ bede bedi ná bɛ kra nya daa ngoa ne aso.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 11
Content:
Gyidie nwo nhwɛsoɛ
1 Gyidie te nikyee bɔ y’anyelasoɛ si pi wɔ nu, ɔne kyɛ yɛkole nikyee bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye yɛkɔto nu ɔ. 2Ofikyɛ, ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ daa ama mɔ sɔle Nyameɛ nye ɔ. 3 Ɔnate gyidie so yɛnya ndeaseɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle aleɛ ɔ, yiti nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu bɛ ne, bammɔ bɛ bamvi nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu bɛ ɔ nu.
Abel
4 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Abel bɔle afɔleɛ paa bɔ ɔtra Kein deɛ ne, ná ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye ɔ. Ɔnate ye gyidie so Nyameɛ buli ye kyɛ ɔtengyɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ lili y’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Abel awu de, nakoso ɔnate ye gyidie so ɔtɛ dwudwo.
Henɔke
5 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ behwimini Henɔke bɛhɔle bɔ wanwu ɔ. Ebiala annwu ye, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fale ye hɔle. Na anzana bɛbaafa ye bɛkɔ nyameɛso nen, né ye nwo adanzeɛ kyire kyɛ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye. 6Ebiala bɔ olle gyidie ne, ɔngora nzɔ Nyameɛ nye, ofikyɛ odi kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔba Nyameɛ berɛ ne onya gyidie kyɛ Nyameɛ wɔ berɛ, na oyira bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aboro bɛpena ye boso ɔ.
Nowa
7 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Nowa le suronyi tiele kyẽa bie nningyein bɔ né bɛbaasi ne nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ ɔ, na ɔbobɔle ɛlɛen alaka bɔ ɔne ye awuro ama bɛfale so benyane ngoa ɔ. Ɔnate ɛhe aso Nowa buale wiase foɛ, na ɔɔyɛle tenenee bɔ ɔnate gyidie so benya ye ne koliagyaa.
Abraham
8 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Abraham tiele Nyameɛ frɛlɛ ne, ná otu hɔle maen bɔ ɔfa hyɛle ye bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ ye agyapadeɛ ne aso ɔ; na otu fili ye maen nu bɔ né ɔnze nekaa bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ. 9 Ɔnate gyidie so ɔɔyɛle amanvraniɛ kyɛ ɔwɔ maen foforɛ so ɔ, wɔ aseɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa hyɛle ye bɔ ne aso, ná ɔne Yisake ne Yakob bɔ bɛte sɔ bɔhyɛ komapɛ ne ala koliagyaa ne bɛtenane ɛtena sua nu. 10Ɔnate kyɛ, né ɔnwondɛ kuro bɔ Nyameɛ akyekye ná wahyehyɛ bɔ ye fapem gyi berɛ pindinn ne.
Sara ne tetefoɛ biemɔ gyidie
11 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Sara bɔ né wabo aworɛ so ne hora nwonzɛle wole ɔ, ofikyɛ obuli bɔ ɔhyɛle bɔ ne kyɛ odi nahorɛ. 12 Yiti ɔnate biaa komapɛ he, bɔ né wayɛ aworowaa na wapingye ewue ne aso yeɛ bɛwole ye bosofoɛ, bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ ewienu nzramaa ne mboanoa anweaa bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa ɔ.
13 Gyidie nu yeɛ sɔ mmenia hemɔ amukoraa bewuli ɔ. Bɛ sa anga bɔhyɛ ne, nakoso befitele dedeede na benwuni bɔhyɛ ne nwo nningyein nen, bele belili, na bele bɛtole nu kyɛ bɛte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ wɔ aseɛ he aso. 14Na mmenia bɔ bɛkã sɔ dwirɛ nen, bekyire kyɛ bɛpena maen bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ ɔ. 15Na sɛ bɛhɔle so bɛdwenene maen bɔ betu befili so ne anwo a, ahaa benyane ate besale bɛ si bɛhɔle. 16Nakoso afei, maen paa bɔ ɔte nyameɛso maen yeɛ bɛpena ɔ. Yiti ɔnyɛ Nyameɛ nya kyɛ bɛkɔfrɛ ye bɛ Nyameɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ wasiesie kuro bie wama bɛ.
17 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Abraham, bɔ né Nyameɛ ahyɛ ye bɔ ne, ɔfale ɔwa bienzua Yisake komapɛ twe ne kyɛ ɔfa ye bɔ afɔleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ sole ye neane ne. 18 Né Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye kyɛ, “Ɔnate Yisake so yeɛ ekonya wɔ bosofoɛ ɔ.” 19Na Abraham nyane adwene kyɛ Nyameɛ kora tingye sona fi awufoɛ nu po, yiti sɛ ɛfa ye anyandera nu a, ye sa hane Yisake fili ewue nu kyɛ awufoɛ bɔ Nyameɛ tingye bɛ ne ala.
20 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yisake fa yirayirale Yakob ne Yisɔ wɔ kyẽa bie nningyein nwo ɔ. 21 Gyidie so yeɛ mmerɛ bɔ Yakob baawu ne, ɔfa yirayirale Yosef mma nyɔ ne ɔ, na ofuale ye pɔmaa so dwɔso sɔnene Nyameɛ. 22 Yosef nate gyidie so yeɛ ɔka kãa maa owu ne, ɔhane kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔye Yisraelfoɛ kofi Misraim ɔ; na ohyirele kyɛbɔ owu a besi bɛyɛ ye mmowue ɔ.
Mose
23 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole Mose nen, ye awofoɛ fale ye feale tonn bosome nza ɔ; ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ ye nwo yɛ nyemene, na banzuro kyɛ bekobu ɛhene ne mmeraa ne aso ɔ. 24 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Mose nyini ne, ɔpole kyɛ bɛkɔfrɛ ye Faro awa brasua n’awa ɔ, 25na mmom ohurole kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ mmenia bekonwu amaneɛ tra kyɛ okoli fɛɛ wɔ bɔne nu mmerɛ kãa bie ɔ. 26Na onwuni kyɛ sɛ ɔnate Kristo ti begua wɔ nyunu ase a, ye nwo le mvasoɛ tra kyɛ ekonya Misraim anwonyadeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ né ye nye la kyẽa bie akatuaa so.
27 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Mose tu fili Misraim bɔ wanzuro ɛhene ne yaafɛlɛ ɔ, na ogyinane pindinn kyɛ sona bɔ ye nye tua Ɛdangama Nyameɛ bɔ bennwu ye ne. 28 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ ɔfa hyehyɛle Abɔtra ne, ɔne mogya petenɛ wɔ b’anoa nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ewue abɔfo ne wanguku bɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ ɔ.
29 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ pɛle Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne kyɛ bɛnate etii so ɔ, nakoso Misraimfoɛ yɛle kyɛ bɛpɛ ye bie nen, asue ne fale bɛ hɔle.
30 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yeriko fasue ne, bɛpɛle ye nwo bɛbra beyiale ɛlɛsoo ne, odwiri guale ɔ.
31 Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ bangu gyanderaniɛ Rahabo bammoka bɛ bɔ banne banni nemɔ aso ɔ, ofikyɛ olele bɛ bɔ bɛɛsrale maen ne anu besiele ne nyemene so.
32 Na nzikyɛ bieku koraa yeɛ nga ɔ? Ɔnate kyɛ sɛ mekã mmenia te kyɛ Gideon, Barake, Samson, Yɛfeta, Dawide, Samuel ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwo dwirɛ a, ahaa mmerɛ kotia me. 33 Bɛ yeɛ ɔnate gyidie so bɛhone belili ahennie ahoroɔ so ngonim ɔ, begyinane bɛmane tenenee, bɛ sa hane bɔhyɛ mɔ, bɛhane gyata mɔ noa bɛtole nu; 34 benuane see wuronyiwuronyi, benyane bɛ ti ngoa bɔ bandotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ, benyane anwoserɛ befili mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, bɛ nwo yɛle se wɔ koɛ nu, na bɛfoane amanvrafoɛ asraafoɛ maa bɛnwatili. 35 Mmrasua sa hane b’awufoɛ bɔ batingye bafi ewue nu ɔ. Ebiemɔ koso bɛhyɛle bɛ anyeborolɛ behuni bɛ, nakoso bambene kyɛ bekonya bɛ nwo bɛkɔtete ɔ, amaa ɔnate so banya ewutingyelɛ paa ne. 36 Beguale ebiemɔ nyunu ase, na besa befini bɛ mbire, yeɛ ebiemɔ wora bɛbɔle bɛ panwu bɛfale bɛ beguale kuku nu. 37 Bɛborole bɛ nyɔboɛ, bɛfale sralaa bedwudwale bɛ nu, yeɛ bɛtotɔle ngrandɛ noa; bewurale mmoaen nwomaa ne mbɔngye nwomaa behyinini, belili hiaa, bɛtanene bɛ nye, na benwuni amaneɛ. 38Bammu wiase kyɛ nikyee bɔ odi mu ma bɛ ɔ, behyinihyini ɛserɛ ne mmokaa so, na bɛtenane aseɛ so nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua, ɔne ngumaa mɔ nu. 39Sɔ mmenia hemɔ amukoraa, ɔnate bɛ gyidie ti bɛsɔle Nyameɛ nye, nakoso bɛ sa anga bɔhyɛ ne; 40ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ayɔ nhyehyɛleɛ paa bɔ ɔtra so wato berɛ wama yɛ, na ɛhe kyire kyɛ sana yɛboka bɛ so koraka na bali mu.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 12
Content:
Nyameɛ tea ye mma
1Yɛ de, yɛle adanzefoɛ pembepembe bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛgyi nikyee biala bɔ osi yɛ ngɔsoɛ nwo ate, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔngyɛ na wakyekye yɛ ne yɛgua, ná yɛ́mia yɛ nye yɛtu amirika bɔ ɔla yɛ nyunu ne. 2 Ɛ́mɔma yɛnea Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ gyidie ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ ne. Na ɔnate anigye bɔ né ɔla ye nyunu ne ati, omiane ye nye fale amaneɛ ne animguaseɛ wue nu wɔ mmeamudua ne aso, na waatena Nyameɛ ahennie bia ne famaa so.
3Ɛ́mɔnea Yesu bɔ ogyinane pindinn wɔ bɔnefoɛ ɛpɔen worawora noa ne, amaa ɛmɔ koso b’abasanu ammu na ɛmɔ wora ammɔ. 4Na apereapereɛ bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɔne bedi ye, ɛmɔnnya bɛffale ɛmɔ ngoa bɛppɛle so. 5 Anaakyɛ ɛmɔ wora afi nguraenhyɛlɛ dwirɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔte ye mma ne hɔ ɔ? Ɔnwa yoo:
“Mma, sɛ Awurade tea wɔ a,
ɔyɛ a nnɛfa di angorɛ,
yeɛ sɛ otwi wɔ nyunu koso a,
ɔyɛ a nnɛma w’aba nu bu.
6Ofikyɛ, bɔ Awurade kuro ye dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔtea ye ɔ,
na baa biala bɔ ode ye to nu ne yeɛ otwi ye nyunu ɔ.”
7Sɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɛ́mɔbu ye kyɛ ɔtea ɛmɔ, Nyameɛ yɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ye mma, ofikyɛ baa beni ala yeɛ ɔse ndea ye ɔ? 8Nakoso sɛ Nyameɛ andea ɛmɔ kyɛbɔ ɔyɛ ye mma mukoraa ne a, né nzaade ɛmɔtte ye mma paapaa, na mmom ɛmɔte adwaman mmaa. 9Afei koso, yɛle seɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ ye aso bɔ bɛtea yɛ ɔ, na yɛfa ebuo yɛma bɛ. Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, aso onhia kyɛ yɛbrɛ yɛ nwo ase bɔ ɔtra so yɛma yɛ sunzum nu Seɛ ne na yanya ngoa anaa? 10Bɛ de, bɛteane yɛ mmerɛ kãa bie anu, kyɛbɔ bɛnea a ɔte paa ma bɛ ɔ; nakoso Nyameɛ de, yɛ yeeyɛlɛ ti yeɛ ɔtea yɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so yanya kyɛfa wɔ ye krongronyɛlɛ ne anu. 11Kekesaala ye de, ɛtealɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔma yɛ nye gye ɔ, na mmom ɔma yɛ wora bɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ne, bɛ bɔ bafa sɔ ɛtealɛ ne batea bɛ ne, bɛ sa kã akatuaa bɔ ɔte tenenee ne asomdwee ɔ.
Foɛtulɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ
12 Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ sa bɔ nu agoho, ɔne ɛmɔ nangoroma bɔ nu ayɛ hodwoo ne anu yɛ se. 13 Na ɛ́mɔsiesie atimbire bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ bɛ́ma ɛmɔ gya, amaa ɔnate so agyirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee ne wando wamvo ye nwo, ná mmom wanya ayaresa. 14Ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ ne mmenia mukoraa bɛtena asomdwee nu, ná ɛmɔbɔ bra bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔ bra anyɛ krongron a, ɛmɔngonwu Awurade. 15 Ɛ́mɔnea yé na Nyameɛ adom ne ammɔ ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔ nu biala anyɛ ye nwo bakaa ndii weewee, bɔ ɔfa ɛhawo brɛ mmeni pee na ogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ; 16 na ebiala anyɛ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ anaakyɛ bɔ nyamesuro nne ye nu kyɛ Yisɔ, bɔ ɔtɔnene ye bamuɛbaa dibea fa lele aleɛ talie komapɛ twe ne. 17 Na ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛhe asi ne, ohurole kyɛ ahaa okonya ɔse saleɛ ne, nakoso wamva wamma ye. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔporole moen fa penane de, nakoso wannwu atee biala bɔ ɔfa so kakyi bɔ wayɔ ne ɔ.
18 Nna bokaa bɔ bɛfa bɛ sa bɛkã ye ne anwo yeɛ ɛmɔawa ɔ: bokaa bɔ né ogye see ne, nekaa bɔ né awosii kabii ne munungum ne mvrama piri wɔ ne, 19nekaa bɔ bɛtele totorobɛndo hulɛ ne, ɔne komviɛ totohyia bɔ ɔmaa bɛsrɛle kyɛ nnɛma Nyameɛ dwudwo kyire bɛ ko ne. 20 Ɔnate kyɛ bangora Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne noa gyina. Ɔnwa, “Sɛ kaka po fa ye nwo kã bokaa ne a bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ (behũ ye).” 21 Na bɔ osili berɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye suronyi si te ne ati, ɔmaa Mose hane kyɛ, “Mesuro, na me nwo wosowoso me.” 22Na mmom ɛmɔawa Sion bokaa ne anwo, ɔne Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne kuro, bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Yerusalem ne anu, yeɛ abɔfo kure kure bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa, bɔ bɛyɛ anigye nyianu ɔ bɛ berɛ. 23Ɛmɔawa Nyameɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ nyameɛso ne bɛ nyianu, ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte adasa mukoraa ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne berɛ, ɔne teneneefoɛ sunzum bɔ bali mu bayie nemɔ berɛ. 24Ɛmɔawa Yesu bɔ ɔte apam foforɛ ne anu ndamgyinaniɛ, ɔne mogya bɔ bɛfa bɛpetene bɔ ɔkã nningyein paa nwo dwirɛ tra Abel deɛ ne berɛ.
Sotie nwo hia
25 Ɛ́mɔnea yé na ɛmɔambo bɔ odwudwo ne dwirɛ. Na sɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpole kyɛ bekotie bɔ odwudwole wɔ aseɛ ye aso ne, benyane ye nwo asohwenɛ de a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ sɛ yɛpo bɔ odwudwo kyire yɛ fi nyameɛso ne dwirɛ a, yɛngonya ye nwo asohwenɛ ɔ? 26 Ye yeɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne ye komvi mane aseɛ wosole ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de wahyɛ bɔ kyɛ, “Nna aseɛ angome yeɛ mebaawoso ye bieku ɔ, na anwuro koso boka so.” 27Na sɔ dwirɛ he: “Woso ye bieku” ne kyire kyɛ abɔdeɛ mɔ kɔwoso ná baye bɛ bafi berɛ, amaa nningyein bɔ bɛngora bɛnwoso ne bahɔ so batena berɛ. 28Na ɔnate kyɛ yanya Ahennie bɔ ɔnwoso ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ ná yɛfa esuronyi ne ebuo yɛsɔne ye kyɛbɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ, 29 ofikyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ne te see bɔ ɔyera nikye ɔ.

Title: HEBRIFOƐ 13
Content:
Bɔ yɛyɔ a yɛkɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ
1Ɛmɔhɔ so behurohuro bɛ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa. 2 Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔkole ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ ɛmɔ awuro ɔ, ofikyɛ ebiemɔ fale sɔ atee he aso besikyele Nyameɛ abɔfo mɔ wɔ b’awuro bɔ né bɛnze ɔ. 3Ɛ́mɔkaye kukunufoɛ, kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ ne bɛ yeɛ begua kuku nu ɔ; ɔne bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ, kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ ne bɛ yeɛ benwu amaneɛ ne ɔ.
4Odi kyɛ ebiala di agyaa ni, na nnɛma ebiala gua agyaa mba nwo fiɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kobua adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ ne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ ndɛen. 5 Ɛ́mɔye sikanyeboro befi ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ nu, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye sɔ bɔ ɛmɔanya ɔ; ofikyɛ ye bɔbɔ wahã kyɛ, “Mengoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ mengɔye me sa wɔ wɔ bo le.” 6 Yiti yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛkã kyɛ,
“Awurade te me bokafoɛ,
mengosuro nikye fee.
Kuro sona kɔhora kɔyɔ me nzu?”
7Ɛ́mɔkaye ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛhane Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne behyirele ɛmɔ ne. Ɛ́mɔnea bɛ brabɔlɛ ayieleɛ ná ɛmɔsua bɛ gyidie. 8Kyɛbɔ Yesu Kristo te anoma nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔte ɛnɛ, ɔne afebɔɔ ɔ. 9Onni kyɛ ɛmɔma ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ ahoroɔ biala twe ɛmɔ fi atee paa ne aso, ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ Nyameɛ adom ne yeɛ ɔhyɛ y’ahone nguraen ɔ, na nna aleɛ bɔ mmenia bɔ bedi ne bennya ye nwo mvasoɛ biala hɔ ɔ.
10Yɛle afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛ bɔ bedi dwumaa wɔ ɛtena sua ne anu ne, belle ye nwo ate kyɛ bedi so nikyee biala ɔ. 11 Ofikyɛ ngaka bɔ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne fa bɛ mogya ba nekaa krongron ne anu babɔ bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ ne, bɛyera bɛ fuin nemɔ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. 12Ye sɔ ne ati, Yesu koso nwuni amaneɛ wɔ kuro piri n’anoa ne asi, amaa ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye mogya so wate adasa mmaa nwo wafi bɛ bɔne nwo. 13Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ ye berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ná ye animguaseɛ ne bie ɔha yɛ. 14Ɔnate kyɛ, kuro biala nne aseɛ ye aso bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ma yɛ ɔ, na kuro bɔ ɔbaawa ne mmom yeɛ yɛpena ye si atee ɔ. 15 Yiti mmerɛ biala ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ayɛyelɛ yɛyɛ afɔleɛ yɛfa Yesu so yɛma Nyameɛ, na ɛhe te yɛ noa afɔleɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam ɔ. 16Nnɛma ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nye begua so kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ paa ná ɛmɔkɔbokaboka bɛ nwo ɔ, ofikyɛ sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.
17Ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ ná ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛma bɛ; ofikyɛ bɛnea ɛmɔ kra so, na bekobu bɛ nwo ngondaa ɔ, Ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma bɛ amaa bayɔ b’adwuma wɔ anika so; na banyɔ ye aworabɔlɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɛhe nwo ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma ɛmɔ.
18Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma yɛ; ofikyɛ yɛde yɛdi kyɛ yɛ tiboa mmua yɛ foɛ, na yɛkuro kyɛ daa yɛdi dwirɛ paa wɔ yɛ brabɔlɛ nu. 19Na mesrɛ ɛmɔ pee kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ, kyɛ ngonya atee ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ bieku ndɛndɛ ɔ.
Mbaeɛbɔlɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
20 Asomdwee Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate apam bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ mogya ne aso tingyele y’Awurade Yesu bɔ ɔte Mmoaenneafoɛ panyi ne fili awufoɛ nu ne, 21ɔ́ma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ nikyee paa biala nu ma ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ; ná ɔ́fa Yesu Kristo so ma ɛmɔli dwumaa bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. Animnyam hã ye afebɔɔ. Amen.
Ngraalilɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
22Aliɛmaa mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔnya aboterɛ betie me foɛtulɛ he, ofikyɛ me krataa bɔ mahyerɛ ɛmɔ ye ɔnware biala. 23Mema ɛmɔte kyɛ baye y’eliɛma Timoteo bafi kuku nu, na sɛ ɔbadwu wa ndɛ de a, mebaasra ɛmɔ a, me ne ye kɔwa. 24Yɛbisa ɛmɔ mbanyi nemɔ mukoraa ne anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bisabisa. Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ befi Yitalia koso bebisa ɛmɔ. 25Nyameɛ adom ne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena. Amen.

Title: YAKOBO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Yakobo hyerɛle sɔ krataa he ɔɔmane agyidifoɛ mukoraa bɔ né bato bapete ewiase amu ɔ. Ɔfale edwirɛ tole dwirɛ nwo yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ fale nworɛ ne Kristoniɛ suban nwo. Ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ fa Kristoniɛ brabɔlɛ nwo: anwonya, ehiaa, nzɔhwɛ, suban paa, nyeyemuɛ, gyidie ne yɔleɛ, sona noa dwirɛ, nworɛ, ngondii, anwomasoɛ ne anwobrɛaseɛ, ebiɛngo ndɛenbualɛ, nduhoɛ, aboterɛ ne mbaeɛbɔlɛ.
Gyidie ne yɔleɛ te nikyee bɔ krataa ne ka bɛ nwo dwirɛ paa, na okyire kyɛ bɛ nwo hia paa.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1
Gyidie ne nworɛ 1.2-8
Ehiaa ne anwonya 1.9-11
Nzɔhwɛ 1.12-18
Kyɛ ekotie ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ 1.19-27
Nyɔpamuɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ 2.1-13
Gyidie ne yɔleɛ 2.14-26
Kristoniɛ noa dwirɛ 3.1-18
Kristoniɛ ne ewiase 4.1—5.6
Ngyerɛkyerɛ ahoroɔ 5.7-20

Title: YAKOBO 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Yakobo bɔ nde Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo akoaa, mefa mebrɛ abusua kure buru ne nyɔ bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ maen maen so ne. Mebisa ɛmɔ bisabisa.
Gyidie ne nworɛ
2Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ nzɔhwɛ ahoroɔ toto ɛmɔ a, ɛ́mɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte anigye nikye; 3ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie nwo nzɔhwɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔfa animia begyina ɔ. 4Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ animia ne ɔyɔ ye adwuma yie pɛpɛɛpɛ, amaa ɛmɔali mu bɔkɔɔ bɔ siitɔlɛ biala nne ɛmɔ nu ɔ. 5Na sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie tɔ sii nworɛ nu a, maa obisa Nyameɛ bɔ ɔye ye kunu fa ma mmenia, bɔ ɔmva animguaseɛ mmata ye nwo ne, na ɔkɔfa kɔma ye. 6Nakoso maa obisa ye gyidie nu, bɔ ye adwene nyɛ ye naa ɔ; ofikyɛ sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye naa ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛpo asorɔkye bɔ mvrama bɔ ye fa ye di akɔneaba ɔ. 7Nnɛma sɔ sona ne dwene kyɛ okonya nikyee bie kofi Awurade berɛ, 8ofikyɛ sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye ndaa ndaa ne, ɔngora nzi ye adwene pi wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔ nu.
Ehiaa ne anwonyadeɛ
9 Ma gyidiniɛ awiɛmvoɛ ɔhoahoa ye nwo wɔ ɛpagyalɛ bɔ bapagya ye ne anu, 10 yeɛ sikaniɛ koso, wɔ ase bɔ babrɛ ye ne anu, ofikyɛ ɔkɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ kyɛ eburo ndire nyerɛen. 11Ofikyɛ eyia pukye bɔ gyireingyirein, na ɔyera ndire ne; ye nyerɛen ne poro gua, na ye nyemene sɛkye. Na sɔ ala yeɛ sikaniɛ koso kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ nu ɔ.
Nzɔhwɛ
12Sona bɔ omia ye nye fa nzɔhwɛ nu ne, onya saleɛ; ofikyɛ sɛ ɔkora gyina nzɔhwɛ ne noa a, okonya ngoa abotire bɔ Awurade afa ahyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ bɔ ne. 13Na sɛ béso ebie bɛnea a, nnɛmaa ɔkã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ yeɛ oso me nea ɔ”; ofikyɛ bɔne bie ngora nzo Nyameɛ nnea, yeɛ ye koso onzo sona biala nnea. 14Na mmom sona bɔbɔ ye akɔnnɔ yeɛ odiedie ye ná ɔlakalaka ye oso ye nea ɔ. 15Na sɛ akɔnnɔ ne ɔnwonzɛ a, ɔwo bɔne; yeɛ sɛ bɔne koso onyi yie a, ɔwo ewue. 16Nniɛma mɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, nnɛmɔma bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ. 17Akyɛdeɛ paa amukoraa ne akyɛdeɛ bɔ odi mu amukoraa fi nyameɛso, na ofi kanea Baba ne berɛ yeɛ ɔba ase ɔ. Na ye yeɛ ɔngakyi ná ɔnyɛ ye nwo kyɛ wawoɛ bɔ ɔsesã ɔ. 18Ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ so yeɛ ɔfale nahorɛ dwirɛ ne wole yɛ ɔ, kyɛ yɛyɛ ye abɔdeɛ ne anu nikyee bɔ oli moa ɔ.
Sotie ma saleɛ
19Aliɛmaa adɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe yé. Ɔsɛ kyɛ sona biala yɛ ndɛ tie, nnɛmaa ɔpe ndɛen dwudwo, nnɛmaa ɔpe ndɛen fɛ yaa; 20ofikyɛ sona yaafɛlɛ ɔnyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nye so ɔ. 21Yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bra fiɛ ne bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa bégua, ná ɛ́mɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ betira edwirɛ bɔ balua ye wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne anu, na ye yeɛ ɔkora de ɛmɔ kra ngoa ɔ.
22Ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ edwirɛ ne kã ne, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ atiefoɛ ngome bɛfa bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ nwo. 23Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie te edwirɛ ne tiefoɛ, ná ɔnyɔ bɔ edwirɛ ne kã ne a, ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ɔnea ye nyunu sue neanu nu ɔ. 24Onwu ye nwo, na ofi berɛ, na berɛ ne ala ye wora fi kyɛbɔ osi soma ɔ. 25Nakoso sona bɔ ɔgyene ye nye nea fawɔnwodi mmeraa bɔ odi mu ne anu, ná ɔtena nu, ná wanyɛ tiefoɛ aworafireniɛ, na mmom odi so ɔyɔ nen, bekoyira ye wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nu.
26Sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ ɔte nyamesomniɛ, ná wannea ye dwudwolɛ so yé, ná mmom ɔlakalaka ye nwo a, sɔ sona ne nyamesom te mbaen. 27 Nyameɛsom bɔ ye nwo te bɔ efiɛ nne ye nwo wɔ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu ɛhe: kyɛ ɛkɔɔnea nyisiaa ne akunafoɛ wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔhwe wɔ nwo kofi wiase bra basabasa nu ɔ.

Title: YAKOBO 2
Content:
Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ nyeyemuɛ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ ɛmɔtira y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte animnyam Hene ne gyidie nu ɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa nyeyemuɛ bɛbata ye nwo. 2Na sɛ ebie bɔ owura sikaa kɔkorɛ mbɛteaa ne ataadeɛ nyemene ba ɛmɔ nyianu sua nu, ná sɛ ehianiɛ koso bɔ owura ataadeɛ turuwaa koso ba berɛ bie, 3ná sɛ ɛmɔfa anidie bɛma bɔ owura ndaadeɛ nyemene ne, ná ɛmɔkã bekyire ye kyɛ, “Tena bia paa he aso,” ná ɛmɔkã bekyire ehianiɛ ne koso kyɛ, “Wɔ de, gyina dɔ” anaakyɛ “Tena ase wɔ me gya bo wa” a, 4aso né ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɛmɔayɔ nyeyemuɛ, bɔ ɔmɔayɛ adwenemmɔne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ?
5Nniɛma mɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie! Aso Nyameɛ ɔnneneane nu ɔyyele wiase ahiafoɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ gyidie nu anwonyafoɛ, ná benya agyapadeɛ wɔ ahennie ne anu, ahennie bɔ wafa wahyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ne bɔ ne? 6Nakoso ɛmɔbu ehianiɛ animtia! Aso nna sikafoɛ yeɛ bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ so ɔ, aso nna bɛ yeɛ bɛtwe ɛmɔ bɛkɔ badwafoɛ nyunu ɔ? 7Aso nna bɛ yeɛ bɛkã musue dwirɛ betia animnyam dumaa bɔ bɛfa bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ ne?
8 Yiti sɛ ɛmɔdi dehyeɛ mmeraa ne aso nahorɛ nu, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo” ne a, ye de né ɛmɔayɛ nikye. 9Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔnea sona nyunu bɛyɛ nyeyemuɛ a, né ɛmɔayɔ bɔne, na mmeraa ne bua ɛmɔ ndɛen kyɛ mmeraatolɛfoɛ. 10Na sona bɔ okoli mmeraa ne aso, ná ɔkɔto nu komapɛ po nen, né wali ye mukoraati nwo fɔ. 11 Ofikyɛ, bɔ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nnɛsɛkye agyaa” nen, ye ala yeɛ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nnɛdi awue” ɔ. Na sɛ anzɛkye agyaa, nakoso edi awue a, né ayɛ ebie bɔ wato mmeraa ne ɔ. 12Yiti bɔ ɛmɔkã ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ sɔ, kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkɔfa fawɔnwodi mmeraa ne aso bekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ. 13Ofikyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ nne ndɛenbualɛ nu mma bɔ wannwu anwumvoin ɔ; na anwumvoinnwunɛ hoahoa ye nwo di ndɛenbualɛ so ngonim.
Gyidie ne nnwumaa
14Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ ebie kã kyɛ ole gyidie, nakoso olle nnwumaa a, né mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ? Sɔ gyidie ne, ɔkɔhora kole ye ngoa anaa? 15Sɛ aliɛmaa bienzua anaa aliɛmaa brasua bie nwo la so, ná ye noa aleɛ abɔ ye, 16ná ɛmɔ nu ko kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa asomdwee bɛhɔ oo, ɛ́mɔnya tena bɛ́kata ɛmɔ nwo oo, ná ɛmɔ ko yi oo,” nakoso ɛmɔamma bɛ nningyein bɔ nipadua ne hia a, mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ? 17Sɔ ala yeɛ gyidie ngome koso ɔte ɔ. Sɛ nnwumaa nne nu a, ɔte wuruwaa.
18Amba, ebie kɔhã kyɛ, “Ele gyidie, yeɛ me wora nne nnwumaa.” “Kyire me wɔ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ɔ, na me koso ngɔfa me nnwumaa ngohyire wɔ me gyidie.” 19Yeɛ ede di kyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ? Ayɔ nikye, sunzummɔne mɔ po bede bedi, na bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ. 20Wɔ bɔ wadwene te kãa ɔ! Ɛpena kyɛ bɛkã bekyire wɔ kyɛ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa anaa? 21 Aso nna nnwumaa so yeɛ begyina bebuale yɛ nana Abraham be, mmerɛ bɔ ɔfale ɔwa Yisake tole afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛ ɔfa ye bɔ afɔleɛ ne? 22Yeɛ anwu kyɛ ye gyidie ne ye nnwumaa bɛbɔle nu bɛyɔle adwuma, na ɔnate nnwumaa ne aso yeɛ gyidie ne lili mu ɔ. 23 Na ɛhe mane Ahyerɛlɛ ne wale nu kyɛ, “Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili, na obuli sɔ tenenee mane ye”; na bɛfrɛle ye Nyameɛ damvo. 24Na ɛhe ma ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ begyina sona nnwumaa so yeɛ bebua ye be ɔ, na bengyina ye gyidie ngome so. 25 Na sɔ ala koso, aso nna nnwumaa so yeɛ begyina bebuale adwamanbɔlɛniɛ Rahabo be ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ olele ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ, ná ɔmaa bɛfale atee foforɛ so bɛhɔle ne? 26Na kyɛbɔ nipadua bɔ sunzum nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa ɔ.

Title: YAKOBO 3
Content:
Edwudwolɛ nu anwohyɛsoɛ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nu somaa yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ, na ɛmɔse kyɛ bekobua yɛ foɛ piri mmom. 2Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛfõ wɔ atee pee so. Na sɛ ebie nyɔ mvomsoɛ wɔ bɔ ɔkã nu a, né ɔte sona bɔ odi mu, bɔ ɔkora hyɛ ye nipadua amukoraa so ɔ. 3Yɛfa buralɛ yɛwura mbɔngɔ noa nu maa betie yɛ, na yɛtengyɛtengyɛ bɛ maa bɛfa yɛ bɛkɔ nekaa biala bɔ yɛkuro ɔ. 4Ɛ́mɔnea ɛlɛen mɔ koso. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛte mbiri paa, bɔ mvrama piri yeɛ ɔfa bɛ kɔ ɔ de, nakoso bɛfa tabɔnga kaaba bie yeɛ bɛtengyɛtengyɛ bɛ maa bɛkɔ nekaa bɔ ɛlɛenhanɛniɛ ne kuro ɔ. 5Sɔ ala yeɛ temverema koso ɔte nipadua akwaa kaaba bie ɔ, nakoso ɔkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri hoahoa ye nwo. Ɛ́mɔtie, see kaaba bie yeɛ ɔyera ɛhɔayeɛ too ɔ! 6Temverema koso te see. Temverema te ewiase bɔ ɔndengyɛ bɔ wafra y’akwaa mɔ nu ɔ; ɔbɔ musue maa ɔkã nipadua ne amukoraa, ɔfa see to mmenia asetena nu, na abɔnzam see nu yeɛ onya ye see ne fi ɔ. 7Na ngaka aboyaa ne nnomaa ne ngaka bɔ bɛkongo ne ɛpo nu ngaka amukoraa, sona kora tete bɛ brɛ bɛ ase, na wabrɛ bɛ ase maa batie ye. 8Nakoso temverema de, sona biala ngora mmrɛ ye ase; ɔte busueniɛ bɔ bɛmmɔ ye kyɛnn so ɔ, na ɛborɔ bɔ ye noa yɛ hye yeɛ wayi ye tɛkyɛ ɔ. 9 Ye yeɛ yɛfa yɛyirayira yɛ Nyameɛ ne Baba ne; na ye komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛfa yɛnoma kuro mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ abɔ bɛ kyɛ ye sɛso ɔ. 10 Noa komapɛ ne anu yeɛ saleɛ ne amoenwaa fi ɔ. Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔba ye sɔ ɔ! 11Asue ti komapɛ ne, aso opu nzue bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ ne bɔ ɔyɛ wee ɔ? 12Aliɛmaa mɔ, aso borɔdoma bakaa kora su olive mmaa? Anaakyɛ bobe kora su borɔdoma mmaa? Sɔ ala yeɛ asue ti komapɛ ne ngora mbu nzue ngyee ngyee ne nzue paa ɔ.
Nyameɛso nworɛ
13Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ ne nimdeɛniɛ ɔ? Maa ɔfa bra paa ohyire ye nnwumaa wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ bɔ nworɛ wɔ nu ɔ nu. 14 Nakoso sɛ anyeboroborolɛ tɛɛ ne pɛsɛmangomenya wɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu a, ye de nnɛma ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔpɛ ngondombo betia nahorɛ ne. 15Sɔ nworɛ he de, nna anwuro yeɛ ofi ɔ, na mmom ɔte aseɛ so deɛ; nna sunzum nu deɛ ɔ, na ɔte sunzummɔne mɔ deɛ. 16Ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ anyeboroborolɛ ne pɛsɛmangomenya wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ basabasa ne bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa wɔ ɔ. 17Nakoso nworɛ bɔ ofi anwuro ne de, bɔ oli moa ɔ, ye nwo te, okuro asomdwee, ye nwo dwo, ye so yɛ mmerɛ, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne bra paa ayi ye tɛkyɛ, na nyeyemuɛ anaa nyaatwom nne nu. 18 Na bɛ bɔ bɛpena asomdwee si atee, bɔ bedua ye asomdwee nu ne, bɛte tenenee mmaa.

Title: YAKOBO 4
Content:
Ewiase abiɛngoɛfalɛ
1Koɛ ne ngondii bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, nisua yeɛ ofi ba ɔ? Ɛmɔ akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔne ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa mɔ bɛko ne, aso nna nu yeɛ ofi ba ɔ? 2 Ɛmɔpena, na ɛmɔnnya ye; yiti ɛmɔdi awue; ɛmɔ nye boro kyɛ ɛmɔkonya ye, na ɛmɔngora benya ye; yiti ɛmɔko, na ɛmɔdi ahoɛ. Ɛmɔ sa nga ye, ofikyɛ ɛmɔmmisa. 3Ɛmɔbisa, na ɛmɔ sa nga ye, ofikyɛ nna adwene paa yeɛ ɛmɔfa bebisa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɛmɔ akɔnnɔ kuro ɔ. 4 Agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ! Ɛmɔnze kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔfa wiase abiɛngoɛ a, né ɛmɔpɔ Nyameɛ ɔ? Yiti ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔfa wiase abiɛngoɛ ne, ɔte Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ. 5Anaakyɛ ɛmɔdwene kyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ye mbaen, kyɛ, “Ɔtwe ye sunzum bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ne nwo nungunɛ” ɔ? 6 Nakoso adom bɔ ɔfa ma ne, ɔsone pee. Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ,
“Nyameɛ nye sa anwomasoɛfoɛ,
na ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ.”
7Yiti ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo béwura Nyameɛ bo. Ɛ́mɔyere ɛmɔ nwo bési abɔnzam ate, na ɔkɔnwati kofi ɛmɔ nwo. 8 Ɛmɔhwe bepingye Nyameɛ, na ye koso ɔkɔhwe kopingye ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔ, bɔnefoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔnwunzi ɛmɔ sa, ná ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ ahone nu, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ adwene yɛ ɛmɔ ndaa ndaa ɔ! 9 Ɛ́mɔli yealɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsu! Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ aserekyekye kakyi aworabɔlɛ, ná ɛmɔ ahurusililɛ kakyi anwumvoin anwumvoin. 10Ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase wɔ Awurade nyunu, na ɔkɔma ɛmɔ so.
Nnɛbua ebiɛngo ndɛen
11Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. Na ebiala bɔ ɔkã oliɛngo nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ anaa obua ye ndɛen ne, ɔkã mmeraa ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, na obua mmeraa ne ndɛen. Na sɛ ebua mmeraa ne ndɛen a, né ɛnyɔ bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne, na mmom ɛte ye so ndɛenbualɛniɛ. 12Mmeraahyɛlɛniɛ ne ndɛenbualɛniɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ; ye ole bɔ ɔkora ode ngoa ná ɔsɛkye ne. Yiti wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen ɔ?
Nnɛfa ɛhema tu wɔ nwo
13 Afei ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkã kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ anaa ɛhema, yɛkɔhɔ kuro he anaa ɛhene aso yɛkooli berɛ afoɛ ko, yɛkɔtɔ ná yayɛ nningyein atɔen, ná yanya mvasoɛ.” 14Nakoso ɛmɔnze bɔ okosi ɛhema ɔ. Ɛmɔ ngoa te nzu? Ofikyɛ ɔte etutue bɔ ɔba mmerɛ kãa bie, ná afei watu wamini ɔ. 15Bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkã mmom ɛhe: “Sɛ Awurade boka ná yɛte ngoa nu a, yɛkɔyɔ he anaa ɛhene.” 16Nakoso ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo wɔ ɛmɔ anwomasoɛ nu; na sɔ anwomasoɛ ne amukoraa te bɔne. 17Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔse paa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɔ, nakoso ɔnyɔ ne, ɔte bɔne ma ye.

Title: YAKOBO 5
Content:
Esikafoɛ asisiefoɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
