1Afei ɛmɔ, esikafoɛ, ɔnate amaneɛ bɔ ɔ́ba ɛmɔ so ne ati, ɛ́mɔsu ná ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye! 2 Ɛmɔ anwonyadeɛ ne aporɔ, na mvrɔlɔ ali ɛmɔ ndena. 3Ɛmɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ ali naakye, na bɛ nwo naakye ne kɔyɛ adanzeɛ kotia ɛmɔ, na okodidi ɛmɔ nwonaen kyɛ see. Ɛmɔaboaboa agyapadeɛ noa wɔ ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu. 4 Ɛ́mɔtie! Apaafoɛ bɔ bɛyɔle ɛmɔ fieso adwuma ne, b’akatuaa bɔ ɛmɔnate asisie so bɛfa besiele ne, ɔtea nu; na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ɛmɔ fieso nnɔbaeɛ ne, bɛ suɛ ne waadwu Asafo Awurade so anu. 5 Ɛmɔ asetena nu wɔ aseɛ ye aso te anigye ne ahohwibra; na ɛmɔayɛ bɛ nwo twɔtwɔfee bama akumyɛɛ kyẽa ne. 6Ɛmɔabua teneneeniɛ foɛ bahũ ye, wɔ aberɛ bɔ onzi ɛmɔ ate ɔ.
Ndoboaseɛ ne mbaeɛbɔlɛ
7 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔnya ndoboaseɛ maa oodwu kyɛ Awurade kɔwa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔtie, kuaniɛ bɔ ɔnwondɛ ma aseɛ kye aleɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ne, onya ye nwo aboterɛ maa okodwu kyɛ feefee ne asuso kotikye ɔ. 8Na ɛmɔ koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnya aboterɛ, ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, ofikyɛ Awurade walɛ ne apingye. 9Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔbobɔ kwaadu betiatia ɛmɔ nwo, ná bammua ɛmɔ ndɛen. Ɛ́mɔnea, ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne ogyi anoa nu berɛ. 10Aliɛmaa mɔ, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bedwudwole Awurade dumaa nu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛ́yɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ne aboterɛ nwo nhwɛsoɛ. 11 Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛ bɔ bemiane bɛ nye bɛfale amaneɛ nu ne, yɛbu bɛ kyɛ banya saleɛ. Yeɛ ɛmɔate Yob amaneɛnwunɛ nu animia ne, na ɛmɔanwu kyɛbɔ Awurade maa osi yiele ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ Awurade anwumvoinnwunɛ sone, ná osa le tema maa ɔbo so ɔ.
12 Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛhe amukoraa asi ne, nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen! Nnɛma ɛmɔfa nyameɛso anaa aseɛ anaa nikyee biala bɛta ndaen. Na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ “Yoo” yɛ yoo, ná ɛmɔ “Daabi” yɛ daabi, ná bammua ɛmɔ foɛ.
Gyidie mbaeɛbɔlɛ
13Ɛmɔ nu bie onwu amaneɛ anaa? Maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ. Ebie nye agye anaa? Maa ɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein. 14 Ɛmɔ nu bie nde apɔ anaa? Maa ɔfrɛ asɔre mbanyi mɔ ma bɛɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ye, ná bɛfa ngoo bɛpopa ye wɔ Awurade dumaa nu. 15Gyidie mbaeɛ kole yarefoɛ ne ngoa, na Awurade kɔpagya ye; na sɛ wayɔ bɔne a, ɔkɔfa kɔhyɛ ye. 16Yiti ɛ́mɔkekã ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ behyirehyire ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔbobɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ɛmɔ nwo, amaa ɛmɔate apɔ. Na teneneeniɛ mbaeɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ne, ɔkora yɔ nikyee biala. 17 Né Elia te sona kyɛ yɛ ala, na ɔbɔle mbaeɛ serɛserɛ kyɛ nnɛma esue tɔ, na esue andɔ aseɛ so alaa afoɛ nza ne bosome nzia. 18 Na afei ɔbɔle mbaeɛ bieku, na nyameɛso tɔle nzue, na aseɛ suli ye aleɛ.
19Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie di nahorɛ ne nwo makyebu, ná ebie sa fa ye ba a, 20 ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa bɔnefoɛ kofi ye makyebu atee so kosa kɔwa ne, okole ye kra kofi ewue nu, na ɔkɔkata bɔne pee so.

Title: 1 PETRO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Petro hyerɛle krataa he ɔɔmane Akristofoɛ bɔ ɔfrɛ bɛ “Nyameɛ mmenia.” Né bato bapete wɔ Asia. Krataa ne botaeɛ paa ɛhe: ɔɔfa hyɛle bɛ nguraen, ofikyɛ né ɔnate bɛ gyidie ti benwu amaneɛ ne ndaneanyeɛ.
Petro fa Kristo Yesu nzɛmba ne: ye wue, ye wutingyelɛ, ɔne anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye walɛ ne anu yeɛ ɔkaye bɛ ɔ. Petro kyire kyɛ, ɛhawo ne amaneɛ bɔ benwu ye ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte bɛ gyidie ne nwo nzɔhwɛ, amaa ɔnate so banya ye nwo akatuaa wɔ kyẽa bɔ Kristo kɔwa ne. Osa ka kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ye bɔ benwu amaneɛ ye, ohia kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛte Kristo deɛ ɔ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Nyameɛ daa ngoa nwo dwirɛ 1.3-12
Brabɔlɛ krongron nwo dwirɛ 1.13—2.10
Kristoniɛ asodie wɔ anwokyere mmerɛ nu 2.11—4.19
Kristoniɛ anwobrɛaseɛ ne ɛsolɛ 5.1-11
Ayieleɛ 5.12-14

Title: 1 PETRO 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɛ, méfa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia, 2bɛ bɔ Baba Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ fi tetetete, bɔ ɔnate Sunzum Krongron so wate bɛ nwo wama Yesu Kristo nwo sotie ɔne ye mogya nu anwopetenɛ ne: Adom ne asomdwee mmorosoɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.
Anyelasoɛ bɔ ngoa wɔ nu
3Animnyam hã Nyameɛ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, bɔ ɔnate ye anwumvoinnwunɛ mmorosoɛ ti wafa Yesu Kristo awufoɛ nu ewutingyelɛ ne aso wawo yɛ foforɛ maa yanya anyelasoɛ bɔ ngoa wɔ nu, 4maa yanya agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔmborɔ, bɔ ngekalewa nne ye nwo, bɔ ɔmbɛ nu ngɔ, bɔ bafa basie nyameɛso bama ɛmɔ 5bɔ bɛnate gyidie so bɛbɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen wɔ Nyameɛ tumi nu, bɔ ɔkɔ ngoalelɛ bɔ basiesie kyɛ bɛbaala ye ali wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu ne.
6Na ɛhe nu yeɛ ɛmɔdi ahurusi paa ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ kekesaala ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora bɔ kãa, ɔnate nzɔhwɛ ahoroɔ ne ati, 7amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ gyidie ne—bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se tra sikaa kɔkorɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ beso bɛnea wɔ see nu po, nakoso ɔsɛkye ne—wakakyi ayɛyelɛ, anidie ne animnyam wɔ Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ ne anu. 8Ye yeɛ ɛmɔnnwuni ye, nakoso ɛmɔkuro ye dwirɛ; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ kekesaala ye de ɛmɔnnwu ye, nakoso ɛmɔde ye bedi, na ɛmɔanya anigye bɔ olle kabea bɔ animnyam wɔ nu ɔ, 9ofikyɛ ɛmɔgu so benya ɛmɔ gyidie ne nwo akatuaa, bɔ ɔte ngoalelɛ ma ɛmɔ kra ɔ.
10Na ɔfa ngoalelɛ he anwo de, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle adom bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ deɛ ne nwo ngɔm ne, bɛfeefeele nu, na bɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛle nu. 11Bɛbɔle mmɔden kyɛ bekonwu mmerɛ horɛ, anaa mmerɛ ahoroɔ mɔ bɔ Kristo Sunzum bɔ né ɔte bɛ nu ne ɔda ye ali ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ olili moa lili Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ nwo adanzeɛ, ɔne animnyam bɔ ɔtoa so ne.
12Na bɛlale ye ali behyirele bɛ kyɛ, nna bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo, na mmom yɛ yeɛ né bɛyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma ne bɛma yɛ ɔ, wɔ edwirɛ mɔ bɔ kekesaala ye yɛbɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ne anu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛnate Sunzum Krongron bɔ basoma ye fi nyameɛso so bɛɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele ɛmɔ ne. Na sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ yeɛ abɔfo mɔ po bekuro kyɛ benwu nu ɔ.
Brabɔlɛ bɔ ye nwo te ɔ
13Yiti ɛ́mɔsiesie ɛmɔ adwene ma osi pi, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ anyelasoɛ amukoraa ówura adom bɔ Yesu Kristo kɔfa kɔbrɛ ɛmɔ wɔ ye nwo aliyelɛ ne anu. 14Ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ ngwadaa bɔ bɛ so yɛ mmerɛ ɔ, na akɔnnɔ bra bɔ daa ne né ɛmɔnze ti ɛmɔbɔle ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsa bekodi ye si. 15Na mmom, kyɛbɔ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne ɔte krongron ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron wɔ ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ amukoraa nu ɔ. 16 Ɔnate kyɛ, bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron, ofikyɛ me, nde krongron.”
17Na sɛ ɛmɔfrɛ bɔ ɔnnea sona nyunu yeɛ obua ndɛen kyɛbɔ ebiala nnwumaa te ɔ kyɛ Baba a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa esuronyi bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔaayɛ amanvrafoɛ ɔ. 18Ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ, bra fiɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ fa yakyili ɛmɔ ne, nna nningyein bɔ bɛporɔ te kyɛ ɛdwetɛ anaa sikaa kɔkorɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛyɛle ɛmɔ ti nyɔboɛ bɛpɔle ɛmɔ befili nu ɔ, 19na mmom Kristo bɔ ɔte kyɛ boaen ba bɔ ollili nnɛen bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye nwo ne, ye mogya bɔ odi mu ne yeɛ bɛfa bɛpɔle ɛmɔ ɔ. 20Ye yeɛ bɛyele ye besiele berɛ koraka yeɛ bɛbaabɔ wiase ɔ, nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yeɛ bala ye ali bahyire wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu ɔ. 21Na ɔnate ye so yeɛ ɛmɔde Nyameɛ bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ná ɔhyɛle ye animnyam ne bedi ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya gyidie ne anyelasoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nu.
22Asoɛmmerɛlɛ bɔ ɛmɔayɛ bama nahorɛ ne ne ati, wamaa ɛmɔate ɛmɔ kra nwo, na ɛhe amaa ɛmɔahurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu, yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfi ɛmɔ ahone nu bekurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ. 23Banwo ɛmɔ bamvi nikyee bɔ ɔporɔ ɔ nu, na mmom befili bɔ ɔmborɔ ɔ nu, bɔ bɛnate Nyameɛ dwirɛ bɔ ngoa wɔ nu ná otimu berɛ daa ne aso yeɛ bawo ɛmɔ foforɛ ɔ. 24 Ofikyɛ
“Anwoɔnaen amukoraa te kyɛ ndire,
na sona animnyam amukoraa te kyɛ ndire bɔ wabɔ nyerɛen ɔ.
Ndire kese,
na ye nyerɛen poro gua;
25nakoso Awurade dwirɛ de,
otimu berɛ afebɔɔ.”
Na edwirɛ he ole nzɛmba bɔ babɔ ye dawure bahyire ɛmɔ ne.

Title: 1 PETRO 2
Content:
Ngoa nyɔboɛ ne maen krongron
1Yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa, nnakannaka amukoraa, nyaatwomyɛlɛ, ɛpɔen ne nzekure amukoraa bégua. 2Ɛmɔte kyɛ nnɔma bɔ bawo bɛ foforɛ ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔpena sunzum nu nyɔfonesue bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanyi nu bahɔ ngoalelɛ nu, 3 mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔanwu kyɛ Awurade te paa ne. 4 Ɛmɔbra ye berɛ, ngoa nyɔboɛ ne, bɔ mmenia apo ye, nakoso Nyameɛ de, waneanea nu waye ye, bɔ odi mu ne; 5na ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔte kyɛ ngoa nyɔboɛ mɔ, na ɛ́mɔma bɛ́fa ɛmɔ bési sunzum nu sua ma ɛmɔyɛ asɔfokure krongron, amaa ɛmɔafa Yesu Kristo so babɔ sunzum nu afɔleɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ. 6 Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu kyɛ:
“Tie, méfa ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire
bɔ maneanea nu maye ye, ná odi mu ɔ meto Sion,
na ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, ye nyunu ngogua ase.”
7 Na ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔde ye bedi ne de, odi mu ma ɛmɔ; nakoso bɛ bɔ benne benni ne de,
“Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne,
ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ;
8 yeɛ
ɔte sundidua nyɔboɛ ne sundiduatolɛ nyɔbotaen ma bɛ.”
Na befi ase, ofikyɛ bɛyɛ edwirɛ ne nwo asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ b’ayieleɛ nhyehyɛleɛ te ne ala.
9 Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ baneanea nu baye ɛmɔ ɔ, nnehyeɛ asɔfokure, maen krongron, maen bɔ wafa ye wayɛ ye deɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔɔbɔ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ fili awosii nu wale ye kanea bɔ ɔyɛ nwanwa ne anu ne, ye ayɛyelɛ ne dawure.
10 Daa ne de, né ahaa ɛmɔtte maen,
nakoso afei de, ɛmɔte Nyameɛ maen;
daa ne de, né onnwuni ɛmɔ anwumvoin,
nakoso afei de, wanwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin.
Nyameɛ ngoaa
11Adɔfo mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ, yiti anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔko tia ɛmɔ kra ne, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo. 12Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ bɛkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ de, nakoso ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ bra yɛ sannwuu wɔ bɛ nu, amaa banwu ɛmɔ bra paa ne, ná bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔkɔwa ne.
13Ɔnate Awurade ti, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma tumililɛ amukoraa: kyɛ ɛhene berembɔn ne ahɔ oo, 14anaa amrado mɔ bɔ ɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔtwe nzɛmmɔnefoɛ so, ná bɛkamvo bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ahɔ oo. 15Ofikyɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhe: kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bra paa ne bɛkɔhã ngwaseafoɛ noa bɛkɔto nu ɔ. 16Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ fawɔnwodifoɛ, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ fawɔnwodi ne bɛkatakata ɛmɔ nyunu bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ; na mmom ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa. 17Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma mmenia amukoraa! Ɛ́mɔhurohuro aliɛmaa mɔ agyidifoɛ dwirɛ! Ɛ́mɔsuro Nyameɛ! Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma ɛhene ne!
Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ te nhwɛsoɛ
18Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔfa esuronyi amukoraa bɛbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mene mɔ. Nna meneɛ mɔ bɔ bɛte paa ná bedwo angome, na mmom meneɛ atianuserɛfoɛ koso bɛboka so. 19Ofikyɛ ɛhe te animnyam, kyɛ wɔ tiboa se Nyameɛ ti, emia wɔ nye edi aworabɔlɛ enwu amaneɛ bɔ ɔmvata ɔ. 20Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee, ná bɛbo ɛmɔ wɔ ye nwo a, nzikyɛ animnyam yeɛ ɛmɔnya ɔ? Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye benwu ye nwo amaneɛ a, ɔsɔ anyeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 21Na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnate yɛ ti Kristo koso nwuni amaneɛ, na ɔfa yɛle nhwɛsoɛ mane yɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔtu ye agyirɛ ne bie.
22 Ye de, wanyɔ bɔne, biala,
yeɛ ngondombo dwirɛ biala amvi ye noa.
23Bɛpepɛle ye nzoaa nen, wangakyi wamma bɛ; mmerɛ bɔ né onwu amaneɛ nen, wannwunanwuna; na mmom ɔfale ye nwo wurale bɔ obua ndɛen turoloo ne sa. 24 Ye bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔsoale yɛ bɔne wɔ ye nipadua nu hɔle bakaa ne aso ɔ, kyɛ, sɛ yawu yafi bɔne nu de a, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛtena ase yɛma tenenee. Na ye nwo beabealɛ ne yeɛ wafa wasa ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ ɔ. 25Ofikyɛ, ahaa né ɛmɔte kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bamini ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔasa bawa ɛmɔ kra so Neafoɛ ne Wɛmvoɛ ne berɛ.

Title: 1 PETRO 3
Content:
Huɛ mɔ ne yeɛ mɔ
1 Yeɛ mɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ ɔ; na sɛ ɔba kyɛ bɛ nu biemɔ benne edwirɛ ne benni a, bafa bɛ ye mɔ suban so, bɔ nna bɛ noa dwirɛ ahɔ ɔ basakyera; 2sɛ benwu ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ sannwuu bɔ esurolɛ wɔ nu ne a. 3 Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo siesielɛ ne ɔyɛ anwoɔnaen nu nikye, bɔ ɔte tirebɔlɛ, sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ, anaa ndena paa heralɛ; 4na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ahone nu nikyee bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye, sunzum bɔ odwo, ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase, nikyee bɔ ɔmborɔ, bɔ ɔte nikyee nyɔboɛserɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. 5Na sɔ atee he aso yeɛ daa tete mmrasua krongron bɔ bɛfale bɛ wora bewurale Nyameɛ nu ne besiesiele bɛ nwo ɔ, na bɛbrɛle bɛ nwo ase bɛmane bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ, 6 kyɛbɔ Sara yɛle sotie mane Abraham ná ɔfrɛle ye ye mene ne. Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔamma ɛserɛ anzi ɛmɔ ate a, ye de ɛmɔte ye mma mmrasua.
7 Huɛ mɔ, ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ aye mɔ bɛ́tena ndeaseɛ nu sɔ ala. Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ aye mɔ, kyɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ɔ, kyɛ bɛboka ɛmɔ so yeɛ ɛmɔle kyɛfa wɔ ngoa adom ne anu ɔ; ná nikye fee wanzi ɛmɔ mbaeɛ ate.
Paayɛlɛ nu amaneɛnwunɛ
8Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛ́mɔnya adwene ko, ɛ́mɔnwunwu ɛmɔ nwo anwumvoin, ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔnya tema bɛ́ma ɛmɔ nwo, na ɛ́mɔdwene anwobrɛaseɛ adwene. 9Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua bɔne so, anaa nzoaapepɛlɛ betua nzoaapepɛlɛ so; na mmom ɛ́mɔyirayira; ofikyɛ ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya saleɛ. 10 Ofikyɛ
sona biala bɔ okuro ngoa
ná ɔpena kyɛ onwu asetena paa nen,
nnɛmaa ɔfa ye noa kekã musue dwirɛ,
yeɛ nnɛma nnakannaka dwirɛ fite ye noa.
11Maa ohyi bɔne ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ;
maa ɔpena asomdwee boso ná oli ye si.
12Ofikyɛ Awurade nye wɔ teneneefoɛ so,
na ɔyɛ asoɛ ma bɛ mbaeɛ;
nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔne de, Awurade nye sa bɛ.
13Na sɛ ɛmɔfa besie ɛmɔ nye so kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔha ɛmɔ ɔ? 14 Nakoso sɛ tenenee ti ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɔte saleɛ ma ɛmɔ. Nnɛmɔma bɛ nwo suronyi tɔ ɛmɔ so, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ; 15na mmom ɛ́mɔma Awurade Kristo ɔyɛ krongron wɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu. Na mmerɛ biala, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ nwo bésie, amaa sɛ ebie bisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ fa anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne nwo a, ɛmɔahora baye ye noa bahyire ye wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ ne anidie nu. 16Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ tiboa obua ɛmɔ be, amaa sɛ bɛto ɛmɔ soen a, bɛ bɔ bɛkekã ɛmɔ Kristo nu bra paa ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ne, bɛ nyunu agua ase. 17Na sɛ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu bra paa nu amaneɛ a, ye sɔ te paa tra kyɛ ɛmɔkonwu amaneɛ wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nu ɔ. 18Ofikyɛ Kristo koso nwuni bɔne nwo amaneɛ pɛenko; ye bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, onwuni amaneɛ mane bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wafa yɛ wahɔ Nyameɛ berɛ. Behuni ye wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, nakoso bɛfale ye bɛwale ngoa nu wɔ Sunzum nu, 19na nu koso yeɛ ɔɔbɔle nzɛmba ne dawure hyirele sunzum mɔ bɔ begua kukunu, 20 bɔ daa tete mmerɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ, mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nwondɛle aboterɛ nu wɔ Nowa aberɛ so, bɔ né ɔ́bobɔ ɛlɛen alaka ne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, mmenia kãa bie, bɔ bɛte mmɔtwɛ ɔ yeɛ bɛfale nzue so belele bɛ ngoa ɔ. 21Na sɔ nzue ne sɛso, ye ole asubɔlɛ bɔ ode ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔ ngoa ɛnɛ ne. Ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu fiɛ nwunzinɛ, na mmom ɔte tiboa paa nwo abisadeɛ bɔ yɛfa Yesu Kristo wutingyelɛ ne aso yɛfa yɛto Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. 22Ye yeɛ ɔhɔle nyameɛso ne, na ɔte Nyameɛ sa famaa so; na abɔfo mɔ ne anwoserɛ mɔ ne tumi mɔ babrɛ bɛ nwo ase bawura ye bo.

Title: 1 PETRO 4
Content:
Brabɔlɛ foforɛ
1Na kyɛbɔ ɔnate yɛ ti yeɛ Kristo nwuni amaneɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne, ɛmɔ koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnya sɔ adwene ne ná ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ wanwu anwoɔnaen nu amaneɛ ne, wayakyi bɔne yɔlɛ; 2na anwoɔnaen nu asetena mmerɛ bɔ waha ne, ɔndena ase mma sona akɔnnɔ ko, na mmom ɔtena ase ma Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ. 3Yɛbɔle yɛ bra kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ wɔ y’asetena mmerɛ bɔ wapɛ nu ne anu, na yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ ahohwibra, akɔnnɔ, nzaabolɛ, bɔne nu anigye, asanzabra, yeɛ bosoensolɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ nu. 4Na ɔyɛ bɛ nwanwa kyɛ afei de, ɛmɔmva ɛmɔ nwo bɛmmɔ bɛ wɔ sɔ bra fiɛ basabasa ne anu ɔ, yiti bɛkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. 5Nakoso bekobu ye nwo ngondaa bekohyire bɔ wasiesie ye nwo kyɛ ɔbaabua ateasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ndɛen ne. 6Na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele awufoɛ mɔ po ɔ, amaa ɔnate so babua bɛ ndɛen kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ɔ, ná batena ase wɔ sunzum nu kyɛ Nyameɛ.
7Nakoso nningyein amukoraa ayieleɛ apingye; yiti ɛ́mɔnya adwene paa ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ ma mbaeɛbɔlɛ. 8 Bɔ ɔtra so ɔ, ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɔdɔ kata bɔne pee so. 9Ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nyunu bɛso ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo wɔfoɛ. 10Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ nu biala wanya adom akyɛdeɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́so ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛ Nyameɛ adom ahoroɔ ne nwo neafoɛ paa mɔ. 11Sɛ ebie dwudwo a, maa ɔhã ye kyɛ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɔ; sɛ ebie ɔyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma a, maa ɔfa anwoserɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye ne ɔso; amaa ɔnate so bafa Yesu Kristo so bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ nningyein amukoraa nu. Ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ daa daa ɔ. Amen.
Kristofoɛ amaneɛnwunɛ
12Aliɛmaa mɔ, amaneɛ yeayea bɔ ɔtoto ɛmɔ bɔ bɛfa beso ɛmɔ bɛnea ne, nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa, kyɛ ebiaa ɔte nikyee foforɛ bie yeɛ ɔtoto ɛmɔ ɔ. 13Na mmom, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu Kristo amaneɛ ne bie ɔ, amaa sɛ bɛye ye animnyam ne ali a, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔali ahurusi ná ɛmɔ nye agye. 14 Na sɛ ɔnate Kristo dumaa ti bɛbɔ ɛmɔ alapaa a, ɔte saleɛ ma ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ animnyam sunzum, Nyameɛ sunzum ne, ɔwɔ ɛmɔ so. 15Nakoso nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nu bie yɛ wudiniɛ anaa awueniɛ anaa bɔnefoɛ anaa ɔyɛ ebie dwirɛ nwo nwondononwondono ná onwu ye nwo amaneɛ. 16Nakoso sɛ ebie te Kristoniɛ ti, ná onwu amaneɛ a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ ye nya; na mmom maa ɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam kyɛ sɔ dumaa ne la ye so ɔ.
17Ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne adwu kyɛ ndɛenbualɛ hyɛ ye bo wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɔ. Na sɛ bɛfa yɛ bɛhyɛ ye bo a, nzaade bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne nwo asoserɛ ne de, okoyie bɛ sɛ? 18 Na
sɛ ɔyɛ se kyɛ bekole sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ngoa a,
né nzaade sona bɔ onzuro Nyameɛ, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ begyi ye sɛ?
19Yiti bɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ti benwu amaneɛ ne, maa bɛfa bɛ kra bewura Ɛdangama bɔ ɔte nahorɛniɛ ne sa, ná bɛhɔ so bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

Title: 1 PETRO 5
Content:
Nyameɛ mmoaen kure so nealɛ
1Yiti me bɔ nde ɛmɔ aliɛma panyi ɔne Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ nwo danzeniɛ, bɔ ngosa ngonya kyɛfa wɔ animnyam bɔ bɛbaaye ye ali ne anu ne, métu ɛmɔ nu mbanyi nemɔ foɛ kyɛ, 2 ɛ́mɔnea Nyameɛ mmoaen kure bɔ owura ɛmɔ sa ne aso, bɔ nna nhyɛsoɛ so ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɛmɔkofia ɛmɔ kunu bɛkɔnea bɛ so kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ pena ɔ; bɔ nna adifuu ti ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ofi ɛmɔ ahone nu ti ɔ; 3bɔ ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhyɛ bɛ bɔ bewura ɛmɔ sa ne aso, na mmom kyɛ ɛ́mɔyɛ nhwɛsoɛ bɛ́ma mmoaen kure ne ɔ. 4Na sɛ Mmoaenneafoɛ panyi ne ɔye ye nwo ali a, ɛmɔkonya animnyam abotire bɔ ɔnzɛkye koraa ne.
5 Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte mmabunu ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bewura mbanyi mɔ bo ɔ. Ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ bɛ́hera, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́so ɛmɔ nwo ngoko ngoko, ofikyɛ
Nyameɛ nye sa anwomasoɛfoɛ,
na ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ.
6 Yiti ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase béwura Nyameɛ tumi asaa ne abo, ná wama ɛmɔ so wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu. 7Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ dadwene amukoraa begua ye so, ofikyɛ ɔdwene ɛmɔ nwo.
8Ɛ́mɔdwo ɛmɔ nwo ase, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ abɔnzam odi akɔneaba, opo kyɛ gyata, na ɔpena sona bɔ okonya ye kɔhye ye ɔ. 9Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu bɛ́fa bési ye ate, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ bafa sɔ amaneɛnwunɛ ne bato ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ewiase amukoraa ɔ so, kyɛ bɛ koso benwu bie. 10Na sɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie beyie a, adom mukoraa Nyameɛ, bɔ wafrɛ yɛ wawa ye animnyam afebɔɔ nu wɔ Kristu Yesu nu ne, okosiesie ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔkoli mu, ɔkɔma ɛmɔkogyina pindinn, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ ná wama ɛmɔagyina pirim. 11Ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen.
Ngraalilɛ
12Silwano bɔ mebu ye kyɛ ɔte aliɛmaa nahorɛniɛ ne, mafa ye so yeɛ mahyerɛ edwirɛ tikaape he mabrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. Na mefa metu ɛmɔ foɛ ná medi adanzeɛ kyɛ, ɛhe te Nyameɛ nohorɛ adom ne, yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ nu. 13 Asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Babilɔn, bɔ baneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɛmɔ ne, obisa ɛmɔ ahye; mma Marko koso obisa ɛmɔ ahye. 14Ɛ́mɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo awaawaatuu wɔ ɔdɔ nu. Asomdwee hã ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu amukoraa. Amen.

Title: 2 PETRO BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Petro hyerɛle ye krataa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ he ɔɔmane tete Akristofoɛ pee. Krataa he botaeɛ fa akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ nwo, ɔne brabɔne bɔ bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ ne fa ba ɔ.
Petro kyire kyɛ bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ ne noa ayire ɛhe: kyɛ gyidiniɛ biala kɔsɔ Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nwo nahorɛ nimdeɛ ne anu yé. Ofikyɛ asomafoɛ bɔ bɛfale sɔ nimdeɛ ne bɛbrɛle bɛ ne, benwuni Yesu, yeɛ bɛtele ye noa dwirɛ koso.
Bɔ né ɔha Petro paa ole kyɛ, akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ ne kyire kyɛ Kristo ngosa ngɔwa ko. Petro mane Akristofoɛ ne tele ye bo kyɛ nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ pena kyɛ sona biala sakyera ye adwene na wammini. Na ɛhe ati yeɛ wama Yesu walɛ ne ahyɛ ɔ (3.9).
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-2
Kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ si ma sona yɛ Kristoniɛ ɔ 1.3-21
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ 2.1-22
Kristo sawalɛ ne 3.1-18

Title: 2 PETRO 1
Content:
1 Simɔn Petro bɔ nde Yesu Kristo akoaa ne somafoɛ ne, mefa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ ɔnate yɛ Nyameɛ ne Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo tenenee so banya gyidie bɔ odi mu kyɛ yɛ deɛ ne ala ɔ. 2 Mesrɛ kyɛ adom ne asomdwee ɔyɛ pee ma ɛmɔ, wɔ Nyameɛ ne y’Awurade Yesu nwo nimdeɛ nu.
Bafrɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛɛnyi gyidie nu
3 Nyameɛ tumi ne afa nikyee biala bɔ yɛhia ye wɔ asetena nu ne nyamesom paa nu ɔ wahyɛ yɛ, na wafa ye bɔ wafrɛ yɛ wahɔ ye bɔbɔ ye animnyam ne ye paayɛlɛ nu ne, ye nwo nimdeɛ so. 4 Na ɔnate ɛhemɔ aso yeɛ wafa ye bɔhyɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ odi mu ne wahyɛ yɛ ɔ; amaa ɔnate ɛhemɔ aso ɛmɔanwati bafi prɔlowaa bɔ ɔwɔ wiase bɔ ɔnate akɔnnɔ so yeɛ ɔba ne anu, ná ɛmɔanya Nyameɛ sue ne bie. 5Na ye sɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ́fa bra paa bɛ́foa ɛmɔ gyidie so; ɛ́mɔfa nimdeɛ bɛfoa bra paa so; 6ɛ́mɔfa anwohyɛsoɛ bɛ́foa nimdeɛ so; ɛ́mɔfa animia bɛ́foa anwohyɛsoɛ so; ɛ́mɔfa nyamesom paa bɛ́foa animia so; 7 ɛ́mɔfa aliɛmaa nwo dɔ bɛ́foa nyamesom paa so, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ bɛ́foa aliɛmaa nwo dɔ so. 8 Na sɛ ɛmɔle sɔ suban paa hemɔ mmorosoɛ a, bɛngɔma ɛmɔngɔtena berɛ mbaen anaa ɛmɔngɔyɛ mmenia bɔ benzu mmaa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nwo nimdeɛ nu ɔ. 9 Ofikyɛ sona biala bɔ sɔ suban nemɔ wabɔ ye ne, ɔte anyesiniwaaniɛ, ye nye so yɛ ye wusiwusi, na ye wora afi kyɛ bate ye nwo bafi ye bɔne bɔ wayɔ ye daa ne nwo ɔ.
10 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bétira ɛfrɛlɛ bɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne, ɔne ɛnealɛ bɔ baneanea nu baye ɛmɔ ne anu yé, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhemɔ a, ɛmɔngofi ase le. 11 Na ɔba ye sɔ a, bɛkɔma ɛmɔ atee mmorosoɛ bɔ ɔkɔ y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo ahennie afebɔɔ ne anu.
12 Yiti mengobu me nye mengogua so kyɛ ngɔkaye ɛmɔ wɔ ɛhemɔ anwo daa biala, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔse sɔ dada, na ɛmɔatira ndii wɔ nahorɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne anu. 13Na mmerɛ bɔ nwɔ ɛtena sua ye anu ye de, menea a, ɔte paa kyɛ ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ so maa ɔkɔkanyane ɛmɔ ɔ, 14 ofikyɛ mese kyɛ, ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bɛkɔye ɛtena sua ne bekofi me nwo, kyɛbɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo wala ye ali wahyire me ne. 15 Na mébɔ mmɔden menea kyɛ, mefi wiase wa mekɔ a, nziɛ ye ɛmɔkɔkaye ɛhemɔ daa biala.
Petro di Kristo animnyam nwo adanzeɛ
16 Amba, edwirɛ bɔ yahã yahyire ɛmɔ yafa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ye walɛ ne anwo ne, yamva kanda ɛhoaatolɛ so, na mmom yɛ bɔbɔ yɛte ye animnyam totohyia bɔ yɛnwuni ye ne nwo adanzefoɛ. 17 Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ onyane anidie ne animnyam fili Baba Nyameɛ berɛ, ná komviɛ bie fili Animnyam Totohyia ne berɛ wale ye berɛ kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe” nen, 18 yɛtele sɔ komviɛ ne kyɛ ofi nyameɛso yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, ofikyɛ né yɛne ye yeɛ yɛwɔ bokaa krongron ne aso ɔ.
19 Na yɛsa yɛle ngɔmhyɛlɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔma y’adwene si pi paa tra sɔ ɔ. Na ɛhe yeɛ ohia paa kyɛ ɛmɔnea ye yé, kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔta awosii nu maa okoodwu kyɛ aleɛ kɔhye, ná ngyerɛmɔ nzramaa kɔta ɛmɔ ahone nu ɔ. 20Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi moa bɛte ɛhe bo: kyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu ngɔmhyɛlɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ye bohyirelɛ ne fale sona so yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, 21 ofikyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ biala wamva kuro sona pɛ so wamma le, na mmom Nyameɛ mmenia krongron bedwudwole, kyɛbɔ Sunzum Krongron ne ɔkanyane bɛ ɔ.

Title: 2 PETRO 2
Content:
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ
1 Na ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ bedwɔsole maen ne anu, kyɛbɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ɛmɔ nu koso ne. Bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfeafea bɛ nwo bɛkɔfa ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye mmenia bekoowura nu ɔ, na bɛkɔpo Awurade bɔ ɔɔpɔle bɛ ná olele bɛ ne po, na bɛkɔtwetwe ɛsɛkyelɛ bɔ ɔba ndɛndɛ ɔ bɛkɔbrɛ bɛ nwo. 2 Na mmeni pee bekoli b’asanzabra ne asi, na ɔnate bɛ ti mmenia kɔkekã nahorɛ ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. 3 Na bɛ nye bɔ ɔboro nikyee ne ati, bɛkɔfa nnakannaka dwirɛ bekodidi ɛmɔ nwo. Na ofi tetetete, ndɛen bɔ babua bɛ ne ɔndwetwe ye ase, yeɛ b’asohwenɛ koso ɔndɔ ngosie.
4Na sɛ Nyameɛ amva abɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛyɔle bɔne ne nwo wangyɛ bɛ, ná mmom ogyili bɛ guale ɛborɔ kumaa kuronguronn awosii kabii nu, ná ɔbɔle bɛ panwu kyɛ ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne a; 5 ná sɛ wamva daa tete wiase nwo wangyɛ ye, na mmom olele Nowa bɔ ɔte tenenee nzɛmbahanɛniɛ, ɔne mmenia nzoo bɔ bɛboka ye so ne, ná ɔfale nzueyilɛ ɔɔkatale amumuyɛɛfoɛ wiase so a; 6 ná sɛ obuale Sodom ne Gomora nguro foɛ ɔbɔle bɛ tɔɔ, ɔsɛkyele bɛ maa bɛyerale bɛtɔle nzoen, ná ɔfa yɛle nhwɛsoɛ mane bɛ bɔ nziɛ ye bɛkɔbɔ amumuyɛɛ bra a; 7 na sɛ ɔpepɛ lele teneneeniɛ Lɔto bɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛfale b’asanzabra bɛteetee ye, 8(ofikyɛ sɔ teneneeniɛ ne, bɔ onwuni ye ná ɔtele wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔte bɛ nu berɛ ne, bɛ mmeraatolɛ yɔleɛ ne mane ye kra tenenee ne olili ye nwo yealɛ daa biala;) 9 né nzaade Awurade se atee bɔ ɔfa so ɔpepɛ de bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ fi nzɔhwɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɔtwe bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ so ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne ɔ, 10 nganga bɛ bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ fiɛ si, ná bebu tumililɛ animtia ɔ. Besi b’ahone, bedi bɛ ti piri, na benzuro kyɛ bɛkɔkekã dwirɛ bekotia animnyamfoɛ nemɔ ɔ. 11 Na abɔfo mɔ po bɔ b’anwoserɛ ne bɛ tumi te piri tra bɛ ne, bɛngeka edwirɛ bendia bɛ bɛmmɔ bɛ kwaadu wɔ Awurade nyunu. 12 Nakoso sɔ mmenia hemɔ, bɔ bɛte kyɛ ngaka bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu, bɔ bɛwole bɛ kyɛ bɛhye bɛ behũ bɛ ne, bɛkekã dwirɛ betia nikyee biala bɔ bɛnde ye bo ɔ, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sɛkyelɛ nu yeɛ bekowuwu ɔ, 13 na ɔkɔyɛ bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne nwo akatuaa. Bɛ nye gye kyɛ bɛkɔbɔ ahohwibra eyia ketee ɔ. Bɛte ngekaleawa ne nnɛen, na bɛbɔ ahohwibra wɔ b’anigye nu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛne ɛmɔ didi ɔ. 14 Bele agyaasɛkyelɛ anyeɛ, bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne a ɔnde ye ɔ, bɛlakalaka akra bɔ bennya bettirale ndii ɔ, balɔ asukɔ wɔ adifuu nu. Bɛte mmenia bɔ banoma bɛ ɔ! 15 Bayakyi nahorɛ atee ne berɛ bali makyebu, na baafa Beɔ awa Balaam atee so, ye bɔ ohurole kyɛ okonya mvasoɛ kofi amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ nu ɔ. 16 Nakoso behwili ye nyunu wɔ ye mmeraatolɛ nwo; afupɔngɔ bɔ ɔngora dwudwo ɔ ɔfale sona komvi dwudwole fa sili ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ngwaseasɛm ne ate.
17 Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛte abura mɔ bɔ nzue nne nu ɔ, ɔne munungum bɔ mvrama bɔ ye huu kɔ ɔ; na bɛ yeɛ basiesie awosii kabii bato berɛ bama bɛ ɔ. 18 Ofikyɛ bɛbobɔ bɛ noa nu bɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ mbaen mbaen, na bɛnate anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu bɛfa ahohwisɛm bɛlakalaka bɛ bɔ begu so bɛnwati befi mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ azanzabra nemɔ bɛ mvomsoɛ nu ɔ. 19 Bɛfa fawɔnwodi bɛbɔ bɛ anohoba, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛte prɔlowaa ngoaa ɔ. Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ odi sona so ne, ye yeɛ sona ne te ye akoaa ɔ. 20 Na sɛ bɛnate y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo nwo nimdeɛ so banwati bafi wiase bra fiɛ nu, ná nziɛ ye bɛma sɔ bra fiɛ ne osa kye bɛ odi bɛ so a, ye de bɛ nziɛ ye asetena ne ɔte bɔne tra bɛ daa asetena ne. 21 Ofikyɛ sɛ bannwu tenenee atee ne po a, ahaa ɔte paa ma bɛ, tra kyɛ banwu ye bayie, ná afei nziɛ ye bakakyi bɛ nwo bafi ahyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ne anwo ɔ. 22 Bɔ wato bɛ ne, ɔte kyɛbɔ nohorɛ anyandera ne kã ne, kyɛ:
“Kyea fe a, osa kodi,”
yeɛ
“Ebia prako a, osa kɔbo ye asaa bɔ ɔla nu ne.”

Title: 2 PETRO 3
Content:
Awurade walɛ ne nwo bɔhyɛ
1Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛhe te me krataa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. Na bɛ nu yeɛ mékayekaye ɛmɔ metwe ɛmɔ adwene bɔ nu te ne mesie so, 2 kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkaye edwirɛ mɔ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron nemɔ bɛhane ye daa ne, ɔne y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfale yɛ bɔ yɛte ye asomafoɛ so wahã ne.
3 Na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi moa bɛte ɛhe bo, kyɛ, ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu, ngorohoɛfoɛ kodwɔso, na bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si bekoli ngorohoɛ; 4 ná babisa kyɛ, “Ye walɛ ne nwo bɔhyɛ ne, ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ ɔwwale nu ɔ? Ofikyɛ, ofi mmerɛ bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bɛlelale ɔ, kyɛbɔ nikyee biala te fi mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle aleɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔte ɔ!” 5 Bɛboapa bɛyɛ kyɛ bɛnze kyɛ, ofi tetetete ne, né anwuro wɔ berɛ, na aseɛ fi nzue nu yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, ofi nzue nu yeɛ ootimuni berɛ ɔ, na ɔnate Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ so. 6 Na ɔnate so ala yeɛ nzue yili sɛkyele wiase bɔ né ɔwɔ berɛ wɔ b’aberɛ so ne ɔ. 7 Na anwuro ne aseɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ye, ɔnate ye noa dwirɛ komapɛ ne ala so yeɛ otira nu ɔ, na wasiesie ye wama see, na ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne amumuyɛɛfoɛ kyẽa ne.
8 Nakoso aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora fi sɔ dwirɛ he, kyɛ, ɛlɛho te kyɛ afoɛ apee wɔ Awurade nye so, yeɛ afoɛ apee te kyɛ ɛlɛho wɔ ye nye so. 9 Awurade ndwetwe ye gya ase wɔ ye bɔhyɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ bɛdwene kyɛ ɔkyɛ ne. Aboterɛ mmom yeɛ ole ye wɔ yɛ nwo ɔ, ɔmbena kyɛ sona biala mini, na mmom ɔpena kyɛ ebiala ba adwenesakyera nu. 10 Nakoso Awurade kyẽa ne kɔwa kyɛ awueniɛ ba [kɔngɔen] ɔ. Na nu yeɛ anwuro kɔbɔ nu kurudududu serɛserɛ kotu komini. See kɔma ewienu abɔdeɛ mɔ kohuro, na aseɛ ne so nningyein amukoraa kɔyera.
11Na sɛ sɔ yeɛ sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa bɛkɔsɛkye a, nzaade nzikyɛ mmenia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ ɔ? Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtira bra krongron ne nyamesom paa nu, 12wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwondɛ ná ɛmɔpere kyɛ Nyameɛ kyẽa ne kɔwa ndɛ ɔ. Nu yeɛ see kɔtɔ anwuro nu kɔyera ye, na see kɔma ewienu abɔdeɛ mɔ kohuro. 13 Nakoso kyɛbɔ ye bɔhyɛ te ne, yɛ nye la nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ bɔ tenenee te nu ɔ ate.
Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
14 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔnwondɛ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden kyɛ okonwu ɛmɔ wɔ asomdwee nu, bɔ ngekalewa anaa nnɛen biala nne ɛmɔ nwo ɔ. 15 Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu Awurade aboterɛ ne kyɛ ɔte ngoalelɛ, kyɛbɔ y’eliɛma dɔfo Pɔɔlo koso nate nworɛ bɔ bafa bama ye ne aso ɔhyerɛ brɛle ɛmɔ ne. 16 Na ɔkã sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo dwirɛ wɔ ye ngrataa ne amukoraa nu. Nu dwirɛ nemɔ bie ye botelɛ yɛ se; na ɛhe yeɛ mmenia bɔ bɛnze huu bɔ bɛ bo onnya ottindimuni ne, bekyirekyire ye bo bɛkyea ye, kyɛbɔ bɛyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ngaa nemɔ koso ne, maa bɛ bɔbɔ bemini ɔ. 17 Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔse ɛhemɔ dada, yiti ɛ́mɔla ɛmɔ nwo so, ná mmeraatolɛfoɛ mvomsoɛ ne wandwetwe ɛmɔ wangɔ, ná ɛmɔamvi ase bamvi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔatindim ne. 18 Na mmom, ɛmɔhɔ so benyi wɔ y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo adom ne ye nwo nimdeɛ nu. Ye yeɛ animnyam hã ye kekesaala ye ɔne daa daa ɔ. Amen.

Title: 1 YOHANE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Sɔ krataa he botaeɛ titire paa te nyɔ: Bɔ oli moa ɔ, Yohane hyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkenga krataa he kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ ne Ɔwa Yesu Kristo betira abiɛngoɛ. Bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, ɔbɔ mmenia kɔkɔ kyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ si lilɛ sɛkye sɔ abiɛngoɛfalɛ ne.
Né sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ ne kyire kyɛ efiɛ aha ewiase abɔdeɛ mukoraati, yiti abɔdeɛ biala te bɔne. Ye sɔ ne ati, né akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ ne nwa: Nyameɛ Awa Yesu Kristo ngɔhora ngɔkakyi ye nwo kuro sona ngɔwa aseɛ ye aso. Bɛnwa daa ngoa mva anwotelɛ bra anaa ɔdɔ nwo.
Yohane kyirekyire nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo wale wiase ɔɔfale dasaniɛ sue amba. Na osili ye pi kyɛ ebiala bɔ ode Yesu Kristo di na okuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ okuro obiɛngo koso dwirɛ.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-4
Kanea ne awosii 1.5—2.29
Nyameɛ mma ne Abɔnzam mma 3.1-24
Nahorɛ ne mvomsoɛ 4.1-6
Dwumaa bɔ ɔdɔ di ɔ 4.7-21
Gyidie ma ngonim 5.1-21

Title: 1 YOHANE 1
Content:
Ngoa dwirɛ ne
1 Bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ fi ahyɛaseɛ ne, bɔ yate, bɔ yafa yɛ nye yanwu ye, bɔ yanea, ná yafa yɛ sa yahã ye, bɔ ɔfa ngoa dwirɛ ne anwo ne; 2sɔ ngoa ne yele ye nwo ali, na yanwu ye, yɛdi ye nwo adanzeɛ, na daa ngoa bɔ né ɔne Baba ne wɔ berɛ na afei bɛyele ye ali behyirele yɛ ne yeɛ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ye.
3 Bɔ yanwu ye ná yate ne yeɛ yɛ koso yɛbɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ, amaa ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔ ne yɛ atira abiɛngoɛ; na y’abiɛngoɛ he, yɛne Baba ne, ɔne Ɔwa Yesu Kristo yeɛ yatira ɔ. 4 Na yɛ́kyerɛ ɛhe yɛbrɛ ɛmɔ, amaa ɛmɔ anigye ne wali mu.
Nyameɛ te kanea
5 Edwirɛ bɔ yate yafi ye berɛ ná yɛ́bɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɛhe: Nyameɛ te kanea, na awosii kaala nne ye nu. 6 Yiti sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛne ye atira abiɛngoɛ, nakoso yɛnate awosii nu a, né ye de yɛlaka, na yɛmmɔ yɛ bra wɔ nahorɛ nu. 7 Nakoso sɛ yɛnate kanea nu, kyɛbɔ ye koso ɔwɔ kanea nu ne a, né yɛ ne yɛ nwo yɛ nwo yatira abiɛngoɛ, na Ɔwa Yesu Kristo mogya ne te yɛ nwo fi bɔne mukoraa nu.
8 Sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛnyɔ bɔne a, né yɛlakalaka yɛ nwo, na né nahorɛ ne ɔnne yɛ nu. 9 Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ odi nahorɛ ná ɔtengyɛ ne ati, sɛ yɛkã yɛ bɔne yɛkyire ye a, ɔkɔfa kɔhyɛ yɛ ná wate yɛ nwo wafi bɔ ɔndengyɛ mukoraa nwo. 10 Na sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛyyɔle bɔne a, né yama wayɛ ngondomboniɛ, yeɛ ye dwirɛ ne koso ɔtte yɛ nu.

Title: 1 YOHANE 2
Content:
Kristo te yɛ bokafoɛ
1 Me ngwadaa mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ amaa ɛmɔanyɔ bɔne. Nakoso sɛ ebie yɔ bɔne a, yɛle kamafoɛ wɔ Baba ne nyunu bɔ ye ole teneneeniɛ Yesu Kristo. 2 Ɔte yɛ bɔne nwo mbata; nna yɛ ngome yɛ deɛ nwo; na mmom ɔte wiase amukoraa koso bɔne nwo mbata. 3 Sɛ yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so a, yeɛ okyire kyɛ yɛse ye ɔ. 4 Na sona bɔ ɔkã kyɛ, “Mese ye”, nakoso onni ye ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔte ngondomboniɛ, na nahorɛ nne ye nu. 5 Nakoso ebiala bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so ne yeɛ Nyameɛ dɔ ne di mu wɔ ye nu amba ɔ. Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛ ne ye atira abiɛngoɛ ɔ. 6 Na ebiala bɔ ɔnwa ɔne Nyameɛ atira abiɛngoɛ nen, odi kyɛ ye koso ɔbɔ ye bra kyɛbɔ Kristo bɔle ye deɛ ne.
Ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ
7 Aliɛmaa mɔ, nna ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ, na mmom ahyɛdeɛ daa ne ala bɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne ɛmɔnyane ye ne yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. Na sɔ ahyɛdeɛ daa ne ole edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate fite ahyɛaseɛ ne. 8 Nakoso ɛnea a, ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɔte nahorɛ wɔ ye nu ne ɛmɔ nu; ofikyɛ awosii ne gu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ, na nahorɛ kanea ne ata dada. 9 Na ebiala bɔ ɔkã kyɛ ɔwɔ kanea ne anu, nakoso ɔpɔ oliɛma ne, ɔtɛte awosii nu. 10 Sona bɔ okuro oliɛma dwirɛ ne te kanea ne anu, na nikye fee nne ye nu bɔ ɔto ebie sundidua ɔ. 11 Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔpɔ oliɛma ne te awosii nu, ɔnate awosii nu, na ɔnze nekaa bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ awosii ne ama ye nye asi.
12Me ngwadaa mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnate Kristo dumaa ti bafa ɛmɔ bɔne bahyɛ ɛmɔ. 13 Ngya mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse bɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne né ɔwɔ berɛ ne. Mmerandeɛ mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔali bɔnefoɛ ne so ngonim. Ngwadaa mɔ koso, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse Baba ne. 14 Ngya mɔ, mahyerɛ he mabrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse bɔ né ɔwɔ berɛ ahyɛaseɛ ne. Mmerandeɛ mɔ koso mahyerɛ he mabrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔatindim, Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne te ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔali bɔnefoɛ ne so ngonim.
15 Nnɛma ɛmɔkuro ewiase anaa nu nningyein dwirɛ. Na sɛ ebie kuro ewiase dwirɛ a, né Baba ne dɔ nne ye nu. 16 Ofikyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wiase amukoraa: anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ, anyeboroborolɛ, asetena nu anwohoahoa offi Baba ne berɛ, na mmom ofi wiase. 17 Ewiase ne nu akɔnnɔ gu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ, nakoso sona bɔ ɔyɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ne te ase afebɔɔ.
Kristo pɔfoɛ ne nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ
18 Me mma mɔ, ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne apingye. Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔate ye daa kyɛ antikristo ne ɔ́ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kekesaala ye antikristo pee bawa ɔ; na ɛhe maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ ayieleɛ ne ala ɛne. 19 Befi yɛ nu yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ, nakoso né bɛmmɔ yɛ fekue ne bie. Ofikyɛ sɛ bɛbɔ yɛ fekue ne bie a, ahaa bɛ ne yɛ hɔle so tenane. Na bafi yɛ nu maa wala ali kyɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛmmɔ yɛ fekue ne bie. 20 Nakoso ɛmɔ de, Krongronniɛ ne wapopa ɛmɔ ngoo, yiti ɛmɔse nikyee biala. 21 Nna kyɛ ɛmɔnze nahorɛ ne ti yeɛ mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɛmɔse, na afei ɛmɔsa bɛse kyɛ ngondombo biala mvi nahorɛ nu mma.
22 Nwa yeɛ ɔte ngondomboniɛ ɔ? Sona bɔ onne Yesu ndo nu kyɛ ye ole Kristo ne. Sɔ sona ne te antikristo, ofikyɛ onne Baba ne ɔne Baa ne ndo nu. 23 Sona biala bɔ onne Baa ne ndo nu ne, onne Baba ne koso ndo nu, nakoso ebiala bɔ ode Baa ne to nu ne, ode Baba ne koso to nu. 24 Yiti ɛ́mɔma edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate bafi ahyɛaseɛ ne ɔtena ɛmɔ nu. Na sɛ bɔ ɛmɔate bafi ahyɛaseɛ ne tena ɛmɔ nu a, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔtena Baa ne ne Baba ne nu daa. 25Na bɔ wafa wahyɛ yɛ bɔ ole daa ngoa.
26Bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye fa bɛ bɔ bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ ne nwo. 27 Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ngoo bɔ wafa wapopa ɛmɔ ne, ɔte ɛmɔ nu, yiti onhia kyɛ ebie kohyirehyire ɛmɔ ɔ. Na sɔ ngoopalɛ ne ala kyirekyire ɛmɔ nikyee biala, ɔkã nahorɛ, ɔmbɛ ngondombo, na kyɛbɔ wahyirehyire ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔli so.
28 Na afei me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛtena ye nu, amaa sɛ ye walɛ ne dwu ná ɔye ye nwo ali a, yahora yasi y’ahone, na yamvɛre wɔ ye nyunu. 29 Na sɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɔte teneneeniɛ a, nzaade ɛmɔse kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne te Nyameɛ awa.

Title: 1 YOHANE 3
Content:
Nyameɛ mma
1 Ɛ́mɔnea ɔdɔ sonongo bɔ Baba ne wafa walo yɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔmaa bɛfrɛ yɛ Nyameɛ mma ɔ, na yɛte ye mma koso amba. Na ɔnate ɛhe ati ewiase nze yɛ, ofikyɛ onnwuni ye. 2 Aliɛmaa mɔ, kekesaala ye yɛte Nyameɛ mma, na kyɛbɔ kyẽa bie yɛkosi yɛkɔyɛ ne de, onnya ɔllale ali. Nakoso yɛse kyɛ sɛ ɔye ye nwo ali a, yɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ye ala, ofikyɛ yɛkonwu ye kyɛbɔ ɔte ɔ. 3 Na ebiala bɔ ole sɔ anyelasoɛ ne wɔ Kristo nu ne, ɔte ye nwo kyɛbɔ Kristo nwo te ne.
4 Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔto mmeraa, ofikyɛ bɔne te mmeraatolɛ. 5 Ɛmɔse kyɛ ɔwale kyɛ ɔbaasoa yɛ bɔne kɔ; na ye de bɔne nne ye nwo. 6 Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔte ye nu ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, onnwuni ye, anaa ɔnze ye.
7Me ngwadaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma ebiala lakalaka ɛmɔ. Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, ɔte tenenee kyɛbɔ Kristo te tenenee ne. 8Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne te abɔnzam sona, ofikyɛ ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne yeɛ abɔnzam yɔ bɔne ɔ. Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne ɔɔlale ye nwo ali kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye abɔnzam nnwumaa. 9 Ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ ye sue ne te ye nu, na ɔngora nyɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ wawo ye ɔ. 10Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla abɔnzam ne Nyameɛ mma b’afia ɔ: ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔndengyɛ anaa bɔ onguro oliɛma dwirɛ ne, ɔtte Nyameɛ awa.
Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ
11 Edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate fi ahyɛaseɛ ne ɛhe: kyɛ yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ. 12 Nnɛmɔyɛ kyɛ Kein bɔ ɔte abɔnzam sona, bɔ ohuni oliɛma ne. Na nzu ati yeɛ ohuni oliɛma ne ɔ? Ofikyɛ né ye yɔleɛ ndengyɛ, nakoso oliɛma ne deɛ de, né ɔtengyɛ. 13 Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ewiase pɔ ɛmɔ a, nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa. 14 Yɛse kyɛ yɛfi ewue nu yawa ngoa nu, ofikyɛ yɛkuro aliɛmaa nemɔ dwirɛ. Na bɔ onguro oliɛma dwirɛ ne tɛte ewue nu. 15 Ebiala bɔ ɔpɔ oliɛma ne te wudiniɛ, na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse ne, daa ngoa ndena wudiniɛ biala nu. 16 Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ ɔdɔ si te ɔ: Kristo fale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ, na yɛ koso odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛ ngoa yɛto berɛ yɛma aliɛmaa nemɔ. 17 Nakoso sɛ ebie le wiase anwonyadeɛ, ná sɛ onwu kyɛ oliɛma nwo kyere ye, ná wannwu ye anwumvoin a, né Nyameɛ dɔ ne te ye nu sɛ? 18 Me ngwadaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma yɛfa yɛ noa mbaen anaa temverema fɛɛ yɛkuro mmenia dwirɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ ye wɔ yɔleɛ nu ne nahorɛ nu.
Yɛ wora wura Nyameɛ nu
19Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu ye kyɛ nahorɛ ne wɔ yɛ nu ɔ, amaa y’ahone atɔ yɛ kunu wɔ ye nyunu: 20sɛ yɛ tiboa bua yɛ foɛ a, Nyameɛ te piri tra yɛ tiboa, na ɔse nikyee biala. 21 Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ yɛ tiboa mmua yɛ foɛ a, ye de yɛsi y’ahone yɛkɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. 22 Na nikyee biala bɔ yɛbisa ne, ɔfa ma yɛ, ofikyɛ yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so, na yɛyɔ bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. 23 Na ye ahyɛdeɛ ne kyire kyɛ yɛle ɔwa Yesu Kristo dumaa ne yɛli, ná yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ kyɛbɔ wafa ahyɛdeɛ wama yɛ ne. 24 Na ebiala bɔ odi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔte ye nu, na ye koso ɔte ye nu. Na bɔ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ ɔte yɛ nu ole Sunzum ne bɔ wafa wama yɛ ne.

Title: 1 YOHANE 4
Content:
Nahorɛ Sunzum ne ngondombo sunzum
1 Aliɛmaa mɔ, nna sunzum biala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔde ye bedi ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔso sunzum nemɔ bɛnea sɛ aso bɛte Nyameɛ deɛ anaa; ofikyɛ ngondombo ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ pee badwɔso wɔ wiase. 2Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu Nyameɛ Sunzum ɔ: Sunzum biala bɔ ode to nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu ne te Nyameɛ deɛ. 3 Nakoso sunzum biala bɔ onne ndo nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu ne, ɔtte Nyameɛ deɛ, na mmom ɔte antikristo bɔ ɛmɔate kyɛ ɔba ná wanya wawa wiase ne deɛ.
4Me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔ de ɛmɔte Nyameɛ deɛ na ɛmɔali bɛ so ngonim; ofikyɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔte piri tra bɔ ɔwɔ wiase ne. 5 Nakoso bɛ de bɛte wiase deɛ, yiti ewiase dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã ɔ, na ewiase koso tie bɛ dwirɛ. 6 Yɛ de, yɛte Nyameɛ deɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɔse Nyameɛ ne, otie yɛ dwirɛ; nakoso bɔ ɔtte Nyameɛ deɛ ne de ondie yɛ dwirɛ. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu nahorɛ Sunzum ne ngondombo sunzum ɔ.
Nyameɛ sue te ɔdɔ
7 Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔma yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ɔdɔ fi Nyameɛ berɛ, na ebiala bɔ ole ɔdɔ ne te Nyameɛ awa, na ɔse Nyameɛ. 8Nakoso ebiala bɔ olle ɔdɔ ne, ɔnze Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te ɔdɔ. 9 Kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ yele ye dɔ ne ali wɔ yɛ nu ɛhe: Nyameɛ somane Ɔwa komapɛ twe ne maa ɔwale wiase, amaa ɔnate ye so yanya ngoa. 10 Bɔ okyire ɔdɔ ɛhe: nna kyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛhurole Nyameɛ dwirɛ ɔ, na mmom ye yeɛ ohurole yɛ dwirɛ ná ɔsomane Ɔwa ne maa ɔɔyɛle yɛ bɔne nwo mbata ɔ. 11Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ sɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ kuro yɛ dwirɛ a, ye de odi kyɛ yɛ koso yɛkurokuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ. 12 Ebiala nye nnwuni Nyameɛ le, nakoso sɛ yɛkurokuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ a, Nyameɛ tena yɛ nu, na ye dɔ ne di mu bɔkɔɔ wɔ yɛ nu. 13 Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛte ye nu ná ye koso ɔte yɛ nu ɔ: ye ole kyɛ wafa ye bɔbɔ ye Sunzum ne wama yɛ. 14 Yanwu ye, na yɛdi adanzeɛ kyɛ Baba ne somane Baa ne maa ɔɔyɛle wiase Ngoadefoɛ. 15Na ebiala bɔ ɔpakye nu kã kyɛ Yesu ole Nyameɛ Awa nen, Nyameɛ te ye nu, na ye koso ɔte Nyameɛ nu. 16Yanwu yɛ nwo dɔ bɔ Nyameɛ le ye ne, yeɛ yɛde yɛdi koso. Nyameɛ te ɔdɔ, na ebiala bɔ ole ɔdɔ ne te Nyameɛ nu, na Nyameɛ koso te ye nu.
17 Ɛhe anu yeɛ ɔdɔ di mu wɔ yɛ nu ɔ, amaa yanya anyelasoɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne; ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ ɔte ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛte wɔ wiase wa ɔ. 18 Esuronyi nne ɔdɔ nu, na mmom ɔdɔ bɔ odi mu ne, otutu esuronyi bo, ofikyɛ esuronyi ne asohwenɛ nwo ahunundetelɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, na ebiala bɔ osuro ne, ye ɔdɔ nni mu. 19 Yɛkuro ye dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ olili moa hurole yɛ dwirɛ ɔ. 20 Na sɛ ebie kã kyɛ “Mekuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ”, nakoso ɔpɔ oliɛma a, né ɔte ngondomboniɛ, ofikyɛ sɛ ebie nguro oliɛma bɔ onwu ye ne dwirɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná wahora wahuro Nyameɛ bɔ onnwu ye ne dwirɛ? 21Na ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wama yɛ ɛhe: ebiala bɔ okuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ okuro oliɛma koso dwirɛ.

Title: 1 YOHANE 5
Content:
Gyidie ma ngonim
1 Ebiala bɔ ode di kyɛ Yesu ole Kristo ne te Nyameɛ awa. Na ebiala bɔ okuro Baba ne dwirɛ ne, okuro Baa ne koso dwirɛ. 2Na sɛ yɛkuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ná yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so a, ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛkuro Nyameɛ mma dwirɛ ɔ. 3 Sɛ yɛdi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so a yeɛ okyire kyɛ yɛkuro ye dwirɛ ɔ, na ye ahyɛdeɛ ne aso lilɛ koso nyɛ se. 4 Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, odi wiase so ngonim, na yɛ gyidie yeɛ ole ngonim bɔ yɛfa yɛdi wiase so ne. 5Nwa yeɛ odi wiase so ngonim ɔ? Ye ole sona bɔ ode di kyɛ Yesu ole Nyameɛ Awa ne ɔ.
Yesu nwo adanzeɛ
6Yesu Kristo yeɛ ole bɔ bafa nzue ne mogya bali ye walɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ ne. Nna nzue ngome, na mmom nzue ne mogya. Na Sunzum ne yeɛ odi adanzeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne ole nahorɛ ne. 7 Adanzefoɛ nza yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ: 8Sunzum ne, nzue ne, yeɛ mogya ne, na bɛ mmɛsa b’adanzeɛ ne te ko. 9 Na sɛ yɛde kuro sona adanzeɛ yɛto nu a, nzaade Nyameɛ adanzeɛ deɛ ne di mu tra so. Ofikyɛ ɛhe te Nyameɛ adanzeɛ bɔ wali wafa Ɔwa ne nwo ɔ. 10 Yiti ebiala bɔ ode Nyameɛ Awa ne di ne, ole sɔ adanzeɛ ne wɔ ye ahone nu. Nakoso ebiala bɔ onne Nyameɛ nni ne, ɔma Nyameɛ yɛ ngondomboniɛ, ofikyɛ onne adanzeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ wali wafa Ɔwa ne nwo nni. 11 Adanzeɛ ne ɛhe: Nyameɛ ama yɛ daa ngoa, na sɔ ngoa ne wɔ Ɔwa ne anu. 12 Yiti ebiala bɔ ode Baa ne di ne ole ngoa, nakoso bɔ onne Baa ne nni ne de, olle ngoa.
Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ
13 Mekyerɛ ɛhemɔ mebrɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔde Nyameɛ Awa ne dumaa bedi ne, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛ ɛmɔle daa ngoa, na ɛmɔahɔ so bale Nyameɛ Awa ne dumaa bali. 14 Na anyelasoɛ bɔ yɛle wɔ ye nu ne ole kyɛ, sɛ yɛbisa nikyee biala kyɛbɔ ye pɛ te a, otie yɛ. 15Na sɛ yɛse kyɛ bɔ yɛbisa biala otie yɛ de a, nzaade yɛse kyɛ yɛ sa ahã nningyein bɔ yɛbisa ye ne dada. 16 Sɛ ebie nwu oliɛma kyɛ ɔyɔ bɔne bɔ ɔmva ye ngɔ ewue nu a, maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ɔma ye, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye mbaeɛ ne aso kɔma ye ngoa. Mekyire bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔne bɔ ɔmva bɛ ngɔ ewue nu ɔ. Nakoso bɔne bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu ɔ, na ɛhe de mengyire kyɛ ɔbɔ ye nwo mbaeɛ. 17Bɔ ɔndengyɛ biala te bɔne, nakoso nna ye mukoraa yeɛ ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu ɔ.
18 Yɛse kyɛ ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne; na mmom bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnea ye nwo so, na bɔnefoɛ ne mva ye sa nga ye. 19 Yɛse kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ deɛ, yeɛ ewiase amukoraa wura bɔnefoɛ ne bo. 20 Yɛsa yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne awa, na wabukye y’adwene nu maa yanwu nahorɛniɛ ne. Yɛne Ɔwa Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte nahorɛniɛ ne atira abiɛngoɛ, na ye yeɛ ɔte nahorɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔne daa ngoa ne ɔ. 21 Me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi mmosoen nwo.

Title: 2 YOHANE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Yohane krataa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne kyire kyɛ bɔ ɔhyerɛle ne te asɔre panyi, na ɔɔfa mane braa animnyamniɛ bie ne ye mma. Akristofoɛ biemɔ kyire kyɛ ‘braa ne ne ye mma’ bo kyire asɔre bie ne nu mmenia.
Edwirɛ titire bɔ ɔwɔ krataa ye anu ɛhe: ɔnwa behurohuro bɛ nwo dwirɛ. Afei osa bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ bɛnea bɛ nwo yé wɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ ne bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1-3
Ɔdɔ di mu 4-6
Ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ 7-11
Ayieleɛ 12-13

Title: 2 YOHANE 1
Content:
1 Krataa he fi me bɔ nde panyi berɛ. Mefa mebrɛ braa bɔ baneanea nu baye ye ne ɔne ye mma. Mekuro bɛ dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, na nna me ngome, na mmom mmenia mukoraa bɔ banwu nahorɛ ne wora bekuro bɛ dwirɛ, 2ɔnate nahorɛ ne bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ná ɔne yɛ kɔtena afebɔɔ ne ati. 3Baba Nyameɛ ne Ɔwa Awurade Yesu Kristo bɛlo yɛ ná bɛ́ma yɛ asomdwee, ná bénwu yɛ anwumvoin wɔ nahorɛ ne ɔdɔ nu.
Nahorɛ ne ɔdɔ
4Ɔyɛle me fɛ paa, kyɛ nwuni kyɛ wɔ mma nemɔ bie nate nahorɛ ne anu kyɛbɔ Baba ne hyɛle yɛ ne ala. 5 Yiti afei, bra panyi, mesrɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔma yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ; nna kyɛ mmeraa foforɛ yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom mmeraa bɔ yɛnyane ye fili ahyɛaseɛ ne ala ɔ. 6 Na ɔdɔ ole kyɛ yɛkoli ye ahyɛdeɛ ne aso ɔ’. Na ahyɛdeɛ ne, kyɛbɔ yate fi ahyɛaseɛ ne ole kyɛ yɛtena ɔdɔ nu. 7 Ofikyɛ nnakannakafoɛ pee bawa wiase, na bɛ yeɛ benne bɛndo nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu waayɛ kuro sona ɔ. Na sona biala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ɔte ngondomboniɛ ne antikristo. 8Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, amaa bɔ ɛmɔafɛ banya ye ne wamvi ɛmɔ sa, na mmom ɛmɔanya ye nwo akatuaa mukoraa. 9Sona biala bɔ onni Kristo ngyerɛkyerɛ so ná mmom ɔfa bie bata ye nwo ne, ɔnze Nyameɛ. Nakoso sona biala bɔ odi Kristo ngyerɛkyerɛ so ne, ɔse Baba ne ne Baa ne. 10Sɛ ebiala ba ɛmɔ berɛ nna ottira sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ye a, nnɛma ɛmɔsikye ye ɛmɔ awuro anaa nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ye akwaaba. 11Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ ye akwaaba ne, ɔyɔ ye yɔleɛ tɛɛ ne bie.
Ayieleɛ
12 Edwirɛ pee wɔ berɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ, nakoso mengɔfa krataa ne pɛn mengɔhyerɛ mengɔbrɛ ɛmɔ; na mmom mepena kyɛ mebafua ɛmɔ nwo ná manwu ɛmɔ nyunu maa yali ngɔmɔ, amaa y’anigye ali mu. 13 Eliɛmaa brasua bɔ baneanea nu baye ye ne, ye mma mɔ bébisa ɛmɔ ahye.

Title: 3 YOHANE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Biapanyi Yohane yeɛ ɔhyerɛle krataa ye ɔ, na ɔɔfa mane asɔre panyi bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Gayɔso. Sona bɔ ɔhyerɛle krataa ye kamvo Gayɔso, ɔnate mmokalɛ bɔ ɔfa bokale Akristofoɛ ngaa ne ati, na afei ɔbɔle ye kɔkɔ fa biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Diotrefe nwo.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1-4
Yohane kamvo Gayɔso 5-8
Yohane twi Diotrefe nyunu 9-10
Yohane kamvo Demetrio 11-12
Ayieleɛ 13-15

Title: 3 YOHANE 1
Content:
1 Krataa ye fi me bɔ nde panyi berɛ. Mefa mebrɛ Gayɔso bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu ɔ. 2Aliɛmaa, mebɔ mbaeɛ mema wɔ kyɛ nikyee biala hɔ so yé ma wɔ, ná enya anwoserɛ anwoɔnaen nu, kyɛbɔ nningyein kɔ so yé ma wɔ kra ne. 3 Ofikyɛ nyane anigye pee mmerɛ bɔ aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛwale belili wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nwo adanzeɛ, kyɛbɔ amba ɛfa nahorɛlilɛ bɔ wɔ bra ne. 4Nikyee biala mma me anigye bɔ ɔtra so te kyɛ ngɔte kyɛ me mma mɔ nate nahorɛ ne anu ɔ.
Gayɔso kamvolɛ
5 Aliɛmaa, nikyee biala bɔ ɛyɔ ma aliɛmaa nemɔ ne, yeɛ afei ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ po ne, ɛyɔ ye nahorɛ nu. 6Bɛ yeɛ bali wɔ dɔ ne nwo adanzeɛ bahyire asɔre ne ɔ. Na ɔte paa kyɛ ekogua bɛ ate kama bɔ ɔfata Nyameɛ solɛ ɔ. 7 Ofikyɛ ɔnate ye ti yeɛ besili nu bɛhɔle ɔ, na banne hwee bamvi Amaenmaensofoɛ berɛ. 8Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛboka sɔ mmenia nemɔ, amaa yɛ ne bɛ yayɛ aliɛmaa adwumayɔlɛfoɛ wɔ nahorɛ ne anu.
Diotrefe ne Demetrio
9Mahyerɛ krataa maama asɔre ne, nakoso Diotrefe bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔyɛ ye nwo panyi tra ebiala ne, onne yɛ ndo nu. 10 Yiti sɛ meba a, ngɔfa bɔ ɔyɛ ne ngɔto dwaa: odi nzekure yeayea fa yɛ nwo. Nna ɛhe angome, afei koso onzikye aliɛmaa mɔ wɔ ye awuro. Asa koso osi bɛ bɔ bekuro kyɛ bede aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛto nu ne ate, na ɔfoa bɛ fi asɔre ne anu. 11 Aliɛmaa, nnɛdi tɛɛ si na mmom di paa si. Sona biala bɔ ɔyɔ paa ne te Nyameɛ deɛ, na sona bɔ ɔyɔ tɛɛ ne, onnwuni Nyameɛ. 12 Mmenia mukoraa di Demetrio nwo adanzeɛ paa, yeɛ ye yɔleɛ koso di ye nwo adanzeɛ paa. Yɛ koso yɛdi ye nwo adanzeɛ, na ɛmɔse kyɛ y’adanzeɛ ne te nahorɛ.
Ayieleɛ
13Edwirɛ pee wɔ berɛ bɔ ahaa ɔsɛ kyɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ wɔ ɔ, nakoso menguro kyɛ mefa krataa ne pɛn mekyerɛ ɔ; 14na mmom ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngonwu wɔ dɔ, ná manwu wɔ nyunu ná yali ngɔmɔ. 15 Nyameɛ ma wɔ asomdwee. Wɔ mmango mɔ bebisa wɔ ahye. Bisa yɛ mmango mɔ ahye ma yɛ ngoko ngoko.

Title: YUDA BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Yuda hyerɛle ye krataa he ɔɔbɔle agyidifoɛ kɔkɔ fale akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ bɔ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ agyidifoɛ nwo. Sɔ krataa he anu dwirɛ soma Petro krataa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne. Yuda hyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkenga krataa he ne kyɛ ogyina pindinn wɔ gyidie bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye mmenia ne anu.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1-2
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ suban, bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne b’ayieleɛ 3-16
Gyidie nwo foɛtulɛ 17-23
Saleɛ mbaeɛ 24-25

Title: YUDA 1
Content:
Ahyebisalɛ
1 Yuda bɔ nde Yesu Kristo akoaa ne Yakobo aliɛma, mefa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ bafrɛ bɛ, bɔ bɛla Baba Nyameɛ ahone nwo, bɔ wafa bɛ wasie wɔ Yesu Kristo nu ɔ. 2Mesrɛ kyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ, asomdwee ne ɔdɔ ɔsone pee ma ɛmɔ.
Gyina ma gyidie ne
3Aliɛmaa mɔ, mabɔ mmɔden amukoraa kyɛ mekyerɛ ngoalelɛ bɔ yɛ mukoraa yanya ye ne nwo dwirɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ, na ye nwo ahia kyɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ná metu ɛmɔ foɛ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔpere bégyina pindinn bɛ́ma gyidie bɔ bafa bama anwoteefoɛ pɛnko ne. 4 Ofikyɛ mmenia biemɔ bawuawua bɛ nwo baawura ɛmɔ nu, mmenia bɔ ofi tetetete bahyerɛ bɛ nwo dwirɛ bato berɛ bama ndɛenbualɛ he, amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɔ bafa yɛ Nyameɛ adom ne bakakyi ahowibra, ná bɛpo Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte yɛ Meneɛ komapɛ ne ɔ.
Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ
5 Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔse ɛhemɔ dada de, nakoso mepena kyɛ mebɔ ɛmɔ so, kyɛ Awurade bɔ olele maen ne fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, nziɛ ye, ohuhuni bɛ bɔ banne banni ne. 6Na abɔfo mɔ bɔ bannea bɛ dibea so yé, ná mmom bɛyakyili bɛ bɔbɔ b’atenaleɛ berɛ ne, wabɔ bɛ afebɔɔ panwu wafa bɛ wasie awosii kabii nu, na ɔfa nwondɛ kyẽa piri ndɛenbualɛ ne. 7 Na sɔ ala yeɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne nguro bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia, bɔ bɛyɛle kyɛ ɛhemɔ, bɔ bɛlɔle asukɔ wɔ adwamanbɔlɛ nu, ná bɛbɔle nnaa nu musue ne, bafa bɛ bayɛ see afebɔɔ nwo nhwɛsoɛ bato berɛ ɔ.
8Na sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ laleɛhyenɛfoɛ nemɔ begua bɛ nwonaen nwo fiɛ ɔ. Bebu tumililɛ animtia, na bɛkekã dwirɛ betia animnyamfoɛ nemɔ. 9 Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ abɔfo panyi Mikayɛl ne abɔnzam bɛpereperele Mose fuin nwo ne, Mikayɛl anzi ye hue wanga dwirɛ wandia ye wammua ye ndɛen, na mmom ɔhane kyɛ, “Awurade hwi wɔ nyunu!” 10Nakoso mmenia hemɔ de, bɛkekã dwirɛ tɛɛ betia nikyee biala bɔ bɛnde ye bo ɔ; na nikyee bɔ befi bɛ sona sue nu bɛse, kyɛ ngaka bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu ne, ye ala yeɛ ogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ. 11 Bɛ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ batu Kein agyirɛ ne bie, na adifuu ti bafa bɛ nwo baawura Balaam nnakannaka dwirɛ ne anu, na bekowuwu wɔ Kora ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne anu. 12Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛte ngekalewa wɔ ɛmɔ ɔdɔ adidie bo, bɛne ɛmɔ didi a, bɛte mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ bɛ ngome bɛ ko yeɛ ohia bɛ ɔ, bɛte munungum bɔ nzue nne nu bɔ mvrama fa ye kyinikyini ɔ; mmakaa bɔ odwu bɛ sulɛ a benzu mma ɔ, bawu pɛen nyɔ, bɔ bɛ bo atutu ɔ, 13bɛte ɛpo asorɔkye bɔ obu fa so, bɔ opu bɛ bɔbɔ b’animguaseɛ gua ɔ, nzramaa mɔ bɔ bekyinikyini bɔ basiesie awosii kabii bama bɛ ɔ.
14 Na sɔ mmenia nemɔ yeɛ Henɔke, bɔ ɔte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nzoo fi Adam so ne, ɔhyɛle ngɔm fale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Tie, Awurade ne ye anwoteefoɛ apee apee bɛ́ba; 15kyɛ ɔbaabua ebiala ndɛen, na okobua amumuyɛɛfoɛ amukoraa foɛ wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa nwo, ɔne edwirɛ tɛɛ amukoraa bɔ bɔnefoɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bakekã batia ye ɔ nwo.” 16Ɛhemɔ te mmenia bɔ bɛ kunu ndwo, somoɛbɔlɛfoɛ, bedi bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si, bɛfa bɛ noa bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo, na adifuu ti bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ mmenia.
Gyidie nwo foɛtulɛ
17Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔkaye edwirɛ bɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo asomafoɛ mɔ bahã bato berɛ ne. 18 Bɛhã behyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ngorohoɛfoɛ kodwɔso, na bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si.” 19Bɛ yeɛ bɛfa mbakyembakyemuɛ bɛba ɔ, Sunzum ne ɔnne bɛ nu, na bɛte mmenia bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen si ɔ. 20Nakoso ɛmɔ de, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔhɔ so benyi wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie krongron paa ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron nu; 21Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛtena Nyameɛ ɔdɔ nu, ná ɛ́mɔnwondɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo anwumvoinnwunɛ ne bɛhɔ daa ngoa nu. 22Bɛ bɔ b’adwene yɛ bɛ naa ne, ɛ́mɔnwu bɛ anwumvoin; 23 ebiemɔ koso, ɛ́mɔhwe bɛ béfi see nu bele bɛ ngoa; ebiemɔ koso, ɛ́mɔfa anwowosolɛ benwu bɛ anwumvoin, nakoso ɛmɔhyi ndaadeɛ po bɔ bɛ nwonaen ayɛ ngekalewa wɔ nu ne.
Ayieleɛ
24Na ye bɔ ɔkora sɔ ɛmɔ nu ma ɛmɔmvi ase, ná ɔfa ɛmɔ gyina ye animnyam ne nyunu bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ɛmɔ nwo, wɔ anigye nu ne, 25Nyameɛ komapɛ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so ɔte yɛ Ngoadefoɛ ne, animnyam, ahennie, anwoserɛ ne tumi ɔyɛ ye deɛ daa, kekesaala ne afebɔɔ. Amen.

Title: NYEKYIRE BƆ OLI MOA
Content:
BƆ OLI MOA
Yohane Nyekyire ne, ɔhyerɛle ye mmerɛ bɔ ɔnate Akristofoɛ gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu kyɛ ɔte Awurade ti né bɛtane bɛ nye ɔ. Yohane botaeɛ ole kyɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛkɔkenga sɔ nwomaa he ne konya anyelasoɛ, na wahyɛ bɛ nguraen, amaa bahɔ so bali nahorɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ ne ndaneanyeɛ ɔ.
Nyekyire ahoroɔ pee nwo dwirɛ wɔ nwomaa he anu. Na ɔte edwirɛ bɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu Akristofoɛ ngome yeɛ bɛtele ye bo ɔ. Na bɛ bɔ né bɛnne Akristofoɛ kure ne anu de, ɔyɛle mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ mane bɛ.
Yohane si ye botaeɛ ne aso pee wɔ nyekyire ahoroɔ nu. Botaeɛ bɔ odi mu paa ne da adi kyɛ, ɔnate Kristo bɔ ɔte Awurade ne aso Nyameɛ koli ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa ne abɔnzam so ngonim bɔkɔɔ wɔ ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne. Na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ ne kɔyɛ saleɛ koyirayira ye mmenia bɔ bedi nahorɛ wɔ ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne.
Nu Dwirɛ
Bɔ oli moa 1.1-8
Nyekyire bɔ oli moa, ɔne asɔre nzoo ne ngraa 1.9—3.22
Nwomaa bɔ ole nzɔanoɛ nzoo ne 4.1—8.1
Totorobɛndo nzoo ne 8.2—11.19
Sasrabɔnzam ne ne ngaka nyɔ ne 12.1—13.18
Nyekyire ahoroɔ nemɔ 14.1—15.8
Nyameɛ ɛyaafɛlɛ kulie nzoo ne 16.1-21
Babilɔn, kaka ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ngondomboniɛ ne ne abɔnzam ali ngoguo 17.1—20.10
Ayieleɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne 20.11-15
Nyameɛso foforɛ ne, aseɛ foforɛ ne, ɔne Yerusalem foforɛ ne 21.1—22.5
Ayieleɛ 22.6-21

Title: NYEKYIRE 1
Content:
1Ɛhe te Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa mane ye kyɛ ɔla ye ali hyire ye ngoaa mɔ ma benwu edwirɛ mɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛba nu ndɛndɛ ɔ; na ɔsomane ye abɔfo maa ɔɔye hyirele ye akoaa Yohane, 2bɔ odi Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne Yesu Kristo adanzeɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ, ɔne bɔ onwuni ye ne amukoraa nwo adanzeɛ ɔ. 3 Na ebiala bɔ ɔkenga nyekyire ne kyire, ɔne bɛ bɔ betie, ná betira bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu ne anu ne, ɔte saleɛ ma bɛ; ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne apingye.
Ahyebisalɛ
4 Yohane yeɛ mefa mebrɛ asɔre nzoo bɔ bɛwɔ Asia ne ɔ: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ dada ne, bɔ ɔbaawa ne, ɔne bɔ ofi Sunzum nzoo bɔ bɛwɔ ye ahennie bia ne anyunu ne, 5 ɔne bɔ ofi Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte danzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ ne, awufoɛ nu bamuɛbaa ne aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɛ hene ne berɛ ne, ɔbra ɛmɔ so. Ye bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ, ná wafa ye mogya wanwunzi yɛ nwo wafi yɛ bɔne nu, 6 ná wayɛ yɛ ahennie maen ne asɔfo wama ye Baba Nyameɛ ne, animnyam ne tumi ɔyɛ ye deɛ daa daa, Amen.
7 Ɛmɔnea! Ɔnate munungum nu ɔ́ba,
anyeɛ biala konwu ye,
yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔle ye pealɛɛ ne po bekonwu ye;
na ɔnate ye ti aseɛ so mmusua kure amukoraa bɛkɔbɔ awuye.
Na sɔ ala yeɛ okosi ɔ. Amen.
8 Awurade nwa Nyameɛ nwa, “Me ole Alfa ne Omega ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ dada ne, bɔ ɔbaawa ne, nikyee biala so Tuminiɛ ne.”
Yohane nwu Kristo wɔ ye animnyam nu
9Me, Yohane, bɔ nde ɛmɔ aliɛma ne ɛmɔ abiɛngoɛ wɔ Yesu Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ ne ahennie ne animia nu ɔ, ɔnate Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne Yesu Kristo adanzeɛ ne ati, né nwɔ Supɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Patemo so. 10Né nwɔ Sunzum nu wɔ Awurade kyẽa ne, na ndele komviɛ piri bie wɔ me si dɔ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ totorobɛndo ɔ kyɛ, 11“[Me ole Alfa ne Omega ne, ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ ne.] Kyerɛ bɔ enwu ye ne gua nwomaa nu, ná fa kɔma asɔre nzoo nemɔ, fa kɔ Ɛfeso, Simina, Pɛgamɔm, Tiatira, Sadise, Filadɛɛfia ne Laodikea.”
12Na ngakyili me nwo kyɛ menea komviɛ bɔ odwudwo kyire me ne, na mbɛle me nye ne, nwuni esikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nzoo; 13 na kanea bakaa nemɔ b’afia ne, nwuni ebie bɔ ɔte kyɛ Sona Awa ne, bɔ owura ataadeɛ tendenn, bɔ wafa sikaa kɔkorɛ abɔsoɛ wabɔ ye afia ɔ. 14 Ye ti ne ye nwiaa te fufue kyɛ gyese, hyɛnn kyɛ asukɔtwea; na ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ; 15 ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo nyemenenyemene ɔ, kyɛ bɔ bafa see bapɔ ye nwo ɔ, na ye komvi te kyɛ asue pee bɔ bɛsẽ wuruwuru ɔ. 16 Né otira nzramaa nzoo wɔ ye sa famaa nu, na sɛpɔ nnaennaen fili ye noa nu fitele, na ye nyunu te kyɛ eyia bɔ ɔbɔ gyireingyirein ɔ.
17Na mmerɛ bɔ nwuni ye ne, nde ndɔle ye gya bo kyɛ ebie bɔ wawu ɔ, nakoso ɔfale ye sa famaa tole me so sele me kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro! Me ole Ahyɛaseɛ ne Ayieleɛ ne, 18ɔne bɔ ɔte ase ne. Nwuli, na tie, nde ase afebɔɔ, na ndira ewue ne ɛborɔ nzafoaa. 19Yiti kyerɛ bɔ anwu ye, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, ɔne bɔ nziɛ ye ɔbaasi ne. 20Na nzramaa nzoo bɔ enwuni bɛ wɔ me sa famaa nu, ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nzoo ne, bɛ nwo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ɛhe: Nzramaa nzoo ne bɛte asɔre nzoo nemɔ b’abɔfo mɔ, yeɛ kanea bakaa nzoo bɔ enwuni bɛ ne bɛte asɔre nzoo ne.

Title: NYEKYIRE 2
Content:
Ɛfeso asɔre ne ngraa
1“Kyerɛ kɔma Ɛfeso asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ otira nzramaa nzoo wɔ ye sa famaa nu, bɔ ɔnate sikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nemɔ b’afia ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 2Mese wɔ nnwumaa, wɔ fɛɛ ne w’animia, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛngora nzosɔ bɔnefoɛ so, ná mmom aso bɛ bɔ bɛnwa bɛte asomafoɛ nakoso bɛtte asomafoɛ ɔ anea, na anwu bɛ kyɛ bɛte ngondombofoɛ. 3Mese kyɛ anya animia paa, na ɔnate me dumaa ti anwu amaneɛ, nakoso w’abasa nu mmu. 4Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu, ofikyɛ ayakyi ɔdɔ bɔ elili moa nyane ye ne anu. 5Yiti kaye tebea bɔ efili nu fini ase ne, ná sakyera w’adwene, ná yɔ nnwumaa bɔ ɛyɔle ye daa ne! Na sɛ anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔwa wɔ so ndɛndɛ, ná maaye wɔ kanea bakaa ne mafi ye boso, sana ɛsakyera w’adwene. 6Nakoso ayɔ paa he, kyɛ ekyi Nikolatafoɛ nnwumaa bɔ me koso mekyi ne. 7 Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔma ye ngoa bakaa bɔ ogyi Nyameɛ Paradise ne anu mma maa okoli.
Simina asɔre ne ngraa
8“Kyerɛ kɔma Simina asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ ɔte ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ, bɔ owuli ná osa te ase ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 9Mese w’amaneɛnwunɛ ne wɔ hiaa, (nakoso anya wɔ nwo), yeɛ mese bɛ bɔ bɛnwa bɛte Yudafoɛ nakoso bɛtte Yudafoɛ ne, ná mmom bɛte Satan nyianu sua ne, bɛ musue dwirɛ kekanɛ ne. 10Nnɛsuro amaneɛ biala bɔ ɛbaanwu ye ɔ. Tie, abɔnzam kɔfa ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kogua kuku nu, kyɛ ɔfa so ɛmɔ nea, na ɛmɔkonwu amaneɛ eleburu. Di nahorɛ kodwu ewue nu, na ngɔma wɔ ngoa abotire. 11 Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ewue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ngɔwa ye so.’
Pɛgamɔm asɔre ne ngraa
12“Kyerɛ kɔma Pɛgamɔm asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Bɔ otira sɛpɔ nnaennaen ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 13[Mese wɔ nnwumaa], mese nekaa bɔ ɛte ɔ, nekaa bɔ Satan ahennie bia gyi ne; nakoso atira me dumaa ne anu bum, na ambo me gyidie ne, mmerɛ bɔ behuni m’adanzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ Antipa wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne po, nekaa bɔ Satan te ne. 14Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu kãa, ofikyɛ ele mmenia biemɔ wɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ basɔ Balaam ngyerɛkyerɛ nu ɔ, ye bɔ ohyirele Balake kyɛ ɔto Yisraelfoɛ sundidua ma beli bosoen so aleɛ, ná bɛbɔ adwaman ɔ. 15Asa koso, ele ebiemɔ wɔ wɔ nu bɔ basɔ Nikolatafoɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ [bɔ mekyi ne] anu ɔ. 16Yiti sakyera w’adwene! Na sɛ anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔwa wɔ so ndɛndɛ, na ngɔfa me noa nu ngrandɛ ne me ne bɛ yɛkɔho. 17 Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔma ye mvealeɛ nu mana ne bie maa okoli, na ngɔma ye nyɔboɛ fufue, na nyɔboɛ ne aso yeɛ bahyerɛ dumaa foforɛ bɔ ebiala nze bagua ɔ, sana sona bɔ onya ye ne angome.’
Tiatira asɔre ne ngraa
18 “Kyerɛ kɔma Tiatira asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ Awa ne, bɔ ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye, bɔ ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo nyemenenyemene ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 19Mese wɔ nnwumaa, wɔ ɔdɔ, wɔ gyidie, wɔ ɛsolɛ, w’animia, ɔne wɔ kekesaala ye nnwumaa bɔ ɔtra daa deɛ ne ɔ. 20 Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu kãa, ofikyɛ ɛma braa Yesebɛl bɔ ɔfrɛ ye nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ate, kyɛ ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ná ɔlakalaka me ngoaa mɔ ma bɛbɔ adwaman ná beli bosoen so aleɛ. 21Mama ye mmerɛ kyɛ ɔfa sakyera fi ye adwamanbɔlɛ nu, nakoso wanzakyera. 22Na tie, ngɔma anwonyerɛ kɔbɔ ye kɔto bɛen so, na bɛ bɔ bɛne ye sɛkye agyaa ne, ngɔprapra amaneɛ pirikua ngogua bɛ so, sana bɛsakyera b’adwene wɔ bɛ yɔleɛ nwo. 23 Ngohũhũ ye mma mɔ, na asɔre nemɔ amukoraa bekonwu kyɛ me yeɛ mepɛnzɛpɛnzɛ sona ti anu ne ahone nu dwirɛ nu ɔ; na ngɔma ɛmɔ nu biala akatuaa kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ. 24Nakoso ɛmɔ ngaa bɔ baha Tiatira, bɔ ɛmɔnni sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne aso, bɔ ɛmɔanzua bɔ mmenia frɛ ye Satan mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne de, ɛmɔ yeɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mengɔfa adesoa foforɛ mengɔto ɛmɔ so. 25Yiti bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne, ɛ́mɔsɔ nu yé kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ɔ. 26 Na bɔ odi ngonim, ɔne bɔ ɔsɔ me nnwumaa nu kodwu ayieleɛ ne,
ngɔma ye maen maen mɔ so tumi;
27na ɔkɔfa buralɛ pɔmaa yeɛ okoli bɛ so ɔ,
na ɔkɔbobɔ bɛ kyɛ ngukuenwonɛniɛ ngukue;
kyɛbɔ me koso nyane tumi mvili me Baba berɛ ne ala.
28Na ngɔfa Ngyerɛmɔ Nzramaa ne ngɔma ye. 29Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne.

Title: NYEKYIRE 3
Content:
Sadise asɔre ne ngraa
1“Kyerɛ kɔma Sadise asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ ole Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo ne nzramaa nzoo ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: Mese wɔ nnwumaa; ale dumaa kyɛ ɛte ase, nakoso awu. 2Tingye, ná kanyane bɔ waha wɔ wɔ nu bɔ ɔpena wu ne; ofikyɛ mennwu kyɛ wɔ nnwumaa di mu wɔ me Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. 3 Yiti kaye bɔ behyirele wɔ, ɔne bɔ ɛtele ne; sɔ nu yé na sakyera w’adwene. Na sɛ anwɛne a, ngɔwa wɔ so kyɛ awueniɛ, na engonwu dɔnhwere horɛ bɔ ngɔfa ngɔwa wɔ so ɔ. 4Nakoso ele mmenia kãa bie wɔ Sadise bɔ bɛ de begguale b’ataadeɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ; na bɛne me kɔnate bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ fufuɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛfata sɔ. 5Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, bɛkɔfa ataadeɛ fufue sɔ bekowura ye, na mengokyikyi ye dumaa mengofi ngoa nwomaa ne anu; na mmom ngɔbɔ ye dumaa wɔ me Baba ne ye abɔfo mɔ nyunu. 6Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne.
Filadɛɛfia asɔre ne ngraa
7 “Kyerɛ kɔma Filadɛɛfia asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ,
‘Krongronniɛ ne nahorɛniɛ ne,
bɔ otira Dawide safoaa ne,
bɔ obukye a ebiala ndo nu,
bɔ ɔto nu a ebiala mmukye ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:
8Mese wɔ nnwumaa. Na tie, mafa anoa bɔ babukye ɔ masie wɔ nyunu, na ebiala ngɔhora nu to; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ w’anwoserɛ te kãa bie, nakoso ali me dwirɛ so, na ambo me dumaa. 9 Tie, ngɔfa bɛ bɔ befi Satan nyianu sua nu, bɔ bɛnwa bɛte Yudafoɛ, nakoso bɛtte sɔ ne, na mmom bɛpɛ ngondombo ne ngɔma wɔ. Tie, ngɔmaa bɛkɔɔkoto wɔ gya bo, ná banwu kyɛ mekuro wɔ dwirɛ. 10Na ɔnate kyɛ ali m’animia dwirɛ so ne ati, me koso ngɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ngofi nzɔhwɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔbaawa wiase amukoraa so ne anu, nzɔhwɛ bɔ ɔbaaso aseɛ ye aso ama nea ne. 11Méba ndɛndɛ, yiti sɔ bɔ anya ye ne anu yé, ná ebiala anne w’abotire ne. 12 Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔyɛ ye bonima wɔ me Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu; na ongofi nu ngofite ko. Na me Nyameɛ dumaa, ɔne me Nyameɛ kuro dumaa, bɔ ɔte Yerusalem foforɛ ne, bɔ ofi nyameɛso ɔba ase fi me Nyameɛ berɛ, ɔne me dumaa foforɛ ne, ngɔhyerɛ ngogua ye nwo. 13Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne!’
Laodikea asɔre ne ngraa
14“Kyerɛ kɔma Laodikea asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Amen, nahorɛniɛ ne nahorɛ danzeniɛ ne, Nyameɛ abɔdeɛ farebae ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: 15Mese wɔ nnwumaa: wɔ ahɔ a ɛtte frɔlɔɔ, yeɛ ɛnyɛ hye koso. Na ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa ɛte frɔlɔɔ anaa ɛyɛ hye. 16Na ɔnate kyɛ ayɛ nnedɛɛnnedɛɛ, ná anyɛ frɔlɔɔ anaa anyɛ hye ne ati, ngɔfe wɔ ngofi me noa nu. 17Ofikyɛ ɛnwa, ‘Manya me nwo, nne agyapadeɛ, na menhia nikyee fee.’ Nakoso ɛnze kyɛ ɛyɛ anwumvo, wɔ nwo yɛ aworabɔ, wahia wɔ, wɔ nye asi, ná wɔ nwo la so ɔ. 18Yiti metu wɔ foɛ kyɛ, tɔ nningyein hemɔ fi me berɛ: sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa see bate ye nwo ɔ, amaa ɔnate so anya sikaa; ataadeɛ fufue bɔ ekowura bɔ ɔngɔma w’animguaseɛ adagya ne nwo ngɔla berɛ ɔ, yeɛ anyeɛ ayire bɔ ɛkɔfa kogua wɔ nye so, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ekonwu nikye ɔ. 19Bɛ bɔ mekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne, metwi bɛ nyunu, yeɛ metwe bɛ so; yiti ma wɔ nye boro ná sakyera w’adwene. 20Tie! Ngyi anoa ne asi mebɔ nu; na sɛ ebie te me komvi ná okobukye anoa ne a, ngowura nu ngɔwa ye berɛ, ná me ne ye yaadidi, ná ɔne me koso adidi. 21Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔmaa ɔne me kɔtena m’ahennie bia so, kyɛbɔ me koso mali ngonim ná me ne me Baba yatena ye ahennie bia so ne.
22Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne.

Title: NYEKYIRE 4
Content:
Nyameɛso asɔreyɛlɛ
(Yesaya 6.1-3)
1Na ɛhe asi ne, ndole me nye, na nwuni kyɛ babukye anoa bie wɔ nyameɛso. Na komviɛ bɔ nnili moa ndele bɔ ɔte kyɛ totorobɛndo bɔ odwudwu hyirele me, osele me kyɛ, “Fo bra anwuro wa, na ngohyire wɔ nningyein bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛhemɔ asi ne besisi ɔ.” 2 Na berɛ ne ala, né nwɔ Sunzum nu. Na yieee, né ahennie bia bie gyi nyameɛso, bɔ ebie te ahennie bia ne aso ɔ. 3Na bɔ ɔte so ne, ɛnea a, ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ oli yasepa ne kokwaboba, yeɛ nyangondoen bɔ ɛnea, ɔte kyɛ dɛngyɛmmoɛ ɔ wapɛ ahennie bia ne anwo wayia. 4Né ahennie bia aburanyɔ ne nna bapɛ ahennie bia ne anwo bayia, na nwuni mbanyi aburanyɔ ne nna bɔ bewurawura ndaadeɛ fufue, bɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ abotire bobɔ bɛ ɔ kyɛ bɛtete ahennie bia nemɔ so. 5 Na agralaa ne komviɛ ahoroɔ ne nu bobɔlɛ kurudududu fili ahennie bia ne anu wale. Na see nganea nzoo bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo ne, né begye wɔ ahennie bia ne anyunu berɛ. 6 Né nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ neanu po, bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu ɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia ne anyunu berɛ. Yeɛ né abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna bɔ anyeɛ tuatua bɛ nyunu ne bɛ si ɔ bɛwɔ ahennie bia ne anwo wɔ ye afia berɛ. 7 Abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ oli moa ne te kyɛ gyata, bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne te kyɛ nandwie ba, bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne nyunu soma kuro sona, yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne te kyɛ kɔleɛ bɔ otu ɔ. 8 Na abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna ne, nu biala le ndaa nzia, na anyeɛ tuatua bɛ nwo ne bɛ nu amukoraa, na alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ biala bɛto dwein bɔ bɛnyakyi ɔ, kyɛ,
“Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ,
ɔte krongron, krongron, krongron
ye yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ fi tetetete, ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, ná ɔbaawa ne!
9 Na sɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ bɛfa animnyam, anidie ne asennaa bɛma bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso, bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne a, 10mbanyi aburanyɔ ne nna nemɔ bɛfa bɛ nyunu bebutubutu bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne nyunu berɛ, na bɛsɔne bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne; na betutu b’abotire nemɔ begua ahennie bia ne nyunu bɛkã kyɛ,
11“Y’Awurade ne yɛ Nyameɛ,
ɛfata kyɛ ede animnyam, anidie ne tumi,
ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle nningyein amukoraati,
wɔ pɛ ti yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ,
na wɔ pɛ ti yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ ɔ.”

Title: NYEKYIRE 5
Content:
Nwomaa ne ne Boaen Ba ne
1 Na bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne, ye sa famaa nu, nwuni nwomaa bie bɔ babobɔ ɔ, bɔ bahyerɛ ye nyunu ne ye si, bɔ bafa nzɔanoɛ nzoo basɔ ye noa ɔ. 2Na nwuni abɔfo anwoserɛniɛ bie bɔ ɔteane nu bisale kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔfata kyɛ obukye nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu ná ɔtete ye nzɔanoɛ nemɔ ɔ?” 3Na ebiala nne nyameɛso, anaa aseɛ so, anaa aseɛ bo bɔ ɔhora bukyele nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu anaa ɔneane nu ɔ. 4Na nzuni pee, ofikyɛ bannya ebiala bɔ ɔfata kyɛ obukye nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu anaakyɛ ɔnea nu ɔ. 5 Yeɛ mbanyi nemɔ nu ko sele me kyɛ, “Nea, nnɛsũ, na Yuda abusua kure nu Gyata ne, Dawide Ndii ne, wali ngonim bɔ okobukye nwomaa ne anu, ná ɔkɔtete ye nzɔanoɛ nzoo nemɔ anu ɔ.”
6Na nneane, na yieee, ahennie bia ne ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna ne ne mbanyi nemɔ b’afia berɛ, né Boaen Ba bie gyi berɛ bɔ osoma kyɛ bahũ ye ɔ. Ole mmɛen nzoo ne anyeɛ nzoo, bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo bɔ wasoma bɛ wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ. 7Oolele nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne fili bɔ ɔte ahennie bia so ne sa famaa nu. 8Na mmerɛ bɔ olele nwomaa bɔ babobɔ nen, abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nna ne ne mbanyi aburanyɔ ne nna ne bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase wɔ Boaen Ba ne nyunu; bɔ bɛ mukoraa betiratira sangoo ne sikaa kɔkorɛ kulie mɔ bɔ ɛyɛɛ, bɔ ɔte anwoteefoɛ mbaeɛ ɔ wayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ. 9Na bɛtole dwein foforɛ bie kyɛ,
“Ɛfata kyɛ ede nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne
ná ebukye ye nzɔanoɛ nemɔ ɔ;
ofikyɛ behuni wɔ,
na afa wɔ mogya atɔ adasa mmaa ama Nyameɛ
afi mmusua kure ne edwudwolɛ ne
mmenia ne maen biala nu,
10na ayɛ bɛ ahennie maen ne
asɔfo ama yɛ Nyameɛ,
na bekoli aseɛ so hene.”
11Afei ndole me nye, na ndele abɔfo pembepembe bɔ bapɛ ahennie bia ne ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ ne mbanyi nemɔ nwo bayia ɔ bɛ komvi; na né bɛ somaa te apee buru apee buru ahoroɔ ne apee apee. 12Na bɛteane nu bɛhane kyɛ,
“Boaen Ba bɔ behuni ye ne, ɔfata kyɛ
ode tumi, anwonya, nworɛ, anwoserɛ, anidie, animnyam ne saleɛ!”
13Na abɔdeɛ biala bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so ne aseɛ bo ne ɛpo nu ne bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ nu amukoraa, ndele kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ,
“Saleɛ ne anidie ne animnyam ne tumi
ɔyɛ bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne
ɔne Boaen Ba ne deɛ afebɔɔ.”
14Na abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ sele kyɛ, “Amen.” Yeɛ mbanyi nemɔ bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli berɛ bɛsɔnene [bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne].

Title: NYEKYIRE 6
Content:
Nzɔanoɛ nzoo nemɔ
1Na nwuni kyɛ Boaen Ba ne wate nzɔanoɛ nemɔ anu ko noa, yeɛ ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ anu ko ole komviɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ esue bɔ ɔbɔ nu kurudududu ɔ ɔkã, “Baanea!” 2 Nneane, na nwuni pɔngɔ fufue bie. Na bɔ ɔte ye so ne, né otira agyaen; na bɛmane ye abotire, na ofili berɛ hɔle oolili ngonim, na ɔhɔle so lili ngonim.
3Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!” 4 Na pɔngɔ foforɛ kɔkorɛ gonn bie yele ye ti, na bɛmane bɔ ɔte ye so ne tumi kyɛ ɔye asomdwee fi aseɛ so, ná behũhũ bɛ nwo bɛ nwo, na bɛmane ye ngrandɛ pirikua bie.
5 Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!” Nneane, yieee, pɔngɔ bire bie, na né bɔ ɔte ye so ne otira tonyi. 6Na ndele komviɛ bie mvili abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nna nemɔ b’afia berɛ kyɛ, “Aburoo kongo ko te denare ko, yeɛ atokoɔ kongo nza te denare ko; nakoso ngoo ne nzaa de, nnɛsɛkye bɛ.”
7Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!” 8 Nneane, na nwuni pɔngɔ hoyaa bie; na bɔ ɔte ye so ne dumaa li Ewue, na Ɛborɔ li ye si. Na bɛmane bɛ tumi wɔ aseɛ ngyɛmuɛ nna nu ko so, kyɛ bɛfa ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen, anwonyerɛ ne aseɛ so ngaka aboyaa behũhũ bɛ.
9Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne noa ne, bɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne b’adanzeɛ bɔ belili ti behuni bɛ ne, nwuni bɛ kra mɔ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo. 10 Na bɛteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “O, Awurade Tuminiɛ, Krongronniɛ ne Nahorɛniɛ, engobua ndɛen, yeɛ ɛngɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so wereɛ wɔ yɛ mogya nwo maa okoodwu kyinzu?” 11Yeɛ bɛmane bɛ nu ko biala ataadeɛ fufue, na besele bɛ kyɛ bɛnwondɛ mmerɛ kãa bie bieku, ma oodwu kyɛ bɛ mmango asomvoɛ ne b’eliɛma mɔ bɔ bekohũhũ bɛ kyɛ bɛ koso ala ne bɛ somaa ɔkɔsõ ɔ.
12 Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne noa ne, nneane, na yieee, aseɛ wosole serɛserɛ; na eyia yɛle tunn kyɛ brisie, na ɛsraen yɛle kyɛ mogya; 13 na ewienu nzramaa tutu guale ase te kyɛ borɔdoma bɔ mvrama piri woso ye ɔporo ye mma amui gua ɔ. 14 Na ewienu tu minini te kyɛ nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ɔ, na mmokaa ne supɔ mukoraa tutu fili bɛ boso. 15 Na aseɛ so ahemvo, atitirefoɛ, esikafoɛ, safohene mɔ, anwoserɛfoɛ, yeɛ ngoaa ne nnehyeɛ amukoraa bɛfeafeale ngumaa mɔ nu ne mmokaa so nyɔbotaen mɔ nu. 16 Na besele mmokaa ne nyɔbotaen nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwiri begua yɛ so, ná ɛ́mɔfa yɛ bɛfea béfi bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne nyunu, ɔne Boaen Ba n’ahonehulɛ nu; 17 ofikyɛ ye ahonehulɛ kyẽa piri ne adwu, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye noa ɔ?”

Title: NYEKYIRE 7
Content:
Nyameɛ ngoaa mɔ nzorɛhyɛlɛ
1 Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, nwuni abɔfo nna kyɛ begyigyi aseɛ ndweasoɛ nna ne aso, bɔ né basi aseɛ so mvrama nna nemɔ ate, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ mvrama biala ngotu ngɔfa aseɛ anaa ɛpo anaa bakaa biala so ɔ. 2Na nwuni abɔfo foforɛ bɔ otira Nyameɛ teasefoɛ nzɔanoɛ ne kyɛ ofi eyia afiteleɛ ɔfo ba ɔ, na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ sele abɔfo nna bɔ bama bɛ tumi kyɛ bɛha aseɛ ne ɛpo ne 3 kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔha aseɛ anaa ɛpo anaa mmakaa, kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔfa nzɔanoɛ yɛkɔteta yɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa mɔ bɛ nwoma so ɔ.”
4Na bɛ bɔ bafa nzɔanoɛ bahyɛ bɛ nzorɛ ne, ndele bɛ somaa: Apee sɔ alaa ɛyaa ko aburanna ne nna yeɛ bɛfale nzɔanoɛ bɛhyɛle bɛ nzorɛ befili Yisrael mma mmusua kure amukoraa nu ɔ. 5Yuda abusua kure nu mmenia bɔ bɛfale nzɔanoɛ bɛhyɛle bɛ nzorɛ ne, bɛte apee buru ne nyɔ; Ruben abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Gade abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; 6Asɛ abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Nafetali abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Manase abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; 7Simeon abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Lewi abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Yisaka abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; 8Sebulɔn abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; Yosef abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ; yeɛ Benyamin abusua kure nu, apee buru ne nyɔ.
Anwoteefoɛ pembepembe ne
9 Na ɛhe asi ne, nneane, na nwuni ɛlɔen kandinga bɔ sona biala ngɔhora bɛ ka ɔ, bɔ befi maen maen, mmusua kure, mmenia ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa nu, kyɛ begyigyi ahennie bia ne nyunu ne Boaen Ba ne nyunu, bɔ bewurawura ndaadeɛ fufue, ná betiratira ɛberɛ ɔ. 10Na bɛteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ,
“Ngoalelɛ te yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne ɔne Boaen Ba ne deɛ!”
11Né abɔfo nemɔ amukoraa bapɛ ahennie bia ne ne mbanyi nemɔ ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ nwo bayia, na bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase wɔ ahennie bia ne nyunu, na bɛsɔnene Nyameɛ 12bɛhane kyɛ,
“Amen! Saleɛ ne animnyam ne nworɛ ne asennaa ne anidie ne tumi ne anwoserɛ te yɛ Nyameɛ deɛ afebɔɔ! Amen.”
13Na afei mbanyi nemɔ nu ko bisale me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ fufue ye, nwa mɔ ɛne, na nisua yeɛ befi bɛwale ɔ?” 14 Na mmuale ye kyɛ, “Me mene, wɔ yeɛ ɛse ɔ.” Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole bɛ bɔ bafa amaneɛ piri ne anu bafite, ná bapo bɛ ndaadeɛ maa wayɛ fufue wɔ Boaen Ba ne mogya nu ɔ.
15Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ bɛwɔ Nyameɛ ahennie bia ne nyunu,
ná bɛsɔne ye alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔ;
na bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa ye tena sua ne kɔkata bɛ so.
16 Ɛhɔen ngohũ bɛ ko, yeɛ nzuhɔen ngohũ bɛ ko,
eyia ngɔyera bɛ,
yeɛ ahuhuro biala ngohũ bɛ.
17 Ofikyɛ Boaen Ba bɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia n’afia berɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ Neafoɛ,
ɔkɔyɛ bɛ taataa kɔhɔ ngoa asue mɔ ti,
na Nyameɛ kokyikyi bɛ nye abo moen amukoraa.”

Title: NYEKYIRE 8
Content:
Nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo
1Na Boaen Ba ne tele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne noa nen, nyameɛso yɛle dinn kɔyɛ dɔnhwere bue. 2Na nwuni abɔfo nzoo bɔ begyigyi Nyameɛ nyunu ne, na bɛmane bɛ totorobɛndo nzoo.
3 Na abɔfo foforɛ bɔ otira sikaa kɔkorɛ ɛyɛɛ kulie ɔ oogyinane afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo; na bɛmane ye ɛyɛɛ pee kyɛ ɔfa boka anwoteefoɛ amukoraa mbaeɛ so ɔbɔ afɔleɛ, wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia ne nyunu ne aso. 4Na ɛyɛɛ nwosina ne, ɔbokale anwoteefoɛ mbaeɛ ne aso fili abɔfo ne sa nu fo hɔle Nyameɛ nyunu. 5 Afei abɔfo ne fale ɛyɛɛ kulie ne, ɔfale afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso see ne bie guale nu maa oyili, na ogyi tole aseɛ so. Na komviɛ ahoroɔ wale, ɔbobɔle nu kurudududu, agralaa tetele, na aseɛ wosole.
Totorobɛndo nzoo nemɔ
6Afei abɔfo nzoo bɔ betiratira totorobɛndo nzoo ne, bɛboaboale bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛbaahu. 7 Abɔfo bɔ oli moa ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na asukɔtwea ne see bɔ bɛne mogya bali afra ɔ bɛwale, na bɛto beguale aseɛ so. Na aseɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yerale, mmakaa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yerale, yeɛ ndire monɛ amukoraa koso yerale.
8 Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne. Na begyili nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ bokaa piri bɔ see asɔ nu ogye buruburu ɔ bɛtole ɛpo nu, na ɛpo ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko kakyili mogya; 9na ɛpo nu abɔdeɛ bɔ bele ngoa ɔ, ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko wuwuli, yeɛ ɛlɛen mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko sɛkyesɛkyele.
10 Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na nzramaa pirikua bie bɔ ogye kyɛ tɛen ɔ otu fili nyameɛso, na oofini asue mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko nu, ɔne mbombonzue mɔ nu. 11Nzramaa ne dumaa li Weewee. Na nzue mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yɛle weewee, na nzue ne mane mmenia pee wuwuli, ofikyɛ ɔte weewee.
12 Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na ɛhe wosole eyia ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, ɛsraen ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, yeɛ nzramaa mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, yiti bɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko kakyili awosii; na alehyeleɛ nu ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko annya kanea, na alesaleɛ nu koso sɔ ala yeɛ osili ɔ.
13Na nneane, na ndele kyɛ kɔleɛ bie otu faa wɔ nyameɛso afia dɔ, ná ɔtea nu kã kyɛ, “Totorobɛndo ngaa bɔ abɔfo nza nemɔ bɛbaahu ne, bɛ komvi ne ati, bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ, bɛ yaakɔ oo, bɛ yaakɔ oo, bɔ yaakɔ oo!”

Title: NYEKYIRE 9
Content:
1Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na nwuni kyɛ nzramaa bie watu wafi nyameɛso waatɔ aseɛ so, na bɛfale aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne noa safoaa bɛmane ye. 2 Obukyele aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne noa, na nwosina bɔ ɔte kyɛ foonoo piri nu nwosina fili kumaa ne anu wale, na ɔnate nwosina ne ati, eyia ne ewienu yɛle kabii. 3 Na mmɛbɛ mbiri fili nwosina ne anu wale aseɛ so, na bɛmane bɛ tumi bɔ ɔte kyɛ aseɛ so anyanyangyeleɛ mɔ tumi ɔ. 4 Na bɛhã behyirele bɛ kyɛ, nnɛmaa bɛkeka aseɛ so ndire, anaa nyaa monɛ biala, anaa bakaa biala; sana mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ nzɔanoɛ ne ɔnne bɛ nwoma so nemɔ ngome. 5Bamma bɛ ate kyɛ behũhũ bɛ, na mmom kyɛ bɛkeka bɛ tonn bosome nnu. Na bɛ kekalɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ anyanyangyeleɛ bɔ ɔka sona ɔ ye deɛ. 6 Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, mmenia kɔpena ewue si atee, nakoso bengonwu ye; bekohuro kyɛ bekowu ɔ, nakoso ewue kɔnwati bɛ.
7Na mmɛbɛ mbiri nemɔ, bɛ sue te kyɛ mbɔngɔ bɔ basiesie bɛ bama koɛ ɔ; nikyee bie wɔ bɛ ti so bɔ ɔte kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ abotire ɔ, na bɛ nyunu soma sona nyunu; 8bele nwiaa te kyɛ brasua nwiaa, yeɛ bɛ gye te kyɛ gyata gye. 9Bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ne, ɔte kyɛ buralɛ bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ɔ; na dede bɔ bɛ ndaa nemɔ bɛyɔ ne, ɔte kyɛ mbɔngɔ pee bɔ teaseɛnam mɔ sosɔ bɛ, bɔ betu amirika bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ bɛ deɛ. 10Bele dua te kyɛ anyanyangyeleɛ, bɛka, na bɛ tumi bɔ bɛfa bɛha mmenia tonn bosome nnu ne, bɛ dua nu yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ. 11Bele bɔ odi bɛ so hene, bɔ ye ole aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn nu abɔfo ne, bɔ ye dumaa li Abadɔn wɔ Hebri dwudwolɛ nu, yeɛ Hela dwudwolɛ nu koso oli Apolɔn.
12Musue ko apɛ nu. Na tie, waha musue nyɔ bɔ bɛbaawa ɔ.
13 Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ogyi Nyameɛ nyunu ne, ndele kyɛ komviɛ bie afi ye mmɛen nna nemɔ anu, 14ná ɔkã kyire abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia bɔ otira totorobɛndo ne kyɛ, “Sangye abɔfo nna bɔ bakyekye bɛ wɔ asue piri Yufreti noa ne.” 15Yiti bɛsangyele abɔfo nna bɔ basiesie bɛ bama sɔ dɔnhwere ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, sɔ bosome ne, ɔne sɔ afoɛ ne, kyɛ behũhũ adasa mmaa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko. 16Na ndele kyɛ ɛlɔen bɔ bɛtete mbɔngɔ so ne bɛ somaa te apepesrala sɔ alaa ɛyaa nyɔ.
17Na mbɔngɔ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛtete bɛ so ne, kyɛbɔ nzi nwuni bɛ wɔ me nyekyire ne anu ne, ye ɛhe: Bele see ne afasebire ne sɔfe buralɛ bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ɔ, na mbɔngɔ nemɔ bɛ ti te kyɛ gyata ti, na see ne nwosina ne sɔfe fili bɛ noa nu wale. 18Na sɔ hawo nza hemɔ, bɔ bɛ ole see, nwosina ne sɔfe bɔ ofi bɛ noa nu ba ne, bɛfale so behuhuni adasa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko. 19Na mbɔngɔ nemɔ bɛ tumi wɔ bɛ noa ne bɛ dua nu, ofikyɛ bɛ dua te kyɛ ewoo, bɔ tire tua so bɔ bɛfa bepura ɔ.
20Nakoso adasa mmaa ngaa bɔ ɛhawo hemɔ wangukũ bɛ ne, banzakyera b’adwene bamvi bɛ sa noa nnwumaa nwo, banyakyi sunzummɔne mɔ sɔnenɛ, yeɛ banyakyi sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere, nyɔboɛ ne bakaa amoen mɔ bɔ bɛngora bennwu nikye, anaa bɛnde dwirɛ, anaa bɛnnate ɔ sɔnenɛ; 21yeɛ banzakyera b’adwene bamvi b’awuelilɛ ne bɛ ngonyaayelɛ ne b’adwamanbɔlɛ ne b’awue nwo.

Title: NYEKYIRE 10
Content:
Abɔfo ne ne nwomaa kaaba ne
1Afei nwuni abɔfo foforɛ anwoserɛniɛ bie kyɛ ofi nyameɛso odwu ba ase; né wafa munungum wahera, nyangondoen wɔ ye ti so, ye nyunu te kyɛ eyia, na ye gya te kyɛ see bonima. 2Né otira nwomaa kaaba bie bɔ babukye nu ɔ wɔ ye sa nu. Na otuli ye gya famaa siele ɛpo so, yeɛ otuli ye gya bɛen siele aseɛ so. 3Na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔbobɔ nu ɔ. Na ɔteane nu nen, agralaa nzoo ne bobɔle nu kurudududu. 4Na agralaa nzoo ne bobɔle nu kurudududu nen, nyɛle kyɛ mekyerɛ, nakoso ndele kyɛ komviɛ bie fi nyameɛso ɔkã kyire me kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ agralaa kurudududu nzoo nemɔ bahã ne, sɔ ye noa, na nnɛkyerɛ.” 5 Na abɔfo bɔ nwuni ye kyɛ ogyi ɛpo ne aseɛ so ne, ɔmane ye sa [famaa] so hyirele nyameɛso, 6na ɔfale bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu, aseɛ ne ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu, yeɛ ɛpo ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne tale ndaen kyɛ, “Mmerɛ biala nne berɛ ko, 7na mmom mmerɛ bɔ abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne kohu ye totorobɛndo ne, yeɛ Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhane ye nwo dwirɛ hyirele ye ngoaa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne.”
8Na komviɛ bɔ nde mvili nyameɛso ne odwudwo hyirele me bieku kyɛ, “Nwomaa kaaba bɔ babukye nu, bɔ ɔwɔ abɔfo bɔ ogyi ɛpo ne aseɛ so ye sa nu ne, kole.” 9Yiti ngɔle abɔfo ne nwo berɛ, na nzele ye kyɛ, “Fa nwomaa kaaba ne ma me.” Na osele me kyɛ, “De ná di; na ɔkɔyɛ weewee wɔ wɔ kunu, nakoso ɔkɔyɛ menemene kyɛ woɛ wɔ wɔ noa nu.” 10Na nnele nwomaa kaaba ne mvili abɔfo ne sa nu nnili; na ɔyɛle me noa nu menemene kyɛ woɛ, nakoso nni nyiele nen, ɔyɛle me kunu dɔ weewee. 11 Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛhyɛ ngɔm fa mmenia, maen maen, edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ne ahemvo pee nwo bieku.”

Title: NYEKYIRE 11
Content:
Adanzefoɛ nyɔ ne
1Afei bɛmane me elemmire bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ pɔmaa, na besele me kyɛ, “Dwɔso ná susu Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne wɔ nu ne. 2Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anwo aluo dɔ de, yakyi to berɛ, nnɛsusu; ofikyɛ bafa berɛ bama Amaenmaensofoɛ, na bekohwi bɛkɔfa kuro krongron ne aso bosome aburanna ne nyɔ. 3Na ngɔma m’adanzefoɛ nyɔ bɛkɔhera ɛsɛen tena bɛkɔhyɛ ngɔm ngyẽa apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburasia.”
